The "Nourishing Body Skill" has average attacking capability but focuses on health, after achieving, can cleanse the meridians, prolong life, and enhance self-healing ability.
"This cultivation technique is quite interesting!" Xu Ping was intrigued, and continued to read.
The "Nourishing Body Skill" has three layers corresponding to early, mid, and late-stage qi cultivation.
Achieving the first layer can extend life by five years, the second layer by ten years, and the third layer by twenty years.
However, progressing in this cultivation technique is extremely difficult, requiring a large amount of spirit medicine concocted into medicinal liquid to assist the practice.
Xu Ping flipped through the required spirit medicines, pondering something.
Quickly checked the pile of herbs.
"Hahaha, the spirit medicines are all complete!" Xu Ping was overjoyed.
The spirit medicines recorded for the first layer of cultivation were all present.
Unknown to Xu Ping, Elder Yan put great effort into gathering these spirit medicines, now benefiting him.
"Not bad, not bad, this ’Nourishing Body Skill’ can be practiced in the future."
Elder Yan had assembled everything, not practicing it would seem disrespectful to Elder Yan.
Xu Ping happily stored everything.
Counting carefully.
These two waves... have made him rich!
Merely counting Spirit Stones, he had around fifty, plus other items easily broke one hundred.
"I can be considered a wealthy person now."
"With so much money, how should I spend it!"
Xu Ping excitedly began to plan this wealth.
"First, I’ll buy some pills to increase cultivation, as cultivation is the foundation of everything."
"I have an attack-type magical artifact, now I should consider getting ones for escape and defense."
"Finally... moving house!"
"The current Spirit Stones should suffice, after harvesting the Spirit Rice, I can move to the market district."
"That way, I don’t have to worry about being targeted for murder on the road."

chapters.title: Chapter 11: Marketplace
chapters.content:
Chapter 11: Chapter 11: Marketplace
Early next morning.
"Fellow Daoist Xu! Fellow Daoist Xu! Are you up?" Old Man Lu’s voice called from outside the courtyard.
Nowadays, Old Man Lu was even more enthusiastic than Xu Ping, coming to wake him up every morning.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, let’s go. I’ve already prepared breakfast." Seeing Xu Ping just opening the courtyard door, Old Man Lu grabbed him, ready to head out.
"I’m not going today."
Xu Ping shook his head and broke free from Old Man Lu, answering, "Postpone those two families for me until tomorrow."
"What’s wrong?" Old Man Lu was taken aback.
"I need to go to the market today to buy some things. Anyway, there’s still time before the fruiting period, so there’s no rush for today."
"Alright then," Old Man Lu responded reluctantly.
After all, Xu Ping was the one watering the spiritual fields. If he didn’t go, there was nothing Old Man Lu could do about it himself.
"Just try to come back early. Maybe you can still water a few acres this afternoon," Old Man Lu advised.
Xu Ping...
Do you think I’m a beast of burden or something?
Can’t you just let me take a break?
After sending Old Man Lu away, Xu Ping closed the courtyard door and headed towards the market.
...
...
The first light of dawn brought with it a hint of gloom.
The whole Dongwu Market was shrouded in a thin layer of mist, with sunlight filtering weakly through. The phoenix trees lined both sides of the valley, their trunks tall and stout, but their branches and leaves appeared sparse, as if they had weathered many hardships.
Dongwu Market got its name from the abundance of phoenix trees growing in the valley where it was located.
The cool morning air carried a lingering faint odor of staleness.
Mixed with the earthy smell, it truly was quite unpleasant.
The house Xu Ping rented wasn’t far from the market, yet he had to walk for almost half an hour before he saw the market walls.
The walls weren’t very high, about three to four meters, intricately carved with array patterns, faintly emanating fluctuations of spiritual power.
They clearly weren’t ordinary walls.
At the market gate, as time passed, the crowd had started to grow denser, and Xu Ping followed the flow towards the market’s entrance.
Suddenly, there was a slight commotion in the crowd.
Hearing the noise, Xu Ping looked up where several others were gazing and saw a young cultivator riding a dazzling flying sword, whooshing down.
Many looked on fervently as the person stopped at the market entrance.
"Is that the legendary sword cultivator?" a newcomer who had just entered the cultivation realm exclaimed.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
"Sword cultivator? Hahahaha!" A veteran of the cultivation realm nearby laughed heartily at the newcomer’s naivety. "That’s no sword cultivator; talk to me when he’s understood the four realms of Sword Dao."
Xu Ping’s gaze was complicated: "I definitely have to get a flying sword someday!"
Honestly, it’s not really about looking cool; mainly, in case of danger, one can escape quickly.
He squeezed into the market with the flow.
The largest buildings immediately came into view.
’Drunken Immortal Tower’, ’Hundred Refining Workshop’, ’Pill Cauldron Pavilion’, ’Talisman Hall’, ...
These were the most important trading spots within the inner city, where daily transactions involved hundreds, even thousands of spirit stones.
On the main road, cultivators were constantly coming and going.
Those carrying swords, with big wine-red gourds on their backs, accompanied by spiritual birds, riding demon beasts...
Most of them emitted a strong evil qi, clearly not to be trifled with at a glance.
"A mix of fish and dragons!" Xu Ping sighed inwardly.
’Dongwu Market didn’t have such fierce people before, seems like it’s the beast tide and the ’Demon Hunt Order’ attracting them.’ Xu Ping thought to himself.
The beast tide was both a danger and an opportunity.
Some of these fierce people were obviously not going to let this opportunity pass by.
As he walked along, Xu Ping’s eyes were drawn to the roadside stalls.
Various demon beast meats were also displayed at the roadside stalls.
He even saw a demon beast carcass, about four meters long from head to tail, skinned but unrecognizable, being quickly dissected by the stall owner wielding a blade, shouting to sell.
Xu Ping didn’t linger any longer, heading straight to an office point set up by the Longevity Sect.
Half an hour later.
He walked out cursing under his breath.
Damn it, the houses in the market are all rented out!
Due to the ’Demon Hunt Order’, Dongwu Market’s population had already surged, coupled with a batch of Longevity Sect disciples also coming to Dongwu Market to hunt demons for training, there were no houses left in the market center.
"Sigh, looks like I’ll have to stay in the slums for a while longer." Xu Ping sighed helplessly.
There are just too many of life’s uncontrollable factors.
After composing himself, he headed to his second destination: Hundred Refining Workshop.
...
"A second-hand Cyan Peak Sword, lower grade magical artifact, it’s not worth much." The shopkeeper of Hundred Refining Workshop glanced up at Xu Ping before continuing to appraise the Cyan Peak Sword.
"Its function is simple, can be used to attack enemies, and its power is average among lower grade artifacts, nothing special about it. It could be worth twelve lower grade spirit stones; if you want to sell, I won’t charge an appraisal fee this time."
"That’s too low. Any random lower grade artifact in your shop at least costs over twenty spirit stones. Add at least four more lower grade spirit stones at the very least," Xu Ping frowned. The price wasn’t meeting his expectations at all.
The shopkeeper unhurriedly sipped tea, speaking slowly, "But you’ve used it for quite a while, and the buyback price for second-hand items is always low, it’s the same everywhere."
Xu Ping haggled for a while, ultimately settling for fourteen lower grade spirit stones.
He knew he was at a loss; selling Elder Yan’s Cyan Peak Sword at a stall would definitely fetch more, but it was also more dangerous, which wasn’t necessary.
"Do you have flying swords for sale? How much spirit stones for one?" Xu Ping asked after putting away the spirit stones.
"Of course we have them. This Changhong Sword, for instance, can be yours for ninety-eight spirit stones." Seeing Xu Ping’s interest in a flying sword, the shopkeeper was a bit more enthusiastic.
"Uh... Do you have defensive magical artifacts?"
Xu Ping thought that flying swords weren’t that cool, actually. Standing on a flying sword was tiring! Better to buy a defensive magical artifact for better self-protection.
"We do have those as well..." The shopkeeper began introducing defensive magical artifacts to Xu Ping.
Eventually, he spent twenty-eight to buy a lower grade defensive magical artifact named Turtle Spirit Armor.
As for conveyance artifacts for fleeing, after the shopkeeper’s introduction, Xu Ping decided not to buy.
Lower grade conveyance artifacts weren’t fast enough and had poor defense. If you tried to flee, you might not get far before being shot down from the sky.
There were of course faster and better-defended ones, but Xu Ping simply couldn’t afford them.
...
...
After leaving Hundred Refining Workshop, Xu Ping headed straight to the Pill Cauldron Pavilion.
Soon, he stopped in front of a store.
On the golden plaque, the words ’Pill Cauldron Pavilion’ were written in bold, flowing script.
When buying valuable items like pills, Xu Ping was very cautious.
Pills on loose cultivator stalls might be cheaper, but weren’t guaranteed to be completely harmless, and showing wealth might get you targeted.
On the other hand, the pill shops of major factions were much better.
Pill Cauldron Pavilion had a reputation and credibility built over hundreds of years. Its backing might not compare to that of the Longevity Sect, but it was stronger than ordinary Foundation Establishment forces.

chapters.title: Chapter 12: Pill
chapters.content:
Chapter 12: Chapter 12: Pill
As soon as he stepped through the gate, a faint aroma of herbs wafted over.
At this moment, a kind middle-aged man greeted Xu Ping.
The man introduced himself as Shopkeeper Wang, with the appearance and attire of a landlord.
As for his cultivation, Xu Ping couldn’t tell at all.
"Fellow Daoist, are you looking to buy some pills?" Shopkeeper Wang looked at Xu Ping with a smile.
"Do you have any pills to enhance cultivation?" Xu Ping asked.
"Of course, we have First Rank Lower Grade Qi Nourishing Pills, useful for early and mid-stage Qi Cultivation practitioners, and they slightly stimulate breakthrough to the next bottleneck," Shopkeeper Wang replied with a broad smile.
Xu Ping’s heart stirred, and he asked, "How many Spirit Stones for one pill?"
"A bottle costs twenty Spirit Stones and contains fifteen pills," Shopkeeper Wang answered, squinting slightly with a smile.
"So expensive!"
Xu Ping clicked his tongue, a multitude of thoughts swirling in his mind, yet he remained expressionless as he handed over twenty Spirit Stones to receive a small jade bottle.
"Any other needs, Fellow Daoist?" Shopkeeper Wang inquired happily after closing a sale.
"No more," Xu Ping’s face was still calm, but inside, he felt heart-wrenching pain!
He had originally thought he was well-off, but reality hit him hard.
The cost of the Magical Artifacts and pills had spent nearly fifty Spirit Stones of his, leaving him with just a dozen or so now.
Alas, poor again!
...
...
After leaving Dan Ding Pavilion, Xu Ping then bought several dozen catties of Demon Beast Flesh.
Demon Beast Flesh was cheap; just one Spirit Stone could buy as much as thirty catties.
Once he finished shopping, Xu Ping didn’t linger at the market; he headed straight home.
In the bedroom, Xu Ping sat cross-legged, gazing at the jade bottle in his hand.
"With such a high price, hopefully, it will be useful."
Xu Ping calmed himself, pouring out a ’Qi Nourishing Pill’ from the jade bottle.
This pill was a bright green color, yet it had a spicy aroma.
After some thought, he swallowed it directly, closing his eyes to refine it.
Upon entering meditation, Xu Ping immediately felt different from usual, as if a warm current was continuously emerging from his abdomen, turning into strands of unending Spiritual Power...
He couldn’t help but start to utilize the third layer of Five Elements Skill, repeating it over and over.
When Xu Ping came to his senses, he had unknowingly practiced the technique for a whole hour.
He opened his eyes and immediately checked the proficiency panel.
To his surprise, he found that his level had gone from ’Qi Cultivation Level 3: 72/100’ to ’Qi Cultivation Level 3: 73/100’.
It jumped up by a point at once.
Moreover, the proficiency of Five Elements Skill increased from "177/200" to "185/200".
An increase of eight points.
"The Qi Nourishing Pill is so effective that one pill can increase a whole point?" Xu Ping’s face lit up with delight, "Wouldn’t that mean taking twenty-seven more pills would help me break through to Qi Cultivation Level 4."
"But the body still holds some residual medicine power; until it’s fully refined, I can’t take more." Xu Ping’s excitement inevitably faded.
Reckless consumption of pills without thoroughly refining their power could lead to Pill Poison clogging the meridians, making further cultivation impossible.
Xu Ping wasn’t shortsighted and wouldn’t blindly consume pills.
By his estimate, it would take about two days to fully refine the residual medicine power.
"I wonder if the remaining fourteen pills can help me break through to Qi Cultivation Level 4?"
"If not, it seems I might have to buy another bottle."
"But I’m short on Spirit Stones, so it looks like I have to continue working on others’ Spirit Fields!"
....
....
Early in the morning.
At Elder Yan’s house.
Fan Shou knocked on Elder Yan’s door.
He was coming to request a deposit refund too.
With Xu Ping as a comparison, everyone knew which choice to make.
Besides, people in the vicinity were secretly cursing Elder Yan for being greedy.
However, he came to request the deposit back and wouldn’t reveal his thoughts.
"Is Elder Yan home?"
Fan Shou put on a smile, knocking on the door.
After knocking for a while, there was no response.
Fan Shou was puzzled, so he pushed the door lightly.
Unexpectedly, it opened easily.
He hesitated for a moment but entered the house.
"Is Elder Yan home?" His voice echoed through the rooms, but no one answered.
Fan Shou had to search every room, finding nothing.
Even the Spirit Rice in the rice jar was completely gone.
"Could it be... this guy ran off with the money?" The thought struck Fan Shou’s mind.
The more he thought about it, the more plausible it seemed.
Currently, few sought Elder Yan for Spirit Field watering, while those wanting refunds kept increasing.
It was too likely he ran away with the funds.Googlᴇ search NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
Given the size of Dongwu Market, no one dared run around; just finding a random place to hide meant they couldn’t find Elder Yan.
"Better not let me catch you," Fan Shou muttered angrily.
After an extra round of meticulous search yielded nothing, he left begrudgingly.
In the following days, more people came to Elder Yan for refunds, all in vain.
The news of Elder Yan’s elopement with the money spread quickly.
Those who got their deposits back early felt lucky, while those who didn’t cursed in frustration.
But all of this had nothing to do with Xu Ping.
Over time, his reputation surpassed Elder Yan’s.
Now, his business was booming, keeping him busier each day.
...
...
The sun rose.
These days, Xu Ping had been busy watering others’ Spirit Fields, leaving little time for his own.
Yet his Spirit Fields were neat and tidy, not a weed in sight.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, all the weeds are removed!"
Old Man Lu, panting, climbed the field edge, carrying a hoe.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Lu!" Xu Pin smiled.
Since he began watering others’ Spirit Fields, Old Man Lu took on the responsibility of tending to his.
"It’s no trouble; after you water your Spirit Fields, you should head to Fellow Daoist Wei’s for watering," Old Man Lu set the hoe down, wiping sweat from his brow.
"Alright."
Xu Ping responded, then leaped down the field edge to water his own field.
As he performed the Magic Technique, clouds gathered, and soon a gentle spiritual rain fell.
With the rain’s nourishment, the Spirit Rice in the field became vibrant.
The bearing phase was more than halfway through.
Xu Ping bent down, carefully observing his rice plants and noting the large green grains they were producing.
He compared them with the neighboring fields’ rice and found his grains not only larger but also richer in Spiritual Qi.
Once the grains matured, this year’s harvest would be twice that of previous years at least.
Xu Ping couldn’t help but smile.
...
Before long, his five acres of Spirit Fields were fully watered.
After a brief rest to recover some Mana, Xu Ping set off with Old Man Lu to Fellow Daoist Wei’s house.
Before going far, they saw a group of Spirit Farmers standing together with gloomy faces, grumbling angrily—a tense atmosphere.
"Fellow Daoist Lu, what’s wrong with them?" Xu Ping asked.
"I don’t know either, let’s find out," Old Man Lu scurried over quickly.

chapters.title: Chapter 13: Five Elements Technique Breakthrough
chapters.content:
Chapter 13: Chapter 13: Five Elements Technique Breakthrough
Half an hour later, Old Man Lu ran over looking troubled.
"What’s the matter?" Xu Ping asked curiously.
"I heard them say a demon beast has broken into the spirit fields, trampling and eating a large patch of spirit rice." Old Man Lu sighed, the wrinkles on his face seeming deeper.
"A demon beast has broken into the market!"
Xu Ping was shocked and immediately asked, "Doesn’t the patrol team survey the market every day? How could there be demon beasts roaming around?"
"Those guys just go through the motions every day. If they truly put effort into patrolling for us, there wouldn’t be so many incidents of robbery and murder happening regularly." Old Man Lu grumbled indignantly.
These words inevitably reminded Xu Ping of the two cultivators who had tried to rob him a few days ago.
If the patrol team had been genuinely patrolling, how could those two individuals have been so bold and dared to attack him in broad daylight?
"Did demon beasts break into the market during the beast tide before?" Xu Ping continued to ask.
Old Man Lu hesitated for a moment, then shook his head: "Once before, many people died, and in the end, the Longevity Sect had to put in great effort to suppress that beast tide."
"But last time, even second-stage demon beasts appeared. This time, not even a shadow of a second-stage demon beast has been seen, so it shouldn’t be that dangerous." Old Man Lu reassured.
"I hope so." Xu Ping sighed, feeling a vague sense of unease.
But there wasn’t much he could do; he could only strive to earn more spirit stones and work hard to enhance his own strength.
....
...
After harvesting sixteen spirit crystals today, Xu Ping hurried home.
The residual medicinal power in his body was finally fully refined, and he could continue to take Qi Nourishing Pills.
The demon beast invasion that happened today had put a lot of pressure on him.
He now wanted to strengthen his power as much as possible.
After dinner, Xu Ping entered the bedroom.
He took out the Qi Nourishing Pills from his storage bag.
After fully refining the medicinal power these past two days, his mastery level increased by a point, and the proficiency of the Five Elements Skill increased by eight points.
The progress was impressive.
At this rate, this bottle of pills would be enough to push his cultivation level to the fourth layer of Qi Cultivation!
Xu Ping swallowed the Qi Nourishing Pill in one gulp and then sat cross-legged.
Soon, he smoothly entered a meditative state.
Time passed unnoticed in cultivation.
Gradually, the flow of spiritual power in his body became increasingly smooth, subtle hindrances began to dissolve, and even the circulation routes underwent slight adjustments and optimizations, becoming more compatible with his physical form.
He cultivated for nearly two hours before he awoke from the meditative state.
Since his arrival, he had never meditated for such long periods.
When he opened his eyes, it felt like waking from a dream.
It took him a good while to come completely to himself, quickly opening the proficiency panel.
He saw the Five Elements Skill proficiency had turned into ’Proficient: 4/400’.
The cultivation level had also increased by 2 points in one go.
"Finally.... the Five Elements Skill has broken through!!" Xu Ping rejoiced!
Initially, the Five Elements Skill had the highest proficiency among all skills, yet the progress was unbelievably slow.
While exhilarated, Xu Ping immediately sensed a unique insight forming in his heart.New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
He seemed to have practiced the Five Elements Skill hundreds of times, gaining a deeper understanding of its many evolutions.
It was something he had never experienced before.
"It’s so amazing?" Xu Ping’s heart pounded intensely.
Moreover, he felt that his cultivation speed had increased by at least one-third compared to before.
This was already akin to the level of top-tier lower grade spirit roots.
And more importantly, now he only needed a day to completely refine the Qi Nourishing Pill!
His time to break through to the fourth layer of Qi Cultivation had been moved forward!
"Great, great!"
Xu Ping beamed with joy.
No matter the deficiency of his spirit root, he could still grind his way forward step by step.
"If the Five Elements Skill were to break through again, my cultivation speed wouldn’t be inferior to those with mid-grade spirit roots."
"This is true... hope for immortality!"
...
...
In the following days, Xu Ping took a Qi Nourishing Pill every day.
His cultivation speed was astounding.
The cultivation level increased by two points daily, and after the proficiency breakthrough of the Five Elements Skill, though proficiency decreased slightly, it continued to show a daily increase of four points.
If things continued this way, in less than ten days, he would break through to the fourth layer of Qi Cultivation!
Amidst his joy, Xu Ping also worried about the demon beast intrusion in the market.
In these few days, he frequently heard that certain families’ spirit fields were devastated by demon beasts, or even certain individuals were attacked while out at night.
Faced with such problems, he was helpless; he could only quietly work on strengthening his abilities.
...
Four days later.
Xu Ping stood amidst a vast spirit field, casting a magic technique with his hands.
The clouds in the sky quickly gathered, and soon, a drizzle of spirit rain began to fall.
At this moment!
Ding!
[Spirit Rain Skill experience +1]
The panel prompt appeared before his eyes, and suddenly Xu Ping’s head buzzed. His consciousness blanked.
In an instant, countless pieces of information about Spirit Rain Skill were forcibly infused into his Sea of Consciousness.
It took him a full half hour before he regained his senses.
"This is... Spirit Rain Skill has broken through!!"
Xu Ping excitedly opened the proficiency panel.
[Spirit Rain Skill proficient: 1/400]
"Finally, it’s broken through!"
Seeing the words on the panel, Xu Ping’s heart raced.
The breakthrough of Spirit Rain Skill meant he had finally truly become a First Rank Lower Grade Spirit Plant Cultivator.
Although the status of a Spirit Plant Cultivator does not compare to formations, pills, artifacts, or talismans, in the myriad arts of cultivation, it ranks in the upper tier of the disdain circle.
After all, the natural spirit medicines and fairy treasures are limited in quantity, and most require extremely harsh conditions for successful cultivation.
However, Spirit Plant Cultivators can use magic and other means to create environments suitable for growing spirit medicines and fairy treasures, even accelerating their growth.
It’s important to note that Spirit Plant Cultivators meticulously cultivate not just ordinary spirit rice, but precious spirit medicine, or high-grade Spirit Wood used for artifact refining and talisman making.
Skillful Spirit Plant Cultivators are not in any lesser status compared to some Talisman Masters!
"It seems I should visit the market center to see if there are houses for rent." Xu Ping mused internally.
The environment for spirit medicine growth is highly demanding, and the thin and unsafe spiritual environment at the market outskirts is clearly unsuitable for spirit medicine cultivation.
The reason rent is high in the market center is partly due to safety, but also because of the spiritual environment.
Dongwu Market is built on a second-stage spirit vein.
The core of the second-stage spirit vein is exclusively occupied by Foundation Establishment cultivators.
There is another branch vein in the market center, where the spiritual qi reaches the level of First Rank Upper Grade.
As for the market outskirts being on the tail end of the branch vein, the spiritual qi barely reaches First Rank Lower Grade.
The difference in spiritual qi concentration is immense; if Xu Ping moved to the market center, his cultivation speed could increase by at least fifty percent.
"Fellow Daoist Xu? Fellow Daoist Xu!"
The voice calling from behind snapped Xu Ping back to reality.
He turned around and waved to Old Man Lu standing on the ridge: "I’m fine."
"Hurry up, we need to go to the next house after this." Old Man Lu urged.
Xu Ping...
Wait, there’s something off here!
Employees starting to exert pressure on the boss in reverse?

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Nourishing Life Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 14: Chapter 14: Nourishing Life Skill
Xu Ping did not continue to daydream, his heart set on trying the unique aspects of mastering the Spirit Rain Skill.
With someone nearby, he naturally couldn’t exert his full power.
However, even so, Xu Ping immediately felt an extraordinary change.
Apart from the raindrops containing more Spiritual Qi, he could actually control the volume of rain and the amount of Spiritual Qi in a specific area.
In other words, with just a thought, he could make the rain somewhere more abundant and filled with Spiritual Qi.
Such a skill doesn’t mean much for spirit rice.
But for spirit medicine, it’s extremely important.
Some fragile spirit medicines, with a little too much rain, would die and rot. Even too much Spiritual Qi in the raindrops could slow their growth or even stop it.
With this skill, he could flexibly adjust the application of the Spirit Rain Skill according to the growth habits of the spirit medicine.
"Not bad, not bad!"
Xu Ping joyfully thought, and his work efficiency increased significantly.
Soon, he had completed watering the remaining spiritual fields.
After receiving his payment, Old Man Lu hurriedly dragged him to the next location.
...
.....
Ending his day’s work, Xu Ping walked on the way home.
Ever since the last time he was attacked by a robber, he always chose the main road, which was undoubtedly much safer.
Occasionally, he would encounter patrols, which settled his heart quite a bit.
At this moment, Xu Ping passed by Old Sun’s spiritual fields and couldn’t help but stop in his tracks.
He looked up, and the spiritual fields were overgrown with weeds, reaching higher than half a person, completely drowning out the spirit rice.
The scene before him made his heart tense up, clearly an indication of long-term neglect.
As the lifeline for spiritual farmers, such neglect of the fields was truly unusual.
"Could it be that Old Sun really got possessed by evil spirits?" This thought flashed through his mind like lightning, immediately bringing unease.
The surrounding air seemed to become cold and icy, making one shudder involuntarily.
Thus, he could only quicken his pace to head home.
"The materials for the Nourishing Life Skill have been brewed into medicine, starting cultivation of the Nourishing Body Skill today."
The beast tide is getting worse, and if evil spirits come now, it would be adding insult to injury.
For now, improving his strength was the only way to bring him safety.
...
Back home.
Xu Ping went to the kitchen, boiling a pot of hot water.
He found a large wooden barrel and poured all the hot water into it, just about to pour in the medicine.
"Knock! Knock! Knock!"
At this moment, there was a knocking on the door outside.
’Who’s looking for me again!’
Xu Ping opened the door, and it was the charming and beautiful Lv Liu in traditional dress.
"Daoist Lv?" Xu Ping was taken aback, not expecting her visit.
"Not welcoming me?" Lv Liu giggled with a hand over her mouth.
"How could I!" Xu Ping awkwardly laughed.
"Hehe, I brought you something good for your health, genuine Demon Beast Flesh." Lv Liu laughed while handing over the meat she was holding.
"This... this is too precious." Xu Ping hesitated, repeatedly declining.
Even if Demon Beast Flesh prices have dropped considerably, it’s still a luxury for regular spirit farmers.
"Just a piece of Demon Beast Flesh, not that valuable. It’s courtesy, no rejecting it next time I ask Fellow Daoist Xu for help." Lv Liu’s tone carried a teasing hint, as if suggesting something.
"Then... alright." Xu Ping took the meat from her hands.
Mainly because refusing someone’s kindness is inappropriate.
"Alright, I’m leaving then. Oh, Fellow Daoist Xu, I gave you Demon Beast Flesh secretly from my husband, don’t tell him." Lv Liu blinked her bright eyes at Xu Ping.
"Ah?"
Xu Ping was bewildered.
He thought it was Lv Liu and her husband’s gesture to bond after his Spirit Rain Skill breakthrough.
Turns out it was secretly from Lv Liu?
What kind of development is this?
After pondering for a moment, Xu Ping decided to let it go.
No matter what development, female cultivators would only slow his cultivation pace.
Soon, Xu Ping put the matter out of his mind.
Returning to the kitchen.
Their conversation was brief, so the hot water was still steaming without needing to be reheated.
Xu Ping again took out the medicine from his storage bag, opened the container, and poured the dark green liquid into the water.
Instantly, the once clear hot water turned to a dark green color.
Seeing this, Xu Ping took a deep breath.
Biting his teeth, he stepped into the barrel, undressing completely.
"Hiss!"
Upon entry, a fierce burning pain washed over him, causing Xu Ping to gasp.
His entire skin became beet-red from the scalding water, like a boiled shrimp.
He didn’t need to guess to know his skin was severely scalded.
Xu Ping endured the pain, forming a peculiar sign with his hands, then starting the Nourishing Life Skill cultivation technique.
After a short while.
The barrel, filled with the dark green liquid, started emitting gentle steam.
The lightly blue-tinged steam entered his body through every pore.
This time, Xu Ping felt intense skin pain throughout his body, even unrest within his body.
Various sensations, tingling, itching, soreness, pain...
All sorts wreaked havoc inside, greatly testing his will!
Xu Ping strived to keep his consciousness lucid, guiding the medicinal liquid through his body as per the first-level entry formula of the Nourishing Life Skill.
The dark green liquid clung to his skin, seeping into his body, nourishing his bones, cleansing his meridians...
The process was extremely painful, as if someone was forcibly combing his flesh, meridians, bones with an iron comb.
Not wanting to give up halfway, Xu Ping gritted his teeth to persevere.
In the end, his teeth were biting till they bled.
The process continued.
Unaware of how much time passed.
Suddenly, he felt a lightness all over, all pain and discomfort vanished, replaced by a warm stream swirling inside.
In that moment, he completely indulged in it.
....ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ
Again, not knowing how much time had passed.
Gentle moonlight seeped through the window’s gap, scattering soft light patches, embellishing the tidy room.
In the barrel, Xu Ping with his eyes shut, absorbed the last trace of the dark green air, turning the dark green liquid to transparency.
His eyelids fluttered, and moments later, he opened his eyes.
The black pupils had a tinge of light blue now.
He exhaled a mouthful of foul breath, blinking energetically, then sprang up, letting the cool water cascade off him.
Feeling the newfound enormous bodily strength, he knew he had successfully reached the entry level of the Nourishing Body Skill.
Crack!
When he clenched his fists with force, the muscles on his arms hardened like iron, veins bulging under his skin, and joints made a crisp crackling sound.
Filled with power.
He never expected such strong body refining effects from a life-nourishing cultivation technique!
The strength increased by several times compared to before.
Then he pinched his arm’s skin.
The texture was no longer soft.
It had a tough feeling.
Like pinching cowhide.

chapters.title: Chapter 15: Early Harvest
chapters.content:
Chapter 15: Chapter 15: Early Harvest
"Even the skin is enhanced? If I keep training, won’t I be able to block magical artifacts with bare hands without injury in the future?" Xu Ping was secretly astonished in his heart.
However, that’s still far from the current stage.
The first level of Body Refining is equivalent to the early stage of Qi Cultivation.
He has just stepped into the first level, equivalent to just stepping into the first level of Qi Cultivation as a minor cultivator.
To block magical artifacts unharmed with bare hands, even lower-grade ones, would at least require reaching the third level.
At this moment, a cold wind blew by.
Although Xu Ping couldn’t feel cold after successfully refining his body, it reminded him that he was standing naked.
He wasn’t an exhibitionist, so he immediately stepped out of the wooden barrel, dried himself, and prepared to get dressed.
He just put on his pants.
But his stomach let out a thunderous growl.
The feeling of hunger swept over him like a tide, every cell in his body craving for nutritional energy.
Xu Ping was so hungry that his eyes turned red.
He hurriedly took out over ten pounds of Demon Beast Flesh from his storage bag and put it into a large pot to stew.
Because he was unbearably hungry, Xu Ping couldn’t wait any longer and started eating before the meat was fully cooked.
As a result, he finished over ten pounds of Demon Beast Flesh, only feeling barely satisfied.
His appetite had already exceeded his usual amount several times over!
Only now did Xu Ping truly experience the "terror" of the Nourishing Life Skill.
The effect is powerful, but the consumption is also significant.
Having recovered, Xu Ping finally had time to check the changes on his proficiency panel.
[Name: Xu Ping]
[Life Span: 28/103 years]
[Cultivation Level: Qi Cultivation Level Three: 82/100; Nourishing Life Skill Level One: 1/100]
[Cultivation Technique: Five Elements Skill Mastery (Level Three): 16/400]
[Skills: Spirit Rain Skill Mastery: 14/400; Geng Metal Finger Minor Achievement: 684/800]
Besides the Nourishing Life Skill appearing on the list, Xu Ping also keenly noticed the change in lifespan.
Increased by five years.
"If all three levels are fully mastered, that would mean an extra thirty-five years of life!" Xu Ping’s eyes flashed with joy.
No one dislikes having a longer life.
In this world, cultivators pursue the ultimate goal of immortality!
"Too bad I don’t have a sword, otherwise I could also practice the swordsmanship included in the Nourishing Life Skill." Turning off the panel, Xu Ping suddenly recalled the set of swordsmanship attached to the Nourishing Life Skill.
"I still have to go buy a magical sword. If I can’t afford a real magical sword, I can at least buy a sword embryo."
"Who knows, with the proficiency panel, I might just become a sword cultivator."
...
...
The following evening.
At Zhuang Mu’s home, the dim candlelight cast a soft glow on the dining table, illuminating a bowl of translucent Spirit Rice, a pot of fragrant Demon Beast Flesh, and a bottle of aromatic Spirit Wine.
As a winemaker, Zhuang Mu’s everyday life was more comfortable than that of ordinary spirit farmers, thanks to brewing Spirit Wine.
At that moment.
Knock! Knock! Knock...
"Friend Zhuang, are you home?" A cheerful knock on the door was accompanied by a gentle, sweet voice.
Zhuang Mu knew who it was just by hearing the voice, a flash of delight crossed his face as he hurriedly opened the door.
Outside, Lv Liu stood gracefully like an elegant flower, mesmerizing the hearts of those who beheld her.
"Friend Lv, you’ve come." Zhuang Mu was captivated, unable to resist reaching out to hold her.
Lv Liu dodged, teasingly saying, "Others might see us."
"Mainly, you’re too beautiful; it’s hard to resist." Zhuang Mu awkwardly scratched his head.
"Smooth talker." Lv Liu cast a charming glance at Zhuang Mu, "Today I’ve specially brought you something good to nourish your body; this is authentic Demon Beast Flesh."
As she spoke, she handed over the meat she was carrying.
Zhuang Mu’s eyes instantly brightened, his heart filled with gratitude, taking the opportunity to gently hold Lv Liu’s delicate hand: "Friend Lv, you’re always so kind to me!"
"You’re terrible!" Lv Liu coyly chided, her face carrying a hint of shyness.
Zhuang Mu held Lv Liu’s delicate hand tightly, unwilling to let go: "Friend Lv, I truly like you, really want to show you my heart!"
"Really? In the future, I may truly want to take your heart out to see it." Lv Liu chuckled lightly, a mischievous look in her eyes.
"No problem, even now!" Without hesitation, Zhuang Mu pulled his clothes open, revealing his sturdy chest.
"Don’t backtrack!" Lv Liu said meaningfully, her tone carrying a hint of playful mockery.
"But for now I’m not ready, once I am, I’ll surely take your heart out to see if you’re speaking the truth!" Lv Liu freed herself from Zhuang Mu’s hand and walked away with her slender waist swaying.
"No problem, make sure to come early!" Watching Lv Liu’s enchanting figure, Zhuang Mu felt a stir in his heart, involuntarily swallowing his saliva.
...
...
Three days later in the morning.
Xu Ping and Old Man Lu were busy in the spirit field when suddenly, a voice came from mid-air: "You two seem to have quite a good relationship!"
The duo quickly looked up and saw an iron-leaf boat slowly descending, from which a person stepped off.
The individual was a male cultivator in his thirties, donned in a sky-gray robe, and was rather obese.
Seeing this, Xu Ping and Old Man Lu immediately put down their hoes, approached with smiles: "We’re neighbors after all, helping each other. May I ask what brings Steward Fu here?"
The man in blue was surnamed Fu, an outer disciple of the Longevity Sect, responsible for some spirit fields in Dongwu Market.
For many spirit farmers on the mountain, he was like a local emperor with life-and-death authority.
"This year, the Spirit Rice needs to be harvested early." Steward Fu nodded slightly, his tone carrying indisputable authority.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
"Early harvest?"
Xu Ping and Old Man Lu exchanged glances, their hearts trembled, instantly understanding that the Longevity Sect feared the beast tide might get out of control, causing irreparable damage to the Spirit Rice, hence the necessity of early harvest.
Although the Spirit Rice was barely mature, and barely harvestable, there would certainly be losses.
"Then Steward Fu, I’ll go home and wait for your instructions." Old Man Lu forced a smile.
Early harvesting meant loss of irrigation sales, and the yield of Spirit Rice would also be affected.
Faced with a double blow, one could only imagine his mood.
"Hmm."
Steward Fu nodded, then walked around the edge of the spirit field, observing the growth of the Spirit Rice. After a moment, he exclaimed in surprise: "Why is the growth of this Spirit Rice so good?"
The Spirit Rice in Xu Ping’s field was not only much larger, but brimmed with abundant Spiritual Qi!
Were it not for recognizing this Spirit Rice, he might have thought it was of a different species altogether.
"Seems your Spirit Rain Skill is quite advanced!" Steward Fu looked deeply at Xu Ping.
"It’s nothing; it’s mainly because Dongwu Market is a place of outstanding people, great Spiritual Qi, hence the Spirit Rice grows well!"
Xu Ping praised while discreetly taking out a small brocade pouch and handed it over.
Inside the pouch were two Spirit Stones.
"With the beast tide so rampant, a small spirit farmer like myself is clueless about the situation outside. Could Steward Fu enlighten me a little?" A hint of concern appeared in Xu Ping’s eyes.
Steward Fu accepted the pouch, without needing to open it, knowing the exact amount, his expression softened, then spoke with layered meaning: "You’re quite smart... Just stay home and don’t go anywhere for now."
"Understood, understood!" Xu Ping nodded repeatedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 16: Qi Cultivation Level 4
chapters.content:
Chapter 16: Chapter 16: Qi Cultivation Level 4
Later, Steward Fu revealed an important piece of information: the Longevity Sect would be sending people to Dongwu Market.
"With experts from the Longevity Sect coming, this little beast tide should be no problem at all." Xu Ping continued to sing praises, feeling a sense of relief.
With the Longevity Sect sending people, the safety of Dongwu Market would surely be greatly enhanced!
"Begin the harvest," Steward Fu’s voice echoed again, carrying a hint of urgency.
"Alright," Xu Ping nodded in agreement.
After mastering the Nourishing Life Skill, his physique was robust, and harvesting the Spirit Rice was naturally much faster than ordinary spirit farmers.
Swish, swish!
Layers of Spirit Rice fell, turning into Spirit Rice grains.
As time went by, the spirit field was gradually harvested into neat rows, with piles of Spirit Rice standing like a small golden mountain.
In the end, Steward Fu took out a large ritualistic artifact specifically used for measuring weight from the storage bag at his waist.
"This year, your harvest is excellent, yielding a full 2,200 pounds of Spirit Rice... You need to submit 60%, which is 1,320 pounds!"
Steward Fu fiddled with the abacus: "The price of Spirit Rice has risen now, and we can purchase it at the rate of forty-five pounds per Spirit Stone. If you sell your private share, you can get 19 Spirit Stones and 5 Spirit Crystals..."
Xu Ping calculated and painfully said: "Leave me half..."
According to the land lease contract, he could originally keep 40% of the harvest, which was 880 pounds of Spirit Rice.
If he wanted to sell this Spirit Rice, it still had to be sold to the Longevity Sect.
The Longevity Sect had a rice store in the market too, so they could severely suppress prices and offer very few Spirit Stones.
And since spirit farmers often needed to cultivate, they generally had to keep most of it.
But this year, as Xu Ping’s harvest was 1,200 pounds more than before, he could sell a bit more.
"Half... then I’ll leave you 480 pounds."
Steward Fu stored the Spirit Rice in the storage bag and tossed a small bag of Spirit Stones before riding away on his iron leaf boat.
Xu Ping opened the bag and was slightly surprised to find ten Spirit Stones and six Spirit Crystals lying inside: "They didn’t deduct anything this year?"
According to past practice, at least five or six Spirit Crystals would be deducted.
But thinking about it, he had just offered two Spirit Stones as respect, so there was no need to deduct those Spirit Crystals.
Of course, if encountered with someone greedy, deductions would definitely continue.
...
The spirit farmers in Dongwu Market began their harvest of Spirit Rice.
However, influenced by the beast tide and early harvest, almost everyone’s Spirit Rice fields had reduced yields.
Some who were less affected had nearly nothing left after submitting the required 60%, barely enough to stave off hunger.
Others, severely affected, toiled all year only to receive not even a pound of Spirit Rice, sometimes even having to submit Spirit Stones to the Longevity Sect.
...
In the evening.
In his bedroom, Xu Ping skillfully swallowed a Qi Nourishing Pill, crossed his legs, and began using the Five Elements Skill to refine the pill.
The pure mana flowed silently through his meridians like a gentle stream, nourishing his five organs, limbs, and bones.
With the cultivation technique running its course, the mana gradually flowed smoothly after several cycles, growing increasingly powerful with a commanding presence, as if the forces of heaven and earth were converging upon him.
Suddenly, Xu Ping’s entire body shuddered, a sense of awareness arising within.
His eyes flickered with a bright sparkle.
Success!
He sensed that the mana in his Dantian had increased by nearly two-thirds, and a surge of excitement settled in as he realized he had stepped into the fourth layer of Qi Cultivation, crossing into the mid-stage threshold.
"Not easy at all!" Xu Ping grinned broadly.
After calming the turbulent mana within him, he tapped open his panel.
[Name: Xu Ping]
[Lifespan: 28/106 years]
[Realm: Fourth Layer of Qi Cultivation: 1/100; First Layer of Nourishing Life Skill: 4/100]
[Cultivation Technique: Proficient in the Five Elements Skill (Fourth Layer): 16/400]Follow current novels on No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
[Skills: Proficient in Spirit Rain Skill: 41/400; Geng Metal Finger at Minor Achievement: 718/800]
"Fortunately, the experience points remain at a hundred; if they doubled like the skills at each level, the thought of nine layers in Qi Cultivation would indeed be despairing."
Xu Ping thought to himself, noticing a further three-year increase in his lifespan, making him even more delighted. He closed the panel and stood up.
He paced back and forth inside the room, filled with excitement, unable to contain himself, so he stepped out of the bedroom and opened the door.
The night was as tranquil as water, the ground coated with a layer of white frost, cold and serene.
The market periphery lost the day’s hustle and bustle, with eerie calls of ghosts and wolves occasionally punctuating the silence, contrasting with the peace and tranquility of the night.
Xu Ping paced around the entrance for a few moments, feeling satisfied, he then closed the door and returned inside to sleep.
...
...
In the dead of night.
The moon had long hidden behind a thick layer of clouds, and the surroundings were shrouded in a cold, dark gloom.
In the quiet night sky, the sharp cries of a few night birds occasionally swept past, sending shivers down the spine.
Suddenly!
"Ah!"
An urgent and brief scream shattered the night’s silence, only to sink back into calm.
At Zhao Tao’s home.
The dim candlelight barely illuminated the room, where a body lay conspicuously in the center, blood mixed with fragments of organs spilling from the sunken chest, the room thick with a nauseating stench of blood.
"You said it yourself, that you’d take out the heart for me to see!" Lv Liu sneered, her gaze coldly fixed on the already lifeless Zhuang Mu.
"Indeed, a brewer always has a fortune!" Zhao Tao meticulously counted through Zhuang Mu’s belongings, a satisfied smile spreading across his face.
"Just a couple more jobs, and we’ll be able to leave Dongwu Market. It hasn’t been peaceful here lately. Have you got the tickets ready?" Lv Liu turned her gaze to Zhao Tao.
"They’re ready, all thanks to our teammates." Zhao Tao’s grin was sinister.
"No loose ends?"
"Rest assured with my work. Have you picked the next target?" Zhao Tao inquired.
"Of course, I planned to fatten him up a bit more, but unfortunately, this year’s Spirit Rice had to be harvested early." Lv Liu shook her head, a hint of regret.
"Xu Ping?"
"Yes." Lv Liu nodded.
Upon hearing this, Zhao Tao’s expression turned enigmatic.
Recently, he had heard quite a few rumors about Xu Ping.
"That kid must be utterly mesmerized by you, right?"
"I hadn’t planned to target this pauper, but his Spirit Rain Skill broke through the proficiency level, making quite a lot of profit lately." Zhao Tao’s eyes gleamed with greed.
"Not entirely mesmerized, but he’s definitely come to trust me," Lv Liu responded coldly, her gaze emotionless.
"Then that’s good. When the time comes, have him come over, and we’ll make him disappear without anyone knowing!" Zhao Tao chuckled, a hint of malevolence in his laughter.
In the chilling night, their schemes were like beasts lurking in the darkness, ready to pounce on unsuspecting prey at any moment.
...
...
The next day, at Xu Ping’s home.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh...
Golden energy shot from Xu Ping’s fingertips like lightning, precisely hitting the distant wooden target.
In no time, the target was riddled with holes, scarred and battered.
Suddenly!
An energy far more potent than any before burst forth,
and with a "bang!" the wooden target was instantly smashed into pieces, flying apart.
"Has it reached mastery?"
Xu Ping’s eyes sparkled with excitement as he eagerly opened his skill panel.
[Geng Metal Finger Mastery: 1/1600]
"It truly broke through!"
Joy spread across Xu Ping’s brow.
The improvement of one’s strength always brings joy!
Especially when it’s through one’s own efforts, this feeling is indescribable.

chapters.title: Chapter 17: Assassination
chapters.content:
Chapter 17: Chapter 17: Assassination
"Late-stage fourth level Qi Cultivation, a perfected Geng Metal Finger, this level of power could be considered top-notch in the entire Dongwu Market, right?" Xu Ping smiled at the corner of his mouth.
Dongwu Market had numerous cultivators, numbering in the tens of thousands.
Early-stage Qi cultivators made up sixty to seventy percent, mid-stage was only about twenty to thirty percent, and as for late-stage Qi cultivators, at most there were a hundred or so.
With Xu Ping’s current strength, although he didn’t dare to claim he could kill late-stage Qi cultivators, he could certainly leave mid-stage ones unrecognizable even to their own mothers.
Of course, not all mid-stage Qi cultivators are on the same level, just as people should not be generalized.
A loose cultivator who struggles daily in Dongwu Market for a living certainly cannot compare to a sect cultivator who has received systematic training.
The former might have more combat experience, but the latter surpasses in equipment, attack techniques, and cultivation knowledge.
"Since there’s no need to water the spiritual field now, it’s a bit idle. I’ll go to the market tomorrow to buy a sword and start practicing swordsmanship, and perhaps find a comprehensive magic book to learn other spells." After admiring the panel for a while, Xu Ping silently closed it.
Stretching lazily, Xu Ping walked into the kitchen to prepare dinner for himself.
After eating, he habitually went to the bedroom to cultivate.
At that moment, a knock on the door suddenly sounded outside.
Knock, knock, knock...
"Fellow Daoist Xu, are you home?"
"So late? Who could it be?"
Xu Ping got out of bed and opened the door, and was greeted by the sight of the beautiful Lv Liu, standing quietly at the door.
Her close-fitting dress outlined her elegant curves. The thin fabric gently swayed in the breeze, with the hem embroidered with exquisite patterns, vivid in color, enhancing her jade-like delicate skin.
"Fellow Daoist Lv? So late, what brings you here?" Xu Ping asked curiously.
"My house... huh?"
"Fellow Daoist Xu, you’ve broken through to the fourth level of Qi Cultivation?" Lv Liu looked at Xu Ping in surprise.
"Just lucky, I only barely broke through yesterday." Xu Ping replied modestly.
"Don’t be so modest; Fellow Daoist Xu is so young and already mid-stage Qi Cultivation, really admirable." Lv Liu’s eyes sparkled with admiration.
The gaze of a charming female cultivator filled with admiration naturally stirred Xu Ping’s heart.
He forced himself to suppress the eagerness in his heart, asking again, "Fellow Daoist Lv, is there something you need from me?"
"There’s something strange in my house, always making weird noises, and my husband is out hunting demons, so I’m scared alone. Can Fellow Daoist Xu come and help me take a look?"
Her voice carried a hint of tremor, as if she had thought of something horrifying, her expression turned timid.
"Strange noises?"
Xu Ping frowned, immediately suspecting whether it could be the doing of a Demon Beast.
"Fellow Daoist Lv, are you sure there are strange sounds at your place?"
"Really, I’ve heard it more than once. It seems like some kind of wild beast. It sounds terrifying, and my heart is still pounding." Lv Liu’s eyebrows drooped as her delicate, fair hand rested on her chest.
Xu Ping furrowed his brows even tighter. Lv Liu’s words strengthened his belief that it must be some sort of Demon Beast.
After hesitating for a moment, he decided to go with Lv Liu to take a look.
After all, it was to return the favor of the Demon Beast Flesh she had given him before.
However, previously, he wouldn’t have gone, but now after breaking through to the fourth level of Qi Cultivation, his strength had increased significantly. He could even contest with late-stage Qi cultivators.
This gave him confidence.
"Fellow Daoist Lv, lead the way, I’ll accompany you to check it out." Xu Ping said calmly after a moment of silence.
"Really? Thank you so much, Fellow Daoist Xu!" Lv Liu’s jade-like hand involuntarily clung to the edge of Xu Ping’s garment, her eyes showing intense joy.
"No need to be so polite, neighbors should help each other." Xu Ping nonchalantly pulled away from Lv Liu.
"Then let’s go." Lv Liu didn’t mind and led Xu Ping towards her home.
Before long, the two arrived at Lv Liu’s house.
"It’s inside." Lv Liu pushed the door open and went inside the room first.
Xu Ping followed closely.
The room was pitch dark, like a giant abyss devouring everything.
Just as Xu Ping stepped over the threshold, a glint of ghostly light appeared silently from the darkness, shooting straight at his head.
The light was like a snake sticking out its tongue, carrying a cold intent to kill.
Keen intuition screamed warnings incessantly, a strong sense of crisis instantly enveloped Xu Ping’s heart!
Xu Ping’s heart almost seized, nearly leaping out of his chest.
Without time to think, he pushed against the door frame with his palm, shifting his body slightly.
In this way, that ghostly light naturally missed.
Shooting straight into the wall, revealing a small section of a silvery needle tip, remarkably a sneakily crafted flying needle!
"Who is it?" Xu Ping broke out in a cold sweat.
That was close, just a little more, and he would have been dead!
If it weren’t for his improved reaction speed from practicing the Nourishing Life Skill, he would have been unable to dodge it.
"You brat, quite sharp, to dodge my Soul-Breaking Needle?"
A chilling voice came from the shadows, carrying a hint of mockery and contempt.
Looking towards the voice, Xu Ping, under the moonlight, identified his attacker. It was Zhao Tao.
"It’s you!" His face changed dramatically, realizing that this was all a trap set by Zhao Tao and Lv Liu.
"He has broken through to the fourth level of Qi Cultivation, make it quick!" Lv Liu’s voice was cold as ice.
"Don’t worry, he can’t escape our grasp!" Zhao Tao sneered, forming a seal with his magic technique.
Pu! Pu! Pu!
Out of nowhere, several yard-long earth spikes emerged under Xu Ping’s feet, aiming to pierce his body instantly.
Yet it was as if his feet had eyes.
His body soared and shifted, narrowly evading the spikes that appeared in succession.
These sudden earth spikes were clearly premeditated.
"Body Refining Cultivator?"
Zhao Tao’s face changed; ordinary magic cultivators don’t have such quick reflexes.
Seeing this, Lv Liu’s expression changed slightly, instantly ceasing to conceal her cultivation, her aura climbing rapidly, reaching the fifth level of Qi Cultivation.
She immediately summoned a flying shuttle magical artifact.
Whiz!
A flash of cold light, the flying shuttle slashed towards Xu Ping in a blink.
Xu Ping fiercely slapped his storage bag at his waist, summoning an ash-yellow shield, which swelled in the wind like a stone wall, blocking in front of him.
Turtle Spirit Armor.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
This was the lower-grade defensive magical artifact he had bought at the Hundred Refining Workshop!
With a "clang", the flying shuttle scored a groove on the Rock Shield, sparks flying, the sharp screech of friction echoing, barely holding back the attack.
Xu Ping breathed a sigh of relief, but the situation was still dangerous. Once Zhao Tao made his move, it would be even more perilous.
Thus, he unleashed his full force in a Geng Metal Finger towards Zhao Tao.
Whoosh!
A golden beam of energy slashed through the sky like lightning, hurtling towards Zhao Tao.
Seeing this, Zhao Tao’s mouth curled into a cold smirk, summoning a mass of black thread.
The black thread expanded dramatically into a dense black net, spanning a yard wide, swirling a gray whirlwind to meet the Geng Metal Finger.
This black net was a mid-grade magical artifact, both offensive and defensive, purchased at great cost.
Activated by his sixth-level Qi Cultivation, it couldn’t be matched by a mere spell.
Zhao Tao’s face was feral, seemingly seeing Xu Ping wrapped by the net, turning into a pool of blood in an instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 18: Spoils of War
chapters.content:
Chapter 18: Chapter 18: Spoils of War
However, something unexpected happened to Zhao Tao.
Boom!
The Geng Metal Finger fiercely collided with the incoming black net, Spiritual Qi surged, and with a loud explosion, the black net was blasted apart, its light dimming slightly.
Zhao Tao’s face changed dramatically; he never expected his magical artifact to be so fragile, shattered by a single strike.
"This is impossible!" Zhao Tao was incredulous, wanting to retreat but it was already too late.
Xu Ping naturally would not let him go easily, seizing the opportunity to launch several Geng Metal Fingers, closing in.
In a panic, Zhao Tao pulled out several talismans and stuck them on himself.
Bang!
The outermost golden protective shield quickly shattered under the continued blows of the Geng Metal Finger, bursting like a soap bubble.
"Lv Liu, save me!" Zhao Tao shouted in fear, hastily retreating.
Lv Liu’s pretty face changed dramatically, without hesitation she launched several talismans.
In an instant, several fireballs and Wind Blades appeared out of thin air, rushing towards Xu Ping.
Xu Ping calmly stuck several talismans on himself.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Fireballs and Wind Blades hit Xu Ping’s protective shields like a storm, but even after continuous impacts, they only broke one layer of shield, leaving two more untouched.
"Die!"
Xu Ping roared angrily.
Bang!
A golden streak shot through the air, directly breaking Zhao Tao’s last protective shield, penetrating his chest like lightning, leaving a gaping hole as blood spurted out, staining the ground red.
A hint of reluctance flashed in his eyes, his lips moved slightly as if wanting to say something, but he had no strength left to speak, finally collapsing onto the ground.
"Zhao Tao!" Lv Liu exclaimed in horror, fear surged into her heart like a tide.
She never expected things to unfold like this; Xu Ping was so powerful, having just broken through the fourth layer of Qi Cultivation, yet he effortlessly dealt with both of them, easily killing Zhao Tao, plunging her into deep despair.
"Did you enjoy this fight?" Xu Ping coldly looked at Lv Liu.
Lv Liu’s heart trembled, she lost the will to fight, and without hesitating, broke through the window to escape, not even having time to recall her magical artifact.Google seaʀᴄh NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
"Trying to escape?" Xu Ping sneered coldly, his gaze like a blade, flicking his finger, a flash of golden energy shot out, instantly breaking her foot.
"Ah!" Accompanied by a painful scream, Lv Liu fell to the ground, clutching her injured ankle, her face full of fear and disbelief.
She looked up at Xu Ping, a hint of pleading in her eyes, "Please, spare my life, I’m willing to..."
Her dress slipped from her fragrant shoulder, revealing her snow-white skin and proud bosom.
But before she could finish her sentence, Xu Ping’s Geng Metal Finger fired once again, golden light flashing, aimed directly at her head.
Bang!
Her head exploded like a watermelon, blood splattering, brain matter flying, dyeing the entire room with a layer of crimson.
The world suddenly fell silent, with deafening silence.
Looking at Lv Liu’s headless corpse, falling to the ground, blood gushing.
Xu Ping felt very calm.
Not as excited and tense as last time.
However, his gaze gradually became complex.
"Damn, the prettier the woman, the more deceitful!"
Xu Ping couldn’t help but curse.
If it weren’t for him breaking through to the fourth layer of Qi Cultivation, if it weren’t for practicing the "Nourishing Life Skill", he would probably be dead by now.
Xu Ping took a deep breath to suppress his thoughts, approaching the corpses, skillfully starting to loot.
After half a cup of tea, Xu Ping hurriedly left Zhao Tao’s house.
Before long, he arrived home safely.
He went inside, closed the door.
His mind completely relaxed, after a brief rest, Xu Ping placed down the spoils of the battle.
The most valuable should be Zhao Tao’s mid-grade magical artifact, the black net, and Lv Liu’s lower-grade magical artifact, the flying shuttle.
Qi Cultivators don’t have Divine Sense, only Spiritual Sense for inner vision.
Limited by Spiritual Sense and mana.
For example, early-stage Qi Cultivators can control one lower-grade magical artifact at most, mid-stage can control two lower-grade artifacts or one mid-grade artifact, and late-stage can only manipulate two mid-grade artifacts or four lower-grade artifacts.
Of course, some elite disciples of top sects, with abundant mana and powerful Spiritual Sense, at late-stage can even barely manage an upper-grade magical artifact.
But top-grade artifacts are entirely the realm of Foundation Establishment Cultivators.
This black net is sufficient for him to use until late-stage Qi Cultivation.
But currently, the power of the Geng Metal Finger is too strong, its usage too convenient, causing him to not habitually use magical artifacts during battles.
"Forget it, better to have than not." Xu Ping kept the black net and flying shuttle, then took out the two’s storage bags.
Spending a little while removing the mana imprint on them.
The storage bags opened, his eyes instantly lit up.
"These two... are loaded!"
Inside their storage bags, the Spirit Stones totaled over eighty pieces.
It’s just unknown how many of these Spirit Stones were obtained from hunting others.
"Got money again!"
Xu Ping chuckled, pocketing the Spirit Stones one by one.
Then, he turned his gaze to several silver flying needles in the storage bag.
Xue Ping certainly knew the power of these Soul-Breaking Needles, he almost fell victim to them.
Interested, he kept them, thinking they’d be handy for future ambushes.
Lastly, only some Spirit Medicine, pills, talismans, books, and other miscellaneous items remained.
Xu Ping sorted them all one by one, storing them carefully.
"Huh? What’s this?"
At this moment, Xu Ping found another unexpected find.
A rolled-up piece of sheepskin.
Xu Ping unrolled the sheepskin and carefully examined its contents.
It turns out it records the recipes for three types of Spirit Wine.
The first Spirit Wine is called ’Fasting Wine’, similar in effect to a Fasting Pill, can be consumed as Spirit Food; a sip can sustain you for three days without water or food.
The second Spirit Wine is called ’Beauty Nourishing Wine’, beneficial for qi nourishment and enhancing beauty.
The last one is ’Hundred Flowers Brew’, which enhances qi and blood, strengthening physique.
"Great stuff!"
Xu Ping’s eyes lit up, although the first two Spirit Wines aren’t very useful for him, the last one is of great value.
The ’Qi Nourishing Skill’ currently increases only by one each day, the progress is indeed slow.
If he gets the last one, the progress might speed up!
Xu Ping took a closer look at the ingredients required for ’Hundred Flowers Brew’—the other Spirit Medicines and Spirit Fruits are all common items, but it requires a special Gu insect called Hundred Flowers Gu.
Hundred Flowers Gu secretes a unique liquid that can decompose and ferment all Spirit Medicines and Spirit Fruits into Spirit Wine.
The quality of the Hundred Flowers Gu also determines the potency and properties of the Hundred Flowers Brew.
"The Hundred Flowers Gu, huh? That’s interesting." Xu Ping stored the sheepskin, intending to start crafting the Hundred Flowers Gu when he had time.
The sheepskin describes, the crafting process for such Hundred Flowers Gu is not difficult, as long as one has a bit of talent in Insect Refining, even the first-time attempt has a decent success rate.
Out of ten tries, at least one or two are likely to succeed.
After all, the Hundred Flowers Gu only counts as a low-level Gu insect, it wouldn’t be overly difficult.
"I can certainly master it!" Xu Ping was full of confidence.
Even if his talent isn’t up to par, with a proficient panel, how could he not succeed?

chapters.title: Chapter 19: Ferry Ticket
chapters.content:
Chapter 19: Chapter 19: Ferry Ticket
After securing the parchment scroll, only two lonely green wooden tokens remained on the table.
"What is this thing?"
Xu Ping was puzzled; he had never seen such an item and had no idea what the wooden token was for.
He picked up the wooden token and tried to infuse it with a trace of Mana.
Buzz!
The black bead embedded in the middle of the wooden token emitted a gentle glow, and some information appeared automatically.
’Longevity Ship Ticket’
’Destination: Longevity City’
’Boarding Time: September 18th’
"This is... a ticket to leave Dongwu Market!!" Xu Ping was overjoyed, his heart racing.
Dongwu Market was extremely dangerous now.
Beast tide, malevolent spirits, and rogue cultivators made people’s scalps tingle.
He had long wanted to leave this godforsaken place, but tickets were hard to come by!
He had not expected to acquire two tickets at once.
"This must be what Zhao Tao exchanged Contribution Points for by hunting Demon Beasts, but to exchange for two tickets, most likely others had become Zhao Tao’s victims."
Xu Ping felt a chill, wondering how many had become victims of the two of them.
"Ah, people’s hearts are unpredictable!"
"These people’s acting skills are superb, completely unreadable." Xu Ping sighed helplessly.
He then turned his attention back to the ship tickets.
The boarding time and destination were very clear.
It was August 7th now, with forty-one days left until the boarding time.
The destination Longevity City, although Xu Ping had never been there, he had heard of it.
A city built at the foot of the Longevity Sect’s mountain.
Its scale was much larger than Dongwu Market.
"But there are two tickets, and I only need one. If I sell one of them, I’d make a fortune."
A thought struck Xu Ping, and he silently put away the two wooden tokens.
These tickets were not registered, whoever held them could board the ship.
The price was two hundred Spirit Stones each, but if he were to sell one, the price would have to be a bit lower.
However, even if he sold it for a bit less, selling it for a hundred or so Spirit Stones would not be a problem.
The question was who to sell it to.
He didn’t know anyone who could afford a ship ticket.
"I should go to the market to see if I can sell it, and while I’m at it, buy a Magic Sword." Xu Ping thought to himself.
Buying a Magic Sword wasn’t just for show. The main thing was that, with a Magic Sword, he could start practicing swordsmanship.
...
...
Three days later.
A burly man with a face full of scars walked out of Xu Ping’s room.
This appearance was altered by Xu Ping using the ’Nourishing Life Skill’.
As he improved in the ’Nourishing Life Skill’, he discovered some tricks, like moving bones and changing appearances.
This time, since the ticket he wanted to sell was quite valuable, he opted for caution.
...
In the early morning, the market was sparsely populated, yet to reach the busiest time of day.
Without lingering in the market, Xu Ping headed straight for the ’Hundred Treasures Tower’.
’Hundred Treasures Tower’ dealt in all kinds of cultivation-related items.
If he wanted to sell the ship ticket, it was clearly the best choice.
Upon entering the Hundred Treasures Tower, an attendant immediately approached: "What can I help you with, fellow cultivator?"
"Get your Shopkeeper, I have something to sell." Xu Ping’s voice was hoarse, his manner rough, and he exuded a trace of Evil Qi!
"Alright, please wait a moment!"
The attendant hurriedly went to the back to get the Shopkeeper.
Although the visitor was only at the fourth level of Qi Cultivation, given the current relentless beast tides, he might have something good.
It wasn’t long before a male cultivator, dressed in purple robes, came out. Around forty years old, with a plump face full of kind laughter:
"What does fellow cultivator wish to sell? I’m Qiao Yue, one of the Shopkeepers of Hundred Treasures Tower. May I take a look?"
"It’s not convenient here." Xu Ping said deeply.
Qiao Yue’s eyes narrowed slightly, then he cheerfully invited Xu Ping into a room.
The room was traditionally decorated, with a carpet laid on the floor, and all necessary items were present.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
Qiao Yue closed the door, invited Xu Ping to sit, and had the attendant pour a cup of hot tea for Xu Ping.
"I wonder what fellow cultivator plans to sell?" Qiao Yue asked.
"A Longevity Sect ship ticket." Xu Ping didn’t waste time, showing the wooden token with a blank expression.
"A ship ticket?"
Qiao Yue was slightly taken aback, quickly picking up the wooden token to inspect it closely. Finally, he nodded, "It’s indeed a Longevity Sect ship ticket!"
"This ticket... how does the guest intend to sell it?" Qiao Yue asked with a smile.
"Originally, a ship ticket was priced at two hundred Spirit Stones. I’m selling it a bit cheaper, one hundred and eighty Spirit Stones." Xu Ping said coldly.
"That’s expensive." Qiao Yue shook his head. "Tickets with fixed times like this aren’t easy to sell, and there are only forty days left. If it doesn’t sell, it could be stuck in your hands."
"Then name your price."
"Ninety Spirit Stones."
"Shopkeeper Qiao, are you joking?" Xu Ping frowned.
This was entirely beyond his expectations.
"I wouldn’t joke with a customer. Tickets with fixed times have always been like this, and the closer to the expiration, the lower the price. Think it over carefully."
Qiao Yue leisurely picked up his teacup and sipped, showing no urgency.
Xu Ping naturally didn’t trust this nonsense; he understood the principle of no merchant without greed.
After another round of bargaining, they finally settled at one hundred and five Spirit Stones.
This price was almost half of normal, but there was no other way.
Qiao Yue did have a point; the closer the expiry, the lower the ticket price.
In a hurry to sell, Xu Ping had to accept a loss.
After the transaction, Xu Ping did not take all the Spirit Stones. He spent fifty-five Spirit Stones with Qiao Yue to buy some herbs required for the ’Nourishing Life Skill’ and a bottle of Qi Nourishing Pills.
Elder Yan didn’t prepare many herbs, and they were almost used up, so he needed to restock.
The benefits of practicing the ’Nourishing Life Skill’ were already evident to him.
He couldn’t just give up like that.
As for the Qi Nourishing Pills, having experienced rapid cultivation, he couldn’t tolerate the previous slow pace.
"Farewell!"
Once the transaction was completed, Xu Ping left immediately.
"Safe journey."
Qiao Yue escorted Xu Ping out of the Hundred Treasures Tower with a smile, saluting as he watched Xu Ping leave.
...
After leaving the Hundred Treasures Tower, Xu Ping disguised himself and sold off all his unused herbs and Magical Artifacts at the market stalls.
He only kept one Turtle Spirit Armor and a black net.
He was busy from morning until afternoon.
In total, he made a profit of over sixty Spirit Stones.
Afterward, he went to the Hundred Refining Workshop and spent ninety-eight Spirit Stones to finally acquire the Magic Sword he had longed for.
Xu Ping tested the Magic Sword in his hand and grew more fond of it.
The Magic Sword was named Qinghe, entirely green, weighing over twenty pounds, more than enough for his current physique.
Though Xu Ping hadn’t practiced swordsmanship, holding the Magic Sword gave him a hint of a Sword Cultivator’s demeanor.
It’s true what they say, clothes make the man, just like a saddle makes the horse.
But his previously over two hundred Spirit Stones were now less than one hundred.
"Ah, Spirit Stones spend quickly!" Xu Ping sighed.
Yet his spending spree wasn’t over.
He hadn’t bought the materials needed to craft the Hundred Flowers Gu insect.
Among them, the most crucial was a Gu insect called the Polar Insect.

chapters.title: Chapter 20: Sword Practice
chapters.content:
Chapter 20: Chapter 20: Sword Practice
Loose Cultivator Market.
Xu Ping strolled around and finally discovered Polar Insects at a stall.
The Polar Insect was about the size of a pinky finger, pure white all over, similar to the silkworm pupae from his past life.
"How much are these Polar Insects?" Xu Ping inquired.
"One Spirit Stone for two," replied the stall owner, a chubby middle-aged man.
"Then I’ll take sixty," Xu Ping nodded; the price was indeed the market price.
"Alright!" The stall owner’s eyes lit up—a big customer!
"Here, hold on to these," the stall owner cheerfully wrapped the Polar Insects and handed them to Xu Ping.
After Xu Ping paid the Spirit Stones and collected the Polar Insects, he left the market.
...
By the time he got home, it was already late.
Xu Ping placed the items he purchased neatly.
The wine-making jar was placed in the corner.
"According to the sheepskin book, refining the ’Hundred Flowers Gu’ isn’t hard, but the process must be extremely careful."
"I’ll leave it for tomorrow and start then."
"Once the Hundred Flowers Gu is refined, the rest will be simple. When the Spirit Wine is brewed, if I can’t finish it, I can always sell the wine."
"When I reach Longevity City, I’ll slowly earn Spirit Stones with the Spirit Rain Skill and Spirit Wine; life there won’t be worse than now."
Xu Ping poured himself a glass of plain water, sat comfortably in a chair, and took a satisfied sip.
Thinking about life after leaving the Dongwu Market made him feel lighter all over.
Longevity City, the city beneath the Longevity Sect’s mountain, was far safer than Dongwu Market.
What he needed most now was time to develop.
...
...
The full moon was bright as snow, casting a silver glow across the sky.
Lying in bed, Xu Ping tossed and turned, unable to sleep for some reason, so he simply got up.
"Well, I’ll practice swordsmanship for a while," he said, taking out the Qinghe Sword from his storage pouch.
Perhaps practicing swordsmanship would tire him out and make him want to sleep.
The swordsmanship recorded in the "Nourishing Life Skill" was the "Flowing Cloud Swordsmanship," which he had thoroughly familiarized himself with over time.
The Flowing Cloud Swordsmanship emphasized the word "flow," with sword moves like flowing water, continuous and integrated in attack and defense.
Xu Ping swung the long sword, with sword light flickering and the sound of flowing water seeming to echo in the air.
Initially, his movements were still a bit stiff, and the sword moves lacked fluidity, but as time went on, he gradually found his rhythm.
The sword light flickered, and the sound of flowing water seemed to reverberate in the air.
Xu Ping’s sword moves became smoother, like real flowing water, continuous and unbroken.
His mood gradually calmed down, casting away all worries and anxieties.
In this moment, he seemed to enter a state of self-forgetfulness, becoming one with his sword.
Each sword strike was a form of catharsis, a release.
His movements grew more skillful, and the sword moves became increasingly exquisite.
He didn’t know how much time had passed.
Xu Ping awoke from this state.
"Hiss!"
Even with his current physique, he felt every part of his body was sore and limp, his entire body drenched as if soaked in water, with muscles twitching unnaturally.
Xu Ping sheathed the Qinghe Sword, staggered over to the table, and took a jug of water for a hearty drink.
The cold water slid down his throat into his stomach, and he finally felt alive again.
Gasping for air, he looked outside and noticed the morning light had already cast over the land.The most update n0vels are published on
"I actually practiced swordsmanship for so long?" Xu Ping was quite astonished.
Immersing himself in swordsmanship, he thought only a few minutes had passed, not realizing it was already daylight.
"No wonder those cultivation realm big shots go into seclusion for years or even decades.
When you start cultivating, you really lose all track of time."
Xu Ping felt sticky, with sweat soaking his clothes and sticking uncomfortably to his skin.
He decided to take a bath.
In his underwear, he went to the small courtyard.
Drew a bucket of cold water from the well.
Had a refreshing wash to clean off the sweat on his body.
Back in the wooden cabin, Xu Ping changed into fresh underwear and threw on a gray hemp robe.
He opened his proficiency panel.
[Flowing Cloud Swordsmanship Entry Level: 22/100]
"It actually increased by twenty-two proficiency points!" Xu Ping was astonished as he looked at the data displayed on the panel.
While practicing swordsmanship, he was aware that proficiency would rise significantly, but he never expected such a dramatic increase.
This was his first time experiencing such significant improvement.
"Could it be that I’m actually a prodigy in swordsmanship?" Xu Ping couldn’t help but have this thought cross his mind.
The more he thought about it, the more possible it seemed, and his mood brightened.
"Perhaps one day, I could become a Sword Cultivator too!" Xu Ping thought joyfully.
Becoming a Sword Cultivator isn’t something achieved by just practicing any sword art.
Sword Dao has four stages: Sword Qi Thunder Sound, Sword Light Like a Rainbow, Sword Rainbow Division, Sword Intent Formation.
At the very least, one must comprehend Sword Qi Thunder Sound to be called a Sword Cultivator.
Sword Cultivators, as the most potent combatants in the Cultivation Realm, can challenge superior levels as simply as drinking water.
However, even the first stage of Sword Dao, Sword Qi Thunder Sound, is typically only comprehended by Foundation Establishment Cultivators with a talent for swordsmanship; Qi Cultivators who comprehend it are incredibly rare, with perhaps one appearing in decades or a century.
If a Qi Refining Realm practitioner can comprehend it, they are considered a peerless genius in Sword Dao.
Those sects of the Golden Core and even the Nascent Soul realm would compete to accept them as disciples.
So even with Xu Ping’s talent in Sword Dao and the help of the proficiency panel, he could merely say he might have a chance at understanding it.
...
...
The next day.
The scorching sun hung high.
The sweltering sunlight bathed the earth, and the air was filled with oppressive heat.
"It’s too difficult, refining the Hundred Flowers Gu Insect is really too challenging!" Xu Ping slumped in his chair, his eyes vacant as he stared at the bodies of over a dozen Polar Insects on the table.
He didn’t expect that his lack of talent in insect refining was so striking.
