```
In just one morning, he had already killed ten Polar Insects.
In other words, he had already failed ten times.
Others might have given up by now, for with such a lack of talent in insect refining, one might as well bid farewell to Gu insect refining for life.
But Xu Ping wasn’t one to give up easily, especially when he had the proficiency panel.
Once he succeeded just once, he could grind it out from there.
"I refuse to believe I can’t do it, let’s go again!" Xu Ping gathered himself, took out another Polar Insect, and placed it in a jar full of powder.
The jar’s powder consisted of various Spirit Medicines.
The key to refining the Hundred Flowers Gu was to have the Polar Insect consume all the Spirit Medicine in the jar, thus completing its evolution.
However, unfortunately, the Polar Insect was an extraordinarily lazy Gu insect.
If it took a bite or two, it was already doing you a favor.
To expect it to seize the initiative and complete the evolution was nothing more than a pipe dream.
Hence, this was when mana stimulation was needed, making it eat heartily.
The difficulty lay in this: if overly stimulated, the Polar Insect might not stop and eat itself to death, but if the stimulation was too weak, the effect would barely show.
Xu Ping took a deep breath, closely watching the Polar Insect, and cautiously extended his index finger, slowly releasing mana to stimulate it.

chapters.title: Chapter 21: Flowing Cloud Sword Mastery
chapters.content:
Chapter 21: Chapter 21: Flowing Cloud Sword Mastery
The previously motionless Polar Insect began to move, slowly opening its mouth to swallow the powder.
One minute, two minutes... the seventh minute... Suddenly, there was a slight sound, and the Polar Insect’s belly exploded.
"Again!" Xu Ping, expressionless, took out another Polar Insect.
Ten minutes later... Failure!
"Again..."
Time passed as Xu Ping continued to fail repeatedly.
Evening.
The golden sunset cast through the window onto Xu Ping’s tense face. A drop of sweat slid across his forehead, but he didn’t dare to wipe it.
He was completely focused, staring at the Polar Insect, while the mana from his index finger steadily and continuously flowed.
In the jar, the previously pure white Polar Insect began to show patterns on its body, and as the feeding continued, the patterns multiplied.
Suddenly, the Polar Insect stopped eating and emitted a clear sound, resembling a weakened cicada’s chirp, as its entire body became covered with patterns.
"Suc...success!!" Xu Ping’s heart raced with excitement.
After enduring more than twenty failures, he finally succeeded.
Xu Ping opened the panel.
[Hundred Flowers Gu Entry Level: 5/100]
Looking at the data on the panel, he couldn’t help but feel like crying!The source of this content ɪs NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
"It’s not easy!"
Thankfully, he had the skill panel. Without it and given his poor insect refining talent, he probably wouldn’t achieve insect refining in this lifetime or the next.
"Let’s continue tomorrow, I’m truly exhausted today." Xu Ping shut the panel, planning to fill his stomach first.
He was extremely hungry, especially since cultivating the ’Nourishing Life Skill’ made him feel hungrier faster in a day.
...
Late night.
Bedroom.
Xu Ping swallowed a Qi Nourishing Pill.
Sitting cross-legged, he began to circulate the Five Elements Skill, refining the pill.
After more than half an hour, Xu Ping opened his eyes, his gaze falling onto the panel.
[Realm: Qi Cultivation Fourth Level: 4/100; Nourishing Life Skill First Level: 7/100]
[Cultivation Technique: Five Elements Skill Proficient (Fourth Level): 32/400]
"Slowing down!" Xu Ping frowned.
Since he broke through to the Qi Cultivation Fourth Level, the effect of consuming the Qi Nourishing Pill has greatly diminished.
The realm only increased by one point each time, and the cultivation technique increased by only four points.
More importantly, the Spiritual Qi around the market’s outskirts was too sparse. He continuously absorbed Spiritual Qi, always depleting all the surrounding Spiritual Qi and needing quite a while to recover.
This intermittent feeling was truly discomforting.
"Ah, it’s a pity that the houses within the market have all been rented out, otherwise I could move there." Xu Ping sighed.
"Endure for another month or so, then I can leave this dreary place."
The plan now was to just hold on for a bit longer; once he moved to Longevity City, things would be better.
...
...
Three days later.
Scorching sun.
The blazing sunlight was like an invisible layer of fire roasting the earth.
Xu Ping, bare-chested, was digging in the bedroom.
Soon, a big pit was dug.
He walked to the corner of the bedroom, gently cradling a few wine jars, cautiously placing them into the pit, afraid of damaging his hard work.
This was the ’Hundred Flowers Brew’ he painstakingly crafted, investing so much effort and Spirit Stones; if it failed, he’d be heartbroken!
Over the past three days, Xu Ping successfully refined eight Hundred Flowers Gu insects.
Though the Hundred Flowers Gu insect was on the list, its success rate wasn’t very high.
Entry Level was merely the foundation; proficiency was when true advancement occurred.
Then, the success rate would greatly improve.
Xu Ping picked up the last jar of wine, scrutinized it, and solemnly buried it.
The Hundred Flowers Gu insects would decompose Spirit Medicine and Spirit Fruit, fermenting them into Spirit Wine, taking about twenty days.
Quietly wait for more than twenty days, then it’ll be ready to savor!
Xu Ping exhaled deeply, wiped the sweat from his forehead, came to the table, and drank a mouthful of cold water.
"I wonder what the effect of the Hundred Flowers Brew is? If the effect isn’t good, then it’s a waste of Spirit Stones and labor."
"Forget it, no point worrying; I’ll know naturally after the breakthrough, practice swordsmanship, practice swordsmanship!"
Ever since realizing his talented affinity for swordsmanship, Xu Ping’s addiction to practicing swords grew immensely; each day, he spent most of his time practicing.
In just a few days, he had broken through to the proficient level.
...
...
Time passes quietly.
Xu Ping spent every day at home, almost never going out, nor socializing.
Aside from eating and sleeping, he constantly practiced various skills.
Such peaceful yet fulfilling days truly put one’s mind at ease.
The only downside was the Demon Beasts intruding into the market city had greatly increased, incidents of Demon Beast attacks happened almost daily.
Some rogue cultivators took the opportunity to commit evil, massacring many people.
The market city’s safety environment began to rapidly deteriorate, everyone felt insecure.
Reluctantly, the Longevity Sect had to organize personnel to sweep away the Demon Beasts, and maintain safety.
But facing the raging beast tide, the effects were limited.
...
That day.
At home.
Xu Ping wielded his sword single-handedly, demonstrating the Flowing Cloud Sword techniques, each move fluid and natural.
His posture, like flowing water, was agile, and the sword edge cut through the air with a clear sound of breaking wind, resonating sharply in the quiet woods.
His movements grew faster, sword shadows overlapping, resembling a cloud floating around him.
At this moment, his mind fully immersed itself in swordsmanship, deepening comprehension of the Flowing Cloud Sword techniques, capturing every subtle change in detail.
Suddenly, Xu Ping felt a strange power surging within him, as if he was breaking through an invisible barrier.
He slashed out a sword strike, its brilliance like lightning splitting the bed before him.
Boom!
The bed was split in two.
Xu Ping emerged from the marvelous state, opened his eyes, breathing slightly heavier.
Eagerly, he opened the proficiency panel.
[Flowing Cloud Sword Proficient: 1/400]
"Proficient!" Xu Ping smiled at the corners of his mouth.
"I truly am a genius with swordsmanship; soon the proficiency of the Flowing Cloud Sword will catch up to the Geng Metal Finger."
"With my current Body Refining first level strength plus proficient level Flowing Cloud Sword, I should be able to match a Qi Cultivation Fourth Level practitioner."
Xu Ping twirled the sword elegantly before placing it into his storage bag.
Gurgle...
His stomach rumbled thunderously.
Although he had eaten not long ago, the energy consumption from practicing the ’Nourishing Life Skill’ was enormous, and he was hungry again.
Xu Ping went to the kitchen and stewed a large pot of Demon Beast Flesh, devouring it alongside Spirit Rice.
Delicious!
Soon the large pot of Demon Beast Flesh was finished.
After eating and drinking to his fill, Xu Ping lazily lounged in the chair, not wanting to move.
At this moment.
Thump thump thump....
The sound of rough knocking came from the door.
"Anyone there? Open the door quickly!"
Xu Ping was startled; the voice was somewhat unfamiliar.
Upon opening the door, two cultivators in Longevity Sect attire stood at the entrance.
Xu Ping froze for a moment before respectfully asking, "May I ask, what business do you have with me, esteemed cultivators from the sect?"
One of the Longevity Sect cultivators, expressionless, said, "The beast tide at Dongwu Market is surging now, requiring deployment of personnel from the Longevity Sect main branch to protect your safety. Naturally, this protection won’t be free."
"Hence, everyone needs to hand over eight Spirit Stones."
"Eight Spirit Stones?"
Xu Ping gasped; that was equivalent to his previous year’s earnings.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 22: Geng Metal Finger Perfection
chapters.content:
Chapter 22: Chapter 22: Geng Metal Finger Perfection
"Of course, if you choose to join the patrol group, not only do you not have to pay eight Spirit Stones, but you can also receive Spirit Stones," another person added.
For Xu Ping, only if his brain malfunctioned would he join the patrol group.
Eight Spirit Stones naturally weren’t much for him at this point.
Yet Xu Ping pretended reluctantly and pulled out eight Spirit Stones.
After receiving the Spirit Stones, the two didn’t linger and went directly to the next house.
Watching the two gradually walk away, Xu Ping thought to himself, "It seems the situation is becoming more dangerous, lacking manpower, they’re even using this method to recruit people into the patrol group."
"But this has nothing to do with me anymore; in just a few days, I’ll be able to leave this place."
...
Not long after the two Longevity Sect members left, Old Man Lu came over to visit.
As soon as they met, he clung to Xu Ping’s leg, wailing loudly, "Last time I spent Spirit Stones on an Exorcism Talisman, and now I have to pay protection fees again. How am I going to live in the coming days!"
"Stop, stop!"
"I’m in the same boat."
Xu Ping felt a headache from his shouting.
"But...you made so much before," Old Man Lu said tearfully.
Xu Ping couldn’t help but roll his eyes, "Didn’t you see that I’m already at mid-stage Qi Cultivation?"
Old Man Lu was left speechless and could only leave dejectedly.
...
Night deepened.
In the bedroom.
Xu Ping’s fingertip trembled slightly, a golden energy beam shot out like lightning, almost piercing through the wall.
The next second, the pure golden Geng Metal energy traced a long arc in the bedroom, pierced through the window, and instantly penetrated the large tree outside.
"The Geng Metal Finger at the Perfection Level is truly extraordinary!" Xu Ping beamed with joy.
Originally, his Geng Metal Finger could only move straight.
Unexpectedly, after breaking through to the Perfection Level, it could now make turns.
This undoubtedly made his attack methods more versatile.
Using it to ambush people would definitely yield surprising effects.
First, deliberately shoot slightly off-target, then make a sharp turn, making it absolutely unguardable.
"It’s just a pity that Perfection is already the highest level, I can’t grind further," Xu Ping looked at his panel with some regret in his heart.
[Geng Metal Finger Perfection: ∞]
"Perhaps I should learn a new magic," Xu Ping pondered to himself.
His time was very limited nowadays, spending at least two or three hours on cultivating Five Elements Skill and Qi Nourishing Skill.
Then there was sword practice, which took at least three or four hours; the remaining time was very scarce.
After all, with his current cultivation, he still needed to sleep and eat.
Geng Metal Finger was practiced whenever he could find the time.
Now that Geng Metal Finger has reached Perfection, he could barely learn another magic.
He decided to get to work immediately.
Xu Ping went to his desk and took out a yellowed book from his storage bag.
This was obtained from the storage bags of Zhao Tao and his partner.
Some magic was recorded in it.
Previously, when he was at Qi Cultivation Level 3, there weren’t many spells he could learn. Now, having broken through to Level 4, there were more options to choose from.
"Need to learn Fireball Technique, useful for destroying evidence, but no need for mastery, just adequate will do."
"Five Thunders Skill, unfortunately, is a First Rank Upper Grade spell, I can’t train in it for now."
"Hemostasis Skill..."
...
Xu Ping perused it for a while, eventually deciding on a magic called Light Body Technique.
Light Body Technique is a magic that increases one’s speed.
With his current Body Refining cultivation combined with the Flowing Cloud Swordsmanship, he’s already powerful, and if paired with Light Body Technique, it would definitely enhance his strength to another level.
It was just perfect for him.
After memorizing the essentials of Light Body Technique, Xu Ping coordinated with his Spiritual Power and quickly formed hand seals.
He silently chanted: ’Light Body Technique.’
The next instant, he radiated a glow.
But the glow only flashed for a second before extinguishing abruptly.
"Spiritual Power didn’t match up with the hand seals; next time, slow down," Xu Ping summed up his failure, and continued to try.
Cultivators rarely use magic to fight.
One reason is its difficulty in learning, another is the complexity of casting spells.
Normally, hand seals and Spiritual Power need to work in concert.
In some cases, even chants are needed in addition.
For a First Rank Lower Grade magic like Geng Metal Finger, it’s easy to learn but incredibly hard to master, and in a cultivator’s combat, it’s far less direct and convenient than talismans and magical artifacts.
But for Xu Ping, none of these were issues; as long as he kept practicing, his proficiency would increase, eventually reaching a level where casting spells was like second nature, and the power of the magic would also grow.
Having an exploit is awesome!
...
...
After exploring for a day alone, Xu Ping finally began to grasp the knack of ’Light Body Technique.’
In the evening, as the sunset’s glow filtered through the window and fell upon him, it seemed to add a touch of warmth to his practice.
Xu Ping’s fingers quickly formed seals, accompanied by the surge of Mana.
The next instant.
"Ah!"
With an exclamation, Xu Ping’s body shot out several meters like an arrow from a bow, hitting the wall with a ’bang.’
Fortunately, at the last moment, he adjusted his posture in time; otherwise, the wall might have had a big hole by now.
"Damn, really scared me to death!"
Xu Ping’s heart raced as he stepped back a few paces, dusting off the dirt on him.
With his current physique, he wasn’t hurt; it’s just that the speed amplified by Light Body Technique was somewhat unexpected, making it hard for him to control for an instant.
Xu Ping saw the shadow of himself on the wall, his gaze joyful: "This ’Light Body Technique’ speeds up even better than I imagined!"
Even though his mastery of Light Body Technique was still lacking and the level was not high, it already improved his speed by at least 10%.
If he continued to progress, his speed might be hard to catch with the naked eye.
By then, his strength could see a significant surge!
Xu Ping opened his proficiency panel, his eyes went to Light Body Technique [Light Body Technique Entry Level: 1/100]
"On the board, keep going!."
He silently motivated himself, focused his mind, and continued practicing.
In the small room, Xu Ping’s body moved like an agile breeze, sometimes left, sometimes right, sometimes forward, sometimes backward, or retreating, or rolling.
The pace of practice constantly increased in his heart, and time passed inadvertently.
Until well past midnight, Xu Ping finally stopped, exhausted, with beads of sweat seeping from his forehead.
He quickly took a shower, exhausted but filled with a sense of accomplishment, and eventually collapsed onto the bed, soon falling into a deep sleep.The source of this content ɪs NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
...
...
"Awoo~"
Just as Xu Ping was sleeping groggily, a sudden harsh wolf howl reached his ears.
Xu Ping suddenly awoke.
"Awoo awoo..."
At this moment, a few more wolf howls came, sounding particularly piercing in the silent night.
He frowned; although beast roars were common, this situation seemed a bit unusual this time.
Thinking it over, he quietly left the bedroom and went to the small courtyard outside.
The night was as dark as ink, and the silvery moonlight draped over the ground. An undercurrent of chill threatened the tranquil atmosphere, causing a shiver.
"Awoo howl awoo howl!"
Just then, a few wolf howls came, tearing through the darkness, sounding quite near.
"Wolf demon?"
Xu Ping frowned deeply and it sounded like there might be more than one.
His senses heightened in alertness.

chapters.title: Chapter 23: Foundation Establishment Demon Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 23: Chapter 23: Foundation Establishment Demon Beast
Bang!
At that moment, the courtyard door was suddenly slammed open.
A stranger, bathed in blood, rushed in with a horrified expression, his voice hoarse as he shouted, "Help!"
By his attire, he seemed to be one of the patrolmen.
Before Xu Ping could react, a dark shadow suddenly leaped from behind the courtyard door, swiftly knocking the cultivator to the ground.
It was a wolf beast the size of a calf, its fur bristling, eyes gleaming with a crimson light. It opened its gaping maw and lunged at the cultivator’s left arm, blood splattering instantly.
Damn!
Xu Ping’s heart surged with fury, his blood boiling. Without hesitation, he thrusted a sword finger towards the wolf beast.
A fierce and unstoppable Geng Metal energy ray sliced through the darkness, striking the wolf beast’s head!
The beast let out a low whine upon being hit, blood spraying out wildly, quickly staining the courtyard’s soil red.
However, the ordeal was far from over.
Out of the surrounding darkness, three or four wolf demons suddenly emerged, each covered in black fur, eyes flashing with a fierce light, clearly kin to the wolf beast.
"Awoo....."
They growled lowly, charging towards Xu Ping as if seeking vengeance for their fallen comrade.
Xu Ping’s face darkened as the Qinghe Sword suddenly appeared in his hand.
With a few flashes of sword light, these wolf demons were all quickly decapitated.
Given his current swordsmanship, killing a few First Rank Lower Grade demon beasts posed no threat to him.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
After dealing with the wolf demons and confirming there were no further movements around, Xu Ping approached the cultivator’s body.
His throat had been bitten through by a wolf demon, one arm missing, a vast pool of blood flowing out.
Without a doubt, he was dead.
Facing the corpse, Xu Ping’s expression remained unchanged.
But his heart was restless.
The patrol team usually consisted of ten people, led by a Late-Stage Qi Cultivation cultivator.
Yet, here was only one person.
Had the entire team been wiped out? Or were they unable to resist and scattered in escape?
Whichever reason, it was not good news for Xu Ping.
He crouched down, searching the body for anything useful.
Just then.
Rumble~
The sky suddenly echoed with crackling thunder.
Instinctively, Xu Ping looked up.
He saw a gigantic bird of prey darting among the thunderclouds, as if trying to tear apart the night sky.
"Foul beast!"
At this moment, the array within the market suddenly activated, with two streams of light shooting towards the bird at a stunning speed.
Along with the streams came an aura of immense terror!
"Foundation Establishment cultivators!" Xu Ping’s face revealed astonishment as he thought to himself that things were not looking good.
For two Foundation Establishment cultivators to step in, that beast had to be a Second-stage Demon Beast.
"Are you kidding me? How did a Second-stage Demon Beast show up!" Xu Ping felt bitter inside.
In a few days, he was supposed to leave; couldn’t things just stay quiet?
Because of the distance and the night sky.
Xu Ping couldn’t clearly see the specifics of the battle.
But even from so far, he could sense the intensity of the battlefield.
Waves of terrifying power continuously surged from the center of the battle.
Even standing this far away, Xu Ping still felt a tingling sensation on his scalp.
Yet, in the face of this power, he did not feel disheartened, but instead, his gaze grew more vibrant, and his thirst for strength burned ever fiercer.
Just then.
The battlefield seemed to change.
An agonizing screech pierced the sky, making the surrounding air tremble, followed by a radiant orb like the sun exploding.
The intense light made Xu Ping squint momentarily.
The orb appeared quickly and disappeared just as fast.
In an instant, the orb vanished, and darkness reclaimed the surroundings.
A moment later.
Two escape lights ascended into the sky, finally merging into the market.
"Luckily, the Foundation Establishment cultivators won." Xu Ping quietly breathed a sigh of relief.
If the demon beasts had won, losing the protection of the Foundation Establishment cultivators over Dongwu Market would have likely led to its destruction.
He wasn’t sure he would survive.
"Let’s hope for some peace in the coming days." Xu Ping sighed helplessly, cleaning the Demon Beast Flesh before turning to enter the house.
In front of Foundation Establishment cultivators and Second-stage Demon Beasts, he was still too weak.
...
...
Inside a luxurious house within the market.
"Senior Brother Qing, that demon bird appearing at night wasn’t ordinary. Even though it’s only early Second-stage, it managed to escape from us."
"Maybe it has a Demon Core inside, a pity it got away." The young man lamented.
A single Demon Core could easily fetch eight or nine thousand Spirit Stones, and with other demon beast materials, it would be worth over ten thousand Spirit Stones—a significant fortune for them both.
The middle-aged man beside him appeared more composed, speaking slowly, "This demon beast’s bloodline is extraordinary. If we had truly slain it, it might have caused trouble. Scaring it off isn’t too bad."
"What trouble could there be? The sect’s reinforcements will arrive in a few days." The young man was unconcerned.
The middle-aged man didn’t say more, just shook his head helplessly.
Guarding a market close to the wilderness, stability was key.
He’s still too young; he’ll understand after a few setbacks.
...
Night was as dark as ink.
In the wilderness, a loud bird cry echoed in all directions, carrying a mysterious undertone.
Like an aggrieved child outside, calling for its parents.
A moment later, a terrifying pressure soared from deep within the wilderness.
Instantly, the demon beasts in the wilderness—fighting, running, feeding—crouched and trembled, not daring to move.
...
This night was destined to be a sleepless one.
The battle between the Longevity Sect’s Foundation Establishment cultivators and the Second-stage Demon Beast was witnessed by almost everyone in the market.
The sheer oppression left them still feeling a tingling in their scalps.
Although the Foundation Establishment cultivators eventually won, it left countless people anxious and uneasy.
After all, in past beast tides, there were no Second-stage Demon Beasts.
However, there was little they could do, only silently hoping that no more Second-stage Demon Beasts would come, and that the beast tide would fade away.
But reality often doesn’t align with one’s wishes.
Though no more Second-stage Demon Beasts appeared, the beast tide intensified, making the demon hunting teams afraid to venture out.
The pressure on the patrol teams increased sharply, but luckily the Foundation Establishment cultivators intervened, slaughtered a batch of demon beasts, and barely maintained the market’s stability.
...
...
Four days later.
Xu Ping, holding the Qinghe Sword, focused his attention, gently digging in the soil in the corner of his bedroom.
With each shovelful of effort, several ceramic jars gradually became visible.
Seeing this, he couldn’t help but become anxious, fearing he might accidentally damage the Hundred Flowers Brew.
Not until he dug out all the ceramic jars intact did he breathe a sigh of relief.
The Hundred Flowers Brew had been painstakingly made with time and Spirit Stones, and now, finally brewed, he would be heartbroken if he accidentally damaged one.
He put all the other wine jars into his storage bag, leaving only one behind.
Xu Ping opened the lid.
Immediately, a rich aroma of wine and flowers surged into the room like a tide, intoxicating and delightful.
He wasn’t a connoisseur, but it didn’t stop him from praising, "Good wine."

chapters.title: Chapter 24: Hundred Flowers Brew
chapters.content:
Chapter 24: Chapter 24: Hundred Flowers Brew
Xu Ping poured himself a cup and took a sip.
The spicy intensity of the liquor hit him like a blaze straight to the Celestial Spirit.
The aroma of the brew was rich and enticing, yet the taste was unexpectedly strong and fierce.
For those who love liquor, this was truly a fine drink.
Xu Ping finished his bowl of Hundred Flowers Brew in a few gulps, feeling as if a fire had ignited in his stomach, the heat surging within, making his blood boil.
"This liquor... is formidable!"
Sweating profusely, Xu Ping hurriedly approached the wooden barrel in the kitchen.
The barrel was filled with hot water he had prepared beforehand.
He took out a medicinal liquid from his storage bag and poured the entire bottle into the hot water.
Then, he undressed completely and jumped in.
With Xu Ping’s current physique, he was long immune to the temperature of boiling water.
He adeptly practiced the entry-level spell of the first layer of the Nourishing Life Skill, guiding the medicinal liquid throughout his body.Googlᴇ search
A murky green liquid seeped through his pores, nourishing his bones and cleansing his meridians...
At this moment, the medicinal power of the Hundred Flowers Brew also began to take effect, flowing along the meridians and being hungrily absorbed by the cells.
Xu Ping was like being submerged in magma, sweat dripping in large drops from his forehead.
His whole skin was turning a deep red.
The pain from cultivating the Nourishing Life Skill right after drinking the Hundred Flowers Brew was somewhat unexpected for Xu Ping.
Yet it was still slightly less painful than what he endured the first time. He could endure it.
Moreover, as the medicinal power was absorbed, the pain gradually diminished.
After an unknown period,
Xu Ping suddenly felt his entire body lighten, and all the pain and discomfort inside vanished.
He opened his eyes, his gaze falling on the proficiency panel.
[Nourishing Life Skill first layer: 23/100]
"It increased by 3 points in one go!" Xu Ping was overjoyed.
He immediately felt that all the suffering he had gone through was worth it.
Every time he cultivated the Nourishing Life Skill, he only increased by one point, and now it had increased by two-fold!
At this rate, he would break through to the second layer within a month.
"This Hundred Flowers Brew is truly a treasure!" Xu Ping was in high spirits.
He had felt that the Nourishing Life Skill’s progress was slow, but now, with the assistance of the Hundred Flowers Brew, he might catch up with his cultivation before long.
Perhaps even surpassing it entirely wasn’t out of the question!
"But it’s rather expensive, a jar of Hundred Flowers Brew costs about two Spirit Stones, and he would need to drink four or five jars a month, which amounts to around ten Spirit Stones a month."
"Adding the Qi Nourishing Pills and Body Refining herbs, the monthly expense could exceed sixty Spirit Stones."
Thinking of this made Xu Ping’s head ache.
That’s not even including food and other expenses; if added, the basic expenditure a month would be eighty to ninety Spirit Stones.
"Cultivation is truly costly!" he sighed helplessly.
"I wonder if relying on my Spirit Rain Skill and Spirit Wine can earn me that many Spirit Stones a month."
"Never mind, I’ll think about it when I get to Longevity City, a big city should have more opportunities."
"By my reckoning, the flying ship should arrive in about three days."
...
...
Three days passed in the blink of an eye.
Xu Ping got up early and collected all the useful items he had.
Today was September 18th, the day to board the ship.
At last, he could leave this place.
He carefully checked everything for any omissions, and Xu Ping pushed open the door.
At this moment, it was still early, the morning sun rising, casting golden rays across the sky, as if paving a golden path for the new journey he was about to embark on.
He shut the door firmly, with no trace of reluctance, and turned away.
Along the way, Xu Ping saw many houses and sheds reduced to ruins, with traces of blood still evident among the debris.
The chaos of the demon beasts in recent days undoubtedly claimed countless lives.
The scene before him sent a chill through Xu Ping’s heart, prompting him to quicken his pace.
However, upon reaching the market, it was a completely different scene.
It seemed completely unaffected by the beast horde outside, just as bustling as ever.
People came and went on the streets, and businesses thrived in the shops.
Just separated by a wall, the difference was stark.
Xu Ping had no interest in wandering around, so he turned down several streets and directly headed to a Longevity Sect office.
This was the place for signing up to board the ship.
Even though it was early, a long queue had already formed.
Xu Ping lined up patiently at the end.
Fortunately, the ticket inspection was quick, and soon it was his turn.
He handed his ticket to a disciple of the Longevity Sect.
The disciple received it and illuminated it with a magic mirror, and the ticket emitted a faint red light.
"You may enter," the disciple nodded and returned the ticket to Xu Ping.
Xu Ping stored the ticket securely, and followed the crowd to a plaza large enough to accommodate a thousand people without crowding.
Inside the plaza, at least a hundred people were scattered around, with acquaintances chatting with each other, and loners sitting aside meditating.
"There are plenty of wealthy people in the market!" Xu Ping thought in surprise.
Considering that each ticket cost 200 Spirit Stones, that was easily two to three million Spirit Stones.
And that wasn’t counting those who hadn’t arrived yet; if everyone was present, it would be no less than forty or fifty thousand Spirit Stones.
"Monopolizing business is profitable indeed!"
Exclaiming this, Xu Ping found a quiet spot to sit and meditate.
As time passed, more people arrived in the plaza, and the noise grew louder.
"Dad, why are we leaving Dongwu Market? Isn’t this place nice?" a girl’s voice rang out.
"What’s so good about this small place? There’s a beast tide every few years, so it’s not safe. Longevity City offers more opportunities. My path to immortality is bleak, but it’s different for you. You can’t waste your potential in this little place," a middle-aged man said sternly.
"Also, it’s easier to find you a suitable husband in Longevity City, and remember, your first child should bear your surname, we can’t let our family..."
"Dad!" the daughter interrupted her father bashfully before he could finish.
Sitting nearby with his eyes closed, Xu Ping couldn’t help but overhear their conversation.
In truth, he wasn’t trying to eavesdrop, but his hearing was just too keen now.
He glanced over, seeing a demure and graceful young woman, her bright eyes glaring shyly at her father.
"Mo... Mo Ting!?" Xu Ping’s heart raced, nearly causing him to lose control and rush over to the girl.
"No, it’s not her, she just looks similar."
He quickly regained his composure.
After a closer look, the girl was not his past life’s girlfriend, Mo Ting.
Mo Ting had been his childhood friend.
They grew up together, naturally fell in love, and naturally reached the point of discussing marriage.
They even had their wedding venue booked.
But one night she didn’t return from her night shift, and Xu Ping failed to pick her up due to overtime.
On her way home, she was killed by a drunk driver while riding a shared bicycle.

chapters.title: Chapter 25: Golden Core Demon Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 25: Chapter 25: Golden Core Demon Beast
"Alas, I never expected such a person in this world to resemble Mo Ting so closely." Xu Ping sighed inwardly.
The young girl before him looked at least eighty to ninety percent like her.
You couldn’t tell without a careful look.
"Kid, have you looked enough?" The girl’s father glared angrily at Xu Ping.
The girl shyly hid behind her father, avoiding Xu Ping’s gaze.
Xu Ping came to his senses, realizing his impropriety.
Staring at someone’s daughter in front of her father was probably, seemingly, somewhat impolite.
Xu Ping turned his head, awkwardly rubbing his nose.
The girl’s father seemed to want to say a few harsh words.
At that moment, a gigantic shadow enveloped them instantly.
Xu Ping looked up.
In the sky, a massive airship came from the west, just blocking the sun.
This airship was hundreds of feet long, its entire body a pale golden hue, with countless complex and mysterious runes engraved on its surface.
At the ship’s bow, a golden banner fluttered in the wind, flapping loudly!
"So big!"
Xu Ping couldn’t help but be shocked.
With the size of this airship, it could easily accommodate thousands of people.
And at this moment, the girl’s father lost interest in troubling Xu Ping, fixedly staring at the airship.
At this moment, several disciples of the Longevity Sect suddenly appeared, starting to drive away the people in the plaza’s center, clearly to make space for the airship to land.
Suddenly!
Just as the airship was slowly descending, a deafening bird cry suddenly came from the sky, as if tearing through the long sky with a fierce wind, causing people in the plaza to look up, eyes fixed on the azure sky.New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
"What is that?" someone exclaimed.
A huge golden bird, its wings spread like mountains and feathers blazing like flames, was diving toward the marketplace at an incredible speed.
Its eyes were like two blazing suns, exuding an oppressive pressure that made the surrounding air seem to tremble under its momentum.
"What is this?? A Foundation Establishment great demon??" The crowd instantly fell into panic.
But those who truly knew how terrifying this bird was knew it was not a Foundation Establishment demon beast, but clearly a Golden Core demon beast.
The Longevity Sect Foundation Establishment cultivators on the airship screamed in terror, "Quick, activate the protective barrier, run fast."
In fact, without his reminder, the moment the other Longevity Sect disciples sensed something was wrong, they already activated the array on the airship.
The runes on the ship lit up one by one, emanating thousands of bright lights.
Immediately, the airship turned into a beam of spiritual light, soaring into the sky.
However, the golden giant bird was too fast, appearing near the airship in the blink of an eye.
It suddenly dove down, its massive wings sweeping, causing a dense barrage of Wind Blades to appear in the air. The Wind Blades whistled like daggers, piercing the airship’s shield with a deafening roar.
Though the airship’s protective array was activated, under the Golden Core demon beast’s formidable attack, it appeared vulnerable.
"Quick, activate the counter-offensive array!" The Longevity Sect disciples screamed in horror, but it was already too late.
The golden giant bird’s attacks rained down like a storm, and under the intense impact, cracks began to appear on the shield, its light flickering, seemingly on the brink of collapse at any moment.
"Boom!" With a loud crash, the airship’s shield ultimately failed, shattering instantly.
The giant bird’s Wind Blades sliced through the airship’s hull like swords, sending pieces of the airship and countless people within flying apart with a piercing metallic tearing sound and numerous screams. The airship was torn to pieces, becoming a burst of flames, crashing at the edge of the plaza.
"Run! Run!"
Not only the plaza but the entire marketplace descended into chaos, countless people frantically fleeing in all directions.
’Damn it... Why did such a powerful demon beast appear?’ Xu Ping’s face turned pale, quickly getting up to find a safe place.
Destroying an airship effortlessly, this was definitely not some Foundation Establishment demon beast!!
Buzzing!
At this moment, a tremendous wave of spiritual power radiated out, the Second-stage array covering the entire marketplace was activated to its full extent.
But, after all, it was just a Second-stage array, how could it withstand the Golden Core demon fowl’s attack.
"Boom!" Another loud bang, the golden giant bird’s attack came crashing down again. The center of the marketplace’s array was heavily hit, its light instantly dimmed, ultimately exploding, dispersing into specks of spiritual light that vanished into the sky.
"Ah!!"
People’s panic reached its peak, fleeing in all directions, plunging the entire marketplace into chaos.
After breaking the protective grand array, the Golden Core demon fowl gently flapped its wings, landing beside a luxurious building. Its enormous claws easily tore through the building’s twinkling array, grabbing a terrified man.
Upon closer inspection, it was the Foundation Establishment Real Person guarding Dongwu Market!
The Golden Core demon fowl’s claws tightened, the spiritual light on the Foundation Establishment Real Person’s body sparkling like a faint candlelight, attempting to resist, but all efforts proved futile.
It only held on for a moment before the light was crushed, the entire person turning into a mist of blood, dissipating into the air.
After doing all that, the golden giant bird still seemed unsatisfied, its gaze fixed on another luxurious building.
Inside the building, a middle-aged man’s face was filled with horror. He understood this Golden Core demon beast was targeting the two Foundation Establishment cultivators.
"Could it be because of that demon bird that night?" His heart tightened, and without further thought, he could only ride his Escape Light, breaking through the building, turning into a stream of light and escaping far away.
His speed was extremely fast, in just the blink of an eye, he was just a small black dot left.
The golden giant bird’s eyes flashed with a hint of human-like contempt, its wings spread open.
Boom!
It was like a level-eight gale arrived, blowing people left and right.
With its wings spread, the golden giant bird vanished instantly, reappearing beside the middle-aged Foundation Establishment cultivator.
The middle-aged Foundation Establishment wanted to resist, but was easily slain.
"What on earth is this demon beast!!!?"
Countless people screamed in terror, this demon beast was beyond their expectations, the two invincible Foundation Establishment large cultivators in their eyes were easily killed just like that?
"The Foundation Establishment Real Person is dead, the grand array is broken, brothers, wealth is sought in danger!"
A cultivator with his figure concealed had eyes blazing with a blood-red glow, clearly cultivating a sinister cultivation technique. After a cheer of delight, he rushed into an opulent building.
Upon hearing this, countless loose cultivators’ eyes turned red, rushing towards the luxurious building.
All at once, the sounds of slaughter, screams... filled the entire marketplace.
For many loose cultivators, the marketplace chaos was an opportunity they might not even encounter in a lifetime!
If they could seize this opportunity, they might be able to completely change their fate.
"Damn, these people are really risking their lives for money!" Seeing the increasingly chaotic marketplace, Xu Ping couldn’t help but curse quietly.

chapters.title: Chapter 26: Fleeing for One’s Life
chapters.content:
Chapter 26: Chapter 26: Fleeing for One’s Life
The Golden Core demon beast hadn’t even left yet, and these people had already started fighting and robbing each other, more reckless than fugitives.
With his golden finger, a long life was within sight, and he wouldn’t risk something so dangerous for a measly gain.
Xu Ping’s expression was tense as he quickly fled from the market. Now that the Second-stage array was broken, it was the perfect opportunity to escape!
Like Xu Ping, there were also other loose cultivators fleeing, most of them being cautious and prudent.
Whizz whizz!
Xu Ping’s movement technique was like lightning, but he still felt his speed wasn’t fast enough, so he used the Light Body Technique to enhance himself.
With a flash of spiritual light, his speed increased even further.
After running a sufficient distance, he turned back and looked.
He saw the Golden Core demon beast had somehow appeared in the sky above the market. It wasn’t destroying the market anymore.
But there was still a smaller-sized demon bird wreaking havoc in the market.
Countless buildings were recklessly destroyed by it, countless loose cultivators were casually slaughtered by it!
The distant sounds of explosions and screams sent a chill through Xu Ping’s heart.
He was now just thankful for his quick escape and that he wasn’t blinded by greed. Otherwise, he would truly have nowhere to run.
He withdrew his gaze, straining his body to the limit as he fled headlong.
After running a bit farther, Xu Ping suddenly raised an eyebrow.
The sound of fighting came from his right rear direction.
He turned his head and saw, surprisingly, it was the father and daughter he had seen in the square earlier.
At this moment, a late-stage Qi Cultivation and two mid-stage Qi Cultivation men had surrounded the father and daughter, constantly attacking them with magical artifacts.
Yet the father and daughter were only at the fifth and third levels of Qi Cultivation, how could they be a match for these three? They were at risk every moment.
However, the father and daughter seemed to have a surprisingly abundant fortune. Whenever they couldn’t hold on, they would pull out some talismans to fend them off temporarily.
"These two are really rich!" The leader of the late-stage Qi Cultivation men looked extremely excited.
He had almost spent all his spirit stones in trying to break through the late stage of Qi Cultivation. This time he could finally recover well.
"Boss, let’s spare the girl’s life so she can entertain us," the other man ogled the young girl’s body with lecherous eyes.
Hearing this, the girl’s face turned pale, fear spreading in her heart as she imagined the dreadful fate if captured by these three, and her body trembled uncontrollably.
The middle-aged father, seeing the situation, gritted his teeth and took out a dull, dragon-eye-sized bead from his storage bag, throwing it at the late-stage Qi Cultivation leader.
The late-stage Qi Cultivation man’s expression suddenly changed: "Not good... a Yin Thunder Pearl?"
Rumble! The sky suddenly flashed with dark thunder, and Thunder Power instantly surrounded him from all directions.
His defensive magical artifact was sent flying, and the Golden Light Shield shattered in an instant.
In his terrified eyes, thunder descended with a roar.
Rumble!
The leader’s charred corpse fell to the ground with a thud, his magical artifact lost its master’s control, and the spiritual light vanished as it fell to the ground.
Meanwhile, the rest of the two’s attacks had also arrived.
Bang bang!!
With two roars, the middle-aged man’s protective shield was shattered, and a hammer-shaped magical artifact smashed heavily onto him.
"Pfft!"
The middle-aged man was sent flying, blood spurting from his mouth.
"Dad!" the girl cried in terror, rushing to her father’s side in a panic.
The two men in the distance exchanged glances, their expressions uncertain, not daring to approach.
Who would have thought this father and daughter really had such wealth, even possessing a Yin Thunder Pearl? Who knew what other tricks they had, and they didn’t want to end up like their leader.
The two looked at each other and ultimately decided to make a move.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
Having come this far, they were unwilling to give up, especially given the father and daughter’s wealth, worth a gamble.
Just as they were about to act, suddenly several strands of golden energy shot out.
The two men’s faces changed drastically, hurriedly applying defensive talismans to themselves.
However, the power of the golden energy was too strong, directly shattering the protective shield and piercing through their heads.
"Ugh ugh..."
The two fell slowly with horror in their eyes.
They released grip, allowing a few talismans to drift down slowly.
Xu Ping stepped out from behind a tree, approaching the three corpses under the father and daughter’s frightened and wary gaze.
He swiftly stripped everything they had, leaving behind the words: "This is your reward for saving you," and turned away.
Xu Ping initially didn’t want to meddle, especially with a late-stage Qi Cultivator involved, along with those two left alive; he was reluctant to take risks.
Even if she was as much like Mo Ting, it wasn’t her.
But he hadn’t expected that late-stage Qi Cultivator to be killed by her father.
The remaining two no longer posed a threat to him.
After considering, he still decided to intervene.
It was a small way to alleviate the regret in his heart.
As for whether the father and daughter would encounter other dangers later, he couldn’t help them anymore.
After all, he was just at the fourth level of Qi Cultivation, helping a little within his capacity was one thing, getting himself into trouble was something he couldn’t afford.
...
...
Back home safely, Xu Ping’s tense mind finally relaxed a little.
Although his home was just a pile of ordinary wood with no defensive power, being in familiar surroundings still brought him some comfort.
Moreover, his home was far enough from the market, and staying at home without running around was the wise choice right now, increasing his survival rate.
Sitting on a chair, Xu Ping couldn’t help but recall the Golden Core demon beast:
"Where did this Golden Core demon beast come from?"
"Did it consider the market a base, or would it leave after some havoc?"
"What should be done in the future?"
"Will the Longevity Sect return and reclaim it?"
His mind was a tangle of feelings, like a yarn ball with no beginning.
This was the first time he felt such confusion since awakening his golden finger.
He pondered for a long time and finally sighed helplessly: "I’m still too weak."
Even though he felt uneasy inside, Xu Ping made an effort to cheer himself up, trying to think positively. Maybe things weren’t as bad as they seemed.
Overthinking now would bring nothing but pressure.
Xu Ping took a deep breath, trying to suppress his thoughts before examining his spoils of war.
He took out the storage bags of the three.
Checking them carefully,
Altogether, the storage bags contained over one hundred and fifty spirit stones, several bottles of pills, several cultivation books, and seven or eight talismans.
Three magical artifacts: one mid-grade and the rest two lower grade ones.
Total valued over three hundred spirit stones.
"Not a bad haul, but the late-stage Qi Cultivation guy had surprisingly little," Xu Ping frowned slightly.
Aside from the mid-grade magical artifact, his possessions were not as good as his underlings’.
Xu Ping wasn’t too upset since he hadn’t been through a life-and-death battle. Such an income was already quite good.
After packing away his things,
Xu Ping poured himself a glass of water, took a few sips, and recited in his heart:
"Wait, wait until everything calms down before going out to take a look.

chapters.title: Chapter 27: Digging a Tunnel
chapters.content:
Chapter 27: Chapter 27: Digging a Tunnel
Late night.
The surroundings were shrouded in thick darkness. Moonlight slipped through the sparse clouds, casting a faint silver glow that barely illuminated the surrounding rocks and trees, creating twisted shadows.
Occasional beast roars tore through the stillness of the night, sending shivers down one’s spine.
Xu Ping sat cross-legged on the bed, eyes closed, resting.
In the current situation, he couldn’t sleep at all.
However, he felt somewhat relieved not hearing any more activity from the Golden Core Demon Beast and Foundation Establishment Demon Beast.
Perhaps they had left.
Xu Ping’s mind slightly relaxed, and a wave of exhaustion washed over him.
Suddenly, a beast’s roar rang out, startling him and dispelling his drowsiness.
From the sound, it seemed quite close to his home.
"This can’t go on. With the market’s order collapsed, Demon Beast attacks are likely to become more frequent. It’s not impossible they’ll treat this place as a hunting ground. I have to come up with a solution." Xu Ping frowned deeply.
After pondering for a moment, he had an idea: "Why not dig a hole underground? As long as it’s deep enough, even if the Demon Beast finds it, there’s nothing it can do, unless it can tunnel through the earth."
Once this thought popped into his mind, it took root.
The more he thought about it, the more he felt it was a good idea. He could dig multiple exits and simply run if there was danger, a perfect solution.
Eagerly, he began his plan.
The mud in his bedroom was sliced open with a longsword and packed into a storage bag.
Once a bag was full, he emptied it into the river under the cover of night.
Xu Ping worked busily and fervently.
When daylight broke outside, he had already dug a pit about a meter wide and three meters deep, but this depth was far from sufficient.
It was wholly inadequate against Demon Beasts.
After breakfast, he continued his labor.
The deeper the hole went, the harder it was to dig. During this time, he also made some ropes and other tools.
In this manner, Xu Ping labored for a full three days.
After removing an unknown amount of earth, an underground cave was finally formed.
With the help of candlelight, Xu Ping surveyed the surroundings and felt quite satisfied with the newly completed underground safe room.
The chamber was about fifteen square meters in area, sufficient for cultivation or rest.
It was hidden and safe, twenty meters underground, with several exits to prevent being trapped.
"The food is plentiful enough. I’ll stay in this underground space for a while until this wave passes." Xu Ping patted the underground walls, feeling an overwhelming sense of safety and accomplishment.
That evening.
A night of good sleep.
Upon waking, Xu Ping felt completely relaxed in the pitch-black underground space, with all the unease lingering in his heart these days swept away.
This was the first night he slept without hearing beast roars.
...
...
Time flew by like a fleeting horse; more than a month passed in the blink of an eye.
During this period, Xu Ping barely left the underground cave. His daily life was simple and monotonous, except for rest and eating, he was wholly devoted to cultivation.
At first, facing the black underground cave every day felt very oppressive.
But as time went on, he got used to it.
Especially watching the game panel’s numbers continuously change, the sensation of growing stronger by the day drew him in irresistibly.
...
This afternoon, in the underground cave.
Xu Ping sat naked in a wooden tub, his face flushed.
He continuously guided the dark green liquid from the wooden basin into his body, a gentle stream of energy nurturing his bones and cleansing his meridians.
At this moment, Xu Ping’s whole body was taut, his skin glowed with a green luster.
In the light of the oil lamp, his physique seemed like a statue carved from ancient trees.
Vibrant vitality, indestructible.
Thick medicinal power seeped silently through the skin and flesh, into the marrow.Thɪs ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
It brought Xu Ping a feeling of tingling and soreness.
A battle-hardened Xu Ping completely ignored the pain in his body.
If he felt nothing, it would indeed be a bad sign.
"I will break through today!"
Xu Ping took a deep breath, and the qi and blood inside him surged like boiling water.
A few days earlier, he had already advanced the Nourishing Life Skill to 99/100 of the first layer.
To break through to the second layer in one fell swoop, he had specially rested for a few days to restore himself to his peak state.
At this moment, he was full of confidence!
Xu Ping formed seals with his hands, mind controlling his breathing, frantically absorbing the medicinal power of the wooden bucket.
Under his unending extraction, the dark green liquid in the basin began to fade at a speed visible to the naked eye.
The pain within him also intensified!
He seemed to be inside a furnace, the medicinal power continually washing through his meridians, penetrating every bone joint, cleansing impurities, purifying the blood marrow, as his bones cracked audibly.
Bang!
With a crisp sound from the apex of the skull, Xu Ping’s muscles and bones simultaneously roared.
[Nourishing Life Skill·Experience +1]
[Nourishing Life Skill Second Layer: 1/100]
[Longevity +10 Years]
....
Realm breakthrough successful!!
After spending so much time, he finally stepped into the second layer of the Nourishing Life Skill.
Xu Ping opened his eyes, his dark pupils flashed rapidly with a bluish glow.
He clenched his fists and felt his body stronger than ever, a smile appearing at the corners of his mouth.
The power of his pure physical body surged enormously, his defensive power, and reaction speed also increased significantly.
It’s not overstating to say he was reborn.
Xu Ping exhaled long, feeling relieved as if a weight was lifted, his whole body seemed so light it might float.
This sensation of realm enhancement, wielding stronger power was incredibly liberating!
After sitting quietly in the wooden tub for a while, his joyful mood gradually calmed, he then put on his clothes.
"Gurgle~"
Just dressed, Xu Ping’s stomach growled like thunder.
He quickly retrieved the prepared dried meat from his storage bag.
Eating in large gulps, he consumed over twenty pounds of jerky before feeling settled.
"The consumption is increasing!" Xu Ping was secretly alarmed.
Before, he would eat only about ten pounds of meat, but after breaking through, he consumed over twenty pounds.
At this rate, he had to eat seven to eight hundred pounds of Demon Beast flesh a month.
After recovering, Xu Ping finally had time to check the changes on his proficiency panel.
[Name: Xu Ping]
[Longevity: 28/116 years]
[Realm: Qi Cultivation Fourth Layer: 26/100; Nourishing Life Skill Second Layer: 1/100]
[Cultivation Technique: Five Elements Skill Proficient (Fourth Layer): 288/400]
[Skills: Spirit Rain Skill Mastery: 41/400; Geng Metal Finger Perfection: ∞; Light Body Technique Mastery: 358/400; Flowing Cloud Sword Advanced: 486/1600; Fireball Technique Entry Level: 23/100; Hundred Flowers Gu Entry Level: 58/100]
"I’ve finished the Qi Nourishing Pills during this period, so my cultivation has slowed, but the other skills have advanced greatly."
"Especially the Flowing Cloud Sword, which has reached an advanced level, coupled with the second layer of Nourishing Life Skill and mastery level Light Body Technique, now my combat skills far surpass just Mana and cultivation."
Xu Ping was very pleased with his progress.
With his current strength, he could easily crush his own self from a month ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 28: Wind Wolves
chapters.content:
Chapter 28: Chapter 28: Wind Wolves
"However, the Demon Beast Flesh is almost gone now, and the second layer of the Nourishing Life Skill requires a new concoction of medicinal liquid!"
Xu Ping frowned slightly, which meant he had to leave the underground cave and head outside.
Otherwise, without the aid of medicinal liquid, the Nourishing Life Skill would halt; without the support of Demon Beast Flesh, consuming only Spirit Rice would not suffice for his body.
He hadn’t ventured outside for over a month and was unaware of the external situation.
After a brief contemplation, he finally made a decision.
He had to go out at least once.
It wasn’t just for obtaining Demon Beast Flesh and herbs, but more importantly, to investigate the situation outside.
...
...
Dongwu Market.
Perimeter.
The Body Refining Cultivator Yuan Wei hid behind a phoenix tree with a heart full of fear and regret: "I must have been blinded by greed, coming out at such a time..."
"But the Spirit Rice and Demon Beast Flesh at home are almost finished; I don’t want to starve, so what choice do I have?"
Yuan Wei had a bitter expression. As a Body Refining Cultivator, his daily food intake was large, and the supplies at home couldn’t sustain him. He was forced to venture out in search of food.
But who knew that shortly after stepping out, he would encounter five or six Wind Wolves.
The First Rank Middle Grade Demon Beast ’Wind Wolf,’ which usually appears deep in the wilderness; five or six could even surround and kill a Late-Stage Qi Cultivation cultivator.
A Late-Stage Qi Cultivation expert was considered a notable figure in the market even before it was breached, let alone now.
"Awoo!"
At this moment, accompanied by wolf howls, seven or eight Wind Wolves, almost never appearing except in the depths of the wilderness, came howling.
With a ripple of Spiritual Qi, several azure Wind Blades zipped towards his hiding spot.
"I’ve been discovered!"
Yuan Wei’s face changed drastically; he hastily activated the Golden Light Shield Talisman, and a layer of gold light flashed over him. Though a Body Refining Cultivator, he dared not withstand the Wind Blades with his flesh.
The Wind Blades easily severed the phoenix tree at its waist, crashing against the Golden Light Shield.
The Golden Light Shield flickered from bright to dim, struggling to hold off the attack.
But the second, third...
The Wind Blades seemed inexhaustible, carrying wolf howls!
Boom!
The golden light around him shattered into fragments.
"This is not good!!"
Yuan Wei was astonished, rolling desperately on the ground, barely avoiding most Wind Blades, yet he was already drenched in blood.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Fortunately, with his robust physical form as a Body Refining Cultivator, he wasn’t facing a lethal threat.
"I can’t die here!!"
Yuan Wei gritted his teeth, unwilling to give up, and struggled to get up, forcing his body to dash forward.
But no matter how fast he was, he couldn’t be faster than a Wind Blade.
Several Wind Blades whistled toward Yuan Wei, seemingly about to slice him into pieces.
Suddenly.
His vision blurred; a figure flickered before him, and then came a "clang" sound, with Wind Blades splitting apart into countless fragments of spiritual light, eventually dissipating in the air.
Yuan Wei turned his head in shock, witnessing the figure rush into the wolf pack; amidst glittering sword light, severed limbs of Wind Wolves danced.
The originally predatory Wind Wolves turned from excitement to terror...
Whimper!
Accompanied by several miserable wolf howls, all five or six Wind Wolves were slain, their bodies lying scattered, with blood flowing everywhere.
"This... this..."
Yuan Wei stared aghast at the scene, profoundly shocked.
Wind Wolves capable of killing a Late-Stage Qi Cultivation cultivator were slain so easily?
And this person before him, merely at the fourth layer of Qi Cultivation, possessed such ability?
Could it be that he reached the third layer of Body Refining??
"I... thank you for saving me, fellow Daoist!"
Seeing the newcomer pack up all the Wind Wolf carcasses, though still bleeding, Yuan Wei still expressed his gratitude with respect.
In today’s disordered market, maintaining respect for powerful individuals who could take his life at any moment was vital, especially when the person saved his life.
However, upon seeing the man, his expression stiffened instantly.
Broad-shouldered, robust, with a face lined in ferocity, his appearance alone was intimidating.
Instinctively sensing immense danger, Yuan Wei became even more respectful.
"A trivial matter," Xu Ping waved his hand and then inquired, "What is the current situation in the market? I haven’t gone out much since the Demon Bird destroyed it."
"Sigh, that day the Golden Core Demon Bird suddenly attacked..."
On this matter, Yuan Wei was filled with bitter tears, "Many were killed or injured back then, and fortunately, after the two Demon Beasts wreaked havoc, they left and have not returned since. Thus, the beast tide receded."
"The Golden Core Demon Beast left, and the beast tide receded!"
Xu Ping felt relieved, like the sword of Damocles over his head had finally been removed.
"Has the Longevity Sect sent anyone here again?" Xu Ping asked.
"Not at all; the Golden Core Demon Beast left days ago, with no sign of movement. It’s unclear whether they’ve abandoned our market," Yuan Wei replied with a bitter smile.
"That shouldn’t be the case, right? The effort the Longevity Sect put into establishing Dongwu Market isn’t something easily abandoned."
"Plus, there should still be remnants of the Longevity Sect disciples within the market, shouldn’t they know?" Xu Ping pushed further.
"Not many Longevity Sect disciples survived..."
Based on Yuan Wei’s account, half of the Longevity Sect disciples were killed just on the day the Golden Core Demon Bird went rampant.
Those who survived became prime targets due to possible possessions of sect classics, spirit pills, and medicines, many of whom were intercepted and slain.
"However, afterward, a disciple named Zhang Changqing at the ninth layer of Qi Cultivation gathered the remaining Longevity Sect disciples, forming the top force in the market now, deterring others from hunting them casually."
"He also announced that the Longevity Sect would reestablish their presence in the market soon, which helped restore a semblance of order."
"But many are wavering after so many days of inactivity, especially considering the Golden Core Demon Beast, which only the Longevity Sect’s Patriarch can handle."
"The Golden Core Patriarch surely wouldn’t risk his life for a place like this." Yuan Wei added.
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping felt a heaviness in his heart.
He found Yuan Wei’s points very reasonable.
Who knows if the Golden Core Demon Beast might return, and if they send people, what happens when it comes again?
Losing a few Foundation Establishment cultivators then would be a far greater loss than losing a border market.
Xu Ping asked again, "What about the current trading site?"
He couldn’t rely on others’ assurances; at worst, he could build his strength to a certain level and leave alone.
"Most of the original market has turned to ruins, so the survivors set up a new trading site in a remote valley."
"I see," Xu Ping nodded, then smilingly asked, "Could I trouble you to lead the way, fellow Daoist?"
Yuan Wei held his breath but dared not refuse, answering helplessly, "It’s my honor."
After simply dressing his wounds, he led Xu Ping to the new trading site.

chapters.title: Chapter 29: The Trading Grounds
chapters.content:
Chapter 29: Chapter 29: The Trading Grounds
Along the way, Yuan Wei also introduced Xu Ping to the current market dynamics.
The market was in disarray, with Demon Beasts lurking nearby, so most cultivators chose to form alliances and created various factions for survival.
Among them, the strongest forces consisted of the Linghu Gang, the Dragon Suppression Gang, the Four Directions Association, and the remnants of the Longevity Sect disciples.
The leaders of these four major forces, except for the leader of the Linghu Gang, were all at the ninth level of Qi Cultivation.
Even though the Linghu Gang leader’s cultivation wasn’t high, he was at Perfection of the third level of Body Refining, placing his combat power among the top three in the market.
Moreover, the new trading area was co-opened by these four, and almost no one dared to cause trouble there.
’It seems that the market is still maintaining the most basic order, which is better than having no order at all...’ Xu Ping thought to himself.
...
...
The new trading area was located in a remote valley.
At the entrance of the valley, Xu Ping wrinkled his nose and stopped.
"What’s that strange smell?" he asked while covering his nose.
He smelled something like sulfur, but more complicated.
"That’s the smell of Beast Repellent Powder, it can ward off some poisonous insects and ferocious beasts, keeping them away from here," Yuan Wei pointed to the red and white powder on the ground not far ahead, explaining.
"This stuff seems useful, is it sold inside?" Xu Ping raised an eyebrow and asked.
"Yes." Yuan Wei nodded, "Beast Repellent Powder is exclusively sold by the Longevity Sect. It wasn’t valued before, but now it’s a hot commodity."
The valley entrance was quite narrow, like a natural checkpoint, but once inside, it opened up and became quite spacious.
As soon as the two entered the valley, they saw seven or eight roughly styled wooden houses built from stacked logs, with a few Loose Cultivators trading next to them in small groups.
"The ones who rented the wooden houses are mostly the remaining shops," Yuan Wei whispered a brief explanation.
In fact, the brutality faced by the disciples of the Longevity Sect was far less severe than what these shops endured.
These shops were the real targets, with Pills, medicinal herbs, talismans, Magical Artifacts... everything was available.
These Loose Cultivators had been eyeing them for a long time, and now that they had the chance, they naturally became wolves.
Of course, the shops that survived must have considerable strength.
"Fellow Daoist, I’ve brought you here, if there’s nothing else, I’ll be going now," Yuan Wei glanced cautiously at Xu Ping.
Walking with someone who looked fierce enough to take his life at any moment was indeed stressful!
"Thank you for leading the way and enlightening me," Xu Ping expressed his gratitude, then took a large chunk of Demon Beast Flesh from his storage bag and handed it to Yuan Wei.
Yuan Wei was momentarily stunned, then overjoyed. He never expected this fierce-looking guy to have a good heart!
This large piece of meat was enough for him to eat for ten days.
"My name is Yuan Wei. If you ever need anything, just let me know." Yuan Wei took the Demon Beast Flesh with a look of joy.Follow current novᴇls on ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
This person is not only powerful but also kind-hearted, a good connection to have!
"Sure!"
Xu Ping nodded and turned to start searching for what he needed at the stalls.
Watching Xu Ping’s departing back, Yuan Wei licked his lips and immediately left the valley.
...
After browsing around, Xu Ping found that the stall’s items were of relatively low grade, mostly daily necessities.
Let alone Spirit Gathering Pills, even the materials needed for the second layer of the Nourishing Life Skill were hard to find.
"Looks like I’ll have to check inside the wooden houses," Xu Ping thought to himself.
He came to a wooden house, next to which stood a wooden sign with white paper on it, written "Buying old Spirit Grass, various ores."
He entered the house and glanced around, finding it simply furnished with just a wooden table and two chairs.
A young man in a green robe was leisurely sitting on one of the chairs, holding a blue book.
Seeing someone enter, the young man put down the book and smiled warmly, "What can I do for you, Fellow Daoist?"
"I want to buy Spirit Medicine. Can you gather the materials on this list?" Xu Ping handed over a piece of white paper he had prepared, which listed the Spirit Medicines needed for the second layer of the Nourishing Life Skill.
"Let me see."
The young man took the paper, checked it carefully, and smiled, "You’re in luck, our shop has all the Spirit Medicines listed."
"That’s good. How much for a full set?" Xu Ping asked.
"Not expensive, eighty-eight Spirit Stones," the young man replied cheerfully.
"That’s too expensive, is this place a black market!" Xu Ping was shocked.
This was fifty percent higher than usual prices. Did they think he was easy prey?
"You’re kidding, Fellow Daoist. Nowadays, prices for everything, let alone Spirit Medicine, are on the rise," the young man said with a faint smile.
Xu Ping frowned slightly, calculated in his mind, and eventually spent eighty-eight Spirit Stones to buy the Spirit Medicines.
He knew there was a premium, but after searching around, this shop was the only one with the Spirit Medicine he needed. It couldn’t be helped.
"Take care, Fellow Daoist!"
After the transaction, the young man saw Xu Ping out the door.
Watching Xu Ping’s fading figure, he stroked his chin, thoughtfully: "This guy is really quite the catch!"
...
Leaving the wooden house, Xu Ping headed to his next destination – the Pill Workshop.
This wooden house was visibly larger, with two or three people inside selecting Pills.
As soon as he entered, a woman in a blue robe greeted Xu Ping, "Fellow Daoist, looking for any specific Pills?"
"Do you have any better Pills for cultivation?" Xu Ping asked directly.
The Qi Nourishing Pill had greatly diminished in effect for him, and he wanted something better.
"Certainly," the woman in blue smiled and nodded, "For someone of your cultivation, I would recommend the Spirit Gathering Pill."
"The Spirit Gathering Pill is a First Rank Mid-grade Pill with strong medicinal power, extremely effective for mid-stage cultivators, even beneficial for late-stage cultivators."
Xu Ping felt intrigued, "How much for a bottle?"
"Fifty-five Spirit Stones per bottle, and there are fifteen pills in each bottle," the woman responded with a pleasant smile.
"That’s way too expensive!" Xu Ping shook his head, nearly double the cost of the Qi Nourishing Pill.
"The Spirit Gathering Pill has always been this price. Other shops have already raised their prices, but we haven’t," the woman still smiled.
"If the price goes up, even fewer people will buy. There’s hardly anyone buying Pills in the market now," Xu Ping reasoned.
"That may be so, but the Spirit Medicines for refining Pills are extremely scarce, mostly old stock. Once sold out, who knows if we can make more," she replied helplessly.
"Could you make it cheaper? I’m buying two bottles..."
...
A dozen minutes later.
Xu Ping wiped sweat from his forehead, leaving the Pill store.
In the end, he didn’t get a discount, but they gave him a bottle of Beast Repellent Powder, which was alright.

chapters.title: Chapter 30: Targeted
chapters.content:
Chapter 30: Chapter 30: Targeted
"Sigh, I’ve only got about a hundred Spirit Stones left. Looks like I’ll need to sell some things to replenish my funds."
Xu Ping felt an inward sigh at the drastic drop in his wealth.
He had quite a few miscellaneous Magical Artifacts, Pills, and talismans. Selling them all should bring in a good amount of Spirit Stones.
However, given the current market demand, it might take quite some time to clear out these items.
Just then, Xu Ping saw a group of cultivators surrounding a large man coming towards him.
Most of these cultivators were at the early or mid-stages of Qi Cultivation. Although they wore different robes and magical garments, they all had the same symbol on their chests and backs.
The large man they surrounded had a burly physique, with a centipede-like scar across his cheek that stretched to his neck, adding a bit of menace to his appearance.
The mana fluctuations from this person had clearly reached the seventh level of Qi Cultivation!
"Greetings, fellow cultivator. I am Zhou Tong, the Gang Leader of ’Xiongba Gang.’ I can see you are quite extraordinary. I wonder if you’re interested in joining our ’Xiongba Gang’?" Zhou Tong spoke up, his voice loud and carrying an intimidating air of authority.
"Xiongba Gang?"
Xu Ping frowned.
Yuan Wei had never mentioned this, but having a Late-Stage Qi Cultivation gang leader clearly meant it wasn’t a second-rate gang.
But why would such a gang want to recruit him?
Had Yuan Wei exposed him, or was there another reason?
Either way, he had no intention of joining any gang.
"Thank you for Master Zhou’s kind offer, but I prefer to be independent and don’t plan to join any gang," Xu Ping shook his head and declined.
"Oh? You are indeed a person with strong opinions."
While Zhou Tong’s smile remained unchanged, a glint flashed in his eyes, "However, it’s not very safe to go solo, especially around here."
Xu Ping frowned tightly. Was Master Zhou hinting at something?
But for someone who veiled threats, he didn’t want to engage in courtesy or waste time.
"That won’t be your concern!" Xu Ping replied coldly.
"What did you say?"
Zhou Tong’s smile stiffened, and the cultivators behind him were filled with righteous indignation.
A mere Qi Cultivation fourth layer cultivator dared to speak like this.
Moreover, since joining the Xiongba Gang, when had they ever suffered such humiliation?
"Fine, since you’re so confident, we won’t disturb you any longer!" Zhou Tong’s expression quickly darkened as he turned to leave.
"Gang Leader, are you really going to let this kid go?" A skinny man rushed over beside him.
"After all, this is the business of the four families. We must show them respect. But that kid won’t escape; he’s already been marked by Su Hua with a One-Day Incense," Zhou Tong replied in a low, cold voice.
"Indeed, we’ll give him a proper beating when the time comes," the skinny man sneered.
"I had planned to recruit him first, then properly exploit this fat sheep, and even spare his life. But since he doesn’t know how to appreciate it, he can’t blame me," a vicious gleam flashed in Zhou Tong’s eyes.
In this precarious market, every Spirit Stone counted. Especially when this man bought herbs and also bought Pills; no matter what, Zhou Tong wouldn’t let this opportunity slip.
...
...
Half an hour later.
Xu Ping walked among the shattered ruins, feeling quite unlucky.
Originally, he intended to sell some things at the trading ground but encountered the ’Xiongba Gang.’ To avoid further trouble, he had no choice but to leave first.
Anyway, there would be opportunities to sell later, so he wasn’t in a hurry.
"Fellow cultivator, want to have some fun? Just two Spirit Stones, and I guarantee you’ll feel like heavenly ecstasy."
A female cultivator with a graceful and charming posture, exuding an enchanting aura, leaned against a dilapidated door, licking her luscious red lips.
’Is this the legendary half-cloaked female cultivator who practices wicked Secret Techniques that can drain one’s bones and marrow?’
’Indeed, beyond what Earth can offer...’
"Ahem, ahem... unfortunate timing, maybe next time." Xu Ping coughed lightly, quickening his pace.
After walking a short distance.
Suddenly!
Xu Ping sharply turned around, brows tightly furrowed, heart alert.
A moment later, Zhou Tong appeared with a group not far away, bursting with momentum.Follow current novels on
"How did you track me?" Xu Ping asked coldly, his voice chillingly sharp.
He had already changed directions several times, yet they still found him, certainly using some unknown method.
"Go to hell and ask!" Zhou Tong sneered, his eyes glinting fiercely.
"You dare reject Brother Zhou’s invitation; you’re asking for death."
Those behind him sneered one by one, each showing their Magic or spells.
Their numbers, even if each cast a spell, would drown him.
Xu Ping’s gaze was icy cold, and with a stomp, his figure vanished!
Boom!
On the ground where he stood, a deep pit appeared, surrounded by countless spreading cracks...
When they first caught up to him, he had already applied the Light Body Technique on himself.
With his current speed aided by a mastery-level Light Body Technique, he nearly reached the limit of the naked eye, leaving only a shadow behind.
"Quick, activate the defensive talismans!"
Zhou Tong’s face changed abruptly, sensing danger, He hadn’t expected this person’s speed to be so fast, even surpassing some second-level Body Refining cultivators.
Could he be a third-level Body Refining cultivator?
As they activated defensive talismans, Xu Ping had already approached them, with the sword in his hand, Qinghe, unsheathed, and the sword light flickered, unpredictable as flowing clouds, charging straight at Zhou Tong’s group.
The surrounding air seemed to be torn apart, producing deep resonant murmurs.
In the next instant, the sword light flashed, the defensive shield shattering with a response, and a middle-aged man’s head flew high.
"What!"
Panic surged in Zhou Tong’s heart, seeing the first rank mid-grade defensive talisman shield shattered in one blow.
Even he couldn’t achieve this!
This had to be a third-level Body Refining cultivator, and his swordsmanship was quite profound.
"Don’t panic, we outnumber him; we can wear him down!" Zhou Tong gritted his teeth, rallying his group, activating the Magical Artifact, which turned into a stream of light aimed at Xu Ping.
Given the speed demonstrated by the opponent, escaping would surely be a dead end, leaving collaboration as the only chance of survival.
He felt intensely regretful now, wondering how a docile fat sheep became a fearsome beast.
The rest of the Xiongba Gang comprehended the situation, hurriedly casting Magic and wielding Magical Artifacts to besiege Xu Ping.
"Humph!"
Xu Ping coldly chuckled, a flick of his wrist, the sword light weaving together, instantly forming a dazzling sword net in the air, like an invisible cage, blocking all of Zhou Tong’s group’s attacks.
This was the defensive move from the Flowing Cloud Swordsmanship - the Primordial Sword Net.
With his mastery of Flowing Cloud Swordsmanship, how could they possibly break through?

chapters.title: Chapter 31: Execution
chapters.content:
Chapter 31: Chapter 31: Execution
Boom boom boom...
Various magic and magical artifacts bombarded the sword net, but besides causing a series of roars, they had no effect!
"It actually...blocked it!!" Zhou Tong was panic-stricken.
Who exactly is this person? His strength is almost comparable to the leaders of the four major forces!!
Xu Ping’s eyes grew colder, his figure once again moved like a specter, sword light falling like rain, quickly descending, like a meteor crossing the night sky, with an unstoppable momentum, charging straight forward.
"Ah!"
A miserable scream, the skinny man who had just activated a defensive talisman was cut by the sword light, the protective shield shattered instantly, blood spraying wildly, his body torn apart by the sword light, turning into a mist of blood that dissipated in the air.
"Quickly... run!" The cultivators nearby were panic-stricken, scattering in all directions.
They were just a makeshift gang, and seeing Xu Ping’s great display of power as he continued to kill several of them, their psychological defenses finally collapsed.
However, Xu Ping’s sword light followed like a shadow, the sword momentum continually shrinking, as if mercilessly harvesting their lives.
"Ah ah..."
Cries of misery were incessant.
