"Spare... spare me!" A young cultivator hastily raised his hands, his face full of fear.
The sword light flashed by, the sword momentum like a rainbow, instantly cutting down the young cultivator, blood splattering, dyeing the surrounding ground red.
"It’s just you now!" Xu Ping, holding the Qinghe sword, coldly confronted Zhou Tong.
"Wait... we can talk..."
Zhou Tong retreated quickly, his face covered in cold sweat.
He never imagined that someone merely at the fourth layer of Qi Cultivation could possess such strong combat power and remarkable swordsmanship.
Xu Ping sneered coldly and attacked again with his sword, the sword light like a rainbow.
"Are you really going for broke?"
Zhou Tong roared, tearing apart a First Rank Upper Grade ’Vajra Talisman’, enveloping himself in a thick golden light, swift retreating while activating a mid-grade magical artifact to attack Xu Ping.
Two mid-grade magical artifacts, one on the left and one on the right, formed a pincer attack, blocking all his escape routes.
Xu Ping’s sword light turned, he moved with the sword, easily knocking away the two mid-grade magical artifacts with two strokes.
He then quickly approached Zhou Tong.
The sword light was like thunder, slashing on the Vajra shield one strike after another.
Boom boom boom.....
The Vajra shield flickered intermittently, exploding into countless light points scattering around.
In Zhou Tong’s terrified gaze, Xu Ping struck another sword blow at his chest.
"Ah!" His scream pierced the sky, blood splattered, staining the surrounding ground red.
However, Xu Ping did not kill him with one blow, but spared his life.
"Spare... spare me." Zhou Tong, spitting blood, pleaded weakly.
"How did you track me?" Xu Ping’s expression was cold and indifferent.
Zhou Tong covered his wound and answered with difficulty: "It was Liang Jian, who sold you the herbs, he placed a One-Day Incense on your clothes, this fragrance is almost colorless and odorless, only special Gu worms can smell it, and it lasts for a day without dissipating..."
"So that’s it!"
Xu Ping nodded, suddenly dashed forward like lightning, and with a slash of his sword, he cut off Zhou Tong’s head.
Puff!
Zhou Tong fell immediately, blood spurting, his head plopping on the side.
For such enemies who wanted his life, Xu Ping had no intention of being merciful.
A moment later.
He had already collected all the spoils of war.
Xu Ping sensed the gazes cast from various directions, sneered, and quickly left the scene, leaving behind a field of corpses.
It wasn’t long before a few figures sneaked over from the forest in the distance, and seeing the ground full of corpses, they were all extremely shocked: "Are these... Xiongba Gang’s people? They’re all dead!"
"Even the gang leader Zhou Tong is dead? This person was at Late-Stage Qi Cultivation!"
"Who exactly is that person?"
"His strength is probably approaching that of the leaders of the four major forces!"
Soon, the figures retreated one after another, and all the remaining forces in the market knew that a mysterious powerhouse not to be provoked had emerged in the market.
...
...
In the valley.
When Liang Jian heard the news, his face instantly changed.
He never expected that the entire Xiongba Gang, including the leader Zhou Tong, would be dead!
"Hit an iron plate!" Liang Jian’s heart sank.
The reason why he cooperated with Xiongba Gang was completely due to the low earnings from his spirit stone jobs.
Yes, he was just a worker, the owner of the wooden house was someone else.
To survive better, he often took advantage of his position, spotting fat sheep, and then notifying the Xiongba Gang.
They had cooperated many times, but unexpectedly this time they stumbled into disaster.
"Damn, it was actually a wolf in sheep’s clothing!" Liang Jian felt indignant, silently cursing.
Why hide your cultivation? If you had shown it honestly, who would dare rob you for those few spirit stones?
"Perhaps that person doesn’t know I cooperated with Xiongba Gang." A hint of luck rose in his heart, but it quickly died down.
The possibility was too low.
"I absolutely can’t sit and wait for death!"
"Offending one person means certain death, offending two is the same, so why not take the loot and run, after all, the spirit stones here are enough for me to live on for a long time." Liang Jian’s mind flashed a hint of madness.
Survivors of the previous catastrophe did not lack ruthlessness.
And he clearly knew the personality of the wooden house’s owner, who would definitely not offend that mysterious powerhouse for him.
So it was better to flee with the loot.
Having made up his mind, Liang Jian changed his attire and quietly slipped out of the valley.
Half an hour later.
Liang Jian hastily passed through a forest, his heart uneasy, afraid of being pursued.
He quickly navigated through the forest, silently hoping to escape smoothly.
But at the moment he quickened his pace, a faint rustling reached his ears, as if someone was approaching secretly.
"Could it be that person catching up?" Liang Jian panicked, suddenly turning back, but saw nothing.
"Am I just imagining things?" He muttered to himself, trying to calm down.
"Are you looking for me?"
Suddenly, a deep voice came from behind, like it came from the depths of the Nine Nether, with a piercing coldness.
Liang Jian was shocked in his heart, turned around sharply, and saw a tall, rough-looking man with a ferocious face, holding a magical sword, looking at him coldly.
"How... how are you here?" Liang Jian stuttered, his face pale, fear surging like a tide in his heart.
"Why is it that you are allowed to send people to track me, but I’m not allowed to track you?" Xu Ping smirked coldly.
"Spare me... my heart was clouded with pig fat!!" Liang Jian knelt on the ground with a thud, continuously kowtowing for mercy, "I know the whereabouts of the Foundation Establishment Pill, as long as you don’t kill me, I will take you to find it."
"Foundation Establishment Pill?" Xu Pin’s face flashed with surprise.
That’s a prized possession!
Foundation Establishment is difficult.
Besides the simple requirement of reaching Perfection in Qi Cultivation before the age of sixty, there are three major hurdles.
The first hurdle is the blood and qi! During Foundation Establishment, a cultivator’s physique must be strong, qi and blood abundant, and free of hidden injuries.The most update n0vels are published on NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
The second hurdle is the mana, which must be sufficiently strong and abundant, as even a slight deficiency makes it difficult to meet the requirements of mana condensation.
The last hurdle is that Divine Sense must be born!

chapters.title: Chapter 32: New Home
chapters.content:
Chapter 32: Chapter 32: New Home
Qi Refinement cultivators only have Spiritual Sense for inner sight, which can only browse jade slips and such, and cannot be released outward.
Foundation Establishment cultivators possess Divine Sense, which can sweep several dozen yards, providing great convenience in techniques or the mastery of hundreds of arts of immortality.
Each stage is more difficult than the last.
Any pills or items useful for these three major checkpoints can be called Foundation Establishment Spiritual Objects!
Among them, Foundation Establishment Pill is the best.
This pill stabilizes blood and meridians, significantly increases Mana, encourages Divine Sense, and increases the probability of Foundation Establishment by thirty percent with one pill, and even if Foundation Establishment fails, the meridians will not rupture and result in death...
However, those who can refine Foundation Establishment Pills are the major sects, and even supplying their own disciples is not enough, so they rarely sell them.
Even if a Foundation Establishment Pill occasionally appears on the market, it is at a sky-high price.
Loose Cultivators simply cannot afford it.
"Really, I absolutely didn’t deceive you, as long as you spare me, I will..." Seeing hope, Liang Jian eagerly continued.
But before he could finish speaking, he saw a sword light flash by, and then he saw a headless male corpse.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Isn’t this my body?
Carrying the last thread of confusion, Liang Jian lost consciousness.
The corpse fell to the ground with a thud, the hand opened, and several black bone needles rolled onto the ground.
"A disposable magical artifact ’Bone Piercing Nail’?"
Xu Ping was slightly startled.
He had always sensed the other party was not honest, but he didn’t expect such a vicious magical artifact. His preemptive kill was indeed a wise choice.
"Judging by this, what he said about the Foundation Establishment Pill is also false."
Xu Ping sighed, moved quickly forward, searched the corpse thoroughly, then cast a Fireball Technique to burn the corpse to ashes.
After finishing all this, Xu Ping chose a direction, his figure flickered, and he quickly disappeared into the forest.
A little half an hour later, a black-robed figure arrived at the scene.
Looking at the mess everywhere, his face slightly changed: "Liang Jian’s scent disappears here, it seems he was slain by that mysterious figure, and the items fell into his hands."
"Forget it, it’s only a few hundred Spirit Stones. It’s not worth offending that mysterious figure for these."
The black-robed figure left the scene without any hesitation.
...
Evening!
Xu Ping restored his original appearance and found a place to stay in the market.
He did not plan to return to the outskirts of the market.
The Spiritual Qi is too scarce, barely enough to maintain, and daily cultivation is really burdensome.
Yuan Wei said that the core of the Second-stage Spirit Veins in the market is occupied by the four major powers, but there are many vacant houses on the branches, not to worry about unavailable places.
Though most living conditions are poor, rundown, and become dangerous buildings.
However, even in such poor condition, the Spiritual Qi is indeed at the level of First Rank Upper Grade.
Xu Ping searched for nearly an hour.
Finally found a satisfactory place.
The house was close to the river, convenient for fetching water, and there was a small yard outside the house, providing better privacy.
Plus, the house was recently abandoned, so the furniture was still usable, saving some trouble.
Xu Ping carefully inspected a round, found no abnormalities, then tidied up briefly, scattered beast repellent powder around the house, and moved in.
Anyway, he had no one to say goodbye to.
After crossing over, although he knew many people, most were just acquaintances, only a bit more familiar with Old Man Lu.
But the relationship was definitely not to the extent of Xu Ping going out of his way to seek him.
He could only wish him good luck.
Sitting on the stool, he began to count the spoils from this time.
The Spirit Stones and magical artifacts from those minor henchmen weren’t many, the main ones were Zhou Tong and Liang Jian!
This made Xu Ping couldn’t help but marvel, wealth indeed accumulates in a pyramid shape.
There were actually four Mid-grade Spirit Stones in their storage bags.
That’s four hundred Lower Grade Spirit Stones, not to mention two Mid-grade magical artifacts, talismans, and a heap of medicinal materials.
"So rich!" Xu Ping exclaimed.
To survive until now, aside from those with low strength, most people’s pockets have swelled quite a bit.
His almost depleted Spirit Stone reserve was replenished again.
"Now that the Golden Core Demon Beasts have left, there are very few people in the market who can threaten me, the Spirit Stones are enough, I can cultivate in peace for a while." After securing all the items, Xu Ping felt at ease.
He didn’t want to fight and kill; he just wanted to quietly accumulate experience, yet trouble always found him.
...
...
Evening.
After swallowing a Spirit Gathering Pill, Xu Ping eagerly began cultivating.
"So expensive, hopefully worth every penny."
Boom!
With a slight operation of the cultivation technique, endless Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi was absorbed without depletion.
In such a dwelling, if before, it would normally take a dozen Spirit Stones, but now it could be free.
"Free... brings joy!"
After Xu Ping marveled, he quickly calmed his mind, practiced the cultivation technique, and refined the spiritual energy.
An hour later.
Xu Ping opened his eyes, ending the cultivation.
He opened the proficiency panel; his gaze fell on the cultivation technique and realm.
[Realm: Qi Cultivation Fourth Layer: 28/100; Nourishing Life Skill Second Layer: 1/100]
[Cultivation Technique: Five Elements Skill Mastery (Fourth Layer): 299/400]
The realm increased by two points; the cultivation technique increased by eleven points!
"Such efficiency..." Xu Ping’s eyes lit up; the Spirit Gathering Pill and the Spiritual Qi bonus exceeded his expectations.
"At this rate, in just over a month, I can break through to the fifth layer of Qi Cultivation."
"When was the last breakthrough?"
Xu Ping slightly calculated and realized the last breakthrough was over three months ago.
"Four to five months for a layer breakthrough, this efficiency is truly remarkable!"
"Maybe, I can reach the Ninth Layer of Qi Cultivation before the age of forty." Xu Ping thought happily.
After closing the panel, he practiced the sword a bit before going to sleep.
However, having been used to sleeping in the basement, sleeping above now felt uncomfortable, lacking a sense of security.
He found it difficult to fall asleep all night.
"Seems like I need to dig a basement."
...
The next morning, Xu Ping stretched after getting up.
After washing and eating something simple, he took some Demon Beast Flesh and visited the neighbors in the vicinity.
The visits to the earlier houses were very smooth.
Knock knock knock...
Xu Ping knocked on the last neighbor’s door.
Soon, the door creaked open.
The one who opened was a young female cultivator, wearing a light moon-colored floral robe, looking about seventeen or eighteen, an immature oval face paired with a well-endowed front, exuding a rich youthful aura.
"Fellow Daoist, you are looking for... oh... benefactor!" the young female cultivator suddenly froze, realized, then excitedly grabbed Xu Ping’s sleeve.
Xu Ping also recognized the young female cultivator before him, she was the daughter in the pair of father and daughter.
’The world is really small.’ Xu Ping marveled in his heart.
Of course, he was very pleased to see the girl still alive.
"Cough... Who is Ling’Er?" Accompanied by a burst of coughs, a middle-aged male cultivator with a slightly pale face walked out.
"Father, it’s our rescuer." The young female cultivator noticed her improper behavior, released Xu Ping’s sleeve, and said with slightly red cheeks.

chapters.title: Chapter 33: Five Elements Technique Breaks Through Minor Achievement (New Author Seeks Collections and Followers)
chapters.content:
Chapter 33: Chapter 33: Five Elements Technique Breaks Through Minor Achievement (New Author Seeks Collections and Followers)
"Benefactor!"
The middle-aged cultivator raised his voice a pitch higher, quickly walked over to Xu Ping, and upon seeing the face clearly, he exclaimed with excitement, "It really is you, benefactor!"
"Fellow Daoist, you’re too kind. It was just a minor effort." Xu Ping said with a smile.
"Your effort truly saved my daughter’s life and mine. Ling’Er, take out Daddy’s Spirit Tea, please come in, Daoist." The middle-aged cultivator pulled Xu Ping inside.
Unable to refuse such hospitality, Xu Ping followed him into the house.
Sitting across from each other at the square table, his daughter served Spirit Tea to both of them.
Xu Ping took the teacup, had a sip, and felt a fragrant aroma fill the air; it was surprisingly delicious.
So he drank up all the tea in his cup in one go.
Seeing Xu Ping devour his Spirit Tea like a cow chewing peonies, the middle-aged cultivator twitched his mouth slightly but still politely said, "I’m Zhang Chenyu, and I don’t even know the name of my benefactor."
"Xu Ping." Xu Ping directly gave his real name to Zhang Chenyu as he had nothing to hide.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, I must express my gratitude once again for saving us... cough cough cough..." Before Zhang Chenyu could finish his sentence, he suddenly started coughing violently.
"Dad!" Zhang Ling’Er’s fair face showed a hint of concern.
"Fellow Daoist Zhang, are you... injured?" Xu Ping hesitated and asked.
"Injured by those three robbers before, still not completely healed, but it’s no big deal now." Zhang Chenyu waved his hand.
"Have you moved here to live?" He changed the topic.
"Yes, I just moved here yesterday." Xu Ping nodded.
Zhang Chenyu did not seem to be alright, but since he was unwilling to reveal more, Xu Ping wouldn’t interfere more.
"That’s a good thing, we are neighbors now. This place is guarded by the Spirit Tiger Gang, so it’s safer than elsewhere." Zhang Chenyu said with a smile.
"This place is guarded by the Spirit Tiger Gang?" Xu Ping was stunned.
"Yes, the Spirit Tiger Gang maintains order here but not for free. Every month, two Spirit Stones must be handed over." Zhang Chenyu explained with a nod.
"I see." Xu Ping suddenly understood.
Having the Spirit Tiger Gang maintaining order was quite good, at least it could keep relative stability.
Though he did not need the protection of the Spirit Tiger Gang, for him, two Spirit Stones were nothing, it was easy to give.
"I’m also a member of the Spirit Tiger Gang now, usually just helping them draw talismans." Zhang Chenyu said with a smile.
"Impressive, impressive, it turns out Fellow Daoist Zhang is a Talisman Master!" Xu Ping was slightly surprised.
Being a Talisman Master was a noble profession, much superior to his roles as a Spirit Plant cultivator and wine brewer.
"Oh, it’s nothing, it’s nothing, can’t do anything else, just barely make a living." Zhang Chenyu humbly said, but judging from his smiling face, he seemed quite proud.
"Dad, could you say a little less!" Zhang Ling’Er couldn’t help but say.
Almost lost his life because of this issue, still unable to correct this flaw.
Zhang Chenyu felt a bit suffocated inside, and retorted, "Are you telling your dad what to do now, I am talking with your uncle, kids shouldn’t interrupt."
Uncle!
Sigh!
Xu Ping’s face showed a somewhat unnatural smile at once.
But upon thinking carefully, given his age of 28, being an uncle to a girl of seventeen or eighteen was not unreasonable.
"Haha, niece... Fellow Daoist Ling’Er is just thinking of your well-being." Xu Ping said with a smile, trying to smooth over the awkwardness.
"Please don’t take offense, Fellow Daoist." Zhang Chenyu forced out a smile.
After exchanging a few pleasantries, Xu Ping took his leave and went home.
...
Arriving home.
Xu Ping thoughtfully stroked his chin, "I didn’t expect Zhang Chenyu to be a Talisman Master, I wonder if he’s selling his Talisman Master’s heritage."
He was quite interested in the Talisman Master’s heritage, after all, being a Talisman Master was like having a golden-egg-laying hen.
Also, with the panel, becoming a real Talisman Master would happen sooner or later.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
"But there’s no rush in this matter, let’s wait till the relationship between us deepens."
...
...
The next day, just as Zhang Chenyu said, members of the Spirit Tiger Gang came to collect protection fees, paid monthly, at a rate of two Spirit Stones.
Xu Ping handed over the two Spirit Stones happily.
After the Spirit Tiger Gang members left, no one disturbed him in the following days.
Xu Ping could also settle down to cultivate.
Of course, he spent a few days digging the basement.
...
Ten days later.
In the bedroom.
Xu Ping swallowed the Spirit Gathering Pill in one gulp, crossed his legs, operated the cultivation technique, and began cultivating.
As he delved deeper into cultivation, Xu Ping gradually felt an unprecedented power within his body, with mana flowing intensely like tidewaters.
Although he hadn’t broken through to Qi Cultivation level five, the mana inside him grew increasingly intense.
The process continued for an unknown period.
Xu Ping suddenly opened his eyes, expelling a puff of gray-black gas from his mouth, instantly feeling his body much lighter and his mana circulating more smoothly.
"This mana!"
Feeling the intense mana inside him, Xu Ping was quite surprised.
The mana had grown as thick as that of some practitioners at Qi Cultivation level five.
"Five Elements Skill... has it broken through!?" Xu Ping excitedly opened the proficiency panel.
[Cultivation Technique: Five Elements Skill Minor Achievement (Level Four): 1/800]
"It really broke through!!"
Xu Ping carefully sensed the changes after achieving Minor Achievement in the Five Elements Skill.
Besides his mana becoming more intense, it had also become more pure.
Long-term Pill consumption certainly wouldn’t make his mana as pure as diligent self-cultivation.
The purity of mana didn’t affect cultivation and combat much but did influence breaking through bottlenecks.
Though with the proficiency panel, Xu Ping wasn’t afraid of being unable to break through, the purification of mana was always a good thing.
"Not bad, not bad, every breakthrough of the Five Elements Skill brings unexpected benefits." Xu Ping smiled.
The ordinary Five Elements Skill had almost been turned into top-tier divine power by him.
Besides the thicker and purer mana, his cultivation speed also enhanced, nearly comparable to Upper Grade Spirit Root.
"The speed of cultivating to Qi Cultivation nine layers has advanced again!"
Stretching lazily, Xu Ping headed to the kitchen to prepare some food.
...
...
Early the next morning.
In a dense forest, a figure rushed at increasing speed, quick to the point where only residual shadows could be seen running through the woods.
If not looked carefully, it would seem as if there were countless people in the woods.
Half a quarter of an hour later, Xu Ping stopped, gasping and sweating heavily, steaming with vapor.
"The speed added by Minor Achievement in the Light Body Technique is too fast, completely surpassing the speed specialists at Body Refining level three cultivators." Xu Ping said as he blew the cold wind, feeling delighted inside.
The Light Body Technique had already broken through two days ago, but the added speed was too fast, and he spent two days getting acclimated to it fully.
Such full-force execution really exceeded expectations.
"With this speed, some mid-stage Qi Cultivation practitioners, even those at level seven, can’t react fast enough before being slain by me."
In this perilous world, no greater joy exists than improving one’s power.

chapters.title: Chapter 34: Selling Goods
chapters.content:
Chapter 34: Chapter 34: Selling Goods
"However, the speed is too fast, and the physical requirements are too high. At full speed, my current second-level body refining seems to be a bit strained. I fear that when the Light Body Technique breaks through to Major Achievement, the second-level body refining will not be able to withstand it." Xu Ping frowned.
"Based on the current cultivation speed, it’s estimated that breaking through the Light Body Technique to Major Achievement will take more than a month."
"And the third level of the Nourishing Life Skill seems far off."
After purchasing all the second-level herbs, Xu Ping began cultivating the ’Nourishing Life Skill’ again, but even with the Hundred Flowers Brew, it would take three days to improve a little.
In smooth circumstances, it would take nearly three hundred days to complete the breakthrough.
Although such speed is already unattainable for other body refining cultivators.
Yet Xu Ping still felt it was somewhat slow, but currently, there seems to be no better method.
"Forget it, let’s take it slowly. The market situation is still stable now, and no one can threaten me for the time being, I’ll go home and practice swordsmanship."
"Swordsmanship is not far from perfection, and I wonder what changes will occur after reaching perfection."
...
...
Time flies, and in the blink of an eye, twenty days have passed.
Xu Ping again transformed into a big, muscular man with a rugged face, arriving at the trading post.
The Spirit Gathering Pills and Hundred Flowers Brew have been used up and need replenishment.
As soon as he arrived at the trading post, some sharp-eyed people recognized him.
Even though it’s been over a month since he annihilated the Xiongba Gang, such an intense battle with such impressive results make it hard not to recognize him.
"Is this the fierce person who destroyed the Xiongba Gang? His face indeed looks fierce, but why is he only at the fourth level of Qi cultivation!"
"What do you know?"
"This is just the surface, how do you know he hasn’t hidden his cultivation, and he’s truly powerful in body cultivation, possibly far advanced in third-level body refining."
"The fellow cultivator is right, I was fortunate enough to witness that battle. Besides the Xiongba Gang’s leader Zhou Tong being able to block a few of this fierce person’s sword strikes, everyone else was killed with a single strike, including those at the sixth level of Qi cultivation."
"So strong?"
"Otherwise, why is he called the fierce person?"
...
The discussions around didn’t affect Xu Ping.
He went straight to the Pill Workshop.
It was still the same blue-robed woman, but when she saw the black-robed, large-built Xu Ping, she was so frightened her face turned pale:
"This... this honored guest, what kind of pill are you looking for?"
’Am I really that scary?’ Xu Ping thought with some helplessness.
"Give me two bottles of Spirit Gathering Pills, and send me a bottle of Beast Repelling Powder."
"Honored... honored guest, please wait a moment." Despite Xu Ping’s calm demeanor, the blue-robed woman was still very nervous.
Afraid that she might accidentally offend Xu Ping, causing him to turn around and annihilate her.
Not until the transaction was completed did she breathe a sigh of relief.
Leaving the Pill Workshop.
Xu Ping began wandering around the stalls set up by loose cultivators.
He didn’t wander for long before stopping at a stall specializing in selling various spirit insects and Gu insects:
"How many spirit stones for these Polar Insects?"
"In reply, sir, one spirit stone for two insects." The vendor apparently recognized Xu Ping and fawningly responded with a smile.
"Give me sixty insects." Xu Ping replied.
"Alright..." The vendor immediately beamed with delight, surprised at the fierce person’s generous purchase.
After buying the Polar Insects, Xu Ping’s wallet was one-third emptier.
"Cultivation is really expensive! Just the basic monthly expenditure of spirit stones is over a hundred." He couldn’t help but lament inwardly.ᴛhis ᴜpdated by
"Although I can sustain for a few months with my current assets, eventually I’d run out of money."
"I must figure out a way to earn some money." Xu Ping silently resolved.
But after careful consideration, he realized he had almost no means to earn spirit stones.
Spirit plant cultivator?
There aren’t any spirit fields for him to cultivate now!
Hundred Flowers Brew?
In the current market, the sales must be extremely low, hardly enough to recover costs.
"Seems like every time I’ve made it big was by taking down the bandits, but..."
"No, no, when you walk by the river often you can’t avoid wet shoes. Some great celestial masters like to hide their cultivation, and you only have one life."
’Looks like, I’ll have to think of other ways.’ Xu Ping silently pondered.
’With the market disrupted, surely some technique inheritance will get leaked, like array tools, pill symbols, etc... If I can get my hands on one, it’d be a hen laying golden eggs.’
While thinking, Xu Ping arrived at the place to rent a stall.
He spent a spirit stone to rent a stall, displaying magical artifacts, talismans, herbs, and some miscellaneous pills.
Passersby couldn’t help but be amazed.
Just how many have this fierce person intercepted and killed?!
They looked at him with increasing apprehension and fear.
Because the quality of items on his stall was noticeably higher than others, some brave souls bought some talismans and herbs.
Thus, the whole morning passed.
Although people visited one after another, they all bought cheap items, adding up to just over ten spirit stones.
"Now the loose cultivators’ consumption downgrade is too severe; who knows when everything can be sold off." Xu Ping felt helpless.
"I find my daily time already insufficient, if it’s wasted on selling things, that would be too wasteful."
"Perhaps, I could find someone to help me sell." As Xu Ping was silently contemplating, a voice called out to him: "Sir."
He turned and saw Yuan Wei: "It’s you, what a coincidence!"
"It really is a coincidence." Yuan Wei smiled fawningly.
It was indeed a coincidence; he came to the trading post almost every day, hoping to encounter Xu Ping again, to attach himself to a powerful benefactor.
Xu Ping’s heart was moved, this person seemed like a great choice, didn’t he?
His cultivation is decent, and he’s familiar with the market.
"Are you interested in working with me?" Xu Ping asked with a smile.
"Of course I’m willing." Yuan Wei responded, excited.
Heaven does not let down the determined, and he finally attached himself to a powerful figure.
"Alright, I’ll give you a task..."
"Wh... what task?" Yuan Wei asked nervously.
"Don’t worry, it’s not too dangerous, have you ever set up a stall?" Xu Ping, noticing his apprehension, reassured him.
"Of course, I’ve set up stalls, hey! Which loose cultivator hasn’t?"
"Good to have set up stalls." Xu Ping nodded, "From now on, you’ll help me sell goods. Additionally, help me gather recent information, and I won’t treat you badly; I’ll give you ten percent commission."
"No problem, I’ll definitely complete the task." Yuan Wei confidently patted his chest.
"Let’s start with these." Xu Ping said as he handed over a stack of talismans, a magical artifact, and several herbs to Yuan Wei.
Then he asked for Yuan Wei’s address, arranging to settle accounts every four days.
He was not afraid of Yuan Wei running off with the goods; he could afford this loss with his current standing.
Besides, where could he run off to?
In this market, it’s inevitable they’d meet someday.
"By the way, help inquire if anyone is selling inheritance types like array tools, pill symbols, or the like. If there are any, remind me." Before leaving, Xu Ping instructed.
"This kind of inheritance is very rare; average people wouldn’t sell it. I’ll do my best to inquire." Yuan Wei responded with some difficulty.
"It’s okay, just do your best." Xu Ping didn’t pressure him.
After finishing all the instructions, he got up and left.

chapters.title: Chapter 35: Qi Cultivation Level 5
chapters.content:
Chapter 35: Chapter 35: Qi Cultivation Level 5
Midnight.
Cultivation completed.
Xu Ping opened the panel and his gaze fell on the cultivation stage.
[Stage: Fourth-layer Qi Cultivation: 98/100; Nourishing Life Skill Second-layer: 10/100]
"Almost there. At this rate, in just two days, I can break through to the fifth layer," Xu Ping’s eyes shone brightly.
He quickly calmed down.
"I don’t know if Yuan Wei can buy the inheritance. I can’t rely solely on him."
"The timing is right, I should also ask Zhang Chenyu if he’s willing to sell his talisman inheritance."
"However, I’ll wait until I break through to the fifth layer before going."
...
...
Two days later, late at night.
The spiritual power within Xu Ping’s body was guided by his consciousness into another tiny branch under increasing spiritual pressure, expanding and complicating the network of spiritual power within him.
"Boom!"
His whole body trembled.
He opened his eyes.
In an instant, there seemed to be a glimmer of light in his eyes, which quickly dimmed again.
"Finally reached the fifth layer of Qi Cultivation, next stop sixth layer, late-stage Qi Cultivation, Foundation Establishment..." Xu Ping’s face showed joy.
Although the breakthrough in cultivation didn’t significantly increase his strength.
But cultivation is the foundation of everything; without it, there’s no longevity, and without longevity, no matter how strong your battle power is, it’s useless.
Xu Ping reveled for a while and opened the proficiency panel.
[Name: Xu Ping]
[Longevity: 28/119 years]
[Stage: Fifth-layer Qi Cultivation: 1/100; Nourishing Life Skill Second-layer: 16/100]
[Cultivation Technique: Five Elements Skill, Minor Achievement (Fifth layer): 68/800]
[Skills: Spirit Rain Skill Mastery: 41/400; Geng Metal Finger Perfection: ∞; Light Body Technique Minor Achievement: 246/800; Flowing Cloud Sword Major Achievement: 864/1600; Fireball Technique Entry Level: 23/100]
Looking at the lifespan of a hundred and nineteen.
Xu Ping couldn’t help but sigh.
Setting aside the dangers of this world.
The life of cultivating immortality is actually quite pleasant.
A long life, no need to worry about approaching the end of life, a strong physique immune to diseases, and countless simply cooked yet extraordinarily delicious foods.
Of course, first, you have to be strong enough.
To survive all sorts of calamities.
Even the mighty Foundation Establishment cultivators can’t escape disasters.
The joy on Xu Ping’s face faded: "This is just a small step forward, the days ahead are long."
He stood up and walked out of the room, into the courtyard.
On a summer night, the chirping of insects was noisy, and a refreshing breeze blew, making one feel extremely comfortable.
But in the distance, there came faint beast roars and screams, disrupting this comfort.
Listening to the sounds, they seemed to be slowly approaching this area.
Xu Ping frowned and turned to look at a patch of forest.
With the help of moonlight, he could vaguely see several humanoid black figures drifting in the woods, occasionally emitting low growls.
Having crossed over for several months, Xu Ping was no longer a novice in immortal cultivation, and naturally understood what these humanoid black figures were.
They were a semi-evil presence formed by the intertwining and absorption of leftover resentful and evil qi following the mass deaths of cultivators.
This semi-evil presence was certainly incomparable to real evil presences.
Not only were they extremely fragile, but they would soon dissipate on their own.
But having so many semi-evil presences showed how severe the casualties of cultivators in Dongwu Market had been recently.
"Alas."
After a sigh, Xu Ping lost the mood to continue strolling and turned back to the house, slipping into the basement to sleep.
...
...
The next day.
Xu Ping calculated the time and arrived at Zhang Chenyu’s house.
Knock, knock, knock...
He knocked on the door.
With a creak, the door opened, and a pretty face appeared.
"Fellow Daoist Ling’Er." Xu Ping greeted with a smile.
"Oh, it’s Brother Xu!" Zhang Ling’Er’s face showed a bright smile, "Are you looking for my father?"
"Yes, I have something to discuss with your father." Xu Ping smiled slightly.
"Please come in, Brother Xu, my father is... huh?"
"Brother Xu, you broke through to the fifth layer of Qi Cultivation?" Zhang Ling’Er exclaimed.
"Just luck, I broke through yesterday," Xu Ping replied modestly.
"This isn’t just luck; Brother Xu is so young yet already in the fifth layer of Qi Cultivation, late-stage or even Foundation Establishment wouldn’t be impossible for you." The girl’s eyes showed admiration and envy.
Despite being praised as young by a girl nearly ten years his junior, Xu Ping couldn’t help but smile: "Not at all, I’m still far behind some true geniuses."
"Please come in, Brother Xu, I’ll go call my father." Zhang Ling’Er giggled, turned, and walked inside.
Xu Ping followed her into Zhang Chenyu’s study, fragrant with ink, with walls full of talismans exuding a faint Spiritual Qi.
Zhang Chenyu was sitting at the desk, holding a talisman, seemingly in the final stages of its creation.
Xu Ping didn’t disturb him, standing quietly to the side and waiting.
Soon, Zhang Chenyu completed the final steps, and a talisman was completed.Follow current novels on
"Fellow Daoist Xu, you’ve come!" Zhang Chenyu looked up, seeing Xu Ping, he smiled slightly.
"I just arrived. Zhang Daoist’s skill in talisman drawing is truly eye-opening," Xu Ping praised.
"Hahaha, not really, I just casually drew a First Rank Upper Grade Golden Saber Talisman, nothing worth mentioning," Zhang Chenyu put down the talisman, stood up, looking quite pleased.
"Ling’Er, serve tea," Zhang Chenyu instructed.
"Got it."
The two sat down at the wooden table, and Zhang Ling’Er had already poured the tea.
After a few sips, Xu Ping felt the time was right, and said, "I’m actually here today with something to ask of Zhang Daoist."
"Fellow Daoist Xu, feel free to speak," Zhang Chenyu replied.
"I’d like to purchase some talisman inheritances. I hear that Zhang Daoist’s talisman skills are ancestral, and I wish to learn some from you," Xu Ping spoke directly.
"Purchase talisman inheritances?"
Zhang Chenyu frowned slightly but quickly relaxed: "Logically speaking, Fellow Daoist Xu saved my daughter and me, and giving them to you would be the least I could do, let alone selling them."
"However, ancestral rules prohibit sharing these skills, and I swore an oath at my ancestors’ graves."
Xu Ping’s heart sank upon hearing this.
But unexpectedly, Zhang Chenyu continued: "However, although the ancestral skills cannot be sold, I have another incomplete talisman inheritance, only up to First Rank Middle Grade; I don’t know if Fellow Daoist Xu would be interested."
"I’d be more than interested!" Xu Ping was overjoyed.
He didn’t even know how to draw the simplest of talismans; First Rank Middle Grade was simply too far for him.
By the time he could draw First Rank Middle Grade, he might very well have access to even better things.
"It’s good that Fellow Daoist Xu doesn’t mind," Zhang Chenyu chuckled, handing an old book to Xu Ping.
"What are you saying, Zhang Daoist?" Xu Ping laughed as he accepted the old book, then asked, "How many Spirit Stones does this inheritance cost?"
"There’s no need to discuss Spirit Stones between us; consider it repayment for saving my life," Zhang Chenyu waved his hands.
"Fair is fair, whatever Spirit Stones are due must be given," Xu Ping insisted earnestly.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, you’re being too courteous..." Zhang Chenyu tried to refuse.
Five minutes later.
After some back-and-forth, Xu Ping finally paid Zhang Chenyu fifty-five Spirit Stones, but Zhang Chenyu also gifted Xu Ping an old talisman pen, a stack of talisman papers, and a bottle of spiritual ink.

chapters.title: Chapter 36: The Evil Spirit Attacks
chapters.content:
Chapter 36: Chapter 36: The Evil Spirit Attacks
A book of talisman inheritance of First Rank Mid-grade, an old talisman pen, a stack of talisman paper, and a bottle of spiritual ink.
Although the old talisman pen is a Lower Grade Magical Artifact, altogether only fifty-five Spirit Stones are required, which is practically a bargain.
Zhang Chenyu may have some quirks, but he is a decent person.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, how much do you know about talisman drawing?" Zhang Chenyu asked after taking a sip of tea.
"Not a clue." Xu Ping shook his head.
"Then let me tell you some of the most basic things about talisman drawing." Zhang Chenyu said.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Zhang." Xu Ping was overjoyed.
Having such a highly skilled Talisman Master he is willing to teach him is definitely much better than exploring alone.
"It’s nothing, just something to do while idle."
"First of all, drawing talismans require attention to the use of Spiritual Qi." Zhang Chenyu said seriously, "A talisman is not just a pattern; each stroke contains the power of Spiritual Qi..."
Xu Ping listened earnestly, silently noting the essentials in his heart.
"Let’s try drawing the simplest basic talisman, the Cleaning Talisman."
Zhang Chenyu said as he picked up the pen and began sketching the pattern on the paper.
His movements were smooth and confident, the pen tip lightly gliding on the paper, leaving clear lines behind.
"It must be completed in one breath, without interruption, otherwise it will fail." He patiently explained.
Xu Ping carefully observed from the side, secretly noting each step.
"You try!" Zhang Chenyu handed the paper to Xu Ping.
"The Cleaning Talisman is the most basic talisman, you can use ordinary yellow paper, but for rank-entering talismans, talisman paper is needed." He added.
"Understood."
Xu Ping took a deep breath, dipped the talisman making pen in spiritual ink.
Officially beginning his first talisman making attempt.
He held his breath, his gaze focused and serious, while softly and evenly transmitting Spiritual Power from his palm through the pen tip.
But suddenly!
"Bang!"
A ball of flame rose, the talisman paper ignited spontaneously.
Xu Ping was startled and slightly recoiled.
Fortunately, he quickly reacted and extinguished the flame with one hand.
"No worries, it’s normal for the first attempt to fail; when I first drew a talisman, I failed several times." Zhang Chenyu comforted.
"Continue, Fellow Daoist Xu should pay attention to keeping Spiritual Qi output stable." He reminded again.
"Okay." Xu Ping nodded and began the attempt again.
The first talisman drawing failure did not affect him at all.
Isn’t it just failure!
That’s quite normal!
In the ensuing time, Xu Ping constantly repeated between drawing talismans and failing.
Initially, Zhang Chenyu offered words of comfort, but later he became numb to it.
This was the most basic Cleaning Talisman, and drawing thirty-something of them all failed; this heavenly fate seemed somewhat powerful.
Several times he couldn’t help but consider saying, "Fellow Daoist Xu, maybe you should give up on talisman drawing, anything else might be better!"
But when he saw Xu Ping still exuberant in spirit, he couldn’t bring himself to interrupt.
Finally, when Xu Ping drew his forty-fifth talisman, the Cleaning Talisman succeeded!
Zhang Chenyu wanted to congratulate him, but upon opening his mouth couldn’t think of what to say, only manage to squeeze out a slight smile, "Xu...Fellow Daoist Xu, your potential for improvement is significant."
Xu Ping naturally understood his own poor talent for talisman drawing, but he didn’t care, having now achieved this milestone, the rest seemed simpler.
"Today has troubled Fellow Daoist Zhang greatly," Xu Ping thanked sincerely.
"Just a minor thing." Zhang Chenyu waved his hand, "Henceforth if Fellow Daoist Xu encounters any issues in talisman drawing, feel free to come to me."
"How could I dare..."
After some casual chatting, Xu Ping bid farewell and returned home.
Upon returning home, he resumed drawing the Cleaning Talisman.
With the panel’s enhancement, talisman drawing felt divinely assisted, with success rate soaring; each success brought forth new insights.
Leading him to become completely engrossed.
...
Midnight.
"Bang!"
The half-finished Cleaning Talisman quickly combusted, Xu Ping was unfazed, casually extinguishing it with one hand.
His Mana was mostly drained, with a faint throbbing headache.
"It’s time to rest." Xu Ping rubbed his forehead.
From returning home until now, he hadn’t taken a break, solely focused on talisman drawing, yielding impressive results.
Currently, his success rate in talisman drawing could maintain at sixty percent.
Xu Ping stretched, joints making subtle popping sounds, then using the Cleaning Talisman to cleanse his body, turned, and went underground to sleep.
...
As night deepened, everything fell silent.
Though the sky was clear, there was an unsettling tranquility.
Suddenly, a few cold raindrops broke the silence.
Although the rain quickly ceased, clouds resembled a giant black curtain, swiftly obscuring the moon, shrouding the earth in dense darkness.
Then the wind rose.
Rustling the sycamore leaves.
Bang!
At that instant, a bolt of lightning slashed through the sky like a sharp sword, illuminating the entire world.
In that fleeting light, a figure emerged, staggering as if learning to walk for the first time, each step appeared so arduous and uncoordinated.
In the night, the clouds silently receded, allowing the moon to reclaim the sky.
Silvery moonlight cast onto the earth, outlining the figure’s contours.
The shadow now stood at Bai Wu’s doorstep.
’Creak’ the door suddenly opened by itself.
The figure swayed in.
Under normal circumstances, Bai Wu wouldn’t be asleep at this hour.
But today he tried a demanding female cultivator physically, consuming energy and feeling mentally exhausted, thus retiring early.
At this moment in sleep, Bai Wu was roused by an urgent need to relieve himself.
For some reason, the longer he slept, the colder he felt, cold enough to make his extremities numb, and thus awakened by the urge.
He struggled to open his eyes, attempting to rise.
But his limbs were stiff as if frozen, unable to move.
Moreover, the surrounding cold intensified, his thoughts nearing complete frost.
Just then, he heard staggering footsteps, like an elderly person dragging heavy steps in the room.
Bai Wu strove to turn his head.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Only to see a muddied old man appearing at his bedside.
The old man’s face was deathly pale, veins bulging from his face, eyes eerily white glaring at him!
Every hair on Bai Wu’s body stood on end, an inexplicable dread swiftly brewing within him.
"Evil...presence!" Bai Wu managed to squeeze out some words through clenched teeth, voice trembling with fear.
"Why...didn’t lend...lend me...money!" The old man murmured haltingly, slowly moving closer, unexpectedly sprouting several tentacles.
"I... don’t... help..."
Fear engulfed him like tides, Bai Wu attempted to resist, struggling desperately to rise, but his body remained motionless, Mana within his meridians and Dantian felt frozen.
He could only stare helplessly as the tentacles from the old man approached relentlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 37: Success
chapters.content:
Chapter 37: Chapter 37: Success
The tentacles, like living creatures, flexibly and icily wrapped around Bai Wu’s body little by little.
Bai Wu felt a piercing chill spreading throughout his body via the tentacles. His consciousness gradually blurred, as if being sucked into a bottomless abyss.
A quarter of an hour later, the old man walked out of Bai Wu’s house, the door closed automatically.
The old man still staggered as he walked, his face was still pale, but there was a strange sense of satisfaction in his eyes. His figure seemed especially eerie under the chilly moonlight.
...
...
Early the next morning, Xu Ping altered his appearance and found Yuan Wei’s residence.
"Besides the three remaining Fireball Talismans, everything else has been sold. These are the Spirit Stones from the sales." Yuan Wei handed over a bulging money bag, feeling tense inside, worried that selling them cheap would make the other suspect he pocketed some profit.
Yet, also worried selling them high would mean less commission.
Xu Ping responded with an "Hmm," took the bag, and expressionlessly poured the Spirit Stones onto the table.
With a "rustling" sound.
A multitude of Spirit Stones rolled everywhere.
"Ninety-eight Spirit Stones... a good sale!" Xu Ping tallied them up; the price slightly exceeded his expectations.
He initially thought selling eighty pieces was decent, but unexpectedly almost reached a hundred.
"The major sales were mainly Magical Artifacts, sold nearly fifty Lower Grade pieces, while the talismans and herbs were sold based on market pricing," Yuan Wei noticeably breathed a sigh of relief.
Xu Ping separated ten Spirit Stones, pushed them aside, and stored the rest back in a storage bag.
"This is your share!"
"Thank you, boss!" Yuan Wei expressed his joy.
Ten Spirit Stones was by no means a small sum, enough to purchase a hundred and fifty pounds of Demon Beast Flesh.
Currently, prices are skyrocketing, especially Demon Beast Flesh and Spirit Rice rising the most.
Increasing several-fold.
In today’s market, there are only a few ways to earn money.
Either master a skill, like painting talismans or alchemy, people in these fields can still live comfortably nowadays.
Technical talents are admired everywhere.
Or possess great strength and form a gang.
High-end gangs extend like the market’s four major forces, making money by providing secured venues charging rent; lower-grade ones, like the Xiongba Gang, extort, murder, and commit arson.
If you have neither strength nor skills, you can only venture out for hunting demons and gathering spirit medicines.
This type of person is currently the most numerous and at the bottom tier in the market.
Xu Ping retrieved a Lower Grade Magical Artifact, a stack of talismans, and herbs from storage, saying: "Same amount as last time, sell well. You can secretly pocket the money, just don’t let me find out!"
"Boss, even if you lent me courage, I wouldn’t dare pocket your money!" Yuan Wei hastily expressed his stance.
He had witnessed the other’s ruthlessness before and didn’t want to risk his life over a few Spirit Stones.
"No need for further words. By the way, any clue on the inheritance matter?" Crystal clear and no fish, as long as it’s not excessive. Xu Ping only slightly tapped the message before asking about the inheritance issue.
"No, I asked several people but got nothing." Yuan Wei felt a bit troubled.
"It’s okay, take your time." Having gained Talisman Master inheritance, Xu Ping’s desire for more inheritance dropped significantly. It would be great to have more, but he’d accept if there wasn’t any.
After finishing all instructions, he got up and left.
....
Leaving Yuan Wei’s house, Xu Ping took another road.New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
He saw a headless corpse lying by the roadside.
The entire body had been stripped, exposing all the wounds.
Xu Ping’s expression didn’t change a bit, accustomed to passing by the corpse.
The market, which had barely restored calm, started to become chaotic again.
When the market was broken, it had just been after the autumn harvest, so everyone’s food reserves were still sufficient.
But as time passed, the food reserves became scarcer, and more people living in difficulty started to take desperate measures.
Xu Ping still had a decent amount of stored Spirit Rice and Demon Beast Flesh, enough to last him months.
...
...
Returning home, Xu Ping began painting talismans again.
This time he didn’t continue with Cleaning Talismans; instead, he started painting another basic talisman—the Silence Talisman.
Cleaning Talisman wasn’t worth much; reaching this success rate was already sufficient.
Once he completed painting four basic talismans, he could officially start painting First Rank Talismans.
With the experience from painting Cleaning Talismans, he successfully painted Silence Talismans after only failing thirty-some times.
Next were the Calm Heart and Guiding Talismans.
Xu Ping took two days to conquer each one.
After finishing all the basic talismans, he didn’t start painting First Rank Talismans immediately.
Instead, he spent another day re-painting the four basic talismans to reinforce them again.
...
The next day.
Xu Ping officially began painting First Rank Talismans.
He chose the First Rank Lower Grade Exorcism Talisman.
Exorcism Talisman, as the name suggests, can purge negative energies, causing harm to malevolent entities, and even alert for warning when encountering powerful evil spirits.
In this world rife with evil spirits, it is a popular talisman.
However, Exorcism Talismans have the highest success rate when drawn at noon.
Sitting quietly waiting.
Time flew by, and soon it was noon.
"It’s time!"
Xu Ping suddenly opened his eyes and got up straight.
The method of making Exorcism Talismans flashed through his mind constantly.
He picked up the brush, dipped it in ink, and began to draw talismans.
The brush tip wandered over the Lower Grade Talisman paper for several minutes. Finally, the pen stroke became less smooth, gradually a bit unyielding...
"Not good!"
Sweat beads appeared on Xu Ping’s forehead.
Fizz~
The talisman paper’s rune shifted slightly, emitting wisps of blue smoke and a small flame.
The first one ruined.
...
The second one also ruined.
...
Consecutively ruined over a dozen.
"Huh!"
Xu Ping had to pause to adjust his breath and Mana, wiping the sweat off his forehead: "Entering rank Talismans are certainly difficult to draw."
Not only did it consume more Mana, but more attention was needed for details.
Failed over a dozen times, couldn’t even grasp the key.
"I still refuse to believe this!" Xu Ping got riled up, picked up the talisman brush, and started drawing again.
But until past noon, he hadn’t completed a single talisman.
"Should I continue?" Xu Ping frowned.
Post-noon, success rates plummet, and the later it got, the lower the rate.
After contemplating for a moment, he still decided to continue.
At worst, he’d use up more talisman paper. Given his current wealth, he could afford it.
Plus, each failure contributed to experience accumulation, aiming to complete the Exorcism Talisman soon.
Time passed in Xu Ping drawing talismans.
...
Three days later.
At noon.
Xu Ping took a talisman paper, lightly dipped the brush into Spirit Ink, and started drawing without hesitation.
The brushstrokes were smooth, like flowing clouds and water, without a single hindrance; Spiritual Power was seamless, everything was extremely smooth, without a single mishap.
He restrained the excitement inside, completing the talisman painting effortlessly, with zest.
"Done!"
Watching the talisman’s rune glow gradually dim and finally vanish, Xu Ping relaxed his tense spirit, feeling utterly fatigued.

chapters.title: Chapter 38: Old Sun
chapters.content:
Chapter 38: Chapter 38: Old Sun
Ding!
[Exorcism Talisman Experience +1]
A message suddenly popped up in Xu Ping’s vision.
"Got on the list!"
Xu Ping couldn’t help but grin, the rest would be simple, just grind it out.
He quickly collected his excitement, realizing that he had only drawn a Lower Grade talisman for now. It was just enough to get by, far from making big money.
To really make big money, he needed to draw First Rank Upper Grade talismans.
The market price for a First Rank Lower Grade talisman is around two Spirit Stones.
While a First Rank Upper Grade talisman would fetch at least twelve Spirit Stones.
That’s a sixfold price difference.
The pure profit difference is even more substantial.
"Keep going, keep going." Xu Ping decided to strike while the iron was hot and draw a few more before noon.
With that thought, he continued drawing talismans until the evening.
The success rate after getting on the list wasn’t bad, with two successes out of five attempts, a 40% success rate.
Generally, if you maintain a 30% success rate with First Rank talismans, you won’t lose money.
40% gives a small profit, and 60% or higher means big profits.
Breaking a 60% success rate in drawing talismans signifies complete mastery of the craft.
"The past few days have been exhausting with all this talisman drawing, time to have a good meal and treat myself." Xu Ping stretched and walked into the kitchen.
...
...
Deep into the night.
A crescent new moon hung high in the sky, its clear, water-like glow illuminating the earth.
At this moment, a muddy and ragged figure emerged from the shadows of the forest.
Under the moonlight, it was none other than ’Old Sun.’
’Old Sun’ moved forward slowly, muttering ceaselessly, "Why won’t you lend me Spirit Stones, why won’t you lend me Spirit Stones..."
Howl!
Suddenly, a wolf demon that had barged into the market saw ’Old Sun.’
Smelling food, it roared and charged at ’Old Sun.’
Just as it got close, a spine-chilling, icy aura surged forth, making the wolf demon stop in its tracks involuntarily.
The wolf demon, though not very smart, instinctively felt fear and emitted a sorrowful cry, turning to flee.
"Why won’t you lend me Spirit Stones!" But ’Old Sun’ wouldn’t let it escape, he roared furiously, becoming a blur as he quickly caught up to the wolf demon.
Tentacles sprouted from his body, tightly wrapping around the wolf demon.
A few minutes later.
The withered corpse of the wolf demon lay motionless on the ground.
’Old Sun,’ with a look of satisfaction on his face, slowly stepped forward, one step at a time.
No one knows how long he walked until he finally stopped in front of Xu Ping’s door.
Bedroom.
While concentrating on practicing his sword skills, Xu Ping suddenly felt a rush of unease, a chill creeping up from his feet to the back of his head, raising goosebumps all over.
"What’s going on!?"
He frowned, a faint sense of uneasiness lingering in his heart.
If this were his past life, he might have dismissed it as a random thought, but this was the cultivation world.
A cultivator’s intuition is not without reason; it often saves lives.
Xu Ping decided to go outside and take a look.
As he opened the door, silence surrounded him, only the sound of the wind echoed in his ears, and the moonlight shone down on the muddy, damp road.
He let his gaze wander, trying to locate the source of his discomfort.
However, everything was silent, except for some insects chirping; there was nothing else.
Still, he did not lower his guard, meticulously inspecting the surroundings of his home, but to no avail.
"Could it really be just an illusion?" Xu Ping frowned, returning indoors.
His heart couldn’t settle, so as a precaution, he decided to stay awake.
He sat cross-legged on his bed, closing his eyes to focus his mind.
The night quietly passed, with Xu Ping remaining in a vigilant state throughout.
As the first light of dawn seeped through the window, his mood gradually calmed.
"Could it truly have been a hallucination?" Xu Ping opened his eyes, puzzled.
After some thought, he decided to ask Zhang Chenyu.
....
"Fellow Daoist Zhang, did you encounter anything strange yesterday?" Sitting at the table, Xu Ping looked at Zhang Chenyu across from him.
"Something strange?" Zhang Chenyu blinked, then shook his head, "No, everything was quite peaceful yesterday."
"Did something happen?"
Xu Ping hesitated for a moment but eventually shared the inexplicable anxiety he felt last night.
"Logically, a cultivator’s intuition shouldn’t be baseless, but there are exceptions occasionally. Fellow Daoist Xu also checked around, found nothing, so perhaps your intuition just acted up," Zhang Chenyu comforted.
"Maybe." Xu Ping nodded.
Still, he hadn’t completely let it go. He planned to observe a few more nights, and if he found nothing, perhaps it was indeed just his imagination.
"By the way, how’s the talisman drawing going, Fellow Daoist Xu?" Zhang Chenyu changed the topic.
"Not bad, I managed to draw an Exorcism Talisman."
"Pfft!"
Zhang Chenyu sputtered out Spirit Tea, slightly opening his mouth in shock: "You...what? You’ve drawn an Exorcism Talisman??"
A few days ago, you were still struggling with basic talismans, and now you’ve drawn a First Rank Lower Grade talisman???
Did my ears deceive me???
"Yes, I was lucky to succeed once." Xu Ping nodded.
He didn’t expect such a big reaction from Zhang Chenyu, but revealing a First Rank Lower Grade talisman was no big deal.
With his current strength, he can completely protect himself.
"Come, draw an Exorcism Talisman for me." Zhang Chenyu took a deep breath, trying to suppress his shock.
"The success rate is low when it’s not noon," Xu Ping replied.
"It’s okay, I mainly want to see your technique and fluidity." Zhang Chenyu led Xu Ping to the desk where he often drew talismans.
"The pen’s a bit unwieldy..." Xu Ping didn’t hesitate, picking up the pen, taking a deep breath to calm himself before he started drawing.
However, his mastery of Exorcism Talismans was not yet high, and since it wasn’t noon, he failed four times before succeeding on the fifth attempt.
Watching as the talisman’s faint glow gradually faded.
Zhang Chenyu gaped, stunned, "No way, you actually drew it!"
With this technique and fluidity, wouldn’t the success rate soar past 40% at noon?
Is this really the same Fellow Daoist from a few days ago?
"What did you think, that I was just joking?" Xu Ping spread his hands.
Zhang Chenyu had a myriad of things to say but ended up sourly congratulating him, "Congratulations, Fellow Daoist Xu. It seems your talent in talisman drawing far surpasses mine."
If he couldn’t match Xiu Ping in cultivation and combat, so be it, but even in talisman drawing?The source of this content ɪs NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
How could he ever boast in front of Xu Ping in the future?
"Mainly because Fellow Daoist Zhang taught me well." Xu Ping complimented.
Heh!
If I didn’t know how to draw talismans, I might have believed your nonsense.
Zhang Chenyu cast a resentful glance at Xu Ping.
...
At home.
Recalling Zhang Chenyu’s resentful expression made Xu Ping chuckle.
With Zhang Chenyu’s personality, not being able to brag would be pretty painful!
Xu Ping stretched before preparing to catch up on some sleep.
He planned to keep an eye on things tonight as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 39: Old Sun Returns
chapters.content:
Chapter 39: Chapter 39: Old Sun Returns
Night fell once again.
The last traces of sunset gradually disappeared from the horizon, and the darkness, like a heavy curtain, slowly enveloped the entire Dongwu Market. Occasionally, the wind would blow, lifting a few fallen leaves to dance in the air.
Xu Ping sat on the bed, cross-legged, with his eyes closed, meditating.
Time passed second by second, the room was silent, with only the sound of his breathing and the occasional wind.
The night grew deeper, as if countless eyes were hidden in the darkness, coldly watching the small house.
Xu Ping’s heartbeat gradually steadied. He tried hard to enter a deep meditative state to enhance his spiritual power and perception.
Suddenly, a slight "click" broke the silence.
"It’s here!"
Xu Ping’s eyes snapped open, a gleam of light flashed through them.
He quickly opened the door, took a few swift steps, and leaped up, landing steadily on the top of the wall.
The night was like water, a thin mist spread over the ground, like a light veil covering the earth.
Xu Ping’s gaze swept around, and soon, his heart almost skipped a beat.
He saw a thin figure, disheveled and covered in a layer of shadow, standing at the entrance of the Bai family, a pair of crimson eyes staring intensely at him, exuding a strange and eerie aura.
The two of them faced each other in silence, as if time had frozen at this moment.
"Old... Old Sun!!" Xu Ping was shocked. He could never have imagined that this malevolence was actually the long-missing Old Sun.
Old Sun continued to stare at him, the fierce light in his eyes growing stronger, the chill emanating from him made the surroundings feel colder, Xu Ping’s hands and feet felt numb, and even his Mana operated sluggishly.
Xu Ping was startled, realizing that this was definitely Old Sun’s doing.
An Exorcism Talisman appeared in his hand.
He cast it immediately.
The Exorcism Talisman quickly ignited and dissolved in the air.
A powerful surge of yang energy swept around.
Old Sun let out a low growl, a sound not unlike a human, reminiscent of an ancient beast, with an intimidating savageness.
At the same time, Xu Ping saw a blur in front of him, the figure turned into a shadow and rapidly fled, soon disappearing without a trace.
"Such incredible speed..." Xu Ping was startled.
This speed was almost enough to rival his own.
As Old Sun left, the chilling air around gradually faded, hands and feet warmed, and the Mana within flowed smoothly.
Looking at the ink-black night, Xu Ping felt a heaviness in his heart; Old Sun, possessed by malevolence, had grown substantially in power.
With the strength it displayed, even cultivators at the Late-Stage Qi Cultivation might not be able to match it.
Xu Ping took a deep breath and returned indoors, closing the door behind him.
He sat on a stool, without any joy in seeing Old Sun off, feeling rather burdened.
"It seems Old Sun has taken a liking to me."
He came yesterday, and again today, clearly targeting him.
"I absolutely cannot sit and wait for death!"
Xu Ping quickly made up his mind, determined to eliminate Old Sun.
This malevolence feeds on the blood of cultivators; if it manages to suck enough, he might also end up drained.
"The Exorcism Talisman is somewhat lacking," Xu Ping frowned.
The Exorcism Talisman was easily dodged by Old Sun. Although it managed to scare him away, it was not enough to kill him.
"I’ll ask Zhang Chenyu tomorrow and see what other talismans can restrain malevolence."
"Damn it, is it because I didn’t lend him money, so after becoming malevolent, he specifically targeted me?" Xu Ping felt a wave of frustration.
He dared not sleep tonight, unsure if Old Sun might return again.
...
...
The next morning, sunlight streamed in through the curtains.
Old Sun did not return after he left.
Xu Ping let out a sigh of relief, got out of bed, stretched, and headed to the kitchen.
He fetched a basin of water from the water jar.
"Splash"
The calm water surface was broken.
Xu Ping washed his face quickly, and the cold water revitalized him quite a bit.
After freshening up, he made his way to Zhang Chenyu’s house.
...
"What! You encountered malevolence last night!!??"
Before Xu Ping could finish speaking, Zhang Chenyu jumped up with a start.
"Daoist Zhang, please calm down first." Xu Ping wanted Zhang Chenyu to sit down and talk slowly.
"How can I not be agitated? This is malevolence, man-eating malevolence!" Zhang Chenyu’s voice was filled with fear and panic.
"I know..."
"No, you don’t understand the horror of malevolence!"
"Since malevolence is already here, getting worked up solves nothing. It’s better to sit and discuss how to deal with it."
Zhang Chenyu was stunned, his mouth slightly open, speechless, and he sat down in frustration:
"Why am I so unlucky, I was about to leave this damned place, who knew that a Golden Core Demon Beast might show up. Finally settling down, and now malevolence appears."
Listening to Zhang Chenyu’s complaints about his bad luck, Xu Ping felt nothing, even found it amusing.
Comparing misfortune with him?
Zhang Chenyu had nothing on him.
"One should look forward. Don’t mind being unlucky now, maybe things will get worse later."
Zhang Chenyu: ???
"Just kidding, just kidding, Daoist Zhang. Besides the Exorcism Talisman, are there other talismans that can restrain malevolence?" Xu Ping asked.
Zhang Chenyu gave Xu Ping a resentful look, and slowly replied, "There are, the Five-Thunder Talisman can also restrain malevolence."
"The Five-Thunder Talisman can restrain malevolence?" Xu Ping was a bit surprised.
"Of course." Zhang Chenyu nodded, talking about his area of expertise, he grew confident.
"The Exorcism Talisman’s yang power, the Thunder Power of the Five-Thunder Talisman, and even the flame power of the Fireball Talisman can restrain malevolence."
"It’s just that the flame power in the Fireball Talisman isn’t as strong as the first two," he added.
"Then between the Five-Thunder Talisman and the Exorcism Talisman, which restrains malevolence more?" Xu Ping asked.
"Of course, the Five-Thunder Talisman. The Exorcism Talisman is merely a First Rank Lower Grade talisman, whereas the Five-Thunder Talisman is a First Rank Upper Grade talisman."
"I remember Daoist Zhang can draw the Five-Thunder Talisman, right? Can you sell me a few?"
"I could, but even if I give my all, the success rate of drawing a Five-Thunder Talisman isn’t high. Plus, with malevolence lurking, I probably can’t sell you many."
"It’s alright, sell me whatever you can."
...
In the end, Xu Ping left Zhang Chenyu’s house with three Five-Thunder Talismans.
At home.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Xu Ping silently took a sip of water, lost in thought.
"Though the Five-Thunder Talisman is more effective against malevolence, Old Sun is too fast. Catching him won’t be easy. I’ll wait until my Light Body Technique reaches Minor Achievement before going after him, to ensure success."
Xu Ping looked at the skill panel and focused on the skill.
[Light Body Technique Minor Achievement: 712/800]
"Almost there, just five or six more days."

chapters.title: Chapter 40: Light Body Technique Mastered
chapters.content:
Chapter 40: Chapter 40: Light Body Technique Mastered
Two days later.
Xu Ping visited Yuan Wei’s home again.
"Master, something bad has happened at the market. Evil spirits have appeared, and many cultivators have been drained of their flesh and blood, leaving only bones." Yuan Wei said in shock.
"I know." Xu Ping nodded calmly.
Seeing Xu Ping remain so calm, Yuan Wei couldn’t help but secretly admire him. He’s truly a fierce man who destroyed the Xiongba Gang, unfazed even when hearing of evil spirits.
"Master, do you need to buy some Exorcism Talismans? The price for talismans at the market is almost four Spirit Stones each, and they might increase even more in a few days." Yuan Wei asked.
"Almost four Spirit Stones each?" Xu Ping felt a stir in his heart.
After a moment of thought, he took out more than twenty Exorcism Talismans from his storage bag and handed them to Yuan Wei: "Sell these together as well."
Yuan Wei was slightly stunned but quickly understood. The master intended to seize this opportunity to make some money!
Though it’s a good time to earn, if all the Exorcism Talismans are sold out and they encounter evil spirits, what will they do then?
It’s hard to abandon such a big backer; if he were lost, it would be heartbreaking.
"Master, shouldn’t we keep a few? After all, evil spirits are really fierce." Yuan Wei hesitated before cautiously reminding.
"No need, I have better things." Xu Ping refused.
"Understood." Yuan Wei nodded.
It made sense; considering the master’s strength and possessions, he surely had better alternatives.
...
...
Three days later.
In the dense forest.
Standing in the forest, Xu Ping suddenly flashed with a spiritual light, and his whole being turned into a breeze, disappearing into thin air.
A series of loud rumblings suddenly erupted, as nearby trees began to split one after another from the middle, the cuts smooth and mirror-like, yet no one was visible around.
Moments later.
Slightly glowing with spiritual light and holding the Qinghe Sword, Xu Ping’s figure emerged.
Although he was panting and sweating profusely, the corners of his mouth turned up slightly, revealing an uncontainable joy.
"After the Light Body Technique broke through to mastery, I’ve reached beyond the limits of the naked eye. Unless someone has practiced magic related to eyesight, they probably can’t catch my figure."
"With just this speed alone, I might already reign at the Qi Refining Realm. And if I add the mastery of the Flowing Cloud Sword..."
"Though I dare not say invincible in the Qi Refining Realm, there are certainly few stronger than me."
"But such extreme speed puts a heavy burden on the body. Even with my current physique, I cannot sustain it for long. If prolonged, my whole being might completely collapse." Xu Ping frowned slightly.
"Ah, the Nourishing Life Skill is progressing too slowly." He sighed lightly, "Perhaps I should ask whether Yuan Wei or Zhang Chenyu have a solution."
"But not now."
Xu Ping made a flourish with his sword and placed it into his storage bag.
"It’s time to find ’Old Sun’." His eyes flashed with a fierce light.
With the mastery of the Light Body Technique and the Five-Thunder Talisman in hand, he was already in an invincible position.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
...
...
In the days that followed, every midnight, Xu Ping would quietly get up, leave the house, wander nearby, searching for the whereabouts of ’Old Sun’.
He wondered if ’Old Sun’ had left this area.
After several days, there was no trace.
...
Late that night.
Moonlight like water, spilled over every inch of land in the dense forest.
After several days without finding traces of ’Old Sun’ nearby, Xu Ping planned to expand his search.
After more than half an hour.
Xu Ping passed by a household.
Suddenly, a sinister wind mixed with piercing cold emanated from the house, chilling to the bone.
"Where!"
Xu Ping’s eyes flashed fiercely.
He knew this aura too well.
Xu Ping suddenly dashed to the door, kicking it open.
He was on high alert, ready for combat, prepared to draw his sword at any moment.
As he scanned the room, he found no trace of ’Old Sun’, only saw two figures lying straight on the bed in the bedroom.
Walking a few steps forward, Xu Ping saw the dried corpses of a man and a woman lying on the bed.
The two corpses had lost almost all moisture, their skin shriveled, muscles extremely atrophied, looking like two skeletons.
Even more frightening was that both corpses had their mouths wide open, their eyes glaring angrily, but showed no signs of struggle, as if they turned into corpses in an instant.
The miserable state of the two made Xu Ping’s heart sink.
"Late by a step." He sighed lightly.
After searching carefully, he found two storage bags, an unexpected gain.
...
...
In the following days, there was still no trace of ’Old Sun’, but the number of cultivators drained by it continued to increase.
For a time, the entire market was plunged into panic. Even the large factions organized nightly patrols, but still found no traces.
In this atmosphere of fear, the price of Exorcism Talismans surged again, reaching as high as six each, yet still in short supply.
Seeing this booming market, Xu Ping decisively devoted most of his time to crafting Exorcism Talismans.
As his proficiency increased, his success rate in crafting talismans greatly improved.
This wave proved to be a lucrative windfall.
After a few more days.
Still no trace of ’Old Sun’, Xu Ping was getting somewhat agitated.
A faint scream came from a nearby house; if not for his enhanced hearing from the Nourishing Life Skill practice, he might not have heard such a subtle sound.
Driven by the philosophy of rather mistakenly capturing a thousand than letting one escape, Xu Ping decided to take a look.
Just a few steps forward, a faint smell of blood permeated the air, becoming increasingly intense.
This... doesn’t seem caused by evil spirits, more like a robbery." Xu Ping furrowed his brow, feeling hesitant.
His encounters with ’Old Sun’ always resulted in drained cultivators, not even leaving a trace of blood, let alone any other odors.
Suddenly, there was a commotion in the room.
Xu Ping hesitated no longer and broke in directly.
A nauseating smell of blood rushed at him, and Xu Ping’s brows furrowed tightly.
As he surveyed, a broken corpse came into view.
Its organs were completely hollowed out, blood flowing everywhere, and a look of deep terror and pain remained on its face.
It seemed as if the person had watched themselves being hollowed out alive.
This... doesn’t match the robbers’ typical style of work?" Xu Ping frowned tightly.
Robbers usually aren’t this cruel, generally killing you simply and plundering everything you have.
"Could it be a robber who enjoys gouging out hearts?" Xu Ping mused.
No matter the truth, it didn’t concern him.
After another search, finding nothing useful, he quickly left the scene.

chapters.title: Chapter 41: Slaying
chapters.content:
Chapter 41: Chapter 41: Slaying
The incident with the rogue cultivator did not affect Xu Ping.
He was still wandering around, searching for traces of ’Old Sun’.
But two days passed, during which he heard another faint disturbance.
However, by the time he got there, only a dried corpse was left at the scene.
After searching the corpse, he quickly left the site.
Only on the fifth day did the situation take a turn.
In the early morning of the fifth day, Xu Ping returned after wandering outside, washed his face in the kitchen, and was prepared to snooze in bed for a while when he suddenly heard faint footsteps from outside.
He paused slightly, his heart skipped a beat, and he immediately became alert.
His figure moved, rapidly darting towards the doorway.
A few quick strides.
He stood atop the wall.
His eyes, sharp as an eagle’s, scanned the surroundings.
At that moment, he saw the familiar figure—’Old Sun’, with white hair all over his head, was standing at his doorstep, glaring at him intently.
Compared to a few days ago, his appearance had changed again, becoming sturdier, his cheeks round, nails black and sharp, his muddy clothing appearing tight on his frame.Thɪs
He was shrouded in a layer of darkness, his crimson eyes flickering with eerie light in the dark, sending chills down one’s spine.
"Damn, he came looking for me by himself.
Xu Ping cursed under his breath, obviously ’Old Sun’ hadn’t given up on him.
"I’ve been looking for you too!"
A fierce glint flashed in Xu Ping’s eyes as he swiftly cast an Exorcism Talisman towards him.
Old Sun still tried to escape as before, his figure like an illusion, darting away into the distance.
No, his speed had become faster than when they last met.
Unfortunately.
Over the past few days, Xu Ping had been painstakingly devising several combat plans to deal with him, simulating them countless times... He wouldn’t let him escape.
Xu Ping’s figure flashed, pursuing him at a speed far exceeding his, followed by a flash of light in his hand as a Five-Thunder Talisman appeared and rapidly struck at him.
’Old Sun’ hadn’t run far before being struck by a formidable Thunder Power.
A precise hit.
"Boom!"
"Roar!"
Old Sun cried out miserably, crashing to the ground, the Thunder Power corroding him with a ’sizzle’, as if a red-hot iron was plunged into cold water. His body convulsed violently, clearly experiencing immense pain.
"Hah, turns out you’re just like this!"
Upon seeing this, more than half of the shadow of the evil entity in Xu Ping’s heart was dispelled, as he jumped down from the wall with the agility of a cat, coldly gazing at the ’Old Sun’ on the ground.
The area struck by Thunder Power showed no blood, but rather a mass of charred, black straw with black liquid oozing from the wound.
The air was filled with an indescribable stench, making one feel queasy.
Xu Ping was startled to discover that ’Old Sun’s’ body was made of straw.
He growled viciously, shadows danced on his body, several black grass ropes shot towards Xu Ping from behind the scarecrow.
"Bring it on!"
Xu Ping sneered, striking with his sword.
A brilliant sword light erupted, severing the black grass ropes instantly, dropping to the ground with a ’thud’, yet they squirmed continuously like eels.
After ’Old Sun’ let out a miserable scream, he wasn’t severely hurt, the severed ends ceaselessly wriggled, sprouting several identical grass ropes the next moment.
Witnessing this, Xu Ping remained unfazed.
The Flowing Cloud Sword Technique continued to unfold, sword lights cleaving on him like thunder.
Amidst the cries of agony, Old Sun became extremely miserable.
Severed grass ropes littered around, wounds all over his body, with black liquid flowing out, while the stench in the air grew increasingly intense.
Yet he seemed unfazed despite not being severely injured.
This evil entity was indeed formidable.
Even after suffering heavy blows from the Five-Thunder Talisman and several sword strikes, he still struggled fiercely, seemingly hardly affected.
Such speed and defense would leave even a Late-Stage Qi Cultivation helpless, only to have their blood and flesh sucked dry.
However, Xu Ping didn’t intend to drag it out any longer.
The commotion was huge, soon someone would come.
He fully exerted the Flowing Cloud Sword, with several strikes, he shredded ’Old Sun’ to tatters.
Then Xu Ping abruptly approached him, releasing the Five-Thunder Talisman from his hand.
This time, it solidly hit his head and shoulders.
"Boom!"
Thunder Power exploded.
"Ah!"
