’Old Sun’ let out an unbearably shrill scream, Xu Ping’s ears suddenly felt a deathly silence, no sound could be heard, and his spirit faltered for a moment.
Just when Xu Ping thought it was all over, ’Old Sun’s’ body suddenly convulsed violently.
His head began rapidly decaying, revealing the straw and black liquid inside. The liquid emitted a more intense stench than before, forcing Xu Ping to cover his nose.
"Not dead yet?" Xu Ping frowned, feeling uneasy. He took out his last Five-Thunder Talisman, preparing to completely eliminate this evil entity.
However, just at that instant, ’Old Sun’s’ body suddenly burst apart, spraying black liquid everywhere, like countless venomous snakes dancing in the air.
Xu Ping quickly retreated, his steps nimble as swallows, dodging the liquid, but still a few drops splashed on his clothes, rapidly corroding several small holes.
"Damn it!"
"Even in death, there’s no peace!"
Xu Ping couldn’t help but curse under his breath, had that liquid been splashed on him, the result would have been dire.
Fortunately, the hidden threat was finally eliminated.
He also felt a sigh of relief in his heart.
"Time to go!"
Xu Ping looked around, fearing some people were already drawn by the commotion.
He didn’t want to linger here much longer, however, just as he was about to turn and leave, the corner of his eye caught a faint shimmer in the black straw.
Oh?
What is this?
Xu Ping’s heart stirred, stopping his steps. He stepped forward with Qinghe Sword and flipped out a crystal bead emitting a silvery-white glow from the pile of black straw!
He wiped the bead clean and held it in his hand.
"So, defeating evil entities might yield items?" Xu Ping wondered, unfamiliar with this, "Better ask Zhang Chenyu when there’s a chance."
After storing the bead, he had no further desire to stay and swiftly left the scene.
...
After returning home, Xu Ping quickly removed the clothes stained with black liquid and changed into a new outfit.
Even just a few drops of liquid, the pungent odor was unbearable.
He had no wish to keep this garment.
Under the cool moonlight streaming through the window, Xu Ping’s face was illuminated.
He poured himself a cup of plain water.
Sipping slowly, his mood grew increasingly relaxed.
"Finally, I can have a proper sleep tonight."
During these many days without proper rest, even he was feeling exhausted despite his robust physique.

chapters.title: Chapter 42: Gu Insect Inheritance
chapters.content:
Chapter 42: Chapter 42: Gu Insect Inheritance
Four days later.
Just back from Yuan Wei’s house, Xu Ping began counting the Spirit Stones in his possession, a faint smile appearing on his face.
"A total of one hundred and forty-three Spirit Stones!"
The evil spirit that Old Sun had transformed into was killed by him, but others still didn’t know, leaving the entire market in a state of fear.
The price of the Evil-breaking Talisman was maintained at six Spirit Stones each, and it even seemed to be on the rise.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, relying on the information asymmetry.
Xu Ping had been frantically drawing Exorcism Talismans these days, having Yuan Wei sell them.
As the Exorcism Talisman reached a proficient level, his success rate had soared to over ninety percent.
The speed of earning money was simply astonishing.
...
Time passed with Xu Ping’s frenzy of talisman drawing.
A month quickly slipped by, and winter quietly arrived unnoticed.
Winter in this world arrived much later than in his original world, only truly entering the cold season in January.
After winter arrived, the weather got colder with each passing day.
Heavy snow also began to fall from the sky.
And with the advent of the heavy snow, the high price of the Evil-breaking Talismans, which had persisted for over a month, finally saw a dramatic decline.
The price not only plummeted, it even failed to maintain its original price of two Lower Grade Spirit Stones and fell all the way to one Lower Grade Spirit Stone.
Xu Ping also stopped drawing Evil-breaking Talismans and turned to drawing other talismans.
Although he hadn’t specifically calculated how many Spirit Stones he earned from drawing Evil-breaking Talismans for a month, it was conservatively estimated to exceed a thousand Spirit Stones.
This was the first time he had broken a four-digit savings.
...
...
In the dense forest.
The towering parasol trees reached the clouds, their branches weighed down slightly by the heavy snow.
The ground was thickly covered with snow, and stepping on it made a crunching sound.
Xu Ping stood in the snow, holding a sword in one hand, the blade glinting silver-white in the cold wind, as light as a flowing cloud.
He took a step forward, and his sword moves unfolded.
The sword flashed as if merging with this white world.
Each move flowed naturally, the Sword Qi tracing graceful arcs in the air, stirring up a flurry of snowflakes.
The invisible sharp aura burst from the sword, felling the surrounding large trees with ease, as if they were mere tofu, one after another.
Accompanied by a continuous rumbling sound.
Xu Ping pressed onward, numerous trees meeting an undeserved fate along the way.
Half an hour later.
He stood in the vast white snow, habitually checking his proficiency panel.
[Flowing Cloud Sword Mastery: 1276/1600]
"The progress of the Flowing Cloud Sword is getting slower." Xu Ping furrowed his brows deeply.
Since the Flowing Cloud Sword proficiency broke through a thousand, the daily practice proficiency began to slow down.
After surpassing a thousand two hundred, it declined markedly, now barely able to increase by one point each day.
"How long do I have to grind before the Flowing Cloud Sword reaches Perfection!" Xu Ping felt a bit irritable.
He had a hunch that as the total experience value increased, his rate of gaining experience could continue to decrease.
"Why didn’t this happen while practicing Geng Metal Finger?" Xu Ping was puzzled as to why the Flowing Cloud Sword progress had stalled.
He grew even more annoyed.
A surge of anger filled his heart, gripping the sword handle tightly, he slashed out fiercely, cutting down a towering tree with a swipe of his sword light.
As if still unsatisfied, he began to recklessly swing in the dense forest, countless trees falling at his sword’s command.
Boom!
A towering tree crashed down before him, its thick layer of snow falling off, turning into countless snowflakes that scattered and danced in the air.
As the snowflakes fell, they soon buried Xu Ping.
Feeling the cold chill, Xu Ping’s mood gradually calmed.
Running his mana, the snow on him was brushed off.
"Let’s go home." He sheathed the Qinghe Sword and retraced his steps.
...
...
Not long after returning home, Zhang Chenyu visited enthusiastically.
"The evil spirit has been unheard of for more than a month, it seems it should have left." Zhang Chenyu, lightly stroking his long beard, the wrinkles on his face seemed to have faded slightly with the good news.
"It should have left." Xu Ping smiled in response.
It indeed had left, and it was he who personally sent it away.
"Yesterday I successfully drew a First Rank Upper Grade talisman again."
"Ah, even though I’m at Qi Cultivation level six, I can only draw three types of First Rank Upper Grade talismans, which is quite embarrassing." Zhang Chenyu sighed, yet his expressions betrayed a hint of pride.
Xu Ping looked at him expressionlessly.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
The old chap, showing off here again.
With Qi Cultivation level six but able to draw First Rank Upper Grade talismans, his Talisman Master talent was far superior to the average person.
"Oh, is that so? Then I must congratulate Daoist Zhang." Xu Ping said with feigned earnestness.
"Daoist Zhang is extraordinarily gifted, unlike me who is naturally dull, just recently managed to draw a First Rank Middle Grade talisman, far inferior to Daoist Zhang." Xu Ping sighed as well.
"What, you drew a First Rank Middle Grade talisman!?" Zhang Chenyu couldn’t help but be shocked, staring at Xu Ping as if he was witnessing a monster.
In less than two months, from knowing nothing about talismans to becoming a Talisman Master capable of drawing First Rank Middle Grade talismans.
What kind of monstrous talent is this?
"Ah, it’s nothing, it’s nothing, I just learned to draw a First Rank Middle Grade talisman, far inferior to Daoist Zhang." Xu Ping waved his hand modestly.
...
After sending off the now discouraged Zhang Chenyu.
Xu Ping internally reflected.
Still not humble enough.
Not subtle in concealing his talent.
A few more times and Zhang Chenyu might feel like hanging himself.
Xu Ping picked up the now cold Spirit Tea and drank it down, the bitter taste spreading in his mouth.
"Should I pay more attention next time?"
...
...
Ever since moving into the new home, Xu Ping had been acting low-key, cautiously dealing with people, avoiding all conflicts where possible, and never showing off his abilities in front of others.
With the Spirit Tiger Gang around, no robbers invaded, and the days passed in peace and stability.
More than ten days passed.
Other skills were steadily progressing, except for the Flowing Cloud Sword and Qi Nourishing Skill, whose progress was slow.
Especially the Flowing Cloud Sword, which had almost come to a standstill.
This also made Xu Ping’s mood increasingly irritable, once contemplating giving up sword practice.
But he gritted his teeth and persisted.
...
...
Yuan Wei’s house.
"Master, I finally found someone willing to sell an inheritance." Yuan Wei said excitedly.
Xu Ping’s heart was filled with delight, he immediately asked, "What kind of inheritance?"
This was one of the few pieces of good news lately.
"Worm inheritance." Yuan Wei’s voice carried some excitement, "I asked the person selling the inheritance, and it contains various methods of refining worms, they can be used in combat, and even to enhance one’s cultivation."
"Worm inheritance?" Xu Ping was a little taken aback.
This inheritance was indeed obscure, but Yuan Wei’s introduction made it sound a bit intriguing.
"How did the transaction go?" Xu Ping inquired.
"I’ve already agreed on a time with the seller, we’ll meet at the trading place tomorrow." Yuan Wei replied.
"Alright." Xu Ping nodded, "You did well this time, take these Spirit Stones as your reward."
He took out ten extra Spirit Stones from his pile for Yuan Wei.
"Thank you, master." Yuan Wei happily accepted the Spirit Stones.
This master was worth following; strong, and generous, too.

chapters.title: Chapter 43: Gu Insect King
chapters.content:
Chapter 43: Chapter 43: Gu Insect King
The next day, the two of them arrived at the transaction site early.
"Boss, it’s just up ahead." Yuan Wei led the way in front and brought Xu Ping to a secluded place.
There was already a person wearing a cloak waiting there.
"My boss is here." Yuan Wei greeted the person.
"Hmm." The person in the cloak responded in a muffled voice.
"Fellow Daoist, how do you plan to sell this inheritance?" Xu Ping asked, looking at him.
"Two hundred Spirit Stones, no bargaining." The cloaked person answered calmly, but seeing their hands and feet trembling uncontrollably despite their efforts to maintain composure, it was clear they weren’t as calm as they appeared.
"Isn’t that a little too steep, and I don’t even know if this inheritance is genuine or worth it." Xu Ping frowned.
Two hundred Spirit Stones was still a significant expenditure for him at this point.
"You can authenticate it first." The cloaked person seemed prepared and took out a thin book from their coat, tossing it to Xu Ping. "This book contains a fragmented version of the inheritance I copied."
Xu Ping took the thin book and began translating it immediately.
The thin book introduced various Gu insects and the methods of crafting them, but only recorded a bit of the crafting methods.
After flipping through a few pages, Xu Ping hesitated.
The inheritance seemed genuine, but the Gu insects documented weren’t of much help to him.
Spending two hundred Spirit Stones on it was worth considering.
Until Xu Ping saw a crafting method for something called ’Gu Insect King,’ he was shocked.
He closed the thin book without revealing any emotion, looking troubled, "The inheritance is real, but the Gu insects inside don’t hold much value for me!"
"Either they are extremely difficult to craft, or they come with significant side effects."
Hearing Xu Ping’s response, the cloaked person couldn’t maintain even a semblance of calm, and their tone grew agitated, "How... how could it be, this Gu Worm Scripture can craft First Rank Upper Grade combat Gu insects."
"These are comparable to Late-Stage Qi Cultivation, First Rank Upper Grade combat Gu insects, how could they not be valuable?"
"For others, they might be of extraordinary value, but for me, Late-Stage Qi Cultivation is nothing. Spending so many resources to craft a First Rank Upper Grade Gu insect that can’t even beat me, what’s the point?" Xu Ping calmly retorted.
The cloaked person was at a loss for words, wanting to retort but, thinking of this man’s impressive battle record, didn’t know how to respond.
"What do you think is reasonable?" the cloaked person asked sullenly.
Xu Ping held up one finger: "One hundred Spirit Stones."
"No no, that’s too low." The cloaked person got agitated again, "At least a hundred and eighty."
...
...
Ten minutes later.
After some bargaining, they settled at one hundred and twenty Spirit Stones.
Leaving the transaction site, Xu Ping bid farewell to Yuan Wei and hurried home.
Once home, he eagerly took out a thick, roughly two-inch thick, somewhat ancient black leather book.
This was the Gu Worm Scripture.
Most of the Gu insects within it weren’t of much use to him.
What finally convinced him to purchase this Gu Worm Scripture was the recorded crafting method for something called ’Gu Insect King.’
The potency and medicinal strength of Hundred Flowers Brew mainly depended on the ’Hundred Flowers Gu.’
And since ’Hundred Flowers Gu’ was also a kind of Gu insect, it might be possible to use this method to craft a ’Hundred Flowers Gu King.’
At that time, the medicinal strength and potency of Hundred Flowers Brew would undoubtedly be elevated to another level.
By then, the progress in cultivating Nourishing Life Skill could also be improved.
He had long been fed up with the slow pace of cultivation.
"Let’s hope the crafting method isn’t too difficult!" Xu Ping began researching eagerly.
A quarter of an hour later.
Xu Ping put down the Gu Worm Scripture, frowning inadvertently.
The crafting method wasn’t difficult—put ten Gu insects into the same box, stimulate them with secret medicine to let them devour each other, and the one left alive would be the ’Gu Insect King.’
But the success rate of crafting a ’Gu Insect King’ wasn’t high, and if it failed, all materials and resources invested would be wasted.
Moreover, crafting a ’Gu Insect King’ relied on the Gu insects themselves to devour and evolve, and his proficiency panel couldn’t be of any help.
Without panel assistance, he was somewhat daunted.
"Let’s do it; after all, my wallet can handle the failure now." Xu Ping exclaimed, gritting his teeth.
Isn’t earning Spirit Stones just for spending? Anyway, Spirit Stones won’t multiply if kept.
...
...
Early the next day, Xu Ping acquired two hundred Polar Insects and several crafting materials from the trading market.
Returning home safely, he couldn’t wait to embark on crafting the "Hundred Flowers Gu King."
The first step in crafting the ’Hundred Flowers Gu King’ was refining Polar Insects into ’Hundred Flowers Gu.’
This step Xu Ping was quite familiar with.Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on
He spent five days, achieving a high success rate of ninety percent, refining two hundred Polar Insects into one hundred and ninety ’Hundred Flowers Gu.’
This success rate was enough to make some Grandmaster Gu crafters blush.
But Xu Ping felt not a bit of pride.
The tough part hadn’t arrived yet!
He looked at the one hundred and ninety ’Hundred Flowers Gu’ in front of him, took a deep breath, and commenced the critical step of crafting the ’Hundred Flowers Gu King.’
This step solely relied on the ’Hundred Flowers Gu’ themselves, in other words, relying on fate and luck.
Yet he never trusted his luck.
Xu Ping meticulously checked the secret medicine in his hand, ensuring every component was prepared perfectly.
Mentally reciting the crafting steps, he gently placed ten ’Hundred Flowers Gu’ into a pre-prepared box.
"Begin." Xu Ping whispered to himself, a slight flick of his fingers, and the scent of the secret medicine permeated, arousing the instincts of the small insects.
As the medicinal power seeped in, the ’Hundred Flowers Gu’ began to appear restless, their appetite for mutual devourment gradually awakening.
However, as time passed, Xu Ping’s mood became increasingly heavy.
The ten ’Hundred Flowers Gu’ tore each other apart inside the box, blood splattered, the scene was incredibly tragic, yet not a single ’Hundred Flowers Gu’ gained the upper hand.
After half an hour, Xu Ping opened the box.
The scene before him made his heart sink: nearly all ten "Hundred Flowers Gu" were dead, even their bodies shattered beyond recognition.
Undoubtedly, the first craft attempt had failed.
Xu Ping sighed slightly as he washed the box clean, then placed a new batch of ’Hundred Flowers Gu’ inside and started anew.
Time was spent in repeated attempts and failures for Xu Ping.
...
Two days later, Xu Ping’s eyes were bloodshot, his demeanor delirious.
"Sigh, this is the last batch, if this fails, I’ll have to buy more." Xu Ping sighed with vacant eyes.
The past two days’ failures had left him numb.
He didn’t even hold hope for the last attempt.
Yet instinct compelled him to cautiously place ten insects into the box, then sprinkle in the secret medicine.

chapters.title: Chapter 44: Refining Success
chapters.content:
Chapter 44: Chapter 44: Refining Success
The potion’s power quickly infiltrated the box, and the insects inside began to stir restlessly, sparking a new round of fighting.
In the past, each Gu insect was evenly matched, and none could really overpower the others.
But this time, something seemed different; one of the ’Hundred Flowers Gu Insects’ appeared to be playing it smart.
It kept skirting the edge of the battlefield, making a great effort to avoid direct confrontation with other ’Hundred Flowers Gu Insects.’
"This insect is quite interesting," Xu Ping observed with keen interest.
He couldn’t help but feel a shred of anticipation in his heart; this insect was so unique that perhaps it could become the Gu King.
As time passed, Xu Ping noticed something even cleverer. If a Polar Insect on the battlefield was near death, it would immediately rush over to take a share.
And it was very decisive, leaving as soon as it gained any advantage, never lingering to fight.
As the conflict grew increasingly fierce inside the box, the other ’Hundred Flowers Gu Insects’ began to fall one after another.
Only that nimble insect continued to roam at the edge, occasionally attacking and retreating, like a shrewd hunter.
"Has this ’Hundred Flowers Gu Insect’ perhaps studied military strategy?" Xu Ping’s expression turned strange.
As the battle progressed, that ’Hundred Flowers Gu Insect’ gradually revealed its strong survival ability. Finally, amidst a pile of corpses, it stood alone in the center of the box, appearing exceptionally proud.
"Successfully achieved it!" Xu Ping’s heart surged with wild joy.
This was truly like an old man wearing a cassock hat—so hard to come by.
Thinking about the Spirit Stones spent, even with his current net worth, it made him feel the sting of loss.
After a brief respite, this Polar Insect started slowly approaching its companions’ corpses, devouring them without hesitation.
With each corpse it consumed, its body became more plump, and as it continued to devour, it was gradually enveloped by a viscous liquid.
When it had finished devouring all the corpses, its entire body was covered in the mucus.
The mucus soon hardened, eventually forming a white cocoon.
"In three days, it will be the true King of the Hundred Flowers Gu Insects," Xu Ping gave one last glance, and with a heart full of anticipation, carefully placed the box and the white cocoon on a corner shelf.
...
Three days passed in the blink of an eye.
This morning, a faint cracking sound came from inside the box.
Xu Ping hurriedly leaned in, and saw that the layer of mucus was beginning to peel away, revealing the King of the Hundred Flowers Gu Insect inside.
Its body was much larger than before, and its colors had become more vibrant, seeming to shimmer with dazzling brilliance under the sunlight.Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn
"It worked!" Xu Ping’s heart raced wildly, the metamorphosis was successfully completed.
According to the book, even this final step of metamorphosis carried the possibility of failure.
Luckily, it didn’t fail, or else the frustration would have been unbearable for him.
Xu Ping gently took out the Gu King and placed it into a brewing jar.
After sealing the lid, he buried the wine jar underground.
In twenty days, he would know if the ’Hundred Flowers Brew’ he had made using so many Spirit Stones and so much effort was worth it.
...
...
After brewing the new ’Hundred Flowers Brew,’ Xu Ping’s life returned to peace, every day consumed with honing various skills.
But the progress with the Flowing Cloud Sword became slower and slower, almost to a standstill.
This made Xu Ping increasingly irritable, the accumulated frustration building in his heart.
In the blink of an eye, ten days passed.
Knock, knock, knock.
The door of the room was knocked!
"Who is it? Coming, coming!" said Xu Ping, who was drawing a talisman, standing up and opening the door.
Standing outside was a middle-aged cultivator with a honest face. He bowed with clenched fists, "I am Ma Hui, your new neighbor, and have come to pay my respects, Fellow Daoist, I apologize if I’m disturbing you."
Xu Ping did not coldly turn him away, returning the gesture with clasped hands.
"I am Xu Ping."
"Fellow Daoist Xu, as this is our first meeting, I didn’t bring anything, just a piece of Demon Beast Flesh. I hope you won’t find it objectionable," Ma Hui said with a simple smile, handing over the Demon Beast Flesh to Xu Ping.
"Fellow Daoist Ma, you are too kind," Xu Ping smiled, accepting the Demon Beast Flesh.
After exchanging a few words, Ma Hui made his farewell, "There are a few other neighbors I haven’t visited yet, so I won’t impose on you any longer, Fellow Daoist Xu."
"Take care." After seeing Ma Hui off, Xu Ping returned indoors and closed the door.
...
After leaving Xu Ping’s house, Ma Hui’s naive expression quickly vanished, replaced by a fawning smile. "Ancestor, is this man at Qi Cultivation level five suitable?"
"Not suitable now!"
A pitch-black snake as thick as a finger, about a foot long, with eyes red as blood, slithered out from his sleeve.
"Although that man’s cultivation is only at Qi Cultivation level five, his movements are smooth and seem to carry a peculiar charm. Obviously, he has practiced a notable Body Refining technique."
"More importantly, he exudes an astonishingly sharp aura, which is similar to some of the sword-obsessed enthusiasts I’ve met. Although his strength is certainly far inferior to those sword fanatics, his achievement in swordsmanship is definitely profound."
If Xu Ping had heard this, he would likely be stunned.
This black snake not only spoke human language but also had such astute insight, able to discern so much from mere brief contact.
What kind of character was this?
"If it were earlier, I could crush him with one finger, but now, we must avoid causing trouble. We need to bide our time through this period... understand?" The black snake’s icy gaze fixed on Ma Hui.
The black snake’s cold voice etched into Ma Hui’s mind, causing him to involuntarily shudder, "Under... understood."
"I will keep the rules set by Ancestor firmly in mind." He lowered his head, doing his best to appear obedient.
...
...
Five days later.
The dense forest was covered in snow.
"Damn it, this damned swordsmanship, I’m done with it!!" Xu Ping shouted angrily, throwing the Qinghe Sword to the ground.
The Qinghe Sword stuck deep into the snow, leaving only the hilt visible.
Xu Ping’s chest heaved continuously, clearly not lightly agitated.
After the Flowing Cloud Sword’s experience points broke thirteen hundred, it suddenly wouldn’t increase anymore.
No matter how he practiced, it was the same result.
For a long while.
Xu Ping’s mood gradually calmed down.
"Sigh, guess I should practice some more. Maybe after a few days, it’ll work again." He pulled out the Qinghe Sword, looking resigned.
...
On the way home.
"Since the Flowing Cloud Sword’s proficiency isn’t increasing, I might reduce the time I spend on sword practice and learn a new magic technique," Xu Ping mused to himself.
"What kind of magic should I learn?"
As he was deep in thought, the sound of fighting and cries of pain came from the front left.
Turning his head, he saw three burly men surrounding and attacking a man.
Xu Ping quickly lost interest, recognizing it merely as a common robbery, and he had no desire to meddle.
Just as he was about to walk away.
The man’s cries of anguish constantly rang in his ears, and the scent of blood wafted into his nostrils.
Xu Ping’s eyes turned crimson, his fists clenched tight, the veins on his forehead throbbing as if about to burst.
"Pant, pant..."
Xu Ping gasped heavily, consumed by an overwhelming urge to tear those men to pieces.

chapters.title: Chapter 45: Heart Demon Enters the Body
chapters.content:
Chapter 45: Chapter 45: Heart Demon Enters the Body
"What... what’s happening? My condition... isn’t right!" Xu Ping gritted his teeth, doing his utmost to suppress the surging impulse within him.
"I need to get out of here..."
He forced himself with immense willpower to turn around, taking steps forward.
Not knowing how long he walked, the screams at his ears gradually faded, and the pungent smell of blood no longer lingered at the tip of his nose.
Only then did he feel that the impulse in his heart slowly weakened and eventually vanished without a trace.
"Huff... huff..."
He took deep breaths, his entire body drenched in sweat, as if he’d just been pulled out of the water.
"What on earth happened to me just now!?" Xu Ping’s eyes revealed a hint of panic.
A moment ago, dominated by intense emotions, he seemed on the verge of turning into someone else.
He had a premonition in his heart that if he hadn’t suppressed that impulse and went up with his sword to kill, some unexpected changes might have occurred to him.
And they would most likely be unfavorable changes.
"No way, I must find out why I felt this way just now." Xu Ping took a deep breath, suppressing the panic in his heart.
...
...
"You said you saw a rogue cultivator killing, and then felt a surge of murderous impulse within yourself?" Zhang Chenyu asked seriously, his face solemn.
"Yes." Xu Ping nodded with a wry smile, "That impulse was so strong, it was almost uncontrollable."
"This situation... sounds oddly familiar..." Zhang Chenyu hesitated, reflecting confusion on his face.
"Zhang Daoist friend, do you know what’s happening to me?" Xu Ping asked excitedly upon seeing Zhang Chenyu’s expression.
"It seems similar, but I’m not sure..." Zhang Chenyu hesitated.
"Zhang Daoist friend, enough with the suspense!" Xu Ping urged impatiently.
"Alright, alright... I’ll tell you. Your condition seems like Heart Demon possession." Zhang Chenyu finally began speaking.
"But according to the books, Heart Demon possession usually occurs to Foundation Establishment Cultivators, and you’re a Qi Cultivator showing such symptoms, it’s truly baffling."
"That’s why I’m not certain about it being the case."
"Heart Demon possession?"
Xu Ping froze, completely unfamiliar with the concept and could only seek Zhang Chenyu’s help, "Zhang Daoist friend, is there any way to resolve this?"
"There is a way."
"Your symptoms don’t seem to have penetrated deeply as of now, I’ll teach you a Spell."
"The Spell is named ’Taihang Nourishing God Skill,’ which helps in gathering one’s mind, calming the spirit and thoughts..."
Zhang Chenyu spoke while taking out a Scroll from his storage bag.
"Practice ’Taihang Nourishing God Skill’ well, and this issue should be resolved in no time."
Xu Ping received the Scroll with excitement, "Zhang Daoist friend, I cannot thank you enough."
He truly did not expect Zhang Chenyu to have such profound knowledge despite his not-so-high cultivation level.
"How many Spirit Stones for this Spell, I’ll buy it with Spirit Stones," Xu Ping earnestly said.
Zhang Chenyu not only helped him resolve the problem but provided a Spell; benefiting like this without compensation felt unjust.
"What are Spirit Stones between us, besides it’s just a Spell, not worth much," Zhang Chenyu waved his hand.
Xu Ping remained insistent on giving, Zhang Chenyu stubbornly refused.
Left with no choice, Xu Ping abandoned the idea of giving Spirit Stones, silently remembering this favor in his heart.
...
...
Returning home, Xu Ping impatiently began practicing the ’Taihang Nourishing God Skill’.
[Taihang Nourishing God, slashing thoughts, eliminating chaos, calming the soul...]
He silently recited the Skill a few times, sitting cross-legged, calming his mind and spirit.
The passage of time was unknown, but Xu Ping seemed to find himself amidst a tranquil lake, the surface like a mirror, undisturbed.
His entire being relaxed from the inside out.
His myriad distracting thoughts dispersed like passing clouds, leaving only clarity and peace within.
...
One night of meditation.
The next day, the morning sunlight gently filtered through the window grilles, illuminating his face, warm and bright.
Xu Ping slowly opened his eyes, his soul feeling cleansed, clear and transparent, full of vitality.
"This effect... is simply amazing!" He thought jubilantly, eagerly checking the panel.
[Taihang Nourishing God Skill Entry Level: 22/100]
"I gained twenty-two proficiency points overnight!" Xu Ping was incredibly surprised.
"At this rate, within a few days, I’ll break through the proficiency layer, and the problem of Heart Demon possession should be completely resolved."
He thought joyfully, the shadow in his heart finally dissipating completely.
The taste of Heart Demon possession was truly terrifying, he didn’t want to experience it again.
For the next few days, Xu Ping devoted himself wholeheartedly to practicing the ’Taihang Nourishing God Skill’.
With the rising proficiency, the accumulated vexation and irritability in his heart gradually weakened, until they disappeared completely upon ’Taihang Nourishing God Skill’ breakthrough.
Moreover, he found that after practicing this Skill, his efficiency in both drawing talismans and cultivation dramatically improved.
What thrilled him further was the proficiency in his Flowing Cloud Sword beginning to increase as well.
A delightful surprise indeed!!
He finally understood why the proficiency in the Flowing Cloud Sword hadn’t been increasing.
Damn it, it was all the Heart Demon’s fault.
...
...
Four days later.
Xu Ping carefully lifted the wine jar from the earthen hole and placed it on the table.Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
Originally, after twenty days, this newly brewed Hundred Flowers Brew would have been ready to drink.
But the Heart Demon possession delayed things a bit.
Xu Ping opened the lid of the jar.
As he opened the lid, a rich fragrance of wine permeated his nostrils, with pungent fumes filling his lungs.
"This wine is potent!" Xu Ping exclaimed slightly.
Such potency, an ordinary person might get drunk merely by smelling it.
Xu Ping poured himself a cup and took a sip.
The spicy vigor of the wine burned on his tongue, as if he swallowed magma into his stomach.
"This wine... is really powerful!"
Despite his current physique, Xu Ping felt his entire body heating up, drenched in sweat.
He quickly stripped off his clothes and jumped into a wooden tub filled with green liquid, immediately running the Entry Level Spell of the ’Nourishing Life Skill’, guiding the medicinal liquid throughout his body.
At this moment, the vigor of the wine raged like a wildfire within him, like a ferocious dragon, crashing into every muscle and vein.
Xu Ping’s face gradually twisted, beads of sweat forming densely on his forehead, as the pain surged like tidal waves.
After a while that felt unending, the pain gradually faded, replaced by a cooling sensation circulating within.
Xu Ping opened his eyes, his gaze immediately falling on the proficiency panel.
[Nourishing Life Skill Second Level: 33/100]
"One point increase!" Xu Ping’s face broke into a smile.
Though not as much as before, gaining even one point a day was still excellent.
He suddenly felt the pain and the spend on Spirit Stones were very worthwhile.
Briefly calculating in his mind, at this rate, in about two months, he could break through to the third level of the Nourishing Life Skill.
Once the breakthrough happens, his capabilities could further surge dramatically.

chapters.title: Chapter 46: Demon Cultivator
chapters.content:
Chapter 46: Chapter 46: Demon Cultivator
"It seems I’ll have to brew a few more vats," Xu Ping thought to himself.
"It’s just a bit expensive," he frowned as he thought about the Spirit Stones spent on brewing.
The success rate was just too low.
Fortunately, he’s quite wealthy now and can afford it.
...
In the next few days, Xu Ping brewed two more vats of Hundred Flowers Wine and buried them underground.
"Monthly expenses have increased again, and I’m almost out of loot to sell. I need to start researching the drawing of the Golden Light Talisman," he mused, patting the dirt off his hands.
The Golden Light Talisman, a first-rank middle-grade talisman, is one of the best-selling talismans among loose cultivators.
If he can succeed in drawing it, his talisman-drawing skills would be considered entry-level.
At the desk, Xu Ping thoroughly examined the key points of the Golden Light Talisman, every detail flashing through his mind.
After confirming he had memorized everything, he began preparing to draw the talisman.
Before that, he silently practiced the ’Taihang Nourishing God Skill’ once.
This helps him eliminate distractions, focus, and increase the success rate of drawing talismans.
A little over half an hour later.
"Begin,"
Xu Ping opened his eyes, his gaze intense, and began drawing the talisman.
Dipping the talisman brush into the spiritual ink, he channeled his Spiritual Power onto the brush and started outlining on the talisman paper.
A faint light appeared on the blank talisman paper as the brush moved.
Then suddenly,
Sizzle—
A spark erupted on a piece of talisman paper on the smooth floorboard, and it instantly burned to ashes.
Xu Ping was already accustomed to failures like this.
Expressionless, he cleaned up the ashes, took out a new talisman paper, and continued drawing.
Drawing continued late into the night before Xu Ping, exhausted, stopped. After using a Cleaning Talisman on himself, he went to sleep in the underground room.
Today wasn’t successful; I’ll continue tomorrow.
...
Early the next morning.
Xu Ping was having breakfast.
"Ah... Someone’s dead!" A piercing scream shattered the morning calm.
"Someone’s dead?"
Xu Ping squinted. The voice was so clear, indicating the person died nearby.
After pondering, he went outside.
A circle of neighbors had already gathered outside a house.
Zhang Chenyu stood among them.
"Zhang Daoist, what happened?" Xu Ping asked upon reaching his side.
"Someone died; rumor has it their internal organs were completely emptied." Zhang Chenyu looked worried.
"Internal organs were all emptied?"
Xu Ping was slightly stunned, recalling a similar corpse they encountered when investigating a sinister presence.
Could it be the same person?
His gaze pierced through the crowd to a house with its door wide open, where a broken corpse lay in sight.
All the internal organs had been emptied, the blood had dried up, leaving only dark stains on the ground.
’The same death method, it seems it’s really the same perpetrator as before.’ Xu Ping furrowed his brows.
"Ordinary rogue cultivators probably aren’t interested in gutting people, but demon cultivators do it quite frequently," Zhang Chenyu muttered, lowering his voice.
"Demon cultivator?"
Seeing Xu Ping’s puzzled expression, Zhang Chenyu explained, "Demon cultivators are practitioners of dark cultivation techniques who enhance their Cultivation by refining the flesh and blood of other cultivators."
"To demon cultivators, average cultivators are no different from Pills."
"They cause abominable events, and some demonic cultivators even massacre entire cities, including ordinary people, in their domains."
"Massacre a city?"
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping frowned.
An entrance of a city hosts at least over a hundred thousand people, and yet they slaughter and refine them all.
The threat of demon cultivators is even greater than sinister presences, at least the latter only eat cultivators.
"Sigh, without the Longevity Sect’s suppression, all sorts of demons and sprites have arisen," Zhang Chenyu sighed, his face full of helplessness and concern.
The threat of sinister presences had barely passed, and now it seemed a demon cultivator was causing trouble again.
When will these days finally see an end?
Not long after, the Spirit Tiger Gang arrived, dispersing the onlookers.
Xu Ping and Zhang Chenyu didn’t linger and each returned to their homes.
...
...
The episode with the demon cultivator didn’t affect Xu Ping.
With his current strength, as long as the demon cultivator isn’t at Foundation Establishment, he has no fear.
Considering, it’s unlikely the demon cultivator is; if they had Foundation Establishment strength, would they need to covertly murder at night?
Should the demon cultivator truly come to him, he wouldn’t mind eradicating evil for the people.
This confidence stems from power.
After practicing the ’Taihang Nourishing God Skill,’ Xu Ping resumed drawing the talisman.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Time passed with each stroke.
Ten days later, he finally sensed a glimmer of hope for success.
At noon.
Fully focused, Xu Ping drew the talisman. The brush tip moved over the paper; the talisman flickered a few times, almost combusting but finally dimming in compliance with his expectation.
"Success!"
Xu Ping let out a long sigh of relief, a surge of joy overwhelming him.
He immediately opened the proficiency panel, seeing it displayed [Golden Light Talisman Entry Level: 1/100], he mused:
"Not easy, it took nearly two weeks just to successfully draw a Golden Light Talisman!"
He quickly activated the talisman he was holding.
After a faint glimmer of mana, a golden shield enveloped him.
He prepared to test the defensive power of the Golden Light Talisman.
Xu Ping took his Qinghe Sword, exerted a tenth of his strength, and struck the golden shield.
Amidst the fluctuation of brightness, it remained intact.
"Defense is decent, should barely withstand a strike from a late-stage Qi Cultivator," Xu Ping nodded, somewhat satisfied with its protection.
No wonder it sells for five Spirit Stones per sheet.
...
...
Another ten days passed in a flash.
In the morning.
Xu Ping visited Yuan Wei’s home again.
"Any major events in the market town lately?" Xu Ping asked while handing over the items for sale to Yuan Wei.
"Recently in the market town, that demon cultivator who extracts internal organs has been the major news," Yuan Wei said after taking the items.
"That demon cultivator is becoming more rampant, even people from the four major factions have been killed by him."
"Even a late-stage Qi disciple from the Longevity Sect was killed by that demon cultivator a few days ago."
"Dare that demon cultivator be so bold?" Xu Ping was slightly astonished.
"Exactly, but this time, that demon cultivator has certainly hit an iron plate."
"Of all troubles, he picked the Longevity Sect."
"So the Longevity Sect has initiated, mobilizing the four major powers to form a Demon Suppression Team to track down that sneaky demon cultivator," Yuan Wei said with schadenfreude.
He loathed such heart-extracting demon cultivators to the core.
He eagerly hoped for their downfall.
"With this, that demon cultivator is no more than a post-autumn cicada, not much time for its antics."
"Indeed..." Xu Ping nodded.
The unity of the four major powers should suffice to annihilate a demon cultivator, unless encountering a Foundation Establishment cultivator.

chapters.title: Chapter 47: Sword Qi Thunder Sound
chapters.content:
Chapter 47: Chapter 47: Sword Qi Thunder Sound
After returning home, Xu Ping started practicing his sword techniques again.
Ever since he began cultivating the ’Taihang Nourishing God Skill’, and his proficiency with the Flowing Cloud Sword started increasing, he became addicted to practicing swords.
Whew!
As the sword moves were executed, the sword light shot forth like a rainbow, slicing through the air, producing a crisp sword ringing sound.
Instantly.
The entire basement flickered with sword light, and an unknown small insect was hit by the sword light, making a "pop" sound, instantly being torn to pieces.
After half an hour, Xu Ping stopped, panting heavily.
As he drank water, he inspected his proficiency board.
[Flowing Cloud Sword Mastery: 1423/1600]
"Almost there, not far from perfection." Xu Ping thought to himself, feeling a surge of anticipation, "I wonder what changes the Flowing Cloud Sword will undergo after achieving perfection."
After resting for a while, Xu Ping continued to immerse himself in sword practice.
...
...
More than half a month later.
In the dense forest.
Snowflakes floated lightly like feathers, covering the earth and dressing everything in a white garment.
The air was filled with a refreshing chill, and with each breath, the bone-chilling cold could be felt, making one shiver involuntarily.
The surroundings were silent, with only the occasional faint sound of falling snow.
Suddenly.
A low rumble of thunder came from deep within the forest.
If anyone were here, they would be immensely surprised, as this place was obviously inhabited by only one person practicing swordsmanship, so why would thunder be heard?
Xu Ping held his sword in one hand, and as the Sword Qi surged, it surprisingly generated faint thunder sounds.
However, this thunder seemed to be repressing something, far from reaching its limit.
Xu Ping’s face was solemn as he followed the movements of the sword.
Countless Sword Qi accompanied by thunder left deep sword marks, several meters long, in the white snow.
Xu Ping was completely immersed, with only the thought of sword practice remaining in his mind.
...Google seaʀᴄh NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
Uncertain of how much time had passed.
"Boom!
Xu Ping slashed with his sword, and a strand of Sword Qi instantly exploded with an astonishing thunder sound, rumbling and shaking the eight directions, as if the entire world trembled in response.
Snowflakes were swept up by the strong Sword Qi, scattering and dancing in the air like countless white butterflies.
"Hiss!"
Xu Ping broke free from a state akin to enlightenment, barely enduring the pain of his spirit and Mana being drained, with joy appearing on his face.
"What was that sword just now? Sword Qi Thunder Sound?"
"Yes! It was Sword Qi Thunder Sound!!"
"Hahaha..." Xu Ping was almost losing control from excitement, his laughter echoing through the dense forest.
This is part of the four realms of Sword Dao, and it was comprehended by someone at just the fifth layer of Qi Cultivation?
If others knew this, not only the Longevity Sect and its Golden Core sect, even Nascent Soul sects would be utterly shocked.
As his crazed laughter subsided, Xu Ping took a deep breath, trying to suppress his overwhelming excitement: "Now that my Mana is almost drained, I need to hurry back to recover my Mana."
He picked a direction and swiftly left.
...
Upon arriving home.
Xu Ping swallowed a Qi Recovery Pill to restore his Mana.
Uncertain of how much time had passed.
Xu Ping suddenly opened his eyes.
Boom!
Instantly, in the dim cave, it was as if a thunderclap burst forth.
"Whew!"
Xu Ping slowly exhaled, ending his cultivation.
"Did I really comprehend Sword Qi Thunder Sound?" he found it hard to believe even now.
Yet what happened in the forest earlier clearly confirmed it.
He really had comprehended Sword Qi Thunder Sound!!
Xu Ping felt delighted as he checked his proficiency board.
[Flowing Cloud Sword Perfection: ∞]
"Perfect!" He sighed within.
This was his second skill to reach perfection.
The enhancement to his power was much greater than that brought by Geng Metal Finger.
Xu Ping reached for his storage pouch, and with a flash of spiritual light, Qinghe Sword landed in his hand.
He gripped the sword hilt tightly, feeling a sudden urge to unleash his full power with one sword strike.
Luckily, he managed to restrain himself.
If he unleashed it entirely, the cave would become unmanageable.
Xu Ping controlled the power as much as possible, slashed out with one sword.
Boom!
A loud crash, like thunder!
Pebbles flew everywhere, and a nearly half a meter deep sword scar was left on the rough ground.
"What power!"
Xu Ping inhaled sharply, overwhelmed with shock.
Despite controlling the power to roughly a tenth of his energy, the power was already formidable.
If he had unleashed it fully, it would have definitely surpassed the limits of power a Qi Refining Realm cultivator could exert.
"Does it have the power of a Foundation Establishment Cultivator?" Xu Ping murmured to himself.
In truth, he hadn’t really seen a Foundation Establishment Cultivator fight properly.
So he couldn’t be sure.
But even if it wasn’t, it wouldn’t be too far off.
Xu Ping instinctively gripped the sword hilt tighter.
He felt he could slay his former self from a day ago with just one sword strike now.
"Though powerful, this can only serve as a trump card; otherwise, if my Mana is drained completely, I’ll be in danger."
"With my Body Refining and speed, although I won’t be as helpless as being unable to truss a chicken, my strength will diminish significantly," Xu Ping thought to himself.
He wasn’t so overwhelmed by the joy of comprehending Sword Qi Thunder Sound that he lost his reason.
He clearly understood his weaknesses.
"To turn Sword Qi Thunder Sound into a regular weapon, I still need to elevate my realm."
"If I reach late-stage Qi Cultivation, with the current density of my Mana combined with Sword Qi Thunder Sound, I should be able to contend with a Foundation Establishment Cultivator, right?"
...
...
Late at night.
The surroundings were eerily silent, with only the occasional sound of wind rustling through the trees.
Moonlight filtered through thick clouds, casting a faint and chilling glow on the snow-covered ground.
At this moment, rustling sounds arose.
In the darkness.
More than thirty cultivators quietly surrounded an old, shabby house.
In the group, each of the thirty-some cultivators looked tense, each wearing a solemn expression, holding their Magical Artifacts, ready to respond to any sudden occurrences.
"After searching for so long, we’ve finally found the demon spawn’s trail; this time he won’t escape death." Jiang Wei, a disciple of the Longevity Sect, snarled with a fierce expression.
His beloved senior sister died at the hands of the Demon Cultivator, having her internal organs excavated.
He swore to avenge his senior sister.
"Everyone be careful, the Demon Cultivator is strong, don’t underestimate him," another gang member warned, his eyes shining with caution.
As everyone approached the old shabby house, a chilling aura pervaded the air, as if the surrounding Spiritual Qi was being suppressed to a weak state.
Just then, a deep laughter emanated from the house, as if mocking their arrival.
"Your dog’s nose is really True Spirit."
A cold voice sounded, accompanied by a gust of chilling wind, revealing a figure shrouded in a black cloak at the entrance of the room.
"Take action!" the leading cultivator commanded, and everyone struck simultaneously, their Magical Artifacts flashing and charging at the Demon Cultivator.
"Hmm? Something’s not right!"
"What’s happening? I feel so dizzy..."
At this moment, several lower cultivation level cultivators staggered, brown spots appearing on their faces.

chapters.title: Chapter 48: Demon Cultivator Patriarch
chapters.content:
Chapter 48: Chapter 48: Demon Cultivator Patriarch
"Not good! Poison—cover your mouth and nose, quickly take the Detoxification Pill!"
The lead cultivator’s face changed dramatically, and after shouting, he hurriedly swallowed the Detoxification Pill.
However, the poison was too strong. Even after ingesting the Detoxification Pill, some cultivators with low cultivation fell down one by one due to poisoning.
Thud! Thud!
Only five or six cultivators with high cultivation or anti-poison artifacts remained standing, but they looked like they wouldn’t last much longer.
"Despicable, you actually poisoned us!" Jiang Wei glared angrily.
The jade pendant at his waist had already turned black, emitting wisps of black smoke.
The demon cultivator let out a cold laugh, "You self-proclaimed righteous cultivators are still so hypocritical, so it’s okay for you to gang up on me? But I’m not allowed to use poison?"
"You deserve to die!" Jiang Wei grumbled through clenched teeth.
Whoosh!
He forcefully channeled his mana, and a stream of silver light shot out from his sleeve like lightning towards the demon cultivator.
A faint shadow of a silver ruler could be seen within the silver light.
This was a mid-grade magical artifact.
"Humph!" The demon cultivator snorted coldly, summoning a dark cyan shield, which expanded with the wind, like a stone wall blocking in front of him.
Boom!
The silver light exploded, and the light from the mid-grade magical artifact dimmed, lacking follow-up strength.
Jiang Wei grunted, a faint brownish color appearing on his face, looking exhausted and unable to attack anymore.
"Vile demon spawn, my Longevity Sect will not let you go." He glared angrily.
"Hehe, every one of you just likes to talk big, wait until I rip out your heart and lungs right before your eyes, you won’t look so fierce then." The demon cultivator sneered, feeling victorious.
"May you be struck by lightning, meet a bad end, and have no... Not good enough? I can’t even curse anymore," Jiang Wei said helplessly.
Whoosh!
As soon as he finished speaking, several magical artifacts were already thrown at the demon cultivator.
Boom boom boom...
The dark cyan shield in front of him was instantly shattered by the impact.
"What!!" The demon cultivator’s face changed dramatically as he quickly retreated, hurriedly looking in the direction of the attacks.
It turned out that the five or six cultivators who were almost incapacitated by poison were suddenly recovering, manipulating magical artifacts to attack him.
The disciples of the Longevity Sect looked at the demon cultivator calmly, their tone mocking, "Did you think we weren’t prepared? It just takes time for the detoxification, fool!"
Upon hearing this, the demon cultivator’s face flushed red, eyes burning with rage.
He hadn’t expected these cultivators to toy with him like this!!
However, at least five of the cultivators were at Qi Cultivation level six, and three were in the Late-Stage Qi Cultivation, he really wasn’t their opponent!
"Ancestor, save me!" He could only call for help in a low voice.
"Fool as a pig!" A cold voice echoed in his mind, and a black snake about a foot long, with eyes red as blood, emerged from his sleeve, looking at him with cold eyes.
"Ancestor," the demon cultivator shuddered, lowering his head.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh...
The other cultivators continued to control their magical artifacts, hurling them at him.
The black snake leaped into the air, its body instantly expanding to two fathoms, a magnificent aura oppressing all directions.
Boom!
Its tail was like a whip, instantly sweeping all the magical artifacts away, although a few scales on its demon body were shattered.
"Snake demon!!"
The remaining five or six were horrified, sensing from its power that it was likely not just an ordinary First Rank demon beast.
The black snake suddenly dashed forward, almost instantly lunging towards a Qi Cultivation level seven cultivator.
Its silhouette cut through the night sky like a black lightning bolt, carrying unmatched power.
"Not good."
The Qi Cultivation level seven cultivator flashed a trace of fear in his eyes, secretly thinking it was bad.
He hurriedly summoned a defensive magical artifact, holding it in front of him.
Boom!
The black snake’s tail instantly lashed the magical artifact away, its remaining power striking down on him heavily.
"Ah!"
He spat blood wildly, collapsing painfully to the ground.
"How could it be??"
The remaining few flashed horror in their eyes, how was a Qi Cultivation level seven cultivator critically injured in one strike?
What kind of snake demon is this!
They glanced at one another, all seeing retreat in each other’s eyes.
This was entirely beyond their ability to handle.
Without the slightest hesitation, they scattered in all directions and fled.
But the black snake calmly watched the scene, not chasing after them.
Only when they had all vanished did the black snake exhale a breath of black energy, its size rapidly decreasing.
"Rip out the organs of these people, then find a hidden place to refine them all." The black snake landed on Ma Hui’s shoulder.
Its tone remained cold, yet revealed a hint of weakness.
"Understood, Ancestor." Ma Hui responded, trembling.
Even after spending so much time with him, he still knew little about the black snake before him.
He only knew that this was a human Golden Core demon cultivator, who encountered an accident during body-seizing, and ended up merging with a demon snake.
The combination of demon cultivation and demon body made this Golden Core ancestor’s temper so unpredictable, often performing demonic secret techniques on him, causing him unbearable pain.
Ma Hui dared not disobey in the slightest.
...
...
The external disturbances did not affect Xu Ping.
For the next few days, he had been adapting to and comprehending his swordsmanship after grasping the Sword Qi Thunder Sound.
Even without using Sword Qi Thunder Sound, the power of his swordsmanship had improved significantly compared to before.
After fully adapting for five days, he could now wield his swordsmanship power freely.
The only blemish was that the Qinghe Sword seemed somewhat mismatched with him.
Every time he used his swordsmanship, he felt a sense of being restrained by the Qinghe Sword, which weakened his swordsmanship’s power.
Especially when using the Sword Qi Thunder Sound, it was even more so.
He felt as if the entire sword body of the Qinghe Sword was about to explode.
"It seems I still need to change to a new magic sword," Xu Ping thought to himself.
"But the Qinghe Sword is already a mid-grade magic sword. If I am to replace it, I must switch to an upper-grade magic sword. Where am I supposed to find one!" Xu Ping felt a headache.
If it was in the previous market, he might still have a chance to buy one with spirit stones, but now, even if others have one, who would sell it!
After all, Xu Ping had been in the trading area for so long, and never heard of anyone selling an upper-grade magical artifact.
"Forget it, let Yuan Wei try to find it first, anyway, I definitely can’t handle it now," Xu Ping sighed slightly.
Upper-grade magical artifacts require at least Late-Stage Qi Cultivation to barely wield.
Even if his mana was thicker than ordinary cultivators, he would need to break through to Qi Cultivation level six to handle it.
And he was only at Qi Cultivation level five, still a way from level six.
Xu Ping moved his gaze upwards, focusing on the proficiency panel.
[Level: Qi Cultivation level five: 82/100; Nourishing Life Skill level two: 52/100]
"Still 18 points away, at least another month," Xu Ping thought to himself.
Ever since breaking through to Qi Cultivation level five, his cultivation speed had slowed down.
And the further along, the slower it got, even with the aid of Spirit Gathering Pills.
Now it was nearly two days to gain just one point.
He wondered if it was due to taking too many pills, creating a resistance.
