chapters.title: Chapter 49: Wind Manipulation Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 49: Chapter 49: Wind Manipulation Skill
Two days later.
Yuan Wei’s home.
"What! Looking for an upper-grade magical sword?" Yuan Wei said with a face full of grievances, "Boss, where do I even go to find that!"
"No worries, take your time looking, it’s okay if you can’t find it." Xu Ping knew it was a bit of a tall order, so he could only comfort him.
"Okay." Yuan Wei nodded.
He then started talking about the big event in the marketplace.
"The team organized by the four major forces to encircle the demon cultivator suffered heavy losses, only a few escaped with their lives," Yuan Wei said worriedly.
"What happened?" Xu Ping showed a look of surprise.
Lately, he had been immersed in practicing swordsmanship and was unaware of the events outside.
"Just a few days ago, the encirclement team had already traced the demon cultivator, but that demon cultivator was powerful, and there was an even more formidable snake demon, ordinary cultivators simply couldn’t withstand it.
Among the team of over thirty people, there were even three late-stage Qi cultivation cultivators, but only a few survived." Yuan Wei’s face showed even more concern.
He had originally thought that this demon cultivator wouldn’t be able to last long, but unexpectedly, they were so formidable that even the four major forces suffered such a setback.
"This demon cultivator is actually that formidable?" Xu Ping was surprised.
Such strength could probably be something even the leaders of the four major forces couldn’t achieve.
"However, the four major forces are preparing to reorganize a group to hunt the demon cultivator, even the leaders of the four major forces will take action, this time they should be able to hunt that demon cultivator down."
"Maybe." Xu Ping nodded in response, but he had a premonition that the demon cultivator might not be so easy to kill.
The marketplace is so large, finding a place to hide isn’t that difficult, how could they find him?
...
...ᴛhis ᴜpdated by ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
After returning home, Xu Ping went through his magic books.
The Flowing Cloud Sword technique was already perfected, and now he could find one or two spells to practice.
It’s the quality of the magic, not the quantity that matters.
One or two spells are enough.
Very quickly, Xu Ping determined a spell, the Wind Manipulation Skill: wind-powered flight.
Practicing immortality without flight was really unthinkable.
He had always been fascinated about flying.
The second spell took him quite a while to choose.
He finally chose a spell called Palm Thunder.
This spell was considered a weaker version of the Five Thunders Skill.
In this world, not only demon beasts and cultivators were dangerous, but also evil spirits, learning a magic to restrain them was important.
After deciding on the two spells he wanted to learn, Xu Ping began to enthusiastically study them.
The first thing he learned was the Wind Manipulation Skill.
The Wind Manipulation Skill was quite difficult to practice, needing spiritual power to coordinate with hand signs, and also requiring the accompaniment of incantations.
For a full three to four days, Xu Ping was still clueless.
Until the sixth day, he finally successfully entered the entry-level.
Underground cave.
Endless gale raged in the room, Xu Ping seemed to feel his body merged with nature, as if he became the wind, his body lightened and slowly started to float upward.
"Hahaha..."
Xu Ping laughed incessantly, this feeling of flying was truly wonderful!
Compared to using tools like magical artifacts, flying with magical skills was even more exciting.
He began attempting to fly.
Flying with the Wind Manipulation Skill wasn’t complicated, his body moved entirely at his mind’s command, shuttling back and forth in the basement.
At first, his movements were a bit awkward, but he quickly became proficient.
However, Xu Ping also felt that this flight speed was indeed quite slow.
Although confined by the environment here, unable to push the speed to its limit, he could roughly estimate it should be faster than an ordinary person running, but not by much, far from the speed of flying with magical artifacts.
However, the feeling of flying autonomously was incomparable to flying with magical artifacts.
After flying for a few minutes, Xu Ping stopped.
He gauged the consumption of mana in his body, roughly one-sixth.
He estimated the flight time in his mind: "Probably can maintain flight for about the time it takes for an incense stick to burn."
This flight time wasn’t short, with the improvement of cultivation, the duration of flight would also get longer and longer.
"The underground cave’s terrain is too narrow, I’ll try it in the dense forest tomorrow." Xu Ping licked his lips, feeling slightly unsatisfied.
...
...
In a desolate dense forest.
Xu Ping stood in the snow, coordinating incantations, spiritual power, and hand signs.
Accompanied by the whirling wind, he suddenly floated up.
’Fly.’
Xu Ping thought, flying close to the ground, continuously accelerating, quickly surpassing the speed of an ordinary person running, finally stabilizing at 30 miles per hour.
His figure shuttled continuously through the dense forest.
Sometimes accelerating in a straight line, sometimes suddenly turning, sometimes shifting... playing joyfully.
"Why not fly a bit higher and see?" A bold thought flashed in his mind, quickly taking root and sprouting.
"Up."
Xu Ping willed, flying directly towards the sky.
.....
Fifty meters!
His heart rate accelerated slightly.
A hundred meters!
His heart pounded wildly, excitement surged in his heart.
A hundred and fifty meters.
The cold wind blew on his face, but it couldn’t extinguish the excitement in his heart.
Four hundred meters!
The trees on the ground gradually became small dots, the entire view of the land below him came into sight.
Eight hundred meters!
"Hahaha..." Xu Ping laughed wildly, this feeling of free flight was just too delightful!
Nine hundred meters.
Just as he was nearly lost in the moment, a bird’s call brought him back to reality.
Xu Ping looked back, only to see a huge bird heading towards him at an extremely fast speed.
"Demon Beast!?" His face changed slightly.
Although it was a first rank demon beast, it had already reached first rank upper grade, and its massive body, wings flapping, brought a sense of oppression in the air.
Xu Ping quickly reached for his storage bag, a flash of light, the Qinghe Sword was suddenly in his hand.
With the magical sword in hand, his momentum rose, a sharp aura unique to a sword cultivator swept in all directions.
"Chirp!"
The bird suddenly shrieked, flapping its wings.
A barrage of feathers shot towards Xu Ping like iron arrows.
"Good!"
Xu Ping shouted, striking with his sword, a wisp of sword qi erupted with a thunderous sound, rumbling thunder.
Boom boom...
The sword qi shredded the barrage of iron-like feathers to pieces.
The residual power of the sword qi didn’t wane, piercing into the bird’s wing fiercely, it let out a shrill cry.
"Die!"
Seizing the opportunity, Xu Ping gave it no chance to escape.
Turning up the power of the sword, accompanied by rolling thunder, a wisp of sword qi pierced through the bird, blood gushed out wildly.
The bird struggled a few times in the air before collapsing, transforming into a mix of feathers and blood, scattering onto the snow.
"Not worth mentioning."
Xu Ping raised an eyebrow, feeling pleased.
This was his first combat since realizing the Sword Qi Thunder Sound.
As expected, his strike was extraordinary, killing a first rank upper grade demon beast with just two sword strikes.
Just as he was rejoicing, several bird calls sounded, a few black dots in the distance were quickly approaching.
"More coming!" Xu Ping’s face instantly fell.
He had already consumed a lot of mana flying, and after striking twice, even though it wasn’t full power, his internal mana was more than half consumed, he probably couldn’t continue fighting with the demon beasts.

chapters.title: Chapter 50: Qi Cultivation Stage 6
chapters.content:
Chapter 50: Chapter 50: Qi Cultivation Stage 6
"I can’t fly anymore!" Xu Ping muttered to himself.
He hadn’t expected the sky to be so dangerous, with flying Demon Beasts coming one after another.
But considering that the market is near the wilderness, it makes sense for there to be Demon Beasts.
He plummeted rapidly, landing steadily, the snow underfoot making a slight crunching sound.
With his feet on the ground, Xu Ping’s heart settled.
Indeed, being grounded gives a person a sense of security.
He looked up and saw those few bird-like Demon Beasts circling overhead, not daring to swoop down.
"Let’s go." Ignoring them, Xu Ping placed the corpse of the large bird on the ground into his storage bag and quickly left the place.
...
Not long after returning home.
Zhang Chenyu came to visit, accompanied by two Qi Refining six-stage cultivators.
"Who are these two Fellow Daoists?" Xu Ping asked curiously.
"Ah, these are people the Linghu Sect specifically arranged to protect me." Zhang Chenyu helplessly spread his hands, "You know I can only draw a few upper-grade talismans, there’s no need for such a grand effort."
Xu Ping...
You really know how to find a way to show off even after being discouraged from talisman drawing!
Forget it, let him be.
Otherwise, he’d probably be sulking to death.
"By the way, Fellow Daoist Zhang, what’s going on with the Demon Cultivators lately?" Xu Ping changed the topic and asked.
"The four major forces are still organizing their teams. I don’t know if they’ll be able to completely eliminate the Demon Cultivators this time." Speaking of this, worry appeared on Zhang Chenyu’s face.
"This time, the leaders of the four major forces will take action, so there shouldn’t be a problem." Xu Ping comforted him.
"Who can say for sure? Each Demon Cultivator is cunning and devious, who knows if they have other tricks up their sleeves." Zhang Chenyu was not optimistic about this.
"Recently, due to the influence of Demon Cultivators, there have been more opportunistic bandits in the market, so be careful, Fellow Daoist Xu." He reminded.
"Understood, Fellow Daoist Zhang, if you encounter any danger, remember to call out loudly. Although I’m only at Qi Refining stage five, my strength is pretty good, I can handle some petty crooks." Xu Ping said seriously.
"That’s reassuring." Zhang Chenyu laughed.
He knew of Xu Ping’s strength; he had killed two mid-stage Qi Refining cultivators at just stage four, now at stage five, he must be even stronger.
Certainly stronger than him, a Qi Refining stage six who only knows talisman drawing.
The two Qi Refining stage six cultivators behind Zhang Chenyu showed a trace of disdain upon hearing this.
Just a Qi Refining stage five cultivator, daring to speak such big words.
However, seeing that Xu Ping was Zhang Chenyu’s friend, they didn’t voice any mockery.
...
...
After seeing Zhang Chenyu off, Xu Ping resumed his cultivation of the ’Taihang Nourishing God Skill.’
This magic was about to break through to proficiency.
Entry Level and Competent are just the most basic two levels; reaching proficiency is when qualitative change occurs.
He eagerly anticipated what changes would occur once this magic broke through proficiency.
Accompanying the operation of the ’Taihang Nourishing God Skill’ again and again, Xu Ping’s state of mind gradually calmed.
Then, at a certain moment, a roar erupted in his mind, and a warm sensation flowed in like a tide, enveloping his Spiritual Sense, making him feel it slowly and steadily enhancing.
He didn’t know how much time had passed.
Xu Ping slowly opened his eyes and carefully felt the intensity of his Spiritual Sense.
"This... how did my Spiritual Sense enhance so much!!" He was overjoyed.
He hadn’t expected that upon breaking through to proficiency in the ’Taihang Nourishing God Skill’, his Spiritual Sense would be enhanced so significantly.
From Qi Refining stage one to stage nine, each breakthrough not only advances cultivation but steadily enhances Spiritual Sense too.
Now the intensity of his Spiritual Sense is probably no less than that of some Qi Refining stage seven cultivators, yet he is only at stage five.
"Now that the Taihang Nourishing God Skill is at proficiency level, it is already so strong. Will I awaken Divine Sense upon achieving perfection?" Xu Ping was very expectant.
Awakening Divine Sense at the Qi Refining Realm, can anyone else imagine that?
"Calm down, calm down!" Xu Ping ran through the ’Taihang Nourishing God Skill’ again.
As the Magic Technique circulated, the excitement and exhilaration in his heart, like a flame, was instantly doused by a splash of cold water.
"I’m only at proficiency now, far from perfection. Besides, whether awakening Divine Sense upon achieving perfection is still unknown, getting too happy now is premature."
Xu Ping coolly analyzed, not helping but feeling a sense of tranquility like a man after the act.
Upon breaking through proficiency in the ’Taihang Nourishing God Skill’, not only did it increase Spiritual Sense, but also enhanced the ability to eliminate distractions.
Taking advantage of this state, Xu Ping began training Palm Thunder again.
This would undoubtedly increase his success rate.
However, the difficulty of Palm Thunder was still significant, and despite the ’Taihang Nourishing God Skill’s aid, it took him a full eight days to master this skill.
Xu Ping tested the power of Palm Thunder, roughly capable of electrocuting a chicken.
Of course, this is just at the Entry Level, but with experience, the power is bound to grow stronger.
While Xu Ping was staying home practicing various skills.
The teams formed to eradicate the Demon Cultivators were finally assembled, and began the grand crusade against them, yet the Demon Cultivators continually escaped, and more people kept getting their hearts and lungs removed.
However, nothing outside affected Xu Ping at all.
He stayed home, grinding away on various skills every day.
...
A month later.
Winter was ending and spring was coming; the cold winter was gradually retreating, and the thick snow started to melt.
Because the burrow was too damp, Xu Ping moved into the bedroom.
With his current strength, there’s no need for him to inconvenience himself.
.....
That night, the bedroom was silent, with only the faint sound of wind outside the window.
"Boom!"
Xu Ping’s whole body shuddered, and the path of Mana circulation within him expanded again, forming a complete network.
Suppressing his excitement, he slowly adjusted his agitated Mana, feeling it surge like tidal waves inside.
He opened his eyes.
"Reached Qi Refining stage six!" He smiled, a wave of joy surging in his heart.
One step further would be Qi Refining stage seven.
Qi Refining stage seven just steps into the threshold of late-stage cultivation; in the present Dongwu Market, such a cultivation is as rare as a phoenix’s feather, estimated to be less than forty people.
He closed his eyes again, carefully experiencing the feeling of advancement.
Mana within was slowly self-circulating.
The profound Mana was almost no less than some Qi Refining stage seven cultivators, with energy brimming all over, and awareness extremely clear, almost as if even thought speed was faster.
He opened his eyes and opened the proficiency panel.
[Name: Xu Ping]
[Lifespan: 29/123 years]
[Realm: Qi Refining stage six: 1/100; Nourishing Life Skill stage two: 63/100]Thɪs ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
[Cultivation Technique: Five Elements Skill Minor Achievement (stage five): 554/800]
[Skills: Spirit Rain Skill Proficient: 41/400; Geng Metal Finger Perfection: ∞; Light Body Technique Great Achievement: 246/1600; Flowing Cloud Sword Perfection: ∞; Fireball Technique Entry Level: 25/100; Taihang Nourishing God Skill Proficient: 316/400; Wind Manipulation Skill Competent: 24/200; Palm Thunder Entry Level: 45/100]
"The Five Elements Skill is also about to break through to Great Achievement, not sure what changes it will bring about." Xu Ping anticipated silently in his heart.
Now that he has broken through to Qi Refining stage six, the effect of the Spirit Gathering Pill might be weaker.
Reaching Qi Refining stage seven seems very far off.
If the Five Elements Skill can break through to Great Achievement, the cultivation speed should improve further.

chapters.title: Chapter 51: Blood-Drinking Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 51: Chapter 51: Blood-Drinking Sword
The next day.
In the dense forest.
The breath of spring quietly descended, sunlight piercing through the treetops, casting mottled shadows on the moist ground.
Xu Ping wielded his sword with one hand, continuously performing sword moves.
In an instant, the dense forest was filled with layers of sword light, with faint sounds of thunder echoing.
After completing a set of sword moves, Xu Ping stood still, frowning as he gripped the Qinghe Sword in his hand:
"After breaking through to the sixth level of Qi Cultivation, the feeling of being suppressed by the Qinghe Sword has become heavier, making it impossible to fully exert my strength."
This feeling was really unbearable, like being confined in a small room where he couldn’t fully extend his limbs.
"Sigh, it’s been almost two months with no news of an upper-grade magical sword, who knows when I can finally switch swords." Xu Ping sighed softly, losing interest in practicing swordsmanship.
After putting away the Qinghe Sword, he returned home.
...
...
Three days later.
As soon as Xu Ping arrived at Yuan Wei’s house, Yuan Wei excitedly shared good news: "Boss, there’s news about the upper-grade magical sword."
"There’s news?" Xu Ping asked happily, "Who is it, and when is the transaction?"
It was like finding a pillow for his sleepiness; he had just broken through to the sixth level of Qi Cultivation, and there was already news of an upper-grade magical sword.
"It’s Zhang Changqing leading from the Longevity Sect; he said the transaction can happen anytime," Yuan Wei explained slowly.
"Zhang Changqing?" Xu Ping was surprised.
This person was not simple, probably the most influential and powerful figure in the entire market.
"How did you find him?" Xu Ping inquired.
"I didn’t find him, he sent someone to find me, saying he has an upper-grade magical sword and wants to meet you to discuss," Yuan Wei answered truthfully.
"Meet me to discuss?" Xu Ping furrowed his brows.
He had no dealings with this Zhang Changqing, what could he want to discuss?
After pondering for a moment, Xu Ping decided to meet him.
No matter what the discussion, he was determined to obtain the upper-grade magical sword.
"It’s too late today, let’s meet the talented disciple of the Longevity Sect first thing tomorrow," Xu Ping said calmly.
"Sure." Yuan Wei agreed happily.
...
...
The next morning.
In the core area of Dongwu Market.
Yuan Wei led Xu Ping to a simple shack, with birds perched on the roof and lizards and beetles crawling all around.
At the door, a glamorous woman in Longevity Sect attire was waiting, and upon seeing Xu Ping and his companion arriving, she hurriedly stepped forward:
"You must be Fellow Daoist Bai, I’ve heard about you for a long time." The glamorous woman performed a salute.
Xu Ping’s alias was Bai Zhiyuan.
"No need to be so polite," Xu Ping returned the salute.
"Please come in, my senior brother is waiting inside for Fellow Daoist Bai’s arrival," the glamorous woman smiled slightly.
"Okay." Xu Ping nodded and followed her inside.
As he reached the entrance, the glamorous woman stopped Xu Ping: "My senior brother is quite particular about cleanliness, please change into these new shoes before entering."
The glamorous woman had prepared a pair of ordinary new shoes in advance.
"Particular about cleanliness?"
Xu Ping wore a peculiar expression.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
Nevertheless, he took the shoes, changed into them, and stepped inside.
The entire room wasn’t large but was exceptionally clean and tidy, even the decorations on the cabinet were neatly aligned in one direction.
"This isn’t just a matter of cleanliness, it’s probably an obsession," Xu Ping’s expression grew more peculiar.
Quickly looking away, he set his sight on the center of the room, where a young man dressed in white stood. The man’s face was ordinary, but he had an ethereal presence, and his aura had already reached the ninth level of Qi Cultivation.
At this moment, the young man was gazing intently at Xu Ping, with a faint purple shimmer in his eyes.
’I’m not a woman, why is he staring at me like that?’
Xu Ping felt baffled, just as he was about to speak, he felt an itch in his nose.
"Achoo!" He couldn’t resist sneezing.
The young man’s pupils slightly constricted, and the purple light in his eyes vanished instantly.
"Sorry, my nose just suddenly itched. I am Bai Zhiyuan, pleased to meet Fellow Daoist Zhang." Xu Ping clasped his fists and apologized.
"No problem at all, Fellow Daoist Bai, have a seat and let’s talk." Zhang Changqing warmly invited Xu Ping to sit down.
"You’re too kind, Fellow Daoist Zhang. I heard you have an upper-grade magical sword, is that true?" Xu Ping sat down, getting straight to the point.
"You are straightforward, Fellow Daoist."
Zhang Changqing smiled slightly, not beating around the bush, and directly took out a plain black scabbard from his storage bag.
He grasped the hilt and slowly unsheathed the sword.
Immediately, an invisible sharp aura filled the room, akin to blades brushing against one’s skin, raising Xu Ping’s hackles.
"This sword is called Blood-Drinking, a Sword Cultivator’s sword, forged by a second-stage upper-grade blacksmith using century-old dark iron, making the blade incredibly hard.
Due to the sophisticated refining method, the restriction forms naturally. Once infused with spiritual power, the sword Qi will soar, unparalleled in sharpness."
Zhang Changqing smiled as he offered the Blood-Drinking Sword to Xu Ping: "Fellow Daoist Bai, are you satisfied?"
Xu Ping suppressed the excitement in his heart, carefully examining the magical sword he held.
The sword’s blade was long and gleamed coldly, resembling a silver serpent slithering through space and time.
"How much does Fellow Daoist Zhang ask for it?" Xu Ping placed the magical sword on the table, maintaining his composure.
This sword was one he was determined to acquire no matter what.
"Sixteen hundred lower-grade spirit stones," Zhang Changqing replied with a beaming smile.
"Gasp!"
Xu Ping drew in a cold breath: "That expensive?"
It was over ten times more costly than a mid-grade magical artifact.
"This is not expensive, upper-grade magical swords have always been priced like this, and my upper-grade magical sword is much better than the usual ones, so sixteen hundred lower-grade spirit stones is a very fair price." Zhang Changqing quickly shook his head.
Hearing this, Xu Ping immediately felt a headache coming on.
Previously, the spirit stones he had barely sufficed, but he had spent quite a few on brewing those vats of Hundred Flowers Brew, and his recent expenditures had been rather high, so he truly didn’t have that many left.
"Fellow Daoist Zhang, could you possibly lower the price a bit?" Xu Ping asked tentatively.
"I can’t lower it, not even by a single spirit stone," Zhang Changqing shook his head vigorously like a rattle drum.
This left Xu Ping in a difficult position, even contemplating the thought of snatching it by force.
Who knew, at that moment, Zhang Changqing suddenly shifted the conversation: "But if Fellow Daoist Bai doesn’t have enough spirit stones, there is another way."
"What way?" Xu Ping’s interest was piqued.
"You probably know about the recent issues with the Demon Cultivators, right?" Zhang Changqing inquired.
"I do," Xu Ping nodded.
"Those Demon Cultivators are heartless and cruel. We wish to eliminate them as quickly as possible, but unfortunately, they are powerful and cunning, making them very difficult to deal with.
And we’re currently short of manpower, so we would like to invite you to join our Demon Suppression Team to jointly hunt the Demon Cultivators, though we aren’t asking you to work for free."
"If you’re willing to join, this upper-grade magical sword can be yours for just six hundred spirit stones," Zhang Changqing suggested sincerely.
"Join the Demon Suppression Team to hunt Demon Cultivators?" Xu Ping furrowed his brows and began weighing the pros and cons.
Zhang Changqing didn’t rush him, patiently waiting on the side.

chapters.title: Chapter 52: Joining the Demon Suppression Team
chapters.content:
Chapter 52: Chapter 52: Joining the Demon Suppression Team
After half a cup of tea, Xu Ping slowly spoke up, "Do I need to search everywhere if I join the Demon Suppression Team? I’m afraid I don’t have the time."
"Fellow Daoist Bai, there’s no need for you to search personally; just join in the collective siege once the trace of a Demon Cultivator is found."
Seeing Xu Ping’s intention to join, Zhang Changqing was delighted, his face wore a warm smile.
"My place of residence is inconvenient to disclose. So, how will you notify me then?" Xu Ping asked.
"That’s simple."
Zhang Changqing took out two talismans, one black and one white, from his storage pouch, "These are Yin Yang Talismans. Once either talisman is activated, the other can sense its location and provide direction."
"If the Yin Yang Talisman in your possession lights up, it’s a signal; at that time, Fellow Daoist Xu can follow in the direction the talisman guides you."
"Yin Yang Talisman?"
Xu Ping was slightly stunned. As a Talisman Master, he had never heard of this kind of talisman, but he didn’t find it surprising.
After all, his knowledge is shallow, so it’s only normal that he hadn’t heard of it before.
But having this talisman put his last remaining concerns to rest.
"Since Fellow Daoist Zhang has thought it over so thoroughly, then I shall join the Demon Suppression Team," Xu Ping said after carefully considering his words.
He didn’t intend to get involved in this at first, but he really had no choice, for the offer was too tempting!
"That’s great. With the help of Fellow Daoist Bai, those Demon Cultivators are like autumn grasshoppers, they won’t be able to jump around much longer," Zhang Changqing said with great joy.
"Fellow Daoist Zhang praises me too highly; the main force to eliminate the Demon Cultivators still relies on high-level cultivators like you,"
Xu Ping complimented and then directed the topic to the magic sword: "Since I’ve agreed to join the annihilation team, does Fellow Daoist Zhang uphold his promise?"
"Of course, it’s six hundred lower-grade Spirit Stones, and this Blood-Drinking Sword will be yours," Zhang Changqing generously pushed the magic sword along with its sheath towards Xu Ping.
"Fellow Daoist Zhang is straightforward," Xu Ping was excited.
But after casually storing the magic sword and sheath, he began to take Spirit Stones out of his storage.
Hulah!
Hundreds of Spirit Stones were laid out all over the table.
Almost all were lower-grade Spirit Stones, only two were mid-grade Spirit Stones.
"Fellow Daoist Zhang, count them. It should be exactly six hundred Spirit Stones," Xu Ping said to Zhang Changqing.
Seeing the Spirit Stones messily scattered on the table, Zhang Changqing frowned slightly and with a wave of his sleeve, all the Spirit Stones disappeared from the table.
Feeling the neatly arranged Spirit Stones in his storage pouch, his frown eased, and he felt delighted: "No need to count. I trust Fellow Daoist Xu."
"We’ve chatted for so long, and Fellow Daoist Bai hasn’t even had a sip of tea, how discourteous of me," Having put away the Spirit Stones, Zhang Changqing warmly poured Xu Ping a cup of Spirit Tea.
"You’re too courteous," Xu Ping had no interest in Spirit Tea, took a sip, and casually set the cup down.
Seeing the misalignment of the teacup, Zhang Changqing felt uncomfortable, his face showing hesitation.
Xu Ping noticed Zhang Changqing’s odd expression and asked, "Fellow Daoist Zhang, what’s wrong?"
Unexpectedly, Zhang Changqing suddenly stood up, apologized, and under Xu Ping’s baffled gaze, gently moved and rotated his cup.
Only when the cup aligned symmetrically with his own did Zhang Changqing sit down, looking content.
Seeing this scene, Xu Ping’s expression turned intriguing: ’Brother, isn’t your obsession a bit extreme?’
"Excuse me, when I see something unclean or untidy, I feel uncomfortable," Zhang Changqing apologized sincerely.
"No problem, it’s understandable and quite normal..." Xu Ping expressed his understanding.
Obsessive-compulsive behavior is things he had encountered before, and he had no particular thoughts about such people.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
"I’m glad Fellow Daoist Bai understands. Many people think I’m doing it on purpose, but it’s really not....," Zhang Changqing seemed to have found a kindred spirit and began unloading his worries.
Xu Ping kept a polite smile and continually nodded in response.
Until his smile grew stiff, Zhang Changqing kept talking uninterrupted.
This person has not only obsessive-compulsive disorder but is also quite a talker!
Xu Ping was helpless and had to find an excuse to leave quickly.
"Take care, Fellow Daoist Bai, and visit more often," Zhang Changqing said with reluctance.
Hearing this, Xu Ping walked even faster.
...
Watching Xu Ping’s figure gradually recede, Zhang Changqing’s expression turned serious: "This Fellow Daoist Bai is not simple; even with my Purple Jade Celestial Dharma Eye, I cannot see through him!"
"From the mana fluctuations around him, it seems he only broke through the sixth layer of Qi Cultivation recently, but as for his Body Refining level, I can’t see through it.
"But these are just superficial. He seems to be hiding a deeply powerful force; when I tried to probe further, all I could perceive was an astonishingly sharp aura, almost breaking through my Purple Jade Celestial Dharma Eye."
"That sharp aura... a Sword Cultivator?"
Zhang Changqing couldn’t be sure, and maybe he could fully understand once his Dharma Eye improves.
"In any case, this Fellow Daoist Bai is on our side, and he has agreed to help eradicate the demons."
Thinking of the Demon Cultivator, Zhang Changqing felt a weight on his heart.
He initially didn’t think much of the Demon Cultivator, but after encountering him and his Spirit Pet Snake Demon, his view changed completely.
The Demon Cultivator was fine, but his Spirit Pet Snake Demon was extraordinary, breaking his Purple Jade Celestial Dharma Eye in one glance, and it was only recently that it recovered.
A Snake Demon breaking his Dharma Eye was almost unbelievable.
Yet it happened.
"That is no mere Spirit Pet Snake Demon; it’s more like an ancient creature," Zhang Changqing’s expression turned gloomy.
"He’s crazily killing to refine organs, perhaps to restore his power."
"We must find him quickly. This time, with Bai Zhiyuan’s help, he won’t escape so easily."
Zhang Changqing’s eyes were deep, filled with killing intent.
...
...
After parting with Zhang Changqing, Xu Ping hurried home.
Though eager to test the power of the upper-grade magic sword, it hadn’t undergone sacrificial refinement yet and couldn’t be used.
In less than half an hour, Xu Ping was home.
He locked the door and immediately began the sacrificial refining of the Blood-Drinking Sword.
With his sixth-layer Qi Cultivation, though his mana was abundant, refining the upper-grade magic sword was quite difficult.
Xu Ping introduced a wisp of his mana into the Blood-Drinking Sword.
Buzz buzz!
The wisp of mana caused the Blood-Drinking Sword to emit a radiant glow, hovering in mid-air, exuding a powerful suction, resembling a bottomless pit...
Xu Ping’s expression remained unchanged as he continued to feed mana.
About half an hour later...
His face turned pale, mana exhausted...
Taking a deep breath, Xu Ping looked at the Blood-Drinking Sword, which showed no significant change, before sitting to regain his mana.
Once his mana was fully restored, he transmitted it into the Blood-Drinking Sword again.
After this repetition four times, the Blood-Drinking Sword was finally satisfied, no longer greedily absorbing mana, but rather radiating with bright light, seemingly establishing a subtle bond with Xu Ping.

chapters.title: Chapter 53: Demon Cultivator Puppet
chapters.content:
Chapter 53: Chapter 53: Demon Cultivator Puppet
"It’s done," Xu Ping was thrilled.
With his current cultivation, forging an upper-grade magical sword was truly challenging.
But it was successful, nonetheless.
He lifted the sword and walked into the courtyard.
Under the sunlight, the sword’s blade glimmered silver-white, with a faint sharpness that exuded a terrifyingly lethal aura.
Xu Ping channeled Mana into the Blood-Drinking Sword, instantly amplifying its sharpness, causing the air at the tip to distort and blur, as if sword gleams were flickering.
He aimed at a rock the size of a washbasin at his feet and casually swung the sword.
The sword tip passed inch-wide above the rock without a sound.
Accompanied by a barely audible "szz" sound.
The next moment.
The rock gently trembled and split into two.
Xu Ping stepped forward to inspect, and the cut surface was as smooth as a mirror, clearly reflecting his image.
"The Sword Qi is very sharp, though I wonder how powerful it will be when the swordsmanship is fully unleashed."
Xu Ping initially wanted to find a secluded place to test the sword, but after glancing at the sky, he restrained himself.
It was too late today; better to go tomorrow.
...
...
Early the next morning.
The deserted woodland.
Xu Ping held the sword single-handedly, and with a thought, the sword emitted a low humming, seemingly responding to his call.
He stepped forward, executing a series of sword moves.
Instantly, the woodland was filled with layers of sword light, and faint thunderous sounds could be heard.
Moreover, the thunderous sounds grew increasingly loud, as if endless thunderclaps were erupting.
Xu Ping’s eyes glowed brilliantly, and he slashed out with one stroke.
"Boom!" A deafening thunderous sound followed, and the Sword Qi descended like a thunderbolt.
Countless tree trunks were instantly severed, a massive sound reverberated in all directions, causing trees to topple amidst a cloud of dust.
"This feeling...is amazing!" Xu Ping’s lips curled into a smile.
The suppressed feeling completely vanished.
It was as if he had broken free from a confined space, finally able to stretch his body freely.
More importantly, with the enhancement of the upper-grade magical sword, his swordsmanship’s power was amplified, meaning his strength was now greater too.
Xu Ping initially wanted to continue practicing with the sword, but he heard some faint noises.
Assuming they were loose cultivators attracted by the commotion earlier, he decided not to get involved and left the scene immediately.
In the following days, Xu Ping devoted most of his time to practicing with the sword.
Though his progress didn’t increase, the feeling of wholeheartedly practicing with the sword was very enjoyable.
It also allowed him to better control the Blood-Drinking Sword.
.....
...
Three days later, in the dead of night.
The Linghu Gang’s stronghold was silent, and moonlight streamed through the window, casting a silver glow on the ground.
Linghu Gang’s leader Gao Jun sat cross-legged on a cushion, quietly cultivating.
After a long time.
He finished cultivating.
Gao Jun opened his eyes, filled with helplessness: "Sigh, the Spirit Gathering Pill’s effect is too weak; at this rate, reaching the Perfection stage of Qi Cultivation is a distant goal!"
He did possess Spirit Stones, but in the current market, even with Spirit Stones, he couldn’t buy a Pill more effective than the Spirit Gathering Pill.
"If the Longevity Sect’s people don’t come soon, I’ll have to risk traveling three thousand miles away, even if it’s dangerous," Gao Jun thought to himself.
He wasn’t getting any younger, and if he continued wasting time here, his immortal path might truly become unreachable.
Moreover, even if he reached the Perfection stage of Qi Cultivation, the three barriers before Foundation Establishment were like an insurmountable gap.
Without the help of a Foundation Establishment Pill and Spiritual Objects for Foundation Establishment, success was virtually impossible.
But where in the current market could he find Foundation Establishment Pills and Spiritual Objects for Foundation Establishment?
As he was calculating in his mind.
"Creak."
A faint noise sounded.
"Who?"
Gao Jun quickly became alert; there were sentries both covert and overt outside his room. How could anyone approach silently?
Creak!
The door suddenly opened, and a figure in a black robe silently entered, then the door closed automatically.
"Demon Cultivator!!"
Gao Jun’s face drastically changed, his hand quickly reached for the storage pouch.
At this moment, a black snake suddenly darted out, its eyes emitting a dazzling light, glaring at Gao Jun.
Crack—
In an instant, Gao Jun felt a chill throughout his body, and then his Jade Pendant shattered into pieces, sliding down from his robe.
Bang!
Just as the Jade Pendant broke, Gao Jun’s head felt like it was struck by a heavy hammer, his vision went black, blood oozed from his seven orifices, pain surged from his sea of consciousness.
He forcibly endured the pain, activating a Body Refining Secret Technique, causing his skin to emit a layer of black luminescence.
With his Perfection-level Body Refining physique and the Secret Technique’s enhancement, he could withstand a strike even from a mid-grade Magical Artifact.
However, unexpectedly, the Demon Cultivator held a short sword emitting blood-red flames, easily breaking through his defense and piercing into his chest.
Sizzle...ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
The blood-red flames scorched his flesh, producing a sizzling sound.
"Ah!"
The intense pain in his sea of consciousness combined with the scorching flames forced him to let out a scream.
"If you want to die, keep screaming."
Ma Hui’s icy voice reached his ears, then he pushed the short sword further into his chest, a bit more and it could pierce his heart.
Gao Jun immediately shut his mouth.
The fear of death silenced the pain in his sea of consciousness and chest, but large beads of sweat continuously oozed from his forehead, contorting his face.
"Spare my life..." he squeezed out, hoarse and trembling.
"What’s happening to the Gang Leader?"
A voice inquired from outside, clearly alerted by the earlier commotion.
Ma Hui remained silent, but his cold gaze conveyed everything.
"I was practicing; don’t disturb me if there’s nothing important," Gao Jun gathered his strength to say.
"Understood, Gang Leader."
Accompanied by faint footsteps, the person outside slowly departed.
"Very good," Ma Hui smiled slightly, revealing sharp teeth, eyes glinting with cold light, "Now, open your mouth."
Helpless, Gao Jun complied.
Ma Hui flicked a finger, and a black Pill shot into Gao Jun’s mouth like a meteor.
Gulp!
The Pill instantly dissolved in his stomach, spreading a chilling sensation, as if a cold dagger was pressing against his heart, ready to stab anytime, causing him a sense of suffocation.
As he watched Gao Jun obediently swallow, Ma Hui withdrew the short sword.
Poof!
Blood gushed out like a spring, Gao Jun’s face turned pale immediately, and he pressed his wound hard, trying to stop the bleeding.
"The Pill you just swallowed is called the Heart-devouring Pill. After consumption, it slowly invades the heart veins. You must take the antidote every half month to suppress its toxicity," Ma Hui said coldly while Gao Jun was desperately trying to stop the bleeding, "I know you’re at Perfection in Body Refining; you can try to endure it."
"I wouldn’t dare, what do you want me to do?" Gao Jun asked weakly.
The Demon Cultivator before him was clearly well-prepared, first attacking his sea of consciousness to disarm him, then effortlessly piercing through his defenses.
This Heart-devouring Pill was certainly not something he could easily withstand.
’But what exactly struck my sea of consciousness just now... Divine Sense?’
’A Snake Demon with Divine Sense, capable of launching Spiritual Sense Attacks?’
Gao Jun cast a fearful glance at the black snake on Ma Hui’s shoulder, involuntarily shivering inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 54: Taihang Nourishing God Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 54: Chapter 54: Taihang Nourishing God Skill
One must know that only Foundation Establishment Cultivators can awaken Divine Sense. And awakening Divine Sense doesn’t mean one can perform a Spiritual Sense Attack; one must also learn the corresponding Magic.
A black snake actually possesses Divine Sense and has even learned the corresponding Magic, which is simply unbelievable!
"Very simple." Before Ma Hui could speak, the black snake on his shoulder spoke in human language, "I need you to cooperate with me to annihilate the entire Demon Suppression Team."
"Alright." Gao Jun agreed without hesitation.
At this life-and-death moment, survival was the most important, and the lives of others no longer mattered.
As for the talking black snake, he had long since stopped caring.
"Not bad, quite ruthless." The black snake said blandly, "After I refine everyone in the market, I will give you a chance for Foundation Establishment."
"A chance for Foundation Establishment?" Gao Jun’s heart trembled violently.
He immediately realized that this might just be the black snake’s empty promise to make him compliant.
But what if it’s true?
Given the black snake’s bizarre nature, Foundation Establishment, which is extremely difficult for others, might actually be possible.
That is Foundation Establishment!!!
Gao Jun admitted, his heart wavered.
"Willing to give my life for the ancestor."
Gao Jun immediately knelt down before the black snake with a ’plop.’
He understood by now that the demon cultivator in front of him was all led by the black snake.
"Carry on as usual, wait for my notice before taking action." The black snake instructed.
"Understood, master." Gao Jun kowtowed.
"Collect everything on the scroll as soon as possible." The black snake glanced over.
Ma Hui immediately took out a scroll and handed it to Gao Jun.
Gao Jun glanced at the scroll; it seemed to hold materials for an Array, some precious, some rather ordinary.
"I will gather them all." Gao Jun’s forehead banged against the floor.
"Very good, take this." The black snake nodded contentedly, spitting out a blood-red Pill into its hand.
"Swallow it." The black snake ordered.
Gao Jun stood up, without the slightest hesitation, swallowing it whole.
Gulp!
The Pill instantly dissolved in his stomach, a pure surge of Spiritual Qi rushed into his Dantian; he absorbed it all effortlessly, increasing his cultivation slightly.
"This... what kind of Pill is this?!" Gao Jun was shocked.
The medicinal effects of this blood-red Pill were much better than a Spirit Gathering Pill, and the effect was extremely pure, transforming into Spiritual Qi without any need for refining.
If assisted by this Pill continuously, achieving Perfection in Qi Cultivation would be just around the corner!
A trace of greed flashed in Gao Jun’s eyes.
"This is a Blood Pill, fulfill your duties well, and you’ll have no shortage of Pills." The black snake said calmly.
"Willing to die for the ancestor!" Gao Jun fell to his knees again with a thud.
"Quickly gather these things and collect some blood food as well." The black snake nodded.
"How much blood food does the ancestor need?" Gao Jun asked, naturally aware of the meaning of blood food.
"The more, the better."
"Understood... understood." Gao Jun’s heart trembled.
After giving all instructions, the black snake and Ma Hui left the room silently.
One man, one snake walked away.
Gao Jun stood up again, his expression shifting unpredictably, and finally sighed deeply, "Body Cultivation is just too easily targeted."
If he had ninth-level Qi Cultivation and the Spiritual Sense strength of ninth-level Qi Cultivation, even if attacked by Divine Sense, he wouldn’t be utterly powerless.
Though there were temptations of improving cultivation and Foundation Establishment, being at someone’s mercy was definitely unpleasant.
...
...
Time flew by.
In the blink of an eye, five days had passed.
In a bedroom.
Xu Ping sat cross-legged on the bed, eyes tightly closed.Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
Time quietly flowed around him until, at a certain moment, he suddenly opened his eyes, a brilliant light flashing in them.
He felt the vastness of the Spiritual Sense in his Sea of Consciousness, and a smile involuntarily curled up at the corner of his mouth, "Minor Achievement!"
After two to three months of hard cultivation, his Taihang Nourishing God Skill finally broke through to Minor Achievement.
Though now only at sixth-level Qi Cultivation, the strength of his Spiritual Sense likely surpassed many ninth-level Qi Cultivators.
Xu Ping increasingly believed that once the Taihang Nourishing God Skill achieved Perfection, he would awaken Spiritual Sense.
A wave of excitement surged in Xu Ping’s heart, hard to suppress, making him walk out of the bedroom and open the door.
The spring daytime, vibrant and full of life, tender green saplings sprouted from the earth, seemingly telling him of the beauty of life.
Upon seeing this scene, Xu Ping’s mood improved even more.
"Roar!"
"Ah!"
At this moment, a scream and a beast’s roar came through.
Xu Ping turned his head sharply, seeing a Demon Beast with enormous fangs barging into the area, already injuring someone.
Fortunately, this Demon Beast was only First Rank Middle Grade, and everyone quickly slew it, gradually restoring calmness to the scene.
"After the onset of spring, Demon Beasts intruding into the market seem more and more frequent; this is already the third this month."
Xu Ping frowned but had no mind to walk around anymore, turning back into the house.
...
Not long after returning.
There was a knock on the door from outside.
Xu Ping opened the door to see two members of the Linghu Gang standing at the entrance.
"Fellow cultivators, may I know what brings you here?" Xu Ping asked politely.
"Good news, our Linghu Gang has decided to recruit more, and this time it’s to recruit the Gang Leader’s personal guards."
"Once you become the Gang Leader’s personal guard, you’ll receive twenty Spirit Stones and a bottle of Qi Nourishing Pill every month," one of them spoke.
’Such generosity?’ Xu Ping was slightly surprised.
Though such a number of Spirit Stones might not mean much to him now, for some Loose Cultivators, it was a huge sum.
"Of course, to become the Gang Leader’s personal guard, you still need to pass a test; it’s not for just anyone," the other added.
"I’m used to being free alone, truly not accustomed to joining a gang." Xu Ping refused without hesitation.
He had no interest at all in becoming the Linghu Gang’s personal guard.
Upon hearing his words, the two didn’t say more, turning away to visit elsewhere.
Nearby neighbors, upon hearing this news, were overjoyed, seeing it as a great chance to reach unprecedented heights.
"I’ll join, I’ll join..."
"Me too!"
...
Instantly, those registering surrounded the two tightly.
"What kind of behavior is this? Line up properly!"
Under the scolding of the two from Linghu Gang, the Loose Cultivators obediently lined up to register.
Of course, it was just registration.
To become the Gang Leader’s personal guard required passing a test, and tests came in batches, so some who registered could only wait patiently.
"Wonder when the test will come, it’s really making people anxious!"
"Indeed!"
Whispers in the crowd expressed anticipation for that unknown opportunity.
...
The Linghu Gang members had scarcely left when Zhang Chenyu came to visit.
"Eh?"
"Daoist Zhang, you have broken through to the seventh level of Qi Cultivation!" Xu Ping surprisedly noticed that Zhang’s aura had reached the seventh level.
"Hahaha, just by chance, just by chance, I don’t know how I suddenly broke through. Upon breaking through, I rushed here to fla... uh... share the good news with you.!"
Zhang Chenyu’s smile was radiant, with the wrinkles on his face bunching up like a bright chrysanthemum.

chapters.title: Chapter 55: Demon Suppression Begins
chapters.content:
Chapter 55: Chapter 55: Demon Suppression Begins
’You wanted to say boastful just now, right?’
Xu Ping was speechless inside, but he still offered congratulations, "Congratulations, congratulations, Fellow Daoist Zhang, there is hope for your Foundation Establishment."
Zhang Chenyu looked old, but he was actually only forty-three years old.
At forty-three years old and at the seventh layer of Qi Cultivation, he should have a chance for Foundation Establishment if all goes well, but the chances of success are slim.
"Fellow Daoist Xu flatters me. At my age, I’ve long abandoned ambitions for Foundation Establishment." Zhang Chenyu’s smile grew wider.
...
After a few more casual exchanges, Xu Ping asked about the Linghu Gang’s recruitment expansion.
"I’m not very clear on that matter, it was the Gang Leader’s own decision." Zhang Chenyu shook his head.
"And it’s all mysterious, most people in the gang don’t know the specifics, just that there is such a thing."
"So mysterious?" Xu Ping frowned slightly, but soon relaxed. No matter how mysterious it is, as long as it doesn’t affect him, that’s fine.
"Yes, recently the Gang Leader has become very secretive and has been collecting a lot of array materials." Zhang Chenyu nodded.
"Array materials?"
"Perhaps to study formations." Xu Ping said with a bit of envy.
To be honest, what he wanted to learn most now was formations, but unfortunately, the inheritance of formations was hard to find.
Known since ancient times as being the most valuable, no other cultivation arts could compare.
...
After seeing Zhang Chenyu off, Xu Ping, taking advantage of the fact that it was not yet noon,
hurriedly went to the bedroom to draw Exorcism Talismans.
Even though with his current proficiency, he could likely succeed even at night, it was smoother and easier at noon.
An hour later.
Six Exorcism Talismans were neatly placed on the table, and Xu Ping let out a long sigh of relief.
The price of Exorcism Talismans had risen again to two Spirit Stones during this period.
Although the profit was still relatively small, such talismans belonged to strategic resources and might soar the next time evil spirits appeared.
He had also accumulated quite a few Exorcism Talismans by now.
...
...
Eight days later.
In a dense forested valley in the market, a hidden cave entrance was obscured by decaying plants; the deeper it went, the wider the cave became, and the light grew dimmer.
The interior of the cave was winding and twisting, and after a few turns, the dim environment suddenly began to glow with faint red lights.
The red light intertwined with the surrounding rock walls like fine silk, neither hot nor bright, blending with the darkness, exuding a hint of eeriness
Within the array, a pungent smell of blood permeated, making one nauseous.
Ma Hui and Gao Jun stared intently at the black snake cultivating in the center of the array.
Around the black snake, corpses lay in piles, the bodies of cultivators quietly lying there, blood trickling like small streams, outlining intricate patterns, with the convergence point where the black snake coiled.
Blood continuously flowed into the black snake’s body, and its body trembled occasionally, with bright red light flashing on it, like a burning flame.
At this moment, the black snake’s aura had reached its peak, even its size swelled, as if it was a supreme demon beast about to awaken.
Boom—
Intense fluctuations surged from the black snake, and the blood flowing from the surrounding cultivators’ bodies was swiftly absorbed.
Buzz—
At this moment, a phantom figure appeared from the black snake’s back.
Ma Hui and Gao Jun felt the gaze of the phantom sweep over them.
They felt a chill rise from their feet to their heads, goosebumps erupting all over their bodies.
Quickly, the phantom merged into the black snake, and they both let out a sigh of relief, simultaneously thinking, "The ancestor is truly becoming more powerful."
"Congratulations to the ancestor on achieving divine mastery." As the black snake opened its eyes, Ma Hui quickly kneeled to the ground.
"Congratulations to the ancestor on your smooth path to immortality." Gao Jun also quickly kneeled.
"Hmm."
The black snake looked down on the two, then turned its gaze to Gao Jun, "You have been doing well recently, I am satisfied with the blood offerings. This is your reward."Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
A porcelain bottle was spat from his mouth, landing in front of Gao Jun.
"Thank you, ancestor, for the reward." Gao Jun was overjoyed, immediately kowtowing.
In this porcelain bottle were fifteen Blood Pills, enough to advance his cultivation significantly, maybe even to break through to the eighth layer of Qi Cultivation with another bottle or two.
"Hmm."
The black snake nodded, then asked, "Are the materials I asked you to prepare ready?"
"Ancestor, they are ready." Gao Jun pulled out a storage bag from his bosom, offering it to the black snake with mana.
The black snake scanned it with his Divine Sense briefly, nodding, "Very good, it’s all there. Once I perfect the array, we can lure the Demon Suppression Team to this valley."
"You can leave now, remember not to forget the daily blood offerings."
"I understand."
...
...
Seven days later.
The first watch of the night.
Darkness cloaked the earth, moonlight filtered through sparse treetops, casting mottled silvery light, reflecting on the moist soil.
Bedroom.
Xu Ping ended his cultivation, exhaling stale air, lowering his hands slowly.
Then he habitually opened the proficiency panel.
[Realm: Sixth layer of Qi Cultivation: 5/100; Nourishing Life Skill Level 2: 93/100]
"Finally, another point."
Since he broke through to the sixth layer of Qi Cultivation, the Spirit Gathering Pill’s effect had diminished; now it nearly took five days to gain one point.
At this cultivation speed, it would take over a year to reach the seventh layer of Qi Cultivation.
"It’s a bit slow." Xu Ping murmured.
He had thought about finding better pills, but the current market had none.
Not only were there few alchemists, but even medicinal materials were scarce.
With more Demon Beasts invading the market, fewer dared to venture out for herbs.
"Alas, who knows how long it’ll be until the people from Longevity Sect arrive." Xu Ping sighed.
The market’s resources were decreasing more and more.
It was barely enough to meet daily cultivation needs.
Buzz--
As he lamented, the Yin Yang Talisman in his bosom suddenly lit up, buzzing.
"The demon cultivator... is here!" Xu Ping’s eyes narrowed, quickly channeling a wisp of mana into the Yin Yang Talisman.
The Yin Yang Talisman emitted a strong light, then with a ’whoosh’, it darted outside.
Xu Ping followed closely.
Although he and Zhang Changqing only had a verbal agreement, not a binding contract.
He still planned to jointly exterminate the demon cultivator.
Though he was not exactly a good person, he still intended to keep his promises within his abilities when possible.
Of course, ensuring his capability came first.
...
...
Outside the valley.
Nearly a hundred cultivators guarded the valley entrance, with four people standing at the front.
"Fellow Daoist Zhang, why are we not entering yet? The demon cultivator acts oddly, it’s best to deal with him soon to avoid dragging it out." Gao Jun urged.
"Waiting for one more person." Zhang Changqing in white, appeared calm and composed.
"Who are we waiting for?" a gracefully shaped female cultivator asked. She was Ye Qing, the president of the Four Directions Association.
"Bai Zhiyuan." Zhang Changqing replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 56: White Mist
chapters.content:
Chapter 56: Chapter 56: White Mist
"The one who annihilated the Xiongba Gang?" the Dragon Suppression Gang Leader Jin Yang asked.
"Yes." Zhang Changqing nodded.
"Is it necessary for us to wait for him?" Jin Yang frowned.
Although being able to destroy the Xiongba Gang was impressive, to them, it was just so-so.
"It is necessary." Zhang Changqing said flatly, his tone resolute.
Hearing this, although a few were dissatisfied in their hearts, they didn’t say anything further.
Among them, Zhang Changqing was the strongest.
Gao Jun was anxious inside, but his face didn’t show it at all.
...
...
After about half an hour.
Still no sign of anyone arriving, Jin Yang grew impatient: "This Bai Daoist really has a big ego, making so many of us wait for him alone."
"I informed him late..."
Before Zhang Changqing finished speaking, a rough voice sounded: "Apologies for keeping everyone waiting."
Then a shadow flashed by, and before the four stood a rugged-looking strong man.
Faced with the sudden appearance of the strong man, the four had different expressions.
Zhang Changqing showed a slight smile: "I only informed Bai Daoist temporarily, it’s already commendable that he could come in time."
"Hmph!"
Jin Yang snorted coldly to vent his dissatisfaction.
Ye Qing nodded slightly at Xu Ping, as a greeting.
As for Gao Jun, his expression was calm. He didn’t care, unless it was a ninth-level Qi Cultivator, which might make him worry a bit, but a mere Body Refining Cultivator could only surrender in the face of a Spiritual Sense Attack.
"Now that everyone is here, let’s move out." Zhang Changqing took the lead, with everyone following closely, gradually disappearing into the shadow of the valley.
...
The valley entrance had a narrow entry extending hundreds of meters. The exterior part was normal, but halfway through, white mist began to spread within the valley, growing denser as they moved forward.
"Everyone, be careful, something seems off with this white mist." Zhang Changqing’s face was heavy, with a faint purple light flickering in his eyes.
Xu Ping’s expression also grew serious. Although he didn’t have Zhang Changqing’s Dharma Eye, his Spiritual Sense, which surpassed the ninth level of Qi Cultivation, sharply detected something amiss about the mist.
A tense atmosphere instantly spread among the Demon Suppression Team.
"Zhang Daoist, have you found anything?" Ye Qing asked.
"No, it’s just that I can’t see through this white mist, I can barely see ten meters ahead, it’s definitely not simple mist." The purple light in Zhang Changqing’s eyes had intensified to the extreme.
"Seeing only ten meters ahead?" Ye Qing was shocked.
They had known each other long enough to be aware that Zhang Changqing practiced an extremely advanced Dharma Eye.
This Dharma Eye had been unfailingly effective in the past, yet it couldn’t see through this white mist?
Xu Ping also noticed the anomaly in Zhang Changqing’s eyes, secretly surprised: ’It seems this Zhang Daoist practices an eye-based magic.’The source of thɪs content is novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
’Maybe I should look for such a spell to learn, just wondering if this spell of Zhang Daoist is for sale.’ Xu Ping’s heart wavered slightly.
Having such a spell would greatly enhance both combat and other conveniences.
Others, upon hearing this news, immediately wore solemn expressions.
The atmosphere of the Demon Suppression Team became even more tense.
"Did the demon cultivators create this?" Jin Yang asked with a grimace.
"Most likely." Zhang Changqing replied.
Upon hearing this, Jin Yang’s expression grew more unsightly, harboring a vague irritation but found it inappropriate to vent, so he sneered: "Had we come earlier, perhaps there wouldn’t be so much trouble!"
Though he didn’t name names, everyone knew who he was referring to.
The members of the Dragon Suppression Gang, seeing their leader speak so, all chimed in:
"Exactly, if we had come earlier, we might have already slain the demon cultivators."
"And we all know who it is, making us waste so much time."
"Some people think that after destroying a few weak gangs, they are invincible!"
...
"Shut up." Zhang Changqing frowned and ordered, "Everyone needs to keep a distance of no more than one meter, keep moving forward."
Hearing this, the members of the Dragon Suppression Gang fell silent, daring not to speak further.
Jin Yang was unwilling to comply, just about to speak when he saw Zhang Changqing’s cold gaze.
He could only shut his mouth sulkily, though his dissatisfaction increased even further.
Even before starting, Jin Yang and Xu Ping were already at odds, making Gao Jun secretly gloat.
Jin Yang, being so arrogant and yet cowardly, was infuriating when he was a teammate.
Now as an opponent, Gao Jun was delighted, wishing the whole Demon Suppression Team were like him.
Everyone continued moving forward.
At this moment, Zhang Changqing whispered to Xu Ping in a voice that only two people could hear: "Bai Daoist, they’re a bunch of rabble, don’t mind what they say."
"It’s fine." Xu Ping was indifferent.
If he couldn’t handle a few words from others, his two lifetimes would’ve been in vain.
Ye Qing saw Xu Ping and Zhang Changqing whispering, a subtle expression passed through her eyes.
The imposing Bai Daoist, and the handsome Zhang Changqing.
Hmm!
After walking for a while, Xu Ping realized that the valley was much bigger than he had imagined, and the Demon Suppression Team, nearly a hundred strong, was like casting a few stones into a vast lake.
Moreover, as they moved forward, the white mist grew thicker, so much that even when less than a meter apart, they could only see each other as blurry shadows.
After walking a long distance further, Xu Ping frowned, stopping Zhang Changqing: "Zhang Daoist, something’s wrong, it seems we’re going in circles!"
He pointed to a large rock on the right: "I’ve seen this rock twice now."
Xu Ping’s words resonated with some people.
"Me too, I’ve seen this tree twice, I even thought it just looked similar."
...
"Zhang Daoist." Ye Qing directed her gaze at Zhang Changqing.
Zhang Changqing nodded solemnly: "We are indeed going in circles; this white mist not only restricts vision but seems to also block our perception."
"If I’m not mistaken, this mist is probably some kind of Illusionary Formation!"
"Illusionary Formation?"
"How do we get out then!"
Zhang Changqing’s words triggered panic among the loose cultivators, worried that if trapped here continuously, they might not even survive, let alone eradicate the demon cultivators.
At this moment.
Suddenly!
Swish swish swish...
From within the dense fog, countless small golden arrows, gathered from energy, began shooting out, piercing through the toxic fog in masses.
"Quick, activate defensive talismans!" Zhang Changqing’s face changed, shouting sharply.
Xu Ping’s eyes narrowed, he flipped his hand to retrieve the Blood-Drinking Sword, his wrist flicked, the sword light weaved, blocking all the golden arrows.
In the mist, everyone also took action.
Jin Yang raised his palm and waved forward, a crimson glow erupted from his palm, a massive blaze surged out, instantly engulfing the golden arrows ahead.
Ye Qing conjured a white scarf magical artifact, which expanded a meter wide in the wind, shielding herself, a chaotic series of clangs echoed as it blocked all the golden arrows.

chapters.title: Chapter 57: Breaking the Formation
chapters.content:
Chapter 57: Chapter 57: Breaking the Formation
Although it was easy for Xu Ping and the others to block, it wasn’t as easy for the others to do the same.
First, the attack was too sudden, and the white fog concealed it, only when it came very close did they realize.
Second, the power of these golden arrows was remarkable, and they were numerous.
"Boom boom boom..."
"Ah ah ah..."
Amidst the screams, many people’s protective shields were burst open by the golden arrows, forcing them to watch helplessly as they were shot into sieves.
The golden arrows came quickly and also disappeared quickly.
After a wave of sudden attacks, the dense fog returned to calm.
"Check the casualties!" Zhang Changqing shouted loudly.
It took just a moment to tally up, and as many as a dozen people were wounded or killed.
Zhang Changqing’s face was grim; they had not even seen the face of the demon cultivator and already had over a dozen casualties.
"Ah!!!"
At this moment, a sudden cry of terror came from the crowd.
The loose cultivators turned their heads and saw a person pointing with horror at the ground, shouting in fear at the already completely shriveled corpse: "Wang... Wang Er’s body, the flesh is gone."
"What!"
"How could this be?"
His words stirred a huge commotion among the crowd.
"Li Er’s body is also missing its flesh..."
"And Zhao Li too..."
Finally, they discovered that all the bodies’ flesh had disappeared without a trace, leaving only bones and dry skin.
Fear began to spread among the crowd; the disappearance of the bodies’ flesh right in front of their eyes was truly eerie.
Now they’re just bodies, but later, will it be their living selves?
"Don’t panic everyone!"
Zhang Changqing shouted in a deep voice to steady the situation, "There is something strange with the ground, blood and flesh from the bodies were absorbed by blood vessels growing from the ground."
"Blood vessels growing from the ground absorbed the flesh??"
The crowd was slightly stunned and quickly looked towards the ground.
Xu Ping did the same, and upon close inspection, he noticed numerous slender things resembling blood vessels growing from the ground.
They had deeply pierced into the corpses, slowly absorbing the flesh and blood.
"This is likely some kind of blood-sucking array, and those golden arrows were probably some kind of attack array."
Zhang Changqing paused for a moment and then slowly explained after organizing his words, "The white fog should be a First Rank Upper Grade Bewildering Array, the golden arrows a First Rank Upper Grade Offensive Array, and what’s on the ground is a type of blood-sucking array."
"The three arrays work together but do not interfere with each other, it seems the demon cultivator’s proficiency in arrays is very strong!"
Zhang Changqing’s words made the crowd slightly relieved knowing it was an array rather than some bizarre technique they couldn’t defend against.
However, their hatred for the demon cultivator grew deeper.
Damn demon cultivator, just how many arrays have you set up!
Wouldn’t it be better if you just let us kill you already!
Seeing how Zhang Changqing had deduced the truth of the three arrays in such a short time, Gao Jun was even more wary of him.
For some reason, uneasy feelings arose in Gao Jun’s heart.
He felt that Zhang Changqing might have something up his sleeve.
"Daoist Zhang, do you have the confidence to break so many arrays?" Ye Qing asked with a serious expression.
The crowd also turned their gaze towards him.
If anyone present could break so many arrays, it would probably be him.
In fact, Xu Ping thought that he might also be able to do it.
If he went all out, he should be able to break through at least one or two arrays with the power of Sword Qi Thunder Sound.
But with his current cultivation, he could only manage two strikes at most before exhausting his mana.
Unless it was a matter of life and death, he couldn’t use it recklessly.
Under the expectant eyes of everyone, Zhang Changqing nodded: "I am confident."
He took out a silver talisman from his storage bag.
"Is this?" Xu Ping voiced his guess: "A Breaking Charm?!"
"Yes, a Breaking Charm, a First Rank Upper Grade Breaking Charm," Zhang Changqing nodded.
Upon confirmation, Xu Ping sighed inwardly: ’This Daoist Zhang has a lot of good things on him, an Upper Grade Sword and a First Rank Upper Grade Breaking Charm.’
A First Rank Upper Grade Breaking Charm was a rare resource.
It was basically unavailable on the market, and if one occasionally appeared, it was at a sky-high price.
Moreover, making talismans was extremely difficult, comparable to some Second-stage Talismans.
No one knows how this top disciple of the Longevity Sect obtained it.
’If one could rob Daoist Zhang, surely he’d make a fortune, maybe even enough resources for Foundation Establishment.’ the thought unwittingly crossed Xu Ping’s mind.
Gao Jun, standing nearby, couldn’t help but curse inwardly upon seeing Zhang Changqing take out a Breaking Charm: "Damn, how did Zhang Changqing even have a First Rank Upper Grade Breaking Charm!"
He almost couldn’t resist rushing forward to destroy it.
But he restrained himself because rushing out now would be akin to seeking death.
Zhang Changqing didn’t say much more and directly activated the Breaking Charm.
Buzz buzz!
The Breaking Charm floated in the air, emitting waves of silver ripples, distorting the array’s operational fluctuations...
The Breaking Charm was specifically made to break arrays, not to mention that this Breaking Charm exploded from within the array, making it even more powerful!
With a series of cracking sounds, the layers of fog that enveloped everyone dispersed.
The previously blurry environment was now finally clear, with the moonlight shining on everyone once more.
The crowd was momentarily stunned, then overjoyed: "The array is broken!!"
"It’s not over yet!"
"Look up, watch out for the golden arrows coming again." When everyone was about to lose themselves in joy, Zhang Changqing’s reminder came.
Upon hearing this, everyone hurriedly looked up and saw an almost invisible translucent ripple in the void, with countless golden arrows slowly forming.
Swish swish swish...
The next moment, countless golden arrows descended like thunderbolts.Follow current novels on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
"Here they come!"
"Four fellow Daoists, attack with me, block the golden arrows." Zhang Changqing shouted loudly, taking the lead in the attack.
He summoned a magical artifact resembling a gold brick, and with a flick of his finger, the gold brick expanded rapidly to several feet, its light flourishing, and with a ’whoosh,’ it sped towards the golden arrows.
Boom boom boom...
Amidst the thunderous sounds, the golden arrows were completely smashed, transforming into dots of spiritual light and dissipating in the air.
As Zhang Changqing attacked, Xu Ping also made his move.
Holding a sword in one hand, Xu Ping swung it down, unleashing a burst of Sword Qi that instantly shredded countless golden arrows, with the sword’s power undiminished, it struck heavily on the translucent ripple.
Boom!
With a loud bang, the Sword Qi dissipated, causing violent ripples on the translucent surface, but ultimately it wasn’t severed.
"Not using Sword Qi Thunder Sound, the power is a bit lacking, one sword strike didn’t break it." Xu Ping frowned slightly.
Although Xu Ping was dissatisfied with the power of his sword strike, those present were shocked beyond words, their eyes widening:
"This... is a Sword Cultivator?!!"
Earlier, with the white fog covering them, though Xu Ping had acted, the crowd hadn’t been able to see clearly, and their perception had been dulled by the fog, leaving them without a clear understanding of Xu Ping’s actual strength.
Now though, witnessing Xu Ping’s actions firsthand, they were deeply impressed: "His body refining is impressive, and his swordsmanship is equally formidable!"

chapters.title: Chapter 58: Black Serpent Attack
chapters.content:
Chapter 58: Chapter 58: Black Serpent Attack
Jin Yang’s heart trembled, his pupils revealing shock.
If that sword had been aimed at him earlier, he probably wouldn’t have been able to withstand it.
This person’s strength is definitely above his own, perhaps not far from Zhang Changqing.
Thinking of the mocking words he said earlier, a trace of regret surged in his heart.
And among everyone present, the one who felt the worst was Gao Jun, as if he’d just swallowed a fly that flew out of the toilet.
Zhang Changqing breaking the array was barely within his expectations, but Bai Zhiyuan possessing such formidable swordsmanship totally exceeded them.
’Could it be that the ancestor might fall at their hands?’
’No, that won’t happen.’ Gao Jun shook his head vigorously, "The ancestor is a Golden Core Demon Cultivator, now he’s fallen, but a skinny camel is still larger than a horse, it’s unlikely for him to fall at the hands of two Qi Cultivators.
"What are you waiting for? Attack!" Zhang Changqing shouted, waking everyone up, and then they began to act.
Ye Qing protected herself with the white cloth magical artifact in front, but her eyes kept drifting to Xu Ping and Zhang Changqing.
Daoist Zhang has meticulous thoughts and is strong; Daoist Bai, rugged in appearance, has unparalleled swordsmanship.
Hmm, hmm!
Without the cover of dense fog, these golden small arrows posed no danger to them.
Soon, the dense golden small arrows were all blocked by them, with no one injured.
...
A high platform in the valley.
A person and a snake were constantly observing Xu Ping and his group. Though the dense fog obscured the specific situation within, through the array flag’s perception, they could clearly understand the movements of their group.
Suddenly!
Crack!
The silent high platform rang with a crisp sound, followed by a ’poof’, and a cluster of flames arose, the array flag spontaneously combusting.
"The ancestor’s array flag is burning!" Ma Hui was suddenly shocked.
The black snake’s eyes also flashed with a hint of surprise: "I didn’t expect that Longevity Sect boy actually has a Breaking Charm."
Last time, that boy used Dharma Eye to spy on him, though he broke the Dharma Eye with his Divine Sense, it also made him realize how special this boy was.
Boom!
Just then, another loud boom came from the valley, and the person and snake looked towards the source of the sound.
Only to see Xu Ping’s mighty display.
"Sword... Sword Cultivator!" Ma Hui’s eyes almost popped out.
The black snake’s eyes also passed a hint of solemnity.
"Ancestor, what should we do now?" Ma Hui said anxiously. Now the array has been broken partially, and such a powerful Sword Cultivator has emerged.
A strong unease surged in his heart.
"What are you panicking for!" The black snake scolded, "The array is just a test of their weight."
"Unexpectedly, such a small marketplace hid two Flood Dragons, this is truly interesting!" The black snake’s vertical pupils reflected the figures of Xu Ping and Zhang Changqing.
...
In the valley.
"It’s over!"
After withstanding another round from the Demon Suppression Team, everyone let out a sigh of relief.
This time, no one died, and now the golden small arrows pose no threat to them.
"According to the forming speed of the golden small arrows, the next attack is in one minute, everyone aim at the transparent ripples in the void and attack with all your might!" Zhang Changqing’s eyes glowed with purple light as he commanded.
This array, he planned to break with force.
"Understood!"
Everyone responded, preparing to use their magical artifacts to act.
"Humph!"
Suddenly, a black-robed person and a black snake appeared before them.
A cold snort came from the black snake’s mouth, followed by a Divine Sense carrying a chilling aura sweeping over the Demon Suppression Team.
Everyone froze in their actions, a chill rising from the soles of their feet to the back of their heads, goosebumps erupting all over.
Feeling the black snake’s chilling Divine Sense, Xu Ping’s heart raced, his face full of disbelief.
A snake has Divine Sense???
Not only him, but everyone in the Demon Suppression Team found it somewhat hard to believe.
They couldn’t figure out why an ordinary-looking Snake Demon possessed a Foundation Establishment’s Divine Sense.
Already anticipated by Zhang Changqing, his face was extremely somber at this point, this old creature, its strength had restored significantly after a month!
"That black snake is the real Demon Cultivator, the black-robed person is just a subordinate!" He reminded in a deep voice.
"The black snake is the Demon Cultivator??"
Zhang Changqing’s words sounded like an impossibility, piercing everyone’s ears, causing them to pause slightly.The most update n0vels are published on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
But upon careful thought, given the black snake’s oddity, it seemed very reasonable.
During the time everyone’s actions were delayed by the Divine Sense’s intimidation, the golden small arrows in the void had reformed.
Swish, swish, swish...
In the next moment, dense golden small arrows rained down like a shower towards the Demon Suppression Team.
"Everyone be careful."
The Demon Suppression Team wanted to resist together.
But the black snake obviously wouldn’t give them that chance.
Its form expanded to several zhang, a vast oppressive aura spread in all directions.
Its tail swung forcefully, like a whip lashing towards Xu Ping and the five.
Bang, bang, bang...
The tail broke the air, emitting bursts of sonic booms.
Xu Ping and the five’s faces changed dramatically, hurriedly evading.
If it struck their bodies, they might turn into flesh and blood on the spot.
Boom!
The black snake’s tail hit the ground, causing a slight shake, leaving a nearly half-zhang deep pit on the ground.
He cared not for their evasion.
His intent was merely to entangle these five.
Boom, boom, boom...
Ah, ah, ah...
Without Xu Ping and the five blocking the golden small arrows, the Demon Suppression Team again suffered casualties.
Several more were pierced through and killed by the golden small arrows.
Ma Hui saw this scene, grinned savagely, and then summoned an array flag. The flag hovered in the void, emitting waves of red glow.
Suddenly, the earth shook violently, countless slender blood vessels surged from the ground, seemingly endless, instantly gathering into a huge humanoid monster.
In the next moment, the humanoid monster reached out with a huge hand, countless blood vessels extending infinitely towards a cultivator.
This Qi Cultivation Stage Level Five cultivator reacted quickly, immediately activating a protective talisman.
But the protective light couldn’t resist these slender vessels, pierced instantly, countless vessels deeply stabbed into his flesh.
He cried out loudly: "Save me..."
The sound was filled with despair.
Then, before he could finish speaking, he was drained of flesh and blood, turning into a skeleton.
The humanoid monster, after draining him, increased in size once more.
Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!
The cultivators in front of the humanoid monster instantly summoned magical artifacts and hurled them toward it.
Boom, boom, boom...
Countless slender blood vessels were burned to ash or blasted into fragments, falling onto the ground.
The humanoid monster’s head and body quickly turned pitted.
However, large numbers of slender blood vessels again surged from the ground, quickly filling in the damage they’d caused.
And at this point, the golden small arrows in the void had formed again; in the next moment, they rained down like a torrential downpour on the Demon Suppression Team.
Amid the screams, several more died or were injured.
"Miscalculated, this isn’t merely a simple blood-sucking array." Zhang Changqing’s face looked grim, wanting to help but was tightly entangled by the black snake, unable to break free.

chapters.title: Chapter 59: Talisman Array
chapters.content:
Chapter 59: Chapter 59: Talisman Array
"You four Daoists, focus your power on this black snake first," Zhang Changqing shouted sternly.
Ye Qing and the others nodded gravely.
Xu Ping’s eyes revealed a hint of helplessness. He originally thought exterminating the demon cultivator should be simple, but who would have guessed this demon cultivator was truly beyond his expectations.
Calling him a bona fide Foundation Establishment Cultivator wouldn’t be an exaggeration.
