Zhang Changqing took the lead again, his magic technique activated the golden brick, causing its form to swell again, becoming as large as a small mountain.
Whoosh!
Accompanied by a whistling sound, the golden brick smashed heavily towards the black snake.
Ye Qing followed closely, she summoned a blue feather fan and swung fiercely at the black snake.
Whizz whizz whizz!
More than a dozen sharp ice spikes formed out of thin air, shooting out explosively, piercing towards the black snake everywhere.
At this point, Xu Ping had no choice but to act. He gripped the Blood-Drinking Sword, and with a slash, the tip of the sword emitted sword qi, striking heavily on the black snake.
Bam!
The sword qi exploded, knocking the black snake backward, smashing heavily against the wall, causing countless stones to fly and dust to rise.
Then, more than a dozen sharp ice spikes rushed into the dust, and finally, the mountain-sized golden brick slammed down heavily.
Boom!
With the earth shaking, the dust almost completely covered the massive form of the black snake.
"What a chance!"
Seeing the three suppress the black snake, Jin Yang wanted to make a move but suddenly heard a familiar, bone-chilling voice around his ear: "I actually didn’t want to deal with you first, but you’re the easiest to handle!"
Then he suddenly felt a stabbing pain in his chest, spewing a mouthful of blood.
"Poof!"
Jin Yang struggled to lower his head, only to see a hand glowing with black light piercing through his chest, gripping his beating heart tightly.
Even with such a severe injury, he did not immediately die.
He strained to turn his head, staring intensely at Gao Jun, and uttered three difficult words: "Why?"
"Such a simple principle, you still don’t understand?" Gao Jun couldn’t be bothered to waste words, and crushed his heart into pieces.
"Gao Jun, what are you doing?" Ye Qing’s face changed drastically.
"You’ve sided with demon cultivators!" Zhang Changqing glowered, spitting each word.
Gao Jun struck so quickly, and their attention was drawn to the black snake so much that by the time they reacted, Gao Jun had already killed Jin Yang.
"Hmph! Wise birds seek wood to dwell, the demon cultist ancestor’s cultivation is astonishing, today is your death day!" Gao Jun said harshly, but retreated rapidly, distancing himself from them.
Though he cared little for Jin Yang, Ye Qing, and others, he was cautious about Zhang Changqing.
"Trouble, Gao Jun has sided with demon cultivators," Xu Ping’s expression darkened.
Gao Jun, being a third-stage perfection cultivator, was even stronger than Ye Qing in battle power.
Boom!
At this time, the black snake, assaulted by them, raised its snake body, eyes full of eerie light: "Kid, your swordsmanship is pretty good, it really hurt!"
The black snake wagged its tail like a person suddenly bumping their hand, then quickly swung it to ease the pain.
The three involuntarily looked at its tail, seeing only a foot-long sword wound. The surrounding scales were shattered, and blood only flowed for a moment before stopping.
Besides that, the black snake had no other wounds.
"This black snake’s defense is so strong!!" Ye Qing’s face turned pale, the three’s attack left only Xu Ping’s sword qi with a wound on it.
Seeing the snake’s size, this injury was like a mosquito bite to a human.
How to fight this!
Her heart was filled with despair!
Xu Ping’s eyes were also filled with seriousness: ’It seems without Sword Qi Thunder Sound, I can’t pierce his defense!’
"Gao Jun, Ma Hui, kill the others, I’ll play with these two kids!" the black snake instructed.
"Understood, ancestor!" they responded.
"You handle the woman, I’ll deal with the group of loose cultivators!" Ma Hui raised the array flag, slaughtering the remaining loose cultivators in the valley.
With humanoid monsters and golden arrows assisting, the remaining loose cultivators were no match.
In no time, several more were slain.
"No, I don’t want to die!"
Facing the massacre, a loose cultivator’s spirit broke down, despairingly shouting, running towards the valley exit.
He was about to reach the exit.
Who would have thought, another humanoid monster suddenly appeared blocking the exit, smaller than the previous one, with countless thin blood vessels shot out, piercing into his flesh, turning him into a skeleton in moments.
"Why is there another monster!!" Countless people cried out in despair.
Meanwhile.
Gao Jun stealthily approached close to Ye Qing: "Such a pity, such a beautiful woman is about to perish."
As he spoke, his whole body glowed with black light.
"Hmph!" Ye Qing snorted coldly, not wanting to waste words and knowing it was time to fight desperately.
She used the blue feather fan vigorously.
Whizz whizz whizz!
More than a dozen sharp ice spikes formed out of thin air, shooting out explosively, targeting Gao Jun.
Gao Jun was a third-stage perfection body cultivator, she wouldn’t let Gao Jun get close.
...
Facing battles at two places, Xu Ping and Zhang Changqing dared not move rashly, their eyes fixed on the black snake.
It was incredibly strange, with unfathomable power, making them stay vigilant.
"Don’t say I didn’t give you a chance, show whatever skills you have," the black snake said calmly.
Xu Ping and Zhang Changqing exchanged glances, now they had no way to retreat, deciding to use their ace techniques.
Zhang Changqing collected the golden brick, patting the storage pouch.
"Appear!"
Ten First Rank Upper Grade talismans, and two Second-stage talismans appeared in his hand.
"Go!"
He gathered spiritual power on the talismans, one by one they flew from his hand, drifting quickly in the void, encircling the black snake instantly.
"Is this... a Talisman Array?"
A flash of surprise crossed the black snake’s eyes.
A Talisman Array is a type of array technique, allowing talismans to coordinate and unleash stronger power.
But to learn Talisman Array, one must become a Talisman Master and an Array Master.
Not to mention, since ancient times, arrays are the most renowned and difficult, even fewer can master talisman drawing even with resources and capability.
Moreover, mastering both arrays and talisman drawing means you can learn Talisman Array.
The two require precise coordination, any mistake could lead to failure.
Only those with extraordinary talent can learn it.
Such difficulty.
The black snake, with years of experience, had hardly seen Talisman Arrays.
A seemingly ordinary disciple left in the Longevity Sect knew the Talisman Array, which truly surprised it.
"But with your current cultivation, you should not be able to control an array with Second-stage talismans, aren’t you afraid the talismans will go out of control and explode you!" the black snake swinged its tail, speaking calmly.
Zhang Changqing’s mastery of Talisman Array indeed surprised it, but forcing control of the array couldn’t harm it.

chapters.title: Chapter 60: Sword Qi Thunder Sound
chapters.content:
Chapter 60: Chapter 60: Sword Qi Thunder Sound
"So much nonsense."
Zhang Changqing snorted coldly, extending his right index finger to forcefully cut across his left palm, creating a wound from which blood flowed profusely.
Then he swung his hand, and twelve drops of blood landed on the talismans.
Instantly, the twelve talismans erupted with a strong blood-red light.
After he completed this, Zhang Changqing’s face immediately turned pale.
Clearly, this wasn’t ordinary blood.
"Blood... Could it be?"
Observing the smoothly functioning talisman array with increased power, the black serpent’s calm gaze finally turned serious, eyes fixed intently on Zhang Changqing.
Recalling something, his face changed dramatically: "Blood Talisman Spirit Body!?"
Zhang Changqing’s gaze flickered, but he did not refute.
"Explode!"
He uttered softly.
Rumble—Thɪs N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
The talismans connected, thunder roared, lightning and fire surged and completely engulfed the black serpent.
Seizing the opportunity, Xu Ping also made his move.
Battle wasn’t a fair 1v1 in the arena; it’s best to strike when the enemy is down.
He held his sword single-handedly, slashing out a strike accompanied by resounding thunder sounds, sending a torrent of Sword Qi towards the black serpent.
Although the full power of Sword Qi Thunder Sound wasn’t unleashed, its force was still significant.
Boom!
The Sword Qi erupted mightily, sending waves rippling in all directions, suppressing the rising lightning and flames.
"Sword... Sword Qi Thunder Sound!!"
Zhang Changqing’s eyes nearly popped out of their sockets.
He had guessed that this fellow Daoist Bai must have some hidden cards, but who would have thought that a Qi Cultivator could wield Sword Qi Thunder Sound!!
Even for particularly gifted Sword Cultivators, mastering it requires at least the Foundation Establishment Realm!
Yet this fellow Daoist Bai had grasped it in the Qi Refining Realm, what is this!?
A peerless Sword Cultivator!!
Even the Longevity Sect, adding nearby dominant forces and Nascent Soul sects, hadn’t seen such a Sword Cultivator in centuries.
Compared to Zhang Changqing, others in the valley fared even worse.
Originally battling each other, Ye Qing and Gao Jun had stopped, staring dumbfoundedly at Xu Ping as if beholding a deity.
Ma Hui even forgot to manipulate the array flags.
Finally, a golden figure reformed in the void with a ’shush-shush-shush’, bringing everyone back to their senses from shock.
Ma Hui and Gao Jun’s faces altered dramatically, involuntarily exclaiming: "Patriarch!"
What they had witnessed was incredibly powerful, beyond even what a Foundation Establishment Cultivator might withstand; could the Patriarch be unharmed...?
In stark contrast to Ma Hui and Gao Jun’s panic, the members of the Demon Suppression Team were all beaming with delight.
They had already been hopeless; was this a reversal from the brink?
As the dust cleared, revealing the scene inside, the Demon Suppression Team went wild with joy.
The black serpent’s body was tattered, lifeless, dead beyond a shadow of a doubt.
"The Patriarch... is dead!" Ma Hui and Gao Jun’s voices were filled with endless panic and fear.
Exchanging glances, they saw the will to retreat in each other’s eyes.
If even the Patriarch was dead, they were in no way a match for the two.
As they got ready to make a run for it.
The supposedly lifeless black serpent suddenly moved.
With a ’crack’, the scales on the black serpent began to break, as if it were shedding its skin.
"Not dead?" Xu Ping’s expression darkened, ready to strike again.
Aware that some unknown transformation was occurring, he wasn’t so foolish as to stand idly by.
Zhang Changqing clearly had the same idea.
Both prepared to act once more.
"Humph!"
A cold snort rang out.
In an instant, Xu Ping and Zhang Changqing both felt a chill sweep through them.
Thud, thud, thud...
Several jade pendants on Zhang Changqing shattered instantly, turning to fragments slipping down his robes.
Boom!
Then Zhang Changqing felt as if a hammer was pounding heavily on his head, his vision went black, intense pain stabbed from his Sea of Consciousness, and nosebleeds trickled down slowly.
Compared to Zhang Changqing’s many defenses, Xu Ping had nothing and had to endure it directly.
Boom!
Xu Ping felt as if someone was jamming a sharp awl brutally into his head, then stirring his brain pulp violently.
A muffled sound came from his mouth as blood oozed slowly from his ears and nose.
Spiritual Sense Attack!
Through the pain, both realized they had been hit by a Spiritual Sense Attack.
This black serpent not only possessed Divine Sense but could also carry out Spiritual Sense Attacks?
A chilling shock ran deeper in their hearts.
What exactly was the origin of this black serpent!!
For Ma Hui and Gao Jun, whose spirits had hit rock bottom, this scene resulted in frantic elation: "The Patriarch’s alive!"
A Golden Core Demon Cultivator like the Patriarch wouldn’t be slain by two Qi Cultivators!
The Demon Suppression Team, on the other hand, plummeted from heaven to hell.
Huff!
At that moment, Xu Ping and Zhang Changqing were suddenly enveloped by a shadow, a foul wind hitting them.
"Bad!"
With difficulty regaining his bearings, Zhang Changqing’s expression changed, hastily slapping his storage bag, and an ancient bronze bell appeared, expanding rapidly to two meters, enveloping the two completely.
Crash!
The black serpent’s tail whipped heavily against the bronze bell.
The bell clearly couldn’t withstand such force and shattered with a ’crack’.
Both Xu Ping and Zhang Changqing hastily slapped numerous defensive talismans onto their bodies.
Multiple layers of Protective Spiritual Light surrounded them completely.
In the next moment.
Bang! Bang!
The two were instantly flung by the black serpent’s tail, smashed heavily into the wall.
Pfft!
A mouthful of blood was spat from both mouths.
The sight was disastrous, yet luckily, the blow had been weakened by the bronze bell, reducing its force and sparing them from fatal injuries.
Especially Xu Ping, with his formidable physique only suffering minor injuries.
Struggling from the wall, he felt the intense pain in his mind alleviated quite a bit.
Of course, this wasn’t relieved by the black serpent’s tail, but unexpectedly, ’Taihang Nourishing God Skill’ began operating autonomously.
With a chill permeating the Sea of Consciousness, the dizziness and starry vision faded away.
"Did not expect Taihang Nourishing God Skill could ease the damage from a Spiritual Sense Attack," Xu Ping marveled inwardly.
"One possesses Blood Talisman Spirit Body; the other astonishingly comprehends Sword Qi Thunder Sound at the Qi Refining Realm—against ordinary foes, they might have turned the tables."
"But alas, just a little short."
A phantom figure emerged from the black serpent’s back, eyes fixed on the two, "This ancestor doesn’t even want to refine you, offering you a chance to become disciples."
Xu Ping and Zhang Changqing remained unmoved after hearing this, their gazes meeting and seeing each other’s killing intent.
"Huff!"
"Fellow Daoist Bai, we must fight for our lives!" Zhang Changqing exhaled deeply, eyes bright.
"This time you’ve put me in quite a spot, a reward of an upper-grade magical artifact isn’t enough!" Xu Ping forced a smile.
"Hahaha, after annihilating the Demon Cultivator, I guarantee satisfaction," Zhang Changqing laughed heartily.
"It seems you’ve made the wrong choice, but don’t worry, I won’t refine you. Such excellent materials should not go to waste not being made into demon corpses." Having heard their conversation, the black serpent regretfully shook its head.

chapters.title: Chapter 61: The Final Slaying of the Black Serpent
chapters.content:
Chapter 61: Chapter 61: The Final Slaying of the Black Serpent
"Who will prevail remains uncertain!"
Zhang Changqing slapped his storage bag fiercely, and instantly, more than twenty talismans flew up.
"Friend Bai, I’ll weaken him. Look for an opportunity to deliver a critical strike!" he whispered.
Without waiting for Xu Ping’s response, he spat a mouthful of essence blood onto all the talismans.
Buzz buzz!
All the talismans burst forth with an unprecedented intense blood light, accompanied by an unsettling energy wave.
After doing all this, Zhang Changqing’s face turned paper gold, almost falling, but he still held up, pointing his finger firmly.
"Go!"
All the talismans transformed into a beam of blood light and shot straight towards the black snake.
Facing all this, the black snake did not dodge, its expression composed; it said calmly, "Although the talisman array has talismans ahead, it still centers around an array, and having an array means there’s an array hub."
"Your talisman array is already honed to perfection. If you hadn’t forced yourself to activate talismans beyond your ability, I might not have found your array hub so easily."
His words were like dousing Zhang Changqing’s pale face even further.
His heart tightened, and he immediately decided to detonate the talisman array.
However, the black snake’s tail flashed like lightning, easily fixing one of the talismans, sealing the entire talisman array in an instant.
No matter how Zhang Changqing tried to activate it, the talisman array remained unmoving, as if subjected to a restriction.
Anxious, he gritted his teeth, seemingly making some decision, and slapped his chest, causing blood to gush out.
The blood, like a red lightning, instantly sprinkled over all the talismans.
Buzz buzz...
The talisman array, initially immobilized, began to operate.
After completing all this, Zhang Changqing could no longer hold on, and collapsed to the ground weakly.
"You’ve actually developed your blood talisman spirit body to this extent!" Seeing the talisman array operational again, the black snake’s face changed, secretly thinking to itself that things were not looking good.
It tried to escape, but what greeted him was a Sword Qi.
Boom!
Accompanied by an ear-shattering thunderous sound, the black snake had to quickly retreat, unable to withstand it.
In the next moment, the talisman array directly exploded.
Boom!
A massive sound erupted, endless thunderfire crashed onto the demon body, the black snake let out a miserable cry.
"Ah!"
Even though it had Divine Sense, this area was full of thunderfire, greatly slowing the injured body.
There was nowhere to hide.
The demon body was torn by the thunderfire, blood dripping, scales from neck to back were ripped apart and scorched, the black snake screamed as it was blown away.
Clearly, it was seriously injured.
A great opportunity!!
Xu Ping naturally wouldn’t miss such a good opportunity, his body suddenly shimmered, transforming into a breeze, disappearing into thin air.
Boom!
A Sword Qi exploded from the void, accompanied by thunder sound, slashing straight at the black snake.
"Die!"
Though the black snake was injured, its Divine Sense remained intact, a Spiritual Sense Attack instantly descended on Xu Ping’s Sea of Consciousness.
Bang!
Intense pain spread through the Sea of Consciousness, as if a nail was fiercely driven into his brain, causing Xu Ping’s vision to black out.
Yet, the silently operating Taihang Nourishing God Skill maintained his barely conscious state.
"Slash!"
Blood continued to flow from his nose and the corners of his mouth, but he still slashed with ferocity.
Boom!
Sword Qi was like a rainbow, striking the black snake with unparalleled sharpness, slicing through it like a blade through tender tofu, completely severing its tail effortlessly.
"Ah!"
The black snake’s wretched screams echoed through the valley.
Yet Xu Ping’s attack hadn’t ended, his figure flickered, disappearing from his original spot and reappearing near the black snake’s demon body.
His wrist trembled, the sword light interwoven, forming a radiant sword net in the air, as if an invisible cage enveloped the snake.
Clang clang clang...
Countless Sword Marks appeared on the black snake, blood gushing out, utterly wretched.
It endured the intense pain, fierce light gleaming in its eyes, its Divine Sense erupted, sweeping all directions.
Xu Ping’s sword movement stalled.
But this time the Spiritual Sense Attack was considerably weakened compared to before, causing Xu Ping little harm.
After all, continually using Spiritual Sense Attacks was also a significant drain on the black snake.
And the black snake took advantage of the moment Xu Ping’s body seized to shed its skin again.
In a cracking sound, its body exploded open, a smaller, intact black snake emerged.
However, although its body was healed, its aura was notably diminished, clearly indicating a cost to this process.
Whoosh!
The black snake’s figure flickered, vanishing from its original position.
"I’ll see how many times you can shed your skin!"
Xu Ping gritted his teeth, for the first time in battle, fully unleashing his speed, disappearing into the void immediately.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Both figure and snake vanished, yet booming sounds continued to resound from the void.
"This speed!"
Everyone in the valley was astonished, unable to see how they fought!
If they ventured, they feared being annihilated without trace instantly.
Boom!
Thunder sound rolled, Sword Qi exploded, and a black shadow clashed into a wall.
The crowd gathered their focus, it was the black snake, blood dripping, its demon body’s scales nearly shattered, pitiful beyond compare.
"I will see you dead!" It hissed venomously, fire of endless rage flickering in its eyes.
At this moment, Xu Ping’s figure was revealed, he breathed heavily, large beads of sweat dripping, his face pale.
He remained silent, only staring intently at the black snake.
He wasn’t intending to prolong the fight any further, the speed that exceeded his limits brought terrifying pressure on his body, he couldn’t hold on much longer, and his mana was considerably depleted.
Xu Ping unleashed Sword Qi Thunder Sound with all his might, a terrifying suction emanated from the Blood-Drinking Sword, drawing out the mana from his Dantian in torrents.
Fortunately, he had broken through to the sixth level of Qi Cultivation, making his mana more robust; otherwise, he would certainly be drained dry.
"Die!"
Xu Ping slashed out, an awe-inspiring Sword Qi swept through the sky, like world-ending thunder crashing.
A formidable force accompanied the sword, pinning down the black snake.
"No!"
"How can a Qi Cultivator comprehend Sword Qi Thunder Sound so deeply!!"
The black snake roared, seemingly sensing the impending doom, its scales erupted with a dark gleam, as if an indestructible black armor enveloping it.The most update n0vels are published on Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Time suddenly froze!
In the next breath, the awe-inspiring Sword Qi pierced down from above, through the black snake’s head and torso, slicing its demon body into segments.
Afterward, the Sword Qi continued its momentum, penetrating the soil and delving underground!
The ground trembled violently, as if the entire valley quaked in response to the battle.
"Insignificant Sword Cultivator...Insignificant Sword Cultivator..."
The voice, unwillingly, pierced with grief mixed with resentment.
"Insignificant Sword Cultivator!"
Thud.
The remaining snake head of the black snake fell to the ground, light fading from its vertical pupils, dying with eyes open.
The battlefield turned silent.
Everyone in the valley stared wide-eyed at this scene.
That exceedingly brilliant Sword Qi was etched deeply in their minds, likely unforgotten for a long time to come.
The shock within everyone’s hearts at this moment was truly beyond words.
Sword Cultivator!
Absolute Sword Cultivator!

chapters.title: Chapter 62: Finale
chapters.content:
Chapter 62: Chapter 62: Finale
"Ancestor!" Ma Hui and Gao Jun were filled with terror. The ancestor, who was like a god in their hearts, died just like that!
Run!
Run quickly!!
This was the only thought left in their minds now.
However, Xu Ping naturally wouldn’t give them this chance; he understood the principle of cutting weeds and eliminating the roots.
Xu Ping’s figure flashed, hurtling towards the two men.
The two were already scared out of their wits by Xu Ping, unable to muster any courage to fight back.
But stimulated by the fear of death, they certainly wouldn’t just wait to die.
Ma Hui manipulated a humanoid monster to charge at Xu Ping, and dense golden arrows from the sky shot down explosively.
Xu Ping’s eyes narrowed, his speed skyrocketed again, easily dodging the rain of arrows, and then a wave of sword qi shattered the humanoid monster.
With no more obstacles in front, he caught up to the two in an instant.
"Die!"
In the two men’s terrified eyes, Xu Ping granted them each a sword strike.
Poof!
Blood sprayed out as their heads flew high into the air before crashing to the ground.
With no one to control them after, the golden arrows in the sky slowly disappeared, and the humanoid monster, which had reformed its shape, stood there dumbfounded and motionless.
"Whew!"
Xu Ping slowly exhaled a mouthful of turbid air: "It’s finally over."
At this moment, the people who survived in the valley were stunned for a moment. After coming to their senses, the overwhelming joy nearly filled their entire chests: "We survived, we survived!!"
Today had been too thrilling for them, with heaven and hell just a thought apart, repeating several times, nearly causing their hearts to give out.
But fortunately, it was all over. They finally survived.
"White Daoyou’s divine power killed the black snake, saving my life. Truly grateful!" At this moment, Zhang Changqing came over and cupped his hands in thanks.
His face was still pale, but his breathing had stabilized.
"Why say such things, Daoist Zhang? If not for Daoist Zhang weakening the black snake, I fear I would be in trouble." Xu Ping waved his hand.
"I only made a trivial contribution..."
Ye Qing, standing to the side with a pale face, had bright eyes, staring fixedly at the two of them.
White Daoyou, the peerless Sword Cultivator, and Zhang Daoyou, with the special Spirit Body.
Mmm, mmm, mmm!!!
...
After tidying up the aftermath.
The Demon Suppression Team left the valley. The team, originally close to a hundred strong, now had only thirty-something people left, with heavy casualties.
And Xu Ping and Zhang Changqing lagged at the end of the group.
"The reputation of the peerless Sword Cultivator, White Daoyou, will likely spread throughout the entire market." Zhang Changqing sighed.
"I’d rather not have such a reputation!" Xu Ping said with a wry smile.
Zhang Changqing naturally understood what the other party was worried about. With the reputation of a peerless Sword Cultivator spreading, forget about the Golden Core Sect, even the Nascent Soul Sect would be shaken.
If he were lucky and got taken in by a Nascent Soul Sect, then his path to immortality would be assured; if unlucky, the end could be quite tragic.
"Daoist friend need not worry. The market’s information is sealed right now, so it cannot spread, and with the strength of the daoist friend, there’s simply no opponent in the entire market." Zhang Changqing comforted.
"Perhaps." Xu Ping sighed in his heart.
Actually, to prevent the news from spreading, there was another way: kill everyone here.
Xu Ping believed that although he was not a good person, he really couldn’t do such a thing of wanton slaughter of innocents.
"Daoist Zhang, do you know when the people from your sect will come?" Xu Ping asked.
Zhang Changqing hesitated for a while, but decided to speak the truth: "I don’t know either. There’s been no message from the sect. I do have a long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman, but it’s one-way and can only passively receive messages."
"If there is any news from the sect, I will definitely tell White Daoyou first." Zhang Changqing said firmly.
Xu Ping gave Zhang Changqing a deep look, then cupped his hands in thanks: "Thank you, Daoist Zhang."
What Zhang Changqing said was certain, but it was only his side of the story, so he couldn’t completely believe it.
"Perhaps I should leave this market." Xu Ping sighed inwardly.
With his current strength, as long as he didn’t court death, or if his luck wasn’t astronomically bad, crossing three thousand miles to leave shouldn’t be a big problem.
"By the way, Daoist Zhang, what did that black snake say about your blood talisman spirit body? Is it a special kind of spirit body?" Xu Ping suddenly recalled what the black snake said.
"Yes, it’s a special Spirit Body." Zhang Changqing nodded, not hiding it at all.
"The blood talisman spirit body is a talisman Dao constitution, naturally in tune with the great way of talismans, allowing cultivators to make rapid progress on the path of talismans. Their essence blood can even augment talismans, making them more powerful, and can also forcibly control talismans with their essence blood."
"Talisman Dao constitution?" Xu Ping was a bit shocked. To think there’s a spirit body particularly suited for the Dao of talismans?
It’s simply incredible.
However, in the Cultivation Realm, there are countless miraculous skills and secret techniques, so having a blood talisman spirit body is normal.
Very soon, he thought back to the previous battles where Zhang Changqing pulled out various talismans: ’So... those were all drawn by him, able to create even second-stage talismans beyond rank, this blood talisman spirit body is truly terrifying!’
If someone with talent for first rank talismans could draw talismans beyond their small rank, the second-stage talismans are completely beyond what a Qi Cultivator can create.
"The blood talisman spirit body is a latent constitution, not evident usually, but it mainly requires postnatal activation to unlock."
"I’ve only recently awakened it and haven’t had the chance to report it to the sect. Otherwise, the sect wouldn’t have abandoned me here, indifferent, though I can’t compare to White Daoyou, I might barely qualify as a genius." Zhang Changqing jokingly remarked about himself.
"Daoist Zhang is joking. With your talent, you’re quite the genius among geniuses." Xu Ping complimented.
The two chatted casually along the way, separating only when nearing the market.
...
...
The first ray of dawn light gently filtered through the light morning mist, softly illuminating the tranquil phoenix trees.
Returning to his original appearance, Xu Ping went back home.New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
He picked up the teapot and took a large gulp. Under the stimulus of cold water, he felt a faint pain in his chest.
Though he was injured in the battle with the black snake just now, it wasn’t severe. Given his physique, he’d recover in a few days.
"Whew!"
Xu Ping put down the teapot and let out a long sigh, "From now on, if something can be solved by spending Spirit Stones, then do so."
Recently, his strength had grown too quickly, and he noticed he was getting a bit overconfident.
Taking on the previous demon eradication mission was something he wouldn’t have even dared to imagine before.
And now, for a thousand and one hundred Spirit Stones, he nearly lost his life.
Still not steady enough!
Now, thinking about that black snake, Xu Ping felt a chill down his spine.
Divine Sense, shedding skins, various arrays.
He felt that even ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivators weren’t this exaggerated.
If not for his Taihang Nourishing God Skill breaking through to Minor Achievement, he felt he would have lost combat ability from the first wave of divine sense attacks.
"The effect of the Taihang Nourishing God Skill is better than I thought. It can even resist divine sense attacks, looks like I need to spend more time on it!"
"Striving to break through to Perfection as soon as possible should bring unexpected changes!"

chapters.title: Chapter 63: Demonic Artifacts
chapters.content:
Chapter 63: Chapter 63: Demonic Artifacts
Crash.
After calming his mind, Xu Ping emptied a pile of things from his storage bag in front of him.
Eight storage bags.
One storage ring.
These were all spoils of war he had collected from the group of Black Snake.
Zhang Changqing didn’t want them; he gave them to him directly.
His gaze swept over the nine storage items, and he eventually picked up the storage ring and put it on his hand.
It fits perfectly.
It’s a pity that it can’t be worn outside.
Storage rings are generally used by Foundation Establishment Cultivators.
Qi Cultivators generally use storage bags, though some wealthy or well-connected Qi Cultivators might use storage rings as well.
Wearing a storage ring outside is akin to blatantly displaying the words "I’m rich, come rob me" on your forehead.
Though with his strength, no one in the market would dare to rob him, it really wasn’t necessary.
Plus, these storage rings are mostly sealed with Divine Sense.
Xu Ping glanced at it, and it was indeed the case.
Fortunately, Zhang Changqing specifically gave him a "Breaking God Talisman."
This talisman is specifically designed for Qi Cultivators to break the seals on Foundation Establishment Cultivators’ storage bags.
It’s hard to say what the creator of this talisman was thinking.
Xu Ping was filled with curiosity about the storage ring and took out the "Breaking God Talisman," gently placing it on the ring.
Buzz—
A faint buzzing sound rang out, and the Divine Sense seal was instantly broken.
Xu Ping grabbed the storage ring.
The space inside the ring was ten zhang in size, much larger than a normal storage bag.
Just this storage ring alone was worth at least several hundred Spirit Stones.
Though the space was large, there weren’t many things inside.
Scrolls, over ten jade slips, a red broken knife, and two jade boxes.
"Pfft..."
When Xu Ping accidentally touched the red broken knife, his whole head went boom, and a surge of murderous intent flooded his mind.
His eyes turned instantly red.
Kill! Kill! Kill!
This was the only thought left in his mind.
He almost rushed out of his home, ready to slaughter all life in front of him.
Buzz!
The Taihang Nourishing God Skill began to operate autonomously, and a wave of cool energy instantly poured into his mind.
The rampant murderous intent in his mind vanished instantly, as if doused by a cold basin of water.
"Huff, huff, huff..."
Xu Ping gasped for breath and tossed away the red broken knife like it was trash.
"A Demon Cultivator’s Magical Artifact... A magic artifact!"
His face showed horror; this red broken knife was truly terrifying!
If it weren’t for the Taihang Nourishing God Skill’s autonomous operation, he would have become a beast only capable of slaughter!
He took a few deep breaths, calming down his mood and sorting his thoughts.
Golden Core Cultivators use magic artifacts; Qi Cultivators and Foundation Establishment Cultivators use magical artifacts.
No wonder a single Black Snake had such impressive eyesight, possessing not only Divine Sense but also Spiritual Sense Attack.
It must be a Golden Core Demon Cultivator that seized and possessed the snake, though there’s also the possibility of a Foundation Establishment Demon Cultivator.
Seizing and possessing in the Cultivation Realm is widely known but comes with significant restrictions.
First, a cultivator cannot seize and possess a mortal, or the body being possessed will self-destruct as it cannot withstand the process.
Second, one must have at least Foundation Establishment cultivation because only Foundation Establishment Cultivators awaken Divine Sense and possess the conditions for rebirth through possession.
Third, one can only seize and possess downward in cultivation level; otherwise, they risk backlash. The larger the gap in mana, the safer it is.
Fourth, a person can only seize and possess once in their lifetime.
"It seems that Black Snake was at least a Foundation Establishment Demon Cultivator; no wonder he was so formidable," Xu Ping thought.
However, he was more inclined to believe it was a Golden Core Demon Cultivator since ordinary Foundation Establishment Demon Cultivators aren’t this powerful after rebirth through possession.
He glanced again at the red broken knife with lingering fear in his heart.
This Demon Cultivator’s magical artifact was truly terrifying.
He definitely wouldn’t touch it again anytime soon.
Xu Ping carefully used his mana to store the red broken knife in the storage ring.
After successfully storing it, his gaze heatedly turned toward those scrolls and jade slips.
The belongings left behind by a Foundation Establishment Demon Cultivator or even a Golden Core Demon Cultivator were certainly extraordinary.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
Twelve scrolls and jade slips in total were laid before him, covering cultivation techniques, magic, and methods for magic artifact refinement.
However, these were all demonic in nature, whether cultivation techniques or artifact refinement—all extremely cruel.
For example, a magical artifact called "Mother and Child Fan."
A magical artifact like the "Mother and Child Fan" required at least a thousand pregnant women—the more, the better and the higher the cultivation, the better—to have their bellies cut open and their fetuses extracted, refining the mother and child flesh and blood to refine the artifact.
Another example was a cultivation technique called "Five Viscera Refining True Demon Skill."
To practice this demonic skill, one needs to refine the five viscera and six bowels of cultivators to temper their own five viscera; only then can they advance to Foundation Establishment.
Once reaching Foundation Establishment Stage, the cultivator’s five viscera become auxiliary ingredients, still requiring the consumption of five types of Spiritual Objects to continue tempering the five viscera.
Though cruel, it’s a cultivation technique that leads straight to Nascent Soul.
"It seems that Black Snake was practicing this technique, but a snake can also cultivate demonic skills?" Xu Ping wondered.
But he was destined not to get an answer since Black Snake was dead, and it seemed unlikely he’d encounter another cultivator possessing a snake in this lifetime.
He picked up the jade slip recording "Five Viscera Refining True Demon Skill," sighing silently: "A Nascent Soul cultivation technique!"
Honestly, a technique that could take him straight to Nascent Soul had been placed in front of him, and it was impossible not to be tempted. Yet the cruel cultivation was too much for his conscience, so he inevitably had to give it up.
Of course, there were techniques that weren’t cruel and bloody, like one called "Demon Flame Skill."
This Demon Flame required the blood and flesh of living creatures as fuel; the more fuel, the stronger the Demon Flame.
The Demon Flame’s cultivation requirements weren’t too high; a Late-Stage Qi Cultivation level was enough to practice it.
"This Demon Flame is worth trying." Xu Ping put down the jade slip of "Five Viscera Refining True Demon Skill" and picked up the scroll of "Demon Flame Skill."
According to its introduction, when cultivated to later stages, this Demon Flame could threaten even Golden Core Cultivators.
It’s considered a very powerful magic.
Also, living creatures didn’t necessarily have to be humans; he could use the blood and flesh of Demon Beasts to refine it.
Xu Ping carefully collected all the jade slips and scrolls; of the recorded magic and cultivation techniques, none aside from "Demon Flame Skill" suited him well.
But he could find an opportunity to sell them.
Xu Ping turned his attention to the last two jade boxes.
Hopefully, they’ll hold something valuable.
Xu Ping opened one of the jade boxes to find a scroll inside. Upon closer inspection, it contained a secret technique for Divine Sense, the "Shocking God Needle."
"There’s truly something valuable here!" His eyes lit up, and he couldn’t help but think of Black Snake’s Spiritual Sense Attack, which probably used this secret technique.
Divine Sense type secret techniques are extremely rare, difficult for even ordinary Foundation Establishment Cultivators to possess.
"Unfortunately, I don’t have Divine Sense right now, nor can I cultivate it; otherwise, it would have made for a great addition to my arsenal."
Xu Ping felt a bit regretful, and then he turned his gaze to the last jade box.

chapters.title: Chapter 64: Complete Array Manual
chapters.content:
Chapter 64: Chapter 64: Complete Array Manual
"Finally, it’s this one."
Xu Ping opened the last jade box, inside which lay a jade slip.
This jade slip was not only much thicker than the others, but its texture was also quite different, resembling mortal mutton-fat white jade, warm and glossy, with threads of gold inside.
At a glance, it was clearly a high-grade jade slip.
As Xu Ping’s spiritual sense entered it, countless dense pieces of information instantly appeared, with the most eye-catching being a line of golden text—"Complete Array Guide!"
This was actually an inheritance of arrays ranging from first to second-stage!
The value of arrays needs no elaboration, as they have always been ranked first since ancient times.
If learned, the boost to one’s immortal path in the future would be unimaginable!
"I didn’t expect such a big surprise at the end!" Xu Ping’s face showed excitement.
He quickly browsed through it; this array inheritance covered everything from the most basic entry-level arrays to the most powerful second-stage upper-grade arrays, perfect for beginners to learn.
If this array inheritance were to be sold, it would cost at least a few thousand spirit stones!
What a huge profit!
Xu Ping took a few deep breaths, trying to suppress his excitement as he carefully browsed the array inheritance.
However, the first line of the entry-level array suddenly left him a bit stunned:
"Arrays harness the changes of heaven and earth, it’s best for cultivators to study them with divine sense, achieving twice the result with half the effort..."
Damn it, divine sense is needed!
Xu Ping finally understood why Array Masters have always topped the chart in terms of value since ancient times.
Other Pill Masters and Artifact Refiners can at least start exploring during the Qi Refinement Stage, whereas Array Masters are best suited to entry during the Foundation Establishment Stage!
Yet, if one possesses divine sense, it significantly enhances all aspects of immortal cultivation and combat.
Continuing on.
The materials and spirit stones required later on were manageable; the key to truly becoming an Array Master lay in one’s aptitude, particularly one’s comprehension of arrays!
After carefully reading through once, Xu Ping solemnly stored the array inheritance safely: "Now is not the time to study arrays; it’s better to wait until I’m in my best condition to research them!"
Although the study of arrays is challenging, with a proficient panel, he still had a chance.
Storing the array inheritance, he then turned his gaze to the last eight storage bags.
He carefully counted them.
One thousand two hundred spirit stones.
Eleven lower-grade magical artifacts, six mid-grade magical artifacts.
Twelve first rank upper-grade talismans and thirty-four first rank middle-grade talismans.
Various pills, minerals, herbs, array materials...
After counting so many things, Xu Ping let out a long breath.
What a staggering windfall!
Xu Ping felt it was somewhat unreal.
One could only exclaim, this old demon cultivator was truly rich!
After categorizing and storing everything, a wave of fatigue washed over Xu Ping who had relaxed.
Today’s fierce battle was truly exhausting.
He used a Cleaning Talisman to clean his body thoroughly, then fell into a deep sleep on the bed.
...
...
During Xu Ping’s sleep.
The demon cultivator incident completely exploded throughout the market.
The casualties were too severe; the Demon Suppression Team lost as much as two-thirds.
To join the Demon Suppression Team, one must have at least mid-Qi Refinement cultivation.
This horrifying level of damage was enough to cripple the four major forces, not to mention, two of the four leaders were killed.
Of course, what was even more striking was Xu Ping, who, in the Qi Refining Realm, comprehended the Sword Qi Thunder Sound, becoming a peerless Sword Cultivator.
"A peerless Sword Cultivator!"
Countless people sighed, if one’s achievements were slightly better, others might be jealous, but when surpassed by so much, all that’s left is admiration!
Among the many loose cultivators in the market, the happiest was Yuan Wei.
"My master is a peerless Sword Cultivator!!" He was so excited he almost jumped up.
In the past, he just wanted to cling to a big thigh, but unexpectedly, this thigh was shockingly thick!
Just as Yuan Wei was reveling in his joy, there was a polite knock at the door.
"Yuan Wei, are you home?"
Opening the door, he saw it was Gang Leader Xue Hu from the World Alliance.
Xue Hu was a cultivator at the eighth layer of Qi Refinement, and the World Alliance he led was considered second only to the four major factions.
"Gang Leader Xue, what brings you to me?" Yuan Wei instinctively felt a little nervous.
"Brother Yuan Wei, you’re being too distant." Xue Hu smiled warmly, "I’m a few years older than you, just call me Brother Xue."
"Brother... Brother Xue?" Yuan Wei’s mind was a bit muddled.
"Hahaha, since you call me Brother, I should give you something in return." Xue Hu laughed heartily and took out several bottles of pills from his storage bag, placing them in front of Yuan Wei, "These are Spirit Gathering Pills, perfect for you."
"Ah?" Yuan Wei was even more bewildered.
What was going on with this sudden camaraderie and offering of gifts!
"Brother Yuan Wei, don’t be polite with me!" Xue Hu pressed the pills into his arms.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Helplessly, Yuan Wei accepted, "Thank you, Gang Leader... Brother."
"Hahaha, there’s no need to thank me between brothers!" Xue Hu beamed.
The two chatted leisurely for a while.
Yuan Wei’s mind was still foggy until Xue Hu was about to bid farewell, and he finally snapped out of it, "Ah... I’ll see Brother Xue out!"
Watching Xue Hu’s gradually retreating figure, a cold breeze cleared Yuan Wei’s mind, and his thoughts became clearer.
Xue Hu coming to him and acting so friendly, even giving him such valuable pills, he finally understood his intentions.
Xue Hu wanted to get close to his master but didn’t have a way, so he came to him.
Recalling Xue Hu’s enthusiastic and even somewhat flattering smile, for some reason, he suddenly wanted to laugh out loud.
To have someone so powerful and influential treating him with such warmth, even flattery, his sense of vanity was about to explode!
Yuan Wei stood at the door, receiving warm greetings from the neighbors passing by.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, come have a drink at my place."
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, I’ve stewed some demon beast flesh today, want to come over for dinner?"
"Fellow Daoist Yuan..."
...
...
"Bang bang bang..."
"Open up!"
"Fellow Daoist Xu, open up!"
A rapid knocking pulled Xu Ping from his slumber. He got up and opened the door to see Zhang Chenyu standing there anxiously.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, do you know what happened last night?"
"Last night’s event?"
Xu Ping paused, then realized, "You mean the demon suppression incident?"
"Exactly!" Zhang Chenyu said eagerly, "The Ling Tiger Gang is almost wasted, their leader Gao Jun actually defected to the demon cultivators, leading to severe casualties among their elite members."
"That’s not really related to you, is it?"
"How is it not? I’m also a member of the Ling Tiger Gang! Once it’s wasted, other gangs will likely come fighting for territory, making life unsettled again."
"That wouldn’t affect you; you’ve already reached the seventh layer of Qi Refinement and you’re a Talisman Master, regardless of which gang comes, they’ll surely treat you with courtesy."
Zhang Chenyu paused, realizing, and then slapped his thigh: "He’s right; as a seventh-layer Qi Refinement cultivator, I’m quite a prominent figure in the market. What am I afraid of!"

chapters.title: Chapter 65: Studying Arrays
chapters.content:
Chapter 65: Chapter 65: Studying Arrays
Xu Ping was speechless.
No, you really need me to remind you of your own abilities!
After completely setting his mind at ease, Zhang Chenyu brought up that Sword Cultivator: "I wonder what kind of extraordinary person that peerless Sword Cultivator is!"
"According to those who survived the Demon Suppression Team, the final sword that defeated the Demon Cultivator was truly dazzling. It’s a shame I couldn’t witness it myself."
’No need to regret, I’ll show you a sword strike myself.’ Xu Ping thought to himself silently.
...
After sending Zhang Chenyu off, Xu Ping closed the door and took out the ’Complete Understanding of Arrays,’ eagerly beginning to study.
After sleeping, his spirit was fully restored. As for the injuries on his body, given his physique, he didn’t need to worry at all.
Yesterday, he only skimmed the ’Complete Understanding of Arrays’; today, upon closer examination, he realized its difficulty.
"The composition of an array includes several important parts: Array Source, Array Patterns, Array Hub..."
The Array Source is the source of power for the array. Some legendary Array Masters can even use the heavens and stars as arrays, possessing power that can destroy the world.
Of course, today’s cultivators mostly use Spirit Veins, Spirit Stones, or other items as the Array Source.
The Array Source is simple, what comes next is the difficulty.
Array Patterns!
This is where countless Array Masters pour their hearts and souls!
Comprehending Array Patterns mainly depends on one’s perception!
Different arrays require different patterns, which when combined create the array. This can be said to be the most fundamental part, and if there’s a conflict in the patterns, the array absolutely cannot succeed!
And the lines of the array look like ancient text yet also resemble simplistic paintings, containing endless mysteries.
When drawing array patterns, you need to communicate with the mysteries of Dao.
No wonder it’s best to have Divine Sense to study arrays.
Divine Sense can extend outward, allowing better communication with the mysteries of Dao.
Xu Ping took a look at the Entry Level array patterns, and the dense symbols instantly made him feel somewhat dizzy.
What are these ridiculous scribbles?!
"Hoo!"
Xu Ping took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down: "Don’t worry, it might just look difficult!"
Before studying arrays, he specifically ran through the Taihang Nourishing God Skill once.
After making himself utterly indifferent, he began to sink his heart into research.
This research lasted five days.
...
...
Five days later.
Xu Ping sat at the table, eyes dull, looking at the scattered white paper in front of him, all covered with dense scribbles
"It’s too difficult, truly too hard!"
It’s been five days, and he hasn’t managed to draw a single array pattern.
Although array patterns look quite hard, they are indeed quite hard.
To know that nine array patterns can form a First Rank Lower Grade array, yet he couldn’t even draw the simplest first pattern.
Up until now, there has been no progress at all; who knows when he will learn arrays!
When he drew array patterns, his hands told him he could do it; his mind told him no, he couldn’t.
There’s always a vague feeling as if some sort of force is disrupting him.
"Try drawing once more, I refuse to believe it!" Xu Ping reinvigorated himself. If he succeeds once, he can rely on the proficiency board and grind slowly.
Another two days passed.
Xu Ping tightly gripped the brush, looking haggard like a venerable scholar diligently studying ancient texts, bloodshot eyes becoming visible:
"Damn... damn it!"
"Hmm... array symbol brushes are too expensive!"
Snap!
He kicked the wooden table, smashing it to pieces, and as if still feeling unsatisfied, he stomped on it forcefully.
After venting, Xu Ping’s mood finally improved somewhat.
The Entry Level first pattern is considered the simplest among the patterns. Those with talent can draw it in an hour, average talent in a day or two, weak talent might need five days."
Yet he still hasn’t drawn it after more than seven days...
Even with the proficiency board, learning arrays may drag on for a long time.
"Forget it, no more grind, practice Nourishing Life Skill." Xu Ping gave up.
After the Taihang Nourishing God Skill breaks through to Perfection, he’ll see if he can awaken Divine Sense.
"Nourishing Life Skill is also close to breakthrough!"
He opened the proficiency board, his gaze falling on the realm tier.
[Nourishing Life Skill Level Two: 96/100]
...
Four days later.
In a wooden barrel, Xu Ping closed his eyes, continuously operating the second level of Nourishing Life Skill.
With the absorption of medicine power, his entire skeletal structure began to feel tingly and numb.
It seemed as if countless ants were crawling, gnawing over his bones...
Soon, this sensation transformed into a burning heat...
Such alternation continued, Xu Ping could feel his muscles and bones tearing and quickly regenerating, becoming tougher and more resilient...
After several rounds of cycles, everything gradually settled.
Xu Ping opened his eyes, exhaling a long breath.
This long breath shot out like an arrow, extending out to nearly a yard, before slowly dissipating.
"Finally level three!"
Seeing the twenty years of lifespan increase on the proficiency board, Xu Ping couldn’t help but smile wide.
No one would wish their lifespan to be shorter.
His current lifespan is now one hundred forty-three years; once he breaks through to Qi Cultivation level nine, his lifespan will definitely exceed one hundred fifty.
"With my current physique, my speed should be reaching new heights." Xu Ping murmured.
...
...
In a secluded forest, Xu Ping’s figure flashed, disappearing suddenly from his spot.
The next moment, he appeared five or six yards away.
Now, whenever he wills it, he can instantly leap to any spot within several yards, even a distance of ten yards only requires the span of a breath to cover.
"Speed has increased by approximately ten percent, while my physique feels no pressure, let’s see the full burst."
Xu Ping began moving slowly at first, then faster and faster in the small open space, until multiple identical afterimages appeared simultaneously, performing the same actions, sharing the same smile.
But when all the afterimages gradually converged to the center, they merged back into Xu Ping standing alone in the middle.
"Still no pressure!" Xu Ping smiled.
After level three of Nourishing Life Skill, the enhancement to physique is tremendous. Now, he might even handle Lower Grade Magical Artifacts barehanded.
"But if I have to deal with Foundation Establishment Cultivators, my speed still isn’t fast enough."
"Foundation Establishment Cultivators can exert Divine Sense outside the body, probing areas tens of yards, even over a hundred yards wide. To prevent them from reacting, I need to be faster!"
"I wonder if breakthrough to Perfection in Light Body Technique will bring changes to speed, and by how much. Xu Ping is quite eager.
...
...
Three days later.
At Yuan Wei’s house.
"Master Zhang Changqing would like to see you." Yuan Wei said with a flattering smile.
These days, he was having a good time; everyone treated him with utmost respect.
He clearly knew who brought all this to him, so he had to hold onto this opportunity.
"When?" Xu Ping asked.
"Anytime is fine." Yuan Wei replied.
"Alright, I’ll go now." Xu Ping nodded.
"Also, there’s something else, you don’t need to help me sell items anymore."
"Ah!" Yuan Wei exclaimed in shock.
"Master, did I do something wrong?" He asked fearfully.
"No, there’s no items to sell anymore, that’s all." Xu Ping turned and walked away.
Yuan Wei opened his mouth, but said nothing, his eyes blankly staring at Xu Ping’s gradually receding figure.

chapters.title: Chapter 66: Map of Yue Country
chapters.content:
Chapter 66: Chapter 66: Map of Yue Country
Zhang Changqing’s home is still so clean and tidy.
"I wonder what Zhang Daoist is seeking me for?" Xu Ping asked directly.
The two were quite familiar with each other, so there was no need to beat around the bush.
"The sect has news."
Zhang Changqing started right away with a bombshell, leaving Xu Ping momentarily stunned: "News?"
Zhang Changqing held a significant position in the Longevity Sect; his grandfather was a Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
"Yes." Zhang Changqing nodded.
"Recently, a Foundation Establishment master in the sect has broken through to the Golden Core, so the sect was sealed off, and no messages came through."
"Now, the Foundation Establishment master has successfully broken through to Golden Core!"
At this, a smile naturally appeared on Zhang Changqing’s face.
As a member of the Longevity Sect, its strengthening filled him with genuine joy.
"So how does your sect plan to handle Dongwu Market?"
Xu Ping wasn’t concerned about who had broken through to Golden Core; he was more interested in what the Longevity Sect would do about Dongwu Market.
"Plan to rebuild."
Zhang Changqing paused for a moment, organizing his words, "The sect will dispatch two Foundation Establishment cultivators and a group of Qi cultivators to rebuild Dongwu Market."
"Rebuild, huh?" Xu Ping murmured to himself, a neutral expression on his face as he calmly inquired, "When will your sect members arrive?"
"The personnel are confirmed and will depart tomorrow, arriving in about ten days," Zhang Changqing replied.
After a brief silence, Xu Ping clasped his hands in thanks: "Thank you, Daoist Zhang, for informing me in advance."
That Zhang Changqing would inform him early on this matter made him a person worth befriending.
"It’s a small matter." Zhang Changqing waved his hand dismissively.
"I have another matter to inquire about, Daoist Zhang."
"Feel free to ask."
"I’m not familiar with the nearby geography, and I wonder if Daoist Zhang could enlighten me?" Xu Ping asked.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
"This is a simple matter."
Zhang Changqing took a scroll from his storage pouch and spread it on the table; it depicted mountains and rivers—a map!
For people of ancient times, maps were precious items.
Even for cultivators, they were invaluable.
"This is a map of the entire Yue Country."
"Daoist, please look, Dongwu Market is located here!"
Zhang Changqing pointed to a very small place on the map.
Xu Ping looked carefully and finally found Dongwu Market, standing in isolation near the wilds on the edge of ’Yue Country.’
Then Zhang Changqing began to describe the geography of the entire cultivation region.
This cultivation boundary is called "Nanchuan."
The area is vast, with over a hundred countries, ’Yue Country’ being one of them.
Each country varies in strength, with the Core Formation Stage as the ceiling for smaller countries.
Medium to large countries have Fourth-stage spirit veins suitable for Nascent Soul stage cultivation.
The ’Yue Country’ he was in could only be considered a medium-sized country, with the strongest force called the "Luoyun Sect," having a Nascent Soul True Monarch presiding as the ruler of this area.
Under the Luoyun Sect are five major sects, each with at least one Core Formation Stage Zhenren.
The Longevity Sect is one of them.
Following closely behind are eight great cultivation families, known as the strongest in ’Yue Country.’
Each of the eight families has a long lineage, with at least a Fake Pill Zhenren and multiple Foundation Establishment cultivators.
"Nascent Soul sects, Golden Core sects, Foundation Establishment families..."
Xu Ping thought about the structure of the ’Yue Country’ in his mind.
Truly, being a disciple from a sect, his knowledge was indeed abundant.
"Thank you for explaining, Daoist, otherwise I truly would know nothing about the nearby geography," Xu Ping sincerely thanked.
"Daoist Bai, no need to be so formal, these are simple matters to inquire about, and I’ll give this map to you as well," Zhang Changqing waved his hand.
"I couldn’t possibly accept."
"It’s not something valuable anyway."
"Then I won’t stand on ceremony."
Xu Ping actually really needed this map right now.
After chatting a bit more, Xu Ping prepared to take his leave: "If Daoist Zhang has no other matters, I’ll take my leave now."
"Daoist Bai, please stay." Zhang Changqing suddenly called out to Xu Ping.
Xu Ping turned in curiosity.
"This is a Bone Shaping Skill, capable of perfectly altering body shape and concealing one’s aura. Though body refining can change shape, it’s not perfect and still reveals clues."
Zhang Changqing took out a scroll from his bosom and handed it to Xu Ping, with a meaningful look.
Xu Ping gave Zhang Changqing a deep look after taking the scroll: "No words can express the great kindness."
"Daoist Bai is too kind."
Zhang Changqing apologized, "If it wasn’t for me inviting Daoist Bai to jointly subdue demons, Daoist Bai wouldn’t have exposed the Sword Qi Thunder Sound. I hope Daoist Bai doesn’t blame me."
"It’s all my choice, I can’t blame anyone else." Xu Ping shook his head.
"Farewell!" Xu Ping clasped his hands.
"Safe travels!" Zhang Changqing returned the courtesy.
...
...
Returning home.
Xu Ping silently took a sip of water, set down the teacup, and sighed quietly: "Ah, it’s time to leave."
Realizing the Sword Qi Thunder Sound at the Qi Refining Realm is indeed a big deal.
Big enough that not even a Golden Core sect like the Longevity Sect could contain it; perhaps only Yue Country’s overlord, the Luoyun Sect, could.
If fortunate enough to be taken in by the Luoyun Sect, it could mean a smooth path to immortality; if unlucky, death might even be a relief.
Although he used the identity of Bai Zhiyuan, even Zhang Changqing could spot clues, staying in this place is undoubtedly courting death.
Better to change identities and flee.
"But where to go?"
Xu Ping took out the map again and began studying.
He now needed to find a relatively stable and resource-rich place to slowly cultivate his Qi Refining to Perfection, then obtain a Foundation Establishment Pill and form his Foundation.
Xu Ping’s gaze moved upward, toward the north of Yue Country.
Qiu Xuan Immortal City.
Qiu Xuan Immortal City was established by Qiu Xuan Zhenren, the first loose cultivator in the Yue Country’s cultivation realm, neighboring the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range.
The Yellow Dragon Mountain Range is rich in demon beasts and spirit medicines, making it quite resourceful, and no major battles have occurred for decades, offering relative peace.
Also, several Second-stage Pill Masters are present in the city, with the capability of refining Foundation Establishment Pills.
It meets all his requirements.
However, the journey is quite far, several tens of thousands of miles from Dongwu Market.
"Tens of thousands of miles away?" Xu Ping pondered for a moment, but still decided to go to Qiu Xuan Immortal City.
With his current strength, such a journey is manageable.
"I’ll leave Dongwu Market tomorrow, but before that, I’ll first study the Bone Shaping Skill."
Xu Ping pulled out the scroll recording the Bone Shaping Skill and began his research.
The skill wasn’t difficult, by the end of the night he had already reached the Entry Level.
"Indeed much more natural than forcefully altering my body shape."
Looking at his reflection in the water, Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction.
"Time to sleep, I’ll leave early tomorrow morning." He stretched lazily and fell asleep.
...
The next day.
Xu Ping got up early, quietly leaving without saying goodbye to anyone.
He intended to bid farewell to Zhang Chenyu, but decided against it.
To avoid unnecessary trouble.
Also, with the people from the Longevity Sect about to arrive, he wouldn’t encounter danger.
May we meet again someday.

chapters.title: Chapter 67: The Longevity Sect Returns to the Marketplace
chapters.content:
Chapter 67: Chapter 67: The Longevity Sect Returns to the Marketplace
Just one day after Xu Ping left, a piece of news suddenly spread in the market.
The Longevity Sect was finally sending someone.
Countless people, upon hearing the news, were first stunned, then filled with joy.
This life of constant fear was finally coming to an end.
When the Longevity Sect was around, though it was like being beasts of burden, at least life was manageable.
Without the Longevity Sect, even being a beast of burden was impossible.
Zhang Chenyu, upon hearing the news, immediately went to find Xu Ping, but after calling for a long time, no one answered.
"Could he have gone out?"
"Never mind, he probably already knows this news. I’ll talk to him about leaving this damn place when he returns."
He had indeed had enough of this place and had long wanted to leave this damn place.
...
...
Time quietly passed amidst the anxious waiting of many.
Eight days later, in the morning.
A gigantic shadow suddenly enveloped Dongwu Market.
Countless people looked up.
They saw high in the sky, a menacing flying ship coming from the west, just blocking the sun.
This flying ship stretched a hundred zhang long, its entire body a light golden hue, with countless complex and mysterious runes inscribed on the surface.
On the prow, a golden banner fluttered fiercely in the wind!
"The Longevity Sect has arrived!!"
Countless people beamed with excitement and began to cheer.
...
"Grandson, you say you’ve awakened the blood rune spirit body?" An elder in a Daoist robe exclaimed excitedly.
"Yes, forefather, I just recently awakened it." Zhang Changqing nodded respectfully.
"Good, my good grandson, hahahaha..." The elder in the Daoist robe burst into laughter.
The blood rune spirit body was powerful even in the Qi Cultivation realm, but it would be even stronger in the Foundation Establishment realm.
After reaching Foundation Establishment, it could even draw third-level talismans, which were exceedingly rare throughout Yue Country.
As long as the sect wasn’t foolish, they would pile resources to make his grandson a Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
By then, his status would probably be second only to the two Golden Core patriarchs.
"I will personally take you back to the sect. You’ve endured hardship, but the sect will surely compensate you well," the elder in the Daoist robe said with a smile, "You’ll definitely get a share of the next batch of Foundation Establishment Pills."
Foundation Establishment Pills are extremely difficult to craft; even with the Longevity Sect’s resources, they can only refine them once every ten years, and the quantity is limited.
Countless sect disciples in the ninth layer of Qi Refining eagerly await the decadal opportunity for Foundation Establishment.
"I understand, forefather." Zhang Changqing also smiled.
Though he had anticipated it, he couldn’t help but be excited.
After all, it was a Foundation Establishment Pill!
"No, to avoid any long nights with dreams, I’ll take you away now." The elder in the Daoist robe hurriedly prepared to leave with Zhang Changqing.
"Forefather, wait a moment, I have important matters to report."
"What matters could be more important than my grandson? You can talk about it on the way," the elder said indifferently.
"It’s very important; among the loose cultivators in the market, there’s a fellow named Bai Zhiyuan, who despite only being in the Qi Cultivation realm, has already comprehended the Sword Qi Thunder Sound."
"What is so..."
The elder’s voice abruptly stopped, and he suddenly turned his head in shock, staring at Zhang Changqing, "You... you said someone in the Qi Cultivation realm has understood the Sword Qi Thunder Sound!?!"
"Yes."
With those words.
Bam!
With a loud noise, the door was violently pushed open, and a middle-aged man in a richly embroidered robe rushed in, shouting at Zhang Changqing’s grandfather Zhang Boxi:
"Old Zhang, something’s wrong! There’s a loose cultivator in the market who comprehended Sword Qi Thunder Sound while still in the Qi Cultivation realm!!"
His voice was as loud as a bell, causing people’s eardrums to throb in pain.
"I know." Zhang Boxi regained his composure, though a trace of shock lingered in his eyes.
"This matters so much we can’t handle it! We must inform the sect!" The middle-aged man shouted urgently, lacking any demeanor of a Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
"Informing the sect is a must, but since the news has already spread, we should seal the market first; no one is allowed to leave." Zhang Boxi calmly analyzed.
"Grandson, that friend Bai Zhiyuan of yours, are you familiar with him? Can you find him?" he turned and asked Zhang Changqing again.
"Not very familiar," Zhang Changqing admitted, nine parts truth and one part lie, about his dealings with Xu Ping.
After hearing, the two Foundation Establishment cultivators fell silent.
Especially when Zhang Changqing mentioned how he cut down a possessed black snake’s Foundation Establishment Demon Cultivator and even a Golden Core Demon Cultivator with one sword stroke, both were astounded beyond words.
To defy a Demon Cultivator with the sixth layer of Qi Cultivation, this is the Sword Qi Thunder Sound!!
"But, that friend Bai Zhiyuan most likely already left the market," Zhang Changqing suddenly added amidst their shock.
"Left?"
Hearing this, they were both startled and quickly asked, "What happened?"
"About half a month ago, that friend Bai asked me for a map of Yue Country and its surroundings. I didn’t dare refuse; after he took the map, he hasn’t been seen for half a month," Zhang Changqing said, half-true, half-false.
Hearing this, both furrowed their brows and fell silent.
If this world-class sword cultivator had left, it would be much more complicated to deal with.
The news might not stay contained.
"Alas, better notify the sect and let the two patriarchs decide," Zhang Boxi sighed.
"That’s all we can do," the middle-aged man nodded.
...
Two hours later.
A message from the sect arrived.
"What do the patriarchs say?" the middle-aged man asked anxiously.
Without speaking, Zhang Boxi handed him the Thousand-Mile Sound Transmission Talisman.
The middle-aged man penetrated it with his Divine Sense and read through in a moment’s time.
"What does the patriarch mean by sealing the market and searching thoroughly, I can understand, but why announce the news if we don’t find him in a month?" the man frowned.
Zhang Boxi didn’t answer, instead, he asked, "Do you think, after we find that sword cultivator, our sect can keep him?"
"What’s so hard about it? Just kill everyone who knows," the middle-aged man blurted out.
"Kill them?"
Zhang Boxi shook his head helplessly, "Not to mention the nearly ten thousand loose cultivators in the market; we have quite a number of disciples in our sect who know, too! Kill them all?"
"We can implant restrictions in the Sea of Consciousness of the sect disciples," the man pondered and suggested.
"What if the news still gets out?" Zhang Boxi countered.
"That loose sword cultivator’s talent is indeed unprecedented; without any guidance, he managed to understand the Sword Qi Thunder Sound at the Qi Cultivation realm."
"It’s almost certain he’ll reach the second realm of swordsmanship, the Sword Light Soaring, and even the third realm, the Sword Rainbow Splitting Light, isn’t off the table."
"You have to know, the third realm of swordsmanship is a domain even Nascent Soul cultivators aspire to reach!"
"Do you think if the news gets out, the Luoyun Sect would let us be?"
"We can’t gamble with the whole sect! The patriarchs wouldn’t wager their lives either!"
Zhang Boxi’s words were like needles, piercing into the middle-aged man’s heart; though he opened his mouth, he said nothing in the end.
The Luoyun Sect was all-powerful in Yue Country, and it wouldn’t allow any force to threaten it.
Not even a hint of potential could be permitted.

chapters.title: Chapter 68: Perilous Journey
chapters.content:
Chapter 68: Chapter 68: Perilous Journey
In a dense forest.
Xu Ping sat under a big tree, resting, as his gaze swept over various strange plants entangled and intertwined.
Huge trees that would take several people to encircle were everywhere here, with thick layers of leaves piled up, blackened from time due to erosion, and the rotting scent permeated the air, suffocating.
Above the canopy, the broad crowns of the forest spread out in all directions, adding a boundless cover to the entire forest.
Although it was already noon and the sun was high, little light could be felt here, as the layers of branches stubbornly rejected the intrusion of sunlight, making the whole forest appear darker and more eerie...
"No wonder the Qi Refining Realm is so dangerous when crossing this area near the wilds; the Demon Beasts alone are enough to claim the lives of many in the mid-stage or even late-stage Qi Cultivation." Xu Ping sighed helplessly.
In the past few days, he had already encountered three to four groups of Demon Beasts.
There was even a First Rank Upper Grade Demon Beast he wasn’t sure he could take down even in late-stage Qi Cultivation.
He had thought about using Wind Manipulation Skill to fly, but not only couldn’t he fly far, but it also consumed a lot of mana.
Moreover, the sky might be even more dangerous than the ground.
"It’s a pity that Dongwu Market doesn’t have self-flying Magical Artifacts; otherwise, it would make traveling easier." Xu Ping sighed slightly.
Self-flying Magical Artifacts are easy to operate, and only require Spirit Stones to fly.
However, crafting such artifacts is more difficult than ordinary ones, and the price is better.
Xu Ping summoned a fireball, lit a pile of wood, and began to roast meat.
After eating and drinking his fill, he resumed his journey.
Until night fell, he found a place to rest.
Traveling deep into the night was still too dangerous.
...
The night gradually deepened.
Crack.
A flash of lightning ripped across the night sky.
Raindrops showered down, splattering on the leaves and grass, making a rustling sound.
Inside a cave in the mountains.
Xu Ping carefully roasted the newly-skinned Demon Beast bear hide over the fire.
Two Demon Beast cubs huddled together in fear, shrinking into the deepest corner of the cave.
In their pitiful state, they and their father were staying well in the cave, only to be suddenly attacked by this man who barged in and subdued their father.
After the fight, he even skinned their father and put his hide on the fire to roast.
This is what kind of devil!
After eating his fill, Xu Ping began practicing Palm Thunder.
Even though he was traveling, daily skill practice was still essential.
But before that, he first stuck several Silence Talismans at the cave entrance.
This way, no matter how loud the noise is, it wouldn’t be transmitted outside.
After making preparations, Xu Ping officially began his practice, setting up the Magic Technique, mana flowing through the meridians into his palm.
"Shh!"
Accompanied by a soft shout, a thunderbolt shot out from his palm, smashing into the cave wall.
"Boom!"
With an explosion, rubble splattered, and a scorched black area appeared on the cave wall.
The two Demon Beast cubs were even more terrified, hugging each other and trembling.
Xu Ping, however, didn’t pay them any attention, continuing his focused practice.
Until late at night, he finally fell asleep, tired.
Although he was very fatigued, he slept lightly, able to awaken immediately at the slightest noise.
...
...
The next day, Xu Ping got up early, had a simple breakfast, and resumed his journey.
Walking all the way.
The ground was filled with various bizarre plants, and huge branches crisscrossed.
Being inside felt like being amidst skyscrapers.
Like in a giant world.
Xu Ping trod on soft fallen leaves, moving quickly through the dense forest.
Given his current physique and speed, he could cover nearly a hundred or two hundred miles in a day.
At this moment.
Buzz buzz buzz...
A swarm of wing-beating sounds suddenly rose from the forest.
"What’s going on?"
Xu Ping frowned, raising his head to see countless fist-sized venomous bees rapidly flying towards him from deep within the woods.
"Venomous bees?"
Xu Ping’s brow furrowed, his hand flashing with light, and the Blood-Drinking Sword appeared in his hand.
With several bursts of Sword Qi, a large number of venomous bees were killed.
The remaining bees buzzed and fled.
Xu Ping didn’t pursue them further, sheathing the Blood-Drinking Sword and continuing his journey.
The following path seemed like stumbling into a nest of vipers.
Venomous snakes coiled on branches ready to strike at any moment; swarming venomous mosquitoes; countless venomous scorpions...
Threats deadly to others were nothing to Xu Ping, but they did delay his progress.
Luckily, he continued walking slowly, as he wasn’t in much of a hurry.
He also took the opportunity to practice Magic Techniques.
After all, live targets are rare.
...
Boom!!
A thunderbolt as thick as an arm shot out from Xu Ping’s palm, directly blasting a swarm of venomous mosquitoes ahead into ashes.
"Did the power break through?" Xu Ping’s eyes lit up, hastily checking the proficiency panel.
[Palm Thunder Minor Achievement: 1/800]
"Sure enough, it broke through!"
Xu Ping’s face showed delight; he estimated the power surpassed the Five-Thunder Talisman.
"Not bad, not bad!"
"Continue, continue!"
Walking and killing along the way.
Until nightfall, Xu Ping stopped to find a place to rest.
This time he didn’t find a cave, but a huge tree hollow.
The tree hollow was spacious, about twenty square meters.
After a careful search, Xu Ping found nothing.
Only a skeleton.
If he had just crossed over, he certainly wouldn’t dare sleep here, but now he had no burden.
He planned to thoroughly rest after a whole day of killing.
Soon, Xu Ping’s breathing gradually became steady.
He hadn’t dreamt in a long time, yet today he unexpectedly had a dream.
In the dream, the skeleton in the tree hollow transformed into a naked woman, her alabaster body faintly visible in the dark.
The woman walked step by step towards him, softly nibbling his ear: "Master, alone and afraid here, could you hold me!"
The woman’s voice was melodious, flowing like water, seemingly penetrating Xu Ping’s heart.
His gaze became hazy, subconsciously wanting to agree.
But just then, the Taihang Nourishing God Skill automatically circulated, a cool sensation instantly permeated his Sea of Consciousness, jolting him awake.
"Just now... something wasn’t right!"
Xu Ping sensed danger, his face grim, staring darkly at the skeleton.
He hadn’t felt anything unusual before, but now it looked enchantingly beautiful.
"A skeleton giving rise to enchanting, beautiful feelings; I must have been influenced by something!" Xu Ping became alert, his expression growing darker.
"Evil spirit!?"
So eerie, this skeleton must be some evil spirit!
"Shh!"
With a soft shout, a thunderbolt as thick as an arm shot out from Xu Ping’s palm, blasting towards the skeleton!
Boom!
With a loud crash, the skeleton was easily shattered into powder, scattering in the air.
Witnessing this, Xu Ping showed no joy; his expression remained grim.
He felt something ominous, as if the evil spirit hadn’t been vanquished.

chapters.title: Chapter 69: Resolution
chapters.content:
Chapter 69: Chapter 69: Resolution
Xu Ping took out a stack of Exorcism Talismans from his storage bag, the talismans were heating up quickly, becoming visibly hot.
"As expected!"
He scanned the surroundings with a grim expression, searching for traces of evil spirits.
His gaze was sharp like an eagle, not missing any spot.
But the tree hollow was extremely clean, with only bone powder on the ground.
Suddenly, a terrifying thought popped into his mind.
"Could it be possessed on me?"
Given the peculiar nature of the evil spirit, there’s a chance it might be.
Xu Ping took a deep breath, placed the Exorcism Talisman on his chest, sat cross-legged, and used his Spiritual Sense to examine himself.
If he didn’t uncover it today, his life might be in danger.
His Spiritual Sense turned inward, searching every inch of his body for anything unusual.
A quarter of an hour, two quarters... two hours passed.
Xu Ping opened his eyes, his expression extremely gloomy.
Couldn’t find it!
He searched everywhere on his body, even checked the important parts of a man without discovering anything abnormal!!
Feeling the stack of talismans on his chest still heating, Xu Ping took them out, the spiritual power in the top few talismans was nearly depleted, turning them into waste paper.
There’s nothing happening now, probably because the Exorcism Talismans are deterring it. As soon as the talismans are exhausted, the evil spirit may act.
"Humph!"
"I’d like to see who can outlast whom?"
Xu Ping coldly retrieved nearly a hundred Exorcism Talismans from his storage,
he might not have much of anything else, but he had an abundance of talismans.
Come on!
Let’s see who runs out first!
