Xu Ping closed his eyes to rest, starting to wait at ease.
One hour, two hours... after a day.
More than thirty talismans lost their spiritual power, turning into waste paper.
At this moment, a peculiar cold wave radiated from his Sea of Consciousness.
Xu Ping abruptly opened his eyes, a chill flashing through them: "So, you are in the Sea of Consciousness!"
He previously checked the Sea of Consciousness first, but it was hidden too deeply, all went unnoticed.
Now unable to outlast him, finally it revealed itself!!
Xu Ping calmed his mind, probing the Sea of Consciousness inch by inch, finally finding a tiny black dot within.
This small black dot emitted bursts of chilling aura.
"Die!"
Xu Ping’s Sea of Consciousness seemed to surge with a mighty wave, pressing down on it with immense pressure.
"Dear, I’m scared."
The black dot suddenly turned into a naked woman, her gaze timid, voice gentle, infinitely pitiable.
Yet, Xu Ping remained unmoved, continuing to suppress it with all his might.
Boom!
Under the great pressure, the naked woman’s body started to deform, her cheeks sinking and looking fierce, eyes wholly dark without whites.
"Hiss!!"
She shouted angrily, emitting a terrifying cold aura from her body.
"Humph!"
Xu Ping snorted coldly, his gaze full of murderous intent.
Attempting to act viciously within his Sea of Consciousness!!
Boom!
With full power, the evil spirit was compressed to the limit, unable to endure further, then with a ’bang’ it was expelled from the Sea of Consciousness,
"Hiss!!"
In the void, the seemingly real and illusory evil spirit roared angrily, staring daggers at Xu Ping.
"Crack!"
To deal with such ghostly things, you have to physically expel it.
Xu Ping suddenly stood, his eyes cold, uttering a soft shout, a bolt as thick as an arm of Thunder Power shot out from his palm, blasting towards the illusory evil spirit!
Booming!
The evil spirit was struck head-on, the Thunder Power exploded.
"Ah!"
The evil spirit let out an unbearably sharp scream, then was blown into tiny light points by the Thunder Power, fading into the air.
"Hoo..."
"Finally dead!" Xu Ping exhaled deeply.
This evil spirit was even tougher than ’Old Sun’, had he not trained in the Taihang Nourishing God Skill and brought enough Exorcism Talismans, he might have been defeated by the evil spirit.
"Damn, this godforsaken place!" Xu Ping couldn’t help but curse under his breath.
Even he nearly stumbled, can other Qi Cultivators truly cross these three thousand miles?
Xu Ping leaned against the tree wall, his body relaxing and fatigue sweeping over him.
But he dared not truly sleep, only able to rest partially to recover his energy.
...
After a day and night.
Xu Ping awoke from partial sleep, instantly feeling a state of unparalleled mental clarity, as though he had endless energy.
"This state... isn’t it a bit too good!?"
He looked puzzled, feeling there was something different about himself, yet couldn’t really say what.
After carefully checking around his body, he finally found something amiss.
Apparently, his Spiritual Sense had enhanced, though not much, but it was indeed a solid enhancement!
"What’s going on here?" Xu Ping showed a happy expression.
The surprise was too sudden, without a breakthrough in Taihang Nourishing God Skill, how could his Spiritual Sense improve?
Thinking it over, the only reasonable explanation was that yesterday’s battle with the evil spirit honed his Sea of Consciousness, making it more stable.
The Sea of Consciousness is the foundation of strength, as it strengthens, so does the Spiritual Sense.
"This certainly was an unexpected delight, if a few more evil spirits like this appear, perhaps Sea of Consciousness could strengthen to a point where Divine Sense is refined."
Xu Ping rubbed his chin, thought for a moment, but eventually gave up on this idea.
Aside from the difficulty of finding this type of evil spirit, mainly the invasion into the Sea of Consciousness was far too dangerous.
If carelessly handled, causing issues to his own Sea of Consciousness, it would be a total loss.
"Time to leave." Xu Ping stood and exited the tree hollow.
He had already delayed here quite some time, days in wilderness weren’t pleasant.
He continued onward, not encountering more evil spirits but faced different Demon Beasts and poisonous insects.
At first, it was quite enjoyable slaying them along the way, but he grew tired later on.
Fortunately, the forest gradually thinned out, with fewer Demon Beasts and insects.
...
...
A month and a half later.
Xu Ping finally emerged from the forest.
Signs of human habitation were visible.
Vast fields appeared on both sides, and as it was late autumn, all crops in the fields had been harvested.
Continuing forward.
Scattered farmers and children carrying baskets were scavenging leftover grain in the fields.
"Mortals."
Xu Ping felt somewhat sentimental at heart, although these were mortals without mana, for someone who hadn’t seen people for nearly two months, it felt inexplicably comforting.
After adjusting his mindset, he began sorting out his thoughts.
"According to the map, this should be a mortal city named Jialan City, heading north several hundred miles should lead me to Beixi Market."
Beixi Market, one of the larger cultivation markets established by Purple Mist Sect, a part of the five major Golden Core Sect.
Indeed, Xu Ping, to be safe, directly crossed Longevity Sect’s territory, reaching Purple Mist Sect’s domain.
"I can find good rest at Beixi Market, then take the Spiritual Boat to Qiu Xuan Immortal City," Xu Ping thought to himself.
There’s always considerable traffic at Beixi Market, and it has direct Spiritual Boats to Qiu Xuan Immortal City.
Though not cheap, Xu Ping, with his current status, could afford them.

chapters.title: Chapter 70: Beixi Market
chapters.content:
Chapter 70: Chapter 70: Beixi Market
Beixi Market, built on a Second-stage Upper Grade Spirit Vein, is much larger in scale than Dongwu Market.
The flow of people is several times greater.
Xu Ping transformed into a thin young man and walked among them without attracting anyone’s attention.
Only two young men at the first layer of Qi Cultivation approached him, exchanging glances before one retreated, leaving this business to the one wearing hemp clothing.
"Senior, do you need a guide? I know everything about this place, even the things being sold at today’s stalls."
Xu Ping looked at this teenage boy, and a thought crossed his mind.
He was unfamiliar with the place, so finding a guide to ask about things might be a good idea.
"How much do you charge?"
"One Spirit Stone per day." The hemp-clad boy smiled ingratiatingly.
"Okay." Xu Ping nodded, not finding it necessary to haggle over this price.
"Do you know when the next Spiritual Boat to Qiu Xuan Immortal City departs?" he asked.
The hemp-clad boy responded immediately: "Every two months, the next should be in a month."
"A month, huh." Xu Ping murmured, then asked, "Where can I rent a place around here?"
"Follow me, Senior."
The hemp-clad boy led the way, with Xu Ping lazily following behind.
On the way, Xu Ping also asked the boy about recent major events.
"If you’re talking about major events, it has to be the fuss about that peerless Sword Cultivator recently." The hemp-clad boy said.
"Peerless Sword Cultivator?" Xu Ping’s brows slightly furrowed.
"I’ve been in closed cultivation recently and know nothing about the outside world, tell me more about it." He asked calmly.
"Alright, speaking of that Sword Cultivator’s talent, it’s a truly earth-shattering existence. He’s a Loose Cultivator from a place under Longevity Sect called Dongwu Market who comprehended Sword Qi Thunder Sound at just late-stage Qi Cultivation."
"Back then, he single-handedly slew a Golden Core Demon Cultivator with just a sword..."
The hemp-clad boy was animated and looked excited, as if he were the one who had slain the Golden Core Demon Cultivator.
Listening to the boy’s story, Xu Ping’s heart trembled, though his face showed no change.
Longevity Sect, Dongwu Market, slaying a Golden Core Demon Cultivator, it was obviously him.
But he couldn’t understand, given Longevity Sect’s strength, they could easily keep the news sealed for a while!
Why, in such a short time, had the rumors spread even within Purple Mist Sect’s territory, causing such a stir?
"How did this news get out?" Xu Ping feigned curiosity as he asked.
"It was spread by the Longevity Sect." The hemp-clad boy answered.
"Longevity Sect?"
This answer indeed surprised Xu Ping. He couldn’t understand why Longevity Sect didn’t just suppress the news, but actively publicized it instead.
"I heard..." Seeing Xu Ping’s puzzled expression, the hemp-clad boy lowered his voice and said, "Longevity Sect feared Luoyun Sect’s reproach, so they took the initiative to spread the Sword Cultivator senior’s story."
"Luoyun Sect’s reproach?"
Xu Ping was briefly stunned, and the next moment he understood the cause and effect.
But Longevity Sect’s actions put him in a difficult position.
"Is Luoyun Sect making any moves?" Xu Ping asked again.
"Nothing particularly significant."
The hemp-clad boy shook his head, "Because the Sword Cultivator senior has disappeared, Luoyun Sect merely stated they would welcome the senior as a core disciple if he joins their sect and he could even become a nominal disciple of their Nascent Soul ancestor after establishing Foundation."
’Become a nominal disciple of the Nascent Soul ancestor!!’ Xu Ping couldn’t help but feel a wave in his heart.
A Nascent Soul ancestor!
The entire Yue Country has only one; being his disciple, albeit nominal, means you can walk anywhere in Yue Country without opposition.
And future resources wouldn’t be a problem at all.
However, it would mean putting his life in someone else’s hands, without any capacity to resist if anything arises.
Under any circumstances, he wouldn’t agree to it.
Besides, with his skill panel, he wouldn’t be short of resources.
"Do any other Golden Core Sects have special reactions?" Xu Ping asked indirectly.
"Special reactions?"
"No special reactions, even if they find the Sword Cultivator senior, they can’t protect him. So they just don’t bother looking."
Hearing this, Xu Ping felt slightly relieved.
Under these circumstances, his journey to Qiu Xuan Immortal City shouldn’t encounter too many obstacles.
"Your cultivation isn’t high, yet you know quite a lot." Xu Ping praised him.
"You’ve flattered me, senior." The hemp-clad boy grinned broadly.
After walking a bit further,
The hemp-clad boy stopped and pointed at a two-story building named ’Beixi Inn,’ saying, "We’re here, senior, right here."
"Mhm." Xu Ping nodded and directly tossed a Spirit Stone to him.
"Thank you, senior." The hemp-clad boy accepted the Spirit Stone and beamed with joy.
Xu Ping had just stepped into the entrance when a young attendant greeted him with a smiling face: "Dear guest, are you looking to rent a cave dwelling?"
"Mhm, can you show me some slightly better cave dwellings?" Xu Ping’s expression remained unchanged as he asked.
The attendant knew immediately that this was big business and cheerfully approached, opening an exquisite booklet: "Superior cave dwellings near the Second-stage Spirit Vein, rich in Spiritual Qi, you may choose from any unoccupied cave dwelling listed here..."
"How much Spirit Stone to rent for a month?"
"Forty Spirit Stones a month."
"That’s a bit expensive." Xu Ping muttered, but he still took out forty Spirit Stones to rent a superior cave dwelling.
The attendant promptly noted it down, collected the Spirit Stones, and returned to the counter. Soon after, he respectfully presented a token: "This is the array token; please keep it safe, dear guest!"
Xu Ping took the redwood token and found ’令’ written on the front, with small characters below: ’Number B-37.’
On the back was a simplified map of the market.
"This token can control the array near the cave dwelling, but it’s only valid for one month." The attendant further explained.
Xu Ping nodded, feeling impressed, "Truly, you get what you pay for; it even comes with an array token."
...
...
In the center of the market, the houses were noticeably more spacious than those on the previous roads.
Small courtyards stood amidst lush woods.
The passing cultivators were predominantly late-stage Qi Cultivation, clad in incredibly splendid robes.
Following the street, Xu Ping found the ’Number B-37’ cave dwelling.
"What are you doing?"
Before he got close, a group of cultivators dressed in Beixi law enforcement uniforms emerged from a distance, their leader asking loudly.
"Renting."
Xu Ping pointed to the ’Number B-37’ cave dwelling.
"May I see the token?" At these words, the leader’s attitude became much more courteous.
Xu Ping retrieved the small wooden token from his storage bag and handed it over.
The leading cultivator examined the token closely and returned it politely: "It’s our duty."
Being able to afford a superior cave dwelling meant one was either wealthy or prestigious, so it was wise to be courteous.
This was knowledge he had accumulated over the years as a captain of a law enforcement team.

chapters.title: Chapter 71: Light Body Technique Perfection
chapters.content:
Chapter 71: Chapter 71: Light Body Technique Perfection
After the law enforcement team left, Xu Ping arrived at the entrance of his rented cave abode.
Though called a ’cave abode’, it’s actually a standalone, luxurious courtyard surrounded by walls, neither too big nor too small.
The courtyard is enveloped by a layer of White Mist Array, which can alert and defend against enemies, as well as obscure privacy, giving him a sense of security.
Xu Ping infused a thread of Mana into the token, instantly understanding how to use it, and holding the token, he arrived at the gate of the courtyard.
A shimmering red light emitted from the token, causing the gate to open in response.
The courtyard isn’t large, but it has a stone table, four round stone stools, and several rooms.
"This small courtyard is nice. Although the price is slightly high, everything else is pretty good," Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction.
Not only is the Spiritual Qi abundant, but the array provides concealment; no matter what he does inside, outsiders have no way of knowing.
Xu Ping pushed open the door to his room, and a spacious room came into view.
The entire room consists of five chambers, with beds, desks, and chairs all equipped.
There’s even a separate cultivation room.
Xu Ping sat on the bed, the fatigue from long travels constantly washed over him.
He hadn’t rested well during this period; it was truly exhausting.
Using the Cleaning Talisman to clean his body, Xu Ping could no longer support himself and fell into a deep sleep.
He slept for a whole day and night.
...
By noon the next day, Xu Ping woke up feeling refreshed.
After snacking on some food, he went to Beixi Market to purchase a ticket to travel to Qiu Xuan Immortal City.
More than half an hour later, Xu Ping returned to his residence.
The ticket purchasing process was very smooth, though the price was quite steep.
Each ticket cost a full three hundred Spirit Stones.
Sitting at the table, Xu Ping took a sip of water, a smile tugging at the corner of his mouth:
"Only thirty-one days until I can leave this place and go to Qiu Xuan Immortal City. Then I’ll rent a house and plant Spirit Medicines every day, draw talismans, research arrays... That’s the life of cultivation!"
He happily picked up the water cup and took another sip, miraculously finding that the bland water tasted somewhat sweet.
After a few gulps of water, Xu Ping walked into the courtyard.
Although the array conceals this place, using powerful spells like Palm Thunder is best avoided to prevent unnecessary trouble.
Thus, he practiced Light Body Technique instead.
Xu Ping’s figure flashed and disappeared from where he stood, only to reappear in the corner of the courtyard.
With his current control, even in a confined space, he wouldn’t collide with the walls.
Thus, in this small courtyard, Xu Ping started moving around variously.
Half an hour later.
Xu Ping, panting, stopped and wiped the sweat off, habitually clicked open the panel for a glance.
[Light Body Technique: Mastery Level: 1230/1600]
"Almost there. At this rate, in about twenty days, I should break through to perfection."
"I’m curious about what changes it will bring at that time."
After admiring the panel for a while, he closed it.
...
...
After finishing dinner, Xu Ping went to the quiet room and took out a bottle of Yellow Dragon Pill from his storage bag.
It was an upper-grade first-rank pill he purchased from Beixi Market, better in effect than the Spirit Gathering Pill.
Opening the lid, he poured out a yellow pill and swallowed it whole, immediately beginning to operate the Five Elements Skill.
Threads of Spiritual Qi continuously converged on him.
After an hour.
Xu Ping finished his cultivation, adjusted the slightly agitated Mana, and, full of anticipation, opened the panel.
[Realm: Qi Cultivation Sixth Layer: 31/100; Nourishing Life Skill Third Layer: 8/100]
"Improved by one point."
Xu Ping felt delighted.
With the aid of pills and Spiritual Qi, his cultivation rate had finally resumed to one point per day.
"Once reaching the late-stage Qi Cultivation, I can start plotting for Foundation Establishment."
Xu Ping closed the panel, stood up, stretched lazily, and headed to the bedroom to sleep.
...
...
In the days that followed, Xu Ping stayed home every day, practicing various skills.
He occasionally took time to draw array patterns, though regrettably, his talent was insufficient, as he hadn’t completed his first pattern even after all this time.
He came to terms with his lack of talent, acknowledging that while arrays were tempting, they weren’t essential.
Occasionally studying them would suffice.
With time passing gradually, twenty days later.
In the morning.
In the courtyard, Xu Ping stood upright, and his body flashed with a burst of spiritual light, disappearing in an instant.
In the next instant.
Boom!
A crash echoed.
Upon closer inspection, Xu Ping had collided solidly with the wall.
Luckily, the array offered protection; otherwise, given his physique, the wall would have certainly been punctured.
"The sudden burst of speed after mastering Light Body Technique is indeed overwhelmingly fast!" Despite being grimy from the collision, Xu Ping’s eyes shimmered with excitement.
The Light Body Technique breakthrough indeed brought unexpected changes, allowing him to suddenly accelerate over short distances.
By his estimation, he could now explosively increase speed to almost double his former pace.
Considering his previous speed had been fast enough, this capability to suddenly surge to twice his speed was astonishing!
Such terrifying speed would certainly catch others off guard.
It might even pose a threat to Foundation Establishment!
Though Foundation Establishment cultivators are shrouded by Divine Sense, under a sudden attack, reacting might still be challenging.
The only drawback is the erupted speed causes physical strain, even on his third-layer Body Refining physique.
"Looks like once I master Qi Nourishing Skill, I’ll need to find a second-stage body refining technique to cultivate," Xu Ping thought to himself.
Body refining is unlike Foundation Establishment; with enough resources at the Qi Refining Realm, one can cultivate into a second-stage Body Cultivator.
Though the resource consumption is quite formidable.
"Keep going, keep going. If I can fully unleash my power in such a small space and avoid hitting the walls, that would mean proficient mastery!"
"Once I master that, I can seek out another magic to learn."
Xu Ping enthusiastically continued practicing.
The courtyard repeatedly resonated with ’boom... boom...’ sounds of collisions against the walls.
However, all these sounds were obscured by the array, unknown to outsiders.
...
...
Ten days later, the day to leave finally arrived.
Having packed everything, Xu Ping directly headed to the square to board the ship.
The square was crowded and bustling with noise.
He found an unoccupied corner and closed his eyes for a rest.
Soon after, the flying ship arrived.
The crowd hurried to form a line, and Xu Ping did the same.
The line moved quickly, and it wasn’t long before it was his turn.
Xu Ping handed the wooden ticket to the guard on the ship, who, upon checking, discovered he was a guest with a separate compartment on the second floor, thus greeting him more politely: "Sir, please take care of your ticket. Your compartment is on the second floor."
"Okay."
After storing the ticket, Xu Ping boarded the flying ship.
This ship was roughly thirty zhang long and divided into three levels.
The third level wasn’t open to the public; the second level had separate compartments, while the first level housed nearly ten meditation mats for the general passengers.
Given his current wealth, Xu Ping sought not to compromise his comfort and bought a ticket for a second-floor compartment without hesitation.

chapters.title: Chapter 72: Arrival at the Immortal City
chapters.content:
Chapter 72: Chapter 72: Arrival at the Immortal City
At this moment, a petite and exquisite maid gracefully arrived, guiding him into the compartment numbered "104."
"Immortal Master, would you like something to drink? The boat offers free spirit tea, as well as spirit wine and spirit fruit at a charge, with prices the same as those within the market."
The maid blinked her lively eyes and said to Xu Ping in a sweet voice.
The maids on these spiritual boats were mostly beautiful mortal women.
They follow the boat day and night, braving the elements, hoping that someday an Immortal Master might take a fancy to them and bring them into his household, a good fate even as a servant.
"No need! You may go."
Xu Ping remained unmoved, for women would only slow down his cultivation progress.
"During the upcoming journey, if Immortal Master needs anything, feel free to let the maid know."
The maid retreated with a charming smile, but a hint of disappointment flashed in her eyes as she turned away.
This Immortal Master, though young, was incredibly wealthy, truly a good prospect, but alas, the Immortal Master was not interested.
With half an hour until departure, Xu Ping quietly began cultivating the Taihang Nourishing God Skill.
Time flowed by, and soon it was time for the ship to depart, the vessel began to rock slightly.
Soon afterward, at the second floor corridor entrance, a voice as loud as a great bell spread across the flying boat.
"Fellow Daoists, I am Peng Wei, a cultivator of the Law Enforcement Hall from Beixi Market, responsible for all affairs aboard this spiritual boat."
Xu Ping ended his cultivation and listened quietly.
"This route begins at Beixi Market and ends at Qiu Xuan Immortal City. Along the way, we will stop at places like White Leaf Market, Yellow Stone Immortal City, and Wujian Mountain.
"We will stay at each stop for three hours, so those wishing to disembark for trade or purchase, please be mindful of the time. The ship will depart on schedule, and if missed, you will have to wait for the next trip."
"Let me make it clear upfront, no combat is allowed on the spiritual boat. Violation will be met with death without mercy!"
His words carried a hint of coldness towards the end.
Simultaneously, a surge of divine sense emanated from the third level, oppressing everyone. Though it quickly dissipated, it still caused almost everyone to tremble inwardly.
Xu Ping also narrowed his eyes slightly.
Then, the voice of the man at the second-floor corridor entrance sounded again: "If any Daoist thinks their cultivation is deep and disregards me, Beixi Market, and the Purple Mist Sect, feel free to try."
"Of course, as long as everyone abides by the rules, we promise to deliver all Daoists safely to your destination."
After these words, Peng Wei spoke no more, turning and walking into a room on the second floor.
The atmosphere on the ship relaxed considerably at this point.
Buzz buzz buzz...
Accompanied by a violent shake, the flying boat soared into the sky at high speed.
The ship pierced through the clouds, parting a path through them.
Before long, it had already left Beixi Market far behind.
The ship flew smoothly, without the slightest feeling of turbulence.
Xu Ping silently returned to cultivating the Taihang Nourishing God Skill.
The journey from Beixi Market to Qiu Xuan Immortal City was long, with stops along the way, taking at least ten days, but with the thin spiritual qi on the ship being poor for cultivation, he had no choice but to pass the time cultivating the Taihang Nourishing God Skill.
And so, ten days passed slowly.
The journey was without any incidents, and they finally reached Qiu Xuan Immortal City safely.
...
A majestic, giant city expanded in view, the surrounding mountains seeming to become mere hills in comparison.
Qiu Xuan Immortal City, settled amid this mountain range, spans hundreds of miles.
Below the city lies a large third-rank upper-grade spirit vein, with several first and second-stage spirit vein offshoots.
The entire Immortal City is enveloped by a massive third-rank grand array, surrounded by white mist, resembling a celestial realm.
Such an array, guarding a sect, is not only vast but also more complex than ordinary formations of the same rank, with exponentially higher resource consumption.
The sky continuously conveys sounds of things breaking through the air, magical artifacts, flying boats, spirit birds, and escape lights blur the view, as if entering a world of immortals.
Occasionally, Foundation Establishment Stage cultivators would break through the air, and the rest of the cultivators would automatically make way.
Xu Ping, staring like a country bumpkin, couldn’t help but sigh inwardly, "Now, this is what cultivation looks like!"
As for Dongwu Market, what the heck is that!!
The flying boat slowly descended, landing in a spacious square outside Qiu Xuan Immortal City.
"Immortal Master, we’ve arrived at Qiu Xuan Immortal City."
At this moment outside the compartment, the maid cautiously reminded.
In truth, Xu Ping didn’t need her reminder to know they had reached Qiu Xuan Immortal City.
He pushed open the door and jumped off the spiritual boat.
What entered his sight was a gate ten stories high, with cultivators coming and going continuously before it.
Xu Ping found a less crowded area, reverted to his true appearance, and followed the crowd into a side hall at the city gate, registered his information, paid two spirit stones, and obtained an identity token.
When traveling, caution is paramount!
...
Qiu Xuan Immortal City was bustling, naturally not short of guides.
Xu Ping easily found a guide and asked about the city’s layout.
"Qiu Xuan Immortal City is divided into four major parts."
"The first is the Outer City, enjoying first-rank medium and upper-grade spiritual qi, generally where ordinary Qi Cultivators live."
"The second is the Inner City, enjoying second-stage lower-grade spiritual qi, where wealthy Qi Cultivators reside. Various shops, inns, hostels, residential areas, and loose cultivator markets are all concentrated here."
"The third is the ’City Center,’ enjoying second stage medium and upper-grade spiritual qi, where Foundation Establishment Cultivators and people of deep backgrounds live. You need a pass to enter. If you’re advancing to Foundation Establishment, you can specially apply for a cave with second-stage upper-grade spiritual qi."
"The fourth is Qiu Xuan Mountain, where Qiu Xuan Zhenren and his disciples reside, not open to the public. I don’t know much about it."
Listening to the guide’s explanation, Xu Ping gradually formed a mental image of Qiu Xuan Immortal City’s layout.
"Where can I rent accommodations in the Inner City?" Xu Ping asked.
"There are definitely places for that. The Immortal City has an official rental option with slightly lower prices but cumbersome procedures; there’s also a broker, which is a bit pricier, but you can move in as soon as you find a place you like," the guide replied.
After some thought, Xu Ping decided to go with the broker.
A bit more expensive is fine, as long as it’s convenient.
"Alright, guest, I’ll take you to find a broker." The guide led the way.
The two of them entered the Inner City, arrived at a large hall, and found a broker with the surname Wu.
"Fellow Daoist, what kind of cave dwelling are you looking to rent?" the broker Wu said with a smile.
"One that’s a bit larger, with a sturdy practice room, preferably with some spirit fields for planting," Xu Ping stated his requirements.
Broker Wu pondered for a moment before nodding, "There are a few cave dwellings that meet your requirements. Would you like to take a look first?"
"Sure, lead the way," Xu Ping agreed.
Then, Broker Wu began to show Xu Ping several cave dwellings.

chapters.title: Chapter 73: Spiritual Spring
chapters.content:
Chapter 73: Chapter 73: Spiritual Spring
The broker led Xu Ping, surveying all the way.
As they walked, all the cave dwellings seemed almost identical, with nothing particularly appealing to him.
"Fellow Daoist, this is the last one, and its conditions are considered the best."
The broker smiled, leading Xu Ping to a magnificent courtyard. As he spoke, he took a specially crafted array plate from his pocket, gently swiped it, and activated the protective array set outside.
"Please look, Fellow Daoist. The courtyard has a mu of spiritual field with abundant spiritual qi, which can accelerate the growth of spirit plants, very suitable for planting spirit medicine and the like."
"Of course, the main feature is this spiritual spring in the field, which continuously seeps spiritual spring water, containing faint spiritual qi, making it very suitable for brewing spirit wine or soaking spirit tea."
The broker pointed to a spiritual spring and explained to Xu Ping.
The spiritual spring is about a zhang long and half a zhang wide, with a shallow layer of accumulated spring water.
"Oh?" Upon hearing this, Xu Ping immediately became interested.
He’s not interested in soaking spirit tea, but he’s skilled in brewing. Perhaps, if his Hundred Flowers Brew were enhanced with some spiritual spring water, its quality could improve even more.
"Will this spiritual spring continue steadily? It won’t just disappear once it’s used up, right?"
He voiced his concern to the broker.
"You can rest assured, Fellow Daoist. It’s said that the spiritual spring is closely connected to a branch of the spirit vein in the Immortal City, and it will continuously seep out, though the quantity isn’t large."
"This can be written into the contract, and if it doesn’t materialize, we will provide sufficient compensation to you."
The broker said with a smile.
"Alright."
Xu Ping nodded, then asked, "And is the training room sturdy? My cultivation tends to be somewhat loud."
"It’s certainly sturdy. Please follow me, Fellow Daoist."
The broker led Xu Ping into a stone room and introduced it: "This room is constructed from a hard mineral, combined with array reinforcement, impervious to those without Foundation Establishment level strength."
The stone room wasn’t very large, but nearly twenty square meters, more than enough for cultivation.
Xu Ping tapped lightly on the wall, and a crisp sound echoed through the empty room.
"Not bad!" He was quite satisfied with this cave dwelling and asked about the price: "What’s the monthly rent for this cave dwelling?"
"Not expensive, ninety-two spirit stones a month," the broker replied with a beaming smile.
"Can the price be any lower? It seems a bit too expensive," Xu Ping tried to negotiate.
Ninety-two spirit stones a month are over a thousand spirit stones a year.
With a bit more, he could afford a high-grade magical artifact.
"Well... I can’t decide the rent. However, if you wish to rent it, you can freely use the First Rank protective array in the courtyard for a period," the broker hesitated before speaking.
"No way, you intended to charge for the array too?" Xu Ping thought, speechless.
After some contemplation, he decided to rent it.
The house perfectly met his requirements in every aspect, so a bit expensive is justified!
"I’ll take this one, renting for half a year," Xu Ping said.
"Alright, I’ll handle everything for you, Fellow Daoist!" The broker was overjoyed.
A big customer indeed!
Renting for six months, completing this deal would earn him quite a bit of spirit stones!
...
After confirming the rental of the courtyard with the spiritual spring, both parties quickly concluded the handover.
Just as promised, he sorted out all the miscellaneous details for Xu Ping, saving him a lot of time and effort.
After paying half a year’s rent and signing the contract, the broker left with a cheerful grin.
Xu Ping sat alone in the small courtyard, gazing at the spiritual field and the shallow spiritual spring, and couldn’t help but sigh, "It’s indeed nice, just a bit pricey."
Throughout the journey, he mostly spent spirit stones and hardly earned any.
Now, after paying the rent, he had only a few hundred spirit stones left.
This amount might not last more than a few months here.
Fortunately, he already had plans for making money.
First, brewing; his Hundred Flowers Brew was quite beneficial for body cultivators. With Qiu Xuan Immortal City’s large population and many body cultivators, sales shouldn’t be an issue.
Next is cultivating spirit medicine. Although his Spirit Rain Skill was only at a proficient level and couldn’t handle high-grade spirit medicine, consistent practice would allow him to grow higher-grade spirit medicines quickly.
Lastly is drawing talismans, although he can only draw First Rank Middle Grade talismans, which isn’t much of an advantage.
Qiu Xuan Immortal City is adjacent to the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range, with a constant flow of demon beast pelts providing the raw materials for talisman drawing.
This led to a large number of Talisman Masters in the city, especially in the mid and lower grades.
Low-level Talisman Masters had to engage in price and quality wars to make money!
Nevertheless, it’s possible to earn a bit of money.
But that’s for the future. After a busy day, it’s best to have a good rest for now.
...
Two days later.
Xu Ping arrived early at the loose cultivator market in the inner city.
Since he needs to prepare to make money, understanding the market conditions is essential.
Walking around, he discovered that the most sellers are those dealing in talismans, and prices are very low.
"Drawing talismans doesn’t make much money!" Xu Ping quickly concluded.
Even if there’s earning, it’s merely labor-intensive money.
As for sellers of spirit wine and spirit medicine, there were not as many.
But unlike the talismans, it wasn’t as competitive.
After spending the day wandering, Xu Ping had a grasp of the market conditions at the loose cultivator market.
By evening, on his way home, his storage pouch was filled with materials for brewing, spirit medicine seeds, and materials for drawing talismans.
The spirit medicine seeds he bought were first-rank lower-grade spirit medicine, Bloodstopping Grass.
In Qiu Xuan Immortal City, many make a living hunting demons, so injuries are inevitable.
Thus, various healing elixirs are quite popular, and among them, the first-rank lower-grade healing elixir Hemostatic Powder, which is affordable and effective, is one of the most favored healing elixirs.
The main ingredient for refining Hemostatic Powder, the Bloodstopping Grass, is almost always in short supply.
With his proficient-level Spirit Rain Skill, he could cultivate Bloodstopping Grass.
Once his Spirit Rain Skill advances, he can cultivate other higher-grade spirit medicines.
Step by step, he planned to gradually improve his earnings.
Early the next day,
Xu Ping planted fifty Bloodstopping Grass spirit seeds, then performed the Spirit Rain Skill to nourish them, with delicate threads of spiritual rain seeping into the soil, being greedily absorbed by the jade-like Bloodstopping Grass seeds.
After planting the Bloodstopping Grass, Xu Ping busied himself with brewing.
After working hard for seven to eight days, he had brewed over twenty jars of the regular version, but with the addition of spirit spring water, of the Hundred Flowers Brew.
As for the new version of the Hundred Flowers Brew brewed with the Hundred Flowers Gu King, its cost-effectiveness was low, pricing too low and making no profit, too high and fearing no buyers.
It’s best to test the waters first with the regular version of the Hundred Flowers Brew.
...
In a stable environment with abundant spiritual qi,
Xu Ping completely immersed himself in cultivation.
Every day, he would draw talismans, tend to the spirit medicine, and practice various skills.
Although he couldn’t practice swordsmanship without restraint due to the training room, there was no issue in practicing other skills.
Time flies in cultivation.
Soon enough, twenty days had passed.

chapters.title: Chapter 74: Qi Cultivation Level 7
chapters.content:
Chapter 74: Chapter 74: Qi Cultivation Level 7
On this day, inside the bedroom, more than twenty jars of Hundred Flowers Brew were neatly arranged.
Xu Ping picked up a jar, removed the lid, and poured himself a small cup.
He drank it in one gulp.
A burst of rich, spicy aroma exploded on his tongue.
He smacked his lips, closed his eyes, and carefully felt the effects of the latest version of the Hundred Flowers Brew.
"The taste is better, and as the Hundred Flowers Brew is refined and absorbed, my Mana... seems to have increased a bit. Although it’s a small amount, it is indeed an enhancement."
"This... the Hundred Flowers Brew is quite effective!" Xu Ping suddenly opened his eyes, showing a happy expression.
He didn’t expect that adding Spiritual Spring water to the Hundred Flowers Brew would make its effects so good, not only enhancing blood and strengthening the physique but also boosting cultivation.
"This time, there definitely won’t be a lack of market, but if I sell it myself, it will surely delay my cultivation. I’ll have to find someone to help me sell it."
Xu Ping thought to himself.
Fortunately, he already had someone in mind.
...
...
The next day.
Xu Ping left home, went to the loose cultivator market, turned a few street corners, and arrived at a pharmacy named ’Hundred Herbs Hall.’
Upon entering the pharmacy, a strong medicinal aroma greeted him.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, here to buy herbs again?"
The thin elder at the desk in front of the pharmacy yawned and greeted him.
The thin elder was Zhang Yan, the owner of this shop. Xu Ping bought his spirit medicines for brewing wine and body refining here. They had interacted several times, and the two were fairly acquainted.
"Not this time." Xu Ping said casually, sitting directly on the chair.
"Then what do you need from me, Fellow Daoist?" The thin elder yawned, tears flowing, looking sleepy.
He then took out a black pill from his bosom and swallowed it.
After taking the pill, in a moment, Zhang Yan, who was previously exhausted, instantly became full of radiance and energy.
"Fellow Daoist Zhang, what pill did you take?" Xu Ping asked in surprise.
What kind of pill is this, turning him into a different person after taking it?
"Bliss Pill, take one when you’re fatigued, and you’ll instantly feel ten times more spirited. Would Fellow Daoist like to try one?" Zhang Yan’s face was rosy, enthusiastically taking out a Bliss Pill and handing it to Xu Ping.
"Uh... no, no." Xu Ping’s expression froze, quickly refusing.
It sounded like something not too good, and he definitely didn’t dare to try it.
"That’s a shame, this pill works wonders." As he spoke, Zhang Yan directly swallowed another Bliss Pill.
Soon, his already rosy face turned even redder, almost dripping with crimson, and even bloodshot appeared in his eyes.
He... won’t suddenly drop dead in front of me, right?
Xu Ping felt uneasy inside.
"By the way, Fellow Daoist Xu, what did you come to find me for?" Zhang Yan stood up, appearing overly excited, like someone who had taken too many stimulants.
"Uh..." Xu Ping hesitated, originally thinking Zhang Yan was a good candidate to sell his spirit wine, but now he had second thoughts.
Is someone who takes medicine really reliable?
After some hesitation, he ultimately spoke out, mainly because he really had no other options.
"I’ve brewed a jar of spirit wine and want to leave it here for consignment. Every jar sold will give you a thirty percent profit."
Xu Ping took out the Hundred Flowers Brew from his storage bag, removed the lid, and poured a cup of spirit wine for Zhang Yan.
"Have a taste, Fellow Daoist."
Zhang Yan did not stand on ceremony, picked up the cup, and drank it in one shot.
He closed his eyes, carefully feeling it.
The next moment, he suddenly opened his eyes, excited: "Good wine, it enhances both blood and cultivation."
"This business can work. Consigning it at my pharmacy, selling ten or so jars a month won’t be a problem." He confidently patted his rib-like chest.
Hearing this, Xu Ping felt slightly reassured: "It seems that although Fellow Daoist Zhang likes to take medicine, he is reliable."
"Fellow Daoist Zhang is experienced. How much do you think a jar should be priced at in Spirit Stones?" he asked.
"How many Spirit Stones..." Zhang Yan pondered for a moment, then said, "According to the market price, a jar of spirit wine is between forty and fifty Spirit Stones..."
"How about we set it at forty-five Spirit Stones per jar?"
"Forty-five Spirit Stones per jar, huh?"
Xu Ping pondered for a moment and agreed with the price.
The cost price of a jar of wine is around ten Spirit Stones. Even after giving Zhang Yan his thirty percent profit, he can still earn around twenty Spirit Stones.
Not bad at all.
...
After the transaction was complete, Xu Ping did not linger in the pharmacy.
"Once the spirit wine’s market opens up, the Spirit Stones will come rolling in." He felt joyous, "Although Fellow Daoist Zhang likes to take medicine, his work is still reliable."
Xu Ping turned to look back at the pharmacy.
Only to see Zhang Yan, with gleeful gestures, taking out another Bliss Pill and downing it with a large bowl of spirit wine.
"..."
Xu Ping slowly widened his mouth.
This damn thing won’t cause problems, will it??
...
...
Returning home.
Xu Ping sat on a stone bench in the courtyard, musing to himself: "I really wonder if it was right to leave the spirit wine with Zhang Yan."
Thinking about Zhang Yan’s over-medicated appearance now left Xu Ping speechless.
But currently, there were no other options.
"Forget it, Zhang Yan runs such a large pharmacy here, surely he won’t be too unreliable."
"Time to continue cultivating. I’m about to break through to the seventh layer of Qi Cultivation."
Xu Ping stood up and walked into the cultivation room.
...
...
Time passed slowly amidst Xu Ping’s cultivation.
A month and a half later.
Within the cultivation room.
Spiritual Qi gathered around Xu Ping, continuously being absorbed into his body.
At a certain moment.
"Boom!"
Xu Ping’s whole body shook, the route of Spiritual Power inside him expanded again, forming a complete cycle network.
Xu Ping suppressed the excitement in his heart, slowly regulating the turbulent Spiritual Power.
He opened his eyes.
"I’ve succeeded, I can finally call myself a Late-Stage Qi Cultivation practitioner now." Xu Ping wore a face full of joy.
After spending so much time, he finally broke through to the seventh layer of Qi Cultivation.
The seventh layer of Qi Cultivation, right at the threshold of Late-Stage Qi Cultivation, at this stage it’s time to prepare for Foundation Establishment.
"Huh? My Spiritual Sense is...?"
Xu Ping was experiencing the changes from his breakthrough but found that his Spiritual Sense had an indistinct feeling of breaking out of his body.
"This... is about to transform into Divine Sense?" He felt a tremor in his mind.
His Taihang Nourishing God Skill had already reached great success before, causing his Spiritual Sense to increase significantly. Now, after breaking through the seventh layer of Qi Cultivation, his Spiritual Sense grew even more.
Perhaps...
Xu Ping suppressed his inner excitement, carefully experiencing the sensation.
After half a cup of tea, he opened his eyes and concluded: "Still a bit short."
It was probably an illusion created by the dramatic increase in Spiritual Sense after his cultivation breakthrough.
But this also meant that his current Spiritual Sense was far beyond that of an ordinary practitioner of the ninth layer of Qi Cultivation.
The small episode did not affect Xu Ping’s pleasant mood, and he opened his panel.
[Lifespan: 29/148 years]
[Realm: Seventh Layer Qi Cultivation: 1/100; Third Layer Nourishing Life Skill: 23/100]
[Cultivation Technique: Five Elements Skill Mastery (Seventh Layer): 1/1600]
Seeing the lifespan of up to 148 years, Xu Ping couldn’t help but reveal a smile at the corner of his mouth.
This lifespan rivaled some dynasties from his previous life known for their short-lived rulers.

chapters.title: Chapter 75: Foundation Establishment Pill Recipe
chapters.content:
Chapter 75: Chapter 75: Foundation Establishment Pill Recipe
Moreover, today is not just about breaking through to the seventh layer of Qi Cultivation; more importantly, the Five Elements Skill has finally reached perfection.
Once again, a meticulous realization.
The extremely pure Mana within his body is slowly circulating by itself, not only accelerating cultivation and recovery but also showing faint signs of liquefaction in his dantian.
"This..." Xu Ping was suddenly startled.
Liquid Mana is typically a feature of Foundation Establishment, yet he is only at the seventh layer of Qi Cultivation and already showing signs of liquefaction?
"Once the Taihang Nourishing God Skill and Five Elements Skill both break through to perfection, perhaps both my Spiritual Sense and Mana might undergo transformation."
"At that time, would I even be called a Qi Cultivator with liquid Mana and Divine Sense?" Thinking of this, Xu Ping couldn’t help but feel incredibly excited.
"Calm down, calm down..." He took a few deep breaths to suppress his excitement.
Ultimately, these are matters for the future; now is not the time to get carried away, but to remain grounded.
"Now that I’m at the late-stage Qi Cultivation, I can start practicing Spirit Eye Skill and Protective Spiritual Light." Finally calming down, Xu Ping pondered.
Spirit Eye Skill and Protective Spiritual Light are both first rank upper grade magic, requiring late-stage Qi Cultivation to practice.
Spirit Eye Skill is a type of auxiliary magic, capable of seeing through disguises and enhancing eyesight; whereas Protective Spiritual Light is purely defensive magic.
The former can help him face complex situations, while the latter simply enhances his defensive power.
Given his current strength, learning attack spells is not necessary for the time being.
Xu Ping closed the proficiency panel, stood up, pushed open the bedroom door, and went into the courtyard.
The gentle stream continued to bubble up from the Spiritual Spring, around which over fifty Bloodstopping Grass plants flourished vibrantly.
"The Bloodstopping Grass is almost mature!"
Seeing this scene, Xu Ping felt even more joyful.
He formed a magic technique with his fingers, and moments later, clouds formed with drizzling Spirit Rain.
With the pour of the Spirit Rain, the Bloodstopping Grass grew even more lush and dripping with vitality.
"Once the Bloodstopping Grass is sold, I can plant Spirit Medicine of higher grade." Xu Ping pondered to himself.
In these two months, his Spirit Rain Skill had advanced significantly and was close to reaching perfection.
Once Spirit Rain Skill reaches perfection, he will be a first rank upper grade Spirit Plant gardener.
By then, he will have numerous choices for the Spirit Medicine to plant.
...
...
Six days later.
Xu Ping used Bone Shaping Skill to conceal his aura to the sixth layer of Qi Cultivation and once more headed to Zhang Yan’s pharmacy.
He planned to wait a bit longer before revealing his cultivation level.
As Xu Ping stepped into the room, Zhang Yan cheerfully approached: "Fellow Daoist Xu, the Hundred Flowers Brew is selling exceptionally well, all twenty-something jugs have been sold out."
"Sold out!!"
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping was overjoyed.
He could earn over twenty Spirit Stones per jug, and with all these sold out, he could earn five to six hundred Spirit Stones in total!
And it took less than two months.
It seems Zhang Yan, despite liking to indulge in medicine, is quite reliable!
No wonder he can run such a large pharmacy.
"Fellow Daoist Zhang, your contributions are outstanding." Xu Ping complimented him with a smile.
"It’s mainly because Fellow Daoist Xu’s wine is indeed excellent, I drink a little every day now." Zhang Yan said, his face flushed.
"Is that so?"
"This Hundred Flowers Brew indeed has a good taste." Xu Ping chuckled.
He had also tasted it, finding it indeed better than the average Spirit Wine.
"Yes, yes, especially when paired with the Bliss Pill and Spirit Wine together, the flavor is simply more pleasurable than being immortal!" Zhang Yan said with satisfaction.
Xu Ping was speechless but couldn’t help good-heartedly commenting: "Fellow Daoist Zhang, I’m afraid your body might not hold up doing this."
Zhang Yan was considered his partner at the present stage; if something happened to him, finding another would be rather troublesome.
"Ah, you just don’t understand, life should be enjoyed to the fullest!"
"Besides, your Spirit Wine is nourishing, and the Bliss Pill likewise, combining nourishing with nourishing, how could anything happen? Look at me, I haven’t slept for five or six days yet I’m still as spirited as ever." Zhang Yan stroked his long beard, immensely proud.
"Five or six days without sleep?"
Xu Ping was dumbstruck, his mouth hanging wide open.
This guy seems to want to become immortal??
Whether before crossing over, or after, he had never been so speechless towards anyone before.
...
Fortunately, Xu Ping refrained from advising further; after all, good words hardly persuade the damned.
After dividing the Spirit Stones, he questioned the matter of Foundation Establishment Pill.
Now that he’s at the seventh layer of Qi Cultivation, it’s time to prepare for Foundation Establishment.
The most crucial is the Foundation Establishment Pill.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, only at the sixth layer of Qi Cultivation, already considering the Foundation Establishment Pill?" Zhang Yan eyed Xu Ping curiously but shared what he knew.
"Foundation Establishment Pill is still incredibly precious in Qiu Xuan Immortal City. To obtain it, you either need to prepare materials and find a second-stage Alchemist in the Immortal City, or see if there’s one for auction."
"Prepare materials, auction..."
Xu Ping pondered for a moment before asking, "How many Spirit Stones might be needed to secure a Foundation Establishment Pill at auction?"
"Judging by past prices, typically close to twenty thousand Spirit Stones."
"Twenty thousand Spirit Stones..."
Xu Ping was speechless and choked up; how long would it take him to accumulate such a large amount?
"Then if seeking a second-stage Alchemist to craft Foundation Establishment Pill, what materials are needed?" He asked again.
"See for yourself." Zhang Yan fetched two sheets of old yellow paper from his sleeve.
Xu Ping took them and looked; they were unexpectedly two Foundation Establishment Pill recipes, which shocked him: "Fellow Daoist Zhang, you just handed me these Foundation Establishment Pill recipes??"
"Fellow Daoist Xu, don’t be surprised." Zhang Yan waved his hand, "The circulation of these Foundation Establishment Pill recipes is wide; with some effort, anyone can collect them."
"But the main ingredients and critical rare auxiliary herbs required are strictly controlled by the major clans, never circulated."
"Even if, by sheer luck, you collect it, without a second-stage middle grade Alchemist, it cannot be crafted."
"There aren’t many powers within Yue Country capable of nurturing such an Alchemist."
"So they don’t bother restricting the circulation of Foundation Establishment Pill recipes."
"After all, you would eventually seek them for crafting; if two pills are successfully made, they’d get one for free, if only one, you’d need to pay them quite a significant fee."
"If none are successful, the loss is borne by you; regardless, they don’t lose."
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping understood.
No wonder Zhang Yan handed over the Foundation Establishment Pill recipes so easily.
It seems the recipes themselves aren’t worth much!
However, Xu Ping still read through the recipes carefully.
The materials required were ones he had neither seen nor heard of.
Ultimately, he needed Zhang Yan to explain them one by one.
"Jade Marrow Mushroom, Purple Monkey Flower, Celestial Spirit Fruit..."
"Demon Core, Purple Flower Grass..."
Listening to Zhang Yan’s explanations, Xu Ping felt weighed down.
The main ingredients and important auxiliary herbs like Jade Marrow Mushroom, Purple Monkey Flower, Celestial Spirit Fruit for the first recipe were tightly controlled by major clans, with none for sale, only risking searching in perilous places.
Not to mention Qi Cultivators; even ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivators might not return.

chapters.title: Chapter 76: Perfection of the Taihang Nourishing God Skill, Divine Sense Transformation
chapters.content:
Chapter 76: Chapter 76: Perfection of the Taihang Nourishing God Skill, Divine Sense Transformation
The second Pill formula is relatively simpler, with the Demon Core being the most important component.
However, a Demon Core is only found in Second-stage Middle Grade Demon Beasts with some probability, and for a guaranteed Core, it needs to be a Second-stage Upper Grade Demon Beast.
As for Second-stage Lower Grade Demon Beasts, unless they are extraordinarily gifted, they hardly ever have a Demon Core.
"For Loose Cultivators like us, gathering all the materials for a Foundation Establishment Pill is nearly impossible; some can only resort to Foundation Establishment Spiritual Objects, which are less effective than the Foundation Establishment Pill, but better than nothing."
"Spirit Protection Pill is the most popular; while it has minimal effect on the three trials of Foundation Establishment, it can preserve one’s cultivation and life if Foundation Establishment fails," Zhang Yan added.
"How many Spirit Stones for one?" Xu Ping’s heart was moved, and he asked.
This might be a backup plan. He’s still relatively young, and when he reaches the ninth level of Qi Cultivation, he should have two or three opportunities to attempt Foundation Establishment.
If he truly can’t obtain the Foundation Establishment Pill by then, perhaps he could try the Spirit Protection Pill.
Of course, that’s only if he has no other options.
"About two thousand Spirit Stones each, they’re available for sale in the Immortal City," Zhang Yan replied.
"Two thousand Spirit Stones..." Xu Ping murmured.
The price wasn’t insurmountable; with a little time, he could afford it.
...
After chatting a few more words, Xu Ping handed over this batch’s Hundred Flowers Brew to Zhang Yan and then took his leave to return home.
He was currently at level seven in Qi Cultivation, and there was some time before he reached level nine, so he planned to focus on earning Spirit Stones and cultivating well.
Time continued to pass quietly, and he grew increasingly fond of his days in Qiu Xuan Immortal City.
Every day he concentrated on cultivating, without bothersome social interaction.
The feeling of seeing himself progress step by step was truly captivating.
During this time, the Heavenly Eye Skill and Protective Spiritual Light were successfully studied one after the other.
It must be said, as a First Rank Upper Grade Magic, the Heavenly Eye Skill was quite powerful.
In the casting state, his vision could easily penetrate walls; even the stone ground could be seen through to a depth of half a meter. More amazingly, the spell could automatically adjust the scale of penetration according to his will, allowing him to see what he wanted to see.
Like automatically adjusting focus.
Moreover, even his home’s Array could be partially seen through with the Heavenly Eye Skill.
Although it was far from fully seeing through it, Xu Ping believed that with increasing proficiency, one day he would completely see through the Array.
...
...
Summer gave way to Autumn.
Another two months passed.
This day.
While cultivating the Taihang Nourishing God Skill, Xu Ping seemed different from usual!
Buzz buzz buzz...
Accompanied by the continuous roar within his Sea of Consciousness, his Spiritual Sense seemed to enhance to a certain limit, constantly transforming.
Boom!
Amidst a tremendous roar in his head, Xu Ping felt dizzy, and when he gathered his senses again, he felt like a third ’eye’ had appeared at his brow.
Under this ’eye’, even with his eyes closed, everything within a fifty-foot radius was still clearly visible.
Not only that, but he could also observe himself from different angles.
In his vision, he saw a young man in blue robes sitting cross-legged, eyes slightly closed!
"This is... Divine Sense!!!"
Xu Ping’s face lit up with wild joy, exceedingly excited.
It was said that even an Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator could have their Divine Sense extend twenty feet away from their body, with everything within the range perceptible down to the finest detail!
Though he could currently observe five feet, there was no doubt that this was Divine Sense!!
"Hahaha, the Taihang Nourishing God Skill didn’t disappoint me; reaching Perfection indeed helped me awaken my Divine Sense!!" Xu Ping laughed heartily.
With the Array concealing him, he wasn’t afraid of being heard.
"Now that the Divine Sense trial of the three Foundation Establishment trials is passed, once the Five Elements Skill reaches Perfection and Mana liquefies, the Mana trial will be broken too."
"Only the Physical Body trial remains. Doesn’t that mean that after reaching Perfection at the ninth level of Qi Cultivation, even without taking any other Pills, I will have a thirty or forty percent chance to break through to the Foundation Establishment Stage?"
Of course, attempting Foundation Establishment on his own would mean grave injuries even if he survived, which Xu Ping definitely wouldn’t do.
If he was to attempt Foundation Establishment, he would certainly take a Foundation Establishment Pill to ensure stability.
The wild laughter subsided.
Xu Ping could hardly contain his excitement and left his cultivation room to the small courtyard, eager to observe the world anew with his Divine Sense.
Under the shroud of Divine Sense, everything was crystal clear, even clearer than with the naked eye.
Looking from different perspectives, the once-familiar surroundings seemed incredibly novel.
For instance, watching ’himself’ take step after step forward had an indescribably strange sensation.
He shifted his gaze to the spiritual field.
The Bloodstopping Grass was standing tall and vibrant; the Spiritual Spring trickled, clear as crystal.
"The Bloodstopping Grass has matured!"
Xu Ping opened his eyes and grinned; after several months of careful tending, it was finally ready to be sold for Spirit Stones.
...
...
The next day.
Xu Ping emerged from his home, and a voice came from the opposite courtyard.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, today you finally emerged from your courtyard, what a rare sight."
Xu Ping looked over to see a middle-aged cultivator looking at him with a broad smile.
"Greetings, Fellow Daoist Wang."
Xu Ping greeted back.
The middle-aged cultivator was named Wang Shan and lived next door. He had visited once after Xu Ping moved in to pay respects.
Wang Shan was at the eighth level of Qi Cultivation, made a living by hunting Demon Beasts, and his only hobby was drinking.
After tasting Xu Ping’s Hundred Flowers Brew, he became a devoted fan of the drink.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, I’m out of wine again, could you sell me a few more jars?" Wang Shan came over, eagerly asking.
"I’ve been ready for you, Fellow Daoist!"
Xu Ping smiled, taking a jar of Hundred Flowers Brew from his storage bag and handing it over.
Wang Shan didn’t stand on ceremony, accepting the jar and started drinking heavily.
"Fellow Daoist Xu’s brew is truly refreshing!"
He laughed heartily after downing half a jar in one breath.
"Hahaha, as long as Fellow Daoist likes it!" Xu Ping laughed.
After chatting a few more words and selling three jars to Wang Shan, Xu Ping was about to leave when Wang Shan stopped him.
"Please wait."
Wang Shan leaned in and lowered his voice, "Fellow Daoist Xu, have you any interest in exploring a cultivator’s relic with me?"
"A cultivator’s relic?"
Xu Ping was half skeptical.
But given Qiu Xuan Immortal City’s long history and proximity to the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range, it wasn’t surprising there were cultivator relics nearby.
Xu Ping’s eyes flickered: "Fellow Daoist Wang, with your strong Mana, why not go alone?"
"You may not know, Fellow Daoist, the relic is protected by a hidden Array, weakened over time but still hard to breach quickly, and it risks leaking information. If I seek aid from other strong cultivators, I might not secure my own interests."
"And Fellow Daoist Xu, your cultivation of the seventh level of Qi Cultivation is similar to mine, your character reliable, making you the ideal partner," Wang Shan explained earnestly.
Though Wang Shan seemed genuine, Xu Ping certainly didn’t plan to go.
He was at a pivotal time for advancing his cultivation, and with the income from Hundred Flowers Brew, resources weren’t currently a concern, so there was no need to take risks.
"Does the cultivator relic have Foundation Establishment Spiritual Objects? If it has them, I’ll go." Xu Ping joked.

chapters.title: Chapter 78: Profound Light Array
chapters.content:
Chapter 78: Chapter 78: Profound Light Array
After the two parted ways, Xu Ping, disguised, headed to the commercial district in the center of the inner city.
Given his current proficiency in the Bone Shaping Skill, his disguise was already perfect.
Only Divine Sense or a special Dharma Eye could see through it.
Most of the shops in the inner city are spread out in this area.
In addition to planning to sell array plates, he also intended to sell all the remaining magical artifacts and pills he had.
Currently, Xu Ping had over twenty unused magical artifacts in his possession.
If he tried to sell them like he did before in Dongwu Market, it wouldn’t be appropriate, as there wouldn’t be any suitable candidates, so he’d have to sell them himself.
When he first arrived at Qiu Xuan Immortal City, he was unfamiliar with the environment and didn’t act rashly.
During this period, he became familiar with the environment and learned that there were places in the city specifically for collecting second-hand magical artifacts, where the recycling price was a few percent lower, without questioning the origins of the artifacts.
Essentially, these were places for covertly selling stolen goods.
Qiu Xuan Immortal City had a large flow of people and was mixed with different sorts, inevitably leading to killings and treasure snatching.
The outer city environment was relatively chaotic, and around Qiu Xuan Immortal City, as well as in the perilous Yellow Dragon Mountain Range, countless cultivators died daily.
With many stolen goods, there was naturally a demand. Shops with background would engage in the business of selling stolen goods.
A little half an hour later.
Xu Ping arrived at a shop collecting second-hand magical artifacts.
Here, the shop openly specialized in artifact repair and also collected second-hand artifacts, essentially selling stolen goods.
"What does the guest need?" The shopkeeper asked with a smiling face.
"I have five magical artifacts that I can’t use. Do you collect them?"
Xu Ping took out the artifacts from his storage pouch.
"Collect, of course, we collect them." The shopkeeper glanced at him, showing a knowing smile, "But after all, they are second-hand artifacts, the price is three to five percent lower than normal artifacts."
The shopkeeper was clearly experienced, and in just a moment, identified all the artifacts.
"Two mid-grade, three lower-grade artifacts, no damage, the condition is decent, how about ninety-seven spirit stones?"
"Too low, at least a hundred and one."
Xu Ping was already very skilled in bargaining.
In the end, the two settled on a price of one hundred and two spirit stones.
Although selling at a stall could fetch a higher price, it was less hassle.
Xu Ping swaggered out of the shop, using divine sense to secretly inspect, wary of being targeted.
Though the range of his divine sense was not large, it allowed him to scan the surroundings.
The inner city had decent security but was not absolutely safe.
The city’s arrays could sense the fluctuation of spells, and law enforcement cultivators would arrive promptly.
But if one was in a secluded area, they could easily kill a target, or attack with success, keeping things quiet; theoretically, killing someone and snatching treasures was possible.
...
"No one’s following."
Xu Ping blended into the crowd, noticing nothing unusual.
Four or five magical artifacts weren’t enough to incite murderous intent in the inner city.
Xu Ping found a secluded area, changed his appearance again, and went to another shop that collected second-hand artifacts.
This time, Xu Ping was bolder.
He sold seven artifacts in one go, getting over a hundred spirit stones.
"Still not being targeted?"
Xu Ping blended into the crowd again, smoothly as expected.
Qiu Xuan Immortal City indeed lived up to its name as a haven for loose cultivators!
It was estimated that as long as the treasures weren’t of major provenance, the risk of selling ordinary artifacts was very low.
From this, it was inferred that there were unknown numbers of robber cultivators hiding within the city.
Xu Ping made one last covert sale, selling six more artifacts for a recovery price of over a hundred spirit stones.
Three trips were made today to sell stolen goods, totaling three or four hundred spirit stones, though he lost some, it indeed saved quite a lot of trouble.
Xu Ping changed his appearance again, went to a shop in the commercial district to sell array plates, and bought some array materials as well.
...
....
After restoring his original appearance, Xu Ping leisurely returned home.
After resting for a while, he went to the spiritual field and cast a Spirit Rain Skill.
As the misty spiritual rain fell, the Spirit Storage Flowers in the spiritual field greedily absorbed the rain.
Spirit Storage Flowers are one of the primary materials for refining Spirit Gathering Pills, and their price is not cheap. If they could all mature, it would also be a significant income.
After absorbing the spiritual rain, the Spirit Storage Flowers appeared even more lush, green, and dazzling.
"Growing nicely." Xu Ping remarked, feeling pleased.
After selling all the artifacts today, his reserve of spirit stones had broken through four figures, and having ample spirit stones at hand made him feel secure.
His gaze shifted left, and beside the spiritual spring, in a small pond, a few golden-tailed carp swam joyfully.
This small pond was excavated by Xu Ping, and the golden-tailed carp were also intentionally bred by him.
After staying at home for a long time, he always felt something was missing, so he simply started raising spirit fish.
Undoubtedly, after bringing in the fish, it did improve things quite a bit.
Whenever he felt exhausted from practicing skills or drawing arrays, he’d lie on a chair and watch the spirit fish swim, which turned out to be a very relaxing way.
As he gazed at the golden-tailed carp swimming freely in the pond, Xu Ping’s eyes suddenly lit up with a spiritual glow and stared at them.
But the spiritual glow in his eyes only persisted for a moment before completely dissipating.
"Failed again, this Shocking God Needle is really challenging." Xu Ping sighed slightly.
After awakening his divine sense, he naturally began learning the Shocking God Needle, since mastering it would give him an additional lethal move and trump card.
In an ideal situation, he’d first unleash a Shocking God Needle, and while it may not severely harm them, it could cause dizziness for half a second. With his current speed and swordsmanship, he could definitely slay the enemy with one sword strike during their dizziness.
However, he didn’t know if it was because his current divine sense was too weak or the Shocking God Needle was too hard to learn, but he hadn’t succeeded even once in almost two months.
"Oh well, take it slow. Eventually, there will be a time when I succeed!" Xu Ping shook his head.
His life was stable now, with abundant spirit stones and reliable ways to earn money, so he didn’t need to push himself too hard as he did before.
...
...
As time flowed by.
Over the next year, Xu Ping’s days in Qiu Xuan Immortal City became more stable and leisurely.
Every day was about cultivating, body refining, practicing skills, honing techniques, planting spirit medicine, and raising spirit fish.
The only downside was that he had yet to succeed in learning the Shocking God Needle.
However, his array skills progressed rapidly under the assistance of divine sense, and he learned several new ones in succession.
As a result, his earning speed increased, and his reserve of spirit stones grew larger.
On this particular noon.
The cultivation room.
Xu Ping was focused entirely on sketching an array.
This time, he was sketching a First Rank Mid-grade Array ’Profound Light Array’.
This array has defensive and alert functions and, if sufficiently powered with spirit stones, typical late-stage Qi cultivators couldn’t easily deal with it.
It was quite favored by some small Qi cultivation families and loose cultivators.
The price was also not cheap, requiring at least around a hundred spirit stones.
But this array was extremely challenging, consisting of seventy-two array patterns.
Even with the aid of divine sense, Xu Ping spent half a year barely mastering the sketching of all array patterns.
This was his first attempt at sketching on an array plate.
The pen tip wandered on the array plate, suddenly the plate flickered with spiritual light, appearing to fail, but ultimately under Xu Ping’s hopeful gaze, it gradually gathered its spiritual light.
"Profound Light Array... complete! !!"
Xu Ping couldn’t help breaking into a smile.
Spending over a year to become a First Rank Mid-grade Array Master, the enhancement of divine sense on the myriad skills of cultivation was indeed powerful.

chapters.title: Chapter 79: Entry Level of Shocking God Needle
chapters.content:
Chapter 79: Chapter 79: Entry Level of Shocking God Needle
One month later.
After tidying up his robe, Xu Ping stepped out to the commercial district of the inner city.
After turning several streets, he stopped in front of a three-story building named ’Qiu Xuan Commerce Association.’
It was obvious that ’Qiu Xuan Commerce Association’ was a property of Qiu Xuan Mountain.
Besides the inner city, Qiu Xuan Commerce Association also had a shop in the city center.
The ’Profound Light Array’ he was selling today was high-priced, so it was better to sell it in some major industry.
And in Qiu Xuan Immortal City, the biggest industry was clearly owned by Qiu Xuan Mountain.
A disguised middle-aged Xu Ping entered Qiu Xuan Commerce Association and was slightly taken aback.
A spacious hall that could accommodate dozens of people without feeling crowded, ultra-long counters made of noble red paulownia wood, and seven or eight attendants dressed in uniform green robes, all of which gave off an absolutely grand and impressive feeling.
In the hall, two of these green-robed attendants were explaining something to several luxuriously dressed cultivators.
Within the counters, there were a variety of items, all of which were precious.
At this moment, a person resembling a green-robed attendant approached with a broad smile, saying, "What would this guest like to see? Would you like some help with an introduction? The things in this shop are guaranteed to satisfy all customers!"
"I want to sell a few First Rank Mid-grade arrays. Do you accept them?" Xu Ping said indifferently.
"Yes, of course, we accept them." The green-robed attendant eagerly invited Xu Ping into a quaint, ancient-style small room with a carpet and all the necessities.
After saying ’Please wait a moment, I will fetch our steward,’ he politely exited the room.
After the time it takes to drink half a cup of tea, an elegant middle-aged man entered the room with a smile, saying,
"I am Tian Li, the steward of Qiu Xuan Commerce Association. How should I address you?"
"Li Xuan." Naturally, Xu Ping would not reveal his real name.
"Ah, Fellow Daoist Li, have some tea." Tian Li unhurriedly took out a teacup and poured Xu Ping some hot tea.
"Thank you." Xu Ping took a small sip before setting the teacup down.
"I have a few Profound Light Arrays. What price will you offer for them?" He planned not to waste too much time and directly stated his purpose.
He then took out four array plates engraved with Profound Light Arrays from his storage bag and placed them on the table.
Tian Li picked up an array plate, examined it carefully, and nodded, "Indeed, these are Profound Light Arrays, and the array patterns are clear and undamaged, clearly just recently engraved."
It must be said that Steward Tian had an exceptionally keen eye. A simple examination revealed the array was newly engraved.
"The Profound Light Array is considered to be quite difficult among First Rank Mid-grade arrays. Is this something you engraved, Fellow Daoist?" Tian Li smiled slightly, seemingly asking unintentionally.
Xu Ping said expressionlessly, "Fellow Daoist Tian, you might be overstepping. Just tell me how many Spirit Stones you’ll offer for these four Profound Light Arrays."
Tian Li was not bothered by Xu Ping’s terse tone. He had dealt with countless customers, and those with a greater sense of secrecy than Xu Ping were not rare—he saw several such mysterious customers every day and was long accustomed to it.
"On the market, a single Profound Light Array goes for about one hundred and twenty Spirit Stones. Our association would acquire it for ten or twenty percent less, so for four Profound Light Arrays..."
After pondering for a moment, Tian Li said, "Let’s say four hundred Spirit Stones."
"Agreed."
Xu Ping nodded. The price was fairly reasonable and within his expectations.
"Fellow Daoist, please count the Spirit Stones." Upon hearing this, Tian Li smiled slightly and took out four hundred Spirit Stones from his storage bag, placing them on the table.
With a simple count, Xu Ping knew the number was correct. With a wave of his sleeve, the Spirit Stones on the table disappeared.
"Now that the transaction is complete, I’ll take my leave." He wasted no time in making to leave.
"Fellow Daoist Li, please stay." At this moment, Tian Li called after him.
"Fellow Daoist Tian, is there something else?" Xu Ping became alert.
"There’s no need to be nervous, Fellow Daoist." Tian Li smiled, taking out an invitation from his pocket, "Our Qiu Xuan Commerce Association’s quadrennial small auction will commence in a few months. I hope Fellow Daoist will do us the honor of attending."
Although it’s a small auction, the items are very valuable, and ordinary people can’t even meet the threshold.
The man before him, likely an array master, was indeed worth inviting.
Xu Ping took the invitation, glanced at it, and put it into his storage bag, "If time permits, I will certainly attend."
...
...
Back home.
Xu Ping took out the invitation; it was made of an unknown material, somewhat resembling beast hide, yet also like paper.
He flipped through the invitation, which specified the time and place of the auction.
On the last page, there was also a catalog of items for auction.
Xu Ping glanced over it, the lowest items were of First Rank Upper Grade level, and there were many of Second-stage and above.
"The items are quite good, but unfortunately, they’re of no use to me right now."
After a brief look, Xu Ping casually tossed the invitation back into his storage bag.
He didn’t plan to attend this auction.
He’d rather spend the time cultivating at home.
...
.....
One month later.
In the cultivation chamber.
Xu Ping opened his eyes, joy spreading across his face.
"I’ve finally reached the eighth layer of Qi Cultivation!"
Calculating briefly, it had taken him over a year.
"The pace is getting slower and slower. Reaching the ninth layer might take another two years."
Xu Ping wasn’t anxious. He was still young; even in two years, he’d only be thirty-two.
He remained far from the sixty-year Foundation Establishment limit.
He carefully sensed the changes after his breakthrough.
Apart from Mana increasing by two or three percent, his Divine Sense was also stronger.
Now he could extend it to ten zhang away.
He believed if his cultivation advanced once more, his Divine Sense would continue to strengthen.
By then, the twenty zhang distance of a Foundation Establishment Cultivator wouldn’t be far behind.
Thinking of this, Xu Ping felt even more cheerful.
He left the cultivation chamber and came to the small courtyard, where he saw the golden-tailed carp in the small pond swimming happily and his eyes suddenly sparkled with spiritual light as he glared at them.
In an instant.
The golden-tailed carp, which had been swimming happily, became completely motionless, floating on the water’s surface.
Ding!
[Shocking God Needle experience +1]
"Success!!"
Seeing the system prompt appear, Xu Ping was ecstatic.
After spending over a year, he finally succeeded in entering the Entry Level.
Now he understood why the Shocking God Needle had never been successful.
His Divine Sense was too weak!
The breakthrough in cultivation strengthened his Divine Sense, barely reaching the threshold.
Moreover, after using the Shocking God Needle once, he felt a thread of fatigue creeping into his mind. He realized that if he tried it two or three more times, his Divine Sense would be overly exhausted.
"But at least I have reached Entry Level. As my proficiency increases, even without strong Divine Sense, the power should not be weak!" Xu Ping murmured to himself.
Looking ahead, all the golden-tailed carp in the small pond were belly-up and motionless.
"Uh... could they be dead!" Xu Ping’s expression stiffened.

chapters.title: Chapter 80: Purple Flower Grass
chapters.content:
Chapter 80: Chapter 80: Purple Flower Grass
Xu Ping hurried forward to check.
Fortunately, it was just knocked out and not dead.
Only then did he breathe a sigh of relief.
After raising them for more than a year, there were feelings involved. If they died, he...
Could only roast them all and eat them.
After all, they’re spiritual fish, can’t be wasted.
After half an hour, the gold-tailed koi slowly woke up. They looked around dazedly, obviously not knowing why they had suddenly fainted.
Xu Ping threw some fish food, and they happily started eating, completely putting the incident behind them.
"Really carefree,"
Xu Ping chuckled and resumed practicing the Shocking God Needle.
However, Shocking God Needle consumes a lot of Divine Sense, allowing for only two or three practices a day.
To break through, it might take forever.
"Is there a way to speed up Divine Sense recovery?"
Xu Ping pondered for a moment and suddenly thought of the Taihang Nourishing God Skill.
"Perhaps it might work."
