```
When his Divine Sense was greatly depleted, he tried operating it and indeed found that Taihang Nourishing God Skill could accelerate the recovery of Divine Sense.
It was simply an unexpected delight.
Thus, he could now practice four to five times a day at least.
...
...
Half a month later.
While feeding the fish in the small courtyard, Xu Ping heard the voice of his neighbor Wang Shan from the courtyard gate.
"Is Fellow Daoist Xu home?"
Xu Ping used the Bone Shaping Skill to conceal his cultivation to the seventh level of Qi Cultivation, then opened the courtyard gate.
As soon as the gate opened, he saw Wang Shan’s expression seemed a bit nervous.
"Fellow Daoist Wang, what brings you to me?" Xu Ping asked curiously.
"Come in to talk," Wang Shan glanced around, appearing very cautious and careful.
The two walked into the small courtyard, closed the courtyard gate, and sat down on the stone stools.
"Fellow Daoist Wang, being so mysterious, what’s the matter?" Xu Ping grew even more curious.
"It’s a big deal!"
Wang Shan’s expression remained tense.
After taking a deep breath and organizing his words, he spoke word by word, "I discovered a Purple Flower Grass in the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range."
"What!"
Xu Ping’s heart shook, his face revealing an incredulous expression, "You discovered Purple Flower Grass in the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range!?"
Purple Flower Grass is one of the main ingredients for refining Foundation Establishment Pills.
In the second Foundation Establishment Pill formula, it is a crucial material second only to the Demon Core.
If one could obtain both the Demon Core and Purple Flower Grass, then the remaining auxiliary materials could definitely be gathered with time and Spirit Stones.
He is currently at the eighth level of Qi Cultivation, and should indeed consider Foundation Establishment.
In the Immortal City over the past year or two, he investigated and, just as Zhang Yan said, the main ingredients for Foundation Establishment Pills are tightly controlled by significant forces, not circulating at all.
He was also maintaining his frustration, yet to have Wang Shan discover this, how could he not be astonished?
"Yes, I’m sure it’s Purple Flower Grass." Wang Shan nodded affirmatively.
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping regained composure, his gaze fixed tightly on Wang Shan: "Fellow Daoist Wang, such an important matter, why tell me? Why not go by yourself?"
"I also wanted to go by myself! But the Purple Flower Grass is guarded by a First Rank Upper Grade Demon Beast whose bloodline is extraordinary, and I’m not at all a match for it, so that’s why I’m seeking assistance."
"I’ve been with fellow Daoist for one or two years, and I’ve come to know fellow Daoist’s character, so I’m specifically seeking you." Wang Shan explained.
"Where is the place? How did fellow Daoist find it?" Xu Ping asked expressionlessly.
"Near the inner mountains of the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range, but it’s still at the edge, not yet entering the inner mountains."
"You know, I’m a demon hunter, and once while chasing a demon beast, I accidentally discovered the Purple Flower Grass in the center of a pool," Wang Shan replied.
The Yellow Dragon Mountain Range is divided into core, inner mountains, and outer regions.
The core area is the domain of Third Rank Demon Beasts, the inner mountains are occupied by Second-stage Demon Beasts, and the outer regions are filled with First Rank Demon Beasts, which are also hunting ground for demon hunting teams.
Some say the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range has a fourth part, the most core area, where it’s rumored a Fourth Rank Demon Beast with Dragon Race bloodlines comparable to a great Nascent Soul cultivator resides.
However, these are just rumors yet unverified.
"If Fellow Daoist Xu doesn’t go, I will find someone else, lest others seize the opportunity," Wang Shan urged.
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping suddenly laughed: "Alright, I will venture with fellow Daoist once. Since you saved me last time, you mentioned that encountering Foundation Establishment Spiritual Objects would be worth taking some risks."
"Then it’s settled, we’ll go tomorrow," Wang Shan showed a happy expression.
"No problem," Xu Ping smiled and nodded.
"Then I’ll go prepare first, fellow Daoist should also prepare well, bring more things, as the demon beast’s power cannot be underestimated."
"Rest assured, I’ll prepare thoroughly."
After seeing Wang Shan off, the smile on Xu Ping’s face gradually disappeared: "So eager for me to go out? Then this time, I’ll grant your wish."
If it were for other items, he would be too lazy to venture out, but he was determined to acquire the main ingredients for Foundation Establishment.
Even if the chance is small, it’s worth the journey.
...
...
The next day.
A single-leaf flying boat carried the two from the north gate of Qiu Xuan Immortal City, flying towards the vast and endless Gray Mountains.
Wang Shan piloted the flying boat in the front, Xu Ping sat in the back.
This flying boat was Wang Shan’s means of transportation. The journey was long, and walking would take a substantial amount of time.
Xu Ping looked out at the distant mountain range shrouded in light mist, recalling information about the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range:
The Yellow Dragon Mountain Range is vast and imposing, spanning Wu Country, Wood Country, and Yue Country, with numerous demon beast communities, making it a formidable power in this cultivation domain.
Most of this mountain range is covered by mist year-round, deepening in color from outside to inside, where entering deeper regions becomes increasingly perilous.
Even Foundation Establishment cultivators dare not venture deeply with ease.
...
After more than half an hour.
The flying boat reached the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range’s outer region, the mist growing denser, obstructing sight and allowing visibility only for tens of meters ahead.
Moreover, the Spiritual Qi and mist in this land contain characteristics more suitable for demon beasts to cultivate.
Here, human cultivators feel a sense of inhibition in both cultivation and Mana recovery.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, let’s disembark and proceed on foot."
Wang Shan stored the flying boat, and the two descended to the ground.
"In the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range sky, human cultivator’s Mana fluctuations are like bright beacons in the dark, likely drawing widespread attention from demon beasts, notably flocks!" Wang Shan reminded.
Having had experience in the wilderness, Xu Ping naturally understood the danger.
Some flocks number in the hundreds or thousands, and even if the vast majority are First Rank demon birds, a Foundation Establishment Stage cultivator caught in them will suffer even if not dying.
The two ventured over ten miles into the mountain’s outer region.
Occasionally sighting early-stage and mid-stage First Rank demon beasts.
Human cultivator’s traces occasionally appeared, mostly Loose Cultivators.
Some came in groups of three to five as hunting teams.
"Fellow Daoist Xu should be cautious, as sometimes humans in the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range can be more dangerous than demon beasts," Wang Shan led Xu Ping, deliberately avoiding people and demon beasts.
Clearly Wang Shan was very familiar with this area, encountering no danger along the way.
Xu Ping followed him, eyes gleaming, occasionally glancing back, his face showing a faintly mocking expression.
...
Forty miles deeper into the mountain range, Wang Shan suddenly stopped.
"Why did Fellow Daoist Wang stop?" Xu Ping asked knowingly.
Wang Shan suddenly turned his head, his gaze fixed intently on Xu Ping: "Why aren’t you poisoned yet?"
"How about you bring out the fellow Daoist you’ve been in touch with, so I may tell you both at once?" Xu Ping replied with a faintly mocking tone.

chapters.title: Chapter 81: Tier 2 Demon Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 81: Chapter 81: Tier 2 Demon Beast
Upon hearing this, Wang Shan’s face changed dramatically: "You... you know?"
Before he could finish his words, several cold glints tore through the mist like lightning, aiming straight for Xu Ping’s forehead, chest, and lower body.
The piercing cold light came howling with such speed that even ordinary Qi Refinement Realm cultivators couldn’t react in time.
However, under Xu Ping’s Divine Sense, none of this could escape his perception.
A flash of light appeared in his hand, and the Blood-Drinking Sword appeared in his palm.
With a flicker of the sword light, Xu Ping thrust forward vigorously, and a burst of Sword Qi erupted like thunder, instantly shattering the incoming hidden weapons with a crash.
"An Upper Grade Magical Sword?"
A surprised exclamation echoed from within the mist.
Moments later, a man in the ninth stage of Qi Refinement emerged from the thick fog, greed gleaming in his eyes as he stared intently at the Blood-Drinking Sword in Xu Ping’s hand: "I didn’t expect you to be wealthier than I imagined."
Just this one Upper Grade Magical Sword was worth at least a thousand Spirit Stones.
"Tell me, is the Purple Flower Grass real or not? I’ll spare your lives." Xu Ping held his sword in one hand, his expression indifferent, yet his tone carried an invisible threat.
"Hahaha, have you gone mad?" Wang Shan couldn’t help but laugh, "You’re only at the seventh stage of Qi Refinement, and you think having an Upper Grade Magical Sword means you can confront us?"
"Ah, it seems I’ll have to completely defeat you before you’ll speak the truth." Xu Ping shook his head.
"You..." Wang Shan intended to continue mocking him, but saw Xu Ping suddenly vanish before his eyes.
By the time he realized what was happening, a strand of Sword Qi erupted before him, and intense pain surged from his chest.
In disbelief, he looked down to find blood gushing out, and a foot-long wound had appeared on his chest.
"Pfft!"
Wang Shan opened his mouth to speak, but a mouthful of blood spurted out, and he collapsed heavily to the ground in a daze.
"What..." The man not far away was shocked, his eyes full of amazement, as he stared at Xu Ping who had reappeared.
He hadn’t seen how Xu Ping had made his move; the speed was terrifying.
It was almost comparable to a Second-stage Body Cultivator!
"Fellow Daoist, it’s all a misunderstanding..." Although the man spoke of a misunderstanding, he had already summoned his defensive magical artifacts and talismans.
"Hmph!"
Xu Ping snorted coldly, his eyes suddenly lighting up as he glared at him.
The middle-aged man felt a chill, and then his Sea of Consciousness shook, causing his view to momentarily go black, and his artifacts and talismans fell to the ground.
Although he quickly regained consciousness, it was too late.
Xu Ping approached in an instant, and with a flash of sword light, he severely injured him, knocking him unconscious.
Xu Ping gathered up the scattered talismans and artifacts into his storage, then grabbed each man’s collar with one hand and swiftly moved to a secluded corner.
After walking a few hundred meters, he entered a cave.
Inside the cave, Xu Ping collected all the artifacts, talismans, and storage bags from the two, then took out a Silence Talisman. With a gentle shake, it turned into a colorless light shield that enveloped them.
Xu Ping slapped Wang Shan awake.
Slap! Slap! Slap!
Wang Shan groaned as he gradually regained consciousness, feeling excruciating pain in his chest and cheeks.
"You!" Seeing Xu Ping, he was horrified and wanted to resist, but the wound on his chest drained all his strength, making it impossible to even cast a simple magic spell, let alone resist.
"Is the Purple Flower Grass real?" Xu Ping asked, expressionless and cold.
Seeing Xu Ping’s emotionless gaze and murderous intent, Wang Shan was flustered and stammered, "It’s... it’s real!"
’It’s real!’
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping’s eyes lit up, and he was overjoyed, realizing this trip was worth it.
"Where is it?" He suppressed his joy and pressed the question further.
"I didn’t lie about the location, but the Purple Flower Grass is in the territory of a Second-stage Demon Beast." Perhaps out of fear that Xu Ping would kill him, Wang Shan poured out everything he knew.
’In the territory of a Second-stage Demon Beast?’
Xu Ping felt his heart sink and frowned deeply.
This wouldn’t be easy. Demon Beasts were tough and hard to deal with.
"Besides you two, who else knows?" Xu Ping continued to press.
"N-no one else." Wang Shan stammered in reply.
In truth, there had been others, but they were already killed by the two of them.
"As long as you don’t kill me, I’ll take you to it," Wang Shan pleaded, trembling.
Expressionless, Xu Ping stepped behind him and delivered a heavy punch to the back of his head.
Wang Shan, powerless to resist, promptly collapsed.
Then Xu Ping roused the middle-aged man, interrogated him carefully, and received the same answers.
"A Second-stage Demon Beast!"
Xu Ping felt a heaviness in his heart, finding it troublesome.
He was only at the eighth stage of Qi Refinement, and slaying a Second-stage Demon Beast would be extremely difficult.
Fortunately, he heard from the two that it was a Second-stage Lower Grade Demon Beast, which brought him some relief.
If it had been a Second-stage Mid-grade or higher Demon Beast, he’d definitely give up.
"This needs careful preparation," Xu Ping thought silently, knowing that even though it was a Second-stage Lower Grade Demon Beast, he couldn’t underestimate it.
"But first, I need to determine the exact location of the Second-stage Demon Beast," Xu Ping thought as he looked at the unconscious pair.
...
...
A dense forest shrouded in mist.
Wang Shan and the middle-aged man were pale-faced and trembling as they led the way, Xu Ping following slowly with eyes as cold as ice.
After walking for about half an hour, Wang Shan and the middle-aged man stopped and pointed toward a lush gorge: "It’s just ahead, in that canyon."
"Keep moving," Xu Ping commanded icily, showing no mercy.
He wouldn’t leave until the existence of the Purple Flower Grass was confirmed.
Wang Shan and the middle-aged man exchanged a look, then gritted their teeth and continued forward.
Passing through the vine-covered cliffs, the view suddenly opened up. A few steps further, they saw a huge pool several hundred meters wide.
Surrounded by densely packed towering trees.
On a small island in the center of the pool, a Purple Flower Grass swayed in the wind.
"Purple Flower Grass!!"
Xu Ping’s eyes gleamed sharply, instantly recognizing it as the Purple Flower Grass he had been longing for!
"We... we’ve brought you here, will... will you let us go?" Wang Shan asked tremulously, his eyes filled with deep hope and a desperate longing to live.
"Where is the Second-stage Demon Beast?" Xu Ping asked calmly.
"In the pool," Wang Shan replied.
"I see!"
Xu Ping nodded, suddenly leaping forward at lightning speed, and with two swift kicks, he sent the two men flying into the pool.
"Ah! Ah!"
With two screams, Wang Shan and the middle-aged man crashed heavily into the pool.
A few moments later.
The water’s surface shook violently, demonic power surged, and an angry "hiss" emanated from beneath.
Amidst the turbulent waves, a giant serpent about six or seven zhang long, with a crystal-white body, broke through the water’s surface and swallowed the two men whole.
"Snake Demon!"
Xu Ping’s eyes were grave as he concealed his aura and quickly vanished into the mist.

chapters.title: Chapter 82: Auction House
chapters.content:
Chapter 82: Chapter 82: Auction House
Two days later.
Xu Ping returned home safely.
He sat on a stone bench, his gaze fixed on the golden-tailed carp joyfully swimming in the small pond, while his mind was deep in thought.
The existence of that snake demon was like a thorn stuck in his heart: "To hunt that snake demon flawlessly, with my current strength, I’m still stretched thin."
"I must use external resources!" he thought to himself.
"Talismans, arrays, puppets, poison..."
Various possibilities flashed through his mind, but after comprehensive consideration, it seemed only talismans and arrays could meet the current needs.
However, to be of help, they must at least be second-stage items.
"This won’t be easy!" Xu Ping felt troubled.
Second-stage items were already precious in the Immortal City; finding a second-stage talisman might be possible, but a second-stage array would be much harder.
"Wait..."
Suddenly, his eyes lit up as if he remembered something. He hurriedly searched his storage bag and finally found the long-forgotten invitation in a corner.
He took out the invitation, turned to the last page, and browsed the auction catalog.
Feeling a surge of excitement, he quickly locked onto his target: "Second-stage lower grade array - Profound Celestial Trapping Array!"
The Profound Celestial Trapping Array is primarily focused on trapping and locking. Though not as powerful as a killing array, it’s very suitable for dealing with demon beasts.
"It seems I must attend this auction!" Xu Ping decided inwardly.
"I just don’t know how many spirit stones the Profound Celestial Trapping Array will cost," a flash of worry crossed Xu Ping’s mind. If he didn’t have enough spirit stones, it would be a real disappointment.
On the market, upper grade magical artifacts generally cost around one thousand two to three hundred spirit stones, with special artifacts like swords costing even more.
As for arrays, they definitely are more expensive than upper grade magical artifacts.
"I currently have around two thousand spirit stones, and I haven’t checked the contents of Wang Shan and Lin Guang’s storage bags yet."
He took out Wang Shan and Lin Guang’s storage bags and counted carefully.
There were four or five mid-grade magical artifacts, about seven or eight lower grade magical artifacts, four hundred spirit stones, and several talismans.
Roughly calculating, he had over a thousand spirit stones.
"A total of four thousand spirit stones, this should be enough, and maybe I can spare some to buy one or two second-stage talismans." He felt a bit relieved.
"However, before the auction, I need to deal with these magical artifacts." He thought to himself, already experienced in handling such items.
Five days later.
Xu Ping, in disguise, went to the magical artifact shop to sell off the loot.
Without attracting any attention, he exchanged all the magical artifacts and talismans for spirit stones.
With a fortune in hand, he eagerly anticipated the upcoming auction.
....
Over a month later, the auction finally arrived.
Qiu Xuan Commerce Association’s auction venue was located in the hall of a temple at the center of the city.
The auction was highly exclusive; without an invitation, one could not enter.
Of course, the rules weren’t completely rigid: if one could verify five hundred spirit stones or possess items of higher value, they could also participate.
This excluded some poor loose cultivators who merely wanted to join in the excitement.
Xu Ping disguised himself, wore a cloak, and arrived at the magnificent temple as per the address. Two men in black stood impressively beside the main door, carrying spirit knife magical artifacts on their backs, eyeing everyone warily.
"Invitation!"
Seeing Xu Ping approach, one of them spoke with a somewhat indifferent tone.
Xu Ping, calm and composed, took the invitation out of his storage bag and handed it to the speaking man in black.
After confirming the invitation was valid, the man in black stepped aside, allowing passage without further action.
Without hesitation, Xu Ping walked inside.
The door led to an extremely spacious hall, with a red carpet laid over the corridors. Rows of chairs were arranged, each separated by approximately a yard, seemingly in some order.
The second and third floors of the hall were composed of private rooms, each with a small window overlooking the situation in the hall.
At the very end of the hall stood a platform about five or six yards high, with countless jade stones embedded in the surrounding walls, emitting a soft light and making the hall bright.
After passing through the door, Xu Ping entered this hall and noticed there were several doors like this around the hall.
Gradually, cultivators began to emerge from behind the doors, suggesting multiple entrances to the auction.
At this moment, a few cultivators sat scattered on the chairs in the hall, many concealing their faces and quietly sitting either meditating or looking around. None of them conversed, clearly unwilling to reveal their identities.
It looked like Xu Ping arrived relatively early; there were still many seats available in the hall.
Xu Ping inconspicuously walked to the back row, casually picking a chair to sit down.
After about half an hour, the seats gradually filled up, and more figures appeared, roughly estimating about four to five hundred cultivators.
Most were late-stage Qi Refinement cultivators, with mid-stage Qi Refinement cultivators being quite rare.
He boldly guessed that Foundation Establishment Stage cultivators were seated upstairs in the private rooms.
Three loud chimes resounded throughout the hall, marking the official start of the underground auction.
"Boom"
Several doors closed with a thunderous sound.
Xu Ping focused his gaze and saw the doors tightly shut, feeling slightly uneasy.
But upon thinking, this was the Immortal City’s auction; surely no one would dare cause trouble here, and he relaxed.
Buzz!
A gentle beam of light descended from the sky, enveloping the front of the auction stage, making it as bright as day.
"Thank you, fellow Daoists, for your support. I am Lin Guang, the host of today’s auction," said a plump middle-aged man with a secular official’s appearance, bowing to the left and right from above and below the stage.
"Let me first explain the rules of this auction: threatening with divine sense, malicious bidding, and private collusion... Any behavior disrupting the normal auction process will lead to expulsion from the auction, or even having one’s cultivation abolished for severe cases."
"All bids are based on lower grade spirit stones. If spirit stones are insufficient, other items may be used for payment."
Lin Guang’s voice was originally gentle, but carried a trace of assertiveness at the end, followed by two flashes of late-stage Foundation Establishment pressure from the second floor, sensed by everyone and then vanishing.
Xu Ping listened carefully to the auction rules, sitting silently.
The cultivators in the hall remained calm upon hearing this; disrupting an auction in the Immortal City would be courting death.
"Enough idle chatter. The first auction item is the mid-grade magical artifact ’Blazing Fire Mother and Child Sword’..."
Lin Guang said, taking out a small hammer and a small bell from his storage bag and lightly tapping the bell with the hammer.
As he finished, a beautiful maid walked up with a jade tray.
"This artifact was forged using a second-stage earth fire over seven days and nights, confirmed by this auction as a mid-grade magical artifact. Its power slightly surpasses ordinary mid-grade artifacts, approaching the level of upper-grade artifacts."

chapters.title: Chapter 83: Auction (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 83: Chapter 83: Auction (Part 2)
"Friends who cultivate Fire Attribute techniques, do not miss this opportunity." Lin Guang’s voice resonated in the auction hall, stirring the crowd’s anticipation.
"Starting bid is one hundred and fifty Spirit Stones, each increment must not be less than ten Spirit Stones."
Cultivators in the late Qi Refining Realm in the hall, their eyes gleaming: "Mid-grade Magical Artifact! A set of Magical Artifacts!"
"I bid one hundred and sixty!"
"One hundred and seventy!"
The bidding voices came one after another, echoing from all corners of the venue.
Xu Ping sat silently in the last row, his face calm, holding an Upper Grade Magic Sword.
Mid-grade Magical Artifacts are of little help to him, even if they are high-quality ones.
In the end, this set of high-quality mid-grade Magical Artifacts was claimed by a late-stage Qi Cultivator for two hundred and sixty Spirit Stones.
"Next, please welcome the second auction item."
Lin Guang waved his hand, the maiden holding the Flaming Mother-Son Sword retreated, and another beautiful maiden walked up carrying a jade tray.
"A Beauty Pill."
"I presume everyone has heard of the renowned Beauty Pill, yes, it may not preserve youth forever, but it can greatly slow the aging of appearance, maintaining a youthful and beautiful look."
"Whether for personal use or as a gift for a cherished female cultivator, it is definitely worth the value."
"Beauty Pill starts at two hundred Spirit Stones, each increment must not be less than twenty Spirit Stones!"
Lin Guang eagerly stirred the cultivators’ emotions, he shouted loudly.
"Two hundred and twenty Spirit Stones!"
"Two hundred and forty Spirit Stones!"
As soon as the words were spoken, excited women’s voices rose incessantly from the hall, and even several private rooms on the second floor joined in.
This Beauty Pill, although not enhancing Mana, can greatly delay the aging of appearance, is one of the most coveted Pills for female cultivators.
But this Beauty Pill, with its precious materials, though only a First Rank Pill, requires Second-stage Spirit Medicine as the main ingredient, and is difficult to concoct, thus its price is steep, beyond what most Qi Refinement female cultivators can afford.
Amidst the successive bidding voices, the price of the Beauty Pill quickly surpassed the four hundred mark.
Realize that the Beauty Pill doesn’t increase Mana nor enhance cultivation, it merely delays aging of appearance, truly surprising why these female cultivators are so frenzied.
Xu Ping watched this scene, feeling somewhat speechless.
In the end, this Beauty Pill was auctioned at four hundred and eighty Spirit Stones in a second-floor private room.
As the auction continued, one treasured item after another was claimed at high prices, the atmosphere at the venue gradually becoming lively.
Xu Ping came this time mainly for the Profound Celestial Trapping Array, adhering to a principle of low profile, even when encountering items that intrigued him, he chose not to bid.
However, the successive treasures at the auction opened his eyes, the wealth of some cultivators indeed left him astonished.
Finally, when it came to the sixteenth auction item, it was the turn of the Profound Celestial Trapping Array.
"Profound Celestial Trapping Array, Second-stage Lower Grade Array, mainly for trapping, mainly for locking, even if a Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator is trapped, they cannot break the Array easily."
"Moreover, it is easy to operate, activating with Mid-grade Spirit Stones."
"Alright, less talk, the starting bid is one thousand five hundred Spirit Stones, each increment must not be less than thirty Spirit Stones!"
Lin Guang, looking excited, announced loudly.
"One thousand five hundred and fifty Spirit Stones."
The words fell, and immediately a long-haired cultivator in a blue robe loudly bid, directly adding fifty Spirit Stones.
"One thousand five hundred and eighty Spirit Stones"
"One thousand six hundred and thirty Spirit Stones"
Xu Ping, seeing it was finally the turn of the Profound Celestial Trapping Array, perked up and sat up straight, but was not eager to bid.
"One thousand six hundred and seventy Spirit Stones"
"One thousand six hundred and eighty Spirit Stones"
The bidding for the Profound Celestial Trapping Array rose continuously, but as the price neared two thousand Spirit Stones, the bidding voices rapidly decreased.
Only two people were left competing, both from the second-floor private rooms.
At this point, the price was already very high, enough to buy two average Upper Grade Magical Artifacts.
Yet, the two competing in the private rooms showed no signs of urgency.
Still calmly raising the bids.
"Two thousand three hundred Spirit Stones."
It was then that Xu Ping’s voice emerged with a bid, immediately raising the price by one hundred Spirit Stones, his voice calm yet resolute.
Wearing a bamboo hat and black veil, with Bone Shaping Skill silently working in his body, showing no Spiritual Power fluctuation, making it hard to gauge depth.
"Interesting, two thousand three hundred and fifty Spirit Stones." came an elderly voice from the private room.
At this moment, the other private room competing fell silent, evidently giving up.
"Two thousand four hundred and fifty Spirit Stones!"
Xu Ping remained unfazed, aggressively raising the bid, clearly determined to win.
For a moment, many in the hall were uncertain and puzzled, unable to ascertain Xu Ping’s identity.
A Qi Cultivator daring to bid against a Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
"Old Li, don’t lose to a Qi Cultivator," jested a voice from another private room, obviously acquainted with the person in the opposing room.
"Hmph, two thousand five hundred Spirit Stones..." The elderly voice now carried a hint of anger.
"Two thousand six hundred Spirit Stones!"
Xu Ping spared no mercy, imposing and forceful, adding directly one hundred Spirit Stones, demonstrating his resolve to succeed.
"Excellent!"
Inside the room, an old man with a youthful face showed traces of anger. Pressured by a youngling in the Qi Refining Realm, his face indeed felt embarrassed.
Especially since there were acquaintances in the other rooms!
If not for being in Immortal City, he would really want to test this youngling’s weight.
At this moment, the steady middle-aged man behind him saw the elder seemed wanting to continue bidding, quickly stepped forward to advise: "Elder, it’s not worthwhile for the Profound Celestial Trapping Array, we need to reserve Spirit Stones for that other item."
"Nonsense! I’ve lived long enough to be over impulsive actions, just some face." The old man’s face returned to calm.
Back when he was young and hot-blooded, he might act recklessly, but that youthful passion had long been spent.
Seeing no response from the room, Lin Guang’s face lit up, with a smile, he asked: "Anyone else wants to bid? Second-stage Array, a rare find indeed!"
Two thousand six hundred Spirit Stones, it was beyond market price.
With no answer after calling three times, he smiled: "Congratulations to this friend for acquiring the Profound Celestial Trapping Array, you may proceed to the side hall for settlement."
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping felt fully relieved internally.
His pressure was actually significant, not as calm as it appeared on the surface.
For the Profound Celestial Trapping Array antagonizing Foundation Establishment Cultivators, if outside Immortal City, he would certainly weigh the consequences, but in the city, even a Foundation Establishment Cultivator dare not act overly presumptuously.
Xu Ping rose to head to the side hall, paid the Spirit Stones, and acquired the Profound Celestial Trapping Array Plate, fulfilling his purpose for coming here, alas unable to leave midway, he returned to his seat.
Meanwhile, many in the hall examined and discussed ceaselessly.
"Who is this extraordinary person?"
"Actually outbid a Foundation Establishment Cultivator?"
"His courage and wealth are truly remarkable!"

chapters.title: Chapter 84: Auction Finale
chapters.content:
Chapter 84: Chapter 84: Auction Finale
"It seems everyone is in high spirits. Let’s move on to the next item." Lin Guang smiled slightly, drawing everyone’s attention back to himself.
The auction proceeded smoothly, the atmosphere growing ever tenser and more intense.
Subsequent auction items included cultivation techniques, inheritances of the hundred arts of immortality, exquisite talismans, upper-grade magical artifacts, and more.
Dazzling and continuous excitement.
During this time, Xu Ping spent several hundred spirit stones to buy two second-stage lower-grade talismans, one offensive and one defensive.
However, in the second-floor private box, the atmosphere was uncommonly restrained, with only a few people placing bids while the rest remained silent, clearly waiting for something more valuable.
"Could there really be something good at this small auction?" Xu Ping’s eyes flickered with a trace of doubt.
The invitation Tian Li gave him included a catalogue, but it was only a partial list, and he didn’t know what else there might be.
Obviously, the distinguished guests in the second-floor private box knew more secrets.
As the auction continued, the people in the hall gradually caught on, and even their bidding enthusiasm began to wane.
But Lin Guang was unconcerned, as the auction was nearing its end, with only the final centerpiece item remaining.
Representatives from various forces perked up, focusing on this auction’s centerpiece, especially those in the second-floor private boxes.
"Honored guests, the moment you’ve been waiting for has come. The final auction item, the centerpiece of this event—Foundation Establishment Pill!"
Lin Guang’s voice rose in excitement, like a whirlwind sweeping through the crowd.
Following his announcement, two Foundation Establishment cultivators personally escorted the jade bottle containing the Foundation Establishment Pill onto the tray.
One was an old man of ancient age, the other a middle-aged man clad in heavy armor, exuding a murderous aura.
"What!!"
"Foundation Establishment Pill!!"
Lin Guang’s words were like a bombshell, instantly causing an uproar in the hall.
Everyone’s eyes were glued to the jade bottle on the tray, some even with bloodshot eyes of madness, as if not for the two Foundation Establishment cultivators guarding it, they would have already rushed forward to grab it.
Even Xu Ping’s heart couldn’t help but race, his fists clenched, his heart surging with excitement.
A Foundation Establishment Pill!
He had spent so much effort, time, and spirit stones, even risking to hunt second-stage demon beasts, only to gather materials to make a Foundation Establishment Pill.
Now that an actual Foundation Establishment Pill was right in front of him, how could one not be thrilled?
Compared to the hall’s fervent atmosphere, the second-floor private box was calm, clearly well aware of such matters.
"There’s no need for me to elaborate on the significance of a Foundation Establishment Pill. This pill not only stabilizes blood and meridians but also boosts mana and fosters divine sense. It increases the success rate of Foundation Establishment by 30%, and failure won’t result in death by meridian rupture..."
Lin Guang’s voice echoed in the auction house, causing countless people in the hall to unconsciously hold their breath, filled with desire.
In the hall, people panted heavily, tempted by the lure of the Foundation Establishment Pill. If not for the imposing presence of late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivators, they would have long lost their sanity.
Even the people in the second floor could hardly contain themselves: "Alright, everyone knows about the Foundation Establishment Pill. Let’s just get on with the auction."
Hearing this, Lin Guang smiled slightly, seeing that the atmosphere was well set. He declared loudly, "This Foundation Establishment Pill starts at ten thousand spirit stones, with a minimum increase of five hundred each bid."
The starting price was like a bucket of cold water splashed on the crowd, instantly bringing their enthusiasm to a chilling low, the hall falling into silence.
Xu Ping was the same, helplessly sighing in his heart: ’Even with a Foundation Establishment Pill up for auction, it’s not really related to me.’
Too expensive!
"Ten thousand five hundred spirit stones!!"
"Eleven thousand spirit stones!"
"Eleven thousand five hundred spirit stones!"
...
In contrast to the hall’s chill, the second-floor private boxes grew lively, the price racing upward like a wild horse, spirit stones seeming of no value to them.
Just hearing the constant escalation past ten thousand spirit stones caused some in the hall to feel dizzy.
As the price climbed to eighteen thousand spirit stones, some in the private boxes could no longer hold on and had to reluctantly give up.
They were not yet at the point of exhausting their family fortunes for a Foundation Establishment Pill.
As the price neared twenty thousand, the number of bidders dwindled, leaving only two parties in the end.
"Nineteen thousand five hundred spirit stones! Any higher bids?"
"Twenty thousand spirit stones!" A resolute yet aged voice rang out as soon as the words were spoken.
Xu Ping recognized the voice as the Foundation Establishment cultivator who had competed with him for the Profound Celestial Trapping Array.
"These Foundation Establishment cultivators are indeed wealthy!" he thought to himself.
A full twenty thousand spirit stones; his room couldn’t contain them all.
"Twenty thousand five hundred spirit stones!" Another voice echoed from the second-floor private box, the atmosphere turning instantly volatile.
"Now the real show begins." The forces in the private boxes started to watch with interest.
"Old Li is already advanced in age, and his family lacks a new generation at the Foundation Establishment. He is bound to win this Foundation Establishment Pill, while his rival, the Ning family, certainly won’t let him easily obtain it without losses."
The two continued to outbid each other until the Foundation Establishment Pill reached a staggering price.
Twenty-two thousand five hundred spirit stones!
"Old Li, do you really have that many spirit stones? Can you produce them?" a mocking voice arose.
"Humph, no need for you to worry about that. If you have the spirit stones, continue bidding; if not, shut up." Old Li snorted coldly, his tone incredibly firm.
"You’d best pray this Foundation Establishment Pill will yield another Foundation Establishment member in your family," his opponent sneered before falling silent.
"Twenty-two thousand five hundred spirit stones for the first time...Such a Foundation Establishment Pill is rare indeed; miss this, and who knows when the next auction will be!" Lin Guang scanned the room, his tone enthusiastic.
However, the entire hall remained silent.
With that, Lin Guang didn’t delay further, quickly calling, "Foundation Establishment Pill sold to the guest at VIP Stand Seven."
Under the watchful eyes of various forces, an elder with a youthful face and white hair, accompanied by a middle-aged cultivator at Qi Cultivation’s ninth layer, proceeded to the side hall for the transaction.
And with the sale of this Foundation Establishment Pill, the auction gradually drew to a close.
"Thank you all for coming to support this event. This auction is now concluded, and we shall meet again next time!"
"Now, I kindly ask all of you to exit the venue in an orderly manner."
Lin Guang’s plump face was all smiles, presumably extremely satisfied with the auction’s result, with the profits likely being substantial.
He clasped his hands towards the crowd, speaking with a wide grin.
As his words fell, the surrounding doors slowly opened, and the attendees began to leave, with two men in black maintaining order on either side of the door.
Without lingering further, Xu Ping slowly stood up and exited the auction hall through the same door he had entered.

chapters.title: Chapter 85: Hunting the Snake Demon
chapters.content:
Chapter 85: Chapter 85: Hunting the Snake Demon
On the way home.
The cool breeze gently brushed by, and Xu Ping’s restless heart gradually calmed down. His thoughts began to swirl, planning his next actions.
"Now that the Profound Celestial Trapping Array is in hand, hunting the demon is also on the agenda!" he mused to himself.
Although the canyon was remote, if discovered, it would inevitably cause unnecessary trouble, so he must act quickly.
But before that, he still needed to prepare something.
Two days later.
Xu Ping went to the Puppet Tower and acquired two sets of First Rank Upper Grade Puppets.
These puppets had no offensive power, but their thick skin made them barely suitable for restraining the Snake Demon.
With the array, talismans, and puppets ready, the plan to hunt the demon could commence.
...
Three days later.
Xu Ping boarded Wang Shan’s Spiritual Boat and left Qiu Xuan Immortal City, heading to the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range.
The fog in the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range remained thick, swirling incessantly, as if concealing terrifying creatures within.
Without hesitation, Xu Ping ventured in.
After more than half an hour.
He put away the Flying Boat and landed on the ground.
Crack!
Xu Ping stepped on fallen branches and leaves, producing a crisp sound.
He surveyed his surroundings.
Towering trees stood like silent sentinels, with thick trunks and lush foliage. Sunlight barely pierced through the thick fog, casting weak beams that seemed to be swallowed by this mysterious veil.
The fog permeated the air, moist and heavy, carrying a faint rotten scent that was suffocating.
From memory, he hurried towards a direction heading to the canyon.
Despite being cautious along the way, he was still targeted by a giant wolf demon, but fortunately, it was just a First Rank Demon Beast and didn’t cause him much trouble.
...
Three hours later, Xu Ping arrived once again at the lair of a Second-stage Demon Beast.
Through a wall of vines, a large pond came into view, with Purple Flower Grass swaying with the wind on the island in the center.
"It’s still there!"
A glimmer flashed in his eyes, and he breathed a sigh of relief.
If it had been picked, all the effort would have been in vain.
He took out the Profound Celestial Trapping Array Plate from his storage bag.
These plates were three feet wide, dark purple throughout, with densely packed array patterns interwoven to form a special array diagram.
Next, Xu Ping took out four Mid-grade Spirit Stones and inserted them into the array plate.
"Activate!"
Xu Ping struck a spell into the array plate.
Rumble!
In the next moment, streams of azure spiritual light appeared from the Array Flag, radiating intense light!
Buzz!!
A layer of spiritual light shield instantly expanded hundreds to thousands of times, enveloping the entire canyon, a vast spiritual pressure intimidating all directions.
A moment later.
"Hiss!!!"
The calm water surface suddenly became turbulent, demonic power stirred, and angry hisses came from beneath the waters.
Apparently, the commotion from the array caught the Snake Demon’s attention.
In an instant, a giant snake about six to seven yards long, its entire body crystal white, broke through the water surface and charged out.
Whoosh!
Amidst water spraying everywhere, the Snake Demon let out an angry hiss, dark green eyes glinting coldly, staring deadly at Xu Ping.
"Trap!"
Xu Ping softly uttered a word, pinched a magic technique, and the array plate lit up brilliantly.
Buzz!
Suddenly, several massive chains of spiritual light appeared in the sky, intertwining, and wrapped towards the Snake Demon.
Bang!
The Snake Demon bellowed with rage, flipping its body like an earth dragon, flinging the chains off.
Witnessing this scene, Xu Ping remained impassive, immediately activating a Second-stage Talisman.
Suddenly, the temperature around dropped sharply.
A vortex of freezing air nearly ten feet wide, accompanied by a blizzard of ice and snow, bombarded the Snake Demon.
Second-stage Lower Grade Talisman, Ice Soul Talisman!
The Snake Demon was encased in a layer of snow-white frost, its movements rigid, and even a large portion of the water surface was frozen into ice!
The Ice Soul Talisman had low lethality but strong control.
The Snake Demon erupted with demonic power, flashes of white crystal patterns on its body, struggling fiercely, and the frost condensing on its serpent body shattered inch by inch.
"Trap!"
Xu Ping once again manipulated the array to restrain the Snake Demon.
In the sky, numerous massive chains of spiritual light tightly coiled around the restricted Snake Demon.
"Slash!"
Seizing the moment the beast was trapped, Xu Ping wielded his sword with one hand, unleashing his mana.
Rumble!
With a burst of sword energy accompanied by thunderous roars, it slashed towards the Snake Demon.
Boom!
The Snake Demon’s demonic power erupted fully, managing to break free from the chains, its tail trailing a ghostly shadow, attempting to dodge.
But the speed of the sword energy was too fast, slicing through with a sharp gleam, leaving a foot-long bloody gash on the serpent body.
"Hiss!!!"
The Snake Demon was utterly enraged, spitting a dazzling white beam straight at Xu Ping.
Xu Ping’s face was grim, hurriedly slapping his storage bag, deploying two puppets to shield him, then activated a Second-stage defensive talisman, forming a protective shield around him.
Puff! Bang!
The puppets in front of Xu Ping were pierced by the dazzling beam.
The large, heavily armored puppets began to corrode extensively on the surface instantly, rotting. It’s hard to imagine the outcome if it hit a fleshly body.
After breaking through the Heavy Armor Puppet, the beam’s power was significantly reduced, hitting the Second-stage shield with sizzling sounds and thick smoke, but ultimately, it blocked the remaining beam.
"That was close!"
Xu Ping was dripping with cold sweat; without the puppets to block, even the Second-stage Talisman might not have held up.
This Snake Demon was probably already approaching a Second-stage Middle Grade Demon Beast!
"Trap!"
Xu Ping was also getting ruthless, pushing the array to its limit, regardless of the damage it might incur to the array.
Buzz!!
The array plate’s spiritual light was so dazzling that it was hard to open one’s eyes. In the sky, an enormous spiritual power cage formed instantly, enveloping the Snake Demon.
The Snake Demon darted around like lightning, trying to escape this power.
"You can’t escape!" Xu Ping’s heart grew resolute, his palm gave a mighty wave, the array plate’s spiritual light intensified abruptly, and the chains lunged at the Snake Demon like living creatures, trying to completely immobilize it.
"Hiss!!!" The Snake Demon let out an angry hiss, its eyes glowed with fierce light, powerful demonic power surged from its body, attempting to tear apart the chains of spiritual light.
"Hmm!"
Xu Ping let out a cold snort, his eyes suddenly emitted spiritual light, glaring at it.
The Snake Demon immediately felt a chill sweeping over, its vision darkened suddenly, and its struggling movements froze.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, the gigantic spiritual power cage overwhelmed and firmly trapped the Snake Demon.
"Hiss!!"
The Snake Demon snapped awake, its demonic power surged incessantly, attempting to break the cage binding it.
Crackling...
Under the fierce struggles of the Snake Demon, the sound of the metal breaking in the spiritual light cage echoed.
Seeing the Snake Demon was about to break free, Xu Ping would certainly not give it this chance.
"Die!!"
Xu Ping’s eyes were icy, gripping his sword tightly, gathering all his spiritual power, Sword Qi Thunder Sound bursting to the limit, slashing towards the Snake Demon.
Rumbling!!
Like the descent of the Thunder God, the sword energy turned into a brilliant light, tearing through the air, heading straight for the Snake Demon.
At this moment, the Snake Demon was trapped by the array, unable to dodge at all.
"Hiss—"
It sensed the deadly threat, letting out a despairing hiss, trying to struggle, but it was already too late.

chapters.title: Chapter 86: Final Kill
chapters.content:
Chapter 86: Chapter 86: Final Kill
Sword Qi sliced through like lightning, directly piercing the heart of the Snake Demon and instantly exploding with dazzling brilliance.
"Boom!" A loud bang resounded as the Snake Demon’s body was instantly torn apart, blood splattering everywhere.
"Hiss!"
Despite the severe injuries, the Snake Demon continued to struggle, though its aura grew increasingly weaker.
"Its vitality is truly strong!"
Xu Ping’s face tightened, delivering several more sword strikes, finally leaving the Snake Demon lifeless, its blood-soaked corpse curling on the icy ground.
"Phew! Finally, it’s over!"
Xu Ping exhaled deeply. Despite thorough preparations, he nearly met disaster.
Defeating a Second-stage Demon Beast in the Qi Refining Realm was incredibly challenging, but thankfully, the outcome was ultimately positive.
Gazing at the Snake Demon’s corpse, Xu Ping’s eyes gleamed with excitement: "I wonder if this Second-stage Snake Demon has a Demon Core. If it does, the main ingredient for the Foundation Establishment Pill will be gathered."
"Perhaps it has, considering how formidable this Snake Demon is; it must be quite gifted!"
With such anticipation, Xu Ping used the Blood-Drinking Sword, slicing open a large bloody hole in the Snake Demon’s abdomen, and then carefully searched inch by inch with his Divine Sense.
"Nothing!"
After thoroughly searching several times without any findings, a trace of disappointment washed over Xu Ping’s heart.
Indeed, the fickle goddess of fortune never favors him.
"Never mind, regardless, successfully hunting a Second-stage Demon Beast, obtaining the Purple Flower Grass, and the Second-stage Demon Beast’s corpse are worth quite a few Spirit Stones."
Xu Ping gathered his thoughts and approached the Snake Demon’s corpse, storing the six or seven-zhang-long body in the Storage Ring, as ordinary storage bags couldn’t contain its large size.
"Finally, the Purple Flower Grass!" Xu Ping eagerly eyed the small island in the water pool’s center.
Despite the fierce battle between him and the snake, the battlefield was far enough from the island to avoid affecting it.
Xu Ping couldn’t wait to tread across the water, reaching the island, and knelt down to carefully observe the Purple Flower Grass.
The Purple Flower Grass emitted a dark purple glow, its five petals resembling exquisite silk.
At such proximity, Xu Ping clearly felt the Spiritual Power and vitality contained within the small petals.
"Secure it!"
Xu Ping carefully picked the Purple Flower Grass and placed it into the prepared jade box.
Once picked, the Purple Flower Grass must be stored in a specially made jade box, or its medicinal power would gradually dissipate over time.
"Phew!"
After securing the Purple Flower Grass, Xu Ping touched the non-existent sweat on his forehead, feeling thoroughly relaxed.
"It’s time to leave!"
With the items in hand, there’s no reason to linger here.
Xu Ping performed a magic technique, and the spiritual light from the array plate floating beside him visibly descended until it completely disappeared.
The spiritual light shield covering the entire canyon vanished instantly.
"This Profound Celestial Trapping Array is quite handy, able to conceal movements and trap enemies."
"The only drawback... is the excessive expenditure!"
Upon inspecting the array plate, Xu Ping discovered that in just that short while, the four Mid-grade Spirit Stones within had nearly consumed entirely.
"It’s really costly!" Xu Ping lamented painfully.
Four Mid-grade Spirit Stones equal four hundred Lower Grade Spirit Stones!
Just to sell the Profound Light Array would take three to four of them!
To deal with this Second-stage Snake Demon, thousands of Spirit Stones were spent, truly a victory bought with Spirit Stones.
Fortunately, the Second-stage Snake Demon’s corpse is quite valuable and can barely reclaim some losses.
Xu Ping packed away the array plate, gently tapped his foot, and leaped five or six meters forward, heading out of the canyon.
His figure quickly disappeared into a dense fog.
...
...
Xu Ping ran tens of miles continuously within the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range until completely exiting it, then boarded the Flying Boat and headed for Qiu Xuan Immortal City.
Several hours later, Xu Ping arrived at his doorstep, covered in dust.
He took out the token to open the array protecting his abode, crossing the small courtyard and entering the house, where he collapsed into a chair.
The intense fight and the long hours on the road left Xu Ping exhausted once he relaxed.
He used a Cleaning Talisman to cleanse his body before lying down on the bed and falling into a deep sleep.
He slept for six straight hours, awakening refreshed the next day as dawn approached.
"Gurgle gurgle!"
Having barely eaten throughout the day, his stomach began to growl hungrily.
Heading to the kitchen, Xu Ping cut some snake demon meat from the Storage Bag and steamed it in the pot.
Truly, I’ve never tasted Second-stage Demon Beast flesh before, wondering how it tastes.
After half an hour, the Second-stage Demon Beast flesh seemed well-cooked.
Xu Ping started feasting heartily.
Second-stage Demon Beast flesh is chewier than ordinary demon beast flesh, offering a unique texture, but its most significant advantage is the Spiritual Qi it contains, incomparable to anything else.
If one could eat Second-stage Demon Beast flesh daily, it would facilitate cultivation at least comparable to consuming pills but without the burden of Pill Poison.
It’s essentially a superior substitute for common pills.
Many offspring of significant factions consume Second-stage Demon Beast flesh from a young age to cultivate.
For Xu Ping at present, the Second-stage Demon Beast flesh holds modest value, far inferior to the potency of powerful pills.
It’s fine to sample a taste, but retaining it remains unnecessary; he plans to sell the Second-stage Demon Beast flesh to recover some losses.
"This Second-stage Demon Beast must weigh at least three thousand pounds or more. I’m also unsure how Second-stage Demon Beast flesh sells, but the price should be substantial enough to help recover significantly."
"I’ll sell it in a few days!"
...
...
Seven days later.
Xu Ping, disguised as a burly man, arrived once more at the entrance of the Qiu Xuan Commerce Association.
Upon entering, a servant in a blue robe immediately approached: "Fellow Daoist..."
"I’m here to sell Demon Beast flesh!"
Xu Ping’s voix was hoarse, and his manner coarse and full of Evil Qi!
"Apologies, fellow Daoist, we don’t procure Demon Beast flesh..." Despite Xu Ping’s rough demeanor, the blue-robed servant remained exceedingly polite.
"Not even Second-stage Demon Beast flesh?"
"Second-stage Demon Beast flesh??" The servant was stunned, lost for words, "Fellow Daoist, is this some jest?"
Second-stage Demon Beast flesh is scarce in the market, how did this cultivator of Qi Refining Realm eighth level acquire it?
"Do I look like I’m joking?" Xu Ping’s tone carried dissatisfaction.
"I’m terribly sorry... this is above my decision-making authority. Allow me to take you to see our steward." The servant quickly apologized after understanding and personally led Xu Ping to the VIP room on the second floor.
The furnishings upstairs differed from the hall below, not only much smaller but also adorned with antique tables and chairs, arranged with elegant simplicity, comfort, and ease.
Most surprisingly, in the room’s corner sat an exquisite incense burner, with a stick of aromatic incense slowly burning within, filling the room with a faint sandalwood fragrance.
Steward Tian Li, holding an ancient book in his hand, stood in the room, reading aloud.
"This Steward Tian Li seems more like a scholar than a cultivator," Xu Ping mused silently.
Once Xu Ping arrived, Tian Li leisurely closed the book, while the blue-robed servant accompanying Xu Ping hurriedly approached and whispered a few words in his ear.
Tian Li’s eyes widened with a hint of shock but quickly managed to hide it.

chapters.title: Chapter 87: Selling Stage 2 Snake Demon Meat
chapters.content:
Chapter 87: Chapter 87: Selling Stage 2 Snake Demon Meat
Tian Li stepped forward with a smile and said, "Does this Daoist friend wish to sell second-stage demon beast flesh? I am Tian Li, the steward of Qiu Xuan Commerce Association. May I take a look first?"
"Alright!"
Xu Ping nodded, then tapped his storage pouch and placed a large piece of prepared snake demon flesh on the table.
Seeing this piece of demon beast flesh, brimming with Spiritual Qi and quite extraordinary, Tian Li was already halfway convinced, though he still needed to verify it carefully.
First, he formed a spell and cast a magic spell to test for poison.
Then, he took out a bronze mirror and shone it on the demon beast flesh.
Buzz!
On the surface of the bronze mirror, a strong blue glow appeared.
"Second-stage lower grade demon beast flesh!" Tian Li nodded and said.
Seeing Xu Ping’s puzzlement, he explained immediately, "This is a magical artifact used exclusively for identifying demon beast flesh in this building. The color represents the rank; white is first rank Qi Refinement level, while blue indicates a second-stage demon beast."
"The number of circles represents the quality. One circle is lower grade, two circles mid-grade..."
"I see!" Xu Ping nodded.
This magical artifact is quite useful!
"I wonder how much second-stage demon beast flesh you have? Our commerce association will surely give you a satisfactory reward." Confirming that it was second-stage demon beast flesh, Tian Li’s attitude became more enthusiastic.
Second-stage demon beast flesh is considered a scarce resource even in an Immortal City; it’s definitely never hard to sell.
"A few hundred pounds!" Xu Ping tapped the storage pouch again, and several more large pieces of prepared snake demon flesh were piled on the table.
Tian Li checked them one by one, confirming they were all the same kind of second-stage demon beast flesh, his smile growing even wider:
"According to the market price, second-stage lower grade demon beast flesh is purchased for one Spirit Stone per pound!"
"In total, there are four hundred and fifty-one pounds here. How about I give you four hundred and fifty-one Spirit Stones?"
’One Spirit Stone per pound? This second-stage demon beast flesh is quite expensive,’ Xu Ping thought to himself upon hearing this.
Ordinary first-stage demon beast flesh can be bought in two to three dozen pounds for a single Spirit Stone, whereas second-stage requires a whole Spirit Stone for just one pound, making it twenty to thirty times more expensive.
’This is about one-sixth of the flesh, which means, if I sell all this second-stage demon beast flesh, I can earn nearly three thousand Spirit Stones.’ Xu Ping did a quick mental calculation of the total price, feeling quite pleased.
This would almost cover all the expenses of hunting the demon beasts!
Plus, he got a Purple Flower Grass for free!
This is a major profit!
"Alright, sold." Despite his inner excitement, Xu Ping still calmly nodded.
"Pleasure doing business!"
...
After the transaction was completed, Tian Li courteously escorted Xu Ping out the door: "Take care, and if you have any more second-stage demon beast flesh in the future, don’t forget to come to our commerce association."
"These second-stage demon beast flesh pieces were acquired by sheer luck." Xu Ping shook his head and disappeared into the crowd.
The price of second-stage demon beast flesh is immense, so he definitely couldn’t sell it all to just one place.
...
"No one is following."
As Xu Ping merged into the crowd, he didn’t notice anything unusual.
He found a secluded spot, changed his appearance, and went to another large shop.
After going to multiple places, spending a full two days, Xu Ping finally managed to handle all the second-stage demon beast flesh he had.
"This time, I’ve made a big profit!" Xu Ping was in a very good mood.
He managed to sell the second-stage demon beast flesh for a total of two thousand nine hundred fifty-three Spirit Stones, recovering the money spent on arrays and talismans.
He only lost those two puppets, but he got the Purple Flower Grass!
This small loss is negligible!
...
...
At home.
Sitting on a stone stool in the small courtyard, Xu Ping took a blissful sip of tea brewed with Spiritual Spring water.
Making money always puts one in a good mood!
"Now, with the Purple Flower Grass, I’m almost at the ninth layer of Qi Cultivation. It’s time to gather the remaining materials for refining a Foundation Establishment Pill." Xu Ping thought to himself.
"However, everything else is fine, but the Demon Core is a bit tricky!" He couldn’t help but frown.
"To hunt a second-stage lower grade snake demon, I went all out, prepared thoroughly, and almost capsized. If I were to hunt a second-stage middle-grade demon beast, mutual destruction would be an optimistic outcome; the far more likely result is my demise."
"Even if I do manage to kill a second-stage middle-grade demon beast by luck, there’s no guarantee it will have a Demon Core!"
"I’d need to hunt several just to be sure!"
Thinking of this, Xu Ping was immediately troubled.
There’s no denying that, with his current strength, obtaining a Demon Core is still too difficult!
"I can only hope that once I reach the ninth layer of Qi Cultivation and the Five Elements Skill reaches perfection, and the Spiritual Qi liquefies, my power will see a surge."
"However, this is still not enough; it’s best if I become a second-stage Body Cultivator as well to ensure the highest success rate." Xu Ping thought to himself.
"By then, with the ninth layer of Qi Cultivation, liquefied Spiritual Qi, and second-stage Body Refining, combined with Sword Qi Thunder Sound, my combat power should reach a very high level. With the array, even second-stage middle-grade demon beasts would not be impossible to slay."
Having sorted through his combat strength, Xu Ping felt slightly more relaxed.
If he truly reaches such combat prowess, planning for a Demon Core would not be out of the question.
He opened his proficiency panel.
[Realm: Eighth Layer of Qi Cultivation: 17/100; Nourishing Life Skill Third Layer: 91/100]
[Cultivation Technique: Five Elements Skill Achieved (Eighth Layer): 1245/1600]
"There’s still time until the ninth layer of Qi Cultivation, but Five Elements Skill is nearly perfect, it will take about two more months. Training the second-stage Body Refining Technique can also be put on the agenda now."
His Nourishing Life Skill proficiency had already reached ninety-one, certainly meeting the conditions for cultivating a second-stage Body Refining Technique, but he currently didn’t have a second-stage Body Refining Technique.
"I have enough Spirit Stones now, so there’s no worry about not having a second-stage Body Refining Technique."
On this point, Xu Ping was not worried; the Immortal City didn’t lack second-stage Body Refining Techniques, or even regular cultivation techniques, although those were quite basic.
If he wanted a better cultivation technique, he would generally only find it at auction.
"Should I wait for the auction?" He hesitated slightly, thinking that he had time and didn’t need to rush.
If he had the choice, he certainly wanted to train a better Body Refining Technique.
"Wait a moment..."
Suddenly, Xu Ping’s eyes lit up as he recalled a Body Refining Technique he obtained among the spoils from defeating the Demon Cultivator.
He carefully searched through his storage ring.
Soon, a black leather scroll appeared in his hand.
He opened the black leather scroll, and four large characters came into view: Blood Soul Body Refining.
This was a demonic path Body Refining Technique.
Blood Soul Body Refining had four layers.
The first layer, second-stage lower grade Body Refining, requires the essence blood from a hundred late-stage Qi Refinement cultivators and one Foundation Establishment cultivator as the main ingredient, supplemented with other Spirit Medicines, bathing to train for four months before achieving.
The second layer, second-stage middle-grade Body Refining, requires the essence blood from two hundred late-stage Qi Refiners, two Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators, and one Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator as the main ingredient, supplemented with other Spirit Medicines, bathing to train for two years.
The third layer, second-stage upper-grade Body Refining, requires doubling the essence blood on top of the existing base and also needs the essence blood of one Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
As for the final layer, it is even more terrifying; it requires a Golden Core cultivator’s essence blood.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 88: Fivefold Cultivation Perfected, Mana Liquefaction
chapters.content:
Chapter 88: Chapter 88: Fivefold Cultivation Perfected, Mana Liquefaction
The cultivation techniques of demonic cultivation often imply cruelty and bloodshed, but they also symbolize unparalleled power.
Blood Soul Body Refinement is no exception.
Once mastered, its speed, strength, and defensive power far exceed that of ordinary body refining techniques, and it even comes with a powerful skill: Blood Demon True Form.
"This Blood Soul Body Refinement is quite impressive!" Xu Ping nodded slightly after reading carefully, feeling secretly delighted.
Great power and not time-consuming, this is exactly what he needs.
Of course, he naturally wouldn’t use the blood essence of cultivators to cultivate; the records of Blood Soul Body Refinement mention that the blood essence of demon beasts can also replace that of cultivators.
The Immortal City naturally does not lack demon beast blood essence.
Xu Ping continued to read and found that the blood essence of a late-stage Qi Cultivation cultivator could still be substituted with ordinary first-rank upper-grade demon beast blood essence.
However, the blood essence of Foundation Establishment cultivators requires specific second-stage ape-type demon beasts to substitute.
"Ape-type second-stage demon beasts?"
Xu Ping felt a sense of difficulty; the blood essence of second-stage demon beasts is precious, and it requires specific ape-type demon beasts, making it even harder.
"Let’s keep looking, maybe we might actually find it. If we really can’t find it, then I’ll just buy another second-stage body refining technique in the Immortal City." Xu Ping comforted himself since he had plenty of time and wasn’t in a rush.
...
Two days later, Xu Ping visited various shops, searching for second-stage ape-type blood essence but to no avail.
He could only ask the shopkeepers and managers to keep an eye out for him.
As for ordinary blood essence, he was too lazy to collect it; if he ultimately didn’t find the second-stage ape-type blood essence, all this essence would be wasted.
...
Time passed, two months later.
Inside the cultivation room.
Xu Ping sat cross-legged on a cushion, surrounded by spiritual qi like a thin mist; his mind immersed in a state of cultivation, seemingly united with heaven and earth.
At a certain moment!
Whoosh!
Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi surged into his body like a tide; meanwhile, the spiritual power in his body spun faster and faster, and the spiritual pressure increased, making his meridians bear an immense pressure, and even his body seemed about to explode.
Internal and external pressure.
Xu Ping never imagined that breaking through to perfection in the Five Elements Skill would be so painful.
In fact, he didn’t know that it was fortunate he was a first-rank upper-grade Body Refining Cultivator; otherwise, he would have been burst to death by this terrifying spiritual pressure.
The first hurdle of Foundation Establishment: Blood and Qi Crossing.
It’s a process of transforming and cleansing the body.
Only in this way can the strength of the body and the toughness of the meridians withstand the spiritual pressure of infusing the body.
However, the breakthrough to perfection in the Five Elements Skill let Xu Ping skip the first hurdle and go directly to the second—Mana Liquefaction.
This would undoubtedly exert tremendous pressure on his body, meridians, and dantian.
In the midst of pain, Xu Ping had a sudden insight, his divine sense introspected, entering the sea of qi in his dantian.
With the aid of his divine sense, the initially violent mana became much more docile, and the extremely dense mist-like mana was continuously compressed, compressed...
Drip! Drip!
The sound of water dripping was heard by Xu Ping after an unknown amount of time.
The next moment, he introspected his own sea of qi in the dantian and saw a drop of liquid mana falling like raindrops.
One drop, two drops, three drops.
All the gaseous mana in his dantian had turned into three drops of liquid mana, at which point the external heaven and earth spiritual qi had ceased being absorbed, finally stopping slowly.
"Phew!"
Xu Ping exhaled a long breath, a surge of wild joy filling his heart, "Liquid mana... has formed!!"
He opened his eyes, and two brilliant beams emerged, reaching a foot long before gradually dissipating.
He touched his own face and hands, a slight smile appearing at the corner of his mouth.
The mana liquefaction, which only Foundation Establishment cultivators possess, he achieved at the eighth level of Qi Cultivation!
This utterly surpassed others’ knowledge!
"Huh? Six days have already passed outside?" Xu Ping keenly perceived the change in time, and was startled.
He thought it had only been a few hours, but unexpectedly, six days had passed.
"No wonder there’s a saying about a hundred days for Foundation Establishment, it might really take a hundred days for it." Xu Ping thought to himself.
"Gurgle... Gurgle..."
At this moment, Xu Ping’s stomach sounded a thunderous growl.
"So hungry!!"
He hadn’t practiced fasting yet, and after not eating or drinking for six days, his eyes turned red from hunger.
He quickly took out the remaining demon beast jerky and devoured it with large gulps of water.
It took eating dozens of pounds of demon beast meat before he felt relieved.
"It seems when establishing Foundation in the future, I need to prepare some Fasting Pills." Xu Ping thought to himself, troubled.
The Foundation Establishment time will only be longer, although not life-threatening due to hunger, it wouldn’t be a joke if hunger caused Foundation Establishment failure.
After eating and drinking his fill.
Xu Ping couldn’t wait to go to the training room to test the power of his liquid mana.
He stood in the room and took out the upper-grade Blood-Drinking Sword.
In the past, when he infused it with mana, he could wield the Blood-Drinking Sword smoothly, but it always felt strenuous as if lifting a heavy object.
But now, with a drop of liquid mana infused, it immediately refined the Blood-Drinking Sword thoroughly.
Buzz buzz!
The Blood-Drinking Sword roared, suspended three feet off the ground, the air at the tip of the blade distorted and blurred, seemingly swallowing Sword Qi, exuding intense fluctuations.
"As expected, only the liquid mana of Foundation Establishment cultivators is best suited to activate an upper-grade magic sword!"
Xu Ping mused upon seeing this.
Although he wanted to try the swordsmanship, he gave up.
The previous swordsmanship was strong enough; now with liquid mana activating the upper-grade magic sword, the attack power could surely reach the Foundation Establishment level.
Even with the Array’s assistance, his small room couldn’t bear it.
"Let’s test the power of magic instead."
The power of magic would undoubtedly be much smaller, and observing it could determine precisely how much the liquid mana can amplify its power.
Xu Ping put away the Blood-Drinking Sword and initiated the magic technique.
"Heh!"
With a light shout, the liquid mana flowed, and a thunderbolt shot out from his palm.
Boom!!
With a loud bang, fragments flew, and the training room shook violently. Even the Array enveloping the entire room began to quiver.
But ultimately, the Array remained stable.
"This..."
Xu Ping stared dumbfounded at the scene before him; the once solid training room was blasted into a large hole, the surroundings charred black.
He never imagined that using liquid mana to activate a first-rank magic technique would be so powerful, the attack power at least reaching the threshold of Foundation Establishment.
It’s conceivable that if he used liquid mana to activate the Blood-Drinking Sword and then unleashed Sword Qi Thunder Sound, the attack power wouldn’t be inferior to some mid-stage Foundation Establishment cultivators.
After the initial shock, a wave of wild joy surged in Xu Ping’s heart.
This strength combined with the Array and other methods means even second-stage middle-grade demon beasts are not impossible to contend with.
"I have both liquid mana and divine sense; although not as strong as a true Foundation Establishment cultivator, I’m ultimately on the same level."
...
....
In the following days, Xu Ping continued to adjust to his liquid mana.
The output was much stronger, making his actions somewhat uncontrolled.
He needs more practice.

chapters.title: Chapter 89: Yin Qi Pearl
chapters.content:
Chapter 89: Chapter 89: Yin Qi Pearl
Half a month later.
Xu Ping was quietly cultivating in the training room. After breaking through the Five Elements Skill perfectly, it not only brought liquid Mana to him but also increased his cultivation speed.
This also meant that he was getting closer to the ninth stage of Qi Cultivation.
At this moment, the Sound Transmission Talisman in his bosom suddenly flashed, interrupting his cultivation.
Xu Ping frowned slightly, took out the Sound Transmission Talisman, and activated it with Mana.
"Fellow Daoist Li, come over for a chat, you have news regarding the second-stage ape blood essence."
A charming and seductive female voice transmitted.
The Sound Transmission Talisman came from Ruan Yumeng, a steward of the Seeking Trade Fair.
"News about the second-stage ape blood essence?" Xu Ping’s eyes lit up. After waiting for so long, finally, there was news.
After using the Bone Shaping Skill to change his appearance, he set off for the Seeking Trade Fair.
...
...
The Seeking Trade Fair is a large trade fair where cultivators can post information or offer items for consignment or purchase.
If items are highly valued, the personnel at the Seeking Trade Fair will also personally help keep an eye out for you.
Of course, the price is certainly not cheap.
About half an hour later.
Xu Ping, disguised as a middle-aged man, arrived at the entrance of the Seeking Trade Fair.
As soon as he stepped inside, he met the steward Ruan Yumeng.
Her eyebrows were like mountains and her eyes like water, as alluring as peach and plum blossoms, wearing a palace-style gauze dress with a slit at the skirt revealing her snow-white, slender legs.
Beneath the thin gauze skirt, her exquisite curves were faintly visible.
If a common man were under such a beautifying effect, it’s likely he’d be overwhelmed with excitement.
"Fellow Daoist Ruan, is there news on the second-stage ape blood essence that I wanted?" Xu Ping asked calmly.
"Yes." Ruan Yumeng nodded, "However, the other party doesn’t want Spirit Stones; they want Yin Qi Pearls."
"Yin Qi Pearls? What are these?" Xu Ping asked with a frown, as he had never heard of this name.
"Yin Qi Pearls are items from evil spirits, similar to Demon Cores in demon beasts. However, only a small part of evil spirits possess them, making them exceptionally rare, so it’s normal for Fellow Daoist not to have heard of them...." Ruan Yumeng explained.
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping was taken aback.
Yin Qi Pearls? Items from evil spirits?
Could it be?
"Although the other party specified they wanted Yin Qi Pearls, and these pearls are exceedingly rare, I called both of you here to see if we could negotiate a trade for something else. The other Fellow Daoist hasn’t arrived yet, Fellow Daoist Li, you..."
Ruan Yumeng hadn’t finished speaking when Xu Ping interrupted: "Fellow Daoist Ruan, could you see if this is a Yin Qi Pearl?"
He handed over a crystal pearl emitting a silver-white glow to Ruan Yumeng.
Ruan Yumeng was slightly startled before carefully taking the crystal pearl to inspect it.
She then took out a transparent Jade Pendant and brought it close to the crystal pearl.
Instantly, the Jade Pendant became dim.
Witnessing this scene, she nodded affirmatively: "Yes, this is a Yin Qi Pearl."
"That’s good!"
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping was overjoyed; he hadn’t expected the pearl he obtained after exterminating ’Old Sun’ to be so precious.
’Old Sun has indeed given me quite a lot; first, he let me sell the Exorcism Talisman for a fortune, then gave me this precious Yin Qi Pearl. It seems appropriate to offer him some paper money during festivals.’ He thought to himself with great sentiment.
"Fellow Daoist Li even possesses such a precious item as a Yin Qi Pearl; it seems he is not an ordinary person."
Ruan Yumeng’s eyes glittered like a serene wave as she stepped closer to Xu Ping and extended an arm resembling a jade lotus, placing the Yin Qi Pearl in Xu Ping’s palm.
A delicate and lasting fragrance emanated from this beautiful lady, stirring desire.
"Just fortunate to have obtained it." Xu Ping kept a calm face as he securely stored the Yin Qi Pearl.
"May I ask Fellow Daoist Ruan what is the use of this Yin Qi Pearl?" He asked with a clasped fist.
Ruan Yumeng looked at Xu Ping with a lingering gaze and then explained: "This Yin Qi Pearl is a special material that can be used for both cultivation and Artifact Refining."
Used for cultivation and Artifact Refining?
Indeed, it is quite rare, but for him, it would be completely useless. Using it to exchange for the second-stage ape blood essence would be entirely worthwhile.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Ruan, for the information," Xu Ping said with clasped hands.
"No need for courtesy, Fellow Daoist Xu. Since the other party has not yet arrived, why not go to the private room for some tea?" Ruan Yumeng suggested with a smile.
"Sounds good...." Xu Ping’s words were interrupted as a handsome man with sword-like eyebrows and stars-like eyes walked into the trading venue.
"Fellow Daoist Ruan, you called me here because there’s news about the Yin Qi Pearl?" asked the handsome man to Ruan Yumeng.
"Yes." Ruan Yumeng smiled and nodded.
"This is Li Xuan, Fellow Daoist Li possesses a Yin Qi Pearl, and this is Jiang Tian, Fellow Daoist Jiang." She introduced the two.
"Fellow Daoist Jiang!"
"Fellow Daoist Li!"
The two exchanged polite greetings.
At this moment, Xu Ping felt a subtle intrusion of Divine Sense.
Xu Ping was immediately shocked; he instinctively wanted to activate the Shocking God Needle to counterattack but managed to suppress the impulse.
Inside, his Bone Shaping Skill quietly operated.
With his current Mana, operating the perfected Bone Shaping Skill, even the Divine Sense of a Foundation Establishment Cultivator would uncover no flaw.
This subtle Divine Sense quickly swept over without noticing anything unusual and then retreated.
"This... Jiang Tian seems off; disguised as a Qi Cultivator, he’s actually a Foundation Establishment Cultivator." Xu Ping’s heart sank, for the Divine Sense he felt earlier was far more powerful than his own, confirming the presence of a Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
Why would this Foundation Establishment Cultivator disguise himself as a Qi Cultivator and go to great lengths to seek a Yin Qi Pearl?
Although Xu Ping appeared calm outwardly, his thoughts were tumultuous.
"Why not discuss the details in a private room?" Ruan Yumeng suggested with a smile.
"Sounds good." Jiang Tian nodded.
Xu Ping hesitated briefly but agreed; regardless, he needed to obtain the blood essence first.
The two followed Ruan Yumeng into a classical room.
As soon as they sat down, Jiang Tian eagerly asked: "Fellow Daoist Li, could you show me your Yin Qi Pearl?"
"No problem, but could Fellow Daoist Jiang also show the second-stage ape blood essence?" Xu Ping nodded, since the other party wants to act, he might as well play along.
As long as the transaction proceeds smoothly.
"Fine!"
He handed Xu Ping a Jade Bottle, while Xu Ping gave her the Yin Qi Pearl.
"Fellow Daoist Jiang, which type of ape blood essence is this?" Xu Ping queried upon receiving the Jade Bottle.
"Celestial Spirit Ape," Jiang Tian replied.
