"Fellow Daoist Ruan, could you assist in verifying this for me?" Xu Ping requested, as he did not know how to assess the blood essence himself, so he turned to Ruan Yumeng for help.
"Certainly!" Ruan Yumeng agreed with a nod.
She took out a copper mirror and reflected it upon the blood essence inside the Jade Bottle.
A illusory image of a white-haired, golden-capped ape appeared in the copper mirror.
"Indeed, it’s the blood essence of a second-stage lower grade demon beast, the Celestial Spirit Ape," Ruan Yumeng affirmed.
At this moment, Jiang Tian also verified the Yin Qi Pearl: "A genuine Yin Qi Pearl."
"Then may our cooperation be successful!"
Xu Ping smiled and clasped his hands.
"May our cooperation be successful!"
The other party returned the gesture.
...
...
After the transaction was complete, Xu Ping quickly left the trade fair.
He had no desire to linger any moment longer with Jiang Tian.
However, he wasn’t interested in probing into whatever exactly this Foundation Establishment Cultivator intended to do.
After acquiring the blood essence, Xu Ping didn’t use it immediately.
Instead, he went to several places to inspect if the blood essence contained anything else.
Better safe than sorry.
Especially considering the owner of the blood essence was a Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
Fortunately, after thorough inspections at various locations, it was confirmed the blood essence contained no issues.
Xu Ping also felt relieved.

chapters.title: Chapter 90: Alchemist Du
chapters.content:
Chapter 90: Chapter 90: Alchemist Du
Seven days later.
Xu Ping took off his clothes and sat in a medicinal tub filled with a red liquid, operating the "Blood Soul Body Refining" skill.
As the technique circulated, steam rose, and his skin emitted a faint crimson and blue crystal light, while the red liquid in the tub gradually dulled in color.
Two hours later.
The liquid in the medicinal tub had become clear as water.
Xu Ping ended his cultivation, slowly opening his eyes with a flash of excitement in them: "This Blood Soul Body Refining is truly formidable; just one session has enhanced my physique by a degree."
If it’s fully cultivated, how powerful will it be!
It’s definitely much stronger than his Nourishing Life Skill.
Xu Ping got up from the tub, left the cultivation room, and stepped into the courtyard.
At this moment, the previously lively Golden-tailed Carp suddenly curled into a ball, shivering.
"This..."
"Could it be... that the evil qi emitted after cultivating Blood Soul Body Refining scared them?" Xu Ping thought thoughtfully.
Although the Demon Beast Blood Essence had been refined, it inevitably carried some evil qi.
And having bathed in the blood of a hundred demon beasts for cultivation, including Second-stage Demon Beasts, the aura definitely carried evil qi.
Xu Ping pondered for a moment.
The Bone Shaping Skill silently operated, concealing all his aura without a trace.
A moment later, the previously shivering Golden-tailed Carp suddenly appeared confused, cautiously swam around, and after discovering nothing unusual, returned to its lively state.
"This evil qi is indeed interesting; it even managed to intimidate the Golden-tailed Carp," Xu Ping couldn’t help but laugh.
Suddenly, a thought flashed through his mind, "Could I use the evil qi against my foes?"
After pondering for a moment, he thought it might work.
If the evil qi in his aura got strong enough and exploded all out, it might affect a cultivator.
As long as they are affected for a moment.
After all, battles between cultivators often decide life and death in an instant.
Of course, he was still far away from that; at least he’d have to complete the Blood Soul Body Refining before seeing any clues.
...
...
Seven days later.
Zhang Yan’s medicine shop.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, your winemaking skills are getting better." Zhang Yan swallowed a Bliss Pill with some spirit wine, and moments later, his complexion visibly improved.
Having known each other for years, Xu Ping kept his emotions in check at this.
He used to advise him.
Now?
Respect others’ lives.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, didn’t you want to meet an Alchemy Master before? Now you have a chance," Zhang Yan said with a smile after putting down the wine pot.
"Is that so?" Xu Ping’s eyes lit up.
He mainly wanted to meet an Alchemist who could refine Foundation Establishment Pills.
The Foundation Establishment Pill, as a Second-stage Middle Grade Pill, requires at least a Foundation Establishment Cultivator to refine it.
Foundation Establishment cultivators, Second-stage Middle Grade Alchemists in Qiu Xuan Immortal City hold an extremely high status.
"Yes." Zhang Yan nodded, "That Alchemist has a prestigious status, being a First Rank Upper Grade Alchemist themselves, with a master who is one of the few Second-stage Middle Grade Alchemists in the Immortal City."
"I definitely need to meet them!" Xu Ping was moved.
With his current status and strength, directly meeting a Second-stage Middle Grade Alchemist was too difficult.
It’s best to approach it indirectly.
"Then you’ll need to prepare a gift, as that Alchemist is going to take a concubine in the next few days, it’s best to prepare more," Zhang Yan reminded.
"Got it." Xu Ping nodded.
Cultivators also value social etiquette.
...
...
Three days later.
Zhang Yan led Xu Ping to a magnificent residence.
The pavilions within the residence were tall and grand, with two sets of First Rank Upper Grade arrays set up, the entrance was decorated with lanterns and streamers, and cultivators delivering gifts came in an endless stream.
"Li Yu, one jin of Celestial Snow Fruit."
"Chen Talisman Master, thirty spirit stones."
At the entrance of the mansion, a steward specifically recorded the gifts, and cultivators announced them.
"Zhang Yan, one Fire Qilin Fruit."
The shout was a bit louder.
The Fire Qilin Fruit, a special Spirit Fruit, greatly aids cultivators of fire-based cultivation techniques, and just one such fruit costs nearly a hundred spirit stones.
And what Xu Ping gifted was no less.
"Xu Ping, one Mid-grade Magical Artifact."
The shout was equally loud.
...
"Fellow Daoist Zhang, you’ve gone to such expense! Please come in."
A skinny middle-aged man stepped out enthusiastically after hearing the gift list.
Obviously, he and Zhang Yan were long acquainted.
"Is this fellow daoist you brought along?" He turned his gaze to Xu Ping since he naturally heard the gift Xu Ping brought.
But the two hadn’t met before, and naturally, there was no invitation, the only possibility was that Zhang Yan brought him along.
"Yes." Zhang Yan smiled and nodded, "This is Xu Ping, Fellow Daoist Xu, who has long admired your reputation and came specifically to congratulate."
"This is Du Xinghuai, Alchemist Du." He introduced the two of them to each other.
"Alchemist Du, it’s an honor to meet you!" Xu Ping clasped his hands in salute.
"Hahaha, Fellow Daoist Xu, you’re too kind, both of you, please come in," Du Xinghuai warmly invited the two to the main hall for a private table.
The treatment was fundamentally different from the public banquet in the yard.
Obviously, those who gave fewer gifts sat at the public banquet in the yard, and those who gave more naturally sat in the main hall.
Not many sat in the main hall, only a dozen or so, but Xu Ping saw an unexpected person—Jiang Tian.
"Why is he here?"
"Following me?"
Xu Ping was shaken, with thoughts racing, yet his face remained calm.
After some careful thought, he believed it was a coincidence.
They had no grudges, and back then, he probably didn’t notice his disguise either.
Perhaps he also wanted to capitalize on Du Xinghuai to meet the Second-stage Middle Grade Alchemist.
Xu Ping thought this was very likely.
The banquet continued.
Alchemist Du toasted each person in the main hall.
"Fellow Daoist Zhang, I’ve improved the Bliss Pill again, it’s even stronger now, want to try it after the banquet ends?" Du Xinghuai laughed.
"That’d be great!" Zhang Yan was delighted to hear that, "I’ve been feeling like the Bliss Pills aren’t quite right now, glad to hear it’s improved."
Xu Ping had a strange expression, realizing that Alchemist Du was the culprit behind the Bliss Pills!
Hearing their conversation, so Alchemist Du also took Bliss Pills.
As an Alchemist, doesn’t he know the harm of Bliss Pills?
Further improvement, making them stronger?
Isn’t he afraid of overdosing himself?
"Fellow Daoist Xu, care to join us!"
Du Xinghuai invited warmly, clearly seeing Xu Ping as a like-minded person. After all, he was brought by Zhang Yan, gave generous gifts, naturally easy to associate with seeking pills.
"No need, no need." Xu Ping’s expression stiffened, quickly refusing.
Such things, he certainly wouldn’t touch.
"No?" Du Xinghuai was briefly taken aback, then realized something with a hearty laugh, "Friend, enjoy, feel free to visit my residence in a few days."
"Sure, no problem." Xu Ping was moved.
Apparently, the Mid-grade Magical Artifact was worth gifting, and this Alchemist Du knew how to treat people.
The banquet continued, the atmosphere getting more lively, maidens gracefully danced in the main hall. Although they were mortals, they had been clearly professionally trained, with elegant and captivating dance moves.

chapters.title: Chapter 91: Blood Demon’s True Form
chapters.content:
Chapter 91: Chapter 91: Blood Demon’s True Form
Three days later, Xu Ping was invited to Du Xinghuai’s mansion.
He walked through the long corridor and entered the main hall.
There weren’t many people in the main hall, only three or four.
Xu Ping glanced around and saw that Jiang Tian was also present.
Now he was almost certain that this Foundation Establishment Cultivator, who was disguised as being in the Qi Refining Realm, also wanted to meet his master through Du Xinghuai.
After everyone had arrived, Du Xinghuai personally entertained the guests with a broad smile, and the table was laden with sumptuous food and drink.
After the guests had their fill of food and drink.
Du Xinghuai privately conversed with each of them.
...
During his conversation with Xu Ping, Du Xinghuai probed to see what he sought.
Xu Ping expressed his desire to meet his master, the Hidden Alchemist, to request the refining of a Pill.
But he did not specify what kind of Pill it was.
Xu Ping had specifically learned about Du Xinghuai’s master, the Hidden Alchemist, who had a good reputation and proficient alchemy skills in the Immortal City.
Over the years, he had helped several Loose Cultivators refine Foundation Establishment Pills without any mishaps.
He was indeed the best candidate for refining Foundation Establishment Pills.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, my master’s alchemy appointments are scheduled for years ahead. You see, there are many powerful forces in the city, and my master cannot afford to offend them."
Du Xinghuai frowned slightly, his expression showing a hint of difficulty.
"I kindly ask Alchemist Du for assistance." Xu Ping’s tone was earnest.
"I am not in immediate need of Hidden Alchemist’s help in refining a Pill as I have not yet gathered all the materials, and it will take at least another year or two." Without showing any emotion, he extracted a jade box from his storage bag and pushed it in front of Du Xinghuai.
Du Xinghuai lifted a finger and opened a corner of the jade box to see a Mid-grade Spirit Stone lying inside.
The corner of his mouth lifted slightly, and with a fluid motion of his sleeve over the table, the jade box vanished instantly.
The motion was as smooth as if it had been practiced a thousand times.
"Ah, Du will try his best! To be honest, it’s been hard to see my master these past few years."
Du Xinghuai sighed, seemingly convinced.
"Sorry to trouble you, Fellow Daoist Du." Xu Ping, without hesitation, pushed forward another identical jade box.
"No need to be formal. Since Fellow Daoist Xu and I hit it off at first sight, we should stay in touch; I believe we can meet each other’s needs in the future." Du Xinghuai gave a bright smile, and with another wave of his sleeve, the jade box vanished in the blink of an eye.
Xu Ping naturally caught the implication.
He knew that although Du Xinghuai was willing to help him contact his master, once it came to alchemy, there would still be costs involved.
"Of course, Alchemist Du, your alchemy skills are unmatched, and I naturally wish to maintain contact."
Xu Ping smiled slightly, calculating inwardly that as long as this Alchemist Du could introduce him to the Hidden Alchemist, even if it cost a few hundred Spirit Stones later, it wouldn’t matter.
...
Upon leaving Du Mansion.
Xu Ping nodded secretly, feeling that it should work out to find a Second-stage Middle Grade Alchemist under normal circumstances.
This Alchemist Du is a man of understanding; if he took gifts and did nothing, it would harm his reputation — who would give him benefits then?
But if, by any chance, he takes the money and does nothing, Xu Ping vowed to let this Alchemist Du know that his Spirit Stones are not so easy to take.
"Now, I just need to complete the Blood Soul Body Refining and break through to the ninth level of Qi Cultivation, then I’ll go to the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range to hunt Second-stage Demon Beasts to obtain the Demon Core."
"Soon!" Xu Ping silently murmured to himself.
...
...
Time flies like a white steed galloping past; four months passed in the blink of an eye.
In the cultivation room obscured by an array, Xu Ping sat quietly in a medicinal bath. A crackling sound came from his entire skeleton, followed by a matte crystal-like pattern surfacing on his skin.
His body radiated a powerful Evil Qi that would likely terrify a mortal should they experience its oppressive aura.
Suddenly, Xu Ping opened his eyes, a flash of blood-red light passing through them.
He carefully felt the transformation in his body, sensing an unending surge of power from deep within his physique.
He used his Mana to conjure his storage bag, then took out a piece of First Rank refined iron ore, crushed it with his hand, and the ore — comparable to a Lower Grade Magical Artifact — shattered instantly.
Then, he picked up a Mid-grade Magical Artifact, ran it along his arm, leaving only a white mark.
"Ha ha, the Blood Soul Body Refining is finally a success!"
Xu Ping laughed heartily in delight.
Now, he was a legitimate Second-stage Body Cultivator.
Even at the Second-stage level, compared to a Foundation Establishment Cultivator, a Body Cultivator is still at a disadvantage.
After all, the physique of a Body Cultivator isn’t on par with Demon Beasts of the same level, nor do they have the means to compete with Foundation Establishment Cultivators.
In a one-on-one situation, an ordinary Second-stage Lower Grade Body Cultivator could not defeat a Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
However, the Blood Soul Body Refining he practiced was no ordinary Body Refining Technique.
Xu Ping put on his clothes and went to the training room, taking out a specially designed puppet from his storage bag meant for training.
This puppet was something he had purchased specifically — it was extraordinarily durable and intended for practice.
With everything prepared, Xu Ping fixed his gaze, formed a Magic Technique, and shouted lowly, "Blood Demon True Form!"
Immediately, his body began to expand, transforming into a brawny figure over two meters tall, with blood flowing across his skin.
Fortunately, his clothing was a special magical robe, or it would have likely burst apart!
"Such power!"
Xu Ping’s eyes shone with blood-red light as he clenched his fists, feeling that his strength had at least doubled compared to before.
Moreover, it wasn’t just a simple increase in strength; it was an all-around enhancement, with speed and defensive power significantly improved.
Taking a step forward, he threw a powerful punch, and blood-colored light flowed from his fist.
Bang, bang, bang...
With the sound of resounding explosions, the training-dedicated puppet in front of him was smashed to pieces by a single blow, scattering fragments into the air.
"Such speed and strength, I fear it’s not inferior to some Demon Beasts." Xu Ping thought joyfully as he surveyed the results of his power.
With his current Body Cultivation prowess, he could definitely hold his own against an ordinary Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
As the "Blood Demon True Form" faded away, his body returned to its original size.
Xu Ping slowly exhaled a turbid breath and then opened the proficiency panel.
[Realm: Qi Cultivation Ninth Level: 6/100; Blood Demon Body Refining First Level: 1/100]
[Cultivation Technique: Five Elements Skill Perfection (Ninth Level): ∞]
"Now that the ninth level of Qi Cultivation and Blood Demon Body Refining are achieved, it’s time to hunt demons and gain Demon Cores." Xu Ping pondered internally.
The breakthrough to the ninth level of Qi Cultivation had occurred a month ago, which had expanded his Divine Sense by another fifteen feet and increased his liquid Mana by three drops.
Currently, his Divine Sense has a range of fifteen feet, and six drops of liquid Mana reside in his Dantian, yet his ninth level of Qi Cultivation is not at Perfection.
Once at Perfection, it should add another drop or half a drop of liquid Mana.
It’s known that even an Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator only possesses eighteen drops of liquid Mana.
"I wonder how many drops of liquid Mana I’ll have after breaking through to Foundation Establishment."
Though it’s impossible to predict now, he believes it will be more than the ordinary eighteen drops of liquid Mana of an Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
...
...
After perfecting the Blood Demon Body Refining, Xu Ping didn’t immediately go off to hunt demons.
Instead, he spent a few days ensuring there were no oversights, preparing various supplies and lifesaving techniques.
Pills for restoring Mana, Second-stage talismans, sturdy puppets...
After seven days, everything was ready.
Xu Ping carefully checked everything again, ensuring nothing was overlooked, and then he rode Wang Shan’s Spiritual Boat, leaving Qiu Xuan Immortal City and heading toward Yellow Dragon Mountain Range.

chapters.title: Chapter 92: Slaying the Demon Ape
chapters.content:
Chapter 92: Chapter 92: Slaying the Demon Ape
Yellow Dragon Mountain Range, Inner Mountain.
Thick fog, like a mysterious veil, enveloped the hundred-zhang tall giant trees, their thick trunks silently narrating the vicissitudes of time.
The canopy was dense with branches and leaves, casting mottled shadows as light filtered through, generating an overwhelming sense of oppression.
The air was filled with a decaying smell, mingling with the damp earth and rotting plants, producing a suffocating sensation.
"Awoo!"
Suddenly, three Red Ice Wolves roared, storming towards Xu Ping, their blood-red mouths forming sharp ice blades as they ran.
In the next instant.
Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh!
The ice blades flew straight at Xu Ping like arrows.
Faced with this scene, Xu Ping remained unafraid, his expression as calm as water.
The Red Ice Wolf is a First Rank Upper Grade Demon Beast, with the attribute of ice, boasting tough skin, fast speed, and the ability to spit ice blades, making them extremely difficult to deal with.
Ordinary Late-Stage Qi Cultivation cultivators would probably only have the option to flee from three Red Ice Wolves.
However, for him, they posed no threat, and he didn’t even bother using the Blood-Drinking Sword.
"Puff! Puff! Puff!"
With a series of slight noises, three golden energy bursts shot from his fingertips, directly shattering the ice blades.
After the golden bursts shattered the ice blades, their power remained undiminished, heading straight for the three Red Ice Wolves.
"Boom! Boom! Boom!"
The three Red Ice Wolves showed fear, attempting to dodge, but the golden energy was too fast. With a series of loud booms, the three Red Ice Wolves exploded directly.
Thud...
Three headless Red Ice Wolf bodies fell heavily to the ground.
"Since entering the inner mountain, Demon Beasts have noticeably increased." Noticing the wolf beasts’ corpses, Xu Ping frowned slightly.
In the inner mountain, within just a day, he had faced three waves of Demon Beast attacks, though fortunately they were all First Rank Demon Beasts and posed no threat to him.
Xu Ping went forward, collected the Red Ice Wolf corpses, and prepared to continue onward.
"Huh?"
"What’s this?"
After collecting the Red Ice Wolf corpses, he stopped in front of a plant with pale white flowers blooming.
Upon closer inspection, there were a dozen plants, each with pale white flowers. In the flowers’ faintly blooming centers were reddish fruits, somewhat hidden, emitting a faint fragrance.
"White Orchid Fruit!"
His gaze swept carefully over the plants, and Xu Ping felt a hint of delight.
White Orchid Fruit, a First Rank Upper Grade Spirit Fruit, containing rich and pure Spiritual Qi in its flesh, can enhance a cultivator’s cultivation without the Pill Poison that comes with pills.
In Immortal City, a single White Orchid Fruit could sell for at least forty Spirit Stones.
"The inner mountain has more Demon Beasts, but the resources are indeed richer."
"What a pity those wolves ate quite a bit, only five are left." Xu Ping sighed, picking the remaining five White Orchid Fruits.
He summoned clean water with mana, washed a White Orchid Fruit, and took a bite. The flesh was tender and juicy with a soft texture.
"It’s quite delicious."
Xu Ping finished it in a few bites, as the Spirit Fruit was digested, a stream of extremely pure Spiritual Qi rose up from his stomach and was absorbed by the Dantian, needing no refining.
Feeling his mana in the Dantian enhance by a fraction, Xu Ping secretly marveled: "This Spirit Fruit is mighty, converting to Spiritual Qi without the need for refining."
"It’s just too few, otherwise, eating it daily could quickly achieve Qi Cultivation Perfection."
Storing the remaining White Orchid Fruits in the pouch, Xu Ping continued forward searching for traces of Second-stage Demon Beasts.
...
...
Half a month later.
A terrifying beast roar echoed through the mountains.
A gigantic white demon ape, presumably three to four meters tall, covered in snow-white long fur, with fierce fangs protruding from a monstrous mouth, and blood-red eyes radiating savage killing intent.
"Huff huff huff..."
The demon ape panted heavily, its small abdomen showing an extremely terrifying scar.
The scar almost tore open the demon ape’s abdomen completely, and as it moved its body, blood kept gushing out, staining the nearby white fur with red.
Xu Ping held his sword single-handedly, his expression surprisingly calm.
"Roar!" The demon ape roared fiercely, consolidating white cold air into a ball that shot explosively at Xu Ping.
Xu Ping’s figure flashed, vanishing instantly from his original spot, effortlessly dodging the demon ape’s attack.
With his current speed, dodging the heavily wounded demon ape was extremely easy.
After dodging the attack, Xu Ping’s eyes sparkled with light, glaring at the demon ape.
The demon ape sensed a cold sensation sweeping over, suddenly losing sight, and its struggling movements stiffened, heavily crashing backward onto the ground.
Xu Ping’s Divine Sense was almost comparable to that of Foundation Establishment cultivators, whereas Demon Beasts aren’t proficient in Divine Sense, unable to withstand his Shocking God Needle.
"Roar!"
A few breaths later, the demon ape regained consciousness, roaring angrily, its hands propping up as it struggled to get up.
"Die!"
Xu Ping decided not to prolong the fight, activating fluid mana.
Buzz buzz!
The Blood-Drinking Sword hummed, hovering three feet off the ground, the air at the blade tip warping and blurring, as if Sword Qi was pulsing, radiating intense energy.
He swung his sword.
Boom!
With a sound like thunder, as if Thunder God had descended, the Sword Qi transformed into an exceptionally brilliant beam, tearing through the air, slicing towards the demon ape’s neck, severing it instantaneously.
Blup!
The demon ape’s head flew off, blood sprayed like a fountain, splattering crimson liquid over every nearby stone and leaf, making the scene extremely horrifying.
With a thunderous crash.
The demon ape’s roar gradually faded, as its massive figure collapsed like a small mountain, falling heavily.
Facing such terrifying scene, Xu Ping felt genuinely delighted: "With my current strength, slaying a Second-stage Lower Grade Demon Beast isn’t too difficult."
Though knowing his strength had greatly improved compared to before, lacking a reference point, he was unsure of his exact level.
Engaging with Second-stage Middle Grade Demon Beasts was too dangerous, so he chose a Second-stage Lower Grade Demon Beast for practice.
Now, without using an Array, independently slaying a Second-stage Lower Grade Demon Beast, his strength might not parallel Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators but definitely wasn’t weaker than Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators.
Moreover, he was more adept at dealing with Demon Beasts than ordinary Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators.
After all, the "Shocking God Needle" spiritual sense attack Magic is extremely precious, most ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivators have merely heard of it.
And Demon Beasts before Fourth Rank, their Divine Sense is certainly inferior to cultivators.
Of course, except for a few gifted Demon Beasts, such as those with ancient True Spirit bloodlines, they are powerful in all aspects.
Xu Ping shifted his gaze forward, focusing on the enormous demon ape corpse.
"This Second-stage demon ape can have its essence extracted for cultivating Blood Demon Body Refining." He thought silently.
Though this meant losing a large sum of Spirit Stones, Spirit Stones aren’t as crucial as enhancing strength.
Whoosh!
As Xu Ping was gathering the spoils of battle, a Foundation Establishment Stage mana aura flew low from a distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 93: Stranger Foundation Establishment
chapters.content:
Chapter 93: Chapter 93: Stranger Foundation Establishment
Xu Ping’s expression changed, he stood up on guard, then operated the Bone Shaping Skill, transforming into a stranger.
In the Black Mist Mountain Range, the danger of demon beasts is only a part.
Every year, countless cultivators are not killed by demon beasts, but by their own kind.
A few breaths later.
In the light gray mist, a disheveled man flew low, black aura swirling around him, his face deathly pale unlike a human’s, and his pupils dark and gloomy.
The aura around his body had reached the Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment.
"Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator? Troublesome." Xu Ping’s heart sank.
If it were an Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, he wouldn’t be afraid, but a Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, he wasn’t confident in killing.
"Senior!" Xu Ping saw him gracefully land, and saluted with clasped hands.
The disheveled man scrutinized Xu Ping, his Divine Sense sweeping over him without hesitation, a hint of a sneer at the corners of his mouth: "Interesting, a Qi Cultivator at the ninth layer can actually slay a second-stage demon ape?"
"By luck! This second-stage demon ape was already injured, so I just took advantage." Xu Ping suppressed the urge to counterstrike and nodded.
"If the senior wants this second-stage demon ape, I will present it with both hands."
Although it pained him to hand over the second-stage demon ape for nothing, if he got into conflict with this unknown Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, life or death was uncertain.
Moreover, fighting him would surely reveal all his resources, and if the opponent escaped, it would be a disaster.
"You are sensible!" The disheveled man grinned widely, his pale complexion making it look sinister, "But it’s a pity you’re from Yue Country, so you still have to die!"
Xu Ping suddenly looked up, his eyes filled with killing intent.
"Next life..." The disheveled man’s ’life’ hadn’t finished before Xu Ping’s eyes shone with spiritual light, glaring at him.
The disheveled man felt a chill sweep over him, his vision suddenly blacked out, but with the strength of his Divine Sense, he recovered instantly.
Boom!
As soon as he regained consciousness, a magnificent Sword Qi, accompanied by the sound of thunder, slashed at him.
"Not good! Sword Qi Thunder Sound!!" The disheveled man’s face changed drastically, hurriedly deploying a Copper Umbrella Magical Artifact.
The copper umbrella spread out, emitting a bright aura, forming a protective shield in front of him.
Boom!
With a loud explosion, the protective shield only lasted half a second before shattering, and the copper umbrella was slashed, creating a crack.
Spat!
The magnificent Sword Qi swept across his leg, blood spraying, a section of his leg being minced by the Sword Qi.
Fortunately, the copper umbrella blocked it for half a second, weakening the Sword Qi, or else his head would have been severed.
"Couldn’t kill him!" Seeing this scene, Xu Ping’s heart sank, if it were a second-stage lower grade demon beast or an Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, they would probably be killed.
"Spiritual Sense Attack, Sword Qi Thunder Sound!" The disheveled man who had suffered this attack didn’t care about the wound on his leg, staring at Xu Ping intently, saying word by word.
The person in front of him was definitely a Foundation Establishment Cultivator in disguise, and definitely not an average one.
The combination of Sword Qi Thunder Sound and Spiritual Sense Attack, this level of strength might be very powerful among Foundation Establishment cultivators.
"Could it be that your Yue Country detected our plan, so they sent you to intercept us?" The disheveled man seemed to have thought of something, his face changed wildly, his eyes revealing a frenzied killing intent.
"What nonsense are you saying!" Xu Ping couldn’t understand what he was saying, nor was he interested in listening, his eyes shining with spiritual light as he glared at him.
Obviously, the disheveled man was prepared this time.
With a flash of spiritual light on the storage ring on his hand, a silver bell-like magical artifact suddenly appeared in his hand.
"Ting ting..."
He suddenly shook the bell, accompanied by a crisp ringing sound, an invisible sound wave spread out.
Dong!
The Spiritual Sense Attack and the invisible sound wave collided, causing invisible ripples to spread in the air.
"Blocked it!" Xu Ping’s face changed, who exactly was this person, able to fully block a Spiritual Sense Attack.
"Humph!" The disheveled man snorted coldly, and a corpse covered in green scales with blue-black mist faintly emerging from its surface suddenly appeared.
"Go!"
He pointed, and the corpse with green scales suddenly opened its eyes, a flash of blood light from its white pupils, a powerful aura rising.
Then it flashed, disappearing in an instant.
"So fast!"
Xu Ping’s face was solemn, mana circulating, about to slash with his sword, but he heard the bell’s crisp sound.
"Ting ting..."
His mana circulation suddenly became sluggish, his expression turned dazed, his eyes blankly looking forward.
Buzz!
At this moment, the Taihang Nourishing God Skill suddenly operated on its own, a cool influx into his mind, Xu Ping suddenly regained his senses.
Hoo!
As he regained his senses, a fist wrapped in blue-black mist enlarged in front of his eyes.
"Not good!"
Xu Ping’s expression changed drastically, at this moment, it was too late to draw his sword, he could only withstand it.
He swiftly formed a magic seal and shouted in a low voice: "Blood Demon True Form!"
In an instant, his body began to swell, transforming into a burly man over two meters tall, the surface of his skin flowing with blood light.
Without hesitation, he punched to counter.
Boom!
With a loud explosion, the ground shook like meteorites colliding, the earth within several meters of their center completely collapsed, an invisible shockwave rippling from their center, sending rubble flying, raising clouds of dust.
When the dust settled, the battlefield situation was revealed.
The corpse with green scales stood unmoving in place, while Xu Ping had been forced back several meters.
Xu Ping grimaced as he shook his numb arm, this corpse with green scales was strong!
It could even suppress his Blood Demon True Form, probably no weaker than some second-stage middle grade Body Cultivators.
’This person is definitely not an ordinary Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.’ Xu Ping’s gaze passed over the corpse with green scales and fell on the disheveled man, his eyes filled with fear.
Having a magical artifact to manipulate Divine Sense and a corpse no weaker than a second-stage middle grade Body Cultivator.
If not for Xu Ping taking preemptive action, crushing one of his legs into pieces, he might not be his opponent either.
And the disheveled man opposite, seeing Xu Ping unharmed, let out an expression of shock: "What! You actually used your body to withstand my bronze corpse?"
"Second-stage Body Refinement?"
"Spiritual Sense Attack, Sword Qi Thunder Sound, Second-stage Body Refinement, what a monster this is!"
At this moment, both sides felt intense fear towards each other and also developed a strong killing intent.
"Go!"
The disheveled man again directed the bronze corpse to attack Xu Ping, then shook the silver bell again.
But Xu Ping, already prepared, naturally wouldn’t fall for it again.
His eyes shone with spiritual light, clashing with the sonic attack.
Then he summoned a second-stage middle grade ’Desert Charm’ talisman.
In an instant, a vortex of wild yellow sand over twenty meters wide appeared out of thin air, enveloping both the disheveled man and the bronze corpse, creating a harsh grinding sound as it clashed with their protective spells.
Taking advantage of this gap, Xu Ping activated an array.
"Activate!"
He took out four mid-grade Spirit Stones, inserted them into the array plate, then cast a magic technique onto the array plate.

chapters.title: Chapter 94: Execution
chapters.content:
Chapter 94: Chapter 94: Execution
Boom!
The next moment, streams of azure spirit aura emerged from the array flag, surging intensely, brilliant and dazzling, flashing like stars.
Buzz!!
A layer of spirit aura shield instantly expanded hundreds to thousands of times, encompassing the entire mountain, with the majestic spiritual pressure intimidating all directions like a tidal wave.
"You actually have a Second-stage array!!"
The man struggling out from the raging sand saw this scene, angering him to the point his eyes turned red, gritting his teeth.
"Hmph!"
Xu Ping let out a cold snort, manipulating the array.
Buzz!
At this moment, a massive cage of Spiritual Power formed instantly in the sky, wrapping around the bronze corpse.
Unable to dodge, the bronze corpse was tightly entangled.
"Not good!"
Seeing the bronze corpse trapped by the array, the long-haired man’s face shifted dramatically as he hurriedly tried to control the bronze corpse to break free.
Crack crack crack...
A vast blue-black mist erupted from the bronze corpse, attempting to tear apart the cage binding it, the sound of metal breaking from the strained cage.
Xu Ping understood well the tactic of capturing the leader first; his heart was resolute without a trace of hesitation, his gaze firmly locking onto the long-haired man.
"Slash!"
His figure flashed, disappearing instantly from the original spot, the next moment, a colossal sword qi accompanied by the sound of thunder slashed toward the long-haired man.
The long-haired man’s face changed drastically, but with his calf shattered, his movement was hampered, forcing him to withstand it; he hastily summoned a piece of upper-grade defensive Magical Artifact and also launched a Second-stage upper-grade defensive talisman.
Boom!
The sword qi broke through the upper-grade defensive Magical Artifact but was blocked by the Second-stage upper-grade defensive shield.
The long-haired man had no time to breathe a sigh of relief, yet suddenly numerous sword qi slashed toward him from the void.
Boom boom boom!!!
The Second-stage upper-grade defensive shield was severely dimmed under the violent attack and nearly shattered.
"No!"
In the long-haired man’s terrified gaze, the Second-stage upper-grade defensive shield shattered.
A sword qi flashed by, slicing across the long-haired man.
"Ah..."
The long-haired man let out a tragic scream, cut vertically from bottom to top by the sword qi’s sharp edge, his body split in two, with blood spewing out.
He slowly fell to the ground, a look of death restlessly lingering on his face.
And the bronze corpse lost the long-haired man’s control, quietly bound firmly by the array, unable to move.
"Phew!"
At this time, Xu Ping landed from the void, his face as pale as paper, his chest rising and falling, breathing slowly.
This battle consumed too much; both his Divine Sense and Mana were almost entirely depleted.
If the long-haired man could have held out a bit longer, he might have been captured.
"This man is really powerful!" Xu Ping’s gaze fell on the already split-in-half long-haired man, a trace of dread emerging in his eyes.
He had nearly exhausted all his means to barely kill the long-haired man, who had lost a leg.
If both were intact and faced off, the outcome would have been uncertain.
"It’s time to go!"
The battle’s commotion had been too great; Xu Ping dared not linger.
He collected the silvery bell into his storage bag; it was a valuable item.
With this silver bell in hand, combined with his Spiritual Sense Attack, his strength could significantly increase, at least firmly suppressing a Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
After securing the silver bell, Xu Ping searched the long-haired man’s body, found a jade token, and once he confirmed there was nothing else, flicked two fireballs to burn the long-haired man’s corpse to ashes.
"Finally, there’s this bronze corpse." Xu Ping shifted his gaze to the bronze corpse tightly bound by the array.
The bronze corpse’s strength was also extremely formidable, comparable to a Second-stage Middle Grade Body Refining Cultivator.
And being essentially a corpse, unaware of life or pain, far more ferocious than an ordinary Second-stage Middle Grade Body Refining Cultivator, definitely making it an excellent aide.
"Pack it up, study it thoroughly later!" Xu Ping dispelled the array, the bronze corpse falling to the ground, its white pupils staring vacantly ahead.
With a wave of his sleeve, Xu Ping retrieved it into his Storage Ring, not forgetting the Second-stage Demon Ape.
Glancing in a certain direction, he employed the Wind Manipulation Skill, lightly tapped his foot, and headed toward the mountains.
His figure soon vanished amidst a dense fog.
...
...
A short half-hour later.
Several black-robed figures arrived at the scene.
Noticing the mess all around, one of the black-robed figures’ face slightly changed: "Xu Liang’s aura disappeared here, could it be that he is dead?"
"But with Xu Liang’s strength, plus the unique treasure he carried, he could handle Second-stage upper-grade Demon Beasts; what in these inner mountains could kill him?"
"The battlefield has been tidied up, clearly not by a demon beast, it should be a cultivator." Another figure calmly analyzed.
"Can it be that the people of Yue Country discovered us and sent a cultivator to eliminate us?" Another speculated nervously.
...
The leading black-robed figure remained silent, frowning slightly, sensing quietly. After a moment, he spoke slowly: "The one who killed Xu Liang was a sword cultivator, moreover..."
He pointed a finger, and the sword mark on the ground, a residual sword qi burst forth slightly, with faint thunder sounds echoing.
"Moreover... it was a sword cultivator who comprehended Sword Qi Thunder Sound." The leading black-robed figure’s expression turned grave.
"A sword cultivator who comprehended Sword Qi Thunder Sound?" Hearing these words, the other black-robed figures were shaken.
Sword cultivators are renowned as the strongest offensive cultivators in the Cultivation Realm, often considered the chosen ones.
Would any sect really send such a chosen one to ambush them?
"This should be coincidental; if Yue Country’s people truly found us, they would have sent a Golden Core cultivator instead." The leading black-robed figure opined.
After pondering momentarily, the others found this reasonable, causing the tense atmosphere to slightly relax.
However, at this moment, the leading black-robed figure spoke in a chilling tone: "From now on, no one should act alone. You know my methods, don’t force me to be merciless."
His icy gaze swept over the black-robed figures present, causing them to lower their heads, not daring to meet his eyes.
"Let’s move!" With an order from the leading black-robed figure, he soared flying at low altitude with his Magical Artifact, and the others quickly followed.
...
...
Yellow Dragon Mountain Range.
In the inner mountains, a secluded cave was shrouded in a thin spirit aura, resembling a shelled egg.
Inside the slightly dim cave, Xu Ping swallowed a Qi Recovery Pill, quietly restoring his mana.
It was unknown how much time had passed.
Xu Ping slowly opened his eyes, a sharp light flashing in his eyes, instantly illuminating the slightly dark cave.
"Phew!"
He exhaled a long breath, softly muttering to himself: "My mana has finally recovered."
Being in the inner mountains of Yellow Dragon, with mana entirely spent, was tremendously dangerous, even if his Body Refining was not lacking, he couldn’t help but feel unease.
Now with his mana restored, he finally felt assurance in his heart.
"It’s time to look at the spoils!" Xu Ping’s eyes inevitably flickered with a trace of delight.
The items on that long-haired man’s body were indeed substantial!
Xu Ping took out the long-haired man’s Storage Ring, with a sweep of his Divine Sense, effortlessly breaking open the Divine Sense seal on it in an instant.
He delved his Divine Sense into the Storage Ring.
A pile of Spirit Stones, various Spirit Medicines and Spiritual Ores, numerous talismans, a few ancient books, two upper-grade Magical Artifacts, and a dozen middle and lower-grade magical artifacts.

chapters.title: Chapter 95: Exotic Treasure
chapters.content:
Chapter 95: Chapter 95: Exotic Treasure
"I’ve struck it rich!" Xu Ping exclaimed in delighted surprise, realizing how incredibly wealthy this person was.
He counted meticulously; just the Spirit Stones alone were close to two thousand.
The total amount, when added all together, surpassed five thousand Spirit Stones.
Surely a windfall!
Undoubtedly a great windfall indeed!
Of course, this certainly didn’t account for the most valuable amongst them—the silver bell and the bronze corpse.
Counting these two would surely make the value even greater.
Xu Ping first took out the silver bell.
He effortlessly erased the Divine Sense imprint from it and then began channeling his Mana for its refinement.
An hour later.
The silver bell burst with radiant light, as if establishing a subtle connection with Xu Ping.
Subsequently, some information automatically surfaced in his Sea of Consciousness.
It’s a lower-grade Mystical Artifact—Soul Sound Bell!
"It’s actually a Mystical Artifact!" Xu Ping was astonished.
He had never anticipated that this silver bell would turn out to be the renowned Mystical Artifact.
Mystical Artifacts are Magical Artifacts used by ancient cultivators for their cultivation.
These Magical Artifacts have singular Divine Techniques, but their power is generally immense, far superior to ordinary Magical Artifacts.
Moreover, Mystical Artifacts are divided into upper, middle, and lower grades.
Upper-grade Mystical Artifacts are exclusive to Nascent Soul Cultivators, middle-grade requires Golden Core Cultivators at the least, while lower-grade belongs to Foundation Establishment Cultivators.
"No wonder this bell is so powerful, turns out it’s a Mystical Artifact!" Xu Ping held the bell in his hand, brimming with excitement.
Even if this Mystical Artifact were taken to auction, it would fetch at least several thousand Spirit Stones.
Having this Mystical Artifact is like adding wings to a tiger, its effect even surpassing that of regular Top-grade Magical Artifacts.
Although Xu Ping really wanted to test the power of this Mystical Artifact now, he restrained himself.
It’s not the right time yet.
Xu Ping took a deep breath, suppressing his inner excitement, and turned his gaze towards the bronze corpse.
He rummaged through the spoils for a while, and finally found an ancient book titled "Corpse Refining," which detailed the uses and refinement of the bronze corpse.
This bronze corpse is a Second-stage Mid-grade Corpse Refining, refined from a Second-stage Mid-grade Body Cultivator combined with various Spirit Medicine and minerals.
Not only can it fully preserve its strength and speed, but also greatly enhance the corpse’s defensive power, even resisting Top-grade Magical Artifacts is not a problem.
"Resist Top-grade Magical Artifacts?"
"This bronze corpse is remarkable! Even Second-stage Upper Grade Body Cultivators probably can’t achieve this!" Xu Ping was secretly shocked, yet extremely relieved at the same time,
"It’s fortunate I didn’t clash head-on with this bronze corpse back then, otherwise I’d be the one who died."
Even though Sword Qi Thunder Sound can break its defense, to completely destroy it, it would certainly take considerable effort.
If it engaged me in combat, that man with disheveled hair could control the Soul Sound Bell and drag me to my doom.
Choosing to kill the man with disheveled hair first back then was indeed the correct decision.
"But how to control it?"
Xu Ping began flipping through the methods of controlling the bronze corpse.
"Its control core is the Spirit Control Token."
"Spirit Control Token?"
"Could it be the token from the chest of that man with disheveled hair?" Xu Ping suddenly recalled the token he took out of that man’s chest.
He took the jade token out and held it in his hand.
This jade pendant was only half the size of a palm, smooth all over, with a ghost head pattern engraved on it.
Xu Ping used his Divine Sense to perceive the jade token and discovered a Divine Sense imprint on it.
He immediately erased it and conveniently planted his own Divine Sense imprint.
At the moment of planting the Divine Sense imprint, Xu Ping felt something, gaining control over the bronze corpse.
"Move!"
Xu Ping directed it with a thought, making it walk.
The bronze corpse stepped forward steadily and upright.
"Interesting!"
A smiled flashed across Xu Ping’s lips, as if he had obtained a fun tool, immediately controlling it to perform various actions which the bronze corpse executed smoothly.
Half an hour later, Xu Ping stopped feeling satisfied.
Looking at the motionless bronze corpse, he couldn’t help but think, "This bronze corpse probably possesses considerable intelligence, far better than a Puppet."
"But can a corpse really be refined into such an intelligent Corpse Refining?" Xu Ping pondered to himself, then flipped through the bronze corpse’s refinement methods again.
Soon he discovered something he had overlooked.
This bronze corpse actually required a living person for refining, only living person refining could maximally ensure the intelligence of the Corpse Refining.
"Living person refining?" Xu Ping frowned slightly, such a cruel method involuntarily reminded him of the Demon Cultivators.
"Whatever, it’s not like I refined it."
Xu Ping wasn’t plagued with a guilty conscience; using innocent living beings for refining was something he’d surely never do, but using others’ Corpse Refinings, he was quite at ease with.
"Now, with the Soul Sound Bell and bronze corpse assisting me, my power has improved greatly, perhaps I should try my hand at hunting a Second-stage Demon Beast." Xu Ping thought quietly, a gleam flickering in his eyes.
...
...
Seven days later.
In a lush canyon.
Echoes of a terrifying beast roar reverberated through the canyon.
A Second-stage Lower Grade Bear Demon, three meters tall, covered in scars, was being mercilessly beaten by a Corpse Refining with green scales and bluish-black mist enveloping its body.
The bronze corpse, expressionless, delivered a punch.
Boom...
The fist exploded the air with a thunderous rumble.
The Bear Demon, unwilling to show weakness, roared furiously and raised its mountain-like fist to strike at the bronze corpse.
However, at that very moment, a crisp ringing sound echoed.
"Ding Ding..."
Suddenly, the Bear Demon’s expression turned bewildered, raising its fist and staring blankly ahead.
Boom!
The bronze corpse’s punch sent the Bear Demon flying, crashing heavily against the rock wall.
Crash!
Amidst a chorus of bangs, the surrounding rock walls crumbled, dust swirling!
"Ah!"
The Bear Demon awoke and let out a painful scream—the punch hurt a lot!!
In the next instant.
It saw a fist enveloped in bluish-black mist rapidly enlarging in its view.
Crash!
Unable to react in time, the fist struck heavily on its head, causing the ground to cave in tens of meters, dust spewing.
Before it could scream out, second fist, third fist, fourth fist... numerous fists relentlessly crashed down on its head.
"Ah..."
The Bear Demon’s cries grew weaker and eventually fell silent.
A Second-stage Lower Grade Bear Demon thus alive was beaten to death by the bronze corpse.
Witnessing this tragedy unfold before him, Xu Ping instead was wearing a hint of smile.
"The Soul Sound Bell combined with the bronze corpse is indeed formidable, without needing me to intervene, it took down a Second-stage Lower Grade Bear Demon."
He ordered the bronze corpse to stop, approached it to inspect whether there were injuries from the fierce battle.
Except for its clothes being slightly damaged, everything else was unscathed.
"Its defensive power is truly strong, probably not inferior to some Second-stage Upper Grade Demon Beasts." Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction.
Of course, it’s only the defensive power that could barely compare to Second-stage Upper Grade Demon Beasts, other aspects still fall short.
If in a one-on-one, the bronze corpse would undoubtedly be overwhelmed and crushed miserably.
Xu Ping stored the bronze corpse in his Storage Ring, then also collected the Bear Demon whose head was flattened.
"Now, Second-stage Mid-grade Demon Beasts shouldn’t pose a threat to me anymore; I should go hunt demons to obtain cores." Xu Ping employed the Wind Manipulation Skill, lightly tapping his foot, rushing towards the deeper parts of the mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 96: Demon Core
chapters.content:
Chapter 96: Chapter 96: Demon Core
One month later.
Beside a lake, a Fire Lizard, about a yard long and covered in scars, lay straight on the ground.
Surrounding it were traces of battle.
Xu Ping, expressionless, used his Divine Sense to carefully search inch by inch on the Fire Lizard’s corpse for a Demon Core.
He searched thoroughly multiple times, yet found nothing.
"Damn, still nothing!" Xu Ping couldn’t help but curse under his breath.
His luck was indeed terrible; over the past month, he had slain two Second-stage Middle Grade Demon Beasts, yet there was no sign of a Demon Core.
"Do I have to hunt a Second-stage Upper Grade Demon Beast?" Xu Ping felt a pang of hesitation in his heart.
A Second-stage Upper Grade Demon Beast would definitely have a Demon Core, but with his current strength, killing such a beast was still risky, to be honest.
After some hesitation, he decided to continue hunting Second-stage Middle Grade Demon Beasts. After all, he wasn’t in a hurry, and time was ample; there was no need to take risks.
He didn’t believe that the goddess of luck would never favor him.
...
...
A few days later, the sun was shining brightly.
Sunlight filtered through the thin mist, falling onto a grassland in a basin of the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range.
Roar! Howl!
On the grassland, a lion was fiercely biting and clawing at a black wolf.
The lion’s mane was red, looking like a burning flame from afar; the black wolf was robust, with black fur, exuding fierce Evil Qi.
The battle between them was intense, blood and flesh flying as they bit and clawed at each other.
Xu Ping, passing by, watched this scene, restrained his Mana, and minimized his presence.
"Black Wind Wolf, Flame Lion!"
He immediately recognized these two types of Demon Beasts, as he naturally had researched the common ones when he decided to hunt Demon Beasts.
The Black Wind Wolf was a relatively common Second-stage Demon Beast, but the Flame Lion was quite renowned.
It had a trace of ancestral True Spirit Golden Crow’s bloodline. Its strength was formidable, and its talent was exceptional; during the day, with the blessing of the sun, it could unleash power far beyond its capability.
"Roar!"
The Flame Lion roared, dispersing the surrounding mist. Sunlight poured down, as if forming a golden passage, landing on it.
Buzz!
Bathed in sunlight, the Flame Lion’s form began to swell, and its red mane gradually transformed into gold, its aura elevating from Second-stage Middle Grade to Second-stage Upper Grade.
Howl!
The Black Wind Wolf sensed the change in the Flame Lion’s aura. A glint of terror flashed in its scarlet eyes. It let out a low howl, wanting to flee.
But the newly strengthened Flame Lion was not about to let it succeed.
The Flame Lion roared, transforming into a streak of golden light, appearing in front of the Black Wind Wolf as if teleporting, and heavily smashed its colossal claw onto the Black Wind Wolf’s body.
Bang!
The Black Wind Wolf was slammed into the ground, its hard skull almost crushed.
Then, with another strike from the Flame Lion, the Black Wind Wolf’s skull was completely shattered, and it lay motionless.
"Roar!"
The Flame Lion roared toward the sky, its golden mane billowing in the wind, like a king declaring victory.
"This Flame Lion truly is unusually gifted, reaching Second-stage Upper Grade with the sun’s blessing." Witnessing this scene, Xu Ping was secretly astounded in his heart.
The Black Wind Wolf, of the same stage as him, could not withstand a single strike from it.
There’s no doubt that such a talented Demon Beast as the Flame Lion possesses a Demon Core.
"But at night, it won’t be this formidable. By then, hunting it should be much easier..." Xu Ping began to hatch a plan.
Having come across such an unusually gifted Second-stage Middle Grade Demon Beast, he would not let it escape.
...
...
Deep into the night.
The Yellow Dragon Mountain Range remained lively, with roars of beasts echoing one after another.
Moonlight struggled through the heavy mist, casting down on the ground.
Xu Ping, suppressing his aura, silently watched a hidden entrance amidst the vine-covered cliff wall in the distance.
That was the Flame Lion’s lair.
"It’s about time!" Xu Ping quietly calculated the time, as it had reached midnight, a time when the Flame Lion was at its weakest.
He rose, clutching a First Rank Upper Grade Escape Talisman in his left hand.
With his right hand, he formed a seal, and a fire snake about a yard long slithered into the hidden cave.
A few moments later.
The cliff wall shook slightly, Demonic Power stirred, and an angry roar was heard.
Amidst the whistling wind and sand, a red-maned Flame Lion charged out of the cave.
Disturbed from its rest, especially during the night it disliked, the Flame Lion was extremely enraged, its scarlet eyes gleaming with a cold light.
However, at that moment, a clear ringing of a bell sounded.
"Ding ding..."
The Flame Lion and Bear Demon suddenly appeared bewildered, staring blankly ahead.
When it snapped back to its senses, it was just in time to see a fist shrouded in black mist pounding heavily on its face.
Boom!
The Flame Lion was instantly sent flying, crashing hard against the cliff wall.
"Roar!"
Embedded in the cliff wall, the Flame Lion roared angrily, Demonic Power surged, trying to break free from the wall.
However, the next moment, a chill descended over it, and then it lost consciousness again.
When it regained consciousness again, the Flame Lion found itself tightly bound by several chains of Spiritual Power, unable to move.
The black mist-covered fist that attacked it earlier now pounded on its body like a torrential storm.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Intense pain spread through its body, as Demonic Power surged forth without restraint, trying to break the Spiritual Power chains. But at this moment, the ringing of a bell sounded again.
Its Demonic Power circulation became sluggish, and it lost consciousness once more.
In the distance, watching the Copper Corpse constantly beating the Flame Lion, which was still lively, Xu Ping was secretly astonished.
Truly deserving of being a Demon Beast with a trace of Golden Crow bloodline, its strength was indeed formidable.
Copper Corpse, Arrays, Soul Sound Bell, Spiritual Sense Attack—so many methods could only suppress it; killing it was difficult.
If it were daylight, he couldn’t imagine how strong it would be.
In any case, Xu Ping decided not to delay further.
With a flicker of spiritual light, the Blood-Drinking Sword appeared in his hand in an instant.
Mana surged, accompanied by clapping thunder sounds, as countless Sword Qi struck the Flame Lion.
"Roar!"
The Flame Lion howled in pain, boosting its Demonic Power to enhance its defensive power, but its wounds kept increasing, and its aura continued to weaken, until finally, Xu Ping severed its head with a single sword strike.
"Phew!"
"Finally settled!"
Xu Ping let out a long breath, finishing off the Flame Lion was not easy, and it had consumed a significant amount of his Divine Sense and Mana.
"Time to see the Demon Core!"
He was visibly excited, using the Blood-Drinking Sword to carve a bloody hole in the Flame Lion’s abdomen.
His Divine Sense extended into the corpse.
"Found it!"
Suppressing his excitement, Xu Ping used the Blood-Drinking Sword to create a larger bloody hole in the Flame Lion’s abdomen.
A crystal stone the size of a walnut, earth-yellow with traces of gold, appeared before his eyes.
"Hahaha, Demon Core!"
Xu Ping could no longer contain his excitement, laughing heartily.
After so much time and effort, the main material for the Foundation Establishment Pill was finally gathered.
Xu Ping carefully sealed the Demon Core into a jade box, then stored the Flame Lion’s corpse into the Storage Ring.
"Time to leave!"
Eager to return, Xu Ping set off into the night.

chapters.title: Chapter 97: Foundation Establishment Pill Completed
chapters.content:
Chapter 97: Chapter 97: Foundation Establishment Pill Completed
Half a month later.
Xu Ping wearily arrived at his own doorstep.
He took out his token to open the array of his cave dwelling, walked through the small courtyard, stepped into the house, and plopped down onto a chair.
"Finally home," Xu Ping said, a smile involuntarily appearing on his lips as his body and mind relaxed completely.
The trip to the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range was uneventful despite some scares.
Not only did he obtain a Demon Core, but also improved his strength to another level.
It was indeed a complete success.
"Now it’s time to refine the Foundation Establishment Pill." With this thought, a trace of anticipation rose in Xu Ping’s heart.
Foundation Establishment Pill!
This was something the original owner didn’t even dare to imagine!
However, his cultivation level had not yet reached the perfection of the ninth layer, so there was no need to rush. It wouldn’t be too late to refine it after reaching perfection.
Moreover, although Du Xinghuai promised to help him connect with his mentor, it hasn’t been confirmed yet.
After everything is settled, it wouldn’t be too late to refine the pill.
"Let’s have a good sleep today." Xu Ping stretched lazily, a hint of fatigue appearing on his face.
During the months at the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range, he hadn’t had a good night’s sleep, and coupled with the long travels, he felt extremely exhausted with his current physique.
After cleaning his body with a Cleaning Talisman, he fell into a deep sleep.
...
...
Time passed.
In the days that followed,
Xu Ping returned to his regular cultivation, slowing down the Body Refining Skill and other techniques a bit.
He sought the best state of body and mind, neither too tired nor too idle.
Sometimes, he would go to the neighboring Du Mansion to drink and chat idly with Du Xinghuai, inquiring about the alchemy situation.
Incidentally, he collected other materials for the Foundation Establishment Pill.
The other materials were quite common, and Xu Ping gathered them without much effort.
...
In the blink of an eye, half a year passed.
This day, Xu Ping was invited to the Du Mansion.
As he arrived, Du Xinghuai smiled and delivered good news to Xu Ping, "Fellow Daoist Xu, I have finally connected with my mentor for you."
"Connected?" Xu Ping’s eyes lit up, his face showing joy.
Sending so many Spirit Stones to Du Xinghuai was precisely to meet the Hidden Alchemist.
"Yes," Du Xinghuai nodded, grinning, "I’ve contacted my mentor, but you must tell me what Pill you want my mentor to help you refine."
After hesitating for a moment, Xu Ping decided to be honest, "I hope your esteemed mentor can help me refine a Foundation Establishment Pill."
"Foundation Establishment Pill!!" Du Xinghuai exclaimed, jumping up from the chair, staring at Xu Ping in shock, "You’re not joking, Fellow Daoist Xu?"
"Do I look like I’m joking?" Xu Ping maintained a calm expression, his tone firm.
To prove this was no trivial matter, he also took out the Demon Core.
"It truly is a Demon Core!"
Upon verification, Du Xinghuai looked deeply at Xu Ping, deeply shaken.
He never expected that a mere Loose Cultivator could actually gather all the materials for a Foundation Establishment Pill.
It’s known that many Foundation Establishment Cultivators find it hard to gather the materials for a Foundation Establishment Pill.
"In three days, I’ll take you to meet my mentor." After suppressing his inner shock, Du Xinghuai said slowly.
"Thank you, Alchemist Du." Xu Ping cupped his hands in gratitude, feeling excited inside.
"No need to be polite." Du Xinghuai’s expression was complex.
To a Qi Cultivator, except for those with Celestial Spirit Roots, who wouldn’t desire a Foundation Establishment Pill?
Greed sprouted in his heart but was quickly quelled by reason.
A Loose Cultivator capable of gathering the materials for a Foundation Establishment Pill must be a formidable figure with both luck and strength.
With his skills, he obviously didn’t have the ability to seize the Foundation Establishment Pill’s materials.
...
...
Three days later, Du Xinghuai introduced Xu Ping to the Hidden Alchemist.
Xu Ping also brought along a witness from the Immortal City.
The so-called witness is a notary to ensure the fair refining of the Foundation Establishment Pill.
The Foundation Establishment Pill is of exceptionally high value. Loose Cultivators who coincidentally gather the materials for it, but fear being killed for wealth by the alchemists in the Immortal City, can invite someone from Qiu Xuan Immortal City to be a witness, ensuring the fair distribution of the Foundation Establishment Pill.
The reason Qiu Xuan Immortal City is famed as a sanctuary for Loose Cultivators is largely due to such a system.
Although inviting a witness requires a considerable fee, compared to the value of the Foundation Establishment Pill, it’s a mere drop in the ocean.
Toward this system of Qiu Xuan Immortal City, Xu Ping actually held a bit of fondness in his heart.
It equates to giving countless Loose Cultivators a chance to rise.
Under the witness’s gaze,
The Hidden Alchemist confirmed the materials’ share and negotiated the alchemy fee.
The parties agreed to begin pill refinement in a month.
This was considered jumping the queue.
In the Loose Alchemist realm of Yellow Dragon Immortal City, the Hidden Alchemist’s skills were deemed top-notch.
Many seeking his pill refinement were in the Foundation Establishment Stage.
For regular Foundation Establishment Cultivators, the Hidden Alchemist wasn’t concerned and often required half a year’s wait.
But Foundation Establishment Pills were different. Their extraordinary value warranted jumping the queue.
After their agreement, Xu Ping chose not to return home, opting to stay at the ’city center’ cave dwelling for half a year.
The ’city center’ was at the base of Qiu Xuan Mountain.
And Qiu Xuan Mountain, being the cultivation realm of Qiu Xuan Zhenren’s lineage, naturally deterred any disturbances.
Xu Ping worried that news of the Foundation Establishment Pill’s main materials might leak, finding staying in the inner city insecure.
Once the Foundation Establishment Pill was refined, he would immediately attempt to break through to Foundation Establishment in the cave dwelling.
...
A month passed without incident.
As agreed, Xu Ping and the witness met at the Hidden Alchemist’s residence.
In the Alchemy Hall he visited years ago,
Xu Ping once again met the Hidden Alchemist, the slender elder with white hair and a youthful face.
"Master Hua." He clasped his hands in salutation.
"Young friend Xu, before refining, there’s a need to verify your materials again," the Hidden Alchemist said.
"Understood." Xu Ping nodded, presenting all the materials for the Foundation Establishment Pill.
After carefully examining them, the Hidden Alchemist nodded, "All materials are correct. Let’s start the alchemy process now."
He instructed them to observe from a distance without disturbing the process.
Securing the materials, he stepped into the hall to begin the alchemy.
...
Xu Ping, the witness, and Du Xinghuai sat on cushions outside the main hall.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, rest assured, my mentor’s alchemy skills are nearing Second-stage Upper Grade, making the refinement of the Foundation Establishment Pill almost a sure success."
Du Xinghuai reassured kindly.
"Indeed, the Hidden Alchemist’s skills are considered top-notch in the Immortal City," the thin elder acting as a witness also nodded.
"Thank you both for your insights, I trust the Hidden Alchemist’s skills."
Despite saying so, Xu Ping couldn’t help but feel nervous inside.
Even though he had a seventy to eighty percent success rate without the Foundation Establishment Pill, the pill was still essential to push the odds further to over ninety-eight percent.
...
Five days later.
A faint medicinal fragrance wafted from the hall, refreshing one’s spirit.
At that moment, the alchemy process was nearing completion.
The Pill Furnace glowed, emanating a dense aroma.
"Open!"
With a shout, the Hidden Alchemist gestured with his hands, executing the Furnace Skill.
Buzz!
A cascade of colorful mist burst open the cauldron lid, with heat waves sweeping around.
Above the Pill Furnace, faint auspicious clouds formed, enveloped in colorful halos.
"What a phenomenon..."
"The Foundation Establishment Pill is complete!!"
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
The auspicious cloud and mist encased two pills, delivering them into the Hidden Alchemist’s hands.
Xu Ping gazed over with excitement.
Two pills, each with a glossy appearance, lay quietly in the alchemist’s hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 98: Foundation Establishment
chapters.content:
Chapter 98: Chapter 98: Foundation Establishment
"Luckily, I didn’t fail you. The Foundation Establishment Pill has been successfully refined." The Hidden Alchemist’s face showed delight.
"Thank you, Hidden Alchemist." Xu Ping was overjoyed beyond expectation.
After spending so much time and Spirit Stones, the Foundation Establishment Pill is finally made!
"Congratulations, congratulations!"
Du Xinghuai and another person also expressed their congratulations.
"It’s all in a day’s work."
The Hidden Alchemist waved his hand, "As agreed, if two or more pills were made, each of us gets one."
"That’s fair." Xu Ping nodded.
Although giving one Foundation Establishment Pill to the Hidden Alchemist pained his heart, he wouldn’t renege in front of the witness.
The Hidden Alchemist used his Mana to levitate a Foundation Establishment Pill, delivering it to Xu Ping.
Xu Ping took the Foundation Establishment Pill and carefully sealed it in a jade box.
The Foundation Establishment Pill needs to be stored in a special jade box; otherwise, its medicinal properties would gradually dissipate.
After storing the Foundation Establishment Pill, Xu Ping made a few polite remarks and then left the Hidden Alchemist’s residence.
...
At the entrance of the Hidden Alchemist’s residence.
"May you succeed in your Foundation Establishment!" Du Xinghuai offered his blessings, though for some reason felt a twinge of bitterness.
"Thank you for your kind words!" Xu Ping replied with a big smile.
With the aid of the Foundation Establishment Pill, his success rate in establishing the foundation wasn’t 100%, but at least 98%.
"Before you make your attempt, it’s best not to be too tense or excited. You should bathe, change clothes, and calm your mind." The witness advised him.
"Thank you for the reminder." Xu Ping cupped his hands in a salute.
The witness in the Immortal City was indeed diligent and responsible.
Qiu Xuan Immortal City held the reputation of being a sanctuary for loose cultivators, thanks in no small part to the efforts of the witnesses.
"No need to be formal, it’s just common sense." The witness waved his hand, then sincerely blessed him, "It’s not easy for a loose cultivator to reach Foundation Establishment. May you succeed in establishing your foundation!"
Hearing the sincerity in his words, Xu Ping solemnly bowed in salute and said, "Thank you for your kind words!"
...
...
Back at the inner city’s cave dwelling.
Xu Ping used the array token to open the entrance of the cave dwelling and entered inside.
Spiritual Qi was all around, vaguely forming a thin mist.
He took a deep breath, feeling as though he was floating like a celestial being.
Though he had lived here for a month, the Spiritual Qi environment still amazed him.
Upon reaching the cultivation chamber, Xu Ping sat on a meditation cushion, took out a Fasting Pill, and swallowed it, silently adjusting his energy and spirit...
As his thoughts wandered, scenes from before he transmigrated, the struggles after his transmigration, and the joy of obtaining the interface flickered by...
The vivid figures, some hateful, some grateful... were still fresh in his mind.
Foundation Establishment is the first gateway on the path of immortality!
Once this gateway is breached, one is no longer a mere mortal!
His thoughts gradually calmed, and Xu Ping silently circulated the ’Five Elements Skill,’ his body shrouded in spiritual light.
Half a month later.
He felt a sudden insight, sensing his spirit and Mana at an unprecedented peak.
Whoosh! Swish!
"Let’s begin!"
Xu Ping hesitated no longer, took out the jade bottle containing the Foundation Establishment Pill, removed the stopper, and swallowed the pill with its lustrous color.
"This Foundation Establishment attempt has a 98% chance of success!"
His eyes shone brightly, like a radiant sun, and a strong conviction surged in his heart!
With great confidence, he activated the ’Five Elements Skill,’ aiming for the summit!
Whoosh whoosh!
The surrounding Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi seemed to be attracted by some force, continuously gathering into the training room, gradually becoming dense and forming a vortex...
Time passed unknowingly.
The intense Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi transformed into a waterfall, pouring down through Xu Ping’s Celestial Spirit, continuously washing over his body.
Pain!
The severe pain caused him to grunt.
This is the first gateway of Foundation Establishment – the Vital Energy and Blood Pass!
A large quantity of Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi invades a cultivator’s body. If the body cannot withstand it, the Foundation Establishment will fail!
Therefore, those with deteriorated vitality or physical defects face greater risks at this pass, with a higher chance of failure!
While this is an obstacle, it’s also an opportunity.
The infusion of Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi into a cultivator’s body is a process of cleansing and marrowing renewal, transforming the body to better accommodate Spiritual Qi, and under the infusion and nourishment of Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi, extending lifespan.
Xu Ping initially found the pain unbearable, but soon composed himself.
"With Second-stage Body Refining, a flawless body, and vigorous vitality, plus the aid of the Foundation Establishment Pill!"
"A mere infusion of Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi is but a trifling matter!"
Xu Ping sat cross-legged on a stone bed, enduring the barrage of violent Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi pouring into his body.
He was like an impregnable fortress that remained unyielding under the scouring waves.
...
Foundation Establishment Second Pass – Mana Pass!
When Xu Ping achieved perfection in the Five Elements Skill, this was already accomplished!
Moreover, following the marrowing purification by Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi
Whoosh!
With the transfusion of Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi, the pressure within Xu Ping’s Dantian suddenly increased, the Five Elements Skill Mana began to compress, and strands of Mana mist rose above the Dantian.
"Mana Pass, it’s also going smoothly."
Xu Ping smiled with composure.
...
The third pass, Divine Sense Pass.
Here, Xu Ping had an even greater advantage; the strength of his Divine Sense now was not much less than that of an early-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator!
Divine Sense, facilitates the control of Mana, guiding the Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi, compressing and liquefying the Mana.
Whoosh whoosh...
Under the guidance of Divine Sense, the Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi outside the cave dwelling quickly surged, forming a vortex of Spiritual Qi dozens of feet in diameter.
Numerous Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi continuously flowed into Xu Ping’s body, increasing the amount of Mana mist in his Dantian.
Time passed unknowingly.
Drip!
Drip!
The sound of water droplets dripping echoed in Xu Ping’s ears.
The next moment, he introspectively observed his own Dantian Sea of Qi, seeing drops of liquid Mana falling like raindrops.
One drop, two drops... ten drops...
...
"Someone is attempting Foundation Establishment!"
"It seems to have reached the critical stage of Foundation Establishment."
The anomaly in Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi attracted the attention of cultivators in some cave dwellings near the ’city center.’
The cave dwellings in the ’city center’ are rented out, and almost every year, cultivators attempt Foundation Establishment or overcome bottlenecks here.
Attempting Foundation Establishment here was nothing extraordinary, but those who succeeded were ultimately few.
...
Another half month passed.
The Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi vortex above the cave dwelling shimmered with faint rosy clouds, and then slowly dissipated.
In the sealed chamber, an influx of Foundation Establishment stage spiritual pressure suddenly appeared.
"Foundation Establishment... succeeded!"
Xu Ping opened his eyes, with two sharp glints appearing, reaching a foot long, then gradually fading.
He quickly checked his proficiency interface.
The original "Realm: Qi Cultivation, Ninth Level: 99/100"
Had turned into "Realm: Early-Stage Foundation Establishment: 1/100"
Meanwhile, his lifespan altered from "Lifespan: 33/142 years"
To "Lifespan: 33/268 years"
"Hahaha..."
"Foundation Establishment, I’ve finally achieved it!!!" Xu Ping could no longer suppress his excitement, bursting into hearty laughter.
This was a realm that his former self could only dream of!
Yet he finally achieved it himself!
Gradually quelling his laughter, Xu Ping suppressed his excitement and began to carefully sense his internal changes.
First, the liquid Mana in his Dantian reached a total of thirty-eight drops.
"Isn’t this liquid Mana... a bit too much!" Xu Ping was shocked.
Although he had expected his liquid Mana to be slightly more than that of cultivators just breaking through to Foundation Establishment, this was indeed a bit excessive.

chapters.title: Chapter 99: Invitation
chapters.content:
Chapter 99: Chapter 99: Invitation
The wild laughter gradually ceased, Xu Ping suppressed the excitement in his heart and began to carefully perceive the changes within himself.
Firstly, the liquid Mana in the dantian had reached as much as thirty-eight drops.
"Isn’t this liquid Mana... a bit too much?" Xu Ping was startled in his heart.
Although he had expected it, his liquid Mana would definitely be a little more than that of cultivators who had just broken through to Foundation Establishment, but this was indeed a bit too much.
Generally, cultivators who had just broken through to Foundation Establishment have twenty drops of liquid Mana in their dantian, and his liquid Mana in the dantian was almost half more than ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivators.
Although it’s still not comparable to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators, as cultivation continues, the liquid Mana will definitely keep increasing.
"Not bad, not bad!" Xu Ping was pleased; the Five Elements Skill at the Perfection level was indeed formidable.
However, when he operated the Five Elements cultivation technique again, he was surprised to find that this technique could only slowly recover Mana, and could no longer improve it.
"This..." Xu Ping was slightly stunned but quickly understood.
The Five Elements Skill was indeed a Qi Cultivation technique; to continue cultivation, he must switch to a Foundation Establishment Technique.
"It seems the matter of changing techniques must be put on the agenda." Xu Ping thought to himself.
Otherwise, he could only stare blankly.
Next, he sensed the changes in his Divine Sense.
To his delight, his Divine Sense range expanded from fifteen zhang to sixty zhang.
"Generally, the Divine Sense range of Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators is only forty or fifty zhang, but now mine is a full sixty zhang, stronger than ordinary Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators."
A slight smile appeared on Xu Ping’s face.
If he now used the Shocking God Needle, that Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment man he met before would definitely not withstand it.
But against Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators, he wouldn’t dare to say for sure.
After taking stock, Xu Ping continued to regulate his breathing and sat meditating to consolidate his cultivation.
...
More than a month later.
Xu Ping officially emerged from seclusion, and the rental agreement for the cave residence had also expired.
As soon as he stepped out, a middle-aged man immediately came up to him, bowed, and greeted, "I am Tang Liangcai, the steward managing the cave residence, congratulating Elder on your successful Foundation Establishment, with prospects for the Great Dao in the future!"
"Fortunate success!" Listening to the man’s compliments, Xu Ping smiled.
"Elder is humble; any cultivator who successfully establishes Foundation is deemed fated by Heaven!" Tang Liangcai flattered once more.
Then he took out a pile of visiting cards from a storage bag, "Many have visited Elder after your successful Foundation Establishment, but knowing Elder was consolidating your cultivation, they dared not disturb rudely, so they left visiting cards, hoping Elder can meet them after coming out."
Seeing the thick stack of visiting cards, Xu Ping was quite startled, "So many visiting cards?"
Judging by its thickness, there were at least sixty or seventy of them.
Although he had expected it, this was indeed too much.
If he were to visit them all, when would he be able to finish attending?
