"Elder, achieving Foundation Establishment as a Loose Cultivator naturally makes it different." Tang Liangcai smiled slightly.
"Every Loose Cultivator Elder who successfully establishes Foundation is a great inspiration to countless Loose Cultivators in the Immortal City."
"However, most of them are from small and medium forces that have not even reached Foundation Establishment, just trying to make connections and giving visiting cards and gifts. Elder need not pay attention to them."
"It would be better for Elder to meet with the forces having Foundation Establishment cultivators; I have categorized these visiting cards for Elder."
Tang Liangcai pulled out over a dozen obviously ornate visiting cards from the sixty-seven visiting cards.
"You are thoughtful." Xu Ping praised Tang Liangcai.
"Elder is kind," Tang Liangcai said with a smile, "These are tasks given by the Immortal City to me; I naturally strive to do my best."
"Tasks given by the Immortal City?" Xu Ping was momentarily startled.
"The Golden Core ancestor of the Immortal City was a Loose Cultivator himself, deeply understanding the difficulties of Loose Cultivation, hence many considerations are given to Loose Cultivators in various places." Tang Liangcai explained.
"I see, Qiu Xuan Immortal City indeed is the sacred place for Loose Cultivation!" Xu Ping admired.
He naturally knew that the Immortal City definitely had intentions of drawing him in this time, but their methods were comforting.
Listening to Xu Ping’s praise, Tang Liangcai smiled even more, "Elder is flattering."
"I wonder after Elder’s Foundation Establishment, what are your plans? Are you intending to stay in Qiu Xuan Immortal City, or do you plan to leave?" Tang Liangcai bowed respectfully and asked, "Besides, Elder likely hasn’t obtained a Foundation Establishment Technique yet?"
"Still undecided, regarding a Foundation Establishment Technique, it indeed troubles me!" Xu Ping replied.
"Then, is Elder interested in being a Guest Minister for our Qiu Xuan Immortal City?"
Tang Liangcai’s eyes lit up, "To be honest... I came today firstly to handle some small matters for Elder, and secondly to invite Elder to become a Guest Minister of Qiu Xuan Immortal City, at which point Elder can obtain cultivation techniques provided by the Immortal City."
"Moreover, you can also obtain a cave residence on Qiu Xuan Mountain for free, and annually receive Spirit Stones, which will surely be quite beneficial to Elder!"
They had naturally conducted a background investigation on Xu Ping before inviting.
His life trajectory before coming to the Immortal City was not clear, but during his years in the Immortal City, he single-mindedly focused on cultivation and interacted little with others.
Obviously, he was not someone who caused trouble.
The cultivation realm isn’t entirely about fighting and killing; even Core Formation forces would find it troublesome to deal with disciples and Guest Ministers who cause trouble everywhere they go, leaving death in their wake.
Additionally, having achieved Foundation Establishment as a Loose Cultivator naturally brings a natural sense of closeness.
Tang Liangcai then went into detail about the specific treatment for Foundation Establishment Guest Ministers.
For instance, Early-Stage Foundation Establishment Guest Ministers receive an annual salary of one thousand Spirit Stones and a bottle of Pill for cultivation use by Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators.
If they reach Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment, the salary would further increase.
Xu Ping pondered for a moment, then slowly said, "Thanks for the kindness... I just wonder what the obligations are after becoming a Guest Minister?"
"Guest Ministers of the city must complete tasks assigned by Qiu Xuan Immortal City periodically; of course, they won’t be tasked with anything too dangerous, and there will be corresponding rewards for completing tasks...
"Besides, to become a Guest Minister of the city and later leave, one must serve for at least thirty years..."
"Thirty years?"
Xu Ping was quite surprised; he wanted to say it was too long, the original was only in his thirties.
But upon careful consideration, he had already achieved Foundation Establishment, with a life span of up to 268 years.
Serving for thirty years isn’t considered long.
"Well... let me think about it for a while." Although Xu Ping was tempted, he decided to observe first.
Check how the conditions are specifically, weigh the pros and cons.
The terms offered by the Immortal City are good; however, this compulsory task feels a bit dangerous, and joining the Immortal City means he’d lose the freedom of being a Loose Cultivator.
Yet, thinking about it again.
In Yue Country, there seems to be no better place to obtain cultivation resources.

chapters.title: Chapter 100: Joining
chapters.content:
Chapter 100: Chapter 100: Joining
He has only just established his Foundation, and doesn’t even have a Cultivation Technique. Finding a faction to rely on and gradually develop until the time is ripe to leave is not too late.
The reason he needs to consider is merely to make a final confirmation.
"Yes, this matter naturally requires careful consideration. Elder Xu can inquire about the treatment of Guest Ministers in our Immortal City; it’s the same for everyone." Tang Liangcai said with a confident smile.
...
...
Going back to his home in the inner city.
Xu Ping sat on a stone stool, drank a sip of water silently, and couldn’t help but think about joining Qiu Xuan Immortal City.
Joining a major faction should involve some scrutiny.
However, even a Core Formation elder would not rashly probe a Foundation Establishment Cultivator’s Sea of Consciousness, Sea of Qi, or Dantian as these are critical areas.
This situation would almost always lead to a deadly feud. At most, they check bone age or whether someone has disguised themselves.
"As long as they don’t check deeply, my Divine Sense and liquid Mana should not be discovered..."
"As long as these two aren’t discovered, it won’t be a big problem..."
"Even if my Second-stage Body Refining is exposed, it doesn’t matter."
As for the proficiency panel, this Golden Finger?
As long as I’m not foolish enough to expose it deliberately, there’s absolutely no need to worry.
...
In the following days, Xu Ping began to visit each Foundation Establishment faction in the Immortal City with a letter of introduction.
To his surprise, most Foundation Establishment Cultivators had actually been Guest Ministers of ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’.
Many resigned only when they got older and felt their path to immortality was hopeless, then accumulated wives and concubines and enjoyed their remaining affluent years.
No wonder most of these loose Foundation Establishment Cultivators are quite old.
The youngest even looked middle-aged.
By actual age, they should also be around a hundred years old.
Many more appear elderly.
"It seems that the compulsory tasks of ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ are not very dangerous. So many Foundation Establishment Cultivators have passed through safely; my strength is much greater than theirs, so there shouldn’t be any fatal threats," Xu Ping thought to himself.
...
On the way back, he paused at Zhang Yan’s medicine shop.
He is now at the Foundation Establishment level, so he shouldn’t be collaborating with Zhang Yan to sell Spirit Wine anymore, as it’s time-consuming and doesn’t earn many Spirit Stones.
He ought to say goodbye.
As soon as Xu Ping entered the shop, he saw Zhang Yan taking Bliss Pills, to which his heart was unimpressed.
"Fellow Daoist Zhang," he greeted.
"Oh, Fellow Daoist Xu, you..."
Zhang Yan turned his head and saw Xu Ping, ready to greet him, but then noticed Xu Ping’s unusual Mana fluctuations.
He was dumbfounded, pointing at Xu Ping as if he had seen a ghost, "You...you...you...you’ve reached Foundation Establishment!"
"I recently had the fortune to reach Foundation Establishment!" Xu Ping replied with a smile.
"That really is a distinguished guest. Fellow Daoist Xu...Elder Xu, please have a seat." Zhang Yan quickly adjusted his emotions and smiled warmly.
"The friendship between the two of us for years doesn’t require such politeness. As before, do not speak of these formalities."
"No, no, I, a mere Qi Cultivator, wouldn’t dare call myself your fellow Daoist. If people found out, they would think me arrogant and ignorant," Zhang Yan quickly waved his hand, his emotions mixed as he saw Xu Ping’s invigorated appearance.
However, having experienced the harsh blows of the Cultivation Realm, his mindset had already adapted and soon adjusted again.
He understood that this was a golden opportunity to cling to.
Xu Ping insisted several times, but Zhang Yan persisted, and so he reluctantly went along. In the Cultivation Realm, the strong are revered, and the hierarchy is as brutally clear as this.
"Fellow Daoist Zhang, after I established my Foundation, Qiu Xuan Mountain invited me to be their Guest Minister. After some thought, I decided to accept, so our Spirit Wine business might have to stop," Xu Ping said.
"Stop?" Zhang Yan was slightly taken aback before he realized, "That’s only proper. Elder Xu is already at the Foundation Establishment stage. Time is precious; how can you waste it on brewing wine?"
Though he said this, worries crept into Zhang Yan’s heart.
Without the Spirit Wine business, their interactions would lessen, and their friendship would likely fade.
Zhang Yan gritted his teeth and took out a jade slip from his storage bag: "Elder Xu, for successfully reaching Foundation Establishment, I don’t have much to gift, so please accept a scroll of alchemical inheritance."
"That’s too precious," Xu Ping shook his head, refusing.
"It’s just a scroll of alchemical inheritance, not very valuable. To Elder Xu, it is of little importance."
"Besides, I’ve tried alchemy, but my talent is too poor. After so many years, I can only refine First Rank Lower Grade Pills barely. It’s wasted in my hands, better to give it to Elder Xu," Zhang Yan insisted.
Xu Ping could not resist and accepted it.
He understood Zhang Yan’s intentions behind giving such a precious gift.
When he scanned the jade slip with his Divine Sense, he initially thought it was just First Rank alchemy.
But he didn’t expect the alchemical inheritance in the jade slip to reach Second-stage Upper Grade.
It even included several Pills that are beneficial for the cultivation of a Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
Even for him now, it was immensely valuable.
Xu Ping was internally shaken, giving Zhang Yan a deep look, and said slowly, "If Fellow Daoist Zhang encounters any trouble in the future, you can come to me. I won’t refuse to help within my power."
"Thank you, Elder Xu," Zhang Yan was overjoyed.
He gave Xu Ping such a precious gift for this reason.
After chatting a bit more, not long after, Xu Ping left.
...
...
Five days later.
Tang Liangcai visited again.
"What has Elder Xu decided?" he asked with a bright smile.
"I’ve made up my mind. I appreciate Qiu Xuan Mountain’s consideration. I’ll join," Xu Ping replied with a smile.
Joining ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ was more profitable than detrimental, with free Cultivation Techniques and a stable environment for cultivation. Thirty years is but a blink for a Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
Upon hearing this, Tang Liangcai’s smile widened, "On behalf of ’Qiu Xuan Mountain,’ I welcome Elder Xu’s joining. Do you need time to pack?"
"No," Xu Ping shook his head, as all his belongings were in his storage bag.
The golden-tailed carp he had raised for years were already in specially purchased spirit beast bags.
"Then please come with me, Elder Xu," Tang Liangcai led the way.
...
...
With Tang Liangcai leading the way along the long mountain path, through the illusionary mist, Qiu Xuan Mountain finally unveiled itself before Xu Ping’s eyes.
It was larger than imagined, with terraced Spirit Fields and Herb Fields extending along both sides of the mountain path, layer upon layer, reaching up to the mountain peak.
The countless pavilions and towers were densely packed and magnificent.
Countless cultivators maneuvered their Magical Artifacts back and forth, busy with activity.
"Senior Brother Zhang, who is this?" a gatekeeping Cultivator asked with cupped hands.
"This is the new Guest Minister, Xu Ping, Elder Xu. I’m taking him to see the Sect Leader, Senior Brother."
Upon hearing this, the two hastily bowed, "Greetings, Elder Xu."
Xu Ping nodded slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 101: Choosing a Cave Dwelling
chapters.content:
Chapter 101: Chapter 101: Choosing a Cave Dwelling
On the road, Tang Liangcai explained the details of Qiu Xuan Mountain as they walked, and Xu Ping listened carefully, periodically asking questions to gain some preliminary understanding of Qiu Xuan Mountain.
Although ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ was established by a Golden Core loose cultivator, its operation model is similar to some sects.
Excluding the mortal servants, ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ has over a thousand people in total.
These Qi Cultivation Stage disciples are divided into outer and inner sects.
Generally speaking, based on cultivation level, those under twenty who enter Late-Stage Qi Cultivation will be promoted to inner sect disciples, provided with the best resources and spiritual land, and need only focus on cultivation without worrying about other matters.
On the other hand, outer sect disciples endure much more hardship, having to handle various chores and engage in production work in addition to cultivation.
The current Tang Liangcai is an outer sect disciple.
"In fact, if we talk about cultivation level, many outer sect disciples are not inferior to inner sect disciples, and there are plenty in Late-Stage Qi Cultivation. It’s just that the older ones have little hope of achieving Foundation Establishment," Tang Liangcai couldn’t help but add.
Xu Ping maintained a polite smile in response to Tang Liangcai’s complaints.
For Qiu Xuan Mountain, these outer sect disciples, although called disciples, are merely tools.
Tang Liangcai quickly adjusted his mood and continued to introduce Xu Ping.
In total, Qiu Xuan Mountain has thirty Foundation Establishment cultivators.
There are only two Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators, one of whom is the sect leader’s senior brother Hongyi, whom Xu Ping is here to meet.
There are eight Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators, with the rest being Early-Stage.
The only Golden Core ancestor in Qiu Xuan Mountain is at the Middle Stage of Golden Core, and at four hundred years old, he is considered to be in his later years according to a Golden Core Cultivator’s lifespan.
Listening to Tang Liangcai’s account, the image of ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ gradually became clearer in Xu Ping’s mind.
...
The two of them walked all the way to the mountain peak.
Xu Ping discovered that it resembled a small cultivation city, with numerous buildings constructed along the mountain, densely packed and arranged in an orderly fashion.
Tang Liangcai led Xu Ping to a hall in a large building, called for a disciple guarding the gate to serve tea, and then bowed and said, "Please wait here for a moment, senior. I will report to the sect leader’s senior brother."
"It’s no problem!" Xu Ping replied.
After Tang Liangcai left, Xu Ping looked around and noticed luminous arrays on the wooden walls, with a mirror prominently placed above the room, reflecting his figure clearly.
"This mirror...." Xu Ping frowned slightly, appearing lost in thought.
Just then, a burst of hearty laughter could be heard.
Xu Ping quickly shifted his gaze, stood up from his seat, and looked towards the door.
An imposing figure, appearing to be around forty or fifty years old, elegantly walked in with large strides.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, please have a seat. There’s no need to be formal here."
"I am Xu Ping. Nice to meet you, sect leader’s senior brother!" Xu Ping clasped his hands and saluted.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, achieving Foundation Establishment as a loose cultivator shows exceptional talent and perseverance!" Hongyi praised.
"Fellow Daoist Hong, you flatter me. I was merely fortunate," Xu Ping humbly replied.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, you are too modest."
Hongyi exchanged pleasantries without rushing into formal discussions, occasionally inquiring about Xu Ping’s past experiences.
Xu Ping was well-prepared and responded fluently.
Yue Country is vast, and although ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ is a Golden Core force, verifying the truth of Xu Ping’s words was nearly impossible.
Hongyi nodded slightly, not probing further; a loose cultivator who achieves Foundation Establishment would inevitably have secrets.
Moreover, he was only recruiting a guest minister, and access to the core of ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ was not necessary, so strict scrutiny wasn’t required.
"Fellow Daoist, you are new to ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ and must have many things to settle. Let’s not chat for too long!" Hongyi said, and after instructing Xu Ping to wait briefly, he went into the inner room for about ten minutes.
He returned with a storage bag, handed it over, and smiled:
"I’ve already registered you. Inside is a robe of our ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’, a bottle of Qi Refining Powder; consider these as welcome gifts. There’s also a guest minister identity token and a jade slip. The contents of the jade slip will help you familiarize yourself with ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ quickly."
"Regarding cultivation techniques, you can use the guest minister token to choose from the library yourself."
"Except for the most core techniques, the rest can be freely chosen."
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Hong." Xu Ping clasped his hands in salute.
This Hongyi is truly generous, gifting a bottle of Qi Refining Pills as a welcome gift.
Qi Refining Pills are a second-stage lower-grade pill, used for Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators, worth several hundred Spirit Stones per bottle.
"No need to be formal. Ideally, I should introduce you to the ancestor, but unfortunately, the ancestor is currently in seclusion and cannot be disturbed."
Hongyi stroked his beard and smiled, "Fortunately, there will be plenty of opportunities in the future, with the entry ceremony scheduled for three days later, where everyone can meet."
"No problem," Xu Ping nodded.
Better not to meet the Golden Core cultivator; he feared they might sense something upon close observation.
Hongyi then went over some of the rules and precautions for guest ministers and summoned a gatekeeping disciple to accompany Xu Ping in selecting a suitable cave dwelling.
...
...
After Xu Ping left.
Hongyi stood up and cast a spell at the mirror above the room.
The mirror’s surface shimmered and then transformed into a stream of light, manifesting before him.
"Hmm... Mana is profound, second-stage Body Refining... No disguise, bone age is indiscernible, probably due to some advanced bone transformation technique," Hongyi assessed.
"Overall, he appears to be an above-average loose cultivator Foundation Establishment, likely with the potential to break through to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment." Hongyi nodded, feeling reasonably satisfied with Xu Ping.
This precious mirror is a special mystical artifact capable of probing the depths of a cultivator.
Each new guest minister must undergo its scrutiny.
This is also the confidence behind their boldness in recruiting guest ministers.
...
...
The cave dwelling is located on the mountainside below the peak, shaded and secluded, with ancient trees and vines, a meandering stream flowing down, and schools of fish and shrimp playing within.
"Guest Minister Xu, there are currently ten available cave dwellings, each connected to a branch of a third-stage spirit vein, making them top-tier cultivation sanctuaries in the mountain," the gatekeeping disciple respectfully introduced.
"Let’s take a look first!" Xu Ping said calmly.
"Yes, senior."
After some selection, Xu Ping finally chose a relatively quiet spot.
He waved the gatekeeping disciple away.
Using the control token, he performed a spell, and the protective array outside the cave dwelling dispersed, revealing the entire cave.
Though called a cave dwelling, most of the structures were outside the cave. There was also a courtyard of several acres, with a one-acre spiritual pool, while cultivation areas like meditation rooms were inside the cave.
"The concentration of Spiritual Qi... is indeed quite exaggerated!" Xu Ping was astonished.
Without the array’s concealment, the Spiritual Qi surged around the cave, and the array evidently had a Gathering Spirit function.
He carefully sensed the Spiritual Qi concentration, discovering it was nearly twice as rich as that of the cave dwelling he rented when breaking through Foundation Establishment.

chapters.title: Chapter 102: Selecting a Cultivation Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 102: Chapter 102: Selecting a Cultivation Technique
The richer the Spiritual Qi, the higher the spiritual pressure; the higher the spiritual pressure, the easier it is to absorb the Spiritual Qi.
In some places with extremely high spiritual pressure, one doesn’t even need to operate cultivation techniques to absorb it; the Spiritual Qi simply tunnels into the body automatically, and such places are truly sacred lands for cultivation.
Xu Ping entered the cave dwelling and reactivated the array.
This array is a First Rank Upper Grade array, with the functions of gathering spirits and protection, but its defensive power for a Foundation Establishment Cultivator is merely better than nothing.
"Now that the Foundation Establishment stage is completed, and my Divine Sense has greatly increased, I should be able to thoroughly research the Second-stage array soon. By then, I’ll rearrange a set of Second-stage array," Xu Ping contemplated internally.
Although ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ is undoubtedly much safer than Qiu Xuan Immortal City, it’s always right to have a setup just in case.
And with the concealment of a Second-stage array, cultivation will be more convenient in the future.
After placing the spiritual fish from the spirit beast bag into the spiritual pool, Xu Ping entered the room.
The room is luxuriously decorated, with everything available, so there’s no need to purchase anything.
After cleansing with a Cleaning Talisman, he moved in.
...
Night descended.
Xu Ping sat cross-legged in the cultivation chamber, eyes closed.
This cultivation chamber is three zhang square, and except for a stone door, all four sides are smooth rock walls.
After a while.
Xu Ping opened his eyes, slowly ceased his cultivation, with a hint of helplessness in his eyebrows.
Even in a place so ample with Spiritual Qi, the ’Five Elements Skill’ has no effect on mana improvement during the Foundation Establishment Stage, just like before.
"It seems that changing the cultivation technique is urgent, tomorrow I’ll go to the Cultivation Skill Pavilion to select one!" he thought to himself.
Since breaking through the Foundation Establishment, the mana has not advanced at all, which is truly distressing.
"But even after switching to a Foundation Establishment cultivation technique, the cultivation speed will definitely be much slower compared to the Qi Refining Realm, so auxiliary pills are indispensable."
Although ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ distributes a bottle of Qi Refining Pills every year, it’s far from sufficient, and one still needs to buy them for assured cultivation.
With a bottle of Qi Refining Powder costing at least six to seven hundred Spirit Stones, calculated for one bottle a month, that’s six to seven thousand Spirit Stones a year.
This doesn’t even include other expenses, such as the cost for Body Refining.
Considering all these expenses together, even a late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator would find it daunting.
"In the past, I could only earn money honestly, but now with alchemy inheritance in hand, I can make pills myself, saving a huge expense," Xu Ping pondered.
The alchemy inheritance from Zhang Yan also includes the method for refining Qi Refining Pills.
With his current Divine Sense and familiarity, refining them is definitely not a problem.
"Then the excess Qi Refining Pills can be sold, providing spirit stones for alchemy materials and body refining too!" With this thought, Xu Ping felt instantly relieved.
The alchemy inheritance from Zhang Yan certainly helped him a lot.
Although he could also earn money through arrays, to earn enough spirit stones for daily expenses, he would at least need to sell second-stage arrays and do it continuously.
But second-stage arrays are still too conspicuous, making them prone to being traced back.
Whereas second-stage pills are much better, as they can be openly revealed, increasing his weight in ’Qiu Xuan Mountain.’
By then, tasks assigned to him will undoubtedly be safer and easier.
This is killing two birds with one stone.
"Sleep, sleep!"
Xu Ping got up and left the cultivation chamber.
...
...
A night of good sleep.
Early next morning, after breakfast, Xu Ping set out for the Cultivation Skill Pavilion.
The jade slip given by Hongyi contained a detailed map of the mountain, so he wasn’t worried about getting lost.
In the morning forest, the greenery is deep, the air is fresh, and a layer of misty fog makes everything appear misty and enchanting. Climbing the moss-covered narrow mountain path, all that can be heard are the chirping birds, noisy yet ethereal.
"Senior!"
"Senior!"
"Senior!"
Along the way, the Qi Refining disciples of ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ bowed and saluted upon seeing Xu Ping’s robe.
Xu Ping nodded in response.
The guest minister robe of ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ and the standard robe of the internal Foundation Establishment cultivators are completely different, so the disciples wouldn’t mistake them.
He twisted and turned all the way to the Cultivation Skill Pavilion.
The gleam of spiritual light and the faint presence of an array made him secretly astonished: "Third-rank Array!"
It is estimated to be one of the most heavily guarded places within the mountain gate!
An old man with the look of a scholar sat at the front desk of the Cultivation Skill Pavilion, holding an ancient book in his hands, reading with great interest. Hearing Xu Ping’s footsteps, he turned his head and sized him up: "A new guest minister?"
"Pardon me, fellow Daoist," Xu Ping cupped his hands, took out the guest minister token from his storage bag: "I was commanded by the Sect Leader’s senior brother to select a Foundation Establishment cultivation technique."
The old cultivator put away his ancient book, took the token to examine it carefully, and after verifying its authenticity, returned it to Xu Ping, "Fellow Daoist, come with me, the Foundation Establishment techniques are on the second floor of the Cultivation Skill Pavilion."
Xu Ping followed the scholarly-looking old cultivator into the Cultivation Skill Pavilion.
The first floor is quite spacious, the air infused with a faint sandalwood aroma, and there were only a few people inside, all Qi Cultivation disciples, both male and female, quietly browsing the jade slips on the shelves.
Passing through the first floor and climbing up the stairs, they reached the second floor of the Cultivation Skill Pavilion.
Looking at the arrays glowing softly on the wooden walls around, Xu Ping paused.
"This is the protective array of our pavilion—the Four Directions Divine Guard Array!" the old cultivator explained, taking out a blue token from his storage bag and casting a spell.
The blue token glowed with spiritual light, revealing a passage through the array light.
"Let’s go," the old cultivator led the way inside, followed closely by Xu Ping.
The second floor of the Cultivation Skill Pavilion is quite small, with only a few rows of bookshelves, neatly filled with jade slips.
"Each jade slip contains only a small portion of the cultivation techniques and secret techniques content, you can view them freely. Once you’ve decided on the full inheritance, you must take an oath not to pass it on to someone else."
The old cultivator explained on the side.
Traditionally, cultivation techniques and secret techniques are the core of an immortal cultivation power.
For a Golden Core power like ’Qiu Xuan Mountain,’ its Cultivation Skill Pavilion is far superior to that of a typical Foundation Establishment Immortal Clan.
Inside are countless cultivation techniques and secret techniques that Loose Cultivators and even some Foundation Establishment powers long for.
"Understood!"
Xu Ping nodded solemnly, first looking at the labels on the wooden shelves:
’Cultivation Techniques,’ ’Secret Techniques,’ ’Hundred Arts of Immortal Cultivation’...
He first walked to the cultivation techniques shelf, extending his divine sense to scan the jade slips on the shelves.
""Mixed Element Skill", this technique practices body refining concurrently, requiring special pills during cultivation..."
""Three Yang Skill", this technique features fierce Spiritual Power and strong mana, excelling in magical combat..."
""Longevity Skill": the mana is average, the cultivation speed is relatively fast, fortifies the foundation, and prolongs life..."
...

chapters.title: Chapter 103: An Unexpected Person
chapters.content:
Chapter 103: Chapter 103: An Unexpected Person
Xu Ping observed for a long time, repeatedly comparing.
In the end, he chose the "Longevity Skill."
This cultivation technique, while average in mana, has fast cultivation speed and solid foundation; most importantly, it can prolong life...
Isn’t the purpose of cultivating immortality to live longer?
Moreover, with his proficiency panel, perhaps with continuous effort, he might extend his life even further.
"Fellow Daoist, I would like to have this ’Longevity Skill’," Xu Ping said.
"No problem, I’ll fetch the complete inheritance for Fellow Daoist."
The old cultivator was about to retrieve the complete inheritance of the "Longevity Skill" for Xu Ping when Xu Ping suddenly stopped him.
"Wait..."
The old cultivator turned his head in confusion, "Does Fellow Daoist have any other matters?"
"If I want other magic spells or secret techniques, how can I acquire them?" Xu Ping inquired.
"That’s simple, just spend Spirit Stones," the old cultivator said with a smile.
"I see," Xu Ping nodded, then picked up two jade slips from the shelf, "How much for this ’Primordial Sword Skill’ combined with this ’Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill’?"
Since he comprehended the Sword Qi Thunder Sound, his swordsmanship realm had not improved any further.
Now that he had reached Foundation Establishment, it was time to learn a second-stage sword technique, and the Primordial Sword Skill was precisely a second-stage sword technique.
Perhaps mastering the Primordial Sword Skill would lead to comprehending the second realm of swordsmanship.
As for the Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill, it’s a second-stage escape technique. Although his speed was fast, it was short-ranged; learning an escape technique was necessary for escaping in critical situations.
"The ’Primordial Sword Skill’ costs fifteen hundred Spirit Stones, the ’Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill’ costs twelve hundred Spirit Stones, so a total of twenty-seven hundred Spirit Stones," the old cultivator replied.
"Alright!" Xu Ping nodded, then immediately placed twenty-seven hundred Spirit Stones on the nearby desk.
This price was slightly cheaper compared to second-stage magic spells and escape techniques at auctions, likely an invisible benefit for guest ministers like them.
The old cultivator counted each stone carefully, then cherished them before heading to the attic, opening a certain array, and retrieving three wooden boxes.
Opening the three wooden boxes revealed three verdant jade slips inside: "Before the transaction, please swear an oath on the Great Dao not to divulge the cultivation techniques!"
Xu Ping’s expression became solemn as he swore the oath.
Calmly, he then took the three jade slips from the old cultivator, first using his spiritual sense to enter the "Longevity Skill."
The Foundation Establishment and cultivation techniques were evident, and he was satisfied seeing that it indeed included parts of the late-stage Core Formation.
This cultivation technique was sufficient for him to cultivate to the late-stage Golden Core.
He also skimmed through the other two jade slips, finding no issues at all.
Xu Ping placed the three single-use transmission jade slips into a storage bag and left the library.
...
Xu Ping returned home, quickly walked to the quiet room, and closed the stone door.
Sitting cross-legged on the meditation mat, he eagerly took out the "Longevity Skill" and immersed his spiritual sense into it.
Soon, a Foundation Establishment technique appeared in his mind.
The contents were quite detailed; he mentally recited them numerous times until he had thoroughly memorized everything in his mind and couldn’t forget it anymore, then his spiritual sense exited.
"Crack!"
The jade slip in his hand quickly filled with cracks and soon shattered.
Xu Ping paid no mind to this, tossing the jade slip aside, and pondered the "Longevity Skill" in his mind.
In terms of complexity and intricacy, this "Longevity Skill" far surpassed his "Five Elements Skill," deserving to be a technique capable of reaching Core Formation!
However, converting fundamental cultivation techniques is no simple task either.
The first step is to comprehend the cultivation technique; the second is to adjust the mana operation.
Neither of these could be accomplished overnight.
"Take it slow," Xu Ping thought to himself.
After all, he had plenty of time and didn’t need to hurry, and there was a two-year buffer period for the guest minister’s mandatory tasks.
...
...
Time flew by, and it was the Entry Level ceremony two days later.
Xu Ping donned the guest minister attire of "Qiu Xuan Mountain" and, accompanied by an old Foundation Establishment cultivator, climbed the mountain on foot, step by step, from the foot of the mountain.
On both sides of the mountain path were lined with the Qi Cultivation disciples of "Qiu Xuan Mountain," resembling a winding, serpentine dragon.
The atmosphere was quite lively.
This was a public debut. From now on, he was a guest minister of "Qiu Xuan Mountain," for at least thirty years.
These disciples of "Qiu Xuan Mountain" were mostly trained from a young age, many of them mere teenagers, around thirteen or fourteen years old. Their expressions towards Xu Ping were a mix of awe and envy, with a hint of admiration.
Although Qi Cultivation to Foundation Establishment was only one rank apart, it was as if separated by a chasm. Even for the disciples of Golden Core forces, most had no chance to step into this realm; how could they not respect and envy those at Foundation Establishment?
Accompanied by the old Foundation Establishment cultivator, he walked step by step to the door of the discussion hall, where Senior Brother Sect Leader Hongyi was already waiting, and meanwhile, more than a dozen Foundation Establishment cultivators were present to witness.
However, among these Foundation Establishment cultivators, Xu Ping surprisingly spotted an unexpected figure—Jiang Tian!
"How is he here?"
"Could it be that he was originally a Foundation Establishment cultivator of ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’?"
Xu Ping was taken aback, his mind racing with thoughts, yet revealed nothing on his face.
The ceremony continued.
Since Xu Ping was a guest minister, and "Qiu Xuan Mountain" was established by Ancestor Qiu Xuan, after paying respect to Ancestor Qiu Xuan’s waiting portrait, his entry ceremony was considered complete.
After the ceremony.
Introduced by Hongyi, Xu Ping exchanged greetings with the Foundation Establishment cultivators, who courteously returned the gestures.
"This is Jiang Tian, like you, he also recently reached Foundation Establishment, but he broke through a year before you," Hongyi cheerfully introduced Jiang Tian.
"Broke through to Foundation Establishment a year ago?" Upon hearing this, Xu Ping’s pupils slightly contracted.
No!
Jiang Tian certainly did not just break through to Foundation Establishment a year ago!!
They first met two years ago, and he was already a Foundation Establishment cultivator then, albeit concealing his cultivation. Had Xu Ping not detected his concealed divine sense, he wouldn’t have seen through Jiang Tian’s disguise.
’Could he have deceived everyone at Qiu Xuan Mountain, including the Golden Core ancestor?’
Thinking this, Xu Ping couldn’t help but feel a surge of unease.
This Jiang Tian is suspicious!!!
"Fellow Daoist Xu, since we are both new to Foundation Establishment, we should exchange insights often in the future," Jiang Tian said warmly with a smile.
"Naturally," Xu Ping replied with a broad grin while internally regretting.
Had he known Jiang Tian had infiltrated "Qiu Xuan Mountain" as well, he would have never chosen to join "Qiu Xuan Mountain."
Jiang Tian is so mysterious and his methods so sophisticated.
Effortlessly joining "Qiu Xuan Mountain," his intentions are undoubtedly not simple.
Should any issues arise, they would undoubtedly implicate guest ministers like him.
"Should I report him?"
The thought crossed Xu Ping’s mind, but he extinguished it instantly.
Report him?
What’s there to say?
Claiming he noticed Jiang Tian’s divine sense two years ago at their first meeting?
Then they would inevitably inquire.
Shouldn’t you have not reached Foundation Establishment two years ago, how did you detect his divine sense?
Suggesting that he had divine sense in the Qi Refining Realm?
If that were the case, Jiang Tian’s fate is uncertain, but his own days would certainly be difficult.

chapters.title: Chapter 104: Entry Level of the Longevity Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 104: Chapter 104: Entry Level of the Longevity Skill
After some contemplation, Xu Ping still decided to keep this matter to himself.
In the future, he could only stay away from this Jiang Tian, to avoid bringing trouble upon himself.
As for leaving ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ immediately, for now, that was even less of a consideration, unless he wanted to be relentlessly hunted by the Golden Core powers, and also have his reputation ruined, a last resort that he would not consider unless absolutely necessary.
If ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ really underwent some major upheaval, with his current strength, as long as he didn’t face a Golden Core or a Fake Pill directly, escaping wouldn’t be a problem.
Not long after, a dozen Qi Cultivation disciples came in to carry away the offering table, tidied up, and replaced it with various Spirit Fruits and tea, lightening up the atmosphere. Seizing the opportunity, everyone began to mingle, discussing various topics.
"Recently, while in the inner mountains of the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range, I found a Star Sky Fruit, but it was guarded by a second-stage lower-grade Demon Beast. Alone, I am not too confident, is there any fellow Daoist willing to venture with me?"
A Foundation Establishment cultivator spoke up, this person was named Xu Zhixuan, middle-aged in appearance, stout in build, and an early-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
"Star Sky Fruit? That’s a great item!" someone exclaimed in surprise.
Star Sky Fruit is a second-stage spirit fruit, enhancing the cultivation for Foundation Establishment cultivators and can be used in alchemy.
"Glad you know it, if it wasn’t for that second-stage lower-grade Demon Beast being somewhat formidable, I would have already kept it for myself, how would it be your turn," Xu Zhixuan joked.
"We all know your cultivation is lacking...." someone teased.
"Hahaha..."
The crowd couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
This entry-level ceremony went on until a feast was held at noon, marking the end.
Although Xu Ping was the protagonist of this ceremony, he conducted himself modestly, speaking little, and was completely unremarkable.
When the ceremony was over, everyone dispersed.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, would you like to come to my cave dwelling?" Jiang Tian warmly invited.
"No need, I have other matters," Xu Ping coldly responded.
Jiang Tian was slightly stunned but said nothing more.
Watching the retreating back of the other party, Xu Ping’s eyes were grave: "I must quickly switch cultivation techniques, and also accelerate earning money and enhancing my strength."
He had come to realize that in this world, ultimately the strong reign supreme, nowhere is truly safe; without strength, one misstep could lead to losing one’s life.
...
...
In the days that followed, Xu Ping began to close himself off, focusing on cultivation.
Switching cultivation techniques was still a gradual effort.
In the meantime, both the ’Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill’ and ’Primordial Sword Skill’ were successfully researched.
...
It must be said, as a second-stage escape technique, the shield technique of the ’Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill’ was exceptionally powerful.
With a mere thought, he could instantly appear several dozen feet away.
And this was only at the entry level—once proficiency increased, the speed would be even swifter.
"If this reaches perfection, I wonder if it could surpass a Golden Core cultivator’s speed," Xu Ping thought with a gleeful smile.
If this were faster than a Golden Core cultivator, even if ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ really had some major incident because of Jiang Tian, he would have confidence in safely withdrawing.
Of course, for now, this was just a thought; the perfection level was still a long way off.
Second-stage magic was far tougher to grind than first-stage techniques.
But this didn’t matter to him, it was merely a matter of persistence which he was long accustomed to.
....
And so, time passed with Xu Ping continuously refining his skills.
A year later.
In the cultivation room.
Xu Ping opened his eyes, a warm blue light flashed through.
"Half a year comprehending the cultivation technique, half a year adjusting Mana circulation, and as of today, I’ve finally entered the ’Longevity Skill’ entry-level stage..."
He sighed; his aptitude was indeed too lacking, taking a whole year to switch cultivation techniques.
Some prodigies might complete the switch within a month.
Opening the proficiency panel.
The original [Cultivation Technique: Five Elements Skill Perfection: ∞]
had changed to [Cultivation Technique: Longevity Skill Entry Level: 2/100]
"Next is to continue cultivating gradually."
He viewed his Sea of Qi Dantian, seeing thirty-eight drops of liquid Mana endlessly circulating, with faint patterns appearing on the surface.
This was the Mana after converting to ’Longevity Skill’; although the total amount of Mana didn’t change, its quality increased by several levels!
"After Foundation Establishment, the subsequent cultivation is a continuous process of increasing the liquid Mana limit..."
"According to the ’Longevity Skill’, at least storing a total of forty to fifty drops of liquid Mana inside the Dantian is required to attempt breaking through to mid-stage Foundation Establishment... If one’s foundation is strong, one can store up to seventy drops at the limit before breaking through to mid-stage Foundation Establishment."
This process generally required cultivators several decades of careful tempering, though aided by pills was an exception...
While Mana consumption recovered quickly, increasing the limit was exceedingly difficult.
"I now have thirty-eight drops of liquid Mana, perhaps storing up to the limit of seventy drops before breaking through to mid-stage Foundation Establishment."
Generally speaking, those with deeper foundations benefit in both combat power enhancement and bottleneck breakthroughs.
His foundation was inherently deeper than that of ordinary early-stage Foundation Establishment cultivators, and with the panel’s aid, storing Mana to the limit of seventy drops for breaking through to mid-stage Foundation Establishment poses no issue.
One fast step, every step fast.
...
After completing today’s training, Xu Ping leisurely exited seclusion.
In the small courtyard, golden-tailed carp in the pond occasionally sank to the bottom, occasionally surfaced, playing joyfully.
The surrounding environment was spacious, except for the barren Spirit Field which seemed somewhat unappealing.
"Perhaps I should use the Spirit Field to cultivate some Spirit Medicine, which would also generate a considerable income annually," Xu Ping mused internally.
But his days were already quite packed; he really couldn’t spare extra time to care for Spirit Medicine.
"Perhaps I could find someone to help care for it?" The thought crossed his mind, but quickly dissipated.
The main reason was the lack of suitable personnel.
Randomly choosing someone didn’t seem very reliable either.
"Forget it!" Xu Ping shook his head, after all, it’s not a necessity and the earnings were minor.
The real method to make big money still lay in alchemy.
Thinking of alchemy, a slight smile appeared on Xu Ping’s lips.
Over the past year, under the enhancement of Divine Sense and the panel, he had managed to successfully refine first-rank upper-grade pills, becoming a first-rank upper-grade alchemist.
Next was refining second-stage pills.
Refining second-stage pills was quite challenging; his attempts had thus far ended in failure.
But he also felt his progress, believing that success in refining was within reach.
"Now, I can spread the word about my alchemy talent, and when I manage to refine second-stage pills, it will be logical and easy," Xu Ping smiled softly, making plans in his heart.
...
...
Half a year later.
In the training room.
Xu Ping pinched a magic technique, continuously emitting several beams of red light onto the array, which absorbed the red light, making the embedded Spirit Stones shine.
A fist-sized flame appeared under the alchemy cauldron, gradually enlarging and fiercely burning within the fire gate. Immediately, the room’s air became filled with intense heat.
This was Xu Ping’s specially-designed alchemy fire array.
Most alchemists used Earth Fire for alchemy; Earth Fire has a high temperature, is stable, and remarkably enduring, making it an excellent choice.

chapters.title: Chapter 105: Successful Refining
chapters.content:
Chapter 105: Chapter 105: Successful Refining
But Xu Ping now doesn’t have Earth Fire, so he can only choose to use the array to ignite flames, though it consumes Spirit Stones.
After about half an hour, the Pill Furnace was sufficiently preheated, the purple-red body of the furnace faintly glowing with red light, and Xu Ping felt an astonishing high temperature.
He knew the preheating was complete, so he quickly formed a Magic Technique, and a wisp of Mana was injected into the small furnace. The furnace trembled, the lid flew up, revealing the round opening.
Xu Ping lightly moved his forefinger, the Storage Ring shimmered, and several jade boxes appeared in the air. They contained the Spirit Medicine needed to refine Qi Refining Pills.
He pointed at the jade boxes, each one opened, using Spiritual Power to levitate a Spirit Medicine above the furnace opening, slowly entering the furnace. With another gesture of Magic Technique, the furnace lid flew back, covering the opening.
Xu Ping’s Divine Sense penetrated inside the furnace, carefully adjusting the size and temperature of the flame to extract the essence of the Spirit Medicine.
Afterwards, Xu Ping continuously formed Magic Techniques, following the Spirit Gathering Pill recipe requirements, inserting each Spirit Medicine, merging the extracted essence into marble-sized orbs, beginning the pill condensation.
Time slowly passed, and the small furnace gradually emitted strands of medicinal fragrance, invigorating anyone who smelled it.
Xu Ping’s face was expressionless, but his heart was somewhat excited.
He formed a Magic Technique in his hand, sending out a white light to the array, making the flames slowly extinguish, and then controlled the furnace lid to slowly rise.
As the furnace lid opened, a rich pill fragrance wafted out, refreshing the senses.
At the bottom of the furnace lay two light blue Pills.
"It’s done!"
Xu Ping’s face broke into a smile.
After spending so much time, the Qi Refining Pill was finally refined!
He finally became a Second-stage Lower Grade Alchemist.
Xu Ping reached out, grabbing in the void, and the two Qi Refining Pills flew from the furnace bottom into his hand.
He held the Pills and sniffed them at the tip of his nose.
"The pill fragrance is rich with a hint of spice, indeed Qi Refining Pills!" Xu Ping’s smile widened, feeling even more joyful.
He carefully sealed the two Qi Refining Pills in a Jade Bottle.
After storing the Qi Refining Pills, he opened the proficiency panel.
[Entry Level in Qi Refining Pill: 1/100]
"On the list! Once proficiency increases, I can start the earning plan!" Seeing the Qi Refining Pill listed, Xu Ping secretly anticipated.
...
...
Night falls.
Cultivation room.
Xu Ping swallowed the Qi Refining Pill, silently cultivating.
Two hours later.
Xu Ping opened his eyes, slowly pressing his hands down, ending a cycle of cultivation.
He checked the proficiency panel.
[Realm: Early-Stage Foundation Establishment: 2/100]
"Whew, at last some breakthrough." Xu Ping exhaled a deep breath: "It took half a year just to increase by one point, truly not easy!"
It had been half a year since the Cultivation Technique transition completed, and even with Qi Refining Pill assistance, progress was extremely slow.
Despite slow progress, he wasn’t discouraged, knowing that as Cultivation Technique level advances, the pace is bound to accelerate.
His gaze shifted lower, landing on the Cultivation Technique.
[Cultivation Technique: Entry Level in Longevity Skill: 89/100]
"Almost there, just 11 points shy of breaking through proficiency level!"
...
A month later.
Xu Zhixuan’s residence.
"Fellow Daoist Xu looks so happy today; did something good happen?" Xu Zhixuan asked with a smile.
Xu Zhixuan was also a Loose Cultivator Guest Minister, known for his frank personality.
Among the Foundation Establishment cultivators of ’Qiu Xuan Mountain,’ Xu Ping had a good relationship with him.
"A few days ago, I successfully refined the Qi Refining Pill!" Xu Ping replied with a beaming smile.
"What!"
Xu Zhixuan’s face showed shock, "Fellow Daoist Xu refined the Qi Refining Pill?"
Though he had long heard Xu Ping was attempting to refine a Second-stage Pill, truly succeeding was still surprising.
Foundation Establishment Cultivators have Divine Sense, greatly enhancing all cultivation arts, but only relatively speaking.
First Rank arts can generally succeed with time investment, but the Second-stage poses significant difficulty.
Without talent, even Divine Sense is no use.
"Lucky, lucky!" Xu Ping smiled.
"Daoist is humble; having become a Second-stage Alchemist, your path will be much smoother than mine. Considering your young age, reaching Golden Core isn’t impossible." Xu Zhixuan spoke with envy.
"Thank you for the good wishes!" Xu Ping replied with a smile.
After some more casual chatting, Xu Ping bid farewell and returned home.
"Now that I’ve gained initial fame, just wait for time to ferment it."
...
...
A month later.
Xu Ping didn’t see other Foundation Establishment cultivators seeking Pills, but rather received the Sect Leader’s senior disciple’s summon.
"Senior, the Sect Leader’s senior disciple requests your presence," a Qi Refinement disciple respectfully said.
"Understood." Xu Ping nodded, wondering the purpose behind the Sect Leader’s senior disciple’s invitation.
"Could it be a Guest Minister mission? The timing seems about right."
"Hope the task doesn’t take too much time."
Having joined ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ and enjoyed free Cultivation Techniques and residence, fulfilling tasks was expected.
Gathering his thoughts, Xu Pin stood up and headed towards the grand hall.
...
Not long after.
Xu Ping reached the grand hall, where besides Hongyi, an elderly Foundation Establishment cultivator was present.
This elderly cultivator carried a heavy air of old age, evidently lacking many years left to live.
"Greetings to Sect Leader’s senior disciple and Master Lie Alchemist," Xu Ping bowed.
This old Foundation Establishment was named Lie and was ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’s’ sole Second-stage Upper Grade Alchemist, with a status vaguely surpassing Hongyi.
In ’Qiu Xuan Mountain,’ he was second only to the Golden Core ancestor.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, sit." Hongyi warmly invited Xu Ping to sit.
After Xu Ping sat down, they chatted briefly, while Master Lie Alchemist silently sat aside.
"I wonder what the Sect Leader’s senior disciple seeks me for?" After exchanging pleasantries, Xu Ping couldn’t help but ask.
"Nothing major." Hongyi smiled slightly, "I heard Fellow Daoist Xu has successfully refined the Qi Refining Pill; is it true?"
At this moment, Master Lie Alchemist’s gaze also fell on Xu Ping.
"Yes, luckily succeeded recently." Xu Ping nodded.
Being the Sect Leader’s senior disciple, the highest authority in ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ after the Golden Core ancestor, knowing disclosed matters was entirely normal.
Hearing that, Hongyi’s smile widened further, he paused to organize words then said, "I wonder if Fellow Daoist Xu could demonstrate refining a batch of Qi Refining Pills in front of me and Master Lie Alchemist?"
"I’ve already prepared the materials."
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping’s expression shifted, and he had a certain guess in his heart.
"Of course, it’s possible." He smiled and nodded, "However, my little Alchemy before Master Lie Alchemist is entirely like showing off, hoping Master Lie can offer guidance."
"Mm."
Master Lie Alchemist nodded.
"In that case, Fellow Daoist Xu, please proceed to the side hall for refining, as there is more space now."
Hongyi led the two through the corridor to a side hall, where faint light dots shimmered on the stone walls, evidently concealed by an array.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 106: Minor Achievement in Primordial Sword Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 106: Chapter 106: Minor Achievement in Primordial Sword Skill
"Fellow Daoist Xu, please begin." After handing the spirit medicine for the Qi Refining Pill to Xu Ping, Hongyi and the Pill Master stepped aside.
"Alright,"
Xu Ping nodded and then took out the alchemy furnace, placing it on the ground.
This time, he didn’t set up the "Flame Ignition Array" to kindle the fire. With a flip of his palm, a pale red flame appeared in his hand—it was the Foundation Establishment’s True Flame!
The Foundation Establishment’s True Flame could meet the alchemy requirements. The temperature was high, and it didn’t consume much mana, but the flame’s stability was slightly lacking.
Xu Ping gently waved his arm, and the Foundation Establishment’s True Flame fell onto the fire gate below the Purple Profound Tripod, then expanded rapidly to the size of a baby’s head, starting to heat the Purple Profound Tripod.
Once preheating was complete, he activated his magic technique, and the lid of the tripod opened slightly.
He placed each spirit medicine into the tripod one by one in the correct order and ratio.
Removing impurities, extracting the essence of spirit grass, merging, condensing the pill, and opening the furnace—each step was so familiar to Xu Ping that, supported by the panel, failure was nearly impossible.
Though Hongyi knew nothing about alchemy, the process seemed very smooth to him.
The truly knowledgeable Pill Master glanced with a slightly heavy gaze, thinking the techniques and proficiency might rival a seasoned second-stage lower grade alchemist. With a decade or more of practice, he could break through to middle grade.
A promising talent.
The Pill Master nodded slightly.
Because the Foundation Establishment’s True Flame had a higher temperature, it removed impurities and refined essence faster, significantly speeding up the alchemy process.
Half an hour later, the alchemy was complete.
Xu Ping extinguished the Foundation Establishment’s True Flame.
His mana controlled the tripod lid to slowly rise.
As the lid gradually opened, a rich pill fragrance greeted them, seeping into one’s senses.
Xu Ping grabbed the air, and two light blue pills appeared in his hand. With a flick of his fingers, the two pills flew towards the Pill Master and Hongyi.
"Fellow Daoist Hong, Pill Master, please appraise them."
The two took them and began inspecting.
Hongyi, though unfamiliar with pill concoction, had no problem with appraisal. After a moment, he nodded, "Not bad, it’s a Qi Refining Pill."
The Pill Master, being a second-stage upper grade alchemist, examined more meticulously, "The impurities are very cleanly removed, the fragrance is robust..."
He scraped a bit of powder into his mouth, savoring it. After half a moment, he nodded slowly, "The medicinal potency is pure; it’s an excellent Qi Refining Pill."
"Your alchemy skills are quite impressive. At least in Qi Refining Pills, your proficiency is not inferior to some second-stage middle grade alchemists." The Pill Master’s gaze showed admiration, and he held Xu Ping in high regard.
Beside him, Hongyi listened to the Pill Master’s praise for Xu Ping, showing a look of surprise.
The Pill Master was known for being extremely proud of his alchemy skills and rarely praised others this way.
It seemed this new guest minister Xu indeed had a great talent in alchemy.
His combat power and potential were already above average for a Foundation Establishment cultivator, and now even his alchemy talent was evident.
This was a real treasure find!
Hongyi felt pleased.
"The Pill Master flatters me; my alchemy skills are nothing in front of you," Xu Ping said modestly.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, don’t be modest. The Pill Master rarely praises people this way. Come, let’s head to the main hall and chat." Hongyi smiled warmly.
The group moved to the main hall again.
Hongyi summoned the gatekeeping disciple to serve tea and then got to the main point, "I invited you, Fellow Daoist Xu, here today to discuss your first task."
"With Fellow Daoist Hong’s arrangements, as a guest minister, I will uphold my duty," Xu Ping said seriously.
"No need to be nervous, Fellow Daoist Xu. For a second-stage alchemist like you, naturally, you won’t be doing ordinary tasks like other guest ministers," Hongyi said with a smile,
"In the future, you’ll just need to periodically help ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ with a batch of pill concoctions, of course, with materials provided by us and a fee for alchemy included."
"Thanks to Fellow Daoist Hong’s regard, I will surely give it my all." Upon hearing this, Xu Ping was delighted inwardly but maintained a serious face.
Revealing his alchemy talent was indeed the right choice.
This task was not only safe but also allowed him to gain spirit stone resources from ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’.
After all, with materials provided by ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ and Xu Ping’s alchemy skills with the support panel, it was all gain with no loss.
A win-win situation.
After discussing the details of the alchemy task, Xu Ping excused himself and left.
Returning home,
Xu Ping drank a joyful sip of tea.
Now that the mandatory task was completely resolved, and he could also get resources from the alchemy, earning a wave of spirit stones.
He could cultivate peacefully for a while.
...
...
Half a year later,
A heavy snow announced the arrival of winter.
Beneath a leaden gray sky,
The feathery snow fell under the perpetually activated Mountain Protection Array of ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’, continuously bounced off by an invisible force field above, shattered into a sprinkle of tiny crystals, finally turning into a mist of fine droplets, wafting lightly down.
Inside, the entire mountain gate was warm like spring, lush and vibrant, with no hint of the external cold.
Inside the training room,
Xu Ping held a sword in one hand as Sword Qi quietly gathered around him, seeming to transform into an invisible tide that rose and fell with his breath.
He turned his wrist lightly, the sword tracing a graceful arc. With his movements, the sword light flickered, resembling a dragon dancing in the air.
"Sword, rise!"
With his shout, the sword light suddenly intensified, like a bolt of lightning tearing through the sky, directly striking a black puppet in the training room.
Whush!
A deep sword mark appeared instantly on the surface of the black puppet. The surrounding air subtly twisted due to the pressure of the sword force, as if even the light distorted, losing its transparency due to the Sword Qi.
Boom!
With a loud rumbling sound, the black puppet instantly shattered into fragments.
"Such power!!"
Seeing the destruction he had caused, Xu Ping’s eyes gleamed.
The black puppet was specifically used for Foundation Establishment cultivators’ training, with very strong defense, yet it was shattered with a single sword strike.
"Is it... the Minor Achievement of the Primordial Sword Skill?"
Xu Ping quickly opened the panel.
[Primordial Sword Skill Minor Achievement: 1/800]
"Indeed, Minor Achievement!"
Looking at the numbers displayed on the panel, Xu Ping felt joyous.
The Primordial Sword Skill was an ancient sword technique, inherently powerful, and now breaking through to Minor Achievement clearly elevated its power to a new level.
"Now, if I just use my mana and sword skill, could I fight a Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator?"
Forty-one drops of liquid mana circulated silently within Xu Ping.
Buzz!
The Blood-Drinking Sword emitted a crisp sword hum.
After a year of diligent practice, his liquid mana had increased by three drops.
Though still far from the limit of seventy drops, it was already at the peak for most Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators, ready to break through to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment at any time.
Moreover, with the Minor Achievement of the Primordial Sword Skill, he might now be able to contend with a Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator without employing other measures.
The main issue was his other methods were rather inconvenient to use publically, and his regular-state combat power occasionally felt insufficient.
Now, with the Primordial Sword Skill breaking through, paired with his mana that was comparable to peak usual Early-Stage Foundation Establishment, he was no longer weak.
However, the only slight inadequacy was...
Xu Ping couldn’t help but glance down at the Blood-Drinking Sword in his hand.
Though the Blood-Drinking Sword was an upper grade magic sword, it fell a bit short when fighting Mid-to-Late Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators.
Most Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators, and even some wealthy Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators, used top-grade magical artifacts.
"Perhaps I should consider acquiring a top-grade magic sword!" Xu Ping mused to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 107: Top-Grade Magic Sword
chapters.content:
Chapter 107: Chapter 107: Top-Grade Magic Sword
At this moment, a familiar voice suddenly came from outside the array.
"Is Fellow Daoist Xu at home?"
Xu Ping tidied up the puppet’s remains and then opened the array.
Looking out into the yard, Xu Zhixuan was beaming at him, "Fellow Daoist Xu, I’ve come to ask for your alchemy services again."
Ever since his alchemy skills gained a reputation, people began seeking him for alchemy one after another, and Xu Zhixuan was one of them.
"Got rich? Didn’t you just come by last month?" Xu Ping teased, inviting Xu Zhixuan in.
"Hahaha, I’ve had a few more Guest Minister tasks recently, so I earned a little." Xu Zhixuan chuckled.
"More tasks?"
After pouring spirit tea for Xu Zhixuan, Xu Ping asked in confusion, "Aren’t Guest Minister tasks usually only once every year or two?"
"That’s usually the case, but lately, demon beasts have increased around Qiu Xuan Immortal City, and there are even sightings of second-stage demon beasts, so we’re needed to drive them away."
"We’re exhausted lately, unlike you, who seem so carefree." Xu Zhixuan’s tone carried envy.
Xu Ping merely smiled at Xu Zhixuan’s envy.
He was more concerned about the sudden increase in demon beasts: "Has this beast influx happened around the Immortal City before?"
"It has happened before, but only during beast tides. It’s only been thirty years since the last, far from the next one."
"It should just be a coincidence." Xu Zhixuan seemed unconcerned.
"Coincidence?"
Xu Ping frowned slightly, feeling that things weren’t that simple.
For some reason, he suddenly thought of the loose cultivator he killed.
The man was babbling about people from Yue Country and some plans, surely hiding secrets.
Unfortunately, he was dead, and there was no way to uncover the truth.
"Fellow Daoist Xu need not worry, it should just be a coincidence. After all, the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range is vast, and it’s normal for some demon beasts to appear occasionally," Xu Zhixuan reassured with a smile.
"Even if we say the worst outcome happens with a beast attack, the five Golden Core sects in Yue Country, even the Nascent Soul sect Luoyun Sect, will send people to resist the beast tide."
"Why would they help us?" Xu Ping asked in surprise.
These sects never take action without benefit, so why such kind intentions?
"Our ’Qiu Xuan Immortal City’ is a defense line against the beast tide. If we’re breached, the beast tide will head straight for their territory."
"If not stopped, the losses would be huge." Xu Zhixuan explained with a smile.
"I see." Xu Ping nodded.
"Let me tell you a little rumor." Xu Zhixuan suddenly lowered his voice, "When the sects in Yue Country allowed Qiu Xuan Zhenren to establish ’Qiu Xuan Immortal City’, the condition was to resist the beast tide occurring every fifty years."
"Heh... although Qiu Xuan Zhenren is the greatest loose cultivator in Yue Country, he couldn’t resist stronger forces, so he had to agree." He shook his head with a laugh.
’You’ve got guts to joke about Qiu Xuan Zhenren on Qiu Xuan Mountain,’ Xu Ping thought silently.
Even though what Xu Zhixuan said was a rumor, it might have some truth.
They chatted a bit more, Xu Zhixuan leaving the herbs, they decided he’d return in three days to collect them, and then he took his leave.
...
As Xu Zhixuan’s figure receded, Xu Ping felt a faint sense of worry.
If the beast tide truly happened, it would be no small matter.
The arrival of third-stage demon beasts was certain, and probably more than one.
Even with aid from other sects, it would be extremely dangerous for Foundation Establishment cultivators.
Reckless action could easily lead to death in battle.
"Better be prepared, or if the beast tide comes, I’ll be helplessly watching," Xu Ping thought to himself.
....
....
Five days later.
After completing his alchemy, Xu Ping quietly left ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’.
Today, descending the mountain, he intended to sell off his second-stage demon beast flesh. A good number of second-stage demon beasts were hunted in the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range, and these were stored in his storage ring, yet to be dealt with.
Now that he wanted to buy a top-grade magic sword, he needed to handle this demon beast flesh.
Disguised as an unfamiliar Foundation Establishment cultivator, he sold second-stage demon beast flesh in major stores.
A Foundation Establishment cultivator selling second-stage demon beast flesh wasn’t unheard of.
Especially in Qiu Xuan Immortal City.
After successfully selling two second-stage demon beasts’ flesh, Xu Ping stopped.
The sale of two second-stage demon beasts’ flesh brought nearly six thousand spirit stones, enough to buy a top-grade magic sword.
To avoid attracting attention, he cautiously sold in batches.
"With enough spirit stones, the next step is to buy a top-grade magic sword." Xu Ping thought silently.
...
...
City Center.
Qiu Xuan Commerce Association.
In an antique-styled room.
"Fellow Daoist, please take a look. This top-grade magic sword, the Purple Sun Sword, was crafted by the renowned second-stage upper grade artifact refiner, Xuanzese, using second-stage spiritual ore and various materials. It’s incredibly sharp and can even break through second-stage upper grade demon beasts’ defenses."
A slightly chubby Foundation Establishment cultivator enthusiastically introduced a dark purple magic sword to Xu Ping.
The slightly chubby Foundation Establishment cultivator was Yu Zhuoqun, a disciple of ’Qiu Xuan Zhenren’, Xu Ping had seen him a few times.
However, Yu Zhuoqun clearly didn’t recognize Xu Ping, who had used the Bone Shaping Skill to disguise himself.
To make his case, Yu Zhuoqun let mana flow through the Purple Sun Sword.
Buzz!
The sword immediately emitted a sharp aura, filling the entire room.
Even Xu Ping’s strong physique couldn’t help feeling a chill creep in.
"It’s a good sword, but too expensive!" Xu Ping shook his head.
"Can’t you give a slight discount?" he tried to negotiate.
This top-grade magic sword was priced at an astounding five thousand spirit stones.
"Fellow Daoist, it’s already quite inexpensive. You see..." Yu Zhuoqun began to lavish praise on the Purple Sun Sword, speaking as if there was nothing else like it in the world.
But Xu Ping remained unmoved, and finally, the sword was sold for four thousand seven hundred fifty spirit stones.
"Fellow Daoist, take care. Come again!" Yu Zhuoqun enthusiastically saw Xu Ping off, displaying none of a Foundation Establishment cultivator’s airs, looking every bit the businessman.
...
...
After leaving Qiu Xuan Commerce Association.
Xu Ping initially wanted to return directly to ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’, but changed his mind, deciding to visit Zhang Yan.
The pharmacy.
As soon as he entered, a young Qi Cultivator at third level came up with a wide smile: "What do you need, customer?"
"Since when did Zhang Yan hire staff?" Xu Ping wondered.
"I’m looking for your shopkeeper. Never mind, I’ll find them myself." He strode toward the inner room.
"Huh? Customer!" The young cultivator couldn’t stop him in time.
As Xu Ping pushed the door open, a choking cloud of smoke billowed out.
In the small room.
The smoke curled around, and two shadowy figures slumped bonelessly in their chairs.
Each popped a Bliss Pill into their mouths and occasionally puffed on something resembling opium from his past life. Despite their sunken eyes, their faces showed complete enjoyment.
Xu Ping couldn’t help but let his mouth drop open.
’These two are in a hurry to die!’ he thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 108: Ancestor Qiu Xuan
chapters.content:
Chapter 108: Chapter 108: Ancestor Qiu Xuan
"Didn’t I tell you? Unless there’s something important, don’t disturb me."
Zhang Yan was interrupted by the sound of the door opening. Just as he was about to reprimand someone, he saw Xu Ping standing at the door with a blank expression.
"Fellow Dao... Elder Xu!" Zhang Yan quickly stood straight, shocked, causing the smoky object he held to drop to the floor with a crisp sound.
Du Xinghuai heard this and immediately became alert, sitting up straight with a sheepish smile on his face, "Elder Xu!"
"Hmm."
Xu Ping nodded, his face expressionless.
"I... I suddenly remembered I have some business to attend to, so I’ll be leaving now." Du Xinghuai found a flimsy excuse and dashed out, leaving Zhang Yan alone in the small room.
The young cultivator understood the gravity of the situation, seeing the shopkeeper and Alchemist Du show such respect to this elder, quickly made his exit.
"This... this is bark from a special tree that Alchemist Du harvested, it has calming properties," Zhang Yan explained with a flattering smile while packing up.
Xu Ping didn’t say much.
Old habits die hard, and he couldn’t possibly force Zhang Yan to stop consuming Pills.
After tidying the room, Zhang Yan ordered the attendant to serve them tea.
"Elder Xu, if you have specifically come here, is there something you need from me?" Zhang Yan asked with a beaming smile.
"It’s nothing major, I came down from ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ and thought to drop by and see you." Xu Ping replied after sipping some Spirit Tea.
"I am grateful for your concern, elder, I’ve been doing well." Zhang Yan’s smile widened upon hearing this.
Indeed, delivering the Alchemy knowledge had been worthwhile, to warrant a visit from a Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
"It’s good to hear all is well. But recently, the surroundings of the Immortal City have seen an increase in Demon Beasts; be on your guard." Xu Ping nodded.
"Is that so?"
Zhang Yan was momentarily stunned and then nodded, "Understood."
Though he hadn’t heard of such things, given the other was a Foundation Establishment Cultivator, he had no reason to doubt him.
"Hmm."
Xu Ping nodded.
After chatting for a while, Xu Ping bid farewell and returned to Qiu Xuan Mountain.
...
...
Seven days later, Qiu Xuan Mountain.
Training room.
Xu Ping used Mana to suspend the Purple Sun Sword in mid-air, then retrieved a Jade Bottle from his storage bag.
Removing the cap, he sprinkled a gray powder over the Purple Sun Sword.
In an instant, the originally radiant Purple Sun Sword dimmed, its purple hue growing lifeless.
"Good. No one will recognize it now."
Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction, gripping the sword hilt, as Mana surged, a sharp aura filled the training room.
This was a special powder capable of altering the appearance of a Magical Artifact without causing any harm.
And his top-grade sword was purchased from ’Qiu Xuan Mountain,’ many would recognize it.
Thus, disguising it was necessary.
Xu Ping held the Purple Sun Sword in one hand and entered the practice chamber.
With the flow of Mana, Sword Qi silently gathered around him, forming an invisible current that ebbed with his breath.
Buzz!
The Purple Sun Sword trembled slightly in his hand, faint traces of thunder sounded.
Xu Ping nearly couldn’t resist unleashing a full sweep, but fortunately, he restrained himself at the last moment.
With a top-grade magical sword, a full power swing might destroy the entire cavern and even disrupt the Array.
"Phew!"
Xu Ping exhaled deeply, secretly astonished, "This top-grade sword is really something!"
Merely having a thought of practicing swordsmanship caused the automatic Sword Qi Thunder Sound.
Couldn’t imagine the strength if fully exerted.
"Need more harmonization, else every practice will trigger Sword Qi Thunder Sound, that would be troublesome." After calming his mood, Xu Ping flicked the sword tip, and the Primordial Sword Skill flowed smoothly.
...
...
Since acquiring the top-grade sword, Xu Ping ceased to venture out, focusing solely on cultivation.
However, the surroundings of Qiu Xuan Immortal City saw an increasing number of Demon Beasts, even Second-stage Demon Beasts started appearing frequently, increasing the assignments for Guest Ministers.
Eventually, people began to get hurt.
Everyone sensed something wasn’t right, secretly pondering,
’Could the beast tide truly be coming?’
...
Three months later.
Xu Ping continued cultivating silently in his training room.
Suddenly.
Dong!
A long, distant bell resounded from the mountain top, piercing through the Array, reaching Xu Ping’s ears.
"This bell sound... does it mean Qiu Xuan Ancestor has emerged?"
Xu Ping’s face registered a trace of surprise.
He quickly donned the Guest Minister attire from his storage bag and hurried out the door.
...
Inside a grand hall with imposing columns lining both sides, the pillars emitted a radiant glow, clearly inscribed with some Array.
By the time Xu Ping arrived, many had already gathered in the hall, with Foundation Establishment cultivators standing in two rows, the atmosphere tense.
The Golden Core Ancestor had yet to arrive.
"Alchemist Xu."
"Alchemist Xu."
"Fellow Daoist Xu."
.....
The Foundation Establishment cultivators in the hall greeted Xu Ping upon his entrance.
Xu Ping smiled and nodded in return.
His current standing in ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ was higher than most Guest Ministers.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, join us here." Xu Zhixuan beckoned Xu Ping over with a smile.
"Since Qiu Xuan Ancestor has emerged, something serious must have happened?" Xu Ping asked as he reached behind him.
"Recently, the demon beasts around the Immortal City have increased drastically, suggesting the beast tide is prematurely arriving, such a significant event would naturally bring Qiu Xuan Ancestor out." Xu Zhixuan’s expression turned serious.
"Moreover, expelling Second-stage Demon Beasts has resulted in a Guest Minister’s death." He said in a lowered voice.
"A Guest Minister has died!" Xu Ping felt shock coursing through him.
The beast tide hadn’t even started, yet a Foundation Establishment cultivator had died; if it did erupt, wouldn’t that mean a batch of Foundations would perish?
"Just unlucky..." Xu Zhixuan was about to continue when footsteps sounded suddenly.
The crowd turned toward the sound, seeing a middle-aged man of average appearance, slightly short at about 1.6 meters in height, with dark skin, walking in.
Despite his less than favorable appearance, his sharp eyes were like swords, and his movements carried the majestic presence of a Golden Core.
Once he arrived, the great hall fell silent.
"Qiu Xuan Ancestor!"
With such imposing presence, there was only one such person in Qiu Xuan Mountain, Xu Ping dared not look further, promptly lowering his eyes.
Qiu Xuan Ancestor took his seat, scanning the hall, causing everyone to bow their heads.
"Regarding the increase in demon beasts around the Immortal City, I personally inspected Yellow Dragon Mountain Range a few days ago and detected the presence of a Third-stage grand demon in the inner mountain..." Qiu Xuan Ancestor’s voice was steady but weighed heavily upon everyone’s hearts.
"All signs indicate... the beast tide is truly about to erupt prematurely!"
Though everyone had their suspicions, having Qiu Xuan Ancestor confirm it made hearts palpably heavy.
If not for the presence of the Golden Core Ancestor, there would likely have been a commotion.
"The beast tide is coming!"
Xu Ping’s heart sank, though his power outstripped ordinary Foundations, the beast tide would have Third-stage Demon Beasts appearing.
His humble Dao path was far from anything significant.

chapters.title: Chapter 109: Longevity Skill Mastery
chapters.content:
Chapter 109: Chapter 109: Longevity Skill Mastery
"However, you don’t need to worry now; the beast tide is still in the brewing phase and far from breaking out," said Ancestor Qiu Xuan.
"Moreover, I have also informed the major sects. Shortly, they will send people to jointly resist the demon beasts."
Upon hearing this, everyone let out a sigh of relief—it wouldn’t erupt immediately, which was good.
At the very least, it gave them time to prepare.
Ancestor Qiu Xuan glanced around and suddenly smiled, "I heard from Hongyi there’s a new Guest Minister. Who might that be? Come, let me see."
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping’s heart tightened as he quickly stepped out from the crowd, showing respect, he stepped forward a few paces, bowed, and said, "Junior Xu Ping greets the Ancestor."
Instantly, he felt a probing gaze fall upon him, seemingly trying to see through him.
Xu Ping felt a surge of pressure in his heart.
"Good, good, good, truly a young and promising talent. There’s no need to be nervous; as long as you act earnestly, whether you’re a Guest Minister or my disciple, we treat everyone equally... Now, step back." Thankfully, with Ancestor Qiu Xuan’s words, that probing gaze vanished.
"Yes, Ancestor!"
Xu Ping returned to his original position, looking overwhelmed with favor.
Facing a Golden Core cultivator, the pressure was indeed immense.
Afterward, Ancestor Qiu Xuan said a few more polite words, left Hongyi behind, and then dismissed everyone.
...
As Xu Ping walked out the door with the crowd, he exhaled lightly.
Facing a Golden Core cultivator, the pressure was truly immense.
When that gaze fell upon him, it was like needles on his back.
Not relaxing at all.
```
