"Looks like our hard days are coming," sighed Xu Zhixuan beside him.
"This is my first time experiencing a beast tide. Would Fellow Daoist Xu be able to tell me the specifics of a beast tide?" Xu Ping inquired.
"I haven’t experienced one either."
"However, I heard some older Foundation Establishment cultivators say that in the history of Qiu Xuan Immortal City, there have been three beast tides in total. The shortest lasted eight months, and the longest was five years..." Xu Zhixuan said.
"Five years?"
Xu Ping was slightly stunned—the duration of the beast tide was indeed too long.
Upon closer thought, the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range was vast and rich, and who knows how many demon beasts were in there.
Perhaps the demon beasts in the beast tide were just a fraction of them.
"Although the beast tide lasts a long time, Qiu Xuan Immortal City is guarded by a third-rank array and hasn’t been breached yet," Xu Zhixuan reassured.
"I hope this beast tide can also be successfully weathered," Xu Ping couldn’t help but sigh.
’Even if the beast tide hasn’t erupted yet, my days ahead certainly won’t be so leisurely,’ he mused inwardly.
...
...
When the Golden Core ancestor confirmed that the beast tide would erupt early, Qiu Xuan Mountain didn’t hold back and announced it publicly.
After all, it made no sense to keep it secret.
"How could this happen?"
"Wasn’t the last beast tide just thirty years ago? How could it erupt so early this time?"
"My uncle died in the last beast tide..."
"The beast tide is erupting? Good, fortune lies in risk!"
...
Cultivators in Qiu Xuan Immortal City were worried, scared, saddened, or hopeful... yet none of it could change the fact that the beast tide was about to erupt.
To cope with this beast tide, Qiu Xuan Mountain made ample preparations, offering heavy rewards and inviting cultivators to guard the city and hunt demons.
Array masters, talisman masters, artifact refiners, among others, were all given generous treatment.
Arrays in various parts of the Immortal City were being reinforced.
Residential properties and caves were collectively discounted.
Even so, many cultivators still withdrew from Qiu Xuan Immortal City.
The city’s marketplaces were no longer as bustling as before.
Many cultivators avoided the beast tide.
However, for some enterprising cultivators, it was a rare opportunity.
There were also more foreign cultivators exuding evil qi in the city.
...
Two months later, at Qiu Xuan Mountain.
Cultivation room.
Xu Ping sat with his eyes closed, silently cultivating.
After an unknown period.
Suddenly!
His aura began to rise.
Whoosh!
A surge of air lifted his robes, but quickly dissipated.
Xu Ping opened his eyes, a gentle blue light flashed.
"Phew!"
He let out a long breath.
"After spending so much time, I’ve finally mastered the Longevity Skill!"
A hint of joy flashed in Xu Ping’s eyes.
He used his divine sense to examine the changes within himself.
Firstly, his cultivation speed had increased by a third, which meant his breakthrough to mid-stage Foundation Establishment would be sooner.
Additionally, the purity of the liquid mana in his dantian, or in other words, the quality, had also improved, with the patterns on the surface of the liquid mana becoming clearer.
The improvement in mana quality also represented an increase in combat power.
Among cultivators with the same conditions, the one with higher mana quality had distinctly higher combat power and endurance.
Most importantly, his lifespan had unexpectedly increased.
Xu Ping opened the proficiency panel, focusing his gaze on the lifespan section.
His lifespan had changed from ’268’ to ’273’, an increase of five years.
Xu Ping couldn’t help but feel a bit of delight, but when thinking about the impending beast tide, that joy quickly faded.
"There’s still a long way to go."
After finishing his cultivation, Xu Ping left the cultivation room and went to the small courtyard.
"Is Elder Xu home?"
At this moment, a voice called out from outside the courtyard gate.
Xu Ping opened the array and saw an unfamiliar Qi Cultivator from ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ standing at the gate.
"Elder Xu, I am a disciple who guards the mountain. Someone claiming to be an acquaintance of yours is looking for you at the foot of the mountain," said the Qi Cultivator respectfully.
"An acquaintance of mine?" Xu Ping’s heart stirred, "Could it be...."
"Thank you, I’ll go with you to have a look," he said.
...
...
At the foot of Qiu Xuan Mountain.
A lean old man paced back and forth, looking somewhat nervous.
"It’s you, Friend Zhang, looking for me," Xu Ping’s voice came before his arrival.
Zhang Yan turned toward the sound and, seeing Xu Ping approaching, couldn’t help but step forward with a smile on his face, "Elder Xu."
"You specifically came to find me. What is it? Surely, not just to reminisce," Xu Ping teased.
"I do have a small matter," Zhang Yan smiled awkwardly. After a moment’s pause, he organized his words and said, "Qiu Xuan Immortal City is about to face a beast tide. As a mere Qi Cultivator, even with the array’s protection, I fear for my life."
"So, I wish to temporarily leave Qiu Xuan Immortal City and return after the beast tide has passed."
"Indeed, being in the Qi Refining Realm during a beast tide is dangerous," Xu Ping nodded.
He actually had another thought, that Foundation Establishment Cultivators were also extremely at risk during a beast tide.
He wanted to run away himself, but as a Guest Minister of Qiu Xuan Mountain, he couldn’t leave now.
Of course, he had to prepare a fallback plan in case Qiu Xuan Mountain was breached by the beast tide, for a proper retreat.
"But recently, all Spiritual Boats in Qiu Xuan Immortal City are fully booked. Even with Spirit Stones, I can’t get a ticket," Zhang Yan smiled awkwardly. "So I wanted to ask you, Elder, if you had any way."
After a moment of silence, Xu Ping replied, "I don’t have any way myself, but I can ask around for you."
"Thank you very much, Elder!" Zhang Yan looked delighted.
"Wait for me here. I’ll be quick," Xu Ping nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 110: Stationed Outside
chapters.content:
Chapter 110: Chapter 110: Stationed Outside
Qiu Xuan Mountain peak, a hall in a grand palace.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, what do you seek from me?" Hongyi rubbed his temples, a hint of fatigue in his voice.
As the Sect Leader Senior Brother of ’Qiu Xuan Mountain,’ with the beast tide imminent, there are evidently many matters to attend to.
"It’s nothing major. I have a Qi Cultivation friend who wishes to leave on the spiritual boat, but there are no spots left. I wonder if the Sect Leader could make an exception?" Xu Ping cupped his hands in a salute.
Although he did not know who was in charge of spiritual boat transportation, seeking Hongyi was surely the right choice.
"It’s a small matter."
Hongyi took out a jade pendant from his storage ring, placed it on the table, and pushed it over. "Give this jade pendant to the steward of the spiritual boat, he will naturally arrange everything for Fellow Daoist Xu’s friend."
"Thank you, Sect Leader." Xu Ping’s eyes brightened.
Indeed, having strength makes things easier. If you’re a Qi Cultivator without backing, who would care about you?
"If the Sect Leader has no other matters, I shall take my leave, as my friend is waiting at the foot of the mountain." Xu Ping cupped his hands again, preparing to leave, but Hongyi stopped him.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, hold on."
"Does the Sect Leader have further matters?"
"With the beast tide about to erupt, there are too many things to do, and reinforcements from other sects have yet to arrive, leaving us short-handed. Hence, I wish to delegate a task to Fellow Daoist Xu." Hongyi said slowly.
"What might the task be?" Xu Ping asked, cupping his hands.
He had long anticipated having to undertake tasks, for every Foundation Establishment cultivator at ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ usually had tasks to fulfill.
Ordinary Guest Ministers like Xu Zhixuan had already been assigned to purge the demon beasts.
He hoped to weaken the beast tide as much as possible before it struck.
Naturally, he could not stand on the sidelines.
"Fellow Daoist Xu need not worry; it’s not a dangerous task, merely to guard a Foundation Establishment family a thousand miles away." Hongyi explained.
"Guard a Foundation Establishment family a thousand miles away?" Xu Ping showed doubt.
What’s the significance of this Foundation Establishment family?
Why would ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ send a Foundation Establishment cultivator to guard it?
"This Foundation Establishment family has some connection with the ancestor." Hongyi explained.
"With the approaching beast tide, although the family has an array for protection, it only has one Foundation Establishment cultivator. Thus, another Foundation Establishment cultivator is being sent as a precaution."
Xu Ping, being a Pill Master who broke through to Foundation Establishment only a few years ago, would not be assigned to eliminate demon beasts unless absolutely necessary.
Guarding a rear Foundation Establishment family is undoubtedly much safer.
"The Foundation Establishment family is located on a Second-stage spiritual land, and a Spirit Gathering Array is set up there. You can also cultivate and practice alchemy there." Hongyi added.
"Understood." Xu Ping nodded; he had no reason to refuse.
Moreover, such an arrangement is quite beneficial; if anything happens to Qiu Xuan Mountain, he could easily escape.
"When should I depart?" Xu Ping asked.
"In half a month, someone will come to inform Fellow Daoist." Hongyi replied.
"I am duty-bound, then I’ll take my leave for now." Xu Ping cupped his hands in salute before leaving the hall.
...
...
Foot of Qiu Xuan Mountain.
"Simply give this jade pendant to the steward of the spiritual boat; he will arrange everything for you." Xu Ping handed the jade pendant to Zhang Yan.
"Thank you, Senior!" Hearing this, Zhang Yan was overjoyed. Having connections indeed makes things easier!
The pill legacy was truly given to the right person.
"Where are you planning to go?" Xu Ping inquired.
"Planning to return to my old home, ’Ten Thousand Mountains,’ for a visit. It’s been over twenty years since I last went back." Zhang Yan laughed.
"Ten Thousand Mountains?"
Xu Ping was momentarily stunned. Zhang Yan’s plan to travel truly covered quite a distance, almost crossing half of Yue Country.
Ten Thousand Mountains is located in the southwest of Yue Country, a vast range of continuous mountains, and going further leads to bordering with Nightmare Swamp.
The swamp is shrouded in mist all year round, even able to block the divine sense of Foundation Establishment cultivators, and its area is vast. It’s said that the swamp contains Third-stage demon beasts capable of poisoning Golden Core insects.
Golden Core cultivators dare not easily set foot there.
It is said that if one could cross ’Nightmare Swamp,’ they could reach further south to an even more powerful and prosperous cultivation realm than Nanchuan.
Scattered throughout ’Ten Thousand Mountains’ are countless peaks, among which are those possessing spirit veins, occupied by small sects and families.
Nevertheless, there are no Third-stage spirit veins, hence the strongest influence remains Foundation Establishment.
"Years ago, I had a dispute with my family, left in anger, and didn’t return for over twenty years. But now it’s time to go back and take a look." Zhang Yan sighed.
"After all, they are blood-related family members." Xu Ping followed up on his words.
After a few more casual conversations, Zhang Yan bid farewell.
...
Returning home.
Xu Ping sat on a stone bench in the small courtyard, watching the spiritual fish swimming in the spiritual pool, silently pondering this task of guarding.
In truth, this task isn’t all that dangerous, but it’s uncertain how long the guarding would be.
Preparedness must be ample for provisions.
If Qiu Xuan Immortal City can’t hold out, it would be easier to escape.
...
Three days later.
Xu Ping descended the mountain and arrived at Qiu Xuan Immortal City.
After some disguise, he started selling various unused spirit medicines and pills.
These spirit medicines and pills came from exploiting ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’ resources to earn.
During this time, he noticed a significant price surge for magical artifacts, with minor increases also for talismans and pills.
The prices of low-grade materials related to demon beasts showed a certain downward trend.
Taking advantage of the favorable market, Xu Ping sold his spirit medicines for thousands of spirit stones.
"Perhaps I should inquire about the availability of Second-stage lower and middle-grade blood essence from ape-type demon beasts." Xu Ping thought to himself.
Although the beast tide hasn’t erupted yet, hunting teams have already slain many demon beasts, including numerous Second-stage beasts.
There might be Second-stage lower and middle-grade blood essence from ape-type demon beasts.
Through years of honing, his Blood Soul Body Refining level has nearly reached its peak, allowing him to practice the second level.
With the beast tide imminent, increasing his strength as much as possible is imperative.
Xu Ping visited various shops but collected only three kinds of Second-stage lower-grade ape-type demon beasts, with no leads on Second-stage middle-grade.
Fortunately, he heard there would be some at the auction in five days.
...
Five days later.
Xu Ping, disguised, attended the large-scale auction in Qiu Xuan Immortal City.
"This Daoist friend’s cultivation is not insignificant, how should I address you?"
"Would you be interested in joining our Qiu Xuan Immortal’s demon hunting team? The compensation will certainly satisfy you..."
Humorously, upon entering the auction venue, his Foundation Establishment cultivation attracted attempts at recruitment by the direct lineage of Qiu Xuan Mountain, disciples of the Golden Core ancestor.
Evidently, he had not been recognized as Xu Ping disguised as an unfamiliar Foundation Establishment cultivator.
Having Foundation Establishment cultivation places one as a formidable strength outside the sect, deemed as high-end combat power.
"I, Li, am only here for the auction, disinterested otherwise."
Xu Ping declined straightforwardly.
This auction was not as lively as previous ones, yet some upper-grade and top-grade magical artifacts were auctioned at higher prices.
Xu Ping also successfully acquired what he desired - Second-stage ape-type blood essence.
After attending the auction, he wasted no time and returned directly to Qiu Xuan Mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 111: The Foundation Establishment Chen Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 111: Chapter 111: The Foundation Establishment Chen Clan
Seven days later.
A small spiritual boat carrying several people flew out from the south gate of the Yellow Dragon Immortal City, heading towards the rear.
A few late-stage Qi Cultivation disciples from Qiu Xuan Mountain took turns controlling the spiritual boat at the front.
Xu Ping sat at the back, resting with closed eyes.
In his mind, information about this Foundation Establishment family’s stationing involuntarily emerged:
’This family’s surname is Chen, originally a small Qi Cultivation family, but with the help of ’Qiu Xuan Mountain’, they became a Foundation Establishment family.’
’Their family has one Foundation Establishment cultivator and nearly two hundred Qi cultivators, occupying a Second-stage Upper Grade spirit vein.’
’Their family’s strength is naturally far from sufficient to occupy this Second-stage Upper Grade spirit vein, but with Qiu Xuan Mountain behind them, no one dares to lay claim on them."
I wonder what connection this small family has with the ancestor of Qiu Xuan, spending so much effort and time to help them.
Although Xu Ping wanted to know this gossip, as it concerned a Golden Core cultivator, he didn’t dare to inquire.
...
The small spiritual boat flew for less than half an hour.
"Ah! Save me..."
The indistinct sounds of fighting and screams reached their ears.
"Elder Xu!" The Qi Cultivation disciples from Qiu Xuan Mountain couldn’t help but look at Xu Ping.
Not having left the territory of Qiu Xuan Mountain, yet discovering robbers killing, by rights, they should intervene.
"Keep going!" Xu Ping didn’t even lift an eyelid.
As long as the robbery wasn’t aimed at him, he couldn’t care less.
"Yes!" Although the Qi Cultivation disciples of Qiu Xuan Mountain were dissatisfied and secretly despised Elder Xu for being timid and selfish, they dared not contradict him and continued silently forward.
Xu Ping sensed their slight emotions but didn’t care, only reflecting to himself:
"The security environment around Qiu Xuan Immortal City is deteriorating further."
"With the beast tide brewing, Qiu Xuan Mountain’s energies are drawn away, and all sorts of monsters and demons are emerging."
To avoid trouble, Xu Ping didn’t hide his Foundation Establishment aura.
They proceeded safely, and no one dared to make a move on them.
.....
Ten days later.
The group safely arrived at the Chen family’s Foundation Establishment clan.
The Chen family’s territory was built around a vast spiritual lake, scattered with villages and manors.
On the shores of the spiritual lake, Xu Ping saw some spirit fields growing spiritual grains and spirit medicines.
The true core of the family’s territory was on an island in the center of the lake.
Beneath the island, there was a Second-stage Upper Grade spirit vein, suitable for Foundation Establishment stage cultivators to cultivate.
"This is truly a good place!" Xu Ping sighed inwardly.
With such a large spiritual lake, raising some spirit fish and growing some spirit medicines could bring huge profits.
"I’m afraid it wasn’t easy for Qiu Xuan Mountain to find such a good place either!"
"After my twenty years as a guest minister in Qiu Xuan Mountain, I’ll find a place like this to cultivate in peace."
...
"Fellow Daoist, you must be weary from your journey. I am Chen Li, the clan leader of the Chen family."
As Xu Ping and his group disembarked from the spiritual boat, a tall, hawk-eyed middle-aged man with a strong mana fluctuation approached with a warm smile, accompanied by seven or eight members of the Chen family.
"Fellow Daoist Chen, there’s no need for such courtesy. I am Xu Ping, a guest minister of Qiu Xuan Mountain, here by command to support your noble clan." Xu Ping cupped his hands, appearing very polite.
After all, this family was related to Qiu Xuan Zhenren, and he didn’t want to offend them.
"This is the sect leader’s token, please verify." Xu Ping took out an ancient token from his storage bag and handed it to him.
"It’s procedural, I hope you understand." Chen Li checked the token, found no errors, and returned it to Xu Ping.
"No problem." Xu Ping smiled.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, you must be tired from your journey. We have prepared a feast, please join us on the lake heart island." Chen Li extended an enthusiastic invitation.
"You’re too kind, Fellow Daoist." Xu Ping responded with a broad smile.
Despite the Chen family’s association with Qiu Xuan Zhenren, they displayed no arrogance, treating others with great courtesy and enthusiasm.
It seems their smooth transition from a small Qi Cultivation family to their current status was not only due to the aid of Qiu Xuan Mountain but also largely attributed to themselves.
...
Along the expansive spiritual lake, the group made their way to the lake heart island.
"Second-stage Upper Grade Array, Water Shadow Curtain Array!"
Xu Ping recognized the array at a glance.
A barely visible ripple of transparency enveloped the entire lake heart island, providing concealment, protection, and alert functions.
’With such an array, even without me, it would take several mid to late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivators to break this array.’ Xu Ping marveled internally.
...
On the lake heart island, in a spacious grand hall.
Chen Li, along with seven or eight important family members, accompanied them.
Xu Ping and several Qiu Xuan Mountain disciples sat alone at separate tables, enjoying a feast of mountain delicacies and fine wines.
In the center of the hall, ten or so young maidens stepped onto the carpet, each graceful and elegant, with diverse physiques.
The air was filled with a pleasant fragrance.
Each girl, though non-cultivators, was beautiful and dignified, lacking the vulgar air of worldly rouge.
"These are our family’s outstanding mortal women, skilled in dance, and they shall perform for our honored guests." Chen Li smiled.
Upon saying this.
The young maidens began to dance like fluttering butterflies.
Their graceful figures and beautiful dance moves attracted the eyes of several Qiu Xuan Mountain disciples, nearly mesmerizing them.
Having grown up rigorously cultivating at Qiu Xuan Mountain, their ingrained philosophy leaned towards austerity and relentless cultivation to achieve Foundation Establishment, leaving them unaccustomed to such spectacles.
...
An hour later, the welcoming banquet ended.
After declining Chen Li’s offer of mortal women for company, Xu Ping went alone to the independent courtyard prepared for him by the Chen clan.
Although he turned down the offer, several disciples from Qiu Xuan Mountain accepted it somewhat reluctantly.
Xu Ping didn’t say much.
After all, this was a personal matter, and he couldn’t be bothered with it.
In the bedroom.
Xu Ping scanned the entire courtyard with his Divine Sense, and after detecting nothing unusual, took out an array plate from his storage bag.
Inserting a Spirit Stone, he activated the array.
A layer of light enveloped the entire courtyard but soon disappeared.
As the controller of the array, Xu Ping could naturally sense the presence of the light curtain.
This array was a First Rank Upper Grade Array, the ’Departing God Array’, which could prevent Divine Sense probing by Foundation Establishment cultivators. Though such a cultivator could forcibly penetrate it, it would be sensed.
Having done all this, Xu Ping’s expression eased somewhat.
Even though on Lake Spirit Island there was only Chen Li as a Foundation Establishment cultivator, he certainly wouldn’t rashly scan him with Divine Sense.
Better safe than sorry.
After all, he had many secrets that would be troublesome if discovered.
"With the beast tide soon to erupt, this place might be safer than Qiu Xuan Immortal City." Xu Ping silently took a sip of the spiritual tea on the table.
Though Qiu Xuan Immortal City was guarded by a Third-rank Array, it also resembled a cage.
Before the array was breached, one couldn’t leave.
Here, if anything went wrong, one could immediately flee, providing much more flexibility.
However, this applied more to Xu Ping; ordinary Qi cultivators, or even Foundation Establishment cultivators, would certainly prefer staying in Qiu Xuan Immortal City.
"Though the Spiritual Qi here isn’t comparable to Qiu Xuan Mountain, the Second-stage Upper Grade spirit vein is more than enough to meet my cultivation needs."
"I hope this beast tide passes peacefully." Xu Ping sighed slightly.
Honestly, the cultivation environment at Qiu Xuan Mountain was good, and he didn’t want to leave easily.

chapters.title: Chapter 112: Demon Beast Invasion
chapters.content:
Chapter 112: Chapter 112: Demon Beast Invasion
A few days later, Xu Ping adapted to life in this place.
He stayed indoors every day, quietly cultivating.
After gathering enough Second-stage ape blood, he began to bathe in the blood and cultivate Blood Soul Body Refining’s second layer.
Ten days later.
In the cultivation room.
In a tub filled with red liquid, Xu Ping had his eyes tightly shut, silently circulating the "Blood Soul Body Refining" technique.
As the technique circulated, steam rose, and his skin radiated a faint green and red light. The color of the red liquid in the tub gradually dimmed.
After two hours.
The liquid in the tub had turned as clear as water.
Xu Ping suddenly opened his eyes, a flash of blood light flickered within them. Deep inside, a strand of frenzied killing intent surged, as though he wanted to rush out of the room and tear apart all living beings in sight.
But this strand of killing intent was quickly suppressed by his Divine Sense, like a small flame extinguished by a torrential downpour.
"This... this Evil Qi can actually affect my mind!" Xu Ping was startled as he sobered up completely.
When cultivating the first layer of Blood Soul Body Refining, he only thought that this Evil Qi might become an aid in the future, but he didn’t expect such side effects.
"Indeed, there is a reason why this ’Blood Soul Body Refining’ is considered a demonic technique." Xu Ping’s expression was uncertain.
Bloody, cruel, quick success, and significant side effects.
"Should I abandon it?"
After hesitating for a moment, Xu Ping ultimately decided to continue cultivating.
This Evil Qi and killing intent might affect ordinary Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators, but he was completely unmoved by it.
With his current Divine Sense strength combined with the Perfection level of Taihang Nourishing God Skill, this Evil Qi and killing intent would have to be at least a hundred times stronger to influence him.
According to his estimation, for this Evil Qi and killing intent to increase a hundredfold, Blood Soul Body Refining must be cultivated to the fourth layer, comparable to the Golden Core level of body refining.
He was still far off from that.
Moreover, Blood Soul Body Refining was far superior to general body refining techniques. Achieving the second layer would undoubtedly enhance his survival abilities during the beast tide.
It was entirely a case of benefits outweighing the drawbacks.
And these minor drawbacks could be completely ignored.
...
...
Half a month later.
In the living room.
"These are the Pills Fellow Daoist Chen entrusted to me to concoct. They have all been completed. Fellow Daoist Chen, please check them." Xu Ping placed a storage bag on the table and pushed it over.
"No need, I have long heard of Fellow Daoist Xu’s alchemy skills, and I have full trust in them." Chen Li happily accepted the storage bag.
With Chen Li’s connection with Qiu Xuan Mountain, he naturally knew that Xu Ping was a seasoned Second-stage Lower Grade Alchemist.
Thus, after getting closer to Xu Ping, he entrusted him to help in refining pills, expressing that he would pay a handsome reward.
And Xu Ping readily agreed.
Time to profit again!
With his alchemy skills and panel assistance, the possibility of failure in refining common pills was nearly nonexistent, allowing him to gladly accept the excess spirit medicines and rewards.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, the purple bamboo fish from the lake have matured, care to join me for a taste?" Chen Li warmly invited as he handed the new batch of spirit medicines and rewards to Xu Ping.
Purple bamboo fish, with tender meat and rich in Spiritual Qi, was highly favored by cultivators for its ability to enhance one’s physique when consumed regularly.
However, its price was exorbitant, and it only matured every five years.
"Sure." Xu Ping was in a good mood, knowing he could continue to gain benefits elsewhere, so he nodded in agreement.
Led by Chen Li, they arrived at a scenic courtyard.
Soon, the freshly cooked purple bamboo fish was brought to the table.
"Fellow Daoist, try a taste. This was freshly caught from the spirit lake this morning," Chen Li encouraged warmly.
"Then I won’t hold back." Xu Ping smiled, picking up a piece of fish meat and putting it in his mouth.
After chatting a bit, Xu Ping inquired with Chen Li about the recent beast tide.
"There are now small groups of demon beasts attacking the Immortal City, and the surrounding cultivator families and forces are also suffering from demon beast assaults." Speaking on this topic, Chen Li’s face showed concern.
The Chen family, though thousands of miles away from the Immortal City, found such a distance insignificant for the beast tide.
If not for Qiu Xuan Immortal City bearing the brunt, the nearby cultivator forces might have already fled.
They enjoyed the resources the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range provided, so they naturally should bear the corresponding risks.
"Have other sects sent reinforcements?" Xu Ping asked.
"Not yet. These sects always drag their feet, never arriving until the last moment." When talking about other Golden Core sects in Yue Country, Chen Li’s face was filled with resentment.
If these Golden Core sects could come early, their days would undoubtedly be much better.
"Clan Leader, there’s trouble, a group of demon beasts appeared near the clan land."
At that moment, an elderly man with white hair and beard rushed in anxiously.
"What!"
Chen Li’s expression changed, immediately asking, "Have they found any Second-stage Demon Beasts?"
"Not yet found." The elder shook his head.
"That’s good." Chen Li immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
If Second-stage Demon Beasts appeared before the beast tide fully arrived, there would be heaps of Second-stage Demon Beasts when the tide truly came.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, excuse me, I need to handle that group of demon beasts." Chen Li cupped his hands.
Though there weren’t any Second-stage Demon Beasts, it wouldn’t do to have this group of demon beasts loitering near the clan land, so they must be eradicated completely.
"If you need my assistance, feel free to ask," Xu Ping said seriously.
"I definitely won’t be reserved." Chen Li joked.
After Chen Li left, Xu Ping no longer had the mind to indulge and returned home to continue cultivating.
The beast tide was approaching rapidly. Even with his current strength, he couldn’t be complacent.
Every bit of strength gained represented an increased chance of survival.
...
In the days that followed, Xu Ping again began quietly cultivating, enhancing his strength.
The previous group of demon beasts, without any Second-stage Demon Beasts, was swiftly eradicated by Chen Li and his group.
But peace didn’t last long before another wave of demon beasts emerged.
Reluctantly, Chen Li had to dispatch people to eliminate the beasts again.
However, since no Second-stage Demon Beasts appeared, Xu Ping was not troubled.
However, a few Qi Cultivation disciples from Qiu Xuan Mountain were lured by the Chen family’s enticements and willingly joined the demon-hunting team.
Even though these Qi Cultivation disciples lacked the experience of the family disciples, their prowess and talent in combat far surpassed those of the family disciples.
Each displayed remarkable skills, transitioning from mere assistance to leading the attack.
Amidst the admiration and praise from the Chen family disciples, they lost themselves and devotedly cleared the nearby demon beasts for the Chen family.
"The Chen family fully and wholeheartedly treats this Guest Minister Xu, yet when the demon beasts attack, he doesn’t even show up, clearly revealing him as a selfish, timid, and cowardly person."
As they cleared the beasts, their disdain for Xu Ping deepened in their hearts.
They believed, from the previous cultivator attack incident and this beast incident, they had completely understood the nature of Guest Minister Xu.

chapters.title: Chapter 113: Tier 2 Demon Beast
chapters.content:
Chapter 113: Chapter 113: Tier 2 Demon Beast
This day.
Xu Ping was cultivating in his room when a sudden beast roar penetrated the array and entered his ears.
His eyes abruptly opened, carrying a hint of seriousness: "Is this... a second-stage demon beast?"
The roar of a first rank demon beast would not have such strong penetration.
"The beast tide hasn’t started yet... and already a second-stage demon beast has appeared in a place a thousand miles away from the Immortal City?" Xu Ping’s heart grew heavy.
He dared not imagine the current situation in the Immortal City, nor dared imagine how many demon beasts would appear once the beast tide fully erupted.
Thinking of this, Xu Ping could no longer sit still.
He pushed the door open and set up his escape light, rushing toward Spirit Lake.
As a result, he had just flown to the edge of Spirit Lake when he encountered Chen Li and his party, who were heading for the island in the center of the lake, looking disheveled.
"Fellow Daoist Chen, did you encounter a second-stage demon beast?"
Xu Ping descended, his gaze falling on Chen Li and his party.
Members of the Chen family were alright, just looking a bit embarrassed, without any injuries.
But a few of Qiu Xuan Mountain’s Qi cultivation disciples were miserable, each carrying injuries.
One even had a missing arm and fell into a coma.
"It was originally just a small group of demon beasts. Unexpectedly, a second-stage lower grade demon beast and more than ten first rank upper grade demon beasts suddenly emerged, catching us off guard."
"I couldn’t rescue them in time and also implicated Qiu Xuan Mountain’s distinguished disciples getting injured." Chen Li sighed helplessly, a hint of apology between his brows.
"Senior Chen, your words are too kind. This second-stage demon beast’s ambush was unforeseeable. If it weren’t for Senior Chen leading us to break through, we might have already fallen to the beasts." Said a relatively lightly injured disciple of Qiu Xuan Mountain.
’These people are beyond help, being sold and still helping count the money.’ Xu Ping shook his head inwardly.
Although the Chen family’s methods were simple, just sugar-coated cannonballs, they were particularly effective on a few people.
"The distinguished disciples of Qiu Xuan Mountain are truly noble in character!" Chen Li spoke another word of praise.
Upon hearing, several people involuntarily puffed out their chests as if accomplishing something worthy of pride.
Xu Ping felt speechless inside, but was too lazy to manage.
After reassuring the Qiu Xuan Mountain’s few Qi cultivation disciples, Chen Li turned his gaze to Xu Ping: "Fellow Daoist Xu, I hope you can help us slaughter this demon beast."
"It’s within my duty." Xu Ping agreed immediately.
A second-stage lower grade demon beast alone posed no threat to him.
The two discussed for a while, bringing along dozens of mid to late-stage Qi cultivation Chen family disciples, and set off to hunt the demon beast.
...
In a dense forest.
A small group of demon beasts, led by a giant rat with a body length of one zhang, surrounded and killed a group of cultivators.
This giant rat was a second-stage demon beast, and these cultivators were merely in the Qi refining realm, how could they be opponents?
In just a moment, these cultivators were killed amidst screams.
Chirp! Chirp!
The giant rat raised its head, its beast roar sweeping through all directions.
At this moment.
A cold light suddenly appeared!
A wisp of dagger phantom, like a lurking snake spitting its tongue, flashed toward the giant rat with lightning speed.
The giant rat reacted swiftly, hissed, then released its innate secret technique; instantly, a violent vortex of yellow sand, spanning more than twenty zhang, appeared in front of it, trapping the dagger within.
The clash of magical artifacts against sandy gravel produced an ear-piercing grinding sound, and the dagger artifact could not break free for a moment.
The giant rat hadn’t even let out a sigh of relief when a dazzling sword qi came from the north, sweeping across the sky toward it in an instant.
Chirp! Chirp!
Terror showed in the eyes of the giant rat as it dodged swiftly.
Boom!
The sword qi left a two-foot-long wound on the giant rat, its power unabated, killing several first rank upper grade demon beasts in succession before dissipating.
"Amazing swordsmanship!" Chen Li sincerely praised.
He never expected that besides being so skilled in alchemy, Xu Ping also possessed such an extraordinary level of swordsmanship.
With such talent, he might have hope even in the late-stage foundation establishment in the future, and even the Golden Core was not an impossibility.
He was a big thigh to hang onto!
Having received aid from Qiu Xuan Zhenren, the Chen family naturally understood the importance of holding onto a powerful ally.
"Fellow Daoist Chen, you flatter me. The swordsmanship I have can only barely be considered passable. It’s not time for small talk yet, let’s slay these demon beasts first."
Xu Ping held the Purple Sun Sword and set up his escape light, charging toward the giant rat demon.
Chen Li also followed closely behind.
"Slay!"
Xu Ping deployed the Primordial Sword Skill, each streak of sword qi slashing like thunder onto the giant rat demon, leaving bleeding wounds.
Chen Li summoned a blue giant axe, slashing at the giant rat demon.
Under the assault of both, the giant rat demon fell into a decidedly disadvantaged position.
If it hadn’t been so agile, dodging many lethal attacks, its head and body might have been severed by now.
But it couldn’t dodge for long. Next, just a little wear and it could be steadily killed.
Just then!
Suddenly!
Boom!
From beneath Xu Ping’s position, the ground exploded with dirt and stones, dust flew up, and a massive, extremely muscular brownish-yellow rat-shaped demon beast, with claws and teeth like metal and iron, sprang out.
Its claws and teeth, like metal, carried an evil wind, grabbing towards Xu Ping.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, be careful." Chen Li was shocked; he had not anticipated another second-stage rat demon hidden underground.
He had swept with his divine sense, how could he not have discovered it!
The sudden attack was truly deadly!
Not only Chen Li had not discovered it, but even Xu Ping’s divine sense had not detected it.
One must know his divine sense was stronger than an average mid-stage foundation establishment cultivator.
After the initial panic, Xu Ping quickly calmed down. If it were an ordinary cultivator under such a sneak attack, they would surely be doomed.
He performed a spell and shouted in a low voice: "Blood Demon True Form!"
In an instant, his physique began to swell, transforming into a robust man more than two meters tall, with blood light coursing over his skin.
Describing takes longer than it took to happen, but it all occurred in just a brief moment.
Xu Ping unhesitatingly swung a punch.
Boom!
With a loud noise, a wave of air exploded at the center of the man and demon beast, sweeping all around!
After a moment of stalemate, Xu Ping’s strength prevailed, directly driving the brownish-yellow rat-shaped demon beast into the ground, creating a deep pit, dust flying all around.
"Second... second-stage body refining!" Chen Li’s eyes bulged out.
Second-stage body refining wasn’t an uncommon technique, but it required a massive amount of time and resources.
How was he able to achieve this? Did he have that much time for cultivation?
A seasoned second-stage lower grade alchemist, an exceedingly strong swordsmanship, and an uncommon second-stage body refining.
Each alone required a vast amount of time or spirit stones.
Yet he managed to achieve all of them simultaneously.
Could this be talent?
In the void, Xu Ping grinned and clenched his fist.
Though he sent the brownish-yellow rat-shaped demon beast flying, he wasn’t unscathed, his right hand was now a bloody mess.
Compared to the beast’s claws, his bare hands had evidently weaker defensive power.
"Fellow Daoist Chen, one each!"
After casting a Hemostasis Skill on his right hand, Xu Ping wielded his sword and charged toward the brownish-yellow rat-shaped demon beast.
Given his physique, such an injury was no major concern.
And naturally, Chen Li had no objections.

chapters.title: Chapter 114: Refining the Rat Demon
chapters.content:
Chapter 114: Chapter 114: Refining the Rat Demon
Xu Ping used the Primordial Sword Skill to engage in battle with the Rat Demon.
He found that although this Rat Demon could use Earth Escape and conceal Divine Sense, its combat strength was rather mediocre.
Before long, Xu Ping had it cut and bruised all over.
Buzz!
Seeing defeat imminent, the brown-yellow rat-shaped demon beast unleashed a flash of spirit light from its fur, attempting to escape via Earth Escape.
But Xu Ping obviously wouldn’t give it this chance, and with a few sword strikes, he shattered the surrounding soil, forcing the Rat Demon out.
"Rest assured, I won’t kill you just yet."
Xu Ping struck again, severely wounding the Rat Demon into unconsciousness, and then walked over with interest.
Though the Rat Demon’s combat ability was mediocre, its ability to use Earth Escape and hide Divine Sense clearly made it an excellent ambusher.
At this moment, an idea sprang up in his mind to make the best use of this Rat Demon to enhance his own strength.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, are you planning to take this demon beast as a Spirit Pet?"
After dealing with another Rat Demon, Chen Li walked over, "Although this type of Rat Demon has strong talent, it’s ultimately a second-stage demon beast, tough to tame. Without a second-stage beast control scroll, it could be hard to subdue."
There’s a consensus in the Cultivation Realm that only demon beasts tamed from a young age and matured to second-stage can be controlled by cultivators, but trying to suppress a second-stage demon beast into submission with absolute force is nearly impossible.
The only method is to use a second-stage beast control scroll to control its mind.
However, second-stage beast control scrolls are extraordinarily precious, more expensive than top-grade Magical Artifacts, and aren’t available on the market.
"No, I spared its life for another purpose." Xu Ping smiled and shook his head.
Naturally, he didn’t have a second-stage beast control scroll, so he’s not planning to tame the Rat Demon.
He spared this second-stage Rat Demon’s life to refine it into a puppet.
In the loot taken from the scattered male cultivator, the ancient book "Corpse Refining" contained methods for puppet creation.
It requires using living creatures for refining to fully preserve their talent and strength completely.
Though he could not bring himself to refine with living humans, using living demon beasts posed no psychological obstacle.
Now, this gifted Rat Demon is just perfect.
If he can refine it into a puppet, utilizing its ability to conceal Divine Sense, paired well, with his outward strength, it’s not impossible for him to kill mid-stage Foundation Establishment cultivators.
This would definitely be a strong support.
Thinking of this, a trace of joy flashed through Xu Ping’s eyes.
Although he also has a bronze corpse puppet, since it was refined using a living human, it’s not suitable to reveal publicly, and in terms of practicality, this bronze corpse certainly couldn’t match the talented Rat Demon.
"Would Fellow Daoist Chen happen to have a Spirit Beast Bag? Could you sell me one?" he inquired.
"I do," Chen Li nodded, and took out a first-rank Spirit Beast Bag from his Storage Ring to hand to Xu Ping.
A first-rank Spirit Beast Bag definitely can’t hold an energetic second-stage demon beast, but it can store a half-dead one.
"Thank you. I’ll make more Pills for you later." Xu Ping expressed his gratitude.
"No big deal, it’s just a first-rank Spirit Beast Bag, not worth much." Chen Li waved his hand.
"Since I’ve taken this second-stage demon beast, the other one will be yours."
"Alright."
Chen Li nodded. Naturally, he didn’t have any objections; truth be told, killing the two second-stage demon beasts mostly relied on Xu Ping.
He indeed benefited.
After each collected the second-stage demon beasts, they began to slaughter the remaining first-rank demon beasts.
With other Qi Cultivation disciples of the Chen Family surrounding and intercepting them, the remaining first-rank demon beasts were quickly slaughtered cleanly.
After declining Chen Li’s dinner invitation, Xu Ping returned alone to his residence.
...
Bedroom.
Xu Ping took out the ancient book "Corpse Refining" for careful study.
"With the power of Earth Fire supplemented, blue crystal ore... Water Spirit Flower... Ten Thousand Iron Rock... Earth Dragon Grass... refine for a month to succeed."
"During the process, it needs Spiritual Liquid to maintain vitality, otherwise, all efforts will be wasted!"
After reading it several times, Xu Ping understood the process of corpse refining.
The other auxiliary materials are manageable; although precious, they can be collected. The challenging part is maintaining the demon beast’s vitality throughout.
If it fails, all resources would be wasted.
"I still need to practice with some first-rank demon beasts first," Xu Ping thought in his heart.
Starting by refining second-stage demon beasts is too difficult; better to hone skills with first-rank demon beasts first.
A second-stage demon beast with such outstanding talent is hard to come by.
...
On the second day.
Xu Ping sought out Chen Li to ask him to help gather various materials needed for corpse refining.
Chen Li immediately agreed.
Although his heart suspected it had to do with Xu Ping capturing the second-stage demon beast alive, he wisely didn’t ask more.
As for Earth Fire, there’s no need to search for it.
The Chen Clan territory already has it.
Ten days later.
Chen Li handed over various filled storage bags to Xu Ping, and during these days he had also captured several First Rank demon beasts.
Now everything is ready for puppet crafting.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Chen, may I borrow your clan’s Earth Fire room?" Xu Ping asked with a bow.
"That shouldn’t be a problem, I’ll take you there." Chen Li nodded in agreement.
But inwardly he couldn’t help but speculate, gathering so many materials and borrowing the Earth Fire room, what is he planning to craft with that Second-stage demon beast?
...
The Earth Fire room of the Chen Clan is not on the heart of the lake island, but on a small active volcano beside Spirit Lake.
The so-called Earth Fire is essentially magma flame, purified by absorbing arrays, its temperature higher and more stable.
"Clan Leader, Elder Xu." Before a giant stone door, a late-stage Qi Cultivation practitioner respectfully greeted both.
"Open the door, Fellow Daoist Xu wants to use the Earth Fire room." Chen Li nodded and instructed.
"Yes."
The late-stage Qi Cultivation practitioner took out a purple arrow-shaped item from his chest, and with a flick towards the stone door.
The purple arrow flashed red, emitting a streak of light that accurately hit the door, causing a rapid rotation of multicolored lights.
Eventually, after several loud cracking sounds, the stone door slowly rose, revealing a black passageway behind it.
This passageway is about a yard tall, rectangular in shape.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, beyond this stone path is the room with Earth Fire."
Led by Chen Li, they traversed the stone path and arrived in a vast circular hall.
The hall was constructed from black stone, over ten yards in diameter and three or four yards high. Around the hall, white stone doors of equal size were evenly distributed, totaling twelve.
At this moment, the hall was deserted except for the newly arrived Xu Ping and Chen Li.
As Xu Ping curiously surveyed the surroundings, he heard Chen Li remark, "There are twelve Earth Fire rooms here, number six has the most intense fire."
Then Chen Li led Xu Ping into room number six.
This room is a square structure, average in size, just five or six yards across, with eight miniature dragon heads embedded along its walls, lifelike in appearance.
Moreover, the mouths of the dragon heads are slightly raised, pointed towards the center of the room, ready to spit, realistic in detail.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, this is the Earth Fire outlet of the room, used for alchemy and artifact refining, the Earth Fire here spouts from these eight dragon heads."
"According to needs, one can also adjust the size and height of the flames. The specific technique for control is engraved on the outer wall of the stone pedestal." Chen Li pointed at the dragon heads and explained.
"I see." Xu Ping nodded, this Earth Fire is quite intelligent, no wonder alchemists and Qi cultivators favor its use.
"Feel free to use it, Fellow Daoist Xu. If any problems arise, consult the gatekeeping disciples." With that, Chen Li exited the room.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Chen." Xu Ping watched Chen Li leave, then shut the stone door.
He approached the dragon heads, carefully studying the details of the eight spouting dragon heads, and memorized the manipulation methods.
He then conjured a spell, consecutively releasing eight streaks of red light onto the dragon heads, which absorbed the light, and then each dragon mouth opened slightly, spewing wrist-thick purple flames.
Instantly, the room’s air filled with burning heat, even Xu Ping felt a bit of the scorching sensation.
This left him secretly astonished.
Shortly thereafter, Xu Ping experimented with altering the thickness of the flames, as well as the height of the dragon head jets, until he could manipulate them with ease. Then he nodded:
"Now fully adept, I can attempt crafting with the First Rank demon beast."
Xu Ping retrieved a palm-sized silver cauldron from his storage ring, then performed a spell, causing the silver cauldron to expand to two yards, hovering in mid-air.
Since no materials had yet been added to the cauldron, Xu Ping controlled the Earth Fire, making it extremely fine, only as thick as a thread. Afterward, he let the silver cauldron slowly rotate in mid-air under the warming of eight fire lines.
After a quarter of an hour, the silver cauldron grew scorching hot, emitting an astonishing heat.
Seeing this, Xu Ping pointed at the cauldron, resulting in the lid flying up, revealing the mouth of the cauldron.
With a flip of his right hand, various materials were thrown into the silver cauldron in sequence.
Under Xu Ping’s control, the purple flames from the dragon heads gradually thickened, becoming finger-thick, while the silver cauldron’s rotation slowly decreased, starting to tremble slightly in the flames.
As time passed bit by bit, under the scorching heat, these materials slowly dissolved.
This step posed little challenge for Xu Ping, as he had alchemized far more difficult concoctions.
Seeing all materials liquefied, Xu Ping retrieved a wolf demon over a yard tall from the spirit beast bag, which was unconscious.
He then tossed the unconscious wolf demon directly into the silver cauldron.
"Sizzle!"
"Roar!"
The scorching hot liquid continually burned the demon beast’s body, emitting sizzling sounds. Intense pain awakened the wolf demon from unconsciousness, causing it to howl in anguish.
It tried to escape, but the burning liquid enveloping it and the intense pain had long drained away all its strength.
At this stage, refining success was yet distant, needing even fiercer Earth Fire to integrate these materials gradually into the wolf demon’s physique.
With this realization, the purple flames under Xu Ping’s control grew even more dazzling, reaching bowl-like thickness, enveloping the entire silver cauldron within them.

chapters.title: Chapter 115: Successful Refinement
chapters.content:
Chapter 115: Chapter 115: Successful Refinement
"Roar!"
Soon, under the continuous scorching of the high-temperature liquid, the Wolf Demon was almost burned into a piece of black charcoal, its life force weakening constantly, on the verge of death.
Xu Ping naturally wouldn’t let this happen. He took out a Jade Bottle and twisted off the cap, revealing a drop of green Spiritual Liquid inside.
"Go!"
Xu Ping flicked his finger, and the green Spiritual Liquid shot out from the Jade Bottle into the mouth of the Wolf Demon.
Gulp!
The Wolf Demon swallowed the green Spiritual Liquid, and its nearly depleted life force surged back, the sounds of its screams getting even louder.
After several repetitions, the Wolf Demon was tortured to the point of being unrecognizable, unable even to let out a scream.
"This method of refining is indeed cruel." Xu Ping frowned slightly.
Using demon beasts like this, he couldn’t imagine what the scene would be like if he used humans for refinement.
But he had no intention of stopping, after all, it was a demon beast.
Just as the Wolf Demon’s life force began to decline again, Xu Ping as usual prepared to instill it with green Spiritual Liquid.
But who would have thought.
The Wolf Demon’s life force declined too rapidly, disappearing in the blink of an eye, turning directly into a charred corpse.
"This..."
"Failed!"
Xu Ping was shocked, his face dark, "The life force declined too fast towards the end, there was no time to react, it seems I need to instill more green Spiritual Liquid in the beginning."
He stopped the Earth Fire and used a Cleaning Talisman to lower the temperature of the charred corpse and waste materials before storing them in a storage bag.
After completing all this, Xu Ping began a second refinement.
This time, he paid constant attention to the condition of the Demon Beast with his Divine Sense.
...
...
Three months later.
In the Earth Fire chamber, Xu Ping stared intently into the silver cauldron, at the Second-stage Rat Demon wrapped in high-temperature liquid.
He carefully controlled the Earth Fire, gradually refining various materials into its body.
As time passed, the high-temperature liquid in the cauldron decreased.
Crack!
At this moment, a piece of charcoal slid off the Rat Demon’s body, revealing skin covered in black scales.
At the final moment, Xu Ping dared not slack off.
He remained fully focused on controlling the Earth Fire while also flicking a drop of green Spirit Medicine into its mouth.
Crack, crack, crack...
More and more charcoal slid off the Second-stage Rat Demon, and at this moment, all the high-temperature liquid in the silver cauldron had been refined into its body.
Bang!
With a slight rumble, the charcoal on the Second-stage Rat Demon fell off. Its eyes suddenly opened, a ghostly light shining from its vertical pupils, a powerful aura emanating from its body, making it look like an armored demon god covered in black scales.
"Finally... it’s a success!" Xu Ping was overjoyed, the time and effort spent had finally paid off with a successful refinement.
He stopped the Earth Fire and, suppressing his excitement, retrieved a Spirit Talisman from his storage bag.
"Go!"
He threw it forcefully, attaching it directly to the forehead of the Second-stage Rat Demon, then pinched a Magic Technique, chanting.
Buzz!
At this moment, the Spirit Talisman on the Second-stage Rat Demon’s forehead started to emit a strong light, so bright it was hard to keep eyes open.
A moment later, the light began to dissipate, and the Spirit Talisman slowly merged into its forehead, finally disappearing.
Then he took out a Spirit Control Token and imprinted his Divine Sense onto it.
Mysteriously, Xu Ping established a connection with the Second-stage Rat Demon, gaining control over it.
"Move!"
Suppressing his excitement, Xu Ping controlled its actions.
The Rat Demon stood up, walking steadily like a human.
"Not bad."
Xu Ping was pleased, there was no problem with controlling it, and simple commands could be executed smoothly.
"Let’s test its defensive power next."
Xu Ping retrieved the Blood-Drinking Sword from the Storage Ring, injecting a trace of Mana to slash at the black scales of the Second-stage Rat Demon.
Clang!
With a harsh metallic clash, the Blood-Drinking Sword was bounced off.
Xu Ping’s eyes lit up as he increased the Mana.
Only after injecting nearly half of his Mana was he able to leave a white mark on the black scales of the Second-stage Rat Demon.
Xu Ping didn’t continue the experiment, satisfied with his understanding.
At least he would need to use nearly half his Mana to break through the Second-stage Rat Demon’s defenses.
Its defensive power wasn’t as good as the Bronze Corpse, but its strength wasn’t for direct confrontation.
Stealth and ambush were its true strengths.
"Finally, its ability to conceal Divine Sense."
The Earth Fire chamber was built with special ores, exceptionally sturdy, with an Array for protection, making Earth Escape difficult to perform, so it had to be outside.
Xu Ping left the Earth Fire chamber and arrived outside the Chen Clan territory.
"Hide!"
He commanded, and the Second-stage Rat Demon’s Demonic Power surged, instantly merging into the ground.
Xu Ping meticulously scanned with his Divine Sense but couldn’t detect the Second-stage Rat Demon at all.
If not for sensing the Rat Demon’s location in his heart, he probably wouldn’t have found it; it was quietly hiding a few yards underground just to his left.
"Not bad!"
Xu Ping was pleased, the Second-stage Rat Demon’s innate talent hadn’t diminished after refinement; even his Divine Sense, stronger than a Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator’s, couldn’t detect it, let alone an ordinary Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
Facing it head-on, with the Second-stage Demon Beast waiting to ambush, he might even be able to kill a Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator with his apparent strength.
"I wonder, can the Second-stage Rat Demon evade a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator’s Divine Sense?" Xu Ping suddenly pondered.
The Divine Sense range of a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator generally reached nearly a hundred yards, much stronger than Xu Ping’s current strength. It might discover the Second-stage Rat Demon’s concealment.
Of course, this was just speculation, since there was no Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator available for testing.
After a series of tests to familiarize himself with the Second-stage Rat Demon, he prepared to return to the Chen Clan territory.
Xu Ping’s brow suddenly twitched as he looked up to the sky.
In the distance, three Escape Lights were entangled in battle, heading north, directly towards the Chen Clan territory.
"This..."
Xu Ping frowned deeply; the auras of the three fighting reached Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment.
"Send the Rat Demon to check first."
Xu Ping’s expression was serious; three Mid-Stage cultivators likely couldn’t break the Second-stage Upper Grade Array, Water Shadow Curtain Array, without other means.
Yet it was enough to threaten him outside.
Although they appeared to be fighting each other, he naturally wouldn’t risk himself.
Under Xu Ping’s control, the Rat Demon proceeded swiftly, soon reaching the Chen Clan territory.
Through the Rat Demon’s eyes, he ’saw’ two auras of spiritual light besieging a third, while the Water Shadow Curtain Array of the Chen Clan territory was fully activated.
The originally nearly invisible transparent ripples now glowed brightly, looking like countless rivers flowing.
Inside the Water Shadow Curtain Array, Chen Li watched the battle outside nervously, only relaxing when the besieged Foundation Establishment cultivator was killed, and the other two left.
Still, he remained vigilant, keeping the Water Shadow Curtain Array fully activated.

chapters.title: Chapter 116: Extermination of the Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 116: Chapter 116: Extermination of the Clan
"What’s going on? Who are these three Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators?" Xu Ping frowned, his heart filled with waves of doubt.
A Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator is considered a high-ranking figure even within Golden Core forces. Yet within this Qiu Xuan Mountain, there are only eight Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators in total.
Now, suddenly, three appeared at once, and one of them is already dead. If this happened within a Golden Core force, it would definitely be a major event.
"Once I return to the Chen clan’s territory, I must ask Chen Li." However, Xu Ping didn’t plan to return immediately, as it was unknown if the two Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators were still lurking nearby, waiting for the right moment to act.
He found a hidden spot and commanded the Rat Demon to search around the vicinity of the Chen clan’s territory.
After several meticulous rounds of searching and not discovering those two unfamiliar Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators, Xu Ping finally relaxed a bit.
"It’s time to head back." Xu Ping stood up and used his Escape Light to hasten towards the Chen clan’s territory.
...
...
Chen clan’s territory.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, it’s good that you’re safe." Chen Li felt a sense of relief seeing Xu Ping return unharmed.
Although Xu Ping was powerful, encountering two Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators would make survival chances incredibly slim.
"Thank you for your concern, Fellow Daoist Chen. I was about to return to your esteemed clan when I noticed three Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators fighting outside the array, so I found a spot to hide, only daring to come back now." Xu Ping said with a bitter smile.
"A wise decision," Chen Li nodded in approval.
"Fellow Daoist Chen, do you recognize those three Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators fighting?" Xu Ping asked.
Chen Li let out a long sigh, "Alas, I don’t recognize the other two Foundation Establishment cultivators, but the one who was slain, I know—it’s the Clan Leader of the Li family, Li Mingqing!"
"He was fleeing towards us, hoping I’d open the array to let him in. But the situation was unclear, and of course, I couldn’t gamble the entire clan’s lives." Chen Li’s voice was tinged with helplessness.
"Fellow Daoist Chen’s actions were correct. No one could open the array to let him in under such circumstances," Xu Ping agreed with this approach.
"Looking across the entire Yue Country, there aren’t many forces that could command more than two Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators. Who could it possibly be? Could it be that the Li family offended them?" Xu Ping asked, frowning.
Hearing this, Chen Li fell into silence.
The forces capable of deploying more than two Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators are practically limited to major Golden Core forces and Nascent Soul sects. Even the eight great families find it challenging, possibly only the strongest one or two families have this capability.
After pondering for a bit, he shook his head, "The Li family has always been law-abiding, and I’ve never heard of them offending any of Yue Country’s top forces."
"Then who could it be?" Xu Ping’s frown deepened, his heart uneasy.
Not knowing who is responsible also means not knowing their purpose in killing the Li Clan Leader, implying that the entire Chen clan, including Xu Ping, might be targeted.
After pondering for a moment, the two still had no clues and could only temporarily give up.
"Fellow Daoist Chen, for now, keep the array fully operational. I will soon notify Qiu Xuan Mountain about this incident." After a while, Xu Ping finally spoke.
The Li family is also a Foundation Establishment family within the influence of Qiu Xuan Mountain. Naturally, they need to inform Qiu Xuan Mountain about the killing of their clan leader to see if Qiu Xuan Mountain has any clues or if they will send someone to investigate.
But Xu Ping knew in his heart that, with Qiu Xuan Mountain’s entire attention preoccupied by the beast tide, they likely wouldn’t pay much attention to this matter.
"Understood," Chen Li nodded, "In a few days, I’ll send someone to the Li clan territory to check the situation."
Given that the Li Clan Leader was killed, the fate of the Li clan members probably wouldn’t be much better.
The two talked a little more, filled with worries, and then bid each other farewell.
...
Residence.
Xu Ping took out the Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman given to him by Hongyi, injected a trace of mana, and then performed a magic technique.
Instantly, the Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman flickered with spiritual light.
Xu Ping held the Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman and, with as few words as possible, reported the matter to Hongyi.
Having finished all this, he began to quietly wait for a reply.
Just thinking about the Li Clan Leader being killed made him worry again.
With the beast tide about to strike, now two Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators have appeared out of nowhere and killed the Li Clan Leader.
If it were just a vendetta, that would be one thing, but if there’s another purpose, things could get troublesome.
Moreover, the force that can dispatch two Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators at once, if they have their eyes on the Chen clan and himself, the Water Shadow Curtain Array might not be enough to withstand them.
It’s even possible that a Fake Pill master might come next time, in which case, no matter how strong he is, he would surely not be able to handle it.
"Alas, it’s a troubled time," Xu Ping sighed helplessly.
With the beast tide approaching, the dominion of Qiu Xuan Mountain over the surrounding area visibly diminishing, all sorts of demons and monsters are surfacing.
Previously, there were scarcely any in the entire Yue Country who dared to ruffle Qiu Xuan Mountain’s feathers.
After all, with the cultivation of Qiu Xuan Mountain’s ancestor at the Middle Stage of Golden Core, only a Nascent Soul sect, Luoyun Sect, could make him bow his proud head.
...
Half a month later.
Chen Li visited Xu Ping and brought bad news.
"All the members of the Li family have disappeared, most likely they have been slaughtered entirely."
"Slaughtered entirely?"
Xu Ping’s expression suddenly became serious, alarm bells ringing in his heart. Is this extermination, or is there something else hidden?
"What did the Sect Leader senior brother say after Fellow Daoist Xu notified Qiu Xuan Mountain?" Chen Li looked at Xu Ping with high hopes.
Annihilation!
And to annihilate a Foundation Establishment family, in the past, this would have been a major event. Even though the beast tide is now striking, perhaps Qiu Xuan Mountain should still send several Foundation Establishment cultivators to investigate.
However, Xu Ping’s response disappointed him.
"The Sect Leader just said one thing: be careful and stay inside the array for now." Xu Ping smiled bitterly.
A few days ago, Hongyi’s reply arrived, and indeed, as he had guessed, they currently don’t have the energy to handle these matters. Overcoming the beast tide is the primary task now.
Hearing these words, Chen Li’s eyes flashed with a hint of disappointment, and he couldn’t help but sigh: "Alas, it seems Qiu Xuan Mountain’s energy is also completely entangled by the beast tide, truly powerless."
"Your clan has the Water Shadow Curtain Array for protection, even another Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator could not break it." Xu Ping reassured.
"That’s true." Chen Li nodded, "But recently, make sure to restrict the clan members; don’t go out for unnecessary matters."
...
...
Ever since the Li family was confirmed to be exterminated, the Chen clan’s territory has been on lockdown, with all entry and exit restricted.
Xu Ping also stopped going out, quietly cultivating at home.
Over half a month later.
Within a grove of the Chen clan’s territory, a light of escape flashed rapidly through the trees.
Suddenly!
His figure accelerated sharply, seemingly tearing through the constraints of time and space, disappearing in an instant and reappearing at the edge of the trees.
"This speed... the Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill has broken through!" Xu Ping’s eyes shone with excitement, eagerly opening the panel.
[Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill Mastery: 1/1600]
"It really reached mastery!"
Looking at the displayed data on the panel, Xu Ping beamed with joy. After years of effort, the Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill had finally reached mastery, just one step away from perfection.
In high spirits, Xu Ping urgently wanted to try again.
With a thought, his entire being transformed into a beam of light, disappearing instantly, in a split second already dozens of feet away.
"This speed..." Observing the distance he traversed instantly, Xu Ping grew more excited, "It’s probably faster than even a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator’s escape technique!"
With his mastered Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill, if he chose to flee, most Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators wouldn’t be able to catch up to him.
This certainly greatly enhanced his survival abilities.
"If the Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill achieves perfection, a Golden Core cultivator might chase me, but a Fake Pill likely can’t catch up!"
In the whole of Yue Country, those with Golden Core cultivation are not many.
"At the current pace, soon! I should be able to break through in a few years!" Xu Ping’s eyes sparkled with excitement.
At this moment.
The long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman in Xu Ping’s chest suddenly began flashing.
"Fellow Daoist Hong has sent news!" His expression changed, quickly taking out the Sound Transmission Talisman and invading it with his Divine Sense.
After a while.
Having read all the information, Xu Ping’s expression shifted unpredictably.
The Sound Transmission Talisman contained two messages.
First, the reinforcements from other sects have finally arrived.
Second, he should quickly return to Qiu Xuan Mountain, as others will be sent to the Chen clan’s territory.
Xu Ping didn’t know whether to be happy or sad at the moment.
It’s worth rejoicing that reinforcements from other sects have finally arrived.
But being asked to return to Qiu Xuan Mountain, he wasn’t sure whether to be happy or sad.
Although returning would relieve him of threats from the mysterious force, facing the beast tide at Qiu Xuan Mountain is evidently not very safe.
But with the beast tide now upon them, unless he defects and goes deeper into Yue Country, nowhere is safe.
Yet, with other sects coming to aid, even the Nascent Soul sect Luoyun Sect is here, and he chooses to defect and leave.
It’s clear he would be wanted by all the major sects.
"It’s not time to run yet." Xu Ping shook his head.
Qiu Xuan Mountain has overcome many beast tides, and now others are supporting them, clearly there’s a good chance of peacefully overcoming the beast tide.
Unless Qiu Xuan Mountain becomes extremely dangerous, defecting is justified.
At that time, even if he can’t stay in Yue Country, with his cultivation, escaping to another country is just the same.
"I should inform Chen Li first." Xu Ping thought inwardly.
After all, he was leaving, a word of notification was necessary, and another Foundation Establishment cultivator was to replace him, this matter involved Chen Li.
....
"What!"
"Fellow Daoist Xu is leaving, and another Foundation Establishment cultivator will replace you." Chen Li looked at Xu Ping in shock.
"Yes." Xu Ping nodded, "The Sect Leader has already notified me through a long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman, urging me to return soon."
"Moreover, reinforcements from other sects have arrived." He finally added.
Upon hearing this, Chen Li’s eyes showed a hint of joy: "Those guys have finally come!"
But when he thought about Xu Ping leaving, he felt bouts of regret.
After all, Xu Ping’s strength is formidable, and being an alchemist, the replacement couldn’t compare to Xu Ping.

chapters.title: Chapter 117: Encountering Zhang Changqing Again
chapters.content:
Chapter 117: Chapter 117: Encountering Zhang Changqing Again
"When are you leaving, Fellow Daoist?" Chen Li inquired.
"Immediately, to avoid unnecessary complications," Xu Ping answered.
"It’s a pity that you’ve been at my clan’s land for so long, Fellow Daoist Xu, and we haven’t had a chance to properly host you. After the beast tide passes, we’ll definitely have a proper welcoming," Chen Li said with a smile.
"You’re too kind, Fellow Daoist. I’ve been here for so long, I hope I haven’t been a bother," Xu Ping humbly responded with clasped hands.
"No need for such courtesy between us," Chen Li laughed.
"Indeed, then I shall take my leave."
"Take care."
As Chen Li and the members of the Chen clan watched, Xu Ping and several Qi Cultivation disciples from Qiu Xuan Mountain boarded the flying boat, heading north.
...
...
Several days later.
The sun shone brightly, the sky was washed clear, its brilliance entrancing to behold.
A spiritual boat sliced through the low clouds, leaving ripples in the sky.
At the stern of the spiritual boat, Xu Ping sat cross-legged, eyes closed, resting his mind, while several disciples from Qiu Xuan Mountain continued to skillfully maneuver the spiritual boat at the front.
"Demon beasts are becoming more numerous. We’ve encountered several waves in the past few days. Fortunately, we haven’t come across any Second-stage Demon Beasts, or else we might have perished," one person remarked nervously, still shaken from a recent demon beast attack.
Suddenly!
Chirping... Chirping...
A cacophony of bird calls reached everyone’s ears. Xu Ping abruptly opened his eyes, looking in the direction of the sound.
A dense swarm of flying demon beasts could be seen flapping their wings in the distance, emitting piercing cries.
"Elder Xu!" the Qi Cultivation disciples’ faces instantly turned pale.
Encountering so many flying demon beasts, Xu Ping’s survival was uncertain, but they definitely wouldn’t survive.
"Step aside, I’ll take control of the spiritual boat," Xu Ping said, his expression darkening.
These were all First Rank demon beasts, not a threat to him, but once entangled, they could become troublesome. Who knows what other beasts might be drawn in if delayed too long?
If the spiritual boat couldn’t outrun them, he would have to abandon these juniors and escape on his own.
As Xu Ping considered whether to abandon them, ten or so spiritual boats suddenly emerged, charging at the flying demon beasts.
The cultivators on the boats attacked in unison, casting various magical artifacts at the flying beasts, especially the two Foundation Establishment cultivators; they mercilessly slaughtered a large area of beasts after joining the fray.
Amid the chaos, the screeching cries of various demon beasts echoed nonstop.
In no time, all the flying demon beasts were exterminated.
"What’s this?"
Xu Ping was bewildered, suspecting these people were not from Qiu Xuan Mountain.
"Could they be cultivators from other sects?" he speculated internally.
The cultivators, having dispensed with the flying demon beasts, noticed Xu Ping’s spiritual boat and approached them.
"They should be allies, not foes," Xu Ping thought to himself.
Being so close to Qiu Xuan Immortal City, a large-scale team of cultivators here was likely dispatched by the city to eliminate nearby demon beasts.
So he waited quietly in place.
As the spiritual boats drew nearer, Xu Ping spotted a familiar face on one of them he hadn’t seen for some time—Zhang Changqing.
Now, he was a Foundation Establishment cultivator.
"How can it be him?" Xu Ping’s heart tightened as he discreetly operated the Bone Shaping Skill to conceal his aura.
Though Zhang Changqing had never seen his true face, he wasn’t a simple character; even the slightest clue could spell disaster.
"Who are you, Fellow Daoist? Why are you near the Immortal City?" Zhang Changqing stood at the ship’s bow emblazoned with a tiger’s head design, shouting out to them from a safe distance.
"I am Xu Ping, Guest Minister of Qiu Xuan Mountain, returning after completing a mission," Xu Ping responded loudly.
On hearing that, Zhang Changqing’s expression softened, "What evidence do you have?"
"Here is my Identity Jade," Xu Ping extracted a jade token from his storage pouch and flicked it towards Zhang Changqing.
Zhang Changqing caught it with Mana, examining it closely before nodding, "It is indeed the identity token of a Guest Minister from Qiu Xuan Mountain."
"Just fulfilling my duty, I hope Fellow Daoist Xu can understand," Zhang Changqing and the other Foundation Establishment cultivator flew over using their Escape Light, returned the token, and clasped their hands in courtesy.
"Fellow Daoist’s diligence is indeed a blessing for Qiu Xuan Mountain," Xu Ping accepted the token with a smile, feeling relieved inside.
It appeared they hadn’t recognized him.
"May I know who you two fellow Daoists are?" Xu Ping inquired, clasping his hands.
"I am Zhang Changqing from the Longevity Sect."
"I am Lu Yanfeng from the Purple Cloud Sect."
The two introduced themselves.
"Fellow Daoists Zhang and Lu, I must return to Qiu Xuan Mountain to report, so I’ll take my leave," Xu Ping clasped his hands.
"Safe travels, Fellow Daoist; most nearby demon beasts have been cleared by us," Zhang Changqing said.
"Thank you," Xu Ping expressed his gratitude before instructing the disciples from Qiu Xuan Mountain to set off again.
...
The spiritual boat gradually flew into the distance, becoming a tiny black dot before completely disappearing at the horizon.
"What a coincidence to encounter Zhang Changqing here, he seems to be sent as reinforcements by the Longevity Sect," Xu Ping gazed into the distance, his mind gradually calming.
"But he should still be a newly advanced Foundation Establishment cultivator, so why would the Longevity Sect send him?" Xu Ping wondered internally.
Anyone who advanced within the last twenty years was considered newly advanced in the Foundation Establishment stage.
"Never mind, it’s their business anyway, but having such a familiar face around Qiu Xuan Mountain means I must be careful not to reveal myself," Xu Ping thought to himself.
Meanwhile.
Since Xu Ping left, Zhang Changqing’s brow slightly furrowed, as if he were contemplating something.
"Is there an issue with that person’s identity, Fellow Daoist Zhang?" Seeing his expression, Lu Yanfeng inquired.
"No, I’m just wondering when this beast tide will finally break out," Zhang Changqing relaxed his brows and smiled.
"Soon, judging by the intense aura of demon beasts in the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range, it could be a matter of months," Lu Yanfeng replied.
"Fellow Daoist seems quite experienced," Zhang Changqing chuckled.
"It’s just some useless experience,"
Lu Yanfeng waved his hand, "We ought to clear out the remaining nearby demon beasts, so when the beast tide breaks out, the pressure will be lesser."
"Alright," Zhang Changqing nodded in agreement.
...
...
Several days later.
At the top of Qiu Xuan Mountain, inside a grand hall.
"Fellow Daoist Xu is finally back safely," Hongyi said with a smile.
As other sects had arrived, his burden seemed lighter, and his complexion improved.
"Thank you for your concern, Fellow Daoist Hong. I am well," Xu Ping replied with clasped hands.
After they exchanged pleasantries, Hongyi got to the main topic:
"The beast tide will break out within a few months; initially, Fellow Daoist Xu won’t need to be on the battlefield. You can focus on refining pills in the rear. However, if the situation becomes dire, your assistance will still be required."
"As a member of Qiu Xuan Mountain, I am obligated to serve," Xu Ping earnestly replied.
Following that, Hongyi inquired about the matter of the Li clan’s extermination.
While Xu Ping had reported via long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman, the details were unclear.

chapters.title: Chapter 118: The Outbreak of the Beast Horde
chapters.content:
Chapter 118: Chapter 118: The Outbreak of the Beast Horde
Xu Ping recounted the events in detail, only concealing the matter of the Rat Demon.
Listening to Xu Ping’s narration, Hongyi frowned deeply. After pondering for a moment, he began:
"I don’t specifically know which faction is responsible, but there are only a few with the capability to act in the entirety of Yue Country. They definitely know that our Qiu Xuan Mountain’s focus is entirely diverted by the beast tide, that’s why they dared to deliver such a vicious blow."
"This matter won’t be left unsettled. Once our Qiu Xuan Mountain endures the beast tide, we will certainly investigate thoroughly who did it, and make them pay." Hongyi said solemnly.
"Indeed, that’s how it should be." Xu Ping feigned agreement with a word.
