He knew this was just the other’s way of speaking for show; once the beast tide is safely passed, Qiu Xuan Mountain would have suffered significant losses, and they wouldn’t have the energy to investigate this matter.
Moreover, so much time has already passed, what could still be discovered?
After exchanging a few more words, Xu Ping then took his leave.
...
Cave mansion, little courtyard.
Though he hadn’t returned for several months, everything in the surroundings still seemed so familiar.
Xu Ping sat on a stone bench in the small courtyard, silently pondering the matter of the beast tide.
With the size of Qiu Xuan Mountain and the assistance of the other sects, it wouldn’t be broken in the short term.
And his Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill would need at least a few years to reach perfection.
Once perfected, even if Qiu Xuan Mountain were indeed broken, he’d have a seventy to eighty percent chance of escaping, unless incredibly unlucky to be targeted by a Third-stage Demon Beast.
But the odds of that were vanishingly small.
"Hopefully, the beast tide can be safely endured." Xu Ping sighed.
To be honest, Qiu Xuan Mountain is considered a top cultivation place in Yue Country; finding another place like it would not be easy.
...
After returning to Qiu Xuan Mountain, Xu Ping hadn’t enjoyed his leisure for long before being assigned numerous alchemy tasks.
For healing, mana recovery, detoxification... various pills, they were all available.
To other alchemists, it would seem a terrifying workload, but for Xu Ping, it was quite leisurely.
Every day, there was still time for cultivation, and he could conveniently reap some benefits.
This life was much better compared to other Foundation Establishment cultivators who were given busy and dangerous assignments.
Two months later.
On this day, he completed his routine alchemy tasks.
Exiting the cave mansion.
As usual, he looked towards the north.
Vaguely sensing the invisible evil demon wind, pouring out from the ancient mountain range to the north.
"Is this... the beast tide coming?" Xu Ping became serious.
He went to a high place and looked towards the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range, seeing a black "wave" sweeping towards Qiu Xuan Immortal City.
It was an army composed of countless various demon beasts!
Land-walking demon beasts, avian demon beasts... Normally mutually hostile and even murderous demon beasts were now cooperating, jointly launching an assault on the city of cultivators.
Ten days ago, Qiu Xuan Mountain had issued a warning to loose cultivators in the Immortal City, advising against going out due to the beast tide’s approach.
Now, there weren’t any stationary cultivators outside the Immortal City, as no one would joke with their own lives.
"Fire Scale Wolves? So many Fire Scale Wolves!"
"And avians... so many Gale Falcons..."
...
Many cultivators recognized the types of demon beasts in the beast tide, their expressions exceedingly solemn.
At this time, the cloud-like demon birds dispersed, revealing a giant roc with wings spanning over ten zhang.
Its feathers shimmered with thunderous light, with a tuft of golden feathers on its head resembling a crown.
"Third-stage Demon King—Great Winged Thunder Roc!"
Then, a tiger’s roar emanated from the group of demon beasts.
"Ow!"
The innumerable demon beasts that had been charging forward scattered fearfully to both sides, revealing a gigantic tiger demon nearly ten zhang tall.
Its whole body was covered in pure white fur, with a large "King" character atop its head.
"Third-stage Demon King—White Spirit Tiger King!"
The next moment.
Boom!
Accompanied by the shaking of the earth, a several-zhang tall, brown Rat Demon with huge fangs drilled out from underground.
"Third-stage Demon King—Leaping Sky Rat!"
Countless people cried out in shock and terror.
"This Demon King naturally excels at manipulating earth element power, it’s a great foe for city defense..."
Three Demon Kings appearing at once, and one of them is even a earth-element Demon King, can this Qiu Xuan Immortal City... hold its ground?
"Hmph!"
At this moment, accompanied by a cold snort, two waves of Golden Core pressure swept across the entire Immortal City. Following that, two escape lights flew towards the outer city, standing in the void before the array.
"Qiu Xuan Patriarch, Zihuan Master!" Xu Ping muttered to himself, uttering their identities.
Qiu Xuan Patriarch, a Middle Stage Golden Core cultivator, single-handedly founded Qiu Xuan Immortal City.
Zihuan Master, similarly a Middle Stage Golden Core cultivator, is an elder of the Luoyun Sect.
The two have illustrious reputations throughout Yue Country.
Though only two figures stood alone in the void, they brought immense safety to everyone in the entire Immortal City.
"Bring the thunder!"
Only hearing a low shout from Qiu Xuan Patriarch.
Boom!
Boom!
On the walls, crimson lightning flashed, effortlessly sweeping across the beast horde.
Wherever the flames and thunder passed, even the Second-stage Demon Beasts could only scream and turn into charred corpses.
"Oh my god!!"
"What... kind of Thunder Skill is this!!"
"How can its power be so strong!!!"
...
Countless Loose Cultivators were deeply shocked by this Thunder Power.
"Geng Metal Divine Thunder?"
Xu Ping looked at those red lightning bolts with a solemn expression.
In terms of destructive power, Bing Fire Divine Thunder was much stronger than Five Element Magic.
Moreover, how could there be just one Divine Thunder emitted from the city wall at this moment?
It was simply hundreds of thunders striking at once!
Even the three Demon Kings had no plans to recklessly take this wave of bombardment head-on.
Thump! Thump!
At this moment, the bell rang loudly.
Hongyi, clad in a purple robe, brought dozens of Foundation Establishment Cultivators to the city wall.
Xu Zhixuan, looking into the distance, had a grave expression.
Zhang Changqing seemed a bit eager to try.
Meanwhile, Jiang Tian’s eyes flickered, his thoughts unknown.
"The beast tide is approaching, Qiu Xuan Immortal City is under martial law, but please be assured, fellow Daoists, resisting the beast tide is a matter for the entire Yue Country. Various Golden Core sects, and even the Luoyun Sect have sent people to support us. Qiu Xuan Immortal City has the ability to ensure everyone’s safety..."
Hongyi’s smile was calm, seeming not to feel any tension, and this emotion immediately spread, allowing lower-level cultivators to breathe a sigh of relief.
After all, this was the cooperation of all major forces in Yue Country. Although it couldn’t be said to be exhaustive, at least they were paying attention.
Moreover, historically, Qiu Xuan Immortal City had been through several beast tides without ever being breached.
"Furthermore, our Qiu Xuan Immortal City recruits Loose Cultivators to join the city’s defense efforts. Early-stage Qi Refinement cultivators can earn one battle merit in seven days, mid-stage three battle merits, late-stage six battle merits... If you are a Foundation Establishment Cultivator, you can discuss it with me in detail!"
"After daily settlement, battle merits can be exchanged in this city for Spirit Stones, Magical Artifacts, Cultivation Techniques, Spirit Pills, Secret Techniques... the list is here!"
Hongyi tossed out a list, as Mana surged, a massive list, measuring dozens of feet in both length and width, floated in the air.
On it, line by line, were various rare resources and the requirements for exchanging battle merits, enough to drive any cultivator mad.
"One battle merit can be exchanged for a Lower Grade Spirit Stone..."
"And Magical Artifacts... there are even top-grade Magical Artifacts..."
"These are nothing, look... there’s even a Foundation Establishment Pill for exchange, twenty thousand battle merits for one Foundation Establishment Pill!"
"Not to mention, during the campaign, the materials of the Demon Beasts you kill are yours to keep."
Countless Loose Cultivators went crazy.
As the saying goes, under great rewards, there are always brave warriors.
Loose Cultivators are by nature the lowest level in the Cultivation Realm, and they wouldn’t easily give up any chance to change their fate, even if it meant taking enormous risks.
...
In the midst of the bustling chaos.
Xu Ping returned to his cave abode.
"I’m still a bit too weak now." Sitting on the chair, he sighed slightly.
The outbreak of the beast tide and the pressure from Golden Core Masters were constant reminders of his weakness.
"The progress of the Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill is still slow. I must devote all my energy to it and strive to reach Perfection as soon as possible," Xu Ping thought to himself.
The pressure the beast tide brought him was truly immense.
...
In the blink of an eye, months passed.
It could be said that the cultivators had very much adapted to the atmosphere of war.
With the protection of a Third-stage Array, no Demon Beast could break through the layers of formations and walls to enter the city and kill.
In the first few months, the interior of Qiu Xuan Immortal City was actually fairly calm, and the prices of various Demon Beast materials plummeted.
Xu Ping’s alchemy tasks were heavier than before.
But he still didn’t feel strained, and he still had plenty of free time for cultivation each day.
To understand the current situation, he would also send Rat Demons out for reconnaissance to keep abreast of the beast tide’s movements.
Of course, to avoid being discovered, the Rat Demons never approached Late-Stage Foundation Establishment Cultivators, always observing from afar.
...
That day.
In the courtyard of the cave abode.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, you seem to be quite at leisure! Unlike me, fighting Demon Beasts day in and day out, with few chances to rest." Xu Zhixuan looked at Xu Ping sitting opposite him with envy.
"I’m not at leisure, busy with alchemy to the point of death, and barely managing to rest for a while, just don’t have to fight." Xu Ping said with a wry smile.
"True, and the other two Second-stage Alchemists are said to be working tirelessly to barely complete the tasks. I heard one Alchemist even blew up his Pill Furnace." Xu Zhixuan laughed.
"Saying it with schadenfreude isn’t right."
After a few casual words, they turned to serious matters.
"In recent times, the battle has gone quite smoothly. Just the slain Second-stage Great Demons number over fifty, and among the Foundation Establishment fellows, only three were seriously injured... none had fallen...
"In reality, no matter how many Demon Beasts die, it’s good news for the Third-stage Demon Kings... The essence of the beast tide is that there are too many types of Demon Beasts with strong reproductive power, which the interior of the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range cannot bear.
"The higher-ranking Demon Beasts drive out some lower-level Demon Beast tribes from the inside out."
Xu Ping sighed.
The driven-out Demon Beast groups, due to their instincts for cultivation, would prioritize attacking the Spirit Vein areas of human territories.
During the beast tide, high-level Demon Beasts would control things secretly, attempting to seize the opportunity to expand their territories.
Thousands of years ago, when the Demon Race was strong, most of the Yue Country was overrun, becoming the territory of Demon Beasts.
This is why, when a beast tide occurs, other Golden Core forces have no choice but to provide support.
They don’t want to repeat the catastrophic scenario from thousands of years ago.

chapters.title: Chapter 119: Onto the Battlefield
chapters.content:
Chapter 119: Chapter 119: Onto the Battlefield
"It’s said that today, another cultivator has obtained a second-stage demon core..."
Xu Zhixuan suddenly changed the topic: "I also slew several second-stage demon beasts. It’s a pity..."
Xu Ping was just about to comfort him, after all, second-stage demon beasts that can nurture demon cores are quite rare, even second-stage middle grade demon beasts may not have them.
Then he heard Xu Zhixuan change his tone, smugly saying, "It’s a pity that only today did I manage to luckily acquire one."
Xu Ping was speechless in his heart.
What can he say, Xu Zhixuan rarely took a day off and came to him, only to show off.
However, obtaining a demon core this time is indeed a big windfall for him.
It should at least be worth several thousand spirit stones.
"Congratulations, Fellow Daoist!" Xu Ping also congratulated him.
"Just lucky!" Xu Zhixuan laughed heartily.
After a few more casual words, Xu Zhixuan took his leave.
...
In the days that followed.
Xu Ping returned to his daily alchemy and cultivation.
However, the situation in the Immortal City gradually became tense, as three third-rank demon kings were entangled by Qiu Xuan Patriarch and Zihuan Master, unable to approach the third-rank array.
Yet recently, more than a dozen Earth-shaking Turtles suddenly appeared from somewhere.
This kind of demon beast could shake the terrain and posed a significant threat to the mountain-protecting array that uses the spirit vein as its source.
Although these dozen or so weren’t enough to threaten the third-rank array, they could weaken it to some extent, and with the countless demon beasts attacking, they increased the pressure on the city’s cultivators.
The city’s cultivators also tried to behead them.
However, these Earth-shaking Turtles had strong defenses and were exceptionally slippery, burrowing into the ground and fleeing at the slightest sign of trouble.
It was truly infuriating.
"If the situation continues to be so tense, I’m afraid I will have to join the battlefield." Seeing the horrific battlefield through the Rat Demon, Xu Ping couldn’t help but sigh inwardly.
This beast tide is so fierce, one wonders if Qiu Xuan Immortal City can withstand it!
When night finally fell, and the demon beasts’ attack subsided considerably, Xu Ping manipulated the Rat Demon to return.
To avoid being detected, he chose secluded paths, avoiding crowds.
Sneaking to a remote place.
Through the Rat Demon, Xu Ping spotted a suspicious silhouette dodging the crowd, heading towards the outer city.
"Is that... Jiang Tian?"
Recognizing the figure, Xu Ping was momentarily stunned, then furrowed his brows deeply, "What is he planning to do?"
Over the years, although Jiang Tian had been honest in Qiu Xuan Mountain, Xu Ping had not forgotten that he had gone through great lengths to infiltrate it, which could not have been for a simple reason.
Now that the beast tide had arrived, and he was acting so furtively, he probably wasn’t up to anything good.
Considering this, Xu Ping controlled the Rat Demon to follow from afar.
After winding through several turns, Jiang Tian entered a deserted alley, changed his appearance, and quietly made his way to a house covered in an array in the outer city.
"What is this array?"
Xu Ping frowned, through the Rat Demon’s sight, intently watching the gleaming array.
Although it was only a first-rank upper grade array, this was but a disguise.
Within the first-rank upper grade array, there was also a second-rank array laid out.
Despite Xu Ping’s knowledge of arrays, he still couldn’t determine what array it was.
Therefore, he didn’t dare to rashly let the Rat Demon enter and could only wait quietly outside.
Jiang Tian didn’t stay there long, only about half a cup of tea’s time, before he left alone and returned to Qiu Xuan Mountain.
"What did he do in that room?"
"An acquaintance? Or an accomplice?"
Xu Ping pondered deeply, continuously thinking.
Unfortunately, there were too few clues, and he couldn’t deduce anything.
Yet a sense of unease lingered in his heart, as if Jiang Tian was plotting something.
If it were before, it wouldn’t be an issue, even if the other party was plotting something big, he was confident in escaping.
But now with the beast tide attacking, the situation was entirely different; any carelessness could lead to death.
"It seems I have to keep an eye on not only the beast tide but also Jiang Tian and that house." Xu Ping thought to himself.
"The beast tide, Jiang Tian, the exterminated Li Clan, and finally... the solitary man from Yellow Dragon Mountain Range!"
Xu Ping whispered, his mind in chaos, realizing that despite his current cultivation and combat strength, he felt no sense of safety.
"Alas."
In the end, he could only let out a long sigh, looking helpless, "I wonder if deciding to join Qiu Xuan Mountain was the right choice back then."
...
In the days that followed.
Xu Ping kept a close watch on Jiang Tian’s movements and the comings and goings from that house.
However, to his disappointment, Jiang Tian seemed exceptionally well-behaved, and that house appeared deserted with no activity.
Worse still, the beast tide’s situation became increasingly tense, with defense forces stretched thin.
His prediction turned true, as Qiu Xuan Mountain ordered him to the battlefield.
"Recently, the situation has been tense, and there’s a shortage of defense forces in the Immortal City. Fellow Daoist Xu, we need you to help out," Hongyi said.
"As a member of Qiu Xuan Mountain, I naturally cannot refuse," Xu Ping had no reason to decline.
Not only him, but even other Pill Masters had to join the battlefield, with the city almost forcibly requiring Qi cultivators above the late stage to take positions on the walls to combat the demon beasts.
"Fellow Daoist, don’t worry too much. I know you broke through to Foundation Establishment only a few years ago, so we’ve arranged for you to guard the less pressured south gate," Hongyi reassured.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Hong, for thinking of me." Xu Ping cupped his hands in gratitude.
He felt slightly relieved, as the south gate was at the rear of Qiu Xuan Immortal City, sparing him from facing third-rank demon kings directly. As long as there were no third-rank demon kings and there was a third-rank array protecting him, with his current strength, he should be able to ensure his own safety.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, being a member of Qiu Xuan Mountain and a Pill Master, I naturally have to consider your needs," Hongyi smiled.
...
With the Immortal City in dire need of manpower, Xu Ping was notified to guard the south gate in the morning and stationed there in the afternoon.
On the city wall, countless Qi cultivators formed ten large groups, under the coordinated command of a Qiu Xuan Mountain disciple, using long-range attack magic against the demon beasts below the city.
One Qi cultivating magic was not much, but hundreds or thousands gathered together could unleash tremendous destructive power.
Bang!
Countless demon beasts were instantaneously turned to ash under the barrage of magic.
Meanwhile, Foundation Establishment cultivators fought independently, constantly using large-scale attack magic, killing large swaths of demon beasts with each strike.
"It seems Qiu Xuan Mountain has ample experience dealing with beast tides," Xu Ping thought, nodding to himself.
His gaze continuously scanned the Foundation Establishment cultivators guarding the south gate.
Suddenly, his eyes focused, and his expression changed slightly.
Among the many Foundation Establishment cultivators at the south gate, he actually saw a person he least wanted to encounter—Jiang Tian.
"Trouble, why is he here too?" Xu Ping’s heart sank.
With him here, the south gate might be more dangerous than other places. Who knows what kind of trouble he might stir up?
"Come here, Fellow Daoist Xu," Xu Zhixuan waved to Xu Ping, who was also stationed at the south gate.
"Fellow Daoist Xu," Xu Ping cupped his hands.
"As you’re new here, you should stick with me; with the third-rank array protecting us, these demon beasts pose no threat," Xu Zhixuan said.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Xu," Xu Ping expressed his gratitude.

chapters.title: Chapter 123: Slaying Jiang Tian
chapters.content:
Chapter 123: Chapter 123: Slaying Jiang Tian
Thanks to Hongyi’s explosive power, the Immortal City managed to hold its ground today.
By nightfall, the south district of the outer city was in ruins, with occasional First Rank Demon Beasts appearing, keeping the Qi Cultivation disciples of Qiu Xuan Mountain busy.
The loose cultivators also suffered heavy casualties, some dying to demon beasts, others in the chaos—after all, once the Immortal City descends into chaos, those originally submissive loose cultivators could easily turn into robbers!
Corpses of cultivators were cleared out, unexpectedly filling up nearly half of the square, covered with white cloth, underneath which blood continued to seep and drip.
Cries could be heard from every surviving household.
Qi Cultivation disciples of the outer city were busy capturing demon beasts and robbers, while array masters worked hard to repair the city walls and arrays.
However, with Hongyi, a cultivator possessing Fake Pill combat strength, the defending cultivators were full of vigor and confidence.
Three Third-rank Demon Kings were entangled by two Golden Core masters, unable to break free.
That Fake Pill combat strength was invincible in the entire beast tide, and with these three present, the defense could surely hold.
Meanwhile, the loose cultivators couldn’t help but marvel, "No wonder Qiu Xuan Immortal City can withstand multiple beast tides and still stand tall, the foundation here is truly profound."
Compared to others who were optimistic, Xu Ping was deeply worried.
"Although Hongyi suddenly possessed Fake Pill combat strength, the cost must have been substantial, otherwise why would he only use it when the situation was about to collapse."
"Whether he can unleash Fake Pill combat strength again in the future is still unknown."
"Moreover, more importantly... Jiang Tian!"
Xu Ping’s eyes involuntarily revealed a hint of killing intent.
If not for him employing some means today, even with the presence of the Earth-shaking Turtle, the Third-rank array and city walls wouldn’t have shattered.
But he really couldn’t figure out his purpose for doing so.
What benefit does Qiu Xuan Immortal City being breached by demon beasts bring to him?
Even if he has Foundation Establishment strength, he’s insignificant in the beast tide.
"Could it be that he has a way to survive even if Qiu Xuan Immortal City is breached?" Xu Ping pondered silently.
Given his ability to conceal from Golden Core cultivators, it might indeed be possible.
"Should I test him out a bit?" The thought popped up in Xu Ping’s mind.
The more he considered it, the more feasible it seemed.
Now with the Third-rank array shattered, both the defensive capability and probing ability have decreased significantly.
And as long as I act fast and decisively, hitting and then escaping immediately, who would know it was me?
Even if I fail then, given his actions, he surely wouldn’t dare report to Qiu Xuan Mountain and cause trouble, but instead would swallow the bitter result.
"Let’s do this!"
Xu Ping thought it over repeatedly and finally made up his mind.
With such a ticking bomb beside him, he couldn’t eat or sleep in peace, not knowing what trouble the other person would cause next.
Strike preemptively!
Waiting for the opponent to act first is too passive.
With everything thought out, Xu Ping began to silently wait for the opportunity.
Waiting for a perfect chance to strike.
...
In the following days, the defending cultivators were motivated, each city gate steadfastly resisting wave after wave of demon beast assaults.
And since Xu Ping exposed part of his strength, he became famous among the cultivators guarding the south gate, with many cultivators approaching and trying to befriend him.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, if you ever have the opportunity, come to my clan, I will definitely entertain you well," an elder with white hair said with a smile.
This elder was named Zhang Yu, the Clan Leader of an ordinary Foundation Establishment family from the Ten Thousand Mountains, having traveled thousands of miles to resist the beast tide in exchange for a Foundation Establishment Pill.
"If there’s a chance, I will definitely come," Xu Ping replied with a smile.
The two chatted intermittently, yet most of Xu Ping’s attention remained on Jiang Tian in the distance.
These days, the opponent had been honestly staying at Qiu Xuan Mountain, not giving him a chance to make a move.
But Xu Ping was not anxious either; without a Third-rank Array Master in the city, relying on Second-stage Array Masters to repair the Mountain Protection Array would take at least a month or two.
"I wonder, Fellow Daoist Xu, could you sell me some battle merits?" Zhang Yu inquired tentatively after a chat.
"Sure," Xu Ping nodded.
Qiu Xuan Mountain doesn’t prohibit the trading of battle merits among cultivators, as long as it’s not coercion or exploitation.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Xu," Zhang Yu rejoiced.
"No problem," Xu Ping waved his hand.
Things exchangeable with battle merits weren’t very appealing to him, and converting them to Spirit Stones wasn’t bad either.
Moreover, if Qiu Xuan Mountain were to be breached, these merits would be useless.
...
Time passed, and half a month went by.
In Xu Ping’s patient wait, the opportunity finally emerged.
This day.
Jiang Tian couldn’t hold back and went back to that room covered by an array in the outer city.
"Finally, you’re out!"
Observing his every move through the Rat Demon, Xu Ping’s eyes flickered with coldness.
He unhesitatingly controlled the Rat Demon to follow, while he silently tailed Jiang Tian.
...
Outer City.
Jiang Tian slipped into a secluded alley, changed his appearance, and deliberately picked places with no people to walk.
Carefully advancing, he suddenly stopped, frowning as he looked ahead at an Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, a burly man with a face full of menace.
"You..." he began to speak, but then heard the crisp sound of bells: "ding ding..."
Boom!
The Jade Token Jiang Tian wore suddenly exploded.
"Not good, Spiritual Sense Attack!"
Jiang Tian’s face changed dramatically, a flash of light in his hand as a defensive top-grade Magical Artifact suddenly appeared, but before he could react, a chilling sensation engulfed him.
Boom!
Jiang Tian felt as if his head was struck by a massive hammer, emitting waves of roars, he couldn’t help but black out, almost falling, dropping the top-grade Magical Artifact to the ground with a clang.
When he resisted the intense pain in his Sea of Consciousness and came back to his senses, he saw a strand of Sword Qi with endless chill slashing towards him.
Buzz!
The Sword Qi activated a one-time protective barrier on Jiang Tian, enveloping him completely in thick spiritual light.
In the next instant.
Boom!
The Sword Qi slashed onto the thick spiritual light barrier with a deafening roar.
Crack crack...
The spiritual light barrier instantly displayed numerous cracks, exploding the next moment, but fortunately, the power of Sword Qi was also depleted.
"So close!"
Jiang Tian was drenched in cold sweat, hairs standing on end, if not for the many treasures he had, an ordinary Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator would have been killed!
Yet before he could sigh in relief, the ground beneath him suddenly burst open, a claw reflecting icy light grabbing at him.
"No..."
Jiang Tian showed fear, not even uttering a single word before being torn in two by the claw, collapsing lifelessly.
Having executed him with Thunder Power, Xu Pin felt slightly relieved.
He quickly tidied up the scene and swiftly left the area.
A quarter-hour later.
The patrol team arrived slowly, searched meticulously, but only found evidence of nearby combat.
They merely treated it as another ordinary robbery incident and wrapped up the matter hastily.

chapters.title: Chapter 124: Mystical Treasure – Thousand Illusion Mask
chapters.content:
Chapter 124: Chapter 124: Mystical Treasure – Thousand Illusion Mask
Qiu Xuan Mountain, residence.
Xu Ping sat on the stone bench in the small courtyard, silently pondering whether there were any places where he might have exposed himself during the operations.
Recalling the entire process, from concealing his presence and attacking to finally cleaning up the battlefield, he carefully considered it several times before finally confirming that there were no loopholes, and he couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
This time, he took action deliberately to stir the pot.
If Jiang Tian was acting alone, then this trouble was completely resolved.
But if Jiang Tian had other comrades or forces behind him, his sudden disappearance would surely arouse their suspicion and action.
No matter what their intentions are, under the observation of two Golden Core Cultivators, their plans are definitely easier to expose than before.
"Now, we’ll just have to see how the situation develops!" Xu Ping’s eyes were solemn, unsure of what might happen next.
Would it get better? Or will it get worse?
He wasn’t sure.
But regardless, it was far better than doing nothing and letting the situation deteriorate.
...
Xu Ping cleared his mind and took Jiang Tian’s corpse out of the Storage Ring.
"Oh?"
"What’s this?"
Xu Ping was slightly stunned, as a nearly transparent ultra-thin mask fell from Jiang Tian’s face.
His corpse was now shrinking, turning into a short and emaciated middle-aged man.
"Is this mask what he used for disguise?"
Xu Ping picked up the ultra-thin mask, feeling puzzled.
He released his Divine Sense to probe the ultra-thin mask and couldn’t help but exclaim.
The Divine Sense seemed to enter a void, yielding nothing.
"This mask has the ability to deceive and obscure Divine Sense perception."
As Xu Ping deepened his Divine Sense, he suddenly caught a trace of an ancient and eerie aura.
"This item is not simple."
Xu Ping’s heart was secretly shocked, he planned to refine the ultra-thin mask after he finished searching all the items on Jiang Tian.
Having stored the ultra-thin mask, he began to search Jiang Tian’s corpse for useful items but only found a single Storage Ring.
He easily broke the Divine Sense restriction on it and invaded with his Divine Sense.
"I’ve struck it rich!" Xu Ping’s eyes flashed with a hint of delight.
The vast space was filled with various items: Spirit Stones, Pills, Magical Artifacts, Talismans...
He even found a top-grade offensive Magical Artifact, and along with the previously discovered top-grade defensive Magical Artifact, there were as many as two top-grade Magical Artifacts.
"These riches are even more abundant than those of an ordinary Late-Stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator." Xu Pin cheerfully stored everything in his own Storage Ring.
Then, he flicked his finger, and a fireball shot out from his fingertip, landing on Jiang Tian’s corpse.
Boom!
In just a moment, Jiang Tian’s corpse turned to ashes.
Next, Xu Ping used a Cleaning Talisman to summon a stream of water, washing away the ashes without leaving a trace.
"Finally... there’s this mask!"
After finishing all this, Xu Ping took out the mysterious mask again.
Having initially probed it before, he knew this strange item was far from simple.
Now he intended to thoroughly refine it.
Xu Ping infused a strand of Mana into the ultra-thin mask.
Buzz buzz!
The ultra-thin mask directly absorbed the strand of Mana, emitting a shimmering glow, floating in mid-air, with an even greater suction emanating from it.
Xu Ping’s expression remained unchanged as he continued to steadily input Mana.
Two hours later.
The ultra-thin mask stopped absorbing Mana; its glow intensified, vaguely establishing a subtle connection with Xu Ping.
Subsequently, some information automatically surfaced in his Sea of Consciousness.
"Lower Grade Treasured Artifact — Thousand Illusion Mask, capable of transforming into a thousand people!" Xu Ping’s heart trembled.
This was a Treasured Artifact that could transform into another person.
To possess a certain face and identity, the simplest and most effective method was to kill a target and allow the mask to absorb their essence and soul.
This identity replacement was nearly perfect; even someone from a higher realm would find it difficult to detect any flaw.
Besides killing the target, collecting their blood and Mana aura and integrating them into the mask could achieve a similar effect, albeit slightly less effective.
"What a treasure!" Xu Ping was ecstatic; having such a Treasured Artifact in hand would make hiding or escaping remarkably easy.
"Let’s test the effect!"
He applied the Thousand Illusion Mask to his face.
It felt like transparent human skin silicone.
Once affixed to his face, it felt cool and seamlessly merged with the skin.
In an instant, Xu Ping’s facial features and demeanor changed dramatically, becoming a handsome and imposing young man.
"Jiang Tian!"
Xu Ping drew a water mirror with his finger, revealing his current appearance.
Not only had his appearance become Jiang Tian, but his eyes, hair, whole body skin tone, emitted aura, and Mana fluctuations all transformed accordingly.
"It’s so perfect!"
Xu Ping was amazed; no matter how he looked, he was Jiang Tian himself.
"It seems Jiang Tian, no, it should be that this person killed Jiang Tian and replaced him, infiltrating Qiu Xuan Mountain."
"No wonder he could fool the Golden Core Cultivators; it seems to be the Thousand Illusion Mask’s doing," Xu Ping thought to himself.
With such a Treasured Artifact at hand, there are countless things he could accomplish in the future.
After having fun with the Thousand Illusion Mask for a while, feeling already satisfied, Xu Ping put it away.
Though the gain today was immense, he wasn’t swept away by the excitement.
"Next, I’ll just wait and see how the situation unfolds."
...
Three days later.
When the people on Qiu Xuan Mountain searched every nook and cranny without finding a trace of Jiang Tian, they realized something was amiss.
A living Foundation Establishment Cultivator vanished without a sound?
Someone with such skill must be at least a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
And in Qiu Xuan Immortal City, there aren’t many cultivators above Late-Stage Foundation Establishment who have no enmity with Jiang Tian; none of them would kill him for no reason.
"Could it be that a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator is hiding in Qiu Xuan Immortal City?"
This idea was far more reliable than before and was accepted by most people.
Under normal circumstances, the Third-rank Array could trap not only a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator but even a Fake Pill cultivator.
But now, with the Third-rank Array not yet repaired, and the pressure from the beast tide so immense, even Golden Core Cultivators are unable to spare time, let alone others.
As for using Qi Cultivators to search?
That’s even less feasible; they wouldn’t even see a shadow.
Thus Qiu Xuan Mountain could only stipulate that unless there were two or more Foundation Establishment Cultivators, no one was allowed to leave Qiu Xuan Mountain.
Following this incident, the once-confident people began to waver.
Indeed, when external problems haven’t been resolved, internal issues arise!
As for Xu Ping, the initiator, his emotions remained stable, and Qiu Xuan Mountain’s actions were within his expectations.
The most important factor would be the reactions of Jiang Tian’s accomplices or any forces behind him.
Regarding the possibility that he had no accomplices or forces behind him,
Xu Ping felt that this was highly unlikely.

chapters.title: Chapter 125: The Southern Gate Falls
chapters.content:
Chapter 125: Chapter 125: The Southern Gate Falls
Outer city.
In a room enveloped by an array, a gaunt middle-aged man stared at the floating bronze mirror in the air, with a face full of fluctuating expressions.
"What did the elders say?" asked an elderly man anxiously beside him.
After a moment of silence, the middle-aged man slowly said, "The plan needs to be advanced."
"That’s also good. Now that Lv Wei is missing, we don’t know if he was discovered by Qiu Xuan Mountain and captured." The elderly man had a somewhat gloomy expression.
"Besides Qiu Xuan Mountain, who else could capture Lv Wei? They even self-direct and act, searching for Lv Wei’s whereabouts, what a joke." The middle-aged man couldn’t help but sneer.
"Will we be exposed?" The elderly man was somewhat worried at this moment.
Compared to Qiu Xuan Mountain, they were insignificant; if truly exposed, only a dead-end awaited them.
"We shouldn’t be. Lv Wei’s Sea of Consciousness has a restriction laid by the Sect Leader himself. If someone tries to invade his Sea of Consciousness or if he dares to reveal even a bit of this plan, his Sea of Consciousness would explode on the spot." The middle-aged man said with confidence.
"I see."
The elderly man instantly breathed a sigh of relief, "Lv Wei has already figured out Qiu Xuan Mountain’s situation over the years and has torn open a breach in the southern array."
"Moreover, the beast tide we’ve prematurely triggered reveals all their methods; Lv Wei has little use now, though it’s a pity his Thousand Illusion Mask fell into Qiu Xuan Mountain’s hands."
"Nothing to pity, once Qiu Xuan Mountain is destroyed, won’t the Thousand Illusion Mask be ours?" The middle-aged man said indifferently.
"That’s true, this time they’ve gathered at least one-fifth of Foundation Establishment cultivators of Yue Country, along with one Fake Pill and two Golden Core cultivators. Exterminating them would indeed severely damage Yue Country."
"And without any hindrance, the beast tide will also spread to Yue Country’s heartlands, making it even worse."
"By then, the plan for nation extermination by the sect will go much smoother, and our years of scheming would not have been in vain." The elderly man’s tone revealed a hint of icy killing intent.
"Once Yue Country is annexed, having two medium-sized countries as support would allow our sect to make a qualitative leap, possibly becoming a top sect in Nanchuan over time!" The middle-aged man’s eyes revealed a trace of fervor.
"That day will certainly come!" The elder’s tone revealed a hint of determination.
...
Several days later, Qiu Xuan Mountain.
In the courtyard.
Xu Ping’s face slightly tensed, suddenly taking a step forward as the spiritual light on him burst and vanished instantly, seemingly traversing space-time, and appeared at the edge of the array in no time.
"Is this a breakthrough?"
Feeling the speed far exceeding the previous, Xu Ping’s eyes sparkled with excitement, impatiently opening the panel.
[Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill Perfection: ∞]
"Hahaha... The Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill has indeed reached perfection!!" Xu Ping could no longer restrain himself, bursting into laughter.
During this period, he had devoted all his energy to practicing the Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill and finally welcomed the moment of breakthrough.
The lingering gloom in his heart dissipated greatly.
Although after eliminating Jiang Tian, Qiu Xuan Immortal City remained unperturbed, as if he had no accomplices or forces behind, Xu Ping felt vaguely uneasy, sensing that something major would happen.
Now, armed with the perfect Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill, his survival ability greatly enhanced.
By then, if something unpredictable happens at Qiu Xuan Mountain, unless a Third-rank Demon King or Golden Core cultivator targets him, he has confidence to escape.
"Need more familiarization." Xu Ping suppressed his inner excitement and activated the perfect-level Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill once more.
...
...
Another few days passed.
The beast tide had been raging for a year now; although Qiu Xuan Immortal City suffered significant casualties, the beast tide was far less fierce than before, evidently having consumed greatly.
"Looking at the current beast tide’s offensive, I’m afraid it’ll end in another half year." Xu Zhixuan chatted with Xu Ping while wielding a magical artifact to attack the demon beasts outside.
"It seems so, this beast tide counts as moderate among all the beast tides in Qiu Xuan Immortal City." Xu Ping released a Palm Thunder, blasting a large group of demon beasts into ashes, then nodded.
"Indeed the beast tide is ending, but the one who assassinated Jiang Tian hasn’t been found, leaving people uneasy. With such cultivation level, killing me shouldn’t be much effort." Xu Zhixuan’s face showed a trace of worry.
"True, but once the beast tide ends, Qiu Xuan Mountain will have a free hand to handle him. With the Third-rank array, he can’t escape." Xu Ping comforted.
"Indeed, Qiu Xuan Mountain’s Mountain Protection Array was set up by an Array Master from Luoyun Sect, and it’s never been breached in over a hundred years."
Just as Xu Zhixuan’s words fell, abnormal fluctuations suddenly arose around.
An eerie black talisman transformed into a twisted beam of light, emitting a strange power of structure destruction, striking the Mountain Protection Array.
Boom!
A thunderous explosion sounded, as a breach several zhang long opened at the southern gate, merging with nearby array openings, triggering chain reactions, causing an entire side of the Mountain Protection Array to collapse.
Everything happened too quickly, and by the time everyone came back to their senses, they could only stare dumbfounded at the fallen southern gate, breached array, and countless demon beasts flooding into the Immortal City.
"The south gate has fallen?!?"
A Loose Cultivator shielded himself, just lifting a piece of debris, staring at the majestic city walls completely collapsed, his expression dazed.
Instantly, he saw a mass of fiery red charging!
It was a group of Fire Wolf demon beasts with flaming horns!
Seeing him, the eyes of those Fire Wolves turned red, raising claws laced with flames and lunging at him,
Bang!
The cultivator’s defense shield was instantly shattered into pieces by the Fire Wolves’ claws, leaving deep gashes on his body.
"Ah!"
The cultivator screamed, his internal organs torn and charred... instantly losing consciousness.
A group of Fire Wolves surrounded, devouring the cultivator’s corpse in large bites.
To demon beasts, the flesh of cultivators was rich in spiritual qi, truly nourishing!
Countless Qi cultivators, like this Loose Cultivator, were submerged in the beast tide in an instant.
Occasionally, amidst the dark tide, flashes of magical light burst, desperately resisting but swallowed by the beast tide, extinguished in mere breaths...
"Help!!"
"Run!!"
"I don’t want to die!!"
...
Countless Loose Cultivators screamed tragically, their psychological defenses completely collapsing, rushing mindlessly into the inner city.
Without the array shielding, this group of Qi Cultivators was utterly overwhelmed by the demon beasts numerically multiplying by tenfold, even dozens of times.
...
"You seek death!!!" Tan Shuyi roared furiously, eyes blazing with wrath, and thrust a palm towards an ordinary-looking elderly cultivator at Qi level nine.
The black talisman’s commotion was too great, and the Foundation Establishment cultivators present sensed it was this Qi cultivator, who somehow breached the Third-rank array.

chapters.title: Chapter 126: Sword Qi Thunder Sound
chapters.content:
Chapter 126: Chapter 126: Sword Qi Thunder Sound
As Tan Shuyi thrust his palm forward, a flash of cold light passed through his palm center, and an earthen awl-like object appeared out of thin air, leaving a streak of light in the void, instantly flashing to the Qi Cultivation elder’s front.
The Qi Cultivation elder seemed to have been prepared for this; raising his hand with a wave, a light curtain seemed to hang down before him, and a Protective Spiritual Light appeared out of thin air, blocking that earthen awl.
Boom!
With a loud crash, the earthen awl smashed into the Protective Spiritual Light, shattering like an egg hitting a stone.
At this moment, the aura on that Qi Cultivation elder shockingly had already reached the Late-Stage Foundation Establishment.
"Late-Stage Foundation Establishment?"
The Foundation Establishment Cultivators present were all startled and discolored.
"Did you kill Jiang Tian?" Tan Shuyi fixed his eyes on the other party.
"Is there any point in you all disguising yourselves now?" The old man spoke with a hint of mockery.
"Disguise? You beast, what nonsense are you talking? Even if you are at Late-Stage Foundation Establishment, you will surely die today!" Tan Shuyi roared, calling all the Foundation Establishment Cultivators to kill him.
At this moment, Xu Ping’s expression also turned extremely dark; this person was surely an accomplice of Jiang Tian.
Although he had predicted that the other party would definitely cause some major event, his heart couldn’t help but tremble when they actually broke through a face of the Third-rank Array.
"Fellow Daoist Yi, this is not the time to kill him!" A Foundation Establishment Cultivator shouted in panic, pointing at the beast tide after pushing back a Second-stage Demon Beast, "If we don’t retreat now, we’ll all be buried in the beast tide."
At this moment, dozens of Second-stage Demon Beasts, carrying countless First Rank Demon Beasts, had already invaded the Immortal City.
Although they had more than twenty Foundation Establishment Cultivators, facing this endless beast tide, they feared they wouldn’t last long.
"Retreat!" Tan Shuyi reluctantly glanced at the Late-Stage Foundation Establishment elder and then summoned everyone to retreat.
The southern gate was breached; they could only move the defensive line back, waiting for the Sect Leader’s support.
"Oh, did I permit you to retreat?" The old man sneered, descending swiftly with a knife in one hand, leveling his long hooked blade to chop down on a mid-aged Early-Stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator from a distance of seven or eight zhang.
The blade shone a dazzling golden light, and an almost substantial crescent-shaped blade light swept downwards.
Due to the opponent’s speed and being at Late-Stage Foundation Establishment, this mid-aged Early-Stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator only managed to grab a talisman and slap it on himself, forming a layer of faint green shield, while simultaneously deploying a soil-colored round shield to meet the oncoming attack.
’Boom!’ A resounding explosion!
The soil yellow round shield shattered with the sound, stirring up a ring-shaped air wave rolling outwards, and the shield on the Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator was also shattered by the residual force of the blade light, directly splitting the person in half.
"So strong!"
In the midst of escape, everyone’s minds were shocked, amazed by the power of a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator capable of killing an Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator with a single strike!
They couldn’t help but feel a flash of fear, afraid that the opponent would target them, causing them to flee even faster!
Upon witnessing this scene, Xu Ping’s eyes slightly narrowed; a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator was truly unimaginably strong, and even if he gave his all, it was uncertain he could kill him.
To avoid the opponent focusing on him, Xu Ping was about to speed up his Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill when a heavy pressure suddenly hurled at him.
Xu Ping looked up sharply, seeing a mountain-like shadow with ancient patterns wandering on its surface and a dim golden light, suddenly blooming bright halos, crashing down on him.
"Not good!"
His face changed wildly, and in urgency, he could only conjure a black turtle-shell-like round shield to protect in front; this Magical Artifact was a top-grade defensive artifact seized from Jiang Tian.
He simultaneously slapped several Second-stage defensive talismans onto himself.
Boom!
The enormous mountain mark instantly smashed through the protective shield formed by the Second-stage talismans, then heavily struck the top-grade defensive Magical Artifact.
Along with a deafening crash, the spiritual light and air waves surged in all directions, overturning an unknown number of First Rank Demon Beasts.
The two held against each other for a moment, and the black round shield emitted a sound of unbearable strain.
The next instant, the black round shield was sent flying by the enormous mountain mark.
"Blood Demon True Form!"
Xu Ping pinched a spell, roaring angrily.
In a moment, his body began to swell, turning into a towering figure over two meters tall, with bloodlight flowing across his skin.
Bang!
Despite executing the Blood Demon True Form, Xu Ping was still pounded and clanged by the enormous mountain mark, his qi and blood surging, retreating step by step.
Had this enormous mountain mark not been layer by layer weakened, its power would’ve been insurmountable even with the Blood Demon True Form.
"Huh? Is this Lv Wei’s Demon Turtle Shield?"
A voice of surprise sounded; the person ambushing Xu Ping now revealed himself as a gaunt middle-aged man, his aura also reached Late-Stage Foundation Establishment.
"Two Late-Stage Foundation Establishment Cultivators!" Xu Ping’s face now turned extremely somber, even though he had deployed all his means, it seemed he was still no match for the two of them!
"Looks like Qiu Xuan Mountain holds you in high regard, actually giving you Lv Wei’s top-grade defensive Magical Artifact to use."
The gaunt middle-aged man’s face showed little surprise as if it was only natural; Lv Wei was already captured by Qiu Xuan Mountain, so his Magical Artifact being in Qiu Xuan Mountain’s possession was very reasonable.
"Also, being both an Alchemist and having such combat power, achieving a Golden Core wouldn’t be impossible, so it’s not unreasonable to let you use it, but... today is your death day!"
A thick killing intent permeated the gaunt middle-aged man’s voice.
Meanwhile.
Xu Zhixuan, fleeing, noticed Xu Ping being intercepted by another Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, holding back from shouting loudly:
"Fellow Daoist Tan, Fellow Daoist Xu is blocked, if we don’t assist him, he probably won’t survive."
Upon hearing this, Tan Shuyi hesitated; if it were an ordinary Guest Minister or Foundation Establishment cultivator from outside, he would surely abandon them, but Xu Ping was no ordinary Guest Minister, losing him would be a massive blow.
After weighing the pros and cons, he finally decided to rescue Xu Ping.
"Fellow Daoists, if our Qiu Xuan Mountain’s Guest Minister is blocked, we hope fellow Daoists will assist Qiu Xuan Mountain as well; just rescue Fellow Daoist Xu from those two Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators."
The Foundation Establishment Cultivators hesitated for a while but eventually followed Tan Shuyi’s arrangement.
If it was merely rescuing Fellow Daoist Xu, it wouldn’t take much time.
Though there were two Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators, they had more than twenty Foundation Establishment cultivators, standing together fearlessly, even having a chance to kill them.
However, this would cost a lot of time, and perhaps by then, they’d already be overwhelmed by the beast tide.
Just as everyone prepared to return to aid Xu Ping, a thunderous sound echoed across the sky.
They looked towards the source, only to see Xu Ping holding a sword with one hand, slashing fiercely, as a majestic Sword Qi burst from the sword tip with a thunderous roar.
Boom!
The majestic Sword Qi seemed like heavenly thunder descending, fiercely striking the middle-aged man’s Protective Spiritual Light.
"Sword Qi Thunder Sound!!!"
Everyone present was shocked, as if witnessing something soul-stirring.

chapters.title: Chapter 127: Golden Cores from Another Nation
chapters.content:
Chapter 127: Chapter 127: Golden Cores from Another Nation
"Sword Qi Thunder Sound!!"
The middle-aged man’s face showed shock as he hastily summoned a yellow earth-colored mirror. The mirror suddenly emitted a dazzling light, forming a yellow earth-colored barrier to block the Sword Qi.
Boom!
A tremendous sound reverberated, shaking the surroundings as Spiritual Qi surged from the center like a tide, spreading outward with invisible ripples.
"Crack!"
Numerous cracks quickly appeared on the yellow earth-colored barrier, as if it could collapse at any moment. In the next instant, the barrier finally couldn’t hold on and exploded with a ’bang’.
Finally, the Sword Qi heavily struck the yellow earth-colored mirror, knocking it backward, but the Sword Qi also dissipated completely.
At this moment, everyone’s eyes fell on Xu Ping, filled with shock, as if seeing him for the first time.
"Sword Qi Thunder Sound!"
The elder said word by word, his eyes filled with murderous intent.
Having just broken through to Foundation Establishment and already able to comprehend Sword Qi Thunder Sound on his own, such talent increases the likelihood of breaking into the Golden Core Realm. Even future comprehension of the second level of Sword Qi isn’t impossible.
Letting such a genius grow smoothly could bring endless trouble to their sect, so he must be eradicated in the bud.
The elder held the hooked sabre with both hands, and golden streams surged into the blade, making it seem as if it was set ablaze, emitting dazzling light.
"Break."
He uttered a low shout, bringing the sabre down with a swing, and golden light burst forth, extending into a serpentine blade light dozens of feet long.
The golden light broke through like a fire dragon, and wild winds swirled around.
"Slash!"
Xu Ping’s face was grave, channeling all his Mana into the Purple Sun Sword for a powerful slash.
Boom!
Sword Qi erupted from the sword tip, clashing with the earth-shattering thunder sound and the twisting blade light.
The Sword Qi and blade light collided, sharp energies and spiritual brilliance swept in all directions.
At this moment, Tan Shuyi finally came to his senses, showing ecstasy, and shouted, "At all costs, save Fellow Daoist Xu!"
Is this the Sword Qi Thunder Sound?
Even at Early-Stage Foundation Establishment can engage in a fierce battle with Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators.
Wouldn’t breaking through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment allow one to challenge even Fake Pill Masters?
Before the words finished, Tan Shuyi threw his yellow earth-colored alms bowl toward the elder.
Comprehending Sword Qi Thunder Sound at Early-Stage Foundation Establishment, such talent and value are much higher than the Foundation Establishment cultivators present.
Other Foundation Establishment cultivators exchanged glances and also decided to take action.
Instantly, spiritual lights filled the sky, enveloping the middle-aged man and the elder.
...
North Gate.
When the array at the South Gate was broken, the cultivators on-site sensed this massive change.
"South Gate... broken?"
"How did this happen?"
"Another Third Rank Demon King appeared?"
...
Countless people panicked; if one city wall is lost, how can they defend?
Hongyi’s expression changed drastically, and immediately, his aura began to surge to Fake Pill status.
He only had time to leave a "Hold your ground," before transforming into an Escape Light and flying toward the South Gate.
At this moment.
Boom!
A thread of Sword Qi soared into the sky with rumbling thunder sounds, and the sharp aura that followed sent a shiver through Hongyi’s heart.
"Is this... Sword Qi Thunder Sound?"
"What’s happening at the South Gate?"
Hongyi’s face was filled with shock, unable to think further, his Escape Light sped up.
...
Outside Qiu Xuan Immortal City.
Three Third-Rank Demon Beasts were in a fierce battle with Qiu Xuan Zhenren and Zihuan Master, continuous booming sounds deafening the ears.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
In just a short second, both parties clashed several times, the waves of spiritual energy fluctuations from their battle would be enough to kill a First Rank Demon Beast.
Suddenly!
Boom!
A loud noise came from the South Gate.
"The array is broken?" Qiu Xuan Zhenren’s brows furrowed, heart alert, his Divine Sense instantly spread out, realizing the seriousness of the situation.
"Fellow Daoist Qiu, the rats hidden in your Immortal City have revealed themselves, but was the commotion just now from breaking the Third-rank Array using a Quasi-Tier Three Breaking Charm?"
Zihuan Master forced back a Third-Rank Demon King, approached Qiu Xuan Zhenren with a gloomy face.
"I’m afraid so." Qiu Xuan Zhenren nodded with a grim expression, with one side of the Third-rank Array broken, although the Immortal City won’t be completely lost, defending against this crisis would likely require a heavy price.
"Which force could it be?" Zihuan Master fell into deep thought; few factions in Yue Country could produce a Quasi-Tier Three Breaking Charm.
Moreover, if Qiu Xuan Mountain is broken, and the beast tide enters the heart of Yue Country, it would be a significant threat to all forces.
Roar!
At this time, the three Demon Kings roared, their sound shook the surroundings, and immediately, the demon beasts attacking other gates of the Immortal City turned to rush toward the South Gate opening.
Third-Rank Demon Kings have intelligence almost equal to cultivators, naturally knowing to beat a dog while it’s down.
"Fellow Daoist Zihuan, we might have to show our true capabilities." Qiu Xuan Zhenren said solemnly, realizing that only by driving away these three Third-Rank Demon Kings, Qiu Xuan Immortal City could survive this crisis.
"Understood." Zihuan Master nodded.
At this moment, a surge of Sword Qi accompanied by thunder sounds erupted from the South Gate.
"Is this... Sword Qi Thunder Sound?"
The two showed surprise, but when they ’saw clearly’ that it was Xu Ping who wielded the Sword Qi Thunder Sound, their expressions differed.
Qiu Xuan Zhenren showed excitement, while Zihuan Master displayed a slightly complex emotion.
"Fellow Daoist Zihuan, take action!"
Qiu Xuan Zhenren decisively summoned his most powerful magical artifact—the Vermilion Bird Ring.
Chirp!
A high-pitched bird cry sounded, flames ignited around the ring-shaped magical artifact, forming a magnificent bird ablaze with fire, spreading its wings and flying towards the three Demon Kings.
Sizzle!
Vermilion Bird Flame burned the sky, enveloping the three Demon Kings.
Seeing this, Zihuan Master did not hesitate, releasing a white orb that formed into a mountain-like size when met with the wind.
Then he quickly made hand seals, and seven starry patterns appeared on the surface of the white giant orb.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Dozens of starlights fell like raindrops, striking the three Demon Kings.
With the two exerting their full strength, the three Demon Kings fell into a disadvantage, but with their tough hides and strong defense, the two couldn’t do much to them in a short time.
At this moment, a blood-colored blade light slashed from a distance, swiftly sweeping across the Vermilion Bird Flame, faster than even falling lightning.
Spiritual Qi exploded, shaking the surroundings, the Vermilion Bird Flame was instantly extinguished, dispersing as sparks in the void.
The blood-colored blade light flew back, falling into a robust hand, revealing a crimson battle axe, with faint red lines flickering on the axe surface.
The owner of the robust hand was a burly man in a blood robe, eight feet tall, red hair draping over his shoulders, eyes dark red, exuding a terrifying Evil Qi all over.
"Yiyang, it’s you!"
Qiu Xuan Zhenren showed anger, demanding sternly, "Was it you from the Myriad Phenomena Sect who destroyed my Qiu Xuan Mountain Array? Aren’t you afraid of sparking a war between Hu and Yue countries with such actions?"
The blood-robed man in front was named Yiyang, an elder in the Myriad Phenomena Sect of Hu Country, in the Middle Stage of Golden Core.
"Hahaha, war between the two countries? Our Myriad Phenomena Sect has precisely that intention!"
A cloud roared as it flew rapidly from afar, landing dozens of feet away in a blink, and within the cloud, a hearty, wild laugh sounded.
"Ou Xuan!" Zihuan Master’s pupils contracted.
"Long time no see, I didn’t expect Fellow Daoist Zihuan to still remember little me, truly honored." The black cloud slowly dispersed, revealing a purple-faced, black-robed man with a very imposing appearance.
His aura also reached the Middle Stage of Golden Core.
"Your Hu Country is only a medium-sized nation, do you want to go for a mutual destruction with our Yue Country?" Zihuan Master’s face was extremely gloomy.
Revealing two Golden Core elders, and destroying Qiu Xuan Immortal City, does the Myriad Phenomena Sect really plan to attack their Yue Country?

chapters.title: Chapter 128: Escape
chapters.content:
Chapter 128: Chapter 128: Escape
"Fish die, net split? You really overestimate yourselves!" Ou Xuan sneered coldly, his gaze as sharp as a blade, "Three Demon Kings, join forces and leave them here completely."
The three Demon Kings showed no hesitation, roaring as they charged toward Qiu Xuan Zhenren and Zihuan Master, their momentum like a storm.
"You dare to collude with Demon Beasts!" Zihuan Master was furious beyond measure.
"So much nonsense." Ou Xuan sneered and joined the battle mercilessly alongside Yiyang.
In a five-on-two situation, with two being Middle Stage Golden Core cultivators, Zihuan Master and Qiu Xuan Zhenren instantly fell into disadvantage, being driven back step by step.
...
In Qiu Xuan Immortal City, countless cultivators looked up towards the sky, fear spreading unchecked across their faces.
Who are these two unknown hostile Golden Core individuals?
Why have they ambushed Qiu Xuan Zhenren and Zihuan Master?
It was already incredibly difficult to resist the beast tide, and now with two unknown Golden Core attackers, is it certain that Qiu Xuan Immortal City will fall today?
At the southern gate.
The crowd that had forced back the two Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators also showed traces of panic on their faces.
"Who are these two unfamiliar Golden Core individuals?" someone asked in terror.
"They probably aren’t from our Yue Country," another answered with a trembling voice.
Foundation Establishment cultivators, though strong, rarely travel across nations, and naturally do not recognize Golden Core cultivators from other countries.
Xu Ping looked at Zihuan Master and Qiu Xuan Zhenren in the air being driven back step by step, his mind racing with thoughts.
This time, Qiu Xuan Immortal City is in big trouble. Relying just on their few numbers is not nearly enough to defend it.
Once those two Golden Core Masters can no longer hold, Qiu Xuan Immortal City will face utter destruction.
"I need to find a chance to run," Xu Ping thought to himself.
Although he was a member of Qiu Xuan Immortal City, he had no intention of living or dying with it.
"Ah!"
"Save me!"
A deathly wail echoed from nearby, followed by the annihilation of a powerful mana wave, evidently the end of a Foundation Establishment cultivator.
The people turned toward the sound and saw a Foundation Establishment cultivator, who was preparing to flee secretly, lying on the ground with a blood hole in the center of his brow, oozing red and white matter.
In front of the fallen Foundation Establishment cultivator stood a young man dressed in white with a wide grin, his face smeared with colorful oil, playing with a wisp of fine gold light between his fingers.
"Fake Pill!"
The crowd’s scalp tingled, and a trace of fear crept onto their faces.
What kind of force is trying to annihilate them, deploying not just two Golden Cores but a Fake Pill cultivator too?
"Destroy them."
The young man in white sneered lightly, and instantly, dozens of Escape Lights swept toward Xu Ping and the others, each containing the strong aura of a Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
"Run!"
The crowd no longer had any resistance left, their only thought was escape.
Xu Ping also hesitated not, setting up his Escape Light, rushing towards the inner city, but he did not exert his full strength, moving just slightly faster than Tan Shuyi, a Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
The young man in white picked up the storage Magical Artifacts of the Foundation Establishment cultivator and continued to dash out, lunging at another tall bearded Foundation Establishment cultivator nearby.
"Spare me, I..."
Before he could finish, a thin golden light pierced through his skull from behind, emerging through his forehead.
The light in his eyes dimmed instantly, and his body collapsed to the ground with a crash.
"What force are you, to suddenly attack our Qiu Xuan Mountain?"
At this moment, Hongyi finally arrived, seeing the scene before him, his heart burning with anger.
Seeing Hongyi’s arrival, the previously disoriented crowd found a backbone and ceased their chaotic escape.
"But I’m not interested in explaining to the dead." The young man in white sneered, and spat out a blue-glowing liquid, quickly spreading in all directions, enveloping Hongyi.
The blue liquid expanded instantly to seven or eight zhang, and its speed was so fast that Hongyi had no way to dodge, forcing him to summon a red copper mirror to block it.
The mirror rotated rapidly, expanding instantly to several zhang, meeting the falling blue light, blocking it from descending.
Before Hongyi could perform any other actions, a golden shadow attacked; it was again the thin golden light that shot from the side.
"Hmph!"
Hongyi snorted coldly, continuing to maneuver the red copper mirror to defend.
While the two were battling.
Accompanied by a violent tremor of Qiu Xuan Immortal City, the spiritual light shield that had enveloped it for a century completely dissipated.
"The Third-rank Array is broken!"
Countless people shouted in terror, but the cries of fear were quickly drowned by the roaring beast tide.
"Run!"
Now that Qiu Xuan Immortal City is in a state of inevitable defeat, and the Third-rank Array is broken, if not now, then when to flee?
Whizz! Whizz! Whizz!
Countless Escape Lights rose into the sky, fleeing in all directions.
Creak... Creak...
At this moment, accompanied by a piercing bird cry, a massive dark cloud obscured the sky, and the surrounding light dimmed instantly.
Everyone looked up uncontrollably, realizing it was not a dark cloud but a frenzy of bird demon beasts.
Buzz... Buzz...
Countless bird demon beasts flapped their wings, creating a powerful gale, instantly catching up with the fleeing cultivators.
With waves of screams and spiritual light flashes, countless cultivators were overwhelmed by the bird demon beasts, and a sense of despair permeated the air.
"Qiu Xuan Immortal City... it’s over!"
Xu Ping’s heart tightened, he picked a direction, set up his Escape Light, and fled for his life.
But he feared attracting the attention of the Golden Core and Fake Pill cultivators, only moving slightly faster than a Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
"Don’t think you can escape!"
With a cold snort, a middle-aged man and an elder with Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivation took off after Xu Ping.
If they could eliminate such a genius from Yue Country, it would be more valuable than killing a dozen Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators.
Xu Ping naturally sensed the pursuit of the two, but as they hadn’t yet left the vicinity of Qiu Xuan Immortal City, he couldn’t exert his full strength and could only gradually accelerate.
"How is this person so fast?"
The middle-aged man saw that he couldn’t keep up and drew a red crossbow.
A sharp whistle sounded as a red arrow flew straight at the back of Xu Ping’s heart.
Xu Ping hurriedly applied a Perfection Level Light Body Technique, his figure instantly blurred, dodging several zhang to the side.
The red arrow struck where he had been, bursting with a loud explosion, as the ground erupted into a large pit, with dust scattering everywhere.
Xu Ping didn’t look back, setting up his Escape Light and continuing to flee for his life.
"Like a slippery eel!"
The middle-aged man gritted his teeth, unwilling to give up, continuing the pursuit.
The three ran, one after another, into the distance.
Along the way, the middle-aged man sporadically attacked Xu Ping with the red crossbow, but Xu Ping dodged every time.
...
Unawares, Qiu Xuan Immortal City in the view gradually became a small black dot.
Xu Ping glanced back, feeling it was about time, thinking he had completely escaped beyond the range of the Golden Core’s Divine Sense, could now flee at full speed.
"No need to see me off any further!"
Spiritual light flashed from Xu Ping, in the next instant, his speed surged, instantly putting a large distance between them.
Under the astonished gazes of the middle-aged man and the elder, Xu Ping gradually faded from sight.
"What kind of ghostly Escape Technique is this, faster even than a Fake Pill cultivator!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 129: Zhang Yu
chapters.content:
Chapter 129: Chapter 129: Zhang Yu
Late at night, the moonlight was like water, softly cascading down onto the quiet forest, draping the earth in a silvery veil.
The outlines of the trees towered against the night sky, like silent guardians, quietly watching everything.
Suddenly!
Whoosh!
A streak of divine light shot through the night sky, swift as a meteor, vanishing instantly into the endless darkness.
"Should be far enough."
Within the escape light, Xu Ping felt the tranquility of the night, and his heart inevitably relaxed.
Having outrun for a day with an escape technique surpassing a fake pill, and having changed directions multiple times along the way, even a Golden Core cultivator looking for him would be like searching for a needle in a haystack.
"Need to find a place to restore my mana."
Xu Ping pondered secretly, as the mana in his Dantian had almost run dry, desperately needing a secure place to rest.
He sparked the escape light and quickly melded into the depths of the forest.
Mana is the foundation of everything, and having depleted it this much, it was unwise to continue traveling.
Soon, he found a hidden spot in a secluded cave.
As a precaution, he set up an array to conceal spiritual Qi and then released the Rat Demon to patrol underground.
After completing all these tasks, Xu Ping swallowed a pill to recover his mana.
...
Meanwhile.
In the night sky, a leaf-shaped flying shuttle streaked by like a meteor, carrying an old man at an astonishing speed.
A moment later, a Wind Hunting Eagle, several tens of meters long, followed closely behind, each flap of its wings causing a massive pressure wave.
On the flying shuttle.
Zhang Yu, who barely escaped alive, looked at the persistent Second-stage Middle Grade Wind Hunting Eagle behind him, inwardly lamenting.
He hadn’t expected this creature to hold such a grudge, chasing him for a whole day, still refusing to give up.
If it weren’t for this special flying shuttle magical artifact in his hand, he would have been caught by the eagle earlier, becoming its delicious meal.
"Need to go faster," Zhang Yu took a deep breath, suppressing his panic, disregarded the mana consumption, performed a spell, causing the liquid mana in his Dantian to surge into the shuttle like a tide.
With a ’buzz’, the shuttle burst forth with intense divine light, its speed abruptly increasing.
Seeing this, a glint of blood flashed in the Wind Hunting Eagle’s eyes, it too increased its speed, pursuing relentlessly.
Person and eagle quickly vanished into the depths of the night.
...
In the depths of the forest, within the cave shrouded by the array, Xu Ping sat cross-legged on the stone platform, eyes closed, silently restoring his mana.
Time quietly slipped away beside him, unknown how long had passed.
"Whew!"
Xu Ping ended his cultivation, opened his eyes, and slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air.
Feeling the abundant mana within his Dantian, he felt somewhat reassured, and his mood also lightened.
But once he thought about Qiu Xuan Mountain likely to be annihilated, his heart grew heavy again.
"Sigh, I wonder how many of them were able to escape," Xu Ping sighed involuntarily.
He had a premonition that their numbers might be very few.
Qiu Xuan Mountain was a good place for cultivation, the people were good too, what a pity.
"Who exactly are these forces?" Xu Ping couldn’t help but frown and ponder, "The only thing certain should be the forces of another country."
After all, in Yue Country, there’s no force daring to offend all sects simultaneously, including Luoyun Sect.
"But what is their purpose in doing this?"
"Could they fear sparking a national war?"
Xu Ping furrowed his brow, suddenly considering this possibility.
In the history of Yue Country, foreign invasions occurred, usually when Nascent Soul cultivators fell, and Yue Country lacked new Nascent Soul cultivators.
Yet, Luoyun Sect’s Nascent Soul elder is still alive, how could an invasion occur at this critical moment?
"Wait..." Xu Ping seemed to recall something, furrowed his brow in deep thought, "How old is Luoyun Sect’s Nascent Soul elder this year? Seems... over nine hundred years old?"
The lifespan limit for Nascent Soul cultivators is just a thousand years, but few live to reach this limit; like Luoyun Sect’s Nascent Soul elder reaching this age is considered nearing the limit.
"Logically, Nascent Soul cultivators nearing their limit are the last to be provoked, yet foreign forces invaded daringly, could some change have occurred?"
Upon thinking this, Xu Ping couldn’t help but feel nervous.
His understanding was still too limited, although he had a Foundation Establishment cultivation, he was still trivial compared to the entire country.
Should a foreign invasion event occur, even Golden Core cultivators probably wouldn’t be able to control their fate, let alone Foundation Establishment cultivators, who were merely advanced pawns.
"Sigh, still too weak," Xu Ping sighed involuntarily.
But he wasn’t one to wallow in self-pity; he quickly adjusted his mindset.
"The most important thing now is to find a safe haven and slowly gather information," Xu Ping began pondering his next plan.
The situation being unclear, he couldn’t roam randomly, better to find a secluded small place and stay there.
When a foreign invasion does indeed happen, such a remote area would likely see battles slow to reach, providing time for preparation without chaos.
More importantly, there wouldn’t be cultivators there threatening him.
Having exposed Sword Qi Thunder Sound, he barely counted as a known figure in Yue Country, encountering high-stage cultivators could cause unnecessary trouble.
"Where should I go?" Xu Ping’s mind flashed across the various regions of Yue Country, contemplating, when suddenly a loud noise from the sky startled him.
Boom!
"Is it the pursuers?" Xu Ping’s heart tightened, hurriedly controlling the Rat Demon to rush towards the source of the noise.
Underground, through the Rat Demon’s view, he observed the fierce battle in the skies.
At that moment.
A massive Second-stage Middle Grade Wind Hunting Eagle and an Early-Stage Foundation Establishment old man were engaged in a fierce confrontation in the air.
Whoosh!
The Wind Hunting Eagle suddenly spread its wings, rushing forth, countless luminescent feathers shot towards the old man like raindrops.
Seeing this, the old man hastily summoned an earth-yellow round shield in front of him.
Boom boom boom...
The earth-yellow round shield was blasted to pieces under the intense bombardment of feathers, but fortunately, it bought the old man time to deploy other means to barely fend off the fatal blow.
"Is this... Zhang Yu?"
Recognizing the old man, Xu Ping showed surprise, unexpected that with only Early-Stage Foundation Establishment, he managed to escape Qiu Xuan Mountain?
However, his current situation wasn’t great, being repeatedly repelled by the Wind Hunting Eagle, facing grave danger.
Xu Ping hesitated for a moment before deciding to help after checking that the surroundings were clear.
Yet, it seemed he acted a bit late.
"Boom!"
Another loud noise, Zhang Yu was struck by the Wind Hunting Eagle’s feathers, spraying blood wildly, his face showed agony, unable to hold on, he plummeted from mid-air.
"Slash!"
Xu Ping suddenly acted, wielding the Purple Sun Sword, his Dantian’s mana surged instantly, accompanied by thunder sounds, a ray of Sword Qi burst forth like a rainbow, aiming straight at the Wind Hunting Eagle.

chapters.title: Chapter 130: Hundred Thousand Mountains
chapters.content:
Chapter 130: Chapter 130: Hundred Thousand Mountains
The Sword Qi carried an invisible might, and the Wind Hunting Eagle seemed to sense danger. It turned its head and saw a fierce glow in its eyes, ready to launch an attack, but suddenly heard a crisp bell sound.
Ding ding...
The Wind Hunting Eagle’s expression became bewildered, and when it snapped back to its senses, it saw a strand of Sword Qi slashing down towards its head.
Crack!
The Wind Hunting Eagle’s head was instantly severed, blood splattering everywhere, a piercing scream echoing in the night sky.
"Zhang Daoist!" Xu Ping quickly made his way to the spot where Zhang Yu had fallen, having dealt with the Wind Hunting Eagle.
Just when Xu Ping found Zhang Yu, his situation was quite dire.
There were dozens of Wind Hunting Eagle’s feathers, as hard as steel, embedded in his body, one of which had pierced through his heart, causing blood to gush out like a spring, staining the ground bright red.
Yet, the strong vitality of a Foundation Establishment Cultivator lingered, preserving his last breath.
Zhang Yu turned his head with difficulty, and upon seeing Xu Ping, managed a strained smile.
’At least I won’t be devoured by beasts.’
But that smile quickly faded away, as his life slowly ebbed away with his breath.
"A step too late." Xu Ping shook his head helplessly, feeling no sorrow or regret.
After all, they weren’t very familiar with each other, and he wasn’t sure if there was an ambush around. Rushing in without caution would only put himself in peril.
Xu Ping took useful items from Zhang Yu’s body and was preparing to burn his corpse when he suddenly paused.
"Wait!"
"The Ten Thousand Mountains seem like a good place!"
Xu Ping’s eyes lit up.
The Ten Thousand Mountains are remote, and the strongest forces there are merely Foundation Establishment, perfectly fitting his requirements.
What’s more important is that the complex terrain makes it very easy to hide.
"But the second-stage spiritual lands in the Ten Thousand Mountains appear to be claimed, making it difficult to find a place to cultivate!" Xu Ping furrowed his brows slightly.
Not only are the second-stage spiritual lands in the Ten Thousand Mountains claimed, but almost all the second-stage spiritual lands in Yue Country are under someone’s control.
Unclaimed spiritual lands are few and far between, even among those of no repute.
With this in mind, he felt a bit agitated about how to find a stable place to cultivate.
As his gaze swept over Zhang Yu’s corpse, a bold idea sprang from his mind:
"Perhaps... I could use the Thousand Illusion Mask to disguise as Zhang Yu."
Firstly, the disguise ability of the Thousand Illusion Mask is undisputed. Even if he hadn’t used it to devour Zhang Yu’s blood essence and soul, blood alone would suffice.
As long as there’s no Golden Core Cultivator, not even a Fake Pill Cultivator could detect his disguise.
Moreover, Zhang Yu’s family only has him as a Foundation Establishment, and his life is nearing its end, having only a few years left, which is why he ventured to Qiu Xuan Immortal City to fend off the beast tide in hopes of earning a Foundation Establishment Pill.
If he returns to the Zhang family as Zhang Yu, he would be revered, with no one daring to question him.
Furthermore, due to his nearing end, he could abandon this identity anytime.
Most importantly, apart from him, no one knows that the real Zhang Yu is already dead.
After contemplating for a long time, Xu Ping felt this method was highly feasible.
As for inconsistencies in daily life, such issues were not significant.
