He planned to pretend to be severely injured, requiring secluded recovery. Even if he secluded himself for years, it was likely no one would dare pull him out.
"Settled then."
Xu Ping finally decided to disguise himself as Zhang Yu and blend into the family, knowing that even if discovered, no one could detain him.
He took some of Zhang Yu’s blood for the Thousand Illusion Mask to devour and absorb, then adhered it to his face.
In an instant, Xu Ping’s features, aura, and height underwent a drastic transformation, becoming identical to Zhang Yu.
Even his voice matched perfectly.
"From now on, I shall live in your place." An elderly voice erupted from Xu Ping’s mouth.
He then flicked his fingers, and a fireball landed on Zhang Yu’s corpse.
With a ’boom’, it burned to ashes in an instant, and with a gentle breeze, it completely dissipated into the air.
"Time to leave."
After finishing all this, Xu Ping activated his Escape Light and hurried towards the Ten Thousand Mountains.
...
...
A month later.
Qianzhu Marketplace.
Renowned for its rich production of spirit bamboo, Qianzhu Marketplace offers a wide variety of spirit bamboo types, some used for making talisman materials, others specifically for crafting First Rank magic swords, etc... Offering extensive uses.
Thus, the foot traffic at Qianzhu Marketplace was significantly higher than at typical marketplaces.
"Qiu Xuan Immortal City has fallen, leaving major cultivation factions severely harmed!"
"Who could disagree? Even Zihuan Master and Qiu Xuan Ancestor met death or fled, with countless Foundation Establishment and Qi Cultivation casualties."
...
In a tavern, diners were discussing recent events shocking the entirety of Yue Country.
Disguised as a late-stage Qi Cultivation cultivator, Xu Ping sat in the corner, listening silently.
"Unexpectedly, Hu Country leveraged the beast tide to breach Qiu Xuan Immortal City, now occupying some lands in Yue Country, coming with ferocity!" a slightly plump diner remarked with concern.
"For us penniless Loose Cultivators, it might not be entirely bad." His companion chimed in.
"Oh? Why do you say that?" The plump diner looked puzzled.
"If Yue Country is stagnant, how could we Loose Cultivators seize opportunities? The more chaotic Yue Country becomes, the greater the opportunities!" His companion’s eyes gleamed with excitement.
"But ultimately, it’s a conflict between nations; we, as Loose Cultivators, can’t avoid being affected!" The plump diner remained worried.
"What’s there to fear? At worst, find a place to hide; even if Hu Country conquers Yue Country, it’s just a change of rulers." His companion answered indifferently.
Loose Cultivators are usually found at the bottom of the exploitation chain, most having little attachment to their homeland.
"That’s true. As for the rumors circulating, is it true that the Nascent Soul Ancestor of Luoyun Sect is critically injured and dying?" The plump diner asked in a lowered voice.
"It’s likely true; otherwise, Hu Country wouldn’t dare invade so boldly." His companion also lowered his voice.
’Hu Country invasion, Nascent Soul Ancestor critically injured and dying...’ These weighty rumors felt like boulders dropping into water, creating huge waves in Xu Ping’s heart.
After listening for a while longer without acquiring more useful news, he paid for his Spirit Food and promptly left the tavern.
"Truly, with another nation’s invasion, Yue Country seems destined for unrest!" Xu Ping sighed slightly in his heart.
Regarding the rumors of the Nascent Soul Ancestor’s critical injury and impending death, he also believed it was highly probable.
Even if not critically injured and dying, their condition likely wasn’t far from drastic.
Hu Country’s actions clearly carry an exploratory intent.
They didn’t mobilize their entire nation for invasion, yet dismantled a Golden Core faction of Yue Country, seemingly to test the reaction of Luoyun Sect, accurately speaking, the Nascent Soul Ancestor’s reaction.
Regardless, it’s best to first head to the Zhang family for refuge.
Even if Hu Country mobilizes fully for invasion, places like the Ten Thousand Mountains wouldn’t likely attract much attention.
Sending a few Fake Pills would be impressive, and by then, using the Thousand Illusion Mask’s ability to hide, even Fake Pill Cultivators definitely couldn’t detect any flaw.

chapters.title: Chapter 131: Seizing the Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 131: Chapter 131: Seizing the Mountain
Ten Thousand Mountains.
The Zhang clan, clan land at Cangyuan Mountain.
Cangyuan Mountain spans over twenty miles, with a Second-stage Middle Grade Spirit Vein in the mountain. It is said that hundreds of years ago, this was the territory of the Second-stage Demon Beast, the Blue Ape.
Later, the Zhang clan’s ancestor slew it, took over this Spirit Vein treasure land, and founded this cultivation family by marrying and taking concubines.
At the summit of Cangyuan Mountain, inside a grand hall, more than ten Late-Stage Qi Cultivators sit quietly, the air filled with an oppressive atmosphere, as if even time itself has frozen.
Finally, a venerable old man at the ninth level of Qi Cultivation slowly speaks, breaking the silence: "Now that the Clan Leader’s whereabouts are unknown, Langqing is continually provoking us with a group of Loose Cultivators. We must provide an explanation today."
"What explanation? We need to give them a stern lesson to show them that even without the Clan Leader, we are not to be trifled with." A hot-tempered cultivator bursts into anger, slamming the table, his voice like thunder.
"That’s inappropriate. Langqing is only at the ninth level of Qi Cultivation. Since he dares to gather so many Loose Cultivators to cause trouble for us, there must be someone manipulating him from behind. He’s trying to use Langqing to test our strength."
Someone argues back and calmly analyzes, "The person behind him probably wants us to battle with Langqing."
"But if we don’t respond, they might take advantage and directly attack our Cangyuan Mountain," another person expresses concern.
"Neither this nor that is possible, what exactly should we do?" The hot-tempered cultivator glares in anger.
...
Underground, Xu Ping, controlling a Rat Demon, silently listens to their dispute.
The Rat Demon has been lurking here for several days, and he has already mostly figured out the personnel structure of the Zhang clan.
Over a hundred Qi Cultivators, with more than ten elders at the Late-Stage Qi Cultivation.
In terms of strength, they’re considered top-tier within the entirety of Ten Thousand Mountains.
After all, throughout Ten Thousand Mountains, there are only four Foundation Establishment families and sects.
But now that Zhang Yu’s whereabouts are unknown, their days are not easy.
The Second-stage Spirit Vein without Foundation Establishment guardians is a tempting piece of meat.
Other Foundation Establishment forces are certainly envious, and Langqing is definitely supported by some Foundation Establishment forces, though it’s unclear exactly how many.
"Now Hu Country is invading Yue Country, while Ten Thousand Mountains is still mutually vying for benefits," Xu Ping shakes his head helplessly.
At that moment, a middle-aged man rushes into the hall in panic:
"Elder, it’s bad, Langqing and a group of Loose Cultivators have killed several of our clan members and are gathering at the foot of Cangyuan Mountain, threatening to storm the mountain and wipe out our clan."
"What!"
The elders in the hall are furious, there’s no need for discussion; they’re already being besieged, failing to respond will lead to annihilation.
"Gather everyone and destroy all the invading enemies!" said the venerable ninth-level Qi Cultivation elder, with a look of anger.
His name is Zhang Qingfeng, the great elder of the Zhang clan.
"Elder, should we call Elder Zhang Yan?" The middle-aged man hesitated.
The elder hesitated for a moment and slowly said, "Call him, after all, he is still a clan member of the Zhang clan."
’Zhang Yan?’
Upon hearing this name through the Rat Demon, Xu Ping frowned slightly, "Same name?"
Although Zhang Yan mentioned he would return to Ten Thousand Mountains to visit his clan, there are quite a few people in Ten Thousand Mountains with the surname Zhang.
Moreover, in recent days, using the Rat Demon to scout Cangyuan Mountain, there has been no sign of Zhang Yan.
Thinking for a while.
Xu Ping decided to control the Rat Demon to follow the middle-aged man through numerous twists and turns, finally arriving at a small courtyard in Cangyuan Mountain.
This courtyard is too secluded; in recent days almost no one from the Zhang clan has visited, hence he hadn’t come here either.
Xu Ping controlled the Rat Demon to enter the courtyard ahead.
Under an old tree in the courtyard, a figure sat limply on a chair as if without bones.
Wisps of smoke spread in the air.
He swallowed one Bliss Pill after another, occasionally taking a puff of something akin to opium from a past life. Despite being thin to the bone, his face showed extreme enjoyment.
"It really is him!"
Xu Ping couldn’t help but reveal a slight smile. Meeting an old friend in such a place was definitely pleasing.
"Elder Zhang Yan." The anxious voice of the middle-aged man sounded outside the door.
Zhang Yan frowned at the disturbance, his tone filled with displeasure: "Didn’t I tell you not to bother me!"
"Elder Zhang Yan, I didn’t mean to disturb you..."
The middle-aged man briefly explained all the recent events.
Listening to his narration, Zhang Yan’s face showed a shocked expression.
The conflict between him and the clan had not dissipated, so since he returned, he hadn’t been much in contact with clan members, mostly living alone.
He was unaware of many external affairs, and now, hearing the narration, he realized the magnitude of the events outside.
But upon hearing about someone taking advantage of the Clan Leader’s unknown whereabouts to rob, anger appeared on Zhang Yan’s face: "Let’s go! I’ll go with you to obliterate this band of thieves!"
Although his conflict with the clan was unresolved, he was still part of the clan and naturally couldn’t sit idly.
"Okay." The middle-aged man showed joy and took Zhang Yan quickly towards the foot of Cangyuan Mountain.
With Elder Zhang Yan, being a Late-Stage Qi Cultivator who returned from Qiu Xuan Immortal City, the advantage in battle was significant.
When Xu Ping, controlling the Rat Demon, followed them to the foot of Cangyuan Mountain, the two groups were confronting each other.
One group was led by Elder Zhang Qingfeng of the Zhang clan, the other by a fierce-looking, red-skinned middle-aged cultivator.
"Humph! If you Zhang clan quickly vacate Cangyuan Mountain, I might spare your entire clan. Otherwise, today will be your Zhang clan’s extinction day." The middle-aged cultivator sneered, his threat apparent.
"Langqing, you have quite the mouth. A dog who used to bow down to our Zhang clan, now having found a new master, dares to bark so boldly?"
The elderliness of Zhang Qingfeng was evident; his words were like sharp swords, piercing Langqing, causing him to shake in anger.
"You old fool at death’s door, today marks the end for your Zhang clan." Langqing stopped the verbal fight, issuing a command, and both sides engaged in battle, with deafening roars.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
"Ah!"
The battle had just begun, and some Loose Cultivators were killed by the Zhang clan members.
Both sides had similar numbers, but in terms of Cultivation, Mana, and talismans, the Zhang clan members clearly had an edge.
And Zhang Yan even faced two Late-Stage Qi Cultivation Loose Cultivators on his own, suppressing them steadily.
In a short time, the battlefield showed a one-sided situation.
"A mere rabble dares to attack my Zhang clan!" Zhang Qingfeng wielded an Upper Grade Magical Artifact, pushing Langqing back repeatedly.
"Hmph!" Langqing snorted coldly, secretly anxious at heart, wondering why reinforcements hadn’t arrived yet.
Suddenly.
Whoosh!
"Ah!"
An artifact resembling a flying shuttle, in a surprise attack, cut off the head of a Zhang clan elder, causing blood to gush out.

chapters.title: Chapter 132: The Clan Leader Has Returned
chapters.content:
Chapter 132: Chapter 132: The Clan Leader Has Returned
From the woods on the left, twenty cultivators flew out, each with a magical artifact in hand.
The leader, a dark-skinned brawny man, stood on a blazing red saber, with a centipede-like scar stretching almost to his neck, adding fierceness to his appearance.
The mana fluctuations from him clearly reached the ninth level of Qi Refinement!
"Zhuo Yao!"
Several cultivators from the Zhang family exclaimed in surprise.
Zhuo Yao, like Langqing, was a renowned loose cultivator in the Ten Thousand Mountains and the leader of the Weihu Gang.
"Zhuo Yao! How dare you attack our Zhang clan!" Zhang Qingfeng’s tone was icy and filled with anger.
"If your Clan Leader was here, I might fear you a bit, but now that your Clan Leader has been devoured by beasts, your Zhang clan is just a toothless tiger." Zhuo Yao mocked.
"Stop wasting words with him; let’s kill this old man first." Langqing sneered, performing a magic technique and manipulated his magical artifact to attack.
With reinforcements arriving, his confidence soared, determined to kill this old man.
"Kill! Make it quick!" With Zhuo Yao’s command, the cultivators behind him leaped into action, joining the battle.
He himself also manipulated a shuttle-shaped magical artifact, teaming up with Langqing to engage Zhang Qingfeng in battle.
Buzz!
Zhang Qingfeng’s face was serious as he cast a spell, his upper-grade magical artifact burst forth with intense spiritual light and shot out to entangle with the two’s magical artifacts.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Red, white, and yellow lights clashed fiercely, and neither side could gain the upper hand.
At this moment, Langqing’s expression turned even fiercer. Performing a magic technique, his originally reddish skin became even redder, as if blood was flowing beneath it.
The next moment, he lunged at Zhang Qingfeng with terrifying speed, almost reaching him in the blink of an eye.
Zhang Qingfeng tensed, quickly crushing a talisman, and golden light enveloped him instantly.
Boom!
A fist glowing red slammed heavily against the Golden Light Shield, producing a deafening roar.
Though Zhang Qingfeng was protected by an upper-grade magical artifact, facing the swift combined assault of both opponents, he was quickly put at a disadvantage.
Meanwhile, other members of the Zhang clan were also struggling in battle.
Despite their greater battle prowess, the enemy’s numbers were overwhelming, and the Weihu Gang’s magical artifacts were of excellent quality, nearly matching their own.
For a time, they were pushed back, suffering continuous casualties.
"Ah!"
A Wind Blade several feet long swept through a Zhang cultivator.
He could only let out a scream before his head was separated from his body, blood spurting and startling those around.
"Damn thieves!"
Seeing continuous casualties in the family, Zhang Qingfeng gritted his teeth in immense anger, wishing to slay them all.
But at this moment, they fell into absolute disadvantage and could not fight head-on.
"Quick, make for the top of Cangyuan Mountain!" Zhang Qingfeng shouted loudly.
Upon hearing, everyone immediately disengaged from the battlefield and made their way toward Cangyuan Mountain.
"You won’t escape so easily," the loose cultivators immediately gave chase.
"Humph!"
Zhang Qingfeng snorted coldly, tossing a handful of talismans, interrupting their pursuit.
Once the spiritual light dissipated, the Zhang clan had already fled far away.
"Fellow Daoists, the Zhang clan has been around for hundreds of years; their wealth is unimaginable. As long as we take down Cangyuan Mountain, everything of the Zhang clan’s will be ours!"
Langqing’s voice thundered across the land.
Hearing this, the loose cultivators’ eyes glinted greedily, and they all rushed toward the top of Cangyuan Mountain.
...
On a distant hill, a man in green robes watched the scene from afar, muttering to himself, "With the current situation, Zhang Yu has yet to take action. It seems he really has fallen prey to beasts, and this second-stage spiritual land shall belong to my Li family."
Having said this, he mounted his Escape Light and flew toward Cangyuan Mountain.
Not long after he left, a giant Rat Demon emerged from the ground, watching him go before burrowing back into the earth.
...
Atop Cangyuan Mountain, a layer of spiritual light shielded the entire mountaintop, resembling an indestructible fortress.
Boom! Boom! Boom...
Outside the shield, over a hundred cultivators continuously attacked the array with magical artifacts, but they couldn’t budge the shield even an inch.
"This damned tortoiseshell is too tough!"
After another round of failed attacks, Langqing grew frustrated.
Facing a second-stage array, these Qi cultivators were simply powerless.
Inside the shield.
Zhang Qingfeng’s calm voice reached everyone’s ears, "The array is connected to the Spirit Vein, absolutely unbreakable."
Upon hearing this, the Zhang cultivators relaxed a little, though their tension remained.
Outnumbered and out-equipped, they had already lost ten clan members after just a short battle.
With only about a hundred cultivators in their clan, losing ten was a devastating blow.
If they continued to fight, they might face annihilation.
As the Zhang cultivators slightly eased, a golden light blade split the sky and struck the spiritual light shield heavily.
Rumble!
A deafening sound spread across the top of Cangyuan Mountain, even causing the spirit-light-enshrouded buildings to tremble.
"What happened?"
Inside the spiritual shield, Zhang cultivators were filled with terror.
"Li Zhengyu!"
Zhang Qingfeng’s gaze pierced the shield, fixating on the green-robed cultivator hovering mid-air.
Li Zhengyu, a Foundation Establishment cultivator, and the Clan Leader of the Li family.
"Zhang clan, abandon the array, and I’ll spare your bloodline. Refuse, and I’ll kill you all," Li Zhengyu said coldly, wielding the golden light blade.
"Clan Leader Li, our families have been allied for generations; you..." Zhang Qingfeng began, only to be cut off by Li Zhengyu. "Spare me the nonsense. I’ll give you a hundred breaths to decide. A second-stage array without a Foundation Establishment cultivator can’t stop me."
"We choose to fight to the death, until the last moment," a fiercely loyal Zhang cultivator roared in anger.
"Dying in vain is meaningless; better to preserve the bloodline," another Zhang cultivator said fearfully.
"That’s cowardice,"
...
Listening to the intense arguing between the two sides, Zhang Qingfeng opened his mouth to intervene but found himself at a loss for words.
"Oh? Is that so? You speak of destroying my Zhang clan with such boldness!" At that moment, a voice of fury echoed from afar.
People turned to see an elderly man with white hair standing in the void, his aura turbulent, eyes fixed on Li Zhengyu.
Anyone could see his fury at this moment.
"Clan... Clan Leader!!"
The Zhang cultivators were momentarily stunned, and then their hearts surged with excitement, almost jumping from their chests.
Li Zhengyu’s face darkened instantly, losing all previous composure.
’I didn’t expect this old guy to return alive!’
His mind raced, and finally, he forced a smile, "Zhang Daoist, this is a misunderstanding."
Zhang Yu’s life was nearing its end, and he wouldn’t want to clash directly.
"Misunderstanding? You instigated loose cultivators to kill my people, a misunderstanding?"
"Enough nonsense; today, I will make you pay!" ’Zhang Yu’ roared, eyes blazing, as he summoned a long saber wrapped in red light.
The fiery saber light slicing through the air, aimed straight at Li Zhengyu.

chapters.title: Chapter 133: Execution
chapters.content:
Chapter 133: Chapter 133: Execution
"Hmph!" Li Zhengyu snorted coldly, and a golden light blade met the attack.
He knew this battle was unavoidable.
The blade light and the golden light blade intersected in mid-air, instantly bursting with dazzling radiance, like stars falling, with a deafening roar echoing all around.
The surrounding cultivators retreated one after another, their faces showing fear, as the battle between Foundation Establishment cultivators was indeed terrifying.
Zhang Yu’s red glowing long blade was as scorching as flames, the blade surged fiercely, like a rampant fire dragon, charging straight at Li Zhengyu.
Li Zhengyu’s expression was serious, the golden light blade in his hand constantly changing to counterattack.
"Go!"
Zhang Yu flicked his finger, a black needle magical artifact turned into a slender silent shadow, silently stabbing at Li Zhengyu’s back.
Li Zhengyu’s face slightly changed; having fought against the opponent many times, he naturally knew how formidable this black needle magical artifact was.
He flipped his hand and summoned a yellow parasol, which flew behind him and opened, spinning continuously.
Rays of slightly hazy yellow light draped down from the parasol, quickly forming a cylindrical yellow light curtain around him.
Thud!
The black needle magical artifact pierced through the yellow cylindrical light curtain and struck heavily against the yellow parasol, causing a loud bang, but at least it blocked the attack.
Before he could catch his breath, Zhang Yan’s frontal assault suddenly intensified.
Zhang Yan slashed; the blade light and flames, accompanied by a terrifying spiritual pressure, surged at Li Zhengyu, making him feel suffocated.
"Zhang Yu, do you really want to fight to the death?" Li Zhengyu’s face changed dramatically.
Even though this guy is almost out of life, his combat power is indeed stronger than an average early-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
Zhang Yan remains silent, his spiritual pressure even increasing again, the heat from the flames distorting the surrounding air.
"This Zhang family clan leader is so strong, he actually suppresses Clan Leader Li!" Langqing’s eyes flashed with fear. If he were to fight against him, he probably couldn’t withstand even one move.
At this moment, Zhuo Yao’s face was also extremely ugly.
The two exchanged glances and saw a hint of regret in each other’s eyes.
If they had known earlier, they definitely wouldn’t have been swayed by Li Zhengyu to attack the Zhang family.
The Zhang family’s clan leader is powerful; once he frees his hands, they won’t have a chance to survive.
But there’s no medicine for regret in the world; now, they only hope Zhang Yu is entangled with Li Zhengyu, allowing them to escape immediately.
Without consulting each other, the two simultaneously fled towards the foot of Cangyuan Mountain.
The other loose cultivators, seeing this, didn’t hesitate and began fleeing for their lives.
Li Zhengyu glimpsed this scene from the corner of his eye, gritting his teeth almost to breaking point. While he was fighting to the death, those damned loose cultivators ran away.
He must kill them all!
But right now, the most important thing is to deal with this mad dog Zhang Yu. Even if not his match, he must let him know he is not to be trifled with!
"Slash!"
Li Zhengyu shouted lowly, the golden light blade in his hand suddenly brightened intensely, like a blazing sun, shooting straight at Zhang Yu.
The blade light arced like a rainbow, with an unmatched momentum, slashing towards Zhang Yu’s face.
"Hmph!"
Zhang Yan snorted coldly, neither evading nor dodging, flipped his hand and summoned a black shield, which expanded several feet in the wind, blocking in front of him.
Thud!
The blade light struck the shield, causing a deafening explosion that echoed across Cangyuan Mountain, a wave of invisible spiritual Qi sweeping in all directions, even slightly flickering the second-stage array.
"Die!"
Blocking Li Zhengyu’s attack, Zhang Yan’s mana surged, the long blade magical artifact in his hand flashing with a burst of light, a flame rising instantly, then transforming into a gigantic fire dragon, charging directly at Li Zhengyu.
The fire dragon, claws and teeth bared, seemed intent on devouring Li Zhengyu.
"Not good!"
Li Zhengyu, startled in his heart, pumped all his mana into the yellow parasol.
"Protect!"
The yellow parasol suddenly surged with light, forming multiple layers of yellow light curtains around him, attempting to withstand this terrifying attack.
However, the power of the fire dragon far exceeded his expectations, and with the yellow parasol having already endured multiple attacks, its internal structure showed some signs of damage.
Bang!
The yellow light curtain shattered on the spot, turning into countless yellow streams of light, and even the yellow parasol above Li Zhengyu’s head emitted cracking sounds, seemingly about to break completely in the next moment.
"Friend Zhang, stop, I am willing to compensate for all the losses the Zhang family suffered today!" Li Zhengyu showed fear and began to plead.
"I only want your death!"
Zhang Yan was not moved in the slightest, his onslaught suddenly intensified!
Buzz!
The fire dragon’s body expanded once more, the void seemingly distorted from the scorching heat.
Finally!
Under this fierce attack, the yellow parasol that had protected Li Zhengyu for so long could no longer hold, shattering with a "tearing" sound into seven or eight pieces, losing all its spiritual nature.
"Spare... spare me!!" Li Zhengyu screamed in terror, "I have secret techniques to enhance Foundation Establishment. If you spare me, I am willing to hand them over to you!"
"Secret techniques to enhance Foundation Establishment?" Xu Ping paused slightly; such a secret technique, if true, would be invaluable, though utterly useless to him.
Unless it’s a technique to enhance Core Formation!
"Die!"
Xu Ping formed a magic technique with a pinch, the red dragon hovering in the air roared and charged directly at Li Zhengyu.
"No!"
In Li Zhengyu’s terrified eyes, the giant fire dragon engulfed him whole.
Bang!
After swallowing him, the fire dragon exploded, countless fire sparks falling like meteors, amidst which a charred corpse plummeted heavily to the ground.
Inside the array, the Zhang family members were dumbfounded, deathly silent.
Once the corpse hit the ground, everyone finally shouted out, "Ah!"
Afterwards, the entire place fell silent once more.
When did their clan leader become so fierce!
But thinking carefully, it seemed quite reasonable.
Li Zhengyu was a newly minted Foundation Establishment cultivator, and their Li family had just risen as a Foundation Establishment family, lacking both strength and foundation compared to their clan leader.
The clan leader fought with all his might out of resentment, slaying him was not surprising.
"Finally, it’s resolved!"
In mid-air, Xu Ping quietly let out a sigh of relief, knowing clearly that the opponent was easily resolved within a few strikes, yet the battle dragged on this long, concealing anything abnormal from others was indeed exhausting.
Xu Ping landed beside Li Zhengyu.
His entire body was charred, even his robe was burnt to ashes, but luckily the storage ring was intact.
After removing it, Xu Ping incinerated his corpse to ashes with a fireball.
"Clan leader is mighty!"
At this moment, someone shouted from the crowd, and the other Zhang family cultivators followed suit, "Clan leader is mighty!"
Such a Foundation Establishment cultivator!
There were not many in the entire Ten Thousand Mountains, and he was slain just like that by their clan leader!
How could they not be overwhelmingly excited!
"Clan leader!"
At that moment, Zhang Qingfeng opened the array and led a group of elders to greet Xu Ping.
"Hm."
Xu Ping nodded slightly and said, "Let’s talk in the main hall."

chapters.title: Chapter 134: Secret Technique
chapters.content:
Chapter 134: Chapter 134: Secret Technique
A secluded hall in Cangyuan Mountain.
With the prowess of slaying a Foundation Establishment, Xu Ping recounted his perilous journey of escape, to which Zhang Qingfeng, without doubting him, couldn’t help but lament, "Clan Leader, this journey was truly fraught with danger!"
However, when he heard that Xu Ping was injured, he couldn’t help but feel anxious, "Is the Clan Leader’s injury healed?"
For the Zhang family, a Foundation Establishment cultivator is extremely important; today’s attack on the mountain was a bloody lesson.
Xu Ping sighed, "It’s not that easy. Coupled with today’s excessive expenditure, I’m afraid I need to enter seclusion for a long time to recover. The clan affairs will rely on you for now."
"Please rest and recover at ease, Clan Leader. I will handle all the clan matters properly," Zhang Qingfeng nodded.
"Do not provoke any trouble recently. Forgive the Li family and those loose cultivators for the time being," Xu Ping further instructed, "Pay attention to Hu Country’s movements, and if there are any major events, remember to inform me with a Sound Transmission Talisman!"
"Understood!" Although reluctant to let go of the Li family and those loose cultivators, Zhang Qingfeng had to obey since it was the Clan Leader’s order.
"Clan Leader, did you manage to obtain the Foundation Establishment Pill?" Zhang Qingfeng asked tentatively.
"No!" Xu Ping shook his head helplessly, "My war achievements haven’t been accumulated enough, and Qiu Xuan Immortal City was already breached. It’s a pity, I spent quite a few Spirit Stones on buying achievements, and now it’s all for nothing."
Hearing this, Zhang Qingfeng couldn’t help but feel a touch of disappointment, but he quickly composed himself, thinking it was already a blessing that the Clan Leader returned safely.
"I will now enter seclusion to heal. Do not disturb me unless it’s urgent!" With that, Xu Ping got up and headed towards his abode.
...
As the only Foundation Establishment cultivator of the Zhang family, Zhang Yu naturally resided at the very center of the Second-stage Spirit Vein.
Xu Ping took out the token that controlled the array, performed a spell, and the spiritual radiance of the array guarding the abode dissipated, revealing the complete abode.
A spiritual pond ten yards wide came into view, with a pavilion in the middle and a luxurious two-story building in the front.
"This place is quite nice."
After surveying around, Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction; although the Spiritual Qi was a bit lacking, the environment was quite good.
He swept his Divine Sense around and after ensuring there was nothing unusual, he took out over a dozen array flags from his storage bag and planted them in various corners of the small courtyard.
Next, Xu Ping took out a gray array plate, inserted several Mid-grade Spirit Stones, and performed a spell.
Buzz!
The array plate glowed gently, emanating a wave of spiritual light, and at this moment, the array flags planted in the corners of the small courtyard also began to shimmer with spiritual light.
Under the cooperation of the array plate and array flags, a layer of spiritual light shield enveloped the entire abode.
Swoosh!
At this moment, a strong suction burst forth from the spiritual light shield, continuously absorbing Spiritual Qi from the outside.
Quickly, the Spiritual Qi inside the abode became abundant, almost forming a thin layer of mist.
"This Second-stage Spirit Gathering Array is indeed useful!"
Xu Ping felt the concentration of Spiritual Qi carefully, and a look of satisfaction appeared on his face.
The Spiritual Qi concentration here was almost comparable to the Second-stage Upper Grade Spirit Vein, more than sufficient for his cultivation.
After setting up the array, Xu Ping walked into the cultivation room.
He sat cross-legged on the futon, took out Li Zhengyu’s Storage Ring, easily removed the Divine Sense imprint on it.
Then, he explored inside with his Divine Sense and poured all the contents out.
Swoosh!
A huge pile of things was poured out instantly, but although the items were many, they were all worthless stuff.
"So poor!"
Xu Ping carefully counted them, and all the items together only amounted to about a thousand Spirit Stones, poorer than an ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivator.
However, on second thought, it made sense.
After all, the other party was just a newly-promoted Foundation Establishment, and his family was originally a small Qi Cultivation family, whose status rose in the Ten Thousand Mountains thanks to his breakthrough into Foundation Establishment.
Xu Ping quickly stored all the items one by one.
It was just that a cultivation technique called the "Thousand Leaves Scripture" caught his attention.
Originally, he wasn’t very interested, but as he casually flipped through a few pages, he immediately perked up.
This technique was rather mysterious, unlike ordinary techniques.
As expected when he reached the end, it turned out to be a technique that led directly to the Late-Stage Golden Core.
One should know that even the clan technique of the Zhang family that had existed for hundreds of years only extends to the Early Stage Golden Core.
Evidently, this cultivation technique was definitely not something his previous Qi Cultivation family could possess.
"To achieve Foundation Establishment with the background of a small Qi Cultivation family, certainly means there was a fortunate encounter," Xu Ping thought to himself.
Seeing this, the "Thousand Leaves Scripture" could only be considered a decent cultivation technique, but when he flipped to the last page, Xu Ping was shocked.
It recorded a secret technique to improve the success rate of Foundation Establishment and Core Formation respectively!
"This... what an unexpected surprise!"
Xu Ping was ecstatic, not expecting that merely killing an ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivator would yield such precious secret techniques.
If these two secret techniques were to be revealed, not to mention the Golden Core forces, even the Nascent Soul forces might eye it eagerly.
After all, besides the Celestial Spirit Root, which does not face the bottleneck of breaking through to the Core Formation Stage, all cultivators are obstructed by this hurdle.
To breakthrough Foundation Establishment Realm, there is the Foundation Establishment Pill which significantly improves success rates, but for Golden Core, there is no such pill.
The rarest item for assisting in Core Formation only barely increases the success rate by ten percent, yet it is enough to drive countless Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators into madness.
Frankly speaking, even with the proficiency panel in hand, he wasn’t very confident about achieving Golden Core.
Now, obtaining a method to significantly improve the Core Formation success rate so easily, how could he not be excited?
"No wonder Li Zhengyu could achieve Foundation Establishment with a background not much stronger than a loose cultivator. This secret technique definitely played a crucial role."
"Let’s take a look at this secret technique first!"
He took a deep breath, calmed his excitement, and began to carefully read this secret technique for Core Formation.
As he continued to read, Xu Ping’s brows gradually furrowed.
By the end, his brows were tightly knit together, "This Core Formation secret technique, I’m afraid very few can cultivate it."
According to the secret technique, one needs to be a cultivator at Late-Stage Foundation Establishment, disperse their cultivation to Early-Stage Foundation Establishment and then retrain themselves, while compressing their liquid mana several-fold during retraining with the secret technique.
After this process thrice, the liquid mana in their body would be a step away from solidification.
The Golden Core is originally formed from the long-crystallized liquid mana in the Dantian. At that time, forming a core would certainly be much easier, probably increasing the success rate by thirty to forty percent.
However, although this idea seems good, implementing it is extremely difficult.
One must know that even with Upper Grade Spirit Roots, smoothly cultivating to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment takes at least a hundred years.
At that time, dispersing cultivation for retraining will still require three cycles, and even if retraining is faster, their lifespan is certainly not enough.

chapters.title: Chapter 135: Body Refining Breakthrough
chapters.content:
Chapter 135: Chapter 135: Body Refining Breakthrough
With the cultivation speed of an Earth Spirit Root, perhaps with the aid of Pills it might barely be possible, but the most reliable choice was undoubtedly the Celestial Spirit Root.
But the Celestial Spirit Root faces no bottleneck during Core Formation and doesn’t need this troublesome Secret Technique at all.
"Can I cultivate this Secret Technique?" Xu Ping carefully assessed his advantages and quickly came to a conclusion:
I can!
Absolutely!
First of all, his lifespan far exceeds that of ordinary Foundation Establishment Cultivators.
Ordinary Foundation Establishment Cultivators have a lifespan of only two hundred years, but he has as much as two hundred seventy-three years.
Not to mention, with the rise in the Perfection Level of the Longevity Skill, his lifespan would continue to increase, far beyond the imagination of ordinary Foundation Establishment Cultivators.
Secondly, with the rise in the Perfection Level of the Longevity Skill, his cultivation speed would also greatly increase. Thinking back to when he cultivated the Five Elements Skill to Perfection, his cultivation speed had already surpassed the Earth Spirit Root.
He believed that when he cultivated the Longevity Skill to Perfection, the cultivation speed would surely not be much inferior.
The combination of the two offered huge advantages.
"This Secret Technique is of immense help to me; I will begin to try it once I reach Late-Stage Foundation Establishment."
Xu Ping couldn’t help but feel a trace of joy in his heart; the journey to the Ten Thousand Mountains was indeed not in vain, yielding such an important Secret Technique.
"It’s just that cultivating this Cultivation Technique might require a long-term, safe, and stable place." Thinking of this, Xu Ping couldn’t help but frown.
Although the Ten Thousand Mountains were temporarily considered safe and stable, if Hu Country decided to fully invade, the Ten Thousand Mountains would surely be drawn into the conflict.
"Forget it, I’m still far from Late-Stage Foundation Establishment, at least decades away; by then, this war should be long over." Xu Ping shook his head, dismissing these thoughts.
"For now, let’s focus on cultivation and increasing my strength. I’m still quite weak; even if I go all out, I can only barely match a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator."
"In the clash between the two countries, a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator is hardly worth mentioning."
"For now, the most important thing is to increase my strength as much as possible to survive future conflicts," Xu Ping contemplated.
However, rapidly increasing cultivation within a short time is unrealistic; one can only rely on external resources to enhance strength.
Thinking of this, Xu Ping flipped his hand, and a black-covered book appeared in his hand, with the characters "Heavenly Demon Disintegration" written on it:
"With my current fifty drops of liquid Mana, I should have reached the threshold for cultivating the Heavenly Demon Disintegration." He murmured to himself.
This is a demonic Secret Technique that can burn vital blood to massively enhance strength.
However, the threshold is quite high, requiring at least fifty drops of liquid Mana.
Although he had been tempted previously, he couldn’t cultivate it; now, after years of diligent cultivation, he finally reached the threshold.
"If I can refine it, then my trump cards will increase by one more." Xu Ping’s eyes gleamed brightly.
Soon, he immersed himself completely into it.
...
The patriarch of the Zhang family returned safely and killed the recently illustrious Li Zhengyu, causing a huge stir in the Ten Thousand Mountains.
"This Zhang patriarch is truly worthy of his fearsome reputation in the Ten Thousand Mountains; his strength as a decades-old Foundation Establishment Cultivator is truly terrifying!"
"Who could deny it? He killed a Foundation Establishment Cultivator just like that!"
"In the future, we’d better be more cautious when encountering cultivators from the Zhang family."
...
Many Loose Cultivators and Qi Cultivation factions were extremely shaken in their hearts.
And the Foundation Establishment forces were no better off; the matter of ’Zhang Yu’ killing a Foundation Establishment Cultivator shocked them all.
Especially several Foundation Establishment Cultivators.
"Although I’m stronger than Li Zhengyu, it would be very difficult to kill him. It seems that this Fellow Daoist Zhang, although his lifespan is almost at an end, his strength is not to be underestimated!" a burly middle-aged Foundation Establishment Cultivator murmured.
"Recently, I must restrain the clan members from provoking the Zhang family lightly."
Strong, yet nearing the end of their lifespan, Foundation Establishment Cultivators are the most terrifying.
Even though they age, their strength doesn’t decline like Qi Cultivators.
...
...
Time flies like water.
In the blink of an eye, two months passed.
During this time, Hu Country still slowly and steadily nibbled away at Yue Country’s land.
Although Luoyun Sect summoned all major forces to send personnel to resist, the Nascent Soul Cultivators did not appear, plus the previous tragic loss at Qiu Xuan Mountain, all major forces merely pretended to obey and had no desire to go all out.
Hu Country also announced that they only intended to annihilate Luoyun Sect, and that as long as other forces did not oppose them, they would be left unharmed.
This news made the minds of all major forces increasingly complicated, and rumors spread more wildly across Yue Country!
Rumors say all major Golden Core forces have already pledged allegiance to Hu Country; Luoyun Sect’s Nascent Soul Patriarch had long fallen; Hu Country’s Nascent Soul Patriarch was ready to use Thunder Power to destroy Luoyun Sect...
Such rumors were vivid, and many Loose Cultivators and even Foundation Establishment forces believed them to be true.
As a result, all of Yue Country became increasingly chaotic, with many Loose Cultivators and Foundation Establishment forces seizing the opportunity to turn into robbers, and even cases of clan massacre emerged.
However, compared to the chaos outside, the situation in the Ten Thousand Mountains in the corner of Yue Country was undoubtedly much better.
Even though during this period, many unfamiliar cultivators came to the Ten Thousand Mountains seeking refuge, causing some conflicts with local forces, the overall situation remained stable.
No one dared to provoke the major Foundation Establishment forces.
One day, at Cangyuan Mountain.
Zhang Yu’s cave dwelling, cultivation room.
Xu Ping sat in a medicinal tub, surrounded by a scarlet liquid exuding a strong bloody smell, its color gradually fading, finally becoming clear water.
Suddenly, a deep rumble like a torrent erupted from within his body, a tremendous surge of vitality mixed with intense Evil Qi surged forth.
Without using any Mana, the array within the chamber flickered chaotically.
Xu Ping abruptly opened his eyes, a flash of bloodlust passed by, a tidal wave of intense killing intent surged up in his heart, nearly compelling him to pounce toward everything alive in front of him.
This overwhelming killing intent was enough to turn even an Early-Stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator into a mindless monster of pure slaughter.
However, before Xu Ping’s powerful Divine Sense and the Perfection Level of the Taihang Nourishing God Skill, this killing intent was like an ant trying to stop a chariot, and it was quickly completely eradicated.
"Hoooo!"
Xu Ping let out a long breath, the killing intent dissipated, and the bloodlust in his eyes gradually faded.
"Second layer of the Blood Demon Body Refining."
He felt the beast-like power in his body and watched as the blood-vein patterns on his body receded.
Ding! Ssss!
Xu Ping took out an Upper Grade Magical Artifact and hacked at his arm several times, leaving only faint reddish marks.
"The strength of my body is comparable to that of a Second-stage Middle Grade Demon Beast. Although it lacks the bloodline talents of a Demon Beast and doesn’t possess Magic Divine Techniques, if I display the True Form of the Blood Demon, the strength of my physical body might surpass that of an average Second-stage Middle Grade Demon Beast."
Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction.
After spending so many resources and time, he had finally cultivated the Blood Demon Body Refining to the second layer.
With his current physique, even if ambushed by a Fake Pill cultivator, and taking a direct hit from the front, he probably wouldn’t fall, only be severely injured at most.
If combined with the Perfection Level of the Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill, even a typical Fake Pill cultivator might not be able to catch him.
"Not bad, this barely affords me a bit of self-preservation." Xu Ping couldn’t help but show a hint of a smile on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 136: Demon Cultivator Treasure, Red Broken Blade
chapters.content:
Chapter 136: Chapter 136: Demon Cultivator Treasure, Red Broken Blade
Just as Xu Ping was preparing to further consolidate his Blood Demon Body Refining, a strong attraction suddenly emanated from the storage ring, as if something was invisibly calling to him.
"What’s going on here?"
Xu Ping furrowed his brows, filled with confusion in his heart. He had never felt this way before; could it be the result of breaking through the second layer of Blood Demon Body Refining?
With such doubts in mind, his divine sense invaded the storage ring to search for answers.
Soon, he found the source of that attraction; a red broken knife quietly lying in the corner!
"It’s it!!"
Xu Ping’s heart trembled; he hadn’t expected it to be this terrifying demon cultivator’s magical weapon.
This red broken knife had left him with a deep psychological shadow back in the day; he always remembered it, but for now, he had no use for it, so it sat gathering dust in the corner.
Unexpectedly, after breaking through the second layer of Blood Demon Body Refining, this red broken knife seemed like a soul-stealing siren, incessantly attracting him.
"Could it be that the Blood Demon Body Refining and this magical weapon share the same origin, hence the attraction?" Xu Ping suppressed his inner turmoil, pondering secretly.
But he knew nothing about this red broken knife, and naturally couldn’t draw any definite conclusions.
"Should I give it a try?" Xu Ping hesitated in his heart.
After all, this was a magical weapon; if he could explore some secrets from it, it would significantly enhance his strength.
What’s more, back in the Qi Refining Realm, he was able to forcefully break free from its terrifying killer intent using the Taihang Nourishing God Skill; now that he had achieved Foundation Establishment, and completed the Taihang Nourishing God Skill, there was no reason he couldn’t break free.
After pondering for a long time, Xu Ping finally decided to give it a try.
He took out the red broken knife and slowly held it in his hand.
The moment he grasped the red broken knife, his entire head buzzed, and a surge of killer intent rushed into his mind.
His eyes instantly turned blood red.
In fact, this killer intent was just as expected, not difficult to dispel. Under the combined effect of his divine sense and the Taihang Nourishing God Skill, the killer intent was quickly suppressed.
But who would have thought, the killer intent originally rooted out from the Blood Demon Body Refining suddenly emerged from some corner and rushed into his mind.
The combination of both exponentially increased the killer intent within!
Kill! Kill! Kill!
This was the only thought left in his mind.
He was almost about to rush out of the cave mansion to slaughter all life before him.
Buzz!
At this very moment, the Taihang Nourishing God Skill at the Perfection Level suddenly operated at full capacity, and his divine sense completely erupted from the sea of consciousness.
Little by little, it expelled the killer intent from his mind, until he regained clarity.
"This... the broken knife is so terrifying; it can resonate with the killer intent contained in the Blood Demon Body Refining!" Xu Ping, who recovered his consciousness, broke out in cold sweat.
If it weren’t for him, even a late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator wouldn’t be able to withstand the combined killer intent of the two, eventually becoming a monster focused solely on slaughter.
Xu Ping tightly gripped the red broken knife, with no trace of killer intent in his heart, seemingly mastering this demonic magical weapon completely.
For some reason, he felt a surge of desire to swing the knife.
Without hesitation, Xu Ping gripped the broken knife and lightly swung it in the air.
Buzz!
Instantly, the red broken knife in his hand unexpectedly erupted with an unimaginable absorbing force, continuously drawing the liquid mana from his dantian.
"What’s happening?"
Xu Ping was shocked in his heart; the red broken knife met the mana as if a bachelor starved for fifty years met a tempting beauty.
He struggled to break free, but the red broken knife seemed to be growing out of his hand, no matter how much force he used, he couldn’t shake it off.
He tried to cut off the mana supply, but it had no effect at all; the attraction was too strong, far beyond what he could resist.
So, Xu Ping could only watch helplessly as it devoured his mana like a glutton.
"Damn it, I shouldn’t have acted recklessly!"
Faced with such a situation, he could only curse himself and wait silently, hoping the red broken knife would let him go once it was sated.
Buzz!
Accompanied by the red broken knife’s constant absorption of mana, a crimson glow appeared around it.
The crimson glow grew ever more intense, so intense that he almost smelled the scent of blood.
However, as Xu Ping’s mana gradually reached its limit, the red broken knife’s attraction showed no signs of weakening; instead, it seemed to be increasing.
This left Xu Ping dumbfounded; the red broken knife simply couldn’t be satisfied.
"Let’s see what happens when you’ve absorbed all the mana!"
Soon, Xu Ping found out what it could do when it absorbed all the mana.
After absorbing all the mana, the red broken knife actually started absorbing his vital blood!
This time, Xu Ping was terrified.
Vital blood, although like mana, could be regenerated through cultivation and pills, but that was only when a small portion was consumed; once vital blood was exhausted, that would mean certain death.
Xu Ping naturally wouldn’t allow this red broken knife to continue its absorption.
"Blood Demon True Form!" he shouted lowly.
Instantly, his body began to swell, turning into a giant over four meters high, his entire skin surface shrouded in a dense blood glow.
A power capable of tearing everything apart surged from deep within his body.
"Let go of me!"
Xu Ping roared, bursting out with all his strength, veins comparable to a baby’s arm size bulging all over his body.
Determined, no matter what, he would rip the broken knife off!
Yet surprisingly, before Xu Ping exerted much force, the red broken knife’s absorption force suddenly disappeared, as if it had never been there.
Whether it was full or for some other reason...
"It’s finally over!"
Xu Ping finally breathed a sigh of relief, his back soaked with sweat.
"This damn knife, from now on I..." he couldn’t help but curse.
"Wait!"
Just as he was about to toss the red broken knife away, he sensed a terrifying power within it that made him shudder.
This power was so potent, it could almost deal heavy damage or even kill a late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator!
"This..."
Cold sweat instantly ran down Xu Ping’s body; if this power were to suddenly erupt, even with his physique, he’d be seriously injured.
As he was unsure how to deal with it, he sensed an inexplicable connection between his mind and the red broken knife.
With just a thought, this power could burst forth, shredding everything before him.
"It’s good that I can control it!"
Xu Ping’s anxious heart finally relaxed; due to the lack of a proper venue to test the power, he could only gradually control it to dissipate.
After all, if this power were to erupt, the second-stage array would surely fail, and Cangyuan Mountain would certainly suffer.
"If this red broken knife could be used in battle, it would definitely become my ace!"
"Once suddenly unleashed, late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivators wouldn’t stand a chance, and even a Fake Pill user could be caught off guard, though not killed, injury is certain."
While controlling the red broken knife to slowly disperse its power, Xu Ping couldn’t help but consider this possibility, feeling a surge of excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 137: New Turmoil Arises
chapters.content:
Chapter 137: Chapter 137: New Turmoil Arises
"Although the process of this red blade absorbing mana on its own is somewhat slow, if I actively infuse it, it will definitely be several times faster."
"The only downside is the huge mana consumption. With my current mana, it’s far from enough. If I’m not careful and overfeed the red blade, and it starts absorbing my blood essence again, it would be troublesome."
Thinking of this, Xu Ping slowly furrowed his brows.
This red blade is not suited for regular means and can only be used as a trump card in a desperate fight.
"Perhaps after I break through to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment, using this red blade should improve a lot." Xu Ping thought to himself optimistically.
With his maximum of seventy drops of liquid mana breaking through to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment, he should have at least over a hundred drops of liquid mana then.
Though not comparable to a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, it would far surpass the average Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
"Soon, after I breakthrough to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment, my strength should have a leap forward, and the threat posed by the war between the two nations should be somewhat diminished."
After dispersing all the power in the red blade, Xu Ping swallowed a pill and began silently recovering his mana and blood essence.
...
....
A month later.
In the cultivation chamber, Xu Ping took a deep breath, Spiritual Qi surged into his body like a tide and was instantly refined along with the operation of his cultivation technique.
The process continued uninterrupted.
No one knew how much time had passed when Xu Ping opened his eyes, a gleam flashed across his pupils.
"Finally, my blood essence has returned to perfection!" Feeling the vitality within him, Xu Ping couldn’t help but smile slightly.
After consolidating a bit more, he walked out of the cave and arrived at the small courtyard.
At a glance, his heart felt relaxed and refreshed.
A grand spiritual pool spanning an acre, covered by a large stretch of emerald green lotus leaves, resembling numerous umbrellas; lotus buds ready to bloom, like shy little girls with red faces, exuding a faint fragrance.
In the spiritual pool, countless spirit fish swam joyfully.
Xu Ping took a handful of spirit food and scattered it, as the spirit fish scrambled eagerly to seize it.
"This is the life of cultivation!"
With a smile on his lips, Xu Ping relished the stable daily cultivation, raising spirit fish in his free time, in utter tranquility.
At this moment, the sound transmission talisman in Xu Ping’s bosom began to flicker.
He slightly furrowed his brow, took out the talisman, and held it in his hand, infusing a wisp of mana, and Zhang Qingfeng’s voice came through:
"Clan Leader, recently Ten Thousand Mountains have been becoming somewhat unstable, potential undercurrents lurk. The clan leader of the Qian family invites you to his cave to have a chat."
"Potential undercurrents?"
Xu Ping furrowed his brows even tighter, speculating in his heart: ’Is Hu Country preparing for a full invasion?’
The entire Ten Thousand Mountains is situated in the remote corner of Yue Country; if it were not a major issue affecting Yue Country, it would be difficult to affect Ten Thousand Mountains.
Thinking of this, Xu Ping had no choice but to leave seclusion to find Zhang Qingfeng and inquire: "Could it be that the war between the two countries has undergone a change?"
"No." Zhang Qingfeng shook his head, and his expression turned serious, "It should be related to the Xu family, a Foundation Establishment family that recently moved to Ten Thousand Mountains."
"A Foundation Establishment family that recently moved to Ten Thousand Mountains?" Xu Ping was slightly taken aback and, upon careful recollection, thought that there was indeed such a thing, which Zhang Qingfeng had informed him of before using a sound transmission talisman.
Li Zhengyu had been slain by him, and naturally, the Li family could not defend the second-stage spiritual vein.
The several Foundation Establishment forces in Ten Thousand Mountains, aside from the Zhang family, were preparing to contest and seize this second-stage spiritual vein. Who would have thought an external Foundation Establishment family would step in, taking the Li family’s second-stage spiritual vein before anyone else?
Thus, the several Foundation Establishment forces in Ten Thousand Mountains were naturally unhappy and were preparing to alliance to ask the Xu family for an explanation.
Who knew that the Xu family would preemptively come to the door to apologize and offer a generous apology gift, even to the Zhang family.
The several Foundation Establishment families found the Xu family to be quite sensible and, after some discussion, decided to drop the issue.
After all, it was just a second-stage lower grade spiritual vein, inferior to those within their own forces.
Moreover, the Xu family had set up a second-stage middle grade array in a short time. If they attacked in unison, it would be difficult to breach, so they finally gave up.
While this was a major affair for the Zhang family and even the entire Ten Thousand Mountains, it seemed insignificant to Xu Ping, so he did not concern himself with it.
"But, has there been any irregular move from this Xu family?" Hearing that it wasn’t the war between the two countries, Xu Ping felt quite relieved.
After all, it’s merely some Foundation Establishment cultivators, and he had confidence he could handle it.
"Exactly... Recently, the Xu family seems to be colluding with external Foundation Establishment forces, and it’s unknown what they are plotting. Therefore, the clan leader of the Qian family secretly invited all major local Foundation Establishment forces in Ten Thousand Mountains to his cave to discuss countermeasures."
Concern appeared on Zhang Qingfeng’s face; with the current chaos in Yue Country, it was inevitable that Ten Thousand Mountains would find it hard to escape.
"Several Foundation Establishment forces!"
Xu Ping’s expression turned solemn, "In that case, I’ll have a look."
Although these forces were unlikely to pose any threat to him, with the entire Yue Country in chaos, finding a relatively stable place for cultivation like Ten Thousand Mountains was incredibly difficult.
As long as it didn’t threaten him, maintaining the stability of the Zhang family still seemed very necessary.
...
...
Maple Leaf Mountain.
This mountain is shaped like a maple leaf, with a large piece of spiritual plants on the summit; it is the clan land of the Qian family.
And the Qian family counts as the first force of Ten Thousand Mountains, with its clan leader Qian Guanyu being the only Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator in all of Ten Thousand Mountains.
At the top of Maple Leaf Mountain, in a lavish grand hall, three men and one woman sat on chairs made of redwood, all with solemn expressions.
"To gather you all here today, I’m sure you know that the problem with the Xu family must be resolved, otherwise it will pose a threat to the entire Ten Thousand Mountains." From above, a robust man in a purple robe with a full face of bristles and a mighty appearance slowly spoke.
He was the clan leader of the Qian family, Qian Guanyu.
"Fellow Daoist Qian, we understand what you mean, but do you know which Foundation Establishment forces the Xu family has colluded with?" asked a female cultivator, dressed in a palace-style gown and having delicate features, with a frown.
"I haven’t been able to investigate exactly how many, but at least three Foundation Establishment forces are colluding with the Xu family, or perhaps the Xu family was originally a plant they inserted in Ten Thousand Mountains."
Upon hearing this, the faces of those present slightly changed.
"Does that mean they have been planning this for a while?" a black-clothed man asked with a sullen expression.
"I’m afraid so." Qian Guanyu nodded, his expression becoming even more serious.
Xu Ping remained silent, information about the three people flashed in his mind.
Needless to say, Qian Guanyu, being a Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, had the highest cultivation and was in a leadership position among the people present.
The only female cultivator was named Li Huachan, the clan leader of the Li family.
The black-clothed man was the clan leader of the Zhao family, Zhao Tianquan.

chapters.title: Chapter 138: Encounter
chapters.content:
Chapter 138: Chapter 138: Encounter
"Ten Thousand Mountains is not a place rich in resources, why do they go to such lengths to plot against it?" Li Huachan frowned, her tone revealing confusion.
"Yue Country is currently in turmoil, while our Ten Thousand Mountains, being somewhat isolated, is less affected. They value precisely this aspect." Qian Guanyu explained.
"Is that so?" Zhao Tianquan’s face looked grim as he quickly asked, "I wonder if Friend Qian has any strategy in mind?"
"At present, we can only strike them before they settle. I invited several of you here with the intention of launching a joint attack on the Xu family." Qian Guanyu said seriously.
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping nodded quietly, ’This is a good plan. If we can eliminate the Xu family, they won’t be able to use it as a foundation to devour Ten Thousand Mountains.’
Zhao Tianquan and Li Huachan also thought this was a good plan and agreed one after another.
"But the He family is protected by a second-stage array. With just the few of us, I fear it will be hard to break through." Xu Ping raised his concerns.
"No need to worry, Friend Zhang, see what I have here!" Qian Guanyu smiled slightly and took out a silver talisman from his chest.
"This is... a second-stage Breaking Charm?" Feeling the strong breaking power within the talisman, Xu Ping was slightly surprised.
Qian Guanyu’s methods were indeed not simple, having even prepared a second-stage Breaking Charm.
Zhao Tianquan and Li Huachan were even more astonished. With a second-stage Breaking Charm, if Qian Guanyu chose to target their families, they too would face destruction.
At this moment, both of them felt a rising apprehension towards Qian Guanyu, but on the surface, they simultaneously praised, "Friend Qian truly has profound resources."
"It’s nothing worth mentioning." Qian Guanyu said modestly with a smile.
"Then Friend Qian, when do you plan to act?" Xu Ping asked.
"Tonight. Since we’re going to act, it naturally needs to be with Thunder Power." Qian Guanyu said firmly.
"Alright, let’s catch them off guard!" The few of them agreed one after another.
After chatting for a few more moments, Qian Guanyu arranged accommodations for them to rest, planning to attack the Xu family at night.
...
Night fell.
The towering peaks appeared especially majestic under the moonlight, their silhouettes blurry yet grand.
At this moment, four streaks of Escape Light rose from the top of Maple Leaf Mountain, flying towards the distance.
"With Friend Qian’s second-stage Breaking Charm, the Xu family must fall today!" Within the Escape Light, Zhao Tianquan complimented with a laugh.
Li Huachan remained silent, looking deep in thought and anxious.
Meanwhile, Xu Ping maintained a calm expression.
This time, the risk was very low, but just in case, he still controlled the Rat Demon to go ahead to the Xu family for an inspection.
With the Rat Demon’s ability to advance, unless it was blocked by a third-rank array or quasi-tier three array, nothing could stop him.
The Rat Demon easily passed through the second-stage array protecting the Xu family.
"This... one, two, three, four, four Foundation Establishment cultivators?" Xu Ping was slightly surprised.
Without the array’s concealment, he easily detected the four Foundation Establishment cultivators hiding within the Xu family, one of whom was even at Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment.
This was troublesome!
Xu Ping frowned; with four Foundation Establishment cultivators in the Xu family, they would hardly gain anything from attacking.
"Could it be that Li Huachan or Zhao Tianquan leaked the information?" He looked at the two of them without showing any expression but quickly shook his head.
Probably not.
The attack plan was informed at the last minute, and both of them were at Maple Leaf Mountain without leaving, with a second-stage array guarding them. It should have been very difficult for them to send out the message, and the Xu family likely couldn’t have prepared so quickly.
"It seems the Xu family was already prepared!" Xu Ping thought to himself.
He had no intention of telling Qian Guanyu and the others about this but instead silently pondered how to resolve the situation perfectly.
Unleashing his full power to kill all the Xu family’s Foundation Establishment cultivators was certainly unrealistic.
’Perhaps, after retreating this time in defeat, I can disguise myself with the Thousand Illusion Mask and sneak into the Xu family to assassinate one or two Foundation Establishment cultivators,’ the thought emerged in Xu Ping’s mind.
After thinking it through, he found this method feasible. With the Thousand Illusion Mask in hand, no one would know it was his doing.
Moreover, after assassinating one or two Foundation Establishment cultivators, their side would have absolute strength, able to easily claim the spoils.
...
After flying for several hours, the group finally arrived at their destination.
The four of them descended from the Escape Light and concealed themselves, quietly nearing the array.
"It’s up to you, Friend Qian!" The three of them looked at Qian Guanyu.
"Leave it to me!"
Qian Guanyu smiled with confidence, flipping his palm to reveal the second-stage Breaking Charm in his hand, "You three prepare yourselves. Once the second-stage Breaking Charm weakens the array to its limit, strike together to completely break through this second-stage array."
"Understood!"
Xu Ping and the others nodded, already holding their magical artifacts in hand.
Though the second-stage Breaking Charm was powerful, some external force was still needed to fully breach the second-stage array.
Qian Guanyu held the second-stage Breaking Charm in his hand, then infused it with mana, muttering incantations.
In an instant, a surge of breaking power rippled from the second-stage Breaking Charm.
Without hesitation, he struck with a palm.
Buzz!
A massive breaking force exploded instantly, causing the protective array covering the entire Xu family to twist.
"What... what happened?" The four Foundation Establishment cultivators within the array showed shock, the first to sense the anomaly.
Rumble!
Before they could react, in the next moment, with an earth-shattering roar, the second-stage array shattered completely.
A powerful spiritual power wave swept across the entire Xu family, instantly collapsing most of the buildings, trapping several Xu family cultivators who couldn’t escape under the rubble and eliciting cries of pain.
"Someone is attacking the array!"
The four Foundation Establishment cultivators within the Xu family were taken aback, soaring skyward to find the attackers.
Since Qian Guanyu and the others didn’t disguise themselves in the slightest, and given the massive commotion just now, the four Foundation Establishment cultivators from the Xu family easily identified them.
"It’s you!" Their gazes were as sharp as knives, locking onto the group of Qian Guanyu.
Thinking the array had broken smoothly, Qian Guanyu and his group were pleased but were promptly dismayed to see four Foundation Establishment cultivators emerge from the Xu family, turning their expressions grim as the situation became tricky.
"Hmph! It is us. Your Xu family harbors ill intentions, wanting to devour our families. Did you think we wouldn’t know?" Qian Guanyu snorted coldly.
"Enough talk! Killing you here today, and Ten Thousand Mountains will finally be ours!" A middle-aged man said coldly.
They had originally planned to ambush Qian Guanyu and the others but instead got ambushed themselves.
Facing the current situation, everyone present was quite shocked and unprepared.
However, with things at this stage, there was no turning back, and a battle was inevitable.

chapters.title: Chapter 139: Double Defeat
chapters.content:
Chapter 139: Chapter 139: Double Defeat
"Attack!"
Qian Guanyu shouted lightly, his voice as thunderous as a storm, taking the lead to strike. Amidst the flashing red light, a sword light shot into the sky.
Within the sword light, it was a sword artifact etched with numerous runes on its surface, without a sword hilt, the blade gleaming coldly. It was a top-grade magical artifact!
Just as Qian Guanyu made his move, Xu Ping and the other two acted almost simultaneously.
Two flying knives soared across the sky like dragons. A horsetail whisk danced in the air, while another long knife wrapped in red light lunged towards the enemy like a flame.
The battle erupted in an instant, sword lights and magical artifacts intertwined, the air was filled with the piercing sound of metal clashes.
Qian Guanyu’s sword light streaked like a meteor, directly targeting the burly middle-aged man.
The middle-aged man’s expression unmoved, quickly mobilized Spiritual Power. At this moment, his ten fingers wore ten pitch-black rings, which burst forth with intense spiritual light. With his palms together, he easily blocked the sword light.
"Die!"
Immediately, he shouted angrily, mobilizing all his Spiritual Power, aiming at Qian Guanyu’s heart, the momentum like a rainbow, chilling to the bone.
Meanwhile, Xu Ping was entangled with a yellow-skinned cultivator wielding a yellow gourd magical artifact.
The yellow-skinned cultivator held the gourd, muttering incessantly, as black water balls emerged from the mouth of the gourd, pouring down on Xu Ping like rain.
Every water ball that landed burst out a strong black gas, filling the air with a pungent stench of decay.
Xu Ping, with a grave expression, wielded his long knife wrapped in red light, slicing repeatedly through the black water balls.
Chh... chh...
However, the long knife wrapped in red light was constantly corroded by the black water balls, emitting a sizzling sound.
"Haha, you half-buried old geezer, today I will send you completely into the earth!" The yellow-skinned cultivator laughed arrogantly, as if victory was already in his grasp.
’Who are these people? Their fighting skills are stronger than those of ordinary cultivators of the same stage.’ Xu Ping glanced across several battlefields, his heart slightly tensed.
At this moment, their situation seemed rather dire!
Zhao Tianquan was suppressed by an Insect Cultivator, who, with hand gestures, threw out a spiritual beast bag. From it flew blue butterflies, fluttering lightly.
These butterflies spread blue fluorescent powder as they danced, making the surroundings appear dreamlike.
Zhao Tianquan could only barely maintain an undefeated stance.
As for Li Huachan, her situation was even worse, being beaten back by a second-stage Middle Grade cultivator, falling into an absolute disadvantage.
"We can’t drag this out any longer," Xu Ping thought to himself. If they didn’t show some strength, Li Huachan and the others might face defeat and demise.
"Go!"
Xu Ping flicked his fingers, and a black needle magical artifact turned into a wisp of thin and dark shadow, silently piercing towards the yellow-skinned cultivator’s back.
When he noticed, the black needle magical artifact was already close to his body.
"Bad!"
The yellow-skinned cultivator’s face changed suddenly. In panic, he could only summon a small black banner, and with the infusion of Mana, a protective black light shield enveloped him.
Thud!
The black needle magical artifact did not pierce the black light shield, issuing a crisp sound.
"Die!"
Taking advantage of the yellow-skinned cultivator’s attention being drawn by the black needle magical artifact, Xu Ping unleashed an explosion of Spiritual Qi, the knife light blossomed suddenly, sweeping towards the yellow-skinned cultivator like a raging fire.
Boom!
The knife light, like a rainbow, instantly shattered the black light shield, emitting a thunderous roar.
"Ah!"
The yellow-skinned cultivator couldn’t respond in time and was struck by the knife light, blood sprayed out wildly, his figure was sent flying backward, and he couldn’t help but let out a heartrending scream.
"Well done, Fellow Zhang!" Qian Guanyu’s face showed ecstatic joy. He hadn’t expected Zhang Yu’s strength to be so formidable, managing to severely injure a person evidently stronger than ordinary early-stage Foundation Establishment cultivators.
"Fellow Zhang, save me!" At this moment, Li Huachan’s cry for help came.
She was being beaten repeatedly by a second-stage Middle Grade Body Cultivator, facing mortal danger with little room for error.
Xu Ping also didn’t hesitate and went carrying his knife to assist.
Zhao Tianquan wanted to ask for help, but could only swallow it silently.
Soon, with Xu Ping and Li Huachan joining forces, the situation instantly turned around, and the second-stage Body Cultivator was beaten back repeatedly, unlikely to hold out for long.
"Looks like your death is coming today!" Qian Guanyu saw his side gaining the upper hand and couldn’t help but sneer.
"Hmph!"
The middle-aged man’s face turned dark, his hands surged with Spiritual Power, suddenly a phantom tiger appeared on his back.
"Merge!"
His eyes were bloodshot, roaring fiercely as the phantom tiger forcefully merged into his body.
As the phantom tiger gradually merged, the aura on the middle-aged man began to climb abruptly.
"What!"
Qian Guanyu’s face changed drastically, trying to intervene, but it was too late.
At this moment, the middle-aged man’s aura had already risen from an ordinary mid-stage cultivator to the peak.
Don’t underestimate this enhancement; it’s at least a difference of twenty to thirty drops of Mana.
Even Xu Ping’s expression changed slightly: "What kind of secret technique is this, able to increase power to such a degree?"
He wasn’t worried about this middle-aged man’s strength but was intrigued by this secret technique.
"Today, I’ll show you my true power!"
The middle-aged man’s eyes flashed with vicious light, palms together, intense Spiritual Power from the ten pitch-black rings on his fingers erupted, instantly turning into a violent blast, rushing towards Qian Guanyu.
"Damn!"
Qian Guanyu’s heart tightened, feeling an overwhelming pressure surging towards him. He hurriedly summoned defensive magical artifacts and talismans, trying to fend off the strike.
However, that force swept over like a storm, instantly enveloping him, making resistance futile.

chapters.title: Chapter 140 - 139: Mutual Defeat
chapters.content:
Chapter 140: Chapter 139: Mutual Defeat
The middle-aged man was already half a notch stronger than him, but his strength had suddenly increased significantly. How could he withstand it!
"Crack!" With a crisp sound, Qian Guanyu’s defensive talisman crumbled like paper under that force, and his magical artifact was sent flying by the middle-aged man.
"Boom!"
Accompanied by a loud noise, a strong shockwave sent Qian Guanyu flying, blood gushing out as his face turned deathly pale.
"Fellow Daoist Qian!" Zhao Tianquan and Li Huachan were shocked, their hearts tightening.
Even Xu Ping’s expression slightly darkened, thinking to himself, ’Looks like we need to escape!’
In a situation where it was inconvenient to reveal his true strength, his group was undoubtedly no match.
However, he still had to rescue these people. They were useful for maintaining stability in the Ten Thousand Mountains.
Just as the middle-aged man was about to deal a killing blow to Qian Guanyu, Xu Ping made his move.
Spiritual Qi erupted, and a blade light suddenly blossomed, slashing toward the middle-aged man like raging flames.
"Tricks of the trade!"
The middle-aged man sneered, and the ten black rings on his hand exploded with immense spiritual pressure as he unleashed a punch without hesitation.
Bam!
The blade light was instantly shattered by his punch. But he hadn’t expected that two faint blue talismans were hidden behind the blade light.
Rumble!
The talismans were activated in an instant, and two purple lightning beams seemed to descend from the sky, striking straight at the middle-aged man!
The defensive spiritual light around the middle-aged man shattered like paper, and the spiritual glow of his robe dimmed, turning into flying ash!
After the lightning, his upper body was charred black, and his aura quickly weakened, clearly severely injured!
"Second-stage Upper Grade talisman--Purple Lightning Talisman!"
His gaze fixed on Xu Ping, knowing that the attack from such a talisman ranked among the strongest of all Second-stage Upper Grade talismans.
"Quickly, go!" Xu Ping shouted.
The seriously injured Qian Guanyu wasted no time in using his Escape Light to flee, and Zhao Tianquan and Li Huachan, seeing this, also chose to escape without hesitation.
"You want to leave?"
The middle-aged man roared, his powerful spiritual power surging around him as he prepared to give chase.
The other two also made ready to pursue.
"Go!"
However, Xu Ping sent out two more talismans, transforming into two giant firebirds. The firebirds, carrying scorching heat, traced a fiery arc in the air, heading straight for the middle-aged man and his companions.
"Disperse!" The middle-aged man shouted angrily, clapping his palms together to summon a phantom tiger shadow, whose powerful aura dispersed the firebirds, scattering sparks.
At this moment, the other two also dispersed the firebirds again.
But in the time it took them, Xu Ping and the others had already fled far away.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, should we pursue them?" one of them asked.
The middle-aged man tightly watched as the group disappeared into the distance without saying a word, only exhaling a deep breath once they were out of sight.
As he exhaled, his aura suddenly weakened, and his complexion turned extremely pale.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, are you alright?" The two were instantly startled.
"Pfft!"
A mouthful of blood spurted from his mouth as he slowly wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, his gaze icy as he said, "I’m fine. Once my injuries recover, I will definitely kill them all."
Qian Guanyu’s injuries were even more severe, making a quick recovery difficult.
Without this Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, they couldn’t stop him.
Especially Zhang Yu, who would definitely not spare him!
...
...
The group didn’t know how long they had been fleeing.
