At that moment, Qian Guanyu’s injuries flared up, and he could no longer hold on, falling from the sky.
Fortunately, Xu Ping was quick-witted and caught him. Otherwise, the injuries would have worsened.
"Please... please, fellow Daoists, help me guard as I heal!" Qian Guanyu weakly said, his face deathly pale, devoid of blood.
With that, he swallowed a pill with difficulty and began meditating to heal his injuries.
Although Zhao Tianquan and Li Huachan were uninjured, their expressions were extremely grim.
Now that Qian Guanyu was seriously injured, and the other side’s Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator was so powerful, how could they resist next?
Relying on Zhang Yu?
Both of them looked at Xu Ping simultaneously but quickly shook their heads.
Even if Zhang Yu was strong, he was still lacking compared to the middle-aged man. In a head-on battle, the other side would be on guard, making another talisman surprise attack difficult.
However, both were astonished by Zhang Yu’s successive use of Second-stage Upper Grade talismans and couldn’t help but speculate, ’Seems Zhang Yu gained quite a bit in Qiu Xuan Immortal City.’
Xu Ping naturally didn’t know what they were thinking.
He sat silently to the side, seemingly worried about what to do next.
But in reality, he was pondering how to obtain the Secret Technique the middle-aged man used.
He was quite envious of this Secret Technique.
Its boost wasn’t much less than ’Heavenly Demon Solution,’ and it didn’t seem to have such terrifying side effects.
If he could acquire this Secret Technique, it would significantly enhance his strength.
And who knows, maybe these two Secret Techniques could be stacked. If they could be combined, it would be a massive boost to his power.
Everyone had their own thoughts, and they remained silent, a heavy atmosphere hanging over them.
...
Unknown how much time passed.
The soft morning light filtered through the forest, the golden rays shining like silky threads through the dense foliage.
"Huff!"
At this moment, Qian Guanyu exhaled a long breath, awakening from his healing session, his previously deathly pale complexion regaining a hint of redness as his aura stabilized.
"Fellow Daoist Qian, how are your injuries?" Zhao Tianquan asked with concern.
"Barely not worsening further, but it will take at least a few months to fully recover," Qian Guanyu said with a bitter smile, a look of helplessness in his eyes.
He had underestimated that person, not expecting him to boost his strength so significantly.
"Does it really require that long?"
Upon hearing this, Zhao Tianquan and Li Huachan felt a sinking feeling, fearing that the enemy’s Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator could wipe out their clan several times over within a few months.
"So, Fellow Daoist Qian, what should we do next?" Zhao Tianquan asked with worry.
Qian Guanyu remained silent for a moment before slowly saying, "I have a friend who is also a Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator. If I offer significant benefits, he might agree to join us in our struggle."
"Then we rely on you, Fellow Daoist Qian!" Upon hearing this, Zhao Tianquan and Li Huachan were overjoyed. If they could get another Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator to help, their chances of winning would increase greatly.
"Once I’ve rested for a few days, I’ll go to find him."
Qian Guanyu nodded, turning his gaze to Xu Ping with genuine gratitude, "Thanks to Fellow Daoist Zhang today, otherwise, we would have struggled to escape."
"Indeed, we are truly grateful to Fellow Daoist Zhang today!" Zhao Tianquan and Li Huachan also bowed to Xu Ping.
"You are too kind, Fellow Daoists. I merely did my best," Xu Ping humbly replied.
If it weren’t to conceal his identity, he would have already dealt with that middle-aged man, perhaps obtaining the Secret Technique.
After expressing his gratitude, Qian Guanyu continued, "In the coming days, it’s best for the three of you not to return to your clans. Speak again once I return."
"Why is that?" Zhao Tianquan asked, puzzled.
But Li Huachan and Xu Ping had their own thoughts.
"I think those people have backing. If we don’t show up, even if they attack our clan, they won’t dare to harm our clansmen.
After all, they fear us going down together, indiscriminately killing their juniors or clansmen," Qian Guanyu explained slowly.
"I see, then I’ll find a place to hide during this time," Zhao Tianquan realized.
"Then, Fellow Daoists, we part ways for now. If I get help, I’ll notify you with a long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman." Qian Guanyu took out three grey-white talismans and handed them to the others.
"Farewell!"
"Farewell!"
After discussing some details, they all used their Escape Light, flying off in various directions.
"It’s better that you’ve left, making it easier for me to act."
Watching them disappear completely, Xu Ping used the Thousand Illusion Mask to transform into a youthful appearance with sword-like eyebrows and starry eyes, heading toward the Xu family’s location.
Now that the Xu family’s array was broken and their only Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator was injured, it was the perfect time to strike.

chapters.title: Chapter 141 - 140: Execution
chapters.content:
Chapter 141: Chapter 140: Execution
When Xu Ping, transformed into a young man, arrived at the territory of the Xu clan, they were still cleaning up the remnants of a battle.
Although Xu Ping’s strength was overwhelming, he did not act rashly and instead first dispatched the Rat Demon underground to search for traces of the middle-aged man.
Soon, in a room covered by an array, he sensed the aura of the middle-aged man.
He originally wanted to launch a sneak attack with the Rat Demon, but with the array as protection, he could only abandon this plan.
Xu Ping pondered for a moment and decided to draw them all out first and deal with them later.
The young man he transformed into flew above the Xu clan and roared, "More than twenty years ago, your Xu clan exterminated my clan. Today, I shall return the favor tooth for tooth!"
The Xu clan members, having just endured a surprise attack, were shocked and fled in panic.
Several Foundation Establishment Cultivators were furious beyond measure. What kind of auspicious day was today for surprise attacks?
Why was one person after another choosing today to attack?
Except for the person whom Xu Ping had severely injured earlier, everyone else was present.
"Boy, dare to act wild in my Xu clan, today is the day of your death!" The middle-aged man, full of pent-up anger, didn’t expect that this Early-Stage Foundation Establishment young man would hit the nail on the head, so he decided to use his blood to make a sacrifice for the flag.
"What! You actually have three people!" Xu Ping was shocked, but the next moment, he suddenly smiled and said, "I was tricking you."
"You brat went nuts..." The middle-aged man had not finished his words when he saw the cold gleam in the opponent’s eyes attacking them.
Crack!
The middle-aged man couldn’t help but grunt as cracks abruptly appeared on the surface of a Jade Pendant on his neck.
"Aah!"
The other two, however, had no treasure to block the attack, and the Spiritual Sense Attack pierced their Sea of Consciousness like a fine needle, causing them to let out a series of blood-curdling screams.
"Spiritual Sense Attack!" The middle-aged man’s face changed drastically, and he hurriedly wanted to summon a defensive Magical Artifact, but at this moment, he heard a clear bell sound.
Ding ding...
The middle-aged man’s expression became dazed, and when he regained his senses, a blood-tinged fist was magnifying right in front of him.
Boom!
"Ah!"
Accompanied by a heart-wrenching scream, he was punched and flew out, blood gushing forth.
Xu Ping continued the pursuit with a blank expression.
Although the middle-aged man was severely injured, he was given a chance to catch his breath at this moment.
Turning his palm, a purple bracelet suddenly appeared and then expanded in the wind, almost growing to the size of a house, protecting him entirely.
Boom!
In practically the next instant, a fist slammed fiercely onto the Purple Yun Bracelet, making a thunderous sound.
"Spiritual Sense Attack, Exotic Treasure, Second-stage Middle Grade Body Cultivator!" The middle-aged man, pale-faced, was shocked. Since when did his Xu clan offend such a person?
"Fellow cultivator, have you perhaps found the wrong person?"
"Found the wrong your grandpa, it’s you Xu clan!" Xu Ping cursed with anger, as a dull gray long sword suddenly appeared in his hand.
"Slash!"
A majestic Sword Qi slashed onto the Purple Yun Bracelet, and accompanied by a thunderous explosion, the Purple Yun Bracelet developed dense cracks.
"Fellow cultivator, you misunderstand, it definitely wasn’t done by our Xu clan." The middle-aged man showed a face of fear, pleading for mercy.
Meanwhile, the other two finally recovered from the Spiritual Sense Attack, and seeing the middle-aged man in peril, their expressions changed drastically, and they all summoned Magical Artifacts to attack Xu Ping.
"Scram!"
Xu Ping rewarded each with a Sword Qi, instantly knocking the two away.
At this moment, the Purple Yun Bracelet could no longer hold, letting out a pitiful wail under unbearable strain.
Xu Ping’s eyes flickered, and the Purple Sun Sword swung down fiercely again, smashing the middle-aged man’s mana, and even though he tried hard to dodge, he still lost an arm to the aftershock of the Sword Qi.
"Ah..."
Amidst the flying blood, the middle-aged man let out a miserable scream, realizing his escape speed was no match for the opponent, immediately plunged into despair, "Spare me!"
"If you surrender, I might spare your life..."
Xu Ping coldly snorted, launching a silent Spiritual Sense Attack.
In an instant, the middle-aged man screamed, unable to even maintain his Escape Light.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Xu Ping struck several waves of mana into the man’s Sea of Consciousness and Dantian, sealing his Divine Sense and mana.
’Hmph... If it wasn’t to capture you alive, you would have been dead already...’
With Xu Ping’s current divine techniques, it was very easy to kill the opponent quickly, but wanting to capture him alive was relatively difficult.
"What!"
In the distance, the two who were preparing to attack again stood dumbfounded at this scene, capturing Xu Daoist alive. Could this young man in front of them be disguised as a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator?
Just when the two were about to flee for their lives, they noticed the opponent coldly glanced at them and then flew away on Escape Light.
This made them sigh with relief and simultaneously feel puzzled: ’Why did this youth, seemingly a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, spare them?’
The two, minds whirling, almost simultaneously thought of a possibility.
’He said he had a grudge with the Xu clan but left after capturing the Xu clan’s Clan Leader, without killing us two, and glanced at us coldly before leaving. Could it be that he wants us to slaughter the entire Xu clan?’
They couldn’t help but glance at each other, seeing the killing intent in each other’s eyes.
They were not originally from the Xu clan, just invited over. Now the Xu clan’s Clan Leader was certainly doomed.
Their clan no longer had any Foundation Establishment cultivators, no one who could threaten them, and on the other hand, the suggestion from the person seemingly a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
They naturally knew what choice to make.
"Fellow Daoist Zhang..."
"Hmm..."
Without needing to say much, after nodding at each other, they showed ferocious expressions and began chanting mana, starting the massacre of the Xu clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 142 - 140: Execution
chapters.content:
Chapter 142: Chapter 140: Execution
"Ah!"
The scream instantly echoed through the clouds.
...
...
Inside a cave mansion in the mountain forest.
Xu Ping casually threw the unconscious middle-aged man to the ground. At this moment, his Divine Sense and Mana had been sealed by Xu Ping, rendering him like a mere mortal, so naturally he was not afraid of him escaping or suddenly attacking.
At this moment, Xu Ping naturally wasn’t aware of the events that transpired in the Xu clan. The look he gave when he left was simply a threat without much meaning.
Who would have thought that those two would overthink it so much, but even if he knew, he wouldn’t care.
After all, it was still his doing.
Moreover, the cultivation realm is just like that; it’s either you kill him or he kills you.
Xu Ping took the storage ring from the middle-aged man’s hand, broke the imprint on it, then infiltrated it with his Divine Sense, starting to search for tracks of the secret technique.
Soon, a secret technique named "Spirit Summoning Skill" appeared before his Divine Sense.
"Could it be this one?"
Xu Ping took it out without hesitation and began to read it carefully.
"Spirit Summoning Skill uses the essence blood and soul of demon beasts as a guide, engraving restrictions on the body to harness the beast’s power for personal use, greatly enhancing one’s mana..."
"Turns out it is this one."
Xu Ping showed a look of ecstasy and began to read carefully.
The Spirit Summoning Skill is a secret technique similar to the ’Heavenly Demon Solution’. Although it doesn’t increase power as much as the latter, it also doesn’t have the side effects of the ’Heavenly Demon Solution’.
It is a secret technique that can be used in regular combat; however, its difficulty is quite high, and to achieve significant enhancement, at least the essence blood and soul of a demon beast of the same or higher rank than one’s own cultivation should be used.
"At the same or a higher rank?" Xu Ping murmured to himself.
Given his current cultivation, using a second-stage lower grade demon beast as a material would definitely result in little enhancement. It should be at least a second-stage middle grade or even a second-stage upper grade.
Xu Ping thought for a moment and then channeled a thread of mana into the middle-aged man on the ground.
The middle-aged man was silent for a moment before waking from his coma. He struggled to look up, seeing Xu Ping’s expressionless face, and his eyes were full of pleading, "Fellow Daoist, spare my life!"
Faced with the pitiful look of the other person, Xu Ping showed no trace of pity.
"You practiced this secret technique, what are its requirements or side effects?" he asked with a blank expression.
"If... fellow Daoist is willing to spare me, I will tell you everything about this secret technique," the middle-aged man said shakily.
"You have no room to bargain now!" Xu Ping snorted coldly, glaring at him.
Shocking God Needle activated!
"Ah!"
The middle-aged man rolled on the ground in pain, and after a few more times, he finally couldn’t bear it anymore and said with a face full of pain, "I’ll tell, I’ll tell... After using the ’Spirit Summoning Skill,’ there are no other side effects, it’s just the physical body that’s required to be very strong; if one cannot endure it, then the cultivation will not be successful."
"The physical body requirement is very high?"
Xu Ping secretly nodded in his heart, this requirement he perfectly met.
He then inquired in detail about several questions regarding the ’Spirit Summoning Skill’, which the other party answered one by one.
"As long as you spare me, I am willing to swear an oath to follow you for eternity," the middle-aged man begged continuously, kowtowing.
"Follow for eternity?" Xu Ping was immediately intrigued.
"Yes, yes... I, being a mid-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, have great combat strength, for the fellow Daoist..." Before the other could finish speaking, Xu Ping suddenly darted forward like lightning, placing a palm on his head.
Poof!
The opponent’s head burst like a watermelon, leaving a headless corpse on the ground.
"It’s a pity, I have too many secrets on me, and the oath isn’t unbreakable...."
Seeing the headless body bleeding profusely, Xu Ping flicked his fingers, igniting it into ashes with a fireball. He then summoned water with mana, thoroughly rinsing the ground until no trace was left behind.
After completing all of this, Xu Ping set up an array in the cave mansion and started studying the ’Spirit Summoning Skill’ with peace of mind.
...
...
Three days later.
Xu Ping closed the book in his hands, the process of depicting the ’Spirit Summoning Skill’ now clearly in his mind.
He frowned slightly, pondering, "Now it’s time to give it a try, but it’s really hard to find demon beasts above the second-stage middle grade."
Currently, Qiu Xuan Immortal City had been breached by a beast tide, and the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range was not a place to go anymore. Other places had very few second-stage demon beasts.
While he was contemplating, the Sound Transmission Talisman in his pocket began to flicker.
No need to think, it must be Qian Guanyu informing him that the Xu clan had been wiped out.
Xu Ping injected a thread of mana into it, and Qian Guanyu’s ecstatic voice sounded from the Sound Transmission Talisman: "Fellow Daoists, the Xu clan has been exterminated, even its clan leader was taken by a mysterious cultivator, their life or death unknown....."
Indeed, this was what was being talked about.
However, upon hearing that the remaining two Foundation Establishment outsiders of the Xu clan slaughtered the Xu clan, Xu Ping couldn’t help but show a hint of surprise, unable to understand why they did it.
"Could it be for the Xu clan’s wealth?" Xu Ping couldn’t help but speculate, but quickly dismissed the thought, for it had nothing to do with him anyway.
Xu Ping expressed joy through the Sound Transmission Talisman as well.
After exchanging a few words, the talisman’s spiritual glow dimmed.
Xu Ping thought to himself, "The matter is already resolved. There’s no need to return to Cangyuan Mountain for now; it’s better to gather the materials needed for depicting the ’Spirit Summoning Skill’ first."
The most crucial material needed for depicting the Spirit Summoning Skill was the soul stone capable of containing the souls of demon beasts.
The soul stone is a special second-stage ore, precious and scarce.
Originally, Qian Guanyu had one, but it was used too many times, losing its function, making it necessary to find another piece.
The Ten Thousand Mountains are safe and stable, but lack resources; to find more, one has to go outside.
"First, let’s try a few nearby markets and see, as they seem to be holding auctions lately!"
Xu Ping’s heart moved, he stood up, packed up the array, chose a direction, and flew off into the distance on his Escape Light, breaking through the clouds.
...
...
A month and a half later.
Hanyang Market.
It was a market set up by the Han family, one of the eight great families of Yue Country, with two Foundation Establishment cultivators stationed long-term.
Although Yue Country is in chaos now, due to its southern part being far from the battlefield, this place remains relatively peaceful, attracting many loose cultivators fleeing here, greatly increasing the flow of people.
Taking this opportunity, Hanyang Market prepared to organize a large auction.
On the opening day of the auction.
The sky was filled with the flickering lights of various magic spells.
Numerous spiritual boats soared across the sky, docking at the edge of the market.
There were also cultivators riding spirit beasts and walking on flying swords, their long sleeves fluttering, resembling immortals.
"Look over there... even the Song family, the head of the eight great families, is here."
A huge spiritual boat was docked at the market edge, with a large flag emblazoned with the word "Song" at the prow.
Their force is only slightly inferior to the Golden Core Sect.
...
Amid the hustle and bustle, Xu Ping entered the auction venue, greeted by Han clan disciples in fluttering law robes maintaining order.
"Welcome, Senior!"
At the auction entrance, Xu Ping, not concealing his cultivation level, naturally didn’t have to queue with the Qi Cultivators at the entrance.
After opening the door, he noticed a water pool connected to the outside through ducts, with carps glimmering like green jade swimming inside.
"Honored Senior, please enjoy!"
The family has prepared a plate of fish sashimi for every guest in a private box..."
"Not bad."
"Then this junior will take his leave. The auction is about to begin." The middle-aged cultivator said and excused himself respectfully.
PAGE SEPARATOR
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 143 - 141: Robber Cultivators (4,000 Words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 143: Chapter 141: Robber Cultivators (4,000 Words)
The middle-aged cultivator saluted and exited. Xu Ping surveyed the box’s environment; although its space was not large, it was exquisitely decorated. Directly in front was a transparent glass through which the entire auction venue could be viewed.
Xu Ping looked down to see that the seats in the hall were filled with Qi cultivators, many of whom concealed their faces.
He only glanced briefly, then lost interest, sitting cross-legged to silently await the auction’s arrival.
Time quietly flowed by, and after waiting for the time it takes to burn an incense stick, a copper gong sounded, officially starting the auction!
On the auction stage, a prosperous-looking middle-aged man was speaking with a smile, saying some pleasantries to foster a cordial atmosphere.
"I am Han Tian of the Han family! Greetings to all fellow Daoists. This auction is hosted by myself, and I hope everyone can purchase items to their satisfaction..."
Though this person appeared adept in social situations, his cultivation was overflowing with spiritual power, clearly having reached the early-stage of Foundation Establishment.
"Without further ado, the first auction item is a small Barrier-Breaking Pill... Used to break through the bottleneck from mid to late Qi Refinement, suitable for cultivators of various techniques, with a starting price of one hundred and fifty Spirit Stones!"
Han Tian’s voice was powerful and sonorous, igniting the enthusiasm of the entire venue.
"I bid one hundred and sixty!"
"I bid one hundred and seventy!"
...
The hall was ablaze with activity, and prices continuously climbed, but Xu Ping showed no interest, continuing to rest with his eyes closed, waiting for the Spirit Stone’s arrival.
As items were auctioned off one by one, the atmosphere at the scene became increasingly fervent.
Just then, Han Tian’s enthusiastic voice rang out: "To thank all fellow Daoists for their enthusiastic attendance, it has been decided to auction one of the finale items ahead of schedule!"
"Great!" an eager voice came from the crowd.
"I can’t wait any longer, let’s begin quickly!" the crowd urged one after another.
...
Facing the enthusiastic crowd, Han Tian’s smile grew even brighter:
"The next auction item—Purple Gold Strange Devouring Ape’s Essence Blood!"
He pointed to a Jade Bottle on the tray, loudly saying: "The Purple Gold Strange Devouring Ape is a second-stage upper-grade demon beast. You don’t need me to explain the efficacy of its essence blood."
...
"Second-stage upper-grade ape essence blood!" Xu Ping’s eyes could not help but brighten.
What a treasure!
He just happens to need it!
Currently, his Blood Demon Body Refining is at the second level; after training a bit longer, he can proceed to the third level.
And second-stage upper-grade ape essence blood is an indispensable item!
...
"Starting price—five thousand Spirit Stones, with a minimum increment of three hundred Spirit Stones per bid!"
Right after Han Tian spoke, bidding voices erupted from the second floor.
"Five thousand three hundred Spirit Stones!"
"Five thousand six hundred Spirit Stones!"
"Five thousand nine hundred Spirit Stones!"
...
Xu Ping did not immediately participate in the bidding; he was calmly waiting.
The price of the second-stage upper-grade ape essence blood kept rising until it neared seven thousand, leaving only two competitors.
One was a cultivator from the Song family, the other a second-stage body cultivator.
"Seven thousand one hundred Spirit Stones!" The second-stage body cultivator’s breathing was somewhat labored, clearly nearing his limit on this price.
"Seven thousand five hundred Spirit Stones!" The Song family cultivator appeared at ease, effortlessly raising the bid by four hundred Spirit Stones, seemingly unconcerned.
The second-stage body cultivator gritted his teeth, wanting to bid again, but this price exceeded his mental expectations. He opened his mouth but said nothing, reluctantly withdrawing.
The Song family cultivator smiled, assuming victory was certain, when suddenly a calm and resolute voice called out:
"Seven thousand eight hundred Spirit Stones."
This was naturally Xu Ping’s bid.
"Eight thousand one hundred Spirit Stones!" The Song family cultivator’s expression changed slightly, yet continued to raise the bid.
"Eight thousand six hundred Spirit Stones!"
Xu Ping showed no mercy, adding five hundred Spirit Stones, demonstrating an unwavering intent to win.
The Song family cultivator stared intently at Xu Ping’s box before finally giving up on the bid.
This price clearly exceeded the market price, continuing to compete would be unwise.
However, he silently logged this competitor in his mind.
"Congratulations to this fellow Daoist for purchasing this bottle of second-stage upper-grade ape essence blood. You may head to the side hall to finalize the transaction at any time,"
Han Tian’s face shone with satisfaction as he spoke with a smile.
Xu Ping went to the side hall, handed over the Spirit Stones, and obtained the Purple Gold Strange Devouring Ape’s essence blood. However, because the Soul Stone had yet to be auctioned, he remained.
As time passed, treasures continued to be auctioned off at high prices.
Xu Ping did not bid again.
"The final headline item—the Soul Stone!"
Han Tian’s voice noticeably heightened: "The Soul Stone is a kind of special ore capable of storing souls. If gravely injured and close to death, one can store one’s soul in it and, if a suitable body is found, live a second life!"
"Han Daoist, stop dawdling, just get on with it!" a Foundation Establishment cultivator in the box urged impatiently.
This treasure has little use for Qi cultivators, but its value is immense for Foundation Establishment cultivators.
Although Foundation Establishment cultivators have the conditions for reincarnation, their souls are exceptionally fragile.
As long as the soul leaves the body for a moment, it will perish. If one desires reincarnation, special objects to store one’s soul are necessary.
And the Soul Stone is one of the items capable of storing a cultivator’s soul.
Hearing the prompting from the crowd, Han Tian smiled slightly and then announced loudly: "Starting price—eight thousand Spirit Stones, with a minimum bid increase of five hundred Spirit Stones!"
"Eight thousand five hundred Spirit Stones!"
"Nine thousand Spirit Stones!"
"Nine thousand five hundred Spirit Stones!"
...
The price continuously climbed until it hit twelve thousand Spirit Stones, and the pace of bidding finally slowed.
"Thirteen thousand Spirit Stones!" the Song family cultivator said deeply.
Currently, the price of the Soul Stone had reached a dreadful number.

chapters.title: Chapter 144 - 141: Cultivator Robbers (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 144: Chapter 141: Cultivator Robbers (Part 2)
"Is there a higher bid?" Han Tian’s voice rang out, surveying the private rooms around.
"Thirteen thousand five hundred Spirit Stones!" Xu Ping’s voice, like a calm lake, broke the silence again.
"It’s him again!"
In the Song family box, a young man with sharp eyes and star-like brows was furious, slapping the table as he stood. He had naturally recognized the voice of his rival in bidding for the Purple Gold Strange Devouring Ape.
But he ultimately restrained his anger.
"Fourteen thousand Spirit Stones!" the Song family youth gritted his teeth and said.
"Fifteen thousand Spirit Stones!" Xu Ping’s voice was indifferent, directly adding a thousand Spirit Stones.
Fifteen thousand Spirit Stones, the Song family youth finally lost his composure; this price had already exceeded his psychological acceptance value.
"I am Song Li, a direct descendant of the Song family. May I know your name, friend?" the Song family youth called out loudly, with a hint of threat in his tone.
Xu Ping did not respond to Song Li, but instead turned his focus to the Han family: "What, does your Han family auction require names to be reported before bidding?"
Upon hearing this, Han Tian’s expression subtly changed. Although he did not wish to offend the Song family, he had to act: "You must be joking, guests don’t have to give their names at our Han family auction."
"Please, Fellow Daoist Song, do not disrupt the auction’s rules. This time we’ll let it pass, but if it happens again, even as a direct Song family member, I will have to escort you out of Han Yang market," Han Tian said with slightly narrowed eyes, carrying a hint of threat.
Song Li’s eyes were ablaze, glaring intensely at Xu Ping’s box.
But he also refrained from saying anything further!
Even though the Han family was not as prominent as the Song family, both were among the eight great families and not far apart in standing. If Han Tian were publicly embarrassed, they might indeed expel him from Han Yang market.
"Hmph!" Eventually, Song Li could only snort coldly, falling silent.
"Congratulations to this fellow Daoist for winning the Soul Stone!"
Without Song Li’s competition, Xu Ping smoothly secured the Soul Stone.
"This person is quite wealthy, spending over twenty thousand Spirit Stones at the auction!"
"Indeed, although this person has Foundation Establishment cultivation, I’m afraid leaving safely might not be easy!"
As Xu Ping went to finalize the Soul Stone trade, the entire venue was abuzz, even causing those in the second-floor boxes to stir with thought.
Among them, Song Li chuckled coldly to himself, curious to see how the other party planned to escape Han Yang market.
...
Side Hall!
"I don’t have enough Spirit Stones with me. Can I use a Magical Artifact as collateral?" Xu Ping asked.
"That’s certainly acceptable," Han Tian replied with a smile.
"You can check." After paying a large amount of Spirit Stones, Xu Ping handed over a top-grade Magical Artifact and an upper-grade Magical Artifact.
Han Tian appraised them, verifying that the Spirit Stones combined with the artifacts indeed amounted to nearly fifteen thousand Spirit Stones, then handed a jade box containing the Spirit Stone to Xu Ping: "The Soul Stone is yours, fellow Daoist!"
Xu Ping used his Divine Sense to sense the black stone inside, revealing a slight smile: "Finally, the Soul Stone is in my possession."
"A word of advice, fellow Daoist; within Han Yang market, I can ensure your safety, but once you leave, we can assume no responsibility," Han Tian remarked with hinted meaning.
Though tempted by Xu Ping’s wealth, Han Tian knew the distinction between two thousand Spirit Stones and the reputation of Han Yang market.
"Thank you for the advice." Xu Ping cupped his hands in acknowledgment.
He was well aware that his prominent display at the auction would indeed attract attention from others.
However, he was not overly concerned; twenty thousand Spirit Stones might entice early- or mid-stage Foundation Establishment cultivators significantly, but meant little to late-stage Foundation Establishment, Fake Pill, or Golden Core cultivators.
Given his strength, even if he couldn’t win, escape was not a problem.
Moreover, securing the Soul Stone and the Purple Gold Strange Devouring Ape’s blood had drained his Spirit Stone reserves; if any ill-intentioned individuals came his way, he wouldn’t mind replenishing his deflated wallet.
...
After securing the Soul Stone, Xu Ping did not linger, exiting Han Yang market and immediately sensing several gazes upon him, prompting a cold chuckle: "Seems there are indeed those who act without thinking!"
Unwilling to waste time on concealment, he directly summoned his Escape Light and flew off into the distance.
Once beyond Han Yang market’s vicinity, the attention on him grew more blatant and unabashed.
Xu Ping even sensed a familiar presence—could it be Song Li, a Song family direct descendant?
"Hmph!"
Xu Ping sneered inwardly, his gaze filled with killing intent. With chaos engulfing the Yue Country, such people grew increasingly brazen.
He continued to fly with his Escape Light, landing on a desolate stretch of land.
Soon, a Spiritual Boat approached, from which descended two Foundation Establishment cultivators, one at mid-stage. Both wore masks, and the mid-stage cultivator chuckled mockingly: "Is this the burial ground you’ve chosen?"
One who reaches Foundation Establishment naturally lacks no caution.
Though confident, both cultivators’ Divine Senses constantly swept the barren land, ensuring no ambushes or arrays were present!
"Burial ground? Though this place is small, it’s more than adequate to bury you both!" Xu Ping, sword in hand, exuded surging Sword Qi.
"All talk, are you?"
The mid-stage cultivator sneered, clapping his hands to summon a pitch-black flame crackling with thunderous explosions.
With a gentle hand lift, the black flame transformed into a phantom bird, radiating potent Mana pulses as it swooped toward Xu Ping.
Before the phantom bird even reached him, the intense heat seemed to curl Xu Ping’s hair.
The early-stage cultivator unleashed a massive Black Iron Hammer, expanding tenfold in size, bearing down on Xu Ping with tremendous momentum.
When they struck, they unleashed an overwhelming force.
"This guy’s just early-stage Foundation Establishment, yet attacked by two, one being mid-stage, might meet his end here."
Hidden watchers shook their heads, while Song Li, not participating directly, watched with satisfaction.
Faced with the two-pronged assault, Xu Ping’s calm belied those pronouncing him doomed.
"Slash!"
Mana surged as a grand Sword Qi erupted from the Purple Sun Sword, glinting with unparalleled sharpness as if to rend the heavens and earth.
Boom!
The Sword momentum surged, the Sword Qi transforming into a resplendent beam sweeping forward.
That Sword Qi, like thunder, sliced through the fire-turned phantasmal bird, shredding it to countless embers, scattering them widely.
Unimpeded, the Sword Qi struck the Black Iron Hammer, the booming clamor sending it flying.
"What!"
The onlookers were stunned; none expected Xu Ping’s Sword Qi to be so potent, obliterating the duo’s attacks in one strike.
"Tough customer, strike together!"
The mid-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator shouted, deploying three linked shields, yet unease lurked in his heart at Xu Ping’s formidable silhouette.
Buzz!
With his outburst, a figure shot toward Xu Ping at great speed.
"Die!"
The newcomer, clad in silver armor, loomed as a mountain, striking with a silver-armored punch without hesitation.
Boom!
The air ahead of the punch erupted, a deafening blast echoing.
"Second-stage Body Refining?"
Faced with the third assailant’s ambush, Xu Ping’s demeanor cooled, not unanticipated.
"Blood Demon True Form!"
With a low cry, Xu Ping’s form expanded, becoming a giant over four meters tall, enveloped in intense blood-red light.
The once-mighty silver-armored cultivator now appeared diminutive before him.
"The one who should perish is you!"
Xu Ping roared in fury, throwing a resolute, countering punch.
Rumble!
The ground shook, and a wide area around them caved as the clash resounded.
Surprisingly, with a scream, the assailing silver-armored cultivator was flung back, blood seeping from within the armor.
"Damn it, he’s a second-stage Middle Grade Body Refining cultivator too!" the mid-stage cultivator sputtered in frustration.
While Xu Ping clashed with the armored opponent, the pair were not idle.

chapters.title: Chapter 145 - 142: Nightmare Marsh
chapters.content:
Chapter 145: Chapter 142: Nightmare Marsh
"Light Body Technique!"
Xu Ping executed a magic technique, and in an instant, his figure dissipated like smoke at the original location.
The perfection of Light Body Technique gave him a burst of short-range speed that no magical artifact or talisman could catch up with.
Dodging the two attackers, before they could react, he had already closed in on the Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, throwing a punch without hesitation and roaring, "Die!"
The Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator’s protective spiritual light was the first to shatter, followed by a black iron shield.
"No!"
With eyes wide open in anger, Mana surged out like there was no cost, trying to withstand what felt like a crushing blow of Mount Tai.
However, all struggles appeared in vain.
Bang!
After a massive explosion, all that remained at the spot where the Early-Stage Foundation Establishment stood was a deep pit, with the black iron shield also smashed away!
"What!"
Upon witnessing his companion being killed in one strike, a wave of panic surged in the heart of the Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator; this was definitely not a normal Second-stage Middle Grade Body Refining skill.
They were besieging one person as a trio; now with one dead and one injured, even though they were all Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators, if this continued, his life would be at risk.
Thus, he did not hesitate to use the Escape Light and turned to flee.
At this moment, the audience was already stunned!
Just what kind of monster was this person, fighting solo against three Foundation Establishment cultivators, including a Mid-Stage, with the result now being one dead, one injured, and one fleeing.
In their hearts, they secretly felt fortunate that they did not wade into this troublesome situation, or else they would have been the ones falling now.
As for Song Li, his face was extremely unpleasant; as a direct disciple of the Song family, he found himself inferior to the opponent despite being the same Early-Stage Foundation Establishment level.
This was undoubtedly hard for him to accept.
"Trying to run!"
Xu Ping’s face showed coldness, and he swiftly used the Escape Light to chase after him!
"Why is your escape technique faster than mine!"
After fleeing a short distance, the Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator was shocked to discover that Xu Ping’s speed was far superior.
"Go to hell and ask!"
Coldness flashed in Xu Ping’s eyes as sword light gathered again, forming a brilliant sword shadow, rushing straight at the Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
He knew he couldn’t outrun it, so he could only choose to fight hard.
"Fall!"
He roared angrily, pushing both hands forward, instantly transforming the black flames into a massive fireball, pouncing towards Xu Ping, containing powerful Mana as if to devour everything.
"Boom!"
When the two collided, countless sparks flew everywhere in an instant.
The fireball was torn apart by sword light, instantly transforming into countless flames, scattering over the barren land.
"This... this is impossible!"
The Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator showed fear, "How is your swordsmanship so strong!!"
"Humph!"
Xu Ping scoffed, the Purple Sun Sword in his hand gleaming brilliantly, sword Qi gathering again, transforming into a thunderous sword light, charging straight at him.
"Five Elements Shield... rise!"
Facing the Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator’s panic, he summoned a five-colored circular shield, injecting all his Mana into the Five Elements Shield, which floated mid-air, blocking the majestic sword Qi.
Boom!
With just one collision, a deep sword mark appeared on the five-colored shield.
Feeling the rapid loss of Mana within, the Mid-Stage’s fear grew stronger: "Are you actually trying to perish together!!"
"Perish together? You really overestimate yourself!"
Xu Ping sneered coldly, gathering sword light again, turning into an invisible sword Qi, aiming straight for the heart of the Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
"You forced me!"
He gritted his teeth, retrieving a seemingly ordinary yellow talisman paper, and sprayed life essence on it.
Buzz!
The talisman paper shattered, revealing a blood-red small knife, emanating a terrifying power.
"Is this... a Blood Spirit Talisman?" Xu Ping’s face showed amazement.
This was a special Second-stage Upper Grade talisman, infused with a cultivator’s life essence, capable of reaching the power of a talisman treasure.
The blood-red small knife effortlessly cut through the sword Qi, and then the power continued to aim at Xu Ping.
Seeing this, Xu Ping did not hesitate to raise a white jade tortoiseshell spiritual artifact.
The next moment!
With a flash of blade light, the blood-red small knife collided with the white jade tortoiseshell, piercing through this magical artifact directly!
The blood-red small knife continued its trajectory towards Xu Ping!
"It’s actually this strong!?"
Xu Ping’s face grew serious, retreating quickly!
"Die for me!"
The Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator’s face turned incredibly pale, and his aura rapidly diminished, but he still clenched his teeth and manipulated the slightly dimmed blood-red small knife, continuing to pursue Xu Ping.
Xu Ping’s face was serious, but there was no trace of panic in his eyes.
"Kill him!"
Accompanied by his thought, with a ’boom’, the hard ground exploded directly, and a ghostly claw illuminated by a faint glow clawed toward the Mid-Stage cultivator’s heart.
"No!"
Fear flooded his eyes, but he was powerless, only able to watch as the ghostly claw tore through the protective spiritual light, easily penetrating his chest.
"Poof!"
Blood sprayed wildly, his lips trembled slightly, wanting to say something.
The next moment.
Boom!
With a exertion, the ghostly claw shattered his upper body into pieces, leaving only the two legs below the waist.
The blood-red small knife lost its source of power, quickly dimming, ultimately ’bang’, it shattered into fragments.
At this moment, the entire battlefield became incredibly quiet, with only the sound of the wind howling.
"Is this... a Demon Beast? Or a Puppet?"
Those hiding in the dark looked on in shock, their backs long drenched in cold sweat.
The rat demon hidden underground was unnoticed by anyone; didn’t that mean that under a surprise attack, no one present could withstand it?
At this moment, their gazes towards Xu Ping were filled with apprehension.

chapters.title: Chapter 146 - 142: Nightmare Marshes (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 146: Chapter 142: Nightmare Marshes (Part 2)
What kind of monster is this person?
His swordsmanship is unparalleled, second-stage middle-grade body refining, and puppets that can hide divine sense. His overall strength is probably not much different from a late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
Facing everyone’s shock, Xu Ping expressionlessly collected the spoils of battle from the two bodies. As for the silver-armored cultivator, seeing the situation turning unfavorable, he had already fled, and Xu Ping couldn’t be bothered to pursue him.
He flicked out two fireballs, reducing the two bodies to ashes, then swept his gaze over the crowd hiding in the shadows.
As his gaze swept over them, everyone felt a chill in their hearts, goosebumps popping up involuntarily.
Song Li felt especially intense, as if Xu Ping’s gaze lingered the longest where he was hiding.
Seeing that no one dared to jump out, Xu Ping smirked coldly at the corner of his mouth, mounted his escape light, and flew away into the distance.
Only when Xu Ping’s figure completely disappeared did everyone breathe a sigh of relief.
"Who is this person? Though only at early-stage Foundation Establishment, his combat power actually rivals late-stage Foundation Establishment. In Yue Country, I fear not even the major Golden Core sects have cultivated such a disciple. Could he be a genius disciple of Luoyun Sect?"
At this moment, everyone couldn’t help but recall his extravagance at the auction, becoming more certain of their guess.
Extraordinary wealth, extraordinary strength, this is definitely a genius disciple of Luoyun Sect.
Though Luoyun Sect is now on shaky ground, a dying camel is still bigger than a horse; it remains the strongest in all of Yue Country.
They all secretly felt relieved again, thankful they hadn’t been the first to engage, or they’d be the ones dead.
...
In a desolate mountain.
On a cliff face, within a cave dwelling temporarily created.
Xu Ping sat cross-legged on a meditation cushion, swallowing a pill and quietly recovering his mana.
Though he fought with apparent ease, the mana consumption was indeed substantial.
As the pill in his abdomen was refined, a continuous stream of medicinal power turned into spiritual Qi, flooding into his dantian, and the previously depleted mana quickly replenished.
A long time passed.
Feeling the abundant mana in his dantian, Xu Ping slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air: "This battle had some risks. If not for the Rat Demon’s sneak attack, it would have been very difficult to deal with the opponent!"
The opponent’s desperate use of the Blood Spirit Talisman was too powerful, probably reaching the might of a treasure talisman.
Treasure talismans are quasi-tier three talismans, equivalent to Fake Pill power.
Facing Fake Pill power, even if he went all out, he might not have been able to withstand it.
Fortunately, he was cautious and had the Rat Demon hide underground beforehand.
"Truly, one must not underestimate any cultivator," Xu Ping reflected.
"I wonder if he still has any Blood Spirit Talismans left. If so, it would be a decent trump card!"
Xu Ping’s thoughts stirred as he took out the two people’s storage rings, broke the divine sense imprint on them, and delved into them with his own divine sense.
After a careful search, he was a bit disappointed not to find any trace of the Blood Spirit Talisman.
Thinking about it, it’s understandable that such a precious talisman is lucky to have even one.
However, although he didn’t find a Blood Spirit Talisman, there were thousands of Spirit Stones and spiritual objects worth tens of thousands of Spirit Stones in their storage rings, which somewhat comforted him.
More exciting was that he found a Purple Flower Grass for refining Foundation Establishment Pills, which was an unexpected gain.
"Now that everything is ready, I can proceed to hunt demon beasts!" Xu Ping mused.
As for where to hunt, he already had an idea.
In all of Yue Country, there aren’t many places with numerous demon beasts for him to hunt that aren’t near the warring regions of the two countries.
The Nightmare Swamp... is the best place to go!
Though the swamp is perpetually shrouded in mist, which can even block the divine sense of Foundation Establishment cultivators, and is infamous for its danger, staying on the outskirts is not that risky for them.
With his strength, as long as he doesn’t act recklessly, staying alive isn’t difficult.
Xu Ping packed up his array and flew in a set direction.
But instead of heading directly to Nightmare Swamp, he first returned to the Zhang family, rested, and then set out for the swamp.
...
...
Nightmare Swamp.
Whimsical white mist enveloped the entire sky, like a mysterious veil. Under the mist, countless towering trees stood tall, with interlocking branches and leaves forming a natural barrier, roots deeply embedded in the slick soil.
Suddenly!
Boom!
A loud noise shattered the silence, accompanied by roiling white mist. A lizard-like demon beast was blown away, its massive body breaking tree roots as it hit the ground, barely alive, seemingly on its last breath.
At this moment, a tall figure walked through the mist, and upon looking closely, it was none other than Xu Ping.
He took out a soul stone, walked to the demon beast, and then extended an index finger toward the lizard demon beast’s head, chanting incantations.
Soon, his extended finger slowly lit up, emitting a faint white light.
As he chanted, the white light grew brighter, gradually becoming almost blinding.
"Hurry," Xu Ping muttered once the timing seemed right.
The white light on his finger suddenly shot out a thread, piercing deep into the lizard demon beast’s skull before he gave a sudden pull.
Buzz!
A green light sphere was instantly drawn out, and as it was removed, the lizard demon beast, which had been on its last breath, moved no more.
Seeing this, Xu Ping immediately summoned the soul stone.
With a ’whoosh’, the soul stone emitted a gloomy light, enveloping the green light sphere and absorbing it.
"This Soul Summoning Skill is quite useful!" Xu Ping remarked, touching the soul stone and feeling the beast’s soul inside, allowing a slight smile to appear at the corner of his mouth.
The Soul Summoning Skill is a type of magic recorded in the "Spirit Summoning Skill", capable of drawing souls.
It’s extremely difficult to cultivate, and even when mastered at the entry level, there’s a chance of failure.
But for Xu Ping, who had panel assistance, it was quite simple.
As his proficiency increased, the likelihood of failure approached zero, making his efficiency far beyond ordinary people.
After extracting the soul, Xu Ping proceeded to refine the essence blood.
A quarter of an hour later.
Xu Ping skillfully extracted and refined the blood and flesh of the lizard demon beast into a vial of essence blood.
"Both soul and essence blood are ready, so it’s time to find a place for practice!" Xu Ping thought to himself.
He didn’t return to the Zhang family, instead choosing a secluded spot in the Nightmare Swamp to dig a cave dwelling.
After all, if he failed completely, he could resupply on the spot, sparing him another trip.
Moreover, the outskirts of the Nightmare Swamp are relatively safe, with the protection of arrays and the patrolling Rat Demon, he wasn’t afraid of being disturbed.
Inside the cave covered by an array, Xu Ping took out all the necessary items.
Soul stone, essence blood, spirit pen.
Taking a deep breath, Xu Ping began to draw the ’Spirit Summoning Skill’.
He removed his robe, revealing his solid chest, and dipped the spirit pen into the demon beast’s essence blood before starting to draw a pattern on his chest along a fixed route.
For someone with rich experience in drawing talismans, this step was quite simple.
Very soon, a peculiar blood-colored pattern prominently appeared on his chest.
"Next is the soul infusion!" Xu Ping’s expression became serious as this was the hardest and most crucial step.
He placed the soul stone in front of him and then extended an index finger toward it, reciting incantations.
"Hurry," he muttered.
With a low shout, a white thread shot from the fingertip, piercing the soul stone. Then, he gave a sudden pull.
A green light sphere was firmly grasped.
Seeing this, Xu Ping’s expression became extremely serious. He performed a magic technique with a word, "Merge!"
Instantly, the green light sphere merged into the blood-colored pattern drawn with essence blood.
"Refine!"
Xu Ping altered his magic technique as mana surged, with green light diffusing along the pattern’s path.
The light flowed rapidly, spreading halfway in a moment.
However, when the green light reached a junction, it suddenly turned sluggish, encountering an obstacle.
In the next instant!
Boom!
With a loud bang, the blood-colored pattern on Xu Ping’s chest exploded, and the huge impact sent him flying, crashing heavily against the wall!

chapters.title: Chapter 147 - 143: Success!
chapters.content:
Chapter 147: Chapter 143: Success!
As the dust settled, Xu Ping grimaced as he climbed up from the ground.
With his physique, although the explosion wasn’t enough to injure him, the churning blood and pain from the blast made him cough involuntarily.
"The connections in the engraved pattern aren’t smooth enough!" Xu Ping rubbed his slightly reddened chest, summarizing the cause of his failure this time.
He was already accustomed to failure, and it couldn’t cause any ripples in his heart.
Just continue with the engravings; success will come eventually.
Xu Ping wiped off the pattern on his chest, adjusted his breath for a moment, and after calming the turbulent energy, he packed up the array and went to search for demon beasts again.
Time passed slowly as he continued hunting demons, engraving, and failing.
Despite repeated setbacks, he never felt discouraged. Instead, with the accumulation of experience, he became increasingly convinced that he was getting closer to success.
...
...
A month later.
In the cave dwelling covered by the array.
Xu Ping’s face was grave; as the magic technique changed, green light began to spread along the route of the blood-red pattern.
The speed of the light flow was extremely fast, and the process was very smooth.
In just a few breaths, the green light had covered the entire pattern on his chest.
"This... did it succeed?" Xu Ping was stunned for a moment, feeling a surge of excitement in his heart.
Buzz!
In the instant his thoughts drifted, a ray of blood-green light burst forth from the pattern on his chest, the dazzling light was so blinding that he couldn’t open his eyes, but it quickly dimmed down again.
"Success!!"
Xu Ping’s face bloomed with a wildly joyful smile; he was certain in his heart that he had finally succeeded.
"Let’s test the effect!"
Xu Ping took a deep breath, suppressing his inner excitement, and was eager to give it a try.
"Spirit Summoning Skill!"
He shouted in a low voice, the spiritual power in his hand surged continuously, and suddenly, a phantom snake appeared on his back, as if it was real.
"Merge!"
Xu Ping’s eyes turned red, and with a roar, he forcibly merged the phantom snake into his body.
As the snake shadow gradually dissipated, his aura surged sharply, and within moments, his mana reached the extreme limit of the early-stage Foundation Establishment, seventy drops of mana.
"Seventy drops of mana!"
Feeling the tremendous boost brought by the Spirit Summoning Skill, Xu Ping was secretly amazed in his heart; it boosted nearly twenty drops of mana.
"It was worth spending all that time and Spirit Stones!"
Xu Ping was in a pleasant mood, feeling that the time and Spirit Stones spent during this period were indeed worthwhile, as it at least elevated his strength by half a level.
He closed his eyes and carefully sensed his situation.
"There seems to be no pressure on both the physique and the mana, so it seems there are no side effects."
"It’s just... the power of the demon beast’s essence blood in the pattern is slowly draining away. At this rate, it can last for about a quarter of an hour?"
Regarding this situation, Xu Ping wasn’t surprised.
Books recorded that once the Spirit Summoning Skill was activated, the power in the demon beast’s essence blood would drain away slowly, requiring replenishment with essence blood of the same stage after each use.
Replenishing essence blood of the same stage wasn’t difficult for Xu Ping; it was just a matter of hunting a few more second-stage demon beasts.
"Now that the ’Spirit Summoning Skill’ test is complete, it’s time to see if it can be used in conjunction with the ’Heavenly Demon Solution’ to stack the effects!" Xu Ping thought to himself.
If they could be combined, it would allow his strength to take a qualitative leap.
Xu Ping composed himself, his expression becoming solemn.
The ’Heavenly Demon Solution’ wasn’t as easy as the Spirit Summoning Skill; it required burning essence blood, and a moment’s carelessness could lead to excessive self-damage.
Fortunately, during this time, he had practiced the ’Heavenly Demon Solution’ to the point of Minor Achievement and mastered it perfectly; otherwise, he wouldn’t dare to try stacking them lightly.
"Heavenly Demon Solution!"
Xu Ping changed the magic technique, mana surged along a special route.
Buzz!
In the next moment, his internal essence blood began to burn, a vast aura rose from his body, as if to tear everything apart, but was suppressed by an invisible force.
Thud!
A deep sound resonated in Xu Ping’s body, and an invisible wave of energy rippled outwards, stirring up dust all around.
If it weren’t for his strong physique, injury would have been inevitable.
Xu Ping’s eyes were bloodshot, his face flushed; he knew this was the bottleneck from early-stage to mid-stage.
"Break!"
He roared, unleashing all his mana.
Crack!
It seemed as though he heard a cracking sound by his ear; the bottleneck was broken!
Boom!
His aura surged like a tide, and the mana within his dantian increased rapidly.
Seventy-five drops, eighty drops, ninety drops... one hundred and ten drops!
"This mana..."
Xu Ping’s face showed a look of shock; one hundred and ten drops of liquid mana, nearly reaching the peak of an ordinary mid-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
Ordinary early-stage Foundation Establishment breaks through with fifty drops of liquid mana, reaching the peak of mid-stage Foundation Establishment with roughly one hundred and twenty drops.
He truly hadn’t expected that the combined effect of the two techniques would be so terrifying.
Xu Ping clenched his fist, abundant mana surged, giving him a feeling as if he could slay everything.
He knew this was an illusion caused by the sudden spike in mana; after all, it increased from fifty drops of liquid mana to one hundred and ten drops, more than double.
"With my current strength, if I give it my all, I may not be able to say for sure about a Fake Pill cultivator, but I should be able to easily kill a late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator!" Xu Ping thought to himself.
Although he had the urge to test his strength, the side effects of the Heavenly Demon Solution were too great. If he tried it now, he would be weak for at least a period, which wouldn’t be practical in the Nightmare Swamp.
