chapters.title: Chapter 152 - 145: Breaking Through to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment
chapters.content:
Chapter 152: Chapter 145: Breaking Through to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment
It’s better to proceed cautiously.
Thus, Xu Ping began to operate the Longevity Skill, regulating his breath to stabilize his cultivation.
Five days passed by in a flash.
"I can start now!"
Xu Ping suddenly opened his eyes, a flash of green flickered past; he was in an unprecedentedly good state!
"Spirit Summoning Skill, Demonic Unravel!"
He shouted in a low voice, consecutively casting two secret techniques, and the liquid mana in his dantian started to increase continuously.
One hundred twenty drops, one hundred thirty drops... Finally stopping at one hundred eighty drops, which was already comparable to the mana cultivation of a late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
"Open!"
Xu Ping held the wooden box with both hands and roared, unleashing the full force of the one hundred eighty drops of mana in his dantian.
Buzz!
The pitch-black wooden box suddenly erupted with a strong spiritual light, illuminating the entire cultivation chamber brightly.
At the next moment.
’Creak’ sounded as the lid of the wooden box suddenly opened.
"It’s open!"
Seeing this scene, Xu Ping couldn’t help but show a joyful expression and decisively stopped both secret techniques.
"Phew!"
Xu Ping let out a deep breath, and with the cessation of the secret techniques, his originally rosy complexion turned pale.
Fortunately, the time for activating the Demonic Unravel was not long, and the burning blood essence wasn’t much, it would take just a few days to recover.
However, at this moment, he didn’t care about such matters. With a look of delight, he gazed into the wooden box, only to see a solitary jade slip lying within.
"Just a single jade slip?"
A tinge of disappointment flashed through Xu Ping’s heart, prompting him to speculate, "Could it be that some top-notch cultivation technique is recorded inside?"
He took out the jade slip, and as his Divine Sense penetrated inside, the four large characters "Wood Sword Array" abruptly appeared in his mind.
"Sword Array?"
Xu Ping was taken aback, his face betraying some surprise.
Dull green characters emerged one after another in his Divine Sense, and Xu Ping plunged into the contemplation of these mantras, remaining motionless.
Sitting there like this, he unknowingly spent several hours.
The expression on Xu Ping’s face was extremely peculiar; at times he was very excited, at times he frowned, and occasionally he appeared with a sweaty forehead in an odd circumstance.
After four hours, the look on his face finally settled down.
Another moment passed, Xu Ping’s face turned sullen as he took a deep breath and opened his eyes, a profound gleam faintly flickering within them.
"The power of this sword array is indeed extremely strong, but its crafting method is too difficult!" Xu Ping licked his dry lips, murmuring helplessly.
The "Wood Sword Array" is a special sword array made with spirit wood swords, having two types in total.
The first type is made with thirty-six flying swords formed by spirit wood of the same root and origin in the second-stage upper grade, then refined into the sword array.
According to the jade slip’s description, if mastered, even a Foundation Establishment cultivator can compete with a fake pill cultivator.
However, as it requires simultaneously controlling thirty flying swords, at the very least, a late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator can barely manage it.
The second type is made with seventy-two flying swords formed by spirit wood of the same root and origin in the third-stage upper grade, then refined into the sword array.
Once mastered, it can sweep across core formation, but at the least, a core formation cultivator is needed to master this sword array.
When Xu Ping first saw the "Wood Sword Array," he was extremely excited, considering that even if he only mastered the first type, combined with his Sword Qi Thunder Sound, how powerful would that be?
If a fake pill cultivator entered his sword array, they’d probably be skinned alive if not dead.
But upon contemplating the difficulty of crafting this array, his scalp couldn’t help but tense.
Thirty-six flying swords, even if making the swords smaller, how much second-stage upper grade spirit wood would it need?
Second-stage upper grade spirit wood is exceptionally precious, once it appears, it’s immediately snapped up, and it might take decades to gather enough of such second-stage upper-grade spirit wood.
"Seems like there’s no way to craft this sword array for now!" After deliberating in the cultivation chamber repeatedly, Xu Ping could only shake his head in resignation.
Of course, he won’t give up on this extremely strong sword array; he can only wait for Yue Country’s situation to stabilize before slowly collecting second-stage upper grade spirit wood.
"Yet even if the second-stage upper grade spirit wood is gathered, finding a reliable person to craft it is still a bother." Xu Ping furrowed his brows slightly.
Crafting thirty-six magic swords with second-stage upper grade spirit wood involves such an enormous workload that typical second-stage artifact refiners can’t accomplish.
Moreover, these thirty-six magic swords hold immense value; not to mention Foundation Establishment cultivators, even fake pill cultivators, or even golden core cultivators, would be tempted.
At that time, it will surely bring him infinite troubles.
"Perhaps I could learn artifact refining; then, I could craft them myself, with the skill panel available, I wouldn’t fear failing to learn or mastering the skill." Xu Ping mused to himself.
"Except, second-stage artifact refining inheritance is hard to find; in remote places like the Ten Thousand Mountains, certainly, there’s nothing for sale."
"I also wonder when Yue Country’s warfare will cease. Although the Ten Thousand Mountains are safely stable, the scarcity of resources does hinder cultivation."
"Why rush? Considering my current lifespan, a little time delay won’t be significant, let’s wait slowly." Xu Ping couldn’t help but chuckle self-deprecatingly.
Rushing won’t help in the matters of cultivation.
After casting a ’Cleaning Technique’ to dust off the dirt on his body, Xu Ping exited the chamber.
Stepping into the courtyard, the pond was tranquil, the water surface mirror-like, several lotus flowers stood tall and swayed gently with the waves.
Koi swam leisurely in the water, occasionally leaping out, generating a series of fine water splashes, with the sunlight’s refraction casting fantasy-like ripples.
Seeing such idyllic scenery, Xu Ping’s mood gradually lifted.
...
...
Half a month later.
Inside the cultivation chamber.
Xu Ping ended a week’s worth of cultivation, opening his eyes, a trace of contemplation in his gaze.
After breaking through to mid-stage Foundation Establishment, he could clearly feel his cultivation pace slowing.
This is due to two reasons.
First, because after Xu Ping broke through to mid-stage Foundation Establishment, the demand for spiritual qi increased, and though the Spirit Gathering Array was in place, making the spiritual qi around his abode akin to second-stage upper grade spirit veins, it was certainly not as intense as during early-stage Foundation Establishment.
Secondly, there’s a lack of suitable pills to aid cultivation.
"There’s nothing I can do about the former, but for the latter, I could try gathering spirit medicine to refine the Dragon Returning Pill." Xu Ping pondered silently.
He had long become a second-stage middle grade alchemist, so refining second-stage middle grade pills like the Dragon Returning Pill naturally posed no difficulty.
However, the only downside is that gathering spirit medicine to refine the Dragon Returning Pill is quite challenging.
Last time, gathering spirit medicine for the Qi Refining Pill alone took two months, and now collecting for the Dragon Returning Pill might take even longer.
Just as Xu Ping was pondering this, the sound transmission talisman from Duan Shuang in his embrace suddenly flickered.
Heart stirring, Xu Ping retrieved the transmission talisman and infused a trace of mana into it.
Suddenly, Duan Shuang’s delighted voice emerged, "Xu Daoist, Luoyun Sect didn’t lie; Yuncheng Ancestor has returned!"
"Is this true?" Xu Ping’s eyes instantly brightened, filled with irrepressible excitement.
"How could it not be! This news will probably spread through the entire Yue Country soon."
Duan Shuang continued, the excitement clear in her tone, "After Yuncheng Ancestor’s return, they immediately struck against Hu Country cultivators, consecutively killing several golden core cultivators, forcing Hu Country’s nascent soul ancestor to reveal himself."
"Reportedly, a fierce duel unfolded between the two nascent soul ancestors, but the outcome was indecisive, and now Hu Country has begun to retreat."
"This is truly great news!" Heaving a sigh of relief, Xu Ping couldn’t help but smile.
Yuncheng Ancestor’s return, Hu Country’s retreat, the cloud of war overhead had finally dissipated.
After Yue Country calms down, he can seek a place rich in resources and spirit veins to focus on his cultivation.
"Indeed, for us Yue Country cultivators, there’s no better news than this." Duan Shuang laughed.
"Though Hu Country has retreated, it’s likely Qiu Xuan Mountain cannot be reassembled; may I ask what Fellow Daoist Xu plans to do now?" she inquired with a hint of meaning.
"What else is there to plan, but to find a place to settle and peacefully focus on cultivation." Xu Ping replied calmly, his eyes flashing.
"Since such is the case, may I invite the fellow to cultivate at Purple Bamboo Mountain?" Duan Shuang offered sincerely.
"Purple Bamboo Mountain? Where is this?" Xu Ping asked with a slight pause, immediately inquiring.

chapters.title: Chapter 153 - 146: Agreeing to Join
chapters.content:
Chapter 153: Chapter 146: Agreeing to Join
"In the southwest of Yue Country, Purple Bamboo Mountain has a large second-stage upper-grade spirit vein, although it isn’t comparable to a third-stage spirit vein, it is definitely among the top of second-stage upper-grade veins," Duan Shuang replied.
"A large second-stage upper-grade spirit vein?" Hearing this, Xu Ping was shocked internally.
Spirit veins are divided into three sizes: large, medium, and small; like Cangyuan Mountain, which belongs to the medium-small second-stage middle-grade spirit vein.
Large second-stage upper-grade spirit veins are rare throughout the entire Yue Country.
Although surprised by Purple Bamboo Mountain’s spirit vein, Xu Ping did not immediately express whether he would join or not, and instead cautiously asked, "May I ask Fellow Daoist Duan, why invite someone like me with unknown backgrounds to join Purple Bamboo Mountain?"
"Fellow Daoist Xu is not someone with an unknown background, but rather a famous sword cultivator in the entire Yue Country," Duan Shuang’s charming laughter came through the sound transmission talisman.
Hearing this, Xu Ping immediately understood, the other party must already know his true identity.
However, this wasn’t something easy to hide; although he had comprehended Sword Qi Thunder Sound in the early-stage Foundation Establishment, making him quite a talent in swordsmanship, it was within cultivators’ understanding.
Naturally, it wouldn’t be comparable to a genius who comprehended Sword Qi Thunder Sound with a Celestial Spirit Root and in the Qi Refining realm, attracting Golden Core Patriarchs, or even Nascent Soul Patriarchs to vie for taking them as disciples.
Moreover, with the end of the war between the two countries, without conflicts of interest, neither Golden Core sects nor Nascent Soul sects, being no fools, would cause trouble for him without reason.
Yue Country is large, enough to accommodate him completely.
"Originally, Purple Bamboo Mountain had three Foundation Establishment cultivators, but unfortunately, one fell during the war between the two countries; now there is a vacancy, so I thought of you, Fellow Daoist Xu," Duan Shuang continued, with a tone of anticipation.
"Thank you Fellow Daoist Duan for your trust," Xu Ping thanked and then asked, "May I ask about the other Fellow Daoist residing on Purple Bamboo Mountain, what is their background?"
"Their background is very clean, and they are a second-stage mid-grade artifact refiner," Duan Shuang replied.
"A second-stage mid-grade artifact refiner?"
Xu Ping’s heart stirred, this would be a nice neighbor, perhaps he could learn the artifact refining technique through them.
Subsequently, he asked several questions about Purple Bamboo Mountain, and Duan Shuang answered each one.
He had a rough understanding of Purple Bamboo Mountain in his mind.
Purple Bamboo Mountain is located in the southwest of Liang Country, not far from the Wanzhe Waters.
Wanzhe Waters is a vast expanse of water, with countless islands scattered within, rich in resources, where one of the Golden Core sects, Shuize Sect, is established.
A large second-stage upper-grade spirit vein, abundant resources, and having a neighbor who is a second-stage mid-grade artifact refiner, it fits his requirements very well.
After thinking for a moment, Xu Ping asked, "Fellow Daoist Duan invited me to join Purple Bamboo Mountain, may I know what the other Fellow Daoist thinks?"
"I’ve discussed it with Fellow Daoist Wu for sure before extending the invitation to you," Duan Shuang laughed charmingly.
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping smiled slightly, "In that case, I appreciate Fellow Daoist Duan’s invitation, I shall join Purple Bamboo Mountain."
"From now on, we will be neighbors," Duan Shuang’s voice, tinged with joy, came through the sound transmission talisman.
Inviting a genius sword cultivator to join Purple Bamboo Mountain, while he is also a second-stage alchemist, would greatly enhance the strength and influence of Purple Bamboo Mountain.
"However, I am quite far from Purple Bamboo Mountain now, it might take me some time to arrive," Xu Ping said, with a tone of apology.
"It’s alright, the war is over now, Fellow Daoist doesn’t need to rush," Duan Shuang laughed.
"Thank you Fellow Daoist Duan for understanding," Xu Ping expressed gratitude.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, no need to be so polite, after all, we’ll be neighbors," Duan Shuang chuckled softly.
"That’s true," Xu Ping smiled slightly.
After chatting for a few more words, the brilliance of the long-distance sound transmission talisman faded away.
Gazing at the long-distance sound transmission talisman, Xu Ping murmured to himself:
"Purple Bamboo Mountain indeed is a good place for stable cultivation, but before leaving, I need to leave a Foundation Establishment cultivator with the Zhang family, only then can the Zhang family continue to pass on successfully."
Thinking for a moment, he turned his hand, and a jade box containing Purple Flower Grass and an earth-yellow demon core appeared in his palm.
"Now the main materials for crafting the Foundation Establishment Pill are ready, the rest of the auxiliary materials are not difficult to find, once the Foundation Establishment Pill is made, the Zhang family can find a Qi Refining ninth layer peak cultivator to start Foundation Establishment."
After pondering for a moment, Xu Ping stored the Purple Flower Grass and demon core, and left the cave dwelling to go to the market outside Ten Thousand Mountains to collect auxiliary materials for the Foundation Establishment Pill.
Seven days later.
Xu Ping returned to the cave dwelling again.
In the cultivation room, he took out the pill furnace and all the materials for crafting the Foundation Establishment Pill.
"Let’s begin alchemy!"
Xu Ping flipped his palm, and a light red flame flower appeared in his palm, which was Foundation Establishment True Flame!
With a gentle wave of his arm, the Foundation Establishment True Flame fell into the fire port below the Purple Profound Tripod, then surged to the size of a baby’s head, starting to heat the Purple Profound Tripod.
With his skill in alchemy coupled with the assistance of the panel, there was naturally no possibility of failure.
Five days later.
The entire cultivation room was filled with a faint medicinal fragrance, refreshing and invigorating.
At this moment, the alchemy was in its final stages.
The alchemy furnace radiated light, emitting a rich medicinal aroma.
"Open!"
Xu Ping shouted, a magic technique in his hands, executing the furnace skill.
Buzz!
A colorful mist burst open the cauldron lid, and heat waves swept around.
Above the alchemy furnace, faint auspicious clouds appeared, enveloped in a colorful halo.
Xu Ping formed a magic technique, and immediately two pills surrounded by auspicious mist settled into his hand.
"Foundation Establishment Pill... is done!"
A smile couldn’t help but curl at the corner of Xu Ping’s mouth; his alchemy technique now almost rivaled that of a Hidden Alchemist in the past.

chapters.title: Chapter 154 - 146: Agreeing to Join_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 154: Chapter 146: Agreeing to Join_2
After carefully storing the Foundation Establishment Pill and restoring his Mana, Xu Ping summoned Zhang Qingfeng to his cave dwelling.
"Clan Leader, what might you need from this old man?" Zhang Qingfeng inquired respectfully.
"I have little lifespan left. In a few months, I fear I might pass away." Xu Ping, disguised as Zhang Yu, said calmly.
"Ah! How could this be? Has your injury not healed completely, Clan Leader?" Zhang Qingfeng raised his head in shock.
"My lifespan was already limited; how could the injury heal so easily?" Xu Ping shook his head with a bitter smile.
"Then what should we do next?"
Looking at the deathly aura on Xu Ping, Zhang Qingfeng couldn’t help but become extremely anxious.
If the Clan Leader truly passes away and the Zhang family has yet to produce a new Foundation Establishment Cultivator, Cangyuan Mountain would be lost.
After a moment of silence, Xu Ping slowly said, "I have a Pill Master friend who is preparing to refine a batch of Foundation Establishment Pills. I plan to visit him and try my luck."
"Gather all the Spirit Stones in the clan and give them to me; I will then sell off my Magical Artifacts and other items to scrape together enough Spirit Stones to purchase the Foundation Establishment Pill."
Upon hearing this, Zhang Qingfeng was overjoyed: "Rest assured, Clan Leader, I will certainly gather all the Spirit Stones in the clan as quickly as possible."
Although the Foundation Establishment Pill cannot guarantee the birth of a Foundation Establishment Cultivator 100%, it is worth the Zhang family’s vigorous effort to try.
...
Several days later.
Zhang Qingfeng handed Xu Ping a storage bag filled with Spirit Stones:
"Clan Leader, these are all the Spirit Stones we have. I don’t know if it’s enough. If it’s not, we still have several shops in the market outside Ten Thousand Mountains, and if they’re mortgaged, we could possibly raise another one or two thousand Spirit Stones."
Xu Ping took the storage bag and scanned it with his Divine Sense, discovering that it contained no less than eleven thousand Spirit Stones.
"Enough!" Xu Ping nodded.
He simply wanted to fleece a bit before leaving and had no intention of bankrupting the entire Zhang family.
"I will be swift in my return; you go ahead and select a clan member suitable for consuming the Foundation Establishment Pill." Having stored the bag safely, Xu Ping instructed.
"This old man understands." Zhang Qingfeng bowed respectfully.
"Hmm!"
Xu Ping nodded, and after a few more instructions, he departed Cangyuan Mountain in his Escape Light.
Watching Xu Ping’s gradually retreating figure, Zhang Qingfeng couldn’t help but sigh: "I hope the Clan Leader goes smoothly."
Xu Ping did not actually leave, but merely feigned as such, sneaking back to Cangyuan Mountain afterward.
...
More than a month later, seeing that the time was about right and the Zhang family had chosen a candidate, Xu Ping pretended to return to Cangyuan Mountain, dust-laden and weary.
In a side hall, Zhang Qingfeng and a middle-aged man around forty respectfully stood before Xu Ping.
"How did your journey go, Clan Leader?" Zhang Qingfeng asked expectantly.
"Though there were ups and downs, the Foundation Establishment Pill is in hand!"
Xu Ping, ’weary’ faced, revealed a smile as he turned his right hand, a quaint jade box appearing in his hand, inside which lay a lustrous pill.
"Foundation Establishment Pill!" Zhang Qingfeng and the middle-aged man exclaimed simultaneously, eyes bursting with intense joy.
Though they hadn’t consumed pig meat, they had seen pigs run before, naturally recognizing this genuine Foundation Establishment Pill.
"Zhang Gaoyuan, this Foundation Establishment Pill is for you. I hope you won’t disappoint me and the whole Zhang family!" Xu Ping used Mana to levitate the jade box to the middle-aged man, his tone filled with expectation.
Taking the jade box, Zhang Gaoyuan showed a resolute expression: "Rest assured, Clan Leader, I will certainly not disappoint you and the family."
"Good!" Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction; he was pleased with the Zhang family’s choice for the pill consumption candidate.
At forty years old, at the peak of Qi Cultivation level nine, possessing Upper Grade Spirit Root, and having undergone hardships, not a fragile flower—success won’t be low post-pill intake.
"Zhang Qingfeng, you may leave. I will instruct Zhang Gaoyuan on matters to watch for during Foundation Establishment." Xu Ping commanded.
"Yes." Zhang Qingfeng respectfully saluted and then left the cave dwelling.
"Listen carefully; what I am about to explain is crucial to your Foundation Establishment; you must remember it." Xu Ping stressed.
"I understand!" Zhang Gaoyuan nodded respectfully, assuming an attentive stance.
Then, Xu Ping began to meticulously explain the key points and cautions during Foundation Establishment.
After spending half an hour, he finally stopped.
"Go to my cultivation room to meditate and nurture your vitality. Once your energy is at its peak, then begin your retreat."
"Yes." Zhang Gaoyuan respectfully bowed and headed to the cultivation room.
Within the cultivation room.
Zhang Gaoyuan sat cross-legged, his expression supremely solemn.
Steadily using his cultivation technique, he felt his energy reach its peak after three days and, wasting no time, swallowed the Foundation Establishment Pill.
Next door, Xu Ping’s Divine Sense observed Zhang Gaoyuan’s every movement silently.
With his Divine Sense stronger than even late-stage Foundation Establishment, Zhang Gaoyuan remained unaware regardless of whether he established his foundation or not.
"It has begun..."
Xu Ping manipulated the Array to channel all the Spiritual Qi in the cave into the cultivation room, a palpable mist of Spiritual Qi promptly enveloping the entire space.
Having executed this, he silently watched Zhang Gaoyuan attempt Foundation Establishment, beginning with the convergence and cleansing of Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi through his body!
’At forty, Zhang Gaoyuan is at full spring vigor and has no residual hidden injuries; it shouldn’t be much of a problem...’
Indeed, under the cleansing of Primordial Qi, Zhang Gaoyuan’s face twisted in pain as large beads of sweat dripped from his forehead.
Yet, under the Foundation Establishment Pill’s potency, his meridians endured the Spiritual Qi cleansing, starting to gather towards his Dantian and Sea of Qi.
"The Mana stage? His foundation is manageable, and with Upper Grade Spirit Root, alongside the family’s prized cultivation technique, it’s quite favorable..."
"As for the final Divine Sense barrier? Though a rare genius in the Zhang family, he has faced numerous deadly contests and ordeals; with an unwavering resolve..."
"In summary, his foundation is quite promising." Xu Ping thought to himself.
Time slipped away slowly, passing a month and a half quietly.
Feeling his Mana within his Dantian and Sea of Qi condensed to the extreme, Zhang Gaoyuan invoked the last power of the Foundation Establishment Pill, surging into his Mud Ball Palace!
Bang!
Dazed, his forehead seemed to open a third ’eye’!
Divine Sense!
With the emergence of Divine Sense, it pressured the Dantian and Sea of Qi, rendering his Mana into liquid!
Outside the sealed chamber, Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi converged, forming a vortex, endlessly drilling inside.
"Foundation Establishment is successful!" In the next room, the corner of Xu Ping’s mouth unconsciously turned upward.
He was relieved to depart the place in peace.
At this moment, all Zhang family cultivators on Cangyuan Mountain, witnessing the gathering Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi above the Clan Leader’s cave, froze for a moment before bursting into ecstatic cheers, some even overcome with joy:
"Foundation... Foundation Establishment successful!!"
Foundation Establishment Cultivators are extremely vital to their family.
...
Ten days later.
At a grave site, a youth dressed in blue silently stood, upon closer inspection revealing Xu Ping.
"I’ve fulfilled what I promised you, and now I must leave!" With a calm visage, he produced a box of Spirit Wine and poured it before the grave.
Staring at the ’Zhang Yan’ carved into the stone wall, Xu Ping couldn’t help but sigh internally: "Time surely flies."
In just a few brief years, everything had changed dramatically.
"Why am I suddenly so nostalgic lately!" Shaking his head, he chuckled wryly.
"Off I go!" Without any lingering attachment, Xu Ping departed the place.
...
Several days after Xu Ping left.
Zhang Gaoyuan emerged from seclusion, his realm fully stabilized, becoming a genuine Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
"Clan Leader, I succeeded in Foundation Establishment!" He expressed ecstatic joy, his first action being to seek Xu Ping disguised as Zhang Yu.
Yet arriving at the room, he found no trace of the Clan Leader, only a set of the Clan Leader’s clothes and a Storage Ring remained.
Zhang Gaoyuan paused briefly, then his face changed drastically: "The Clan Leader has passed away?"
Qi Cultivators upon passing leave behind a corpse, but Foundation Establishment Cultivators may not.
Some Foundation Establishment Cultivators, to prevent their corpse from being exploited by others, choose to render their physical form into ashes, dissipated within the void.
Refusing to give up, Zhang Gaoyuan searched throughout the entire cave dwelling, yet still found no trace of the Clan Leader; only then did he truly accept the Clan Leader’s passing.
"The Clan Leader has truly passed!" Zhang Gaoyuan murmured, his face showing a hint of sorrow.

chapters.title: Chapter 156 - 147: Overbearing Aggression (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 156: Chapter 147: Overbearing Aggression (Part 2)
"They’re just empty reputations." Xu Ping waved his hand.
"We should first take Fellow Daoist Xu to his future Daoist district, Thousand Leaves Mountain." Duan Shuang chuckled sweetly.
"That’s right." Gong Yang smiled.
The three of them then proceeded together to the farthest main peak.
"This is Fellow Daoist Gong’s district, Xiao Hui Mountain." Duan Shuang began introducing Xu Ping to the three main peaks of Purple Bamboo Mountain, "This one is my district, Flower Butterfly Mountain; and as for the last, Thousand Leaves Mountain, it will be Fellow Daoist’s future district."
Gong Yang held a token in his hand and broke through the array, and suddenly the full appearance of Thousand Leaves Mountain came into view.
Thousand Leaves Mountain was considerably lower than the other two.
The peaks weren’t so steep, relatively flat and wide, with a cave mansion at the top, which was presumably the former owner’s.
Xu Ping noticed that each of the other two main peaks had their own mountain-protecting arrays.
...
The three landed on the top of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
A vast spiritual field spanning more than forty acres came into view, though it was barren and rather desolate.
In front of the spiritual field was a luxurious cave mansion.
It was called a cave mansion, but it seemed more like a large estate, complete with rock gardens, spirit pools, and pavilions.
It was evident that the previous owner enjoyed the finer things.
"Is Fellow Daoist Xu satisfied?" Gong Yang asked with a smile.
"No problem."
Xu Ping nodded after surveying around, noting the stable spirit vein environment and spacious terrain, which were ideal for cultivation and living.
"Since there are no issues, let’s sign the spirit contract." Gong Yang chuckled, taking out a prepared spirit contract from a storage ring.
"Alright."
Xu Ping nodded, ready to sign, when Duan Shuang stopped him: "Fellow Daoist Xu, please wait a moment, there’s something I want to tell you..."
Hearing this, Gong Yang slightly narrowed his eyes and quickly interrupted with a smile: "Whatever it is can wait until Fellow Daoist Xu signs the spirit contract."
"No, let’s set the spirit contract aside first; let me finish what I have to say before Fellow Daoist Xu decides whether to sign!" Duan Shuang insisted firmly.
Hearing their conversation, Xu Ping immediately sensed something was off.
’Is there a pitfall in Thousand Leaves Mountain?’
Xu Ping frowned slightly, asking: "I wonder what the issue is? Is there something wrong with Thousand Leaves Mountain?"
"Sigh, there’s nothing wrong with Thousand Leaves Mountain, the issue is with me!" Duan Shuang sighed helplessly and recounted Bai Kun’s story in detail.
Upon hearing, Xu Ping’s brows furrowed tightly together.
So it turned out there was indeed a pitfall with Thousand Leaves Mountain, and although he didn’t care due to his strength, he detested being deceived into a trap.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, I sincerely apologize, this indeed was my fault. Here is an inheritance of a Second-stage spirit plant cultivator as compensation." Duan Shuang apologized earnestly, flicking a jade slip into Xu Ping’s hand.
"An inheritance of a Second-stage spirit plant cultivator?"
Xu Ping toyed with the jade slip in his right hand, a hint of surprise flashing across his face. This apology gift was fairly significant; the inheritance could sell for several thousand spirit stones at least.
"Even if Fellow Daoist Xu decides not to reside in Thousand Leaves Mountain, I will find another suitable cave mansion for you to stay." Duan Shuang offered sincerely.
Hearing her words, Xu Ping’s expression eased considerably, seeing Duan Shuang’s genuine apology.
However, as for this old man Gong, he wasn’t a good person!
Xu Ping glanced sideways, noticing Gong Yang looking up at the sky, feigning ignorance.
He was certain that Gong Yang was also involved in deceiving him into this trap, perhaps as the mastermind.
"Fellow Daoist Duan..."
Xu Ping was about to say something.
Buzz!
The array originally enveloping the entire Thousand Leaves Mountain suddenly rippled.
"Someone is breaching the array?"
The changes in the array immediately caught the three’s attention.
Gong Yang then took out a restriction token and waved it gently.
The clouds parted, revealing a young man in fine clothing, standing on a golden flying boat, holding a golden ring magical artifact.
"Why is Fellow Daoist Bai disturbing the protective array of Thousand Leaves Mountain?"
Gong Yang furrowed his brows and shouted sternly.
"No offense, Fellow Daoists!"
Bai Kun smiled faintly, not concealing the powerful mana at the peak of Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment, "I heard that the Fellow Daoist intending to move into Thousand Leaves Mountain had arrived, so I came especially for a visit."
Upon hearing this, Duan Shuang’s eyes went cold: "You installed surveillance over Purple Bamboo Mountain?"
"Fellow Daoist Duan jests, how could I do such a thing? It’s just that I have many friends and broad sources of information." Bai Kun smiled indifferently.
"Fellow Daoist Bai isn’t such a person; since you’re a guest, Fellow Daoist Bai, please come in." Gong Yang quickly smoothed over the situation, and the array opened, inviting Bai Kun in.
Xu Ping sized up the young man in fancy clothes, thinking to himself: "So this is the Bai Kun that Duan Shuang mentioned, truly overbearing!"
While Xu Ping evaluated him, Bai Kun was also appraising Xu Ping.
Seeing Xu Ping’s cultivation at merely Early-Stage Foundation Establishment, he slighted Xu Ping a bit in his heart.
Xu Ping had advanced to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment, but he hid his rapid advancement to avoid attracting attention.
With his current concealment abilities, even a Fake Pill cultivator couldn’t see through his disguise.
"You must be the Daoist planning to reside at Thousand Leaves Peak. I am Bai Kun; may I know your name?" Bai Kun cupped his hands politely.
Had Xu Ping not seen his earlier domineering attitude, he might have mistaken him for a genteel gentleman.
"I am Xu Ping." Xu Ping responded with a cupped hand gesture.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, may I have a private word with you?" Bai Kun asked with a smile.
"Fellow Daoist Bai, what do you mean?" Xu Ping hadn’t replied yet when Duan Shuang blocked in front of him, her gaze coldly fixed on Bai Kun.
Seeing Duan Shuang protect Xu Ping in such a manner, unfavorable thoughts flitted through Bai Kun’s mind, his gaze slightly chilly, but a warm smile still adorned his face:
"No need to worry, Fellow Daoist Duan, I just wish to have a private chat with Fellow Daoist Xu, nothing more."
"Fellow Daoist Xu, you don’t need to get involved, leave this matter to me." Duan Shuang privately transmitted to Xu Ping.
Hearing this, Xu Ping couldn’t help touching his nose, feeling that while he didn’t mind a woman shielding him from trouble, if he didn’t handle this himself, it would likely lead to numerous vexing issues.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Duan, for your consideration. Since Fellow Daoist Bai wishes to speak with me, how could I refuse?" Xu Ping replied with a smile.
"Fellow Daoist Xu is straightforward; shall we converse in the pavilion?" Bai Kun asked, palms raised with a smile.
"Fellow Daoist Xu..." Duan Shuang still wanted to say something, but Xu Ping gave her a look telling her to stay calm.
Their little interactions were noted, and a trace of coldness emerged deep in Bai Kun’s eyes.
He saw Duan Shuang as his possession, allowing no one else to interfere.
...
The two arrived at the pavilion within the cave mansion, and Bai Kun casually set up a sound-isolating restriction to prevent eavesdropping.
"I wonder what the relationship between Fellow Daoist Xu and Duan Shuang is?" Bai Kun inquired with a smile after finishing his arrangements.
"Just ordinary friends." Xu Ping replied.
’Ordinary friends?’ Bai Kun sneered internally, "If you’re just ordinary friends, would Duan Shuang protect you like that?"
But on the surface, he showed nothing and instead asked with a smile: "How did you come to know Duan Shuang? I’ve never heard her mention you."
’Is he checking my history?’
Xu Ping frowned slightly and answered calmly: "That’s personal business and not convenient to disclose."
Having reached Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment, neither Bai Kun nor even his backing Song family dared to provoke him.
He certainly wouldn’t accommodate Bai Kun’s attitude.
’An insignificant Early-Stage Foundation Establishment dares speak to me like this!’
Hearing this, the coldness in Bai Kun’s eyes deepened, and even his tone became indifferent: "Fellow Daoist Xu, you seem fierce, but in the cultivation realm, being overly rigid leads to breaking, don’t you think?"
Detecting the threat in Bai Kun’s tone, Xu Ping simply laughed.
He was well aware of Bai Kun’s intentions for wanting to talk to him.
After almost being tricked into a pit, and despite Duan Shuang’s subsequent honesty and compensation, his initial interest in Thousand Leaves Mountain had waned.
If Bai Kun had treated him well, he might have still considered relocating there, but Bai Kun’s interrogation and subsequent threats?
What, did he think Xu Ping was made of clay?
If they were in a deserted place, Bai Kun would have already tasted his sword.
"No need for Fellow Daoist Bai to worry, if there’s nothing else, I’ll be taking my leave." Xu Ping remarked lazily.

chapters.title: Chapter 157 - 148: Victory (4000 Words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 157: Chapter 148: Victory (4000 Words)
Bai Kun’s eyes displayed a touch of sinister sharpness.
This kind of tone when speaking to him?
In the Wanzhe Waters, let alone Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators, even Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators would speak to him courteously.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, please wait, I indeed have important matters to discuss with you."
But considering that if the other party had already signed the Spirit Contract, and if things turned sour now, it would be a waste of effort, Bai Kun suppressed his inner anger.
"I wonder if Fellow Daoist has signed the Spirit Contract? To be honest, I actually wish to rent Thousand Leaves Mountain as well. If you have signed it, could you sublease it to me?"
’Isn’t it possible to speak properly? What took you so long?’ Xu Ping mused inwardly, while still lazily replying, "I wasn’t able to sign the Spirit Contract before you arrived."
"You haven’t signed the Spirit Contract?"
Upon hearing this, Bai Kun’s eyes gradually turned cold, and Xu Ping’s value in his mind instantly disappeared, his tone turning icy:
"If that’s the case, then Fellow Daoist Xu should go home. This Thousand Leaves Mountain is not something you can touch."
"And what if I do touch it?" Xu Ping retorted sharply.
"Do you want to drink the penalty wine instead of the offered wine? This Purple Bamboo Mountain cannot protect you!" Bai Kun’s tone revealed a hint of hostility.
Regarding someone who could be killed with a few sword strikes, Xu Ping was disinclined to waste words.
"Since you are so confident in your strength, how about we have a duel?"
"If you win, I’ll leave immediately and compensate you with five thousand pieces. If I win, you compensate me with five thousand Spirit Stones. How about that?" Xu Ping proposed an enticing offer to Bai Kun.
Five thousand Spirit Stones, for him, was no small sum.
Though Bai Kun was tempted, he didn’t immediately agree, instead pondering whether Xu Ping had some hidden means or reliance, given his confidence.
But after careful consideration, he didn’t think the other had any extraordinary means to defeat him, especially since he wasn’t without his own ace, so he agreed:
"Alright, since Fellow Daoist Xu is so confident, I accept."
...
To prevent Bai Kun from defaulting, Xu Ping found Duan Shuang and Gong Yang to witness, and both parties also signed a contract.
"What! Fellow Daoist Xu wants to duel Bai Kun? This is absolutely unacceptable." Duan Shuang was astonished upon hearing and urged persistently.
"I know Fellow Daoist Xu is a Sword Cultivator genius who comprehended Sword Qi Thunder Sound, surpassing tiers is no issue, but Bai Kun is not your average Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator."
"He cultivates a top-grade technique and is a peak Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, his Mana far stronger than average mid-stage, plus I’ve heard he seems to have other cards up his sleeve, you must not act recklessly."
Even Gong Yang, who didn’t seem like a good person, began to counsel Xu Ping: "Fellow Daoist Xu should not duel with the opponent, if you accidentally get hurt, it wouldn’t be worth it."
He knew Sword Cultivators usually had such straightforward, direct, and intense personalities.
However, he didn’t expect this Sword Cultivator Xu to be so fierce, how come he hadn’t talked things through with Bai Kun and already wanted to duel!
"No need to persuade me, my mind is made up!" Xu Ping’s tone was resolute.
If the matter wasn’t handled well this time, it would become a constant issue in the future.
Duan Shuang and Gong Yang glanced at each other and saw helplessness in each other’s eyes.
Knowing they couldn’t sway him, they decided to find a good dueling location, so if anything unexpected happened, they could intervene.
Thus, the final duel location for Xu Ping and Bai Kun was set at Gong Yang’s dojo on Little Hui Mountain.
This mountain had abundant Spiritual Qi and was guarded by a Second-stage Upper Grade array. If anything unexpected occurred, they could leverage the array to intervene.
...
Little Hui Mountain, a flat terrain.
Bai Kun stood in mid-air, clad in a cyan long robe, elegant: "Please, Fellow Daoist, make the first move..."
Seeing the other party so arrogant, Xu Ping couldn’t help but find it amusing, opting to hold the Purple Sun Sword and, without wasting words, decisively struck out.
Boom!
With a deafening thunderclap, several meters of Sword Qi erupted like lightning, tearing through the air. Where the Sword Qi passed, even the air seemed to be ripped apart, carrying an incomparable sharpness.
Even Duan Shuang and Gong Yang outside the battlefield felt their skin tingling slightly and exchanged amazed glances: "This Sword Qi Thunder Sound is truly formidable!"
"Sword Qi Thunder Sound!!" Bai Kun’s expression changed drastically as he was locked on by the Sword Qi.
He dared not act arrogantly, with both hands pushing, a golden circle from a ring-like magical artifact erupted, forming a golden defense shield around him.
Heavenly Gold Ring!
This was the name of the artifact he wielded, a top-grade magical artifact combining offense and defense, considered high quality even among top-grade items.
The defensive shield from this artifact was far more resilient than the Mana shields of ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivators and had a quality of continuous regeneration, even if broken temporarily, it would quickly recover.
Boom!
At the instant he erected the glowing shield, the several-meter Sword Qi collided with the defense, producing a thunderous crash.
In the next moment, both the Sword Qi and the protective shield shattered simultaneously.
"You are actually Qiu Xuan Mountain’s Guest Minister—Xu Ping!" Bai Kun fixed his gaze intensely on Xu Ping.
When he first heard the name Xu Ping, he felt it was familiar, but couldn’t recall immediately. Now upon witnessing the Sword Qi Thunder Sound in action, he suddenly realized.
"What, you want to concede?" Xu Ping asked nonchalantly, holding the sword single-handed.
"Hmph! Concede?"
Bai Kun sneered coldly, a flicker of murderous intent appearing in his eyes.
Considering the other party’s talent, if Xu Ping were to move into Thousand Leaves Mountain, Duan Shuang would drift even further away from him.

chapters.title: Chapter 158 - 148: Victory (4000 Words)_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 158: Chapter 148: Victory (4000 Words)_2
"Swift!"
Bai Kun summoned the Heaven Gold Ring, channeling all the mana he had cultivated over the years into it.
Buzz!
The Heaven Gold Ring suddenly erupted with astonishing spiritual light, transforming into a giant golden dragon.
Roar!
The golden dragon let out a roar, rolling in mid-air, its body expanded several times. Its claws and fangs sharpened, its eyes became extremely lively, and it ferociously charged at Xu Ping.
"Good timing!"
Xu Ping’s expression was calm. In a brief instant, he thrust several swords in succession. Each sword light, about a long length, appeared and crisscrossed, forming a massive net that wrapped around the golden dragon entirely.
Crunch!
Squeak!
The golden dragon was entangled by the Sword Qi net, emitting spine-chilling sounds, and the scales composed of spiritual Qi on its body began to crumble. Finally, the entire golden dragon disintegrated into specks of spiritual light, dissipating into the void.
Bai Kun saw Xu Ping easily dissolve his offensive, his expression turned exceedingly gloomy, "You do have some skill, but do you really think that’s all I have?"
He raised his hand in a gesture.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Six second-stage puppets appeared, each hovering in mid-air.
"So Bai Kun is actually a Puppet Master?" Gong Yang and Duan Shuang showed shocked expressions.
They hadn’t expected that Bai Kun’s hidden card was being a Puppet Master, able to control six puppets at once, with two of them being Second-stage Mid-grade puppets. Bai Kun was at least a Second-stage Mid-grade Puppet Master.
After all, unless a puppet possesses some intelligence like Xu Ping’s puppet rat demon, they require a cultivator’s divine sense or other secret techniques to control.
"Puppet Master?" Xu Ping’s face showed surprise.
"Go!"
With a thought from Bai Kun, the runes on the chests of the six second-stage puppets started to flicker, producing mechanical sounds, then with a roar, they rushed straight at Xu Ping.
Though surprised by the other party’s Puppet Master identity, with only four Second-stage Lower Grade puppets and two Second-stage Middle Grade ones, they couldn’t pose a real threat to him.
"Blood Demon True Form!"
Xu Ping shouted in a low voice, instantly, his body began to swell, transforming into a giant over four meters tall, his entire skin enveloped in intense blood light.
He unhesitatingly threw a punch.
Boom!
One Second-stage Lower Grade puppet was instantly smashed away by him.
Then spiritual light flashed over him, and the Perfection Level Light Body Technique exponentially increased his speed.
In an instant, he broke out of the puppet encirclement and rushed straight at Bai Kun.
"Second-stage Body Refining!" Bai Kun showed a panicked expression.
How on earth did this person cultivate? His swordsmanship is already so exceptional, yet even his body refining is equally strong.
In a panic, he hastily activated the Heaven Gold Ring, instantly a golden protective shield enveloped him. But feeling it wasn’t enough, he slapped several Second-stage defensive talismans on himself.
The next moment.
Thud!
Xu Ping punched heavily at the spiritual Qi shield, an invisible soundwave resonated all around, blowing several things over, but ultimately did not break Bai Kun’s defense.
"Body refining’s attack power is still somewhat lacking!" Xu Ping shook his slightly numb arm.
"Get lost!"
Bai Kun yelled in a strange voice, then waved his hand on the ring, causing several Second-stage talismans to appear!
Bing Fire God Thunder, Fiery Fire Golden Saber, Xuanyin True Water...
Several Second-stage Lower Grade, even Mid-grade talismans were madly consumed and activated by him, in a frenzy of bombardment, forcing Xu Ping to retreat.
And at this moment, the six puppets that were brushed aside by Xu Ping blocked Bai Kun’s front.
"Attack!"
Bai Kun, hiding behind the puppets, pointed a finger.
Buzz!
The six puppets opened their mouths, six colorful energy balls rapidly gathered in their mouths.
The next moment!
Bang!
Six energy balls instantly shot out, intertwining in mid-air, carrying a catastrophic aura, attacking Xu Ping.
"This power... probably just barely reaches the threshold of Late-Stage Foundation Establishment!!" Gong Yang exclaimed.
If he faced this attack, he definitely couldn’t withstand it, and Xu Ping, who was only at Early-Stage Foundation Establishment, was surely in grave danger.
"Fellow Daoist Gong, quickly activate the array, block this attack!" Duan Shuang said urgently.
She couldn’t help but deeply regret, if she had known it would be like this, she would have definitely stopped this duel earlier.
And Gong Yang now knew the seriousness of the situation, without any hesitation, he took out the array plate to control the array.
Boom!
Just as he was preparing to manipulate the array, suddenly a deafening thunderous sound erupted, as if the Thunder God had descended!
"Primordial Sword Skill, Five Qi Extinguishing Heaven!"
Xu Ping shouted low, holding his magic sword, the sword light suddenly splitting into five beams, each carrying the endless might of thunder, a magnificent momentum!
Boom!
Lightning sparkled, Sword Qi slashed wildly!
The Sword Qi entwined with multicolored energy, devouring each other... finally dissipating completely.
"What, actually took it!!" All three present were shocked and discolored.
Especially Bai Kun, his eyeballs practically popped out. He was very clear about how strong his attack was, never expecting that a cultivator in the Early-Stage Foundation Establishment could also explode with such powerful strength.
Could it be the power of Sword Qi Thunder Sound?
"My turn!"
Xu Ping’s face showed coldness, he swung a sword down, the sword light split into five beams, accompanied by heaven-shaking thunder sound, slashing towards Bai Kun.
"Oh no!"
Bai Kun’s face changed drastically, wanting to once again manipulate the puppet for a combined attack was already too late.
He could only place a Second-stage puppet closest to him in front of himself for protection, directly pulling out the Divine Sense thought, letting this Second-stage puppet meet the Sword Qi.
Bang!
Under a single sword, the Second-stage puppet was instantly slashed into two halves.
Bai Kun showed horror, using this bit of time, he poured his entire Mana into the Heavenly Gold Ring like it was free.
Buzz!
A thick Spiritual Qi shield enveloped his whole body!
In the next moment!
Crack!
The Sword Qi slashed onto the Spiritual Qi shield, producing a grating sound of fragmentation, Bai Kun’s protective spiritual shield shattered instantly.
But at this moment the Sword Qi was also exhausted!
Not even waiting for Bai Kun to breathe a sigh of relief, he found Xu Ping had somehow appeared in front of him.
In his face of terror, Xu Ping punched out.
Boom!
Bai Kun was punched away, a mouthful of fresh blood spurted, heavily hitting the stone wall, his aura quickly withering.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, please hold your hand, I surrender on behalf of Fellow Daoist Bai!"
Seeing Xu Ping seemingly still not planning to let Bai Kun go, Gong Yang immediately shouted out in a long call, coming out of shock.
If they killed Bai Kun just like this, how would they explain to the Song family!
Hah!
In front of the stone wall, a fist glowing with blood light pressed against Bai Kun’s forehead.
Xu Ping smiled slightly, asking, "Fellow Daoist, do you surrender?"
"Pfft!"
"I... I surrender!"
Bai Kun struggled to spit out a few words, another mouthful of fresh blood spurted out, his messy hair, the green robe also covered with blood stains, extremely embarrassed, no longer the previous graceful appearance.
"That’s good."
Xu Ping casually withdrew his fist, looking incredibly relaxed, "The five thousand Spirit Stones you lost to me, don’t forget to give them to me!"
Upon hearing this, Bai Kun almost spat out another mouthful of blood, but forced himself to swallow it.
After struggling to climb out from the stone wall, he took out a storage bag from the Storage Ring and tossed it to Xu Ping, "This is my offering, I hope Fellow Daoist Xu is generous and lets me go."
Facing the fear of death, Bai Kun had to lower his noble head.
"Fellow Daoist Bai is overreacting, we were merely having a simple duel, not a life-and-death fight!"
Xu Ping sent his Divine Sense into the storage, discovering it contained a full seven thousand Spirit Stones, a slight smile involuntarily showing on his lips.
He originally didn’t intend to kill him openly, if to kill, then it would be sneakily.
Honestly, Bai Kun’s Magical Artifacts and Puppetry were very tempting, if he could get them, they would be quite helpful to him.
...
Already seriously injured, Bai Kun naturally dared not stay any longer, he set up Escape Light and left dejectedly.
At this moment, only Xu Ping, Duan Shuang, and Gong Yang were left on Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Facing Xu Ping’s meaningful gaze, Gong Yang only felt his scalp tingling.
After all, Xu Ping’s Swordsmanship at present was comparable to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment, truly making him awed.
Thus Gong Yang could only brace himself, pulling out a trace of a smile, "Fellow Daoist Xu’s Swordsmanship is unmatched, truly admirable."
"Oh? Really?" Xu Ping stared at Gong Yang with a faint smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 159 - 149: Slaying Bai Kun (4,000 Words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 159: Chapter 149: Slaying Bai Kun (4,000 Words)
"Fellow Daoist Xu, I truly participated in concealing Bai Kun’s covetous intentions for Thousand Leaves Mountain. I sincerely apologize to you for this," Gong Yang confessed entirely, almost on the brink of tears as Xu Ping’s gaze bore into him.
With Xu Ping’s prowess, he was undoubtedly no match.
Moreover, Xu Ping was currently only at the Early-Stage Foundation Establishment. His future was bright, incomparable to someone like him who had already reached the peak of his cultivation.
Offending him was out of the question.
"So Fellow Daoist Gong was involved as well. However, Fellow Daoist Duan has already compensated me. I wonder what compensation Fellow Daoist Gong plans to offer me?" Xu Ping inquired with a faint, half-smiling expression.
"What kind of compensation does Fellow Daoist Xu wish for?" Gong Yang asked with a bitter expression, it seemed today would be costly.
"I’m quite interested in Fellow Daoist Gong’s Artifact Refining Technique," Xu Ping answered flatly.
"What!!"
"Artifact Refining Technique! I..."
Upon seeing Xu Ping’s gaze grow colder, Gong Yang reluctantly swallowed his words of refusal, forcing a rather unsightly smile onto his face, "I... I can’t not give it to you."
Enduring the pain in his heart, he retrieved a blue jade slip from his Storage Ring and flicked it towards Xu Ping with a finger, "This is the Artifact Refining Technique I’ve cultivated, containing everything from the First Rank to Second-stage Upper Grade."
Having spoken, Gong Yang couldn’t help but look earnestly at Xu Ping.
Duan Shuang, who was observing from the side, couldn’t help but find the situation amusing.
It was rare to see such a shrewd Fellow Daoist Gong being so easily handled.
Xu Ping held the jade slip, explored it with his Divine Sense briefly, and nodded. Gong Yang indeed hadn’t deceived him; the Artifact Refining Techniques for the first and second stages were indeed complete.
"Fellow Daoist Gong is truly courteous. Now that Bai Kun has been sent away, can we proceed with signing the Spirit Contract?" After storing the jade slip, Xu Ping said with a smile.
Upon hearing this, a trace of a smile emerged in Gong Yang’s heart, and he nodded quickly, "Yes, yes, yes, let’s sign the Spirit Contract first."
With Xu Ping’s strength, once he settled in Thousand Leaves Mountain, the benefits to their Purple Bamboo Mountain as a whole would be tremendous.
"Wait!" At this moment, Duan Shuang intervened to stop them.
"Fellow Daoist Duan, what do you intend to do now?" Gong Yang was exasperated. Couldn’t this matter wait till after signing the Spirit Contract?
"The Spirit Contract still needs some adjustments. When Fellow Daoist Gong and I discussed earlier, we promised to help pay a few years of rent for Fellow Daoist Xu Ping," Duan Shuang stated solemnly.
"Did you make such a promise?" Xu Ping cast his gaze at Gong Yang.
"Yes... such a promise was made," Gong Yang admitted, gritting his teeth as Duan Shuang had put him in a position with no escape.
"I see, then thank you both, Fellow Daoists!" Xu Ping said with a laugh and a cupped fist; not taking advantage of a good deal would be foolish.
Following this, the three of them proceeded to sign the Spirit Contract.
The Spirit Vein of Purple Bamboo Mountain had a rent of thirty-six thousand Spirit Stones every ten years, to be shared equally among the three.
While it amounted to only twelve hundred Spirit Stones per annum per person, time passed quickly for cultivators, and with long lifespans, a lease of ten to twenty years was a significant outlay.
After confirming everything, Xu Ping appended his signature.
The Spirit Contract recorded that Duan Shuang and Gong Yang would pay a total of three thousand six hundred Spirit Stones covering three years’ rent for him.
This type of Spirit Contract, once signed and sealed with personal Mana imprints, lacked coercive power but served as a public trust document.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, once you move in, I’ll arrange for a cultivator from Shuize Sect to come. At that time, the three of us will sign a new joint lease contract," Gong Yang added.
"Agreed," Xu Ping nodded.
"Congratulations, Fellow Daoist Xu, on becoming the master of Thousand Leaves Mountain," Duan Shuang said with a beaming smile, offering congratulations.
...
Xu Ping bid farewell to the two and returned to Thousand Leaves Mountain alone.
The current Thousand Leaves Mountain was merely a bare shell.
The prior owner had passed, and their descendants or friends had taken everything valuable from it.
What was left for him was just an empty, green-covered mountain and a protective array.
For Xu Ping to officially move in, he needed some preparation.
He surveyed the terrain of Thousand Leaves Mountain, formulating a rough plan in his mind.
The mountain already had a protective array, but to ensure safety, he needed to set up another array himself.
After that, he had to refurbish the cave dwelling and plant exotic spirit flowers and herbs.
With such a vast spiritual field, it should not be wasted. It was best to grow high-grade, valuable types, and fortunately, he had acquired the legacy of a second-stage spirit planter.
...
Several days later, Xu Ping activated his Escape Light and traveled to Flower Butterfly Mountain.
"The nearest market to our Purple Pavilion Mountain is probably the Dragon Lion Market established by Shuize Sect on Dragon Lion Island," Duan Shuang said with a smile, pouring a cup of tea for Xu Ping within a pavilion.
Some beautiful scantily-clad maidservants also served plates of Spirit Fruits.
"Dragon Lion Island? Could Fellow Daoist Duan inform me of its exact location?" Xu Ping, having cast a cursory glance, withdrew his gaze.
"Of course, that’s no problem," Duan Shuang replied with a slight smile, providing Xu Ping with Dragon Lion Island’s exact location and giving him a map of the surrounding area.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Duan," Xu Ping expressed with a cupped fist.
"It was a simple task."
"As Fellow Daoist is new to Thousand Leaves Mountain and has no attendants, would you like me to introduce a few beautiful maidservants to take care of your daily needs?" Duan Shuang offered with a charming smile, her eyes sparkling and her demeanor graceful.
"I am devoted to the Dao and do not prefer to be attended to," Xu Ping declined with a shake of his head.
In truth, he carried too many secrets, and his practice sessions were too conspicuous, running the risk of being discovered.
"It seems that Fellow Daoist Xu’s ability to comprehend the Sword Qi Thunder Sound owes much to rigorous cultivation as well as innate talent!" Duan Shuang said with sparkling eyes, smiling like a flower.
....
A short time later.
Xu Ping departed from Flower Butterfly Mountain, gazing at the boundless sky, he closed his eyes and quietly sensed the position of the Rat Demon.

chapters.title: Chapter 160 - 149: Slaying Bai Kun
chapters.content:
Chapter 160: Chapter 149: Slaying Bai Kun
"Ran quite far, didn’t you!" A moment later, Xu Ping opened his eyes, revealing a hint of helplessness in his gaze.
If it weren’t for his divine sense surpassing the late-stage Foundation Establishment, he probably wouldn’t have sensed the position of the Rat Demon from such a distance.
Following the vague link in his heart, Xu Ping locked onto a direction and soared into the distance on the Escape Light.
...
...
More than half a month later.
Wanzhe Waters, Celestial Water Island.
Recently, the servants and maids on Celestial Water Island had become jittery, fearing to provoke the displeasure of the island’s master, Bai Kun.
"What’s wrong with the Island Master?" one servant whispered.
"I heard he was seriously injured!" another servant replied in a voice only audible between the two of them.
"How can that be? The Island Master is a peak mid-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator!" the servant exclaimed in surprise.
"I..."
"What are you two whispering about? Get back to work!" At that moment, a middle-aged man in a green robe scolded them.
"Steward Hao!!" The two were startled and hurried away with their heads down.
Steward Hao watched their retreating figures with cold eyes. If he didn’t have to leave the island today to purchase supplies, he would definitely have taught them a lesson.
After scolding them away, Steward Hao came to the edge of the array that protected the island, and then he took out a Jade Token from his bosom, infusing it with mana while mumbling incantations.
Buzz!
Instantly, a passage leading to the outside world appeared in the array.
He skillfully passed through the passage, emerging outside the array.
"Phew!"
Steward Hao took a deep breath and his repressed emotions began to ease.
Ever since Bai Kun returned severely injured, even he had been living cautiously.
Now that he had the chance to leave the island, he intended to vent his frustration and find a few understanding fairy maidens to comfort his soul.
Thinking about the enchanting figures of the maidens, a heat rose in his heart.
"Quick trip out and back!"
Steward Hao patted his Storage Bag, and a Spiritual Boat floated into the air. He jumped on and directed it to fly away.
He didn’t know how long he had been flying, and Celestial Water Island had completely disappeared from view.
Looking at the surrounding verdant lake waters, Steward Hao’s mood gradually relaxed.
As a Qi Cultivation level nine cultivator and the steward of Celestial Water Island, no one had the courage to mess with him over the years.
Just as Steward Hao was leisurely enjoying himself!
Suddenly!
He felt a chill descending upon him, his Sea of Consciousness erupted into a turbulent storm, and the next instant, he lost consciousness and fell into a coma.
Without its master’s control, the Spiritual Boat was about to plunge into the lake.
At this moment, an Escape Light flew from the deserted island, controlling the Spiritual Boat to land on the deserted island.
"Waited all these days, finally someone came out." Watching the comatose middle-aged man, Xu Ping smiled slightly.
Half an hour later.
Disguised as Steward Hao, Xu Ping mounted the Flying Boat again and headed back to Celestial Water Island.
...
...
Celestial Water Island.
Inside a luxurious building, Bai Kun sat with his eyes closed, silently healing his injuries.
No one knew how much time had passed.
"Phew!"
Bai Kun slowly opened his eyes, exhaling a foul breath.
Feeling the lingering pain from his injuries, a sinister look flashed in his eyes: "Xu Ping, I must kill you!"
For so many years, he had never been so severely injured, nor been so close to death.
If he didn’t kill him, his Dao heart would remain unstable!
"And that bitch Duan Shuang, I will tear those dogs apart!" Bai Kun snarled through gritted teeth, feeling all his efforts wasted.
Thinking this way, his anger flared even more.
Bang!
In his fury, he struck out, smashing a lavish cabinet to pieces, venting his inner rage.
Bang bang!
Just as he was seething with rage, a knocking sound came from outside the door.
"Who is it!"
Bai Kun spread his divine sense, discovering a middle-aged man standing outside the door, whom he recognized as the steward of his island.
With a wave of his sleeve, the door opened naturally.
"If it’s not something important, you know the consequences!" Bai Kun looked at him coldly.
"Isl... Island Master, if it wasn’t important, how would I dare disturb you..." ’Steward Hao’ showed a trace of fear, then nervously entered the room, closing the door behind him.
"What is it? Speak quickly!" Bai Kun said impatiently.
"Island Master, today... is the day you die!" Steward Hao changed his expression, the initial fear vanished, replaced by an extremely cold demeanor.
Buzz!
Bai Kun suddenly felt a chill descending upon him.
Crack!
The hairpin on his head split into two, and his Sea of Consciousness surged violently, as if it was about to explode with pain.
"Ah!"
Bai Kun couldn’t help but let out a painful scream.
The next instant.
Jingle!
In the midst of extreme pain, he faintly heard a tinkling of bells, and then everything went black, and he collapsed to the ground.
"Kill him!"
Xu Ping attached a Sound Insulation Talisman to the door frame while commanding the Rat Demon hidden underground.
The Rat Demon burst from the earth in an instant, and its sharp claws easily crushed Bai Kun’s skull.
Blood and brain matter spilled all over, the intense smell of blood filling the room instantly.
"Not bad, after breaking through to mid-stage Foundation Establishment, my Shocking God Needle has indeed become much more formidable. With this attack, even a typical late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator would likely be killed!"
Seeing Bai Kun’s corpse, dead as dead could be, Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction.
Using his beyond late-stage Foundation Establishment awareness to launch the Shocking God Needle, even if Bai Kun had treasures to defend against spiritual sense attacks, they couldn’t withstand it.
"It’s just a pity that for a sneak attack on a late-stage Foundation Establishment, the Rat Demon probably won’t be of much use and I’d have to act personally." Xu Ping regrettably shook his head.
After his divine sense increased, he could sense the Rat Demon hiding underground even without the inexplicable link in his heart.
Although a typical late-stage Foundation Establishment divine sense couldn’t compare to his, they would still have a vague sense, unlike early or mid-stage cultivators who were completely unaware of the Rat Demon.
Xu Ping went to Bai Kun’s body and retrieved the Storage Ring from his hand, then leisurely began to break the divine sense restriction on it.
From launching the spiritual sense attack to killing Bai Kun, only two breaths had passed, and all movements within the room were covered by the Sound Insulation Talisman, so no one noticed.
Although he wasn’t afraid of the Song family given his strength and escape techniques, avoiding trouble by quietly killing the opponent and eliminating suspicions was preferable.
...
Xu Ping quickly dispelled the protective divine sense on the Storage Ring.
He inspected the items inside, first screening for suspicious items.
Besides a Second-stage Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman, there was nothing notably suspicious.
This talisman couldn’t be destroyed for now, or its pair could detect it being deactivated from afar.
Afterwards, with a motion of his divine sense, Xu Ping emptied a pile of colorful Spirit Stones from the Storage Ring.
Among them, the lower grade Spirit Stones were the least valuable, about six thousand pieces, followed by middle grade stones useful even to Foundation Establishment cultivators.
The contents of the Storage Ring exceeded Xu Ping’s expectations.
Dozens of First Rank Puppets were neatly arranged inside the Storage Ring, along with mostly first rank middle and upper grade puppets, and the five Second-stage Middle Grade puppets that surrounded him that day were also among them.
"So rich! Altogether worth at least tens of thousands of Spirit Stones." Xu Ping couldn’t help but be pleased with the haul.
Among the items in the Storage Ring, a Jade Token caught Xu Ping’s attention.
Embedded within the Jade Token was a Divine Techniques manual titled ’Thousand Threads Puppet Transformation Skill.’
Upon careful examination, he discovered it was a Puppet Control Skill.
"So Bai Kun wasn’t actually a Second-stage Puppet Master, he just knew this skill which allowed him to control so many Second-stage Middle Grade Puppets."
Despite his immense interest, Xu Ping decided that now wasn’t the time to study this skill, so he tossed it back into the Storage Ring.

chapters.title: Chapter 161 - 150: Sweeping Through
chapters.content:
Chapter 161: Chapter 150: Sweeping Through
"Finally, here is this top-grade magical artifact -- the Heavenly Gold Ring!" With a flick of his Divine Sense, Xu Ping took out a golden ring and examined it closely in his hand.
He wasn’t impressed by the ring’s offensive power, but its defensive power was quite commendable.
At least it could withstand the attacks of a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator without issue.
His offensive power and escape techniques were already strong enough, but his defensive power was lacking a bit, and this Heavenly Gold Ring perfectly compensated for that shortcoming.
After fiddling with it for a while, Xu Ping stored it back into his Storage Ring.
Then he turned his gaze towards Bai Kun’s corpse, and an idea suddenly popped into his mind: "Perhaps I can use Bai Kun to ransack the entire Celestial Water Island."
Not to mention the Spirit Stones, just the Spirit Medicine and Spirit Plants on the island would be worth quite a few Spirit Stones.
Moreover, currently, there was no one on Celestial Water Island who could see through his disguise.
As for why he suddenly wanted to harvest everything?
As the sole master of Celestial Water Island, Bai Kun had no need to explain to some servants.
...
...
Half an hour later.
A short-range Sound Transmission Talisman flew out from Bai Kun’s room.
Only half a quarter of an hour passed before a young and beautiful female cultivator rushed over, respectfully inquiring, "Island Master, for what reason did you summon me?"
"You have half a day to gather all the Spirit Stones, Spirit Medicine, and Spirit Plants on the island for me!" ’Bai Kun’ commanded coldly.
"Ah?"
The young and beautiful female cultivator was taken aback, about to ask why, but upon seeing the cold gleam in the Island Master’s eyes, she swallowed any words she had.
"Yes, Island Master, I’ll attend to it immediately!" The young and beautiful female cultivator bowed respectfully before hurrying out.
...
This female cultivator was quite efficient.
In less than half a day, she had gathered all the Spirit Stones, Spirit Medicine, and Spirit Plants on the island, filling up seven Storage Bags.
"Island Master, here are all the Spirit Stones, Spirit Medicines, and Spirit Plants from the island!" the female cultivator reported respectfully.
"Hmm!"
’Bai Kun’ nodded, using his mana to levitate the seven Storage Bags before him, then probing them with his Divine Sense.
There weren’t many Spirit Stones, only a few thousand.
But there was a large amount of Spirit Medicine and Spirit Plants; even with a rough estimate, they could sell for at least ten thousand Spirit Stones.
Xu Ping was overjoyed in his heart, but his face remained expressionless, his demeanor still cold: "You may leave."
"Yes!" The female cultivator bowed respectfully again and shut the door as she left.
Now, only Xu Ping remained in the room.
Seeing the Storage Bags floating before him, he finally couldn’t suppress the smile at the corner of his mouth: "This time, it’s quite a haul!"
Altogether, the items added up to at least thirty to forty thousand Spirit Stones, far more lucrative than robbing a single Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
It was definitely a case of striking it rich!
"Could this be the correct way to use the Thousand Illusion Mask?" Xu Ping couldn’t help but wonder.
"Perhaps in the future, if I run out of Spirit Stones, being a thief with the Thousand Illusion Mask wouldn’t be a bad idea!" he thought with a smile.
In the future, if he found anyone displeasing, he’d simply use the Thousand Illusion Mask to sneak into their residence and clean them out of everything.
Then, leave a note saying ’So-and-so was here,’ guaranteed to make them furious.
After securing all the Storage Bags, Xu Ping gradually calmed his excitement, as he hadn’t forgotten he still needed to purchase supplies on Dragon Lion Island.
"It’s time to go!"
Without any hesitation, Xu Ping quietly left Celestial Water Island.
Given his cultivation level and his control of the array’s Token, no one noticed that their ’Island Master’ had already left.
...
...
Dragon Lion Island, Dragon Lion Marketplace.
The island’s appearance was reminiscent of a dragon and lion, hence its name.
On the island, there was a Second-stage Spirit Vein that was later occupied by the Shuize Sect and turned into a marketplace. Surrounding the marketplace, there were terraced fields filled with Spirit Rice.
Xu Ping changed his appearance and traveled for more than ten days riding his Escape Light, finally arriving at Dragon Lion Island.
There were no flying bans over the island, so he flew over the uneven terraced fields, approaching the marketplace entrance.
Xu Ping didn’t hide his Foundation Establishment aura and, under the envious eyes of everyone, swaggered into the marketplace via a special passageway.
After all, even in the resource-rich Wanzhe Waters, Foundation Establishment cultivators were considered the upper echelon.
"Greetings to this Foundation Establishment Senior, is this your first time visiting the marketplace?"
At the entrance of the marketplace, a Qi Cultivator at the eighth level, dressed in Shuize Sect robes, asked respectfully, "Would you like this junior to arrange a guide for you?"
"Yes, arrange one for me." Xu Ping agreed.
This was the difference in treatment brought by strength; if he were merely a Qi Cultivator, even the disciples of the Golden Core Sect wouldn’t spare him a glance.
His visit to this marketplace wasn’t only to purchase some daily necessities; he also needed to buy materials for crafting arrays and magical artifacts and to see if there were any Second-stage Upper Grade Spirit Woods for sale. Meanwhile, he would also sell off the Spirit Plants and Spirit Medicines he had looted from Celestial Water Island.
He had many things to buy and sell, but since the marketplace was shrouded by an array, extending his Divine Sense was not feasible. Not wanting to waste more time, he had to find a guide familiar with the marketplace.
"You, guide this Foundation Establishment Senior, and look after him well!"
The Shuize Sect cultivator assigned a Qi Cultivator at the third level with an honest face to be Xu Ping’s guide.
"Yes!" The Qi Cultivator in blue nodded respectfully, then quickly approached Xu Ping with a flattering smile on his face:
"Senior, I am very familiar with the inside of the marketplace; I can find any corner..."
Xu Ping nodded: "Lead the way ahead; you’ll be well rewarded... I’m planning to sell a large batch of Spirit Medicine and Spirit Plants while purchasing some materials for crafting arrays, materials for magical artifacts, and Second-stage Upper Grade Spirit Wood..."

chapters.title: Chapter 162: 150: Sweeping Through
chapters.content:
Chapter 162: Chapter 150: Sweeping Through
The blue-robed cultivator pondered for a moment: "For selling large quantities of spirit medicines and spirit plants, the most reputable place is the ’Water Gate Pavilion’ established by the Shuize Sect. Of course, if senior wishes to sell other items...
The blue-robed cultivator lowered his voice and said: "I also know some channels for disposing of stolen goods..."
"Channels for stolen goods?" Xu Ping’s eyes flashed. This guide is quite interesting, he even knows about channels for stolen goods.
But spirit plants and spirit medicines are not as distinguishable as magical artifacts, there’s really no need to dispose of stolen goods, the normal trade is sufficient.
The blue-robed cultivator continued: "As for materials for array crafting and magical artifact crafting, the ’Water Gate Pavilion’ also has everything in stock, but if it’s second-stage upper grade spirit wood, it’s best to purchase it at the ’Spirit Wood Pavilion’ established by one of the eight Foundation Establishment families, the Song family."
"Their spirit wood is quite complete in both quantity and quality."
"The Song family?"
Xu Ping was taken aback; he really had some connections with the Song family!
But they were all unfortunate ties.
"Is the Song family’s spirit wood very famous?" Xu Ping asked curiously.
He was usually focused on cultivation and remained quite ignorant of matters in Yue Country.
"Naturally!" The blue-robed cultivator nodded, "The Song family rose by cultivating spirit wood. It’s said they can even cultivate third-stage spirit wood."
"Third-stage spirit wood?"
Xu Ping’s heart tingled, and he thought to himself, "It seems this family really has some skills. Maybe they can truly gather the second-stage upper grade spirit stones I want."
"Lead the way ahead, first to the Water Gate Pavilion!" Xu Ping instructed, feeling quite satisfied with this guide.
If he were doing it himself, figuring all this out would surely require a lot of time and effort.
...
Water Gate Pavilion.
The pavilion is octagonal, with entrances on each direction.
On the eaves, there are carvings of ’chiwen’ with dragon heads and fish bodies.
"Please, senior, come up to the second floor. I’ll take you to meet our shopkeeper!"
As Xu Ping and the blue-robed guide just entered the pavilion, a Qi Refinement mid-stage youth’s face changed, and he quickly led Xu Ping up to the second floor.
The furnishings upstairs were different from the hall below, not only was the area much smaller, but it also featured some antique-looking tables and chairs, arranged in elegance and comfort.
"Greetings, fellow Daoist. I am Li Qian. May I know what you’re here to purchase?"
As Xu Ping arrived up, a middle-aged man at the early-stage Foundation Establishment welcomed him.
This person wore a dark black magical robe, was slightly overweight, and sported a droopy mustache.
"Daoist Li, I would like to purchase some materials for magical artifact crafting and array crafting, and additionally sell a large batch of spirit medicines and plants."
Xu Ping cupped his hands and then handed a jade slip to him: "The materials I wish to purchase are recorded in this jade slip."
Li Qian scanned the jade slip with his divine sense and was immediately stunned, ’This is way too much, and many are very precious.’
He simply estimated, and it would take at least eight or nine thousand spirit stones.
"A big customer!" He couldn’t help but feel excited. Even Foundation Establishment cultivators rarely buy and sell so much at once.
"Please wait a moment, fellow Daoist, I will be right back!" Li Qian quickly stood up, cupped his hands to Xu Ping, and then left to go downstairs.
After about the time it takes to drink a cup of tea, Li Qian appeared in front of Xu Ping again.
"These storage rings contain the items you need, fellow Daoist. You can check them." He pushed several storage bags in front of Xu Ping.
Xu Ping scanned them with his divine sense, nodded: "The number is correct, how much are the spirit stones in total?"
"You also want to sell a large batch of spirit medicines and spirit plants, right? We’ll calculate their value in spirit stones first, and then make up the difference." Li Qian smiled.
’It should be them making up my difference.’ Xu Ping grumbled inwardly, then took out seven storage bags from his storage ring and placed them on the table.
"Here are all the spirit medicines and spirit plants I want to sell."
Upon hearing this, Li Qian couldn’t help but scan the seven storage bags with his divine sense and gasped: "Fellow Daoist... you want to sell all of this?"
"Hmm, please handle it all."
Xu Ping looked indifferent.
"Please wait a moment, fellow Daoist..."
Li Qian then began to meticulously examine the spirit medicines and spirit plants in the seven storage bags.
Xu Ping wasn’t anxious and calmly drank the spirit tea poured by the attendant.
Li Qian’s actions were very swift.
In just a quarter of an hour, he finished tallying all the spirit medicines and plants: "All spirit medicines and spirit plants in the seven storage bags total fourteen thousand five hundred and sixty-three spirit stones."
