"Excluding the eight thousand six hundred and thirty spirit stones’ worth of various materials you purchased, our ’Water Gate Pavilion’ still needs to reimburse you with five thousand nine hundred and thirty-three spirit stones. Is this acceptable, fellow Daoist?"
"That’s fine, let’s trade like this." Xu Ping nodded.
The price was quite reasonable, and with the ’Water Gate Pavilion’ backed by the Golden Core Sect, they wouldn’t target a Foundation Establishment cultivator for just over ten thousand spirit stones; it wouldn’t be worth it at all.
This was the reason Xu Ping dared to sell all his spirit medicines and plants at once.
...
...
After leaving the Water Gate Pavilion, the blue-robed cultivator led Xu Ping to the Song family’s ’Spirit Wood Pavilion’.
Upon learning that a Foundation Establishment cultivator had arrived, the shopkeeper of the ’Spirit Wood Pavilion’ personally met him.
And once Xu Ping recognized the shopkeeper of the ’Spirit Wood Pavilion’, his expression couldn’t help but change.
For it was none other than Song Li, who previously bid against him at Hanyang Market, secretly followed him afterward, and plotted against him.
’What a small world, indeed!’ Xu Ping couldn’t help but sigh.
However, Song Li evidently did not recognize Xu Ping. He first courteously greeted: "I am Song Li, may I know which type of spirit wood the fellow Daoist wishes to purchase?"
Song Li’s manners clearly reflected specialized training, his every move showcased etiquette.
But there was also a faint trace of arrogance between his brows.
"I wish to buy enough second-stage upper grade spirit wood. Does your pavilion have it for sale?" Xu Ping asked casually.
"We certainly do; may I know how much you wish to buy?" Song Li confidently replied.
The Song family, having risen by cultivating spirit wood, naturally wouldn’t lack second-stage upper grade spirit wood.
However, when he heard Xu Ping specify the quantity of second-stage upper grade spirit wood he wanted, and also require them to be from the same root source, his face quickly darkened: "Are you joking with me, fellow Daoist?"
"If you want a large number of second-stage upper grade spirit wood all from the same root, even searching the entire Yue Country might not yield any."
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping’s heart couldn’t help but sink: "If it’s impossible even after searching all Yue Country, then is my Wood Sword Array destined not to take shape?"
"Is there really no way?" Xu Ping pressed, refusing to give up.
"Not entirely, if using my Song family’s cultivation method and secret technique maybe..." Song Li glanced at Xu Ping but stopped speaking.
With their Song family’s unique cultivation method and secret technique, cultivating such a number of same-root second-stage upper grade spirit stones in a few decades, or even a hundred years, might be possible.
But the price would be unaffordable not just for the current early-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, but even for a fake pill cultivator.
Luckily, he was too lazy to explain.
"Can the Song family cultivate them? If so, spirit stones are not an issue!" Seeing the other party stop halfway, Xu Ping grew quite anxious, repeatedly asking.
It was rare to have even a glimmer of hope, he couldn’t let it slip away.
"This is beyond what you can bear, I’d advise you to abandon this idea!" Song Li said indifferently.
"Would Song Daoist sell to me the cultivation method and secret technique for second-stage upper grade spirit wood?" Xu Ping immediately asked.
Upon hearing this, Song Li’s face changed dramatically, an anger surfaced on his face: "This is the Song family’s untransmissible secret; how could it be up for sale? Please leave!"
He immediately swung his sleeve and led Xu Ping out.
Outside the Water Gate Pavilion.
Xu Ping’s face also darkened.
It was rare to glimpse even a semblance of hope, and he wouldn’t give up easily.
If the other party’s attitude was hard, he’d just have to be harder.
Moreover, he had yet to settle the score with Song Li for previously coveting him.
"Merely subduing the opponent is easy, but obtaining the Song family’s unique cultivation method and secret technique would be extremely difficult!" Xu Ping thought to himself.
Such an important secret technique, the Song family would surely not allow Song Li to carry it.
Even if passed on, it was likely through oral transmission.
"This is indeed quite troublesome!" Xu Ping thought with difficulty.

chapters.title: Chapter 163: 151: Primordial Sword Skill Perfected
chapters.content:
Chapter 163: Chapter 151: Primordial Sword Skill Perfected
"Elder... elder, what has happened?" the cultivator in blue asked, trembling.
Compared to Xu Ping, he had been directly expelled by the ’Spirit Wood Pavilion,’ feeling extreme fear inside.
"It’s none of your business. This is your pay for today; you may go." Xu Ping said indifferently, flicking his fingers as over twenty Spirit Stones fell directly into the blue-clad cultivator’s arms.
"Thank you, elder. I bid you farewell!" The cultivator in blue held the Spirit Stones joyfully, unable to help but sigh inwardly, ’Foundation Establishment Cultivators are indeed generous; the reward for just leading the way is enough for a whole month’s earnings.’
...
After the blue-clad cultivator left, Xu Ping quickly disappeared into the crowd.
However, he kept pondering how to acquire the cultivation method and secret techniques of the Song family.
"Perhaps I can use the Thousand Illusion Mask to infiltrate the Song family and plot to obtain their cultivation methods and secret techniques?" Xu Ping immediately thought of using the Thousand Illusion Mask.
But after careful consideration, he shook his head.
"I’m afraid not!"
"Important figures in the Song family likely have soul tokens. If they die, the tokens will break. Should I infiltrate then, it would be like delivering myself into their hands."
"And becoming an unimportant figure in the Song family certainly wouldn’t let me access the core cultivation methods and secret techniques."
Xu Ping pondered for a long time.
He felt that there was only one somewhat reliable way, which was to learn a Soul-Searching Secret Technique, directly capture important figures from the Song family, and then perform a soul search.
If one doesn’t work, then two will. After all, with his current strength, apart from having some trouble with the Song family’s Fake Pill patriarch and the Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivators, he hardly regarded other mid-to-late Foundation Establishment cultivators.
"Since Song Li knows about the cultivation methods and secret techniques, then I’ll make him the first target."
"However, before that, I still need to learn the Soul-Searching Secret Technique."
"But this kind of technique, leaning towards demonic ways and involving Divine Sense, is hard to find!" Xu Ping felt somewhat helpless.
Even at the large auction in Qiu Xuan Immortal City previously, he hadn’t seen it for auction, and he didn’t know if Wanzhe Waters had it.
"Perhaps I could go back and ask Duan Shuang and Gong Yang; they might know something." Xu Ping thought to himself.
Now that almost everything had been purchased, it was time to leave.
With Song Li stationed at the Spirit Wood Pavilion on Dragon Lion Island, he likely wouldn’t leave for a while. Even if he did leave, it didn’t matter. Given Xu Ping’s strength and ability to hide, capturing one or two Foundation Establishment cultivators from the Song family posed no problem.
...
...
Half a month later.
Xu Ping piloted the Flying Boat back to Thousand Leaves Mountain.
After resting for a day, he first visited Duan Shuang on Flower Butterfly Mountain.
"Soul-Searching Secret Technique? I don’t know about that." Duan Shuang shook her head.
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping couldn’t help but feel a tinge of disappointment, bowing as he said, "Then I shall ask Fellow Daoist Gong."
"Fellow Daoist Xu, hold on." Duan Shuang called after Xu Ping.
"Does Fellow Daoist Duan have something else in mind?" Xu Ping turned back, puzzled.
Duan Shuang smiled charmingly, "I’ve recently discovered a secret realm. I’m wondering if Fellow Daoist Xu would be interested in exploring it with me?"
"A secret realm?"
Xu Ping’s expression turned strange, not helping but recall their first meeting when Duan Shuang had been trapped in ruins.
If not for him, she might have been trapped indefinitely.
It seems this Fellow Daoist Duan really enjoys exploring secret realms!
"I have many things to attend to recently, so I won’t accompany Fellow Daoist Duan this time. I wish you a fruitful adventure," Xu Ping shook his head, refusing.
For him, exploring unknown secret realms posed more risks than benefits, and there was no need to take such risks.
Besides, he truly had many tasks at hand.
Exchanging a farewell, Xu Ping then conjured Escape Light to reach Little Hui Mountain.
In a pavilion on Little Hui Mountain.
Gong Yang warmly greeted Xu Ping, "What brings Fellow Daoist Xu to this old man?"
Their previous encounter had left their relationship somewhat awkward, and Gong Yang naturally wanted to mend it.
"Pardon the intrusion; I’ve come to ask if Fellow Daoist Gong knows where Soul-Searching Techniques are sold," Xu Ping inquired, cupping his hands.
"Soul-Searching Technique?"
Gong Yang furrowed his brow, contemplating for a moment before shaking his head, "I have not heard of anywhere selling Soul-Searching Techniques."
"So Fellow Daoist Gong doesn’t know either?"
Just when Xu Ping thought he would leave disappointed again, he heard Gong Yang suddenly say, "But, this old man could take Fellow Daoist Xu to an underground auction to try your luck."
"Underground auction?" Xu Ping showed a puzzled expression.
What’s this auction he had never heard of before?
Seeing the confusion on Xu Ping’s face, Gong Yang explained, "It’s an auction organized by a group of mysterious cultivators, locations are never fixed, and notices are temporary. The items sold are mostly things that shouldn’t see the light of day, but the items are all top-notch."
"After the auction, if you haven’t found anything satisfying, you can still go on stage to seek trades."
"But it’s incredibly secretive with high entry barriers, so very few people know about it."
Listening to Gong Yang’s explanation, Xu Ping’s eyes flickered. This underground auction sounded intriguing, allowing participants to go on stage and seek trades.
However, those daring to go on stage might become targets, and if their strength was weak, their lives could be in danger.
"Do Fake Pill or Golden Core cultivators participate in such auctions?" Xu Ping asked.
"It’s just a small auction held every two years, unlikely to attract Golden Cores. However, as for Fake Pill cultivators, it’s possible, just with a very low probability." Gong Yang thought for a moment before responding.
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping immediately felt relieved.
As long as there were no Golden Core cultivators, he had nothing to fear even if a Fake Pill cultivator attended.

chapters.title: Chapter 164 - 151: Primordial Sword Skill Perfected (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 164: Chapter 151: Primordial Sword Skill Perfected (Part 2)
Moreover, the ’Soul-Searching Technique’ he sought was not something of immeasurable value; for Fake Pill cultivators, it was not particularly attractive, let alone for Golden Core cultivators.
"I wonder when the next underground auction will be?" Xu Ping asked again.
"The last one was a year ago, so it should be about a year from now," Gong Yang said with a smile, stroking his beard. "But the exact time is still unknown; they usually notify us three months in advance."
"Then, Fellow Daoist Gong, please notify me before the next underground auction begins," Xu Ping cupped his hands.
"It’s a small favor." Gong Yang smiled.
The two chatted for a while, and it wasn’t until dusk began to fall that Xu Ping left.
...
...
Night descended, like heavy silk covering the earth.
Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Xu Ping sat in the courtyard, his mind pondering the plan ahead.
"With a year until the next underground auction, I could use this time to set up a protective array for the mountain, renovate and decorate the cave dwelling, and plant spirit valley, medicinal herb seeds, and spirit wood saplings, which would be good practice."
"However, these are not difficult tasks; the focus should be on the ’Thousand Threads Puppet Transformation Skill.’" Xu Ping flipped his hand, and a jade pendant appeared in his palm.
He was quite interested in this Puppet Control Skill; if he could master it and combine it with a dozen second-stage upper-grade puppets, even a Fake Pill cultivator might be a match.
Xu Ping’s divine sense penetrated the jade slip, gradually grasping its profound concepts.
Pale green spiritual light floated one after another in his divine sense, and he became absorbed in comprehending these mantras, his body motionless.
In this way, an hour quietly passed.
At this moment, Xu Ping suddenly opened his eyes, a deep meaning flashing in them: "Divine Sense into Threads, huh?"
This secret technique emphasizes drawing a small amount of divine sense to create a thread of divine sense imprint, planting it on the puppet, allowing full control of the puppet with one’s mind.
Although there is no limit to the number of divine sense imprints, one can plant as many as one wishes; nonetheless, a cultivator’s divine sense is ultimately limited.
If too many divine sense imprints are planted, it will severely affect oneself, so generally, a cultivator can control at most five or six puppets simultaneously.
Moreover, one can also retrieve the divine sense planted on the puppets at any time without harming oneself.
This divine sense secret technique is immensely valuable, at least not inferior to his ’Shocking God Needle,’ for puppets controlled by divine sense have much greater combat capability than those not controlled by divine sense.
The ’Thousand Threads Puppet Transformation Skill’ has three levels.
Upon mastering the first level, one can control puppets with a cultivation lower than one’s own.
Upon mastering the second level, one can control puppets with the same cultivation as one’s own.
Upon mastering the third level, one can control puppets one tier higher than one’s own cultivation.
"It seems reaching the third level will significantly enhance my strength," Xu Ping thought to himself.
Controlling a second-stage middle-grade puppet holds little significance for him; controlling a second-stage upper-grade puppet would truly be beneficial to him.
"But before that, I still need to acquire a second-stage puppet skill inheritance set to start manufacturing puppets."
A second-stage puppet holds immense value; if he intended to buy a dozen at once, even going bankrupt wouldn’t suffice.
It’s far more economical to forge them himself.
"There’s so much to do ahead; I haven’t even gotten started on the artifact refining technique, and now I need to purchase second-stage puppet techniques to start manufacturing puppets," Xu Ping couldn’t help but sigh inwardly.
However, he did not feel rushed; with a proficiency panel available, he wasn’t afraid of not mastering it.
...
The following period was exceedingly busy for Xu Ping.
By day, he set up protective arrays for the mountain, renovated and decorated the cave dwelling, and planted spirit valley, medicinal herb seeds, and spirit wood saplings.
By night, he practiced the ’Thousand Threads Puppet Transformation Skill’ and cultivated.
Besides, he also had to find time to practice swordsmanship and research artifact refining.
Although life was busy, Xu Ping had already grown accustomed to it and instead found it fulfilling.
In this way, time flowed like water, and two months quietly slipped by.
This day, the sun was blazing in the sky.
Xu Ping stood before a medicine field, performing the Spirit Rain Skill, massive clouds completely shrouding this area of spirit fields. Soon, a drizzle of spirit rain fell, causing the spirit herbs in the fields to grow even more lush and full.
Having finished performing the Spirit Rain Skill, Xu Ping looked up and instantly felt refreshed.
From the outskirts of the mountain top to the halfway point, large swathes of verdant green were shining; that was the spirit valley thriving robustly.
From the outside to the inside, spirit wood saplings were encircling the outer ring of the mountain top.
At the center of the spirit fields, various spirit flowers and exotic grasses bloomed splendidly in a riot of color.
At the entrance of the cave dwelling, a self-dug half-acre pond was covered in brilliant lotus flowers, resembling a sea of pink.
"Now, this looks like a spiritual land!"
Xu Ping smiled with satisfaction; he was very pleased with the results of his two months of busy work.
Moreover, not only has the environment of Thousand Leaves Mountain become more pleasant and visually appealing, but its security has also greatly improved.
The array originally set up in Thousand Leaves Mountain was only a second-stage middle-grade array. After his days of labor and modification, this array has now been upgraded to the second-stage upper-grade level.
Yet Xu Ping felt it still wasn’t safe enough, so he set up another second-stage upper-grade array.
Under his design and adjustments, the two arrays complemented each other, greatly augmenting their power, even touching a hint of third-rank power.
With these two arrays guarding it, even a Fake Pill cultivator could not break through.
"It’s a pity that with my current array skills, I still can’t set up a third-rank array; otherwise, it would truly be impregnable," Xu Ping regrettably shook his head.
The main issue is that a third-rank array is too difficult, completely in a different league from the second stage.
Even with the help of the skilled interface, Xu Ping is still at a loss.
However, he wasn’t too worried, after all, there aren’t many Golden Core cultivators in the entire Yue Country, and without any plausible reason, a Golden Core cultivator wouldn’t suddenly attack his Thousand Leaves Mountain.
...
...
After arranging the cave dwelling on the mountain, Xu Ping invited Duan Shuang and Gong Yang over.
With the notarization of the cultivators from the Shuize Sect.
The three of them re-signed a spirit contract for shared rental.
This time the spirit contract officially took effect, and for the next decade, this Thousand Leaves Mountain would completely belong to him.
After signing the spirit contract.
Lu Chang’an held a banquet in the cave dwelling, entertaining Duan Shuang and Gong Yang.
Gong Yang stayed briefly before returning to Xiao Hui Mountain, as he had taken up a major deal recently and was busy day and night.
Xu Ping knew about this, so he did not ask him to stay.
Therefore, only Xu Ping and Duan Shuang were left on Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"Fellow Daoist Duan, try the Hundred Flowers Brew I have crafted," Xu Ping poured Duan Shuang a cup of his modified Hundred Flowers Brew.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, you know how to brew wine?" Duan Shuang showed a surprised expression, then immediately picked up the cup to taste.
The flavor was very peculiar, with the fragrance of various spirit flowers bursting along with the taste of the wine on the tip of the tongue.
Duan Shuang’s eyes brightened, and she couldn’t help but exclaim, "Excellent wine!"
"As long as the fellow daoist enjoys it!" Xu Ping smiled slightly and poured Duan Shuang another cup.
The two drank and chatted.
Xu Ping couldn’t help but ask why she was so fond of exploring secret realms.
"Ah, I just want to control my own destiny!" Duan Shuang sighed softly, "I possess a Pure Yin Body, and once a male cultivator seizes the Primordial Yin from me..."
Saying this, she looked at the young man in white, warm as jade, with sharpness hidden in his brows.
She seemed to realize the inappropriateness of her words since Xu Ping was also a male cultivator.
A faint blush surfaced on her delicate face.
At this moment, Xu Ping couldn’t help but show an awkward expression.
...
...
After seeing off Duan Shuang, Xu Ping found it difficult to calm his thoughts.
"Controlling one’s destiny, how difficult is that!" He sighed softly.
It’s not just for Foundation Establishment cultivators like them, even Golden Core cultivators might not dare claim to fully control their destiny.
Perhaps only the lofty Nascent Soul cultivators have the confidence to make such a claim.
For some reason, a desire to practice his sword suddenly welled up in his heart.
Xu Ping turned his palm, and the Purple Sun Sword appeared in his hand.
He held the sword single-handedly, the sword momentum like a rainbow, thrusting straight out, the sword light cutting through the air, the Primordial Sword Skill fluently executed.
The sword momentum spread around him, the air filled with a kind of Sword Intent, as if even time had come to a halt.
In this instant, Xu Ping’s body seemed to merge with heaven and earth, countless insights surfacing in his heart.
He closed his eyes, feeling the changes of the sword momentum, mentally reciting each detail, gradually comprehending the essence of swordsmanship.
The sword momentum in his hand kept changing, each change carrying different forces, reaching for the sky.
Xu Ping was completely immersed, his sword momentum growing stronger as though it was about to envelop the entire Thousand Leaves Mountain with this Sword Intent.
"Break!" he shouted in a low voice, the sword light suddenly flashed, seemingly tearing through the void, with formless Sword Qi thrusting straight at the mountain rock ahead.
Rumble!
The mountain rock was instantly pulverized into powder, scattering in the air, and even the arrays guarding the entire Thousand Leaves Mountain began to flicker ceaselessly.
"Primordial Sword Skill... has reached perfection!"

chapters.title: Chapter 165 - 152: Sword Light Like a Rainbow?
chapters.content:
Chapter 165: Chapter 152: Sword Light Like a Rainbow?
"Primordial Sword Skill has reached mastery!" Xu Ping opened his eyes, and an indescribable excitement surged in his heart.
Although he didn’t check the proficiency panel, he was absolutely certain that his Primordial Sword Skill had broken through to mastery.
He raised his sword and struck, the sword light briefly flashing with a fleeting white rainbow, seemingly tearing through the void, carrying boundless sharp energy, turning a sturdy hillock into powder, scattering in the air.
"Is this... the second realm of Sword Dao—Sword Light Like a Rainbow?" Xu Ping was astonished.
But upon closer inspection, he felt it wasn’t quite right.
He had barely touched the edge of Sword Light Like a Rainbow; there was still a long way to go before fully comprehending the second realm of Sword Dao, Sword Light Like a Rainbow.
Nonetheless, even so, the power of his swordsmanship had at least doubled.
Originally, his swordsmanship was powerful; when fully executed, even late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivators couldn’t withstand a few of his strikes.
Now the power of his swordsmanship has doubled again.
How many strikes can Foundation Establishment Perfection withstand?
It’s simply unimaginable how strong the power of the swordsmanship would be upon completely comprehending Sword Light Like a Rainbow!
Perhaps, at that time, slicing through Fake Pill cultivators wouldn’t be just a dream.
"Slicing through Fake Pill cultivators!" Xu Ping murmured to himself, his heart brimming with excitement.
Though it is named Fake Pill, it’s not on the same level as Foundation Establishment cultivators; the gap is greater than from Qi Cultivation to Foundation Establishment, entirely a chasm impossible to cross.
At that time, maybe he would barely have some means of self-preservation in Yue Country.
"It’s just... the mana consumption is a bit high." Xu Ping carefully sensed his mana condition, noticing that just the casual two sword strikes had consumed at least one-tenth of his mana.
If he were to exert himself fully, perhaps in just a few sword strikes his mana would be exhausted.
"Sword Light Like a Rainbow undoubtedly deserves to be a Golden Core power, even with such abundant mana as mine, the execution is very strenuous." Xu Ping sighed in his heart.
"However, a breakthrough in swordsmanship is indeed a great joy in life, let’s drink a cup for it!"
Xu Ping, in high spirits, took out the Hundred Flowers Brew. With a thought, a First Rank Upper Grade puppet walked out from the house to pour him a cup of wine.
He picked up the wine glass and drank it in one gulp.
...
...
In the blink of an eye, half a year had passed.
Xu Ping had been at Thousand Leaves Mountain for a year now.
On this day, the entire training room was illuminated like a sea of flames by the crimson Spiritual Fire emitted from the Fire Supplying Array, with waves of heat rolling, as if intending to roast everything dry.
However, in the face of this high temperature, Xu Ping’s expression remained unchanged. Utilizing the Spiritual Fire, he began to forge the sword embryo, his expression focused, like a calm ancient well, free from waves.
Heart serene, detached from the material world.
His every movement, every detail was executed with such fluidity and grace, like drifting clouds and flowing water.
As if he had tempered thousands of times, a pleasure to watch.
Not sure how long the forging continued.
Twang!
The sword sang sharply, clear and echoing like a dragon; a mid-grade Spiritual Sword dazzling with spirit light took shape in the Spiritual Fire.
"The Upper Grade Spiritual Sword, Cyan Dragon Sword, finally finished.
Xu Ping was content and smiled.
Relying on the proficiency panel, Second-stage Body Refining, and his terrifying Divine Sense surpassing the late-stage Foundation Establishment.
He went from knowing nothing about artifact refinement to forging an Upper Grade Spiritual Sword in just half a year.
If other Foundation Establishment cultivators knew this, they would probably call him a monster.
After all, although Foundation Establishment cultivators had the assistance of Divine Sense, granting significant advantage in the myriad arts of immortality.
Becoming proficient in First Rank techniques was easy, but Second-stage challenged talent.
Moreover, every cultivator has limited lifelong energy.
Personal cultivation itself consumes a lot, one must plan for breakthroughs in small realms and the resources for major realms, resulting in most Foundation Establishment cultivators often not possessing even one Second-stage skill.
Duan Shuang was such a cultivator.
Xu Ping held the Cyan Dragon Sword, mana surged, ’buzz’ a sword light several feet long sprang from the sword tip.
"Not bad!"
Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction; this Upper Grade Spiritual Sword was forged perfectly.
Its quality completely matched those forged by seasoned Second-stage Artifact Refiners.
He swung the Cyan Dragon Sword around, played with it until satisfied, then returned it to the Storage Ring.
However, when he paused to check the Spirit Stone consumption in the Fire Supplying Array, he slightly frowned.
The forging of this Cyan Dragon Sword alone consumed three mid-grade Spirit Stones, equivalent to three hundred lower-grade Spirit Stones.
To know, in the Upper Grade Spiritual Sword tier, this Cyan Dragon Sword could only be considered average, how terrifying the consumption would be when forging Top-grade Magical Artifacts?
Even with Xu Ping’s wealth, it might be difficult to bear.
As for using Foundation Establishment True Flame for forging, perhaps even if his mana was exhausted, he could barely manage a single Upper Grade Spiritual Sword.
"Without Earth Fire, forging Magical Artifacts is truly troublesome; perhaps I should consult Gong Yang?" Xu Ping speculated in his heart.
As he knew, there was no Earth Fire in Little Hui Mountain, yet orders kept flying to the other party, surely they had some special Skill.
Speak of the devil, and he will appear.
Just as Xu Ping planned to find Gong Yang, Gong Yang came to visit, bringing a middle-aged man with a small mustache.
"Fellow Daoist Gong, this fellow Daoist?" Xu Ping courteously invited them into the cave residence.
"This is Zhou Leqi. Zhou Daoist, this is the famous Xu Ping, Fellow Daoist Xu." Gong Yang smilingly introduced the two.
"Fellow Daoist Xu," Zhou Leqi cupped his hands slightly, his expression with a touch of ingratiation.
The other party’s unparalleled swordsmanship and formidable power, along with being a Second-stage Pill Master, far exceeded him in strength, naturally worthy of being flattered.
"Fellow Daoist Zhou," Xu Ping returned the gesture, but inwardly pondered the man’s background.
After some pleasantries, Gong Yang began to explain why they had come to find Xu Ping.

chapters.title: Chapter 166 - 152: Sword Light Like a Rainbow? (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 166: Chapter 152: Sword Light Like a Rainbow? (Part 2)
"I’ve completed the matchmaking task. The rest is up to Fellow Daoist Zhou and Fellow Daoist Xu to discuss," Gong Yang said with a smile.
Zhou Leqi continued, cupping his hands, and said, "Fellow Daoist Xu, I’ve heard your alchemy skills are unparalleled. I’d like to ask you to refine a batch of pills."
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping instantly understood that Gong Yang had introduced him to some business.
Having business come to him was naturally something to take on, especially since alchemy wouldn’t take much of his time.
"Of course, that’s no problem. What kind of pills would you like refined?" Xu Ping asked with a smile.
"Here’s the list of pills, please have a look, Fellow Daoist Xu," Zhou Leqi handed Xu Ping a jade slip.
Xu Ping glanced over it with his Divine Sense. There were quite a few types, most of which were related to beast taming.
’It seems this Fellow Daoist Zhou has a Beast Taming Family behind him,’ he thought to himself, deducing part of Zhou’s background from the pills.
"No problem, I can refine all these pills within a month," Xu Ping nodded in agreement.
This was still a conservative estimate. If he went all out, he could refine them in half a month at most.
Zhou Leqi’s eyes flashed with a hint of delight, "Thank you, Fellow Daoist Xu. Here are the materials for alchemy, please check them."
He took out two storage bags filled with materials from his Storage Ring and handed them to Xu Ping.
Xu Ping swept over them with his Divine Sense and found there were extra materials.
This was quite normal, as alchemy also involves loss.
However, for Xu Ping, with his skilled panel, loss was almost non-existent.
With extra materials, he naturally accepted them with a smile.
After the two discussed the specific fees for refining pills, Zhou Leqi bid farewell, "There are matters in my family that need attending, so I won’t chat further. Farewell."
"Safe travels, Fellow Daoist Zhou!" Xu Ping personally saw him out of the cave.
...
After sending off Zhou Leqi, Xu Ping returned to the cave, only to see Gong Yang looking at him with a full smile, much like a proud child waiting to be praised for doing a good deed.
Seeing this, he couldn’t help but find it amusing, ’This Fellow Daoist Gong really went to great lengths to please me!’
"Thank you, Gong Yang, for introducing this business to me." Xu Pin, though amused, showed no hint on his face, and cupped his hands in thanks.
"Just a small task, just a small task!" Gong Yang’s smile grew even brighter.
After a few casual exchanges, Xu Ping inquired about how Gong Yang refined Magical Artifacts without Earth Fire.
"That’s simple, using Arrays or raising a spirit beast that breathes Demon Fire works," Gong Yang said with a smile.
"Demon Beast? That’s indeed a good idea!" Xu Ping’s heart stirred.
"However, to refine Upper-grade Magical Artifacts or even Top-grade Magical Artifacts, the Demon Fire of a First Rank Demon Beast might not suffice," Xu Ping continued to ask.
’Upper-grade Magical Artifacts, Top-grade Magical Artifacts?’
Gong Yang glanced at Xu Ping with curiosity before replying, "Just set up an array to amplify the Demon Fire. Since this array only serves as a magnifier, it doesn’t consume many Spirit Stones."
"I see!" Xu Ping suddenly understood, cupped his hands, and thanked, "Thank you, Fellow Daoist Gong, for informing me."
It seems Gong Yang must have employed the same method.
"No problem, it’s just some unconventional knowledge," Gong Yang waved his hand.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, the path of Artifact Refining requires steady progress, step by step," Gong Yang said earnestly.
Xu Ping smiled slightly, without explaining further, he asked instead, "I wonder if Fellow Daoist Gong could recommend a place that sells such Demon Beasts?"
"You can purchase them from Fellow Daoist Zhou Leqi’s family. His family specializes in selling various Demon Beasts, good quality at affordable prices. I bought my Fire Crow from them," Gong Yang answered.
"What a coincidence, next month when Fellow Daoist Zhou comes, I’ll go visit his family," Xu Ping said with a smile.
"Next month may be difficult!"
Gong Yang shook his head and explained, "The time and place of the underground auction are confirmed, it will be held three months later on a deserted island in the Wanzhe Waters."
"However, the island is quite far from our Purple Bamboo Mountain, so we must plan our departure."
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping’s eyes brightened, "Then next month isn’t plausible. Anyway, there’s no rush, I can go after returning."
"I wonder how far in advance we need to depart. If it’s very tight, I’ll have to negotiate with Fellow Daoist Zhou to postpone the alchemy timeline," Xu Ping asked.
"No need to rush, Fellow Daoist Xu. We can depart about a month in advance," Gong Yang said with a smile.
"Then there’s indeed plenty of time, enough for me to complete the alchemy," Xu Ping laughed.
...
...
A month later, at Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"Mission accomplished. The pills Fellow Daoist Zhou entrusted to me have been completely refined!" Xu Ping smiled, handing a storage bag full of pills to Zhou Leqi.
Zhou Leqi accepted the storage bag, scanned it with his Divine Sense, and knew the count, "Thank you for your hard work, Fellow Daoist Xu. Here’s your reward."
He cheerfully took out a storage bag containing Spirit Stones from his Storage Ring and handed it to Xu Ping.
Xu Ping accepted it without even checking and directly stored it into his Storage Bag.
"The family matters have been busy lately, so I’ll take my leave for now."
Zhou Leqi cupped his hands, ready to leave, but was stopped by Xu Ping, "Please wait, Fellow Daoist Zhou."
"Is there anything else, Fellow Daoist Xu?" Zhou Leqi turned his head in confusion.
"I’ve heard that Fellow Daoist Zhou’s family specializes in selling various Demon Beasts. I wonder if you have any Demon Beasts that can breathe Demon Fire to assist in Artifact Refining?" Xu Ping asked with a smile.
Upon hearing this, Zhou Leqi replied cheerfully, "Of course, we have Fire Crows and Fire Soul Wolves that can breathe Demon Fire to assist in Artifact Refining."
"Just listening to my driest explanation won’t give you an understanding. How about you follow me to my family, and then you can slowly choose?" Zhou Leqi warmly invited.
"That’s precisely my intention, but I won’t be able to go for a few months due to an outing. When I return, I’ll go to your family for a good selection," Xu Ping cupped his hands.
"Looking forward to your arrival at any time, Fellow Daoist Xu," Zhou Leqi said with a smile.
...
...
Another month went by.
The sky was clear, an endless expanse of blue, resembling a giant sapphire embedded in the horizon.
The sunlight was bright, casting golden rays that illuminated the earth.
At that moment, a Flying Boat carrying two people lifted off from the summit of Maple Leaf Mountain and flew into the distance.
Gong Yang cheerfully piloted the Spiritual Boat at the front, looking relaxed; Xu Ping, in a white robe, serene and peaceful, akin to an ancient tree rooted at the stern of the boat.
The boat proceeded on its course, flying for a month before they reached a deserted island devoid of Spirit Veins.
"Remember to conceal your identity, Fellow Daoist," Gong Yang reminded Xu Ping, then donned a mask to shield his Divine Sense vision and used a Secret Technique to alter his form.
Xu Ping also wore a mask Gong Yang handed him, and used the Thousand Illusion Mask to change his shape.
Once both were disguised, Gong Yang steered the boat deeper into the island.
A quarter of an hour later, they came across the dazzling spiritual light of a large array, resembling stars in the dawn, resplendent and eye-catching.
"A Third-rank Array!!"
Xu Pin felt the power of the array and was greatly astonished.
The array didn’t have Spirit Veins as its Array Source; how many Spirit Stones would this consume?
But Gong Yang wasn’t fazed, calmly stowing the Flying Boat, "We’re here, let’s get off."
The two descended before the array.
Standing at the front of the array were two black-clad men, each wearing a grotesque ghostly mask.
Xu Ping glanced at the black-clad men, his eyes narrowing slightly.
These two were the same Foundation Establishment Stage cultivators as he was, and one appeared to be Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment.
"Token!" rumbled the mid-stage black-clad man.
Gong Yang flicked his finger, and a token made of a special metal landed in his hand.
After verifying the token, the mid-stage black-clad man returned it to Gong Yang.
Then, he took out a Spirit Plate to control the array, infused Mana into it, and with the flicker of spiritual light, an array passage appeared before their eyes.
"Enter," the mid-stage black-clad man said coldly.
According to the underground auction rules, the holder of the token could bring one other person along inside, clearly acknowledging Xu Ping and Gong Yang were together, so it was unnecessary to check if Xu Ping had a token as well.
The two exchanged a glance and, without hesitation, passed through the array passage into the interior of the array.

chapters.title: Chapter 167 - 153: Geng Metal
chapters.content:
Chapter 167: Chapter 153: Geng Metal
Passing through the array channel, a magnificent hall suddenly appeared before the two of them.
The crimson carpet, the pure white jade walls, and the high-hanging palace lanterns all exuded the grandeur and wealth of the secular world.
The hall was oval-shaped, with a diameter of several dozen yards. Inside, there were seven or eight rows of wooden chairs, upon which sat dozens of Foundation Establishment cultivators dressed in various styles, all of whom had their figures and faces concealed with masks or secret techniques.
Opposite them was a solitary empty table, with three sandalwood chairs not far off to one side of the empty table.
Seeing Xu Ping and Gong Yang enter, those seated couldn’t help but glance their way.
Swept by the gazes of so many Foundation Establishment cultivators, the two remained unfazed and silently found a relatively secluded corner to sit down.
Although there were quite a few people in the hall, everyone remained silent, creating an extremely quiet atmosphere, which infused the air with an undercurrent of tension.
Yet Xu Ping was completely unaffected; instead, he transmitted a message to Gong Yang, "Fellow Daoist Gong, how does one obtain a token for this auction?"
"It’s not difficult. If the total value of the auctioned items exceeds five thousand Spirit Stones, the underground auction house will send you an auction token, with the time and place for the next auction inscribed on it," Gong Yang replied.
"Five thousand Spirit Stones, huh?" Xu Ping’s heart trembled.
This threshold was not low; for some ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivators, they’d have to grit their teeth to bring out such an amount.
But for him, it wasn’t much.
Time flowed slowly by.
People continued to enter the hall, most of whom were Foundation Establishment cultivators, and Xu Ping didn’t pay much attention to them, but then a few Fake Pill cultivators arrived, which made Xu Ping’s expression grow grave.
"Fellow Daoist Gong, do so many Fake Pill cultivators come to every small auction?" Xu Ping couldn’t help but inquire.
"No, usually only one or two at most," Gong Yang was also a bit bewildered at this point.
He had attended these underground auctions many times, yet it was the first time he encountered such a situation.
With the arrival of several Fake Pill cultivators, the atmosphere in the hall grew even more tense.
However, when a Golden Core cultivator entered the hall, the atmosphere solidified completely.
"This... a Golden Core cultivator!?"
Under the astonished gazes of countless Foundation Establishment cultivators in the hall, the Golden Core cultivator, whose face was indistinguishable, swaggered to the first row and sat down.
Xu Ping’s expression quickly turned grim, ’Even a Golden Core cultivator has come; it seems this auction is extraordinary!’
He couldn’t help but speculate about the identity of this Golden Core cultivator, as there were only a few Golden Core cultivators across the entire Yue Country, each a renowned figure.
But after racking his brains, he couldn’t come up with a fitting Golden Core cultivator, suggesting that the person must have used a secret technique to obscure their figure.
With his current cultivation, seeing through the disguise of a Golden Core cultivator was obviously a pipe dream.
’Should I still go on stage to seek a transaction after the auction?’ He couldn’t help but feel troubled as the Golden Core cultivator’s presence entirely disrupted his plans.
Although the probability of being targeted by a Golden Core cultivator was low, who could know what was in the heart of a Golden Core cultivator?
After some thought, he decided to wait and observe the unfolding situation.
At worst, he could wait for the next underground auction, held once every two years, and with his lifespan, he could afford to wait.
Everything should prioritize safety.
Creak!
Once everyone was present, the wooden door behind the table finally opened, and three people gradually walked out.
The attire of these three was identical to the two black-clothed guards at the stone gate.
However, what shocked Xu Ping was the cultivation of these three: one Golden Core cultivator and two Fake Pill cultivators.
Such a casual mobilization of one Golden Core cultivator and two Fake Pill cultivators could probably only be achieved by the Luoyun Sect throughout the entire Yue Country.
’Could the force behind this underground auction be the Luoyun Sect? If not, would the Luoyun Sect allow such a powerful force to run rampant in Yue Country?’
"It seems the waters in the entire Yue Country run deep indeed!"
As Xu Ping pondered secretly, the three lined up behind the long table, and the leading Golden Core cultivator spoke in a low, hoarse voice:
"Welcome, fellow cultivators from the cultivation realm, to this auction. This time, we have both old customers from before and newcomers attending for the first time. But this doesn’t matter, as this auction treats everyone equally!"
As soon as the leading Golden Core cultivator finished speaking, the Fake Pill cultivator on the left immediately continued:
"The rules for this transaction remain unchanged. We will call out a base price in Spirit Stones, and everyone can then compete with Spirit Stones.
If you don’t have enough Spirit Stones on you, you can use other items of equivalent value as collateral, whose specific value will be jointly assessed by the three of us! In short, the highest bidder wins the auctioned items."
This person’s voice was sharp and thin, extremely uncomfortable to hear.
"Finally, after the auctioned goods are all sold off, it will be time for everyone to trade freely.
If you have any items to exchange or sell, you can step forward to display and trade them freely; we won’t intervene at all, merely providing the venue.
With that said, let the auction begin!"
The Golden Core cultivator spoke again.
But as soon as he finished speaking, the three made way to the side, vacating the space behind the table, then respectively sat on those three sandalwood chairs.
Meanwhile, from behind the wooden door emerged a tall, slender man with the face of a fierce demon.
This man came to the back of the table, coughed a few times, and then began to speak:

chapters.title: Chapter 168 - 153: Geng Metal (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 168: Chapter 153: Geng Metal (Part 2)
"Today’s auction will be hosted by myself. First, we have a top-tier magical artifact, the Geng Metal Parent-Child Sword. This item..."
The first item in the auction being a top-tier magical artifact surprised Xu Ping a bit, but considering the deep resources of this underground auction, it made sense.
This particular magical artifact, vividly described by the eloquent tall and thin individual as unmatched in the heavens and rare on earth, made cultivators who needed top-tier magical artifacts exceedingly eager.
However, Xu Ping was not interested in this top-grade artifact.
Soon enough, this top-tier magical item was sold amidst the clamorous bidding of the cultivators, fetching a frighteningly high sum.
Once the first item was sold, the tall and thin man cleared his throat and said again:
"The second item, Second-stage Longevity Pills, of which there are three. Each pill can extend life by fifteen years. I remind you all, that only one pill of this type per stage can extend life, and the effects do not stack."
"Second-stage Longevity Pills?"
The young cultivators showed little interest, but the eyes of the middle-aged and elder cultivators lit up.
Even Xu Ping showed interest, appearing thoughtful.
He practiced the "Longevity Skill," which could increase lifespan, and had cultivated it to Minor Achievement, perhaps not inferior to certain top-tier divine skills.
Taking the Second-stage Longevity Pills might even further extend his life.
Although his lifespan already far exceeded that of ordinary Foundation Establishment Cultivators, who wouldn’t want a longer life?
"Starting bid is two thousand Spirit Stones, with each increment no less than fifty Spirit Stones."
"Two thousand one hundred Spirit Stones!"
Before the voice faded, a Foundation Establishment Cultivator quoted eagerly.
"Two thousand one hundred fifty Spirit Stones!"
"Two thousand two hundred Spirit Stones!"
But it was quickly drowned out by others’ bids.
"Two thousand three hundred Spirit Stones!"
Xu Ping joined the bidding.
Gong Yang gave Xu Ping a surprised look. As far as he knew, the other had just recently broken through to Foundation Establishment, so he should be quite young.
With those Spirit Stones, bidding on other items would be more cost-effective than the Second-stage Longevity Pills.
But after all, it was Xu Ping’s choice, so he said nothing.
The price of the Second-stage Longevity Pills continued to climb, until it broke four thousand Spirit Stones, and the number of bidders quickly dwindled, finally leaving only two.
"Four thousand one hundred Spirit Stones!" Xu Ping said in a deep voice.
"Four thousand two hundred Spirit Stones!" The other person raised the bid without hesitation.
"Four thousand four hundred Spirit Stones!" Xu Ping directly increased the bid by two hundred Spirit Stones, showing his determination.
The other hesitated for a moment and ultimately gave up the bidding.
With Xu Ping’s current wealth, even late-stage or Perfection cultivators couldn’t compete with him.
...
After the Second-stage Longevity Pills transaction, the auction continued.
Various exquisite items appeared one after another, the on-site atmosphere continuously rising, but the "Soul-Searching Technique" Xu Ping wanted never appeared, causing a tinge of disappointment in his heart.
As time passed, the auction reached its final stage.
The final items included a Talisman Treasure and a Magical Treasure Prototype, selling for astronomical prices.
Especially the Talisman Treasure!
Even Fake Pill Cultivators got involved.
Talisman Treasures seal a portion of a Magical Treasure’s power in a special Spirit Talisman.
Foundation Establishment cultivators can use a Talisman Treasure to suppress cultivators below the Fake Pill Stage.
Though Xu Ping envied it, competing with Fake Pill Cultivators for a Talisman Treasure was clearly unwise.
The Talisman Treasure was finally taken by a Fake Pill Cultivator.
...
"Esteemed guests, the moment has come for the grand finale of this auction—the final item, Geng Metal!"
The man’s low voice, like a bombshell, stirred great excitement in the auction hall.
"What!!"
"Geng Metal!!"
Exclamations of astonishment erupted, as numerous greedy, heated gazes were all directed at the glowing, golden ore escorted by the black-robed Golden Core cultivators.
Geng Metal is a renowned Third-stage Magical Treasure material.
Adding a bit of Geng Metal to a Golden Core Cultivator’s treasure can greatly enhance its power.
Due to Geng Metal’s special properties, it can even be incorporated into magical artifacts.
Even a slight inclusion in an ordinary magical artifact could enhance its power and potentially raise its tier!
If some is added to a top-grade magical artifact, it might even transform into a Magical Treasure Prototype.
Thus, Geng Metal is extremely precious and exceptionally rare!
Even Xu Ping couldn’t help but get excited. If he could add some to the Wood Sword Array’s magical swords, how powerful would it become?
It might even contend with Golden Core Cultivators!
But when his gaze swept over the Spiritually charged Fake Pill and Golden Core Cultivators, his excitement was instantly doused like a bucket of cold water.
He quickly realized those Fake Pill and Golden Core Cultivators were likely there for the Geng Metal.
With them present, who would dare snatch food from the tiger’s mouth?
"The value of Geng Metal needs no elaboration from me, but due to its preciousness, Spirit Stones won’t be the medium. Instead, it’s a bartering system."
"Interested cultivators can enter the room behind the wooden table privately and present the items they wish to trade to the auction’s cultivators for evaluation."
"Then, the auction will choose the attendee offering the highest-valued item to complete the transaction," the male cultivator announced loudly.
The cultivators present were not surprised by this, as exceptionally rare cultivation items often use this silent auction method.
Soon after his words, a figure cloaked in black stood up, moved swiftly, and slipped directly into the room.

chapters.title: Chapter 169 - 153: Geng Metal (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 169: Chapter 153: Geng Metal (Part 3)
The small room is concealed by a third-rank array, even the Divine Sense of Golden Core Cultivators can only be blocked outside.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, we’d better not get involved in this Geng Metal!"
Gong Yang advised through transmission, "Although it’s in the form of a secret auction, anyone confident enough to enter the small room must be immensely wealthy and will inevitably attract unwanted attention."
"Don’t worry, Fellow Daoist Gong. I cherish my life a lot and won’t act recklessly!" Xu Ping replied with a laugh through sound transmission.
Xu Ping also understood this reasoning; although he was tempted by the Geng Metal, he didn’t plan to enter the small room.
Moreover, according to the value of Geng Metal, the only item he had that might compare was that Demon Cultivator artifact.
"That’s good."
Hearing this, Gong Yang finally relaxed his tense heart.
Sword Cultivators are especially tempted by Geng Metal; he was worried Xu Ping might rashly enter the small room for a transaction.
In the end, not obtaining the Geng Metal but causing trouble for himself!
Amidst countless gazes in the auction hall, about two minutes later, the previous cultivator came out, then sat silently without saying a word.
Since his figure was hidden under a black robe, people couldn’t observe much from his face.
With the initial precedent, things naturally went smoothly thereafter, with a continuous stream of individuals entering the room.
Even Fake Pill and Golden Core Cultivators went in one after another.
Once nearly half the cultivators in the auction hall had entered the small room, the hall fell into silence.
"Anyone else wish to auction for the Geng Metal?" The man looked around the room, and after calling out three times without response.
"Since no one else wants to continue auctioning, we’ll ask those who’ve been in the small room to go in once more. The auction hosts will then inform you if you’ve succeeded." The man said solemnly in the spotlight of the entire venue.
Then more people went in and came out intermittently, but it was unclear whether any had succeeded.
Until a Golden Core Cultivator emerged from the small room, radiating a chilling anger.
"Did the Golden Core Cultivator not win the Geng Metal?" Everyone was suddenly taken aback.
"Who then won the Geng Metal?"
Numerous gazes swept over the cultivators who entered the small room.
As for Xu Ping and Gong Yang huddled in the corner, no one paid them any attention.
When the last person came out of the small room, the auction was considered completely over.
"Now it’s time for fellow Daoists to trade freely. If you feel there’s nothing worth exchanging, you can leave through the newly opened array passage."
Standing nearby, the black-robed Golden Core Cultivator spoke in a hoarse voice.
As soon as he finished speaking, several people left first through the array passage.
Including the Golden Core Cultivator.
Xu Ping speculated that the person was not intending to leave; likely finding a place to stop those who entered the room one by one.
He couldn’t help but feel relieved that he didn’t enter the small room, otherwise, he’d be targeted by the Golden Core Cultivator.
After seeing the Golden Core Cultivator and several Fake Pill Cultivators leave, Xu Ping couldn’t help but relax.
In that case, he could go on stage to seek a trade for the Soul-Searching Technique.
Apparently, others had the same idea; a Foundation Establishment Cultivator wearing a lion mask moved and suddenly appeared on the auction stage.
"I am seeking a Second-stage Upper Grade Terminal Flower, those who possess it can come trade with me!"
As soon as he finished, a cultivator in purple robes stood up, "I have one, may we talk in detail in the room?"
The hall has a dozen small rooms around it, all concealed by arrays, safe from prying eyes.
"No problem." The Foundation Establishment Cultivator wearing the lion mask nodded, and the two entered a room to trade.
Once the first one started, people continued going on stage to seek trade.
Some departed satisfied, others disappointed.
Once Xu Ping felt the timing was right, he decisively went on stage and loudly said, "I wish to purchase a Soul-Searching Technique!"
His voice echoed through the entire venue.
However, after a while, there was still no response, and just when he thought he was going to leave disappointed, a hoarse voice sounded.
"I have it. Is it possible to discuss detailed matters in a room?" A cultivator shrouded in a mass of black fog slowly stood up.
"Of course!" Xu Ping’s eyes flashed with delight; this underground auction was definitely worth attending.
After entering the room, Xu Ping got straight to the point, "I wonder, Fellow Daoist, what is the asking price for this Soul-Searching Technique?"
"Four thousand Spirit Stones, plus delivering a jade box to the Island Master of Celestial Desolate Island!"
The cultivator said in a hoarse voice, then turned his palm over, revealing a jade box covered in restrictions.
"A jade box?"

chapters.title: Chapter 170 - 154: The Object in the Jade Box?
chapters.content:
Chapter 170: Chapter 154: The Object in the Jade Box?
"A jade box? Deliver it to Celestial Desolate Island and hand it to the Island Master?" Xu Ping’s eyes instantly showed vigilance as he wondered to himself, is this person setting a trap for him?
But he didn’t enter the room to bid for Geng Metal, and he did make a purchase for a second-stage Longevity Pill, so he shouldn’t have been targeted!
"Yes, you just need to deliver it, don’t ask anything!" The cultivator continued in a hoarse voice, with a tone that carried a hint of undeniable firmness.
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping’s brows furrowed deeply, and he lowered his head in contemplation, continuously weighing the pros and cons in his mind.
Is this trip very dangerous?
It shouldn’t be very dangerous. With his Escape Technique and strength, even Fake Pill cultivators couldn’t catch up to him.
And Golden Core cultivators would leave him alone unless they were looking for trouble for no reason.
After thinking for a moment, Xu Ping had made up his mind.
The cultivator sitting opposite remained silent and did not urge him, quietly waiting.
After the time it takes to drink half a cup of tea, Xu Ping raised his head and slowly said, "Fellow Daoist, may I first see the Soul-Searching Technique!"
"Of course!" The cultivator was secretly pleased, but his tone remained hoarse and indifferent. "Here is a part of the Soul-Searching Technique recorded for you to verify its authenticity."
With that said, he flicked his finger, and a jade slip fell into Xu Ping’s hand.
Xu Ping held the jade slip in his hand, swept it with his Divine Sense, and the three characters "Soul-Searching Technique" suddenly appeared in his Sea of Consciousness.
He then began to carefully examine the ’Soul-Searching Technique’.
A quarter of an hour later.
Xu Ping’s Divine Sense withdrew from the jade slip, nodding his head: "This ’Soul-Searching Technique’ is indeed real!"
Although it was only a portion, he could confirm its authenticity.
"Since my things are genuine, would Fellow Daoist be willing to deliver this jade box to Celestial Desolate Island and hand it over to the Island Master?" the cultivator immediately inquired.
After a moment of silence, Xu Ping slowly opened his mouth and said, "I can!"
"In that case, Fellow Daoist should make an oath!" Though the cultivator was extremely excited inside, his tone was still calm.
"An oath?" Xu Ping furrowed his brow deeply, immediately refusing, "If I have to make an oath, then I will not deliver it, and this transaction can be called off."
He immediately stood up, ready to leave.
If it meant restricting him, he would rather give up this transaction and search slowly in the future.
"Please wait, Fellow Daoist!" the cultivator suddenly called out to Xu Ping, with a hint of urgency in his voice, "Since Fellow Daoist is unwilling to make an oath, I will not force you."
"Could we change the transaction method? You deliver the jade box to Celestial Desolate Island and have its Island Master give you the Soul-Searching Technique, as he also knows this kind of technique."
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping gave the other a long look, but unfortunately, the figure and face were shrouded in black mist, only revealing a vague silhouette.
After pondering for a moment, Xu Ping nodded, "This method, I accept."
Since the other party values the jade box so much, they must not be deceiving him.
"Good! Then I hope Fellow Daoist delivers as soon as possible!" The cultivator cupped his hands, shoved the jade box to Xu Ping, and without further delay, turned and left the room, then passed through the array passage, leaving the auction venue.
Seeing the other completely disappear from sight, Xu Ping turned his gaze back, then lowered his gaze to the jade box in his hand.
After carefully investigating the restriction on it, he couldn’t help but be secretly startled.
The restriction on it was inscrutable to him despite his array knowledge.
"Could it be a third-stage restriction?"
"What kind of treasure is contained inside to be concealed by a third-stage restriction?"
"Surely it can’t be Geng Metal... right?"
Xu Ping was startled by his sudden thought and quickly shook his head, "It shouldn’t be, it shouldn’t be...he wouldn’t be that bold...would he?"
This is priceless Geng Metal, after all!
Would he give it to a stranger just like that?
Does he have such courage?
Xu Ping carefully recalled, noticing the other seemed to have entered a small room.
"Deception!?" His face quickly darkened.
If this jade box indeed contained Geng Metal, even he had to admire the other’s nerve.
Xu Ping’s expression was uncertain, but he eventually regained calm, "It’s all just my speculation. I can’t be sure what is truly inside this jade box!"
"For now, it’s crucial to safely take this jade box out."
Xu Ping flipped his palm, and the jade box in his hand suddenly disappeared.
The probability of him safely taking this jade box out was still quite high, as Golden Core cultivators are searching worldwide for those who entered the small room and have no time to deal with him.
Fake Pill cultivators would surely behave the same way.
As for other Foundation Establishment cultivators causing him trouble, it was quite unlikely.
Otherwise, he would’ve tossed the jade box away long ago.
Moreover, with his current knowledge in arrays, although he couldn’t break the restriction in a short time, concealing it for a period was feasible.
This way, he could have control and not fear being tracked.
...
After securing the jade box, Xu Ping walked out of the room.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, was the transaction successful?" Gong Yang stepped forward and inquired.
"It was successful." Xu Ping nodded.
"Good to hear it’s successful. Let’s go then." Gong Yang smiled, he came to the underground auction not to buy anything but mainly to accompany Xu Ping.
"Alright." Xu Ping nodded in response.
Then the two walked through the array passage and arrived outside.
...
Golden sunlight spilled onto the ground, sparkling with specks of light; a gentle breeze blew, bringing a hint of coolness.
With a move of his Divine Sense, Gong Yang summoned a flying boat shimmering with spiritual light into the air.
"Let’s go!"
Gong Yang beckoned with a word, his figure flashing onto the flying boat, followed closely by Xu Ping.

chapters.title: Chapter 171 - 154: The Item Within the Jade Box? (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 171: Chapter 154: The Item Within the Jade Box? (2)
He determined the direction, then quickly set up the Flying Boat and flew off into the distance.
However, just as the Flying Boat departed the desolate island, an overwhelming Divine Sense swept over Xu Ping and Gong Yang.
In an instant, a chill surged from the soles of their feet to the back of their heads, raising goosebumps all over their bodies.
Under the scrutiny of this Divine Sense, they felt that their disguises were utterly useless, as if they were stark naked in front of it.
"Gol...Golden Core Cultivator!" Gong Yang’s face involuntarily showed a trace of terror.
Xu Ping couldn’t help but feel a thread of tension in his heart, fearing that the Golden Core Cultivator might detect something unusual.
Fortunately, the Divine Sense only swept past them without lingering on either of them.
On the Flying Boat, Xu Ping and Gong Yang both breathed a sigh of relief at once.
Xu Ping was fearful of the Golden Core Cultivator detecting anomalies, while Gong Yang was afraid the Golden Core Cultivator, failing to find the Geng Metal, might vent their anger on the two.
"Quick, let’s go, let’s go!"
Gong Yang poured all his mana into the Flying Boat, hastily maneuvering it to flee.
Whoosh!
The Flying Boat transformed into a ray of spiritual light, disappearing into the horizon at incredible speed.
After flying for a full day and night, reaching a safe distance, they completely relaxed.
At such a far distance, even a Golden Core Cultivator would undoubtedly find it near impossible to track them again.
"That auction really was dangerous!"
Gong Yang wiped the cold sweat off his forehead, still with lingering fear, "If unnecessary, one should attend these underground auctions sparingly."
Though he had attended several auctions before, it was his first time encountering such peril; if the Golden Core Cultivator vented their anger on them, it would truly be an unexpected calamity.
"Indeed." Xu Ping nodded in agreement.
The items auctioned in these underground auctions, though of better quality than those in ordinary auctions, posed a higher danger level.
Fake Pills and Golden Core Cultivators, rare on usual days, were more than one at the underground auction, and with his current strength, self-preservation might be somewhat borderline.
"Does Fellow Daoist Xu have any further plans, or will you return to Purple Bamboo Mountain with me?" Gong Yang asked, slowing the speed of the Flying Boat.
"I have some matters to attend to, so I won’t be traveling with you." Xu Ping shook his head in refusal; he still needed to deliver the jade box to Celestial Desolate Island, and he would certainly go alone.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Gong, for accompanying me to this underground auction; I shall invite you for a drink once I return." Xu Ping cupped his fists in thanks, smiling.
"Certainly, I’ve long been eagerly awaiting Fellow Daoist Xu’s Spirit Wine!" Gong Yang displayed a brilliant smile on his face.
His purpose in accompanying Xu Ping to the underground auction was to draw their relationship closer; it seemed like the relationship had progressed rather well.
After saying farewell to Gong Yang, Xu Ping set up his Escape Light and disappeared into the horizon.
Gong Yang casually maneuvered the Spiritual Boat towards Purple Bamboo Mountain.
...
...
A month later.
Wanzhe Waters, Celestial Desolate Island.
"Miscalculated, I didn’t expect an Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator to have the ability to conceal the induction of a third-tier Restriction; could someone have helped him, an Array Master?"
He had intended to track down the opponent once he safely left the underground auction, but unexpectedly, they had been concealed.
Thinking about the hefty price he had paid, fearing that it might all be in vain, his face grew increasingly darker, filled with regret; he pondered he should have chosen someone else.
At this moment.
Knock! Knock! Knock!
"Island Master!"
Eager knocking sounded from outside the door.
"Enter!"
The elderly man swept his Divine Sense to identify the visitor, swung his sleeve, and the door opened automatically.
At this moment, a pot-bellied middle-aged man hurriedly stepped inside, respectfully taking out a wooden box engraved with a Divine Sense imprint from his storage bag, and handed it to the elderly man:
"Island Master, a Foundation Establishment senior asked me to deliver this wooden box to you."
"Wooden box?"
"Did he say anything?" the elder’s face moved slightly as he spread out his hand, causing the wooden box to float slowly into his grasp.
"The Foundation Establishment senior only mentioned one thing, an underground auction!" the pot-bellied middle-aged man replied respectfully.
"Underground auction!?"
Rumble!
The elderly man widened his eyes, aura erupting instantly, as a formidable spiritual pressure swept through the entire room.
"Isla...Island Master!" the middle-aged man said tremulously, his face pale and legs quivering under the elder’s spiritual pressure.
The elderly man realized he was somewhat losing composure, promptly suppressed his excitement, restrained his aura, and hurriedly asked, "Did he say anything else?"
"No...nothing else, the Foundation Establishment senior only mentioned those words." The middle-aged man stuttered slightly even as he spoke.
"Understood, you may leave now." The elder spoke with a composed face.
"Yes, Island Master!" The middle-aged man courteously bowed and quickly exited the room, closing the door behind him.
"Unexpectedly, there’s still room for a turnaround in this matter!" the elder murmured to himself, a hint of excitement flashing through his eyes.
His Divine Sense moved, easily erasing the Divine Sense imprint on the wooden box, which then opened automatically, revealing a verdant Spirit Talisman inside.
"This is... the Yin-Yang Induction Talisman?" The elder recognized the Spirit Talisman in the jade box at once.
"Do you want me to come find you? Then I’ll grant your wish."
....
On an unnamed desolate island.
The moment the elderly man erased the Divine Sense imprint from the jade box, Xu Ping, previously sitting cross-legged with closed eyes on a branch, suddenly opened his eyes, a gleam flashing through them.
"The Divine Sense imprint has been erased; Old Celestial Desolate should be arriving soon!" he muttered to himself.
Xu Ping had arrived near Celestial Desolate Island a few days earlier but hadn’t acted rashly; instead, he began investigating information about the Island Master of Celestial Desolate Island.
He learned from others that the owner of Celestial Desolate Island was known as Old Celestial Desolate, a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, with quite the reputation in the entire Wanzhe Waters.
However, in Xu Ping’s view, a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator was of no significant concern.
Especially after his Primordial Sword Skill breakthrough, a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment was no match for him at all.
Yet, to be on the safe side, Xu Ping opted to arrange a meeting, which undoubtedly offered more security.
...
Another half-hour passed.
"He’s here!"
Xu Ping sensed something, looking up sharply to see an Escape Light rapidly approaching the desolate island.
He leaped down from the branch, arriving at a flat area.
A moment later.
The Escape Light landed not far from Xu Ping, and as the spiritual light dispersed, an elder with youthful features revealed his form.
"Are you Old Celestial Desolate?" Xu Ping inquired, cupping his hands.
"Indeed, I’m Old Celestial Desolate. My friend tasked you to bring something to me, is it with you?" Old Celestial Desolate replied with a salute, then asked eagerly.
"Do you have the item I seek?" Xu Ping didn’t answer directly but instead asked with an expressionless face.
"I have it here!" Old Celestial Desolate flicked his fingers, sending a jade slip skimming through the air, precisely landing in Xu Ping’s hand.
Xu Ping grasped the jade slip, swept it with his Divine Sense, and a complete ’Soul-Searching Technique’ appeared in his mind.
"The ’Soul-Searching Technique’ is genuine!" Xu Ping nodded in confirmation.
"Then the item I’m looking for, is it with you?" Old Celestial Desolate’s voice carried a hint of urgency.
Xu Ping didn’t speak but flipped his right hand, revealing a dull gray jade box in his palm, followed by a tap with his left index finger.
Crack! Crack!
With a series of crisp breaking sounds, a jade box brimming with spiritual light and covered with Restrictions appeared.
"Yes, this jade box is mine, give it to me!" Old Celestial Desolate, unable to control his excitement and wearing a ferocious expression, demanded as the jade box appeared intact.
Seeing Old Celestial Desolate’s excitement, Xu Ping furrowed his brow but nonetheless returned the jade box to him.
Old Celestial Desolate meticulously inspected the jade box upon retrieval and found that the Restrictions were intact, with no signs of being opened, he exhaled a breath of relief.
Likely, if the jade box had been opened and its contents discovered by the opponent, they wouldn’t have bothered coming back to return it to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 173 - 155: Sword Slays the Elder of Desolation, Acquiring Geng Metal_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 173: Chapter 155: Sword Slays the Elder of Desolation, Acquiring Geng Metal_2
In due time, the opponent might truly comprehend Sword Light Like a Rainbow.
"Die!"
Celestial Desolate Elder’s Magic Technique changed, and the gray small sword talisman treasure, carrying terrifying power, slashed at Xu Ping.
With his Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivation controlling the talisman treasure, this attack power has completely surpassed the Foundation Establishment Realm.
"Go!"
Xu Ping directly summoned a purple bracelet, which then expanded with the wind to nearly the size of a house, protecting him completely inside.
Bam!
With one sword strike, the purple bracelet instantly turned to ashes.
Xu Ping’s expression was exceedingly serious, and using this little time, he directly activated the Spirit Summoning Skill and Heavenly Devil Solution.
As his face turned red, within him, some consumed Mana deep within the pool gathered strands of blood and essence, forming drop by drop of liquid mana,
Boom!
At this moment, his aura completely broke through Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment, entering Late-Stage Foundation Establishment.
"Slash!"
At this point, he infused all the skyrocketing mana into the Purple Sun Sword in his hand, and then slashed out with it.
Boom!
As if the Thunder God descended to the world, a dazzling, majestic sword light burst forth from the sword tip, carrying the momentum to cut through heaven and earth, slicing at the gray small sword talisman treasure.
Bang!
The sword light and gray small sword talisman treasure collided fiercely, accompanied by a huge rumbling sound.
The sword light shattered into pieces, while the gray small sword talisman treasure regressed into a gray talisman, which then scattered, turning into ashes!
"What kind of secret technique is this!" Seeing this scene, Celestial Desolate Elder was shocked and cried out, directly forming seals with both hands, his face turned red, and escaped as a blood light!
Even his strongest talisman treasure had been destroyed by the opponent, if he didn’t leave now, he feared his life would be in jeopardy!
"Demonic escape technique?"
Xu Ping likewise formed seals with both hands, instantly activating the Perfection Level Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill.
Swoosh!
The next moment, he transformed into a long rainbow of spirit light, pursuing at a speed far surpassing the opponent.
In the blink of an eye, the two were over a hundred miles away.
"What kind of monster are you?"
Celestial Desolate Elder glanced back with Divine Sense to see Xu Ping closing in, his face showing fear.
Swordsmanship, secret technique, escape technique, all so strong; could the opponent actually be a Fake Pill Cultivator pretending?
"Ah... This is your doing!"
Celestial Desolate Elder transmitted with Divine Sense, his expression malicious.
In the next instant, he suddenly stopped the Escape Light, each of his ten fingers pinching a thunder bead, fiercely flung them backward: "Today I will perish with you!"
Xu Ping’s expression remained unchanged, the Purple Sun Sword flew out, flipping two real thunder beads.
Boom! Boom!
Terrifying explosions occurred in the surroundings, but the remaining thunder beads only exploded into flying ash and scattered upon hitting the Heaven Gold Ring’s surface—they were all fake!
Under his strong Divine Sense, the opponent’s little tricks were utterly ineffective, instead exposing their own weakness.
Xu Ping no longer planned to delay, the longer Heavenly Devil Solution was used, the greater the consumption of essence.
"Slash!"
He suddenly accelerated, closing in on Celestial Desolate Elder, striking a sword directly from above.
The majestic sword light turned into a stream of cyan-gold, slashing towards Celestial Desolate Elder.
Celestial Desolate Elder helplessly threw out a small black shield, yet it was ruthlessly shattered by the sword light.
The next instant.
Another sword light came attacking.
Crack!
Accompanied by a teeth-grating cracking sound, Celestial Desolate Elder’s protective spirit cover shattered in an instant.
Then, Xu Ping wielded the Purple Sun Sword, stabbing forward, piercing into Celestial Desolate Elder’s Dantian Sea of Qi...
"Ah!"
Celestial Desolate Elder just emitted a scream and was pinned down by Xu Ping, mana surging, as layers of restriction appeared on his body.
After finishing all this.
Xu Ping immediately stopped the Heavenly Devil Solution and Spirit Summoning Skill.
"Phew!"
"The first time using Heavenly Devil Solution for this long, the side effects are truly substantial."
Xu Ping gently breathed out a turbid breath, his aura rapidly declining, and his complexion became exceedingly pale.
If delayed further, excessive essence consumption would damage the Primordial Qi.
"Time to leave!"
Xu Ping carried Celestial Desolate Elder and whisked away into the sky with Escape Light.
The commotion from the duel just now was significant. Given his current state, it would be troublesome if it attracts others.
...
Ten days later.
Nighttime.
Inside a temporarily carved-out cave mansion.
The Luminous Pearls embedded in the walls radiate brilliant light.
Xu Ping suddenly opens his eyes, with a sharp gleam passing through his pupils, "Phew, my vitality is finally restored!"
Although this battle wasn’t extremely dangerous, it was quite exhausting.
A cultivator at the Foundation Establishment Perfection holding a treasure talisman could still cause him considerable trouble.
Xu Ping’s gaze shifts to the unconscious Celestial Desolate Elder in the cave mansion.
The reason he spared the other person’s life was mainly to figure out what exactly was inside that Jade Box and how to open it.
Without hesitation, he directly injected a wisp of Mana into the Celestial Desolate Elder on the ground.
The Celestial Desolate Elder moaned and awoke from unconsciousness. He felt his broken dantian and his face instantly turned ashen, "Just kill me!"
With his dantian broken, he is now just an ordinary person.
"Tell me, is the Geng Metal inside this Jade Box?" Xu Ping asked calmly.
The Celestial Desolate Elder kept his eyes tightly shut, saying nothing.
"I know you seek death wholeheartedly, but with the Soul-Searching Technique at hand, once I master it, I can personally take action. Given your current state, achieving death is exceptionally difficult." Xu Ping threatened coldly.
Upon hearing this, the Celestial Desolate Elder couldn’t help but tremble all over. He forced open his heavy eyelids and hoarsely said, "The box contains Geng Metal."
"It’s really Geng Metal!!"
Xu Ping could hardly suppress his wild joy in his heart; it’s a treasure even coveted by Golden Core cultivators, and he was extremely envious.
Did he really just obtain it?
If he could forge it into the Sword Array, the power of the Sword Array would be significantly enhanced.
By that time, even if he hasn’t comprehended sword light as a rainbow, slashing a Fake Pill might not just be a dream!
Slashing a Fake Pill!!
Is that something a Foundation Establishment can imagine?
"How do I open the restriction on this?" Xu Ping took a deep breath, suppressing his inner excitement, and asked.
The Celestial Desolate Elder remained silent for a moment and then weakly replied, "In my Storage Ring, there’s a control token; you can control the restriction on the Jade Box with it,"
"Control token?"
"Is it this one?" Xu Ping carefully searched within the Celestial Desolate Elder’s Storage Ring with his Divine Sense, and unexpectedly pulled out a token made of metal.
"Yes." The Celestial Desolate Elder nodded with difficulty, "Once you refine it, you’ll be able to control the restriction on the Jade Box."
"Refine?"
Xu Ping held the token in his hand, channeling Mana, he removed the Divine Sense imprint on it and began refining it.
Half an hour later.
As the token emitted bursts of spiritual light, mysteriously, a connection was formed between Xu Ping and it, and a surge of information flowed directly into his mind.
Xu Ping pondered slightly, then turned his palm, and the Jade Box covered with restrictions appeared.
The Celestial Desolate Elder’s cloudy eyes flashed with a glimmer, but it quickly dissipated, and then he tightly closed his eyes.
Who could imagine a Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator having such strength?
He was defeated without injustice!
"Open!"
Xu Ping held the token, channeling Mana, and uttered lightly.
Instantly, the restriction on the Jade Box erupted with intense light, and finally, all converged.
Click!
