```
The Jade Box popped open with a bang, and inside lay a large piece of pale golden stone.
"Is this the renowned Geng Metal?"
Xu Ping curiously held it in his hand, observing it carefully.
It felt somewhat cold to the touch, similar to ordinary stones, the only remarkable thing being it could block his Divine Sense.
After playing with it for a while, Xu Ping then placed it back into the Jade Box, carefully storing it in the Storage Ring.
After securing the Geng Metal, his gaze fell on the Celestial Desolate Elder, who was waiting to die with closed eyes.
"Farewell, fellow Daoist!"
Xu Ping flicked a finger, and a ray of spiritual light pierced directly through his forehead, leaving a blood hole penetrating from front to back.
The Celestial Desolate Elder let out a muffled sound, and with a thud, fell to the ground dead.
Having removed the restriction on the Jade Box and obtained the Geng Metal, the Celestial Desolate Elder held no further value to Xu Ping.
Considering the other party generously gave him a piece of Geng Metal, he was still willing to give him release.
Xu Ping operated his Mana to extract some blood from his corpse, then injected it into the Thousand Illusion Mask to begin refining.
Spirit Stones and Spirit Medicine on the Celestial Desolate Island should not be wasted; they are also a significant source of income.

chapters.title: Chapter 174 - 156: The Surprise of the Tier 2 Longevity Pill
chapters.content:
Chapter 174: Chapter 156: The Surprise of the Tier 2 Longevity Pill
Three days later.
Xū Píng, disguised as the Celestial Desolate Elder, flew away from Celestial Desolate Island.
At the thought of the nine storage bags full of Spirit Stones and Spirit Medicines, he couldn’t help but smile.
This time, the harvest was truly abundant.
Just the Spirit Stones and Spirit Medicines alone were worth twenty to thirty thousand Spirit Stones, not to mention the priceless Geng Metal.
"Now everything is ready, just need to master ’Soul-Searching Technique’ to obtain the cultivation methods and secret techniques for planting Spirit Wood from the cultivators of the Song family."
With this in mind, Xū Píng increased the speed of his Escape Light by a few degrees.
This time, the battle of skills with the Celestial Desolate Elder also made him realize the gap between himself and a Fake Pill cultivator.
A cultivator at Foundation Establishment Perfection, wielding a talisman treasure with only one or two levels of a magical artifact’s power, could cause him considerable trouble.
If a Fake Pill cultivator wielded a magical artifact, he would absolutely not be an opponent.
Right now, he was still somewhat weak.
But once his Sword Array was achieved, everything would be completely different.
By then, he would at least have a shred of self-preservation capability in the entire Yue Country.
...
...
Half a month later.
Xū Píng returned to Thousand Leaves Mountain, covered in dust and dirt.
He took out the Token, opened the restriction of his cave dwelling, went into the bedroom, and used Mana to coalesce a ball of water, cleansing himself from head to toe, then took off his robe and fell into a deep sleep on the bed.
During this time, he had basically been on the road, and he also had an exhilarating battle of skills, which even left his body and Divine Sense feeling exhausted.
He slept for a full six hours until the early hours of the second day when he woke up refreshed.
Walking out of the cave dwelling.
The summit of Thousand Leaves Mountain was surrounded by gold, which was the Spirit Grain that was about to mature.
Outside the Spirit Grain, young seedlings of Spirit Wood encircled the outer perimeter of the mountaintop, seemingly guarding this mysterious land.
In the center of the Spirit Field, various Spirit Flowers and exotic grasses competed in beauty, forming a vivid picture.
Upon seeing this, Xū Píng couldn’t help but smile.
Nothing is more joyous than watching the Spirit Grain and Spirit Medicines he planted mature step by step.
But the long absence of Spirit Rain had left the Spirit Grain and Spirit Medicines somewhat listless.
"Perhaps I should hire someone to take care of it?" Xū Píng pondered as he used the Spirit Rain Skill to water the Spirit Field.
Sometimes he would be away for several months, and it’s definitely not feasible to leave the Spirit Grain and Spirit Medicines uncared for over a long period.
"But whom should I hire?"
He had many secrets that certainly could not be exposed to others.
"Perhaps I should buy one or two Demon Beasts capable of taking care of Spirit Plants and Spirit Medicines?" This thought emerged in Xū Píng’s mind.
To his knowledge, many Foundation Establishment forces used Spirit Beasts to tend to Spirit Medicines and Spirit Grain.
"Surely, the Zhou Leqi family has such Spirit Beasts, next time when I go to buy a Spirit Beast capable of spitting Demon Fire, I’ll buy a few at the same time."
He certainly couldn’t go anytime soon, so he needed to master the Soul-Searching Technique as soon as possible and then obtain the cultivation methods and secret techniques to avoid any unforeseen changes.
After watering the Spirit Field, Xū Píng returned to his cave dwelling.
Cultivation room.
Xū Píng took out the Second-stage Longevity Pill he had purchased at an underground auction from his storage bag.
Previously, he had always been away and didn’t have the time to easily take the Longevity Pill for a test.
Now, having finally returned home and ensuring the environment around him was safe.
Xū Píng gazed at the palm-sized dark green pill, which emitted a strange scent.
It was hard to imagine that this was the exceptionally precious Longevity Pill in the Cultivation Realm.
Xū Píng sat cross-legged, took the Second-stage Longevity Pill, and closed his eyes to meditate.
As soon as the Second-stage Longevity Pill entered his stomach, the mana of Longevity surged forth, engulfing the pill immediately.
In the next moment.
Xū Píng’s heartbeat accelerated, the Second-stage Longevity Pill, under the refining of Longevity Mana, transformed into a continuous stream of Essence, replenishing his own.
In merely a few breaths, the vitality within him surged dramatically, as if he were a towering, vibrant ancient tree.
After repeating this cycle ten times, the efficacy of the Longevity Pill faded.
Xū Píng opened his eyes, feeling the intense vitality emanating from himself, shocked.
"Isn’t the effect of this Second-stage Longevity Pill a bit too good?"
He felt that his life span had increased by far more than just fifteen years.
Eagerly, he opened his panel.
[Name: Xū Píng]
[Lifespan: 43/348 years]
[Realm: Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment: 12/100; Blood Demon Body Refining Second Layer: 85/100]
[Cultivation Technique: Longevity Skill Minor Achievement: 157/800]
...
"Extended by thirty years?"
The original life span of 318 years had become 348 years.
More than double the expected fifteen-year increase.
This surprised Xū Píng immensely; after contemplating for a long while, he could only surmise that the Longevity Skill at Minor Achievement level maximized the benefits absorbed from the Longevity Pill.
"This Second-stage Longevity Pill was definitely worth the price!"
Xū Píng couldn’t help but smile; extending life by thirty years at once, perhaps only a Third-stage Longevity Pill could achieve that.
As he admired the panel for a while, just as he was about to close it, he noticed something unusual on the panel.
"Wait, why has the proficiency of the Longevity Skill increased so much?" Xū Píng’s pupils shrank, and he looked shocked.
He clearly remembered that the proficiency of the Longevity Skill should have been "127/800," but now it had become "157/800," an increase of thirty points.
Thirty points!
This is almost equivalent to his proficiency from half a year of arduous cultivation.
"Could this also be the effect of the Second-stage Longevity Pill?" Xū Píng was overjoyed.
Given his current cultivation, it was unlikely that he had remembered wrongly, so it could only be the effect of the Second-stage Longevity Pill.
"Unexpected joy, double the surprise!!" Xū Píng’s face bore a look of ecstasy.
He merely intended to test the effect of the Longevity Pill, not expecting to be struck by such a tremendous surprise.
Although it didn’t directly increase his cultivation, the increase in the proficiency of the Longevity Skill would undoubtedly enable him to break through to the next level faster.

chapters.title: Chapter 175 - 156: The Surprise of the Tier 2 Longevity Pill (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 175: Chapter 156: The Surprise of the Tier 2 Longevity Pill (Part 2)
It greatly enhanced his cultivation speed and the purity of the Longevity Mana.
Xu Ping speculated that ordinary Longevity Skills definitely wouldn’t have such effects; otherwise, it would have been discovered long ago.
It must be the Minor Achievement level of Longevity Skill that possesses such additional abilities.
Xu Ping carefully sensed the changes in the Mana within his body.
Soon, he discovered that although the Longevity Skill hadn’t broken through, the strength of the Longevity Mana in his Dantian, namely its purity, had slightly increased.
"This Second-stage Longevity Pill is truly surprising!" Xu Ping’s smile could no longer be suppressed.
Given the special condition of the Longevity Skill, he suspected that if he took a second or third Second-stage Longevity Pill, it might still have effects.
There’s a considerable possibility, but it’s unlikely to be as effective as the first one.
"It’s just that Second-stage Longevity Pills are truly rare!" Xu Ping shook his head helplessly.
Despite attending so many auctions, only the underground auction yielded three pills, highlighting the preciousness and rarity of Second-stage Longevity Pills.
"Looks like I’ll need to attend underground auctions frequently and keep an eye on longevity-related precious resources, besides the Longevity Pill." Xu Ping thought to himself.
Taking one Second-stage Longevity Pill yields such exaggerated effects.
If he could consume higher-stage longevity items in the future, stacking them, the effects would surely be more anticipated.
"But for now, staying home with the ’Soul-Searching Technique’ is the top priority." Xu Ping took a deep breath, suppressing his inner excitement.
Once he planted the Spirit Wood, he would free up his hands to manage other matters.
Xu Ping flipped his palm, and a jade slip suddenly appeared in his hand.
Then, his Divine Sense penetrated into it, starting to study keenly.
...
...
Time passed as he researched and practiced the ’Soul-Searching Technique.’
A month later.
In the cultivation room.
Xu Ping appeared exhausted but his eyes sparkled with a hint of brilliance.
"Soul-Searching Technique!"
He uttered softly, conjuring a magic technique with both hands, and a cold gleam radiated from his eyes, followed by the spreading of his Divine Sense.
Despite having no target in front, his Divine Sense quickly retracted but he had undoubtedly successfully cast the Soul-Searching Technique once.
He eagerly tapped open the panel.
[Soul-Searching Technique Entry Level: 1/100]
"Soul-Searching Technique... finally entry-level!"
Seeing the clear display on the panel, Xu Ping’s lips curved into a smile, feeling joyous.
The entry to this skill is still very challenging; an ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivator would find it impossible to achieve entry-level without unique talents, not to mention with a few months or even half a year’s time.
Fortunately, his Divine Sense was mighty, and he had experience with practicing secret techniques like ’Shocking God Needle.’
After spending a month, he finally managed to attain the entry level.
"However, with just the entry-level Soul-Searching Technique, it’s still very difficult to Soul Search a Foundation Establishment cultivator." Xu Ping furrowed his brows slightly.
A mishap could easily result in the loss of the opponent’s Divine Soul and memory.
If it happened to result in missing the memory about planting Spirit Wood, it would be a significant loss.
"To ensure no issues, at least practicing the Soul-Searching Technique to the proficient level is necessary." Xu Ping thought to himself.
With a proficient level Soul-Searching Technique coupled with his powerful Divine Sense, unless he was Soul Searching a cultivator with Divine Sense superior to his own, he could ensure extracting all memories completely.
He had already spent so much time, a bit more won’t hurt.
Besides, with the panel’s assistance, advancing the Soul-Searching Technique to a proficient level wouldn’t take long.
...
...
Two days later.
Xu Ping carried two jars of the new Hundred Flowers Brew, heading to Little Spark Mountain to visit Gong Yang.
"Elder Xu, my master is refining magical artifacts in the secret chamber; would you like to observe?" a beautiful female Qi Cultivation cultivator respectfully asked.
"Observe?"
Xu Ping mused, although he has panel assistance, his current artifact refining ability certainly couldn’t match Gong Yang’s.
"This wouldn’t disturb Fellow Daoist Gong, would it?" Xu Ping hesitated.
"Not at all, my master specifically instructed that Elder Xu is welcome to do so at any time," the female Qi Cultivation cultivator smiled.
"Alright, please lead the way," Xu Ping nodded, keen to learn from Gong Yang.
"Elder Xu, follow me," the female Qi Cultivation cultivator smiled slightly and led Xu Ping through a long corridor to a stone house.
Even before entering, Xu Ping could feel waves of heat.
"My master is inside; I shall leave for now," the female Qi Cultivation cultivator said with a bow before departing.
Xu Ping stepped into the stone house, instantly engulfed by scorching heat, but with his current physique, such heat was negligible.
His gaze settled on a half-zhang tall demon beast with feathers as red as fire, resembling a First Rank Upper Grade crow, spewing intense flames.
The flames, enhanced by the array, burned even fiercer and hotter.
"This must be Fellow Daoist Gong’s Fire Crow; it’s indeed quite useful."
"However, if it were trained into a Second-stage Demon Beast, it would be even more useful. Perhaps once I buy a demon beast, I could try this approach," Xu Ping thought to himself.
Although buying a Second-stage Demon Beast is exceptionally difficult, training one is not a challenge for him.
Being an Alchemist, coupled with leftover Demon Cores from previous hunts, unless he was exceptionally unlucky, cultivating one or two Second-stage Demon Beasts wouldn’t be a problem.
By then, one could help him with Spirit Medicine and Spirit Plant care, and the other could assist in artifact refining; during battles, both demon beasts could aid significantly.
Isn’t that splendid!
As Xu Ping contemplated silently, Gong Yang’s forging process reached its final critical moment.
Buzz!
Accompanied by surging flames, a black shield-like magical artifact abruptly formed in the fire.

chapters.title: Chapter 176 - 156: The Surprise of the Tier 2 Longevity Pill (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 176: Chapter 156: The Surprise of the Tier 2 Longevity Pill (Part 3)
"Upper Grade Defensive Magical Artifact!"
Xu Ping, with his current forging technique, could recognize it at a glance.
However, it was still somewhat challenging for him to forge it at the moment.
At this moment, Gong Yang’s serious expression also relaxed, and he immediately ordered, "Stop!"
The Fire Crow immediately stopped spewing fire, a look of flattery appearing on its face.
"All you ever want are rewards!" Gong Yang chuckled, flicked his finger, and a black Pill instantly entered the Fire Crow’s mouth.
The Fire Crow quickly swallowed it and affectionately rubbed its head against Gong Yang’s hand.
"Thank you for waiting, Fellow Daoist Xu!" Gong Yang dismissed it and cupped his hands toward Xu Ping.
"Fellow Daoist Gong’s forging skills truly opened my eyes!" Xu Ping said with a smile.
"Hahaha, not too bad, let’s chat in the courtyard, fellow Daoist."
Beaming, Gong Yang used a Cleansing Technique to remove the dust from himself, then led Xu Ping to the courtyard.
As the two sat on the stone bench, Xu Ping took out the Hundred Flowers Brew and the wine cups and said with a smile, "I promised to find you for a drink once I returned, Fellow Daoist Gong."
He then poured each of them a cup of the Hundred Flowers Brew.
"Hahaha, I’ve been coveting Fellow Daoist Xu’s Spirit Wine for a long time!" Gong Yang’s eyes lit up.
The two chatted while drinking, and as the two jugs were about to be finished, Duan Shuang arrived.
"It seems I’m late, the Spirit Wine is all gone!" she said with a radiant smile.
"Next time, Fellow Daoist Duan, remember to come earlier," Xu Ping teased.
With a fragrant breeze, Duan Shuang gracefully sat beside Xu Ping, her beautiful eyes turning, she smiled and said, "In that case, I’ll have to guard Fellow Daoist Xu every day."
The three exchanged a few more pleasantries.
Duan Shuang got to the point, "I’ve come to ask if you two would like to follow me to explore a cultivator’s relic?"
"Based on my initial investigation, it’s at least a Golden Core Cultivator’s relic, with great value."
"A Golden Core Cultivator’s relic?" The two’s expressions couldn’t help but change.
Fellow Daoist Duan usually enjoys exploring various secret realms and relics, has she actually made a big find this time?
"I won’t be going, I’m quite occupied lately." Xu Ping directly shook his head and declined.
A Golden Core Cultivator’s relic carries risks and opportunities, naturally worth a gamble for others, but for Xu Ping, there’s no need.
Seeing Xu Ping’s straightforward refusal, a hint of disappointment flashed in Duan Shuang’s eyes.
As the strongest force on Purple Bamboo Mountain, his participation would undoubtedly be a great help.
"Then will Fellow Daoist Gong join us?" Duan Shuang turned to Gong Yang.
Unlike Xu Ping’s lack of interest, Gong Yang became spirited, "Where is this relic located?"
"Deep in the Wanzhe Waters, found under the guidance of a treasure map," Duan Shuang replied.
"How did Fellow Daoist Duan confirm that it’s a Golden Core Cultivator’s relic..."
...
Seeing the two already discussing the details of exploring the Golden Core Cultivator’s relic, Xu Ping prepared to take his leave.
But he suddenly remembered something, stopped in his tracks, and cupped his hands:
"If you two are going to explore the Golden Core Cultivator’s relic, could you keep an eye out for any Longevity Pills or rare treasures?"
"That’s certainly no problem." Duan Shuang nodded, then asked again, "It’s a Golden Core Cultivator’s relic, are you sure you won’t join us, Fellow Daoist Xu?"
"I won’t be going."
Xu Ping said firmly and after a moment of silence, said, "However, I have several Second-stage Upper Grade talismans here, I hope you two will accept them. If you find Longevity Pills or rare treasures, I’m willing to exchange Spirit Stones or other treasures."
Xu Ping took four talismans from his Storage Ring, giving two to each.
Duan Shuang and Gong Yang did not refuse, accepting the talismans and feeling the extraordinary power within them, their expressions showing a hint of surprise.
These talismans were considered top quality among Second-stage Upper Grade talismans.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Xu," the two cupped their hands and thanked him.
"You two are too kind, I rarely go out from Thousand Leaves Mountain, so I have no use for them," Xu Ping said with a smile.
"May you both return laden with spoils!"
"Thank you for your good wishes!"
...
After leaving Xiaohui Mountain, Xu Ping returned straight to Thousand Leaves Mountain.
He then quietly resumed his cultivation of the ’Soul-Searching Technique’.
Duan Shuang and Gong Yang had considerable strength on their own, plus the aid of several Second-stage Upper Grade talismans, the danger was not great as long as they didn’t act recklessly.
Although it was quite a loss to give them four Second-stage Upper Grade talismans, considering their years of friendship and the possible existence of Longevity Pill or other life-extending treasures in the Golden Core Cultivator’s relic.
If even one is brought back, Xu Ping would have gained greatly.
...
...
After Duan Shuang and Gong Yang had discussed all details, they went to the Golden Core Cultivator’s relic.
Purple Bamboo Mountain, instantly became much quieter.
Xu Ping, however, felt nothing and continued his silent cultivation.
Four months later.
Training room.
Pinching a Magic Technique, a cold gleam shone from Xu Ping’s eyes, and his Divine Sense spread out.
It lasted a full half-hour before his Divine Sense retracted.
"Whew!"
Xu Ping exhaled a turbid breath, a look of uncontrollable joy on his face, "The ’Soul-Searching Technique’... finally broke through!"
```

chapters.title: Chapter 177 - 157: Song Li Slain
chapters.content:
Chapter 177: Chapter 157: Song Li Slain
"The ’Soul-Searching Technique’... has finally broken through!" A trace of joy appeared on Xu Ping’s face, and he couldn’t wait to open the proficiency panel.
[Soul-Searching Technique Proficiency: 1/200]
Seeing the display on the panel, Xu Ping felt delighted.
Now that the Soul-Searching Technique has finally reached the proficiency level, he could finally soul search Song family’s direct descendant to obtain the cultivation method and secret techniques for Spirit Wood.
His primary target was still Song Li.
From what he knew, Song Li was still at Dragon Lion Market, and every year he would personally escort some Spirit Wood or other items from the Song family to the Dragon Lion Market to sell.
Judging by the time, it was almost that time of the year.
Xu Ping composed himself, adjusted his breath, and after his energy and spirit returned to peak condition, he rode the Escape Light and left Thousand Leaves Mountain, heading towards Dragon Lion Market.
...
...
A month later.
The sun was shining brightly, and the sky was blue with white clouds.
A Spiritual Boat of several meters long, with a large flag bearing the word ’Song’ flying at the prow, moved quickly through the air, surrounded by clouds stretching like a white carpet, reflecting the golden glow of sunlight.
Song Li lay on a chair at the back of the Flying Boat, with a pot of Spirit Tea and a tray of spiritual light placed beside him, looking extremely relaxed.
Meanwhile, at the front of the Flying Boat, seven or eight Qi Cultivation disciples from the Song family were also very leisurely, chatting while piloting the Spiritual Boat.
No wonder they were so relaxed and unguarded.
After all, their Song family was quite famous in Wanzhe Waters, and it had been a long time since anyone dared to attack the Song family cultivators.
However, right at the moment of their leisure.
Boom!
A tremendous spiritual pressure erupted, a white bone Magical Artifact sword transformed into a white beam over ten meters long, slashing down from the sky!
It directly sliced through the Song family’s Flying Boat at the waist.
The seven or eight Qi Cultivation disciples from the Song family were instantly shredded by the Sword Qi, without even a single scream.
"Who dares to attack my Song family’s Flying Boat!?"
Song Li suddenly opened his eyes, glaring furiously, and hastily sacrificed a shield-like defensive Magical Artifact to block the white bone Magical Artifact sword.
However, he clearly underestimated the power of this white bone Magical Artifact sword.
The white bone Magical Artifact sword was as mighty as thousands of pounds, slashing onto the shield, causing his Magical Artifact to emit a mournful cry under the strain.
In the next moment.
Thud!
With a loud boom, the defensive Magical Artifact could no longer hold and was directly sliced into pieces.
"Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator?"
Song Li shouted in terror, for someone capable of breaking his shield with one slash could only be a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment.
Before he could react further, the white bone Magical Artifact sword, gleaming with white light and resembling a Flood Dragon, continued its momentum and sliced onto his Protective Spiritual Light.
Crack!
The Protective Spiritual Light shattered, and amidst the residual Sword Qi, despite Song Li’s efforts to dodge, an arm was still severed off.
"Ah!"
Blood splattered, and Song Li couldn’t help but scream in pain.
But he forced himself to endure the pain, retreating swiftly while transmitting his Divine Sense: "I am a direct descendant of the Song family, if you kill me, the Song family surely won’t spare you!"
"Faced with death, you dare threaten me?"
Disguised as a burly man, Xu Ping’s lips curled into a cold smile, and the white bone Magical Artifact sword chopped down again fiercely.
"Ah!"
In an instant, the white bone Magical Artifact sword struck heavily on Song Li, causing him to scream, unable to maintain his Escape Light.
Xu Ping suddenly accelerated, closing in beside him, and injected streams of Mana into his Sea of Consciousness and Dantian, sealing his Divine Sense and Mana.
In an instant, he subdued him.
Given his current cultivation and Divine Techniques, capturing an Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator posed little difficulty.
"Time to go!"
Xu Ping lifted Song Li and used Escape Light to leave quickly.
He was quite close to Dragon Lion Market, so it was best to leave early.
...
...
On a deserted island, inside a newly excavated cave abode.
"What... are you going to do?"
Song Li lifted his head with difficulty, eyes full of pleading.
But Xu Ping showed no mercy to the person who had tried to kill him before.
"Friend Song, please relax, I just want you to cooperate in executing a magic." Xu Ping’s face bore a gentle smile while his right hand grasped the man’s head amid his terror-filled look.
"Soul-Searching Technique!"
With a soft cry, Xu Ping’s Divine Sense spread into Song Li’s Sea of Consciousness, forcibly extracting his memories.
"Ah ah ah..."
Intense pain caused Song Li to scream sharply.
Fortunately, the cave was surrounded with an Array, regardless of how terribly he screamed, it couldn’t be heard outside.
However, Xu Ping remained unmoved, keeping his hand on Song Li’s head as if watching a fragmented movie.
The memories were incredibly chaotic, and finding useful information required strong Divine Sense and patience.
Luckily, Xu Ping’s Divine Sense was strong enough, and he soon found the Skill concerning Spirit Wood cultivation within Song Li’s memories.
"Tribulation Spirit Skill, Spirit Storage Skill... So, that’s how it is!"
Xu Ping displayed a look of delight, his Divine Sense surged, and he continued to explore meticulously.
...
Half an hour later.
Upon confirming that he firmly remembered both Skills, Xu Ping released his grip on Song Li’s head.
At this time, Song Li’s face was completely rigid, left with only a breath.
Xu Ping flicked his finger, a beam of spiritual light shot out, piercing a bloody hole in his forehead.
Song Li let out a dull sound, his vitality dissipating rapidly.
Suddenly, a strange red strand emerged from Song Li’s body, silently trying to wrap around Xu Ping.
"What is this?"
An ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivator might overlook it, but in Xu Ping’s powerful Divine Sense, the peculiar red strand could not hide at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 178 - 157: Song Li Slain (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 178: Chapter 157: Song Li Slain (Part 2)
With a wave of his right hand, a blue Mana palm directly grabbed that eerie red thread.
"This is... ’Blood Soul Silk’?"
After Xu Ping observed and examined it closely, his face inadvertently flashed a hint of surprise.
But upon careful thought, Song Li, after all, is a direct descendant of the Song family, so having ’Blood Soul Silk’ implanted by a Fake Pill cultivator isn’t unusual.
This Secret Technique can only be performed by at least a Fake Pill wielder, leaving a thread of blood on a relative. If someone kills the relative, this Blood Soul Silk lodges on the murderer, constantly tracking their whereabouts, discovering and finding them even if they escape a thousand miles.
Once the red thread was caught by Xu Ping’s Mana palm, it continued to struggle and twist, attempting to wrap around him.
"Burn!"
Xu Ping murmured, and a cluster of blue True Flame appeared out of thin air, incinerating it into nothingness.
"This place is exposed, I must leave!"
Xu Ping scavenged all useful items on Song Li’s body, then used Foundation Establishment True Flame to burn his corpse to ashes, packed up the Array, and quietly departed the place.
...
...
The Song family estate.
At the core of the Third-rank Spirit Vein, a yellow-robed Daoist had his eyes closed, with countless Spiritual Qi pouring into his body with each breath.
Just when Xu Ping killed Song Li, the yellow-robed Daoist suddenly opened his eyes, a sharp light flashed through his gaze, and his face revealed a hint of anger: "Who dares to kill a descendant of my clan?"
He suddenly stood up and pointed his finger, causing a surge of Mana, revealing a blurry image.
In the next moment.
Buzz!
Mana scattered, and the blurry image instantly disappeared.
"Someone destroyed the ’Blood Soul Silk’!" The yellow-robed Daoist’s face slightly changed.
Burning Blood Soul Silk isn’t difficult, but detecting it is extremely hard, at least requiring a Foundation Establishment cultivator with a strong Divine Sense.
"Who could it be?" The yellow-robed Daoist frowned in thought.
In the Wanzhe Waters, there aren’t many late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivators with a powerful Divine Sense, but throughout Yue Country, there are many late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivators.
Now without any clues, it’s undoubtedly like searching for a needle in a haystack.
As he pondered silently, he suddenly looked up towards the depths of Wanzhe Waters, showing a shocked expression: "What is this...?"
...
...
The depths of Wanzhe Waters.
An expansive desolated island abruptly began to shake violently.
In the next moment, the calm lake surface surged, countless fish and shrimp were thrown from the lake bottom to the surface, as if a minor earthquake occurred.
Rumbling!
A blue light pillar soared into the sky, visible clearly within hundreds of miles!
At this moment, Duan Shuang and Gong Yang hurriedly flew away from the desolated island, shocked by the changes in the ruins.
"This is going to be big!"
The two exchanged glances, such a significant disturbance couldn’t help but be noticed throughout Wanzhe Waters.
They didn’t want this, after all, who would’ve thought that merely breaking the outer Array would cause such a huge commotion?
"Fellow Daoist Duan?" Recovering their senses, Gong Yang turned his head towards Duan Shuang, with greed flashing in his eyes.
"Yes!" Duan Shuang firmly nodded.
Although the two didn’t explicitly say it, they already understood each other’s intentions.
The ruins caused such a commotion, it’s certainly not ordinary Golden Core cultivator’s remnants, possibly even Nascent Soul cultivator’s relics.
If they can gain some opportunity or treasure from it, achieving Golden Core is no longer unreachable.
What they must do now is to explore the ruins as much as possible before others arrive.
Duan Shuang and Yang’s eyes showed determination as they flew back to the desolated island.
However, in the next instant, they felt their bodies as heavy as thousands of pounds, forcing them to land on the lake surface: "Forbidden space Restriction? Breaking the outer Array somehow triggered the ruins’ forbidden space Restriction?"
...
...
The outskirts of Wanzhe Waters.
Xu Ping was flying in the air, piloting Escape Light.
At this moment, he suddenly turned back, looking towards the depths of Wanzhe Waters, his eyebrows subtly raised.
Despite the distance, he could vaguely sense an unusual Spiritual Qi fluctuation emanating from the depths.
That fluctuation was like a storm, causing his heart to tremble: "What on earth is happening?"
Such a significant disturbance, a normal Golden Core cultivator or third-rank Array definitely cannot trigger.
"Could it be the work of a Late-stage Golden Core Great Cultivator, fourth-rank Array, or even a Nascent Soul ancestor?"
Xu Ping speculated, but couldn’t find an answer, yet no matter the situation, he didn’t want to get involved.
"Hopefully, it won’t affect my Spirit Wood cultivation." He prayed silently, yet felt uneasy.
Thousand Leaves Mountain is right next to Wanzhe Waters, if something big indeed happens, how can he remain unaffected?
Just as Xu Ping was burdened with worries, preparing to continue his flight, he suddenly paused, thinking of this possibility:
"Wait, Duan Shuang and Gong Yang planned to explore the ruins supposedly in the depths of Wanzhe Waters!"
"Could it be the ruins causing this?"
Xu Ping pondered for a moment, turned his palm over, and a Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman appeared in his hand.
Then he injected a trace of Mana into it.
This Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman flashed briefly, but quickly dimmed, as if obstructed by an invisible force.
"Blocked!" Xu Ping’s face slightly changed.
It’s evidently Duan Shuang’s Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman being blocked by Array or Restriction.
"Is it really their exploration of that ruins causing the commotion?"
Xu Ping’s expression was uncertain, eventually only able to silently sigh, "Hope they both return safely!"
Currently, the situation remains unclear, and he definitely doesn’t want to risk diving into danger to find them.
...
...
Several days later, an explosive news spreads across Wanzhe Waters.

chapters.title: Chapter 179 - 157: Song Li Slain (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 179: Chapter 157: Song Li Slain (Part 3)
Deep within the Wanzhe Waters, a cultivator’s relic has been discovered!
It is at least the relic of a Late-Stage Golden Core cultivator, and possibly even of a Nascent Soul patriarch.
Due to the significant commotion caused by the emergence of the relic, a large number of cultivators became aware of it, and the news spread like a tidal wave in all directions!
In a short time, it was announced across Yue Country.
For Loose Cultivators, exploring an ancient secret realm is a journey filled with both opportunity and risk, attracting a vast swarm of cultivators.
Even the major Golden Core Sects, and even the Luoyun Sect, sent people to partake in a share of the spoils.
The originally peaceful Yue Country has now been stirred into turmoil.
...
...
Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Upon hearing this news, Xu Ping felt a slight sense of relief.
The relic’s emergence would certainly cause the Wanzhe Waters to become a mixed bag of characters, but since he wasn’t going to explore the relic, it didn’t greatly affect him.
With the two secret techniques for cultivating Spirit Wood now in hand, he could only stay at Thousand Leaves Mountain in peace to cultivate Spirit Wood.
"Unfortunately, it’s still unknown whether Duan Shuang and Gong Yang are exploring that relic," Xu Ping shook his head helplessly.
He had tried contacting Duan Shuang these past few days, but all attempts were unsuccessful.
However, upon reflection, if they really are exploring this relic, it’s not necessarily a bad thing for them but rather a huge opportunity.
Being close to the water gets you the moon first.
If they can return safely, the fortune would certainly be significant, and perhaps they might even find the longevity-enhancing item he asked them to look for.
"For now, it’s best to wait patiently!"
Xu Ping thought it over and decided to first practice the Spirit Storage Skill and Tribulation Spirit Skill.
The sooner he succeeds in cultivation, the sooner he can plant the Spirit Wood, and the sooner he can forge the Sword Array.
Xu Ping closed his eyes, and the information about the two skills appeared automatically in his mind.
Spirit Storage Skill is a cultivation method for nurturing Spirit Wood.
Second-stage Spirit Wood requires a harsh growth environment, and the Spirit Storage Skill is a Skill that allows it to thrive in ordinary spiritual grounds.
Though Spirit Storage Skill can solve the issue of vigorous growth for Second-stage Spirit Wood, it is well-known that Second-stage Spirit Wood requires at least a hundred years to fully mature.
The Tribulation Spirit Skill can steal the vitality and essence from other Spirit Woods and spiritual values, injecting it into the Second-stage Spirit Wood, thereby significantly shortening the maturation time.
It can even break through its own limits and allow unlimited growth in size.
It’s vital to know that typical Second-stage Spirit Wood is not large, at most enough to make four or five Magic Techniques.
If Xu Ping wants to craft thirty-six Magic Techniques at once, then the size of Second-stage Upper Grade Spirit Wood must be at least eight times that of ordinary Spirit Wood.
A Second-stage Upper Grade Spirit Wood of such size would take a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, or even a Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivator, several decades to cultivate, even with the two skills well-mastered.
This is not even counting the resources consumed in the process.
It is no wonder Song Li once told him to give up on this idea, as such a significant cost is definitely unaffordable for a Foundation Establishment cultivator.
However, for Xu Ping, while cultivating such an immense Second-stage Upper Grade Spirit Wood would certainly consume a lot of resources, the time required would be much less than for ordinary Foundation Establishments.
On one hand, as the proficiency with the two skills increases, their power would certainly be greatly enhanced.
On the other hand, there’s his Longevity Mana.
According to what’s recorded in the two skills, the Wood Element Mana used in these two skills will provide extra enhancement to Spirit Wood.
And his Longevity Mana would likely surpass even the mana from the top Wood Element cultivation techniques.
The combination of these elements makes Xu Ping estimate that he can complete the cultivation in around ten years.
In ten years, he estimates he might not have even reached the Late-Stage Foundation Establishment.
"Let’s begin!"
Xu Ping took a deep breath, cleared his mind, and silently began to practice the two skills.

chapters.title: Chapter 180 - 158: Jade Longevity Peach
chapters.content:
Chapter 180: Chapter 158: Jade Longevity Peach
A month later.
Cultivation room.
Two emerald green Spirit Plants quietly floated in front of Xu Ping.
"Tribulation Spirit Skill!"
His expression slightly concentrated as he gently drew a line in the air with his finger, and Longevity Mana gushed from his fingertips, striking one of the Spirit Plants in an instant.
Whoosh!
In an instant, the originally green Spirit Plant quickly turned yellow and withered, turning into a pile of black ash within moments, leaving behind only a clump of vibrant green light.
"Go!"
With a flick of Xu Ping’s finger, the clump of green light instantly merged into the other green plant.
Buzz!
After absorbing the green light, this plant suddenly emitted a faint green glow, and the vitality within it grew even stronger, as if cheering for the newfound life force.
"Tribulation Spirit Skill... Entry Level!"
Seeing this, a slight smile appeared on Xu Ping’s face.
He opened the proficiency panel and focused his gaze on Tribulation Spirit Skill and Spirit Storage Skill.
[Tribulation Spirit Skill Entry Level: 1/100; Spirit Storage Skill Entry Level: 5/100]
"Both skills have now reached Entry Level, but to cultivate Second-stage Spirit Wood, both skills need to be raised to proficient level."
"However, with the proficiency panel, I can grind these two skills to proficient level within a month at most!"
The thought of being able to cultivate Spirit Wood soon filled Xu Ping with joy.
After admiring the proficiency panel for a while, he closed it and then beckoned with his hand, causing the Spirit Plant floating in the air to slowly fall into his hand.
Just as he placed the Spirit Plant into his Storage Ring, Xu Ping frowned slightly, seemingly sensing something.
With a flip of his hand, a Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman appeared in his palm.
"Duan Shuang!"
Xu Ping raised his brow and injected a trace of Mana into the Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman. Duan Shuang’s pleasant voice emerged from it.
...
...
Several days later.
In the pavilion at Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Xu Ping sat in the main seat, with Duan Shuang and Gong Yang beside him.
"So it seems..."
Xu Ping’s brows furrowed slightly: "Even Golden Core Cultivators can’t break through the restrictions of the ruins?"
"Indeed..."
Gong Yang still had some lingering fear on his face: "The Golden Core Cultivator of Wanzhe Sect attempted to force their way in, but was easily injured by the restrictions. If he hadn’t escaped quickly, he might have been stuck there permanently."
"That is truly dangerous!" Xu Ping mused outwardly, but inwardly he was indifferent. He was not interested in exploring the ruins, so no matter how powerful its restrictions were, it didn’t concern him.
"However, although the restrictions on that Ruins Deserted Island are formidable, the resources within are exceptionally abundant.
"Even a search around the outermost parts yielded several kinds of rare Spirit Grass for Fellow Daoist Gong and me," Duan Shuang smiled beautifully, a hint of joy in her voice.
"Based on my observations, as time passes, those originally damaged restrictions will lose their power to stop us from entering, and the ruins will eventually open up..."
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping’s heart stirred.
"Congratulations to both Fellow Daoists. May I ask if you found any life-extending treasures during your exploration?" Xu Ping inquired with a smile after expressing his congratulations.
"Hehe, I knew Fellow Daoist Xu would ask that. Take a look at this!"
Duan Shuang’s eyes sparkled with light as she smiled charmingly, flipping her delicate hand to reveal a small jade box.
With a wave of her hand, the jade box automatically opened, revealing a Spirit Peach inside, emitting an exotic fragrance that stirred the Longevity Mana within him.
"This is... the Jade Longevity Peach?"
Xu Ping’s eyes lit up with surprise.
The Jade Longevity Peach, a Second-stage Upper Grade Spirit Peach, could extend life by fifteen years. Among life-extending treasures, it was considered a fine specimen.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoists." Xu Ping gratefully accepted the jade box, with delight on his face.
Consuming this peach would extend his life by at least thirty years, and the proficiency in the Longevity Skill would increase by at least thirty points.
It seemed that deciding to give them talismans was indeed a wise choice at the time.
In Xu Ping’s mind, the value of a few Second-stage Upper Grade talismans paled in comparison to the importance of this Jade Longevity Peach.
"No need to be so polite, Fellow Daoist Xu," Duan Shuang said with a smile.
Seeing this, Gong Yang quickly signaled to Duan Shuang with his eyes.
Duan Shuang understood tacitly and smiled gently, "Fellow Daoist Xu, the resources within the ruins are plentiful. The life-extending treasures surely aren’t limited to just the Jade Longevity Peach. Who knows, we might find even better life-extending items. Would you care to join us?"
Although they were Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment and Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators, in terms of Divine Techniques and combat strength, the two of them together were probably no match for Xu Ping.
Moreover, the exploration of this ruin was a significant event that affected the entire Yue Country, with many Golden Core and Fake Pill cultivators likely exploring the ruins.
They were still too weak within, but if they could bring in Xu Ping, whose combat strength was comparable to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators, they could naturally avoid many dangers.
In exploring ruins, the greatest dangers aside from traps set by restrictions were other cultivators!
"Exploring the ruins, huh?"
Xu Ping contemplated for a moment. He had never attempted to explore ancient ruins before.
Unfortunately...
He shook his head, "I have no interest in the ruins..."
No matter how tempting the ruin, or how abundant its resources, he would not go.
He could cultivate in peace, so why take the risk?
"Fellow Daoist Xu...."
Hearing this, Gong Yang became a bit anxious, "That ruin might have been left by a Nascent Soul Cultivator. We Loose Cultivators lack resources, and our cultivations are stuck at bottlenecks. This is a heaven-sent opportunity... There’s even the possibility of finding Spiritual Objects suitable for our cultivation breakthroughs, or even Core Formation!"
’It may be so for ordinary cultivators, but for me, even if there are Core Formation Spiritual Objects, it’s not worth the risk.’
’Once I complete the Sword Array and reach Foundation Establishment Perfection, I can slowly seek out Core Formation Spiritual Objects later.’

chapters.title: Chapter 181 - 158: Jade Longevity Peach (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 181: Chapter 158: Jade Longevity Peach (Part 2)
Xu Ping’s expression became serious, and he said firmly, "Thank you for your kind intentions, Fellow Daoist Gong, but I am focused on my cultivation and do not wish to explore any secret realms."
Gong Yang looked at Xu Ping, his lips moving slightly, but in the end, he couldn’t find the words to respond.
Sword cultivators are usually determined individuals. Talented sword cultivators like him, who have comprehended the Sword Qi Thunder Sound, are even more so. Once they make a decision, no one can sway them in the slightest.
"Although I won’t be going, I would still like to offer these two Second-stage Middle Grade puppets to you both, Fellow Daoists."
With a wave of his sleeve, Xu Ping made two puppets, clad in black armor, suddenly appear in the pavilion.
These two puppets were, of course, the ones he had previously confiscated from Bai Kun, but he had altered their appearance using other spiritual materials. Now, he could use them openly without any issues.
These Second-stage Middle Grade puppets weren’t of much use to him, but for Duan Shuang and Gong Yang, they would be significant allies.
One puppet was for attack and the other for defense. Combined with their cultivation and divine techniques, they could easily escape from Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators.
Seeing the two imposing Second-stage puppets, Duan Shuang and Gong Yang couldn’t help but show a touch of delight on their faces. They cupped their hands in thanks, "Thank you, Fellow Daoist Xu, *2."
With these puppets’ assistance, they could further explore secret realms and greatly increase their own safety.
"No need to be polite, Fellow Daoists. I hope you both can also keep an eye out for life-extending treasures for me," Xu Ping said with a smile, cupping his hands.
"That will certainly not be a problem," the two of them nodded with smiles.
After exchanging a few more words, Duan Shuang and Gong Yang took their leave.
...
...
Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Training room.
Xu Ping flipped his palm, and a jade box containing a Jade Longevity Peach appeared in his hand. The smooth jade surface emitted a gentle luster.
Xu Ping’s lips curled up slightly, "This arrangement where I provide the resources and Duan Shuang and Gong Yang provide the effort seems quite effective. If I can find a few more life-extending treasures, it will be a great profit."
"This way, I can ensure safety and obtain what I desire."
However, this method requires understanding the character of the other person. If they are deceitful individuals, it would be a loss.
Xu Ping opened the jade box, took out the translucent Jade Longevity Peach, and without hesitation, took a bite.
The sweet and fresh juice burst in his mouth, quickly spreading and making him feel delighted.
As he swallowed, the Jade Longevity Peach was continuously refined in his abdomen by his Longevity Skill, transforming into an endless stream of essence to replenish himself.
After a cup of tea, the Jade Longevity Peach was completely absorbed.
Xu Ping looked joyful, eagerly checking his proficiency panel.
[Name: Xu Ping]
[Lifespan: 45/378 years]
[Realm: Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment: 16/100; Blood Demon Body Refining Level Two: 90/100]
[Cultivation Technique: Longevity Skill Minor Achievement: 200/800]
...
"Extended my life by thirty years! My Longevity Skill’s proficiency also increased by thirty points!"
"If I come across more life-extending treasures like this, my lifespan could approach that of a Golden Core cultivator!"
Xu Ping felt content within.
For cultivators, their ultimate goal is to live even longer.
...
...
Time passed.
As the restrictions of the deserted island ruins continued to weaken, various life-extending treasures flowed out one after another.
The appearance of a Core Formation spiritual object even spurred several battles among Golden Core and Fake Pill cultivators, eventually being claimed by the Shuize Sect, which held the geographical advantage.
The appearance of the Core Formation spiritual object undoubtedly further stimulated the nerves of many cultivators.
As a result, the cultivators became even more frenzied, and the prices of various cultivation items surged.
However, the external chaos did not impact Xu Ping at all.
He continued to stay at home, silently cultivating with single-minded devotion.
...
A month later.
Thousand Leaves Mountain.
A tall and slender figure was busy in the spiritual field.
Using his mana, Xu Ping dug a small hole in the soil and planted a seedling of Hundred Bamboo Wood.
Then, he covered it with layers of soil of different textures.
After the transplantation was complete.
Xu Ping took out a bottle of Green Liquid and poured it onto the soil near the seedling.
"Spirit Storage Skill!"
After these actions, he pointed his forefinger, and the Green Liquid in the soil suddenly surged with a faint green wave of light.
As the faint green wave of light continuously flowed into the Hundred Bamboo Wood seedling.
It was noticeable that the Hundred Bamboo Wood seedling became more resilient.
This is not the end yet.
Xu Ping’s expression turned solemn as he pinched a magic technique with both hands. His fingers lightly pointed, and dozens of strands of Longevity Mana shot out from his fingertips, instantly hitting the spirit plants and spirit medicine planted in the spiritual field.
Swoosh!
In an instant!
The originally lush green spirit plants and spirit medicine quickly turned yellow and withered. In no time, they turned into clusters of black ash, leaving behind clusters of vibrant green light spheres.
"Go!"
Xu Ping’s fingers moved continuously, and in an instant, the clusters of green light spheres were embedded into the sapling seeds of the Hundred Bamboo Wood.
Buzz!
After absorbing the green light spheres continuously, the sapling seeds of the Hundred Bamboo Wood suddenly emitted a faint green light. The life force contained within the green plants became increasingly strong.
And it was apparent that they had grown significantly in size.
"Finally, the sapling of the Hundred Bamboo Wood is planted!" Xu Ping nodded with satisfaction.
This sapling of the Hundred Bamboo Wood was a carefully selected second-stage upper-grade spirit wood sapling.
Its characteristic is renowned for its sturdiness, and if refined into a magical sword, it would be far more solid than an ordinary magical sword.
If Geng Metal is added during the refining process, its hardness might not be much inferior to a magical artifact.
By then, once the sword array is completed, its power and sturdiness will be enough to astonish Golden Core Cultivators.
"In the future, it will only require the Spirit Storage Skill and Tribulation Spirit Skill to be performed every two months."
"The Spirit Storage Skill is fairly manageable, but after performing the Tribulation Spirit Skill, having to replant spirit medicine and spirit plants is quite troublesome," Xu Ping frowned slightly at the vast spiritual field covered by the black ash of the spirit medicine.
Replanting spirit medicine and spirit plants is not a difficult task for him, but it does consume considerable time and effort.
Even though he has a long lifespan, he doesn’t wish to handle these trivial matters.
"Now that most of the matters are dealt with, it’s time to visit the Zhou Leqi family and purchase mystical beasts!" Xu Ping contemplated silently.
The spirit wood has been planted; once it grows to a sufficient size, refining the magical sword can begin.
Therefore, purchasing a demon beast capable of spitting demon fire to aid in artifact refining should be a priority.
Additionally, buying a demon beast that can care for spirit medicine and spirit plants would relieve him of personally tending to the spiritual field.
To avoid wasting time.
That afternoon, Xu Ping set out on his Spiritual Boat towards the Zhou Leqi family.
He now needs to perform the Spirit Storage Skill and Tribulation Spirit Skill every two months and cannot afford to delay too long outside.
...
...
Half a month later.
Xu Ping successfully reached the Zhou Leqi family.
The Zhou family’s territory was built along a vast plain, dotted with villages and manors.
On the plain, Xu Ping also saw many spirit beasts reared by the Zhou clan.
"With its open terrain and dense Spiritual Qi, this is quite an excellent place for rearing spirit beasts!" Xu Ping thought, nodding.
...
"Fellow Daoist Xu has arrived." As soon as Xu Ping disembarked from the Spiritual Boat, Zhou Letian greeted him with a beaming smile.
"I hope I didn’t disturb you, Fellow Daoist Zhou." Xu Ping responded with a smile.
"How could you disturb me? It’s my honor for you to visit our clan!"
"Fellow Daoist Xu must be exhausted from the journey. I have prepared food and drink; please proceed to my cave residence," Zhou Letian enthusiastically invited.
"You flatter me, Fellow Daoist Zhou." Xu Ping cupped his hands slightly.
.....
Inside Zhou Letian’s cave residence.
Zhou Letian, along with seven or eight important family members, kept him company. Each had their own table, filled with gourmet food and spirit wine.
On the carpet in the middle of the hall, a dozen young girls entered in succession, fluttering like butterflies, starting to dance and adding some lively atmosphere.
After half an hour.
Seeing that the banquet showed no signs of ending, Xu Ping couldn’t sit still and took the initiative to say, "Fellow Daoist Zhou, with the spirit wine already had our fill, could you take me to see the spirit beasts now?"
"Of course, that’s no problem at all. The spirit beasts have long been prepared for you, Fellow Daoist Xu, and you can choose at your leisure." Zhou Letian put down his wine glass and said with a smile.
"In addition to buying spirit beasts that can aid in artifact refining, I also want to purchase one capable of caring for spirit plants and spirit medicine," Xu Ping expressed his requirements along the way.
"That’s a trivial matter."
Zhou Letian instructed an elder from the clan, "Go and bring the spirit beasts needed by Fellow Daoist Xu so he can choose."
"Yes!" A thin elder respectfully nodded and then left the cave residence.
At this moment, Xu Ping and Zhou Letian began to chat again.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, have you ever been to those ruins on the deserted island?" Zhou Letian asked curiously.
"No, but Fellow Daoist Gong and Fellow Daoist Duan have teamed up and explored it several times, with abundant harvests. Fellow Daoist Zhou, would you like to join them and give it a try?" Xu Ping replied with a smile.
Zhou Letian had dealt with him several times before and also had his family as a vulnerability, so he wanted to draw the other party into his team to help him search for life-extending treasures.
After all, strength lies in numbers!

chapters.title: Chapter 182 - 159: Bloodline-Mutated Lake Mouse
chapters.content:
Chapter 182: Chapter 159: Bloodline-Mutated Lake Mouse
Upon hearing this, Zhou Letian was quite tempted, but after pondering for a moment, he shook his head helplessly: "I’m afraid I can’t go. I’m the only Foundation Establishment Cultivator in the clan. If something happens to me, I’m afraid our clan won’t even be able to defend our land."
"That’s true!" Xu Ping nodded and did not continue to persuade him.
About the time it takes to drink a cup of tea later, a thin elder led five spirit beasts of various kinds to Xu Ping.
"This is a First Rank Upper Grade Fire Crow. Its demon fire can assist in artifact refining without any issue; this is a Fire Soul Wolf..."
Zhou Tianle began introducing the demon beasts one by one.
Xu Ping listened quietly, secretly selecting suitable spirit beasts in his mind.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, have you decided which spirit beasts you want?" After introducing all the spirit beasts, Zhou Tianle asked with a smile.
Xu Ping looked at the five different spirit beasts, pondered for a moment, and then gave his answer: "I’ll take the Fire Crow and the Water Lake Rat."
The demon fire breathed by the Fire Crow is stable and an excellent choice for assisting in artifact refining.
As for the Water Lake Rat, it is a water element demon beast that can perform a skill similar to the Spirit Rain Skill, making it excellent for taking care of spirit medicines and spirit plants.
"Alright, give Fellow Daoist Xu the Demon Control Talisman!"
Zhou Tianle instructed the elder, then turned his gaze back to Xu Ping and said with a smile, "Once you refine the Spirit Control Token, you can control the actions and give orders to the demon beasts."
"Like the Water Lake Rat, they have been trained. You can simply give it an instruction, and it will take care of the spirit medicines and plants efficiently."
"Oh?"
A hint of surprise flashed across Xu Ping’s face.
They’ve been specially trained?
This is quite convenient, so there’s no need to worry about it not understanding my words.
Just as the elder of the Zhou family was about to hand the Spirit Control Token to Xu Ping.
Buzz!
Suddenly, the array that enveloped the entire Zhou family started to ripple.
"Is someone breaking through the array?"
The change in the array immediately captured the attention of everyone present.
"Zhou Tianle, come out and see me!" A long shout sounded like thunder, echoing throughout the entire Zhou family territory.
"My apologies, Fellow Daoist Xu, I will go and take a look!" Zhou Tianle’s expression changed slightly, apologized to Xu Ping, and hurriedly walked out of the cave.
Xu Ping frowned slightly, hesitated for a moment, but ultimately followed out.
Outside the cave!
Zhou Tianle took out a restriction token and waved it lightly.
The mist cleared, revealing a late-stage Foundation Establishment youth standing on a spiritual boat above the array.
This person was wearing a deep black robe embroidered with a dragon turtle insignia, the dragon turtle looked extremely majestic and had two dragon whiskers.
"Dragon Turtle Robe?"
"Someone from the Shuize Sect?"
Xu Ping was slightly surprised.
The Shuize Sect has a third-rank guardian dragon turtle spirit beast, so the robes of Shuize Sect cultivators are adorned with dragon turtle patterns.
"Fellow Daoist Lan Hun!"
Upon seeing this person, Zhou Tianle’s face immediately filled with a fawning smile, quickly opening the array to invite him in.
"Bring all your First Rank Upper Grade spirit beasts from your clan!"
Lan Hun put away his spiritual boat, and without any courtesy, directly ordered Zhou Tianle, completely ignoring Xu Ping’s presence.
A mere early-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator wasn’t worth his attention at all.
"This..." Zhou Tianle glanced at Xu Ping, showing a hint of hesitation on his face.
"What, you have a problem?" Lan Hun noticed his gaze, and his tone was icy cold.
"No, no, it’s just that this Fellow Daoist Xu had reserved two First Rank Upper Grade demon beasts, after all, Fellow Daoist Xu came first. Could you let Fellow Daoist Xu take the reserved demon beasts first?" Zhou Tianle felt a tightness in his heart, forced a smile, and attempted to negotiate with Lan Hun.
"Are you hard of hearing?" Lan Hun’s gaze was sharp as a knife, coldly staring at Zhou Tianle.
Zhou Tianle was instantly drenched in cold sweat, forcing a smile as he responded:
"I understand, I understand, I will immediately call people to bring the First Rank spirit beasts to Fellow Daoist Lan Hun, while you rest for a moment in my cave!"
Seeing the other person’s arrogant posture and insistent attitude, a trace of unnoticed coldness flashed in Xu Ping’s eyes.
’The people of Shuize Sect really are overbearing!’
’By the looks of it, the spirit beasts I reserved are probably lost!’
If this were in the wild, he would have cut the person down with a single sword strike.
"My deepest apologies, Fellow Daoist Xu. Please go to the side hall to wait for me, I assure you won’t leave empty-handed." Zhou Tianle transmitted his voice through Divine Sense, his tone full of apology.
"I understand," Xu Ping responded indifferently.
Lan Hun naturally sensed the voice transmission between the two, but he couldn’t be bothered to interfere, walking briskly towards Zhou Tianle’s cave.
And Zhou Tianle hurried to follow.
Watching the two gradually receding figures, Xu Ping’s gaze flickered, and after a cold laugh in his heart, he followed the Zhou family’s cultivators to the side hall.
...
...
Half an hour later.
Whoosh!
Lan Hun could be seen stepping on his spiritual boat, soaring into the sky, transforming into a stream of light, swiftly leaving the Zhou family territory.
"This score will be settled later!" Xu Ping cast a cold glance, then retracted his gaze.
Although it would be easy to kill the other person, it was inappropriate to make a move under the watchful eyes of many.
By the time he finished handling the spirit beast matters, the other person would probably have returned to the Shuize Sect long ago, especially since he still had spirit wood to plant, and time couldn’t be wasted outside.
A gentleman’s revenge can wait for ten years. He also remembered Shuize Sect with a mental note.
Shortly after Lan Hun left.
Zhou Tianle walked into the side hall, full of apologies, and said:
"Fellow Daoist Xu, truly sorry, I had arranged with Lan Hun to meet in two months, but I never expected him to suddenly show up and take away even the two spirit beasts promised to you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 183 - 159: Bloodline-Mutated Lake Mouse_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 183: Chapter 159: Bloodline-Mutated Lake Mouse_2
"I understand, after all, being a top disciple of Shuize Sect, it’s normal to look down on us Foundation Establishment cultivators with no background." Xu Ping feigned a self-mocking smile.
"Who can blame them? Shuize Sect is the undisputed dominator of the Wanzhe Waters; even Luoyun Sect has to treat them seriously." Zhou Tianle sighed helplessly.
Xu Ping showed surprise: "Is Shuize Sect just a Golden Core sect, that formidable?"
"Fellow Daoist Xu might not know." Zhou Tianle sighed and patiently explained:
"Initially, although Shuize Sect was slightly stronger than the other four major Golden Core sects, Luoyun Sect still didn’t regard them highly."
"But after Hu Country’s invasion ended, who would have thought Shuize Sect’s Sect Leader would step into Golden Core Perfection, even enhancing their sect’s array to a fourth-rank array!"
"Plus, Shuize Sect possesses a third-rank upper grade Dragon Turtle. In Shuize Waters, leveraging the mighty lake waters makes it several times more formidable than typical third-rank upper grade demon beasts, almost as powerful as Golden Core Perfection cultivators."
"As it stands, if Shuize Sect chooses to retreat within their array, even Luoyun Sect might find it difficult to deal with them easily."
"Is it so!"
Xu Ping’s heart was shocked, and he hurriedly asked, "Logically, such a major event should be widely known throughout Yue Country, why have I never heard about it?"
"It’s normal that you haven’t heard, Fellow Daoist!" Zhou Tianle showed no surprise on his face:
"Though Shuize Sect’s strength has greatly increased, there’s still a qualitative gap compared to Luoyun Sect. To prevent agitating Luoyun Sect, Shuize Sect has kept a low profile without publicizing the matter, and naturally, Luoyun Sect wouldn’t help spread the news."
"So within the whole Yue Country, only the local Foundation Establishment forces in Wanzhe Waters and various Golden Core forces might know."
"Facing two sects that can easily overwhelm us, we naturally dare not spread the matter widely."
Listening to Zhou Letian’s account, Xu Ping’s eyes flickered.
One must say, Shuize Sect has hidden deeply, leveraging the Hu Country invasion to outmaneuver Luoyun Sect.
Yet, this fourth-rank array’s acquisition seems odd; where did Shuize Sect find an Array Master to set it up?
Since Luoyun Sect’s only Array Master capable of setting up fourth-rank arrays passed away, there hasn’t been one in the entire Yue Country!
’Could this be related to Hu Country?’
Xu Ping couldn’t help but have this thought.
The more he thought, the more possible it seemed; although Hu Country has retreated for now, everyone can see Hu Country’s intention to invade Yue Country remains.
In this way, planting a thorn for Luoyun Sect seems sensible.
Xu Ping guessed that the various cultivation forces probably have the same idea, which further explains why it’s not widely publicized.
Xu Ping had countless thoughts whirling in his mind, but his face only showed a bitter smile:
"Whether Luoyun Sect or Shuize Sect, they are giants to us, and no matter how they develop, we should certainly keep our distance."
"Fellow Daoist Xu speaks rightly, we think the same!" Zhou Tianle also returned a bitter smile.
The two of them simultaneously fell into silence, and after a moment, Xu Ping took the initiative to break it:
"Earlier, Fellow Daoist Zhou transmitted that I wouldn’t return empty-handed, but are you still hiding a few first-rank upper grade spirit beasts?"
"Faced with Shuize Sect, I dare not hide them!" Xu Ping’s words made Zhou Tianle wave his hands in fear.
"Though there aren’t any first-rank upper grade spirit beasts, there is a peak first-rank middle grade Waterloose Rat, and its bloodline has mutated, manifesting both water and fire!"
"It can both unleash demon fire and bring down spirit rain; whether for assisting artifact refining or tending to spirit plants and medicines, it serves well!" Zhou Tianle explained with a smile.
"Oh?"
"This Waterloose Rat is interesting!"
Xu Ping’s eyes lit up, showing immediate interest.
"Just hearing Fellow Daoist Zhou’s description, I can tell this Waterloose Rat is extraordinary. Are you willing to part with it?" Xu Ping jested.
"Originally, I was reluctant, but who would have thought the spirit beast I promised you got intercepted? To compensate you, I had to offer my prized asset!" Zhou Tianle responded jokingly.
"Then I won’t stand on ceremony!" Xu Ping laughed.
"That’s how it should be." Zhou Tianle nodded earnestly.
"However, though this Waterloose Rat is good, it has drawbacks; advancing requires too many resources. The materials our clan spent on nurturing it could have raised at least two first-rank upper grade spirit beasts."
"And it’s still stuck at peak first-rank middle grade, with no knowing when it might break through!"
"Our clan is just ordinary and small, with other spirit beasts to raise; we truly cannot afford it." Zhou Tianle offered a bitter smile.
’So it turns out to be a gold-devouring beast!’ Xu Ping understood in his heart.
For the Zhou clan, this indeed is a significant drawback. After all, no matter how formidable the Waterloose Rat, they can at most nurture it to a first-rank upper grade demon beast.
As for nurturing it to a second-stage spirit beast, the Zhou clan clearly lacks that ability.
Spending multiple times the resources for other spirit beasts to nurture it into a first-rank upper grade demon beast is somewhat uneconomical for the Zhou clan.
’But for me, this isn’t a problem at all.’
’Not to mention my wealth is several times the entire Zhou clan’s, and I have no clansmen or spirit beasts to raise, cultivating the Waterloose Rat to a second-stage spirit beast isn’t hard either.’
Xu Ping mused secretly, but his face betrayed nothing, instead, he laughed: "This isn’t a big issue. I’m selling spirit beasts mainly to assist artifact refining and tend to spirit medicines, not for them to be powerful."
"Then I’ll have it brought here!" Zhou Tianle smiled slightly and immediately instructed the clan elder to bring the demon beast.
Soon after.
The elder of the Zhou clan led a roughly ten-foot-tall, with fur in red-blue symmetry, Rat Demon in front of Xu Ping.
Xu Ping examined it with great interest, knowing from the appearance alone that this Waterloose Rat was extraordinary.
"Let this Waterloose Rat demonstrate its divine techniques for Fellow Daoist Xu!" Zhou Tianle instructed.
"Yes!"
The clan elder held the Spirit Control Token and issued a command to the Waterloose Rat.
The Waterloose Rat obediently showcased its abilities, unleashing demon fire and conjuring spirit rain.
’Not bad, worth nurturing!’
Xu Ping nodded inwardly.
Though this Waterloose Rat was only peak first-rank middle grade, the two abilities it displayed could rival a first-rank upper-grade demon beast.
If it can be nurtured into a second-stage spirit beast, it could be far superior to typical second-stage spirit beasts.
This would be a notably good asset.
"Is Fellow Daoist Xu satisfied?" Zhou Tianle asked with a smile.
"Indeed, this Waterloose Rat is extraordinary." Xu Ping nodded and then asked, "How much does it cost?"
"Given my relationship with Fellow Daoist Xu, I’ll definitely offer a friendly price..." Zhou Tianle responded with a cheerful grin.
...
....
An hour later.
With Zhou Tianle’s respectful send-off, Xu Ping drove the Spiritual Boat and departed from the Zhou clan.
Upon the Spiritual Boat.
Xu Ping glanced down at the brand-new spirit beast pouch attached to his waistband, showing a trace of a smile.
Though it cost a considerable amount, he was completely satisfied to acquire this Waterloose Rat with such exceptional talents.
Raise it well, and it will be quite useful in the future.
Is this perhaps a blessing in disguise?
But ultimately, Lan Hun snatched the spirit beast from him; this grudge will just have to be noted for now.
...
Half a month later.
Xu Ping successfully returned to Thousand Leaves Mountain.
He stood in the spirit fields holding the Demon Control Talisman, releasing the Waterloose Rat from the spirit beast pouch.
"Squeak! Squeak..."
The Waterloose Rat’s eyes gleamed red as it looked at Xu Ping with some eagerness and fear.
Not just because of the Demon Control Talisman that decides its life or death, but also Xu Ping’s Foundation Establishment aura made it extremely apprehensive.
"Plant these several Spirit Medicines in the spirit fields." Xu Ping tossed a few Spirit Medicines to the Waterloose Rat’s vicinity, then his Divine Sense, through the Demon Control Talisman, issued a command to the Waterloose Rat.
Upon hearing this command, the Waterloose Rat wasted no time, quickly digging several pits in the spirit fields, then carefully planting the Spirit Medicines within and covering the roots with soil.
Finally, it didn’t forget to shower the Spirit Medicines with spirit rain.
"Your skills are rather nimble!" Xu Ping chuckled, noting the Waterloose Rat’s talent for planting Spirit Medicines was slightly better than ordinary spirit farmers.
With it around, the spirit field planting tasks on Thousand Leaves Mountain were assuredly settled.
"You’re responsible for planting all the spirit fields in this area, here’s your reward!" After instructing, Xu Ping flicked a finger, sending a first-rank upper grade Pill directly into the Waterloose Rat’s mouth.
"Squeak squeak..."
Feeling the massive medicinal power spreading within its body, the Waterloose Rat excitedly squeaked, resolutely beginning to complete Xu Ping’s planting task.

chapters.title: Chapter 184 - 160: Fishing?
chapters.content:
Chapter 184: Chapter 160: Fishing?
Half a year later.
On this day.
Gong Yang and Duan Shuang once again returned to Purple Bamboo Mountain, covered in dust, bringing good news for Xu Ping.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, fortunately, we did not fail in our mission!" Duan Shuang beamed like a flower, pushing a small jade box in front of Xu Ping.
Inside the jade box lay a Jade Longevity Fruit, exuding an enticing aroma.
Seeing this scene, Xu Ping’s eyes couldn’t help but brighten, and he clasped his hands together. "Many thanks to both of you, Fellow Daoists!"
This trade was truly worthwhile for him, needing to take no risks and only spending some resources, yet acquiring another Jade Longevity Fruit.
"We should be the ones thanking Fellow Daoist instead, for if not for your puppet, the two of us might have been in grave danger!" Duan Shuang’s charming face still showed some lingering fear.
"It’s just a shame that the puppet you gave us has been damaged!" With a sweep of her sleeve, two battered puppets suddenly appeared before them.
"The main issue was the competition for the herb garden; there were too many Foundation Establishment Cultivators fighting for it, even several Late-Stage Foundation Establishment Cultivators. Fellow Daoist Duan and I had great difficulty escaping." Gong Yang’s brows revealed a hint of helplessness.
"It’s a minor matter, as long as both Fellow Daoists return safely." Xu Ping smiled slightly, indifferent.
Two Second-stage Mid-grade puppets might be priceless to others, but to him, they were of no substantial value.
The three of them continued to discuss the island ruins.
Listening to the tales of Duan Shuang and Gong Yang, he learned that through the continued exploration and breaking of restrictions by the cultivators, the outskirts of the island ruins had been nearly turned inside out.
Not long ago, the restrictions were breached, revealing vast quantities of spiritual fruits and spirit medicines, even several Jade Longevity Fruits.
Only by expending great effort were they able to seize one.
’Several Jade Longevity Fruits?’
Xu Ping listened, his heart pounding with excitement.
If he could obtain them all, how much would that increase his lifespan and proficiency?
Unfortunately, their strength was somewhat lacking, managing to seize only one.
If it were him, never mind, he wouldn’t go even if it killed him.
"So, you’re saying...the restrictions on the outskirts of the island ruins have mostly been broken, and now only the interior and the most core area remain?"
Xu Ping listened to them, his face thoughtful.
"Exactly..."
Gong Yang spilled everything, withholding nothing: "Though we’re still unsure about the origins of these ruins, the outermost area yielded abundant rewards, including Core Formation spiritual objects. One can only imagine how many defying spiritual objects lie in the interior and the most core area."
"This ruin can be confirmed as a Nascent Soul cultivator’s ruin!"
"And in the inner spirit medicine garden, it has been seen that there’s a quasi-third-order spiritual fruit, the Hundred-Year Fruit!"
"Quasi-third-order spiritual fruit, Hundred-Year Fruit?" Upon hearing this, Xu Ping’s heart skipped a beat.
The Hundred-Year Fruit is essentially also a Jade Longevity Fruit.
But just as cultivators can appear with various spirit bodies, and demon beasts can have bloodline mutations, spirit fruits and spirit plants can too.
The Hundred-Year Fruit is derived from the mutation of the Jade Longevity Fruit.
Its life-extending capability far exceeds ordinary Second-stage life-extending items, but does not surpass those of the third stage.
Hence it’s called quasi-third-order spiritual fruit!
Although the Hundred-Year Fruit is merely a quasi-third-order spiritual fruit, it can also extend the lifespan of Golden Core cultivators.
"Yes, it’s the Hundred-Year Fruit!"
Gong Yang nodded definitively, "This spiritual fruit is extremely rare, and there are likely many cultivators vying for it. With Fellow Daoist Duan and I being rather weak on our own, we fear we may not be competitors. If Fellow Daoist Xu could join us, our hopes of capturing this fruit would greatly increase."
In the face of Gong Yang’s repeated invitation, Xu Ping, though tempted, still shook his head: "This fruit is so precious that Fake Pill and Golden Core cultivators are bound to strive for it. We wouldn’t stand a chance."
"Fake Pill and Golden Core cultivators?"
"They probably might not be available at the moment!" Gong Yang’s expression was a bit odd.
"Why is that?" Xu Ping was taken aback.
Duan Shuang interjected to explain: "Recently, there’s been a rumor circulating that in the core area of the ruins, an Infant Devouring Fruit, unseen in Yue Country for millennia, has appeared!"
"Infant Devouring Fruit!?"
Xu Ping’s pupils constricted, shocked, and he repeatedly questioned, "Is this true?"
He couldn’t be blamed for his loss of composure—the Infant Devouring Fruit was simply too rare and precious.
The Infant Devouring Fruit is a being that lies between a spiritual fruit and a life form. It’s rumored that swallowing this fruit can raise the success rate of Golden Core Perfection cultivators forming a Nascent Soul by a significant portion.
Not to mention in a mid-sized country like Yue Country, even in those super-sized countries, this is a rarely encountered defying spiritual object.
"This we don’t know, nor do we know who spread the rumor, but it spread plausibly, making it hard to distinguish true from false!" Duan Shuang shook her head.
Don’t know who spread it? Yet it spread plausibly?
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping quickly calmed down.
This matter felt quite suspicious!
In Yue Country, let alone a Foundation Establishment cultivator, even a Golden Core cultivator, without profound insight, might not recognize an Infant Devouring Fruit.
But someone recognized it and still spread the word.
No matter how it’s thought through, it seems fishy!
’Could someone be deliberately disseminating rumors to fish for information?’ Xu Ping’s heart trembled in realization.
’Who would it be?’ He pondered this for a while and already had an answer.
In all of Yue Country, the one with enough background to spread indistinguishable rumors is the entire Yue Country’s hegemon—the Luoyun Sect.
As for whose information they’re fishing for, it’s clearly evident!
The only confusion for Xu Ping was that Luoyun Sect’s tactics weren’t sophisticated, even he could detect them, and there’s no reason that the people from the Shuize Sect wouldn’t notice either.
Those old monsters who’ve lived for hundreds of years aren’t fools.
"Given that Fake Pill and Golden Core cultivators probably won’t act, if Fellow Daoist Xu joins us, our chances of seizing the Hundred-Year Fruit would increase significantly!" Gong Yang continued to urge with patient persuasion.

chapters.title: Chapter 185 - 160: Fishing? (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 185: Chapter 160: Fishing? (2)
If Xu Ping was slightly tempted just now, he felt nothing now.
No matter how important the Hundred-Year Fruit is, can it be more important than his own safety?
The Luoyun Sect plans to act as fishermen and lure the Shuize Sect, this sawtooth shark.
He’s just a small shrimp; there’s no need to join in the excitement.
He now only wants to peacefully plant Spirit Wood at home!
He has no desire to get involved in the chaotic world outside!
Xu Ping cupped his hands, his expression firm: "Fellow Daoist Gong, there’s no need to say more. I definitely won’t be going."
Upon hearing this, Gong Yang sighed helplessly but did not continue to persuade.
Even the temptation of the Hundred-Year Fruit couldn’t make Fellow Daoist Xu agree to explore the relics; it seemed the other party was resolute.
