The three exchanged silent glances, and the atmosphere became heavy again.
Xu Ping chuckled lightly, breaking the silence: "Fellow Daoists, as per the old rule, although I will not be going, I hope the two of you will accept these."
He waved his sleeve.
Two brand new Second-stage Middle Grade Puppets, seven or eight Second-stage Upper Grade Talismans, and five or six Thunder Beads suddenly appeared before Duan Shuang and Gong Yang.
"This... this is really too valuable!!"
Seeing this, the two were greatly startled; these items are worth at least tens of thousands of Spirit Stones, and he handed them over just like that!
"Fellow Daoists, there’s no need to be polite."
Xu Ping waved his hand and smiled, "I also want you to try and see if you can obtain the Hundred-Year Fruit, but if you don’t succeed, it’s alright. Your safety is the priority."
Though he wanted them to give it their all, he definitely couldn’t say it directly.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, rest assured, I will do my utmost!" Duan Shuang said seriously.
Gong Yang hesitated for a moment before also cupping his hands, saying, "I will also try my best."
"Your safety is the priority!" Xu Ping laughed warmly.
With so much help, if the two join forces, even a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator can be vanquished. This greatly increases the hope of obtaining the Hundred-Year Fruit.
...
After chatting for a bit, Duan Shuang and Gong Yang bid farewell and left.
Watching the two leave, Xu Ping couldn’t help but stroke his chin: "It seems I must learn the arts of Puppetry and Talisman drawing."
He felt that what he gave them wasn’t secure enough.
If he could draw treasured talismans and create Second-stage Upper Grade, or even Quasi-Tier Three Puppets.
By arranging for the two separately, they could dominate the Foundation Establishment Realm together, increasing their chances of securing the Hundred-Year Fruit to 70 or 80 percent.
This incident gave Xu Ping some ideas: if he encounters such dangerous explorations of relics and secret realms again and cannot act himself, he can let the two help obtain what he desires.
Moreover, he can give them some good things to enhance their strength, benefiting both them and himself.
Once the two had completely left, Xu Ping leisurely returned to his cultivation room.
He took out the Jade Longevity Fruit and swallowed it in a few bites.
"Extend life by twenty years!"
Xu Ping’s mouth curled into a smile.
Consuming two Jade Longevity Fruits didn’t double his lifespan, but the effect still exceeded expectations.
According to his estimate, he could still consume four or five more Jade Longevity Fruits before they would completely lose their effect on him.
...
...
Luoyun Sect!
A towering peak pointed straight to the sky, with mist like a veil around the mountain’s waist, partially revealing and concealing the mountain, like a fairyland.
Atop the peak, a white-haired elder with a sallow face in a brocade robe calmly gazed at the endless horizon.
After a while.
A middle-aged man with three strands of long beard quietly appeared, respectfully saluting the elder in the brocade: "Master, the message has been successfully released."
"Hmm."
The elder in the brocade continued to gaze forward, nodding indifferently.
The middle-aged man, seeing the back of the elder in the brocade, showed a hesitated expression, pondering for a moment before biting his teeth, cupping his hands and asking, "Master, will the Shuize Sect fall for such false information?"
The elder in the brocade turned to look at him and said calmly, "Who told you this is false information!"
"What!"
The middle-aged man was shocked at this, disregarding his demeanor as a Golden Core Perfection cultivator, repeatedly asking, "Master, did you mean the information you let me release is true?"
"Half true, half false."
The elder in the brocade answered lightly, "I can almost confirm this relic belongs to the Nine Nether Elder."
"Nine Nether Elder!!" the middle-aged man was again astonished.
The Nine Nether Elder was a Nascent Soul Loose Cultivator in Yue Country thousands of years ago.
The prestige of Nascent Soul Loose Cultivator goes without saying.
Let alone achieving Nascent Soul, even becoming a Foundation Establishment cultivator was remarkable for a Loose Cultivator.
According to the sect’s records, this Nine Nether Elder was once the number one in Yue Country, commanding the entire country, and even the then Luoyun Sect had to respect him.
But for some unknown reason, he suddenly disappeared, and there was no more news!
The elder in the brocade ignored the middle-aged man’s shock and continued indifferently, "Though we don’t know why the Nine Nether Elder disappeared or why his relic would appear deep in Wanzhe Waters, one thing is certain."
"He should have an Infant Devouring Pill refined from an Infant Devouring Fruit core, which, although not as effective as the fruit, still has a strong auxiliary effect on achieving Nascent Soul."
Faced with such explosive news, it took the middle-aged man, with his cultivation level, a long time to suppress his inner shock and excitement.
After pondering for a while, the middle-aged man gradually understood the elder in the brocade’s intention: "Master, you wish to use the false information about the Infant Devouring Fruit to cover the true information about the Infant Devouring Pill?"

chapters.title: Chapter 186 - 160: Fishing? (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 186: Chapter 160: Fishing? (Part 3)
"In this way, even when the true news of the Infant Devouring Pill is released, the Shuize Sect will suspect that it was our bait!"
"And by the time they determine the authenticity of the news, the Infant Devouring Pill would have long been in our possession, too late for them to inform the Hu Country cultivators!"
The elderly man in brocade said nothing, but the implication was clear.
After a moment of silence, the elderly man in brocade continued, "I don’t have much life left, perhaps with a few more moves, I’ll face my demise!"
"At present, it’s not yet certain whether the Infant Devouring Pill is in the ruins, it’s not time for me to act!"
"If it is there, everything will be great. If not, releasing the news of the Nine Nether Elder and the Infant Devouring Pill, I don’t believe that the Shuize Sect and Hu Country cultivators can sit still!"
The elderly man in brocade had a cold gleam in his eyes.
Upon hearing this, the middle-aged man didn’t feel his master was cunning but rather a strange bitterness in his heart.
If only his master’s life were longer; if only he could smoothly form a Nascent Soul, there wouldn’t be a need for these means, they could simply advance directly.
Currently, their Luoyun Sect faces its most perilous time in thousands of years.
An unwary step could lead to the sect’s destruction and their demise.
Every step must be perfect.
...
...
Two years later.
Thousand Leaves Mountain, cultivation chamber!
As Xu Ping quietly operated the Longevity Skill cultivation technique, strands of Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi flowed through his newly opened meridians, returning to his Sea of Qi in his Dantian.
A droplet of liquid mana coalesced and merged into the central water sphere, making it appear more lustrously emerald.
Xu Ping opened his eyes after an indefinite time, finishing his cultivation.
Sensing the mana within his Dantian, he smiled slightly: "One hundred and forty drops of mana, far exceeding typical mid-stage Foundation Establishment cultivators."
"At this rate of cultivation, it should take seven or eight years to break through to late-stage Foundation Establishment."
"When did I break through to mid-stage Foundation Establishment?"
Xu Ping recalled briefly and realized it was eight years ago.
"Seven years to break into mid-stage Foundation Establishment, fifteen to sixteen years for late-stage Foundation Establishment!"
Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction, pleased with his progress.
After consolidating his cultivation somewhat, he walked out of the cave abode.
Looking around, his mood lifted.
The lush greens and bright reds enveloped him, the unique fragrance of spirit medicine and spirit plants pervaded the whole of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
At this moment, the Water Lake Mouse was performing spirit rain before a medicinal field, nurturing the spirit medicine, which grew even greener under the drizzle of spirit rain.
"Ever since the Water Lake Mouse advanced to First Rank Upper Grade, its divine techniques have indeed improved considerably!" Observing its earnest demeanor, Xu Ping couldn’t help but stroke his chin.
Over the past two years of cultivation, the Water Lake Mouse had already surpassed First Rank Upper Grade, and now it was close to reaching the peak of First Rank Upper Grade.
It must be said, with abundant resources, the training talent displayed by this mutated Water Lake Mouse is indeed terrifying!
Not much different from demon beasts with special bloodlines.
"With another year or two of nurture, it should reach the pinnacle of First Rank, then we must prepare for its breakthrough to Second-stage."
"If it were an ordinary demon beast, preparing a demon core would suffice."
"But it might not be enough for it; it’s best to prepare two, one with a water attribute demon core, one with a fire attribute demon core, along with several auxiliary spiritual materials and pills for assurance."
While Xu Ping contemplated privately, planning how the Water Lake Mouse would break through to Second-stage Demon Beast.
"Hmm?"
He suddenly, his expression shifted slightly.
In the next moment.
He ascended into the air using escape light above Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Not far away, under the blue sky, several streams of light were intensely pursuing each other at high speed, evidently Foundation Establishment Stage cultivators in combat!
Among them, a pink and a yellow light fled ahead while numerous streaks of purple light chased them, heading towards Thousand Leaves Mountain!

chapters.title: Chapter 187 - 161: Hundred-Year Fruit
chapters.content:
Chapter 187: Chapter 161: Hundred-Year Fruit
The aura of these Foundation Establishment cultivators was incredibly strong, and to Xu Ping’s eyes, the two streaks of light escaping seemed particularly familiar.
They were precisely Duan Shuang and Gong Yang!
"Enter the grand array first!"
Xu Ping quickly transmitted his voice via divine sense and raised his hand to take out an array plate.
The mist at the edge of the array instantly dispersed, and the pink and yellow Escape Light, like two meteors, swiftly rushed into the array and the grand array firmly closed thereafter.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Xu..." Duan Shuang’s charming face appeared pale, and the trace of blood at the corners of her mouth tugged at people’s hearts.
Though Gong Yang seemed okay, his aura was also weak, suggesting he had sustained some injuries.
"What happened to the two of you? Who is chasing you?" Xu Ping asked with a frown.
With the puppets and talismans he had given them, battling against a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator should have been no problem, so why were they being pursued by so many Foundation Establishment cultivators?
Could it be that they had obtained some kind of good thing in the ruins?
"Alas, Fellow Daoist Duan seized the Hundred-Year Fruit right in front of the Song family, so naturally, the Song family wouldn’t let the two of us go." Gong Yang sighed in response.
"Hundred-Year Fruit!"
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping felt a surge of joy in his heart and couldn’t help but look at Duan Shuang.
He had given them so many resources, and now at last, it hadn’t been in vain.
"Behold, Fellow Daoist!"
Duan Shuang smiled like a blooming flower, her pale complexion revealing a tender beauty that evoked compassion.
She turned her jade-like hand over, and a jade-green box appeared in her palm.
Before Xu Ping could take a closer look, a loud shout reached their ears.
"Duan Shuang, Gong Yang... hand over the ’Hundred-Year Fruit’ immediately."
Outside the array, purple light gathered and revealed three cultivators in cyan robes: two were Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment, and one was Late-Stage Foundation Establishment.
The Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator waved his hand, stopping the two behind him, and approached the edge of the grand array. A flash of blue appeared in his eyes as he seemed to penetrate the array’s barrier, spotting Xu Ping and the others concealed in the mist.
"Xu Ping, the Guest Minister of Qiu Xuan Mountain?"
A cold smile tugged at his lips, "Don’t think that just because you’ve comprehended Sword Qi Thunder Sound, you can take Yue Country by storm. Open the array and hand over the Hundred-Year Fruit, and I might let bygones be bygones!"
Listening to the threats outside the array, Xu Ping wasn’t concerned. Let alone him, not even the Song family’s Fake Pill ancestor could get in with the array’s protection.
Xu Ping ignored the other party, opening the jade box to reveal a crystal-clear spiritual peach, the size of a fist, emitting an exotic fragrance.
"So this is the Hundred-Year Peach?"
Xu Ping’s eyes gleamed with joy as the exotic fragrance wafted towards him, stirring his longevity mana eagerly.
"I’m no longer young, and have been anxious about my lifespan. Who would’ve thought the two of you would achieve such a fortune!"
He placed the jade-green box in his Storage Ring, then activated a part of the array and revealed himself.
The Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator outside the array had long seen Xu Ping’s every move and his face darkened: "Xu Ping... don’t court your own doom!"
Just an Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, even if he comprehended Sword Qi Thunder Sound, couldn’t last a few rounds against him, let alone compare with the entire Song family.
This array seemed somewhat unusual, making him wary of rash action, otherwise, he would have breached it long ago.
"Be careful, Fellow Daoist Xu, this person’s name is Song Fei. His mana is nearly at Foundation Establishment Perfection, and he holds a unique treasure, the Xuanwu Sword, making his strength comparable to Foundation Establishment Perfection!"
"Do not meet him head-on, rely on the power of the array, and he won’t dare to enter." Gong Yang reminded Xu Ping via divine sense.
"Thank you for the reminder, Fellow Daoist Gong."
Xu Ping nodded, then turned his gaze towards Song Fei, his tone calm: "In the ruins, whatever one gains is according to their own fortune. It’s unreasonable for you to snatch away possessions... how about extending some face to me, and we call it a truce?"
"Your face?"
Upon hearing this, Song Fei sneered: "A mere Early-Stage Foundation Establishment dare spout such arrogance, one would think you’re a Golden Core cultivator. If you dare leave the array to duel me, and if you win, I will leave."
"Fellow Daoist Xu, do not act on impulse, I know your combat strength is unparalleled, but the gap in cultivation is too big, don’t fall for his provocation!" observed Gong Yang, upon seeing Xu Ping’s apparent movement.
"I feel the same way!" Duan Shuang nodded in agreement.
"Thank you both for your counsel, I am well aware of the situation!" Xu Ping nodded.
"As long as you understand,"
Both thought Xu Ping had given up the idea of fighting the other party, and were instantly relieved.
However, in the next instant, they heard Xu Ping coldly declare: "Since Fellow Daoist Song is so confident in his own strength, I might as well spar with you!"
"Fellow Daoist Xu!"
Duan Shuang and Gong Yang were shocked, and were about to stop him, only to see Xu Ping already opening the array and stepping out.
"Who would have thought you’d be so foolish!"
Seeing Xu Ping straightforwardly exit the array, surprise flashed across Song Fei’s eyes, then he laughed mockingly once he regained composure.
"You talk too much. I hope your skill is as strong as your mouth!" Xu Ping’s tone was indifferent.
"You... courting death!"
A trace of viciousness flickered across Song Fei’s face as he grasped a small golden sword in his hand.
The two Song family cultivators behind him sensibly retreated swiftly. To deal with an Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator certainly didn’t require ganging up.
After all, their Song family was a Fake Pill family, still needing to maintain some face.
"Hmph!"
Xu Ping snorted coldly, his aura suddenly surged, instantly rising from Early-Stage Foundation Establishment to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment. The Purple Sun Sword appeared in his hand at some point,
"Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment?"
Song Fei slightly narrowed his eyes, "You kid, you’ve hidden quite deeply!"

chapters.title: Chapter 188 - 161: Hundred-Year Fruit (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 188: Chapter 161: Hundred-Year Fruit (Part 2)
"If you won’t fight, then admit defeat quickly!" Xu Ping held the Purple Sun Sword, his tone indifferent.
Since he broke through the Foundation Establishment, it has been over a decade; thus, revealing his Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivation is quite normal.
"Fellow Daoist Xu has broken through to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment!"
Inside the Array, Duan Shuang and Gong Yang saw Xu Ping’s breakthrough explode with Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivation, a look of joy appearing on their faces.
Achieving Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivation, along with his Swordsmanship, might possibly allow him to truly contend with the opponent!
"Hmph, don’t think that breaking through to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment allows you to disregard others!" Song Fei snorted coldly, a flash of anger passing through his eyes, as though brewing a storm about to break.
"Slash!"
He raised the small golden sword high, suddenly slashing it down.
Instantly, a golden sword light, nearly ten zhang long, roared forth like an enraged dragon breaking through the air, unstoppable, carrying a suffocating sharpness, directly aiming at Xu Ping.
"Well met."
Facing the sword Qi unfolding at the thought, Xu Ping remained calm, infusing Mana into the Purple Sun Sword, decisively slashing downward.
Boom!
Accompanied by an ear-splitting thunderous roar, a mighty sword light burst forth from the sword tip, resembling countless gathered thunderbolts, rushing directly ahead.
Thud!
At the moment the sword lights collided, the air seemed to split, bringing waves of deafening thunder sounds, the surrounding Spiritual Qi surged like a tempest, shaking, unsettling people’s minds.
The two sword lights held steady for a moment.
Then—crack!
Xu Ping’s sword light clearly took the upper hand, shattering Song Fei’s sword light without suspense, its own power only diminished by fifty percent!
"Indeed some skill!"
Song Fei’s expression slightly changed, flipping his palm, revealing a wooden green shield.
With the infusion of Mana, the green shield exploded with intense Spiritual light, automatically forming a circle of defense Spiritual Barrier around him.
Slash!
The sword light pierced the defense Spiritual Barrier, emitting a series of teeth-gritting sounds, but ultimately remained unharmed.
"Go!"
After taking Xu Ping’s strike, Song Fei tossed the small golden sword skyward, pinching a magic technique with both hands.
In an instant, countless small golden swords materialized in the void, formed by Spiritual Qi.
"Fall!"
Buzz buzz buzz!
With a gesture of his finger, the small golden swords poured down like raindrops, emitting deafening sword cries, directly charging toward Xu Ping.
Facing the overwhelming golden sword rain, Xu Ping remained calm!
He wielded the Purple Sun Sword, Mana surging, releasing continuous slashes, sword lights over a zhang long appeared, crossing and weaving, forming a large sword light net, meeting the tidal sword rain.
Boom boom boom!
The overwhelming golden sword rain fell upon the sword light net, sending forth tremendous booms.
The golden sword rain fell upon the sword light net, producing immense booms, akin to the clash of thunder and storm, tearing the surrounding Spiritual Qi into chaotic torrents.
However, the sword light net, like an impenetrable cage, sealed off the golden sword rain outside.
"So strong!"
Everyone present at the scene felt a tinge of fear, knowing they couldn’t withstand this if they faced it!
"Now, take this slash from me!"
Xu Ping’s voice thundered like a storm, as he swung the Purple Sun Sword.
With a thunderous blast, a dazzling sword light emerged like a Thunder Flood Dragon, winding and moving, carrying unparalleled sharpness, directly targeting Song Fei.
"Slash!"
Song Fei gritted his teeth, the small golden sword shimmering brilliantly in his hand, forcibly confronting it.
He truly hadn’t anticipated that the other’s Swordsmanship would be so formidable; even a general Late-Stage Foundation Establishment might not be his match.
Boom!
The two sword lights collided again, akin to two mountains clashing, sending forth deafening thunderous booms.
Crack!
With a crisp shattering sound, Song Fei’s sword light was defeated once more.
The dazzling sword light descended heavily like a Thunder Dragon, striking directly at the defense Spiritual Barrier beside him.
Bam!
The defense Spiritual Barrier couldn’t hold up under the strike, exploding, perishing along with the sword light!
The explosion’s Spiritual Qi fluctuation pushed Song Li back tens of zhang, his aura surging uncontrollably, his face momentarily paling.
Clearly, he suffered internal injuries.
"Is this all your skill?" Xu Ping held his sword single-handedly, a hint of mockery in his mouth, his gaze sharp, directly staring at Song Fei.
"You..."
Facing the mockery from Xu Ping, Song Li’s eyes turned red, his killing intent filling his heart!
Driven to such a state by a Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, while taunted mercilessly, he couldn’t suppress the fury in his heart.
"You forced me!"
He roared angrily, striking his chest fiercely, spraying a mouthful of essence blood onto the small golden sword.
Buzz!
The golden little sword was stained blood red by the essence blood, its blade trembled incessantly, as if responding to Song Fei’s anger.
"Die!"
Song Li’s face twisted with fierceness, as he pinched a magic technique, the golden little sword sliced through the air.
Roar!
In an instant, the brilliant sword light transformed into a blood dragon dozens of feet long, roaring as it charged towards Xu Ping, seemingly wanting to devour everything.
"Interesting!" Xu Ping showed a look of surprise.
This strike was stronger than the attack of an ordinary Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivator by several notches.
However, in front of him, it still wasn’t enough.
"Spirit Summoning Skill!"
Xu Ping uttered softly, as an illusory snake shadow forcibly merged into his body.
His aura climbed rapidly, almost instantly reaching the threshold of an ordinary Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator!
"Slash!"
Xu Ping held the Purple Sun Sword, slashing with one strike.
Rumble!
Accompanied by a thunderous roar, the sword light seemed to tear through the void, carrying a sharp, endless force, slashing towards the blood dragon!
Crack!
In the blink of an eye, the splendid sword light pierced through the blood dragon’s head and body from below, the unmatched sword Qi shredded the dozens of feet long body into dust.
Then the residual force of the sword light continued unabated, heading straight for Song Li.
"What!"
Song Li’s eyes widened in fear, an unspeakable terror rose in his heart, his essence blood-consuming strike still couldn’t withstand the opponent’s attack!
He hastily pulled out various defensive charms and magical artifacts, hoping to block this sword light.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
However, in front of this brilliant sword light, the protective shields were fragile like paper, easily slashed through.
"Stop, we surrender!"
At this moment, the distant Song family cultivators watching turned pale, regardless of the fact that it was a solo duel, without hesitation, they activated their magical artifacts to stop Xu Ping.
However, they were too far away, unable to make it in time, only able to watch helplessly as the sword light broke through Song Fei’s last line of defense, heading straight for his head.
"No!"
Song Fei’s eyes showed intense fear, the shadow of death seemed to be about to descend.
Puff!
However, the expected beheading did not occur, at the last moment, the sword light deviated, leaving only a deep sword mark on Song Fei’s shoulder, blood gushing out.
"Do you concede?"
Xu Ping instantaneously appeared in front of Song Fei, the Purple Sun Sword pressed against his forehead, looking down at him.
Although he could kill him, he was not yet a match for the Song family’s Fake Pill elder; he did not currently wish for a mortal enmity with them!
Of course, since the opponent harbored murderous intent against him, intending to kill him outright, he wouldn’t forget that.
He would find a chance to secretly kill him.
Or, after mastering the Sword Array, he could also exterminate the entire Song family.
"I concede, I concede!"
With a new lease on life, Song Fei lost all will to fight, his pale face was full of fear, nodding repeatedly.
"Elder brother isn’t dead!"
Distant Song family cultivators sighed with relief at the sight.
Song Fei was the only cultivator in the Song family with hope to reach the Golden Core; if he were killed here, it would cause immeasurable loss to the family.
Thankfully, the opponent held back!
At this moment, their gaze inevitably fell on Xu Ping, who effortlessly defeated Song Fei, a strong sense of dread rising in their hearts.
This person was really too strong, probably in the entire Song family, only the ancestor could suppress him.
"Is this Fellow Daoist Xu?"
Inside the Array, Gong Yang was dumbfounded watching Xu Ping move the Purple Sun Sword away from Song Fei’s forehead, feeling somewhat unreal!
He originally thought that even if Xu Ping revealed his hidden cultivation level, he could at best exchange a few moves with the opponent.
Unexpectedly, Xu Ping so effortlessly defeated Song Fei, this combat power was probably unmatched even by most Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivators.
Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivators were notable even in the entire Yue Country, let alone in the Wanzhe Waters!
Furthermore, Xu Ping was only at Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment, if he reached Late-Stage Foundation Establishment, wouldn’t he could dominate the Foundation Establishment stage?
At this moment, Duan Shuang wasn’t much better, her face full of shock, her beautiful eyes sparkling.
...
...
After the Song family cultivators left sullenly,
Xu Ping, Duan Shuang, and Gong Yang sat in the pavilion on Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"What’s the matter, do you two not recognize me anymore?"
Seeing the two of them staring at him without blinking, Xu Ping asked jokingly.

chapters.title: Chapter 189 - 162: Song Family Ancestor
chapters.content:
Chapter 189: Chapter 162: Song Family Ancestor
"Fellow Daoist Xu, you’ve truly hidden yourself well!" Gong Yang sighed, with a hint of admiration in his tone.
Xu Ping had acted twice since arriving at Purple Bamboo Mountain, but each time had exceeded Gong Yang’s expectations.
"Congratulations, Fellow Daoist Xu, you’ll surely be renowned throughout the Wanzhe Waters now!" Duan Shuang also laughed.
"It’s all just empty fame," Xu Ping smiled slightly, modestly.
"However, we’ve offended the Song family quite severely this time. I’m worried whether they’ll let this go without retaliation?" Duan Shuang’s face showed a trace of concern.
After all, the Song family had a Fake Pill ancestor, and although Xu Ping was strong, he was still far from matching a Fake Pill cultivator.
"Fellow Daoist Duan, there’s no need to worry about this matter!"
"If I’m not mistaken, your Mountain Protection Array probably isn’t simple and might have reached a Quasi-Tier Three level, which should be able to block Fake Pill cultivators, right?"
Gong Yang’s eyes shone sharply, revealing a touch of shrewdness.
Xu Ping smiled faintly, nodding in acknowledgement, "Fellow Daoist Gong sure has keen insight. If the Song family decides to break things off with us, you two can simply come to my Thousand Leaves Mountain, where I can protect you both thoroughly!"
"However, the chance of the Song family breaking ties with us is low, since Fellow Daoist Xu didn’t strike lethally; he not only spared Song Fei’s life but also didn’t harm his foundation."
"Furthermore, with the array present, unless the Song family members are fools, they won’t want to offend such a talented Sword Cultivator like Fellow Daoist Xu!"
Gong Yang stroked his beard with a smile, full of confidence.
"Gong Yang certainly has more confidence than myself!" Xu Ping teased.
But the other party was indeed correct; the chance of the Song family breaking ties is small. If something unpredictable happens, worst comes to worst, he can just flee.
As for Gong Yang and Duan Shuang, they would just have to wait for him to avenge them in the future.
Subsequently, Xu Ping turned to inquire about the relic.
"All factions heavily invested this time, even using several Third-rank Breaking Array Talismans to successfully breach a small portion of the core restrictions...."
Duan Shuang slowly recounted the events in the relics, also explaining how they competed with Song Fei for the Jade Longevity Fruit.
"So, does this mean the exploration of the relics has barely reached the inner circle?"
Xu Ping had asked the most crucial part.
Gong Yang and Duan Shuang exchanged glances: "That’s right... even within the inner circle, quite a few Third-rank items have appeared. In the core building, while there might not be Spirit Objects like the Infant Devouring Fruit, there could very well be Nascent Soul Formation Spiritual Objects!"
"It’s just puzzling that the Luoyun Sect has been going all out, with five or six Golden Core cultivators firmly occupying several core areas, seeming certain of some Nascent Soul Formation Spiritual Objects in the relic, while the Shuize Sect isn’t all that interested, merely collecting various Spiritual Objects within the inner circle!"
"After all, the Luoyun Sect is a Nascent Soul sect; they certainly know more than us loose cultivators!" To this, Xu Ping smiled slightly, but bore it without much concern.
The power struggles between two major forces didn’t concern him, as long as he wasn’t caught in the crossfire.
"By the way, Fellow Daoist Xu mentioned wanting to purchase a set of talisman inheritance previously, and during the relic exploration, I happened to find one."
Duan Shuang handed over a jade slip with a smiling face.
"Talisman Inheritance!"
Xu Ping’s eyes lit up the moment he received the jade slip, and upon probing it with his Divine Sense, he was pleasantly surprised to find that this talisman inheritance recorded up to the Third-rank Middle Grade level.
"Many thanks, Fellow Daoist Duan!" he cupped his hands in sincere gratitude.
This set of Third-rank Talisman Inheritance was invaluable and immensely useful to him.
"You’re too kind, Fellow Daoist Xu; if not for your generosity in providing those talismans and puppets to both myself and Fellow Daoist Gong, we wouldn’t have been able to acquire so many things."
"Moreover, Fellow Daoist Gong and I have already copied a set of the inheritance!" Duan Shuang smiled lightly.
...
...
After more casual chatter, Duan Shuang and Gong Yangling hurriedly departed, aiming to enter their secluded retreat for healing.
Xu Ping then made his way to the cultivation chamber alone.
Eagerly, he took out the Hundred-Year Fruit.
"Hundred-Year Fruit!"
Smelling the crystalline, fragrant spirit peach, Xu Ping couldn’t help but reveal a smile.
A Quasi-Tier Three spirit fruit; an ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivator consuming it would at least gain an extension of over twenty years, and surely he would gain even more.
Without any hesitation, he swallowed it in several bites.
As he ingested it, the Hundred-Year Peach was continually refined in his stomach by Longevity Mana, turning into a continuous flow of essence, nourishing his being.
A small half-hour later, the Hundred-Year Peach was completely absorbed.
"Life extended by fifty years, proficiency increased by fifty points!"
Looking at the proficiency panel, Xu Ping felt elated; his lifespan had finally broken through four hundred, reaching four hundred forty-eight!
His lifespan was now double that of Foundation Establishment cultivators, not much less than Golden Core cultivators.
"Alas, such a long lifespan can be a kind of trouble at times!" Xu Ping couldn’t help but smile wryly.
...
After admiring the panel for a bit, Xu Ping finally closed it.
Then, with a flip of his palm, the Third-rank Talisman Inheritance jade slip appeared in his hand. He immediately infused it with his Divine Sense to begin comprehending.
This set of Third-rank Talisman Inheritance was extremely beneficial to him; crafting a Third-rank talisman would undoubtedly increase his trump cards.
Throughout the Yue Country, Third-rank talismans were rare commodities.
Not even mentioning Foundation Establishment, even among Golden Core cultivators, there might not be many.
So far, he hadn’t seen any Foundation Establishment cultivator with a Third-rank talisman.
...
...
Half a month later.
A yellow-robed Taoist quietly approached Thousand Leaves Mountain, without attracting anyone’s attention.
"This array...?"
The yellow-robed Taoist’s eyes emitted a green light, directly penetrating the barrier of the array to view the full landscape of Thousand Leaves Mountain. However, when he attempted to further explore Xu Ping’s cave abode, he was blocked by a flash of the array’s spirit light, and no matter how much mana he increased, it had no effect.

chapters.title: Chapter 190 - 162: The Song Family Ancestor (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 190: Chapter 162: The Song Family Ancestor (Part 2)
"An array within an array? And these two formations are connected, enhancing their power!" The yellow-robed Taoist was secretly surprised in his heart.
The combination of the two formations produced a result greater than the sum of their parts, reaching the level of a Quasi-Tier Three Array. Even he could do nothing about it!
"Which Array Master set this up?" The yellow-robed Taoist frowned in thought.
The two formations were combined so cleverly that even a Second-stage Upper Grade Array Master could not have achieved it; only a Third-stage Array Master could have that capability.
But after pondering for a long time, he still had no clue, and had no choice but to give up.
"He really has become a force to be reckoned with!" The yellow-robed Taoist took a deep look at Thousand Leaves Mountain before quietly leaving.
...
...
Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Cultivation Room.
Xu Ping was concentrating on studying the inheritance of talismans when he suddenly looked up sharply, his face changing: "Someone is spying on the formation!!"
This person was hidden extremely well, and if it weren’t for Xu Ping’s powerful Divine Sense and his detailed understanding of the formation’s subtle changes, he would never have detected this strange aura.
A person with such cultivation and means is at least a Fake Pill cultivator.
"Who could it be?"
"The Fake Pill ancestor of the Song family?"
Xu Ping immediately thought of the Song family ancestor, after all, the only ones he had wronged were the Song family.
"Do they want to explore my capabilities?"
Xu Ping’s mouth couldn’t help but curl into a cold smile. Then, with a flip of his hand, a control token for the formation suddenly appeared in his hand.
He performed a spell, infusing Mana into it.
Buzz!
As the Mana flowed in, the formation’s token burst with a strong spiritual light, and the Mountain Protection Array and the array protecting the cave residence quietly began to operate.
A protective spiritual light enveloped the entire cave residence.
Time slowly passed.
Half an incense stick later.
Xu Ping sensed that the prying gaze had disappeared.
"Gone?"
His gaze turned slightly cold, and a surge of killing intent welled up in his heart: "The Song family is courting death!"
He had been hesitating whether to kill Song Fei alone or to completely annihilate the entire Song family.
Now there’s no need to hesitate.
Since the other party already has him in their sights, he too would not hold back.
But he currently was not a match for the Song family ancestor.
"Looks like I need to remain in Thousand Leaves Mountain for a while." Xu Ping’s expression was calm.
He currently lacked no cultivation resources, had everything he needed, and there was no necessity to venture out.
"Once I’ve perfected my Sword Array, reached Foundation Establishment Perfection, and fully mastered my swordsmanship, then not to mention Fake Pill cultivators, even Golden Core cultivators, I will have the confidence to face."
"But, should I tell Duan Shuang and Gong Yang about this matter?" Xu Ping hesitated in his heart.
After thinking for a moment, he decided against it.
The Song family ancestor secretly explored the formation’s strength, clearly not wanting to attract Xu Ping’s attention nor completely fracture relations.
Their target is him; Duan Shuang and Gong Yang have no threat in the eyes of the Song family.
As long as he exists, Song family cultivators would not harm the two.
"Song family, once I reach Foundation Establishment Perfection, master the Sword Array, and have my swordsmanship shine brightly, your demise is inevitable!"
"But that will take at least decades, by then I might be seventy or eighty years old..."
"Oh, it turns out my lifespan is around four hundred years, so I will still be overly youthful then."
"Then there’s no problem!"
Xu Ping continued silently delving into the Third-rank Talisman Inheritance in his hand!
...
...
Ten days later.
Song family grounds.
In the core of the Third-stage Spirit Vein, Song Fei stood respectfully in front of the yellow-robed Taoist, full of anticipation, and asked: "Uncle, could you assess the formation’s details and whether it can be broken?"
The yellow-robed Taoist maintained a calm demeanor and spoke in a soft tone: "The Mountain Protection Array of Thousand Leaves Mountain, though not a Quasi-Tier Three Array, is composed of two subtly combined Second-stage Upper Grade formations, and its burst power is not inferior to a Quasi-Tier Three Array."
"With the Song family’s strength, it is difficult to break it."
"Damn it!"
Seeing this hope dashed, Song Fei grit his teeth, his heart filled with rage.
Having cultivated for nearly a hundred years, he had never suffered such humiliation nor been so close to death.
Now thinking about it, his shoulder still felt somewhat faintly painful!
"Such a small failure makes you lose your composure like this, and yet you claim to be the Song family’s only Golden Core seed?" The yellow-robed Taoist frowned and reprimanded Song Fei seeing his demeanor.
"The path of Immortal cultivation is long, who can dwell on temporary wins or losses?"
"Even if his current combat power is unmatched, forming a Golden Core is still immensely difficult, while you have the Song family as your support, and with the advent of this relic, your hope of reaching Golden Core far surpasses his!"
"After you achieve Golden Core, and he remains at Foundation Establishment, taking his life will be as easy as pie!"
The words of the yellow-robed Taoist, though not loud, pierced deep into Song Fei’s heart like a basin of cold water extinguishing his inner fury.
"Uncle’s reprimand is right, nephew understands!" Song Fei took a deep breath, made a respectful bow.
With great talent, he was naturally not a foolish person, he understood this reasoning.
It was only for a moment that anger and humiliation clouded his mind.
"It’s good that you understand!" Seeing Song Fei come to his senses, the yellow-robed Taoist nodded with satisfaction, then instructed, "Have Song Qiwu send some gifts to Xu Ping."
"Why is this?"
"Is my Song family afraid of him?"
The anger that Song Fei had managed to dissipate nearly ignited again.
"Foolish!"
"Can’t you see through this?" The yellow-robed Taoist rebuked.
"Our Song family certainly does not fear him, but for now, we can do nothing to him."
"Moreover, from the fact that he spared your life and didn’t harm your foundation, it is clear that he also does not wish to tear our Song family apart. Sending some gifts to ease the relationship is beneficial for both parties!"

chapters.title: Chapter 191 - 162: Song Family Ancestor_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 191: Chapter 162: Song Family Ancestor_3
"This is the first reason. The second is that gift-giving can also lower his guard, making him think our Song family bears no grudges with him. If he comes out of Thousand Leaves Mountain, I’ll seize the opportunity to personally end his life!"
Upon hearing this, Song Fei immediately nodded in admiration, "Uncle, your insight is impressive. I truly admire it!"
"Go now and remember to handle the matters I’ve assigned!" The yellow-robed Taoist nodded.
"Yes!"
After Song Fei cupped his hands in salute, he respectfully withdrew.
...
...
Over a month later.
Thousand Leaves Mountain, cultivation chamber.
Xu Ping took a piece of Second-stage talisman paper, spread it open on the stone table, and then lightly dipped a brush into spiritual ink made from Second-stage Demon Beast blood. Without any hesitation, he began to write.
The strokes flowed smoothly, like water, with no hindrance. The Spiritual Power was steady, and everything proceeded flawlessly, without the slightest accident.
"It’s done!"
Seeing the spiritual light of the Celestial Thunder Talisman completely subdued, Xu Ping smiled faintly.
After spending two months, he finally succeeded in drawing the Second-stage Lower Grade talisman--the Celestial Thunder Talisman.
For others, this speed would be deemed monstrous, yet Xu Ping found it quite normal.
He could originally draw talismans with considerable skill, and with the assistance of the panel and Divine Sense, completing the Second-stage Lower Grade talisman in two months was quite normal.
As Xu Ping put away the Celestial Thunder Talisman and prepared to draw the second one, he seemed to sense something, stepped out of the cave, and dispersed the mist of the Array.
He saw the sky above Flower Butterfly Mountain filled with a vast Spiritual Qi.
"Is this... a breakthrough to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment?" Xu Ping’s face showed a trace of surprise.
But upon reflection, it seemed reasonable. As Duan Shuang had a Pure Yin Body, her innate talent was exceptionally strong.
Moreover, with considerable rewards from this relic exploration, breaking through to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment was only logical.
"It seems I need to go and congratulate her." Xu Ping smiled.
He was quite pleased about Duan Shuang’s breakthrough to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment.
This also meant that Duan Shuang and Gong Yang’s chances of obtaining the things he desired from the relics increased again.
...
...
Three days later, after Duan Shuang had completely stabilized her cultivation, Xu Ping and Gong Yang went to Flower Butterfly Mountain to congratulate her.
"Fellow Daoist Duan has broken through to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment at just over fifty, while I am over a hundred and still circling at Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment," Gong Yang said enviously.
"Fellow Daoist Gong is modest, your improvements aren’t small either. You’re now at the peak of Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment, just a step away from breaking through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment," Xu Ping smiled.
"But I don’t know when I’ll be able to break through this last step!" Gong Yang said worriedly.
Though he reached the peak of Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment thanks to the opportunities from the relic, he could clearly feel the bottleneck.
Without external help, breaking through indeed seemed very difficult.
’It seems the relic’s opportunities are necessary. Now that Fellow Daoist Duan has broken through to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment, our chances of obtaining them together have increased.’
’But we’ve offended the Song family gravely, and I’m afraid if we meet again in the relics, we’ll encounter danger!’ Gong Yang thought inwardly.
...
Inside Duan Shuang’s cave.
"Congratulations to Fellow Daoist Duan for advancing further on the path of the Great Dao. You now have hope of achieving the Golden Core!" Xu Ping and Gong Yang both congratulated with smiles.
Immediately, the maid delivered their congratulatory gifts before Duan Shuang.
Gong Yang’s gift was a one-time-use defensive Jade Token, while Xu Ping’s gift was a Second-stage Beauty Pill.
"Thanks for your kind words, dear Daoists. Please have a seat!"
Seeing the Second-stage Beauty Pill Xu Ping gifted, Duan Shuang’s eyes sparkled, her smile radiant, and she warmly invited the two of them to a stone table laid with delicious cuisine.
Clearly, she favored Xu Ping’s gift more.
Seeing this, Gong Yang was speechless.
In terms of value and practicality, his one-time-use defensive Jade Token was undoubtedly superior.

chapters.title: Chapter 192 - 163: Reconciliation with the Song Family?
chapters.content:
Chapter 192: Chapter 163: Reconciliation with the Song Family?
The banquet continued amidst laughter and merriment, with Duan Shuang eagerly instructing the maidservants to dance, adding to the lively atmosphere.
However, at that moment, an unexpected guest disrupted the joyous scene.
"I am Song Qiwu of the Song family, here specifically to visit all you fellow daoists!" A deep voice pierced through the array, reaching everyone’s ears.
"Song Qiwu, is the Song family here to cause trouble?" Duan Shuang and Gong Yang frowned, their hearts on alert.
Meanwhile, Xu Ping had an expression of contemplation.
The three of them stepped out of the cave dwelling and dispersed the fog surrounding the array.
They saw above the array, a slightly chubby middle-aged man, whose cultivation was only at Early-Stage Foundation Establishment, standing confidently on a bluish-green Spiritual Boat, smiling as he cupped his hands in greeting, "I am Song Qiwu, greetings to you three fellow daoists."
"Fellow Daoist Song is too kind, may I ask what brings you to us three?"
Seeing Duan Shuang and Gong Yang’s gazes fixed on him, Xu Ping no longer hesitated, stepping forward, his tone polite and inquiring.
Though he wished to cut down all cultivators of the Song family, at this moment, he needed to exchange pleasantries with them.
"My cousin Song Fei and you three fellow daoists had some misunderstandings, so our family’s ancestor specially sent me to mediate with you."
Song Qiwu’s expression was gentle, his tone warm, "Would the three fellow daoists mind opening the array to let me in for a detailed discussion?"
"Resolve the misunderstandings?"
Gong Yang was momentarily stunned, but when he realized, he was overjoyed, decisively giving Xu Ping a meaningful glance, hoping he would let him in.
The Song family actually taking the initiative to resolve the disputes between both parties was indeed a great thing!
Though they were hiding in Fellow Daoist Xu’s Thousand Leaves Mountain, unafraid of the Song family, the Song family was, after all, a Fake Pill family. If they tore each other apart, life would not go easy for them either.
It wasn’t even impossible that they might pay any cost to take over Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Resolving the disputes now was undoubtedly the best choice.
Xu Ping’s eyes flashed subtly, smiling as he said, "That’s naturally not a problem, guests are always welcome, Fellow Daoist Duan, please open the array for Fellow Daoist Song to come in."
He understood this was the Song family’s patriarch choosing this path upon realizing they couldn’t conquer Thousand Leaves Mountain.
If he didn’t know about this, perhaps the relationship really could have been eased.
But for the Song family, who bore murderous intent yet had to reluctantly choose to ease tensions due to being unable to conquer Thousand Leaves Mountain, he naturally wouldn’t let it slide.
Yet, with the enemy strong and them currently weak, easing tensions temporarily was undoubtedly the best option.
Cultivation is about stability, what is temporary anger worth?
When the time comes that his strength overwhelms them, it will be their end.
"I understand."
Upon hearing Xu Ping’s words, Duan Shuang smiled slightly, taking out the token to open the array passage, inviting Song Qiwu inside.
...
...
Within a side hall in Flower Butterfly Mountain.
Song Qiwu exchanged a few pleasantries with Xu Ping and the other two before getting to the main topic: "My cousin has an impulsive temper, and being unfamiliar with the background of you three fellow daoists, reacted so impetuously in that situation."
"He bears no malice towards you three fellow daoists, and hopes you’ll understand." His tone contained a measure of helplessness.
"No harm done, no harm done, we understand Fellow Daoist Song Fei’s impulsive nature, it’s good that the misunderstanding is cleared up." Gong Yang eagerly picked up the conversation, quickly giving Xu Ping a glance.
Seeing Gong Yang so eager, Xu Ping was silently speechless.
Really, since they approached us to resolve the dispute, at least show a bit of restraint!
But upon reflecting, he seemed always to be like this.
"I see, as the saying goes, one doesn’t get acquainted without a fight. The Cultivation Realm is ever-changing, making more friends is always beneficial."
Xu Ping smiled slightly, though he knew that Song Qiwu’s claim that Song Fei bore no malice was only fit to deceive a child.
But he intended to temporarily ease the tensions, so he didn’t care what lousy excuses they used.
"Fellow Daoist Xu is absolutely right!" Hearing this, Song Qiwu’s smile became even brighter, "Fellow Daoist Xu’s swordsmanship is unparalleled, and his magnanimity is truly a model for our cultivators!"
"Fellow Daoist Song is overpraising me." Xu Ping quickly waved his hand, though inwardly he sneered.
Seeing this scene, Gong Yang finally breathed a sigh of relief.
He was afraid that Xu Ping would stubbornly refuse to relent.
Looks like Xu Ping understands flexibility!
"Now that the misunderstanding is cleared, everyone is happy, why not have a drink, everyone?"
As the host of the cave dwelling, Duan Shuang raised her cup, smiling brightly, seemingly sweeping away all the tension.
"Just what I wanted!" Song Qiwu lifted his cup with a full smile, downing it heartily in one go.
With a glass of Spirit Wine down, the atmosphere finally turned harmonious and lively, Song Qiwu having excellent eloquence, the four soon engaged in a hearty conversation akin to old friends, laughter resounding continuously.
The banquet persisted until dusk when Song Qiwu finally took his leave: "Meeting with you three fellow daoists today is such a belated joy, but alas, there are matters in the family awaiting my handling, so I must take my leave."
"This is a gift I specifically prepared for you three fellow daoists, hoping you will accept it with a smile."
He took out three wooden boxes, imbued with restrictions, from his storage ring. With a wave of Mana, the three boxes floated lightly in front of them.
Xu Ping was momentarily stunned, if he didn’t know the Song family patriarch himself investigated his circumstantial truth, he might have really thought they sincerely came to resolve tensions.
"Fellow Daoist Song is indeed too courteous!" Xu Ping smiled, cupping his hands in thanks, swiftly taking the boxes, as the saying goes, one must not refuse what is beneficial.
"Such generous gifts are really overwhelming." Gong Yang showed a broad smile, even more certain in his heart that the Song family came with genuine intentions to reconcile.

chapters.title: Chapter 193 - 163: Song Family Reconciliation? (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 193: Chapter 163: Song Family Reconciliation? (2)
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Song, for the generous gift." Duan Shuang also expressed her gratitude with a smile.
"No need for formalities, Fellow Daoists. It’s just a humble gift, I shall take my leave now." Song Qiwu smiled slightly, turned around, and left.
"Take care, Fellow Daoist." The three of them escorted him out of the cave.
...
Watching the silhouette gradually fade in the distance, Gong Yang sighed, "It seems the Song family genuinely wants to resolve our conflict, and we owe it to Fellow Daoist Xu."
"After all, Fellow Daoist Xu is a swordsmanship prodigy, the Song family surely wouldn’t want to offend him easily." Duan Shuang smiled radiantly, her beautiful eyes glancing over Xu Ping, filled with admiration.
Listening to their admiration, Xu Ping rubbed his nose, "You both flatter me too much, surely the Song family respects all three of us."
"Fellow Daoist Xu, you are too modest. I know my own worth, without you, the Song family might not even glance at me." Gong Yang said self-deprecatingly.
Duan Shuang smiled gently and interjected, "Regardless, the Song family’s initiative to resolve our conflict is worth celebrating, tonight we drink to our heart’s content!"
"Indeed, we drink to our heart’s content!"
...
After Song Qiwu left, the three continued the banquet.
The festivities continued until the end of the hour of Hai.
During this time, Duan Shuang and Gong Yang resumed discussions about continuing the exploration of the ruins.
Now that the Song family has reconciled with them, without a troublesome enemy, the idea of exploring the ruins naturally resurfaced.
Both of them had gained significant benefits from it, so naturally, they wouldn’t easily give it up.
Xu Ping, as usual, funded their puppets and talismans, while asking them to help find spiritual objects for prolonging life.
After a brief discussion, they quickly sorted out all the details: "Alright, we’ll join the underground auction first, then proceed."
"Would Fellow Daoist Xu be interested in joining?" Gong Yang extended the invitation to Xu Ping.
Due to the events related to the ruins, the underground auction was set in the Wanzhe Waters, promising a variety of items.
Duan Shuang and Gong Yang both had items they needed, so they invited Xu Ping to join the auction before exploring the ruins.
"An underground auction, huh?"
Xu Ping’s eyes sparkled, tempted by the idea.
He currently lacked a puppetry technique and a fire attribute demon core.
The puppetry technique goes without saying, and the fire attribute demon core was intended for the Water Lake Mouse to break through to the second-stage.
He already had a water attribute demon core, now he just needed the fire attribute demon core.
However, these two items were rare and not commonly seen in regular markets; perhaps they might only appear at an underground auction.
Yet, thinking of the Song family’s ancestor secretly spying, his excitement quelled.
"I won’t be going." Xu Ping shook his head.
Although the Song family has reconciled with them superficially, Xu Ping was certain they were still secretly observing him.
There was no need to take unnecessary risks.
"However, I would like to trouble you two, Fellow Daoists, to help me buy a puppetry technique and a fire attribute demon core at the underground auction."
"The puppetry technique should be third-grade, and the higher the grade of the fire attribute demon core, the better!" Xu Ping clasped his hands.
Although he wouldn’t attend, entrusting Duan Shuang and Gong Yang could achieve the same goals.
"Third-grade puppetry technique, fire attribute demon core?"
Gong Yang paused, and after realizing, nodded, "That should be no problem, but I’m not sure if they can be found."
While the third-grade puppetry technique and fire attribute demon core are rare, they do not attract the attention of fake pill and Golden Core cultivators; this favor can be helped.
"It’s fine, just do your best, Fellow Daoists." Xu Ping smiled, and then handed each of them a demon core and thousands of spirit stones to cover the auction funds for the puppetry technique and demon core.
"If the spirit stones are insufficient, I’ll be sure to reimburse both of you once you’ve bought the items."
...
...
After the banquet concluded, Xu Ping returned alone to the Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Inside the cultivation room.
Sitting cross-legged on a meditation mat, Xu Ping took out Song Qiwu’s wooden box, and with a swipe of his divine sense, easily erased the restriction on it.
Then he reached out and opened the wooden box, it emitted a faint spiritual qi, revealing a sleek piece of spirit wood, the material was delicate, imbued with a hint of spirituality.
"This is... third-rank spirit wood?" Xu Ping expressed surprise.
Though just a small section, it could be used to create third-rank talisman paper, thus quite valuable.
"The Song family is quite generous; when the time comes to extinguish them, I’ll make sure they don’t feel pain." Xu Ping thought silently.
After putting the third-rank spirit wood back into the wooden box and securing the restrictions, Xu Ping began his cultivation for the day.
...
...
In cultivation, there is no perception of time, and in the blink of an eye, ten days had passed.
After attending the underground auction, Gong Yang sought out Xu Ping.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, the puppetry inheritance was not found at the auction, but I managed to acquire a Second-stage Upper Grade Fire Attribute Demon Core."
Gong Yang, looking resigned, took out a transparent jade box, which contained a fiery red Demon Core.
"A Second-stage Upper Grade Fire Attribute Demon Core?" Xu Ping’s eyes lit up involuntarily.
He hadn’t expected to gather both items in one go, so finding a Second-stage Upper Grade Fire Attribute Demon Core was already an unexpected delight.
It’s important to know that specific attribute Demon Cores are difficult to find. Finding a Second-stage Middle Grade one is already considered good.
With this Second-stage Upper Grade Demon Core, the chance for the water lake rat to break through the second stage increased again.
"Finding a Second-stage Upper Grade Fire Attribute Demon Core is already an unexpected delight. Thank you greatly, Fellow Daoist Gong!" Xu Ping gratefully clasped his hands after storing the Demon Core.
"No need to be so polite, Fellow Daoist Xu; here are the remaining Spirit Stones and Demon Cores!" Gong Yang handed the remaining Spirit Stones and Demon Cores to Xu Ping.
After Xu Ping put everything away, he smiled and asked, "When will Fellow Daoists Gong and Duan go explore the relics?"
"In five days. Fellow Daoist Duan still has some preparations to make and is currently in seclusion," Gong Yang replied.
"I see, may Fellow Daoist Gong accept these talismans and pass a few to Fellow Daoist Duan as well." Xu Ping handed over the Second-stage talismans he had drawn to Gong Yang.
Receiving the Second-stage talismans, Gong Yang chuckled, "I’m truly grateful to Fellow Daoist Xu!"
’To do things for Fellow Daoist Xu, he is indeed generous if it can be accomplished.’
’If I didn’t know how to refine artifacts, I’d consider working for Fellow Daoist Xu full-time.’
After some more casual chatting, Gong Yang took his leave.
With only a few days left before exploring the relics, he naturally needed to make some more preparations.
...
...
After Gong Yang left, Xu Ping leisurely made his way to the spiritual field.
From the outskirts of the Thousand Leaves Mountain peak to the mountainside, a vast expanse of lush green spread out, where spirit plants and spirit medicines were thriving.
In the center of the spiritual field, a verdant Hundred Bamboo Wood was growing straight, emitting waves of Spiritual Qi.
"Tribulation Spirit Skill!"
Xu Ping, with a calm expression, performed a magic technique with his hands, lightly pointing with his fingers. Hundreds of strands of Longevity Mana shot out from his fingertips, instantly hitting the spirit plants and spirit medicines planted in the spiritual field.
Whoosh!
In an instant!
The originally lush spirit plants and spirit medicines quickly turned yellow and withered, and within moments, they turned into masses of black ash, leaving behind clusters of life-filled green light orbs.
"Go!"
With a flick of Xu Ping’s fingers, these clusters of green light orbs instantly merged into the Hundred Bamboo Wood.
Buzz!
As the Hundred Bamboo Wood continuously absorbed these green light orbs, the entire Spirit Wood emanated a green spiritual glow, exuding a rich aura of vitality.
Crack! Crack!
Amidst a series of crisp sounds, the entire Hundred Bamboo Wood began to grow visibly taller.
It grew a full foot taller before gradually stopping.
"The Tribulation Spirit Skill has reached Minor Achievement, and the efficiency has indeed increased considerably!" Seeing the Hundred Bamboo Wood now two meters tall, Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction.
It’s at least twice as efficient as at the proficiency level.
At this rate, in no more than seven years, this Hundred Bamboo Wood will grow enough to refine thirty-six magic swords.
It’s getting close!
...
After performing the Tribulation Spirit Skill, Xu Ping did not forget to use the ’Spirit Storage Skill’ to stabilize the growth of the Hundred Bamboo Wood.
"Come here, and fill this spiritual field with spirit plants and spirit medicine!"
With a thought, Xu Ping summoned the water lake rat and gave it an order!
The water lake rat scampered over, its face full of flattery.
"Work hard, and once you reach the peak of the First Rank, I will help you break through to the second stage!" Xu Ping took out the jade box containing the Second-stage Upper Grade Fire Attribute Demon Core and revealed a slight gap.
The scent of the Demon Core almost made the water lake rat drool.
It patted its chest with its paws, as if to say it would take care of it.
"Go on, work hard!" With a flick of his finger, Xu Ping sent a Pill into the water lake rat’s mouth.
With a ’gulp’, the water lake rat swallowed it and energetically began planting spirit medicine.

chapters.title: Chapter 194 - 164: The Waterlake Rat Breaks Through to Tier 2!
chapters.content:
Chapter 194: Chapter 164: The Waterlake Rat Breaks Through to Tier 2!
Another half a year passed.
Under Xu Ping’s nurturing, the Water Lake Mouse finally reached the peak of the First Rank and could officially begin to break through to the Second-stage.
Inside the cultivation chamber.
Squeak squeak!
The Water Lake Mouse, nearly a zhang tall, stood obediently in front of Xu Ping, its eyes shining, eager to give it a try.
"This mouse is in good condition." Xu Ping nodded inwardly, feeling that it wasn’t in vain that he gave the mouse a few days off to rest and build its strength.
"Get on the stone bed!"
Under Xu Ping’s command, the Water Lake Mouse swiftly climbed onto the stone bed.
Then he placed several auxiliary breakthrough spiritual materials, pills, and two differently colored Demon Cores in front of the stone bed.
Staring at the Demon Cores before it, the Water Lake Mouse almost drooled, but without Xu Ping’s command, it dared not move a muscle.
"Hmph, spending so many resources on you, if you don’t break through to the Second-stage this time, I’ll definitely turn you into a dish!" Xu Ping coldly snorted, deciding to put some pressure on it.
The Water Lake Mouse shivered all over, its scarlet eyes became firm.
"Begin!"
Once everything was ready, Xu Ping retreated to the back, responsible for protecting.
The Water Lake Mouse swallowed all the spiritual materials and the pill in one go.
At that moment.
Bang!
The demonic power within it began to rise, absorbing the Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi.
A demon beast’s abilities mostly lie in their physical body and bloodline, their demand for Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi during a breakthrough is not as big as human cultivators, and the commotion is much smaller.
At a certain moment, the Water Lake Mouse also swallowed the two Demon Cores.
Whoosh bang!
As soon as the Demon Cores were swallowed, the demonic power inside the Water Lake Mouse surged like a violent tide, as if it was about to shatter the entire cultivation chamber.
Fortunately, the array protected it, and the cultivation chamber stood firm.
At this moment, the Water Lake Mouse’s body underwent changes, emitting a faint glow, and the air around it alternated between frigid cold and scorching heat due to its cultivation.
"The commotion from this breakthrough is quite big!" Xu Ping was secretly amazed, while his mana quietly circulated, ready to handle any unforeseen circumstances.
As the power of the Demon Core was gradually absorbed by the Water Lake Mouse, the demonic power inside it began to become unstable.
The Water Lake Mouse’s body trembled slightly, and a flash of pain crossed its eyes.
The surrounding air temperature became even harsher, sometimes bone-chilling cold, sometimes blazing hot.
If it were a first-rank Body Cultivator here, they wouldn’t be able to withstand such temperature changes, but to Xu Ping, it felt like a gentle breeze.
Boom!
After some unknown time, the figure of the Water Lake Mouse gradually became blurry, and the surrounding spiritual energy seemed attracted to it, crazily pouring into its body.
"It’s the critical moment!"
Xu Ping’s eyes slightly narrowed as he flipped his palm, and the token controlling the array appeared in his hand. Then he pinched a spell, injecting a trace of mana into it.
Whoosh!
Instantly, all the spiritual energy of Thousand Leaves Mountain rushed into the cultivation chamber, forming a dense fog of spiritual energy.
At this moment, the Water Lake Mouse suddenly burst into red and blue spiritual light, nearly blinding the eyes.
In the next moment.
With a deafening roar, the body of the Water Lake Mouse suddenly swelled, and its demonic power surged sharply, stepping into the threshold of a second-stage demon beast.
"Success!" Xu Ping’s eyes lit up.
Unexpectedly, however, the Water Lake Mouse’s breakthrough hadn’t ended; extreme cold and scorching heat appeared simultaneously on its body.
Its body seemed to fall into a state of extreme pain.
"Bloodline conflict?" Xu Ping’s heart sank, his Divine Sense spread out, sensing that the Water Lake Mouse’s demonic power inside was violent, its bloodline chaotic, nearly collapsing!
...
...
Ten days later.
The Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi in the sky above Thousand Leaves Mountain’s cave abode was unusually agitated.
Since Duan Shuang and Gong Yang had long since gone out to explore relics, no one noticed.
Inside the cave abode.
Under the cover of two Second-stage arrays, a powerful wave of demonic power erupted, with the wind howling and the stone walls trembling.
The fierce aura was enough to make an Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator moved.
Squeak squeak!
The Water Lake Mouse’s body expanded greatly, its face and limbs were stained with dried blood trails, and the blue and red hair on its body became deeper.
Its scarlet pupils cast a grateful and pleasing emotion toward Xu Ping.
If not for Xu Ping’s thorough preparations, having already refined pills to regulate bloodline conflict, this mouse would have exploded long before it could even think about advancing to the Second-stage.
"As expected, the more naturally talented a demon beast is, the more difficult it is to break through!" Xu Ping felt a pang of emotion.
"Mas... Master!"
At this moment, a childlike voice sounded in Xu Ping’s mind.
"Divine Sense transmission!" Xu Ping looked at the Water Lake Mouse, full of a flattering look, surprise crossing his face.
To know that even some Second-stage Upper Grade demon beasts do not possess Divine Sense transmission, it’s surprising that this mouse learned it just after breaking through to the Second-stage.
It seems this mouse is indeed extraordinarily gifted, certainly also having much to do with being raised by a cultivator.
"Interesting!" Xu Ping stroked his chin, though he was very much interested in exploring what other abilities this mouse acquired upon its breakthrough to the Second-stage, but considering it just advanced, it still needed to stabilize its state.
...
...
A month later, the Water Lake Mouse’s stage was stabilized.
Now, it was a veritable early-stage Second-stage demon beast, matching human Foundation Establishment cultivators.
Inside the cave abode, Xu Ping tested the Water Lake Mouse’s capabilities.
First and foremost was the ability to spit demon fire.
Boom!
A clump of purple demon fire spewed from the Water Lake Mouse’s mouth, the scorching heat almost melting the stone bed. Fortunately, the cultivation chamber was bolstered by an array; otherwise, the entire room might have been incinerated.
"This fire is so formidable!" Xu Ping was secretly amazed, feeling threatened by the fire even with his physique, likely not inferior to some Second-stage Middle Grade demon fires.

chapters.title: Chapter 195 - 164: Waterlake Rat Breaks Through to Tier 2! (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 195: Chapter 164: Waterlake Rat Breaks Through to Tier 2! (Part 2)
"That’s right!" Xu Ping nodded with satisfaction.
Squeak!
The Waterlake Mouse’s face revealed a pleased expression.
"Master, I can do another Divine Technique!" the Waterlake Mouse offered as if presenting a treasure.
After a month of practice, it had become very proficient in using Divine Sense to convey messages.
"Oh?"
Xu Ping’s eyes flashed with curiosity, and he immediately instructed, "What is it? Show it to me!"
"Master, this place is too small. It’s difficult to exhibit it." The Waterlake Mouse was a bit troubled.
"Then go outside the cave!" Xu Ping decisively said.
...
...
One person and one mouse arrived at an open space at the top of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"Start!" Xu Ping stepped back, leaving enough space for the Waterlake Mouse, and then looked at it with interest.
Squeak!
The Waterlake Mouse let out a roar, and a powerful wave of Demonic Power erupted. A red and blue colored spirit light rose from its body, even its originally blood-red eyes turned one red and one blue.
Buzz!
A mass of ghostly blue water and a mass of scorching purple fire formed in front of the Waterlake Mouse’s mouth, and a strong pressure permeated the top of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
In the next instant.
Bam!
The ghostly blue water sphere and scorching purple fire shot from the front of the Waterlake Mouse’s mouth like two meteors, spiraled through the air, and directly blasted onto a small hill.
Boom!
A resounding roar, rubble splattered, smoke and dust rose, and the small hill was forcibly flattened to pieces.
"The power of this Divine Technique is quite impressive. It’s probably not weaker than the attack of a Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator!" Xu Ping’s eyes shone.
Breakthroughs are difficult, but the benefits obtained are also greater.
Although this mouse is still far from being comparable to him, with its current combat power, it might be able to contend against a Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
Squeak!
Listening to Xu Ping’s praise, the Waterlake Mouse’s face showed an even more obvious proud expression.
"Hmph, I let you test it, not flatten that small hill! You must know that every grass and tree on Thousand Leaves Mountain is mine." Xu Ping sneered.
The Waterlake Mouse’s originally proud expression instantly froze on its face.
What? How can he change his expression so quickly!
"Come over here!" Xu Ping said coldly.
The Waterlake Mouse hurried over, squeezing out a flattering smile... although with its mouse face, it looked particularly terrifying.
Xu Ping beckoned with his hand, and the Waterlake Mouse obediently leaned its head on his palm. Then Xu Ping released his Divine Sense outward and further reinforced the enslavement mark.
After the Waterlake Mouse broke through to the second stage, the original enslavement mark became less stable.
Although Xu Ping wasn’t afraid due to his cultivation level, to prevent any accident, further reinforcement was necessary.
During this process, the Waterlake Mouse didn’t resist at all. It allowed Xu Ping to strengthen control over it again, and even showed a pleasing smile, lacking any arrogance of a Second-stage Demon Beast.
After the enslavement mark was reinforced, Xu Ping’s expression softened a bit: "Count yourself smart. From now on, take good care of the Spirit Medicine and Spirit Plants for me!"
"No problem, Master, leave it to me!" The Waterlake Mouse confidently patted its chest.
"Hmm, go then." Xu Ping nodded.
The Waterlake Mouse followed Xu Ping’s orders, running off to tend to the Spirit Medicine and Spirit Plants.
After a simple glance, Xu Ping returned to the cave to begin cultivation.
For the past two months, in order to help the Waterlake Mouse break through to the second stage, he hadn’t properly cultivated.
...
...
Time passed quietly like sand slipping through fingers.
Half a year later, late at night.
Luoyun Sect.
The night sky hung low, and stars adorned the firmament, like numerous dazzling jewels embedded in a black silk fabric.
The towering mountain peaks stood like majestic giants in the tranquil night.
Suddenly!
Whoosh!
An Escape Light surged in, breaking the tranquility of the mountain top night.
"Master, a trace of the Infant Devouring Pill was indeed discovered in the relic!"
The Escape Light dissipated, revealing a middle-aged man with three strands of long beard, who displayed a strong sense of joy in his tone.
Upon hearing this, the richly dressed elder sitting at the mountain top abruptly opened his eyes. An overwhelming spiritual pressure that could chill Golden Core cultivators suddenly surged from his body.
"Tell me in detail!" the richly dressed elder calmly said, and the huge spiritual pressure also instantly withdrew.
"Yes!" The middle-aged man respectfully replied, letting out a sigh of relief.
The spiritual pressure of a Nascent Soul was truly terrifying. Even being a cultivator at Golden Core Perfection, in front of this pressure, he felt like a small boat that could capsize at any moment in a storm.
After collecting himself, he began to explain in detail: "The Infant Devouring Pill was discovered in the core relic of the ruins. When we broke through the outer restrictions, we saw a gray-purple pill quickly flash in the internal restriction."
"Although it was just a fleeting moment, I’m sure the characteristics and appearance of this pill are exactly the same as the Infant Devouring Pill.
"But the only thing puzzling is that this pill seems to have some sort of sentience, as it moves about within the restriction."
"Sentience?" The richly dressed elder showed a hint of surprise on his face; according to him, the Infant Devouring Pill shouldn’t have such manifestations.
He frowned and pondered for a moment, then spoke:
"The Infant Devouring Pill is originally refined from the sap of the Infant Devouring Fruit, which inherently contains a trace of sentience. Over thousands of years, the sentience within the Infant Devouring Pill surely has grown, making its behavior seem like a living being, which is understandable!"
"I see. Then this pill must indeed be the Infant Devouring Pill." Upon hearing the elder’s explanation, the middle-aged man had a sudden realization.
"Hmm!"
The elder nodded in agreement and then stood up, his stooped figure exuding an air of authority: "Since the Infant Devouring Pill has been confirmed, I will retrieve it without delay to avoid unnecessary complications."
"Wait, Master." The middle-aged man hurriedly stopped the elder.
"Anything else?" The elder’s brow slightly furrowed.
After organizing his words, the middle-aged man respectfully said:
"Master, within that core building, apart from the Infant Devouring Pill, there are countless malevolent entities sealed, and I even noticed some reaching Golden Core Perfection level, which is quite shocking!"
"Who knows why Nine Nether Elder captured so many malevolent entities!"
For him, a Golden Core Perfection cultivator, malevolent entities aren’t anything novel, but those at Golden Core Perfection level are very rare.
He had cultivated for hundreds of years, and this was his first time seeing such!
"Malevolent entities?"
Upon hearing this, the elder’s brow tightened, but there was no surprise on his face.
The higher one’s cultivation, the more mysterious malevolent entities become, especially since they seem to have no lifespan limits. If they aren’t slain, they can live indefinitely.
He knew that many Nascent Soul cultivators captured malevolent entities for meticulous study, hoping to glimpse a thread of immortality.
It seems Nine Nether Elder might have been doing the same.
At this moment, the elder seemed to have thought of something. His frown relaxed, and he suddenly burst into laughter: "The emergence of malevolent entities in the relic might not necessarily be a bad thing!"
"Why is that?" The middle-aged man asked in confusion, thinking that the emergence of malevolent entities would complicate their acquisition of the Infant Devouring Pill.
"The malevolent entities breaking free from the seal will certainly first strike the Shuize Sect. With so many malevolent entities to entangle them, during your Nascent Soul breakthrough, they will be overwhelmed and unable to interfere with you." The elder smiled slightly, feeling pleased.
"Master is insightful!" The middle-aged man’s eyes flashed with joy.
The timely opportunity, favorable circumstances, and harmonious people are all in his Luoyun Sect, so this crisis should smoothly pass.
As for whether the malevolent entities breaking free from the seal would harm others in Wanzhe Waters, that wasn’t within their concern.
Just some people dying!
Even if everyone in Wanzhe Waters died, as long as it kept Shuize Sect occupied, it would be a tremendous profit.
...
...
Wanzhe Waters.
Shuize Island.
At the door of a great hall.
The Song family’s ancestor excitedly walked out of the hall, thinking of the Shuize Sect leader’s promise, he couldn’t help but smile.
If they can seize this opportunity, the Song family will soar.
As he was congratulating himself in secret, he saw a Fake Pill cultivator from Shuize Sect hurriedly walking into the hall, seemingly having an urgent matter to report to their Sect Leader.
The Song family’s ancestor glanced briefly before retracting his gaze.
He dared not inquire further about Shuize Sect’s affairs.

chapters.title: Chapter 196 - 165: Tier 3 Talismans
chapters.content:
Chapter 196: Chapter 165: Tier 3 Talismans
In the spacious and grand hall.
A Fake Pill cultivator hurriedly walked into the hall and went straight to the middle-aged man sitting above, urgently reporting:
"Sect Leader, the details of the relic have been clarified. This place was the cultivation ground of the Nine Nether Elder from several thousand years ago."
"The cultivation ground of the Nine Nether Elder?"
The middle-aged man was instantly shocked upon hearing this, and he stared intensely at the Fake Pill cultivator below, immediately asking, "Are you certain?"
Originally, he only thought it was an ordinary relic left behind by a Nascent Soul cultivator, but he never expected it to involve the Nine Nether True Person.
This makes it tricky!
"Absolutely certain!"
The Fake Pill cultivator nodded vigorously, speaking with confidence, "Initially, we had some suspicions from certain clues."
"Yesterday, within a building in the relic that had restrictions set up, we found the notes of the Nine Nether Elder. Thus, we can confirm the origin of this place with one hundred percent certainty!"
"Sect Leader, this relic is the cultivation ground of the Nine Nether Elder. Even if there is no Infant Devouring Fruit, there are likely other Spiritual Objects to aid Nascent Soul Formation. What should we do?"
The Fake Pill cultivator’s words were filled with anxiety.
