If someone from the Luoyun Sect really obtained the Spiritual Objects that assist Nascent Soul Formation and successfully formed a Nascent Soul, their Shuize Sect would be in danger!
The middle-aged man’s face turned somber instantly, and thoughts raced through his mind, quickly comprehending the situation.
The Luoyun Sect might have already confirmed this is the cultivation ground of the Nine Nether True Person, and they also know about the hidden Spiritual Objects that can aid Nascent Soul Formation inside.
Thus, they deliberately released the false news about the existence of the Infant Devouring Fruit to mislead them, to conceal the true secret.
"You may leave for now, keep this matter confidential and await my further instructions!"
The middle-aged man’s face gradually calmed, and he instructed in an indifferent tone.
"Yes!"
Seeing the Sect Leader’s calm demeanor, the Fake Pill cultivator felt somewhat reassured.
After respectfully bowing, he left the hall.
At this moment, only the middle-aged man remained in the empty hall.
"The Luoyun Sect has indeed employed clever tactics, but who will win remains uncertain!" He smirked coldly, then flipped his hand, revealing a talisman with a flickering dark purple glow.
This is a Third-rank Upper Grade Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman, capable of transmitting messages across nations!
...
...
Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Cultivation room.
Xu Ping gazed at the purple talisman papers on the stone table.
These talisman papers, although blank, shimmered with bright spiritual light and emitted a treasure-like glow, clearly not ordinary items.
"The success rate is still a bit low, even with the help of the proficiency panel, using a piece of Third-rank Spirit Wood, only made ten sheets of third-rank talisman paper!"
Xu Ping shook his head helplessly, sighing inwardly.
"I wonder if these ten sheets of third-rank talisman paper can produce at least one third-rank talisman; even if I can draw just one, it would be my gain!"
Despite more than a year of persistent drawing, aided by the proficiency panel.
His skill in drawing talismans had surpassed ordinary Second-stage Upper Grade Talisman Masters, but the failure rate in crafting third-rank talismans was still high.
However, should he succeed even once, with the proficiency panel’s assistance, he could continuously craft third-rank talismans.
Then, holding more than a dozen third-rank talismans, defeating a Fake Pill cultivator would be easy, and even threatening a Golden Core Cultivator wouldn’t be impossible.
"Oh well, although Third-rank Spirit Wood is precious, it can be purchased with time and Spirit Stones. Once these third-rank talisman papers are used up, I can just buy more."
"For now, I should try drawing a third-rank talisman!" Xu Ping composed himself, preparing to start drawing talismans.
However, he did not start drawing immediately but adjusted his state to the peak before attempting.
.....
...
Time flies, and two months passed in the blink of an eye.
Cultivation room.
"This is the last one!"
Seeing the lone last sheet of third-rank talisman paper on the table, Xu Ping felt immensely frustrated.
Crafting this third-rank talisman was truly difficult, wasting as many as nine third-rank talismans.
Fortunately, Xu Ping’s temperament had been honed over the years, becoming exceedingly resilient, and he quickly regained his composure!
Three days later.
After restoring his internal mana to peak condition, Xu Ping prepared for the final attempt.
He meticulously ground the spiritual ink, dipped the talisman brush, and began drawing the third-rank talisman script, stroke by stroke, on a talisman exuding a purple radiance.
Boom!
When the talisman brush had progressed halfway, a change suddenly occurred.
Thunder roared from the purple talisman, and Thunder Power erupted from the talisman, sweeping all around.
In the face of the sudden Thunder Power, Xu Ping remained expressionless, appearing calm and composed.
Under his precise control, the talisman brush continued to move smoothly across the talisman paper.
Gradually, the talisman on the purple background was adorned with patterns resembling thunder.
At this moment, sweat beads increasingly dotted Xu Ping’s forehead, and his internal Longevity Mana was rapidly consumed.
The cyan liquid mana was infused into the talisman paper, consuming nearly half, before barely coming to a halt.
Various lights flashed brilliantly on the talisman paper, but ultimately, silver light retracted, stabilizing it.
"Finally succeeded!"
Seeing his first crafted third-rank talisman ’Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman’, joy flickered in Xu Ping’s eyes.
Luck played a big part in this success. If it were an ordinary person, the success rate would still be terrifyingly low.
But not for him!
[Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman Entry Level: 1/100]
Seeing the information on the panel, Xu Ping’s lips slightly curved: "The rest is simple; I can take my time grinding it out!"

chapters.title: Chapter 197 - 165: Tier 3 Talismans (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 197: Chapter 165: Tier 3 Talismans (2)
As his proficiency improved, the success rate of his talisman crafting would also rise sharply.
"Now I should be considered a Third-rank Talisman Master!"
In major powers, the status of a Third-rank Talisman Master far exceeded that of a Fake Pill cultivator and was comparable to a Golden Core Cultivator.
After admiring the panel for a while, Xu Ping closed it.
Then, he picked up the first "Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman" he had crafted and carefully experienced its essence.
"The Thunder Power contained within... it’s so strong!"
Feeling the vast Thunder Power within the "Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman," Xu Ping couldn’t help but be shocked.
If this talisman were used on him, even if he could withstand it, he would likely suffer serious injuries.
"Indeed, it’s a Third-rank Talisman!" Xu Ping’s face lit up with joy. If he had a dozen Third-rank talismans, he could easily overwhelm a Fake Pill cultivator.
"It’s just that I’m out of Third-rank talisman paper, so it looks like I need to buy more Third-rank Spirit Wood from the Song family!"
Xu Ping had no intention of trading with the Song family himself. He planned to wait for Duan Shuang and Gong Yang to return and have them help contact the Song family for a transaction in Thousand Leaves Mountain.
This way, he could ensure his absolute safety!
"If the Song family knew that the Third-rank Spirit Wood they sold me was finally crafted into a talisman used to destroy their family, I wonder what expression they would have!"
Xu Ping couldn’t help but entertain a slightly mischievous thought.
But on second thought, he decided against it. After all, the Song family had given him a piece of Third-rank Spirit Wood, so there’s no need to kill the heart.
Xu Ping took out a jade box and carefully stored the "Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman."
"Now I just wait for Duan Shuang and Gong Yang to return and help me get in touch with the Song family!"
...
...
Half a month later.
Rather than seeing Duan Shuang and Gong Yang return, Xu Ping was hit with a thunderous piece of news.
Hu Country had invaded again!
"How could this happen?" Xu Ping frowned tightly.
When Hu Country first chose to invade Yue Country, it was because the Nascent Soul Ancestor of the Luoyun Sect had fallen.
But now, although the Nascent Soul Ancestor of the Luoyun Sect didn’t have long to live, he was still alive. Why would Hu Country choose to invade now?
Could it be...
Is it possible that the Nascent Soul ruins really contain Infant Devouring Fruit, or perhaps spiritual objects that can aid in Nascent Soul Formation?
This was the only possibility Xu Ping could think of.
"Now that Hu Country has invaded, I can’t contact my master. Elder, can you reach Senior Brother Duan?" A beautiful maid asked respectfully, with a hint of anxiety in her voice.
She was the housekeeper of Little Hui Mountain, Hua Ling.
It was also she who informed Xu Ping about Hu Country’s invasion.
"I’ve tried using a Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman, but unfortunately I couldn’t reach Fellow Daoist Duan." Xu Ping held the Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman, injected a trace of Mana into it, but the talisman had no response.
"They must still be exploring the ruins!" Xu Ping sighed helplessly.
"What should we do now?" Hua Ling’s pretty face showed a trace of worry and fear.
With Hu Country’s invasion and her master away, she was completely at a loss!
"There’s no need to panic, Miss Hua Ling. We at Purple Bamboo Mountain are united as one. Now that the two fellow Daoists have not yet returned, I also have the responsibility to protect Purple Bamboo Mountain," Xu Ping said solemnly.
Though, if they did encounter some insurmountable danger, he would undoubtedly make a run for it.
He had already planned where to go in such a situation, back to Ten Thousand Mountains!
If Ten Thousand Mountains were no longer safe, then he would hide in the Nightmare Marsh, staying for dozens or even hundreds of years.
In such a long time, surely the war between the two countries would reach a conclusion!
After all, he could completely afford it with his lifespan!
"Thank you, Elder Xu!" Joy filled Hua Ling’s beautiful eyes.
She was well aware of Xu Ping’s battle achievements; he was outright equivalent to a Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivator, much stronger than her master.
A mere petty foe was absolutely no match.
"Miss Hua Ling, please go back to Little Hui Mountain and wait in peace. Don’t go out during this time. If there is any other news, remember to notify me immediately!" Xu Ping instructed.
"I understand!" Hua Ling respectfully bowed and took her leave.
Watching her gradually disappearing figure, Xu Ping’s face grew somber.
Things had been quiet for so little time, and yet war had erupted between the two countries again.
Although his strength had increased greatly compared to before, he was still insignificant amidst the two nations’ conflict.
A mere splash could easily overturn him.
"Moreover, with Hu Country’s invasion, Shuize Sect is bound to make a move!" Xu Ping thought worriedly.
It was obvious that Shuize Sect was supported by Hu Country; they must have some dealings together. With the invasion now, Shuize Sect was bound to act!
If Shuize Sect took action, Purple Bamboo Mountain would inevitably get caught in the crossfire.
Thinking about this, Xu Ping felt an immediate headache.
Being caught between two major forces was truly uncomfortable!
The only relief was that Purple Bamboo Mountain was located behind the Luoyun Sect, temporarily free from Hu Country’s threat!
"Alas, it’s so out of my control!" Xu Ping sighed helplessly.
If only he were stronger, at Nascent Soul capability, he’d have no fear of Hu Country’s invasion!
...
...
Five days later.
Just as Xu Ping had foreseen, Shuize Sect finally took action!
And unexpectedly, they launched a major offensive. Shuize Sect actually declared war on the Luoyun Sect, rallying other forces in the Wanzhe Waters to attack Luoyun Sect together.
Upon hearing this news, Xu Ping was utterly dumbfounded.
Are they planning to tear each other apart and fight to the death?
"Elder Xu, what should we do?" Hua Ling, pale as paper, had a face full of fright, completely at a loss, like a startled bird.

chapters.title: Chapter 198 - 65: Tier 3 Talisman Markings (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 198: Chapter 65: Tier 3 Talisman Markings (3)
For Purple Bamboo Mountain, this matter is more serious than the Hu Country invasion.
Though Hu Country poses no immediate threat to Purple Bamboo Mountain, the Shuize Sect is a fearsome neighbor they cannot move away from. A slight oversight with this neighbor could easily lead to their downfall.
"Alas, I’ve no choice but to take things one step at a time!" Xu Ping sighed helplessly.
The Shuize Sect’s declaration of war seemed to pour fuel onto a raging fire, further complicating the situation in Yue Country.
For a small force like Purple Bamboo Mountain, they are utterly powerless.
At this moment, Xu Ping felt increasingly strong urges to flee, yet he was reluctant to abandon the Spirit Wood planted in Thousand Leaves Mountain.
It had been several years of cultivation, and the Spirit Wood was nearing the standard for crafting thirty-six magical swords. If he fled now, all previous efforts would be wasted.
Just as Xu Ping hesitated.
"Peak Masters of Purple Bamboo Mountain, come forth and meet me!" A thunderous voice echoed, engulfing the entire Purple Bamboo Mountain!
Xu Ping’s expression slightly changed. After a moment of hesitation, he stepped out of his cave dwelling, Hua Ling followed nervously.
Outside the cave!
Xu Ping took out the Restriction Token, lightly waved it, and the mist from the array dispersed.
In the distance, a Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivator stood atop a Spiritual Boat, quietly gazing at the three main peaks of Purple Bamboo Mountain.
"Xu Ping, Master of Thousand Leaves Mountain?"
The cultivator noticed movements in the array of Thousand Leaves Mountain and unhesitatingly flew above the array on his Spiritual Boat.
As the cultivator approached, Xu Ping clearly saw his attire.
He was dressed in a mysterious black robe, embroidered with a majestic Dragon Turtle patch, with long dragon whiskers.
"Dragon Turtle Robe?"
"Someone from Shuize Sect?"
Xu Ping’s heart skipped a beat, contemplating silently, "The Shuize Sect has just declared war on the Luoyun Sect, and now they send someone to Purple Bamboo Mountain, likely with ill intentions!"
Thousands of thoughts raced through Xu Ping’s mind, but he showed no sign on his face. Instead, he politely asked, "So it’s a fellow cultivator from the Upper Sect. Unfortunately, the other two Peak Masters have gone to explore the ruins and have yet to return."
"May I know why the Upper Sect colleague seeks Purple Bamboo Mountain?"
"Gone to explore the ruins?"
The cultivator frowned, pondered momentarily, and said dismissively, "Having you is sufficient!"
After briefly organizing his words, he declared with righteousness, "The Luoyun Sect’s reckless actions have oppressed various forces in Yue Country for years. Now, our Shuize Sect has allied with Hu Country cultivators, vowing to eradicate this cancer from Yue Country and restore its clear skies!"
"Because this concerns all the forces in Yue Country, every faction must dispatch personnel to join the campaign against the Luoyun Sect. Naturally, Purple Bamboo Mountain is no exception."
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping’s heart sank!
Indeed, they are here with ill intentions!
To make him participate in the annihilation of the Luoyun Sect and join the battle between Nascent Soul-level forces, is this not a death wish?
"Upper Sect colleague, this matter is of great importance, and I can’t make the decision alone! How about we wait for the other two Taoists to return, and we three will discuss a response for the Upper Sect?" Xu Ping suggested earnestly.
"Stop with the nonsense."
The cultivator impatiently retorted, "Your combat strength is comparable to Foundation Establishment Perfection; the other two are merely Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment. It’s you who holds the decision!"
"To be blunt, if you refuse to join the campaign against the Luoyun Sect, you’ll be deemed a lackey of the Luoyun Sect and an enemy of our Shuize Sect!"
"Against enemies, whether it’s a small Foundation Establishment cultivator like yourself or even a Golden Core cultivator, our Shuize Sect has only one word—’kill’."
Cold light flickered in the cultivator’s eyes, staring directly at Xu Ping, his tone full of naked threats!
Listening to such arrogant and domineering words, a strong killing intent surged within Xu Ping.
It seems there’s no avoiding this calamity now!
He certainly wouldn’t choose to join the campaign against the Luoyun Sect, so offending the Shuize Sect is inevitable.
Since offending is inevitable, why worry about so much!
Kill this cultivator, and then flee!
If the Luoyun Sect ultimately wins, it’s all good.
If Hu Country and Shuize Sect triumph, he’d hide away for decades, even a hundred years.
He doesn’t believe the Shuize Sect will always remember him, a mere Foundation Establishment cultivator!
Just as Xu Ping made up his mind to kill the cultivator.
Xu Ping and the cultivator seemed to sense something simultaneously, looking towards the depths of Wanzhe Waters, eyebrows slightly raised.
Despite the distance, they could still faintly feel the abnormal Spiritual Qi fluctuations and a looming, cold aura emanating from the depths.
"Is this... the direction of the Ruins Deserted Island?"

chapters.title: Chapter 199 - 166: Malignant Spirit Catastrophe
chapters.content:
Chapter 199: Chapter 166: Malignant Spirit Catastrophe
"Is this... in the direction of the Ruins Deserted Island?"
"Why is the commotion this time even bigger than at the beginning? What’s happened over there?" Xu Ping looked shocked, his gaze tightly fixed on the distance.
The Daoist above the array showed an equally undisguised look of surprise, evidently clueless about what was happening over there.
Buzz!
At that moment, the long-distance sound transmission device he held began to tremble fiercely.
The Daoist hurriedly took it out, quickly injecting Mana into it.
"What!"
In just a moment, the Daoist’s face turned pale as paper, his expression extremely fearful.
Without sparing a thought for Xu Ping, he instantly performed Escape Light and sped away toward the Wanzhe Waters as swiftly as an arrow.
"Hmm?"
This sudden scene caused Xu Ping to pause, a look of astonishment appearing on his face.
As he came back to his senses, he immediately realized that the person’s hasty departure was likely related to the change in direction of the ruins he had just seen.
"What on earth has changed in the ruins?" Xu Ping furrowed his brows, pondering deeply within.
He knew this was no trivial matter, or else the person would not have left in such panic.
Yet, after pondering for a long time, he remained clueless.
After all, he had never set foot on the Ruins Deserted Island and knew nothing about its situation, making it hard to imagine what astonishing change had occurred there.
"Alas, I don’t even know whether this is beneficial or harmful to me!" Xu Ping couldn’t help but sigh softly.
For the time being, it should be considered a good thing, at least it has distracted the attention of the Shuize Sect.
...
...
The Ruins Deserted Island.
In front of a building shimmering with the Restriction’s light, several cultivators of the Luoyun Sect stared solemnly at the brocade-robed elder who was cracking the Restriction.
The brocade-robed elder waved his sleeve, releasing more than a dozen small flags of various colors, which began to gently revolve around him.
"Go!"
With a flick of his finger, the numerous rays of light soared up, and the array flags flew to the top of the Restriction, arranged in a certain pattern to faintly form the shape of the Big Dipper floating lightly above.
"Break!"
With the elder’s soft call, the array flags emitted a low hum.
Then, over a dozen beams of light shot from the small flags, converging into a thick beam in the air, directly striking the Restriction.
Boom!
A huge, earth-shaking sound of Spiritual Qi reverberated everywhere.
Yet, regardless of how the light beam bombarded, the Restriction remained intact.
"This..."
The cultivators of Luoyun Sect changed their expressions slightly, and even the elder’s face became dark.
He hesitated for a moment and flipped his palm, revealing an ochre talisman, then pinched a Magic Technique with both hands, unleashing a powerful force to break the Restriction!
Crack!
With the auxiliary power of breaking the Restriction, it could no longer withstand; the light curtain was instantly covered with dense cracks.
Whoosh!
As the Restriction gradually shattered, an extremely chilling aura burst forth from within.
Everyone present, except for the brocade-robed elder, felt a chill creeping up from their feet to their heads, raising goosebumps all over their bodies.
"The Restriction is broken; I’ll block the evil entities while you search for the Infant Devouring Pill!" The elder’s face was slightly condensed.
"Alright..."
Boom!
As soon as he finished speaking, the Restriction was completely broken, a series of deafening blasts continually sounding.
Moments later.
Hiss! Roar!
Accompanied by strange, non-human roars, a chilling aura powerful enough to make their hearts tremble swept over.
"Move!"
The elder charged into the building first, his face serious.
The cultivators of Luoyun Sect had no choice but to grit their teeth and follow.
...
...
Several hours later.
Rumble...
Continuous explosions echoed from the Ruins Deserted Island as multicolored Escape Lights fled outward from the island, as if escaping...
"Fellow Daoist Duan, hurry up!"
Gong Yang shouted urgently, struggling to rush out of the deserted island while summoning a small, sleek Flying Boat.
Duan Shuang’s pretty face was full of fear; she flashed and instantly appeared on the Flying Boat.
Gong Yang rapidly chanted a Spell, muttering constantly.
With a "whoosh," the Flying Boat turned into a dazzling ray of light, flying rapidly toward the distance like a meteor.
Moments later.
Buzz!
The brocade-robed elder, with several Luoyun Sect cultivators, flew out from the Ruins Deserted Island.
Hiss! Roar!
A horde of dark evil entities roared angrily, surging out of the island like a cloud of darkness, pursuing them directly.
Seeing this, the elder didn’t rage but chuckled; with a wave of his sleeve, a ray of light shot straight at the evil entities.
Boom!
The light exploded, a cloud of red powder with a pungent bloody smell fell like fine rain on the evil entities.
Hiss!
The evil entities’ blood-red eyes turned even more intensely red, like burning flames.
Without caring about anything else, they accelerated, madly pursuing the elder and others.
...
...
Half a month later.
In Thousand Leaves Mountain’s courtyard.
"What!"
Upon hearing Duan Shuang and Gong Yang’s account, Xu Ping’s face turned extremely dark, "You’re saying there are numerous evil entities hidden on the Ruins Deserted Island, including several at the Golden Core Perfection level?"
Not to mention Golden Core Perfection-level evil entities, even early-stage ones, he couldn’t defeat them.
"Exactly!"
Duan Shuang gave a bitter smile, speaking with lingering fear:
"If it hadn’t been for Luoyun Sect’s Yuncheng ancestor using some unknown method to draw most evil entities away and attack Shuize Sect, we might have perished among the evil entities."

chapters.title: Chapter 200 - 166: Demonic Calamity (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 200: Chapter 166: Demonic Calamity (Part 2)
"Hmph!"
"Shuize Sect, Luoyun Sect, not a single good thing among them!" Gong Yang snorted coldly, resentment unfurling in his eyes.
The more he spoke, the angrier he became: "Luoyun Sect certainly knew about the numerous evil spirits in the relics long ago. To attack Shuize Sect, they broke the restriction, releasing the evil spirits, putting the entire Wanzhe Waters under threat."
"In their eyes, we small cultivators’ lives are probably no different from weeds on the roadside!"
Xu Ping ignored Gong Yang’s complaints. Although he knew every word Gong Yang said was true, the most crucial matter right now was to understand the specifics of the evil spirits.
"So, the numerous evil spirits were led towards Shuize Sect by Luoyun Sect?" Xu Ping quickly inquired.
"Yes."
Duan Shuang nodded and continued:
"All the Golden Core-level evil spirits were basically led towards Shuize Sect, and it’s unknown what method Patriarch Yuncheng used to make the evil spirits attack Shuize Sect furiously, showing no intention of stopping until death."
"However, even so, there are still numerous Qi Cultivation and Foundation Establishment level evil spirits that haven’t been led away. Now, the entire Wanzhe Waters suffers the rampant evil spirits, and I fear our Purple Bamboo Mountain may not remain unscathed."
Duan Shuang’s face revealed a hint of worry, for evil spirits at the same level, without methods of restraint, are generally not something regular cultivators could contend with.
Although Duan Shuang was immensely worried, Xu Ping felt secretly relieved after hearing this.
As long as no Golden Core-level evil spirits attacked, he had no fear of Foundation Establishment level evil spirits.
"Fellow Daoist Duan, there’s no need to worry excessively. Purple Bamboo Mountain is a unit as a whole. If the evil spirit calamity becomes too overwhelming, Fellow Daoist Duan can come to my Thousand Leaves Mountain."
"As long as no Golden Core-level evil spirits attack, I can certainly ensure the safety of the fellow Daoists, including Fellow Daoist Gong." Xu Ping said earnestly.
Upon hearing this, a hint of joy flashed across Duan Shuang and Gong Yang’s faces, and they immediately clasped their hands in gratitude: "Then thank you a lot, Fellow Daoist Xu!"
"You’re too kind, dear fellow Daoists." Xu Ping waved his hand.
The few people continued to discuss deeply about the state of the relic and the situation with the evil spirits, after which Duan Shuang and Gong Yang rose to leave.
At this moment, only Xu Ping remained on Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"I wonder whether this evil spirit calamity will ultimately be beneficial or detrimental to me!" He looked around the vibrant Thousand Leaves Mountain and sighed helplessly.
If we speak of disadvantages!
The evil spirit calamity has tied up Shuize Sect, making them completely unable to divert their attention, probably forcing them to stay holed up within their array.
Naturally, there is no way for them to gather cultivators to besiege Luoyun Sect, and he wouldn’t be drawn into the battlefield of these two great forces.
But if we speak of advantages!
Although most of the Golden Core-level evil spirits were led to Shuize Sect, if one or two Golden Core-level evil spirits were missed, that would be a huge problem.
Should it happen that the lingering Golden Core spirits set their sights on his Thousand Leaves Mountain, although the likelihood is quite slim, it’s not entirely impossible.
"To ensure my safety, in the current situation, my only choice is to focus on talismans." Xu Ping thought privately.
Third-rank Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans restrain evil spirits. With some at hand, even Golden Core evil spirits can be slain.
As for not having Third-rank Spirit Wood to make Third-rank talisman papers, Xu Ping plans to have Duan Shuang and Gong Yang visit the Song family.
At that time, he will give them a few Second-stage Upper Grade talismans that restrain evil spirits for protection. As long as they don’t encounter Golden Core evil spirits, they will certainly be safe.
And for the Third-rank Spirit Wood, Xu Ping also plans to exchange Second-stage talismans that restrain evil spirits for it. Presumably, in the current situation, the Song family surely won’t refuse.
In fact, Xu Ping also considered upgrading the array’s level.
But unfortunately, with his current cultivation, setting up a Third-rank array is very difficult, not to mention the unresolved issue of the Array Source.
With the terrifying consumption of a Third-rank array, Purple Bamboo Mountain’s large Second-stage Upper Grade Spirit Vein can barely suffice on regular days, but at full power, it might instantly drain all the Spiritual Qi of Purple Bamboo Mountain!
"Ah, if only there were Array Sources capable of supporting a Third-rank array!" Xu Ping sighed helplessly.
If there indeed were Array Sources capable of maintaining a Third-rank array, he would painstakingly work to establish a set of Third-rank arrays no matter how long it took.
...
...
The sudden onset of the evil spirit calamity was like a sudden nightmare, completely unanticipated by all cultivators in Wanzhe Waters.
Even though all Golden Core Realm evil spirits and most Foundation Establishment Stage evil spirits rushed to attack Shuize Sect with reckless abandon,
the remaining Qi Cultivation and Foundation Establishment level evil spirits were still enough to make the other small and large forces in Wanzhe Waters lament and suffer greatly.
These evil spirits were unpredictable, sometimes moving in small groups, sometimes wandering alone.
Instances where strong evil spirits broke into Spirit Islands, slaughtering both cultivators and mortals on the islands, were not uncommon.
In this catastrophe, only forces like the Song family, with Fake Pill level experts holding the fort, could barely ensure their own safety, finding temporary peace in the chaotic tide of evil spirits’ rampage.
...
...
"Evil spirit calamity?"
A man with a square face and thick brows, exuding a powerful aura, frowned slightly as he looked at the Third-rank Sound Transmission Talisman in his hand.
"Yes, there are currently three or four Golden Core Perfection level, five or six early to mid-Golden Core level evil spirits and dozens of Foundation Establishment level evil spirits, fiercely attacking my sect."
"If not for relying on the power of arrays, my sect would have been entirely wiped out by now. I don’t know what method that old Yuncheng used to target so many evil spirits just at my sect!"
A voice full of anger came from the Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman.

chapters.title: Chapter 201 - 166: Calamity of the Malignant Spirits (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 201: Chapter 166: Calamity of the Malignant Spirits (Part 3)
Upon hearing this, the square-faced man with thick eyebrows instantly darkened his expression.
The outbreak of the supernatural disaster has rendered Shuize Sect completely immobile, and now the strategy of besieging Luoyun Sect from front and back has essentially failed.
"What kind of luck does Luoyun Sect have!" Even the square-faced man with thick eyebrows couldn’t help but curse under his breath.
Luoyun Sect was originally on the verge of decline, but suddenly the relic of Nine Nether Elder appeared, and among it, there were Spiritual Objects that assist in Nascent Soul Formation!
And that’s not all, the relic even contained a large number of supernatural forces that have completely trapped Shuize Sect!
This is beyond ordinary good luck, it’s as if even the heavens are assisting Luoyun Sect!
"What now?" The voice of the Shuize Sect Leader, slightly anxious and worried, came again through the Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman.
"Why panic!
The square-faced man with thick eyebrows furrowed his brows and reprimanded, "Even if Luoyun Sect obtained the Spiritual Objects to assist in Nascent Soul Formation, so what? The probability of forming a Nascent Soul is still frighteningly low; having a success rate of even one or two in ten is already extraordinarily lucky."
"I don’t believe Luoyun Sect’s luck can continue indefinitely!"
"Besides, Nascent Soul Formation requires an absolutely safe and stable environment. Do you think I would give Luoyun Sect that chance?"
Saying this, the square-faced man with thick eyebrows slowly curled the corners of his mouth into a chilling cold smile.
"Indeed that’s the case!"
Upon hearing this analysis, the Shuize Sect Leader’s heart felt like a heavy stone was lifted, and his tension eased considerably.
Thinking it over, their chances of winning remain high, and Luoyun Sect has merely found a slim chance of survival.
"Once I attack Luoyun Immortal City before me, I can face Luoyun Sect head-on!" A glint flashed in the eyes of the square-faced man with thick eyebrows.
"Congratulations to Ancestor Wan Ming, may you win overwhelmingly and crush Luoyun Sect!" The Shuize Sect Leader complimented.
...
Luoyun Immortal City!
"Attack!"
Amid the shouts, three or forty Foundation Establishment Cultivators, led by several Golden Core Cultivators, recited incantations in unison, concentrating their Mana together.
In the void, a large amount of thunder attribute Spiritual Power gathered, transforming into dozens of thunderbolts several tens of feet long, fiercely striking the walls of Bai Ze Immortal City.
Boom!
After another round of attacks, the layer of light originally enveloping Luoyun Immortal City started to teeter and totter.
"Last strike, annihilation celestial thunder!"
Suddenly, the void condensed into a hundred-foot-long black thunderbolt, with a boom, directly hurling towards the protective Array light screen.
"Humph!"
At the critical moment, a cold hum suddenly exploded in the minds of the cultivators!
In the next instant.
A gigantic purple sword flew from Luoyun Immortal City, growing to a hundred feet against the wind, heavily slashing onto the black thunderbolt.
Crack!
The black thunderbolt was cut in half, shattering inch by inch, with countless Thunder Power exploding in the void!
Puff puff puff...
The Mana-condensed black thunderbolt, Foundation Establishment Cultivators, and Golden Core Cultivators all suffered Mana backlash, spitting a mouthful of fresh blood directly!
"Yun Chengzi!"
A man with overwhelming momentum, square-faced with thick eyebrows, flew out from Hu Country’s cultivator camp, staring intensely at Luoyun Immortal City!
"Wan Ming!"
Crackle!
With a flash of lightning, Yun Chengzi appeared in mid-air in a robes, looking across at Wan Ming.
"Yun Chengzi, your lifespan is near its end, your strength diminished, yet you dare to appear before me!" Wan Ming squinted his eyes and spoke indifferently.
"Dragging you down is enough!" Yun Chengzi’s expression was indifferent.
Upon hearing this, a tinge of dread flashed in Wan Ming’s eyes.
Although Yun Chengzi’s strength is not as good as his own, if he fights desperately, it wouldn’t be pleasant either; being severely injured and his fall weren’t impossible!
However, Wan Ming also knew that in this current situation, Yun Chengzi absolutely dare not really fight to mutual destruction.
After all, once Yun Chengzi is defeated and dies at this time, what awaits Luoyun Sect will be a rapid extinction.
"Humph, you can try then!" Wan Ming coldly snorted, a mass of purple flames fiercely burning on his body, instantly transforming into a purple fire man.
"Dare to come out and fight!" Wan Ming shouted fiercely.
"Why wouldn’t I?"
Yun Chengzi flashed out of the Array, engaging Wan Ming in combat.
And at this moment, Hu Country’s cultivators took advantage of this gap, began to launch even more violent attacks on Luoyun Immortal City at this moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 202 - 167: Purchasing Tier 3 Spirit Wood
chapters.content:
Chapter 202: Chapter 167: Purchasing Tier 3 Spirit Wood
The calamity of evil spirits erupted, two months later.
This day.
In the spiritual fields of Thousand Leaves Mountain, Xu Ping, who was performing the Tribulation Spirit Skill, suddenly looked up.
Whirr, whirr, whirr...
At this moment, over Purple Bamboo Mountain, a sinister aura pervaded.
Several shadows of evil spirits roamed among the clouds, glaring at the spiritual vein below.
The leading evil spirit, with a human face and beast body, had blood-red eyes and was equivalent to an Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, while the other three were no more than Qi Cultivation level!
"Foundation Establishment evil spirit?"
Xu Ping frowned slightly; evil spirits of the Foundation Establishment level naturally posed no threat to him, but he was currently performing the Tribulation Spirit Skill and was busy.
"Water Lake Rat, take care of the evil spirits outside!" Xu Ping instructed through Divine Sense transmission.
"Yes, Master!"
The nearly two-zhang-tall Water Lake Rat responded excitedly.
After cultivating spirit plants for so long, it finally got to do something else.
"Squeak!"
It let out an excited roar, its body surging with demonic power, transforming into a gust of demon wind and attacking the evil spirits.
In the blink of an eye, the Water Lake Rat charged at the group of evil spirits.
It opened its large mouth, and a searing Demon Fire spewed out.
This Demon Fire was a ghostly purple, extremely hot, and wherever it passed, the air became twisted and deformed from the scorching heat.
...
As the evil spirits attacked, the defensive arrays of Little Radiance Mountain and Flower Butterfly Mountain, several miles away, instantly activated.
Gong Yang and Duan Shuang flew from their own arenas.
Just as the two were channeling their mana, ready to summon their magical artifacts to deliver a fatal blow to the evil spirits!
A ghostly purple Demon Fire swept past their eyes, crashing towards the evil spirits.
Whoosh!
Boom!
The leading evil spirit with a human face and beast body, seeing the Demon Fire coming, immediately sensed danger, wanting to dodge, but found itself surrounded by the Demon Fire with no way out.
It flailed its claws, its body shrouded in a sinister aura, attempting to resist the invasion of the Demon Fire, but it was all in vain.
Hiss!
The Demon Fire instantly consumed it, emitting a shrill scream, and in no time, it was reduced to ashes.
The other three Qi Cultivation level evil spirits were even more vulnerable. The moment the Demon Fire touched them, they ignited like dry wood in a blazing fire, disappearing without a trace before they could even struggle.
In just a few breaths.
The evil spirits that had been hovering over Purple Bamboo Mountain were all burned to death by the Demon Fire spat by Water Lake Rat, and the sinister aura gradually dissipated with the demise of the evil spirits.
"This... this is Fellow Daoist Xu’s spirit beast!!!"
Duan Shuang and Gong Yang witnessed the scene, immediately stunned, their mouths agape, unable to close for a long time.
A Foundation Establishment-level evil spirit was burned to death by a Second-stage Lower Grade demon beast’s single breath of Demon Fire?
Even the two of them likely couldn’t achieve this level!
Fellow Daoist Xu was already an exceptionally gifted existence, and they hadn’t expected his spirit beast to be equally extraordinary.
In terms of strength, Water Lake Rat should be about on par with Duan Shuang, still somewhat lesser than Gong Yang, who was at the peak of Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment.
But fire-type magic inherently restrained evil spirits, and coupled with the Water Lake Rat’s Demon Fire being equivalent to Second-stage Middle Grade, naturally, a single breath of Demon Fire could burn this evil spirit equivalent to Early-Stage Foundation Establishment to death!
"Come back!"
At this time, Xu Ping, having successfully performed the Tribulation Spirit Skill, summoned the Water Lake Rat through Divine Sense transmission.
Then, he warmly invited Duan Shuang and Gong Yang, "Fellow Daoists, come to Thousand Leaves Mountain for a visit!"
"Squeak!"
The Water Lake Rat shook its head proudly and transformed into a demon wind, coming before Xu Ping.
This time, it learned to behave, obediently lowering its large body, showing a hint of a fawning expression on its face, eagerly looking at Xu Ping.
Duan Shuang and Gong Yang exchanged a glance, putting away their magical artifacts, and rode their Escape Light to Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, your mutated Water Lake Rat is truly formidable!"
Gong Yang saw the obedient Water Lake Rat lying in front of Xu Ping and couldn’t help but exclaim in amazement, eyes full of envy.
So powerful yet so obedient, truly rare!
"Nothing worth mentioning, just taking advantage of the restraint mechanism!" Xu Ping waved his hand and then kicked the Water Lake Rat nudging at his trouser leg.
"Don’t think about slacking off, quickly go and plant the Spirit Medicine and Spirit Plant!"
"Squeak!"
Despite being kicked by Xu Ping, the Water Lake Rat wasn’t angry at all, instead, it pranced off to the spiritual field, swiftly starting to plant Spirit Medicine and Spirit Plant.
Seeing this scene, Gong Yang couldn’t help but twitch at the corner of his mouth, such excellent training!
A demon beast, whose strength was comparable to it, actually doing the work of a spiritual farmer?
...
After sending the Water Lake Rat off to plant Spirit Medicine, Xu Ping invited Gong Yang and Duan Shuang into the pavilion.
The three took their seats as hosts and guests, with steaming Spirit Tea already set on the table.
"Ah, now that Hu Country has invaded, attacking Luoyun Sect, the number of Qi Cultivation and Foundation Establishment cultivators who have died or been injured is countless."
Gong Yang gently set down the teacup in his hand, couldn’t help but let out a long sigh, his face full of worry.
"And Shuize Sect is even besieged by Golden Core evil spirits, only able to shrink back within their Array. But our Purple Bamboo Mountain, sandwiched between two major forces, apart from facing some Foundation Establishment evil spirits, has remained peaceful and stable," Gong Yang remarked.
"In this view, our Purple Bamboo Mountain should be a feng shui treasure land!" Xu Ping laughed.
The development of the situation to its current state was indeed beyond his expectations.
Originally inconspicuous in Yue Country, Purple Bamboo Mountain, amid the great chaos in the entire Yue Country, was barely affected at all.
This cannot but make one sigh, how unpredictable the change of events!
Xu Ping now only hoped that stability could last a few more years, at least until the Spirit Wood ripens.
By then, even if the situation becomes uncontrollable, he could retreat into the Nightmare Marsh with peace of mind.
"With Fellow Daoist Xu in our Purple Bamboo Mountain, evil spirits dare not disturb, naturally, peace and stability prevail!" Duan Shuang chuckled lightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 203 - 167: Purchasing Tier-3 Spirit Wood (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 203: Chapter 167: Purchasing Tier-3 Spirit Wood (2)
"Fellow Daoist Duan, you overestimate me." Xu Ping said modestly.
...
After the three chatted for a while, Xu Ping mentioned the serious matter, "Fellow Daoists, I have invited you here today because I have an important request."
"Please go ahead, Fellow Daoist Xu. Though I must say, with the rampant supernatural threats in Wanzhe Waters and the Luoyun Sect at war with Hu Country cultivators, my meager skills may not be of much help!" Gong Yang slightly frowned, and spoke with a wry smile.
At this moment, Duan Shuang also turned his gaze toward Xu Ping, a hint of curiosity in his eyes.
"Fellow Daoists, rest assured, it is not a dangerous task!" Xu Ping smiled and explained, "I would like to ask for your help in going to the Song family to trade some third-rank Spirit Wood for me."
"Go to the Song family to trade third-rank Spirit Wood?"
Upon hearing this request, Duan Shuang and Gong Yang both breathed a sigh of relief.
This task is indeed not difficult. With their combined efforts, unless they encounter Golden Core-level threats or a large number of Foundation Establishment threats, they should be able to escape safely.
"This task isn’t particularly tough, but third-rank Spirit Wood is extremely precious. How much would Fellow Daoist Xu like to purchase?" Gong Yang asked.
"About three feet in length should suffice!" Xu Ping replied.
A three-foot long piece of third-rank Spirit Wood can roughly produce a hundred or so sheets of third-rank talisman paper. Given his current success rate in drawing talismans, it shouldn’t be a problem to create a dozen or so Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans.
With so many Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans, he will be able to protect himself effortlessly under current circumstances.
Even if a few Golden Core-level threats come, he won’t fear them!
"Three feet long?"
Upon hearing this, Duan Shuang was slightly stunned, a glimmer of surprise flashing in his eyes. "Such a length of third-rank Spirit Wood would cost a fortune in Spirit Stones!"
"Fellow Daoists, please look at this!" Xu Ping smiled slightly, flipped his palm, and a batch of second-stage talismans suddenly appeared in his hand.
Gong Yang and Duan Shuang swept their Divine Sense over them, finding that they were all talismans of the fire and thunder elements, which were effective against supernatural threats.
Moreover, among them, second-stage upper-grade talismans were not in short supply, each emitting a faint spiritual light, indicating extraordinary quality.
"Fellow Daoist Xu... how do you have so many fire and thunder element second-stage talismans?" Gong Yang exclaimed in surprise, unable to hold back his inquiry.
"These were naturally drawn by me."
Xu Ping replied cheerfully, "I was previously a second-stage lower-grade Talisman Master, but I lacked the legacy of second-stage middle-grade or higher talismans.
"Truthfully, I owe Fellow Daoist Duan special thanks for the third-rank talisman legacy he gifted me before."
At this moment it isn’t much of a scandal to reveal that he can draw second-stage upper-grade talismans.
As long as he doesn’t reveal that he can draw third-rank talismans.
"I see."
Duan Shuang suddenly understood, then curiously asked, "Is Fellow Daoist Xu buying third-rank Spirit Wood to make third-rank talisman paper and draw third-rank talismans?"
"Indeed, although it seems a slim hope, I might as well try!" Xu Ping smiled wryly.
"Fellow Daoist Xu is remarkably talented, you might indeed succeed," Duan Shuang said earnestly.
"I appreciate Fellow Daoist Duan’s kind wishes," Xu Ping replied with a smile, then added, "During such rampant supernatural threats nowadays, these many second-stage talismans should be enough to purchase three feet long."
"That should be enough." Gong Yang nodded.
The Luoyun Sect is desperately resisting Hu Country’s invasion, and cultivation items like talismans and puppets that can enhance combat power have naturally seen their prices skyrocket.
Not to mention now in Wanzhe Waters, plagued deeply by supernatural threats, the prices for talismans and magical artifacts effective against such threats are astronomical!
"In that case, I hope Fellow Daoists will accept these talismans for self-defense along the way!"
Xu Ping took out seven or eight second-stage upper-grade thunder element talismans from his Storage Ring, handing them respectively to Gong Yang and Duan Shuang.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Xu..." Duan Shuang and Gong Yang’s eyes lit up instantly, quickly reaching out to accept the talismans.
With so many second-stage upper-grade thunder element talismans, as long as they don’t meet Golden Core threats, self-protection is more than sufficient.
Under favorable circumstances, they might even acquire them with no cost.
"Fellow Daoists, you’re too kind. Since it’s in service to me, I naturally wish to ensure your safety." Xu Ping waved his hand sincerely.
...
...
Duan Shuang and Gong Yang set off the next day to seek a trade with the Song family.
However, for safety’s sake, they didn’t directly head to the Song family’s territory, instead going to the market established by the Song family.
Meanwhile, Xu Ping stayed at Thousand Leaves Mountain, quietly awaiting news.
Time passed leisurely by, and a month and a half flew quickly.
On this day, inside the cultivation room.
Xu Ping exercised with closed eyes. As his cultivation technique operated, countless Spiritual Qi was absorbed through his mouth and nose into his body, continuously refined into cyan Longevity Mana.
Suddenly, the mana fluctuations surrounding him were full of vitality and deep in mystery.
Time unknown slipped away.
Xu Ping opened his eyes as his cultivation concluded.
"Hoo!"
He slowly exhaled a breath of impure air, like he usually did, then checked his data panel.
[Name: Xu Ping]
[Life: 49/448 years]
[Realm: Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment: 65/100; Blood Demon Body Refining Stage Two: 99/100]
[Cultivation Technique: Longevity Skill Minor Achievement: 678/800]
...
"Only thirty-five points away from breaking through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment. At the current pace, it’ll take about another four years or so." A faint smile appeared at the corners of Xu Ping’s mouth.
Nothing is more gratifying than seeing oneself steadily advancing step by step.
"And breaking through to Major Achievement in Longevity Skill requires even less time, a year or two should suffice."
"It’s just that the Blood Demon Body Refining has been stuck at a bottleneck for over a year now!"
Xu Ping’s eyes rested on the data panel’s "Blood Demon Body Refining Stage Two: 99/100" line, causing him to slightly frown.

chapters.title: Chapter 204 - 167: Purchasing Tier 3 Spirit Wood (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 204: Chapter 167: Purchasing Tier 3 Spirit Wood (3)
He was well aware that the root cause of this bottleneck was the lack of auxiliary ape blood.
"Forget it, collecting ape blood in the current situation is like finding a needle in a haystack. Take it slow, it’s not something too urgent."
After some self-reassurance, Xu Ping closed the data panel and walked out of the cave.
Stepping out of the cave.
What greeted his eyes was a mountain range covered in lush green, the fresh air filled with the fragrance of spirit medicine, making Xu Ping instantly feel relaxed and at ease.
He strolled leisurely around the mountain, and just as he was about to return to the cave, he sensed something and looked towards the sky above Purple Bamboo Mountain, only to see three Escape Lights heading towards Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"That’s... Duan Shuang and Gong Yang, but who is the other person?"
...
In a side hall of the cave at Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"It’s a matter of third-rank Spirit Wood, so I’ve chosen to personally come for the transaction. I hope Fellow Daoist Xu will understand!" Song Qiwu said with a smile, bowing politely.
"I completely understand, Fellow Daoist Song is cautious in his actions, which is a good thing. It’s never wrong to be cautious." Xu Ping replied with a smile.
After two years, the other party had already progressed from Early-Stage Foundation Establishment to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment.
"I’m glad Fellow Daoist Xu understands."
Song Qiwu smiled slightly, then with a turn of his hand, a wooden box nearly four feet long appeared in his hand: "This is the third-rank Spirit Wood you need, feel free to take a closer look first."
Saying this, under the virtual support of Mana, the wooden box floated slowly in front of Xu Ping.
Xu Ping waved his sleeve, and the lid of the wooden box opened instantly. Inside was a piece of smooth Spirit Wood, with a fine texture and a trace of spirit.
"Not bad, indeed a high-quality third-rank Spirit Wood!"
After carefully examining it, Xu Ping showed a satisfied expression and nodded in approval.
"Glad Fellow Daoist Xu is satisfied."
Song Qiwu’s smile became even more radiant, then asked curiously, "I’ve heard Fellow Daoist Xu is already a Second-stage Upper Grade Talisman Master. Are you confident in successfully crafting a third-rank talisman?"
"Such a difficult task, I have no confidence at all. Buying this third-rank Spirit Wood is entirely just to cover the cost of trial and error." Xu Ping chuckled bitterly.
"In the future, I might have to purchase more third-rank Spirit Wood from your family." Xu Ping made a gesture of goodwill.
"That’s certainly no problem. As soon as Fellow Daoist Xu wants to buy third-rank Spirit Wood, I’ll make sure to deliver it first thing." Song Qiwu guaranteed, patting his chest.
"However, if Fellow Daoist Xu successfully crafts a third-rank talisman, I hope you can sell one or two to our family. I assure you the price will not disappoint." Song Qiwu bowed sincerely.
"Of course, if I do craft a third-rank talisman, your family will be the first to know." Xu Ping said earnestly.
Nowadays, Xu Ping could lie without changing his expression, his acting skills well-honed.
Even Song Qiwu didn’t perceive any hint, believing Xu Ping’s words to be true.
"Then I’ll thank Fellow Daoist Xu in advance." Song Qiwu said with a broad smile.
"No need to be so polite, it’s a mutually beneficial matter." Xu Ping waved dismissively.
...
After completing the transaction, Xu Ping asked Song Qiwu about matters concerning evil spirits.
As a Fake Pill family, the Song family surely knows more than him.
"Alas, currently the entire Wanzhe Waters is suffering from the evil spirit disaster, no force can avoid it." Song Qiwu said helplessly.
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping sighed: "Not having Golden Core Level evil spirits slaughtering everywhere is the only thing worth being thankful for right now."
A hint of hesitation showed on Song Qiwu’s face. After pondering for a moment, he slowly spoke, "However, I’ve recently heard rumors that someone has seen Golden Core Level evil spirits."
"Golden Core Level evil spirits?"
Xu Ping frowned and questioned, "If someone has truly seen them, would they still be alive to return?"
"That’s indeed true." Song Qiwu nodded in agreement, as even he had doubts about the authenticity of this rumor.

chapters.title: Chapter 205 - 168: Longevity Skill Reaches Mastery!
chapters.content:
Chapter 205: Chapter 168: Longevity Skill Reaches Mastery!
After sending off Song Qiwu, Xu Ping eagerly arrived at the cultivation chamber.
Immediately, he flipped his palm, and a wooden box containing third-rank Spirit Wood appeared in his hand.
"Now that the third-rank Spirit Wood is in hand, I must quickly craft the talismans and draw all the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans," Xu Ping mused to himself.
Although the rumors Song Qiwu mentioned about Golden Core evil spirits likely are false.
But what if they aren’t?
No one can say for sure.
For the sake of his own safety, it’s always best to be thoroughly prepared.
Thinking thus, Xu Ping took the third-rank Spirit Wood from the wooden box and began officially crafting the talisman paper.
The process of crafting talisman paper, though not effortless for the increasingly experienced Xu Ping, was not extremely complex either.
Thanks to the valuable experience and assistance from earlier accumulation and his skilled panel.
In about a month’s time, Xu Ping crafted one hundred and ten pieces of third-rank talisman paper from the three-foot-long Spirit Wood.
At this moment, placed on the stone table were sheets of talisman paper glimmering with spiritual light, emitting a mysterious purple glow.
"I can finally start drawing the talismans!"
Xu Ping gazed at these talisman papers, his lips curled into a smile involuntarily.
To ensure the talisman drawing process was foolproof, Xu Ping deliberately rested for a few days, meticulously conditioning himself to peak state before officially beginning to draw the talismans.
...
Time flew by swiftly, like a galloping white horse, half a year passed in the blink of an eye.
In the tranquil cultivation chamber.
Xu Ping’s expression was solemn, holding a talisman brush over a talisman paper emitting a purple halo, drawing the third-rank rune stroke by stroke.
Boom!
Without any warning, a purple thunder erupted suddenly from the talisman paper, like a raging tide, instantly sweeping across the entire cultivation chamber.
The Thunder Power raged wildly, the momentum was terrifying.
However, in the face of this sudden Thunder Power, Xu Ping remained exceptionally calm and composed, as if accustomed to it.
He did not even lift an eyelid, the talisman brush in his hand steadily and smoothly glided over the talisman paper, precisely and expertly controlling every detail.
Buzz!
As Xu Ping completed the final stroke.
Various glows flashed vividly across the talisman paper, settling into a stable state eventually.
"The last one... finished drawing!"
Xu Ping let out a long sigh of relief, his taut nerves finally relaxed, a faint smile curving at the corners of his mouth.
For the past half year, he had spent most of his time on drawing Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans.
Though exhausting, the outcomes were remarkably fruitful.
Including the one just completed, he successfully drew as many as twenty Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans.
Thinking of this, Xu Ping’s confidence greatly surged.
Now, even if one or two Golden Core evil spirits appear, with these powerful Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans, they could be piled to death.
"Now, finally, I can barely be considered safe!"
Xu Ping murmured softly, carefully put away the last Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman, feeling a sense of relieved happiness.
Then, he stepped out of the dwelling with a light gait.
At this time, Thousand Leaves Mountain was lush and verdant, full of vitality.
Xu Ping strolled leisurely until he felt satisfied, then contentedly returned to his dwelling.
...
...
With these twenty Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans as solid protection, Xu Ping finally was able to put his mind at ease and focus on cultivation.
Time flowed like water, another year passed quietly.
This past year, the evil spirit disaster situation in Wanzhe Waters grew increasingly severe.
The strength of the evil spirits does not remain constant.
Once they consume enough blood meals, they can evolve.
Now, many evil spirits originally at Qi Cultivation level have evolved to Foundation Establishment level, with considerable enhancement in strength.
And the Foundation Establishment level evil spirits continue to evolve, fortunately, none have reached the Golden Core level yet, which is a silver lining amidst adversity.
At Purple Bamboo Mountain, occasionally, some reckless evil spirits came to harass.
But every time, without exception, they were instantly burnt to ashes by the formidable Demon Fire of the Lake Water Mice, unable to stir any waves.
As for the situation in Luoyun Immortal City, it was far from optimistic.
The entire Immortal City was now desperately sustained by a powerful array, barely making ends meet.
Wan Ming, a Nascent Soul cultivator from Hu Country, although wary of Luoyun Sect’s patriarch Yun Chengzi, dare not engage in a deathly battle.
Yet he adopted an insidious strategy, constantly draining Yun Chengzi’s lifespan.
Now, Yun Chengzi’s lifespan was almost depleted, each move consumed more lifespan.
Once his lifespan exhausts, it would signal the downfall of Luoyun Immortal City and potentially even Luoyun Sect.
Despite Yun Chengzi being well aware of this fact, he had no solution.
He could only hope his disciple could form a Nascent Soul.
...
One night, with the moon high and the wind fierce, dark clouds obscured the sky.
In Wanzhe Waters.
On a spirit island occupied by the Yang Foundation Establishment family, a tall youth with hair as white as snow silently arrived on the spirit island, ignoring the array’s spiritual light without attracting any attention.
This youth’s eyes were blood-red, surrounded by thick Yin energy, exuding a chilling aura.
Its cold and greedy gaze quickly locked onto two Qi Cultivation disciples on patrol like a starving wolf.
The two young disciples hadn’t realized the imminent danger before being grabbed by the youth like helpless chicks.
The youth opened its blood-filled maw, a black absorbing force like a turbulent dark stream gushed from it.

chapters.title: Chapter 206 - 168: Longevity Skill Breaks Through to Perfection! (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 206: Chapter 168: Longevity Skill Breaks Through to Perfection! (Part 2)
In an instant, the blood of those two disciples was pulled out from their bodies as if by an invisible hand.
The two disciples widened their eyes, filled with fear and despair, unable to utter a sound even with their mouths agape.
Within a few short breaths, their bodies rapidly shriveled, with their vitality completely extinguished, resembling nothing more than lifeless husks.
The youth’s blood-red eyes involuntarily revealed a hint of satisfaction.
Immediately, his figure blurred and vanished, darting ghost-like through the residence, as he hunted Yang family cultivators and ordinary people one by one.
Screams and cries for help echoed incessantly, yet in this dark night, they seemed so helpless and feeble.
The Foundation Establishment Cultivators of the Yang family quickly sensed the anomaly and hastily led the family elders to investigate.
However, when they perceived the horrifying aura emanating from the youth, their faces paled in terror as they exclaimed, "A Foundation... Foundation Establishment Perfection level fiend??"
This level of fiend was completely beyond the ability of their small Foundation Establishment family to resist.
"Quick... Run!" The Yang family Foundation Establishment Cultivators shouted desperately at the top of their lungs.
Everyone woke as if from a dream, panicking and fleeing in all directions.
However, by then, it was already too late. Against the bizarre and overwhelming strength of the fiend, their struggles were futile.
Except for a few fortunate souls who escaped with their lives, the entire Yang family of cultivators and ordinary people were completely drained.
The ground was littered with shriveled corpses, a ghastly and unbearable sight, akin to a hell on earth.
As more and more blood was consumed, the aura of the fiend grew increasingly stronger. Strange lights began to flicker around its body, as if undergoing some transformation.
After absorbing the blood of the Yang family Foundation Establishment Cultivators, the youth’s body radiated brilliance.
A vast and terrifying aura soared skyward, directly breaking through the shackles of Foundation Establishment, successfully transforming into a Golden Core fiend.
...
...
Meanwhile, at Thousand Leaves Mountain.
In the cultivation chamber.
Xu Ping sat cross-legged on a meditation mat, his palms facing upward with eyes closed, his aura withdrawn.
As he slowly circulated the Longevity Skill, the surrounding Spiritual Qi seemed to be drawn invisibly from all directions, converging into a massive vortex above his head.
It was unknown how long he had been cultivating.
Suddenly, Xu Ping’s body erupted with light, exuding a vast and rich aura.
The vortex of Spiritual Qi that surrounded him was instantaneously scattered by this powerful force, transforming into strands that integrated into his body.
Xu Ping abruptly opened his eyes, filled with uncontainable delight: "The Longevity Skill... finally broke through to great success!"
He eagerly opened the panel and glanced at the cultivation technique section.
[Cultivation Technique: Longevity Skill Great Success: 1/1600]
...
"It really succeeded!" Xu Ping couldn’t suppress his inner joy and burst into laughter.
Having spent so many years, he was now only one step away from Perfection.
He suppressed his excitement, closed his eyes, and carefully sensed the changes in his body.
Firstly, his cultivation speed had increased by a third; at his current pace, it was at least comparable to Earth Spirit Roots.
Originally, it would have taken over two more years to break through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment, but now, it only required a little over a year.
This was within Xu Ping’s expectations; what delighted him the most was the enhancement in the purity of his liquid mana.
He used his Divine Sense to inspect his Dantian.
In the center of his Dantian, a slightly viscous azure liquid mana slowly circulated, emitting a deep blue glow.
"This Longevity mana... can it still be called liquid mana?" Xu Ping was astonished.
At this moment, the Longevity mana, though still far from complete solidification, was already distinctly different from ordinary liquid mana.
Xu Ping pondered briefly, then his palm flipped lightly, and a ghostly light flickered as the Upper Grade Purple Sun Sword appeared in his hand.
He attempted to infuse it with a strand of mana.
In an instant.
With a light hum, a sharp and extraordinarily potent aura radiated from the Purple Sun Sword, rippling outward like waves.
Yet, Xu Ping remained calm, unaffected, continuously channeling mana into the Purple Sun Sword.
Buzz, buzz, buzz...
The Purple Sun Sword burst forth with a fierce spirit glow, an overwhelming sharp aura that would strike fear into even the most seasoned Foundation Establishment Cultivators, like a tidal wave, filling the entire cultivation chamber.
"Limit reached!"
Xu Ping observed the ceaselessly quivering and whining Purple Sun Sword in his hand and ceased his mana infusion.
"Unexpectedly, with my now nearly transformed liquid mana, I can push the Upper Grade Purple Sun Sword to its limit." Xu Ping’s face showed a hint of surprise.
It’s worth noting that even a Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivator couldn’t attain such a level.
Indeed, Xu Ping’s liquid mana presently fell short in quantity compared to a Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivator, but its quality now far surpassed a typical Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivator.
"I wonder, with my current mana, can I control a proto-magic artifact?" Xu Ping pondered to himself.
A true magic artifact would be immensely powerful, far beyond his current ability to aspire towards, but a proto-magic artifact, slightly inferior to a true magic artifact, might be worthy of a trial.
If he could master it, it would elevate his strength by half a level at least.
However, the reality proved somewhat disappointing.
Currently, he had no suitable proto-magic artifact to attempt with, and given the current turbulent conditions, he had no place to seek or to acquire one.

chapters.title: Chapter 207 - 168: Longevity Skill Breaks Through to Perfection! (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 207: Chapter 168: Longevity Skill Breaks Through to Perfection! (Part 3)
"Forget it, for now the Purple Sun Sword is sufficient." Xu Ping consoled himself, not overly upset about it.
After all, at present, to deal with ordinary enemies, the power of the Purple Sun Sword was more than enough; and if he encountered a formidable opponent like a Fake Pill expert, he could use the incredibly powerful Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman.
As for the proto-form of an artifact, it wouldn’t be too late to search for it after he reaches Late-Stage Foundation Establishment or even Foundation Establishment Perfection.
"Now that I’ve been in seclusion for almost a month, it seems it’s time to use the ’Tribulation Spirit Skill’ on the Hundred Bamboo Wood."
Xu Ping muttered to himself as he closed the proficiency panel visible only to him, then slowly stood up.
Just as he was about to leave the cultivation chamber, a sudden inspiration flashed in his mind.
"Wait... Although I cannot attempt to wield the proto-form of an artifact currently, with my variant liquid Mana now, perhaps I could try drafting a Third-rank Middle Grade Talisman!"
Thinking of this, Xu Ping’s heart couldn’t help but beat fast.
That would be a Third-rank Middle Grade Talisman, a power at the Middle Stage of Golden Core!
With his current cultivation, he could at most draft a Third-rank Lower Grade Talisman, but now, after the Longevity Skill breakthrough, his liquid Mana variant has a quality far surpassing a cultivator at Foundation Establishment Perfection.
Perhaps he could really draw out a Third-rank Middle Grade Talisman!
"Yet, with my current Divine Sense, it might be very difficult to precisely control a Third-rank Middle Grade Talisman." Xu Ping couldn’t help but feel troubled.
The power in a talisman also requires guidance by Divine Sense.
For an ordinary Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, if they rashly used a Third-rank offensive talisman, whether the enemy would die or not is uncertain, but they themselves would certainly be doomed.
"Whatever, I’ll try to draw it out first!" Xu Ping quickly reasoned it out.
There’s no certainty yet, whether he can draw a Third-rank Middle Grade Talisman is still an unknown.
Moreover, soon he will be able to break through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment, at which point his Divine Sense will surge, fully capable of handling a Third-rank Middle Grade Talisman.
With his decision made, Xu Ping immediately took out the Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman to send a message to Song Qiwu, stating his desire to purchase a six-foot-long Third-rank Spirit Wood.
Before long, Song Qiwu replied in agreement but mentioned that preparing the Spirit Wood required some time.
Xu Ping naturally had no objection to this, as it was entirely a seller’s market now.
...
...
Thus, Xu Ping patiently awaited at Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Time flew by, and two and a half months passed in the blink of an eye.
On this day, a majestic and vigorous Spiritual Qi suddenly enveloped the sky above Xiao Hui Mountain.
The Spiritual Qi surged and rolled as if tangible, forming a peculiar cloud cluster.
At this moment, Xu Ping, leisurely resting and sipping Spirit Tea in a pavilion, witnessed this scene, and a knowing smile lifted the corners of his mouth:
"Fellow Daoist Gong Yang... has broken through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment!"
Gong Yang had long been at the peak of Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment, and with the resources from the deserted island relics, breaking through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment was perfectly normal.
"It’s time to go and extend my congratulations." Xu Ping set down the Spirit Tea cup in his hand, silently making up his mind.
...
Seven days later.
Once Gong Yang’s cultivation was completely stabilized, Duan Shuang and Xu Ping coincidentally went to Xiao Hui Mountain to congratulate Gong Yang.
"Congratulations, Fellow Daoist Gong, on your breakthrough to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment; hoping for Golden Core in the future!" Xu Ping smiled, cupping his hands in congratulations.
Gong Yang, now over one hundred forty years old, theoretically still had the possibility of breaking through to Golden Core.
However, this possibility was so slim, like a carrot dangling in front of a donkey—seemingly within reach yet actually unattainable.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, you really think too highly of this old fellow. Having the fortune to break through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment is already a massive blessing; how dare I entertain the delusion of achieving Golden Core?"
While Gong Yang responded humbly with his words, the slightly upturned corners of his mouth inadvertently revealed his inner joy at the moment.
Even though he understood Xu Ping’s words carried some complimentary intent, what if there truly was just a sliver of hope?
"Gong Yang, with this breakthrough to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment, you can’t be stingy now; you must bring out some good items to entertain the two of us." Duan Shuang quipped humorously aside, smiling warmly.
"Of course!"
Gong Yang laughed heartily, warmly inviting Xu Ping and Duan Shuang to take their seats.
The banquet began soon thereafter.
The three of them sipped fine wine while enjoying the graceful dances of the maids on Xiao Hui Mountain. The atmosphere was harmonious and lively, filled with joyful laughter.
It was at this moment that Song Qiwu suddenly contacted Xu Ping using the Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman, announcing his arrival to trade the Third-rank Spirit Wood.
"How truly coincidental!" Xu Ping was slightly taken aback, surprised by the perfect timing of the trade.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, is there something the matter?" Gong Yang, noticing Xu Ping’s unusual expression, couldn’t help but ask.
"Fellow Daoist Song Qiwu has arrived..." Xu Ping smiled slightly, explaining the situation from start to finish.
"Then it’s perfect, invite Fellow Daoist Song Qiwu to join us at Xiao Hui Mountain for a get-together." Gong Yang laughed warmly, making the enthusiastic suggestion.
Xu Ping considered for a moment, finding nothing inappropriate, then nodded in agreement.
After all, both Duan Shuang and Gong Yang were aware of the trading of the Third-rank Spirit Wood, so there was no need to deliberately conceal or avoid it.
About a quarter of an hour later, Song Qiwu’s figure appeared on Xiao Hui Mountain.
"Fellow Daoist Gong, congratulations, congratulations! This is a little gift from me; I hope you will accept it."
Song Qiwu beamed, speaking as he used Mana to support a delicate gift box, presenting it before Gong Yang.
"Fellow Daoist Song, you’re too kind."
Gong Yang, face full of smiles, gladly accepted the gift box, followed by warmly inviting Song Qiwu to join in the feast.
"This old fellow’s breakthrough to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment and having fellow Daoists gather to celebrate is truly one of life’s great joys. Come, I toast to you all!"
Gong Yang raised his wine cup, stood up, and said with a smile.
"Fellow Daoist Gong, you’re too courteous."
Xu Ping, Duan Shuang, and Song Qiwu all raised their wine cups in turn, tilting back their heads to drink the spirit wine in one go.
As Xiao Hui Mountain was basked in the delightful and harmonious atmosphere of the celebration.
No one noticed, a dense, ink-like yin energy began to silently spread from all directions, enveloping the entire Xiao Hui Mountain tightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 208 - 169: Slaying the Golden Core Evil Spirit!
chapters.content:
Chapter 208: Chapter 169: Slaying the Golden Core Evil Spirit!
At that moment, a tall and well-built young man descended silently onto the summit of Little Radiant Mountain like a phantom.
His white hair resembled a blanket of snow, glaringly conspicuous in the brilliant sunlight, like a cold frosty mist exuding an indescribable strangeness.
What was terrifying was that his eyes were entirely blood-red, like two flaming seas of blood, from which emanated an endless aura of ominous presence that seemed capable of consuming all life around.
"Food!"
The young man’s blood-red eyes shot out an exceedingly greedy gaze, locking fiercely onto a beautiful maid.
Before the words were fully spoken, his figure flashed abruptly, disappearing instantly, leaving only a faint ripple of sinister aura in the air.
In the next moment, the youth had ghostly appeared beside the maid.
He extended his long, cold hand, grabbing the maid tightly.
In an instant, the maid’s face was covered with terror, her mouth opened wide, yet before she could emit even a trace of scream, she was drained of blood, turning into a lifeless husk.
....
Meanwhile, inside the cave mansion within the mountain.
"Three friends, please!"
Gong Yang’s face was filled with a warm smile, his hands steadily holding a wine cup, preparing once more to offer a toast to Xu Ping, Duan Shuang, and Song Qiwu.
"Please, Friend Gong!"
Xu Ping, Duan Shuang, and Song Qiwu also raised their wine cups, ready to down the spirit wine in one gulp.
At that moment, Xu Ping, who was initially smiling, suddenly changed his expression.
His gaze turned sharp, fixed firmly on the outside of the cave mansion, his voice turning extraordinarily serious: "Friends, there seems to be something unusual outside."
His divine sense spread outward, but found that the entire Little Radiant Mountain seemed wrapped in a cold aura.
This cold aura is... an evil presence?
As soon as Xu Ping spoke, Duan Shuang, Song Qiwu, and Gong Yang were slightly taken aback.
After exchanging glances, the three immediately released their divine senses, instantly detecting the cold aura permeating the entire Little Radiant Mountain.
"This aura is... an evil presence?" Gong Yang’s face instantly changed, a trace of panic flashing in his eyes.
He truly could not understand what method this evil presence used to silently penetrate the protective array without drawing any attention.
No time to ponder more, Gong Yang flipped his palm, and a control token for the array, flashing faint spirit light, appeared in his hand.
Immediately after, he quickly formed a seal with his hands, magic techniques rapidly launched from his fingertips, with boundless mana continuously pouring into the token.
Buzz!
In an instant, the array on Little Radiant Mountain blazed with radiance, fully activating, emitting a low humming sound, starting to search for the evil presence’s traces with all its might.
Everyone waited anxiously, but after thoroughly searching the entire Little Radiant Mountain.
Aside from discovering several withered corpses, proving that indeed an evil presence had invaded this Little Radiant Mountain, it was impossible to find even the slightest trace of the evil presence.
"An evil presence invaded my Little Radiant Mountain, yet the array cannot detect its traces!" Gong Yang’s face turned extremely grim.
"In that case, let’s go out and take a look!"
Xu Ping’s expression was serious; he slowly put down the wine cup in his hand and stood up.
He vaguely felt that the evil presence this time seemed significantly different from those encountered before, but at the moment, it was not the time to sit idly by.
Gong Yang, Duan Shuang, and Song Qiwu all nodded, and the four headed towards the entrance of the cave mansion.
Just stepping out, after a few steps, a strong cold aura rushed towards them, causing a shiver.
Raising their eyes, they saw not far away a youth surrounded by sinister aura, with white hair and blood-red eyes, tightly grasping a maid.
In the blink of an eye, the maid lost all life in the youth’s hands, her blood drained completely.
The oppressive aura emanating from the youth was suffocating, as if an invisible mountain weighing down on their chests.
"Gold... Golden Core evil presence!!"
Duan Shuang’s face instantly turned pale as paper, his voice trembling.
Gong Yang and Song Qiwu also looked extremely frightened; they knew very well how terrifying a Golden Core level evil presence was, with their current strength, they were utterly incapable of contending against it.
No wonder the array couldn’t detect it, although Golden Core is only one realm higher than Foundation Establishment, the difference is like heaven and earth.
Even if the four joined forces, facing this Golden Core evil presence, it would be like striking a stone with an egg, with absolutely no chance of victory.
"Run!"
Gong Yang decided immediately, without any hesitation, directly using magic to open the array.
The four hurriedly set up their escape light, fleeing wildly outside the cave mansion like startled birds.
At present, only by desperately fleeing might there be a slim chance of survival.
In the midst of the frantic escape light, Xu Ping inadvertently glimpsed Duan Shuang and Gong Yang flying in different directions, causing a hint of hesitation.
If the Golden Core evil presence targeted them, should he reveal the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman to save them?
However, very soon, he no longer needed to be troubled by this.
Because after draining the maid’s lifeblood, the Golden Core evil presence slowly turned its head, its blood-red eyes revealing endless greed and savagery.
It paused slightly, as if capturing something in the air, then transformed into a jet-black light, swiftly chasing after Xu Ping.
In its perception, Xu Ping was much more enticing than the other three!

chapters.title: Chapter 209 - 169: Slaying the Golden Core Evil Spirit! (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 209: Chapter 169: Slaying the Golden Core Evil Spirit! (Part 2)
"How did it catch up to me?"
Xu Ping secretly shouted that things were not going well. He extended his Divine Sense and clearly detected this perilous situation, silently cursing in his heart.
Even though he was giving it his all to urge on the Escape Light, the speed of the Golden Core evil spirit was truly astonishing, rapidly closing the distance between them in the blink of an eye.
With the terrifying speed of this Golden Core evil spirit, there was no way he could escape.
"You forced me!"
Xu Ping gritted his teeth, a trace of determination flashing in his eyes. At this moment, he couldn’t care about exposing his ace in the hole anymore.
With a flip of his palm, a purple talisman appeared conspicuously in his hand.
"Swift!"
Xu Ping abruptly halted his Escape Light, resolutely turning to face the Golden Core evil spirit, quickly forming a Magic Technique with his hands, shouting loudly.
In an instant.
