The purple talisman shone brilliantly, a tremendously thick purple Divine Thunder carrying destructive power blasted fiercely towards the Golden Core evil spirit.
Where the thunder light passed, the air was instantly ionized with a "sizzle" sound, as if space itself was distorted.
"Roar!"
The Golden Core evil spirit clearly sensed the immense threat posed by the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman, let out an infuriated roar, its sound echoing through the sky as if it wanted to tear this sky apart.
Whoosh...
Accompanied by the roar, swirls of thick, inky black mist rapidly spread in front of it.
In the blink of an eye, it condensed into a gigantic black wall dozens of feet high, exuding a terrifying aura, attempting to withstand this deadly blow.
Boom!
Accompanied by an earth-shattering crash that seemed to shatter the world, the purple Divine Thunder crashed heavily onto the black mist wall.
In an instant, brilliant light flared, and the powerful energy wave spread outward like a storm.
The Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman was a Third-rank Lower Grade talisman containing terrifying might.
Even ordinary Golden Core Cultivators would have to avoid facing such Divine Thunder head-on.
Moreover, the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman was specifically designed to counter evil spirits, making it even more lethal to the Golden Core evil spirit before them.
Bam!
The unstoppable purple thunder pierced through the black mist wall, exploding directly on the youth.
The formidable Thunder Power erupted instantly, engulfing the Golden Core evil spirit in a sea of purple thunder light, the powerful energy impact twisting the surrounding space.
"Th-Third-rank talisman!"
At this moment, Gong Yang, Duan Shuang, and Song Qiwu had already halted their Escape Light, staring blankly at the breathtaking scene before them.
They all widened their eyes, filled with disbelief, their eyeballs nearly falling out.
They couldn’t believe that Xu Ping could actually take out such a tremendously powerful Third-rank talisman.
This was a Third-rank talisman!
Comparable to the power of a Golden Core Cultivator!
"Could this talisman have been drawn by him?"
At this moment, an idea that shocked them to the core involuntarily surfaced in their minds.
The thunder light lasted for several breaths before gradually dissipating.
Everyone fixed their gaze, only to see the Golden Core evil spirit’s body riddled with holes from the thunder light, the sinister aura on it dimmer than before.
"Roar!"
The Golden Core evil spirit’s body trembled slightly, letting out a roar of pain, evidently suffering extremely severe injuries.
"It’s not dead yet!"
Xu Ping’s eyes squinted slightly, a trace of fierceness flashing through his gaze.
Without hesitation, he retrieved another Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman.
"Swift!"
With a soft shout from him, a purple thunderbolt, like a flood dragon, roared towards the youth.
In the blood-red eyes of the Golden Core evil spirit, for the first time, there was a trace of fear.
Its figure flickered, transforming into a black light in a desperate attempt to escape.
However, the speed of the thunderbolt was too fast for it to evade.
Boom!
The thunderbolt hit the Golden Core evil spirit heavily, the Thunder Power and sinister aura wildly entangled, colliding.
Continuous "crackling" sounds filled the air, the light flickering uncertainly, the entire sky turned an eerie shade of purple by this terrifying force.
The powerful energy shockwave raged in all directions.
Nearby rocks shattered, turned to dust; surrounding trees vaporized instantly, without leaving a trace.
"Is this...a Third-rank talisman?"
The faces of Gong Yang, Duan Shuang, and Song Qiwu instantly turned as pale as paper.
Even though they were quite a distance away, they could still clearly feel the terrifying power that made their hearts race.
If they took such a blow, not even their bones would remain.
"It should be... dead now, right?"
Xu Ping fixed his gaze on the direction of the explosion, a hint of paleness flashing across his face.
The continuous use of two Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans was no small burden even with his current Divine Sense.
At this moment, the dust cleared!
A broken corpse shrouded in strands of sinister aura slowly fell from the sky like a kite with a broken string.
Everyone was shocked to find that, having faced the terrifying assault of two Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans head-on, the Golden Core evil spirit still hadn’t completely died!
Its vitality was far beyond everyone’s imagination.
However, at this moment, it only had one last breath left, its aura incredibly weak.
Seeing this scene, Xu Ping let out a small sigh of relief in his heart.
Not wanting to waste any more Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans, he took out a Second-stage Upper Grade Thunder Element talisman, preparing to send it on its way.
"Go!"
Xu Ping gently waved his hand, infusing Mana into the talisman.
Boom!
Thunder roared again, the dazzling thunder light instantly obliterating the last breath of the Golden Core evil spirit.

chapters.title: Chapter 210 - 169: Slaying the Golden Core Evil Spirit! (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 210: Chapter 169: Slaying the Golden Core Evil Spirit! (Part 3)
Suddenly, the entire battlefield fell into a deathly silence, leaving only the heavy and rapid breathing of a few people.
"Succeeded?" Duan Shuang murmured in disbelief.
"This... Fellow Daoist Xu Ping actually slew the Golden Core evil entity by himself!" Gong Yang was full of shock, his voice even trembling slightly.
Song Qiwu, on the other hand, looked at Xu Ping with a complex expression, feeling both awe and relief.
"It’s finally dead!"
Seeing the Golden Core evil entity had turned to ashes, Xu Ping could finally breathe a sigh of relief.
Fortunately, it was restrained by the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman, otherwise, any other Golden Core cultivator or third-rank demon beast probably wouldn’t have been slain so easily.
"Huh?"
"A Yin Qi Pearl?"
Just as Xu Ping was about to join Song Qiwu and the other two, he suddenly paused, discovering a silvery-white glowing pearl amidst the remains of the Golden Core evil entity.
Without hesitation, he used mana to form a giant mana hand, securely grasping the Yin Qi Pearl in his hand.
This was a Yin Qi Pearl at the Golden Core level; although he couldn’t use it for the time being, it was undoubtedly a valuable item.
At this moment, Gong Yang and the other two barely recovered from their shock and quickly used Escape Light to reach Xu Ping’s side.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, are you alright?" Duan Shuang asked concernedly upon seeing Xu Ping’s somewhat pale face.
"I’m fine, just consumed quite a bit of Divine Sense." Xu Ping forced a slight smile.
At this moment, Gong Yang couldn’t help but ask, "Fellow Daoist Xu Ping, was this third-rank Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman drawn by you?"
Xu Ping pondered for a moment and smiled wryly:
"Indeed, I was lucky enough to draw it, but I only managed to draw two, both of which are now used up."
Since the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman was exposed, there was no need to hide it anymore.
"Hiss!"
Although the three had vaguely guessed, they couldn’t help but gasp when Xu Ping confirmed it.
Third-rank Talisman Masters were rarer than Golden Core cultivators throughout Yue Country.
And Xu Ping, just a mid-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, could draw third-rank talismans—was his Talisman Master talent even stronger than his swordsmanship talent?
"Thank you, Talisman Master Xu, for saving our lives today. If it weren’t for Talisman Master Xu, we would likely not have escaped the pursuit of the Golden Core evil entity."
Song Qiwu respectfully bowed.
A third-rank Talisman Master held a higher status than Fake Pill cultivators, even if their ancestor met Xu Ping, he would politely call him ’Daoist’.
If he were to call him Daoist again, it would seem inappropriate.
"Fellow Daoist Song is courteous; this Golden Core evil entity was clearly targeting me, I only defended myself."
"My Divine Sense is greatly consumed after using two third-rank talismans in succession, so I won’t chat with you further," Xu Ping bowed, then used Escape Light to hurry towards Thousand Leaves Mountain.
At this moment, he had no intention to chat idly; the exposure of his trump card made him feel a lack of safety.
He resolved not to leave Thousand Leaves Mountain until he had drawn a third-rank mid-grade talisman.
...
After Xu Ping left, Song Qiwu didn’t wish to stay either.
He bowed to Duan Shuang and Gong Yang, "Fellow Daoists, I shall take my leave."
"Safe travels, Fellow Daoist Song!" Duan Shuang and Gong Yang politely returned the gesture.
Watching Song Qiwu’s gradually distant figure, Gong Yang couldn’t help but sigh, "What a thrilling day."
Recalling the despair when encountering the Golden Core evil entity, he still felt apprehensive.
He had thought he was doomed at that time.
Unexpectedly, Xu Ping suddenly displayed great prowess, using third-rank talismans to obliterate the terrifying Golden Core evil entity.
"Indeed, who would’ve thought Fellow Daoist Xu quietly drew the third-rank talismans!"
Duan Shuang was also filled with emotion and amazement.
"Now Fellow Daoist Xu is bound to be famous throughout the Wanzhe Waters."
If it weren’t for Hu Country’s invasion and the turbulent situation, he would probably be famous throughout Yue Country.
The two exchanged a glance and couldn’t help but smile.
Xu Ping drawing third-rank talismans was a great fortune for them too.
Not to mention other things, at least they wouldn’t have to fear Golden Core evil entities at Purple Bamboo Mountain.
...
...
Half a month later.
At the core site of the third-rank Spirit Vein of the Song family.
"You are saying, Xu Ping drew third-rank talismans and slew a Golden Core evil entity?" The Song family’s patriarch stared intently at Song Qiwu, speaking slowly and deliberately.
"Yes!"
Song Qiwu nodded firmly, "It was a kind of Thunder Element third-rank talisman; Xu Ping used two in succession, directly crushing the Golden Core evil entity down to its last breath."
Upon hearing this, the Song family’s patriarch showed a complex expression.
He squinted slightly, his mind racing.
The power of such a formidable third-rank talisman would be difficult even for him to easily withstand with his cultivation and strength.
Does this mean that Xu Ping now possesses the terrifying ability to kill him?
Thinking of this, the Song family’s patriarch felt a sense of relief.
Fortunately, he chose to reconcile with the other party back then; otherwise, having a third-rank Talisman Master as an enemy, especially a gifted third-rank Talisman Master, would make him restless.
After a moment of silence, the Song family’s patriarch quickly regained his usual calm composure and instructed peacefully:
"In the future, you should engage more with this Talisman Master Xu; it would be best to obtain a few third-rank talismans."
"Yes." Song Qiwu nodded respectfully.
"If he refuses, use some subtle means. You’ve dealt with the family market for many years; I’m sure I don’t need to teach you," continued the Song family’s patriarch.
"I understand," Song Qiwu smiled faintly.
Subtle means: just playing the sympathy card along with the third-rank Spirit Wood restriction.
Obviously, it wouldn’t be wise to forcibly threaten Xu Ping.
"Oh!"
The Song family’s patriarch suddenly remembered something, pondered for a moment, and then slowly resumed speaking.
"Spread the word widely that Xu Ping is a third-rank Talisman Master and has slain a Golden Core evil entity; make sure to target the markets controlled by the Shuize Sect."
Upon hearing this, a flash appeared in Song Qiwu’s eyes; he immediately understood and bowed in salute:
"Yes! I will follow the patriarch’s instructions!"
Although the Shuize Sect was surrounded by several Golden Core Perfection evil entities, there were still quite a few people from the Shuize Sect remaining in the markets it controlled.
From what he knew, there was even a Fake Pill cultivator who also remained in the market.

chapters.title: Chapter 211 - 170: An Old Friend Invites to Join the Shuize Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 211: Chapter 170: An Old Friend Invites to Join the Shuize Sect
Not long after, Xu Ping’s name spread like wildfire across the entire Wanzhe Waters, thanks to the deliberate and widespread promotion by the Song family.
The ability to draw third-stage talismans and to slay a Golden Core demon in one fell swoop, each of these feats alone would be enough to stir up a storm in Wanzhe Waters.
Moreover, both of these astounding feats were achieved by the same person.
Those who heard of this couldn’t help but marvel, especially in these challenging times when demons run rampant.
People pondered in their hearts that if they could acquire one or two third-stage talismans, wouldn’t they have a crucial layer of protection in these demon-infested times?
...
...
Dragon Lion Island.
In the marketplace of Dragon Lion Island, there was a particularly luxurious building.
"Elder Hao, all the detailed information about Talisman Master Xu is recorded in this jade slip."
A Foundation Establishment Cultivator respectfully presented a jade slip to a burly middle-aged man.
"Hmm."
The middle-aged man nodded slightly, using the mana within his body to form a gigantic mana hand, which steadily received the jade slip.
Next, he delved his Divine Sense into the jade slip.
Instantly, the various bits of information about Xu Ping recorded in the jade slip clearly surfaced within his Divine Sense.
After a moment, the middle-aged man withdrew his Divine Sense, a meaningful smile appearing on his face, as he murmured to himself:
"Interesting... The experience of this Talisman Master Xu is indeed legendary."
Born a loose cultivator, he succeeded in Foundation Establishment at Qiu Xuan Immortal City, and later joined Qiu Xuan Mountain.
Later, during the beast tide, he showcased ’Sword Qi Thunder Sound,’ dazzling everyone.
However, he vanished after the beast tide broke through Qiu Xuan Immortal City.
Upon reemerging, he had settled at Purple Bamboo Mountain.
During this period, he consecutively defeated a Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator and a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator. His displayed strength was in no way inferior to cultivators at Foundation Establishment Perfection.
Most recently, he made a name for himself by drawing a third-stage talisman and successfully slaying a Golden Core demon, spreading throughout Wanzhe Waters.
"You also once served at Qiu Xuan Mountain, so you should be quite familiar with this Talisman Master Xu, right?"
The middle-aged man turned to a plain-faced, robust Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator next to him.
If Xu Ping were present, he would surely recognize at a glance that this Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator was indeed his old acquaintance at Qiu Xuan Mountain—Xu Zhixuan.
"Still... fairly familiar." Xu Zhixuan forced a smile, his mood extremely complex at this moment.
He never imagined that after not seeing each other for over a decade, Xu Ping would have soared high up in the sky.
Yet he remained stuck at Early-Stage Foundation Establishment, with even his personal freedom heavily restricted.
"In that case, you are to head to Thousand Leaves Mountain immediately and buy some third-stage talismans. Meanwhile, see if there’s a chance to recruit this Talisman Master Xu to our Shuize Sect!"
The middle-aged man decisively commanded.
Currently, the Shuize Sect was encircled by demons, and if they could bring in a third-stage talisman, the sect’s hope of breaking the demon encirclement would undoubtedly increase.
Xu Zhixuan opened his mouth slightly, seemingly wanting to say something, but swallowed it back, hesitating for a moment, finally nodding and responding: "Yes!"
Now, his life and fate were in the hands of the other party, leaving no room for refusal.
...
...
Two months passed swiftly.
At the foot of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"You should leave now, my master is in closed-door cultivation and will not see anyone!"
At this time, the Water Lake Mouse, standing two zhang tall and exuding a fierce aura, looked down at a Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator and spoke through Divine Sense transmission.
Although this Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator was surprised that a Second-stage Lower Grade Demon Beast could transmit via Divine Sense, now was clearly not the time to delve into such matters.
"When will Talisman Master Xu likely exit closed-door cultivation?"
He pleaded warmly, "I sincerely wish to purchase some third-stage talismans. Spirit Stones are absolutely not an issue, and I humbly request you, revered spirit, to please inform him."
As he spoke, he gently flipped his palm, and an inconspicuous, dusty storage bag appeared in his hand, which he then supported with mana before the Water Lake Mouse.
"How would I know when my master will exit closed-door cultivation?"
The Water Lake Mouse resolutely refused, its tone filled with impatience, "Leave quickly, leave quickly. If you provoke my master’s wrath, you wouldn’t be able to bear it."
Ever since it was caught discreetly taking Spirit Stones by its master and punished, it dared not repeat the same mistake.
’This damn mouse!’
Hearing the Water Lake Mouse’s rude response, the Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator couldn’t help but curse inwardly.
Yet his face maintained a smile of appeasement: "I shall wait until Talisman Master Xu comes out of closed-door cultivation and visit again."
After sending this person away, as the Water Lake Mouse was about to return to the top of Thousand Leaves Mountain, another Escape Light approached swiftly from afar.
’These people never end?’ The Water Lake Mouse was full of frustration.
Currently, it had to take care of the spirit medicines and spirit plants on the mountain diligently, and also continuously handle people hoping to meet its master, leaving no time to rest throughout the day.
"My master is in closed-door cultivation and will not see anyone, leave!" The Water Lake Mouse transmitted via Divine Sense even before the person approached.
"I am an old acquaintance of Talisman Master Xu. Could you, revered spirit, please inform him?" The person hastily said.
"Master’s old acquaintance?" The Water Lake Mouse was slightly taken aback...
...
Thousand Leaves Mountain, cultivation chamber.

chapters.title: Chapter 212 - 170: An Old Friend Invites to Join the Shuize Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 212: Chapter 170: An Old Friend Invites to Join the Shuize Sect
"After spending two months, I finally managed to transform this segment of Third-rank Spirit Wood into two hundred and twenty sheets of Third-rank Talisman Paper."
Xu Ping gazed at the neatly arranged stacks of talisman paper on the stone table, their surfaces gleaming with mysterious purple light, and he couldn’t help but let out a long sigh of relief.
With the Third-rank Talisman Paper successfully crafted, he could now attempt to draw Third-rank Mid-grade Talismans.
Ever since the incident involving the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman was exposed, Xu Ping had been feeling quite uneasy.
Especially now, when his reputation was soaring and spreading throughout the Wanzhe Waters, this inexplicable sense of unease grew increasingly intense.
After all, in the current situation, having too much fame was not a good thing.
Moreover, he faintly suspected that the rapid and widespread dissemination of his reputation was likely being deliberately driven by someone behind the scenes.
"The Song family?"
Xu Ping narrowed his eyes slightly, and the suspicion instantly surfaced in his mind.
After all, in the entire Wanzhe Waters, his only conflict had been with the Song family.
Furthermore, given the Song family’s influence and methods, spreading the news to all corners in a short time was not difficult.
"Good!"
A trace of murderous intent involuntarily appeared in Xu Ping’s eyes.
The Song family had long been added to his must-kill list, but currently, his strength was not powerful enough, so he could only endure for now.
"Soon!"
Xu Ping muttered under his breath, forcibly suppressing the turbulent thoughts and intense killing intent in his heart.
For now, the most important task was to focus his energy on drawing the Third-rank Mid-grade Talisman.
However, Xu Ping did not rush blindly into attempting it due to impatience.
Firstly, he practiced the Longevity Skill to adjust his state to the best peak condition before he properly prepared to draw the Third-rank Mid-grade Talisman.
Xu Ping closed his eyes, carefully recalling the Third-rank Mid-grade Talisman he intended to draw—the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman.
This talisman was a gold-type talisman, possessing an extremely powerful attack, its might virtually equivalent to the full-force strike of a cultivator at the Middle Stage of Golden Core.
Compared to the earlier drawn Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman, the difficulty of drawing the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman was much higher.
"Let’s begin!"
After repeatedly recalling and confirming every detail of the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman in his mind, Xu Ping slowly opened his eyes, gently unfolded the talisman paper, and picked up the talisman pen, ready to formally begin the drawing.
However, at this moment, the Divine Sense transmission of the Lake-Mouse passed through the wall and entered his mind:
"Master, someone claiming to be an old acquaintance of yours has come to visit."
"An old acquaintance?"
Xu Ping’s hand holding the talisman pen involuntarily paused, his brows furrowed tightly, "What’s the name of the visitor?"
He couldn’t recall any old acquaintances in the Wanzhe Waters.
Could it be someone deliberately inventing such an excuse just to meet him?
"He said his name is Xu Zhixuan," Lake-Mouse promptly replied.
"Xu Zhixuan?"
Xu Ping’s demeanor subtly shifted in surprise, not expecting it to be him.
At this moment, memories from the past surged like tides, pulling his thoughts back to when he had just succeeded in Foundation Establishment and joined Qiu Xuan Mountain.
Counting the years, it’s been roughly over a decade since they last met.
"Master, do you wish to see him?" Lake-Mouse inquired again via the Divine Sense transmission.
Xu Ping pondered for a moment and slowly said, "Invite him to the side hall."
After all, during their time at Qiu Xuan Mountain, their relationship was fairly amicable. Since he came, they should meet.
"Yes."
Having received the response, Lake-Mouse silently went down the mountain to prepare to welcome Xu Zhixuan.
...
A quarter of an hour later.
In the side hall.
"It’s been over a decade since we last saw each other, and now Fellow Daoist—Talisman Master Xu has soared to great heights, your reputation spreading throughout the entire Wanzhe Waters. It’s truly admirable!"
Xu Zhixuan beamed with smiles, cupped his hands, and greeted Xu Ping.
"We’ve known each other for years, Fellow Daoist Xu, no need to be so formal. Feel free to speak casually." Xu Ping replied with a smile.
Upon hearing this, Xu Zhixuan’s smile grew even brighter: "Then I graciously accept your kindness."
After a few brief pleasantries, Xu Zhixuan began recounting his experiences since escaping from Qiu Xuan Immortal City over the last decade.
Xu Ping listened, occasionally nodding in acknowledgment, but when Xu Zhixuan mentioned joining Shuize Sect and becoming its Guest Minister, Xu Ping’s brow subtly furrowed.
"So, Fellow Daoist Xu has been with Shuize Sect for two or three years?" Xu Ping inquired.
"Indeed."
Xu Zhixuan nodded, then proceeded to praise Shuize Sect,
"Shuize Sect treats its Guest Ministers very generously. As an Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, not only is there a monthly Pill aiding in Mana enhancement, but also a handsome salary..."
At this point, Xu Ping instantly grasped the genuine purpose behind his visit.
The initial joy of meeting an old friend instantly vanished without a trace.
Xu Ping smiled faintly, timely interrupting Xu Zhixuan’s words: "It seems Fellow Daoist Xu didn’t come specifically to reminisce with an old friend, but rather to act as a spokesperson for Shuize Sect."
Xu Zhixuan’s face revealed a hint of embarrassment: "To be honest, I was indeed entrusted by the Shuize Sect elder in charge of Dragon Lion Market to invite Fellow Daoist Xu to join Shuize Sect."
"Could it be Elder Hao?"
Xu Ping’s brows furrowed tightly; to his knowledge, this Elder Hao from Shuize Sect was a Fake Pill cultivator.
"Exactly."
Xu Zhixuan quickly nodded and continued, "Elder Hao has already consulted the Sect Leader of Shuize Sect; if Fellow Daoist Xu agrees to join, a position of elder will surely be granted."

chapters.title: Chapter 213 - 170: An Old Friend Invites Me to Join the Shuize Sect (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 213: Chapter 170: An Old Friend Invites Me to Join the Shuize Sect (3)
"The position of Elder?"
Xu Ping inwardly sighed and immediately shook his head in refusal, "I appreciate your sect’s kindness, but I have always been accustomed to a carefree life and have no desire to join any faction."
Only if he were mad would he fight to the death for a Shuize Sect elder position.
"Fellow Daoist Xu..."
Xu Zhixuan tried to persuade him further, but was once again interrupted by Xu Ping: "Fellow Daoist Xu, there’s no need to say more, I truly have no intention of joining any sect or faction at present, my mind is made up."
Xu Ping’s tone was exceptionally firm, and his attitude was quite clear.
Xu Zhixuan opened his mouth, wanting to say more, but in the end, the words turned into a simple: "I understand."
At this moment, the gap between the two of them was like heaven and earth; he truly couldn’t find the right words to continue persuading.
"Then, Fellow Daoist Xu, could you sell me a few third-rank talismans? Spirit Stones are absolutely not a problem." Xu Zhixuan cupped his hands again, his words full of pleading.
If he couldn’t complete any of the tasks Elder Hao assigned, life would not be easy once he returned.
However, faced with Xu Zhixuan’s plea, Xu Ping wasn’t moved at all, instead showing a faint bitter smile:
"To be honest with Fellow Daoist Xu, I only managed to draw two third-rank talismans, and they were all used up during the last battle against evil spirits.
"Moreover, you know that with my current mid-stage Foundation Establishment cultivation, drawing a third-rank talisman is extremely difficult. As for when a new third-rank talisman will be successfully created, I have no confidence.
"However, rest assured, Fellow Daoist Xu, if I succeed in drawing new third-rank talismans in the future, I will definitely consider trading with your sect first."
Xu Ping spoke these words very sincerely.
In his heart, these third-rank talismans cannot be sold at this moment.
Only when he successfully draws mid-grade third-rank talismans does he intend to consider it.
Despite Xu Ping’s sincere words, Xu Zhixuan, who was determined to complete Elder Hao’s assigned task, still refused to give up and asked:
"Fellow Daoist Xu, do you really not have a single third-rank talisman left?"
"What? Do you intend to search me, Fellow Daoist Xu?"
Seeing Xu Zhixuan pressing on endlessly, Xu Ping’s attitude suddenly turned cold.
He didn’t have much of a close friendship with Xu Zhixuan, and moreover, they hadn’t met for over a decade, and their camaraderie had long since faded.
Besides, since Xu Zhixuan was now a Guest Minister of Shuize Sect, he didn’t want to have too much to do with him.
Drawing a clear boundary now would save a lot of trouble in the future.
"How... how could that be, I was just in a moment of desperation, I hope Fellow Daoist Xu can forgive me." Xu Zhixuan broke out in a cold sweat and quickly apologized.
Now that Xu Ping’s strength and position had far surpassed his, how could he dare to offend him lightly?
"No problem, I understand your difficulties."
Xu Ping’s tone was cold, and then he gave the order to dismiss the guest, "However, I have important matters to attend to next, so I won’t keep you any longer, Fellow Daoist Xu."
"Since... since that’s the case, I won’t be able to stay any longer." Xu Zhixuan forced a very awkward smile.
At this moment, a trace of resentment towards Xu Ping arose in his heart.
He merely asked one more question, yet Xu Ping’s attitude was so cold, completely disregarding their many years of friendship and issuing a dismissal.
Although Xu Zhixuan harbored resentment towards Xu Ping in his heart, he didn’t show it on his face, instead, he respectfully bid farewell to Xu Ping and flew away hastily from Thousand Leaves Mountain on his Escape Light.
Watching Xu Zhixuan’s gradually receding figure, Xu Ping couldn’t help but reveal a slight cold smile at the corner of his mouth.
Though he appeared respectful outwardly, he was sure to harbor resentment within.
But Xu Ping didn’t care, as a Shuize Sect fake pill cultivator posed no threat to him.
Once Xu Zhixuan’s figure completely disappeared, Xu Ping called the Water Lake Mouse over and specifically instructed: "Remember, next time don’t let this person in, got it?"
"Understood!"
The Water Lake Mouse nodded hastily, a flattering expression plastered on its face.
It keenly sensed that its master was in a bad mood, fearing that it might accidentally provoke the master, who could then vent his anger on it, something it couldn’t afford to risk.
"Hmm, you may go now." Xu Ping nodded slightly.
"Yes, master!"
Without another word, the Water Lake Mouse turned and ran away, as if chased by a terrifying monster, disappearing in the blink of an eye.
"That damned mouse!"
Seeing this, Xu Ping couldn’t help but chuckle and curse.
He naturally understood why the Water Lake Mouse was in such a hurry to run away.
He did have a fleeting thought of mildly punishing the mouse, but he had not carried it out yet.
"Truly timid as a mouse!"
Xu Ping shook his head helplessly, then got up and returned to the cultivating room, once again immersing himself wholly in talisman making.
...
...
Ten days later.
Dragon and Lion Market.
"From what you say, of the two tasks assigned to you, not a single one was accomplished?"
Elder Hao’s tone seemed flat, yet his cold eyes revealed his deep dissatisfaction.
Xu Zhixuan trembled all over, instinctively wanting to place all the blame on Xu Ping:
"Elder Hao, it’s really not my fault! Xu Ping showed no sense of camaraderie; he barely let me speak before he threw me out."
"Regarding purchasing talismans and inviting him to join our Shuize Sect, he refused outright, without the slightest room for negotiation."
"From what I see, since he’s become a third-rank Talisman Master, he simply doesn’t regard our currently weakened Shuize Sect at all!"

chapters.title: Chapter 214 - 171: The Temptation of Spiritual Objects for Core Formation
chapters.content:
Chapter 214: Chapter 171: The Temptation of Spiritual Objects for Core Formation
"Oh, is that so?" Elder Hao’s face remained calm, making it hard to gauge his thoughts.
He knew well that Xu Zhixuan had surely exaggerated and embellished the story to some extent.
However, Xu Ping’s refusal to join Shuize Sect and his unwillingness to sell them talismans was undoubtedly a fact nailed down.
"Elder Hao, how dare I deceive you? This matter is absolutely true, not a single false word!" Xu Zhixuan assured vehemently while patting his chest.
After a brief pause, his eyes shifted, and he started to embellish again: "Who knows, Xu Ping might have secretly allied with Luoyun Sect."
"Joining Luoyun Sect?"
Elder Hao frowned slightly, though he thought it was highly unlikely, it was not impossible.
If a third-level Talisman Master were to join Luoyun Sect, the damage to their sect could even be more severe than that caused by a Golden Core Cultivator.
During ordinary times, it might still be tolerable, but given the current tense situation, if talents like Xu Ping cannot be used by Shuize Sect, they must be dealt with to prevent future troubles.
Elder Hao pondered for a moment, his gaze fell back on Xu Zhixuan, before he slowly asked, "How confident are you in luring Xu Ping out of Thousand Leaves Mountain?"
He knew well, if Xu Ping continued to stay hidden in Thousand Leaves Mountain, it would indeed be hard to find an opportunity to strike.
But if he could be lured out, and caught off guard in an ambush, he’d have great confidence in preventing Xu Ping from deploying his talismans, solving him in one swift move.
"Lure out?"
Xu Zhixuan was stunned for a moment and showed a difficult expression, "Just based on my current thin friendship with him, I’m afraid it’s quite challenging."
He realized clearly, the relationship with Xu Ping had almost been exhausted.
He even doubted whether he could step into the mountain gate if he went to Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"What if we use Core Formation Spiritual Objects as bait?" Elder Hao asked, his gaze intense.
"Core Formation Spiritual Objects?" Xu Zhixuan stirred sharply in his heart.
In the Cultivation Realm, unless you are a genius with a Celestial Spirit Root, almost no Foundation Establishment Cultivator can resist the temptation of Core Formation Spiritual Objects.
Xu Zhixuan lowered his head and pondered for a while before slowly speaking, "If we use Core Formation Spiritual Objects as the lure, the possibility of luring Xu Ping out of Thousand Leaves Mountain is quite high."
"But... fabricating a believable false story would indeed be difficult."
"Who said we have to use a false story?" Elder Hao said coldly.
Upon hearing this, Xu Zhixuan was startled and instinctively asked, "Could it be... you intend to use real Core Formation Spiritual Objects to lure him?"
...
...
Three months later.
Inside the cultivation room at Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"Poof!"
The semi-finished Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman being drafted suddenly caught fire, a violent stream of Geng Metal power surged out from the talisman.
"Creak...creak..."
This force left several deep marks on the sturdy wall.
"Failed again!"
Xu Ping was extremely frustrated, waving his hand to extinguish the flame.
He had spent three months crafting the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman.
During this period, he wasted dozens of third-grade talisman papers, yet he hadn’t even grasped the secret of the talisman, and success seemed far away.
However, after repeated attempts, he vaguely sensed the crux of the problem.
Though his mana barely met the requirements, his Divine Sense was somewhat lacking.
The feeling was akin to a child attempting to wield a heavy hammer, unable to exert force.
"Do I really have to break through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment before trying again?" Xu Ping pondered secretly.
He knew well that once he broke through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment, his Divine Sense would certainly receive a substantial boost.
By then, the success rate of crafting the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman would surely increase.
Thinking this, Xu Ping shifted his thoughts and opened the proficiency panel.
[Realm: Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment: 87/100; Blood Demon Body Refining second level: 99/100]
"Just thirteen more points... At my current cultivation speed, it probably needs... about a year more."
Gazing at the numbers on the panel, Xu Ping estimated inwardly.
"A year!" he muttered softly to himself.
Since he didn’t plan to leave Thousand Leaves Mountain involuntarily anytime soon, a year was neither long nor short, and would pass rather quickly.
Xu Ping gently waved his sleeve, sweeping up all the talisman paper, talisman pen, spiritual ink, and other items on the stone table.
Just as he was about to leave the cultivation room, Water Lake Rat greeted him with a fawning face:
"Master, your friend Gong Yang has come to visit, would you like to see him?"
"Gong Yang?"
"Invite him to the pavilion," Xu Ping nodded and said.
...
...
Inside the pavilion.
"Fellow Daoist Gong, please have some tea!" Xu Ping smiled and poured a cup of fragrant Spirit Tea for Gong Yang.
"Tha...thank you, Fellow Daoist Xu." Gong Yang appeared somewhat nervous and uneasy.
Since Xu Ping successfully slew the evil Golden Core, this was their first meeting.
Now, both in terms of status and power, they’re vastly disparate, making Gong Yang momentarily lost, unsure how to face Xu Ping.
Xu Ping naturally noticed Gong Yang’s restraint, so he smiled and half-jokingly said:
"Fellow Daoist Gong being so courteous, could it be like others, here to ask for a third-grade talisman?"
"Let me say first, I haven’t crafted one yet!"
Upon hearing this joke, Gong Yang’s heart immediately eased, the barrier and unfamiliarity vanished instantly.
A slight smile involuntarily appeared on his face: "Of course not."
"Good, I’m glad it’s not."

chapters.title: Chapter 215 - 171: The Temptation of Core Formation Spiritual Objects (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 215: Chapter 171: The Temptation of Core Formation Spiritual Objects (Part 2)
Xu Ping smiled faintly, "Fellow Daoist Gong, try the Spirit Tea I just picked recently. It tastes quite good!"
He gestured with his hand in an inviting manner.
"Then I must savor it well." Gong Yang raised the teacup and said with a smile.
With a cup of Spirit Tea consumed, the atmosphere between the two gradually became harmonious.
After a few more casual words, Gong Yang turned serious and spoke of the actual matter of his visit: "Fellow Daoist Xu, to be honest, I have an important matter to discuss with you today."
"Feel free to speak!" Xu Ping smiled slightly, adopting a posture of attentive listening.
"I want to invite Fellow Daoist Xu to explore a secret realm together."
Gong Yang organized his words briefly and said with a serious expression, "I know Fellow Daoist Xu has never been keen on exploring secret realms, but the situation this time is somewhat special."
"Oh?"
"What is special about it?"
Xu Ping asked with interest.
"I discovered traces of Crystal Condensing Liquid in that secret realm." A trace of excitement flashed in Gong Yang’s eyes.
"Crystal Condensing Liquid?"
Xu Ping’s heart jolted.
This Crystal Condensing Liquid is renowned in the Cultivation Realm, as it can at least increase the success rate of Core Formation by one or two percent.
Do not underestimate this one or two percent success rate; for countless cultivators at Foundation Establishment Perfection struggling to form a core, it’s enough to lead them into fierce contests.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, look!"
As Gong Yang spoke, he gently flipped his hand, and a crystal-clear Jade Bottle appeared in his palm.
Xu Ping fixed his gaze, noticing a small cluster of silvery-white viscous liquid flowing inside the Jade Bottle.
"Is this Crystal Condensing Liquid inside?"
Xu Ping’s face showed curiosity, as he had only ever heard of the renowned Crystal Condensing Liquid and never seen the actual object.
"Exactly!"
Gong Yang nodded with certainty, "What is contained inside is indeed genuine Crystal Condensing Liquid!"
"However, the quantity of this small cluster of Crystal Condensing Liquid is really insufficient. According to my estimation, at least five or six portions are needed to barely meet the requirement for a cultivator’s Core Formation."
As Gong Yang spoke, a trace of regret appeared on his face.
"Five or six portions?" A glimmer of contemplation flickered in Xu Ping’s eyes, before he continued to ask, "Fellow Daoist Gong, was this small portion of Crystal Condensing Liquid acquired from that ruin?"
"Indeed!"
Gong Yang answered confidently, "My friend and I only broke the restrictions on the periphery of that secret realm to obtain this small portion of Crystal Condensing Liquid."
"If all the restrictions in the secret realm can be broken, there must be plenty of Crystal Condensing Liquid remaining inside."
"However, the core restriction of that secret realm is extremely powerful. With my and my friend’s abilities, it is very difficult to break it in a short time, and once we act, it’s easy for information to leak out."
"Therefore, after much deliberation, I wish to invite Fellow Daoist Xu to come along. Once the restrictions are broken, the treasures inside will be equally divided among the three of us."
Gong Yang spoke sincerely, his tone was very earnest.
Now that he was at Late-Stage Foundation Establishment, he naturally started planning for Core Formation.
Facing such a rare opportunity, he naturally did not want to miss it easily.
"Does anyone else know about this matter? And it’s not Duan Shuang?"
Xu Ping’s eyebrows furrowed almost imperceptibly.
He pondered for a moment before asking, "I wonder how Fellow Daoist Gong discovered this ruin?"
"It was my friend Li Wei who told me." Gong Yang answered truthfully.
"Friend Li Wei?"
Xu Ping had no impression of this unfamiliar name. After hearing it, the slight interest remaining in his heart completely vanished.
Although he trusted Gong Yang, it was difficult to generate a sense of trust towards this friend of Gong Yang’s whom he had never met.
"Thank you for the kind offer, Fellow Daoist Gong, but I am concerned that there might be traps or strong prohibitions lurking in the secret realm. In comparison, it is more prudent to stay at Thousand Leaves Mountain drawing talismans."
Xu Ping politely declined Gong Yang’s invitation.
In his view, even if the secret realm truly held a large amount of Crystal Condensing Liquid, he wasn’t interested in risking his safety to go there.
After all, he possessed a long lifespan, and there was ample time before he needed to form a core. There was no need to rush into danger at this time.
Once he reached Foundation Establishment Perfection, perfected the Sword Array cultivation, and broke through to the second stage of Sword Dao, it wouldn’t be too late to slowly seek out Core Formation Spiritual Objects.
Upon hearing Xu Ping’s refusal, Gong Yang instinctively wanted to persuade him further, but knowing Xu Ping’s nature, he swallowed back the words that came to his lips.
"Since Fellow Daoist Xu is unwilling, I have no choice but to seek out others." Gong Yang shook his head with slight regret.
"Then I wish Fellow Daoist Gong a fruitful journey." Xu Ping said with a smile.
"Thank you for your kind words, Fellow Daoist Xu!" Gong Yang replied with a hearty laugh.
...
Two days later.
Dragon Market.
"Xu Ping didn’t go?" Elder Hao was full of astonishment upon hearing Xu Zhixuan’s report.
"Yes."
Xu Zhixuan said with a face full of helplessness, "According to Li Wei, Xu Ping refused because he was concerned that the secret realm might contain traps or hidden prohibitions."
"Concerned about traps or hidden prohibitions in the secret realm?" Elder Hao’s eyebrows knitted together tightly.
What kind of ridiculous reason is that?
Given Xu Ping’s demonstrated combat power, combined with his ability as a Tier Three Talisman Master, how could he be afraid of such things?
"Could it be that you, or perhaps that Li Wei, had a fault in the execution of the plan, which allowed Xu Ping to detect a flaw?"
Elder Hao’s gaze turned sharp and dangerous.
"No... no!"
Xu Zhixuan broke into a cold sweat in fright and hurriedly explained, "I followed your plan precisely, proceeding cautiously every step of the way."

chapters.title: Chapter 216 - 171: The Temptation of Core Formation Spiritual Objects_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 216: Chapter 171: The Temptation of Core Formation Spiritual Objects_3
"Over on Li Wei’s side as well, mostly through subtle hints and suggestions, guiding Gong Yang to invite Xu Ping."
"Since no flaws have been exposed, why hasn’t Xu Ping taken the bait?" Elder Hao knitted his brows, lost in thought.
He found it hard to believe that the immense allure of the Crystal Condensing Liquid didn’t affect Xu Ping.
"Could it be... truly as Xu Ping himself said, that he’s genuinely worried about uncontrollable dangers in the secret realm?"
Xu Zhixuan cautiously said, "Back when we were at Qiu Xuan Mountain, Xu Ping was always focused on quietly cultivating, almost never leaving."
Upon hearing this, Elder Hao quietly recalled the information about Xu Ping previously recorded in the jade slip.
The jade slip noted that during the Ruins Deserted Island expedition, Xu Ping didn’t participate but stayed at Thousand Leaves Mountain to cultivate diligently.
"Could it indeed be as Xu Ping himself claims, worried about uncontrollable dangers in the secret realm?" Elder Hao furrowed his brows.
For now, this seems to be the only reasonable explanation.
"Elder Hao, since Xu Ping doesn’t want to go to the secret realm, our previous plans have fallen through. What should we do next?" Xu Zhixuan asked with a worried expression.
"Since the other party is concerned about encountering uncontrollable dangers in the ruins, find a relatively safer place."
Elder Hao quickly regained his composure, speaking with a cool tone.
"A safer place?" Xu Zhixuan was slightly puzzled, momentarily not comprehending Elder Hao’s meaning.
...
...
A month later.
Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"Fellow Daoist Duan, what brings you to Thousand Leaves Mountain today?" Xu Ping smiled as he poured a cup of Spirit Tea for Duan Shuang and asked.
"Must there always be a reason to come visit Fellow Daoist Xu for some old time’s sake and a chat?" Duan Shuang coyly raised her eyebrows and smiled brightly.
"Of course not."
Xu Ping wore a warm smile, "Fellow Daoist Duan is welcome anytime you wish to visit."
"Now that’s a promise, don’t say I’m a bother when the time comes." Duan Shuang joked lightly.
"How could that be, Fellow Daoist Duan?" Xu Ping smiled softly, picked up his cup, and took a delicate sip of Spirit Tea.
After some casual chatting, Duan Shuang’s expression turned serious as she spoke of her visit’s purpose: "Fellow Daoist Xu, truthfully, I’ve come with an important matter."
"Please speak, Fellow Daoist Duan." Xu Ping put down his cup, his expression earnest.
"It’s like this, I usually prefer not to attend regular auctions; instead, I enthusiastically participate in trade gatherings initiated by Foundation Establishment cultivators." Duan Shuang said slowly.
Xu Ping nodded slightly, as he was somewhat aware of this.
Trade gatherings initiated by Foundation Establishment cultivators are akin to underground auctions, where participants may voluntarily seek trades at the last moment.
However, the grade is much lower.
Duan Shuang continued, "Yet this trade gathering is somewhat unusual; I’ve heard rumors that someone is willing to trade the Frost Moon Peach."
"Frost Moon Peach?"
Xu Ping’s heart stirred slightly.
The Frost Moon Peach was also renowned in the Cultivation Realm as a Core Formation Spiritual Object.
Although its effect was slightly inferior to the Crystal Condensing Liquid, improving Core Formation success rate by merely half to one percent.
Even so, for those Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivators struggling for breakthroughs and longing for Core Formation, it remained invaluable.
"When I first heard this, I was quite shocked, thinking it was a false rumor to attract attention to the gathering."
"But after extensive inquiries, I found there indeed seemed to be someone intending to sell this item." Duan Shuang explained.
"However, I’ve heard that the price for Frost Moon Peach is extremely high, so I can’t afford it with my current resources. Thus, I thought of Fellow Daoist Xu."
As she spoke, Duan Shuang looked sincerely at Xu Ping, "With Fellow Daoist Xu’s strength and resources, acquiring this item and safely bringing it back should not be a problem."
Though she was also tempted by the Frost Moon Peach, she surely couldn’t afford it with her current resources.
Moreover, even if she acquired it, she certainly couldn’t carry it away with her strength.
"Trade gathering, huh?"
Upon hearing this, a ripple surged in his heart, almost tempting him.
Considering his resources and strength, acquiring the Frost Moon Peach seemed very promising.
Yet he quickly and keenly detected something peculiar.
Recently, the frequency of Core Formation Spiritual Objects appearing seemed somewhat excessive.
In the past, such rare Core Formation Spiritual Objects rarely appeared on the market, often not for decades, but now they were emerging one after another.
First was the Crystal Condensing Liquid mentioned last time in the secret realm, and now the Frost Moon Peach from the trade gathering.
After pondering for a moment, Xu Ping smiled wryly and shook his head, "I am unfortunately short of finances, so I won’t be attending."
"Truth be told, though I’ve crafted Third-tier talismans, the failure rate is terrifyingly high."
"It’s been so long since I slew the Golden Core demon, yet I’ve still not successfully crafted even one Third-tier talisman while squandering quite a bit of material, depleting most of my resources."
Upon hearing this, Duan Shuang regretfully shook her head, "That’s truly unfortunate; such Core Formation Spiritual Objects are truly hard to come by."
"There’s nothing unfortunate; everything has its destined time." Xu Ping feigned profundity and remarked.
Listening to this, Duan Shuang couldn’t help but smile, jesting, "When did Fellow Daoist Xu start delving into Daoist philosophy?"
...
...
"Could someone be scheming to lure me out of Thousand Leaves Mountain recently?"
After Duan Shuang left, Xu Ping sat alone in the pavilion, his brows tightly furrowed as strong vigilance arose in his heart.
Scrutinizing these two matters carefully, they seemed to lack any direct connection on the surface.
Moreover, he hadn’t detected any noticeable flaws from them.
But it was just too coincidental; sometimes excessive coincidence is also a flaw.
"Who could it be?"
Xu Ping pondered with knitted brows.
"The Song family?"
"Or... Shuize Sect?"

chapters.title: Chapter 217 - 172: Breaking Through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment
chapters.content:
Chapter 217: Chapter 172: Breaking Through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment
"The Song family?"
Xu Ping’s mind instantly flashed to the Song family.
After all, there was a grudge between them, and the rapid spread of his reputation this time seemed to vaguely bear the traces of the Song family.
"Or perhaps... the Shuize Sect?"
Xu Ping’s thoughts turned, and the image of Xu Zhixuan surfaced in his mind.
Previously, Xu Zhixuan had visited Thousand Leaves Mountain, first inviting him to join the Shuize Sect, and then requesting to purchase a third-tier talisman, but he had decisively refused.
Now, the Shuize Sect was deeply trapped in the plight of being besieged by evil forces.
For someone like him, a third-tier Talisman Master, his usefulness to the Shuize Sect would undoubtedly be immense.
Thinking this way, if the Shuize Sect was unwilling to give up, setting up such a trap meticulously to lure him away from Thousand Leaves Mountain seemed reasonable enough.
"No matter who the mastermind really is, daring to scheme against me like this, I will not let them off lightly once my strength is fully perfected!"
A chilling gleam flashed in Xu Ping’s eyes, revealing a hint of cold killing intent.
With his current ability, relying on the advantage of talismans, he was confident in taking down the Song family and Longshi Market in one fell swoop, but the risks were considerably high.
Just to eliminate enemies, risking his own life, in Xu Ping’s view, was really not worth it.
He always preferred to strike with thunderous might only when he had absolute strength and could ensure everything was foolproof.
"But, did Duan Shuang and Gong Yang participate in this plot to lure me out?"
Xu Ping’s brow slightly furrowed, and he fell into deep thought.
Though he felt that the two of them were probably not involved, human hearts are hard to read, and who could truly see through the thoughts of others?
"Ah, why do I just want to cultivate in peace, yet trouble keeps coming unceasingly?" Xu Ping sighed helplessly.
He originally had no intention of making trouble, but the troubles came like tides, wave after wave towards him.
In the end, it was still because his strength was not strong enough.
"The only way is to cultivate, I must break through to the Late-Stage Foundation Establishment as soon as possible!"
Xu Ping lightly waved his sleeve, properly putting away the teacup and teapot on the table, then turned and walked into the cultivation chamber with steady steps.
For him, reaching the Late-Stage Foundation Establishment meant not only a substantial increase in cultivation and strength.
More importantly, after reaching this realm, his Divine Sense would surge, allowing him to draw the incredibly powerful Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman.
...
...
Time flew by, and a month passed in the blink of an eye.
Longshi Market.
"Why hasn’t Xu Ping shown up at this trade fair? Could it be that you, thinking of past associations, secretly tipped him off?"
Elder Hao’s gaze was sharp, glaring intensely at Xu Zhixuan, his words carrying an undisguised hint of killing intent.
The plan that was originally perfect, ended up failing twice in succession, which truly tested his patience.
"Elder Hao, you must see clearly, I am truly innocent!"
Xu Zhixuan’s face turned ashen, terrified, quickly defending himself loudly, "Back at Qiu Xuan Mountain, my relationship with Xu Ping was very ordinary, and we could hardly talk about any rapport.
"Moreover, I specially went to Thousand Leaves Mountain to visit him a few days ago, not only did I not receive a good face, I was ruthlessly turned away."
"To this day, I only harbor hatred towards him, so how could I possibly leak information to him?"
Hearing this, the intense killing intent in Elder Hao’s eyes gradually dissipated, merely letting out a cold snort: "You don’t have the guts, that’s for sure!"
In fact, Elder Hao knew clearly in his heart that the likelihood of Xu Zhixuan secretly informing Xu Ping was indeed minuscule.
After all, Xu Zhixuan’s life and death were completely in his control.
Based on their relationship, it was clear that Xu Zhixuan would not risk his life to inform Xu Ping.
"Elder Hao, rest assured, I have always been loyal to the Shuize Sect, with no disloyalty at all."
Seeing Elder Hao’s killing intent reduce a bit, Xu Zhixuan secretly breathed a sigh of relief, then cautiously asked, "Now that Xu Ping hasn’t taken the bait, what should we do next?"
"What should we do?" Elder Hao also frowned, feeling increasingly troubled by the situation.
The other party remained unmoved even at a trading fair event, firmly staying out of sight, as if he was dead set.
Given this scenario, trying to tempt him out of Thousand Leaves Mountain again seemed almost impossible.
After pondering for a long time, Elder Hao decided to temporarily abandon the plan to deal with Xu Ping.
Once, twice, was fine, but a third attempt in a short period might alert Xu Ping to something unusual.
...
...
As time flowed by quietly, a year slipped by unknowingly.
During this year.
Purple Bamboo Mountain remained peaceful, Wanzhe Waters had no more Core Formation Spiritual Object sightings, and no one came to ask Xu Ping to search for treasures or participate in auctions.
Apart from the rampant scourge of evil forces, everything seemed peaceful.
On this day.
In the cultivation room, Xu Ping sat quietly on the meditation cushion.
As he operated the "Longevity Skill," the surrounding Spiritual Qi was seemingly drawn by some mysterious force, rushing towards him like rivers converging into the sea.
The previously calm and serene cultivation room instantly transformed as clouds and winds churned.
Spiritual Qi surged violently, forming a massive vortex centered on Xu Ping, spinning rapidly without cessation.
His body was tightly surrounded by a thick layer of azure light, that azure light akin to a vast ocean of waves, wave upon wave, overwhelming and majestic, instilling awe in the heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 218 - 172: Breaking Through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 218: Chapter 172: Breaking Through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment (2)
Fortunately, all of this was perfectly concealed by the cleverly arranged array.
Apart from the Water Lake Rat bustling in the spiritual fields of Thousand Leaves Mountain, no one from the outside world could notice any anomalies here.
"The spiritual pressure from the master’s breakthrough... so strong!"
The Water Lake Rat, busy in the spiritual fields, seemed to sense something, suddenly stopped its actions, lifted its head, and peeked in the direction of the cultivation room, its eyes filled with astonishment, secretly marveling in its heart.
"Is the master breaking through from Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment?"
"Why does this spiritual pressure feel even stronger than Gong Yang, who is a true Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator? It’s simply a whole level higher."
Inside the cultivation room.
"Break!"
Xu Ping kept his eyes tightly shut, his expression serious yet carrying a hint of determination.
He could clearly feel the mana within him surging like a flood about to burst its banks, continuously crashing against the barrier hindering his breakthrough.
Suddenly.
A crisp "crack" sound was heard.
The barrier that had trapped him for so long finally developed a crack, which quickly spread out, covering like a web.
Ultimately, with a loud "boom," the barrier shattered completely!
In an instant, a vast and magnificent mana erupted from Xu Ping’s body like a volcanic eruption, sweeping through the entire cultivation room with overwhelming force.
The originally wildly spinning vortex of spiritual qi around quickly dissipated into nothingness.
Finally, it transformed into streams of lively spiritual qi, all scrambling to pour into Xu Ping’s body.
Drip! Drip!
The turquoise liquid mana continuously dripped down, like a torrential rain, instantly causing Xu Ping’s dantian’s sea of qi to expand once more!
At this moment, he successfully broke through the barrier, advancing to become a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator!
"Late-Stage Foundation Establishment!"
After a long time, Xu Ping slowly opened his eyes, the ink-black pupils gleaming with excitement and joy. He felt comfortable physically and mentally, unable to resist a delighted chuckle.
From Early-Stage to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment, it took seven years.
From Mid-Stage to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment, it took thirteen years.
This speed of cultivation, even a genius with an Earth Spirit Root, could not compare.
Xu Ping couldn’t hold back the excitement in his heart and eagerly opened the familiar panel.
[Name: Xu Ping]
[Lifespan: 53/488 years]
[Realm: Late-Stage Foundation Establishment: 1/100; Blood Demon Body Refining Second Layer: 99/100]
[Cultivation Technique: Longevity Skill Mastery: 106/1600]
...
"Four hundred and forty-eight years of lifespan!"
Seeing the data displayed on the panel, the corners of Xu Ping’s mouth involuntarily lifted, revealing a satisfied smile, his mood becoming increasingly joyful and cheerful.
Successfully breaking through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment instantly added as much as forty years to his lifespan. Although he had anticipated this, it still filled him with delight.
After all, breaking through to Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment had already added thirty years to his lifespan, so now breaking through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment with forty additional years was entirely reasonable.
"I’m only fifty-three years old now, with over four hundred years more, equivalent to the lifespan of two generations of Foundation Establishment cultivators. If I don’t form a core, who can?"
After admiring the panel enthusiastically for a while, Xu Ping finally calmed his mind and began to carefully perceive the various changes brought by advancing to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment.
He tried to slowly extend his divine sense outward, pleasantly surprised to find that his current divine sense limit had astonishingly reached two hundred zhang away.
This distance had already far surpassed the level of an ordinary Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
Moreover, when he used his divine sense to internally examine his dantian’s sea of qi, he was even more astonished.
His dantian’s sea of qi had once again significantly expanded, accommodating surprisingly two hundred and forty drops of liquid mana inside.
One must know that a typical Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivator’s dantian usually only held about two hundred drops.
Xu Ping secretly calculated, based on this trend, by the time he reached Foundation Establishment Perfection, breaking through three hundred drops of liquid mana within his dantian should be easily achievable.
"Three hundred drops, huh!" Xu Ping murmured to himself, his eyes filled with anticipation.
Then, he rose and walked out of the cultivation room, reaching a spacious area in Thousand Leaves Mountain.
He saw only that with a gentle flip of his palm, the Purple Sun Sword appeared in his hand instantly.
Immediately after, he continuously injected mana into the Purple Sun Sword.
Bzzzz...
The Purple Sun Sword trembled violently under the influx of mana, emitting an anguished cry as if unable to bear the pressure.
"It seems that the Purple Sun Sword is indeed somewhat inadequate for me now."
Looking at the Purple Sun Sword that had already reached its limit, Xu Ping shook his head helplessly and promptly ceased the mana output.
Using the Purple Sun Sword now, he clearly felt a strong sense of constraint, which prevented him from fully displaying his abilities.
When dealing with ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivators, perhaps there wasn’t much difference, as with his current strength, he could solve the problem with a single strike.
But when facing a Fake Pill cultivator, the limitations of the Purple Sun Sword became apparent, far from satisfying the demands of battle.
"It seems I need to quickly acquire an Artifact Embryo of a Spirit Sword."
Xu Ping pondered silently in his heart.
With his current cultivation, combined with the swordsmanship that could touch sword gleam, if he wielded an Artifact Embryo of a Spirit Sword, he would be confident to contend even with a Fake Pill cultivator.
"Congratulations to the master for breaking through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment; the Golden Core is just around the corner."
At this moment, the Water Lake Rat came scampering over, its face full of a fawning smile, flattering as it said.
"Mm."
Xu Ping nodded slightly in acknowledgment, then headed towards the direction of the spiritual fields, with the Water Lake Rat closely following behind.
"Unknowingly, these Hundred Bamboo Wood have been planted for over eight years. Now they’re finally about to mature enough to meet the requirements to craft thirty-six magical swords."

chapters.title: Chapter 219 - 172: Breaking Through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 219: Chapter 172: Breaking Through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment (3)
Gazing at the lush Hundred Bamboo Wood in front of him, nearly five zhàng tall, Xu Ping couldn’t help but feel a surge of emotions.
"The challenge now is, should I refine thirty-six magical swords for the time being, or go all the way and refine seventy-two flying swords directly?"
Xu Ping stroked his chin, lost in deep thought.
If he were to only refine thirty-six flying swords, once he achieves Core Formation, the increased demands will inevitably require him to refine them again, which would be both time-consuming and troublesome.
Moreover, the Geng Metal he obtained from Old Man Tianhuang is a rare treasure capable of elevating the level of a magical artifact.
If the amount of Geng Metal is sufficient, he has the opportunity to refine all seventy-two magical swords into artifact embryos.
After achieving Core Formation, he could directly refine these artifact embryos into truly powerful magical artifacts.
This would indeed save a lot of trouble down the road.
However, the ideals are plentiful, but reality is quite barren!
Currently, he is faced with two thorny problems.
The first problem is that his current level of artifact refining technique is far from sufficient.
The artifact refining technique heritage given by Gong Yang only reaches Second-stage Upper Grade at most, whereas artifact embryos are at the Quasi-Tier Three level.
To refine artifact embryos, he would need to acquire a Quasi-Tier Three set of artifact refining techniques.
But Quasi-Tier Three artifact refining techniques are incredibly rare; even at mysterious underground auctions, it’s uncertain if you’d find them.
As for the second problem, it’s even more difficult.
The piece of Geng Metal he got from Old Man Tianhuang could barely meet the demand for refining thirty-six magical swords.
But if he wants to refine seventy-two magical swords, this piece of Geng Metal is far from enough.
At the very least, he would need to acquire another piece of Geng Metal of the same size as the current one.
But Geng Metal is already an extremely rare and precious material; once it appears, it will inevitably spark fierce competition among Fake Pill and Golden Core cultivators.
Given his current strength, even if he encounters Geng Metal, it would be very difficult to acquire it smoothly.
After a long period of weighing and contemplation, Xu Ping finally made up his mind to refine seventy-two magical swords.
After all, he has a long lifespan and enough time to slowly seek out the necessary resources.
Furthermore, he currently possesses Tier Three talismans, so his demand for a sword array isn’t that urgent.
"The Hundred Bamboo Wood personally cared for by the master is indeed extraordinary, a world apart from ordinary Hundred Bamboo Wood."
Seeing Xu Ping lost in thought while gazing at the Hundred Bamboo Wood, the Water Lake Mouse quickly seized the opportunity to flatter him.
Xu Ping snapped out of his contemplation and his gaze slowly fell on the Water Lake Mouse.
"No, I’ve almost overlooked a key issue."
Xu Ping suddenly realized that if he were to only refine top-grade magical swords, the current extent of the Water Lake Mouse’s Demon Fire could just barely meet the requirement.
But if he wants to refine artifact embryos, the Water Lake Mouse’s current Demon Fire falls far short; it’s still lacking by a long shot.
The Water Lake Mouse would at least need to break through to Second-stage Middle Grade for its Demon Fire to meet the requirement for refining artifact embryos.
However, it’s known that for demon beasts, both the accumulation of demonic power and realm breakthroughs are much more difficult and lengthier than those for cultivators.
Under natural growth conditions, one cannot hope for a breakthrough without several decades.
"Mas... Master, what’s the matter?"
The Water Lake Mouse was so unnerved by Xu Ping’s gaze that it forced a fawning smile on its face while asking anxiously.
"Honestly, have you been slacking off in your cultivation lately?"
Xu Ping’s tone turned somewhat harsh, "You’ve been a Second-stage Demon Beast for years, yet your progress has been negligible; it’s quite disgraceful."
"Master, no!"
The Water Lake Mouse said with a face full of grievance, "I train hard every day, but the accumulation for us demon beasts is inherently slow, and with my bloodline mutation, the time required is even longer."
In truth, there was another reason it dared not mention.
Every day it has to take care of the Spirit Wood, shoo away cultivators seeking talismans, and occasionally fend off invading evil spirits, leaving very little time for cultivation.
"I’ll give you fifteen years to break through to Second-stage Middle Grade, or I definitely won’t spare you!" Xu Ping’s lips curled into a cold smile.
"What? Breakthrough to Second-stage Middle Grade in fifteen years!"
"This..." The Water Lake Mouse was utterly shocked upon hearing this demand, and just as it was about to blurt out how impossible it seemed, Xu Ping’s gaze turned increasingly dangerous, forcing it to quickly change its tone.
"This... since it’s the master’s command, I’ll do my best to complete the task," the Water Lake Mouse said, looking mournful.
"Good, that’s more like it!" Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction.
"Go, and cultivate well."
He reached out to gently pat the Water Lake Mouse’s head, speaking in a gentle tone, "If you don’t reach Second-stage Middle Grade in fifteen years, I’ll stew you."
’Stew... stew me!’
The Water Lake Mouse was so frightened its mouse eyes went wide, lamenting inwardly, ’Is this life even tolerable for a mouse!’
It kept lamenting in its heart but dared not show anything on its face, instead forcing a smile even more bitter than tears: "Master, rest assured, I’ll definitely complete the task."
...
...
After intimidating the Water Lake Mouse, Xu Ping turned and returned to the cultivation chamber.
"Now that I’ve finally broken through to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment, my divine sense has increased significantly, and I can finally attempt to draw the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman," Xu Ping contemplated secretly.
Over the past year, to avoid unnecessarily wasting precious Tier Three talisman materials, he had refrained from rashly attempting to draw the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman.
Now, having succeeded in the breakthrough to Late-Stage Foundation Establishment, he was naturally eager to give it a try.
However, considering he had only just broken through, and his cultivation was still somewhat unstable, Xu Ping did not blindly attempt it.
The difficulty of drawing the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman is immense, so naturally, he must wait until everything is at its peak before attempting.
Seven days passed by in a flash.
Suddenly, Xu Ping opened his eyes during cultivation, a warm and gentle azure light flashing across his eyes.
"Phew!"
He exhaled a deep breath, and at this point, his cultivation was completely stabilized, his aura restrained, and he exuded a steady and powerful presence.
"It’s time to start drawing the talisman!"
Xu Ping stood up, walked to the stone table, lightly waved his sleeve, and a stack of brand-new Tier Three talisman papers, a talisman brush, and a bottle of spirit ink instantly appeared neatly on the stone table.
Then, he spread out a sheet of Tier Three talisman paper, held the talisman brush steadily, his expression focused and solemn as he formally began drawing the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman.

chapters.title: Chapter 220 - 173: Drawing the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman
chapters.content:
Chapter 220: Chapter 173: Drawing the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman
Half a year has flown by like the passage of a white colt glimpsed through a crack, disappearing in an instant.
During this time, Xu Ping has been secluded at Thousand Leaves Mountain, single-mindedly crafting talismans without distraction.
Meanwhile, subtle changes have been quietly unfolding on the battlefield where the Luoyun Sect and Hu Country face off.
The most reliable method of breaking an array has always been to besiege it over the years, depleting the earth’s spirit and spiritual power, thereby weakening the array before seizing the opportunity to break it!
The fierce battles have lasted nearly a few years, and the quasi-Fourth Rank spirit vein within Luoyun Immortal City has struggled to keep up with the supply due to prolonged depletion.
Lately, they could only rely on a large number of Spirit Stones to barely maintain its operation.
However, once the earth’s spirit is damaged, it is difficult to repair.
Luoyun Immortal City.
"Break!"
Amid thunderous roars, a hundred-zhang long black thunderbolt gathered in the void, emerging like a flood dragon from the sea, with a loud ’boom’, it charged directly at the light barrier of Luoyun Immortal City.
"Crack!"
The protective barrier of the Immortal City emitted a mournful cry, and under the horrified gaze of the city’s cultivators, it shattered inch by inch like a spider web.
After years of relentless attrition and siege...
The Fourth Rank Grand Array... has been broken!!!
"Hahaha..."
After a fierce exchange with Yun Chengzi, Wan Ming laughed freely and heartily.
"Today’s battle is decided, the victory of Hu Country is in sight... Why do you persist in pointless resistance, friend?"
With the fall of Luoyun Immortal City, the Hu Country army can charge directly into the heart of the Luoyun Sect.
In such a situation, there’s no possibility for anyone within Luoyun Sect to successfully form a Nascent Soul.
"Alas, is it truly destined for heaven to destroy my Luoyun Sect!"
Yun Chengzi gazed distantly at the fallen Luoyun Immortal City, sighing deeply, his entire being shrouded in a deathly stillness, his eyes turning somewhat cloudy.
This kind of despairing situation is unimaginable for a great cultivator at the Nascent Soul Stage.
However, even in such desperate circumstances, Yun Chengzi did not abandon his last hope.
His hands moved quickly to form seals, and as his spells transformed, the mana within him surged violently like a torrential tide.
His eyes instantly turned a mysterious purple, with lightning flickering within them, as if containing boundless power.
At this moment, the only chance for salvation for the Luoyun Sect is to slay Wan Ming!
"What, planning to make a desperate fight?"
Wan Ming’s tone seemed calm, but a hint of seriousness flickered in his eyes.
Even though Yun Chengzi had been tormented to his last breath after prolonged combat, if the opponent launched a suicidal strike, he still risked perishing together with him.
"Poof!"
Yun Chengzi did not respond, but instead spat out a mouthful of essence blood, spraying it all over his massive purple sword.
"Buzz!!!"
The purple greatsword, drenched in essence blood, let out a high, resounding wail like a dragon’s cry.
As a magical artifact that had been nurtured by the Nascent Soul Cultivator for many years, this sword was extraordinarily spiritual, seemingly sensing that this would be the last epic battle alongside its master.
"Slash!"
After spitting out essence blood, Yun Chengzi’s face turned ashen pale, but he forcefully suppressed his weakness, lifted his fingers with effort, and pointed toward Wan Ming.
In an instant, the purple greatsword expanded rapidly in the wind, growing to a hundred zhang long, its blade emanating terrifying might capable of annihilating all, and it fiercely slashed toward Wan Ming.
Seeing this scene,
Wan Ming’s expression turned extremely grave, and a fiery red iron fan appeared in his hand out of thin air.
Next, he quickly performed an incantation, and mysterious Dharma Seals flickered in the air.
As the spell was completed, a mass of ghostly blue flames ignited fiercely from the iron fan, carrying intense heat and immense spiritual power.
"Annihilate!"
Wan Ming shouted loudly and swung the iron fan with great force; the blue flames surged forward like a roaring dragon, enveloping with endless power, charging toward the purple greatsword.
In the blink of an eye, the blue flames collided violently with the purple greatsword, erupting in a thunderous explosion.
At that moment, the entire heavens and earth seemed to tremble, the brilliant light was blindingly intense, making it impossible to look at directly.
A violent energy flow expanded outward like a surging tsunami, tearing the surrounding space into a twisted distortion, as if it would collapse at any moment.
The ghostly blue flames and the purple greatsword became locked in a stalemate, madly devouring and annihilating each other, neither yielding an inch.
Amidst the fierce battle, Yun Chengzi seized the opportunity while Wan Ming was fully engaged in countering the magical artifact’s attack, his form flickered like a phantom, and he instantly moved close to Wan Ming.
Before it was known when, a simple Jade Talisman had appeared in his hand.
The talisman shone with flickering runes, exuding a vast and powerful mysterious aura.
"Speed!"
Without hesitation, Yun Chengzi activated the Jade Talisman.
"Buzz!"
With the talisman’s radiance blasting forth, it emitted a deafening hum.
Immediately following, an ancient, majestic sword light burst from within the talisman, seeming as if it would cleave the heavens and earth.
"Slash!"
Determination flashed in Yun Chengzi’s eyes as he drove the sky-piercing sword light violently toward Wan Ming.
"Immortal Slaying Talisman!"
Feeling the tremendous threat heading his way, a flicker of panic crossed Wan Ming’s eyes.
He never anticipated that Yun Chengzi was concealing the renowned Fourth Rank Talisman of the Cultivation Realm—the Immortal Slaying Talisman.
At the critical moment, Wan Ming gritted his teeth, quickly made an incantation gesture, and in an instant, a suit of blazing armor appeared on him.
In the surrounding void, faint flames generated out of thin air, continually shooting dazzling sparks outward.
However, the sword light that pierced the heavens was beyond all expectation!
Upon mere contact, his protective shield emitted a series of crackling sounds, covered with countless cracks like a spider web.

chapters.title: Chapter 221 - 173: Drawing the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 221: Chapter 173: Drawing the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman (2)
Wan Ming was struck by the terrifying sword light, his body felt like it had been struck by lightning, and he spat blood wildly from his mouth, as his entire being flew backward like a kite with a broken string for hundreds of zhang.
The protective flame armor was completely shattered, turning into sparks that scattered into the vast air.
A horrific wound appeared on his chest, the flesh flipped outward, and blood gushed out like a spring, instantly dyeing a large part of his clothes red.
Fortunately, despite suffering such a heavy blow, Wan Ming did not injure his vital points and retained the ability to continue fighting.
"Just a little bit... just a bit more!"
Wan Ming steadied himself and laughed heartily to the sky, his tone unexpectedly filled with delight.
"Alas, in the end... I still couldn’t protect the sect..."
Seeing that his last trump card could not kill Wan Ming, Yun Chengzi sighed helplessly.
His breath quickly weakened, and his face turned as white as paper without a trace of blood, his body swayed precariously.
Unleashing the purple giant sword and then activating the "Immortal Slaying Talisman", this series of moves exhausted a large amount of his Spiritual Power and blood essence, making him incapable of continuing the battle at this moment!
"Luoyun Sect will not perish!"
A Foundation Establishment disciple of the Luoyun Sect, with eyes red as blood and determined to die, charged resolutely into the Hu Country cultivator group, directly detonating his own Mana.
With a loud explosion, several Foundation Establishment cultivators were killed or injured.
Luoyun Immortal City announced its fall, and many disciples loyal to the Luoyun Sect chose to desperately seek mutual destruction in an attempt to delay the advance of Hu Country’s army.
However, such brave, fatal disciples were indeed a minority, most chose to flee hastily when the Array of Luoyun Immortal City was breached.
Just as everyone was certain that the Luoyun Sect was doomed, and Hu Country’s army was about to drive straight in and flatten the sect, an unexpected twist suddenly occurred!
Deep within Luoyun Sect, a column of Spiritual Power light soared to the heavens, its brilliance dazzling and illuminating the entire sky.
Visible clearly for thousands of li!
This vast and majestic wave of Spiritual Power spread with the force of overturning mountains, causing changes in the heavens and storms.
What was once a gloomy and oppressive sky was instantly torn open, and warm sunlight cascaded down like a waterfall.
