"This... this is a sign of breaking through to the Nascent Soul!" Exclaimed a sharp-eyed cultivator.
"How could it be!"
Wan Ming stared at this scene, suddenly dumbstruck.
Being a Nascent Soul Stage cultivator himself, he naturally knew that this was not merely a sign of breaking through to the Nascent Soul; it clearly had successfully reached the Nascent Soul Realm.
After expending so many resources and effort, could it all end in vain?
"Hahaha... the heavens have not abandoned my Luoyun Sect!"
Witnessing this, Yun Chengzi’s eyes shone with unprecedented brilliance, and he laughed excitedly to the sky.
...
...
Thousand Leaves Mountain, within the cultivation room.
Xu Ping held the talisman brush, his expression focused, as unique runes slowly formed on the third-rank talisman paper.
As the tip of the brush moved, Spiritual Power was continuously injected into the talisman through the brush, the runes seemed to come to life, flickering with a gentle glow.
As the runes gradually took shape, the surrounding Spiritual Qi seemed summoned, gathering towards the talisman.
Fine beads of sweat appeared on Xu Ping’s forehead, but his gaze remained steadfast and calm, watching the talisman closely and not missing a single detail.
Finally, as the last stroke was completed, a perfect third-rank talisman appeared before him.
The runes on the talisman shone brightly, then gradually retracted, and a discreet yet potent force emanated from the talisman.
"The Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman is finally successfully crafted!" Xu Ping exhaled deeply and smiled contently.
Though he had exhausted all of his third-rank talisman paper to craft this Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman, all the effort was worthwhile.
With the aid of the proficiency panel, his success rate in crafting talismans would surely skyrocket as his skill improved.
"The power of Geng Metal within... so strong!"
Xu Ping carefully held the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman in his hands, the powerful force contained within made him secretly amazed.
Even before activation, he could feel a slight tingling on his skin.
If this talisman were fully activated, its power would be unimaginable!
With his current strength, he certainly couldn’t withstand it.
Having three or four Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans would surely annihilate an Early Stage Golden Core and heavily wound a Middle Stage of Golden Core.
"But the third-rank Spirit Wood has already been used up, time to purchase some from the Song family again!" Xu Ping thought to himself.
Previously, Song Qiwu approached him to buy third-rank talismans, which he declined by saying he hadn’t crafted them yet.
If he were to seek out Song Qiwu for third-rank Spirit Wood now, he feared the latter would use it as a bargaining chip to once again ask him to sell third-rank talismans.
Whether to sell or not is indeed a tricky issue.
"Master... Duan Shuang and Gong Yang have matters to discuss!"
Just as Xu Ping was pondering, Water Lake Mouse’s Divine Sense voice transmission passed through the wall and reached his ears.
"Duan Shuang and Gong Yang?"
"Invite them both inside, to the pavilion!"
Xu Ping flipped his palm lightly, and the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman instantly vanished.
He then tidied his robe and calmly walked out of the cultivation room.
...
...
In the pavilion.
"What!"
Upon hearing Gong Yang’s message, Xu Ping’s eyes widened in disbelief, "The sect leader of Luoyun Sect, Jiang Jingxing, actually broke through to the Nascent Soul Realm?"
This is a Nascent Soul cultivator!
In Yue Country, that equates to heaven!

chapters.title: Chapter 222 - 173: Drawing the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 222: Chapter 173: Drawing the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman (3)
"Absolutely true!" Gong Yang nodded heavily, his expression full of certainty.
Recalling the moment he first heard the news, he was so shocked that it took him a long while to regain his composure.
"Now that Hu Country’s cultivators have retreated, it seems unlikely that there will be any more war between the two countries in the short term."
Duan Shuang spoke timely, her tone unconsciously revealing a sense of relief.
Although they at Purple Bamboo Mountain were not directly drawn into the war, the impact of the conflict between the two countries was significant, adding considerable pressure to them.
After all, if Luoyun Sect were defeated, the entire Yue Country would fall under the control of Hu Country.
Needless to say, at that time, Hu Country would definitely plunder and exploit Yue Country’s cultivators to satisfy their own country’s needs.
Though Luoyun Sect often wielded power to suppress others within Yue Country, showing no mercy to various loose cultivators and other smaller forces, not taking them seriously at all.
Yet Luoyun Sect at least based its development in Yue Country, and for its long-term interests, wouldn’t excessively oppress various forces unless absolutely necessary, to avoid cutting off their source.
Hu Country, however, has no such concerns, and once Yue Country is conquered, their days would undoubtedly become difficult.
"Indeed!"
Xu Ping couldn’t help but express, "Yue Country is finally going to return to peace!"
For someone like him who seeks stability and the pursuit of cultivation, having a safe and stable environment for practice is certainly the best.
"Return to peace?"
Gong Yang paused slightly, his tone becoming meaningful, saying slowly, "I fear it’s not that simple. Fellow Daoist Xu, have you perhaps forgotten about Shuize Sect?"
"Of course I haven’t forgotten."
Xu Ping’s expression remained calm, pondered briefly and continued, "But now that Hu Country’s cultivators have withdrawn, Shuize Sect alone probably won’t stir much trouble, besides, they’re surrounded by evil forces and can’t move at all!"
"Under the current circumstances, Shuize Sect naturally cannot cause much trouble."
Gong Yang’s expression was somewhat peculiar, his gaze showing a complex reflection, "But... the one to stir trouble this time is indeed Luoyun Sect!"
"Luoyun Sect?"
Xu Ping was slightly startled, thoughts spun in his mind and he instantly understood Gong Yang’s meaning, blurting out, "Luoyun Sect is preparing to eradicate Shuize Sect completely?"
Originally, Shuize Sect was much weaker than Luoyun Sect, relying solely on the power of arrays to barely protect themselves.
Confront Luoyun Sect head-on and it would undoubtedly be like attacking a stone with an egg, without any chance of victory.
At the time, Luoyun Sect’s old ancestor Yun Chengzi, due to having little remaining lifespan and the threat of Hu Country looming, constantly endangered the security of Luoyun Sect, naturally dared not to easily expend his Primordial Qi and lifespan to completely eradicate Shuize Sect.
But now the situation is entirely different, Luoyun Sect’s Sect Leader Jiang Jingxing successfully broke through to Nascent Soul Realm, lifespan greatly extended, with enough confidence and time.
He can fully adopt a strategy of attrition, slowly wearing down Shuize Sect’s Mountain Protection Array.
Once that Fourth Rank array is breached, Shuize Sect would be like fish on a chopping board, at the mercy of others.
"Exactly."
Gong Yang firmly nodded, "Luoyun Sect has officially issued a campaign order against Shuize Sect."
"However, because Jiang Jingxing has just broken through to Nascent Soul Realm, his cultivation hasn’t fully stabilized yet, so it will be at least two to three years before Luoyun Sect actually takes action against Shuize Sect."
"Moreover, the target of Luoyun Sect’s campaign this time is not only Shuize Sect." Gong Yang spoke with an increasingly serious expression, "It also includes some forces that secretly sided with Shuize Sect."
"Fellow Daoist Xu, take a look!" Gong Yang said as he gently flipped his hand, a jade slip appeared in his palm.
Xu Ping took the jade slip and sent his Divine Sense into it for inspection, frowning slightly.
Unexpectedly, the list of forces that secretly sided with Shuize Sect was quite long, and among them, the name "the Song family" was exceptionally prominent.
’The Song family?’
Xu Ping murmured in his heart, a somewhat odd expression appearing on his face.
Why had he not even taken action yet, but the Song family seemed hell-bent on ruining themselves?
Thinking about it carefully, it was understandable.
Given the circumstances at the time, everyone thought Luoyun Sect was finished.
It was just unexpected that Luoyun Sect would manage to overturn the situation in such a desperate state.
"Now Luoyun Sect has already issued orders to various forces in Yue Country." Duan Shuang added from the side, her voice pleasant,
"Every force must send people to unite and eradicate the claws of Shuize Sect, otherwise, they’ll also be considered as Shuize Sect’s claws."
"But it’s not exactly free labor." Duan Shuang raised her eyebrows slightly, a glimmer of light flashing in her eyes,
If they manage to wipe out the forces allied with Shuize Sect, the treasures and resources among them will be Luoyun Sect’s, whoever grabs it counts as theirs."
"Oh?"
Xu Ping heard this, his eyes narrowed, and thought that with this condition, the whole Yue Country will probably be in chaos for a while.
"Then, certainly our Purple Bamboo Mountain will also have to participate in the campaign."
Xu Ping looked at Duan Shuang and Gong Yang, asking, "Do you know whether Luoyun Sect’s requirement is for full participation, or just a part of people to go?"
"Based on the content of Luoyun Sect’s campaign order, it appears that as long as some people go, it’s sufficient." Duan Shuang pondered for a moment before providing the answer.
"I see."
Xu Ping understood, paused for a moment, and then asked, "Do you, fellow Daoists, have plans to participate in this campaign?"
"I intend to join." Duan Shuang nodded without hesitation, her gaze filled with determination and anticipation.
To her, this is undoubtedly a rare opportunity.
If she can seize some precious treasures in this campaign, it would significantly aid her cultivation journey, enabling smoother progress towards higher realms.
Gong Yang hesitated at first, then slowly nodded as well, expressing his willingness to join.
Previously, he would not easily take part in such unpredictable moves, but times have changed.
Now he has reached Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivation, and Core Formation is no longer unattainable.
He naturally wants to seize this chance, to accumulate more resources and opportunities for his Core Formation path.
"Since both fellow Daoists have decided to join, I won’t be going."
Xu Ping smiled slightly and nodded gently, "I wish both fellow Daoists a fruitful campaign."
"Thank you for your blessings!"
Duan Shuang and Gong Yang simultaneously clasped their hands in gratitude, responding with smiles.
They were familiar with Xu Ping’s disposition, hence they didn’t expend further effort to persuade him.

chapters.title: Chapter 223 - 174: Pursuit of the Song Family Patriarch
chapters.content:
Chapter 223: Chapter 174: Pursuit of the Song Family Patriarch
After Duan Shuang and Gong Yang left, Xu Ping held the exquisite teacup in his hand, murmuring: "An order for expedition, huh..."
On the surface, he would definitely not participate in this matter.
After all, once involved, he will inevitably become the focus of attention, attracting unnecessary trouble and easily fostering hatred.
Though under the joint siege of various forces in Yue Country, those who secretly sided with the Shuize Sect would be like candle flames in the wind, easily uprooted and completely eradicated.
However, the world is unpredictable, and it’s inevitable that some will slip through the net and survive.
At that time, if these survivors sought revenge, Xu Ping, with his strength, wouldn’t fear them, but it would undoubtedly bring him a lot of unnecessary trouble.
Nonetheless, he could quietly follow in the shadows, see if he can seize some benefits when the timing is right.
"The Song family!"
A chilling glint suddenly flashed in Xu Ping’s eyes.
Since the Song family has already appeared on the expedition order issued by the Luoyun Sect, their demise is assured, and they are destined to be unable to escape this calamity.
And he certainly wouldn’t miss such a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
On one hand, he currently lacks third-rank Spirit Wood, and on the other, he can personally witness the destruction of his enemies.
"Ah, the Cultivation Realm truly is ever-changing, like fleeting clouds and changing landscapes."
Xu Ping sighed softly, his mood at this moment quite complex.
There is the joy of finally avenging a great feud; yet full of sentiment, as the Cultivation Realm situation changes instantaneously, no one knows what will happen the next moment.
"In this peril-filled Cultivation Realm, only by staying low-key and acting prudently can one stand long-term and have the chance to climb to higher levels."
Xu Ping slightly lifted his head and drank the cooled Spirit Tea in his hand in one go.
...
...
When the Luoyun Sect’s expedition order swept across Yue Country like a tempest, the entire country was instantly plunged into chaos.
It was like a boulder thrown into a calm lake, stirring waves upon waves, causing mixed reactions among the people.
Some, upon hearing the news, had eyes shining with wild joy, seemingly seeing a perfect opportunity for profit; while others were gripped tightly by fear, panicking like ants on a hot pan.
Longshi Market.
This market, opened and controlled by Shuize Sect, has now become a place of trouble.
Even though the entire Wanzhe Waters is still rampant with malevolent forces, countless Loose Cultivators hurriedly packed up their bags to flee, avoiding being caught in the turmoil.
The major forces unaffiliated with the Shuize Sect also made the decision to withdraw, fearing being dragged into the impending conflict.
Yet, there are always those whose eyes are blinded by greed.
They hold onto luck and choose to stay in Longshi Market, eagerly hoping to seize some benefits in the upcoming chaos.
"Hmph, all are just cowardly and deceitful bunch!"
On the high ground of a luxurious building in Longshi Market, Elder Hao looked down at the scrambling crowd with disdain and madness intertwined in his eyes, the madness deepening in them.
Now the various forces in Yue Country, under Luoyun Sect’s pressure, will sooner or later attack Longshi Market.
Though Longshi Market is protected by a quasi-tier three array, Elder Hao knows in his heart that this market will eventually find it hard to fend off the multiple assaults, its downfall is merely a matter of time.
"In that case, let them all stay here!"
The madness in Elder Hao’s eyes intensified as he flipped his palm, and a jade-green array control Token appeared in his hand.
Following this, he rapidly formed a magic technique with his hands, slowly infusing a thread of Mana into the Token.
Buzz...
Suddenly, the thin mist enveloping the market rapidly thickened, emanating a powerful wave of Spiritual Power.
Numerous colorful runes swam leisurely within the thick mist like little fish, each carrying extreme danger.
"What’s happening?"
"Why has the array of Longshi Market suddenly been fully activated?"
The Loose Cultivators preparing to leave were immediately thrown into chaos, some shouting anxiously.
"Is Shuize Sect insane? Are they planning to trap us all here and completely wipe us out?"
Some quick-witted individuals were suddenly seized by this terrifying thought, their faces full of fear.
"Kill them all, leave no one alive!"
Within the luxurious building, Elder Hao issued a cold command.
Before his words had fallen, seven or eight Foundation Establishment Cultivators behind him flooded out like hungry wolves, charging toward the various cultivator forces in Longshi Market.
At the same time, the Qi Cultivators wearing Shuize Sect’s uniform robes also rode their Magical Artifacts, rushing toward the defenseless Loose Cultivators like locusts.
"Ah!"
"Save me!"
...
The tragic screams instantly echoed throughout Longshi Market.
Under the powerful force of the fully activated quasi-tier three array, even the Foundation Establishment Cultivators had their strength forcibly suppressed by at least half, let alone those weaker Qi Cultivators.
In this array-covered area, only those authorized and recognized by Shuize Sect could be unrestricted.
In this way, the cultivators trapped in the array were like fish on a chopping block, waiting to be slaughtered.
Similar bloody scenes also played out in other markets guarded by Shuize Sect.
Shuize Sect’s people went on a rampage within the markets, exterminating all existing Foundation Establishment Cultivators with countless Qi Cultivators killed or injured.
Subsequently, they took the resources and treasures they seized, breaking up and fleeing in all directions.

chapters.title: Chapter 224 - 174: Pursuing the Song Family Patriarch (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 224: Chapter 174: Pursuing the Song Family Patriarch (Part 2)
...
...
The Song family’s territory.
When the cultivators of the Song family learned that the Sect Leader of the Luoyun Sect had successfully broken through to the Nascent Soul Realm and issued a campaign directive against the Song family, the entire clan instantly fell into chaos and panic.
They understood in their hearts that their own forces amounted to nothing more than a mere Fake Pill level — how could they withstand a joint attack from various forces?
After a brief panic, the senior members of the Song family quickly regained their composure.
At this critical moment of life and death!
They understood deeply that the only way to survive this crisis was to quickly relocate before the various forces had fully assembled and taken action — leaving the turbulent lands of Yue Country.
Furthermore, to avoid being wiped out during their escape, the Song family’s cultivators decided after deliberation to split into several small teams to disperse and flee.
Under the enormous pressure of life and death, the Song family demonstrated astonishing initiative.
In just a mere two days, the once bustling Song family territory was emptied of people, leaving only those ordinary humans who could not cultivate, staring blankly at the departing silhouettes, helpless.
...
Ten days later.
A gigantic and luxurious Spiritual Boat streaked across the sky, carrying hundreds of Song family disciples, flying toward the distance like a meteor.
"There’s definitely no problem, after all, the Old Ancestor is on this Spiritual Boat with us!" Another Song family cultivator quickly spoke comfortingly.
Upon hearing this, the Qi Cultivation young man’s gaze instinctively turned towards the second floor of the Spiritual Boat — the place where the Song family Old Ancestor was.
For some reason, when he looked in that direction, his heart instantly settled greatly.
To the Qi Cultivation disciples of the Song family, the Fake Pill Old Ancestor was like a sky above them, as if no matter what difficulties they faced, the Old Ancestor could easily handle them, leading them through dangers.
However, at that moment, a sudden mishap occurred.
Suddenly, a tremendous earth-shattering sound rumbled from above the Spiritual Boat, initially just intermittently one or two booms, but in an instant, the noise reverberated throughout the heavens and earth, endless as though the world were angrily roaring.
The disciples on the deck of the Spiritual Boat shivered in terror from the unexpected booming and hurriedly looked skyward.
And the sight that met their eyes instantly turned their faces pale as paper.
Out of nowhere, the sky had become entirely crimson, all the clouds turning into deep red fiery clouds.
They roiled continuously like lava, producing one inverted bubble after another, and the massive rumbling sound was actually the sound of these bubbles bursting.
"What is this?" A Qi Cultivation disciple on the deck screamed in horror.
"Lava Magic!!" A Foundation Establishment cultivator of the Song family showed a startling expression.
This magic was an immensely powerful Quasi-Tier Three magic that, once cast, had devastating destructive power.
Buzz!
Just as everyone was in shock, along with a sudden tremor of the Spiritual Boat, a vast expanse of dazzling blue light spread out, and a giant light screen instantly enveloped the entire Flying Boat, as if armor of blue had been draped over the Spiritual Boat.
Almost at the same moment the shield formed, a drop of deep crimson lava, about a foot in size, fell like a scorching cannonball, heavily striking the light screen.
Boom boom boom...
A continuous series of deafening booms rang out, and the powerful impact caused the entire Flying Boat to shake violently.
Ultimately, the overwhelmed Spiritual Boat plunged straight down from mid-air, finally crashing heavily onto the ground, raising a cloud of dust.
"Blocked... blocked it!"
Though the Song family’s Qi Cultivation disciples were knocked about, none were injured.
Just as they were secretly thankful, a multitude of figures swiftly flew out from within those fiery clouds, instantly surrounding the Spiritual Boat.
Leading the group were two individuals with imposing demeanors, unquestionably two Fake Pill cultivators, followed by more than a dozen Foundation Establishment cultivators and hundreds of Qi Cultivation cultivators—a formidable formation, aggressive in their approach.
"People of the Song family, today is the day of your demise!" One of the Fake Pill cultivators shouted, his voice resounding like a bell through the heavens and earth.
"Mengyang, Lv Yuhui!"
The Song family Old Ancestor, unnoticed at some point, had already appeared atop the Spiritual Boat, his expression dark as water, glaring at the two Fake Pill cultivators, Mana surging around him with extraordinary momentum.
"Do you really want mutual destruction?" the Song family Old Ancestor asked, suppressing his anger, in a deep voice.
"Mutual destruction?"
Lv Yuhui sneered, his eyes full of mockery, "The Luoyun Sect’s campaign directive has already been issued; the entire Yue Country will no longer accommodate your Song family.
Yet you dare to flee so brazenly; today we are here to take the lives of your entire clan!"
"Why waste words with him, take action!" Mengyang shouted explosively, taking the lead in attacking.
He raised his hand to summon a green wooden staff, which expanded with the wind, swiftly reaching a length of ten zhang.
Immediately, as he lightly pointed with his finger, the green wooden staff, carrying the momentum to crush everything, fiercely struck at the Song family Old Ancestor.
The Song family Old Ancestor did not dare to act carelessly, quickly forming seals with his hands, mysterious runes flashing at his fingertips, and in the blink of an eye, a massive and solid protective shield condensed before him.
Bang!
A sound shaking heaven and earth rang out, and the shield was hit with powerful force, trembling violently as its surface light dimmed slightly, but it barely blocked this fierce attack.
At the same time, the Foundation Establishment cultivators and Qi Cultivation cultivators on both sides launched into intense combat.
For a time, mana brilliance flashed, magic crisscrossed, and shouts of killing, screams, and cries filled the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 225 - 174: Pursuing the Song Family Patriarch (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 225: Chapter 174: Pursuing the Song Family Patriarch (Part 3)
The Qi Cultivation disciples of the Song family, though fighting valiantly, were gradually at a disadvantage due to the sheer number and strength of the opposition.
Many Song family disciples fell injured under the enemy’s onslaught, their blood staining the deck of the Spiritual Boat.
Meanwhile, in the battlefield of the Fake Pill cultivators, the Song family patriarch was struggling to hold his ground against two adversaries.
Their attacks were relentless, like a torrential storm, each strike carrying immense power, constantly battering against his defense.
"Old fool, let’s see how long you can last!"
Mengyang seized the opportune moment and once again hurled his cyan wooden staff towards the Song family patriarch fiercely.
This strike was incredibly fast, with astounding force; the Song family patriarch couldn’t evade it, and his Protective Spiritual Light shattered instantly. His body shuddered violently, a trickle of blood seeping from the corner of his mouth, as his face turned increasingly pale.
"Patriarch!"
The Song family disciples were struck with panic at the sight, despair spreading like a plague among them.
...
From a distant mountain peak, Xu Ping, wearing the Thousand Illusion Mask, disguised as an ordinary-looking young man, quietly watched the fierce battle unfold.
"This Song family contingent... is likely doomed to total annihilation!"
Xu Ping muttered to himself, a glint of contemplation flashing in his eyes, "Yet, it’s strange, why is there no sign of Song Fei in this group?"
As logic would dictate, Song Fei, being such an exceptional talent among the Song family cultivators, should be by the patriarch’s side.
Moreover, after careful observation, Xu Ping noticed that this Song family unit had hardly any significantly powerful cultivators.
"A decoy?"
A realization sparked in Xu Ping’s mind.
He understood that for a family as large as the Song family, ensuring all members safely escaped Yue Country was practically impossible.
But if they used the patriarch and these common Song cultivators as bait to attract the attention of various forces, then the chances of the elite disciples escaping successfully would naturally increase greatly.
However, to Xu Ping, the other members of the Song family didn’t matter much, as long as the patriarch perished, it would be enough.
...
Just as Xu Ping was mulling over it, the battlefield took on a new turn.
"Run! Save as many as you can!"
Seeing that the entire Song family force was on the verge of being utterly wiped out, the patriarch suddenly erupted with immense power, breaking through the encirclement of the Song cultivators with reckless abandon, shouting loudly.
The remaining Song family disciples, seeing this, clung to it like a last straw, frantically rushing towards the gap in the encirclement, attempting to escape.
"Stop them!" Mengyang roared angrily at the sight.
"Break!"
At this moment, the Song family patriarch gritted his teeth, forcefully burning his own essence blood to coercively enhance the power of his magic treasure.
In an instant, a wild and powerful force erupted from him, momentarily repelling the besieging enemies.
Subsequently, the Song family patriarch harnessed a brilliant Escape Light, shooting off into the distance like a meteor.
Mengyang and Lv Yuhui, the two Fake Pill cultivators, had failed to capture him and naturally refused to give up, immediately taking to the air in pursuit using their own Escape Techniques.
From a distance, Xu Ping, observing this scene, followed stealthily using his movement technique without the slightest hesitation.
However, to avoid detection by the trio ahead, he maintained a considerable distance from them at all times.
But to Xu Ping’s surprise, the Song family patriarch was somehow using an Escape Light that was even faster than that of Mengyang and Lv Yuhui.
As time passed, the distance between them steadily increased.
"Indeed daring to use himself as bait, indeed resourceful!"
Seeing the Song family patriarch about to disappear from view completely, Xu Ping couldn’t afford to hesitate anymore.
He clasped his hands together in a magic gesture and immediately invoked the Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill.
In an instant, his speed shot up dramatically, pursuing the patriarch like a bolt of lightning, far outstripping Mengyang and Lv Yuhui.
"This..."
Xu Ping’s sudden acceleration startled Mengyang and Lv Yuhui, leaving them gaping at him in shock.
"Late-Stage Foundation Establishment?"
When the two clearly saw Xu Ping’s cultivation level, they frowned deeply, a strong sense of doubt welling in their hearts.
How could a cultivator at Late-Stage Foundation Establishment possess speed that even they, as Fake Pill cultivators, could only dream of?
They instinctively wanted to capture Xu Ping, but his speed was simply too overwhelming.
They had no time to react, left to watch helplessly as Xu Ping and the patriarch vanished rapidly from their sight.
"Damn it, how can someone at Late-Stage Foundation Establishment move so fast?" Mengyang couldn’t help but curse.
While he could reluctantly accept the patriarch’s burst of speed, a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator moving so fast was far beyond his expectations.
"Late-Stage Foundation Establishment?"
"Perhaps not!"
Lv Yuhui’s eyes narrowed slightly, a trace of contemplation in his gaze, "This person might be a Golden Core cultivator disguising his strength, otherwise, there’s no way he’d have such speed."
In his view, this person not only had speed far exceeding that of ordinary Fake Pill cultivators but also had the audacity to chase the patriarch alone, which hardly seemed like the actions of a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
"Golden Core cultivator?"
Mengyang was slightly stunned, then suddenly realized, "Could he be here to reap the benefits?"
At this thought, his expression turned exceedingly grim.
They had been fighting tooth and nail at the front, only to find a dignified Golden Core cultivator swooping in to claim the spoils in such a lowly manner.
...
...
Xu Ping, of course, had no idea that the two Fake Pill cultivators had guessed him to be a Golden Core cultivator.
At this moment, he was wholly focused on trailing the Song family patriarch closely.
With his current cultivation level, paired with his Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill, refined to Perfection Level, his speed was now on par with that of Golden Core cultivators.
The Song family patriarch’s Escape Technique, while remarkable enough to stand out among Fake Pill cultivators, was ultimately slightly inferior to Xu Ping’s.
As time passed, the gap between them was swiftly closing.
"Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator?"
As the Song family patriarch fled at full speed, he keenly sensed the relentless pursuit from Xu Ping behind.
This discovery greatly astounded him, baffling him as to how a mere Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator could possess such astonishing speed.
"Something’s not right!"
The patriarch’s pupils suddenly contracted, and a chilling thought flashed through his mind, "This person must be a Golden Core cultivator in disguise!"
After all, in this Cultivation Realm, strength rules supreme, the disparity between realms like a vast chasm.
How could a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator surpass Fake Pill cultivators in speed, not to mention dare pursue someone alone?

chapters.title: Chapter 226 - 175: Severely Wounding the Song Family’s Ancestor
chapters.content:
Chapter 226: Chapter 175: Severely Wounding the Song Family’s Ancestor
The Song family’s Patriarch knew very well that the opponent before him, disguised as a Golden Core Cultivator, was much faster than himself, making escape absolutely impossible.
Rather than sitting idly awaiting death, it would be better to put up a fight; he might still find a glimmer of hope for survival.
He gritted his teeth, his face etched with determination.
Suddenly, a seemingly ordinary wooden sword appeared in his hand with a quick flick of his palm.
Without hesitation, he poured all his Spiritual Power into the wooden sword, holding nothing back.
"Slash!"
The Song family’s Patriarch shouted loudly, swinging his arm fiercely.
In an instant, the wooden sword, once plain and unremarkable, burst forth with dazzling azure light, so resplendent that it was almost unbearable to gaze upon.
Mysterious runes flickered intermittently around the sword’s body, as if containing endless secrets.
Amidst the piercing, shrill wails, the wooden sword surged towards Xu Ping like a blue Flood Dragon, with a power akin to overturning seas and mountains.
Where the wooden sword passed, space seemed burdened beyond endurance, leaving fine cracks in its wake, accompanied by a sizzling sound, as if space itself was wailing in agony.
"Magical Treasure!"
Xu Ping’s expression grew exceptionally grave. Faced with the incoming, formidable blow, he dared not be careless or slack.
He similarly flicked his palm, and the Purple Sun Sword instantly appeared in his hand. At the same time, the aura around him started to rise rapidly, momentum continuously increasing.
"Slash!"
Holding the sword in one hand, Xu Ping softly uttered a word, then swung the sword fiercely.
"Boom!"
With a thunderous roar, a sword light carrying a fleeting white rainbow emerged, like a sky-opening blade, as if intending to rend the void completely.
This sword light, imbued with endless sharpness, cleaved directly toward the wooden sword Magical Treasure.
"Boom!"
In an instant, the sword light clashed intensely with the wooden sword Magical Treasure, erupting in deafening explosions.
Powerful Spiritual Power fluctuations spread furiously in all directions from the point of collision, swiftly raising a storm of Spiritual Power.
The surrounding rocks and trees turned to powder under the impact of this terrifying force, leaving the once-peaceful place in utter disarray amidst the flying sand and rocks.
"What!"
"Sword Qi Thunder Sound? Sword Light Like a Rainbow?" The Song family’s Patriarch turned pale in shock, a trace of terror flashing across his face.
"No, it’s not!"
But in the next moment, he reacted quickly, his eyes fixated intently on Xu Ping.
With his years of experience and discernment, he immediately recognized that the opponent had only just touched the edges of the Sword Light Like a Rainbow realm.
Yet there was still a substantial gap to completely understanding this profound realm.
Moreover, judging by the aura emanating from the opponent, Xu Ping was significantly stronger than an ordinary Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivator, yet still distinctly inferior compared to Fake Pill cultivators.
Could it be that the one pursuing him was a Foundation Establishment Sword Cultivator with extraordinary talent?
"No matter who you are, you must die!"
The Song family’s Patriarch’s eyes flashed with ruthlessness and determination, and he relentlessly increased the output of Spiritual Power.
In an instant, the azure light on the wooden sword grew even more intense, its offensive akin to a relentless storm, continuously attacking Xu Ping.
In his view, a Foundation Establishment Cultivator with such outstanding Sword Cultivator talent must be killed early, to prevent endless troubles in the future.
Xu Ping instantly felt pressure bearing down like a mountain, and though the Purple Sun Sword in his hand was of exceptional quality, it was hard to entirely channel his surging Sword Intent and overwhelming strength at this moment.
In the intense clash with the Song family’s Patriarch’s Magical Treasure Wooden Sword, Xu Ping gradually found himself overwhelmed, slowly falling into a disadvantage.
"Boom!"
Suddenly, another earth-shattering roar erupted.
Xu Ping’s face became extremely grave, and he unleashed all his Mana without reservation, causing the Purple Sun Sword to erupt with incredibly terrifying sword light.
His figure flickered, slashing thirteen consecutive strikes, each infused with boundless power and Sword Intent, managing to barely force the Song family’s Patriarch’s Magical Treasure Wooden Sword to retreat.
"Alas, even wielding the Purple Sun Sword, I ultimately cannot match a Fake Pill cultivator equipped with a Magical Treasure!"
Observing the flickering, dim Purple Sun Sword, emitting a sorrowful hum, Xu Ping sighed helplessly in his heart.
He understood that if he had an Artifact Embryo at hand at this moment.
Relying on his strength and swordsmanship, he was confident he could fight evenly with the opponent and wouldn’t have been driven into such a passive situation so quickly.
However, while Xu Ping felt considerable disappointment over the strength he portrayed, his performance nevertheless astonished the Song family’s Patriarch.
Never before had the Song family’s Patriarch imagined that a cultivator, whose aura was merely at the Foundation Establishment Perfection realm, could battle him to this extent.
If this person were to grow steadily, to what terrifying heights will he ascend in the future?
Golden Core Realm? Nascent Soul Realm?
Truly unimaginable!
In response, the Song family’s Patriarch’s expression became extremely cold, a boundless killing intent almost drowning him entirely.
He continuously sent the Mana he accumulated through years of cultivation into the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword.
No matter how talented the opponent may be, today, this place will be his burial ground!
"Die!"
Holding the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword, the Song family’s Patriarch used all his strength to slash fiercely!
"Chiii!"
An azure sword light, extending over a hundred feet, instantly filled the skies and the earth. This sword light was unparalleled in its sharpness, seeming as though it wished to annihilate everything in existence.
"So powerful!"

chapters.title: Chapter 227 - 175: Severely Wounding the Song Family Ancestor (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 227: Chapter 175: Severely Wounding the Song Family Ancestor (Part 2)
Seeing this scene, Xu Ping’s expression became extremely grave.
The power of this strike was beyond imagination, stronger than an ordinary Fake Pill cultivator by half a level.
He had already exhausted all his strength just resisting the prior attack, and faced with this fatal strike, relying merely on his own strength and cultivation, there was no way he could withstand it.
However, Xu Ping did not intend to continue relying on his own cultivation to endure.
His action this time was meant to test how his strength compared to Fake Pill cultivators.
Now that his goal was reached, he certainly would not engage in futile resistance.
Xu Ping swiftly formed seals with his hands as he chanted incessantly under his breath.
In an instant, a talisman exuding a chilling purple light flew out of his sleeve, slowly floating in mid-air.
"Go!"
Xu Ping forcefully swung his hand, and the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman instantly transformed into a massive thunder dragon.
This thunder dragon was encircled by crackling arcs of electricity, which flickered while releasing world-destroying terror, ferociously charging towards the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword.
"Boom!"
The immense thunder dragon fiercely collided with the hundred-zhang long cyan sword glow, and as soon as they contacted, an intense and magnificent confrontation unfolded.
For a time, thunder light flashed incessantly, Sword Qi madly slashed, and the whole world seemed to be shaken by this terrifying power.
Ultimately, it was the thunder dragon that had the upper hand.
After a fierce struggle, the thunder dragon successfully obliterated the sword glow before roaring towards the Song family patriarch.
Although the Song family patriarch’s previous attack was extremely formidable, it essentially still belonged to the realm of Fake Pill level.
However, the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman was genuinely a third-rank lower-grade talisman, containing the terrifying power of a Golden Core cultivator.
"Third-rank talisman!"
Seeing this, the Song family patriarch’s face revealed a look of terror, and he frantically formed seals with his hands.
Numerous mysterious runes flashed quickly at his fingertips, and in the blink of an eye, a huge and sturdy shield condensed in front of him.
"Boom!"
A thunderous crash reverberated, and the thunder dragon formed by the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman fiercely struck the shield in front of the Song family patriarch.
In an instant, thunder rays spilled out, and the intense light illuminated the whole world, as if daylight had descended.
The powerful impact caused the shield to shake violently, and the originally bright cyan light on the shield dimmed somewhat.
The next moment.
"Crack."
With a crisp sound of breaking, the shield in front of the Song family patriarch finally couldn’t bear the load, cracking and shattering.
However, the thunder dragon’s power was almost exhausted at this point.
However, before the Song family patriarch could breathe a sigh of relief.
"Boom!"
Another thunder dragon appeared out of thin air, roaring with fury, carrying all its might and directly charging at the Song family patriarch.
"Another third-rank talisman!"
The Song family patriarch’s face filled with fear, he hurriedly tried various means to resist, but all in vain.
"Crack!"
Thunder Power erupted, easily shattering all his defenses, before heavily striking his body.
"Boom!"
The Song family patriarch was instantly enveloped in thunder light, his body uncontrollably flying backward tens of zhang, crashing heavily onto a massive rock.
The tremendous impact shattered the rock into debris, which scattered everywhere.
Moments later, the dust gradually settled.
"Cough cough... splutter!"
The Song family patriarch’s body was blackened, his aura chaotic and unstable, almost entirely depleted of Spiritual Power, with very severe injuries.
He coughed with difficulty twice, unable to hold back a mouthful of fresh blood spurting out.
He struggled to raise his head, his eyes filled with shock and resentment.
He could never have imagined that the person before him would still hide such powerful third-rank talismans.
It should be known that even someone like him, entrenched in Yue Country for hundreds of years as a Fake Pill cultivator, did not possess third-rank talismans.
"Not dead?"
A hint of surprise flashed across Xu Ping’s face, even after using two Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans consecutively, he still failed to kill the opponent outright.
It seems this Song family patriarch is indeed stronger than ordinary Fake Pill cultivators.
However, though he narrowly survived, he is now gravely injured and critically endangered, his strength greatly reduced.
Seizing this perfect opportunity, Xu Ping swiftly flashed forward like a ghost to approach.
The Purple Sun Sword in his hands shone brightly, Sword Intent overflowing, as if the whole person transformed into a sharp bolt of lightning, quickly attacking the Song family patriarch.
"Slash!"
Facing the situation, the Song family patriarch clenched his teeth, forcibly using the remaining Spiritual Power in his body, injecting it again into the wooden sword.
He was well aware that if he didn’t fight with all his might today, he would surely die here.
The wooden sword emitted a low hum, struggling to release the last faint trace of cyan light, heading towards Xu Ping.
However, at this point, the Song family patriarch was already at his limit, and this strike, although fierce, was actually greatly diminished in power.
Xu Ping easily struck the magical treasure flying with one sword, then followed up with another sword thrust, which was precise beyond compare, directly piercing into the Song family patriarch’s Dantian.
The Sword Qi burst instantly, shattering the Fake Pill he painstakingly cultivated.
"Splutter!"
The Song family patriarch spat another mouthful of blood, his face turning pale as paper, and his aura rapidly declining.
In such severe injury, he directly fell into unconsciousness.
Xu Ping quickly approached, continuously injecting mana into this person’s Sea of Consciousness and Dantian, sealing off his Divine Sense and mana.
Capturing the opponent alive, he naturally intended to use the Soul-Searching Technique to sift through the opponent’s memories.
For a great power, the truly precious secrets are often not carried on the person.

chapters.title: Chapter 228 - 175: Severely Injuring the Song Family Patriarch (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 228: Chapter 175: Severely Injuring the Song Family Patriarch (Part 3)
For instance, some of the top cultivation techniques won’t be explicitly written down but passed on orally to ensure complete secrecy.
The other party, as a Fake Pill Cultivator and an ancestor of the fake pill forces entrenched in Yue Country for centuries, knows countless secrets.
Various wondrous cultivation techniques, precious resource points...
These are the real wealth of the Song family!
Moreover, these secrets might not be recorded in jade slips.
Especially the skill to cultivate third-rank spirit wood, if acquired, would eliminate any worries about the materials for third-rank talisman paper.
After subduing the Song family’s ancestor, Xu Ping carefully cleaned up the traces of the battlefield and then leisurely left the place.
...
...
The night was like ink, slowly covering the earth.
In the depths of the forest, a temporarily created cave dwelling lay quietly hidden.
Embedded in the walls, the luminous pearls radiated brilliant light.
Xu Ping suddenly opened his eyes, a spark seemed to flash in his pupils, and he murmured to himself, "So that’s it, the Song family’s squad was indeed bait!"
The Song family’s ancestor, having cultivated as a Fake Pill Cultivator for centuries, had memories that were vast and chaotic.
The memories in his mind were like a tangled thread, not only numerous but also chaotic.
Xu Ping had only explored a small portion, but after meticulous unraveling, he had clarified some critical matters.
For instance, the Song family’s alliance with the Shuize Sect was entirely due to an extremely precious Core Formation spiritual object.
And ultimately, this Core Formation spiritual object naturally ended up in Song Fei’s hands.
Song Fei, who was intrinsically gifted, had reached Foundation Establishment Perfection after years of arduous cultivation.
Originally, he planned to adjust his state to the peak before fully breaking through to a higher realm, yet he didn’t foresee sudden changes.
With no choice, he had to flee to Hu Country, carrying the Core Formation spiritual object with him.
However, even the Song family’s ancestor had no idea which direction he fled to in Hu Country.
"Hu Country, huh!" Xu Ping muttered softly, with a hint of contemplation in his tone.
At first, he intended to kill Song Fei as well, but now it seemed that he could only temporarily abandon that thought.
However, Xu Ping didn’t dwell on this matter much.
After all, though Song Fei was a Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivator, traversing countries was extremely perilous.
Throughout the journey, confronting vicious rogue cultivators or navigating dangerous areas concealed with crises could easily lead to his demise.
Typically, at least a Fake Pill cultivation is needed to have enough strength to safely cross different countries.
Even if by some miracle, Song Fei safely reaches Hu Country and successfully forms his core.
Xu Ping was not afraid, possessing the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman, a mere newly advanced Golden Core Cultivator posed no substantial threat to him.
Apart from the matter with Song Fei, Xu Ping also realized that the Song family did not conspire to lure him out of Thousand Leaves Mountain with the Core Formation spiritual object.
Besides the issue with Song Fei, during the soul search, Xu Ping learned that the Song family wasn’t plotting to lure him out of Thousand Leaves Mountain using the Core Formation spiritual object.
"In that case, it’s the Shuize Sect trying to lure me out of Thousand Leaves Mountain?"
Xu Ping slightly squinted, a chill silently passed through his heart.
Although he wasn’t sure if it was Elder Hao, the Fake Pill Cultivator in the Longshi Market, or the decision of the Shuize Sect’s high level.
He already firmly placed the blame on the entire Shuize Sect.
However, with the vast power of the Shuize Sect, avenging at present was as difficult as climbing to the sky for Xu Ping.
Yet he wasn’t overly concerned about it.
After all, once the Luoyun Sect Leader’s cultivation stabilizes, it will be the day to wage war on the Shuize Sect.
Even if he can only cheer from behind, witnessing his enemies turn to ashes in the flames of war.
It was indeed a gratifying thing.
"For now, it’s best to wait patiently!"
Xu Ping forcefully suppressed the surge of thoughts in his heart, refocusing, and continued to perform the Soul-Searching Technique, diving deeper into the Song family ancestor’s memories.
This time, he focused on various secret techniques.
Before long, Xu Ping was thrilled to find the long-sought skill to cultivate third-rank spirit wood.
"I’ve found it!"
A trace of barely contained joy flickered in his eyes.
Immediately, he quickly took out a blank jade slip and devoted himself to recording the secret technique of cultivating third-rank spirit wood, word by word.
Half an hour quickly passed.
Xu Ping had already recorded the entire secret technique accurately.
After confirming there were no omissions, he relaxed a bit.
"With this secret technique, I will no longer lack third-rank talisman paper in the future."
Xu Ping smiled slightly, carefully stored the jade slip, and continued to delve into the Song family ancestor’s memories.
As the exploration progressed, Xu Ping quickly skimmed through many worthless memories and some secret techniques of little use to him.
Gradually, the Song family ancestor’s memories were nearly fully explored.
However, at this critical moment before the end, Xu Ping made two more significant discoveries that filled him with immense surprise: ’Treasure Planting Skill’ and ’Cyan Wood Shield.’
"These two skills are just perfect for me!" Upon careful inspection, Xu Ping couldn’t help but feel a surge of indescribable excitement.
The former, ’Treasure Planting Skill,’ emphasizes planting the wood element artifact embryo into a spirit wood of the same origin.
After years of careful nurturing, the artifact grows and perfects itself, eventually achieving greatness.
Xu Ping originally planned to forge seventy-two artifact embryos, but the time and resources required to forge so many artifact embryos into artifacts were astronomical.
If he could leverage this ’Treasure Planting Skill’ to assist in cultivating artifacts, it would undoubtedly save a considerable amount of time and valuable resources.

chapters.title: Chapter 229 - 176: Bountiful Harvest; Epiphany of the Primordial Sword Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 229: Chapter 176: Bountiful Harvest; Epiphany of the Primordial Sword Skill
As for the latter, the "Cyan Wood Shield" is an exceptionally strong defensive magic.
Previously, the protective shield that the Song family’s ancestor used to block his Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman was precisely condensed through this skill.
If Xu Ping can cultivate the "Cyan Wood Shield" to a higher level and complement it with his body refining techniques, he will undoubtedly be able to handle even Fake Pill or Golden Core cultivators more effortlessly.
"It seems my luck is truly good this time!"
Xu Ping slightly curved his lips, unconsciously revealing a faint joyful smile.
He once again took out the jade slip and began to meticulously record the ’Treasure Planting Skill’ and ’Cyan Wood Shield’.
During this soul search, being able to obtain two secret techniques and skills that greatly aid him far exceeded Xu Ping’s original expectations.
Another half a quarter-hour passed.
The ’Treasure Planting Skill’ and ’Cyan Wood Shield’ were thoroughly recorded in the jade slip, and he had completely explored the Song family ancestor’s memories.
"Now that the memory exploration is over, it’s time to take a good inventory of the harvested materials."
Xu Ping’s gaze slowly fell on the emerald green ring on the right hand of the Song family ancestor.
He reached out to take off the ring, and after some refining, he gently tilted it.
In an instant, a pile of colorful, glowing Spirit Stones appeared before his eyes.
Among them, the lower grade Spirit Stones were the most numerous, with more than five thousand pieces, followed by about a hundred mid-grade Spirit Stones, quite useful for Foundation Establishment cultivators; the most eye-catching was that upper grade Spirit Stone brimming with Spiritual Qi!
"Just the Spirit Stones alone are quite valuable. Wow, this is indeed a bountiful harvest!"
Xu Ping carefully stored the upper grade Spirit Stone, secretly feeling fortunate that his decision to ambush the Song family ancestor was undoubtedly a correct one.
In this assassination action, he himself did not suffer any damage, merely expending two Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans.
Compared to this ample harvest, that small loss was hardly worth mentioning.
Xu Ping sent his Divine Sense into the Storage Ring, beginning to carefully inspect the various Spiritual Objects, Magical Artifacts, and jade slips stored inside... looking at the dazzling array of items.
He couldn’t help but take a deep breath, exclaiming in awe: "Truly a rich family... as expected from the Song family ancestor..."
Additionally, he delightedly discovered the Third-rank Spirit Wood that he had been yearning for, with a length of two zhang.
With such a length of Third-rank Spirit Wood, he should not have to worry about the raw materials for Third-rank talisman paper for a long time.
"Apart from this, the most significant acquisition is this Magical Treasure Wooden Sword." Xu Ping reached out to hold the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword in his hand.
Judging by its appearance, this Magical Treasure Wooden Sword seemed unassuming, with nothing particularly striking about it.
However, when he lightly swept his Divine Sense over the sword, he instantly sensed the formidable power contained within.
Xu Ping had always lacked a magical sword at least at the artifact embryo level.
Now, being able to obtain a magical treasure-level sword directly, it was truly a dream come true for him.
"With my current cultivation level and Divine Sense strength, once I completely refine this artifact, I should barely be able to wield it."
Xu Ping thought for a moment, then stored the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword, planning to properly refine it after returning to Thousand Leaves Mountain.
After all, refining a magical treasure at his current cultivation level still required a considerable amount of time.
After storing everything safely, Xu Ping’s gaze returned to the Song family ancestor’s body.
He flicked his finger lightly, and a brilliant spiritual light shot out from his fingertip, blasting the Song family ancestor’s head apart, splattering brain matter everywhere, and a strong scent of blood quickly filled the entire cave house.
Then, he flicked his finger again, accurately sending a blazing fireball onto the Song family ancestor’s corpse.
In just a moment, the Song family ancestor’s body was reduced to a pile of ashes.
"A little revenge is indeed one of life’s greatest joys!"
Xu Ping smiled, and if it weren’t for the unsuitable venue, he really wanted to drink a hearty cup of Spirit Wine to celebrate.
A moment later.
Xu Ping walked out of the cave house, manipulating his mana to transform into a giant hand of Spiritual Qi, leveling the temporary cave house to the ground, then leaving without looking back.
Apart from him, no one knew that a Fake Pill cultivator was buried beneath this land.
...
...
Ten days later.
Xu Ping returned quietly to Thousand Leaves Mountain.
In the cultivation room, Xu Ping took out the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword from his storage bag, quickly forming magic techniques with his hands, beginning to patiently dispel the residual Divine Sense imprint, officially refining this magical artifact.
Though the owner of this wooden sword artifact had already fallen, the Divine Sense imprint left by the Fake Pill cultivator was not so easily eradicated.
Even with Xu Ping’s considerably strong Divine Sense, it would require a significant amount of time.
While Xu Ping stayed in Thousand Leaves Mountain, focused on refining the wooden sword artifact, the situation throughout Yue Country grew ever more turbulent.
After eradicating the Shuize Sect’s claws, various forces began bickering endlessly over resources, Spiritual lands, and other interests.
They often resorted to violence at the slightest disagreement, a situation that became increasingly common.
Over half a month later.
At the Yue Country border.
Swoosh!
Song Fei piloted a wooden boat, swiftly breaking into a vast desert in Hu Country.
At this moment, he suddenly looked back towards Yue Country, his eyes filled with an intense, unforgettable hatred.

chapters.title: Chapter 230 - 176: Bountiful Harvest; Epiphany of the Primordial Sword Skill (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 230: Chapter 176: Bountiful Harvest; Epiphany of the Primordial Sword Skill (2)
"The Luoyun Sect, the forces that destroyed the Song family... and Xu Ping, when my Golden Core is formed, I will definitely return, definitely!!!"
Like a desperate beast roaring, Song Fei shouted out and then rushed directly into the depths of the Hu Country’s desert, soon disappearing without a trace.
...
...
Thousand Leaves Mountain, inside the cultivation room.
Xu Ping tightly gripped the wooden Magical Artifact sword, and the mana within his Dantian surged continuously towards it like flowing rivers.
Half an hour later.
This wooden sword Magical Artifact finally, like a satisfied glutton who has eaten his fill, stopped greedily absorbing mana, and instead emitted a dazzling light.
"Finally, the refinement is complete!"
Feeling the subtle and close connection established with this wooden sword Magical Artifact, Xu Ping let out a long breath.
For more than half a month, he had been refining day and night, even with his profound cultivation and strong physique, he felt exhausted.
Upon completing the refinement, some information about the Magical Artifact automatically appeared in Xu Ping’s Sea of Consciousness.
"The Green Wood Sword, eh!"
He murmured to himself, then gripped the hilt, and strode to a vacant spot on Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Xu Ping held the sword in one hand, with the mana fiercely surging within him.
The Sword Qi whistled, slicing through the sky, and a sudden flash of green light burst forth; even before the sword was truly swung, an extremely terrifying Sword Qi swept across the entire Thousand Leaves Mountain like a hurricane.
"Master... Master, this... Sword Qi!"
The Water Lake Mouse, busy in the spirit field, felt a strong palpitation.
It hurriedly turned to look at Xu Ping in the clearing, with fear displayed unconsciously in its eyes.
The Sword Qi emanating from the master at this moment was too terrifying; such momentum alone, even without full exertion, was enough to make one feel afraid.
It’s hard to imagine what kind of power it would have if fully unleashed!
"No wonder it’s a Magical Artifact!"
In the clearing, Xu Ping held the Green Wood Sword, nodding in satisfaction.
At this moment, he exerted himself fully yet was unable to probe the power limit of the Green Wood Sword.
In his current state, even if the requirements weren’t high, he could still use the Green Wood Sword upon reaching the Core Formation Realm.
"It’s just... the only drawback is that the mana consumption is really too great."
Feeling the constant flood-like mana draining from his Dantian, Xu Ping couldn’t help but frown slightly.
If he exerted the Green Wood Sword fully, he feared that after several swings, all his mana would be exhausted.
"It seems this Green Wood Sword can only be used at critical moments for the final life-and-death struggle!" Xu Ping thought secretly to himself.
"Congratulations, Master, on obtaining this Magical Artifact, your strength has increased greatly!"
At this moment, the Water Lake Mouse quietly came beside Xu Ping, with a flattering smile on its face, beginning to butter up Xu Ping.
"Hmm." Xu Ping nodded slightly.
Suddenly, a flash of inspiration struck him, and he turned to look at the Water Lake Mouse, revealing a radiant yet elusive smile, "Do me a favor!"
"Gulp!"
Looking at Xu Ping’s demeanor, the Water Lake Mouse nervously swallowed, suddenly having a strong premonition of something bad.
"Master... Master, my strength is too weak, I fear I can’t help you much!" The Water Lake Mouse said in a sad tone.
"Don’t worry, it’s very simple!" Xu Ping showed a mysterious smile.
...
...
A quarter of an hour later.
The Water Lake Mouse stood trembling in the clearing, surrounded by several layers of radiant spiritual light shields, with a shield Magical Artifact exuding a mysterious aura in front of it.
The surface of the shield glowed with runes, silently proclaiming its extraordinariness.
"Master... Master, are you sure there won’t be any mistakes? You... you might accidentally kill me." The Water Lake Mouse said, trembling with fear and worry in its voice and small eyes.
"No, I have it under control!" Xu Ping smiled slightly, gently instructing, "Stand still, don’t move!"
"Master, you must take care of my little life, otherwise if I die, there will be no one to tend to the spirit fields for you anymore."
The Water Lake Mouse spoke in trembling fear as it looked pitifully at Xu Ping.
"Rest assured!"
Xu Ping nodded slightly, without saying more.
He held the sword in one hand, with mana surging like a tide, stepped forward, and thrust the sword fiercely.
Instantly, the immense power contained in the Green Wood Sword erupted like a volcanic eruption.
Buzz!
A brilliant sword light burst forth from the sword tip, resembling a vibrant azure dragon, rushing toward the Water Lake Mouse with world-destroying momentum.
"This... this is going to kill the mouse!"
Feeling the terrifying power within that sword light, the Water Lake Mouse was terrified.
Though surrounded by multiple layers of spiritual light shields and the sturdy shield Magical Artifact, it still felt no sense of security, as if death would descend at any moment.
The Water Lake Mouse gritted its teeth, with demonic power foaming, opened its mouth, and spat forcefully.
Swish!
A translucent water curtain instantly formed around it, shimmering with gentle blue light.
However, as soon as the water curtain formed, the dazzling sword light fiercely slashed onto the outermost spiritual light shield.
Boom!
Accompanied by a deafening roar, followed by a crisp snapping sound.
The first layer of the spiritual light shield only resisted for a short few moments before being easily shattered like fragile glass, dissolving into light spots scattered into the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 231 - 176: Bountiful Harvest; Epiphany of the Primordial Sword Skill (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 231: Chapter 176: Bountiful Harvest; Epiphany of the Primordial Sword Skill (3)
Subsequently, the terrifying sword light continued forward unimpeded, successively slashing towards the second layer and third layer of protective barriers...
In the end, it struck heavily against the magical artifact shield.
Bang!
The Waterfield Rat only felt an irresistible force violently collide with the magical artifact shield, as if a towering mountain collapsed upon it.
The next moment.
I was instantly lifted into the air, tracing a beautiful yet slightly awkward parabola.
Then with a "plop," it fell into the spirit field not far away.
Although the Waterfield Rat, as a second-stage demon beast, had a physique far superior to ordinary creatures, it was still left dizzy and disoriented by the terrifying power within that sword light.
Fortunately, relying on multiple layers of protection, it managed to avoid any substantial harm.
"Exhilarating!"
Upon seeing this, Xu Ping couldn’t help but burst into hearty laughter.
Being able to unleash his full power without reservation in such a straightforward manner was truly satisfying and delightful.
Since the "Longevity Skill" broke through to the Great Success Realm, he had never experienced such a thorough enjoyment.
Every time he practiced the "Primordial Sword Skill," he always felt like he was tightly bound by an invisible shackle.
But at this moment, all constraints seemed to vanish in an instant.
At this time, a strong, uncontrollable urge to practice swordsmanship surged within Xu Ping’s heart!
Xu Ping gripped the Azure Wood Sword tightly, firmly planting his feet on the ground, like an unyielding mountain standing amidst storms with not a trace of movement.
Suddenly, a bright light gleamed in his eyes, like stars twinkling in the night sky.
With the sword in hand, he swiftly swung forward, executing all the moves of the "Primordial Sword Skill" with smooth fluidity.
Xu Ping used no mana, and every stroke, every move was delivered in the purest, most original form.
The sword tip sliced through the air, producing a sharp whistling sound.
At this moment, he was completely engrossed in the pure feeling of practicing swordsmanship.
It was as if only he and the Azure Wood Sword in his hand remained in the entire world, with everything else fading into oblivion.
"What is Master doing?"
The Waterfield Rat poked its head out of the spirit field, its small eyes darting around. After a brief thought, it immediately realized that the master must have had some insight into a certain sword technique.
With a quick glance, the rat’s wit immediately kicked in, and it swiftly dragged the magical artifact shield away to hide.
It was genuinely afraid that after Xu Ping’s breakthrough in swordsmanship, he would use it as a target for practice.
...
Xu Ping, of course, was unaware of the little thoughts running through the Waterfield Rat’s mind.
At this moment, his mind was consumed with the singular thought of practicing swordsmanship.
As if tireless, his sword movements changed continuously with ease, one move following another, without stopping for a moment.
Sunrise and sunset, time passed quietly without him noticing, and he didn’t know how much time had passed.
With eyes closed, Xu Ping was fully immersed in the world of the Sword Dao.
A strong sword intent emanated from him, like an invisible storm, spreading from him as the center to the surroundings.
He wielded the sword fiercely forward with a slash.
Buzz!
This time, without any mana augmenting it, the area around the sword naturally emitted extremely sharp sword qi.
This sword qi seemed to have a life of its own, shimmering with an icy cold light, as if it could slice through the void ahead.
At this moment, the originally calm Mountain Protection Array suddenly flickered violently, with the runes on the array growing intensely bright, as if bearing immense pressure.
The entire Thousand Leaves Mountain was enveloped by this extremely sharp sword intent, and the air was filled with an atmosphere of carnage.
Xu Ping suddenly opened his eyes, and his gaze, like tangible sword qi, shot out sharply, slicing through the surrounding air with a "sss" sound.
It was as if the air trembled in fear under this fierce gaze!
"How long has it been?"
Fully awake now, Xu Ping calculated, finally realizing that he had been practicing the "Primordial Sword Skill" for ten days and nights.
"It’s been such a long time!" Xu Ping was secretly astonished.
Lost in the world of sword practice, it seemed as if time no longer held meaning, and he thought only a few minutes had passed.
He hadn’t expected that a long ten days and nights had already gone by.
He had never practiced swordsmanship for such an extended period in one go.
Fortunately, he had successfully established his foundation and reached the mid-second-stage body refining realm, with physical attributes far beyond ordinary people, or he would have long been exhausted and collapsed, unable to move.
"Now the proficiency of the ’Primordial Sword Skill’ is likely to increase significantly!"
A flash of joy unconsciously crossed Xu Ping’s eyes, and he eagerly pulled up the proficiency panel in his mind.
[Primordial Sword Skill Perfected: 810/1600]
"Gasp!"
"It’s increased this much!"
Although Xu Ping had anticipated that proficiency would grow, when he saw the numbers on the panel, he couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
In just ten days and nights of practice, the proficiency of the "Primordial Sword Skill" soared by as much as 106 points.
By rough estimation, this was almost equivalent to the proficiency he would ordinarily have accumulated over more than two years of hard training.
"This is so exhilarating!"
Xu Ping couldn’t help but grin widely with uncontrollable excitement and satisfaction on his face.
If he could experience more moments of epiphany like this in the future, perhaps it wouldn’t take long for the "Primordial Sword Skill" to reach perfection.
However, he also understood that such near-enlightened feelings are truly a fortuitous event.
In all the time he had been cultivating, this was only his first time experiencing it.
"With such a massive increase in the ’Primordial Sword Skill’ proficiency, my sword realm might have also made significant progress."
After pondering for a moment, Xu Ping wielded his sword and fiercely struck towards a sturdy small hill nearby.

chapters.title: Chapter 232 - 177: Cyan Wood Shield Completed; Luoyun Sect Comes Calling
chapters.content:
Chapter 232: Chapter 177: Cyan Wood Shield Completed; Luoyun Sect Comes Calling
Xu Ping pondered for a moment, then raised his sword and launched a powerful slash towards a sturdy small hill not far away.
In an instant, a sharp sword light burst forth abruptly, faintly carrying a dazzling white arc, as if containing an endless, majestic force that tore through the void.
The unstoppable momentum, like a turbulent torrent, roared straight towards the small hill!
"Boom!"
A loud noise resounded through the heavens and earth.
In the blink of an eye, the small hill that was as solid as a rock was shredded to pieces.
Countless fragments of stone scattered into the air like a grand, awe-inspiring rain of stones pouring down.
Afterward, the residual power of the sword light didn’t diminish and heavily struck the protective array light of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"Boom!" Another earth-shattering rumble.
The entire array guarding Thousand Leaves Mountain trembled violently, emitting a huge roar, but in the end, it stood completely undamaged.
"Indeed!"
Witnessing this scene, Xu Ping’s eyes shone like stars, "My Sword Dao realm has truly advanced another step."
If the realm of "Sword Light Like a Rainbow" is to be compared to a target a hundred meters away.
Then previously, he might have been just one meter away; whereas now, he was already at ten meters.
Although the distance to the end is still far, compared to before, it’s undoubtedly a qualitative leap, his strength has become much more powerful.
Xu Ping became more certain in his heart that when he cultivated the ’Primordial Sword Skill’ to perfection, it would perhaps be the time he fully comprehended the realm of ’Sword Light Like a Rainbow’!
"With my current strength, I suppose I could defeat the ancestor of the Song family even without using the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman." Xu Ping’s lips curled slightly.
Yet he was also aware that compared to Golden Core cultivators, there was still a certain gap.
After all, with his current cultivation, it would be easy for a Golden Core cultivator to deplete his mana with their deep mana reserves.
...
After carefully putting away the Cyan Wood Sword, Xu Ping turned around and returned to the cultivation room.
Inside the cultivation room.
Xu Ping took out a piece of Third-rank Spirit Wood, planning to make it into Third-rank talisman paper.
"Huh?"
"The quality of this Third-rank Spirit Wood seems somewhat unusual!"
Looking at the section of Spirit Wood that continuously emitted dense Spiritual Qi, Xu Ping couldn’t help but raise an eyebrow and utter a light exclamation.
He hadn’t carefully examined it when inventorying supplies before.
Now, upon careful scrutiny, he discovered that the quality of this Third-rank Spirit Wood seemed a notch higher than what he previously bought from the Song family.
Next, Xu Ping slowly infiltrated it with his Divine Sense and began a careful inspection.
Half a moment later.
"Mid-grade Third-rank Spirit Wood!"
Confirming the quality of this piece of Third-rank Spirit Wood, Xu Ping felt a burst of joy in his heart, and his eyes lit up immediately.
Like Lower Grade Third-rank Spirit Wood, it can usually only be made into ordinary Third-rank talisman paper, suitable only for drawing Mid to Lower Grade Third-rank talismans.
But Mid-grade Third-rank Spirit Wood is entirely different, capable of producing premium Third-rank talisman paper, allowing even Upper Grade Third-rank talismans to be drawn without issue.
This is undoubtedly an unexpected delight.
"Better to save some of this talisman paper!" Xu Ping mused silently.
In the entire Yue Country, materials for making Mid-grade Third-rank talisman paper are exceedingly rare.
Keeping some for future use when drawing Upper Grade Third-rank talismans would certainly be useful.
Xu Ping then took out the Purple Sun Sword, mana surging continuously, and began to carefully cut the Mid-grade Third-rank Spirit Wood, starting to produce premium Third-rank talismans.
...
...
Time is like fine sand held in the palm, silently slipping through the fingers.
A year and a half passed in the blink of an eye.
During this period, Xu Ping remained peacefully at Thousand Leaves Mountain, making talisman paper, drawing talismans, practicing swordplay... every day he also made sure to set aside time to cultivate the Cyan Wood Shield.
Days passed busily yet fulfillingly, and he found great joy in it.
Moreover, what surprised Xu Ping even more was that since his enlightenment on ’Primordial Sword Skill’ last time.
Every time he cultivated the ’Primordial Sword Skill’ now, the increase in proficiency, although not as remarkable as during his moment of enlightenment, was nonetheless twice as much compared to before.
Because of this, he became even more immersed in sword practice, devoting more and more time to it each day.
However, standing in stark contrast to the peaceful and harmonious atmosphere at Thousand Leaves Mountain, the entire Yue country’s situation grew increasingly chaotic and restless.
Apart from the open and covert battles among various forces over resources, spiritual lands, and other benefits, the remnants of Shuize Sect’s disciples, dispersed abroad, also began to incite chaos and deliberately sow discord among all parties.
As a result of this impact, even several Foundation Establishment and Fake Pill forces were tragically destroyed.
And due to the heavy losses from the war with Hu Country, Luoyun Sect’s Sect Leader remained secluded within to stabilize his Nascent Soul cultivation, taking no actions apart from issuing a call to arms.
.....
That day, on the open ground of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"Master, should... should I really come?"
"Come, give it your all."
"Squeak!"
Upon hearing these words, the Water Marsh Mouse hesitated no more, let out a roar, and a fierce Demonic Power fluctuation burst forth, red and blue spiritual lights rising from its body, making its originally crimson eyes turn one red and one blue.
Buzz!
A ghostly blue water orb and a scorching purple flame formed in front of the Water Marsh Mouse’s mouth, an intense pressure permeating the entire top of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
The next moment.
Bang!
The ghostly blue water orb and the scorching purple flame shot forth like two meteors from the Water Marsh Mouse’s mouth, spiraling and intertwining in the air, directly blasting towards Xu Ping.

chapters.title: Chapter 233 - 177: Cyan Wood Shield Complete; Luoyun Sect Pays a Visit (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 233: Chapter 177: Cyan Wood Shield Complete; Luoyun Sect Pays a Visit (2)
"The power is rather impressive!"
Xu Ping’s eyes slightly narrowed as he silently appraised in his heart.
Although the water lake mouse hadn’t broken through to Second-stage Middle Grade, the attack it unleashed had reached the pinnacle of that level.
"Protect!"
Xu Ping’s expression was calm and collected. His hands quickly formed a seal as he uttered a single word.
"Buzz!"
Instantly, a layer of crystal-clear cyan shield rose up, completely enveloping him.
"Boom!"
At the moment the shield formed, the water lake mouse’s attack collided fiercely with it.
Accompanied by a deafening roar, the azure blue water ball and blazing purple fire exploded simultaneously.
A violent fluctuation of Spiritual Qi, mixed with sparks and searing heat, swept outward like a storm.
However, facing this powerful attack, comparable to the pinnacle of Second-stage Middle Grade, the cyan shield around Xu Ping held firm, merely quivering slightly yet remaining perfectly intact and protecting him closely.
"Not bad!"
Seeing this scene, Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction.
This "Cyan Wood Shield" had indeed met his expectations in terms of defense.
Currently, the "Cyan Wood Shield" was merely at the proficient level, but its protective power could easily withstand attacks from Late-Stage Foundation Establishment.
If it advanced to major completion or even perfection, it might effortlessly repel attacks from a Golden Core Cultivator.
Moreover, maintaining the shield didn’t consume much Mana.
With a thought, Xu Ping dissipated the cyan shield instantly.
"Master’s protective shield is truly too strong; I simply can’t break through its defense!" A cheeky smile adorned the water lake mouse’s face, but its tone was cautious.
It was terrified that Xu Ping might whimsically use it again to test his defenses.
Recalling the terrifying experience of testing swords last time still sent shivers down its spine, vivid in memory.
Seeing the water lake mouse’s expression, Xu Ping couldn’t help but find it amusing.
"Go, work in the spirit fields." He waved his hand dismissively.
Having achieved the purpose of the experiment, there was no more need for the water lake mouse.
"Alright!"
The water lake mouse’s smile grew even brighter as it enthusiastically scampered to the spirit fields, diligently attending to the Spirit Medicine and Spirit Plant.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, could you come out for a meeting?"
As Xu Ping was about to return to his cave dwelling, an elderly and resonant voice penetrated the Mountain Protection Array, echoing clearly throughout Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Xu Ping’s expression changed slightly; instinctively he raised his head to gaze at the sky above Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Through the thick clouds and mist, he vaguely saw a Spiritual Boat quietly hovering above the array.
Xu Ping hesitated briefly and then took out a Token, waving it gently.
Immediately, the clouds began to disperse, revealing an elderly figure clad in adorned robes, standing on a Spiritual Boat with flowing white hair and beard.
"Fake Pill cultivator!"
Upon discerning the visitor’s cultivation realm, Xu Ping’s brow furrowed slightly.
He was about to inquire when the visitor preemptively introduced himself: "I am Yang Hong, an outer sect elder of Luoyun Sect, here to visit Fellow Daoist Xu!"
"Yang Hong from Luoyun Sect?"
Xu Ping was slightly startled but soon recovered, breaking into a warm and friendly smile: "So it’s Elder Yang from Luoyun Sect. May I ask, what brings you here today?"
He respectfully clasped his hands, asking courteously.
"Good news!"
Yang Hong chuckled, his eyes flickering, "Would Fellow Daoist Xu be open to letting me in for a detailed conversation?"
"Of course, no problem!"
Xu Ping smiled faintly and proceeded to open the array, welcoming Yang Hong inside.
Although he couldn’t be absolutely certain that the visitor was indeed an elder of Luoyun Sect, he was only a Fake Pill cultivator after all. Even if he allowed him into the mountain, it should pose no significant issue.
Yang Hong landed the Spiritual Boat steadily on a clearing at Thousand Leaves Mountain.
