At that moment, Xu Ping finally noticed that a person was securely bound on the Spiritual Boat, his face filled with terror.
"Xu Zhixuan!"
Xu Ping was astonished and greatly surprised.
He truly hadn’t expected their next meeting to occur in such a manner.
"Does Fellow Daoist Xu recognize this person?" Yang Hong asked with a smile.
Xu Ping couldn’t fathom why the visitor brought Xu Zhixuan here, so he reluctantly nodded, "I do, we used to serve as Guest Ministers together at Qiu Xuan Mountain."
After a pause, Xu Ping added, "The last time I saw him was years ago when he served as a spokesperson for Shuize Sect, trying to persuade me to join them, but I refused."
"No need for such tension, Fellow Daoist Xu. I’m not here to accuse you of anything," Yang Hong laughed heartily, his tone quite amiable.
"I know well that Fellow Daoist Xu has no ties with Shuize Sect."
"I have deliberately come today mainly to inform you that this person has been conspiring with Shuize Sect against you."
"Conspiring to harm me?"
Xu Ping’s heart stirred, but he purposely showed a puzzled and confused expression, "Could such a thing happen?"
"Fellow Daoist Xu may not know, but after being turned away by you, he went off exaggerating..."
Yang Hong then thoroughly explained how Elder Hao from Dragon Lion Island had used a Core Formation spiritual object, meticulously planning step by step to lure Xu Ping away from Thousand Leaves Mountain.
’So that’s how it is!’
Despite a quick flash of realization in the depths of Xu Ping’s eyes, he remained expressionless on the surface.

chapters.title: Chapter 234 - 177: Cyan Wood Shield Complete; Luoyun Sect Pays a Visit (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 234: Chapter 177: Cyan Wood Shield Complete; Luoyun Sect Pays a Visit (3)
The content recounted by Yang Hong, sounds truthful, as many details corroborate each other.
Moreover, Xu Ping was already basically certain that the Shuize Sect was behind the scenes causing trouble.
"Fortunately, Fellow Daoist Xu did not suffer the temptation of the Core Formation spiritual objects to venture out. Otherwise, even as a third-rank Talisman Master, facing the sudden attack of a Fake Pill cultivator, it would be difficult to escape disaster."
Yang Hong said slowly, with a tone containing a trace of relief.
"Is that so!"
After listening to Yang Hong’s account, Xu Ping displayed an appropriate expression of anger intertwined with relief.
"Thank you, Elder Yang, for informing this junior. Otherwise, I would have remained in the dark." Xu Ping respectfully cupped his hands, sincerely expressing gratitude.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, you are too kind."
The smile on Yang Hong’s face grew broader, "Fellow Daoist Xu, being a third-rank Talisman Master, your status is not beneath mine. Let us regard each other as peers!"
"How could that be!" Xu Ping quickly waved his hand in refusal.
Though Yang Hong’s words held truth, the other party was, after all, an outer sect elder of the Luoyun Sect; maintaining humility was always prudent.
At Xu Ping’s insistence, they ultimately agreed to disagree.
Yang Hong continued, "Although the scheme to harm Fellow Daoist Xu was orchestrated by that old fellow Hao Chun, in reality, he acted on the instructions of the Shuize Sect’s higher-ups..."
"Since the Shuize Sect now harbors harmful intentions against you, I believe you are well aware of the relations between our Luoyun Sect and the Shuize Sect, Fellow Daoist Xu."
"Once our sect leader stabilizes his Nascent Soul cultivation, our Luoyun Sect will mobilize a large force to thoroughly eradicate the Shuize Sect."
"Why not join our Luoyun Sect as a guest elder, and together, we shall face our common enemy."
Moreover, our Luoyun Sect is immensely resource-rich, and we will surely nurture a third-rank Talisman Master such as yourself generously. What do you think, Fellow Daoist Xu?"
As he spoke, Yang Hong looked at Xu Ping expectantly, his gaze full of anticipation.
"Join the Luoyun Sect?"
Hearing these words, Xu Ping had to admit that a ripple arose in his heart.
Though Luoyun Sect suffered heavy losses in the war with Hu Country, the sect’s foundation still remained unfathomably deep.
Moreover, their sect leader had successfully broken through to the Nascent Soul Realm, ensuring at least five hundred years of peace for the Luoyun Sect.
If Xu Ping joined, obtaining Core Formation spiritual objects might not be difficult. After all, for a Nascent Soul level major sect like Luoyun Sect, the value of a third-rank Talisman Master far exceeds that of an ordinary Golden Core cultivator.
Furthermore, Yang Hong personally captured Xu Zhixuan and presented him, showing significant sincerity.
Xu Ping pondered for a long time, then cupped his hands and said, "I appreciate Elder Yang’s and the esteemed sect’s kindness."
"However, I am naturally fond of freedom and prefer to study Talisman Dao without constraints here at the Thousand Leaves Mountain, not suitable for joining a sect and adhering to many rules."
Although joining Luoyun Sect has many attractions, it also has many disadvantages.
Aside from having to comply with various sect rules, it also risks having his concealed secrets exposed to the Nascent Soul cultivators, apart from a very fatal issue.
Although the Luoyun Sect seems calm and stable currently, who can predict what might transpire next?
If another devastating war like the one with Hu Country were to occur, he might not even have the chance to escape then.
But it’s different at Thousand Leaves Mountain; if anything seems amiss, he can withdraw anytime!
Xu Ping knew very well, many Golden Core cultivators perished in the battle with Hu Country this time.
Hearing Xu Ping’s words, Yang Hong was slightly stunned, seemingly not expecting Xu Ping’s decisive refusal.
After a brief thought, he continued to persuade, "Fellow Daoist Xu, you must consider carefully."
"Joining the Luoyun Sect not only brings numerous aids but also offers the opportunity to access deeper Talisman Dao inheritance, which is greatly beneficial for your Talisman Dao cultivation, potentially making acquiring Core Formation spiritual objects not difficult!"
Although all cultivators in Yue Country knew Luoyun Sect suffered severe losses in the recent war, only the mid to high-levels within Luoyun Sect knew the extent of the devastation.
Nearly half of the Golden Core cultivators were killed or injured, and as for Foundation Establishment and Qi Cultivators, the casualties were countless.
Currently, within the sect, there remain only a third-rank mid-grade Artifact Refiner and a third-rank upper-grade Array Master with skills above third-rank.
Such grave losses will require at least a century of recuperation to restore vitality.
Precisely because of this, Luoyun Sect sincerely invites a pure-blooded and exceptionally gifted third-rank Talisman Master like Xu Ping to join.
Xu Ping smiled gratefully, "I understand Elder’s words; the generous conditions offered by Luoyun Sect are indeed very enticing."
"But everyone has their own path of cultivation. I feel that focusing and delving into Talisman Dao here at the Thousand Leaves Mountain is the path most suitable for me."
Seeing Xu Ping’s resolute attitude, Yang Hong realized further persuasion would be futile, and sighed slightly, "So be it, since Fellow Daoist Xu’s mind is made up, there’s no need for my insistence."
Xu Ping, knowing Shuize Sect had once secretly plotted against him, would not be swayed by Shuize Sect to join them.
Thus, Luoyun Sect, unlike Shuize Sect, need not secretly scheme against Xu Ping anymore.
"Then I wonder if Fellow Daoist Xu could sell a few third-rank talismans to me? As for Spirit Stones, please rest assured, you will not be underpaid." Yang Hong’s expression turned stern.
After this war, Luoyun Sect had almost exhausted all its third-rank and higher talismans.
Additionally, within the current sect, there’s no Talisman Master capable of drawing third-rank talismans. Therefore, the sect is now massively purchasing third-rank talismans to stockpile its reserves.
"Purchasing third-rank talismans?"
A thought surged in Xu Ping’s heart, as he swiftly realized this was a perfect opportunity to acquire what he currently needed!

chapters.title: Chapter 235 - 178: Transaction for Geng Metal; Perfection Level Tribulation Spirit Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 235: Chapter 178: Transaction for Geng Metal; Perfection Level Tribulation Spirit Skill
Xu Ping pondered slightly, a gentle smile gradually appearing on his face as he slowly said, "Elder Yang, the matter of selling third-rank talismans is not entirely unfeasible."
"It’s just that I prefer not to trade with Spirit Stones; I’d rather exchange goods. I wonder what Elder thinks of this?"
Yang Hong was slightly taken aback, then smiled and said, "Oh? Bartering is certainly possible. Fellow Daoist Xu, don’t hesitate to say what kind of goods you desire."
The Luoyun Sect, despite consuming a lot of resources, still had more than enough to meet the requirements of a mid-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
Xu Ping looked at Yang Hong with a forthright gaze and said deliberately, "I want Geng Metal. I wonder if the Luoyun Sect possesses such a thing?"
Among the things he currently desired most were: Geng Metal, third-rank upper-grade or even near-fourth-rank talisman inheritance, puppetry skills above third-rank, longevity-extending items, and spiritual objects for Core Formation...
However, he first had to rule out third-rank upper-grade, even near-fourth-rank talisman inheritance and Core Formation spiritual objects.
After all, the value of these two types of items was too high, and it would be difficult to exchange them with just third-rank lower-grade talismans.
As for puppetry skills above third-rank and longevity-extending items, although there was a chance to acquire them, they were not urgently needed for Xu Ping at present.
In this way, the only suitable choice left was Geng Metal.
"Geng Metal?"
Yang Hong furrowed his brows slightly, and after a moment’s thought, said, "Geng Metal is a precious material for refining magical artifacts. We do have some reserves in the Luoyun Sect. But I’m not sure how much Geng Metal Fellow Daoist Xu requires?"
Geng Metal, a refining material that enhances the power of magical artifacts, wasn’t of much use in the heat of battle.
Therefore, the quantity remaining in their sect was still quite substantial.
Hearing this, Xu Ping was secretly delighted, but his face remained composed: "I don’t need a large amount, about twenty pounds would suffice."
He already had a piece of Geng Metal weighing about ten pounds, and another piece of equivalent weight would be enough.
But Xu Ping thought it more prudent to prepare a bit more, just in case.
"Twenty pounds of Geng Metal?"
Yang Hong was instantly shocked, not understanding why Xu Ping needed so much Geng Metal!
Even for refining a magical artifact, adding around five to six pounds of Geng Metal would suffice.
Adding more would still enhance the magical artifact’s power, but the increase would be relatively limited, compared to the value of Geng Metal, it was not very cost-effective.
Moreover, such a large amount of Geng Metal could not be easily exchanged for one or two third-rank talismans.
Yang Hong pondered for a moment, then tentatively asked, "The sect indeed has this amount of Geng Metal, but its value is considerable..."
Although Yang Hong hadn’t explicitly said it, Xu Ping already understood his implication.
"Elder Yang, do you think these third-rank talismans would be enough to exchange for twenty pounds of Geng Metal?"
Xu Ping smiled slightly, gently flipping his palm, and six Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans exuding waves of thunder power appeared in his hand.
"Six third-rank lower-grade talismans!!" Yang Hong’s eyes involuntarily revealed a trace of shock at the sight of the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans in Xu Ping’s hand.
It was well known that drawing third-rank talismans was extremely difficult, with a high failure rate.
If the success rate of drawing third-rank talismans could be maintained at around twenty percent, one could be considered a legitimate third-rank Talisman Master.
A legitimate third-rank Talisman Master would not be able to draw many third-rank talismans in a year.
"And this Talisman Master Xu can take out six third-rank talismans at once, indicating that his talisman proficiency far exceeds that of a typical legitimate third-rank Talisman Master!" Yang Hong thought to himself.
If Yang Hong knew that these six third-rank talismans were just a small part of the third-rank talismans Xu Ping had, he would surely be even more shocked.
Of course, Xu Ping would never be foolish enough to reveal all the third-rank talismans he had.
After all, if six third-rank talismans were still within the psychological tolerance range of the Luoyun Sect, dozens of third-rank talismans would far exceed their expectations.
They might unhesitatingly send out a Golden Core Cultivator to capture Xu Ping and harshly interrogate him to explore why he possessed so many third-rank talismans.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, twenty pounds of Geng Metal is no small amount; I need to consult with the sect."
Yang Hong suppressed his internal shock and slowly said, "Once I get a reply, I’ll give you a definite answer immediately, how does that sound?"
To the Luoyun Sect at present, six third-rank talismans were undoubtedly more valuable than twenty pounds of Geng Metal.
After all, with the Shuize Sect eyeing them covetously, they could not afford to let their guard down.
Once their sect leader’s Nascent Soul cultivation stabilizes, they are bound to attack Shuize Sect, and third-rank talismans can play a huge role in this conflict.
But such a transaction must be handled carefully, considering it involves the allocation of sect resources.
Xu Ping nodded in understanding: "That is as it should be. Elder Yang, feel free to consult, and I will wait here patiently."
Yang Hong didn’t delay any further, borrowed a room from Xu Ping, and went inside, casually setting up a soundproof restriction.
Meanwhile, Xu Ping waited calmly in the pavilion.
After a little less than half an hour.
Yang Hong came out with a broad smile on his face: "Fellow Daoist Xu, the sect has agreed to this transaction."
He continued, "However, I currently don’t have the Geng Metal on me and will need to retrieve it from the sect. I hope Fellow Daoist Xu can wait a little longer, I will return as soon as possible!"
Hearing this, Xu Ping smiled and saluted: "Thank you for your effort, Elder Yang!"
"This is part of my duties!" Yang Hong waved his hand.
Having said that, Yang Hong chatted a little more with Xu Ping before boarding the Spiritual Boat and leaving.

chapters.title: Chapter 236 - 178: Acquiring Geng Metal Through Trade; Tribulation Spirit Skill at the Perfection Level
chapters.content:
Chapter 236: Chapter 178: Acquiring Geng Metal Through Trade; Tribulation Spirit Skill at the Perfection Level
...
After Yang Hong’s figure completely disappeared, Xu Ping’s gaze fell on Xu Zhixuan, who had a face full of terror and pleading.
"This is the benefit of possessing the identity of a Third-Grade Talisman Master!" Xu Ping couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.
If he were just an ordinary Foundation Establishment Cultivator, the Luoyun Sect would probably not even glance at him, let alone personally capture someone for him to handle.
Moreover, acquiring Geng Metal certainly wouldn’t be as smooth as it is now, having someone come to his doorstep to trade while he sits at home.
It can only be said that revealing the identity of a Third-Grade Talisman Master has its pros and cons.
Xu Ping’s mind was filled with endless thoughts, yet his actions were unwavering.
He flicked his fingers, releasing a ray of spiritual light which instantly blew Xu Zhixuan’s head apart, causing brain matter to splatter everywhere.
He naturally wouldn’t show any mercy to someone who had secretly plotted against him before.
"Water Lake Mouse, clean this place up!" Xu Ping summoned the Water Lake Mouse that was working in the Spirit Field.
"Alright!"
The Water Lake Mouse responded happily and scurried over, then spewed a breath of Demon Fire, turning Xu Zhixuan’s body into ashes, and then summoned water to wash the ground clean.
After finishing everything, the Water Lake Mouse looked at Xu Ping, showing a flattering smile.
At this moment, Gong Yang’s voice suddenly came from outside the array: "Fellow Daoist Xu!"
"Go back to work..." Xu Ping instructed the Water Lake Mouse and then opened the array.
Outside the array stood a man and a woman, besides Gong Yang, Duan Shuang had also come.
"Please come in, Fellow Daoists!"
Xu Ping smiled and welcomed them into the pavilion, secretly guessing their purpose for coming.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, I wonder what business the outer sect elder of Luoyun Sect had with you?" As soon as they sat down, Gong Yang asked nervously.
To them, the Luoyun Sect was like an insurmountable mountain, a mighty entity one could only look up to.
Moreover, the one who came was a Fake Pill cultivator, which naturally made them both feel tense.
"Fellow Daoists, you need not worry, the Luoyun Sect came merely to purchase Third-Grade Talismans from me." Xu Ping smiled slightly, pouring them each a cup of Spirit Tea.
He did not mention that the Luoyun Sect tried to recruit him, but he refused.
Though this matter could shock them, there was no necessity to publicize it.
"I see!"
Upon hearing this, both of them couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
They were just afraid it might be some troublesome matter, although the trouble was Xu Ping’s, their close relationship might somehow involve them.
"Now that Fellow Daoist Xu has established connections with the Luoyun Sect, surely acquiring Core Formation Spiritual Objects won’t be difficult in the future!" Gong Yang said enviously.
"Fellow Daoist Gong jests, my relationship with the Luoyun Sect is purely business."
"Core Formation Spiritual Objects are so precious, their sect probably doesn’t even have enough to distribute internally, how could they sell them to me?" Xu Ping waved his hand.
"Even if the Luoyun Sect doesn’t sell, with Fellow Daoist Xu’s status as a Third-Grade Talisman Master, acquiring Core Formation Spiritual Objects elsewhere should be no trouble!" Duan Shuang said with a bright smile.
"So, today the two Fellow Daoists came especially to praise me?" Xu Ping couldn’t help but joke.
"Fellow Daoist Xu doesn’t need us to praise him." Duan Shuang couldn’t help but chuckle.
After a few more casual conversations, the topic shifted to the current situation.
"The Luoyun Sect has started taking action now, I suppose Sect Leader Jiang Jingxing’s cultivation is nearly stabilized."
"Coming to Fellow Daoist Xu today to purchase Third-Grade Talismans must be in preparation for their campaign against the Shuize Sect!"
Gong Yang said, a hint of worry surfacing in his eyes, "In this case, the entire Yue Country might be plunged into ongoing turmoil."
While he has no fondness for either the Luoyun Sect or the Shuize Sect and naturally relishes their mutual conflict,
the war between the two sects is bound to cause waves; if it affects them, it could be troublesome.
"There’s no need for excessive worry, Gong Yang. At present, the entire Shuize Sect is besieged by evil forces, if they truly had the ability to act, they would have already done so, why wait until now?"
Xu Ping reassured, "Moreover, the ancestor Yun Chengzi of the Luoyun Sect has not yet passed away; he definitely wants to resolve the critical threat of the Shuize Sect before he does."
"As such, the impact of the two sects’ war on us shouldn’t be too great."
Nonetheless, one must still exercise the necessary caution.
With the cards and power Xu Ping currently has, he believes he can protect and escape safely even if Early Stage Golden Core or even Middle Stage Golden Core cultivators come.
...
...
A month quickly passed.
On this day, Thousand Leaves Mountain once again welcomed the presence of Yang Hong.
"Thank you for waiting, Fellow Daoist Xu," Yang Hong said with a smile, cupping his hands.
"Elder Yang, you flatter me. The distance between Luoyun Sect and Thousand Leaves Mountain is quite far, and the journey is long; that you could make two trips in just one month surely took considerable effort."
Xu Ping hastily returned the gesture, speaking with a sincere smile.
His words were not mere empty pleasantries.
The distance between Luoyun Sect and Thousand Leaves Mountain is indeed vast, even given Yang Hong’s status as a Fake Pill cultivator, possessing abilities far beyond ordinary people, completing the round trip within a month surely required traveling day and night.
In the cave, the host and guest took their seats.
After exchanging a few pleasantries, Yang Hong smiled and handed over a wooden box inscribed with restrictions to Xu Ping: "Fellow Daoist Xu, this contains twenty kilograms of Geng Metal, please inspect it carefully."

chapters.title: Chapter 237 - 178: Transaction for Geng Metal; Perfection Level Tribulation Spirit Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 237: Chapter 178: Transaction for Geng Metal; Perfection Level Tribulation Spirit Skill
Xu Ping took the wooden box and effortlessly broke the restriction on it.
As the restriction dissipated, the wooden box automatically opened, and a piece of ore emitting dazzling golden light lay quietly inside.
Xu Ping slightly squinted his eyes, released his Divine Sense, and carefully examined the Geng Metal inside the box.
A moment later, confirming it was indeed the Geng Metal he needed, and that its quality was undeniably pure, a satisfied smile appeared on his face.
"Elder Yang, here are six Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans, all Thunder Element talismans. Please inspect them." Xu Ping then took six Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans from his bosom and handed them to Yang Hong.
"This third-rank talisman’s... variety seems a bit high!"
Yang Hong took the talismans, carefully probed them with his Divine Sense, and couldn’t help but feel greatly astonished.
He discovered that the quality of these six third-rank lower-grade talismans was half a notch higher than ordinary third-rank lower-grade talismans.
It must be known that for most third-rank Talisman Masters, successfully crafting a third-rank talisman is already an extremely difficult task.
Often, they give their all in the crafting process just to succeed, and rarely can they also ensure the talisman’s quality.
This shows that Talisman Master Xu’s attainments are far deeper than Yang Hong had imagined.
Not only could he ensure the quantity of talismans, but he also pursued excellence in quality!
Yang Hong suppressed the surging emotions in his heart, still smiling as he said, "Truly excellent quality third-rank lower-grade talismans, working with Fellow Daoist Xu is indeed a pleasure."
"A pleasure working with you." Xu Ping nodded with a smile in response.
After the transaction was completed, Yang Hong couldn’t help but mention, "Fellow Daoist Xu, have you truly considered not joining our Luoyun Sect?"
"With your exceptional talent as a Talisman Master, as long as you join our sect, our sect will fully support you to ensure you form your core smoothly."
Hearing this, Xu Ping’s face showed a slight bitter smile, and he quickly cupped his hands and said, "I am grateful for Elder Yang and your sect’s kindness; I sincerely appreciate the gesture."
He then continued apologetically, "However, I truly have no intention of joining any sect, and hope Elder Yang can understand!"
Xu Ping knew well and believed that Yang Hong’s words were not false; Luoyun Sect indeed had the capability to ensure his Core Formation.
However, Luoyun Sect was not a charitable organization. If he truly relied on their power to successfully form his Golden Core,
he might end up being tightly bound, completely tied to Luoyun Sect’s interests, losing much freedom and the right to make independent choices.
Hearing Xu Ping’s answer, a trace of disappointment flashed in Yang Hong’s eyes, and he softly sighed, "Fellow Daoist Xu is so determined. I won’t force you anymore in the future."
If an ordinary third-rank Talisman Master refused their Luoyun Sect once, they naturally wouldn’t invite again, after all, Luoyun Sect was a Nascent Soul force that dominated Yue Country for thousands of years, naturally proud.
However, Xu Ping’s displayed talent as a Talisman Master was truly extraordinary. Over time, if he could successfully form his core, with his talent and potential, creating third-rank upper-grade talismans might even become possible.
It was known that third-rank upper-grade talismans were incredibly rare! Even in Luoyun Sect’s most glorious era, the number of third-rank upper-grade talismans had never exceeded ten.
As for whether Xu Ping could draw near fourth-rank talismans or draw fourth-rank talismans, that was not a matter of skill anymore; it involved many complex factors.
"Thank you, Elder Yang, for understanding. Although I couldn’t join your sect, if your sect needs third-rank talismans crafted by me in the future, as long as it’s within my capability, I certainly won’t refuse."
Xu Ping earnestly cupped his hands, his words full of sincerity.
Though Xu Ping had no intent to join Luoyun Sect, he understood, Luoyun Sect was mighty, with deep foundations and abundant resources.
Maintaining a good relationship with Luoyun Sect would surely benefit his future cultivation path greatly.
"Your words are more than enough, Fellow Daoist Xu!" Yang Hong laughed heartily.
Although Xu Ping had twice refused Luoyun Sect’s invitation, fortunately, there was no conflict of interest between them, but rather, a pleasant trading relationship.
As a great sect, Luoyun Sect would not narrow-mindedly hold a grudge against Xu Ping for refusal, let alone go to any lengths to eliminate him.
...
...
After a few more idle conversations with Xu Ping, Yang Hong rose to take his leave, and Xu Ping escorted him outside the cave dwelling, watching Yang Hong’s figure gradually recede.
At this moment, only he remained in the cave dwelling.
Xu Ping slightly raised his hand, gently flipping his palm, and two pieces of Geng Metal of different sizes instantly suspended in the air.
"Now that the Geng Metal is gathered, just waiting for the Hundred Bamboo Wood to grow sufficiently, I can refine the Sword Array!"
Looking at the two dazzling golden pieces of ore before him, the corners of Xu Ping’s mouth involuntarily lifted.
Once that overwhelmingly powerful Sword Array was successfully crafted, with his current cultivation and Sword Dao realm, its unleashed attack power would definitely reach the Golden Core Level.
After pondering for a moment, Xu Ping carefully put away the two pieces of Geng Metal, then moved towards the spirit field center of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Arriving at the spirit field center, a scene of lush greenery and vibrant life came into view.
The Hundred Bamboo Wood grew wantonly in the spirit field, each leaf exuding abundant vitality.
Gazing at the Hundred Bamboo Wood before him, Xu Ping’s eyes were full of satisfaction, and he nodded gently, murmuring to himself, "The growth is indeed impressive, but I still need to give you a little boost!"
"Tribulation Spirit Skill!"
Xu Ping’s expression remained as calm as water as he rapidly formed a series of complex spells with his hands.
With a gentle point of his finger, a massive, mysterious cyan Longevity Mana burst forth from his fingertip like a torrential flood.
In an instant—
"Boom!"
The cyan Longevity Mana suddenly exploded in the open ground, transforming into countless tiny cyan specks.
These specks fluttered down like a dreamlike green rain, precisely falling upon every Spirit Medicine and Spirit Plant on Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Whoosh!
In a flash!
The originally verdant Spirit Plants and Spirit Medicine on Thousand Leaves Mountain quickly yellowed and withered, turning into heaps of black ash in mere moments, leaving behind countless vibrant green orbs filled with life force.
"Go!"
Xu Ping flicked his fingers, and those green orbs seemed to be guided by a mysterious force, like green meteors trailing brilliant tails through the air, instantly embedding themselves into the Hundred Bamboo Wood.
"Buzz!"
After absorbing these orbs filled with powerful life force, the entire Spirit Wood emitted a concentrated green spiritual light.
This layer of spiritual light, like a mysterious veil, enveloped the Hundred Bamboo Wood, while a very dense aura of life emanated from the wood, spreading outward.
"Crack! Crack!"
The entire Hundred Bamboo Wood began growing at a remarkably visible speed, its branches becoming sturdier and its leaves ever more luxuriant.
In this way, the Hundred Bamboo Wood grew more than two feet before its growth gradually slowed and eventually came to a halt.
"The Tribulation Spirit Skill at the Perfection Level is truly extraordinary!"

chapters.title: Chapter 238 - 179: Designing the Talisman Array; Forging the Breaking Charm
chapters.content:
Chapter 238: Chapter 179: Designing the Talisman Array; Forging the Breaking Charm
"The perfection level of the Tribulation Spirit Skill is indeed extraordinary!" Xu Ping observed the scene, feeling a deep sense of emotion.
With a single gesture, all the spirit medicines and spirit plants on Thousand Leaves Mountain were instantly refined into a vibrant green orb of life.
This level of efficiency was worlds apart from the past.
If this continues, Hundred Bamboo Wood will grow to the level where seventy-two magical swords can be crafted; it seems it won’t take long.
In stark contrast to Xu Ping’s joy, the Water Lake Mouse was secretly lamenting, "Now I’m going to be busy again."
In the blink of an eye, the spirit plants and medicines on Thousand Leaves Mountain vanished entirely, requiring at least a month of hard work to repopulate the mountain with a lush array of spirit plants and medicines.
"Congratulations, Master, on your great achievement!"
Despite feeling troubled inside, the Water Lake Mouse showed no sign of it on its face, instead, it was filled with a flattering smile.
"Hmm." Xu Ping nodded slightly, his thoughts already turning to the matter of crafting magical swords.
Now, the various materials needed to craft the swords were essentially prepared, but two crucial things were still missing.
First, the Quasi-Tier Three artifact refining inheritance.
After pondering this matter, Xu Ping decided to start with the Luoyun Sect.
Just wait for a year or so, then he can trade with Third-Tier talismans again.
Given the Talismaster skills he had demonstrated earlier, producing a few Third-Tier talismans after a year and a half would not be a difficult task.
The second challenge was the Demon Fire.
At this thought, Xu Ping’s gaze involuntarily fell on the Water Lake Mouse.
The flattering smile on the Water Lake Mouse’s face instantly froze. It seemed this was the same look Master had when he talked about stewing it last time!
"I remember saying if you don’t break through to Second-stage Middle Grade within fifteen years, I’d stew you, right?"
Xu Ping squinted slightly, a faint smile appearing on his face, "Hasn’t fifteen years already passed?"
Hearing this, the Water Lake Mouse was so startled its eyes nearly popped out.
It really wanted to grab Xu Ping’s collar and loudly question him about not knowing how to count, as it’s only been a few years.
But how could it dare do such, only pitifully saying, "Master, only three or four years have passed, there’s still plenty of time until fifteen years!"
"Oh, is that so?"
Xu Ping’s tone was indifferent, "I’m unsure if you’re mistaken or if I am. In that case, let’s split the difference and give you five more years."
"If you still can’t break through to Second-stage Middle Grade, then I’ll have no choice but to stew you."
The Water Lake Mouse’s mouth slowly dropped open, staring blankly at Xu Ping, its heart filled with disbelief.
Is it really possible to do this?
Could it really be that preparations to kill the mouse are already underway?
"Speechless, do you think the time is too long? If so..."
"No, no, it’s just right..." Seeing Master about to reduce the time further, the Water Lake Mouse hurriedly responded in panic.
It was truly scared, for fear that if it spoke any later, Master might require it to break through to Second-stage Middle Grade by tomorrow.
"Good, ambitious!"
Xu Ping nodded satisfactorily, "In that case, I’ll prepare a large pot now, otherwise, you won’t fit when the time comes."
’Master, you’re really planning to kill me, aren’t you, using this excuse.’ The Water Lake Mouse felt utterly miserable inside but had nowhere to voice its plight.
"Open your mouth!" Xu Ping then instructed.
The Water Lake Mouse had no choice but to slowly open its mouth.
Xu Ping flicked his finger, and a Demon Core accurately shot into the Water Lake Mouse’s mouth.
"Demon Core?"
After a moment’s realization, the Water Lake Mouse swallowed the demon core with a ’gulp’.
Feeling the demon core being digested in its stomach, releasing threads of power, the Water Lake Mouse once again donned a flattering smile: "Master can rest assured, within five years, I will definitely strive to break through to Second-stage Middle Grade."
’Master indeed, having a demon core to feed me but didn’t mention it earlier, causing me unnecessary fear.’
"Go now, and replant the spirit medicine and spirit plants throughout Thousand Leaves Mountain’s spirit fields." Xu Ping instructed.
From his perspective, although the Demon Core was extremely precious, using it to accelerate the Water Lake Mouse’s growth was indeed worth it.
After all, he wouldn’t truly set an impossible task for the Water Lake Mouse.
"Okay!" The Water Lake Mouse obediently responded, swiftly running to the spirit fields, and began expertly planting spirit medicines and spirit plants.
After casting a brief glance, Xu Ping returned to the cultivation chamber.
Lately, he was preparing to experiment with some small gadgets, which, if successful, might greatly enhance his strength.
...
...
Luoyun Sect!
Under the vast sky, the mountains stretched endlessly, majestic and magnificent.
Clouds lingered and wandered among the mountains, each peak standing like a guardian of the world, mighty and awe-inspiring.
Among them, one peak towered into the clouds, like a giant standing between heaven and earth, proud and unyielding.
At the mountain’s summit.
"Master, my cultivation has now completely stabilized." Jiang Jingxing respectfully saluted Yun Chengzi.
Though he was now a Nascent Soul Cultivator, his respect for his master, who had protected Luoyun Sect for many years, remained undiminished.
"Hmm."
Yun Chengzi nodded slightly. Although he had narrowly survived his battle with Wan Ming, his brow showed slight discoloration, surrounded by an elusive aura of death, clearly nearing his end.
"Master, now that my cultivation is stable, should we eradicate the poisonous Shuize Sect completely?"
Upon mention of the Shuize Sect, Jiang Jingxing’s eyes instantly filled with intense killing intent and hatred.

chapters.title: Chapter 239 - 179: Designing the Talisman Array; Refining Breaking Charm 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 239: Chapter 179: Designing the Talisman Array; Refining Breaking Charm 2
Although Hu Country almost led Luoyun Sect to annihilation, in his heart, traitors like Shuize Sect made him hate them even more.
"Wait a bit longer, and take action only after we’ve prepared the Third-rank Breaking Charms fully!" Yunchengzi said calmly.
"Preparing Third-rank Breaking Charms?"
Upon hearing this, Jiang Jingxing was slightly taken aback, then asked with a face full of confusion, "The array of Shuize Sect is a Fourth-rank large array; preparing Third-rank Breaking Charms might have limited effect, right?"
Yunchengzi didn’t respond immediately but merely waved his sleeve lightly, and a jade slip flew towards Jiang Jingxing like a meteor, landing steadily in his hand.
Jiang Jingxing quickly probed the jade slip with his Divine Sense, and its content instantly appeared in his mind.
"Talisman Array?" Jiang Jingxing frowned slightly and began to concentrate on studying it carefully.
After a while.
He raised his head, looking at his mentor with a rather complex expression.
The Talisman Array of his mentor was indeed exquisitely wonderful.
If it were composed of twelve Third-rank Lower Grade Breaking Charms, four Third-rank Middle Grade Breaking Charms, and one Third-rank Upper Grade Breaking Charm, its power might reach a quasi-fourth rank, perhaps even touching the fourth rank level.
However, this Talisman Array requires a Nascent Soul Cultivator to drive and assist with their own Primordial Qi.
With such array power, combined with other auxiliary methods, it might be able to break the Fourth-rank large array of Shuize Sect, but the Nascent Soul Cultivator driving the array would inevitably suffer great damage to their Primordial Qi.
Naturally, Jiang Jingxing guessed that his mentor intended to make one last move for Luoyun Sect.
After all, given his mentor’s current condition, whether Shuize Sect’s Mountain Protection Array is broken or not, his mentor certainly won’t survive.
Jiang Jingxing’s lips moved slightly, wanting to voluntarily take this difficult task upon himself, but he swallowed his words.
He was not afraid of serious Primordial Qi damage, only worried that if his Primordial Qi was harmed, the entire plan to annihilate Shuize Sect would be affected.
"Using the Talisman Array to break the Fourth-rank large array is a method I’ve pondered for a long time; the success rate should be fairly high. But earlier, with the danger from Hu Country, I dared not attempt it."
"Now that Hu Country is gone, there are no more concerns, but I fear I don’t have much time left. Instruct them to gather the Third-rank Breaking Charms quickly," Yunchengzi ordered with a calm face.
At this moment, he was almost on the brink of passing any day, and even with heavenly treasures sustaining his life, they probably wouldn’t last much longer.
"Yes!" Jiang Jingxing replied in a low voice, then respectfully withdrew.
Currently, there was no Talisman Master within the sect able to draw Third-rank Breaking Charms; they could only think of alternatives elsewhere.
...
...
A month and a half passed in an instant.
Training room.
Xu Ping had a grim expression, his hands swiftly forming spells, as he gave a low shout: "Manifest!"
In an instant, three First Rank Upper Grade talismans materialized out of thin air, floating leisurely in mid-air.
"Go!"
Xu Ping continuously gathered spiritual power from within his body onto the talismans floating in the void, causing the three talismans to shine intensely, their light dazzling.
They moved swiftly through the void, quickly surrounding a Second-stage Lower Grade puppet.
"Explode!"
Xu Ping slightly parted his lips and uttered a word.
"Boom—"
Following a loud bang, the connections between the talismans formed a linked mechanism, and thundering sounds rumbled, with fierce lightning fire rushing towards the puppet like a roaring beast, instantly engulfing it.
As the lightning fire gradually dissipated, Xu Ping gazed intently to see that the Second-stage Lower Grade puppet only had its exterior slightly damaged.
He furrowed his brows tightly, muttering to himself: "No, the power of this Three Talents Talisman Array didn’t manifest at all!!"
This Three Talents Talisman Array, was created by Xu Ping based on the most basic and simple array, the Three Talents Array.
Xu Ping had long been aware of the powerful capabilities of talisman arrays, always eager to try them.
However, his proficiency as a Talisman Master hadn’t reached the corresponding level, compounded by the difficulty of finding talisman array inheritance, which had sidelined the matter.
Now, Xu Ping’s array proficiency had reached the quasi-Tier Three realm, with his talisman mastery even climbing to Third-rank Middle Grade.
Thus, he resolved to attempt creating the simplest talisman array.
His goal wasn’t high; he didn’t expect to multiply the power of various talismans by several times, even a few percent increase would be ideal.
After all, if constructing the array with Third-rank talismans, even just a few percent increase would be devastatingly powerful.
"The connections between the talisman energies are always not smooth enough, too obscure!" Xu Ping contemplated the reason for this failure, filled with frustration.
According to his initial concept, after activating the Three Talents Talisman Array, the powers of the three First Rank Upper Grade talismans should mutually enhance, increasing power by at least several percent rather than counteracting each other’s forces like this.
Although he understood the failure’s cause, Xu Ping couldn’t come up with improvement methods immediately, leaving him feeling overwhelmed.
"Is there some key element within the talisman array that I haven’t discovered?" Xu Ping pondered deeply.
Given his current proficiency in talisman and array mastery, along with the aid of the mysterious panel, there was no reason he couldn’t create even the simplest Three Talents Talisman Array!
"Try again, this time use First Rank Middle Grade talismans."
"The talismans’ power is slightly smaller, perhaps it will be easier to control and observe the problems within." Xu Ping made up his mind.
Just as he prepared to try again, the voice of Waterlake Mouse came from outside the training room: "Master, Yang Hong from Luoyun Sect has come to see you!"
"Yang Hong?"

chapters.title: Chapter 240 - 179: Designing the Talisman Array; Forging the Breaking Charm 3
chapters.content:
Chapter 240: Chapter 179: Designing the Talisman Array; Forging the Breaking Charm 3
Xu Ping’s hand suddenly paused, and after a brief thought, he immediately instructed, "Invite the guest to the pavilion."
"Understood!" replied the water lake rat.
...
...
In the pavilion, a delicate fragrance of tea wafted through the air.
Xu Ping, with a smile on his face, poured a cup of Spirit Tea for Yang Hong and warmly said, "Elder Yang, this is Spirit Tea newly harvested from Thousand Leaves Mountain. Please have a taste."
"Thank you very much."
Yang Hong smiled slightly and politely said, "Coming to trouble you once again, I hope Fellow Daoist Xu won’t hold it against me!"
"Elder Yang, what are you saying? It’s a great honor for a junior to be able to converse with a senior like you!" Xu Ping replied with a smile.
After the two exchanged a few casual remarks, Yang Hong’s expression turned serious as he spoke of the matter at hand for his visit.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, this time I have come with an urgent request!" Yang Hong said, cupping his hands in a respectful gesture, his expression very sincere.
"Elder Yang, please speak freely. As long as it is something within my capabilities, I will not refuse!" Xu Ping responded earnestly.
"To be honest, I would like to ask for your help in crafting some Third-rank Breaking Charms," Yang Hong stated bluntly.
"Third-rank Lower Grade Breaking Charms?"
Upon hearing this request, Xu Ping’s brows furrowed tightly, and he slowly replied,
"Elder Yang, although these are just Lower Grade Third-rank talismans, the crafting difficulty is extremely high. Even for most Third-rank Lower Grade Talisman Masters, it’s a challenging task to succeed in drawing them!"
"I’m well aware of this.
That’s precisely why I’ve come to seek your help, Fellow Daoist Xu. With your outstanding expertise as a Talisman Master, I’m sure you can handle the task with ease!" Yang Hong said with a smile.
"Elder Yang, you truly overestimate me."
Xu Ping shook his head with a wry smile, "To be honest, I’ve never crafted a Third-rank Lower Grade Breaking Charm before, and I’m not at all confident of succeeding!"
"There’s no need for concern, Fellow Daoist Xu, just go ahead and give it a try.
If there are failures along the way, they will all be at my expense. If you succeed, any requests you have will be granted without hesitation!" Yang Hong offered sincerely, with genuine intent.
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping’s heart was stirred.
He currently had several requirements to ask from the Luoyun Sect.
Moreover, although Yang Hong had come under his own name to request talismans, it was most likely authorized by the Luoyun Sect, making it hard for Xu Ping to refuse.
Otherwise, did he truly believe that the Luoyun Sect would let things go so easily?
"Since Elder Yang trusts me so, I will attempt my best. How many talismans does Elder require me to craft?" Xu Ping asked with a slightly bitter smile.
"The more, the better, but time is pressing. Within a year, as many as you can craft, that’s how many we’ll count!"
Yang Hong, seeing that Xu Ping had agreed, was overjoyed and quickly stated his requirements.
"Within a year?"
Raising his eyelids slightly, Xu Ping immediately deduced the probable reasons the Luoyun Sect wanted him to create Third-rank Lower Grade Breaking Charms.
"I will do my utmost!" Xu Ping cupped his hands earnestly.
"Then I’ll leave it in your capable hands, Fellow Daoist Xu. Here are the Third-rank premium talisman papers and Spirit Ink needed for crafting the Breaking Charms."
After expressing his thanks, Yang Hong retrieved from his Storage Ring a stack of talisman papers emitting a faint purple glow, a bottle of jade-green Spirit Ink, and a jade slip recording the Third-rank Lower Grade Breaking Charm, offering them to Xu Ping.
Xu Ping accepted the talisman papers, and upon scanning them with his Divine Sense, he realized the quantity.
There were as many as a hundred sheets!
Privately astonished, Xu Ping couldn’t help but marvel at the grand gesture of the Luoyun Sect.
"Now that you’ve agreed to craft the Breaking Charms, Fellow Daoist Xu, do let me know your needs."
Elated by the concluded arrangement, Yang Hong, after savoring a sip of Spirit Tea, said leisurely.
After a brief contemplation, Xu Ping slowly spoke, "I indeed have a few items I wish for. I wonder, Elder Yang, do you have any Quasi-Tier Three or higher Transmission of Artifact Refining Technique and Talisman Array?"
"Quasi-Tier Three or higher Transmission of Artifact Refining Technique and Talisman Array?"
Yang Hong, upon hearing this request, furrowed his brows slightly, pondered for a moment, and then responded, "I do have both of these transmissions."
"However, the current Talisman Array transmission is only Second-stage Middle Grade, is that acceptable for you, Fellow Daoist Xu?"
"Second-stage Middle Grade?"
Contemplating for a moment, Xu Ping nodded and said, "It will do."
Even a Second-stage Middle Grade Talisman Array transmission would suffice for his research.
"Just, Fellow Daoist Xu, do you intend to obtain both transmissions, or choose just one?" Yang Hong asked with a smile.
"Naturally, both," Xu Ping responded without hesitation.
"If you take both together, just a few Third-rank Lower Grade Breaking Charms might not suffice as compensation," Yang Hong remarked with a half-smile.
Hearing this, a sense of resignation surfaced on Xu Ping’s face as he chuckled wryly, "Such high value for these two items indeed? It seems I have overestimated myself a bit."
"Fellow Daoist Xu, don’t belittle yourself. I have complete faith in you. I believe that within a year, you can at least draw four Third-rank Lower Grade Breaking Charms." Yang Hong expressed with utmost sincerity.
"Elder Yang, you overestimate me,"
Xu Ping quickly waved his hand, "I can only say that I will do my best, and strive my hardest."
...
...
After exchanging some final pleasantries and agreeing on the specifics of the transaction timing, Yang Hong rose to take his leave.
"Take care, Elder Yang." Xu Ping, being very courteous, personally saw Yang Hong to the outside of the cave abode.
"No need to see me off, Fellow Daoist Xu," Yang Hong replied with a smile, then summoned a leaf-shaped Spiritual Boat.
Standing on it, with the operation of his Spiritual Power, the boat transformed into a streak of light, speeding towards the horizon and disappearing in the blink of an eye.
Gazing into the wide, clear sky, Xu Ping found himself lost in contemplation.
"Should I aim to acquire both items at once, or just one?" This question circled persistently in his mind.
If opting for just one, although the approach is more stable and the risk is lower,
obtaining the other item might take quite some time and the need to find an opportune moment.
Furthermore, the future holds many uncertainties, and there’s no guarantee of success when the time comes.
Yet, striving for both items at once could satisfy his requirements in one go.
However, this move would undoubtedly expose his talisman skills further in front of the Luoyun Sect.
Considering that drawing four Third-rank Lower Grade Breaking Charms within a year would reveal a Talisman Master at least at the Third-rank Middle Grade level.

chapters.title: Chapter 241 - 180: Turmoil at the Island Ruins; Three Talismans Array Formed
chapters.content:
Chapter 241: Chapter 180: Turmoil at the Island Ruins; Three Talismans Array Formed
Xu Ping pondered for a moment and ultimately decided to act prudently.
Choosing just one was enough.
At present, he displayed a cultivation level of only Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment. If he were to reveal his Talisman Master skills had already reached Third-rank Middle Grade, it would indeed be too startling.
No one could guarantee that the Luoyun Sect wouldn’t covet him because of it.
For some external items, there was truly no need to take such a risk.
After all, he had a long life ahead and plenty of time to wait.
As for what exactly to choose, Xu Ping already had an idea in mind.
Currently, the Water Lake Rat had yet to break through to Second-stage Middle Grade, and the Hundred Bamboo Wood hadn’t grown enough to refine seventy-two flying swords. Hence, Quasi-Tier Three Artifact Refining could only be put aside for now.
It’s more urgent to get hold of the Talisman Array inheritance.
If this Talisman Array inheritance could play a critical role in constructing the Tri-talismans, then it would be quite rewarding.
With a plan in mind, Xu Ping turned towards the cultivation chamber.
Though his Talisman Master skills were now at Third-rank Middle Grade, crafting a Third-rank Lower Grade Breaking Charm was quite challenging, especially since he hadn’t tried it before, so it was best to familiarize himself as early as possible.
...
...
Time slowly passed.
Time gently flowed.
Just as Xu Ping was peacefully crafting talismans at Thousand Leaves Mountain, a piece of explosive news suddenly spread.
The relic that appeared in the Wanzhe Waters was actually the cultivation site of the Nine Nether Elder from several thousand years ago.
More shockingly, the Luoyun Sect Leader Jiang Tian successfully formed a Nascent Soul thanks to the Infant Devouring Pill acquired from the relic.
This news was like a heavy bomb, causing a furore in a short time within Yue Country, and then swiftly spreading to the neighboring Hu Country and Feng Country.
The cultivation realm where Yue Country was situated known as "Nanchuan," spanned vast and boundless lands, covering hundreds of countries.
And Yue, Hu, and Feng countries were located at the northern edge of the Nanchuan cultivation realm.
Although there were several smaller countries still lingering in the north, their highest combat prowess only consisted of Golden Core stage cultivators and were truly not worth mentioning.
Moreover, at the intersection of Yue, Hu, and Feng countries, stood an imposing and massive mountain range, stretching in a "Y" shape, separating the three countries.
This was the ’Yellow Dragon Mountain Range.’
Several thousand years ago, the Nine Nether Elder was without doubt the top cultivator, even faintly carrying the stature of the top cultivator among Yue, Hu, and Feng countries.
Thus, when news of the Nine Nether Elder’s relic and the Infant Devouring Pill came out, Yue Country instantly became feverish, and even the cultivators of Hu and Feng countries went mad over it.
The renown of the Nine Nether Elder, coupled with the allure of the Infant Devouring Pill, the influence of these two combined is self-evident.
Even those deeply rooted Nascent Soul sects would likely fight to the death for such a chance.
Moreover, as revealed by those who participated in exploring the relic and were lucky enough to survive, many areas of the Ruins Deserted Island had yet to be explored.
The Luoyun Sect merely succeeded in breaking one of the internal restrictions and obtained the Infant Devouring Pill.
This news, without a doubt, was like pouring oil on a dry wood, making the cultivators of the three countries even more frenzied.
To acquire the Infant Devouring Pill merely by breaking an internal restriction, it’s truly unimaginable how many rare treasures lie hidden within the relic!
...
Thousand Leaves Mountain!
In the pavilion.
"Is this true?"
When Xu Ping heard this news from Duan Shuang and Gong Yang, his face couldn’t help but turn serious.
Previously, the Ruins Deserted Island was almost forgotten in obscurity due to the outbreak of sinister calamities compounded by Hu Country’s brazen invasion.
Now this news suddenly arriving, without a doubt, brought the Ruins Deserted Island back into the spotlight of everyone’s focus, once again becoming the storm center of various factions’ attention.
If the news is true.
Then compared to the dreadful sinister forces on the island, they would seem insignificant.
"It should be true, Shuize Sect has presented plenty of evidence proving this deserted island relic is indeed the cultivation site of the Nine Nether Elder," Gong Yang said with a bitter smile.
"Shuize Sect?"
Upon hearing this name, Xu Ping’s brows furrowed, "How is Shuize Sect involved in this? Could it be that they deliberately leaked the news?"
"Most likely!"
"Most likely it is so!"
Duan Shuang nodded lightly, "Shuize Sect and Luoyun Sect have long become sworn enemies, completely broken apart. After the retreat of Hu Country’s cultivators, Shuize Sect can’t possibly stand up to Luoyun Sect on their own."
"Even with Shuize Sect’s Array protection, their downfall is just a matter of time."
"Having been besieged and immobilized by sinister forces, releasing this news must be an effort to disrupt the entire Yue Country’s situation, preventing Luoyun Sect from dealing with them calmly."
Xu Ping naturally understood Duan Shuang’s analysis.
However, he secretly speculated that even Shuize Sect and Hu Country’s leadership might have known this secret all along.
This would explain why Hu Country dared to brazenly launch an invasion back when Luoyun Sect’s ancestor Yun Chengzi hadn’t yet passed away.
"Ah, Yue Country barely calmed down for less than two years, and now it might fall into turmoil again," Xu Ping couldn’t help but sigh softly.
Yet compared to Hu Country’s invasion, this incident was somewhat better.
As long as he stays peacefully at Thousand Leaves Mountain and doesn’t easily meddle in the Ruins Deserted Island’s muddy waters, with his current strength, the risk factor should not be too high.
"Whoever said otherwise, this time perhaps the cultivators from Hu and Feng countries will swarm like bees, and it’s not unimaginable for Nascent Soul stage cultivators to fight openly,"

chapters.title: Chapter 242 - 180: Turmoil at the Island Ruins; Three Talismans Array Formed
chapters.content:
Chapter 242: Chapter 180: Turmoil at the Island Ruins; Three Talismans Array Formed
Gong Yang also sighed helplessly.
At this moment, all three of them involuntarily fell into silence.
Finally, it was Duan Shuang who broke the silence first: "Actually, this matter may not be entirely bad for us."
"If we try our best, perhaps the opportunity for Core Formation might just appear." A resolute glimmer flashed in Duan Shuang’s eyes.
"Core Formation opportunity?"
Upon hearing these words, Gong Yang’s heart was immediately stirred.
However, when he thought about this trip to the Ruins Deserted Island being potentially several times more dangerous than before, hesitation arose in his heart again.
The last time they explored the Ruins Deserted Island, all the forces of Yue Country had come out in full force.
But with the help of the talismans provided by Xu Ping, he and Duan Shuang could barely rank in the upper-middle tier on the island.
This time, however, it was different. With cultivators from three countries gathering, the two of them might only be at the very bottom.
’Is it really worth risking it all for a vague chance at Core Formation?’ Gong Yang deeply pondered.
"Fellow Daoists, discussing this now might be premature. The entire Wanzhe Waters is currently rife with evil entities, and the Ruins Deserted Island is a hotspot for them."
"Even if all the cultivators from the three countries come here, it would still take quite some effort to clear the evil entities from the island." Xu Ping slowly said.
"Indeed!"
Upon hearing this, both Duan Shuang and Gong Yang nodded in agreement.
The Wanzhe Waters has always been overrun by evil entities, and the Ruins Deserted Island is the source of the outbreak. Even if all the cultivators gathered here, just discussing how to clear the evil would lead to endless debates.
After all, no one wants to be at a disadvantage!
"Master, Yang Hong from the Luoyun Sect has come to seek an audience!"
While the three were discussing, the voice transmission from the Water Rat Divine Sense came.
"Yang Hong?"
Xu Ping was slightly startled. It was still early from the agreed time, why did he come earlier?
Could it be that...
"Fellow Daoist Xu, what happened?" Gong Yang inquired.
"Elder Yang from the Luoyun Sect is here. He must have an important matter to discuss with me," Xu Ping replied.
"Elder Yang from the Luoyun Sect?"
Both Duan Shuang and Gong Yang were slightly taken aback, then sensibly said, "In that case, it is inappropriate for us to disturb Fellow Daoist Xu and Elder Yang’s conversation."
After all, Yang Hong, an elder with a Fake Pill from the Luoyun Sect, specifically came to visit Xu Ping, a Third-rank Talisman Master. Clearly, they were not qualified to be present and listen.
....
After Duan Shuang and Gong Yang left, Xu Ping invited Yang Hong to the pavilion.
Just as they settled down, Yang Hong hurriedly said, "Fellow Daoist Xu, how many Breaking Charms of the Third-rank Lower Grade have you drawn? Our transaction might need to be advanced."
’As expected.’
Xu Ping had already guessed this much, but still maintained a hint of surprised expression and asked in confusion:
"It’s only been about half a year since our agreed time. Why has the transaction time been moved up so much?"
"Ah, there’s no choice." Yang Hong shook his head regretfully, showing a troubled expression, but did not explain the reason in detail.
And Xu Ping sensibly did not inquire further, instead, he sighed helplessly and said, "Over the past six months, I have been tirelessly researching and drawing day and night, and have only succeeded in making one piece."
Saying that, he flipped his palm, and a purple talisman imbued with powerful breaking energy appeared in his hand.
With Xu Ping’s current Talisman Master skill, along with panel assistance, it was naturally impossible to only refine one Breaking Charm.
In reality, he had successfully refined three Breaking Charms in just three months.
After that, he stopped his production.
After all, he originally planned to offer two pieces for the transaction, and leave the remaining one for unexpected situations, to prepare for any unforeseen emergencies.
"Just one?"
Yang Hong’s gaze fell on the talisman in Xu Ping’s hand, with a trace of disappointment involuntarily flashing in his eyes.
However, the current situation was urgent, leaving him with no room for too much pickiness or choice. Having one was better than none, after all.
"One will barely do. But a single Third-rank Lower Grade Breaking Charm can only be exchanged for one item. What would Fellow Daoist Xu like to exchange it for?" Yang Hong asked, looking at Xu Ping.
Originally, it required at least two Third-rank Lower Grade Breaking Charms for the exchange, but since he was the one who brought the transaction forward, he had to take some loss.
After pondering for a moment, Xu Ping slowly said, "I’ll take the Second-stage Talisman Array Inheritance!"
After all, it was something he had decided long ago, so there was no need to overthink it.
"Alright!"
Yang Hong nodded slightly to indicate his agreement, then swiftly flipped his palm to produce a smooth jade slip in his hand.
He used his mana to gently support the jade slip and moved it in front of Xu Ping, saying, "This jade slip contains detailed records of the Second-stage Talisman Array Inheritance. You might want to check it first, Fellow Daoist."
Xu Ping reached out and took the jade slip, then carefully sent his Divine Sense into it.
In an instant, the contents of the jade slip clearly appeared in his mind.
A moment later, Xu Ping nodded with satisfaction: "It is indeed the Second-stage Talisman Array Inheritance, without a doubt. This cooperation has been very pleasant!"
"Pleasant cooperation!" Yang Hong responded.
After successfully completing the transaction, Yang Hong promptly stood up and bid farewell. From his urgent demeanor and actions, it was clear that he was pressed for time and busy with affairs.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, I still have many pressing matters to attend to, so I won’t linger here for long," Yang Hong said as he cupped his hands in salute.
"Take care, Elder Yang." Xu Ping also politely responded without any pretense of insisting him to stay.

chapters.title: Chapter 243 - 180: Changes at the Desolate Island Ruins; Three Talent Talisman Array Complete
chapters.content:
Chapter 243: Chapter 180: Changes at the Desolate Island Ruins; Three Talent Talisman Array Complete
Yang Hong stepped onto the Spiritual Boat, but at this moment, he suddenly turned his head, his gaze deep and meaningful, and said to Xu Ping:
"Nowadays, the situation in Yue Country is turbulent and unstable. Fellow Daoist Xu, it’s best for you to stay safely on Thousand Leaves Mountain for the time being!"
’I actually haven’t had any plans to go out recently.’
Hearing Yang Hong’s reminder, Xu Ping secretly grumbled in his heart, but his face showed a grateful expression: "Thank you, Elder Yang, for the reminder."
A faint smile appeared on Yang Hong’s face: "No need for you to see me off, Fellow Daoist Xu."
With that said, he skillfully maneuvered the Spiritual Boat, speeding towards Luoyun Sect.
...
Watching Yang Hong gradually disappear until he became a tiny black dot on the horizon, Xu Ping fell into deep thought and quietly pondered in his heart:
’It seems the sudden revelation of the ruins’ news caught Luoyun Sect off guard as well, prompting them to move forward their plans by half a year. They must be preparing to cut the Gordian knot.’
’But it doesn’t concern me. It would be best if Luoyun Sect destroys Shuize Sect. If not, I can personally seek revenge after forming a Golden Core or even a Nascent Soul.’
Xu Ping quickly became indifferent.
Compared to his safety, revenge seemed trivial.
Once Yang Hong’s figure completely vanished, Xu Ping turned back to the training room, eagerly taking out the jade slip recording the Second-stage Talisman Array inheritance, ready to delve deeper into research.
Earlier, he only used his Divine Sense to briefly verify the authenticity of the jade slip’s content, without conducting detailed research.
Xu Ping took out the jade slip, gently placed it before him, then calmed his mind and slowly immersed his Divine Sense into it, dedicating himself to a thorough study.
Half an hour later.
"So that’s it!" Xu Ping’s eyes suddenly flashed with a light of sudden realization.
Through this Second-stage Talisman Array inheritance, he finally discovered why the energy between the talismans he constructed was always not smooth and was obscure.
It turns out it was due to the lack of a Secret Technique named ’Spirit Silk Skill’ for controlling the Talisman Array.
If he could master ’Spirit Silk Skill’, he could use Spiritual Power to transform into spirit threads to precisely control the Talisman Array, perfectly solving the issue of unsmooth energy flow among talismans.
"No wonder I couldn’t construct an ideal Talisman Array before; it was missing this critical link."
Xu Ping immediately became enthusiastic, throwing himself wholeheartedly into the study of ’Spirit Silk Skill’.
...
...
Two months later.
Training Room.
Three First Rank Upper Grade talismans, glowing with spiritual radiance, quietly floated in mid-air.
"Control!"
Xu Ping’s face was solemn, his expression focused, as his hands quickly and precisely formed the Spell, the Mana in his body circulating rapidly along a special meridian path, he let out a low shout.
In an instant, three nearly imperceptible mana threads, like nimble drifting threads, gently fell onto the three talismans.
"Coalesce!"
As the mana threads touched the talismans, Xu Ping with his keen senses could already fully control any minute movement of the talismans.
Systematically, he continuously transmitted abundant mana from his body along the mana threads onto the talismans in the void.
At this moment, the three talismans seemed injected with mighty energy, instantly blossoming with dazzling, striking radiance, illuminating the entire training room.
"Trap!"
Under Xu Ping’s precise control, the three talismans flexibly weaved and shuttled among each other in the void, without interference, and swiftly surrounded a Second-stage Lower Grade Puppet tightly.
"Great!"
"Under the exquisite control of ’Spirit Silk Skill’, the energy flow between the talismans is extremely smooth, without the previous sense of awkwardness or blockage."
Xu Ping’s eyes glowed with excitement and anticipation, and an intense premonition involuntarily surged in his heart: this time, success is certain!
"Explode!"
Without any hesitation, Xu Ping swiftly manipulated the Talisman Array to explode with a thought.
"Boom——"
With a deafening roar, three mighty powers abruptly burst from the three First Rank Upper Grade talismans.
Due to the tightly connected energy flow between the talismans, for a time, the thunderous rumble was unceasing in the ears.
The surging thunderfire, like a roaring dragon, aggressively swept towards the puppet, instantly engulfing it completely.
Once the torrential thunderfire gradually dissipated, Xu Ping fixedly observed it meticulously.
The Second-stage Lower Grade puppet was densely covered in holes, and the severely damaged areas even clearly exposed the internal structural framework.
"Indeed... it succeeded!"
Seeing this scene, Xu Ping’s heart was overwhelmed with a strong sense of joy.
Upon testing, he found that the power exerted by this Talisman Array was increased by as much as 50% compared to using three First Rank Upper Grade talismans individually.
Although even with a 50% increase, the power of First Rank Upper Grade talismans alone didn’t seem especially remarkable at first glance.
Yet Xu Ping knew well that if the First Rank Upper Grade talismans were replaced with Third-rank Lower Grade talismans, or even more powerful Third-rank Middle Grade talismans.
The power that could be exerted would be entirely different, incomparable.
By then, forming a Three-talented Array with three Third-rank Lower Grade Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans, with its terrifying power, it might not be impossible to annihilate an Early Stage Golden Core cultivator.
Also, even if accidentally exposed in front of others, it wouldn’t necessarily provoke intense wariness from Luoyun Sect or other Nascent Soul Level forces.
After all, in the history of cultivation in Yue Country, it wasn’t unprecedented for Foundation Establishment Cultivators to ingeniously use Talisman Arrays to slay Golden Core Cultivators beyond their level.
"However... with my current proficiency in ’Spirit Silk Skill’, attempting to control a Three-talented Array composed of Third-rank talismans is likely a bit challenging and slightly strenuous."
Xu Ping slightly furrowed his brows, pondering, then quickly opened the proficiency panel, his gaze immediately falling on the progress bar of ’Spirit Silk Skill’.
[Spirit Silk Skill Entry Level: 32/100]
"To completely and smoothly control a Talisman Array formed by Third-rank talismans, ’Spirit Silk Skill’ must, at the very least, reach a level of expertise or even Minor Achievement stage."
Xu Ping mentally calculated, "Judging by my current cultivation progress, breaking through to the Minor Achievement stage... will take about two years."
"Two years, huh!" Xu Ping murmured softly to himself.
Since he has already made up his mind, he will stay safely on Thousand Leaves Mountain, focusing diligently on cultivation without going anywhere.
This way, even an ancient ruin on a deserted island will pose no threat to him with ease.

chapters.title: Chapter 244 - 181: The Onslaught of Evil Spirits
chapters.content:
Chapter 244: Chapter 181: The Onslaught of Evil Spirits
Time flies like a white horse passing through a gap, vanishing in a flash.
A month later.
The Shuize Sect, once a dominant cultivation sect across the entire Wanzhe Waters, was now shrouded in a sinister and terrifying atmosphere.
The yin energy churned as if tangible, and the sky full of black clouds covered the entire Shuize Sect like a massive curtain, airtight.
Roar, roar, roar...
Low, horrifying roars echoed continuously.
Numerous low-level evil spirits with various forms, emanating a cold aura, were driven by several Golden Core Perfection level evil spirits.
Like a group of crazed beasts, they relentlessly slammed into the faintly glowing Sect Protection Array of the Shuize Sect.
Boom, boom, boom...
The sounds of crashing and attacks were continuous, echoing to the sky, as if they were about to shatter the heavens and the earth.
Each impact stirred a ripple of energy, causing the spiritual light of the Sect Protection Array to flicker slightly.
However, no matter how frantically this group of evil spirits attacked, the array’s spiritual light enveloping the Shuize Sect remained rock steady, unwavering and as solid as a boulder.
"Ah, I don’t know when this situation will end!"
Under the protection of the array’s spiritual light, a slightly plump patrolling disciple stopped, looking up at the ink-like black clouds, sighing helplessly.
Unknowingly, the evil spirits had besieged the Shuize Sect for nearly three years.
Though relying on this powerful Sect Protection Array the evil spirits could not breach inside, they were trapped within this world, unable to venture out.
It was like being imprisoned, with days dragging on like years.
"Stop complaining; if an overseer hears you, you’ll surely be punished."
The other patrolling disciple beside him, with a sallow complexion and slightly tired expression, gently reminded.
"Can’t go out, can’t even complain?"
Although the slightly plump patrolling disciple was still muttering, he unconsciously lowered his voice.
While saying this, he cautiously looked around, his eyes revealing a trace of tension, afraid an overseer would suddenly appear nearby.
"You, sooner or later, will get into big trouble because of that mouth." The sallow-faced disciple shook his head helplessly.
"I haven’t even..." The slightly plump disciple was still dissatisfied, about to say more.
"Boom!"
A deafening explosion came from outside the array, the enormous sound reverberating even to those inside, shaking the very ground beneath them.
"What’s happening?"
Their faces showed instant shock as they hurriedly looked outside the array.
They saw several dazzling rays of light shooting toward the frenzied evil spirits like sharp swords.
The next moment!
Boom, boom, boom.....
A series of explosions erupted, those rays of light instantly shattered, scattering crimson powder like fine spring rain over the evil spirits.
Roar, roar, roar...
The evil spirits had been ceaselessly attacking the array’s spiritual light, but they paused in unison as if under an Immovable Spell.
Immediately, their initially fierce scarlet eyes turned a deeper blood red, as if dripping blood.
They let out an angry roar towards a faint shadow in the distance, then rushed at it frantically.
In just a few breaths, the evil spirits that had tightly surrounded the Shuize Sect receded like a tide, vanishing without a trace.
Even those powerful Golden Core Perfection level evil spirits disappeared.
"They’re... gone?"
The two patrolling disciples stared blankly at the scene before them, their minds blank, unable to react.
After a while, they finally came to their senses, their hearts overflowing with excitement and joy like a tidal wave.
The evil spirits actually left!!!
However, just as they were reveling in this sudden joy, an unexpected change occurred outside the array.
Zoom, zoom...
Countless streaks of light flashed across the sky like lightning, surrounding the Shuize Sect in the blink of an eye, leaving no corner untouched.
Each streak of light carried strong spiritual power fluctuations, bringing an invisible pressure.
Thud, thud!
Amidst the passionate drumbeats, various majestic flying boats appeared out of thin air.
The flying boats carried solemn cultivators, exuding sharp auras, as they passed, commanding profound authority.
"Master, what method did you use?" Jiang Jingxing asked in amazement.
This numerous evil spirits, including several powerful Golden Core Perfection level entities.
Even their well-established Luoyun Sect would expend considerable effort and pay a hefty price to eliminate them.
Yet his master diverted them so easily?
"Just some minor methods against evil spirits, all recorded in the jade scroll I left you, be sure to study it carefully for your future cultivation journey!"
Yun Chengzi, radiating a thick sense of death, spoke in a calm yet icy tone.
"Disciple understands!"
Jiang Jingxing gently touched his Storage Ring, nodding solemnly.
"Strike swiftly to avoid prolonged dreams!"

chapters.title: Chapter 245 - 181: The Onslaught of Evil Spirits (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 245: Chapter 181: The Onslaught of Evil Spirits (2)
Yun Chengzi’s gaze was cold as he stared ahead at the Shuize Sect, decisively giving his orders.
"Yes!"
Jiang Jingxing responded without hesitation, then immediately issued a loud command to all the disciples of Luoyun Sect: "Attack!"
"The disciples obey!"
The disciples of Luoyun Sect shouted in unison, their voices echoing through the skies.
At this moment, with two Nascent Soul ancestors stationed at the rear, their morale was high, bravely taking the lead. Without hesitation, they unleashed their signature magic towards the perimeter of Shuize Sect’s Defense Array.
...
...
Meanwhile, a sinister atmosphere spread across the Wanzhe Waters.
"Roar!"
Numerous low-level supernatural creatures of varying forms, exuding a strange aura, led by several powerful creatures at the Golden Core Perfection realm, let out deafening roars in unison.
The roar seemed to come from the Nine Nether hell, carrying endless greed and ferocity, as they frantically chased towards that distant mysterious shadow.
Where the creatures passed, it was as if a terrifying disaster had descended.
Whether weak ordinary beings or Foundation Establishment cultivators, none could escape, all becoming targets of their devouring.
"Help... Help, ah!"
A Foundation Establishment cultivator, face full of terror, pale as paper, fled desperately.
However, within moments, the creatures caught up to him, only allowing him to let out a scream before he was completely devoured.
A little half hour passed.
At this moment, the speed of the shadow suddenly began to slow down.
The distance between the shadow and the creatures was slowly closing, nearly falling into the creatures’ encirclement.
Roar!
A tall, humanoid creature with three eyes at the Golden Core Perfection level suddenly let out an earth-shattering roar.
Before the roar faded, its form instantly vanished from its place, as if merging into the void.
In the blink of an eye, it already appeared above the shadow, overlooking the target from above.
Seeing the third eye on its forehead suddenly glow with a strange light, followed by a thick black beam shooting out like lightning, carrying world-destroying power, directly striking at the shadow below.
Boom!
The shadow was instantly hit by the black beam, and its chest was forcibly blasted out with a huge hole.
Amazingly, in this hole with front and back penetrating, there was no blood or internal organs flowing out; instead, cold metal structures were in sight.
This mysterious shadow was actually a puppet!
The puppet, struck so hard, began to emit a strange light throughout its body.
Next moment!
Boom!
Another loud explosion resonated, and the entire puppet unexpectedly exploded.
Instantly, reddish powder like torrential rain scattered everywhere, covering numerous supernatural creatures’ bodies.
At this moment, all supernatural creatures couldn’t help but show a hint of satisfaction on their faces.
However, when the red powder completely fell onto them, their expressions turned twisted and irritable in an instant.
They twisted their bodies frantically in place, emitting eerie and chilling screams as if suffering great pain.
Roar!
Several Golden Core level creatures, rushed with dark energy, transformed into a black light flying in all directions of Wanzhe Waters.
And all the other creatures also scattered completely, spreading to various places in Wanzhe Waters.
Originally, all the families and forces that struggled to survive in this chaos now faced utter catastrophe.
Countless cultivators were powerless in the face of this sudden disaster, falling one after another into the bloodthirsty mouths of the creatures in an instant.
Yun Chengzi, who caused all this, surely knew, but in his mind, even if all the cultivators of Wanzhe Waters died, as long as he could destroy Shuize Sect, it would be well worth it.
...
...
Half a month passed in the blink of an eye.
Thousand Leaves Mountain, cultivation chamber.
Xu Ping sat cross-legged on the mat, as the ’Longevity Skill’ at Perfection Level cycled, the surrounding Spiritual Qi felt like men who had been single for years, seeing a seductive beauty lying on their bed, eagerly entered Xu Ping’s body.
Time continued to pass.
It wasn’t until the pressure inside Xu Ping’s Dantian surged that he stopped operating the ’Longevity Skill’.
"Phew!"
Xu Ping slowly opened his eyes, a gleam of light flickering in them, followed by a gentle exhalation of turbid air.
"Two hundred and sixty-five drops of liquid mana!"
Xu Ping carefully sensed the abundant mana within his Dantian, and the corners of his mouth involuntarily curved upwards, revealing a satisfied smile.
He had broken through to the late-stage Foundation Establishment three years ago, and in those three years, he had increased his liquid mana by twenty-five drops in total.
Such cultivation efficiency, in his eyes, was quite satisfactory.
According to his own estimation, in another thirteen or fourteen years, he would be able to break through to the Foundation Establishment Perfection realm.
By then, the mana in his Dantian was expected to reach as much as three hundred and sixty drops.
This amount of liquid mana was almost close to twice that of an ordinary Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivator.
"Three hundred and sixty drops of liquid mana!" Xu Ping muttered to himself, his mood joyful.
