After all, in the Cultivation Realm, having a sufficiently abundant mana during the Foundation Establishment realm was of great significance to the subsequent path of cultivation.
Once he formed his Golden Core, the abundance of his mana would also far exceed that of cultivators of the same tier.
At that time, whether it was the formidable combat power displayed in fights or the potential to break through to higher realms, it would be far beyond what ordinary Golden Core cultivators could match.
In the path of cultivation, advancing quickly in every step matters!
Even those peerless geniuses with Celestial Spirit Roots highly value the Foundation Establishment realm.
They too spend a vast amount of time meticulously honing their realm at this stage, striving with all their might to consolidate their foundation.
They do so just to possess combat power far exceeding commoners and limitless potential after breaking through to the Golden Core realm.
According to Xu Ping’s conjecture, if he truly could reach three hundred and sixty drops of liquid mana at Foundation Establishment Perfection, he would likely have already touched the limits that Foundation Establishment cultivators could reach.
Though not perfect, his foundation would certainly be considered among the top-notch, far beyond the reach of ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivators.
After stabilizing his cultivation for a bit, Xu Ping planned to get up and move around to relieve the slight stiffness brought by prolonged meditation.
However, just as he stepped out of the cultivation chamber, a sinister and exceedingly eerie aura suddenly spread out.
This aura was like a giant beast that had been dormant for a long time awakening, instantly wrapping the entire Purple Bamboo Mountain tight.
Vaguely, countless low and terrifying roars surged towards him from all sides, as though innumerable evil spirits roared in the darkness.
Xu Ping’s heart tightened, and he quickly looked around.
He saw the sky covered with billowing dark clouds, layered together like a giant black curtain, tightly blocking out the sunlight.
Numerous dark shadows flitted back and forth within the heavy clouds, sometimes vanishing, sometimes appearing, and upon closer inspection, they were indeed those terrifying evil spirits.
Leading this group of evil spirits was a powerful evil spirit at the Middle Stage of Golden Core Level.
Its figure was extraordinarily tall, like a moving little hill, surrounded by dense black Yin energy that seemed almost impenetrable.
The Yin energy was surging like a tangible entity, constantly emitting a powerful aura that made the heart palpitate.
Beside it was another evil spirit at the Early Stage Golden Core Level.
Although its aura was somewhat inferior compared to the leading evil spirit, it was equally exuding a chillingly ferocious and brutal energy.
Behind them, countless Foundation Establishment Level and Qi Cultivation Level evil spirits followed closely.
Gathered together, these evil spirits resembled an endless black tidal wave, sweeping towards Purple Bamboo Mountain with a momentum that threatened to obliterate everything in their path.
"How can there be so many evil spirits attacking!"
Seeing this, Xu Ping’s face changed drastically, his eyes full of disbelief.
Since the outbreak of the evil spirits, he had experienced numerous instances of evil spirits haunting, but such exaggerated numbers and powerful strength attacking together was something he witnessed for the first time in his life.
"Could it be the work of the Luoyun Sect?"
Thoughts raced in Xu Ping’s mind, but the situation was extremely urgent at the moment, and the evil spirits were coming aggressively, leaving no room for him to think more.
Immediately, Xu Ping raised his hand without hesitation and cast several spells, activating the defense array set up on Purple Bamboo Mountain.
In an instant, lights flickered, the array activated, and a transparent light curtain slowly rose, enveloping the entire Purple Bamboo Mountain.
Then without hesitation, he led the Water Lake Mouse to confront the evil spirits.
Such a number of evil spirits, including two Golden Core evil spirits, this array certainly couldn’t hold them off.
Moreover, at his speed, he definitely couldn’t escape from the mid-Golden Core evil spirit; now there was no choice but to fight.
"Die!"
Xu Ping’s expression was solemn, he snorted coldly, and with a lift of his hand, several ’Celestial Thunder Talismans’ were thrown out.

chapters.title: Chapter 246 - 182: Fierce Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 246: Chapter 182: Fierce Battle
"Die!"
Xu Ping’s face was solemn. He snorted coldly and raised his hand to release several "Celestial Thunder Talismans."
In an instant, those few talismans blossomed with dazzling cyan light, transforming swiftly into thick cyan divine lightning.
The divine lightning bore an earth-shaking roar as it surged forward like a raging tide, fiercely blasting at the large group of evil spirits ahead.
"Crackling!"
A series of dense explosions followed, striking the group of qi cultivation-level evil spirits at the forefront in an instant.
These evil spirits seemed like fragile bubbles, turning into mass black smoke and dispersing into the air, accompanied by eerie screams that were hair-raising.
The early stage Golden Core evil spirit roared furiously upon seeing this, opening its mouth wide, and a column of dense black yin energy surged out, menacingly attacking Xu Ping.
Faced with the ferocious attack of the early stage Golden Core evil spirit, Xu Ping dared not let his guard down, decisively releasing a Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman.
"Swift!"
Xu Ping’s hands moved in a blur as he quickly formed a spell, shouting loudly.
In an instant, that purple talisman emitted a radiant light, and an unimaginably thick purple divine lightning appeared out of thin air.
This divine lightning seemed to descend from the heavens, carrying a colossal power of destruction as it collided fiercely with the black yin energy column.
Wherever the lightning passed, the air instantly ionized, making a "sizzling" sound. It seemed as if even space itself couldn’t withstand this immense power, beginning to warp and distort.
"Boom!"
The purple divine lightning and the yin energy column collided intensely, unleashing a deafening boom, as if set to shatter the entire heavens and earth.
However, though the black yin energy column appeared sturdy, it only blocked the divine lightning momentarily before being shattered under the divine lightning’s overwhelming force.
The residual power of the divine lightning remained undiminished, heavily striking the early stage Golden Core evil spirit.
The formidable thunder power erupted instantly, completely engulfing this evil spirit in a dazzling purple lightning light.
The violent energy clash made the surrounding space ripple like the surface of a lake, seemingly on the verge of breaking.
"Boom!"
Accompanied by another loud crash, the early stage Golden Core evil spirit was blasted several dozens of yards away by the divine lightning’s impact, falling heavily to the ground, creating a massive deep pit with dust flying.
"Roar!"
Just as Xu Ping was attacking the early stage Golden Core evil spirit with talismans, the middle stage of Golden Core evil spirit let out a howl.
Its entire body burst forth with yin energy, transforming into a ghostly black light, shrouded in sinister, bone-chilling aura and suffocating limitless pressure, rapidly attacking Xu Ping.
"Hmph, coming at a good time!"
Well-prepared for this, Xu Ping snorted coldly and unhesitatingly released two more Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, I will assist you!"
While Xu Ping was intensely battling with the two Golden Core level evil spirits, Duan Shuang and Gong Yang dashed out from various arenas, riding on escape light, charging towards the group of lower-tier evil spirits like two sharp arrows.
"Annihilate!"
The two of them brought out magical artifacts designed to restrain evil spirits and attacked them savagely.
Each strike was like a gale sweeping away leaves, resulting in a large number of qi cultivation-level evil spirits being entirely slain under the magical artifact’s power.
While Duan Shuang and Gong Yang were showcasing their divine prowess among the lower-tier evil spirits, Water Lake Rat refused to be outdone and unexpectedly opened its mouth.
"Whoosh!"
A mass of fiercely hot ghostly purple demon fire burst forth.
This demon fire had an extremely high temperature, causing the air to twist and distort as though boiled, as space itself appeared to melt under the heat.
"Boom!"
The ghostly purple demon fire exploded in the center of the evil spirit group, causing countless purple sparks the size of fingers to fly and spread like meteors.
Those qi cultivation evil spirits would turn to ashes upon contact with even a tiny spark; even foundation establishment level evil spirits suffered gravely when touched by the demon fire, unleashing painful howls.
"Swift!"
Xu Ping’s hands quickly formed a seal, chanting with focused and resolute expression.
Two Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans instantly emitted dazzling light, turning into two more formidable purple divine lightning bolts.
These two purple divine lightning bolts, like enraged thunder dragons, ferociously sped towards the rapidly approaching middle stage of Golden Core evil spirit.
The middle stage of Golden Core evil spirit sensed the terrifying thunder power, causing its flight to falter slightly.
Yet its eyes grew fiercer, its whole body brimming with yin energy like raging black waves, desperately trying to conjure a dense yin energy shield to withstand the divine lightning’s attack.
The purple divine lightning fiercely struck the yin energy shield.
Boom!
Accompanied by thunderous roars, for a time, the lightning flashed, yin energy surged, as the two interwoven and collided violently.
The blinding light bloomed like the scorching sun, the relentless explosions painfully shook the eardrums.
The surrounding space seemed unable to bear such intense impacts of immense power, showing spider-web-like cracks, as if it might collapse completely at any moment.
Though the yin energy shield was exceedingly resilient, under the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman’s apocalyptic power, flaws began to appear.
With two earth-shattering booms, the divine lightning finally breached the defenses of the yin energy shield, landing heavily on the evil spirit.
"Roar!"
The evil spirit let out a soul-wrenching cry of anguish, the part of its body struck by the divine lightning instantly turned charred black, as voluminous yin energy surged out from the wounds.
Its figure trembled violently in the air, clearly suffering serious injuries.
"To simultaneously wield two third-tier talismans, Fellow Daoist Xu’s control power is even stronger than that of many perfection-stage cultivators!"

chapters.title: Chapter 247 - 182: Fierce Battle (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 247: Chapter 182: Fierce Battle (Part 2)
Duan Shuang and Gong Yang, who were engrossed in battle with the lower-level evil spirits, couldn’t help but show expressions of shock mixed with joy on their faces.
If Xu Ping hadn’t turned the tide here, the two of them facing such numerous and powerful evil spirits would have had no chance of survival.
However, Xu Ping showed no sign of happiness at all, his face was as solemn as if it was covered with frost.
The strength difference between the mid-stage Golden Core evil spirit and the early stage is as wide as the gap between clouds and mud!
Just two Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans only injured it, far from the point of slaying it.
One should know, last time against an early stage Golden Core evil spirit, the same means directly annihilated it in one fell swoop.
"Roar!"
The mid-stage Golden Core evil spirit glared at Xu Ping with its blood-red eyes, the venomous intent nearly materializing in its gaze.
It then let out a furious roar, opening a mouth vast enough to swallow the sky, a colossal suction power erupted from its abyssal maw.
Whirr...
Under this terrifying suction, the surrounding lower-level evil spirits were swept in as if ants caught in a whirlpool, involuntarily getting sucked in one by one into its mouth.
As countless lower-level evil spirits were swallowed into its belly, the wounds inflicted by the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman healed at a visibly astonishing speed.
Moreover, the aura it emitted grew stronger and stronger, like a volcano about to erupt, continuously escalating.
"This is bad!"
Xu Ping’s face changed drastically, internally shouting that something was wrong, he unhesitatingly raised his hand to unleash a Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman, aiming at the evil spirit.
He knew very well, he absolutely couldn’t allow this evil spirit any chance to recover, otherwise there would be endless trouble.
In an instant, the talisman burst with dazzling cyan light, transforming instantly into a raging purple Thunder Dragon, rushing with thunderous momentum towards the mid-stage Golden Core evil spirit.
Whirr...
The mid-stage Golden Core evil spirit’s eyes flickered with a chilling gleam, its body swirling with ink-cloud-like yin energy, the suction from its mouth suddenly intensified several times.
The countless lower-level evil spirits had no time to resist, forcibly sucked to the front, forming a "barrier of evil spirits" in front of the purple thunder.
Boom boom boom...
A series of deafening explosions.
The lower-level evil spirits blocking in front of the evil spirit were instantly hit by the purple Divine Thunder, immediately transforming into clouds of pungent black smoke, dissipating in the air, accompanied by piercingly extreme screams that chilled the spine.
Once the purple thunder had eradicated all the lower-level evil spirits, its remaining force continued, directly striking at the mid-stage Golden Core evil spirit.
However, after this obstruction, the power of the purple thunder had been weakened by thirty percent.
Finally, this thunder was completely blocked by the hastily formed yin energy shield of the mid-stage Golden Core evil spirit.
"Let’s see whether you have more low-level evil spirits or I have more talismans!"
Xu Ping’s gaze was as cold as frost, exuding unwavering killing intent, he unhesitatingly unleashed another Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman.
After breaking through to late-stage Foundation Establishment, his Divine Sense and Mana increased greatly, casting around ten Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans was not difficult for him.
He didn’t believe he couldn’t outlast this mid-stage Golden Core evil spirit with his talismans!
Boom!
A massive purple thunder, under Xu Ping’s precise control, like a giant ax splitting the heavens, precisely shattered countless low-level evil spirits, the powerful shock directly pushed the mid-stage Golden Core evil spirit back dozens of feet.
"Again!"
Xu Ping’s face showed determined killing intent, raising his hand again, another Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman whistled out.
The mid-stage Golden Core evil spirit seeing this, finally showed a hint of fear in its eyes.
It truly couldn’t comprehend why this being before it, originally exuding a sweet scent like prey, would possess talismans of such power specifically restraining it.
But now it knew very well that if it didn’t hurriedly flee from here, its fate would likely end here.
Whirr...
The mid-stage Golden Core evil spirit exerted all its strength, its whole body bursting with yin energy wildly, opening its vast maw, the suction reached unprecedented limits.
In an instant, countless low-level evil spirits flew into the flame like moths, drawn to its front.
Even the previously severely wounded early-stage Golden Core evil spirit couldn’t escape, and was also drawn in.
Boom!
At this moment, the purple thunder struck fiercely on the early-stage Golden Core evil spirit, lightning spread all around, exploding with a thunderous roar.
The blinding lightning instantly erupted, enveloping this early-stage Golden Core evil spirit along with numerous lower-level evil spirits.
Seizing this chaos, the mid-stage Golden Core evil spirit abruptly turned around, transformed into a dim black gleam, fleeing desperately without any regard.
In just the blink of an eye, it disappeared from everyone’s view, leaving only a faint black dot at the horizon.
At this moment, as the lightning gradually dissipated, the early-stage Golden Core evil spirit and countless lower-level evil spirits hit by the purple thunder had long since turned to ash, all reduced to nothingness.
"Finally managed to scare away that mid-stage Golden Core evil spirit!"
Seeing this scene, Xu Ping couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief.
Although continuing the fight, his chances of winning were certainly high, who knew if this mid-stage Golden Core evil spirit had other means.
Scaring it away was already quite good.
’It’s a pity my proficiency with the Spirit Silk Skill isn’t enough, otherwise I could trap it using the Three-Talent Talisman Array, it certainly wouldn’t escape.’ Xu Ping shook his head helplessly.
The Three-Talent Talisman Array built using Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans held vast power, coupled with talismans that restrained evil spirits, it might have been able to kill it in one strike.
On the other side of the battlefield, the fight between Duan Shuang, Gong Yang, and the Water Lake Rats against Qi Cultivation and Foundation Establishment level evil spirits showed a one-sided situation.
Though initially these lower-level evil spirits were extremely numerous, most were absorbed by the mid-stage Golden Core evil spirit to restore its strength.
Now under the combined attacks of the two people and a rat, these evil spirits were gradually losing support, showing a noticeable trend of defeat.
At this time, after Xu Ping resolved the Golden Core level evil spirits, he hurried over to assist, still having several Celestial Thunder Talismans left in hand, he unhesitatingly threw them into the group of evil spirits.
Only to see the talismans instantly transform into several streaks of thunder, pouring down like a torrential storm, completely submerging the remaining Qi Cultivation and Foundation Establishment level evil spirits.
With flashes of dazzling thunder and deafening booms, the last batch of evil spirits under the mighty power of the talismans transformed into rolling black smoke, dissipated in the air.
Until now, after a fierce battle, Purple Bamboo Mountain finally returned to calm.
"This time was really too thrilling." Gong Yang let out a long breath, the lingering fear of escaping death still present on his face.
Duan Shuang gently raised her hand, slowly putting away her Magical Artifact.
Her beautiful eyes, still faintly revealed some signs of fear.
"Indeed, who could have anticipated so many evil spirits suddenly attacking Purple Bamboo Mountain, and among them, there was even one early-stage and one mid-stage Golden Core evil spirit!"
Speaking, Duan Shuang cast a grateful gaze towards Xu Ping: "If it wasn’t for Fellow Daoist Xu turning the tide, the two of us would have been devoured by the Golden Core evil spirits long ago!"
"Fellow Daoist Duan is too kind, I was merely acting for self-preservation." Xu Ping waved slightly, his face couldn’t help but show a wry smile.
He indeed spoke truthfully, against the mid-stage Golden Core evil spirit, fleeing wouldn’t work.
"This large-scale evil spirit assault event, this old man feels is definitely not by chance."
Gong Yang’s brow furrowed tightly, like a twisted rope, his face solemnly in deep thought.
Such a vast number of evil spirits, also with two Golden Core level ones appearing simultaneously, truly seemed unnatural.
"I think so too!" Xu Ping nodded upon hearing this.
Then, he lowered his head slightly, pondered for a moment, then slowly spoke: "I suspect, this matter perhaps cannot be separated from Luoyun Sect?"
"Luoyun Sect?"
Duan Shuang and Gong Yang were slightly taken aback, after reacting, their expressions changed, "Could it be due to Luoyun Sect attacking Shuize Sect?"
Throughout the Wanzhe Waters although evil spirits were rampant, the most severe area was the Shuize Sect surrounded by countless evil spirits.

chapters.title: Chapter 248 - 183: The Fall of the Shuize Sect
chapters.content:
Chapter 248: Chapter 183: The Fall of the Shuize Sect
"I’m afraid that’s indeed the case!"
Xu Ping nodded solemnly, and then explained in detail,
"Currently, the news about the Nine Nether Elder’s relic is spreading wildly across the countries of Yue, Hu, and Feng, making the entire Wanzhe Waters a vortex of contention among various forces.
"If the Luoyun Sect doesn’t make a move soon, unforeseen changes might occur."
"And within the Wanzhe Waters, the place most severely affected by malevolent spirits is undoubtedly the Shuize Sect, surrounded by countless such spirits."
"With so many malevolent spirits, including several at the Golden Core Perfection level, even the Luoyun Sect would have to expend considerable time and effort to clear them all!"
"In that case, it would be better to divert all the malevolent spirits surrounding the Shuize Sect, just like last time when they led the spirits to Shuize Sect."
Upon hearing Xu Ping’s explanation, both Duan Shuang and Gong Yang were almost convinced that these malevolent spirits were indeed the work of the Luoyun Sect.
Given the nature of the Luoyun Sect, such actions are entirely within their capability!
"The Luoyun Sect truly has no decency!" Gong Yang cursed the Luoyun Sect in anger.
In his view, the Luoyun Sect’s actions this time were utterly insane, as if dragging all the forces of the Wanzhe Waters to bury the Shuize Sect alongside.
And all of this stemmed merely from the Luoyun Sect’s unwillingness to spend time and effort dealing with those troublesome malevolent spirits.
"All these major sects are birds of a feather, completely disregarding the lives of us loose cultivators." Duan Shuang’s expression was equally displeased.
She had always harbored little fondness for the major sects, and this incident undoubtedly exposed the Luoyun Sect’s nature of treating loose cultivators as nothing.
"Our Purple Bamboo Mountain is quite far from the Shuize Sect, so compared to other areas in the Wanzhe Waters, we should be less affected by the spirits this time."
Xu Ping slightly furrowed his brows, shook his head helplessly,
"But even so, two Golden Core malevolent spirits and countless low-level spirits have come here, making it unimaginable how severe the spirit disasters might be in other parts of the Wanzhe Waters!"
Hearing this, Gong Yang instantly realized the gravity of the situation, his expression turned extremely tense, and he quickly and urgently asked, "Fellow Daoist Xu, from your perspective, what should we do now?"
Xu Ping pondered for a moment and then slowly said, "For now, we can only wait a few more days to see how the situation develops."
"If the Luoyun Sect continues to ignore it and the spirit disasters keep worsening, we might have to temporarily leave Purple Bamboo Mountain and reside elsewhere for a while."
The spirit calamities in the Wanzhe Waters are now several times worse than before, with even several Golden Core Perfection level malevolent spirits wandering around.
It should be known that Golden Core Perfection malevolent spirits, without effective countermeasures, are generally half a level stronger than cultivators of the same stage.
Even if Xu Ping mastered the ’Spirit Silk Skill’ or reached the Minor Achievement realm, using the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman as a base to deploy the Three Talents Array,
it would still be difficult to inflict substantial harm on a Golden Core Perfection malevolent spirit.
Although, once he leaves, the Hundred Bamboo Wood he painstakingly planted might be left unattended and might require replanting.
But all of this is external; nothing is more important than one’s safety. After all, he has a long lifespan, and he can always replant them in the future.
"Temporarily leave, then?"
Duan Shuang muttered to herself, then agreed, "I also think so; once the situation worsens, let’s leave Purple Bamboo Mountain temporarily and return when the cultivators from the three countries gather at the Wanzhe Waters!"
"Currently, the Wanzhe Waters are filled with malevolent spirits, and without clearing them out, no one can explore the Nine Nether Elder’s relic."
Although the spirit calamities are fierce this time, as long as the cultivators from the three countries are willing to spend time and effort, they can still eradicate the spirits.
Upon hearing this, Gong Yang sighed slightly and reluctantly nodded, "It seems we have no other choice."
The war between the countries of Hu and Yue has temporarily ceased, but the overall situation in the Yue Country is still turbulent.
But for us Foundation Establishment cultivators, as long as we proceed cautiously, traveling to other parts of the Yue Country shouldn’t pose too many problems.
""Fellow Daoists, if you receive the latest news about the Luoyun Sect, the Shuize Sect, or the spirit disaster situation in the future, please remember to inform each other."
Thus, we can all have some understanding and better prepare for countermeasures in advance." Xu Ping earnestly reminded.
"That’s only natural!" Duan Shuang and Gong Yang both nodded.
Xu Ping, in terms of both combat strength and status, far exceeds the two of them. If any changes occur in the situation, they would surely notify Xu Ping first.
...
...
Meanwhile, at the Wanzhe Waters, Shuize Sect.
"Attack!"
Amidst thundering shouts.
Outside the array, twenty or thirty Foundation Establishment cultivators, along with over a hundred late-stage Qi Cultivation disciples, led by several Golden Core stage experts, chanted incantations in unison.
In an instant, mana surged over the crowd, converging in one place.
In the blink of an eye, a massive amount of wood attribute Spiritual Power wildly gathered in the void, transforming into huge green Spirit Woods, each a hundred feet long.
These Spirit Woods exuded a vast spiritual power fluctuation and, under the precise control of several Golden Core cultivators, were hurled with immense force towards the sect protection array of the Shuize Sect.
"Boom, boom, boom..."
The earth-shattering explosions seemed to shatter the sky. The fierce collision sounds echoed endlessly over the vast waters.

chapters.title: Chapter 249 - 183: The Fall of the Shuize Sect (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 249: Chapter 183: The Fall of the Shuize Sect (Part 2)
"""
However, even in the face of one mountain-crushing attack after another, Shuize Sect’s Sect Protection Array held firm, remaining intact with only a gentle ripple of spiritual light on its surface.
"With the Sect Protection Array sheltering us, our Shuize Sect stands as steady as Mount Tai!"
Many disciples of Shuize Sect witnessed this scene, their faces lighting up with delight.
The Luoyun Sect’s assault had lasted for over half a month, yet they were unable to breach the sturdy Sect Protection Array.
"Yun Chengzi, Patriarch Yun, Jiang Sect Leader!"
A dazzling stream of light shot out from the depths of Shuize Sect, containing the powerful mana of a Golden Core Perfection cultivator.
When the light dissipated, the figure revealed was none other than the Sect Leader of Shuize Sect.
He looked composed, speaking earnestly in a loud voice: "Your Luoyun Sect has long failed to breach our Mountain Protection Array, perhaps it’s time to cease your attempts."
"As long as you retreat, our Shuize Sect will continue to honor your Luoyun Sect!"
Yun Chengzi stood on the bow of a massive flying boat, his luxurious attire fluttering in the wind.
His expression was calm and water-like, replying coldly: "Your Shuize Sect harbors ill intentions, your ambitions are clear as day; this time we will uproot you all!"
Upon hearing these words, the Shuize Sect Leader’s tone instantly turned cold: "Then go ahead and try!"
"Roar!"
Just as his words dropped, a dragon turtle’s roar echoed across the sky.
A green-horned fish turtle soared from the spiritual pool deep within the Shuize Sect, exuding the powerful aura of a Third-rank Upper Grade demon beast.
A Golden Core Perfection cultivator, a demon beast comparable to Golden Core Perfection in water, combined with the protection of a Fourth Rank Array— even two Nascent Soul cultivators would struggle to breach it in a short time.
After all, Fourth Rank Arrays are fundamentally different from Third Rank Arrays.
It is closely connected to the earth vein, forming a small world of its own.
Unless this unique world is broken, or continuously depleted until it exhausts the earth vein’s power, forceful destruction is impossible.
And depleting the earth vein is not a task for a single day; besides, the whole Wanzhe Waters are caught in a whirlpool of conflict, the Shuize Sect Leader does not believe the Luoyun Sect can endlessly attack.
"Enough talk!"
Yun Chengzi gently flicked his sleeve, his expression resolute, "Flying boat, attack!"
Upon command, the flying boat hovering above the array aimed its barrels directly at the Mountain Protection Array of Shuize Sect.
In the next moment, countless energy beams sprayed out from the barrels like a turbulent flood, crashing straight onto the spiritual light of the array.
"Boom, boom, boom..."
A series of deafening blasts erupted, causing the entire Mountain Protection Array to tremble violently, its surface rippling continuously.
"Consume them!"
The Shuize Sect Leader’s expression was stern, watching quietly as the Luoyun Sect’s army continued to bombard the Fourth Rank Sect Protection Array.
He had initially speculated that the Luoyun Sect had a fatal trump card for this assault, but if it was only a war of attrition, then time favored his Shuize Sect.
Just then, a slightly plump middle-aged man suddenly broke the surface of the water and swiftly arrived before Yun Chengzi and Jiang Jingxing via Escape Light.
He dutifully cupped his hands and said: "Patriarch, Sect Leader, all three sets of ’Tsunami Earthquake Array’ have been fully arranged!"
"Tsunami Earthquake Array" is a meticulously improved Third-rank Array, constructed using water forces and has the powerful capability to disrupt terrain and spirit veins.
"Now, let the Shuize Sect be completely annihilated today!" Yun Chengzi nodded slightly, his eyes flickering with a cold killing intent.
Although three sets of "Tsunami Earthquake Array" were insufficient to directly destroy Fourth Rank Spirit Vein.
They could cause interference, decreasing the power of the Sect Protection Array, and this was the opportunity he had been waiting for.
"Proceed!"
Yun Chengzi commanded decisively.
"Yes!"
The slightly plump man respectfully bowed and then instructed the sect’s mages to activate all "Tsunami Earthquake Arrays".
Under the lake, several mages who had been lurking for quite a while each took out an Array Plate.
The Array Plates had a groove, where three Spirit Stones were embedded firmly.
The Spirit Stones emitted glittering brilliance, their purity far surpassing mid-grade Spirit Stones, they were upper-grade Spirit Stones!
To unleash the full power of the "Tsunami Earthquake Array," Luoyun Sect had spared no expense, directly using upper-grade Spirit Stones.
It is known that one upper-grade Spirit Stone can be exchanged for a hundred mid-grade Spirit Stones, equivalent to ten thousand lower-grade Spirit Stones.
Just activating these three arrays cost Luoyun Sect a total of ninety thousand Spirit Stones.
And counting the myriad rare materials required to arrange the arrays, the expenditure was at least two hundred thousand Spirit Stones, indeed demonstrating great wealth!
"Tsunami Earthquake Array, rise!"
Finally, the mages moved their fingers over the Array Plates, shouting in unison.
In an instant, the blue flags floating in the water erupted with a blinding brilliance.
"""
Amidst the intense flicker of spiritual light, mysterious magical patterns swiftly combined, gradually forming a massive Array Gate.
"Break!"
Several Array Masters simultaneously executed a magic technique, manipulating the Array Plates in their hands to merge with the array’s spiritual light.
"Buzz buzz buzz..."
In an instant, three mighty water dragons, towering hundreds of feet high, appeared from nowhere, rushing fiercely into the fourth-rank Spirit Vein of the Shuize Sect with a thunderous roar, like a flood dragon emerging from the sea.
"Boom!"
In a flash, the lake surface surged with terrifying waves, muddy torrents soaring skyward, and the ground shook violently, as if a dreadful disaster had occurred.
Countless overflowing spiritual qi scattered around the island where the Shuize Sect was located, creating a scene of chaos.
The fourth-rank lower-grade Spirit Vein beneath the island seemed to be violently disrupted by a horrendous force, appearing to be forcibly broken.
The spiritual qi sustaining the Sect Protection Array suddenly diminished significantly, and the array’s power noticeably weakened.
Moreover, the entire island started to shake fiercely, as if the earth dragon had turned over.
Thankfully, the fourth-rank Mountain Protection Array guarded the sect, preventing a highly intense earthquake from erupting.
"They actually set up an array underwater to destroy the terrain and spirit vein!?"
The Shuize Sect Leader’s face was grave, staring intently at the surging waves on the lake surface, instantly guessing Luoyun Sect’s layout.
But evidently, the array set up by Luoyun Sect was far inferior to their own fourth-rank array.
It could only weaken the fourth-rank array’s power but could not reach the level of destruction.
"Today marks the day of your Shuize Sect’s annihilation!"
Yun Chengzi flew out, waved his sleeve, and instantly suspended more than a dozen Breaking Charms of different grades—third-rank upper, mid, and lower—in the void.
"Rise!"
Yun Chengzi chanted incantations, quickly forming a sequence of complex magic techniques with his hands.
"Buzz buzz buzz..."
In an instant, more than a dozen third-rank Breaking Charms interwove, their auras linking and merging, spreading a strong and profound force of breaking charms that vibrated the space around.
"Puff!"
Yun Chengzi quickly opened his mouth, spraying a purple True Essence like an arrow precisely onto those dozen Breaking Charms.
"Destroy!"
After spewing the True Essence, Yun Chengzi’s face turned deathly pale, and his entire aura weakened to the extreme.
His body trembled slightly, as if a light breeze could knock him over.
Yet even so, he still endured his body’s extreme frailty, exerting all his effort to maneuver the Talisman Array toward Shuize Sect’s Mountain Protection Array.
In an instant.
Those dozens of Breaking Charms seemed to be infused with infinite power, bursting forth unprecedentedly intense spiritual light.
Blinding beams of light interwove, converging into a pure beam of energy composed of breaking power.
This beam, like a roaring giant dragon, charged with an unstoppable momentum, striking heavily upon the array’s spiritual light.
"Boom!"
A thunderous sound shook the very heavens and earth.
Following that was a sharp cracking sound like that of solid ice breaking.
The breaking power surged like an overwhelming tide, enveloping the entire Mountain Protection Array.
"No..."
Shuize Sect leader’s eyes widened in disbelief, witnessing the Mountain Protection Array scream out, greatly diminishing in power.
But he had no time to make any remedial actions.
Numerous energy beams, like turbulent floodwaters, shot forth from the cannon’s mouth, directly impacting the array’s spiritual light.
This barrage of energy beams was akin to the last straw that broke the camel’s back.
Building on the breaking power’s weakening effect on the Mountain Protection Array, it delivered a fatal blow.
In an instant, accompanied by an earth-shaking explosion, the Mountain Protection Array could withstand no more of this violent attack and dispersed completely.
Where the light faded, Shuize Sect lay completely exposed and defenseless before Luoyun Sect.
"The array is broken, blood cleanse Shuize Sect, leave no one alive!"
Jiang Jingxing beamed with joy, issuing commands.
A fleet of spirit ships charged into Shuize Sect, bringing an apocalypse upon the Shuize Sect.
Even Jiang Jingxing himself flew out, exuding the might of a Nascent Soul Cultivator, charging toward the Shuize Sect Leader!

chapters.title: Chapter 250 - 185: Exterminating the Evil Alliance; Hongyi Pays a Visit
chapters.content:
Chapter 250: Chapter 185: Exterminating the Evil Alliance; Hongyi Pays a Visit
Ten days later.
Thousand Leaves Mountain
The array makes it feel like spring all year around.
A gentle breeze blows, and the air is quite fresh.
Xu Ping had just finished performing the ’Tribulation Spirit Skill’ on the Hundred Bamboo Wood and was taking a brief rest when Gong Yang and Duan Shuang came together to visit, bringing earth-shattering news.
The Luoyun Sect has annihilated the Shuize Sect!
"Friend Gong, please explain in detail..." Upon hearing this, Xu Ping’s expression instantly turned grave.
Although he knew the Luoyun Sect would definitely take action, he didn’t expect them to move so quickly.
After all, the Shuize Sect had a Fourth Rank Sect Protection Array, with defenses said to be impregnable, which truly exceeded his expectations.
"... I just received this confirmed news."
"Currently, the Luoyun Sect has issued a statement, claiming the Shuize Sect committed the grave sins of colluding with enemy nations and defying the higher sect, hence they’ve launched a crusade against it and have exterminated it."
Now, the Shuize Sect’s leader is dead, the divine turtle guarding the sect has also perished, and not one of the five Golden Core masters under the sect survived."
"The remaining Foundation Establishment Stage cultivators either died in battle or chose to surrender... Only a few disciples are fleeing outside, and have been publicly wanted and rewarded..."
Some remnants of shock remained on Gong Yang’s face: "The foundation of the Luoyun Sect is truly profound, able to so decisively and thoroughly uproot the Shuize Sect."
"Indeed!"
Xu Ping couldn’t help but echo with some admiration.
The Luoyun Sect, initially in a dire situation, not only successfully reversed the tide but also wiped out the Shuize Sect thoroughly before the cultivators of the three countries arrived at the Wanzhe Waters.
With this battle, the entire Yue Country is once again fully under the control of the Luoyun Sect.
Judging by this situation, the Luoyun Sect can at least peacefully maintain its rule over Yue Country for another five or six hundred years.
"Besides this affair, the Luoyun Sect also announced an important piece of information..."
Duan Shuang pondered for a moment before speaking slowly, "The Luoyun Sect declared that the evil spirit disaster rampant in the entire Wanzhe Waters was all orchestrated by the Shuize Sect before its downfall; they attempted to drag all the Wanzhe Waters’ cultivators to their grave."
"The Luoyun Sect also stated they exerted all efforts to stop it, yet ultimately to no avail!"
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping couldn’t help but sneer inwardly: ’These words would only fool a three-year-old.’"
In his view, if the Shuize Sect truly had the ability to divert the evil spirits besieging their sect, they wouldn’t have waited until this desperate situation but would’ve acted long ago.
To be honest, he didn’t have much goodwill towards the Luoyun Sect either.
During the Luoyun Sect’s induced evil spirit disaster, if he weren’t already a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, with numerous Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans, survival would have been incredibly difficult.
"The Luoyun Sect further claims that in order to prevent the evil spirit disaster from further spreading, they intend to form a ’Extermination Evil Spirits Alliance’, where cultivators of any nation can join."
Duan Shuang continued narrating, "However, the Luoyun Sect won’t let the cultivators exert their efforts in vain.
Every cultivator joining the ’Extermination Evil Spirits Alliance’ can obtain the eligibility to explore the Nine Nether Elder’s ruins."
"Extermination Evil Spirits Alliance?"
Xu Ping slightly raised his eyebrows, contemplating internally, ’The Luoyun Sect indeed plays a good game.’
Knowing it could never hold the Nine Nether Elder’s ruins alone, it proactively formed the ’Extermination Evil Spirits Alliance’, leveraging cultivators from other countries to exterminate evil spirits.
In this way, it could both keep these foreign cultivators in check to some extent, preventing them from causing too much trouble in Yue Country.
On the other hand, it could utilize their strength to eliminate the evil spirit threat, killing two birds with one stone.
Whether cultivators from other countries would choose to join the ’Extermination Evil Spirits Alliance’ formed by the Luoyun Sect, Xu Ping deemed highly probable.
After all, as the saying goes, a dragon is not as oppressive as a local snake, especially when the Luoyun Sect is not just a mediocre local snake.
These foreign cultivators traveled thousands of miles primarily for the Nine Nether Elder’s ruins, and currently, evil spirits have become the greatest obstacle standing in their way.
In order to explore the ruins more swiftly, joining this alliance indeed seems the best choice.
As for how many treasures one might find in the Nine Nether Elder ruins after the evil spirits are purged, it would entirely depend on personal luck and skill.
"In this case, it seems we don’t need to rush to move away from Purple Bamboo Mountain!" Xu Ping’s lips curled slightly, revealing a relaxed smile.
After all, once the ’Extermination Evil Spirits Alliance’ is established, the evil spirit disaster will most likely not affect them.
"Indeed!"
Duan Shuang nodded vigorously, his eyes showing a hint of temptation, "Once the three-countries cultivators arrive in droves, these evil spirits would naturally become insignificant.
The operation to exterminate evil spirits surely won’t encounter too much danger.
Most importantly, as long as one joins the ’Extermination Evil Spirits Alliance’, one can obtain the eligibility to explore the Nine Nether Elder’s ruins."
"I plan to join, but I wonder what you two fellow cultivators think?" Saying this, Duan Shuang turned his gaze towards Xu Ping and Gong Yang.
"I’m fine on my own." Xu Ping shook his head decisively, directly refusing.
Although he craved the Nine Nether Elder ruins greatly, choosing to risk his life for them didn’t seem necessary.
Hearing this, a hesitating look appeared on Gong Yang’s face.
He bowed his head in deep contemplation, weighing the pros and cons of joining or not joining.
Ultimately, his strong desire for Core Formation prevailed and he gritted his teeth, saying, "Then this old man will join too."
Despite the many dangers in exploring the Nine Nether Elder’s ruins this time, if he doesn’t fight for it, the hope of Core Formation would likely be slim.
Though Xu Ping did not plan to participate, he generously sponsored both with several Second-stage talismans, asking them to help him find some life-extending items and Quasi-Tier Three or higher Artifact Refining Technique at the Nine Nether Elder’s ruins.

chapters.title: Chapter 251 - 185: Exterminating the Evil Spirits Alliance; Hongyi Pays a Visit
chapters.content:
Chapter 251: Chapter 185: Exterminating the Evil Spirits Alliance; Hongyi Pays a Visit
The third-stage talismans are too precious, so he did not give them to the two people, after all, he was not running a charity.
It’s not too late to give them once they truly find what they need.
...
...
After Duan Shuang and Gong Yang left, Thousand Leaves Mountain returned to its tranquility.
In the empty pavilion, only Xu Ping remained, alone.
"Now that the disaster of the evil spirits has dissipated, and a small revenge has been achieved, it is a double joy, time to drink a cup!"
Xu Ping’s lips curled into a faint smile, as he took out spirit wine, specially asking the water lake rat to come and pour it for him.
The water lake rat nimbly bustled over, skillfully filling Xu Ping’s cup.
Xu Ping raised the cup and drank it all in one go, the wine sliding down his throat, bringing a slight warmth.
Even though the revenge wasn’t personally taken by him, the destruction of his enemies was still a great satisfaction.
...
Time quietly passed by.
On the tenth day after Shuize Sect’s destruction, cultivators from the countries of Hu and Feng arrived at Wanzhe Waters like a tide.
Everything was just as Xu Ping had predicted before, with cultivators from both countries joining the "Alliance to Exterminate Evil Spirits."
For a time, a grand and imposing operation to exterminate the evil spirits was underway.
As a result, those magical artifacts and talismans that could restrain the evil spirits in the entire Wanzhe Waters suddenly became rare commodities, with prices soaring like a runaway horse.
During this period, many people came to Thousand Leaves Mountain by name, trying to purchase the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman made by Xu Ping, but without exception, all were skillfully deflected by Xu Ping.
On this day.
Xu Ping was immersed in cultivation, spiritual power circulating around him, his aura calm and steady, when the water lake rat’s divine sense message interrupted his cultivation:
"Master, a fake pill cultivator claiming to be an old friend of yours has come to visit."
"An old friend who’s a fake pill cultivator?"
Xu Ping’s brows furrowed instantly, filled with confusion, and he immediately asked through divine sense: "What is the visitor’s name?"
He couldn’t recall knowing any fake pill cultivators before.
"He says his name is Hongyi!" the water lake rat quickly responded.
"Hongyi?"
Xu Ping was slightly taken aback, thoughts swirling in his mind, ’The senior disciple brother of Qiu Xuan Mountain’s Sect Leader?
First it was Xu Zhixuan, and now it’s Hongyi, why do all the surviving members of Qiu Xuan Mountain enjoy reminiscing with him so much?
Moreover, Hongyi has actually become a fake pill cultivator.
But upon closer thought, it’s reasonable, since Hongyi already had the combat power of a fake pill before, though it’s unclear what means he used.
But after all these years, his becoming a fake pill cultivator is indeed very plausible.
"Master, should I bring him up to meet you?" the water lake rat once again inquired through divine sense.
Xu Ping pondered for a moment before slowly saying, "Invite him up... nevermind, I will personally bring him up."
After all, Hongyi is now a fake pill cultivator, and given his previous kindness when he was at Qiu Xuan Mountain, it’s only right to meet him in person.
...
Xu Ping set up Escape Light and went to greet him mid-air.
From afar, he saw a middle-aged man with slightly graying temples standing silently.
Xu Ping approached, bowed with hands clasped, and smiled: "Sect Leader Hong, long time no see!"
"Qiu Xuan Mountain has long since been destroyed, how can I still be a Sect Leader!" Hongyi smiled wryly, "Let us call each other fellow daoists."
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping sighed slightly: "Unknowingly, so many years have passed now!"
"But it’s a cause for celebration that Fellow Daoist Hong has broken through to the fake pill." Xu Ping congratulated him with a smile.
"I am far from being comparable to Fellow Daoist Xu!" Hongyi waved his hands repeatedly.
He looked at Xu Ping, who looked almost the same as before, showing no signs of aging, but even seemed to be growing younger, and couldn’t help but feel countless emotions.
When first meeting Xu Ping, he knew Xu Ping was extraordinary, later revealed by his Sword Qi Thunder Sound.
Even with psychological preparation, he never imagined that in the short span of twenty or thirty years, Xu Ping would have grown into a third-stage Talisman Master.
Now, Xu Ping’s status and position exceeded that of an actual fake pill cultivator like him by half a step.
"Let us stop praising each other here, why don’t we chat as we drink in my cave residence." Xu Ping warmly invited.
"I couldn’t ask for more!" Hongyi agreed readily with a smile.
Subsequently, under Xu Ping’s guidance, the two came to the pavilion within the mountain.
"Ah... I truly envy Fellow Daoist Xu, farming and making talismans at Thousand Leaves Mountain, living a carefree and leisurely life..."
Hongyi drank a sip of spirit tea, seemingly in genuine admiration.
However, in the next second, his words abruptly shifted: "Yet, even though Thousand Leaves Mountain is good, it is ultimately only a second-stage spirit vein, now somewhat inferior to a third-stage spirit vein, not a true blessed land."
"Oh?"
Xu Ping’s expression changed slightly as he immediately asked, "What high opinion do you have, Fellow Daoist Hong?"
"To be frank, Fellow Daoist Xu, I indeed came today to discuss an important matter,"
Hongyi said seriously and sincerely, "Although Qiu Xuan Mountain was unfortunately breached by a beast tide back then, the third-stage spirit vein within the mountain remains intact."
"Now that the beast tide has receded, it is an excellent time to reorganize Qiu Xuan Mountain!"
At this point, Hongyi looked at Xu Ping with burning eyes and sincere words: "I sincerely invite Fellow Daoist Xu to join Qiu Xuan Mountain and take the position of Sect Leader."
"While I become the deputy Sect Leader, fully supporting Fellow Daoist Xu, I believe it won’t be long before Qiu Xuan Mountain regains its former glory."
"Moreover, with a third-stage spiritual land as a firm foundation, the entire force can be at Fellow Daoist Xu’s command to consolidate, then Fellow Daoist Xu’s desire to form the Golden Core may not be illusory!"
’Join Qiu Xuan Mountain as its Sect Leader?’ Hearing Hongyi’s suggestion, Xu Ping couldn’t help but freeze momentarily.
After a brief moment of shock, he regained his composure and immediately shook his head in refusal: "I feel my strength is still lacking and likely cannot bear such a significant responsibility."
For ordinary cultivators, Hongyi’s proposal would be immensely tempting.
But for Xu Ping, it held no allure whatsoever.
Not to mention anything else, just the once-every-few-decades beast tide threat at Qiu Xuan Mountain was enough to make him lose all interest.
Upon hearing how decisively Xu Ping refused, Hongyi became somewhat anxious.
He quickly urged repeatedly: "With Fellow Daoist Xu’s current status and strength as a third-stage Talisman Master, taking on the role of Sect Leader at Qiu Xuan Mountain would be entirely fitting."
"Rest assured, Fellow Daoist Xu, once you become Sect Leader, you won’t need to worry about any trivial matters, just focus on closed-door cultivation and drawing talismans.
This is no different from your life at Thousand Leaves Mountain, and moreover, there would be a substantial Sect Leader’s allowance solely for Fellow Daoist Xu every year."
Admittedly, Hongyi’s offer was indeed very enticing.
Yet, Xu Ping still, without any hesitation, firmly refused once more: "Thank you, Fellow Daoist Hong, for your kind intentions, but I truly have no interest in being the Sect Leader of Qiu Xuan Mountain, please seek others who are suitable."
Hongyi opened his mouth as if wanting to say more, but finally, he just smiled bitterly and shook his head helplessly: "Since Fellow Daoist Xu has made up his mind, I won’t force further persuasion."
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Hong, for understanding. Honestly speaking, even without inviting me, with your current fake pill strength, reviving Qiu Xuan Mountain isn’t a difficult task!"
Xu Ping’s words were genuine and not empty flattery.
With the entire Yue Country repeatedly suffering calamities, many forces have already perished, not to mention that Shuize Sect, a formidable presence, was annihilated at the hands of Luoyun Sect.
Under such circumstances, Hongyi’s strength as a fake pill cultivator makes revitalizing Qiu Xuan Mountain quite possible, although returning to its peak of prosperity might be somewhat challenging.
"I understand what Fellow Daoist Xu is saying, just... forget it, there’s no point discussing it." Hongyi sighed slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 252 - 185: Bartering for Lower Grade Tier-3 Artifact Refining Technique; Spirit Silk Skill Reaches Minor Achievement
chapters.content:
Chapter 252: Chapter 185: Bartering for Lower Grade Tier-3 Artifact Refining Technique; Spirit Silk Skill Reaches Minor Achievement
After the two exchanged a few casual words, the topic inadvertently shifted to the "Alliance to Annihilate Evil Spirits".
"Fellow Daoist Xu, have you joined the ’Alliance to Annihilate Evil Spirits’?" Hongyi inquired.
"Me?" Xu Ping paused slightly, then shook his head, "No."
"Fellow Daoist Xu, don’t you plan to explore the Nine Nether Elder’s Legacy?" Hearing Xu Ping’s response, a hint of unusual color flashed across Hongyi’s face.
After all, only by joining the ’Alliance to Annihilate Evil Spirits’, can one have the qualification to explore the Nine Nether Elder’s Legacy.
If someone attempts to secretly go there, once discovered, they will surely suffer the intense wrath of practitioners from the three countries, with unimaginable consequences.
"I feel that my strength is too feeble, and I really don’t want to join this buzz, fighting life and death with other practitioners from various paths." Xu Ping said candidly.
Upon hearing this, Hongyi immediately stood in awe: "Fellow Daoist Xu, to be able to restrain your inner greed like this, such a mindset is rare indeed, truly a model for us practitioners to learn from!"
"Fellow Daoist Hong is flattering me. To be honest, it’s just that I’m timid." Xu Ping joked about himself.
"How can that be considered timid! Fellow Daoist Xu possesses extraordinary talent, with a future of limitless potential. Not venturing into danger at this time is the wisest choice." Hongyi said while waving his hand repeatedly.
Next, he sighed softly, with a slightly desolate expression, "Unlike me, whose whole life will just be like this."
"Fellow Daoist Hong, do not belittle yourself."
One must know, being able to cultivate to the Fake Pill Realm already surpasses ninety-nine percent of the practitioners in the Cultivation Realm. Such achievements, countless people admire." Xu Ping earnestly advised.
Hongyi smiled bitterly, full of helplessness in his tone:
"Although I fortunately achieved the Fake Pill, in this vast and boundless Cultivation Realm, the Fake Pill Realm is nothing more than an ant that’s slightly stronger, really nothing much."
Speaking to this point, his gaze suddenly turned deep, carrying a trace of longing, "However, it is said that there exists the Transformation Pill Fruit in the Nine Nether Elder’s Legacy."
"Transformation Pill Fruit?"
Xu Ping’s mind shook.
Under normal circumstances, the realm of a Fake Pill True Person remains stagnant for life unless there is a great opportunity.
The Transformation Pill Fruit is one of them.
It can help practitioners safely revert the Fake Pill back to the liquid mana of Foundation Establishment.
On this basis, the assurance of achieving the Golden Core in the next Core Formation attempt is greatly enhanced.
For a Fake Pill True Person, this Transformation Pill Fruit is akin to providing them with a second life in importance.
"I hope Fellow Daoist Hong can successfully find the Transformation Pill Fruit and fulfill your wish this time."
Xu Ping quickly recovered from his shock, his expression calm, then smiled and blessed.
Although the effects of this Transformation Pill Fruit are remarkably miraculous, it indeed is of little use to him personally.
"Then I shall borrow your good words, Daoist!" Hongyi laughed heartily.
.....
After conversing for a moment, Hongyi suddenly shifted the topic, with a faint hint of expectation in his eyes, looking at Xu Ping and asked:
"Fellow Daoist Xu, do you currently have any Third-rank Talismans? If it’s convenient, could you bear the pain of parting and allow me to have a few?"
Xu Ping slightly furrowed his brow, showing a look of difficulty on his face: "Fellow Daoist Hong, the crafting of Third-rank Talismans is extremely difficult, the hardships of which you are well aware."
"I don’t have many of them in stock, and these talismans are crucial for me, kept for emergencies usually, so I’m afraid..."
Upon hearing this, Hongyi became anxious immediately, and hurriedly said: "Fellow Daoist Xu, I also know that requesting this is quite abrupt and presumptuous.
"But as long as you are willing to part with a few Third-rank Talismans for me, no matter if it’s magical treasures, Spirit Stones, or any other items, as long as it’s within my capability, I will certainly not disappoint you!"
Listening to this, Xu Ping secretly pondered.
Hongyi, as a Fake Pill True Person, compared to Duan Shuang and Gong Yang, he undoubtedly has a greater chance of finding what he needs in the Nine Nether Elder’s Legacy.
If through Hongyi’s hand, he could obtain objects that extend life and Artifact Refining Techniques above Quasi-Tier Three, giving him a few Third-rank Talismans might not be impossible.
"Ah."
Xu Ping sighed softly and slowly said, "Fellow Daoist Hong has taken care of me quite a bit back at Qiu Xuan Mountain, considering this friendship, selling a few Third-rank Talismans to you is not out of the question.
"It’s just, I’m not sure if Fellow Daoist Hong has anything I want."
Hearing this, Hongyi’s eyes lit up, and he promised firmly: "Fellow Daoist Xu, just speak without hesitation! Even if I don’t have it in hand currently, I will certainly do my utmost to find it for you!"
One must know, Third-rank Talismans, let alone for Fake Pill True Persons, even for Golden Core True Persons, are extremely precious and scarce treasures.
If he could obtain a few Third-rank Talismans, then when competing with other Fake Pill True Persons for the Transformation Pill Fruit, he would certainly gain a huge advantage.
"In this case, does Fellow Daoist Xu have any longevity Spiritual Objects above the Second-stage, or Artifact Refining Techniques above Quasi-Tier Three?" Xu Ping immediately asked.
"Longevity Spiritual Objects above the Second-stage, or Artifact Refining Techniques above Quasi-Tier Three?"
Hongyi slightly frowned, after pondering for a moment, he said: "I indeed do not have longevity Spiritual Objects above the Second-stage. However, I do have a set of Third-rank Lower Grade Artifact Refining Techniques, would Fellow Daoist Xu be satisfied with this?"
’You really have it?’
Xu Ping’s eyes suddenly lit up; he initially just asked casually, unexpectedly Hongyi really had it.
"This is naturally very satisfying." Xu Ping’s face showed a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 253 - 185: Trading for Tier 3 Lower Grade Artifact Refining Technique; Spirit Silk Skill Breaks Through to Minor Achievement_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 253: Chapter 185: Trading for Tier 3 Lower Grade Artifact Refining Technique; Spirit Silk Skill Breaks Through to Minor Achievement_2
In the end, Xu Ping handed three Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans to Hongyi.
Hongyi took the talismans, unable to conceal his excitement, and immediately cupped his hands in gratitude: "Thank you, Fellow Daoist Xu, for your generous gift!"
In his view, exchanging a Third-rank Lower Grade Artifact Refining Technique for three Third-rank Lower Grade Talismans was a huge bargain.
"With such generous assistance from Fellow Daoist Xu, if there’s anything you need my help with in the future, just say the word!" Hongyi promised, thumping his chest.
Xu Ping smiled slightly: "Fellow Daoist Hong, you exaggerate. In fact, there is indeed something I would like to ask for your help with."
"Please speak, Fellow Daoist Xu. As long as it’s within my capabilities, I will definitely not refuse!" Hongyi replied solemnly.
"It’s nothing difficult!"
Xu Ping chuckled softly and said slowly, "I would like to ask Fellow Daoist Hong to keep an eye out for two things while exploring the relics of the Nine Nether Elder."
"The first is an item for longevity at or above the Second-stage; the second is a Quasi-Tier Three or higher puppetry technique."
Seeking longevity items needs no elaboration.
As for the Quasi-Tier Three or higher puppetry, it’s because Xu Ping is currently cultivating the ’Core Formation Secret Technique’, and during the phase of transforming the cultivation technique, his own strength will surely plummet, making it the most dangerous time for him.
To ensure he can safely get through this ordeal, he must enhance his own protection as much as possible.
Puppetry, without a doubt, is an excellent choice.
After all, even if his mana decreases with the transformation, his Divine Sense remains unaffected.
If he can control several Quasi-Tier Three or even Third-rank puppets by then, his strength won’t be much diminished compared to now.
"Of course."
After a slight pause, Xu Ping continued, "If you encounter powerful spells or secret techniques in the relics, you can also let me know."
"At that time, regardless of whether it’s exchanging with Spirit Stones, other items, or even more Third-stage Talismans, everything is negotiable."
"No problem!" Hongyi readily agreed.
For him, it’s just a simple task.
If he could actually exchange them for Third-stage Talismans again, that would indeed be a great deal, a surefire win.
The two then meticulously discussed various details.
Afterward, carrying the Third-stage Talismans given to him by Xu Ping, Hongyi left Thousand Leaves Mountain.
...
"To obtain the Third-rank Lower Grade Artifact Refining Technique from Hongyi was truly an unexpected surprise."
Xu Ping toyed gently with the jade slip recording the Artifact Refining Technique, a faint, joyful smile appeared unconsciously at the corner of his mouth.
Now he only needed to wait for the Hundred Bamboo Wood to continue growing and the Water Rat to break through to Second-stage Middle Grade, and he could start refining the Artifact Embryo.
...
...
Since then, Xu Ping’s life returned to tranquility.
Each day, he devoted himself to cultivation, diligently practicing swordsmanship... Occasionally, he would take some time to delve into the legacy of the Third-rank Lower Grade Artifact Refining Technique.
However, the external operations against the malevolent beings grew increasingly intense.
With the concerted efforts of the cultivators from the three countries, the malevolent entities dispersed throughout the Wanzhe Waters were gradually being eradicated.
Time flew by swiftly, and a year and a half passed in the blink of an eye.
On this day, in a cultivation chamber at Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Xu Ping’s face was grave, fully concentrated, his hands moving like phantoms, swiftly and precisely forming magic techniques, as the mana within his body surged along a special meridian path like a torrential flood.
In an instant.
Dozens of nearly invisible threads of mana shot out suddenly from between his fingers, resembling nimble spirit threads, landing precisely on the dozens of talismans suspended in the air.
Then, with a slight move of Xu Ping’s fingers.
Those dozens of talismans began interweaving and shuttling past one another at a dizzying speed.
The talismans spun, leaving behind traces of phantom shadows, yet never once did they collide!
This was exactly the unique skill of Xu Ping’s cultivation of the "Spirit Silk Skill", which allowed him to swiftly increase his proficiency in this magic technique.
And so, the process continued incessantly.
Unwittingly, half an hour quietly slipped by.
Suddenly.
A fierce fluctuation of mana surged around Xu Ping, and the originally steady mana threads instantly glowed intensely, too dazzling to look at directly.
The talismans that were intertwining seemed to be attracted by a mysterious and powerful force, whirling rapidly around Xu Ping.
Emitting a dense "buzzing" vibration, as if venting some impending breakthrough power.
A look of sudden realization gradually appeared on Xu Ping’s face, his eyes brimming with excitement and surprise.
He barely moved his fingers, seeming casual yet containing exquisite control.
Immediately, the dozens of talismans, as if obeying a silent command, spun quickly and arranged themselves in a unique order in the blink of an eye.
In an instant, two large characters formed by the talismans, "Minor Achievement", floated clearly in the air, emitting a peculiar and gentle glow.
"Spirit Silk Skill... has finally reached Minor Achievement!"
Xu Ping murmured to himself, a slight smile appearing at the corner of his mouth.
After nearly two years, the Spirit Silk Skill was finally mastered at a Minor Achievement level.
He was finally able to use the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman as a foundation to construct the Three-Talent Talisman Array.
"Not easy at all!!"
Xu Ping couldn’t help but sigh, his eyes revealing an unmistakable excitement, shimmering with a gleam of exhilaration.
"Let’s try constructing the Three-Talent Talisman Array with the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman first!" Xu Ping took a deep breath, striving to calm his emotions.
He then gently flipped his palm, and three Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans appeared instantly in his hand. These three talismans exuded a mysterious aura, their symbols glowing as if filled with endless thunder power.
"Rise!"
Xu Ping let his mana surge, and the three Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans shimmered, suddenly flying out from his palm to float quietly in the air.
"Control!"
Xu Ping’s expression turned solemn, his hands quickly changing forms, precisely forming one magic technique after another.
In a flash, three thin yet powerfully charged mana threads shot out from his fingertip, like nimble lightning, landing exactly on the three Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans.
"Condense!"
Once he successfully gained full control over the three Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans, Xu Ping began to methodically channel the abundant mana within his body, continuously transmitting it through the mana threads to the three Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans in the void.
At this moment, the three Third-rank Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans seemed to be imbued with endless energy, bursting forth with dazzling and blinding spiritual light.
"Trap!"
Under Xu Ping’s precise control, the three talismans flexibly interwove and shuttled through the void, cooperating seamlessly without interfering with each other.
Simultaneously, their Qi began linking together thinly yet tightly, as if forming an inseparable whole.
"Success!"
Xu Ping’s face shone with wild joy, his heart beating with excitement.
It proved that constructing a Three-Talent Talisman Array with the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans is entirely feasible!
This achievement will undoubtedly allow his power to undergo a qualitative leap, reaching a whole new level.
Despite the intense desire to immediately witness the power of a Three-Talent Talisman Array constructed with Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans,
Xu Ping restrained himself, refraining from further testing.
Firstly, Third-stage Talismans are extremely precious, and wasting three of them on experimentation would be too extravagant, even with Xu Ping’s wealth, it would still hurt for a long time.
Secondly, as a formidable talisman array, the Three-Talent Talisman Array’s power is beyond imagination.
If detonated, the released terrifying force could well flatten the entire summit of Thousand Leaves Mountain in an instant.
Even with a powerful protective array set up at Thousand Leaves Mountain, it’s doubtful it could withstand such a massive impact.
"Disband!"
With a subtle movement of his finger, the three Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans that formed the Three-Talent Talisman Array in the air disbanded in an instant.
The closely intertwined Qi threads cut off abruptly.
He then dexterously moved his finger again, and the three Third-rank Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans, like obedient birds, landed steadily in his hand.
Xu Ping gazed down at the talismans in his hand, his eyes shimmering with thoughtful reflection, pondering silently, "Now it is proven possible to construct the Three-Talent Talisman Array using the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman.
It remains to be seen whether the same could be done with Three-rank Middle Grade Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman to construct the Three-Talent Talisman Array."

chapters.title: Chapter 254 - 186: The Tragic Extermination of a Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 254: Chapter 186: The Tragic Extermination of a Clan
"If the Gold Armor-Breaking Talisman, a third-rank middle-grade talisman, could be used as the foundation to construct a Three Talents Talisman Array, even a cultivator at the Middle Stage of Golden Core would face a life-threatening situation."
This thought flashed through Xu Ping’s mind, and a surge of uncontrollable excitement rose within him.
With a flip of his palm, three Gold Armor-Breaking Talismans appeared in his hand.
The runes on the talisman paper flickered, seem to emit traces of gold attribute Spiritual Power fluctuations.
"Rise!"
Xu Ping lightly called out, as his Mana surged like a flowing stream through his meridians and into his palm.
Under the activation of Mana, the three Gold Armor-Breaking Talismans glowed with spiritual light, and suddenly flew from his palm, quietly hovering in the air.
Xu Ping then concentrated entirely, following the steps to construct the Three Talents Talisman Array, proceeding step by step.
However, when the process reached the final step "trap", a sudden change occurred.
The three originally obedient Gold Armor-Breaking Talismans began to show subtle signs of mutual repulsion.
A slight tremor emerged from the talismans.
"Buzz..."
As the seconds ticked by, the repulsion between the three Gold Armor-Breaking Talismans grew stronger, and the amplitude of the tremors increased.
It seemed as if an invisible force was driving them to break free from their constraints.
"Trap!"
Xu Ping’s face tensed, he gritted his teeth, exerted all his strength, with veins slightly bulging on his forehead.
He desperately tried to use his Mana to control the gradually disordered situation.
But the third-rank Gold Armor-Breaking Talismans, at this moment, appeared to be like rebellious youths.
The more Xu Ping tried to suppress them, the more they resisted, becoming ever more defiant.
"Bang!"
Finally, the repulsion reached its limit between the three Gold Armor-Breaking Talismans.
With a loud bang, they suddenly released like highly compressed springs, violently shooting off in different directions.
"Not good!"
Xu Ping’s face changed dramatically, immediately channeling Mana throughout his body, forming a massive Mana hand in front of him.
Just as the three Gold Armor-Breaking Talismans were about to hit the wall, it securely caught them in his hand.
Although the impact should not normally damage the Gold Armor-Breaking Talismans, it’s better to be cautious.
If the talisman paper gets damaged, the contained power would indiscriminately explode.
His small Thousand Leaves Mountain could not withstand the power of a third-rank middle-grade talisman.
"Fortunately it’s not broken."
Xu Ping tightly grasped the three Gold Armor-Breaking Talismans, and upon confirming their intact condition, he let out a breath of relief.
Yet, thinking back to the failed attempt to construct a Three Talents Talisman Array with the Gold Armor-Breaking Talismans as the foundation, a trace of helplessness crossed his face.
"The proficiency in ’Spirit Silk Skill’ is still insufficient; the control is lacking," Xu Ping thoughtfully considered.
The power contained in the Gold Armor-Breaking Talismans is indeed overwhelming; controlling them at will is unimaginably difficult.
With his current Minor Achievement level in "Spirit Silk Skill", it’s truly challenging to perfect control, leading to the situation of mutual repulsion between talismans.
According to his estimate, at least mastering the ’Spirit Silk Skill’ would be required to fully control them.
"Mastery, huh!" Xu Ping murmured to himself, yet his heart wasn’t too disappointed.
He has plenty of time ahead.
Moreover, the outside world, though turbulent due to exterminating evil spirits and the relics of the Nine Nether Elder.
But it hasn’t affected the peace within Thousand Leaves Mountain.
His status and strength as a third-rank Talisman Master are recognized, coupled with his habit of seclusion, rarely venturing out to stir trouble, enemies have nearly disappeared.
Naturally, no one would bother trying to confront him unnecessarily.
After safely storing the three Gold Armor-Breaking Talismans, Xu Ping began meditating to restore his Mana.
Given his current cultivation, using third-rank talismans for the Three Talents Talisman Array consumes a great deal of Mana.
...
Several hours later.
The Mana in Xu Ping’s Dantian has fully recovered.
"Phew!"
Xu Ping opened his eyes, slowly exhaling a breath of turbid air.
Just as he stood up, the Divine Sense transmission from the Water Lake Rat entered his mind.
"Master, Hongyi has arrived!"
"Hongyi?"
Xu Ping’s expression shifted, responding via Divine Sense, "Understood, I’ll go to welcome him now."
After tidying his robe, he stepped out of the cultivation chamber to welcome Hongyi.
...
In the pavilion.
Xu Ping poured a cup of Spirit Tea for Hongyi, smilingly asking, "Has Fellow Daoist Hong arrived today because you found the items I entrusted to you previously?"
"Precisely."
Hongyi picked up the teacup, smiling and nodding.
After drinking the Spirit Tea, he handed Xu Ping a storage bag: "After a year, I’ve finally prepared all the items Fellow Daoist Xu needed."
Xu Ping took the storage bag, scanning it with his Divine Sense.
He saw that it was filled with Quasi-Tier Three Spirit Iron Profound Crystal Iron, Quasi-Tier Three Spiritual Ore Flame Sun Crystal... and some auxiliary materials.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Hong, it’s very complete, and the quantity meets the requirements." Xu Ping gratefully cupped his hands.
He couldn’t help but think: The Fake Pill cultivators are indeed quick; if it were cultivators like Duan Shuang and Gong Yang at the Foundation Establishment level, gathering so many Quasi-Tier Three materials would take years.
"This is a reward for Fellow Daoist Hong." Xu Ping flipped his palm, and a Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman appeared in his hand.
He then handed it to Hongyi.

chapters.title: Chapter 255 - 186: The Annihilation of the Meng Clan (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 255: Chapter 186: The Annihilation of the Meng Clan (Part 2)
"Fellow Daoist Xu is indeed too courteous."
Hongyi’s smile grew brighter, as he gladly accepted the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman, then confidently patted his chest and assured,
"If Fellow Daoist Xu has any similar affairs in the future, feel free to come to me. I will certainly do my utmost to handle everything impeccably for you."
"Certainly." Xu Ping laughed heartily.
Fake Pill masters are somewhat more useful than Foundation Establishment cultivators, so there will surely be a need to approach Hongyi again in the future.
After Hongyi stored the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman, he asked curiously, "You bought Black Crystal Iron and Flame Sun Crystal, along with so many auxiliary materials, is it for refining an artifact embryo?"
"I indeed have that idea."
Xu Ping did not conceal and frankly admitted.
After all, his third-rank lower grade Artifact Refining Technique inheritance was acquired through trading with Hongyi, so there was nothing to hide.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, you must know that in the path of cultivation, cultivation is the most important, it is the foundation of everything. You must remember not to get too obsessed with various techniques." Hongyi kindly reminded.
In his view, Xu Ping, being a Third-rank Talisman Master, also has quite profound Alchemy skills.
Now, he wants to delve into the field of artifact refining, which might exceed the capacity of an ordinary person.
After all, a cultivator’s energy is extremely limited, and being able to bring one skill to a high level is already commendable outside of daily arduous cultivation.
If one is greedy for too much, it may inevitably have a negative impact on one’s own cultivation.
"Thank you for the reminder, Fellow Daoist Hong. I just want to try and will not be obsessed with it." Xu Ping replied with a smile.
"Hmm."
Hongyi slightly nodded and did not continue persuading.
After all, the reminder is out of consideration, but how Xu Ping chooses is ultimately his own matter.
After the two chatted for a while, Hongyi brought up the ’Alliance for Eradicating Demons’.
"Most demons have been eliminated through the joint efforts of cultivators from the three countries, with only a few still lingering near the Nine Nether Elder’s Ruins Deserted Island."
"I believe it won’t be long before all the demons are cleared, allowing exploration of the Nine Nether Elder’s ruins."
At this point, an irresistible hint of enthusiasm flashed in Hongyi’s eyes.
After all, in that deserted island ruins, there is likely the Transformation Pill Fruit he dreams of, which can’t help but make his heart race.
"Is that so?"
"It seems Fellow Daoist Hong is one step closer to finding the Transformation Pill Fruit!" Xu Ping congratulated with a smile.
Although he personally lacks interest in exploring the Nine Nether Elder’s ruins, the demon eradication is indeed something worth celebrating.
"It is still too early to discuss this matter."
Though Hongyi spoke these words, his lips involuntarily curled slightly, forming a restrained smile.
After all, he now possesses four powerful third-rank talismans, making his advantage over other Fake Pill masters quite significant.
"By the way, there is another important matter, Fellow Daoist Xu should pay more attention recently."
Hongyi seemed to suddenly recall something, slightly furrowing his brow as his tone turned serious, "In the vicinity of Purple Bamboo Mountain, the Fake Pill faction Meng family suffered a massacre!"
"The Meng family’s Fake Pill ancestor, along with all the Foundation Establishment and Qi Cultivation stage clansmen were all brutally killed."
"Meng family?"
Hongyi’s mention of the massacre caught Xu Ping’s attention.
Although the Meng family is ten thousand miles away from Purple Bamboo Mountain, for Fake Pill masters, or even Golden Core masters, it’s just a few days’ journey.
They indeed count as a nearby faction.
Moreover, the Meng family’s Fake Pill ancestor Mengyang even visited to request third-rank talismans, but was refused by Xu Ping.
"As for the details of the Meng family’s extinction, I know little. It is said that the perpetrator first ambushed Mengyang, then went to their clan grounds and killed all the Meng family’s cultivators."
Hongyi shared everything he knew without reservation.
"Oh?"
Xu Ping’s eyes gleamed.
During the chaotic period of demon eradication, those sneaky and sinister won’t be few.
But the extinction of the Meng family is different.
The perpetrator must have some deep enmity with the Meng family, otherwise, there would not be such an elaborate attempt to annihilate their entire clan.
Seeing Xu Ping slightly change color, Hongyi quickly reassured, "But Fellow Daoist Xu need not worry excessively, the annihilation of the Meng family was likely carried out by their enemies.
"Just pay some attention since the Meng family is not far from Purple Bamboo Mountain."
"I understand." Xu Ping cupped hands to express gratitude to Hongyi.
