The perpetrator able to destroy the Meng family is at least a Fake Pill cultivator, with a reasonable probability of being a Golden Core cultivator.
...
...
After Hongyi left.
Xu Ping held the teacup in his right hand and stared at the Spiritual Tea inside, which had long cooled, falling into deep thought.
The extinction of the Meng family, although likely due to enemies seeking revenge, the proximity to Purple Bamboo Mountain poses a potential danger, making Xu Ping dare not slacken, requiring precautions.
If the perpetrator is a Golden Core cultivator, especially a Middle Stage Golden Core cultivator, that would be troublesome.
Xu Ping looked up, his vision obstructed by the pavilion, but his Divine Sense quickly spread like a tide, instantly covering the entire Thousand Leaves Mountain, carefully sensing the two protective arrays on the mountain.
"The arrays are still relatively weak." Xu Ping sighed slightly.
Though he cleverly deployed the arrays to cooperate and enhance each other, achieving a quasi-third-rank level.
But a quasi-third-rank array is still somewhat weak against Golden Core cultivators.
"If the Mountain Protection Array on Thousand Leaves Mountain could be replaced with a third-rank array, then true peace of mind could be achieved." Xu Ping thought silently.
If a third-rank lower-grade array could be set up, combined with his talismans, he wouldn’t be afraid even of Middle Stage Golden Core cultivators.
As for Late-Stage Golden Core or Golden Core Perfection cultivators, they are not within Xu Ping’s consideration.
After all, combining cultivators from the three countries, there are only a dozen or so such Golden Core masters.
The existence here would be notable even for Nascent Soul cultivators.
"But my current array skills cannot reach third-rank, at most only quasi-third-rank, and more importantly, there’s no array source."
Thinking of these, Xu Ping couldn’t help but frown deeply, feeling troubled.
Actually, with his current array skills, he’s already very close to third-rank. If he calms down and diligently studies, with the mysterious panel power, breaking through to third-rank is not entirely impossible.
But the array source problem is more difficult to solve.
Using Purple Bamboo Mountain’s large second-stage spirit vein for setting up a quasi-third-rank array is barely adequate.
Yet, to set up a third-rank array, even just a lower-grade third-rank array, the spirit power from this vein is far from sufficient.
Moreover, the large second-stage upper-grade spirit vein at Purple Bamboo Mountain isn’t his alone to enjoy,
"If it could be upgraded to a quasi-third-rank spirit vein, setting up a lower-grade third-rank array would be a breeze." Xu Ping muttered.
"Is there a method to upgrade the spirit vein?" Xu Ping pondered.
"I seem to remember that in the ’Hundred Arts of Immortal Cultivation’, ’Geomancers’ have the ability to survey terrains, geomancy, and Spiritual Qi distribution." A flash of insight occurred to Xu Ping.
’Geomancers’ are considered a niche among the Hundred Arts of Immortal Cultivation.
Generally, only those large sects with deep foundations might invest resources to train one or two geomancers.
And the trained geomancer grades are usually not too high.
To find a geomancer capable of upgrading a second-stage upper-grade large spirit vein, they must at least reach quasi-third-rank level.
Are there quasi-third-rank geomancers in Yue Country?
"Maybe I can ask Yang Hong." Xu Ping thought.
Yang Hong, being an elder of Luoyun Sect, should know about geomancers, even if they don’t have a quasi-third-rank geomancer, they might have the corresponding inheritance.
Perhaps it can be traded for when the time comes.

chapters.title: Chapter 256 - 187: The Waterlake Rat Breaks Through to Tier 2 Mid-grade
chapters.content:
Chapter 256: Chapter 187: The Waterlake Rat Breaks Through to Tier 2 Mid-grade
If the spirit vein of Purple Bamboo Mountain can be successfully upgraded to a quasi-tier three, it would certainly bring numerous benefits.
Besides being able to arrange formations, more importantly, it will be an excellent place for breaking through to the Golden Core in the future.
After all, as long as a Spirit Gathering Array is placed in the right location, enhancing the concentration of Spiritual Qi in a spot on Thousand Leaves Mountain to a third-rank level is not a difficult task.
It can be described as killing two birds with one stone!
Xu Ping thought silently for a long time, and gradually had a plan in his mind.
With a light flip of his palm, a Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman instantly appeared in his hand.
Then he injected a trace of Mana into it.
In an instant, the talisman flickered, and Xu Ping began to send a message to Yang Hong.
However, after waiting for half an hour, there was no response from Yang Hong.
Xu Ping had no choice but to store the Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman away.
But after sending the message, the talisman would still alert the other party.
There’s no rush to wait for a moment.
Although he had to be on guard against the mysterious person who had previously wiped out the Meng clan, there was no need to be overly anxious.
Whether the person would target him is still unknown, and besides, he holds both the Three Talents Talisman Array and the powerful Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman.
Even if facing a cultivator in the Middle Stage of Golden Core, he is confident in resisting to some extent.
Xu Ping waved his sleeve and, after storing the teacup and teapot on the stone table, came to the spirit fields.
Looking at the Water Lake Mouse busy in the spirit fields, Xu Ping couldn’t help but touch his chin.
"In one or two months, the Water Lake Mouse should reach the peak of Second-stage Lower Grade, and then it can start attempting to break through to Second-stage Middle Grade."
He purchased materials for refining the Artifact Embryo mainly to practice and become a real Quasi-Tier Three Artifact Refiner, so he can directly refine the magic sword then.
The only thing missing now is the demon fire from the Water Lake Mouse.
"Master."
At this moment, the Water Lake Mouse also noticed Xu Ping and couldn’t help but show a flattering smile on its face.
"Hmm."
Xu Ping nodded slightly, originally wanting to give it some pressure, but after thinking carefully, he decided to let it go, "Keep working!"
Upon saying that, he turned and walked to the cultivation chamber.
...
...
Time passed quietly, and a month flew by in the blink of an eye.
Wangyue Mountain, Wind Night Pavilion.
The array that originally covered the sky above the Wind Night Pavilion suddenly began to flicker on and off.
The next moment.
Crack!
Cracks, dense like a spiderweb, quickly spread across the protective shield of the array.
Boom!
A deafening roar echoed, as if the heavens and earth trembled with it.
The array that protected the Wind Night Pavilion for years suddenly shattered.
A vast and unparalleled wave of Spiritual Qi centered on the Wind Night Pavilion surged like a raging tide in all directions.
This force was too powerful, and wherever it reached, countless pavilions, towers, palaces, and terraces were mercilessly overturned, with bricks and rubble flying all over the sky.
"Ah!"
"Help!"
...
The screams and cries for help rang out one after another, echoing across the entire Wangyue Mountain.
Countless Qi Cultivators were caught off guard by this sudden disaster, and were violently crushed into the ground by collapsing buildings.
For a time, the Wind Night Pavilion was filled with misery, and the scene was unbearable to behold.
"Who dares to destroy my Sect Array?!" An angry shout, filled with shock and fury, exploded like thunder from the depths of the Wind Night Pavilion.
In an instant, a brilliant Escape Light shot out from the depths of the Wind Night Pavilion, with the powerful pressure of a Fake Pill Realm spreading tangibly in all directions, suppressing all.
In mid-air, Lv Yuhui’s expression was grim, and he spread his Divine Sense with all his might. The tragic scene within the Wind Night Pavilion flooded into his mind, making his face turn incredibly pale with rage.
The array was broken too quickly; even if he wanted to stop it, he was powerless to reverse the situation.
"Hahaha, today is the day your Wind Night Pavilion meets its doom!"
At this moment, a mysterious figure tightly shrouded in a black robe slowly rose into the air, letting out a sinister laugh.
"Such arrogant words!"
Lv Yuhui’s eyes widened with anger, the killing intent in his eyes burned like a blazing fire.
Sensing the aura of a fellow Fake Pill Realm cultivator from the opponent, his heart was filled with boundless killing intent, yet he forced himself to restrain it.
After all, both being in the Fake Pill Realm, there was no absolute level of overwhelming power between them.
Moreover, for the other party to so easily destroy the carefully arranged Quasi-Tier Three array of Wind Night Pavilion, their strength must not be underestimated.
With the slightest carelessness, the entire Wind Night Pavilion, including himself, was highly likely to perish here.
"Who on earth are you? Why did you destroy our sect’s formation without reason?"
Lv Yuhui forcibly suppressed the surging killing intent in his heart and asked coldly, his voice as icy as frost.
"The dead don’t need to know!"
The black-robed figure sneered disdainfully, then quickly clasped his hands together, causing Mana to surge madly around him.
In an instant, streams of pitch-black airflow appeared out of thin air.
In the blink of an eye, a massive black spiritual power arrow, dozens of meters long and formed by the black airflow, with overwhelming pressure, shot towards Lv Yuhui like a meteor.
"Boasting ignorantly!"
Lv Yuhui snorted coldly, the Spiritual Qi around him surging like a raging ocean.
A magic long sword emitting a cold light appeared in his hand, the blade gleaming with a chilling light, seemingly capable of easily tearing through space.
With one hand holding the sword, he infused it with power and swung it fiercely.
A dazzling golden sword light burst from the magic long sword like lightning.
This golden sword light carried an extremely terrifying spiritual power wave, with an unstoppable momentum, slashing fiercely towards the black spiritual power arrow.
Boom!
The golden sword light and the black spiritual power arrow collided fiercely, erupting in a thunderous roar.

chapters.title: Chapter 257 - 187: Waterlake Rat Breaks Through to Tier 2 Mid-grade (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 257: Chapter 187: Waterlake Rat Breaks Through to Tier 2 Mid-grade (Part 2)
The black aura surged, and Sword Qi pierced through!
The black arrows and golden sword light intertwined, wildly devouring each other. The collision of Spiritual Power generated intense shockwaves, sweeping out like a hurricane.
In the end, both dissipated into nothingness.
"Is this all you’ve got?" The shadowy figure in black robes spoke with mockery in his tone.
Lv Yuhui said nothing but stared at the opponent with a grave expression.
The opposing Magic Technique could contend with his full-force strike using a Magical Artifact without yielding, a terrifying strength far beyond his imagination.
But the situation was dire, leaving him no room for retreat. He had to fight to the death, perhaps there was still a glimmer of hope.
"Cut!"
Lv Yuhui let out a long cry to the heavens, his Mana bursting like a volcanic eruption.
The longsword in his hand seemed to sense its master’s determination, emitting an exhilarating screech.
When his aura reached its peak, a sword strike was unleashed.
Facing this fierce attack, the shadowy figure did not panic, leisurely summoning a shield at the level of a Magical Artifact.
As soon as the shield appeared, it emitted a powerful wave of Spiritual Power.
At the moment of their battle.
"Kill! Leave no one alive!"
Over twenty black-robed Foundation Establishment Cultivators darted like phantoms among the disciples of Wind Night Pavilion.
Their Magical Artifacts glinted with spiritual light, each strike claiming a life.
For a moment, cries of battle and screams of agony intertwined within Wind Night Pavilion.
The Foundation Establishment elders of Wind Night Pavilion fought desperately, but the gap in strength was too vast.
These black-robed individuals cooperated seamlessly, their attacks fierce, clearly superior to average Foundation Establishment Cultivators.
The cultivators of Wind Night Pavilion gradually fell into despair, the shadow of death looming like a dark cloud over the entire pavilion.
"Damn it!"
Lv Yuhui saw this scene from the sky, his heart burning with urgency.
He knew well if he couldn’t quickly deal with the black-robed Fake Pill Cultivator before him, Wind Night Pavilion would be utterly doomed.
At this moment, he disregarded everything else, his body churning out Spiritual Power, radiating brilliant light.
He gripped the longsword with both hands, lifted it high, and shouted, "Wind Night Sword Skill—Sky-splitting Slash!"
A massive Sword Qi soared into the sky as if to rip the heavens asunder.
The Sword Qi contained destructive power and roared towards the shadowy figure.
The surrounding Spiritual Qi was disturbed into chaos wherever it passed.
The shadowy figure finally felt the immense power, his expression turning serious.
"Defend!"
He formed a Magic Technique with his hands and shouted lowly.
The shield at the level of a Magical Artifact flared brightly, a thick black barrier suddenly appearing in front of him, mysterious runes flowing over its surface.
Boom!
As the black barrier ascended, Sword Qi struck the shield, emitting a deafening boom.
The massive impact caused the surrounding ground to tremble, countless stones shaken into the air.
The Sword Qi and barrier remained deadlocked, unable to overcome each other for some time.
But Lv Yuhui’s strike consumed considerable Spiritual Power, his face paled, his breath became ragged.
The shadowy figure was also struggling, maintaining this powerful defensive Magical Artifact cost him effort too, sweat beaded on his forehead.
"This swordsmanship is extraordinary, at least at the third-stage level!" The shadowy figure felt amazed.
A Fake Pill Cultivator actually mastered a third-stage Sword Technique, truly remarkable.
However, just then, a shadow silently assaulted Lv Yuhui from behind.
"Die!"
A purple Magical Artifact short sword, shimmering with darkness, carried the pressure of a Golden Core’s power and stabbed at Lv Yuhui’s back.
"Not good!"
Lv Yuhui’s expression changed dramatically, a hint of fear flashed in his eyes.
He truly did not expect a Golden Core Cultivator to ambush him.
It was too late to dodge now.
Crack!
The protective spiritual light on his body shattered like fragile glass.
The purple Magical Artifact short sword penetrated Lv Yuhui’s back effortlessly, embedding deeply into his body, mercilessly tearing through his internal organs, then protruded from his chest, unleashing a shower of blood.
"Ugh!"
Lv Yuhui spat a mouthful of blood, his aura rapidly dwindling.
He moved his lips, attempting to say something.
Yet the purple Magical Artifact short sword suddenly swung back, directly severing his head.
Lv Yuhui stared with eyes unclosed in death, as his body and the magical artifact plummeted down.
"Sect Leader!!"
The cultivators of the Wind Night Pavilion witnessed this scene, their eyes filled with despair and grief.
"Leave no one alive!"
The Golden Core Cultivator, shrouded in dark mist, issued a cold command to the shadowy figure in black robes.
"Yes!"
The shadowy figure in black robes acknowledged, directly charging towards the disciples of Wind Night Pavilion.
With Fake Pill cultivators joining the battlefield, the already overwhelmingly disadvantaged disciples of Wind Night Pavilion completely collapsed!
In less than half an hour, they were all slaughtered cleanly, leaving nothing but corpses on the ground!
"Next..."
The Golden Core Cultivator shrouded in black mist turned his gaze towards Purple Bamboo Mountain, a cruel curve forming at the corner of his mouth.
...
...
A month later.
Cultivation Room.
"Master!"
The Water Lake Rat, two zhang tall, wore a fawning smile on its face.
"Hmm!"
Xu Ping nodded, his Divine Sense surged forth, carefully examining the Water Lake Rat.
’Second-stage Lower Grade peak, stable and long-lasting aura, has a fair chance to break through to Second-stage Middle Grade!’ Xu Ping nodded secretly in his heart.
"Get on the stone bed!"
At Xu Ping’s command, the Water Lake Rat swiftly climbed onto the stone bed.
"Open your mouth!"
Another command was issued, and the Water Lake Rat obediently opened its mouth.
Xu Ping flicked his finger, and several Pills he meticulously crafted entered the Water Lake Rat’s mouth.
"Next, operate your demonic power with all your might, and break through the barrier in one go." Xu Ping calmly instructed.
"Gulp!"
"Understood, Master!"
The Water Lake Rat swallowed the Pills, nodding heavily, then shut its eyes tightly, its demonic power beginning to flow like a surging undercurrent.
As it operated its cultivation technique, the surrounding Spiritual Qi instantly became active.
Threads of it gathered toward it, gradually forming large whirlpools of Spiritual Qi, swirling around the Water Lake Rat incessantly.
Time passed silently, and the aura on the Water Lake Rat slowly rose, but at the critical moment just before breaking through, its aura suddenly halted, making no further progress.
The Water Lake Rat’s body trembled slightly, its forehead beading with large sweat droplets, clearly encountering a massive obstacle.
Xu Ping’s expression slightly tensed, his Divine Sense unfurling without hesitation to probe the Water Lake Rat’s condition.
Although breaking through from Second-stage Lower Grade to Second-stage Middle Grade isn’t as risky as breaking through from First Rank to Second-stage,
a failure in breakthrough would definitely result in severe depletion of Primordial Qi.
With Xu Ping’s powerful Divine Sense’s insight, he quickly found the sticking point that had trapped the Water Lake Rat.
It turned out that the bottleneck from the Water Lake Rat’s dual-bloodline was too solidly entrenched, and its own foundation and demonic power were inadequate to break through this difficult hurdle.
"In that case, external force it is!"
Xu Ping flipped his palm, the Token controlling the Array appearing in his hand. He then pinched a Magic Technique with both hands, injecting a thread of Mana into it.
Instantly, the Array radiated intense light, more Spiritual Qi flooding towards the Water Lake Rat like a torrent.
However, even so, the Water Lake Rat remained stuck at the bottleneck, unable to make any progress.
"Open your mouth!"
Xu Ping’s eyes flashed; without a hint of hesitation, he flipped his palm to take out a Second-stage Upper Grade Demon Core, flicking his finger.
The Demon Core transformed into a stream of light, entering the Water Lake Rat’s mouth instantly.
The Water Lake Rat swallowed the Demon Core, then its Demon Fire began continuously refining the Demon Core.
Boom!
The Water Lake Rat felt a surge of vast and pure energy explode within its body.
Not daring to be the slightest bit slack, it quickly operated its demonic power, guiding this energy to breach the boundary.
With the aid of the Demon Core’s energy, the once unbreakable barrier started to show tiny cracks.
"Boom!"
Alongside a dull and heavy rumbling sound, the momentum on the Water Lake Rat’s body erupted like a volcanic eruption.
A tremendously powerful force radiated outward from it, like ripples, spreading in all directions.
The tables and chairs in the cultivation room were shaken askew, the runes on the walls flickering erratically, barely holding back the impact force.
"Second-stage Middle Grade!!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 258 - 188: Geomancer Legacy
chapters.content:
Chapter 258: Chapter 188: Geomancer Legacy
"Second-stage Middle Grade!"
Xu Ping gazed at the Shuize Mouse that had successfully broken through the realm, a faint smile unconsciously forming at the corner of his mouth.
He had invested a significant amount of precious resources for this Shuize Mouse’s advancement.
Fortunately, his efforts hadn’t been in vain; the Shuize Mouse had smoothly achieved a breakthrough to the Second-stage Middle Grade realm.
"Master!"
The Shuize Mouse opened its eyes, swiftly jumped down from the stone bed, then nuzzled Xu Ping’s pants with its head affectionately, a look of excitement and flattery on its face.
Although the master often threatened to stew it, he was actually quite generous.
Bam!
Xu Ping gave it a kick!
"Go clean yourself up!"
The mouse was covered in blood stains, which Xu Ping found somewhat disgusting.
Even after getting kicked, the Shuize Mouse continued to have a flattering smile on its face. Its demonic power gently swept around, instantly clearing the stains.
"You’ve grown quite a bit!"
Xu Ping looked up and down at the rejuvenated Shuize Mouse.
Its body had grown from the original height of two zhang to nearly three zhang, and its half-blue, half-red fur looked increasingly deep in color.
It was unknown how much its demon fire power had increased.
"Try out your demon fire!" Xu Ping ordered immediately.
"Okay!"
The Shuize Mouse nodded obediently, and its demonic power surged around it as a ball of purple demon fire spewed from its mouth.
Boom!
Instantly, the temperature in the cultivation room skyrocketed, and the scorching heat seemed to melt the stone bed.
Fortunately, the cultivation room had a powerful array in place; otherwise, the entire room might have been reduced to ashes in the raging flames.
"Not bad!"
Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction.
This ball of demon fire was indeed formidable, comparable to the demon fire of a Second-stage Upper Grade demon beast.
Even with his physical body, he could feel his skin getting hot.
If enhanced with an array, this demon fire should be enough to craft an artifact embryo.
However, the Shuize Mouse had just broken through to the Second-stage Middle Grade, and its cultivation was still unstable.
It would be wiser to craft the artifact embryo once its cultivation stabilizes.
...
...
Time flew by, and half a month passed in the blink of an eye, with the Shuize Mouse’s cultivation thoroughly stabilized.
Xu Ping was about to attempt crafting an artifact embryo when Yang Hong visited him, bringing significant news concerning the "Earth Master."
Inside a pavilion.
Yang Hong leisurely took a sip of Spirit Tea, then slowly began to speak:
"Fellow Daoist Xu, the Earth Master’s lineage has always been incredibly niche. Even with Luoyun Sect’s deep accumulation, we have only recorded a scroll of Quasi-Tier Three inheritance."
"Quasi-Tier Three inheritance?"
Hearing this, a trace of undisguisable disappointment flickered deep within Xu Ping’s eyes.
If it was only a Quasi-Tier Three inheritance, it might not include the method to upgrade a Second-stage large Spirit Vein to a Quasi-Tier Three Spirit Vein.
Nonetheless, Xu Ping still decided to make the exchange, believing that having something was better than nothing.
"Thank you, Elder Yang, I will exchange for it!" He suppressed his emotions and expressed his gratitude with a cupped fist.
"It’s a small matter, not worth mentioning." Yang Hong smiled and waved his hand dismissively.
The two concluded the transaction with two Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans.
After completing the transaction, they chatted a bit more.
After the transaction, they had a few more casual conversations.
Suddenly, Xu Ping shifted the conversation to Purple Bamboo Mountain.
"Elder Yang, Purple Bamboo Mountain was originally occupied by the ill-intentioned Shuize Sect. Thankfully, your sect eradicated Shuize Sect, removing a major threat to the cultivation realm in Yue Country."
Xu Ping discreetly flattered him before continuing, "Now that Purple Bamboo Mountain naturally belongs to your sect, I’ve been living here for quite some time and have grown accustomed to the environment. I’m thinking about purchasing it; how much Spirit Stone would that require?"
"Purchase it?"
Upon hearing this, an unexpected expression appeared on Yang Hong’s face.
Indeed, after Luoyun Sect destroyed Shuize Sect, according to customary practice, all Shuize Sect’s properties, including numerous spiritual lands, were transferred to Luoyun Sect.
However, in reality, Luoyun Sect had only sent people to take over a Fourth Rank and a Third-rank Upper Grade Spirit Vein of Shuize Sect.
It’s not that they didn’t want to acquire all the Third-rank Spirit Veins, but rather the sect was short-handed and unable to manage everything.
Third-rank Spirit Veins were one thing, not to mention the Second-stage Spirit Veins.
Thus, although Luoyun Sect nominally owned all of Shuize Sect’s Spirit Veins, in reality, they didn’t have the capacity to manage them.
For some loose cultivators who secretly occupied various Spirit Veins of Shuize Sect, Luoyun Sect mostly turned a blind eye and never sought to charge them rent.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, although we at Luoyun Sect nominally control all Shuize Sect’s Spirit Veins, the sect’s affairs are many and varied..." Yang Hong said meaningfully, squinting slightly.
"I understand what Elder Yang means, but I still wish to purchase Purple Bamboo Mountain!" Xu Ping cupped his hands and said.
He naturally understood the reasoning. Given Luoyun Sect’s current size and manpower, Second-stage Spirit Veins like Purple Bamboo Mountain were essentially in a semi-abandoned state.
Even if he resided there for a hundred or eighty years, Luoyun Sect would likely not come demanding rent.
However, the problem was that Purple Bamboo Mountain was still nominally Luoyun Sect’s property.
If he expended significant effort and resources to successfully upgrade the Spirit Vein here to a Quasi-Tier Three Spirit Vein,

chapters.title: Chapter 259 - 188: Earthmaster Inheritance (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 259: Chapter 188: Earthmaster Inheritance (Part 2)
If the Luoyun Sect suddenly comes to reclaim it in the future, then all his efforts would be in vain, and everything he worked for would go up in smoke.
"Alright then!"
Yang Hong pondered for a moment, then nodded and said, "Although the sale of Purple Bamboo Mountain isn’t a major affair, I must still return to the sect to report and prepare a Spirit Contract."
If it were another Foundation Establishment Cultivator asking to buy the spiritual land of Purple Bamboo Mountain, he would definitely ignore it, but after all, Xu Ping is a Third-stage Talisman Master.
To the Luoyun Sect, a Third-stage Talisman Master is far more valuable than a Golden Core cultivator.
"Thank you, Elder Yang!" Xu Ping’s face was full of gratitude, and he cupped his hands in sincere thanks.
"It’s nothing."
Yang Hong smiled faintly and continued, "In my estimation, Purple Bamboo Mountain would sell for at most twenty to thirty thousand Spirit Stones, with Fellow Daoist Xu’s wealth, purchasing it is more than affordable."
"Twenty to thirty thousand Spirit Stones?"
Hearing this price, a hint of surprise flashed in Xu Ping’s eyes.
This price is indeed a bargain, almost equivalent to ten years’ rent.
Thanks to the current unique situation, he has the hope of acquiring it at such a low price.
Under normal circumstances, it would cost at least a hundred and fifty thousand Spirit Stones just to make the Luoyun Sect take a look.
"Then I’ll eagerly await good news from Elder Yang." Xu Ping chuckled, enthusiastically refilling Yang Hong’s cup with Spirit Tea.
...
...
Half an hour later, Yang Hong departed Thousand Leaves Mountain on an Escape Light.
The Escape Light sliced through the sky, leaving behind a faint streak before quickly disappearing into the horizon.
Meanwhile, back with Xu Ping, as soon as Yang Hong left, he eagerly entered the cultivation room, taking out the jade slip that recorded the ’Earth Master’ inheritance.
"Let’s see if there’s any method to upgrade the Spirit Vein in this inheritance!"
A hint of excitement flashed in Xu Ping’s eyes, and he immediately used his Divine Sense to carefully investigate it.
Time silently passed, and several hours went by in a flash.
Finally, Xu Ping slowly withdrew his Divine Sense from the jade slip, his eyes full of exhilaration: "There are actually so many methods, all capable of upgrading the Spirit Vein!"
This Earth Master inheritance, though only a Quasi-Tier Three inheritance, recorded three methods to upgrade Second-stage large Spirit Veins to Quasi-Tier Three Spirit Veins.
First, by using an Array called "Purifying Spirit Nourishing Vein Array."
This type of Array can cleanse impurities in the Spirit Vein and rearrange the chaotic Spiritual Qi pathways, like giving the Spirit Vein a deep clean and nurture, aiding in the enhancement of the Spirit Vein’s level.
Second, through the ’Earth Master’s’ unique Secret Technique: Guide Spirit into Vein.
Performed during specific times, on a full moon night and during Spiritual Qi tides, the Earth Master casts a special Magic, connecting the Spiritual Qi channels between heaven and earth, guiding powerful external Spiritual Qi torrents into the Spirit Vein.
Third, by using a low-level Spiritual Beast known as "Spirit Worm."
It excels at digging underground, loosening the soil around the Spirit Vein to promote the circulation of Spiritual Qi.
Meanwhile, providing some Spiritual Objects for it to consume, the substances excreted by the Spirit Worm after digestion are rich in Spiritual Power, serving as high-quality fertilizer for the Spirit Vein, helping to enhance the quality of the Spirit Vein.
...
Although each of these three methods has its own wonders, the unfortunate part is that they require a very long time.
Under normal circumstances, it would take decades, even centuries, to successfully upgrade the Spirit Vein.
However, Xu Ping was not discouraged by this, instead, a bold idea emerged in his heart—he planned to implement all three methods simultaneously.
By coordinating three approaches, he might increase the speed of upgrading the Spirit Vein two or threefold.
More importantly, he has a skilled panel, as long as he practices ’Guide Spirit into Vein’ to a high enough realm.
The efficiency of his once implementation would be at least several times, if not more than ten times that of an ordinary person.
Moreover, he only plans to upgrade the Spirit Vein of Thousand Leaves Mountain to Quasi-Tier Three, places like Duan Shuang and Gong Yang’s cultivation sites aren’t within his consideration.
The ’Earth Master’ inheritance records that large Second-stage Upper Grade Spirit Veins sprawl extensively, independently upgrading a segment of the Spirit Vein is entirely doable.
All that’s needed is to set a partition Array on the Spirit Vein, to prevent the Spiritual Qi within the veins from circulating and dissipating.
In this way, the speed of his Spirit Vein upgrade would certainly be swift, and the success rate extremely high.
Very feasible!
"Before that, I still need to master the core Magic of the Earth Master, ’Earth Master’s Gaze.’" Xu Ping contemplated inwardly.
This Magic allows the Spirit Vein to present itself in unique colors and forms in the Earth Master’s eyes.
With this technique, the "Earth Master" can easily locate the precise location of the Spirit Vein, laying a solid foundation for subsequent operations on the Spirit Vein.
Suppressing his excitement, Xu Ping began to studiously learn ’Earth Master’s Gaze.’"
As for the Artifact Embryo crafting, it’s not urgent at this moment, and it’s not too late to craft it after learning the ’Earth Master’s Gaze.’
...
...
Meanwhile.
The Spiritual Boat carrying Yang Hong was racing through the sky like a meteor.
Wherever the Spiritual Boat passed, the air was swiftly sliced, producing a slight whistling sound.
As the Spiritual Boat flew like a lightning bolt over a desolate mountain and wilderness, a sudden change occurred!
Out of nowhere, a black Spiritual Power arrow tens of feet long, carrying terrifying Spiritual pressure that filled the air with fear, attacked Yang Hong rapidly like a prehistoric beast.
Wherever the Spiritual Power arrow passed, the surrounding Spiritual Qi was thrown into chaos.
"Not good!"
Yang Hong’s face drastically changed as he unhesitatingly summoned a special golden bell.
The golden bell rapidly expanded to ten feet tall in the wind, radiating brilliant golden light like a blazing sun suspended in the sky.
The golden bell enveloped Yang Hong and his Flying Boat securely, forming an impenetrable defensive barrier.
Boom!
The black Spiritual Power arrow slammed into the golden bell with a deafening roar, shaking the heavens and the earth.
A violent surge of Spiritual Qi spread out from the point of impact like ripples, resonating in all directions.
Under this fierce impact, the golden bell shook violently, its light flickering uncertainly, but ultimately, it blocked the Spiritual Power arrow outside.
"Who dares to ambush me here!" Yang Hong roared angrily, his voice filled with endless killing intent.
He stared fiercely at the barren mountain below, his eyes ablaze with fury.
"Hmph!"
With a cold snort, a figure in a black robe leapt from the barren mountain, emanating the aura of a Fake Pill, "Yang Hong, today is the day you die!"
Before the words were finished, the black-robed figure quickly formed a Seal Formation with his hands, chanting incantations under his breath.
Instantly, several black Spiritual Power arrows coalesced into formation like raindrops shooting toward Yang Hong, each arrow containing world-destroying power.
Yang Hong did not dare to be careless, controlling the golden bell to continue the defense.
Simultaneously, he changed the Spell in his hand, Spiritual rays gushing from his body, transforming into several spiritual snakes attacking the Fake Pill cultivator.
For a time, Spiritual Power raged in the sky as both sides clashed fiercely.
However, just as Yang Hong focused entirely on battling the Fake Pill cultivator, an indistinct black mist silently spread from the side.
Suddenly!
A purple Artifact short sword, radiating a cold and eerie light, shot from the black mist, carrying Golden Core Realm’s world-destroying mighty aura, it slashed fiercely toward Yang Hong.
"Golden Core cultivator!"
Yang Hong showed fear, alarms rang in his mind as he attempted to dodge but it was too late.
Boom!
In a flash, the Artifact short sword pierced through the golden bell’s defense with overwhelming momentum, eliciting a mournful cry from the bell as its light instantly dimmed.
And that short sword, with unabated might, pierced straight through Yang Hong’s chest.
"Puh!"
Yang Hong spat out a mouthful of blood, and his entire body was flung backwards like a kite with a broken string, crashing heavily onto the ground, while the golden bell and Spiritual Boat, both uncontrolled, also fell to the ground.
In the next instant.
A dark shadow darted from the black mist like lightning, arriving beside Yang Hong instantly.
This person grabbed Yang Hong’s head, Mana surged like a tide, sealing Yang Hong’s Mana and Sea of Consciousness in the blink of an eye, leaving him completely powerless to resist.

chapters.title: Chapter 260 - 189: The Mastermind Behind the Scenes
chapters.content:
Chapter 260: Chapter 189: The Mastermind Behind the Scenes
The next day.
Xu Ping was silently cultivating the ’Earth Master’s Gaze’ in the training room when the Divine Sense message of the Water Lake Rat penetrated the walls, directly entering his Sea of Consciousness.
"Master, Yang Hong has come again!"
"Yang Hong?"
Xu Ping’s hand abruptly paused, and he couldn’t help but be slightly stunned.
It had only been a day, and under normal circumstances, it should have been impossible for Yang Hong to return to the Luoyun Sect so quickly.
Could he have overlooked something important and forgotten to explain?
Thoughts flashed through Xu Ping’s mind like lightning. He immediately responded through Divine Sense transmission: "Understood, I will personally go to greet him."
Xu Ping tidied his robe slightly and then calmly walked out of the training room to meet Yang Hong.
...
Xu Ping arrived at the open space of Thousand Leaves Mountain and looked up, seeing Yang Hong’s Spiritual Boat quietly hovering above the array.
"Elder Yang, is there something that was not thoroughly explained?"
Xu Ping asked with a full-faced smile, while taking out the array token, gently waving it to manipulate the array and slowly reveal a passage.
"Indeed, there’s still one crucial matter that hasn’t been explained," Yang Hong nodded solemnly, then steadily controlled the Spiritual Boat to slowly descend onto the open ground.
"I wonder..."
Without the obstruction of the array, when Xu Ping clearly saw Yang Hong before him, his pupils suddenly constricted.
Yet, his face showed no change as he maintained a smile and continued to ask, "What exactly is the matter Elder Yang has yet to explain?"
"Why don’t we move to the pavilion and discuss it slowly?"
"Alright!" Yang Hong nodded in agreement.
"Please!"
Xu Ping made a gesture of invitation and then led the way.
Yang Hong followed unhurriedly behind.
At this moment, as he looked at Xu Ping, who was just a Zhang away in front of him, a sinister gleam flashed deep in his eyes.
However, just as he was secretly preparing to make a move, two arrays enveloping Thousand Leaves Mountain suddenly burst out with dazzling and intense spiritual light.
In an instant, a pressure akin to a mountain swept towards him overwhelmingly.
Under this immensely powerful pressure, he felt his body abruptly sink, as if burdened by weight of ten thousand jun.
Even the flow of mana in his Dantian became extremely obscured and difficult, every cycle seeming to break through multiple obstacles.
"Array suppression?" Yang Hong’s face instantly revealed a trace of panic.
But before he had time to take any countermeasures.
Rumble!
A gigantic Thunder Dragon, carrying with it an earth-shattering force, charged at him swiftly!
This Thunder Dragon was densely entwined with crackling arcs of electricity, and between its electric flashes, it exuded a terrifying aura seemingly capable of destroying the heavens and the earth, making one’s heart tremble.
"Tier-three talisman!" Yang Hong’s face was full of shock and horror.
How could he not realize that he had been completely exposed?
Yet he couldn’t comprehend why he had been exposed?
Though his disguise wasn’t the most sophisticated, it was not something a mere Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment could see through!
No time for further thought, his figure retreated as fast as lightning, trying to quickly distance himself from the Thunder Dragon.
Immediately after, he unsparingly summoned his treasure-level shield.
"Protect!"
He quickly formed seals with his hands, chanting in a low voice.
In a flash, spiritual light erupted, and a thick black barrier appeared abruptly in front of him.
On the surface of the black barrier, mysterious runes flowed slowly like lively fish, emitting a peculiar glow.
Rumble!
Just as the black barrier soared up.
The unbelievably powerful Thunder Dragon crashed into the barrier with unmatched force, producing a deafening roar, as if it would shatter the whole world.
In an instant, thunder radiated everywhere, the intense light akin to a tide spreading around, illuminating the entire world.
Buzz!
The tremendous impact made the shield tremble intensely, its concentrated black glow dimming instantly.
Meanwhile, the surrounding ground began to shake violently, with countless stones of different sizes flying high and scattering in all directions.
Were it not for the array being exerted to its fullest, the entire summit of Thousand Leaves Mountain might have been overturned by this terrifying impact.
The next moment.
"Crack."
Amidst a crisp shattering sound, the barrier in front of Yang Hong finally couldn’t bear the load and cracked.
"No good!"
Yang Hong’s expression instantly turned as pale as a sheet, his demeanor drastically changing.
He gritted his teeth and desperately drained all his mana, continuously infusing it into the treasure, attempting a final struggle.
Yet, it was all in vain. The Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman inherently contained the terrorizing power of a Golden Core expert.
Moreover, his mana was suppressed by at least twenty percent by the array, and at this moment, no matter how hard he tried to resist, it was like hitting a rock with an egg, utterly futile.
Boom!
The black shield finally shattered completely, disintegrating into countless fragments scattered into the air.
The purple Thunder Dragon smashed through the treasure shield with no resistance, directly and heavily hitting Yang Hong’s Protective Spiritual Light.
"Crackle!"
The Thunder Power erupted instantly, like a raging tide, easily shattering his Protective Spiritual Light and then forcefully rushing through to crash upon him.
"Boom!"
Yang Hong was instantly engulfed in thunderlight, his body uncontrollably flying backward dozens of Zhang away, crashing heavily onto a huge rock.
The massive impact shattered the rock into pieces, with fragments flying in all directions.
Moments later, the smoke and dust slowly dispersed.
"Cough cough... Pfft!"
A burly middle-aged man lay in disarray amidst the stones, coughing with difficulty, a mouthful of bright red blood involuntarily spouting from his mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 261 - 189: The Mastermind Behind the Scenes (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 261: Chapter 189: The Mastermind Behind the Scenes (Part 2)
At this moment, his body was charred black, his breath was in disarray, his Spiritual Power nearly exhausted, and his injuries extremely severe.
He struggled to get up, but under the suppression of the Array, he tried several times without success.
"Is it you?"
Upon seeing the true face of the middle-aged man, a trace of surprise flashed across Xu Ping’s face.
It turns out that the person masquerading as Yang Hong with ill intentions towards him was actually Elder Hao, a remnant of the Shuize Sect.
"I wasn’t looking for you, but you found me instead!"
A cold killing intent suddenly surged in Xu Ping’s eyes. The other party had once designed a trap to kill him using Core Formation Spiritual Objects, a deep enmity he had never forgotten!
Xu Ping’s figure flickered, like a ghost, he instantly approached.
His Mana surged furiously, transforming into a giant Mana hand that heavily struck Elder Hao’s Dantian.
"Boom!"
Elder Hao spat out a mouthful of fresh blood again, his face turning as pale as paper, and his aura quickly declined.
In such serious injuries, his eyes rolled back, and he fell into unconsciousness.
Xu Ping quickly stepped forward, continuously channeling streams of Mana into this person’s Sea of Consciousness and Dantian, sealing his Divine Sense and Mana.
He refrained from immediately killing the other party, naturally for the purpose of Soul Search.
On one hand, he wanted to find out if this Elder Hao had any other accomplices.
If there were, it would be best to catch them all in one go to prevent endless troubles.
On the other hand, it was to inquire about the whereabouts of Yang Hong.
This person dared to impersonate Yang Hong and was even in possession of Yang Hong’s Spiritual Boat, it was quite possible that Yang Hong had already fallen into his hands.
No matter what, Xu Ping needed to get to the bottom of this and give the Luoyun Sect an explanation.
Thinking of this, Xu Ping extended his right hand like an eagle claw, firmly grasping Elder Hao’s head.
"Soul-Searching Technique!"
With a soft shout, Xu Ping’s Divine Sense spread into his Sea of Consciousness, forcibly extracting his memories.
...
...
Outside the Array.
A mass of thick black fog filled the mountain valley.
Suddenly, the black fog surged, and a young cultivator in a green robe slowly emerged from it.
Upon closer inspection, it was actually Song Fei, who had fled to Hu Country and disappeared for a long time!
Song Fei looked towards the direction of Thousand Leaves Mountain, his eyes flickering with a cold, ghostly light: "Could it be that Xu Ping has discovered that Yang Hong was impersonated?"
At this moment, looking at the fully activated Array in Thousand Leaves Mountain, his expression was uncertain.
In fact, he had been eyeing Xu Ping for a long time!
But since the other party had never left Thousand Leaves Mountain, he hadn’t found an opportunity to strike.
Thousand Leaves Mountain had a strong protective Array, as solid as a stronghold, and coupled with Xu Ping holding a third-rank talisman of astonishing power.
Even though he had now broken through to become a Golden Core Cultivator, if he rashly attacked Thousand Leaves Mountain, he would not gain any advantage!
Thus, he set his mind on sabotaging the Array from within, just like when he destroyed Wind Night Pavilion.
It was at this moment that Yang Hong happened to arrive at Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Song Fei naturally set his eyes on Yang Hong!
The Luoyun Sect had issued a crusade order against the Song family, being the main culprit in destroying the Song family, with the Meng clan and Wind Night Pavilion merely as accomplices.
Although he couldn’t do anything about Luoyun Sect now, it didn’t stop him from collecting some interest.
The plan was well laid out, but who would’ve thought that as soon as Hao Jun, disguised as Yang Hong, stepped into Thousand Leaves Mountain, the Array would instantly activate at full force.
Judging by this situation, Hao Jun likely had been exposed; otherwise, this would never have occurred.
"Let’s wait and see!"
Song Fei glared at Thousand Leaves Mountain with resentment, then without hesitation, he activated the Escape Light, turning into a stream of light, disappearing into the distant horizon instantly.
After all, within the Array, Hao Jun with his Fake Pill cultivation was no match for the prepared Xu Ping.
...
Inside the Array.
"Song Fei!!"
After searching through all of Hao Jun’s memories, Xu Ping’s face instantly turned somber as water.
He truly hadn’t expected that the one eyeing him was actually Song Fei who had fled to Hu Country.
Even more unexpected was that the other party had already broken through to the Golden Core Realm.
"This is going to be a bit troublesome!" Xu Ping frowned, starting to ponder a countermeasure.
Song Fei was in hiding, while he was in the open, this situation was inherently unfavorable.
Moreover, the other party was a Golden Core Cultivator who would stop at nothing to achieve his goals, dealing with him was far from easy.
If it came to a direct confrontation, Xu Ping wasn’t afraid.
But his greatest worry was Song Fei lurking in some hidden place, waiting to launch a sneak attack.
After all, his Divine Sense was far less powerful than the other party’s, and trying to find Song Fei with his own strength was like finding a needle in a haystack.
"It seems now I can only notify the Luoyun Sect to have them pursue Song Fei." Xu Ping thought to himself.
Song Fei was already a wanted cultivator by the Luoyun Sect, and in addition to killing Yang Hong, an outer elder of the Luoyun Sect.
The Luoyun Sect certainly wouldn’t let this go easily.
However, not letting it go is one thing; being able to find Song Fei is another matter entirely.
If it was the previously flourishing Luoyun Sect, they’d surely chase down someone like Song Fei, who’s only in the Early Stage Golden Core, leaving him no escape above or below ground.
But now, the overall strength of the Luoyun Sect is much less than before, coupled with the complicated situation of Wanzhe Waters gathering many cultivators from three countries, a mixed bag of good and bad.
It’s really too difficult for the Luoyun Sect to find a Golden Core cultivator who intentionally hides himself!
It’s likely to be thunder without rain!
But at least some thunder is better than none, at least it might keep Song Fei cautious, not daring to make any moves for a while.
...
...
Ten days later.
Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"Xu Ping, come out and meet me!"
A mighty and powerful voice, like rolling thunder, pierced through the Mountain Protection Array, echoing clearly throughout the entire Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"The people of Luoyun Sect... have arrived!"
Xu Ping, who was silently cultivating in the cultivation room, suddenly opened his eyes.
Due to having no direct means to contact Luoyun Sect and Song Fei watching secretly outside, he didn’t dare leave easily, so he had previously asked Hongyi to contact Luoyun Sect on his behalf.
Xu Ping quickly got up, grabbed the unconscious Haojun from the corner, and strode to the open space on Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Then he took out the Restriction Token and gently waved it.
In an instant, the originally dense clouds gradually dispersed, and above the Array, an old man in purple robes stood proudly.
"Middle Stage of Golden Core peak!!"
Seeing the cultivation realm of the visitor, Xu Ping couldn’t help but be secretly amazed.
This person was only one step away from entering the realm of a major cultivation in the same rank, his status in Luoyun Sect must be extremely high.
"Junior Xu Ping, greets the senior of Luoyun Sect!" Xu Ping bowed respectfully.
Facing such a cultivator, he dared not be the least bit presumptuous.
"Hmm."
The silver-haired elderly man fixed his gaze on Xu Ping and asked in a deep voice, "You said you know who killed Yang Hong?"
"I know!"
With great respect, Xu Ping pointed to the unconscious Hao Jun in the corner and said, "Senior only needs to perform Soul Search and you’ll know."
Upon hearing this, the silver-haired elder showed no hesitation. In a flash, his figure disappeared, and then instantly reappeared in a completely different position, comfortably standing tall above the Array, wearing a purple robe.
An aura surged up within him, manifesting into a spectral hand, firmly grabbing Hao Jun’s head. The Divine Sense spread into his Sea of Consciousness, initiating a forced extraction of his memories.
Meanwhile, Xu Ping stood below, watching silently and respectfully.
The reason he had spared Hao Jun’s life was to allow the elder to perform a Soul Search.
On one hand, it was to ensure that his trump card was not revealed to Hao Jun.
If his hand had indeed been exposed, he would have unhesitatingly obliterated Hao Jun.
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 262 - 190: Purchasing Purple Bamboo Mountain
chapters.content:
Chapter 262: Chapter 190: Purchasing Purple Bamboo Mountain
A quarter of an hour later.
"The remnants of the Song family and the Shui Ze Sect!!"
After thoroughly searching through Haojun’s entire memory, the silver-haired elder’s eyes suddenly erupted with the most intense killing intent.
In an instant, the aura around him surged and rose frantically, an immense spiritual pressure, as if materialized, swept over the entire Thousand Leaves Mountain like a raging tsunami.
The gust of wind created by this spiritual pressure formed a violent hurricane, the roaring sound deafening.
On Thousand Leaves Mountain, those precious Spirit Plants and Spirit Medicines, under the rampage of this hurricane, their branches and leaves clashed against each other, emitting a dense "rustling" sound.
From Haojun’s memory, the silver-haired elder had already confirmed that Xu Ping did not lie.
Indeed, Song Fei colluded with the remnants of the Shui Ze Sect to assassinate Yang Hong.
However, this was essentially a mistaken attack, as their real target was actually Xu Ping.
"Is this the terrifying power of a cultivator at the peak of the Middle Stage of the Golden Core?"
Nearby, Xu Ping was facing this powerful spiritual pressure directly, sweating slightly, and was greatly shocked in his heart.
Even before making a move, the imposing power was already terrifying; once fully unleashed, its power would surely surpass even that of the Third-rank Middle Grade talisman, the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman.
Unless he could construct a Three-Talents Talisman Array with the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman, it was impossible to harm the opponent.
"Phew!"
Moments later, the silver-haired elder quickly resumed his composure, and the surging aura around him gradually began to recede.
He turned his gaze back to Xu Ping, his previously stern expression softened considerably, and his tone became gentle: "Thank you, Young Friend Xu, for telling the truth. If it weren’t for you, my Luoyun Sect might still be in the dark."
Although Yang Hong was harmed due to Xu Ping, the perpetrator was Song Fei and the remnants of the Shui Ze Sect, filled with hatred.
He wouldn’t irrationally transfer his anger to Xu Ping.
"Senior is too kind. Song Fei has also set his sights on me; I did this only for self-preservation."
Xu Ping replied humbly and respectfully, "Now that Song Fei is a Golden Core Cultivator, it’s truly difficult for me to contend with him. In desperation, I could only seek assistance from the Luoyun Sect."
"Song Fei dared to kill an outer elder of my Luoyun Sect; I will tear him to pieces and grind his bones to dust!" The silver-haired elder’s words were icy, exuding endless killing intent.
"With your intervention, Senior, Song Fei is like a cricket in autumn, not jumping around for many days." Xu Ping timely flattered.
"Young Friend Xu is not simple either. Your technique for concealing your cultivation is wonderfully ingenious.
It seems that most Fake Pill cultivators can’t perceive your true cultivation, and it’s no wonder you could see through Haojun’s disguise." The silver-haired elder spoke with profound eyes, his words filled with significance.
Hearing this, a slight bitter smile appeared on Xu Ping’s face: "Senior’s insight is as sharp as a torch, nothing can be hidden from you.
My humble means are really nothing to mention in front of you, Senior."
Knowing that the other could see through his true cultivation, Xu Ping didn’t feel particularly surprised nor worried about it.
After all, having reached the Late-Stage Foundation Establishment at his age was considered exceptionally gifted among cultivators.
But compared to his identity as a Third-stage Talisman Master, it seemed less remarkable.
"Young Friend Xu should not be overly modest. In my view, your aura is profound and dense, with mana immensely abundant, beyond what ordinary Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators can compare to." The silver-haired elder smiled slightly, his eyes bearing some admiration.
Before Xu Ping could respond, the silver-haired elder continued, "If Young Friend Xu has nothing else, then I will take Haojun back to the Luoyun Sect and further interrogate him to see if I can extract more information about Song Fei."
"Please wait, Senior."
Xu Ping hurriedly stopped the silver-haired elder who was preparing to leave and spoke with a face full of respect, "Junior does have one more matter to trouble Senior with..."
Then, Xu Ping recounted his intention to purchase the Spirit Vein of Purple Bamboo Mountain in full detail.
"This is not a difficult matter."
After listening to Xu Ping, the silver-haired elder’s expression remained calm, nodding indifferently, "After I return to the sect, I will arrange for someone to come and sign a Spirit Contract with Young Friend Xu."
A Second-stage Spirit Vein is nothing significant to the entire Luoyun Sect.
Given the current situation, it’s just as well to sell it.
"Thank you, Senior!" Joy flashed in Xu Ping’s eyes, and he immediately thanked with respect.
Given the elder’s status and position in the Luoyun Sect, this matter should be secure.
"I wonder what the price of the Spirit Vein of Purple Bamboo Mountain is approximately, so that I can make preparations and gather the Spirit Stones in advance." Xu Ping carefully inquired.
"About thirty thousand Spirit Stones." The silver-haired elder provided a price similar to Yang Hong’s previous estimate.
Upon hearing this offer, a huge burden in Xu Ping’s heart was finally relieved, and he fully relaxed.
Thus, he once again expressed his gratitude to the silver-haired elder with utmost respect.
"It’s a trivial matter, not worth mentioning."
The silver-haired elder waved his hand, "If Young Friend Xu has no other matters, then I will take my leave."
"Safe travels, Senior!" This time, Xu Ping did not attempt to detain, but instead bowed respectfully.
"Hmm."
The silver-haired elder nodded slightly in acknowledgment, casually lifting the unconscious Haojun, and then employing Escape Light, transformed into a stream of light, swiftly vanishing into the distant sky.
In the vast void, only a faint afterimage lingered.
Xu Ping gazed at the vast endless sky, feeling slightly at ease in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 263 - 190: Purchasing Purple Bamboo Mountain (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 263: Chapter 190: Purchasing Purple Bamboo Mountain (Part 2)
Now that the Luoyun Sect has stepped in to deal with Song Fei, it’s likely Song Fei won’t dare to act recklessly for the time being.
In this way, he can finally cultivate steadily for a period.
However, he still has several pressing matters to resolve at present.
Firstly, he needs to accelerate his progress in cultivating the "Spirit Silk Skill."
He must race against time to cultivate it to the Great Success Realm as soon as possible.
Only then can he successfully construct the Three-Talents Talisman Array using the "Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman" as the foundation.
With Song Fei’s mere Early Stage Golden Core cultivation, he would find it extremely difficult to resist the formidable Three-Talents Talisman Array; if not dead, he would be severely injured.
Only by completely solving the Song Fei issue in one go can potential future troubles be eliminated.
Secondly, he is eager to find a secret technique that can enhance his Divine Sense or locate rare Spirit Medicines.
Currently, although his Divine Sense far exceeds that of a Foundation Establishment Cultivator, there is still a gap when compared to a Fake Pill cultivator, let alone a Golden Core Cultivator.
Only by upgrading his Divine Sense to a sufficiently strong level will he be safe from Song Fei’s surprise attacks.
Moreover, only then can he better control the terrifying power contained within the Three-Talents Talisman Array built with the "Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman."
After all, the power of this array built around the "Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman" is truly overwhelming.
With his current Divine Sense strength, it’s really uncertain whether he can fully master it.
The last matter is to elevate the level of the Spirit Vein and start laying out a real Third-rank Array to thoroughly eliminate worries.
However, raising the Spirit Vein’s level is not something that can be done overnight. Currently, he hasn’t even successfully cultivated the "Earth Master’s Gaze," so everything must progress step by step.
As for matters like refining Artifact Embryos, those will have to be postponed.
...
...
After the elder with silver hair returned to the Luoyun Sect and truthfully reported the detailed situation, the Luoyun Sect quickly initiated a series of actions.
First, they significantly increased the bounty.
Regarding Song Fei, the Luoyun Sect issued an even more enticing bounty order.
Anyone who can provide accurate and true information about Song Fei will immediately receive a generous reward of five thousand Spirit Stones.
If someone successfully captures or kills Song Fei, the reward is even more astonishing—not only will they receive two magical artifacts but also an additional fifty thousand Spirit Stones.
Such a bounty might even tempt Golden Core cultivators.
However, whether they would actually fight to the death against Song Fei, a Golden Core cultivator, remains uncertain.
Besides this, the Luoyun Sect also organized a squad specifically for hunting down Song Fei.
This squad is composed of one Golden Core cultivator and several Fake Pill cultivators.
However, throughout the execution of their hunting mission, their harvest has been sparse.
They only managed to capture some remnants of the Shuize Sect, but regarding Song Fei’s whereabouts, they couldn’t find even the slightest trace.
As for the cultivators from the other two countries within Yue Country, most took a detached stance, just watching the commotion.
They generally believe that given the current situation of the Luoyun Sect, it’s entirely impossible for them to continuously invest a lot of manpower to hunt down Song Fei.
Moreover, the evil beings in the Wanzhe Waters have been gradually wiped out, and the exploration of the Nine Nether Elder’s mysterious relics is not far off.
Under such circumstances, the Luoyun Sect absolutely cannot afford to spend too much effort and resources on Song Fei.
It’s just a matter of time before this squad quietly disbands after finding nothing.
...
...
Although the Luoyun Sect’s event of issuing a bounty to hunt Song Fei has added additional turmoil to the already chaotic Wanzhe Waters, none of this affects Xu Ping.
At this moment, he is comfortably waiting at the Thousand Leaves Mountain, leisurely awaiting the arrival of individuals from the Luoyun Sect.
Fortunately, Xu Ping didn’t have to wait too long.
One and a half months later, an elder from the Luoyun Sect with a Fake Pill cultivation arrived as scheduled.
"I am He Chen, greetings to Fellow Daoist Xu."
A slightly plump middle-aged man, with a faint smile on his rounded face, greeted Xu Ping.
"So it’s Elder He, the journey must have been arduous. Why don’t you rest for a moment at the pavilion?" Xu Ping warmly invited.
"That’s a good idea." He Chen smiled and nodded, accepting readily.
Then, under Xu Ping’s guidance, the two went to the pavilion in Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Inside the pavilion, the aroma of tea lingered.
Xu Ping personally poured He Chen a cup of Spirit Tea. The tea was clear, with Spiritual Qi billowing, clearly not ordinary.
He Chen picked up the cup, sipped lightly, and a look of satisfaction flashed in his eyes. He then put down the cup, smiling pleasantly, and said, "Fellow Daoist Xu, I’ve come this time regarding your purchase of the Purple Bamboo Mountain Spirit Vein."
"The sect has already agreed to sell you the Spirit Vein. The price is two thousand five hundred Spirit Stones, how about it?"
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping’s heart relaxed slightly. This price was within his expectations and even a bit lower than anticipated.
He quickly nodded, saying, "What Elder He says is quite reasonable, the junior has no objections."
He Chen’s eyes slightly narrowed, but he didn’t immediately take out the Spirit Contract; instead, he said with meaning, "Fellow Daoist Xu being able to purchase the Purple Bamboo Mountain is truly commendable. From now on, you will have your own domain.
Unlike me, who had rushed on the road for half a month non-stop, only to finally arrive at this Thousand Leaves Mountain..."
Upon hearing these words, Xu Ping instantly understood He Chen’s implied meaning.
He got the hint, gently flipped his palm, and a gray storage pouch appeared in his hand.
"Elder He, your long journey has truly been exhausting. This is just a small token of my regard, nothing much!" Xu Ping, all smiles, handed the storage pouch to He Chen with both hands.
Xu Ping understood very well that even if he didn’t give any extra benefits, the deal to purchase the Purple Bamboo Mountain Spirit Vein could proceed smoothly.
But he knew he’d likely have to deal with He Chen in the future.
Handle each matter according to the person.
Xu Ping understood this principle.
He Chen, without changing his expression, accepted the storage pouch, scanned its contents with his Divine Sense, and saw a large number of Spirit Stones instantly appeared in his Sea of Consciousness.
Seeing this, he nodded in satisfaction and then took out a Spirit Contract from his ample sleeve, handing it to Xu Ping: "This is the Spirit Contract for this transaction, Fellow Daoist Xu may examine it carefully.
If there’s no issue, you may sign and seal it; once the procedures are complete, the Purple Bamboo Mountain Spirit Vein will officially belong to you."
Xu Ping took the Spirit Contract, read it carefully, confirmed it had no issues, then signed his name and pressed his handprint.
Afterward, he retrieved two thousand five hundred Spirit Stones from his Storage Ring and handed them to He Chen.
"Congratulations Fellow Daoist Xu on officially becoming the new owner of the Purple Bamboo Mountain!"
He Chen carefully checked the quantity and quality of the Spirit Stones, confirmed everything was in order, and then beaming with a smile, congratulated Xu Ping.
"It’s just a Second-stage Spirit Vein, hardly worth mentioning." Xu Ping, despite speaking humbly, couldn’t help but show a hint of joy betrayed by the upward curve of his mouth.
After the transaction was completed to perfection, the atmosphere between Xu Ping and He Chen became increasingly harmonious.
After a few casual chats, He Chen’s sharp little eyes suddenly gleamed and he proactively said: "Fellow Daoist Xu, do you have any other matters that need handling or are you lacking in any rare items?"
"Although my cultivation is just Fake Pill, I’m nevertheless an outer door elder of the Luoyun Sect. As long as it’s not too difficult a matter, I will do my utmost to assist you."
"Needed things?"
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping couldn’t help but feel a heart stir.
He instantly realized this might be an opportunity to obtain a secret technique that enhances Divine Sense or a Spirit Medicine.
Xu Ping knew well that He Chen’s words were no more than a bid to solicit some benefits from him.
But as long as the other party could help him obtain a key item to increase Divine Sense, what harm in paying some price?
As long as actions are taken, it poses no problem!
Xu Ping pondered quietly for a while and then said slowly: "Since Elder He is so magnanimous, then the junior won’t stand on ceremony; the junior currently does indeed need something."
"I wonder if Elder He knows where to find a secret technique or Spirit Medicine that enhances Divine Sense?"

chapters.title: Chapter 264 - 191: Entry Level of the Earth Master’s Gaze
chapters.content:
Chapter 264: Chapter 191: Entry Level of the Earth Master’s Gaze
"A secret technique or spirit medicine to enhance Divine Sense?"
Upon hearing Xu Ping’s request, He Chen’s eyebrows instantly furrowed.
Such things are considered rare not only among cultivators in the Foundation Establishment Realm but even within the Golden Core Realm.
After a moment of silence, He Chen’s eyes turned as if he had thought of something, and he slowly opened his mouth to say, "To be honest, Fellow Daoist Xu, techniques like these are extremely precious, and within our Luoyun Sect, they are a closely guarded secret..."
Upon hearing this, a hint of disappointment flashed across Xu Ping’s eyes.
As it was a non-transferable secret of the Luoyun Sect, the other party probably didn’t have the courage to secretly sell it to him.
Moreover, with the resources and means at Luoyun Sect’s disposal, they would certainly have numerous safeguards to prevent such techniques from leaking out.
However, just when Xu Ping was filled with disappointment, thinking he would leave empty-handed, He Chen suddenly changed his tone:
"However, although the Luoyun Sect’s technique for enhancing Divine Sense cannot be taught to you, I have a friend who possesses a similar technique."
"Though his technique is somewhat inferior to Luoyun Sect’s, it’s still quite extraordinary."
"Elder He, is this true?"
Xu Ping could not conceal his delight and eagerly inquired.
He had thought all hope was lost, but unexpectedly, the situation took a turn for the better, presenting an opportunity.
"This is indeed true."
He Chen smiled with confidence, his expression resolute, "My friend is a Fake Pill cultivator, and this technique was acquired by chance in a mysterious secret realm. Having practiced it for years, his Divine Sense is far beyond what ordinary Fake Pill cultivators can compare to."
"I see!"
Xu Ping’s eyes were filled with joy, and he immediately asked, "So does Elder He’s friend have any interest in selling the technique?"
He Chen pondered for a moment and then slowly shook his head, "I can’t be certain, as he has always regarded this technique as his prized possession, unwilling to easily show it to others."
"However, if Fellow Daoist Xu is interested in purchasing it, I could ask my friend on your behalf to see what he thinks."
Upon hearing this, the joy in Xu Ping’s eyes slightly faded, but he quickly clasped his hands in a respectful bow, sincerely saying, "Then I must trouble Elder He to inquire."
Even though it’s uncertain whether the other party would sell it, it’s still worth making an effort.
Saying this, without waiting for He Chen to indicate, Xu Ping lightly turned his palm, and a storage bag appeared in his hand, which he then extended towards He Chen, "This is a token of my appreciation. I hope Elder He doesn’t mind."
He Chen’s way of dealing with matters was completely different from Yang Hong’s, and Xu Ping knew well that to get things done, he had to cater to He Chen’s preferences.
He Chen reached out to take the storage bag, and his Divine Sense swept lightly over it. After seeing the number of Spirit Stones inside, his smile grew even brighter. He patted his chest confidently and promised:
"Rest assured, Fellow Daoist Xu, after I return to the sect and complete my duties, I will contact my friend as soon as possible and bring him to Thousand Leaves Mountain to meet you."
"Then you two can discuss the matter in detail privately."
As he spoke, He Chen’s hand moved swiftly, his palm turned over again, and the storage bag vanished instantly.
"Then many thanks to Elder He!" Xu Ping said with a smile.
If he could communicate with the friend in person, the likelihood of closing the deal on the secret technique would undoubtedly increase greatly.
"It’s a small matter." He Chen, satisfied, stored away the bag and waved his hand dismissively.
"While it might be a small effort for Elder He, to me it concerns a major issue," Xu Ping replied with a smile.
His Spirit Stones were not easily given. If He Chen indeed had such a friend and connected them, it would naturally be a cause for celebration.
But if He Chen intended to deceive, Xu Ping certainly wouldn’t let him off easily.
Although defeating a Fake Pill cultivator posed no trouble for him, doing so without arousing Luoyun Sect’s suspicions would indeed be tricky.
After a few more casual exchanges, He Chen rose to take his leave, "Then I shall take my leave. After returning to the sect and completing my report, I will promptly contact my friend for Fellow Daoist Xu."
"Take care, Elder He," Xu Ping politely escorted He Chen out of the pavilion.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, stay here," He Chen responded cordially and then spread his figure, riding the Escape Light, swiftly departing from Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"I hope He Chen can bring back good news!" Xu Ping thought silently as he watched He Chen’s figure gradually disappearing into the distance.
The benefits of mastering a secret technique that enhances Divine Sense are immense.
Not only would it allow for better control over the Three Talents Array, but a stronger Divine Sense also greatly aids in breaking through one’s own realm.
"However, since He Chen will definitely not be back immediately, the current focus should be on quickly mastering the ’Earth Master’s Gaze’."
Once He Chen’s figure completely disappeared, Xu Ping turned and headed towards the cultivation chamber.
After persistent research during this period, he was now just a step away from mastering the "Earth Master’s Gaze."
Once mastered, he would be able to start upgrading the Spirit Veins.
...
...
Time flowed silently like a gentle stream.
During this period, Xu Ping immersed himself in the arduous study and practice of the "Earth Master’s Gaze" at Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Meanwhile, the sect’s cultivators were also reaching the crucial final stage of their campaign against the malevolent forces.
In the blink of an eye, half a month passed.
Deep within the Wanzhe Waters.
"Roar!"
"Roar!" A powerful fiend at the Perfection Level of the Golden Core fiercely roared at the cultivators in front of it, sending waves of ominous aura expanding outwards.
Its body was covered in dark azure scales, tough and cold, while in its eye sockets, green flames danced maniacally, exuding a fearsome aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 265 - 191: Entry Level of the Earth Master’s Gaze (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 265: Chapter 191: Entry Level of the Earth Master’s Gaze (2)
"Hmph!"
"Die!"
"Little evil spirit, don’t act recklessly!"
...
One angry and decisive cold snort after another echoed.
In an instant, over a dozen Golden Core cultivators attacked simultaneously, targeting the arrogant evil spirit before them.
Countless magical artifacts shone brightly, carrying terrifying destructive power, hurling towards the Golden Core Perfection level evil spirit like a torrential downpour.
Each artifact contained the deep mana of the cultivators, causing the air to hum with their power.
The evil spirit, sensing a mortal threat, let out a furious roar.
Immediately, dense black fog, as thick as ink, surged around it, like a giant wave, attempting to block the overwhelming attack.
However, facing the combined assault of over a dozen Golden Core cultivators, especially with several late-stage Golden Core powerhouses among them, the resistance of the evil spirit was ultimately futile.
With its piercing and tragic cries, it was quickly pulverized by the powerful forces of the magical artifacts, dissipating into the heavens and earth.
With the demise of this powerful evil spirit, other low-level evil spirits were swiftly overwhelmed by the tide-like attack from numerous Foundation Establishment cultivators, one after another meeting their end.
The team eradicating evil spirits advanced steadily, crushing through everything in their path.
Soon, the ruins of Nine Nether Elder on the deserted island appeared before them.
"Ruins Deserted Island!!"
Cultivators from three nations looked at the island in the distance, and their eyes instantly revealed unabashed greed.
This was the renowned grave of the Nine Nether Elder!
Nobody knew how many treasures lay hidden inside, especially since the Sect Leader of Luoyun Sect, Jiang Jingxing, had obtained spiritual objects for Nascent Soul Formation from there.
If they could obtain one or two treasures, it might mean the opportunity to defy fate and embark on a completely different, glorious path of cultivation.
"It’s all mine!"
Countless cultivators shouted excitedly, their eyes bloodshot as if possessed, madly rushing towards the ruins of the deserted island without a care.
Thus, in that moment, the ’Evil Spirit Eradication Alliance’ organized by Luoyun Sect crumbled to dust, announcing its dissolution.
Despite the fact that some remnants of evil spirits still lingered on the island, the crowd, intoxicated by the allure of treasures, had already forgotten the dangers, seeing nothing but the tempting ruins.
Boom!
Just as the cultivators of the three nations set foot on the deserted island, a fierce battle erupted instantly.
The scope of the battle swiftly expanded, involving deadly confrontations between cultivators and the remaining evil spirits, as well as brutal fights between cultivators over the relic treasures.
"Die!"
"Spare me!"
...
The sounds of shouts and clashes of magical artifacts intermingled, echoing above the deserted island...
...
...
At the same time.
In the cultivation room at Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"Open!"
Xu Ping’s expression was calm, his hands quickly forming spells while chanting softly.
In an instant, the mana in his dantian surged like a torrent, swiftly flowing through special meridians before rushing to his forehead.
Then, a slight pain emerged from his forehead.
In a mere instant, a vertical pupil slowly appeared on Xu Ping’s forehead.
"This is the ’Earth Master’s Gaze?’ It feels somewhat similar to Erlang God’s Heavenly Eye," Xu Ping murmured to himself in amazement.
The sensation of having an extra eye was indeed peculiar, as if opening a new dimension of perception.
Unable to contain his curiosity, Xu Ping immediately activated the "Earth Master’s Gaze," beginning to observe the distribution of spirit veins at Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Threads of faint light extended from underground, intertwining throughout the mountain.
These lights were the external manifestation of spirit veins.
The spirit veins presented a radial pattern, centered around the main peak of Thousand Leaves Mountain, spreading outward.
Under the main peak, the spirit veins were most concentrated and the lights were brightest, seemingly forming a huge light cluster, like a radiant pearl buried underground.
Towards the mountain’s edges, the glow of the spirit veins weakened, and the lines became sparse.
"Somewhat blurred!"
Xu Ping frowned slightly, thinking for a moment before channeling all his mana into the "Earth Master’s Gaze," hoping it would clarify the blurred vein paths.
However, despite exerting his utmost effort, he could only see an outline.
From the current observations, upgrading the spirit veins seemed to hinge on the area under the main peak where the veins converged.
But those veins were complex, and with Xu Ping’s current mastery of the "Earth Master’s Gaze," fully understanding them was extremely difficult.
"Too challenging!"
Xu Ping sighed gently, understanding that with the entry level of the "Earth Master’s Gaze," he couldn’t fully see the spirit veins under Thousand Leaves Mountain.
It was beyond his capacity, allowing only a vague outline.
He estimated that to clearly discern the distribution, the "Earth Master’s Gaze" needed to reach proficiency level at least.
At this moment, Xu Ping’s attention was drawn to a rather thick vein branch.
This vein branch wound from one side of the main peak, standing out prominently.
"I suppose this must be the vein branch connecting to the spirit veins of Xiaohui Mountain and Flower Butterfly Mountain."
Xu Ping pondered, "Perhaps I can place an isolation array here first, to block the Spiritual Qi."
Given the current limitations of the "Earth Master’s Gaze," and the information available, he dared not upgrade the spirit veins rashly.
Even a small mistake could disrupt the veins, causing irreparable damage to Thousand Leaves Mountain’s spirit veins.
Better to complete the isolation array first.
No sooner said than done.
Xu Ping hurriedly gathered the materials needed to set up the array and went to the vein branch at the foot of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"This is it."
After carefully confirming the location, Xu Ping began methodically setting up the isolation array.
The isolation array is a second-stage upper grade array. Given Xu Ping’s current array skills, it’s not difficult to complete this task, but the process is quite intricate.
Moreover, every placement of the array must be precise, or the goal of complete Qi isolation could not be achieved.
Ten days passed swiftly.
On this day, Xu Ping held the control token for the array, his hands quickly changing spells.
"Buzz!"
With the infusion of powerful mana, the control token suddenly emitted a dazzling spiritual light, painfully piercing the eyes.
Then, a vast surge of spiritual light spread from it, sweeping in all directions like raging waves.
Instantly.
The array flags and jade stones placed at each corner began to glow with spiritual light.
With the cooperation of the array plate, flags, and jade stones, a layer of strong isolating spiritual light burst forth.
This spiritual light, like a tangible barrier, plunged into the ground.
