Under the sharp observation of Xu Ping’s "Earth Master’s Gaze," the spiritual light appeared as a transparent and solid wall, piercing straight into the vein branch.
In the blink of an eye, it completely isolated Thousand Leaves Mountain’s spirit vein from those of Xiaohui Mountain and Flower Butterfly Mountain.
"The isolation array... is successful!" Witnessing this, Xu Ping’s lips curved upward into an involuntary smile.
After ten days of meticulous setup, the isolation array was perfectly arranged, seamlessly isolating Thousand Leaves Mountain’s spirit veins with no gaps.
The ten days of hard work were not in vain.
Xu Ping celebrated for a moment before quickly regaining his composure.
After all, this was only the first step; setting up an isolation array was just the beginning, and there was much more work needed to truly enhance the spirit veins of Thousand Leaves Mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 266 - 192: Transaction for Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 266: Chapter 192: Transaction for Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill
Xu Ping meticulously observed the isolation array a while longer, confirming repeatedly from various angles and positions that there were no flaws, before he returned to the cultivation chamber with peace of mind.
Now that the ’Earth Master’s Gaze’ is at the entry level, the rest should be simple, just grind it slowly.
Next, Xu Ping turned his attention to another important secret technique — "Spirit Integration into the Vein."
In Xu Ping’s plan and conception.
The secret technique "Spirit Integration into the Vein" should play a larger role in upgrading the spirit veins compared to both the Spirit Worm and the Purifying Spirit Nourishing Vein Array combined.
After all, as cultivators become more proficient with the secret technique "Spirit Integration into the Vein," its power grows exponentially.
The thought of the terrifying power this secret technique could manifest upon reaching perfection filled Xu Ping with anticipation.
The extent of that power is truly unimaginable.
Regarding the "Purifying Spirit Nourishing Vein Array," Xu Ping is aware that it is a large Second-stage Upper Grade array.
Compared to typical Second-stage Upper Grade arrays, its setup is undoubtedly much more challenging.
However, given Xu Ping’s current skills and his research into various arrays, it wouldn’t be difficult for him.
He already has a plan in mind; once the "Earth Master’s Gaze" is cultivated to a proficient level, allowing him to seamlessly investigate the core spirit veins of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
He can then proceed to set up the "Purifying Spirit Nourishing Vein Array" and commence the spirit vein upgrade operation.
As for the low-level demon beast "Spirit Worm," Xu Ping had previously entrusted Duan Shuang, Gong Yang, and Hongyi to keep an eye out for it.
However, as of now, no relevant information has been received.
Inside the cultivation chamber.
Xu Ping sat cross-legged on the stone bed, silently recalling all the details of "Spirit Integration into the Vein" in his mind.
From the initial foundational skill to every key step, and then to every possible situation and solution during cultivation, he carefully organized them one by one in his mind.
After two quarters of an hour.
Once he was assured that nothing was overlooked, Xu Ping officially began to cultivate this secret technique.
"Spirit Integration into the Vein" is no simple secret technique; it is a profound magic of controlling celestial phenomena and inducing spiritual qi tides, with an exceptionally high cultivation difficulty.
For ordinary cultivators, without sufficient talent, even spending a lifetime cultivating may not reach the entry level.
However, Xu Ping certainly has no such concerns.
His divine sense far surpasses that of ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivators, an advantage ensuring that even without talent, he can forcefully achieve the entry level.
Once at the entry level, he can gradually increase experience and levels using the proficiency panel.
"Spirit Integration into the Vein!"
Xu Ping’s expression was grave as he exerted force with his hands, accompanied by a light hum, causing the mana within his dantian to flow along the special meridians.
...
...
Time gradually passed as Xu Ping continuously practiced "Spirit Integration into the Vein."
Thousand Leaves Mountain remained tranquil and serene, yet the entire Wanzhe Waters fell into increasing chaos.
Previously, during the eradication of malevolent entities, there was at least the "Alliance of Eradication" in existence, and by relying on this loose organization, it barely managed to exert some restraint on numerous cultivators.
But now, with the dissolution of the alliance, even the slightest semblance of restraint has completely vanished.
Without restrictions, the cultivators, scrambling for the treasures within the Nine Nether Elder’s relic, engaged in even fiercer slaughter, enveloping the entire waters in bloodshed and carnage.
In this turmoil, some devious calamity cultivators took advantage of the situation, leading to the extermination of numerous Foundation Establishment factions.
However, none dare target Thousand Leaves Mountain.
After all, Xu Ping, being a Third-stage Talisman Master coupled with the protection of arrays, leaves even Golden Core cultivators unrewarded.
Thus, a month slipped by unnoticed.
One day, as Xu Ping was, as usual, quietly cultivating "Spirit Integration into the Vein" within the cultivation chamber.
It was at this moment that He Chen, fulfilling his promise, finally arrived at Thousand Leaves Mountain with his friend.
A corner hall of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"This is my friend Hua Yan, and this is the renowned Third-stage Talisman Master Xu Ping, Fellow Daoist Xu." He Chen smiled broadly, introducing the two.
"Talisman Master Xu, I’ve long admired your name." Hua Yan greeted warmly with a smile on his face.
"Elder Hua, you’re too kind." Xu Ping smiled in return, unconsciously letting his gaze fall upon Hua Yan.
Hua Yan was thin to the point that a gust of wind seemed capable of toppling him, yet his eyes were particularly bright, shining with shrewdness and acuity as if they could pierce through one’s heart.
After a few simple exchanges, He Chen laughed and said, "Fellow Daoist Xu, I’ve explained your request in detail to my friend Hua Yan, and I think you two might as well talk privately to delve further into the trading matter."
"Indeed,"
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping chuckled, directing his gaze at Hua Yan, "Elder Hua, may we move to the pavilion?"
"Naturally, that’s no problem." Hua Yan agreed with a smile.
Then, under Xu Ping’s lead, the two of them proceeded to a pavilion atop Thousand Leaves Mountain.
In the pavilion, the scent of spirit tea lingered.
Xu Ping poured Hua Yan a cup of spirit tea, and the two sat opposite each other.
Hua Yan lifted the teacup, taking a gentle sip, a hint of satisfaction flashing in his eyes before setting it down and looking at Xu Ping with a smile:
"Fellow Daoist Xu, He Chen has mentioned your requirements to me. I hear you’re looking to purchase a secret technique that enhances divine sense?"

chapters.title: Chapter 267 - 192: Trading for the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 267: Chapter 192: Trading for the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill (2)
"Indeed."
Xu Ping nodded, "Senior, in the path of talismans I cultivate, the enhancement of Divine Sense is crucial. I have heard that Elder Hua holds a secret technique that increases Divine Sense. Is there any chance you could part with it?"
Upon hearing this, Hua Yan’s smile slightly faded, revealing a hint of difficulty, "Fellow Daoist Xu, this secret technique is my treasured possession and has never been passed on for years.
"Divine Sense secret techniques are rare, not to mention those that can significantly enhance Divine Sense, which are extraordinarily valuable."
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping actually felt more at ease.
The implication of Hua Yan’s words was a willingness to sell, but at a price that satisfied him.
Without showing it on his face, Xu Ping spoke, "Elder Hua, I fully understand the preciousness of this secret technique and am willing to pay the commensurate price. Could you name your price, Elder?"
Hua Yan narrowed his eyes slightly, gently tapping his fingers on the table. After a moment of contemplation, he said, "Fellow Daoist Xu, this secret technique holds extraordinary significance for me. If not for He Chen’s face, I wouldn’t take it out for trade."
"However, since you are sincere, there’s no harm in naming a price — five lower grade third-rank talismans, plus one artifact embryo."
"Five lower grade third-rank talismans, plus one artifact embryo?"
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping tightly furrowed his brows.
This offer far exceeded his expectations and was even much higher than the normal market price for a Divine Sense secret technique.
Clearly, Hua Yan had determined Xu Ping’s urgent need for this secret technique, so he dared to shamelessly set a sky-high price.
However, Xu Ping was no greenhorn; he maintained a calm demeanor, smiling slightly, and said:
"Elder Hua, the price of five lower grade third-rank talismans and an artifact embryo is indeed quite high."
"While I am in dire need of this secret technique, I must also act within my capabilities. Could the elder reconsider a bit?"
Upon hearing this, Hua Yan’s eyes flickered with thought, but he continued to gently tap his fingers on the table, speaking slowly:
"Fellow Daoist Xu, the value of this secret technique is something you undoubtedly understand. Divine Sense secret techniques are rare, not to mention those that can significantly enhance Divine Sense."
"Setting this price is already considering He Chen’s face."
Xu Ping understood that Hua Yan was convinced he would not easily give up, so he remained neither anxious nor rushed, continuing to say, "What the elder says is true; Divine Sense secret techniques are indeed precious."
"However, my talisman reserves are limited, and artifact embryos are even rarer."
"If the elder could concede a bit, I am willing to offer three lower grade third-rank talismans and thirty thousand Spirit Stones in exchange."
"Additionally, I can craft one lower grade third-rank talisman for the elder free of charge to show my sincerity."
’Craft one lower grade third-rank talisman for free?’
Upon hearing Xu Ping’s counteroffer, Hua Yan slightly raised his eyebrow.
He contemplated for a moment, his gaze sweeping over Xu Ping’s face as if weighing the pros and cons.
After a moment, he suddenly smiled, his tone softening slightly, "Fellow Daoist Xu is indeed straightforward. Since you are so sincere, it’s hard for me to make things difficult for you."
"Three third-rank talismans and thirty thousand Spirit Stones, plus you crafting a third-rank talisman for me, this condition is not unacceptable."
Xu Ping’s heart relaxed, knowing Hua Yan had yielded, and he seized the opportunity, "Then many thanks to Elder Hua for accommodating me. Could you present the Divine Sense secret technique so I may examine it first, Elder?"
"That is of course no problem at all."
Hua Yan smiled slightly, then with a flip of his palm, a jade slip instantly appeared in his hand.
"This jade slip contains a short segment of the secret technique. Fellow Daoist Xu can use it to verify authenticity."
With that, Hua Yan gently placed the jade slip on the stone table and slowly pushed it towards Xu Ping.
Xu Ping took the jade slip, scanning it with his Divine Sense.
"Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill!"
He quickly saw the name of this secret technique.
Delving deeper, although the jade slip contained only a brief segment, with his own knowledge, he could ascertain that this secret technique was genuine!
After reviewing the short segment of the secret technique from the jade slip, a hint of joy flashed in Xu Ping’s eyes.
He gently placed the jade slip down, once again turning his gaze to Hua Yan, asking: "The secret technique is indeed genuine. I wonder what type of third-rank talisman Elder Hua would like me to craft?"
Hua Yan’s lips curled slightly in a faint smile as he clearly and slowly uttered a few words, "Lower grade third-rank Breaking Charm!"
"Lower grade third-rank Breaking Charm?"
Xu Ping felt a bit surprised in his heart, but his face revealed nothing at all. Instead, he clapped his hands suddenly: "What a coincidence, I happen to have a Third-rank Lower Grade Breaking Charm on me!"
"Elder Hua, please take a look!"
With that, Xu Ping flipped his palm, and a purple talisman containing a strong power of breaking restrictions appeared in his hand.
Hua Yan scanned it with his Divine Sense and immediately knew it was a genuine Third-rank Lower Grade Breaking Charm!
Seeing this, a trace of surprise flashed across Hua Yan’s face: "Fellow Daoist Xu’s skills as a Talisman Master seem to far surpass that of an ordinary Third-rank Talisman Master."
After all, the difficulty of crafting a Third-rank Lower Grade Breaking Charm is not something ordinary Third-rank Lower Grade talismans could compare to.
"Alas, I wasted dozens of Third-rank Talisman papers and only barely managed to create this one by luck," Xu Ping shook his head helplessly and sighed lightly.
Upon hearing this, Hua Yan neither agreed nor disagreed, merely smiling slightly before saying, "Since Fellow Daoist Xu has what I need, why don’t we complete the trade immediately?"
"I’d be delighted!" Xu Ping nodded immediately.
The two of them then completed this transaction, which even Golden Core masters would envy, within the pavilion.
After the trade was done, Hua Yan was in high spirits, taking a sip of tea with a smile and saying, "Fellow Daoist Xu is indeed straightforward, no wonder He Chen praises you so much. If there’s an opportunity in the future, we can collaborate more."
Xu Ping also smiled in response: "Elder Hua flatters me, I am merely earnestly seeking the Secret Technique. If there’s a need in the future, I will surely try my best to assist."
"It’s just mutual support."
After saying that with a smile, Hua Yan retrieved a talisman emitting a soft blue light from his storage pouch and handed it to Xu Ping,
"This is a Second-stage Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman. If Fellow Daoist Xu encounters any difficult problems during the cultivation of this Secret Technique, you may contact me through this talisman."
"Thank you, Elder Hua." Xu Ping felt a stirring in his heart and immediately put away the talisman.
"Between fellow Daoists, it is only right to look out for one another, no need for such courtesy," Hua Yan said with a gentle smile.
The two of them exchanged a few more casual pleasantries, then stood up together, heading towards the side hall where He Chen was located.
Along the way, Xu Ping continued to lead the way unhurriedly at the front, while Hua Yan quietly followed behind.
At this moment, Hua Yan’s gaze intentionally or unintentionally fell upon Xu Ping’s back, a profound and meaningful look fleeting through his deep eyes.
...
Before long, the two of them arrived at the side hall.
He Chen immediately noticed Xu Ping and Hua Yan entering and saw the joyful expressions on their faces, prompting him to smile and say, "You two seem quite happy, it seems the trade went smoothly!"
"All thanks to Elder Hua’s understanding and not making things difficult for the younger generation," Xu Ping laughed heartily and humbly said.
"It was still Fellow Daoist Xu’s sincerity that moved me," Hua Yan also smiled and said.
"In any case, it is a great thing that the trade was completed perfectly. Fellow Daoist Xu, do you have any treasured Spirit Wine?"
"Today, the three of us must drink to our heart’s content and not return until we’re drunk!" He Chen proposed enthusiastically.
"Since Elder He is in such high spirits, how could I not accompany him?"
Xu Ping replied happily, and then immediately retrieved several jars of well-sealed Hundred Flowers Wine from his Storage Ring.
Their gathering lasted until midnight.
"Take care, esteemed elders." Xu Ping courteously saw the two of them out of the cave dwelling.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, please stay*2."
He Chen and Hua Yan responded politely.
Then He Chen waved his hand, and an exquisitely crafted Spiritual Boat appeared instantly in mid-air.
He and Hua Yan boarded the Spiritual Boat, which shimmered with light and quickly disappeared into the vast night like an arrow leaving the bow.
...
In the dark sky, aboard the Spiritual Boat.
"Take these two Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans," Hua Yan flicked his finger, and the two talismans transformed into two beams shooting towards He Chen.
He Chen seemed accustomed to this kind of scenario and naturally raised his hand to catch the talismans, then casually stored them into his Storage Ring: "Are you sure he will still come to you?"
"As long as he wants to cultivate the ’Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill’, he inevitably will. You are well aware of the difficulties in cultivating this Secret Technique," Hua Yan replied with full confidence, his tone unmistakable in its certainty.

chapters.title: Chapter 268 - 193: Cultivation Failure; Setting Traps
chapters.content:
Chapter 268: Chapter 193: Cultivation Failure; Setting Traps
"This person is not an ordinary third-tier Talisman Master, and his wealth is exceptional. You must handle it well; don’t let this money-maker slip away." He Chen instructed.
"Rest assured, he won’t get away." Hua Yan’s expression was calm, and his tone carried a hint of confidence.
He had sold this Secret Technique before and was naturally aware of how to handle it.
"Instead, you’re free these days. Why not wait in my cave for a few days? I believe it won’t be long before he contacts me." Hua Yan said confidently.
He Chen pondered silently for a moment, then nodded in agreement, "Alright."
As he spoke, he glanced sideways at Hua Yan, "But let me be clear, if Xu Ping comes looking for you to trade later, don’t forget to give me my share."
"Rest assured, I won’t forget your portion." Hua Yan replied.
"Hmm."
He Chen nodded in satisfaction and then set up the Spiritual Boat and hurried towards Hua Yan’s cave.
...
Thousand Leaves Mountain.
After He Chen and Hua Yan left, Xu Ping couldn’t contain the urgency in his heart and hurried to the cultivation chamber.
As soon as he entered the room, he eagerly took out the jade slip that recorded the "Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill" Secret Technique.
"Finally got it!"
Xu Ping gazed at the jade slip in his hand, murmuring to himself, and a trace of uncontrollable excitement flashed in his eyes.
Although he clearly suffered a loss in this transaction with Hua Yan, Xu Ping believed it would all be worth it if he could successfully cultivate this Secret Technique.
"Phew!"
Xu Ping took a deep breath to calm his emotions and then invaded the jade slip with his Divine Sense.
Suddenly, the entire content of the ’Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill’ emerged in his mind.
Xu Ping began to read and ponder word by word, striving to fully understand every detail.
Several days later.
A hint of comprehension appeared in Xu Ping’s eyes.
"So that’s how it is!"
A trace of excitement flashed in Xu Ping’s eyes. At this moment, he fully understood all the details of the ’Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill.’
Undoubtedly, this "Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill" is indeed extraordinarily ingenious!
With a special method, it precisely guides one’s Mana to the Sea of Consciousness area.
These Mana act like fine craftsmen, tempering and nurturing the Sea of Consciousness.
They constantly wash over the barriers of the Sea of Consciousness, making it more resilient and broad. Meanwhile, the cultivator’s Divine Sense will slowly enhance in this process.
"Let’s give it a try!"
Xu Ping took a deep breath, suppressing his inner excitement, and started his first attempt at cultivating the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill.
Although his entry level in drawing the spirit into his veins was not yet successful, the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill was evidently more important to him.
Xu Ping sat cross-legged, formed a seal, then slowly closed his eyes, immersing his mind into the Sea of Consciousness, solemnly attempting to cultivate the "Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill" again.
However, as soon as he began to circulate the cultivation technique, as traces of Mana cautiously flowed into the Sea of Consciousness, the originally calm Sea of Consciousness was instantly like being hit by a storm, stirring up turbulent waves.
A burst of intense pain felt like sharp blades cutting through his consciousness mercilessly, as if to shred his soul into countless pieces.
Initially, Xu Ping thought this was a normal phenomenon to experience during cultivation.
Therefore, he clenched his teeth tightly, soon having a profuse sweat on his forehead, his face turning pale as paper, and his body involuntarily trembling.
Even so, he persisted with staunch determination.
But as time passed, the pain not only did not alleviate but became increasingly intense.
More frighteningly, even the barriers of the Sea of Consciousness seemed to become precarious under the continuous wash of Mana, as if it would collapse at any moment.
"Something’s not right..."
Xu Ping immediately stopped cultivating and slowly opened his bloodshot eyes.
He vaguely sensed that if he continued recklessly, not only would his Sea of Consciousness fail to strengthen, but it could also suffer severe damage.
It is known that if the Sea of Consciousness is damaged, the consequences would be unimaginable, far more severe than damage to the Dantian, almost rendering the cultivation path half-wasted.
"Could it be that I missed some details?"
A trace of doubt flashed in Xu Ping’s eyes, and he then flipped his hand to retrieve the jade slip, immersing his Divine Sense into it for a careful read.
Half a day later.
Xu Ping withdrew his Divine Sense from the jade slip and fell into deep thought.
He had thoroughly read the jade slip several times, knowing each word and sentence by heart.
He could confidently assert that he had followed the cultivation method recorded in the jade slip without making any mistakes.
"Could it be that I introduced too much Mana into the Sea of Consciousness?" Xu Ping pondered to himself, "Why not try reducing the amount of Mana this time?"
Thoughts surged in his mind, and he decided to try again.
However, this attempt again ended in failure, and the intense pain from the Sea of Consciousness remained unabated.
"What exactly is going on? I’ve clearly reduced the Mana, why is this still happening?"
Feeling the waves of pain from his Sea of Consciousness, Xu Ping couldn’t help but feel exceptionally irritable. "Is there another problem I haven’t discovered?"
He frowned deeply, pondering hard for a long time. Finally, gritting his teeth, he decided to try a few more times to see if he could identify the problem.
Time passed in these repeated painful attempts, and seven days flew by.
At this moment, Xu Ping remained seated in the cultivation chamber.
His entire face was as pale as a sheet of white paper, devoid of any blood color, and his forehead was covered with dense beads of sweat, which rolled down his cheeks, soaking his clothes.

chapters.title: Chapter 269 - 193: Cultivation Failure; Setting Traps_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 269: Chapter 193: Cultivation Failure; Setting Traps_2
In his sea of consciousness, it felt like countless sharp blades were stirring, and every time he operated the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill, it was as if he was walking on the tip of a knife.
This excruciating pain had persisted for seven whole days; even with his resilient nature, he was nearly at his limit.
"Could it be... there’s a crucial issue with the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill, that Hua Yan didn’t tell me?"
Xu Ping’s eyes were bloodshot, and a hint of malevolence flashed through his heart.
During these seven days, he tried every possible method and attempted various adjustments, yet the pain in his sea of consciousness was unbearably intense.
Let alone successfully cultivating this Secret Technique, at this rate, even his sea of consciousness might not withstand, constantly on the verge of collapsing.
Xu Ping took a deep breath, gritting his teeth against the sea of consciousness’s pain, his hands deftly forming the Spell, quietly activating the Taihang Nourishing God Skill.
Instantly, strands of coolness like babbling brooks continuously flowed into the sea of consciousness.
These cool sensations seemed to carry magical power, slowly soothing the waves of throbbing pain in his sea of consciousness.
Half a day later.
"Hah!"
Xu Ping slowly exhaled a foul breath, gradually opened his eyes.
At this moment, a sharp gleam flashed in his eyes, and the throbbing in his sea of consciousness finally vanished completely after being nourished by the Taihang Nourishing God Skill.
His gaze instinctively shifted downward, landing on the jade slip recording the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill at his feet.
Staring at this jade slip, Xu Ping’s eyes gradually turned cold.
"This won’t do. I must ask Hua Yan clearly. Though the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill isn’t a fraud, there’s certainly something crucial he hasn’t told me..."
With this thought, a hint of killing intent flashed in Xu Ping’s eyes.
He had already overpaid, and with the suffering of these days, even the slightest negligence could cause irreparable damage to his sea of consciousness.
This was already a deep-seated enmity!
Xu Ping flipped his palm, and the Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman appeared in his hand.
With a grim expression, he injected a trace of Mana into the talisman, attempting to contact Hua Yan.
...
...
At Earth Soul Mountain, in Hua Yan’s cave dwelling, within a luxurious side hall.
"Brother He, please!" Hua Yan smiled broadly, gesturing invitingly.
"Brother Hua, please." He Chen also smiled widely.
The two laughed as they raised their cups and, under the attentiveness of a beautiful female cultivator, finished their Spirit Wine in one gulp.
Just as they were cheerfully exchanging drinks, Hua Yan’s actions suddenly paused, his previously relaxed brows twitching slightly, as if he sensed something amiss.
The next moment.
He put down the wine glass in his hand, then waved his hand decisively, ordering the beautiful female cultivator: "You all leave now!"
Witnessing this scene, He Chen’s heart stirred, and he immediately asked, "Has Xu Ping sent a message?"
"Yes!"
Hua Yan nodded slightly, a barely noticeable trace of smugness flickering on his face.
He held the glowing Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman in his hand, a subtle grin on his lips.
Then, he injected a trace of Mana into the talisman, and immediately Xu Ping’s voice came through, with some hesitation:
"Elder Hua, junior has encountered some problems while practicing the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill..."
Upon hearing this, Hua Yan promptly adopted a tone full of concern: "What issue has Fellow Daoist Xu encountered? Feel free to speak."
"Junior, whenever I practice the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill, my sea of consciousness experiences intense pain..." Xu Ping’s voice kept coming through the Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman.
"Divine Sense pain?"
Hua Yan deliberately intensified his tone, then purposefully fell silent, creating a weighty atmosphere.
"Elder Hua, what’s causing the problem?" Xu Ping’s tone carried urgency.
"Your situation..."
Hua Yan purposely paused before continuing, "There might be repulsion between the Cultivation Technique and your sea of consciousness."
"Repulsion between the Cultivation Technique and sea of consciousness?" Xu Ping’s tone held confusion.
"Exactly!"
Hua Yan’s tone was decisive, appearing extremely confident, "Though theoretically anyone can attempt to practice the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill."
"But in this world, exceptions happen; inevitably, some instances arise where the sea of consciousness doesn’t align with the Cultivation Technique, causing repulsion."
"It’s my fault for not notifying Fellow Daoist Xu beforehand, mainly because I didn’t expect such a low probability to occur." Hua Yan’s tone carried a hint of apology.
"I see!"
Xu Ping seemed to understand as he sighed lightly, and then he hurriedly asked, "What should be done to resolve this matter?"
"Under the current circumstances... the only option is to use Concentration Incense to aid your cultivation."
Hua Yan spoke steadily, "Concentration Incense can strengthen the sea of consciousness’s barriers and alleviate the pain of Divine Sense. Only with its aid can the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill be successfully cultivated!"
"Fortunately, I still have some here, and if Fellow Daoist Xu needs... I can sell him some."
"Thank you, Elder Hua!"
Xu Ping’s voice carried gratitude, "What is the price of this Concentration Incense..."
"Alas, this incense is difficult to refine, requiring several rare ingredients..."
Hua Yan feigned difficulty, "But since Fellow Daoist Xu needs it, I’ll offer it cheaper, a Third-rank Lower Grade talisman for three sticks, how about it?"
"Alright, junior will prepare the talisman immediately." Xu Ping agreed without hesitation.
Having achieved his goal so easily, Hua Yan’s smile was radiant: "I’m currently tied up with various matters and truly can’t free myself.
Fortunately, Brother He is staying in my cave dwelling for the next few days, and in six or seven days, I’ll have Brother He deliver the Concentration Incense to Fellow Daoist Xu."

chapters.title: Chapter 270 - 193: Cultivation Failure; Setting Traps_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 270: Chapter 193: Cultivation Failure; Setting Traps_3
"Then I’ll trouble Elder He." Xu Ping thanked him.
Afterwards, the two discussed some specific details of the transaction, and once confirmed without error, they cut off the transmission.
At this moment.
Beside him, He Chen couldn’t hold back any longer and smiled, "Xu Ping is hooked now, right?"
Upon hearing this, Hua Yan’s lips curved into a sly smile, "This is just the beginning. Once he uses the calming incense for cultivation over a period, that’s when he’ll truly be caught, allowing me to manipulate him at will."
"Oh?"
He Chen was momentarily stunned, then reacted, "Could it be... there’s something wrong with the calming incense you gave Xu Ping?"
With a calm expression, Hua Yan replied, "The incense itself is without issue, of course. It’s of absolute superior quality, but there’s just a minor side effect when using it to aid in cultivation."
"Once someone over-relies on the calming incense during cultivation, they become addicted."
"Addicted?"
He Chen frowned slightly, "With the strong will of a Foundation Establishment Cultivator, mere addiction shouldn’t be a big deal, right?"
"Ordinary addiction is naturally not an issue for a Foundation Establishment Cultivator."
"But this is Sea of Consciousness addiction; it’s entirely different. Not just Foundation Establishment Cultivators, even Fake Pill Cultivators can be affected." Hua Yan confidently stated.
"I see!"
He Chen suddenly understood, his doubts dissipating, a cold smile unconsciously appearing on his face, "Once he’s addicted, he’ll be at our mercy."
The thought of the wealth a Third-rank Lower Grade Talisman Master could bring made his heart feverish.
Not just Fake Pill Cultivators; even Golden Core Cultivators would be powerless in the face of addiction.
...
...
Meanwhile.
In the cultivation chamber within Thousand Leaves Mountain, Xu Ping slowly put down the super long-distance sound transmission talisman, a cold murderous intent flashing in his eyes.
"Sea of Consciousness not compatible with cultivation technique? Hmph, there’s no such coincidence in this world!" Xu Ping snorted coldly in his heart.
Clearly, he had been set up, and quite badly too.
The other party definitely plans to use this so-called "calming incense" to control him like a puppet, turning him into a tool they can endlessly extract benefits from.
The deliberate arrangement for He Chen to deliver the calming incense made it all the clearer to Xu Ping.
Hua Yan’s move was simply out of fear of him, in case he discovered the truth and turned against them.
Given He Chen’s status as an outer elder of the Luoyun Sect, even if Xu Ping was furious, he wouldn’t dare to openly act against him.
At this thought, Xu Ping sighed, "Ah, these old schemers in the Cultivation Realm, their traps are hard to guard against."
Who knows, there might be more issues with the calming incense Hua Yan gave him.
And He Chen is no good either.
He surely knows about all this.
The two are definitely in cahoots.
But what can he do?
Could he possibly kill them both?
.....
...
Five days later.
"Friend He, I eagerly await your good news." Hua Yan smiled, personally seeing He Chen off at the mountain gate of Earth Soul Mountain.
"Rest assured."
He Chen was confident, speaking with certainty, "Even if Xu Ping senses something amiss, he’ll surely not dare act rashly against me."
"Even if I gave him several guts, he wouldn’t dare provoke lightly; otherwise, it’s seeking his own death."
"I naturally believe this, otherwise I wouldn’t trouble you, Friend He, with delivering the calming incense to him."
Hua Yan nodded slightly, then added, "However, if Xu Ping thinks exchanging one Third-rank Lower Grade talisman for three sticks of calming incense is too expensive, feel free to give him all five sticks I gave you, to ensure the matter is settled."
"Understood, I take my leave then." He Chen nodded, then rode his spiritual boat and slowly headed toward Thousand Leaves Mountain.
After He Chen’s silhouette completely disappeared from view, Hua Yan turned and returned to the cultivation chamber.
His remaining stock of calming incense was running low; he needed to quickly refine another batch.
Entering the cultivation chamber, Hua Yan expertly retrieved an alchemy furnace.
With a focused expression, he skillfully added various materials into the furnace in a specific order.
He grasped the timing and quantity of each material precisely and accurately.
Time swiftly passed, and in the blink of an eye, seven days had gone by.
That day at Shen hour.
Hua Yan was fervently refining the calming incense when suddenly there was a knock at the door.
"Knock knock!"
"Lord of the Mountain..." a cautious voice called from outside.
Hua Yan halted his actions, his brow furrowing instantly, filled with displeasure, he shouted, "Didn’t I already instruct not to disturb me unless it’s urgent!"
"Lord of the Mountain, it’s truly a big matter this time!" The voice outside the cultivation chamber instantly turned exceedingly anxious, tinged with urgency.
Hua Yan’s brow furrowed even tighter, as if it could crush a fly.
He lightly waved his right hand, a burst of spiritual power surged out, and the heavy stone door slowly opened automatically.
A plain-looking, unremarkable middle-aged man stood respectfully outside.
"What exactly is this big matter?" Hua Yan said coldly, his gaze piercingly fixed on the middle-aged man.
"Lord of the Mountain, there’s a Fake Pill Realm person I’ve never met who instructed me to deliver something to you." The middle-aged man trembled as he spoke, his face full of reverence.
"An unfamiliar Fake Pill Cultivator? Wants you to give me something?"
Hearing this, Hua Yan’s expression was slightly stunned, curiosity rising within him, bemused.
After a brief thought, he asked again with a frown, "What does he want you to deliver?"
"It’s a box, Lord of the Mountain." The middle-aged man hurriedly answered with reverence.

chapters.title: Chapter 271 - 194: Slaying Hua Yan; Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill Level 2
chapters.content:
Chapter 271: Chapter 194: Slaying Hua Yan; Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill Level 2
"A box?"
Hua Yan’s brow furrowed tightly, his face immediately showing a deep look of confusion.
"That’s right, it’s just a box, and it’s covered in restrictions, I’ll take it out for you... Go to hell!"
The middle-aged man suddenly turned hostile, the previously anxious expression on his face vanished without a trace, replaced by an extremely frigid, murderous look.
Before the words had even left his mouth
Boom!
A thunder dragon, a full three zhang in length, with an earth-shattering and majestic momentum, charged towards Hua Yan with incredible speed!
This thunder dragon was tightly wrapped in crackling arcs of lightning, and amidst their flickering, it released a terrifying aura as if capable of destroying the heavens and the earth, making one’s blood run cold.
"This is bad!"
Hua Yan’s face turned ghastly pale in an instant, eyes filled with sheer terror.
The incident occurred too suddenly, leaving him no time for any effective response, and he instinctively hurried to summon a defensive artifact embryo.
However, he had not even had time to circulate the Mana within his body to activate the artifact’s power.
The immensely powerful thunder dragon, carrying an unrivaled force, had already struck the defensive artifact embryo, sending it flying.
Following that, the dragon’s momentum showed no sign of stopping, and it crashed heavily onto Hua Yan’s protective spiritual light.
Boom!
In an instant, dazzling lightning erupted like a fiery sun, enveloping Hua Yan entirely within it.
The sound, as if it intended to shatter the whole world, reverberated throughout the space.
"No!"
Hua Yan’s eyes widened in fury, his pupils reflecting the exploding lightning.
The scales on the thunder dragon, enwrapped in arcs during combustion, disintegrated the supposed protective defense artifact inch by inch like glass, and he caught the scent of his own charred flesh.
The next moment, the lightning, so intense it was almost blinding, spread outwards like a raging tide.
Crack!
Bam!
Meanwhile, the entire cultivation chamber under this massive energy’s fierce assault exploded like a fragile eggshell.
Countless shards flew like cannonballs, raising a sky-full of dust and smoke, obscuring everything.
The surrounding ground started shaking violently, and if not for the sturdy mountain and strong array guarding this area, it would have already been flattened by this terrifying force.
As the lightning subsided, Hua Yan found himself lying in the rubble, his left arm twisted awkwardly, each breath feeling like swallowing a heated blade.
"Cough... Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman..."
Hua Yan coughed up blood mixed with electrical sparks, his gaze fixed on the middle-aged man standing amidst the scorched earth, "You are... Xu Ping?"
Amidst the sound of rolling rubble, the middle-aged man was enveloped in a crystal-clear cyan shield, like a demon god from hell.
He didn’t speak, only a cruel smirk curled at the corner of his mouth.
The next instant, his figure flickered like a ghost, instantly appearing before Hua Yan, and without hesitation, he thrust the magical treasure wooden sword.
This sword, quick as lightning, with a blade flickering with surging Mana, aimed straight for Hua Yan’s dantian.
Though Hua Yan was severely injured, the instinct to survive made him unwilling to give up easily.
He gritted his teeth, mustering the last sliver of strength to desperately summon a top-grade defensive magical artifact, hoping to use it to block this fatal blow.
However, it was all in vain, as the magical treasure wooden sword effortlessly shattered the top-grade defensive magical artifact.
’Puff’!
Following that, the magical treasure wooden sword effortlessly pierced into Hua Yan’s abdomen, the Mana within it exploding, instantly tearing his dantian to shreds.
"Pfff!"
A mouthful of blood spurted out, Hua Yan’s vitality plummeted rapidly, and then his eyes rolled back, slipping directly into unconsciousness.
Everything happened so quickly, catching everyone off guard.
By the time other cultivators from Earth Soul Mountain hurriedly arrived, this thrilling battle had already completely ended.
"Steward Yuan?"
"Mountain Lord!!"
The crowd stared dumbfounded at the tragic scene before them, their eyes filled with shock and fear.
They were completely stunned by the sight, unable to understand what exactly had happened?
Why did a Steward Yuan in the Foundation Establishment Realm reduce the Fake Pill Realm Mountain Lord to such a state?
At this moment, the middle-aged man slowly turned his head, his gaze sweeping indifferently over the crowd.
His lips moved slightly, muttering to himself, "You can only blame your bad luck."
To cover his tracks, he had not many choices left.
"Slash!"
The middle-aged man wielding the magical treasure wooden sword, with Mana surging like a raging wave within him.
His figure flickered like a ghost again, instantly attacking them...
...
...
Thousand Leaves Mountain.
After a leisurely month-long journey, He Chen finally arrived at Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"Elder He, please." Xu Ping said, smiling broadly as he invited He Chen into the pavilion.
Within the pavilion, the fragrance of tea wafted gently.
Xu Ping poured a cup of Spirit Tea for He Chen, and the two sat facing each other.
He Chen picked up the teacup and took a gentle sip before setting it down again with a slight sigh, "Fellow Daoist Xu, I’ve also come to learn about your situation. Actually, it seems unfair to blame Hua Yan, as the likelihood of such an event is remarkably low."
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping let out a wry smile, "I certainly don’t blame Elder Hua for this; no one could have predicted such an event."
"As long as you understand."
He Chen couldn’t help but smile a bit, "Luckily, there’s a way to resolve this matter. Hua Yan also mentioned to me that the Condensation Incense should be able to resolve the issue with the cultivation technique repulsion."

chapters.title: Chapter 272 - 194: Slaying Hua Yan; Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill, Level 2_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 272: Chapter 194: Slaying Hua Yan; Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill, Level 2_2
"Let’s hope so!" Xu Ping sighed slightly.
"However, the price of this Concentration Incense is exorbitantly high, and drawing a third-tier talisman is daunting..." As he spoke, Xu Ping showed a troubled expression.
"I’m aware of that, which is why I tried my utmost to persuade Hua Yan to take a bit of a loss and give you an extra stick of Concentration Incense, Fellow Daoist Xu." He Chen said with a smile.
"But I still find the price somewhat unbearable." Xu Ping said with a rather helpless expression, shaking his head gently.
"Still expensive?"
He Chen’s eyebrows furrowed slightly, and just as he was about to respond, he suddenly sensed a Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman within his Storage Ring trembling violently.
"Please excuse me for a moment." He Chen said, his brow furrowed as he rose and walked toward a fake mountain not far away.
After reaching the fake mountain, He Chen quickly raised his hand and placed a layer of soundproof Restriction.
After completing all this, he took the Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman from his Storage Ring.
He slowly infused a wisp of Mana into the Sound Transmission Talisman.
Instantly, an urgent voice emerged from the Talisman: "Elder He, all the cultivators inside Earth Soul Mountain, including Hua Yan, seem to be dead."
"What!"
He Chen’s face transformed drastically, his originally calm eyes suddenly flashing with shock.
A month ago when he left, everything was fine; how did it suddenly become an annihilation?
Could it be...
Thoughts spun rapidly in He Chen’s mind. He turned abruptly, his eyes like a hawk’s, fixated fiercely on Xu Ping.
However, just moments later, he slowly shook his head.
It should... not be him!
It’s essential to know that Thousand Leaves Mountain is quite far from Earth Soul Mountain.
A month’s return trip between Thousand Leaves Mountain and Earth Soul Mountain is challenging even for him using his Escape Technique, let alone wiping out all of Earth Soul Mountain.
Xu Ping is merely a Foundation Establishment Realm cultivator; how could he possess an Escape Technique far superior to his?
Moreover, Earth Soul Mountain is guarded by Hua Yan, who possesses the Fake Pill cultivation, along with powerful Arrays set up in the mountains for protection. Even for a Golden Core cultivator, breaking through swiftly is no easy task.
Though Xu Ping is a third-tier Talisman Master, attempting to break it would be as difficult as ascending to heaven.
"Whew!"
He Chen took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the tumultuous emotions within him, and asked in a deep voice to the Sound Transmission Talisman: "Do you know who did it?"
"I don’t know, the only thing certain is that Earth Soul Mountain appears to have been breached from the inside." The voice from the Talisman carried a hint of helplessness.
’Breached from the inside?’
’Could it be Hua Yan’s enemy?’ He Chen furrowed his brow again, his mind swirling with thoughts.
Hua Yan was ruthless in his actions, using Divine Sense Secret Techniques to harm many, having numerous enemies.
If an adversary used some Magical Artifact to conceal their identity or deployed a mysterious Secret Technique to infiltrate Earth Soul Mountain.
And then caught Hua Yan off guard, indeed it was possible to slaughter all cultivators of Earth Soul Mountain.
For now, this seems to be the only reasonable explanation.
This further reduces the probability of Xu Ping’s involvement.
After all, Hua Yan’s Divine Sense far exceeds that of a typical Fake Pill cultivator, extremely sensitive, perfectly concealing one’s aura before him; even for a Fake Pill cultivator, it would prove exceedingly challenging.
Could it be a Golden Core cultivator?
...
After asking several more questions, He Chen still obtained no useful clues.
His face darkened like water as he made his way back to the pavilion, his steps noticeably heavy.
"Elder He, has something happened?" Xu Ping noticed He Chen’s unusual expression and asked in confusion.
He Chen remained silent for a while, staring directly at Xu Ping, and said each word with extraordinary gravity: "All the cultivators of Earth Soul Mountain, including Hua Yan, are dead."
"What!"
Upon hearing the news, Xu Ping’s face momentarily displayed a fitting shock and disbelief, his eyes wide open as if he couldn’t trust his ears.
"How could this happen? Who did it?" he inquired urgently.
Seeing Xu Ping’s genuine reaction, He Chen’s last trace of doubt completely dissipated.
After pondering for a moment, he said slowly: "I don’t know either, but from the situation on site, Earth Soul Mountain should have been breached from the inside."
"Breached from the inside?"
Xu Ping furrowed his brow, speculating, "Could it be the work of Elder Hua’s enemies?"
"At the moment, that’s the most likely possibility."
He Chen nodded, continued, "The opponent likely concealed their identity, secretly infiltrated Earth Soul Mountain, and then caught the opportune moment to attack Hua Yan."
"But Elder Hua’s Divine Sense far exceeds that of typical Fake Pill cultivators; could the infiltrator be a Golden Core cultivator?" Xu Ping put forth his guess.
"A Golden Core cultivator, huh?" He Chen repeated silently, inwardly suspecting a Golden Core cultivator’s involvement.
"Whoever did it, Luoyun Sect will certainly not let them go!" A faint trace of fierceness flashed through He Chen’s eyes.
Although Hua Yan wasn’t a formal disciple of the Luoyun Sect, he secretly pledged allegiance to them years ago, using his means to handle many shady and tricky affairs for Luoyun Sect.
He was considered half a member; now, having suffered such a tragic demise, if Luoyun Sect stands by idly, the dependents of Luoyun Sect would surely be concerned, and their work wouldn’t be as dedicated as before.
"With the Upper Sect’s intervention, the culprit will surely be brought to justice." Xu Ping nodded affirmatively.
"Earth Soul Mountain has been annihilated, I must immediately return to the sect to handle the situation and won’t stay any longer." He Chen hastily uttered a farewell and prepared to leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 273 - 194: Slaying Hua Yan; Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill, Level 2_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 273: Chapter 194: Slaying Hua Yan; Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill, Level 2_3
At this moment, his mind was filled with the urge to hurry back to the sect as soon as possible, leaving him no interest in the trade of calming incense.
He had no intention to trade for calming incense now, with a sole desire to leave this place quickly.
Even though he was convinced that Xu Ping had nothing to do with it.
Yet for some reason, when facing Xu Ping, an inexplicable unease lingered in his heart, like a shadow that wouldn’t dissipate.
Perhaps he was being too suspicious, but in any case, returning to the Luoyun Sect sooner was certainly the right move.
"Take care, Senior." Xu Ping courteously saw He Chen out of the cave.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, no need to see me off."
He Chen returned the courtesy with a bow and summoned a leaf-shaped spiritual boat.
He stepped onto the boat, and as his spiritual power surged, the boat transformed into a stream of light, swiftly flying towards the horizon, disappearing in the blink of an eye.
Watching He Chen vanish completely from sight, Xu Ping’s gaze turned icy cold, like the frigid snow of midwinter.
"Consider yourself lucky this time, but I certainly won’t spare you!" The words were charged with intense killing intent.
He was not one to show any mercy towards those who sought to harm him.
Although he couldn’t act against He Chen now, he would settle the score later.
As for the ambush and slaying of Hua Yan, and the destruction of Earth Soul Mountain, Xu Ping believed the Luoyun Sect would find it hard to suspect him.
After all, no one would imagine a Foundation Establishment Cultivator to surpass regular Fake Pill Cultivators in escaping techniques.
In concealing one’s identity, he could deceive a Fake Pill Cultivator with a powerful divine sense.
And eventually, even completely eliminate a Fake Pill Cultivator.
Is this really just a Foundation Establishment Cultivator?
...
After He Chen left, Xu Ping went straight to the door of the cultivation chamber.
Standing before the stone door, he formed magic techniques with both hands, accompanied by a flicker of spiritual light.
In an instant, the restriction enveloping the entire cultivation chamber shattered like a bubble, fading away without a trace.
Then, with a wave of his right hand, a surge of spiritual power erupted, and the massive stone door slowly opened automatically, emitting a deep rumbling sound.
As his gaze moved forward with the opening door, a figure lay quietly in the corner of the cultivation chamber.
Upon closer inspection, it was Hua Yan in a state of unconsciousness.
At that time, Xu Ping hadn’t immediately killed Hua Yan, as he needed to find a method to solve the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill’s training problem.
And, of course, he needed to perform a soul search.
On the way back to Thousand Leaves Mountain from Earth Soul Mountain, time was too tight, so he had no choice but to bring Hua Yan back to Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Now that the situation was mostly dealt with, he was naturally going to take his time dealing with him.
Xu Ping entered the cultivation chamber, and the stone door closed automatically.
He approached Hua Yan, reaching out with his right hand, which resembled an eagle’s claw, and firmly grasped Hua Yan’s head.
"Soul-Searching Technique!"
With a soft shout, Xu Ping’s divine sense infiltrated his sea of consciousness, forcibly extracting his memories.
The skills of a Fake Pill Cultivator were extremely varied and extensive, requiring careful exploration and organization.
Fortunately, Xu Ping’s experience was quite rich, and he quickly found all the memories related to the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill from Hua Yan’s chaotic memories.
"The calming incense really is problematic!" Xu Ping’s gaze instantly turned as cold as ice, filled with endless coldness.
From his memories, he learned that although the calming incense solved the issue of severe pain in the sea of consciousness, it was highly addictive.
Once one became overly reliant on the calming incense, the user would become thoroughly entangled, forming an inescapable dependency.
At that point, the user would be like a puppet controlled by strings, at the mercy of others.
Moreover, upon close examination of the memories, Xu Ping discovered that He Chen was involved in the entire matter from start to finish.
If it weren’t for He Chen acting as an intermediary and catalyst, Hua Yan probably wouldn’t have targeted him.
At this thought, Xu Ping’s intention to kill He Chen intensified.
However, now was not the time for revenge.
Suppressing his killing intent, Xu Ping continued to delve into the memories regarding training the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill.
Time slipped quietly by in silence, and several hours passed in a flash.
"So that’s how it is, the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill can continue to be practiced!!" Xu Ping’s eyes suddenly showed intense excitement and joy.
After thoroughly exploring all of Hua Yan’s memories regarding the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill, Xu Ping finally discovered the true reason why he had always failed to succeed because of the severe pain in his sea of consciousness while practicing the skill.
It was because that old bastard Hua Yan had withheld a secret technique essential for the practice of Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill.
This auxiliary secret technique was called "Solid Spirit Skill," which had a similar effect to calming incense, stabilizing the sea of consciousness during the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill training.
However, unlike calming incense, Solid Spirit Skill had no side effects at all, making it a perfect auxiliary technique.
What’s more shocking for Xu Ping was that the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill actually had two layers, yet Hua Yan always claimed publicly that there was only one.
During the initial trade, Hua Yan naturally only gave Xu Ping the first layer.
The first layer of Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill required at least the Late-Stage Foundation Establishment to practice. If the first layer was cultivated to its limit, it could enhance one’s divine sense by thirty percent.
The second layer required at least the realm of a Golden Core Cultivator to qualify for practice. If cultivated to its limit, it could enhance one’s divine sense by forty percent.
To know, that is a forty percent divine sense increase at the Golden Core Level.
The strength of the divine sense enhancement, far surpassing the increment of the Foundation Establishment Realm, was vastly different in comparison.
With Xu Ping’s current divine sense strength far exceeding that of a Foundation Establishment Cultivator, even if he successfully advanced to the Golden Core afterward, his divine sense strength might not compare to a Middle Stage Golden Core Cultivator.
Attempting to easily surpass the Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment divine sense strength like he did at Early-Stage Foundation Establishment was almost impossible.
This was the enormous gap between Golden Core Cultivators, not just in mana but also in divine sense.

chapters.title: Chapter 274 - 195: Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill Successfully Cultivated
chapters.content:
Chapter 274: Chapter 195: Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill Successfully Cultivated
"A fortune has come my way!" Xu Ping couldn’t suppress the joy in his heart and laughed out loud.
This sudden gain was completely unexpected, a surprising delight.
Xu Ping understood well that this complete Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill, if placed within the Luoyun Sect, would surely be a town-level secret whose value was immeasurable.
For Xu Ping, the worth of this Secret Technique far surpassed the massive amount of Spirit Stones, precious Artifact Embryos, and various rare resources in Hua Yan’s Storage Ring.
What’s more, with his well-versed panel, he had no worries about failing to successfully cultivate this skill.
And thanks to this unique advantage, the boost that cultivating this Secret Technique could bring him was destined to far exceed ordinary cultivators.
Just thinking about the terrifying intensity of Divine Sense achievable in Foundation Establishment Realm was exciting beyond control.
Fake Pill?
Golden Core?
.....
"It’s better to first record the complete Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill on a jade slip."
Xu Ping suppressed his excitement, knowing that preserving the Secret Technique was the priority.
He took out a blank jade slip and began recording the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill word for word on it.
After nearly a half-hour, he finally recorded all complete information of the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill in detail on the jade slip.
Xu Ping checked the jade slip repeatedly, confirming multiple times that no detail was incorrect, then carefully and assuredly put it away.
Having done this, Xu Ping’s gaze fell on Hua Yan again, his eyes now filled with coldness.
He flicked his fingers lightly, and a dazzling spirit light shot out from his fingertips, directly blasting Hua Yan’s heart.
Blood spurted out like a fountain from the wound, quickly dyeing the ground shockingly red, and a pungent smell of blood filled the practice room.
Hua Yan, even in his unconsciousness, let out a muffled groan from such a severe injury as his life force quickly waned like a candle in the wind.
It wasn’t long before there was no movement, leaving only a gradually cooling corpse.
Then, Xu Ping flicked his fingers again, and a blazing fireball landed accurately on Hua Yan’s corpse.
In just a moment, Hua Yan’s body was burned into a pile of ashes.
Thus, the great revenge was achieved, and the long-kept resentment in Xu Ping’s heart was finally vented, leaving him exceptionally pleased.
But he knew well this wasn’t the time to relax and celebrate.
He quickly and carefully cleaned the practice room, wiped away all remnants, and was eagerly ready to begin practicing the Solid Spirit Skill.
Only by successfully cultivating the Solid Spirit Skill could he formally start practicing the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill.
With these thoughts, Xu Ping couldn’t wait another moment.
...
....
A month quietly passed.
Within the practice room in Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"Solid Spirit Skill!"
Xu Ping focused intently, his hands quickly forming seals, accompanied by a low shout.
In an instant, a strange force gathered around him.
At this moment, in his Sea of Consciousness, a transparent film undulated like water waves, enveloping the entire Sea of Consciousness.
"The Solid Spirit Skill... successfully cultivated!"
Xu Ping felt the changes within his Sea of Consciousness, a slight smile appearing on his lips.
That film seemed fragile, yet it contained astonishing resilience, as if able to withstand any impact.
"Now, I can finally start cultivating the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill."
Xu Ping took a deep breath, adjusted his state, formed seals with his hands, then slowly closed his eyes, immersing his mind completely into his Sea of Consciousness, solemnly attempting to cultivate the "Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill" once again.
As the cultivation technique began to operate quietly, strands of mana carefully flowed into his Sea of Consciousness, which instantly erupted into tempestuous waves like encountering a storm.
However, this time, the film vibrated slightly, neutralizing the violent energy fluctuations.
The tearing pain vanished, replaced by a cool and refreshing sensation.
Xu Ping’s Divine Sense roamed his Sea of Consciousness like a fish swimming in a clear lake.
He was completely immersed in this extraordinary state, forgetting everything around him.
Time spent cultivating always quietly slips by unnoticeably, having no sense of how long it has been.
Xu Ping suddenly awakened from this entranced state, a sharp gleam appearing in his eyes.
"This... is Entry Level?"
Xu Ping suppressed the surging excitement in his heart and eagerly summoned the proficiency panel.
[Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill Entry Level: 1/100]
"It truly is Entry Level!"
Seeing the clear display on the panel, Xu Ping could not suppress his excitement and laughed out loud.
After expending so much time and effort, he’s finally cultivated this Secret Technique to entry level.
When his emotions slightly settled, Xu Ping calmed down and began to carefully feel the subtle changes in his own Divine Sense and Sea of Consciousness.
As expected.
Divine Sense and Sea of Consciousness hadn’t undergone any shocking transformation, but he could barely feel a slight increase.
This is quite normal, after all, this Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill focuses on mana tempering and nurturing the Sea of Consciousness.
They continuously wash over the barriers of the Sea of Consciousness, making it increasingly resilient and expansive, while simultaneously, cultivators’ Divine Sense will slowly become stronger in this process.
Thus even if the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill successfully reaches entry level, no drastic changes occur in Divine Sense and Sea of Consciousness.
It is a gradual enhancement process.

chapters.title: Chapter 275 - 195: Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill Successfully Cultivated
chapters.content:
Chapter 275: Chapter 195: Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill Successfully Cultivated
Xu Ping had expected this and felt no disappointment or impatience.
He stood up and walked out of the cave abode.
Looking around, he felt delighted.
The lush greens and vibrant reds wrapped around him, and the unique fragrance of Spirit Medicine and Spirit Plants filled the entire Thousand Leaves Mountain.
At this moment, a Water Lake Mouse was using magic to water the Spirit Medicine in front of a field, and under the gentle spiritual rain, the Spirit Medicine appeared even greener.
After strolling around leisurely, Xu Ping felt satisfied and returned to his cultivation room to continue his practice.
Although he had mastered the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill, there were still many things he hadn’t done.
Such as cultivating ’Guiding Spirit into the Veins’ or refining Artifact Embryos.
These undoubtedly would require a vast amount of time.
...
...
In the following time, Xu Ping became busy again.
Sword practice, cultivation, and practicing various kinds of Magic, he hardly had time to rest.
However, this intense training pace was something Xu Ping had long been accustomed to.
To him, it wasn’t arduous at all; rather, he found great enjoyment in it.
As for Hua Yan’s death, the Luoyun Sect’s reaction was also as he expected, without any suspicion falling on him.
Instead, after a seemingly thorough investigation, Luoyun Sect casually found some so-called enemy of Hua Yan as a scapegoat, hastily concluding the matter.
As for Song Fei, after being wanted by the Luoyun Sect, he never showed up again, nor did he target Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Without these potential external disturbances and threats, Xu Ping immersed himself wholeheartedly in the world of cultivation.
Seeing various skills improve bit by bit like this, even after so many years, was something he found endlessly fascinating.
Half a year went by quietly.
This day in the cultivation room.
Xu Ping sat with his eyes closed, his whole aura restrained, immersed in deep cultivation.
Suddenly!
A tremendous and powerful Divine Sense erupted from Xu Ping’s Sea of Consciousness like a raging flood.
This unstoppable Divine Sense swept through the entire cultivation room with the force of a tsunami.
Whoosh!
This mighty Divine Sense coursed with tangible energy waves, rippling through the void, creating visible ripples in the air.
Under its influence, the items in the room were blown into disarray, left in a chaotic state.
It only lasted for a brief moment.
This overwhelming Divine Sense then abruptly retracted. If it weren’t for the chaotic scene in the cultivation room, it would seem as if the Divine Sense explosion had never happened.
At this moment, Xu Ping slowly opened his eyes, excitement flashing in his gaze, and a smile tugging at the corners of his mouth: "The Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill... has broken through!"
His eyes moved downward, landing on the proficiency panel.
[Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill Proficiency: 1/200]
"Spent half a year... finally broke through the proficiency stage." Xu Ping murmured to himself, a trace of sentiment in his voice.
After speaking, Xu Ping closed his eyes again, calming his mind, and began to carefully sense the significant changes in his Sea of Consciousness and Divine Sense.
First, he clearly perceived that compared to before, his current Sea of Consciousness had made a qualitative leap in both tenacity and breadth.
This enhancement was very noticeable, even more formidable and stable than the Sea of Consciousness of typical Fake Pill cultivators.
It is known that the Sea of Consciousness is the foundation of the Divine Sense, and only with a solid and profound foundation can the Divine Sense not be like a castle in the sky, swaying and fragile at the slightest touch.
Secondly, upon careful perception, he found that the strength of his current Divine Sense had increased by at least one-fifth compared to before.
Don’t underestimate this seemingly minor one-fifth increase; even before, his Divine Sense was slightly inferior to Fake Pill cultivators but not by much.
Now, with this one-fifth enhancement, his Divine Sense was no less formidable than some Fake Pill cultivators.
"With my current powerful Divine Sense coupled with the superb disguising abilities of the Thousand Illusion Mask, even an Early Stage Golden Core cultivator would have difficulty discerning my true identity, right?" Xu Ping pondered to himself.
As for whether cultivators at the Middle Stage of Golden Core could see through his disguise, Xu Ping wasn’t entirely confident.
After all, the Divine Sense of a Middle Stage Golden Core cultivator was far more potent than that of the Early Stage.
However, for the current stage, it was enough.
After all, his only Golden Core Realm enemy was Song Fei.
As long as the other didn’t find out, it was enough!
...
"Let’s take a half-day rest today."
Xu Ping slowly stood up, stretched his stiff body from the long cultivation, and then walked out of the cultivation room.
After half a year of arduous training, it was time to give himself a break.
On top of Thousand Leaves Mountain, covered by an Array, the seasons were like spring all year round.
The gentle breeze blew, and the air was very fresh.
Xu Ping strolled beneath the three-zhang tall, lush Hundred Bamboo Wood.
He gently leaped and then lay down on a flat stone slab, eyes slightly closed, entering a state of reposeful rest.
An utterly comfortable appearance.
The Water Lake Mouse, busying itself in the spirit fields, dared not disturb him, only lowering the sounds of its work as much as possible to avoid bothering Xu Ping.
However, just as Xu Ping was enjoying a rare leisurely moment, Hongyi paid an unexpected visit.
In the pavilion, the fragrance of Spirit Tea lingered.
Xu Ping poured a cup for Hongyi as they sat across from each other.
After taking a sip of tea, Hongyi sighed, "Fellow Daoist Xu truly lives a leisurely life, drawing talismans and cultivating Spirit Medicine, so at ease."
"What is there to envy about this."

chapters.title: Chapter 276 - 195: Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill Successfully Cultivated (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 276: Chapter 195: Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill Successfully Cultivated (3)
Xu Ping responded with a smile, making a self-deprecating remark after putting down the teacup, "The current situation in the Wanzhe Waters is turbulent; my courage is small, so I dare not venture out easily."
The first half of the sentence was not a lie. Stimulated by the various treasures in the Nine Nether Elder’s relics, the entire Wanzhe Waters was literally in chaos.
Although there was no intervention from Nascent Soul cultivators, fights among Golden Core Stage cultivators occurred frequently and were exceptionally intense.
There was even a Golden Core cultivator from Hu Country who perished, and as for Fake Pill cultivators, even more had fallen.
"Although the Wanzhe Waters are indeed turbulent, the treasures in the Nine Nether Elder’s relics are numerous. Fellow Daoist Xu, take a look at this."
Hongyi slightly smiled, then flipped his palm revealing a transparent jade box in his hand.
Xu Ping fixed his gaze and saw two fist-sized, crystal-clear Spirit Peaches emanating an exotic fragrance lying inside the jade box.
"This is... the Hundred-Year Fruit!!"
Xu Ping’s eyes lit up, instantly recognizing the Quasi-Tier Three spirit fruit, the Hundred-Year Fruit, that he had consumed before.
Seeing this, Hongyi gently pushed the jade box towards Xu Ping, asking, "Is Fellow Daoist Xu satisfied?"
"I am certainly immensely satisfied, thank you Fellow Daoist Hong." Xu Ping joyfully accepted the jade box, hastily cupping his hands to thank Hongyi.
Fake Pill cultivators are indeed different; previously Duan Shuang and Gong Yang risked their lives and could only bring out one, while Hongyi’s action produced two, the difference is plain to see.
"You are too kind, although the Hundred-Year Fruit is precious, among the numerous treasures, it is not considered the most superior."
"Most of the contestants for this fruit are Foundation Establishment Stage cultivators, so acquiring it wasn’t too difficult with my abilities," Hongyi waved his hand, sounding rather modest.
"Fellow Daoist Hong, being a Fake Pill cultivator, possesses great Divine Techniques, naturally unmatched by Foundation Establishment cultivators."
Xu Ping replied with a smile, carefully storing the two Hundred-Year Fruit, then asked, "I wonder if Fellow Daoist Hong has found the Transformation Pill Fruit?"
"It’s not that easy to obtain." Hongyi chuckled with a hint of helplessness, slightly shaking his head.
"However, I can determine its approximate location." As he spoke, a gleam flashed in Hongyi’s eyes.
"Since Fellow Daoist Hong can pinpoint the location of the Transformation Pill Fruit, acquiring it must be within reach." Xu Ping asserted confidently.
"Let’s hope!" Hongyi sighed slightly.
Facing Fake Pill cultivators from three countries, especially those from major sects, even with Quasi-Tier Three talismans at hand, he couldn’t claim much advantage.
"By the way."
Hongyi seemed to remember something important and continued, "Luoyun Sect plans to hold a grand auction on Dragon Lion Island, and it’s said that Millennium Spiritual Liquid will be up for bids."
"Millennium Spiritual Liquid?"
Xu Ping was taken aback, urgently asking, "Is this true?"
Millennium Spiritual Liquid is a genuine Tier Three life-extending substance, usually formed from Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi, taking a millennium to form and can extend the life of a Golden Core cultivator by at least forty years.
Moreover, Millennium Spiritual Liquid, besides possessing miraculous life-extending properties, also enhances physical condition and slightly boosts a cultivator’s cultivation.
However, compared to its significant life-extending function, its effects on enhancing physique and cultivation can only be considered auxiliary.
For Golden Core cultivators, the cultivation improvement from Millennium Spiritual Liquid consumption equates roughly to what half a year of hard practice would yield.
"Pretty much!" Hongyi nodded.
"I know Fellow Daoist Xu has been gathering information on life-extending substances, so you must be very interested in this Millennium Spiritual Liquid, so I came specifically to inform you."
"This is incredibly interesting!" Xu Ping couldn’t hide his excitement, "I wonder if Fellow Daoist Hong plans to attend the auction?"
"I probably won’t go." Hongyi decisively shook his head, "The Transformation Pill Fruit’s location is finally confirmed; I can’t afford delays here, lest someone else seizes the opportunity."
Hearing this, disappointment flickered in Xu Ping’s eyes.
He hoped Hongyi could help him bid for the Millennium Spiritual Liquid at the auction, but it seems this hope has diminished.
"Although Millennium Spiritual Liquid is precious, many other treasures at the Luoyun Sect’s auction surpass it."
"Golden Core cultivators won’t fight too fiercely over it, as besides those with imminent lifespans, others are more inclined to spend Spirit Stones on cultivation-increasing pills." Hongyi explained with a smile.
"That’s true." Xu Ping nodded.
That may be, but when it comes to Golden Core cultivators, who can say for sure; currently, his strength compared to Golden Core cultivators is still somewhat lacking.
Xu Ping pondered for a moment, then asked, "I wonder when the Luoyun Sect’s auction will start."
"In six months." Hongyi replied.
"Six months." Xu Ping murmured.
Six months may be short for other cultivators, making significant strength improvements unrealistic.
But for him, it might be different.
This auction seems worth attending, as missing items like the Millennium Spiritual Liquid means the next occurrence would be uncertain.
...
...
After Hongyi left with two Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans, Xu Ping hurried to his cultivation chamber and took out the two Hundred-Year Fruit.
"Hundred-Year Fruit!"
Smelling the exotic fragrance of the two crystal-clear spirit fruits, Xu Ping couldn’t help but smile.
He had consumed one previously, and its effects remain fresh in his memory.
Even though subsequent consumption might not be as effective as the first, it surely won’t be disappointing.
Without hesitation, Xu Ping quickly swallowed the two Hundred-Year Fruit.
As he swallowed, the Hundred-Year Peach was continuously refined by Longevity Mana in his stomach, transforming into an endless stream of Essence, replenishing himself.
After over half an hour, the two Hundred-Year Peach were completely absorbed.
"Extended life by seventy years, proficiency increased by seventy points!!"

chapters.title: Chapter 277 - 196: Spirit Vein Upgrade; Spirit Silk Skill Mastered
chapters.content:
Chapter 277: Chapter 196: Spirit Vein Upgrade; Spirit Silk Skill Mastered
"Seventy years of extended life, and proficiency increased by seventy points!!"
Feeling the genuine growth in his lifespan and the increase in his Longevity Skill proficiency, Xu Ping’s mood was exceedingly joyful.
The first one increased his lifespan by forty years, the second by thirty.
Although these two weren’t as effective as the first one he consumed, they were still quite satisfactory for him.
Out of habit, he opened the proficiency panel.
[Name: Xu Ping]
[Lifespan: 68/558 years]
[Realm: Late-Stage Foundation Establishment: 51/100; Blood Demon Body Refining Second Layer: 99/100]
[Cultivation Technique: Longevity Skill - Mastery: 801/1600]
...
"Lifespan has officially exceeded five hundred."
Xu Ping murmured to himself, his gaze resting on the high figure of five hundred and fifty-eight years, an involuntary satisfied smile curling at the corners of his mouth.
This had entirely reached the lifespan of a Golden Core Cultivator.
A Foundation Establishment Cultivator possessing the lifespan of a Golden Core Cultivator was beyond the realm of an ordinary cultivator’s understanding. More important, this was far from the limit of his lifespan.
As long as he could find more longevity-extending spiritual objects, his lifespan could continue to grow.
All of this was thanks to the Longevity Skill at the level of mastery.
Xu Ping’s gaze moved down to the realm and technique sections.
[Realm: Late-Stage Foundation Establishment: 51/100; Blood Demon Body Refining Second Layer: 99/100]
[Cultivation Technique: Longevity Skill - Mastery: 801/1600]
...
"Now that my realm and proficiency in the Longevity Skill have both surpassed half. According to the normal cultivation progress, in another decade or so, I should reach the Foundation Establishment Perfection stage.
"However, the cultivation progress of the Longevity Skill, in comparison, is still somewhat slower," Xu Ping thought to himself silently.
"But, if I can auction the Millennium Spiritual Liquid, the breakthrough time will certainly be greatly advanced," a flash of anticipation crossed Xu Ping’s eyes.
The effect of the Millennium Spiritual Liquid was far stronger than the Hundred-Year Fruit. Moreover, besides increasing lifespan and Longevity Skill proficiency, it also had the effect of enhancing cultivation.
Although for high-level cultivators in the Golden Core Stage, the cultivation improvement from consuming the Millennium Spiritual Liquid wasn’t significant, for someone like him still in the Foundation Establishment stage, its effects surpassed many spirit pills and wondrous medicines.
"It seems I must attend this auction organized by the Luoyun Sect," Xu Ping made up his mind.
Besides, he also planned to acquire some materials needed for the Purifying Spirit Nourishing Vein Array and Spirit Worms at the auction.
After years of continuous practice, his mastery of the Earth Master’s Gaze had become increasingly refined, nearing the realm of mastery.
Now, the complex network of spirit veins buried beneath the Thousand Leaves Mountain had become clearer and more discernible to him.
As such, the Purifying Spirit Nourishing Vein Array and Spirit Worms naturally needed to be arranged as soon as possible.
The most crucial technique of introducing the spirit into the veins could finally be performed.
...
...
Time slipped away like sand through an hourglass, bit by bit.
Two months later, deep in the night.
The night sky was like an endless black silk mantle, softly and serenely spread across the vast heavens and earth, enveloping everything in a mysterious veil.
In the sky, a bright moon hung like a radiant pearl, shimmering high on the dark blue canopy.
The cold and gentle moonlight poured down unreservedly, penetrating through the branches, casting fragmented and mottled shadows on the ground.
At this moment.
On Thousand Leaves Mountain, everything was silent.
Xu Ping sat quietly on a large rock, his eyes gently closed.
Suddenly, a faint wave emanated from the distant horizon, like a gentle breeze quietly sweeping across a calm lake, instantly creating subtle ripples.
This seemingly insignificant wave contained an indescribable mystical power.
"It’s here!"
Xu Ping opened his eyes abruptly, excitement and anticipation lighting up his gaze.
He quickly stood up, for the Spiritual Qi tide he had long awaited finally arrived.
"Open!"
Xu Ping’s face remained calm, his hands moving rapidly to form seals, a low shout escaping his mouth.
In an instant, the mana within his dantian, like a surging flood, rapidly flowed along special meridians and rushed toward his forehead.
In a moment, a vertical eye slowly emerged on Xu Ping’s forehead.
With the Earth Master’s Gaze successfully activated, Xu Ping didn’t dare show any carelessness and immediately prepared to perform the technique of introducing the spirit into the veins to enhance the quality of the spirit veins.
After all, the Spiritual Qi tide was an opportunity that lasted for an extremely short time. Once missed, he’d have to wait for the next chance.
"Introduce the spirit into the veins!"
When the Spiritual Qi tide’s surge reached its peak state, Xu Ping’s hands rapidly formed seals, complex and mysterious spells flying from his fingertips.
Simultaneously, incantations softly murmured from his mouth, mingling with mysterious power, resonating in the air.
Buzz!
At this moment, a gentle halo emanated from Xu Ping’s entire body.
This halo seemed to possess a unique magic, like a magnet, establishing a subtle and close connection with the surging and raging Spiritual Qi in the heavens and earth.
