The originally raging Spiritual Qi, as if pulled by an invisible hand, began changing directions, swiftly converging towards Xu Ping’s location.
Those streams of Spiritual Qi transformed into brilliant beams of light, circling above Xu Ping rapidly, forming a massive and gorgeous Spiritual Qi vortex.
At the center of the vortex, Xu Ping’s figure grew increasingly mysterious and unfathomable.
Despite the immense pressure he was bearing at the moment, Xu Ping’s expression remained calm and composed, steady as a mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 278 - 196: Spirit Vein Upgrade; Spirit Silk Skill Mastered (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 278: Chapter 196: Spirit Vein Upgrade; Spirit Silk Skill Mastered (Part 2)
He focused all his attention on controlling the vast and majestic Spiritual Qi, not daring to be distracted in the slightest.
Then, Xu Ping concentrated all his attention on the spirit vein deeply buried beneath Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Under the proficient gaze of the Earth Master’s Gaze, the complex network of the spirit vein clearly appeared before him, like a detailed map.
He quickly located its core!
"Manifest!"
Xu Ping uttered softly, his hands changing the magic technique.
In an instant, a faintly discernible Spiritual Qi passage slowly took shape.
This passage was like a bridge spanning heaven and earth, emitting a heart-palpitating glow, connecting the vast flow of external Spiritual Qi with the silent spirit vein beneath Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"Integrate!"
Xu Ping’s mind moved slightly, then he gently pointed with his index finger.
In an instant, the Spiritual Qi within the passage transformed into a raging, turbulent river, roaring deafeningly as it rushed toward the spirit vein buried under Thousand Leaves Mountain.
As the first stream of Spiritual Qi flow reached the spirit vein through the passage, the entire Thousand Leaves Mountain trembled.
The gentle Spiritual Qi originally permeating Thousand Leaves Mountain suddenly became agitated, like an enraged beast.
Under the watchful gaze of Xu Ping’s Earth Master’s Eyes.
The spirit vein, like a container yearning for a long-overdue rainfall, eagerly absorbed this powerful Spiritual Qi.
As the Spiritual Qi continued to pour in, Xu Ping’s expression gradually grew more solemn.
He knew that a slight error at this moment could not only waste previous efforts but might also cause chaos in the spirit vein, leading to irreparable disaster for this region’s spirit vein.
He increased his control over the Spiritual Qi passage, slowing down the infusion to strive for stability.
As the Spiritual Qi persisted in flowing in, the spirit vein buried beneath Thousand Leaves Mountain grew increasingly radiant, its vitality becoming even richer.
Initially narrow and fragile spirit vein pathways gradually expanded and toughened, with new branches growing continuously, extending outward like the root system of a great tree.
The land surrounding the spirit vein was also affected, becoming unusually fertile.
Especially the spirit medicine and spirit plants grown in the spiritual fields, under the careful nourishment of abundant Spiritual Qi, appeared increasingly lush and vibrant.
And Xu Ping, amid all these changes, dared not relax for a moment. Even though sweat covered his forehead, he maintained his complete focus, guiding the flood of Spiritual Qi.
"The master’s actions this time... are too significant!" Not far away, Water Lake Rat widened its round eyes, staring blankly at the spectacular scene before it.
If it weren’t for the array barely concealing this, the area within tens of miles might have seen it.
As time went on, the tidal wave of Spiritual Qi began to recede gradually.
The Spiritual Qi infused into the spirit vein became increasingly scarce, like the receding sea water returning to the ocean, and Thousand Leaves Mountain slowly calmed down.
When the Spiritual Qi tide completely retreated, Xu Ping could no longer sustain it. He decisively ended the magic technique, no longer maintaining the connection between heaven and earth’s Spiritual Qi and the spirit vein.
"Hoo!"
At the moment the Spiritual Qi passage vanished, the immense pressure that had been bearing down on Xu Ping suddenly disappeared.
His tense nerves finally relaxed, and he couldn’t help but take a long breath of relief.
"No wonder there are almost no people upgrading spirit veins; aside from the difficulty of finding an Earth Master, the main reason is that upgrading is truly labor-intensive." Xu Ping wiped the sweat from his forehead, saying with a bitter smile.
Maintaining the Spiritual Qi passage and controlling Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi is an immense pressure, even considering his current Divine Sense and cultivation.
If other Foundation Establishment Cultivators came, they might not be able to sustain it; at least a Fake Pill cultivation would be needed to withstand it.
After resting for a moment.
Xu Ping’s Divine Sense spread across the entire summit of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
He calmed down and carefully sensed the changes in this region after performing the technique of guiding spirit into the vein.
"Not bad, the Spiritual Qi of Thousand Leaves Mountain has grown denser and more active."
Half an hour later, Xu Ping slowly retracted his Divine Sense, showing a satisfied expression.
To achieve such effects on the first attempt at guiding spirit into the vein is quite impressive.
Especially considering that his proficiency in guiding spirit into the vein is only at a proficient level; as proficiency increases, the effects are bound to improve further.
Upgrading to a Quasi-Tier Three spirit vein is completely feasible.
However, there is still a considerable wait for the next arrival of the Spiritual Qi tide.
"The master truly possesses immense Divine Techniques!"
At this moment, galloping up to Xu Ping, Water Lake Rat’s face was full of flattering smiles, speaking with flattery.
It too felt the change in Spiritual Qi at Thousand Leaves Mountain, amazed by the master’s means to even improve the quality of spirit veins.
"Hmm."
Xu Ping merely nodded slightly, briefly responding, and turned to walk toward the cultivation room.
Having just performed the technique of guiding spirit into the vein, both his Divine Sense and mana were greatly depleted, and he had no time to spare for Water Lake Rat.
"Master worked hard."
Even though he was treated perfunctorily, Water Lake Rat still wore a smile, nodding and bowing, appearing like an utter sycophant.
The enhancement of spirit vein quality is beneficial to it.
Undoubtedly, it can accelerate cultivation!
...
In the cultivation room.
Xu Ping sat cross-legged on the bed, quietly running the cultivation technique to restore depleted mana.
At this moment, the benefits of increased Spiritual Qi concentration were evident.
Within a few hours, he restored his mana to perfection within his Dantian.
Xu Ping opened his eyes, a hint of joy flashing in them: "Even though the spirit vein hasn’t been upgraded to Quasi-Tier Three yet, the effects are already substantial, truly commendable."

chapters.title: Chapter 279 - 196: Spirit Vein Upgrade; Spirit Silk Skill Mastered (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 279: Chapter 196: Spirit Vein Upgrade; Spirit Silk Skill Mastered (Part 3)
"Once I upgrade to a quasi-tier three Spirit Vein, and with the support of the Array, the speed at which I disperse and re-cultivate will be even faster."
Currently, he is not far from the realm of Foundation Establishment Perfection.
Once he reaches Foundation Establishment Perfection, he will be able to cultivate the Core Formation Secret Technique, increasing the success rate of forming a core by compressing mana.
The process of dispersing and re-cultivating undoubtedly poses the greatest danger to him.
Therefore, he must do everything possible to shorten the time required for re-cultivation as much as possible.
Only in this way can he maximize the safety of himself.
And improving the quality of the Spirit Vein is undoubtedly the key to shortening the re-cultivation time.
"It would be best to upgrade the Spirit Vein to a quasi-tier three before re-cultivating," Xu Ping pondered in his heart.
Although time is a bit tight, with the auxiliary panel, it’s not impossible.
After all, as the proficiency of channeling Spiritual Qi into veins increases, its efficiency will double.
"However, it’s still a bit early for the next Spiritual Qi tide to arrive. The urgent matter at hand is still to prioritize the Luoyun Sect auction affairs."
Currently, there are about four months left until the auction held by the Luoyun Sect.
The primary task for this auction trip is to ensure his safety without fail.
In terms of hiding his identity, with the Thousand Illusion Mask, he should not be overly worried.
However, there is still room for improvement in terms of combat power.
Thinking of this, Xu Ping opened the proficiency panel and focused his gaze on the Spirit Silk Skill.
[Spirit Silk Skill Minor Achievement: 711/800]
...
"Almost there, just 89 more points to Great Success!" Looking at the data displayed on the panel, Xu Ping’s eyes gleamed.
Once the Spirit Silk Skill achieves Great Success, he can construct the Three Talents Talisman Array based on the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman.
Although the power of the Three Talents Talisman Array built with third-rank middle-grade talismans may pose a limited threat to late-stage Golden Core super cultivators,
it is enough to be a deadly threat to middle stage Golden Core cultivators.
Moreover, with his significantly increased Divine Sense, he can fully master this incredibly powerful Three Talents Talisman Array.
Of course, all of this is based on the premise that he can use the Talisman Array first.
Otherwise, if a middle stage Golden Core cultivator strikes first, he probably won’t even have a chance to deploy the Talisman Array.
"For now, I need to focus most of my energy on the Spirit Silk Skill," Xu Ping thought to himself.
Based on the current progress estimate, with four more months, he should just barely be able to break through the Spirit Silk Skill to the Great Success Realm.
However, before officially starting to cultivate the Spirit Silk Skill, Xu Ping still spent a few days recovering his depleted Divine Sense to perfection.
"Let’s begin!"
Finally, after his Divine Sense recovered, Xu Ping’s expression was calm as water. He sat steadily in the training room, formally preparing to start practicing the Spirit Silk Skill.
With a gentle wave of his right hand, a surge of mana flowed out, and dozens of First Rank talismans instantly floated neatly in mid-air, shimmering with a faint blue light.
Then, he formed a seal with his hands, and the mana within his body circulated quickly along a special meridian path like a raging torrent.
In an instant.
Dozens of nearly imperceptible mana threads burst forth from between his index fingers, like nimble threads, landing precisely on the dozens of talismans suspended in the void.
Immediately, Xu Ping flicked his index finger lightly.
The dozens of talismans intertwined, shuttling back and forth at such a rapid pace that it was dazzling to watch.
...
...
Three and a half months passed in the blink of an eye.
In the training room.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh...
Accompanied by a series of whirring sounds of breaking through the air, over a hundred talismans were rampaging through the not-too-spacious room.
They seemed chaotic and disordered, with no pattern to follow, but a close observation would reveal that each talisman’s trajectory was in perfect order. This extremely contradictory scene provided a strong visual impact.
Xu Ping’s face remained calm as he steadily controlled everything.
Each mana thread felt like an extension of his body, closely connected to those talismans.
Suddenly.
The talismans rampaging in the training room emitted a dense buzzing sound, as if unleashing a power on the cusp of breaking through.
A strong fluctuation of mana surged around Xu Ping, and the previously stable mana threads suddenly shone brightly, so dazzling that it was hard to look directly at.
"The Spirit Silk Skill... has reached Great Success!"
At this moment, there was a hint of understanding in Xu Ping’s eyes, and a slight curve appeared at the corner of his mouth.
With a slight movement of his index finger, the seemingly out-of-control hundreds of talismans instantly transformed from intense movement to extreme stillness.
They aligned neatly in mid-air, as quiet as obedient lambs, forming a stark contrast to the previous fierce scene.
"Finally, I’ve broken through the Spirit Silk Skill to Great Success before the auction," Xu Ping breathed a long sigh of relief, feeling particularly joyful.
He beckoned with his right hand, and the hundreds of floating talismans in the void fell into his palm.
"I can begin constructing the Three Talents Talisman Array with the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman as the foundation!" Once Xu Ping properly stored the First Rank talismans, he cautiously took out three Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans.
It is necessary to become familiar with the process of constructing the Three Talents Talisman Array in advance to avoid being flustered and messing up in the event of real danger.
"Rise!"
Mana surged from Xu Ping, and the three Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans glowed with spiritual light, suddenly flying from his palm and hovering silently in the air.
Then, he began to construct the Three Talents Talisman Array step by step in order.
With his current Great Success level of the Spirit Silk Skill, combined with a Divine Sense comparable to that of a Fake Pill cultivator, the process was supremely smooth.
"Trap!"
Under Xu Ping’s precise control, the three talismans interwove and shuttled nimbly in the void, cooperating seamlessly and without interference.
At the same time, the Qi between them began to interlink, thread by thread, closely connected, as if they had become an inseparable whole.
"It’s done!"

chapters.title: Chapter 280 - 197: Winning the Bid for the Tier 3 Upper Grade Body Refining Technique, Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 280: Chapter 197: Winning the Bid for the Tier 3 Upper Grade Body Refining Technique, Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill
"It’s done!"
Xu Ping’s lips curled up slightly, an uncontrollable smile appearing, his eyes shimmering with excitement.
Indeed, as he had anticipated, relying on his Spirit Silk Skill, which had already reached the Great Success Realm, and coupled with the powerful Divine Sense comparable to that of a Fake Pill Realm expert.
The process of constructing a Three Talents Talisman Array using three Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans was completely unimpeded, everything proceeding smoothly.
However, because the Three Talents Talisman Array with the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman had come before, he was not overly excited.
"Disperse!"
Xu Ping softly uttered a word, his forefinger moving gracefully with a slight motion.
In an instant, the three Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans that formed the Three Talents Talisman Array in the air immediately dispersed.
The tightly-knit aura formed between each other was abruptly severed at that moment.
Subsequently, his forefinger moved gracefully once more, and the three Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans fell steadily into his hand.
"Now that the Three Talents Talisman Array is complete, it’s time to head to Dragon Lion Island." Xu Ping turned his hand, and the three Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans suddenly vanished, concealed within a storage space.
At this time, only half a month remained until the highly anticipated auction, and time was relatively tight.
After securing the Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans, Xu Ping stood up and left the cultivation room.
Just as he stepped out of the cultivation room, he saw the Shuize Mouse busy in the spiritual fields, and immediately communicated via Divine Sense: "I need to go out for a bit, take good care of the house."
"Rest assured, master!" The Shuize Mouse quickly raised its head, a fawning smile on its face.
In its heart, however, there was a burst of secret joy, as the master leaving meant it could justifiably laze about!
Xu Ping naturally could not fathom the little schemes in the Shuize Mouse’s heart.
After giving a few more simple instructions, he rode the Escape Light, his figure soon appearing in the sky.
...
...
Dragon Lion Island.
Once slaughtered by the Shuize Sect, it had become quite desolate.
However, with the news of a grand auction to be held here by the Luoyun Sect spreading like wildfire, Dragon Lion Island revived in a short time, flourishing and bustling once more.
Cultivators from three countries were gathering, becoming a chaotic mixture of fish and dragons, but with the intimidating presence of the Luoyun Sect, various forces were wary, and few dared to cause trouble or disrupt the order here.
Ten days later.
Xu Ping deliberately transformed into a tall and sturdy man, riding a Spiritual Boat swiftly toward Dragon Lion Island from a distant horizon.
From afar, he saw the brilliant spiritual light rising from Dragon Lion Island.
Above the island, hundreds of Escape Lights were shuttling back and forth, clearly all cultivators coming to attend the auction.
Xu Ping restrained his aura and descended at the dock on the outskirts of the island.
"Sir, are you here for the auction?"
A Qi Cultivation Stage disciple clad in the Luoyun Sect’s distinctive attire approached with steady steps, his demeanor neither obsequious nor overbearing, showing full courtesy in his words.
"Yes." Xu Ping replied in a deep voice.
"This is the Jade Token required for entry to the auction. Please be sure to keep it safe, sir. Otherwise, when the auction officially begins, it might be difficult to enter the venue without this token."
Saying this, the Luoyun Sect Qi Cultivation disciple took out a simple-looking Jade Pendant with a faint luster from his storage bag and handed it respectfully to Xu Ping with both hands.
"Thank you." Xu Ping reached out to take the Jade Pendant and politely thanked the other party.
After all, this person was a disciple of the Luoyun Sect, so a little politeness was certainly appropriate.
"You are too kind, sir. There are still five days before the auction officially begins. During this time, you might as well visit the market, where there are numerous rare treasures, including some rare and precious items."
The Luoyun Sect’s Qi Cultivation disciple smiled and cupped his hands enthusiastically.
"Hmm." Xu Ping gave a slight nod and then stepped into the market.
At this moment, a vast, overwhelming pressure from a Golden Core Cultivator suddenly descended, like an invisible mountain, heavily weighing on the hearts of every cultivator at the dock on the outskirts of the island.
The crowd showed expressions of astonishment and instinctively looked up to the sky.
They saw two dazzling Escape Lights streak across the sky like meteors, finally landing steadily at the market’s entrance.
As the Escape Lights gradually dissipated, two figures of cultivators became visible.
One was an elder with snow-white hair, and the other was a middle-aged man with an arrogant demeanor and extraordinary aura.
"A Middle Stage of Golden Core cultivator!"
Xu Ping keenly sensed the powerful cultivation aura emanating from the middle-aged man, causing him a silent shock.
It was important to know that such individuals were extremely rare in the Cultivation Realm of the surrounding three countries.
As for the elder with snow-white hair, although his cultivation was much lower, merely in the Fake Pill Realm,
he was not someone that ordinary cultivators could easily provoke.
The two of them swaggered toward the market as if no one else existed.
Seeing this, the crowd showed expressions of reverence, hastily making way for them, fearing even a slight misstep could anger these powerful seniors.
It was only after the two figures were completely swallowed by the mysterious light of the array at the market entrance that the people present seemed to be relieved, collectively letting out a sigh.
"That Golden Core senior is Jin Yifei, the Nascent Soul seed of the Profound Nether Sect from Feng Country!" A knowledgeable and experienced Foundation Establishment Cultivator in the crowd whispered.

chapters.title: Chapter 281 - 97: Winning the Bid for the Tier 3 Upper Grade Body Refining Technique: Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 281: Chapter 97: Winning the Bid for the Tier 3 Upper Grade Body Refining Technique: Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill (Part 2)
"Nascent Soul seed?"
"No wonder this senior’s aura is much stronger than that of an ordinary Golden Core senior!" whispered another person in amazement.
...
Upon hearing the murmurs of the crowd, Xu Ping remained uninterested and directly strode into the marketplace.
He was destined to have no interaction with them, and truly couldn’t be bothered to expend any effort understanding these irrelevant matters.
The moment he stepped into the market, he felt a powerful restriction wave.
"This array is at least at the third-rank middle grade level!" Xu Ping was secretly amazed.
With such an array combined with the disciples of the Luoyun Sect on the island, even a Golden Core Perfection cultivator would have difficulty breaching it in a short time.
Xu Ping walked along the main road paved with blue stones, flanked on both sides by shops with endless cries of vendors.
He noticed that the goods sold in these shops were of a much higher grade compared to regular marketplaces.
He even saw the presence of third-rank spiritual materials in a few shops.
However, Xu Ping wasn’t very interested and walked straight to a shop named "Hundred Beasts Studio" at the front door.
Hundred Beasts Studio was established and opened by the Hundred Beasts Sect, one of the Golden Core Sects of Yue Country, with a wide variety of spirit beasts.
As soon as he entered, an amiable Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment elder greeted him with a full-face smile and enthusiastically asked, "This fellow Daoist, is there any spirit beast you have your eye on?"
"Does your store have any Spirit Worms for sale?"
While speaking, Xu Ping looked around and found various spirit beasts on display in the store, but they were mostly first-rank spirit beasts.
"Spirit Worm?"
The elder’s face revealed a trace of surprise, then he curiously asked, "Are you an Earth Master?"
The Spirit Worm is a very rare demon beast, and although it has the effect of improving spirit veins, its intelligence is too low, making it difficult to control.
Moreover, very few cultivators are willing to purchase Spirit Worms to improve their spirit veins.
After all, without the Earth Master’s Gaze, you wouldn’t even know the exact location of the spirit vein, let alone talk about controlling the Spirit Worm to improve it.
"How come one must reveal their identity to purchase spirit beasts in your esteemed store?" Xu Ping, with a calm expression, responded faintly.
"That’s certainly not the meaning."
The elder hurriedly waved his hand to explain, "It’s just that Spirit Worms are extremely rare and uncommon. Not only is there no stock in this store, but even in our entire Hundred Beasts Sect, there is only one second-stage Spirit Worm."
"And this second-stage Spirit Worm is of great significance to our sect, so it certainly won’t be sold externally."
Upon hearing this, a trace of disappointment flickered in Xu Ping’s eyes.
If even the Hundred Beasts Sect doesn’t sell Spirit Worms, then finding them in Yue Country is difficult.
However, just as Xu Ping was feeling resigned, the elder suddenly changed the topic, speaking lightly:
"However, our sect recently discovered traces of a nest of Spirit Worms elsewhere."
"If you truly have an urgent need for them, I can arrange for our disciples to catch them for you."
"Oh?"
Xu Ping’s eyes lit up, immediately saying, "Then I’ll trouble your sect’s disciples to help capture this nest of Spirit Worms for me. Spirit Stones are not an issue."
"Alright."
The elder nodded in satisfaction, smiling even more widely, "However, according to the rules, you will need to pay a portion of the deposit first."
"No problem." Xu Ping agreed readily without thinking.
After all, backed by a major Golden Core Sect like the Hundred Beasts Sect, they have no need to deceive him over such a small amount of Spirit Stones.
In the worst case, even if they did try to deceive him, he had ways to deal with a Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator.
Subsequently, Xu Ping paid a portion of the deposit as required and carefully discussed some specifics of the transaction with the elder, such as delivery time, location...
...
...
A quarter of an hour later.
Xu Ping left Spirit Beast Studio with a Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman.
Then he turned down a few streets and arrived at a store named "Array Pavilion."
This store specializes in items related to arrays, and Xu Ping came here this time to purchase the materials needed to construct the Purifying Spirit Nourishing Vein Array.
Although many of the materials required for the Purifying Spirit Nourishing Vein Array are quite precious, fortunately, these materials are not especially rare.
With the abundant resources now gathered on Dragon Lion Island, and the Spirit Stones Xu Ping carried, he managed to completely gather them.
"Now that most of the items are prepared, all that’s left is for the auction event to officially begin," Xu Ping pondered to himself.
.....
...
Five days later, the Luoyun Sect held their auction as scheduled.
On this day, the entire marketplace on Dragon Lion Island was more bustling than usual, with crowds thronging the streets and alleys in a lively mob.
Within this sea of people, even a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator like Xu Ping walked unnoticed, blending in quite ordinarily.
The auction venue was situated at the center of the island and was a grand and imposing circular building.
This building had three floors.
The first floor was a very spacious and massive plaza, capable of accommodating many ordinary cultivators.
The second and third floors had various luxuriously decorated private rooms providing a more private and comfortable auction environment for Foundation Establishment, Fake Pill, and Golden Core cultivators.
"This way, senior please!"
Guided by an attendant, Xu Ping arrived at a private room on the second floor.
The room was decorated elegantly, with Spirit Fruits and Spirit Tea on the table. Most strikingly, a Crystal Ball at the center showed a clear view of the auction stage.
"Hmm!"
Xu Ping nodded slightly, expressing his satisfaction, then walked over to the mat in the room and sat cross-legged.

chapters.title: Chapter 282 - 197: Winning the Bid for the Tier 3 Upper Grade Body Refining Technique: Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 282: Chapter 197: Winning the Bid for the Tier 3 Upper Grade Body Refining Technique: Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill (Part 3)
And the attendant was very perceptive, gently retreating and closing the box door.
Xu Ping closed his eyes for a moment of rest, quietly waiting for the auction to begin.
After about the time it takes an incense stick to burn, a crisp and loud gong sounded, announcing the official start of the auction!
Subsequently, a voice full of energy transmitted from the crystal ball flashing with spiritual light:
"I am Tong Xingbang from the Luoyun Sect! Greetings, fellow Daoists, this auction is hosted by me, and I hope everyone can obtain what they desire..."
Xu Ping opened his eyes and gazed at the auction platform through the crystal ball.
On the auction platform stood a portly middle-aged man with a smiling face, speaking a slew of formalities with an air of amicable prosperity.
Although he seemed adept at handling situations, he was brimming with spiritual power, surprisingly at the Fake Pill level!
"Alright, let’s not dwell on needless chatter; the auction officially begins now."
"The first item, Foundation Establishment Pill!"
Tong Xingbang announced loudly, "The efficacy of Foundation Establishment Pill needs no introduction, starting price is ten thousand Spirit Stones, with each bid not less than five hundred."
"The first item is actually the Foundation Establishment Pill!" Xu Ping thought in surprise.
It’s known that even in the previous Qiu Xuan Immortal City auction, Foundation Establishment Pills were at least among the final few items.
It seems the Luoyun Sect’s approach is grand, using such a precious pill to kick things off.
Thinking this, Xu Ping fixed his gaze on the auction platform inside the crystal ball.
Immediately, the floor became lively, with bids rising one after another.
"Ten thousand five hundred Spirit Stones!"
"Eleven thousand Spirit Stones!"
"Eleven thousand five hundred Spirit Stones!"
...
The price climbed swiftly, soon breaking past fourteen thousand Spirit Stones.
Xu Ping silently observed, without any intention of bidding; he was already in Late-Stage Foundation Establishment, the Foundation Establishment Pill held little use for him.
When the price reached seventeen thousand Spirit Stones, the pace of bidding slowed slightly, and the voices calling out bids diminished significantly.
Only the boxes on the second floor were left competing.
"Twenty-two thousand Spirit Stones!"
Ultimately, the Foundation Establishment Pill was acquired at a high price of twenty-two thousand Spirit Stones by a mysterious box on the second floor.
"If I ever lack Spirit Stones, maybe I could also refine some Foundation Establishment Pills to sell!" Witnessing this scene, Xu Ping stroked his chin, thinking.
The price of Foundation Establishment Pills is high, yet they don’t attract as much attention as third-rank talismans.
While he continued to watch the events unfold.
One by one, precious auction items were continuously auctioned.
"The Artifact Embryo Green Nether Sword... this sword was forged by the Heavenly Craft Pavilion and carries inherent divine techniques..."
"True Essence Skill... an ancient cultivation technique that can be cultivated to Golden Core Perfection!"
...
As one eye-catching item after another was auctioned, the atmosphere at the auction site grew more intense, seemingly igniting the air.
During this time, several items also appeared that somewhat interested Xu Ping.
However, all these items inevitably attracted fierce bidding from numerous competitors, with competition far beyond expectations.
Weighing things up carefully, Xu Ping decided to temporarily give up on these items, waiting for a better opportunity.
"The next item, a third-rank upper-grade Body Refining Technique---Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill!" Tong Xingbang introduced yet another auction item.
"The defensive power of the body refined through this technique is outstanding; perhaps some Daoists present have heard that hundreds of years ago, there was a Body Refining Cultivator who cultivated this technique to the Great Success Realm and survived an attack from a Nascent Soul Cultivator, exhibiting its defense."
"However, the technique has its advantages and disadvantages; cultivating the Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill not only consumes a large amount of cultivation resources but also requires high comprehension from the cultivator.
"If one’s comprehension is insufficient, penetrating its mysteries might be as hard as ascending to heaven."
"Yet overall, its flaws do not overshadow its merits; this technique still counts as one of the top third-rank Body Refining Techniques, incredibly valuable!"
...
"Third-rank upper-grade Body Refining Technique!"
Listening to the description, Xu Ping’s eyes lit up.
Although he was also cultivating the Blood Demon Body Refining, this technique was nonetheless a demonic cultivation technique, easily drawing the attention and targeting of Orthodoxy cultivators.
Furthermore, the ape-class essence blood needed for cultivating Blood Demon Body Refining was extremely hard to find, severely limiting Xu Ping’s progress in cultivation.
For a long time, he had wanted to abandon Blood Demon Body Refining but had not yet found a suitable Body Refining Technique to replace it.
The appearance of this technique, named Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill, seemed tailor-made for him.
After all, he never lacked offensive techniques, but his defensive power was notably insufficient!
If he could master this technique, the defensive shortcoming would be completely resolved.
As for the vast resources needed and the high comprehension requirement for cultivation, they were no real problem for Xu Ping.
Relying on his wealth, he was confident in solving the resources issue; regarding comprehension, he had the skilled panel assistance, why worry?
"For auctioning the Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill, our sect decided not to auction with Spirit Stones, but to barter with goods; those interested can write the items they wish to exchange on the surface of the crystal ball, and the highest offer wins." Tong Xingbang’s deep voice resounded widely.
"Oh?"
"An anonymous bidding mode?"
"This indeed helps avoid revealing too much!"
Hearing this, Xu Ping’s heart was stirred, and he promptly moved to the crystal ball within the box.
After contemplating for a moment, he extended his index finger and started writing on the surface of the crystal ball.
A quarter-hour later.
Tong Xingbang, after collecting all bidding information, smiled slightly: "At present, box fifty-one on the second floor temporarily leads, any higher bids?"
He called out thrice, and no new bidding information appeared on the crystal ball!
"Since no one bids higher, this Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill belongs to the esteemed guest in box fifty-one on the second floor!" Tong Xingbang decisively announced the auction item’s ownership without hesitation.
At this moment, Xu Ping in box fifty-one on the second floor, upon hearing Tong Xingbang’s announcement, breathed a sigh of relief from his heart.
You know, to bid on this item, he wrote as many as four third-rank Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans; if he couldn’t acquire it, he might be hesitant to raise his offer further.

chapters.title: Chapter 283 - 98: Winning the 1,000-Year Spiritual Liquid
chapters.content:
Chapter 283: Chapter 98: Winning the 1,000-Year Spiritual Liquid
After the successful auction of the Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill, Tong Xingbang seamlessly continued to introduce the next auction item—a third-rank Demon Beast’s blood essence.
However, Xu Ping showed no interest in this so-called third-rank Demon Beast’s blood essence, so he sat back on his mat, choosing to remain a quiet spectator.
Dong dong!
Just then, an elderly voice suddenly came from the tightly closed door outside: "Sir, the Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill you just auctioned has been sent to you!"
"Enter!" Xu Ping said in a deep voice.
Eek!
The door opened, and an elderly woman with white hair at the Fake Pill Realm walked in.
"Sir, this jade slip records the Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill you auctioned!" As she spoke, the elderly woman flipped her withered hand, revealing a verdant jade slip in her palm.
"Could I perhaps take a look first?" Xu Ping asked in a resonant voice.
Although the Luoyun Sect wouldn’t deceive him, it was still wise to be cautious in matters involving precious cultivation techniques.
"Of course, this is not a problem!"
The elderly woman smiled slightly and then used Mana to hover the jade slip over to Xu Ping.
Backed by the Luoyun Sect, she naturally feared not a mere Foundation Establishment cultivator acting against her or attempting to snatch the item.
Xu Ping reached out to take the jade slip, instantly probing his Divine Sense into it.
In a flash, the content of the Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill recorded in the jade slip vividly appeared in his mind.
After some careful identification and confirmation, Xu Ping nodded secretly, feeling assured: "This cultivation technique is indeed genuine."
Then, Xu Ping waved his right hand, and four Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans slowly floated towards the elderly woman with the Fake Pill Realm.
He spoke calmly: "These are four third-rank lower-grade talismans, please verify them."
The elderly woman steadily caught the talismans, and upon contact, she could clearly sense the power contained within them.
The overwhelming Thunder Power, which even at her Fake Pill Realm cultivation, made her secretly startled.
"A late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator possessing four third-rank talismans, such astounding wealth is truly rare," the elderly woman thought to herself.
If she were not the outer elder of the Luoyun Sect, tasked with maintaining the safety of this auction, she might have been tempted to act against him.
The elderly woman discreetly secured the four Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans, still wearing a gentle smile, and asked:
"The transaction is complete, I wonder if the guest wishes to purchase the Earthly Rock Milk that aids in the cultivation of the Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill."
"Yes!" Xu Ping nodded without hesitation.
Earthly Rock Milk is a rare Spiritual Liquid born in the depths of molten magma.
It carries the profound power of the earth, having an excellent effect on strengthening the resilience of bones.
In cultivating the Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill, it helps cultivators solidify their foundation and better endure the pressure brought about by the operation of the technique.
Without Earthly Rock Milk, it’s not that one cannot train in the Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill.
But the efficiency and power would be significantly reduced!
In that case, it would be more appropriate to choose other body refining techniques.
The Luoyun Sect sells Earthly Rock Milk.
The price of each bottle is six hundred Spirit Stones.
However, this amount is only sufficient for the needs of two cultivation sessions.
Considering what it takes to cultivate, Xu Ping didn’t hesitate and immediately spent twelve thousand Spirit Stones to purchase twenty bottles.
Though he usually had considerable wealth, spending so extravagantly at this moment still made his heart ache slightly.
After all, these twenty bottles of Earthly Rock Milk could barely sustain two months of cultivation.
If calculated for a year’s supply, it would require more than seventy thousand Spirit Stones!
Such terrifying consumption of resources, even those in the Fake Pill Realm, would find it difficult to bear long-term.
Moreover, once successfully advancing to the third-rank Body Refining Realm, the needed auxiliary spiritual materials would change to a more advanced Lava Spiritual Marrow.
The price of Lava Spiritual Marrow is unbelievably high.
Not to mention those in the Fake Pill Realm, even more powerful Golden Core realms face enormous pressure with such exorbitant costs, unable to bear them.
"Wish the guest success in acquiring desired items in the upcoming auction," the elderly woman said politely after completing the transaction, then turned and exited the room.
Once again, Xu Ping was the only one left in the room.
He toyed with a grayish storage bag in his hands, and when his Divine Sense penetrated it, twenty jade bottles neatly containing a reddish-brown viscous liquid came into view.
"Hopefully, this Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill is as good as Tong Xingbang claimed!" Xu Ping sighed inwardly.
Having spent so much, if the effects fall short, the thought would be truly disappointing.
In the following time, piece by piece, precious auction items were successively auctioned, yet Xu Ping didn’t bid again, choosing to watch peacefully.
"The next auction item might be... Millennia Spiritual Liquid!"
Tong Xingbang’s voice suddenly reverberated throughout the auction venue, instantly invigorating the previously languid Xu Ping.
Amid everyone’s expectant gazes, a graceful waitress holding a delicate jade bottle in both hands gracefully stepped onto the auction stage.
Through the crystal ball, Xu Ping could see the crystal-clear liquid inside the bottle, radiating a subtle spiritual light.
"Fellow cultivators, please note, this Millennia Spiritual Liquid is a third-rank life-extending treasure." Tong Xingbang’s voice grew increasingly enthusiastic and intense.

chapters.title: Chapter 284 - 198: Bidding for 1,000-Year Spiritual Liquid (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 284: Chapter 198: Bidding for 1,000-Year Spiritual Liquid (Part 2)
"It is typically formed from the purest Spiritual Qi between heaven and earth, condensing after a millennia.
"For a Golden Core Stage cultivator, it can extend their lifespan by at least forty years."
"In addition, this millennial Spiritual Liquid also has the miraculous effect of enhancing constitution and can assist in the advancement of a cultivator’s cultivation to a certain degree..."
He paused briefly, then continued, "The auction method for this item remains barter..."
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping didn’t hesitate in the slightest, immediately standing up and moving in front of the Crystal Ball within the private room.
He frowned slightly, contemplated for a moment, and then wrote down his bid on the auction interface: four Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans + one Artifact Embryo.
A quarter of an hour passed quickly.
After collecting all the bidding information, Tong Xingbang’s smile became even more dazzling and radiant:
"Currently, the bid from private room number eleven on the third floor is in the lead. Fellow Daoists, does anyone have a higher bid?"
He deliberately paused, scanning the entire venue with his eyes, then shouted loudly, "If you have a need for longevity, don’t miss this rare opportunity!"
"The third floor!"
Hearing this news, Xu Ping’s eyes narrowed slightly while inside his private room.
The private rooms on the third floor were always reserved for at least Fake Pill Realm cultivators.
But if it’s just a Fake Pill cultivator, that’s fine; the real worry is if it’s a Golden Core cultivator, or even a Middle Stage of Golden Core cultivator.
However, with the millennial Spiritual Liquid right in front of him, he naturally couldn’t give it up.
Moreover, as long as Luoyun Sect could strictly keep his identity confidential, no one would know that he participated in the bidding.
Therefore, Xu Ping added another Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman and one more Artifact Embryo without hesitation.
After briefly pondering, he felt it still wasn’t secure enough, so he added a Demon Core to ensure everything was failsafe.
Tong Xingbang had been closely watching the continuously changing bidding information on the Crystal Ball. Seeing Xu Ping’s changes in the bid, a flash of surprise appeared in his eyes.
But quickly, he returned to his enthusiastic demeanor, beaming as he loudly announced, "Currently, the bid from private room number fifty-one on the second floor is leading!"
As Tong Xingbang’s words fell, a wave of whispers immediately erupted in the auction hall:
"It’s him again!"
"Does this person really have such a vast fortune? It’s hard to believe!"
...
Everyone was astounded, after all, first, he had previously won the ’Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill’, and now he was showing such wealth in the bid for the millennial Spiritual Liquid.
It seemed that the wealth of this Foundation Establishment Stage cultivator on the second floor had probably long surpassed that of ordinary Fake Pill cultivators.
...
In the private room number eleven on the third floor.
Listening to Tong Xingbang’s announcement, a middle-aged man with an arrogant expression and extraordinary demeanor furrowed his brow slightly.
Then, in a cold tone, he ordered the silver-haired elder behind him, "Increase the bid!"
"Yes!"
The silver-haired elder responded respectfully and, without hesitation, approached the Crystal Ball and increased the stakes.
"The distinguished guest from private room number eleven on the third floor has raised the stakes again, now surpassing the distinguished guest from private room number fifty-one on the second floor!"
Tong Xingbang announced loudly, his voice full of irrepressible joy.
"Are they challenging me head-on?"
Xu Ping’s heart sank slightly, his eyes involuntarily narrowing.
But at this stage, he certainly couldn’t easily give up the opportunity at hand.
"Might as well suppress him all at once!"
Xu Ping gritted his teeth, as if making a huge decision, and directly entered a Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman on the auction interface.
Now that his Talisman Array was completed, although the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman remained precious, it was no longer his most critical trump card.
Tong Xingbang’s gaze fell on Xu Ping’s bid, his eyes instantly narrowing, and his voice carried unconcealed excitement:
"The distinguished guest from private room number fifty-one on the second floor has raised their bid again, once more leading the entire venue in total value of the auctioned items!"
"These two seem to be thoroughly confronting each other!"
"Heh, this is quite interesting!"
...
Those not involved in the auction became quite interested, eagerly watching this fiercely competitive "drama."
Inside private room number eleven on the third floor.
The middle-aged man looked coldly at the Crystal Ball, a hint of displeasure flashing in his eyes: "Increase the bid!"
"Yes!"
The elder dared not hesitate for a moment, immediately executing the command and raising the bid once more.
However, after completing the operation, he heard Tong Xingbang’s somewhat regretful voice resound in the auction hall:
"Even though private room number eleven on the third floor has increased the stakes again, it still pales in comparison to the distinguished guest from private room number fifty-one on the second floor."
Hearing this, the silver-haired elder was slightly taken aback and instinctively glanced at the middle-aged man: "Jin Yifei."
The middle-aged man’s face was exceedingly somber.
He coldly snorted, his tone carrying a hint of unrestrained threat: "A mere Foundation Establishment dares compete with me?"
His voice wasn’t loud, but it effortlessly penetrated the protective Array of the private room, resounding clearly throughout the auction hall.
However, before his words could completely dissipate, Tong Xingbang’s voice suddenly turned icy cold:
"Daoist Jin Yifei, Luoyun Sect Auction House has always had clear rules prohibiting any bidder from threatening others.
If anyone dares to violate..."
He deliberately paused, his gaze sternly sweeping across the venue, "Don’t blame us at Luoyun Sect for being unmerciful!"
Tong Xingbang unambiguously named Jin Yifei, which undoubtedly served as a substantial warning to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 285 - 198: Winning the 1,000-Year Spiritual Liquid (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 285: Chapter 198: Winning the 1,000-Year Spiritual Liquid (Part 3)
If it were any other ordinary violator, he would have already sent people to forcibly take them down.
"Jin Yifei?"
"A Nascent Soul seed from the Profound Nether Sect?"
...
Upon hearing this name, everyone in the auction hall was instantly surprised, and the buzzing chatter immediately grew louder.
They looked towards Xu Ping’s private box with eyes full of pity.
In their view, a mere Foundation Establishment Cultivator daring to provoke someone with such a great background was simply seeking death.
There’s no need to think much; he’s definitely doomed.
After all, this person, whether in strength or status, far exceeds an average Middle Stage of Golden Core cultivator. Even if facing a Late-Stage Golden Core or even a Perfection cultivator, they probably wouldn’t dare to act arrogantly in front of him.
"This is a big trouble now!"
Inside the private box, Xu Ping’s heart sank to the bottom upon hearing that the person he was competing against was Jin Yifei.
This person, as a Nascent Soul seed, had unfathomable strength.
Even with his constructed Three Talents Talisman Array using the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman, it’s unlikely to pose a substantial lethal threat to the opponent.
However, it was fortunate that the Luoyun Sect stepped in at this moment, temporarily relieving him from the pressure from Jin Yifei.
Otherwise, the consequences would have been unimaginable.
"Hmph!"
Upon hearing Tong Xingbang’s merciless threatening words, a flash of cold light flickered in Jin Yifei’s eyes, and a chilling coldness instantly pervaded.
Although furious, after weighing pros and cons, he ultimately just snorted coldly and then fell silent.
The atmosphere in the private box became particularly oppressive after this brief confrontation.
"Since no one else is competing, this millennium Spiritual Liquid belongs to the distinguished guest in Box 51 on the second floor!"
Tong Xingbang waved his auction hammer high and dropped it heavily, making the decision.
"Finally won the bid!"
Xu Ping’s strained nerves finally relaxed, and he sighed deeply.
However, not much joy appeared on his face; instead, a hint of worry surged up, and he couldn’t help but smile bitterly and mutter to himself:
"But, just for this millennium Spiritual Liquid, is offending a Nascent Soul seed really worth it?"
But now that things had developed to this point, the die was cast, and regret was useless.
Xu Ping pondered internally: "The auction cannot continue to stay now; I must find a chance to escape quickly.
"As long as the people from Luoyun Sect can keep my information confidential, even with Jin Yifei’s vast powers, it will be difficult for him to catch me."
After all, this place was not within the influence scope of the Profound Nether Sect, and even if the opponent intended to retaliate, he couldn’t muster enough manpower to block him.
Quickly, Xu Ping made up his mind; as soon as the millennium Spiritual Liquid was in hand, he would immediately escape.
Luckily, Xu Ping didn’t have to wait long.
Fortunately, Xu Ping did not wait too long.
Before long, the silver-haired Fake Pill elderly woman reappeared at the private box door, holding an exquisite tray, and said with a smile, "Guest, here is the millennium Spiritual Liquid you auctioned."
On the tray, the millennium Spiritual Liquid lay quietly in a crystal-clear jade bottle, like a solidified moonbeam, exuding a gentle and mysterious spiritual glow.
"Is this the millennium Spiritual Liquid?"
With a hint of curiosity in his eyes, Xu Ping immediately asked, "May I take a look first?"
"That’s naturally no problem." The Fake Pill elderly woman smiled and nodded in agreement.
Xu Ping gently picked up the jade bottle and cautiously opened the lid just a tiny crack.
Instantly, a fresh and pure aroma with a hint of sweet scent permeated the entire room.
The moment Xu Ping smelled the millennium Spiritual Liquid.
As Xu Ping caught the aroma of the millennium Spiritual Liquid, a fierce, nearly overwhelming desire surged abruptly from the depths of his heart.
Every cell in his body seemed to be hysterically screaming:
Swallow it!
Swallow it all at once!!!
...
This desire welled up like a surging tide, nearly drowning Xu Ping’s reason completely.
Veins bulged on his forehead, and his left hand clenched tightly into a fist, but in the end, he sealed the bottle with its lid with great willpower.
"Guest, you... what’s wrong?" The Fake Pill elderly woman’s eyes widened in surprise, witnessing this scene.
Isn’t this reaction a bit too excessive?
"No... nothing." Xu Ping forced a stiff smile onto his face.
He took a deep breath, trying to calm himself, and said, "The millennium Spiritual Liquid is genuine, and this Storage Bag contains the auctioned items. Please, senior, take a look."
With those words, Xu Ping channeled Mana, and a Storage Bag steadied in front of the Fake Pill elderly woman.
The Fake Pill elderly woman took the Storage Bag, scanning it with Divine Sense.
Though she had expected it, she was still shocked by the pile of talismans and artifact embryos inside.
Especially the quietly lying Third-rank Middle Grade Talisman - the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman, made her heart suddenly race.
"This Foundation Establishment cultivator’s wealth is exceedingly abundant, far exceeding what an average Golden Core cultivator could compare to."
The Fake Pill elderly woman marveled inwardly, and at the same time, an uncontrollable greedy thought quietly sprouted in her heart.
"The quantity and quality of the items are no problem; they’re authentic!"
After carefully checking, the Fake Pill elderly woman suppressed the greed in her heart, still maintaining a calm expression as she nodded gently.
"I hope guests can secure items of their desire in the upcoming auction."
She discreetly put away the Storage Bag and, with a polite remark, turned and exited the room.
"I should leave too!"
Xu Ping flipped his hand, and the jade bottle containing the millennium Spiritual Liquid vanished instantly into the Storage Ring.
Without hesitation, he stood up and walked briskly out of the room, heading swiftly towards the auction’s exit.
A few moments later.
The Fake Pill elderly woman slowly emerged from the shadows where she was lurking, her gaze fixed intently on Xu Ping’s gradually retreating figure, a sinister murderous intent and undisguised greed flickering in her eyes.
Subsequently, she slowly flipped her hand, and a jade talisman with a mysterious aura appeared ominously in her hand.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 286 - 199: The Power of the Three Talents Talisman Array
chapters.content:
Chapter 286: Chapter 199: The Power of the Three Talents Talisman Array
In Room 11 on the third floor.
Jin Yifei’s expression moved slightly, as if he had sensed something. He reached into his robe and took out a Jade Talisman.
Then, his Divine Sense infiltrated it, and his eyes revealed a hint of understanding.
"The kid who bought the Thousand-Year Spiritual Liquid has already left the auction venue."
Jin Yifei spoke coldly, his voice carrying an undeniable authority.
He turned to the silver-haired elder beside him and instructed, "Follow him. You must kill him and bring the Thousand-Year Spiritual Liquid back to me."
The auction was still going on, and the item Jin Yifei desired had not yet been presented.
Otherwise, given his temper, facing Xu Ping, a mere Foundation Establishment Cultivator who dared to publicly oppose him in the auction, he would have personally acted long ago, extracting the soul and refining the marrow to vent his anger.
"Yes!"
The silver-haired elder respectfully responded, turned around, and prepared to leave the room to carry out the task.
However, just as he took a step, Jin Yifei called him back.
"Wait."
Jin Yifei frowned slightly, seemingly weighing something, and after a moment of hesitation, he took out a higher-grade Spirit Beast pouch and handed it to the silver-haired elder, saying coldly:
"This kid can bring out so many precious items for auction, clearly not an ordinary Foundation Establishment Cultivator."
"Take my Spirit Pet along, just in case something unexpected happens."
The silver-haired elder received the Spirit Beast pouch with both hands, and sensing the faint aura emanating from the spirit beast within, he felt reassured and his face showed a confident expression, saying firmly:
"Rest assured, Jin True Transmission, I will surely destroy that kid’s spirit and form, and bring the Thousand-Year Spiritual Liquid back intact!"
Originally, he was somewhat worried about chasing and killing Xu Ping alone, but now with the powerful assistance of this Spirit Pet, he was full of confidence.
After all, this spirit pet raised by Jin Yifei was no ordinary one, it was a third-rank Lower Grade spirit beast with strength comparable to an Early-Stage Golden Core Cultivator.
In the silver-haired elder’s view, with such a formidable Spirit Pet assisting, dealing with a mere Foundation Establishment Cultivator was as easy as reaching into a bag and getting something.
"Hm!"
Jin Yifei nodded with satisfaction, waved his hand, and said, "Go, act quickly, don’t let that kid get far."
The silver-haired elder carefully secured the Spirit Beast pouch, fearing any mishap, and then quietly left the room...
...
...
Xu Ping barely left the auction before he keenly sensed something amiss behind him.
"Someone is following me?"
Xu Ping’s heart sank; being targeted immediately after leaving the auction was indeed unusual.
After all, he had exhibited cultivation at the Late-Stage Foundation Establishment, which ordinary people wouldn’t have the guts to provoke.
"Could it be the Luoyun Sect planning to make a move against me?" Xu Ping frowned deeply, and a chill spontaneously rose from the bottom of his heart.
He couldn’t help but suspect the Luoyun Sect, because his wealth had only been displayed at the auction.
And only the Luoyun Sect knew his identity.
"Trouble!"
With this thought, Xu Ping’s heart sank to the bottom.
If the Luoyun Sect really decided to act against him and he got trapped in an Array, wouldn’t he become like a lamb waiting to be slaughtered, powerless to resist?
However, after careful consideration, it seemed unlikely.
Despite the items he revealed being extremely precious to ordinary Golden Core Cultivators.
As a large sect at the Nascent Soul Level, the Luoyun Sect shouldn’t act rashly for a few third-rank Talismans and a third-rank Mid-Grade Talisman.
After all, a sect’s actions must weigh reputation and gains and losses.
But being targeted for no apparent reason was truly baffling.
Xu Ping’s mind churned with thoughts, but his steps remained steady as he headed straight for the entrance of the market.
Regardless, the priority was to leave Dragon Lion Island.
Xu Ping successfully passed through the Array’s light, and under the reverent gazes of a group of Qi Cultivators, he soared on Escape Light, quickly leaving Dragon Lion Island.
"They didn’t try to trap me?"
"From this, it seems unlikely to be the Luoyun Sect. So who could it be?"
"Could it possibly be... Jin Yifei?"
Xu Ping slightly squinted his eyes, and the name flashed in his mind involuntarily.
The opponent, being a Middle Stage of Golden Core Cultivator, might indeed have some unknown means, capable of tracking his whereabouts.
Or perhaps someone in the Luoyun Sect coveted what he owned and secretly divulged his whereabouts to Jin Yifei.
As these thoughts swirled, Xu Ping was already maneuvering Escape Light, flying over ten miles away.
Just then.
Suddenly from behind, came waves of Mana fluctuation!
Xu Ping quickly turned his head and saw a silver-haired elder pursuing him with imposing Mana pressure, disregarding everything else.
"It’s him!!"
Xu Ping’s pupils contracted violently, immediately recognizing the silver-haired elder as the Fake Pill cultivator who had been following Jin Yifei.
"It’s indeed Jin Yifei!"
Xu Ping gritted his teeth, and without hesitation, he directly exhibited the Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill he had perfected.
In an instant, he transformed into a black stream of light, desperately fleeing forward.
Although a Fake Pill Cultivator wasn’t too threatening to him, if Jin Yifei were nearby, the situation could be dire.
"What kind of Escape Technique is this? How can it be so fast!!"
Xu Ping’s full-speed burst truly startled the silver-haired elder.
For a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator’s speed to exceed his Fake Pill Cultivator level was genuinely unimaginable, it was too exaggerated.
But thinking about the opponent’s substantial wealth, his heart immediately settled down.

chapters.title: Chapter 287 - 199: The Power of the Triad Talisman Array (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 287: Chapter 199: The Power of the Triad Talisman Array (Part 2)
Although unexpected, it reluctantly makes sense.
"Hmph, if it were only me chasing you, I might really let you escape!" The silver-haired elder snorted coldly in his heart.
"Spirit Master, please lend a hand."
The silver-haired elder injected a trace of Mana into the advanced spirit beast pouch and spoke with great respect.
Chirp!!
As his words fell, a sharp and resonant bird cry echoed far and wide.
Whoosh!!
In an instant.
A flying demon beast, with wings spanning a full three zhang, appeared in the void.
Its feathers shimmered with a metallic cold shine, with spiral wind blades wrapped around its sharp claws, exuding an astonishing aura.
Its wings flapped, causing a strong wind pressure like a level-ten storm, overwhelmingly powerful.
Xu Ping, who was completely focused on the movements behind, felt a jolt in his heart, his expression instantly turning extremely somber.
He understood well that although his escape technique was fast, compared to a third-rank flying demon beast, it undoubtedly paled in comparison.
"Spirit Master, it’s that boy in front!" The silver-haired elder said respectfully.
Chirp!
The flying demon beast locked its emerald eyes tightly on Xu Ping, a hint of disdain flashing unmistakably in its vertical pupils.
Immediately, it stretched its wings forcefully, swiftly transforming into a green shadow, like a sharp blade tearing through the clouds directly, carrying the silver-haired elder with lightning speed toward Xu Ping in hot pursuit.
"So fast!"
Seeing this scene, Xu Ping was shocked inside.
Even though he had mentally prepared, he was still astounded by the speed displayed by the third-rank flying demon beast.
This flying speed was incredibly fast, probably even comparable to a general Golden Core cultivator in the middle stage.
Thus, one party desperately fled while the other pursued relentlessly.
In the blink of an eye, Dragon Lion Island was left far behind, eventually disappearing completely from view.
"It seems Jin Yifei hasn’t personally come to hunt me!"
Despite the distance between Xu Ping and the third-rank flying demon beast constantly closing, he felt a sense of relief at this moment.
After all, as long as Jin Yifei hadn’t come personally, he believed he could handle just a third-rank lower-grade flying demon beast and a fake pill cultivator.
With this thought, Xu Ping’s gaze gradually cooled down.
"Appear!"
With a soft shout from him, a green light flashed repeatedly from the storage ring, and three Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans shot out.
"Control!"
Xu Ping’s expression turned solemn, his hands rapidly changing, precisely pinching out one magic technique after another.
In an instant, three thin but powerful lines of Mana shot out fiercely from his fingertip, like agile lightning, accurately landing on the three Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans.
"Condense!"
Xu Ping pointed, Mana surged.
The three Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans seemed to be infused with endless energy, instantly blooming with shining, dazzling light that was impossible to look at directly.
"Trap!"
Under Xu Ping’s precise control, the three talismans flexibly interlaced and shuttled through the void, cooperating seamlessly without interfering with each other.
At the same time, their aura began interconnecting, closely linked as if forming an inseparable whole.
"Explode!"
Xu Ping’s face was solemn as he softly uttered a word.
In the next moment.
Boom!!
Accompanied by a thunderous sound that shook the heavens and earth, the Three Talents Talisman Array exploded suddenly, a terrifying force like it came from the abyss of hell, surging backward with a landslide-like momentum.
Amidst the flashing light, the entire space seemed twisted and deformed by this terrifying force, as if it would collapse completely under pressure any moment.
"What!!
"This is impossible!!"
The silver-haired elder witnessed such horrifying power firsthand, his face turning as pale as paper, eyes filled with extreme fear and disbelief.
He naturally recognized at a glance that Xu Ping was summoning a talisman array.
But the problem was, how could a late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator manage to summon such an overwhelmingly powerful talisman array!??
Such a potent talisman array would even leave a general Golden Core cultivator hard-pressed to escape unscathed, inevitably suffering heavy injuries!
And the flying demon beast’s situation was not much better, with its vertical pupils also showing rare signs of terror!!
Feeling the terrifying threat rushing at it, it frantically flapped its wings in a futile attempt to escape this sudden deadly attack with speed.
However, the force from the talisman explosion was so overwhelmingly strong that it afforded it no chance to escape at all.
Only to see that under the devastating impact of this terrifying power, the demon beast’s massive body was ripped apart in the blink of an eye like a fragile ant, blood and flesh flying everywhere.
Whoosh!!
In its mournful wail, countless feathers wrapped in charred air fell rustling down.
Thus, a mightful third-rank lower-grade demon beast was utterly annihilated in an instant.
The flying demon beast bore most of the talisman array explosion’s power, unexpectedly, the silver-haired elder was not directly killed.
Nonetheless, he was severely injured too, akin to a kite with its string snapped, violently thrown out by the terrifying blast’s aftershock.
After uncontrolled tumbling for dozens of times in the air, he finally crashed heavily onto the water surface, splashing a large spray of water.
"This... this power, it’s too terrifying!!"
Xu Ping gazed in shock at the scene before him, his mouth agape, practically wide enough to fit an entire egg.

chapters.title: Chapter 288 - 199: The Power of the Three Talents Talisman Array (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 288: Chapter 199: The Power of the Three Talents Talisman Array (3)
Originally, he had some expectations about the power of the Three Talents Talisman Array constructed with the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman.
But when he witnessed the array unleash such astonishing power with his own eyes, he was deeply shocked!
To think that was a Third-rank Lower Grade Demon Beast, with an extremely tenacious life force, and it was blasted to death in the blink of an eye?
But Xu Ping knew that now was not the time to be shocked by the power of the Three Talents Talisman Array.
"We should leave now, this place is not safe to stay for long!"
He took a deep breath, striving to suppress the surge of excitement in his heart.
After all, he had just slain Jin Yifei’s Third-rank Spirit Beast, Jin Yifei might explode with rage!
If Jin Yifei were to catch up with him, it would be a big problem.
Xu Ping quickly stepped forward and secured the corpse of the Demon Beast.
This was a Third-rank Demon Beast, its entire body was a treasure, invaluable in the Cultivation Realm, any piece taken outside could cause a major stir.
Of course, he would not let such an opportunity slip away and waste it.
Lastly, Xu Ping did not forget the silver-haired old man who had fallen into the water after being seriously injured.
With a flash of his figure, he came to the water’s surface and reached out to fish the old man out from underwater.
Afterward, Xu Ping released his Divine Sense and quickly scanned the old man’s body.
Once he was sure there were no items or marks capable of tracking his whereabouts, he carried the old man, transforming into a streak of light, and quickly disappeared into the vast horizon.
...
...
Dragon Lion Island, Auction Hall!
"Congratulations, Fellow Daoist Jin, on successfully bidding for the grand treasure of this auction—the Millennium Thunderstruck Wood!"
Tong Xingbang’s high-spirited voice resonated like a large bell throughout the spacious auction hall.
"This Millennium Thunderstruck Wood is an unparalleled rare material for crafting top-tier magical treasures!!"
"Senior Jin has successfully bid on it, even if not crafting an extraordinary top-class magical treasure anew, just having his Lifebound Magical Treasure absorb and merge with it, its power would certainly be greatly enhanced!"
"I’ve heard that Senior Jin possesses a Thunder Attribute Spirit Root, and now having the fortune to acquire this Millennium Thunderstruck Wood is like adding wings to a tiger, his strength will surely advance to a new level!"
"Indeed it is so!"
...
As soon as the words fell, a series of whispering murmurs arose in the auction hall.
The voices of everyone were filled with reverence and envy towards Jin Yifei!
In private box number eleven on the third floor.
Jin Yifei, having successfully bid on the Millennium Thunderstruck Wood, couldn’t help but display a slight smile at the corner of his mouth.
"I’ve been searching for the Millennium Thunderstruck Wood for so long, and now, I finally have it in my possession."
"Once my Lifebound Magical Treasure absorbs it, its power will surely ascend to a higher level."
"In this way, I will certainly have the upper hand over that fellow!"
At this thought, a chilling glint suddenly flashed in the depths of Jin Yifei’s eyes.
Though he was the Nascent Soul seed of the Profound Nether Sect, the pressure he was under was immense.
After all, he was not the only Nascent Soul seed in the Profound Nether Sect; there were three in total.
In this fierce competition, only the victor among the three could receive the full support of the Profound Nether Sect to help achieve Nascent Soul Formation.
As for the two who fail, they will be stripped of their Nascent Soul seed status.
Though their lives wouldn’t be endangered, they would remain stuck at the Golden Core Stage for the rest of their lives, with no further possibility of advancement.
To pave his own path, Jin Yifei undoubtedly had to fight with all his might!
However, within these three, though his strength was not the weakest, he was consistently suppressed by another, unable to stand out.
Now, having finally acquired the Millennium Thunderstruck Wood, as long as he uses it to enhance his Lifebound Magical Treasure, he should manage to surpass his rival by a measure!
In fact, Jin Yifei also knew that the Luoyun Sect, in holding this auction and even putting such treasures as the Millennium Thunderstruck Wood out, had ulterior motives.
It was, after all, to make him and the first-line Nascent Soul seed kill or be killed, plunging Feng Country into chaos.
But!
So what!
As long as he can gain the upper hand over his rival and achieve Nascent Soul, everything is worth it.
At this moment.
Creaaak!
The door opened, and Tong Xingbang, with a full-face smile, brought in the Millennium Thunderstruck Wood.
"Congratulations, Fellow Daoist Jin, on bidding for the Millennium Thunderstruck Wood, with such Spirit Wood as assistance, achieving Nascent Soul is just around the corner!" Tong Xingbang said with a smile, his tone warm and cordial.
"Fellow Daoist Tong is too polite, achieving Nascent Soul is easier said than done, throughout history, how many astonishing talents have struggled to cross this great chasm in their lifetime."
Jin Yifei instantly retracted his usual arrogance, his tone becoming very humble and courteous, appearing completely different from the reckless image he projected during the auction earlier.
He was able to cultivate up to the Middle Stage of Golden Core, naturally intelligent and wise beyond ordinary, certainly not reckless and ignorant.
He was very clear in his mind about what attitude to adopt towards different people.
"With Fellow Daoist Jin’s talent, crossing the threshold of Nascent Soul, in my opinion, will surely be no problem!" Tong Xingbang laughed softly, continuing to flatter.
"Here is the Millennium Thunderstruck Wood, Fellow Daoist Jin might as well examine it carefully first."
As he spoke, Tong Xingbang lightly flipped his hand, and an ancient wooden box, about three feet long, emitting a mysterious Restriction light, surprisingly floated above his palm.
Jin Yifei reached out and took the wooden box, his sleeve lightly waving, a thread of Mana passed over it, and the Restriction on the wooden box was instantly and effortlessly dispelled.
The next moment.
With a ’crack,’ the wooden box opened automatically.
Inside the wooden box, lay a piece of Spirit Wood with a peculiar shape, quietly resting within.
The surface of this Spirit Wood was carbonized, as hard and textured as black dragon’s scales, with mysterious and splendid purple lightning patterns faintly emerging from the cracks.
Upon closer inspection, its form was winding and twisting, like a dormant dragon, exuding a sense of ancient and majestic aura.
What’s more, the cracks flowed with lightning that seemed liquid, each pattern appearing as if personally engraved by thunder, emanating a powerful force that caused the heart to tremble.
Jin Yifei’s fingers moved slightly, a strand of pure Mana silently injected into it.
Bzzz!
The Millennium Thunderstruck Wood buzzed and trembled, the air in the private box permeated with tingling static electricity, even the surrounding tables and chairs were cracked into blue smoke.
If it weren’t for the protective Array around this box, it would probably be blasted to dust by the static power.
"It truly is the genuine Millennium Thunderstruck Wood!!"
Jin Yifei tightly gripped this long-cherished Spirit Wood, his eyes could not help but flash with an uncontrollable gleam of excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 289 - 200: 1,000-Year Spiritual Liquid Extends Lifespan by 120 Years
chapters.content:
Chapter 289: Chapter 200: 1,000-Year Spiritual Liquid Extends Lifespan by 120 Years
"Hoo!"
Jin Yifei took a deep breath, suppressing his excitement.
He looked at the mess all over the floor and said apologetically, "Apologies, Tong Daoist. In the heat of the moment, I couldn’t control myself and damaged the items in the room. I will definitely compensate at full price!"
"Jin Daoist, you don’t need to take it to heart. They’re just a few worthless trinkets." Tong Xingbang waved casually, showing complete indifference.
"Then... happy cooperation!"
Jin Yifei’s lips slightly curved into a smile, and he handed the precious treasure, equivalent in rarity to the Millennium Thunderwood—the Xuanpin Bead—to Tong Xingbang.
Tong Xingbang reached out to take the Xuanpin Bead and carefully inspected it. After confirming its authenticity, the smile on his face became even brighter, and he quickly responded, "Happy cooperation!"
With the successful completion of this transaction, the atmosphere between them became increasingly relaxed and harmonious.
However, just at this seemingly peaceful moment.
"I don’t know..."
Jin Yifei had barely opened his mouth, intending to say something.
Instantly!
His expression dramatically changed.
Immediately following, the powerful Mana pressure of his Middle Stage of Golden Core erupted, like a surging tide, instantly engulfing the entire room.
"Actually!!!"
Jin Yifei clenched his teeth, unable to control his emotions.
"Jin Daoist, what is this..."
Witnessing this sudden scene, Tong Xingbang couldn’t help but be slightly taken aback. His previously relaxed expression instantly turned serious, a strong sense of vigilance rising in his heart.
Just as he was fully guarded, thinking Jin Yifei was about to suddenly strike, the situation developed in a way that was completely unexpected to him.
Jin Yifei, without a word, rushed out of the room.
"What just happened?"
This series of unforeseeable, sudden actions left Tong Xingbang completely baffled, like a Buddhist monk who couldn’t fathom the situation.
...
A moment later, at the pier on the outskirts of Dragon Lion Island.
Under the shocked and terrified gaze of the crowd, Jin Yifei unleashed his aura without reservation.
Around him was the unique powerful Mana pressure of a Middle Stage Golden Core Cultivator, like a lightning bolt cutting through the sky, speeding away into the distance.
"What really happened?"
The crowd watched Jin Yifei leave until his figure completely disappeared into the distant horizon, and finally, their tension slowly subsided.
At this moment, everyone exchanged glances, all showing a confused and puzzled expression.
"Could it be that someone dared to provoke this Nascent Soul seed of the Profound Nether Sect?" The crowd couldn’t help but speculate.
Although Jin Yifei said nothing, everyone could sense his anger.
...
Half an hour later, Jin Yifei arrived at the waters where the incident occurred.
He wore a gloomy expression, expanded his powerful Divine Sense, sweeping out like a fine net to his surroundings.
He only found a group of low-level Demon Beasts, fighting over something.
Jin Yifei naturally recognized at once that it was a piece of his Spirit Pet’s flesh.
"Die!"
Seeing this scene, Jin Yifei could no longer suppress the anger in his heart.
He activated the vast Mana within him, and a gigantic Mana hand instantly condensed in the void, carrying an earth-shattering momentum, and slammed down on the group of low-level Demon Beasts.
Bang!
A deafening sound echoed through the sky and earth, as a large area of the water seemed to explode with force, splashing like a sudden downpour.
The pitiful low-level Demon Beasts, under this terrifying attack, were instantly smashed into pieces, vanishing without a trace.
However, after venting his anger, the fury in Jin Yifei’s heart not only hadn’t diminished, but burned even hotter.
His Spirit Pet, the Profound Wind Falcon, was actually a third-rank Lower Grade flying Demon Beast, its bloodline originating from ancient species with extraordinary potential.
Given time, it wouldn’t be difficult to advance to a third-rank Upper Grade Demon Beast.
In his future cultivation path, the Profound Wind Falcon would definitely become a great assistance to him.
And now it’s dead?
While Jin Yifei was angry, he couldn’t help but feel a sense of disbelief.
How could a mere Foundation Establishment Cultivator so easily put the Profound Wind Falcon to death?
Not even giving the Profound Wind Falcon a chance to flee?
You know, with its astonishing speed, the Profound Wind Falcon could even escape when facing a Middle Stage Golden Core Cultivator.
"Could someone be using this Foundation Establishment Cultivator to bait me?"
Jin Yifei’s eyes slightly narrowed, cold light flickering in his eyes, as this thought crossed his mind.
With the strength of a Foundation Establishment Cultivator, there’s no way they could accomplish this.
At least three Early-Stage Golden Core Cultivators surrounding, or one Middle Stage Golden Core Cultivator, would be needed to so cleanly kill the Profound Wind Falcon.
"Who could it be?"
Jin Yifei muttered to himself, his eyes involuntarily flashing with a sinister killing intent.
The first suspect was the Luoyun Sect.
After all, in the whole Yue Country, perhaps only Luoyun Sect had such power.
However, after careful consideration, he slowly shook his head, rejecting this suspicion.
The Luoyun Sect had no such motive.
After selling the Millennium Thunderwood to him, they certainly wouldn’t be bored enough to kill his Spirit Pet.
If it was the Luoyun Sect, then only one suspect remained.
"Zhan Chen!"
Jin Yifei gritted his teeth, his tone icy cold.

chapters.title: Chapter 290 - 200: 1,000-Year Spiritual Liquid Extends Lifespan by 120 Years (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 290: Chapter 200: 1,000-Year Spiritual Liquid Extends Lifespan by 120 Years (Part 2)
Although he didn’t come to Yue Country to explore the Nine Nether Elder’s secret realm this time, his Protector did come.
And his Protector is a genuine Middle Stage of Golden Core Cultivator!
...
...
Xu Ping, who was completely unaware that someone had taken the blame for him, finally stepped into the territory of the Purple Bamboo Mountain after ten continuous days of relentless flying.
When the familiar silhouette of the Thousand Leaves Mountain appeared in sight, Xu Ping’s tense nerves finally relaxed a little.
