He hurried back from Dragon Lion Island straight to Thousand Leaves Mountain, exercising utmost caution, and moreover, no one knew his true identity.
In this way, even if a Golden Core Cultivator wanted to track him down, they would definitely find no clues.
Of course, if it was a Nascent Soul Cultivator doing the tracking, the situation would be entirely different!
After all, the great skills of a Nascent Soul Cultivator are vast and unfathomable, and no one can predict what methods they might have.
However, speaking of which, even though Jin Yifei is a Nascent Soul seed heavily nurtured by the Profound Nether Sect, to ask a Nascent Soul Cultivator to help trace clues is simply a fantasy.
A quarter of an hour later.
Xu Ping landed on Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Irritated by the sycophantic greetings of the Water Lake Rat, Xu Ping paid no heed to them.
With one hand clutching the unconscious, barely breathing silver-haired old man, he rushed straight towards the cultivation chamber.
Xu Ping deliberately kept the old man alive for a clear purpose, which was to perform the Soul-Searching Technique.
As soon as he left the auction, someone was following him, and naturally, he wanted to investigate why.
With that thought, Xu Ping’s right hand reached out like an eagle’s claw, firmly grasping the silver-haired old man’s head.
"Soul-Searching Technique!"
With a light shout, Xu Ping’s Divine Sense spread into his Sea of Consciousness, beginning to forcibly extract his memories.
...
Half an hour later.
Xu Ping slowly withdrew his Divine Sense from the silver-haired old man’s Sea of Consciousness.
At this moment, a trace of cold killing intent flickered in his eyes: "So it’s really the Luoyun Sect coveting my wealth, and that’s why they revealed my whereabouts to Jin Yifei!"
The one who revealed his whereabouts was none other than the Fake Pill old woman who sent him the Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill and the millennial Spiritual Liquid.
"This Luoyun Sect truly is ’full of talents’!" Xu Ping sneered slightly.
Old grudges have not yet vanished, and new ones have arisen!
Not only did He Chen harbor ill intentions towards him, but now this Fake Pill old woman also stirred up trouble behind his back.
Xu Ping already didn’t have a favorable impression of the Luoyun Sect, and now, even more so.
Though not yet to the point of becoming mortal enemies with the Luoyun Sect, Xu Ping absolutely wouldn’t miss any opportunity to hit them when they are down, given the chance.
Suppressing his thoughts, Xu Ping flicked his fingers, and a flash of Spiritual Light exploded the silver-haired old man’s head, then expertly disposed of the body, leaving no trace behind.
After everything was done, Xu Ping finally had the time to check his spoils of war.
He first took out the silver-haired old man’s Storage Ring, gently exploring it with his Divine Sense.
Inside the ring’s space, a pile of Spirit Stones, stacked like a mountain, came into view.
Xu Ping roughly estimated that there were more than forty thousand Spirit Stones.
Additionally, there were two Artifact Embryos.
As for the talismans and Pills, their quantities were also quite considerable.
"Not too bad!" Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction.
Overall, this silver-haired old man was wealthier than an average Fake Pill Cultivator.
He had spent quite a few Spirit Stones at the auction this time, and this somewhat made up for it.
After organizing the silver-haired old man’s items one by one, Xu Ping finally focused on the main event of this time---the corpse of a third-stage Demon Beast.
He sent his Divine Sense into his Storage Ring, then injected a trace of Mana.
In an instant, the ragged third-stage Demon Beast’s corpse appeared in the cultivation chamber.
This Demon Beast’s body was extremely huge, almost occupying the entire space of the cultivation chamber, and a strong, pungent bloody smell instantly spread, filling the entire room.
Despite being dead for many days, the immense body of this third-stage Demon Beast still faintly exuded a heart-palpitating pressure.
"A third-stage Demon Beast really lives up to its name!" Xu Ping’s eyes flashed with a trace of excitement as he sighed in his heart.
It’s well known that the value of a complete third-stage Demon Beast corpse far exceeds that of an average magical treasure.
This single third-stage Demon Beast’s corpse could almost cover most of his expenses at this auction.
Xu Ping’s Divine Sense, as fine as a thread, slowly scanned the enormous third-stage Demon Beast’s corpse.
"Found it!"
Suddenly, his eyes lit up, and with a flip of his hand, a Magical Treasure Wooden Sword appeared in his palm.
He grasped the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword, and with Mana surging around him, he stabbed it into the Demon Beast’s corpse.
Then he flicked it upwards, and a dark blue, jade-smooth Crystal Stone was directly flipped out.
Xu Ping was quick-eyed and deft, swiftly reaching out his palm, and the dark blue Crystal Stone was steadily caught in his hand.
"Is this the renowned third-stage Demon Core?" Xu Ping curiously gazed at the mysterious Crystal Stone in his hand.
This Demon Core was only the size of a quail egg, surrounded by a faint cyan light.
Close examination revealed subtle patterns on the Demon Core’s surface, and a gentle wind elemental force gradually seeped out from within, circling around it to form a faint wind ring.
If a Foundation Establishment Perfection Cultivator swallowed this Core, it would almost have a two to three out of ten chance to achieve a Fake Pill.

chapters.title: Chapter 291 - 200: 1,000-Year Spiritual Liquid Extends Life by 120 Years_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 291: Chapter 200: 1,000-Year Spiritual Liquid Extends Life by 120 Years_3
For some Fake Pill forces, this is something they would be willing to give everything away for.
However, the precious rarity and scarcity of a Third-Stage Demon Core far exceed the imagination of an average cultivator.
After all, once a demon beast achieves the third stage, it will awaken one or even several innate divine abilities of astounding and unparalleled power.
To securely capture it is not easy; at least two or three cultivators of the same level are required to besiege it.
Moreover, during the siege, they have to be constantly on guard against the Third-Stage Demon Beast from being pushed to the brink and self-destructing its Demon Core.
Once the Demon Core self-destructs, it would be like pouring water into a bamboo basket, all efforts would be in vain.
For a general Golden Core power, a Third-Stage Demon Core is an extremely precious item.
Only those Nascent Soul powers with profound foundations can afford to be somewhat composed when dealing with a Third-Stage Demon Core.
"Store it well; it will definitely come in handy in the future!"
Xu Ping took out a jade box and carefully placed the Third-Stage Demon Core inside, then affixed a restriction talisman over it to prevent demon power leakage.
After properly storing the Third-Stage Demon Core, Xu Ping shifted his attention to the corpse of the Third-Stage Demon Beast.
Even though the Third-Stage Demon Beast’s corpse is not as valuable as the Third-Stage Demon Core, it is still a rare item.
Not to mention, the Demon Beast Flesh from a Third-Stage Demon Beast has effects for Second-Stage Body Refining Cultivators that surpass any spirit pills and wondrous medicines.
And Xu Ping, cultivating the "Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill," naturally seeks such highly energetic Third-Stage Demon Beast Flesh.
Several hours passed, and the refining room was bustling.
"Hoo!"
Xu Ping let out a deep breath, and though his face showed exhaustion, it couldn’t hide his satisfaction. "Finally finished processing this Third-Stage Demon Beast corpse!"
The meat and feathers of a Third-Stage Demon Beast are extremely tough.
If one were to use a regular upper-grade magical artifact to cut, the artifact might be declared ruined before a few pieces of Demon Beast Flesh are processed.
After resting a moment, Xu Ping cleaned up the refining room thoroughly once more.
As he looked at the neat and tidy refining room, a satisfied smile unconsciously appeared at the corner of his mouth.
Then, he plopped down on a chair, relaxing completely.
"The Third-Stage Demon Beast is dealt with. Now..."
Xu Ping mumbled, then with a flip of his hand, a jade bottle containing millennium spiritual liquid appeared in his hand.
Looking at the millennium spiritual liquid in the jade bottle emitting a gentle spiritual light, Xu Ping’s eyes flashed with a fervent longing.
Despite spending so many resources and efforts, and even offending a Middle Stage Golden Core cultivator, Xu Ping felt it was all worth it when thinking about the effects of the millennium spiritual liquid.
Though he intensely desired to gulp down the millennium spiritual liquid right now, he ultimately restrained his impulse, suppressing his urgency.
"In such a state, it’s not suitable to consume the millennium spiritual liquid. Better wait until my spirit, energy, and essence recover to their peak," Xu Ping murmured tiredly.
After storing the millennium spiritual liquid securely, he used mana to gather a water sphere, cleansing himself from head to toe, then took off his robe and fell into a deep sleep on the stone bed.
...
...
Seven days flew by like galloping horses, unnoticed in their passage.
The refining room was silent.
Xu Ping sat cross-legged on the stone bed.
His gaze fell on the jade bottle with the millennium spiritual liquid before him.
"Let’s begin!"
Xu Ping’s eyes showed determination as he carefully picked up and gently unplugged the cork.
Instantly, a fresh and pure aroma, with a slight sweet fragrance, filled the entire room.
This fragrance seemed to carry the depth of time, enchanting and intoxicating.
"Hoo!"
As Xu Ping inhaled the scent of the millennium spiritual liquid, a powerful, nearly manic longing erupted deep from within him.
The desire surged like a tidal wave, relentlessly battering his lines of rationality.
But this time, Xu Ping no longer suppressed his desire.
He gently tilted his head, slowly pouring the millennium spiritual liquid, and without hesitation, he drank it all in one gulp.
The spiritual liquid melted the moment it entered his mouth, transforming into a vast yet gentle spiritual power torrent, rampaging through his meridians.
This spiritual power carried incomparable vitality and energy; wherever it went, his meridians absorbed its nutrients greedily, like parched land receiving an overdue rain.
A never-before-experienced wondrous feeling arose from all over Xu Ping’s body like curling green smoke.
This sensation was so seductive, so intoxicating, he felt almost entirely engulfed, forgetting everything.
Yet, he managed to operate the Longevity Skill with the last thread of his rationality.
As the technique was deployed, his internal spiritual power circulation system started operating at high speed, continuously refining the millennium spiritual liquid.
During the refinement process, Xu Ping’s body underwent an astonishing transformation.
His bones emitted a crisp "crackling" sound as if being remodeled, growing tougher and more robust; his muscles constantly contracted and expanded, filled with explosive power.
This was merely the change in physique; more critically, his cultivation and longevity reached unprecedented heights...
Uncertain of how much time had passed.
The massive spiritual power torrent gradually subsided, and Xu Ping fully absorbed the millennium spiritual liquid.
Xu Ping slowly opened his eyes, and a gentle green light briefly passed through his pupils; he eagerly checked the panel.
[Name: Xu Ping]
[Lifespan: 68/678 years]
[Realm: Late-Stage Foundation Establishment: 65/100; Blood Demon Body Refining Second Layer: 99/100]
[Cultivation Technique: Longevity Skill Great Accomplishment: 1011/1600]
...
"Hahaha... Six hundred seventy-eight years!!"
Xu Ping’s gaze fixed on the lifespan data displayed on the panel, and his excitement surged like a levee breaking flood, unable to be contained, he burst into raucous laughter.
This millennium spiritual liquid actually increased his lifespan by one hundred and twenty years!!
Such effects far exceeded the extreme limits reached by Third-Stage life-extending items, only Fourth-Rank longevity treasures might achieve such heaven-defying results!

chapters.title: Chapter 292 - 201: Tremendous Advancement
chapters.content:
Chapter 292: Chapter 201: Tremendous Advancement
"Comparable to fourth-stage longevity items!" Xu Ping couldn’t help but marvel.
Fourth-stage longevity items are so precious that they are on par with celestial spirit objects like the Infant Devouring Fruit.
Even the esteemed Nascent Soul cultivators might go mad for such treasures, sparing no cost to seize them.
This time, using the Millennium Spiritual Liquid has increased Xu Ping’s lifespan to a degree comparable to fourth-stage longevity items, thanks to its extraordinary effects.
However, the key factor is that he has cultivated the Longevity Skill to a consummate level, absorbing the power of the Millennium Spiritual Liquid to the fullest.
An increase of a full one hundred and twenty years!
Upon this thought, Xu Ping’s heart burned with excitement.
"Phew, calm down, calm down!"
Xu Ping took a deep breath and repressed the surging emotions within him.
After all, using the Millennium Spiritual Liquid not only propelled his lifespan forward but also significantly advanced his cultivation technique and realm.
Afterward, his gaze returned to the proficiency panel:
[Realm: Late-Stage Foundation Establishment: 65/100; Second-stage Blood Demon Body Refining: 99/100]
[Cultivation Technique: Longevity Skill Perfected: 1011/1600]
...
"Realm proficiency increased by fourteen, and Longevity Skill proficiency shot up by nearly two hundred."
Looking at the panel’s data, Xu Ping’s lips curled into a slight smile.
His originally calm mood stirred again.
To know that an increase of fourteen in realm proficiency and nearly two hundred in Longevity Skill proficiency is essentially the result of several years of arduous cultivation.
And he merely consumed a bottle of Millennium Spiritual Liquid.
"If only I could have a few more bottles of Millennium Spiritual Liquid, both the Longevity Skill proficiency and my realm might quickly reach perfection!"
Xu Ping couldn’t help but harbor such fervent thoughts.
For him, the effects of Millennium Spiritual Liquid are far more practical than those elixirs used solely to enhance cultivation.
Not only does it avoid the troublesome accumulation of Pill Poison like ordinary pills, but its efficacy in prolonging life is astonishing.
Thinking of this, an overwhelming urge surged in Xu Ping’s heart—wanting to scour the world for Millennium Spiritual Liquid immediately.
However, this impulse was shattered like a bubble by his strong rationality, disappearing without a trace.
After all, Millennium Spiritual Liquid is elusive; whether he encounters it again is uncertain.
Moreover, even if he’s fortunate to obtain more, its effects would likely not be as remarkable as this time.
Right now, his lifespan is lengthy; finding Millennium Spiritual Liquid again would be ideal, but lacking it is no cause for excessive worry.
"Forget it, greed isn’t good!"
Xu Ping shook his head, suppressing the volatile emotions within, and continued exploring the body’s changes.
Among many transformations, the most noticeable is undoubtedly the remarkable enhancement of his physique.
"My physique probably improved by a full ten percent!"
Xu Ping clenched his fists tightly, hearing the crisp ’snap’ of his bones.
Do not underestimate this seemingly insignificant ten percent increase.
Given his current tough physique, this improvement is equivalent to adding the strength of a First Rank Upper Grade body refining cultivator.
In addition, Xu Ping felt an infinite vitality and exuberance all around him.
After a moment’s reflection, he drew out his Magical Treasure Wooden Sword and lightly grazed his arm. Instantly, a deep and long cut appeared on his arm.
Surprisingly, only a few drops of blood emerged, and the wound rapidly healed at a speed visible to the naked eye.
"This recovery speed is faster than typical healing spells!" Xu Ping’s eyes brightened.
Fast recovery means improved survival capabilities when facing various dangers.
If attacked by a Golden Core cultivator, what seemed a death sentence now might only result in severe injury due to such formidable regenerative power.
Additionally, Xu Ping vaguely sensed this might not be his recovery capability’s limit.
He felt that with his current recovery force, even if a finger were cut off, it might restore completely!
Of course, feeling is feeling; he wasn’t crazy enough to chop off a finger to test it.
"Physique and recovery power are crucial, but the most significant change is in Mana..." Xu Ping’s gaze sharpened as he walked out of the cultivation chamber.
...
In the magical garden.
"Master..."
The Water Rat followed closely behind Xu Ping with a fawning expression.
Xu Ping ignored it and directly stopped in front of a second-stage spirit medicine.
This spirit medicine is called Nourishing Essence Spirit Orchid; at the moment, its leaves are yellowed and both the petals and flower leaves are starting to curl, looking listless.
"Master, it’s really not my fault!"
Seeing this, the Water Rat mistakenly assumed Xu Ping intended to blame it and hastily hurried to explain via Divine Sense transmission.
"This Nourishing Essence Spirit Orchid’s seed was infested with insects from the start, there’s really nothing I could do..."
"Shut up, I’m not here to trouble you!"
Xu Ping, annoyed by the Water Rat’s chatter, frowned and rebuked.
Despite the reprimand, the Water Rat sighed in relief, quickly halting its Divine Sense transmission.
With the Water Rat’s noise gone, Xu Ping’s expression turned especially focused, his gaze firmly on the sickly Nourishing Essence Spirit Orchid.
Then he gently lifted a finger, and strands of greenish-blue light-emitting mana, like fine rain, continuously descended into the roots of the Nourishing Essence Spirit Orchid.

chapters.title: Chapter 293 - 201: Tremendous Improvement (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 293: Chapter 201: Tremendous Improvement (Part 2)
Time passed quietly without a trace, and before anyone knew it, several hours had gone by.
"Done..."
When Xu Ping withdrew the Longevity Mana, he saw that the wounds on the roots of the Nourishing Essence Spirit Orchid had miraculously vanished, and the previously withered roots began to grow again.
Just by watering it with Spirit Water, it could surely regain its vitality!
If that was all, it wouldn’t be all that astonishing.
After all, even a second-stage Spirit Plant cultivator could do the same thing.
The more important aspect was the increase in the Spirit Orchid’s medicinal age.
Xu Ping’s Divine Sense carefully felt that the medicinal age of this Nourishing Essence Spirit Orchid had surprisingly grown from one year to two years, gaining an extra year out of thin air.
"I didn’t expect the Longevity Mana to have such a marvelous transformation!" Xu Ping’s eyes shone brightly.
It is known that in the field of spirit plant cultivation, cultivators indeed possess some means to hasten the maturation of spirit medicines.
However, these methods mostly apply to ordinary spirit medicines, and the entire process is quite lengthy.
For example, to carefully cultivate a spirit medicine to reach a medicinal age of one year often requires spending half a year.
How could it compare to Xu Ping, who only needed a few hours to increase the medicinal age by one year!
However, this was not without cost; Xu Ping also consumed two months of his lifespan.
But, two months of lifespan is insignificant compared to his long lifespan.
"If it’s merely for increasing the medicinal age of ordinary spirit medicines, consuming lifespan to accelerate is naturally not worth it, but if it can increase the years of rare spirit medicines, the value it brings is immeasurable." Xu Ping pondered inwardly.
In his view, even if he had to pay ten years of his lifespan to increase the years of rare spirit medicines greatly beneficial to his cultivation, it would be entirely worth it.
After all, ten years of lifespan could easily be compensated by obtaining a second-stage life-extending Spiritual Object.
"What kind of method is the master using?"
At this moment, the Lake Shores Mouse, which had been witnessing all of this, was already dumbfounded with astonishment.
It naturally also keenly noticed the significant increase in the medicinal age of this Nourishing Essence Spirit Orchid.
Saving this Nourishing Essence Spirit Orchid wasn’t anything too difficult, but raising its medicinal age by such an amount in such a short time was truly rare.
However, Xu Ping never mentioned the method he used, so the Lake Shores Mouse, despite being filled with curiosity, dared not ask rashly.
But at this moment, Xu Ping had no time to care what the Lake Shores Mouse was thinking. His thoughts had already drifted to another matter.
He was contemplating the extent of enhancement the Hundred Bamboo Wood would receive if he applied his current Longevity Mana to the Tribulation Spirit Skill.
Although the day to perform the Tribulation Spirit Skill hadn’t yet arrived, doing so a few days early wouldn’t make much of a difference.
Thinking this, Xu Ping approached the Hundred Bamboo Wood.
"Tribulation Spirit Skill!"
Xu Ping’s expression remained as calm as ever, his hands quickly forming complex Spells.
His fingertips lightly tapped, and a massive torrent of vibrant green Longevity Mana, like a roaring flood, burst out from his fingertips.
In an instant.
"Boom!"
This mass of Longevity Mana exploded in the open space, turning into countless small green dots.
These green dots drifted down like a green downpour, falling precisely on all the Spirit Plants and Spirit Medicines on the Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Phew!
In the blink of an eye!
The lush and green Spirit Plants and Spirit Medicines on the Thousand Leaves Mountain rapidly lost their vitality, the leaves turning yellow and gradually withering.
In just a moment, they turned into piles of black ash, leaving behind numerous large green clusters teeming with powerful life force.
"Go!"
Under Xu Ping’s skillful control, these life-filled green clusters dashed through the air, swiftly merging into the Hundred Bamboo Wood.
"Buzz!"
After absorbing these life-filled green clusters, the entire Spirit Wood instantly emitted a strong green spiritual light.
"Crack!"
In the next instant, the entire Hundred Bamboo Wood began to grow at an eye-catching speed visible to the naked eye, with the trunk thickening and the branches and leaves becoming more luxuriant.
Just like that, the Hundred Bamboo Wood grew over three feet taller and then gradually slowed in growth, eventually stopping.
"An increase of fifty percent!" Witnessing this scene, a trace of joy flashed in Xu Ping’s eyes.
Although he had anticipated some increase in the efficiency of the Tribulation Spirit Skill, he hadn’t expected it to be this significant.
But after a little thought, it seemed quite reasonable.
After all, each spirit medicine added a small amount of life force, but altogether, the entire mountain’s worth of spirit medicines amounted to a lot.
This is the concept of quantitative change leading to qualitative change.
"Not bad!" Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction.
This enhancement meant that the time required to forge the Sword Array had been pushed forward again.
By then, the Sword Array formed by seventy-two artifact embryos, combined with his profound Sword Dao realm, might even allow him to contend with cultivators in the Middle Stage of Golden Core.
And not just rely solely on the Talisman Array as before.
After all, although the Talisman Array was powerful, it was useless if the opponent dodged it.
The combination of the Sword Array and Talisman Array is the foundation to stand firm.
"Looks like Artifact Refining Technique should be on the agenda!" Xu Ping touched his chin thoughtfully.
Although the materials needed to forge the artifact embryos had long been fully acquired, he had been busy with other matters, delaying the Artifact Refining.

chapters.title: Chapter 294 - 201: Significant Advancement (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 294: Chapter 201: Significant Advancement (Part 3)
Now that everything is gradually settling down, it is indeed time to enhance my Artifact Refining Technique.
"However, before that, I should first properly establish the Purifying Spirit Nourishing Vein Array," Xu Ping contemplated silently.
After all, setting up the Purifying Spirit Nourishing Vein Array is relatively easier compared to crafting an Artifact Embryo, and it requires less time.
It is only natural to proceed from the simple to the difficult, step by step.
...
...
So Xu Ping wasted no time and went directly to the core of the Spirit Vein to begin setting up the Purifying Spirit Nourishing Vein Array.
"This is the place."
After carefully confirming the location, Xu Ping started methodically arranging the Purifying Spirit Nourishing Vein Array there.
Although the Purifying Spirit Nourishing Vein Array is also considered a Second-stage Upper Grade array, its difficulty is exceedingly high, perhaps only slightly less challenging than some Quasi-Tier Three arrays.
Even with Xu Ping’s considerable expertise in arrays, he must focus entirely and be extremely cautious with this array, allowing no room for even the slightest deviation.
After all, any mistake could not only fail to cleanse the impurities within the Spirit Vein but also potentially cause irreparable damage to it.
"Rise!"
With a wave of his hand, Xu Ping let dozens of Array Flags fly out from his Storage Ring, hovering in mid-air.
These Array Flags were crystal clear, their surfaces covered with intricate runes, each emitting a faint spiritual glow.
His gaze was focused, with a flick of his finger, he placed the Array Flags down one by one at specific positions, inserting them into the ground.
Afterward, he took out the Array Symbol Pen and began to carve densely packed Array Patterns on the ground.
...
And so, time quietly slipped away as Xu Ping busied himself, tense and focused.
A month’s time passed like a fleeting moment, vanishing in an instant.
On this day, Xu Ping, holding the Array Symbol Pen, was intently carving array patterns on the ground.
Finally, when he successfully connected all the Array Flags with a complex web of array patterns into a flawless complete formation, he slowly stopped his actions.
"Finally finished carving!"
Xu Ping exhaled a long breath, and the tense, grave expression on his face relaxed somewhat.
However, he didn’t dare to relax completely, as the Purifying Spirit Nourishing Vein Array hasn’t been fully activated yet.
There’s still one final step.
"Purifying Spirit Nourishing Vein Array, activate!"
Xu Ping put away the Array Symbol Pen and uttered in a low voice.
Simultaneously, he rapidly signed hand seals, channeling the Spiritual Power within him through his fingertips into the Array Flags.
Instantly, the runes on the Array Flags lit up, beams of spiritual light spread from the Array Flags to the array patterns on the ground, weaving together like a spider web, forming a massive array pattern.
The moment the array formed, the Spiritual Qi at the core of the Spirit Vein seemed to be drawn by an invisible force, beginning to flow slowly.
At the same time, the array emitted a gentle glow, like warm tendrils effortlessly penetrating the solid ground, silently reaching deep into the core of the Spirit Vein.
Under Xu Ping’s Earth Master’s Gaze, the light expelled impurities from the Spirit Vein wherever it reached.
The entire Spirit Vein gradually and slowly became purer and clearer.
"The Purifying Spirit Nourishing Vein Array... succeeded!"
Witnessing this scene, Xu Ping couldn’t help but smile.
The month of hard work had finally paid off; this Purifying Spirit Nourishing Vein Array was perfectly arranged, with no flaws.
Xu Ping spread his Divine Sense like fine threads, carefully sensing the subtle changes in the Spiritual Qi of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
He discovered that as impurities were continually expelled from the Spirit Vein, the Spiritual Qi on Thousand Leaves Mountain began to thicken at an extremely slow yet immensely stable rate.
Though the enrichening effect of this Spiritual Qi couldn’t possibly compare to the immediate, pronounced effect of previously employing the Spirit Qi Induction into the Vein, it was superior in stability and endurance.
"Now, two out of the three methods to enhance the Spirit Vein have been completed, leaving only the Spirit Worm," Xu Ping pondered to himself.
Nevertheless, he wasn’t in a hurry.
After all, he had already arranged to complete the transaction with the people from the Hundred Beasts Studio in eight months, with ample time still remaining, a full six months.
If everything goes smoothly, in six months, he will successfully obtain the Spirit Worm.
By then, with all three methods applied concurrently, the Spirit Vein’s enhancement speed will surely increase significantly.
.....
Xu Ping observed the Purifying Spirit Nourishing Vein Array carefully for a while, confirming repeatedly from various angles and positions that there were no errors before finally feeling assured enough to return to his cultivation chamber.
Upon entering the chamber, Xu Ping thought to himself, "Now that the Purifying Spirit Nourishing Vein Array is properly set, it’s time to focus on enhancing my Artifact Refining Technique."
He walked to the stone bed, leapt lightly, and sat crossed-legged on it.
Then he flipped his palm, taking out a jade slip recording Third-rank Lower Grade Artifact Refining Techniques from within his Storage Ring.
Following that, Xu Ping immersed himself in it, meticulously studying the method of crafting an Artifact Embryo named the Lingxiao Sword.
The crafting method for the Lingxiao Sword shared many similarities with those of the magical swords in the Sword Array.
This is one reason he chose it from among the numerous Artifact Embryo crafting methods.
If Xu Ping can successfully refine the Lingxiao Sword, with the assistance of the skill board, the magical swords in the Sword Array will no longer pose a problem.
...
...
As Xu Ping was deeply immersed in studying the Artifact Refining Technique, Duan Shuang and Gong Yang, who had been away for a long time, finally returned and made a special visit to him.
Thus, Xu Ping had to emerge from seclusion to entertain the two.
Thousand Leaves Mountain.
In the pavilion, the aroma of tea lingered.
With a smile, Xu Ping poured Spirit Tea for Duan Shuang and Gong Yang, saying, "It seems you two fellow cultivators have gained considerable rewards from your exploration of the Nine Nether Elder’s ruin!"
At that moment, although Duan Shuang and Gong Yang showed faint signs of fatigue from their long journey, their eyes couldn’t hide their joy.
"It’s not worth mentioning, not worth mentioning." Gong Yang chuckled as he lifted the Spirit Tea, sipping it with delight.

chapters.title: Chapter 295 - 202: Lingxiao Sword Successfully Forged
chapters.content:
Chapter 295: Chapter 202: Lingxiao Sword Successfully Forged
"Ah, this exploration of the Nine Nether Elder’s relic was far more dangerous than before. Fellow Daoist Duan and I almost lost our lives there and would never return."
Gong Yang gently put down the teacup in his hand, his face full of emotion, and with a trace of lingering fear in his words.
Recalling the various thrilling encounters in the relic, he still felt a lingering terror.
Beside him, Duan Shuang agreed deeply and nodded heavily, echoing, "After returning this time, I and Fellow Daoist Gong don’t plan to explore the Nine Nether Elder’s relic anymore."
"It’s indeed admirable that you two can restrain your greed and know when to stop." Xu Ping said with a smile, his eyes expressing approval.
In his view, knowing when to quit was undoubtedly a wise choice for these two.
After all, their cultivation levels were limited, and if they continued exploring deeply, it was only a matter of time before they met with disaster.
"It’s a helpless move."
Duan Shuang sighed with a bitter smile, "To be honest, the barren island where the relic is located might soon explode into a Nascent Soul battle."
"Nascent Soul battle?"
Xu Ping was startled by these words, his face showing surprise as he quickly asked, "Fellow Daoist Duan, where did you hear this news?"
Although the relic of the Nine Nether Elder had certainly attracted Nascent Soul cultivators, when or even if they would make a move was filled with uncertainty.
After all, for Nascent Soul cultivators, their safety and cultivation level were always paramount.
Take Jiang Jingxing, the Sect Leader of Luoyun Sect, for example. He had just broken through to become a Nascent Soul cultivator; even if there were an Infant Devouring Pill in the relic, he wouldn’t risk everything to seize it.
Of course, if his life span was nearing its end, that would be a different story.
"Now the entire Wanzhe Waters are buzzing with rumors."
Duan Shuang patiently explained, "It’s said that the Heaven-Reaching Spiritual Treasure of the Nine Nether Elder—the Yin Yang Qi Cauldron—is currently hidden in the relic."
"Heaven-Reaching Spiritual Treasure?"
"Yin Yang Qi Cauldron?"
Upon hearing these words, Xu Ping’s pupils instantly contracted, and a storm raged within his heart.
In the Cultivation Realm, Foundation Establishment cultivators generally use Magical Artifacts; Fake Pill and Golden Core cultivators often use Artifact Embryos or Artifacts.
Only those who reach the Nascent Soul Realm qualify to use Spirit Treasures.
Although Heaven-Reaching Spiritual Treasures belong to the Spirit Treasure category, their power far surpasses ordinary Spirit Treasures, making them exceptionally rare treasures.
Even ordinary Nascent Soul cultivators would be mesmerized by such a treasure.
"No wonder Fellow Daoist Duan mentioned an upcoming Nascent Soul battle."
"If there truly is a Heaven-Reaching Spiritual Treasure hidden in the Nine Nether Elder’s relic, those Nascent Soul cultivators will surely fight to the death." Xu Ping thought to himself.
But on second thought, this matter seemed to have little to do with him.
After all, he was merely a Foundation Establishment cultivator; only a fool would meddle in such affairs.
To fish in such troubled waters, one needs at least Golden Core-level cultivation.
Though Xu Ping’s mind teemed with thoughts, his expression remained calm, not a hint of anomaly showing. He spoke with a carefully measured hint of astonishment, saying:
"In the current scenario, it’s undoubtedly the correct decision for you two Fellow Daoists to refrain from taking risks."
"Indeed!"
Gong Yang sighed deeply, "Given the situation, unless they’re reckless Foundation Establishment cultivators, who dares to continue exploring the relic?"
After the trio chatted casually for a while, Duan Shuang suddenly placed a delicate jade box on the stone table.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, take a look at this."
Duan Shuang’s beautiful eyes shimmered brightly as she smiled, then waved her jade hand, and the jade box opened automatically, revealing a spirit peach inside.
"Hundred-Year Fruit!"
Xu Ping’s eyes moved, and he immediately expressed his gratitude with a smile, "You Fellow Daoists are so considerate."
Although he had previously consumed precious thousand-year Spiritual Liquid, greatly reducing his anticipation for the Hundred-Year Fruit.
But still, even a mosquito leg is meat; it can at least enhance life span and Longevity Skill proficiency.
"Fellow Daoist Xu is too polite. We’ve known each other for decades, and our friendship is deep; this small token is nothing." Gong Yang chuckled heartily and waved his hand.
"That’s true."
Xu Ping nodded with a smile, then seemed to remember something and said, "By the way, there’s one thing I forgot to tell you Fellow Daoists."
"I’ve bought the Spirit Vein at Purple Bamboo Mountain from Luoyun Sect."
"Bought Purple Bamboo Mountain from Luoyun Sect?"
Duan Shuang and Gong Yang froze upon hearing this, instinctively exchanged glances, their eyes full of shock.
Upon hearing that Xu Ping acquired Purple Bamboo Mountain for just twenty-five thousand Spirit Stones, their faces showed envy.
Knowing that this was a large Second-stage Upper Grade Spirit Vein.
Selling for just twenty-five thousand Spirit Stones was nearly akin to a gift.
However, they understood that this must be due to Xu Ping’s identity as a third-stage Talisman Master.
For other ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivators, even dreaming of such a prospect was unthinkable.
"Congratulations to Fellow Daoist Xu, now you’ve become our landlord. We must not anger Fellow Daoist Xu; otherwise, if you evict me, I’ll be homeless." Duan Shuang smiled softly, jesting sweetly.
"Indeed!"
Gong Yang chimed in, "I wonder if Fellow Daoist Xu plans to charge us rent in the future?"

chapters.title: Chapter 296 - 202: Lingxiao Sword Successfully Forged (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 296: Chapter 202: Lingxiao Sword Successfully Forged (2)
"This place certainly doesn’t charge rent. You two are welcome to stay as long as you wish," Xu Ping said with a chuckle.
Given his current standing, such meager rent income was naturally beneath his notice.
Moreover, the bond between the three of them was quite deep, making it unnecessary to fuss over such trivial rent.
...
...
The three chatted casually for a while longer before Duan Shuang and Gong Yang stood up to take their leave. Xu Ping leisurely strolled back to his cultivation chamber.
He took out the Hundred-Year Fruit and swallowed it in a few bites.
"Hmm, fifteen years of extended lifespan, and the Longevity Skill’s proficiency increased by fifteen points. Not too bad," he remarked.
Xu Ping carefully sensed the growth in both lifespan and Longevity Skill proficiency and nodded slightly.
This was already the fourth Hundred-Year Fruit he had consumed, and still, to have a fifteen-year lifespan extension effect was quite impressive.
After all, most people find it hard to derive further benefits from the Hundred-Year Fruit after consuming just two.
Xu Ping calmed his mind, sat cross-legged, and began to meditate.
Once he had fully absorbed the effects of the Hundred-Year Fruit, he took out a jade slip and focused all his attention on studying the crafting method of the Lingxiao Sword.
...
...
Time flowed on gently, with Xu Ping peacefully residing at Thousand Leaves Mountain, wholeheartedly immersing himself in the art of Artifact Refining.
However, outside, the world was in an uproar over the rumors of the Yin Yang Qi Cauldron.
The entire Ruins Deserted Island was descending further into chaos.
Some sought to make one last big haul before the Yin Yang Qi Cauldron made its appearance; meanwhile, other cultivators, already driven to madness by their greed for treasures, hoped to fish in troubled waters amidst the tumultuous conditions.
Four months flew by.
In front of a luxurious building on the Ruins Deserted Island.
Seven or eight Fake Pill cultivators continually directed their Artifact Embryos to launch fierce attacks at the Restriction enveloping the entire building.
"Boom! Boom! Boom..."
With each resounding explosion, the Restriction’s aura flashed incessantly, and the violent Spiritual Qi ripples surged in all directions like tumultuous waves.
Among those seven or eight Fake Pill cultivators, Hongyi’s figure was conspicuously present.
"There’s only a fifty percent chance. I sincerely hope the Transformation Pill Fruit is right here!"
Watching the Restriction remain stalwart despite everyone’s concerted assault, Hongyi inwardly prayed.
Currently, within the Nine Nether Elder’s relic, there were two places likely to conceal the Transformation Pill Fruit.
Yet, he really couldn’t determine where the Transformation Pill Fruit was located.
Without any better option, he could only choose a place he deemed most probable to instigate his action.
Meanwhile, Fake Pill cultivators were also attacking the other location, and if his guess was wrong, his slim hopes of obtaining the Transformation Pill Fruit would become even more negligible.
"I hope my judgment isn’t wrong!"
Although his mind was a flurry of thoughts, Hongyi’s movements while maneuvering the Artifact Embryo against the Restriction showed no sign of hesitation.
The group’s frantic assault continued unabated.
Crack, crack...
Finally, after a prolonged siege, at this moment, the sturdy Restriction, under their ferocious storm-like onslaught, could no longer hold and became riddled with densely interwoven crack lines like a spider’s web.
The next moment.
Bang!
With an earth-shattering roar, the Restriction above the building burst open, and a vast wave of Spiritual Qi surged outward like a torrential flood.
At the instant the Restriction shattered, the Fake Pill cultivators present unhesitatingly maneuvered their brilliance, darting towards the building’s interior like hungry wolves pouncing.
After half a moment.
Inside the building, in a Spirit Field, a solitary green plant swayed gently in the breeze, beside which stood a peculiarly shaped scarecrow.
"Transformation Pill Fruit!!"
Both Hongyi and another Fake Pill cultivator’s eyes locked, as if magnetically drawn, onto the solitary, more-than-man-tall green plant in the center of the Spirit Field.
No!
To be precise!
Their gazes were fixed upon a fruit the size of an adult’s fist that dangled from the branches of this green plant.
This fruit was a translucid pale pink, with silver streaks crisscrossing its surface.
"Die!"
Almost in the same instant they spotted the Transformation Pill Fruit, both simultaneously struck at each other.
The other Fake Pill cultivator, surrounded by surging Mana, unhesitatingly urged his Artifact Embryo towards Hongyi with vicious intent.
But Hongyi reacted with exceptional swiftness, decisively deploying the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman.
"Swift!"
Hongyi rapidly formed a seal with his hands, uttering a low command.
In an instant.
A massive Thunder Dragon appeared out of thin air.
This Thunder Dragon, enveloped in crackling arcs of electricity that flickered bright, unleashed a terrifying might capable of annihilating the heavens and the earth, rushing towards the Fake Pill cultivator like a roaring ancient beast.
"What!"
"Tier-three Talisman!!"
Witnessing this, the Fake Pill cultivator’s face instantly revealed a hint of shock and fear.
Was this person mad?
Deploying such a trump card right at the start?
That was a tier-three talisman!
Even if it facilitated seizing the Transformation Pill Fruit now, how would he safely carry it away later?
If that Fake Pill cultivator knew that Hongyi still had several more Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans, one wonders what expression this revelation would elicit.
Boom!
The Thunder Dragon, unstoppable, smashed the Fake Pill cultivator’s Artifact Embryo aside and, with the massive impact, sent the Fake Pill cultivator hurtling backward.
Hongyi did not press his advantage, instead turning swiftly and darting toward the Transformation Pill Fruit’s location.
In the blink of an eye, he was upon it, reaching out to securely grasp the Transformation Pill Fruit in his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 297 - 202: Lingxiao Sword Successfully Forged (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 297: Chapter 202: Lingxiao Sword Successfully Forged (Part 3)
Subsequently, he carefully placed the Transformation Pill Fruit into the jade box he had prepared in advance.
However, Hongyi did not notice that at the moment he picked the Transformation Pill Fruit, a faint wisp of ghostly spirit from a nearby scarecrow silently attached itself to his body.
...
...
Meanwhile.
In the artifact refining room on Thousand Leaves Mountain, specially opened by Xu Ping.
Xu Ping stood in the center of the artifact refining room, his forehead beaded with sweat, his clothes already soaked through.
His gaze was as sharp as a hawk’s, firmly locked onto the ball of searing flames hovering in mid-air in front of him.
This flame had a faint purple hue, emanating from the demon fire spat out by a Water Lake Rat, and with the enhancement of a delicate array, Xu Ping could control its size at will.
With a grave expression, Xu Ping’s hands rapidly formed seals as streams of Spiritual Power flowed from his fingertips into the array.
Under his precise manipulation, the flame’s color gradually changed, from a gentle light purple at first, slowly turning into a deep, intense purple.
Each color shift was accompanied by a dramatic spike in temperature.
Within the flames, the embryonic form of a longsword began to faintly take shape.
The sword body was crystalline, with the cold gleam of Profound Crystal Iron and the fiery patterns of Flame Sun Crystal intricately intertwined.
Subsequently, Xu Ping methodically continued to add various auxiliary materials into the flames.
These auxiliary materials, like dots of starlight, merged into the flames’ embrace.
Time passed slowly, and under the thousand-fold tempering of the flames, an embryonic longsword gradually began to take form.
"Just the final step left..."
Xu Ping murmured softly, forming a seal with his hands as Mana continuously surged into the array.
In an instant, the flames abruptly surged, and the temperature soared, causing the air in the artifact refining room to distort from the extreme heat.
Various materials, forged under the insufferable demon fire, gradually fused into one, with the sword’s outline becoming increasingly clear.
Xu Ping could feel the Spiritual Power within the sword embryo gradually coalescing, a sharp aura sweeping across the entire artifact refining room.
His mind was taut, not daring the slightest relaxation, fearing that a single mistake would lead to failure.
"Condense!"
Xu Ping shouted in a low voice, his hands clasping together abruptly, causing the demon fire to instantly contract, enveloping the sword embryo tightly.
The sword body trembled slightly within the flames, emitting a crisp humming sound, as if responding to Xu Ping’s call.
"Quench!"
Xu Ping’s eyes remained as grave as an abyss, his Mana furiously rushing into the array without reservation.
The array operated at its limit, the flames soaring to unprecedented heights, turning the entire artifact refining room into a sea of fire.
If not for the array’s protection, the refining chamber would have long turned to ash.
Clang!
At this moment, from within the flames, the sword embryo emitted a crisp and resonant sound.
"Extinguish!"
Moments later, Xu Ping pinched a hand seal, causing the demon fire to gradually extinguish, and the temperature inside the refining chamber to slowly decline.
With the fire’s disappearance, a wholly crystalline longsword, emitting a gentle glow, slowly descended into Xu Ping’s hands.
"The Lingxiao Sword... finally succeeded!!" Xu Ping couldn’t help but let a slight curve form at the corner of his mouth.
The hard work of this period was finally not in vain!
He had officially become a Quasi-Tier Three Artifact Refiner!
Xu Ping’s eyes held a hint of joy as he began to carefully examine the Lingxiao Sword he had crafted.
The sword was about three feet long, two fingers wide, the blade extraordinarily sharp, exuding a faint chill.
On the spine of the sword, the Profound Crystal Iron and Flame Sun Crystal patterns weaved into a mysterious rune, as if containing boundless power.
Xu Ping gently caressed the blade, sensing a faint pulse from within, as if the sword had developed its own spirit.
He took a deep breath, injecting Spiritual Power into the sword, causing it to immediately emit a brilliant light, and a sharp Sword Qi shot into the sky, sweeping across the entire artifact refining room.
"Not bad!"
Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction.
Although this was his first attempt at crafting an Artifact Embryo, the current Lingxiao Sword, in terms of quality and power, was no less than a typical Artifact Embryo, and in some aspects, it even surpassed them.
Xu Ping gripped the hilt tightly, swinging lightly, a Sword Qi sweeping out, slicing a deep crack into the stone wall of the refining chamber.
"Congratulations, Master, on successfully refining the artifact!"
Upon witnessing this, even though the Water Lake Rat was now panting exhaustedly, it still forced itself to perk up, its face wearing a flattering smile.
"Mm."
Xu Ping nodded slightly, a hint of warmth in his eyes, then spoke, "You have worked hard during this time."
"Not at all, not at all, as Master’s Spirit Pet, it’s only what this little mouse should do."
The Water Lake Rat spoke, its flattering smile growing even brighter, its little paws waving to express its loyalty.
"I am not one to let merit go unrewarded. Open your mouth!"
As Xu Ping spoke, he flicked his fingers, sending two special Pills like two streams of light straight into the Water Lake Rat’s mouth.
Gulp!
The Water Lake Rat’s throat moved, and the two Pills smoothly slid down, landing in its belly.
Soon after, under the continuous refinement of its own demon fire, the two Pills steadily transformed into pure Spiritual Qi, flowing into its Demon Core like a gentle stream.
"Thank you, Master, for the reward!!" The Water Lake Rat beamed with joy, bowing diligently in gratitude.
"Off you go."
Xu Ping nodded slightly, then gave another instruction.
"Alright."
The Water Lake Rat cheerfully responded, then cheerfully left the refining room,
After the Water Lake Rat left the refining room, Xu Ping once again carefully examined the Lingxiao Sword in his hand, unable to help but feel a myriad of emotions in his heart:
"If only the ’Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill’ could be cultivated as smoothly as the Lingxiao Sword."
This whole time, besides putting his whole heart into studying and crafting the Lingxiao Sword, he had been tirelessly delving into the ’Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill’ as well.
However, despite spending a significant amount of time and effort, after all this time, he hadn’t even grasped the basics of this Cultivation Technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 298 - 203: Tier-2 Spirit Worm
chapters.content:
Chapter 298: Chapter 203: Tier-2 Spirit Worm
"No wonder Tong Xingbang emphasized back then that cultivating the ’Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill’ requires an extraordinary high level of comprehension from the cultivator!" Xu Ping couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.
Recalling Tong Xingbang’s solemn demeanor when he mentioned this cultivation technique, Xu Ping now deeply understood.
Although Xu Ping’s own comprehension was mediocre among many cultivators, his Divine Sense was much stronger than that of the average Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
Cultivating the ’Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill’ had somewhat enhanced this aspect.
However, after months, he still couldn’t grasp it at all.
If it were another ordinary cultivator trying to cultivate this technique, the difficulty would likely be unimaginable.
And this is just the entry-level; once the technique deepens, the difficulty will surely increase exponentially.
This cultivation technique is truly impossible to cultivate without high comprehension!
Forget it, there’s no use being anxious; better to take it slow." Xu Ping soon adjusted his mindset.
Currently, he did not have any urgent need to master the ’Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill’.
Besides, with the proficiency panel he had, once he reached the entry level, he could advance slowly without relying on the elusive comprehension!
Thinking of this, Xu Ping felt much more relaxed.
He flicked the Lingxiao Sword flower with his wrist and gently shook it, then stored the Lingxiao Sword into his Storage Ring.
Immediately afterward, Xu Ping headed straight to the cultivation room.
After entering the cultivation room, he effortlessly came to the stone bed and slowly sat cross-legged on it.
Then, he slightly closed his eyes, a calm expression on his face, and began operating the cultivation technique to quietly restore the mana he had consumed.
During this time, crafting the Lingxiao Sword had consumed a great deal of his mind and mana, and he needed a good few days to recuperate.
...
...
Six days later.
In the cultivation room.
Xu Ping silently operated the ’Longevity Skill’; threads of Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi coursed along his meridians and returned to the Sea of Qi in his Dantian.
A drop of viscous liquid mana coagulated and merged into his Dantian, making it look more jade-like in its verdant sheen.
Half an hour later, Xu Ping opened his eyes, concluding his cultivation.
Feeling the mana in his Dantian, a faint smile appeared on his lips: "Three hundred drops of viscous liquid mana, exceeding both in quantity and quality those of a typical Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivator."
"The limit of three hundred sixty drops of liquid mana is not far away," Xu Ping thought to himself.
Once this limit of perfection is reached, he could begin cultivating the Core Formation Secret Technique to compress the liquid mana in his Dantian.
With his now-mutated, unique liquid mana, even without the aid of precious Core Formation spiritual objects, Xu Ping estimated that his success rate of achieving Core Formation could reach seventy to eighty percent.
If he could obtain one or two Core Formation spiritual objects, his success rate—if not a full hundred percent—would at least not be less than ninety-eight percent.
"Ninety-eight percent!"
Xu Ping’s eyes sparkled, murmuring to himself.
In the Cultivation Realm, successfully establishing the Foundation means truly shedding the mortal coil and stepping onto the path of immortality.
Becoming a Golden Core Cultivator, however, signifies an important and tremendous step forward on this path.
From this point on, whether in life span, strength, or status in the Cultivation Realm, a significant transformation would occur.
Xu Ping again calmed his mind, meditated for a while to regulate the slightly agitated mana within, then stood up and slowly walked out of the cultivation room.
Strolling leisurely through the mountains, he breathed in the continuous aromatic scent of spirit medicine, which lifted his spirits.
Just at this moment.
Just at this moment, Xu Ping seemed to sense something, his previously relaxed brows slightly raised.
In the next instant, with a turn of his hand, a Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman glowing with spiritual light appeared in his hand.
He infused it with a trace of mana, and an elderly voice immediately emanated from the talisman: "Friend Li, the Spirit Worm you captured met with an accident."
"Accident?"
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping frowned, immediately changing his voice line to ask in a rough voice, "Friend Pang, could you tell me what exactly happened?"
The one sending him the transmission was named Pang Po, a steward of the Hundred Beasts Sect.
"Here’s the thing, the Spirit Worm was captured just fine, but unexpectedly among them was hidden a Second-stage Spirit Worm..." Pang Po’s helpless voice continued from the talisman.
According to Pang Po, this Second-stage Spirit Worm was exceptionally fierce, injuring over a dozen Qi Cultivation disciples of their Hundred Beasts Sect.
Their sect even organized four or five Foundation Establishment Cultivators to hunt it down.
However, this Second-stage Spirit Worm was extremely cunning; every time it sensed danger, it would burrow into the Spirit Vein underground, leaving them unsuccessful after multiple attempts.
"Second-stage Spirit Worm?"
A trace of astonishment flickered across Xu Ping’s face.
It’s well known that Spirit Worms are not only rare, but their evolution is particularly challenging.
Even after so many years, the Hundred Beasts Sect had only a single Second-stage Spirit Worm, which showed their rarity.
If this Second-stage Spirit Worm could be captured, the speed of the Spirit Vein’s upgrade would significantly increase.
But failing to capture it could hinder the capture of ordinary Spirit Worms due to the interference of this Second-stage Spirit Worm.
So was he lucky or not?
"Does Friend Pang have any strategy now?" Xu Ping suppressed his thoughts and inquired.
Pang Po pondered for a moment on the other side of the talisman and slowly said, "The only current option is to leverage an Earth Master to drive the Second-stage Spirit Worm from the Spirit Vein."
"Earth Master?"

chapters.title: Chapter 299 - 203: Tier-2 Spirit Worm (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 299: Chapter 203: Tier-2 Spirit Worm (2)
Xu Ping slightly furrowed his brow.
But after careful consideration, he discovered that the Earth Master might really be possible!
The Earth Master’s Gaze can penetrate multiple obstacles to precisely locate the position of a second-stage Spirit Worm hidden deep within the Spirit Vein.
Then, by skillfully manipulating earth energy and the Spirit Vein, he is quite confident in forcing this cunning second-stage Spirit Worm out from the vein.
"Moreover, an ordinary first-rank Earth Master’s abilities in this area are limited. Only when one reaches the level of a second-stage Earth Master do they possess sufficient capability to handle this matter."
Pang Po, on the other end of the Sound Transmission Talisman, tentatively asked, "May I ask if Fellow Daoist Li knows any second-stage Earth Masters?"
Xu Ping did not reply immediately but fell into contemplation.
Given his current accomplishments in the path of the Earth Master, he was not actually inferior to some second-stage Earth Masters. By relying on his own abilities, he was largely likely to succeed in forcing the second-stage Spirit Worm out.
However, a key question lay before him: was it worth revealing his prowess as an Earth Master and personally going to handle this second-stage Spirit Worm?
Quickly, Xu Ping weighed the pros and cons in his mind and came to a conclusion.
It was worth it!
Exposing himself as a second-stage Earth Master was not a big deal.
Moreover, the other party did not know his true identity yet, so it wasn’t likely they would go to great lengths to target him.
After thorough consideration, it was a relatively low-risk endeavor with potentially huge rewards.
Having made up his mind, Xu Ping slowly spoke into the Sound Transmission Talisman: "To be honest, I am a second-stage Earth Master."
"Fellow Daoist Li is a second-stage Earth Master, that’s wonderful!"
Pang Po’s voice carried a hint of joy, "Then can Fellow Daoist Li assist us in capturing this second-stage Spirit Worm?"
As he had expected, this Fellow Daoist Li was probably one of the rare second-stage Earth Masters in the entire Yue Country.
"There is certainly no problem with that."
Xu Ping’s tone was calm, and then he shifted the topic, "However, before that, I would like to be clear on the ownership of this second-stage Spirit Worm."
"The ownership of the second-stage Spirit Worm?"
Pang Po’s tone revealed a trace of hesitation, then fell silent, seemingly deep in thought.
After half a cup of tea’s time, Pang Po’s aged voice once again sounded from the Sound Transmission Talisman: "The ownership of the second-stage Spirit Worm can be negotiated; it all depends on what price Fellow Daoist Li is willing to offer!"
After a moment of thought, Xu Ping replied, "How about one Demon Core?"
"A Demon Core?"
Pang Po was slightly taken aback, but after a moment of thought, he still refused: "Although Demon Cores are precious, they are not on the same level as a special demon beast like a second-stage Spirit Worm."
Upon hearing Pang Po’s decisive refusal, Xu Ping did not reveal any signs of anxiety. Instead, he calmly asked, "Then what price does Fellow Daoist Pang have in mind?"
It must be noted that Earth Masters were already quite scarce within the entire Yue Country, let alone second-stage Earth Masters.
Even for a sizeable sect like the Hundred Beasts Sect, finding a second-stage Earth Master for assistance on short notice was extremely difficult.
After a moment of silence, Pang Po directly made an exorbitant demand: "Three Demon Cores."
"Three Demon Cores?"
Xu Ping’s tone contained a hint of dissatisfaction, "Is Fellow Daoist Pang joking with such a statement?"
"The value of three Demon Cores already far exceeds that of a second-stage Spirit Worm; moreover, I will be the main force in capturing this second-stage Spirit Worm."
"That may be the case, but this second-stage Spirit Worm was discovered by our sect first..."
Pang Po, at this moment, remained composed and began bargaining with Xu Ping unhurriedly.
After half an hour of pulling back and forth, Xu Ping finally secured the ownership of the second-stage Spirit Worm at the cost of two Demon Cores.
To be fair, from a purely interest-based perspective, Xu Ping was indeed at a loss for this trip.
After all, he not only had to give up precious Demon Cores but also had to personally participate in the capture mission, taking on the primary role.
However, as far as he was concerned, securing the second-stage Spirit Worm was worth everything.
"Then it’s settled. I will await Fellow Daoist Li’s arrival at Spirit Void Peak," Pang Po’s voice, carrying a tinge of pleasure, came clearly from the Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman.
"I will certainly arrive as soon as possible," Xu Ping replied steadily.
"All right." Pang Po simply acknowledged.
The two then exchanged a few more polite remarks before the spiritual light on the Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman gradually dimmed.
Xu Ping gazed at the fading light of the Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman in his hand, going over the plan to hunt the second-stage Spirit Worm once more in his mind.
Even considering the worst case, the risk of this operation was not significant.
Although the Hundred Beasts Sect was a formidable Golden Core-level sect, it did not possess top-tier late-stage Golden Core-level cultivators, only one middle-stage Golden Core and one early-stage Golden Core cultivator sat in charge.
Even if the Hundred Beasts Sect intended to break the agreement and seize the second-stage Spirit Worm greedily, without knowing his true identity, at best, they would send one or two Fake Pill cultivators.
Given Xu Ping’s current strength, one or two Fake Pill cultivators, or even an early-stage Golden Core cultivator, posed no substantial threat to him.
"I hope the Hundred Beasts Sect does not make a fool of itself!" Xu Ping muttered to himself, a cold glint inadvertently flashing in his eyes.
...
...
Meanwhile, at Spirit Void Peak.
In the depths of a secluded forest, a transparent spiritual qi veil appeared silently, enveloping the area tightly, as if forming an isolated space detached from the outside world.
At this moment, five cultivators clad in the unique attire of the Hundred Beasts Sect stood quietly within the veil.

chapters.title: Chapter 300 - 203: Second-stage Spirit Worm (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 300: Chapter 203: Second-stage Spirit Worm (Part 3)
Pang Po, who had just used the Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman to contact Xu Ping, was also among these people.
"This matter... should be settled!"
Pang Po’s lips curled up in a barely noticeable cold smile.
He turned his palm, and the Super Long-distance Sound Transmission Talisman instantly disappeared into the Storage Ring.
"Hmm, the other party shouldn’t have any suspicions." One of them, an unremarkable black-faced man with Fake Pill cultivation, nodded slightly.
Their conversation was clearly heard by the few present.
This fellow named Li Feiyu seemed to have been deceived.
"But is this person really a Loose Cultivator?"
Another Foundation Establishment Cultivator asked worriedly, "After all, Second-stage Earth Masters are extremely rare throughout Yue Country, and most are cultivated by major sects?"
Pang Po pondered for a moment, then slowly said, "He’s likely a Loose Cultivator. After extensive verification, the well-known Second-stage Earth Masters from major sects do not match his characteristics."
"Could this person be disguised?"
Another cultivator expressed doubt, "If he’s a Second-stage Earth Master sent by another sect, that could be problematic."
"This matter..."
The remaining Foundation Establishment Cultivators began to argue.
"Alright, once he arrives, it will be clear; when he comes, I’ll be able to discern the truth."
The black-faced man’s tone was indifferent, and although his voice was not loud, it carried an undeniable authority that directly interrupted the argument.
The Divine Sense of a Fake Pill cultivator far surpasses that of Foundation Establishment cultivators; for a Foundation Establishment cultivator to disguise in front of him is extremely difficult.
"If he indeed belongs to some sect, or even the Luoyun Sect, then find an excuse to send him away; but if he’s just a Loose Cultivator..."
The black-faced man stopped here, a cold, sinister light flashing in his eyes.
Although he did not finish speaking, the meaning he intended to convey was quite clear.
"With Elder Song taking action, success is assured!"
Pang Po flattered the black-faced man, then continued, "If we can capture this Second-stage Spirit Worm, the speed at which our sect upgrades its Third-rank Upper Grade Spirit Vein to a Quasi-Fourth Rank Spirit Vein will greatly increase!"
Upon hearing this, a hint of fervor flashed in the eyes of the few present.
A Spirit Vein is the foundation of a sect.
Although upgrading from a Third-rank Upper Grade Spirit Vein to a Quasi-Fourth Rank may not show immediate results, from a long-term development perspective, it undoubtedly represents a qualitative leap.
Having a higher-level Spirit Vein means the sect disciples can obtain more abundant Spiritual Qi resources for cultivation, and the overall strength of the sect will rise accordingly.
If not for the Nine Nether Elder’s relic attracting two Golden Core Supreme Elders and several Fake Pill Elders, resulting in a temporary shortage of personnel in the sect,
otherwise, dealing with this matter would at least involve a Golden Core expert stationed here.
However, with one Fake Pill cultivator and four Foundation Establishment cultivators at present, they are confident that dealing with a mere Late-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator is more than adequate.
"This Second-stage Spirit Worm must be ours!" one of the Foundation Establishment cultivators asserted firmly.
Due to the rarity of the Spirit Worm demon beast, few are aware of it, and there is a world of difference between a Second-stage Spirit Worm and an ordinary First Rank Spirit Worm, they are entirely different concepts.
The abilities of a Second-stage Spirit Worm far surpass that of a First Rank Spirit Worm.
Whether in loosening the soil surrounding a Spirit Vein, or its excrement serving as nutrient for the Spirit Vein, it far exceeds the normal First Rank Spirit Worm.
Moreover, the Second-stage Spirit Worm has one more crucial ability!
That is Spirit Qi Tide Guidance!
The Second-stage Spirit Worm can perceive the natural fluctuations of Spiritual Qi around a Spirit Vein.
It will, at the time of the Spiritual Qi tide, lead First Rank Spirit Worms through its wriggling and energy release to trigger a phenomenon akin to "Spiritual Qi Resonance."
This resonance can lead the external Spiritual Qi tide into the Spirit Vein, promoting its self-purification and upgrading.
The Hundred Beasts Sect has relied on the decades of hard work of its only Second-stage Spirit Worm in the sect.
Its Spirit Vein quality has already surpassed an average Third-rank Spirit Vein.
For this reason, the sudden appearance of a Second-stage Spirit Worm is undoubtedly a rare opportunity for the Hundred Beasts Sect, one they absolutely cannot let slip!
...
...
A month passed in the blink of an eye.
Spirit Void Peak!
In the sky, a dazzling Escape Light shot from a distant place like a meteor, incredibly fast, and in an instant, disappeared into the lush forest of Spirit Void Peak.
A quarter of an hour quietly passed.
The Escape Light landed steadily on an open space within the forest.
As soon as the Escape Light landed, Pang Po and a few Foundation Establishment cultivators quickly approached.
Only to see Pang Po’s face full of enthusiastic smiles, hands clasped in salute, respectfully saying, "Friend Li, it must have been quite a tiring journey."
Xu Ping smiled slightly, clasped his hands in return, and said in a calm tone, "Friend Pang, you are too kind, it was just a relatively short journey, not much of a hardship."
Pang Po’s smile grew wider, he turned to face the cultivators behind him, and said to Xu Ping, "Let me introduce you, these are the deacons of our sect, this is Jin Jia..."
This time, including Pang Po, there were a total of five Foundation Establishment cultivators from the Hundred Beasts Sect who came.
Among them, one was at the Late-Stage Foundation Establishment, two were at the Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment, and the remaining two at the Early-Stage Foundation Establishment.
As Pang Po spoke, he gestured, pointing to a plain-looking black-faced man beside him, smiling as he introduced, "This is Friend Song Li, who, like Friend Xu, is also at the Late-Stage Foundation Establishment."
"Friend Li." Song Li nodded slightly, giving Xu Ping a simple greeting.
Before his words trailed off, his Divine Sense extended silently like an invisible tentacle, brushing over Xu Ping like a gentle breeze without leaving a trace.
In his heart, he thought to himself, "This person is not disguised."

chapters.title: Chapter 301 - 204: Capturing the Rank 2 Spirit Worm
chapters.content:
Chapter 301: Chapter 204: Capturing the Rank 2 Spirit Worm
Song Li withdrew his Divine Sense and nodded imperceptibly.
Pang Po and the others understood this immediately.
Although Song Li hadn’t noticed Xu Ping’s disguise, at the moment his hidden Divine Sense quietly touched Xu Ping, Xu Ping’s pupils contracted slightly.
"This person is somewhat suspicious, the intensity of this Divine Sense is definitely not what an ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivator should have, clearly a Fake Pill cultivator."
Xu Ping was secretly alert in his heart, but his expression remained calm and unremarkable.
"Fellow Daoist Song." He politely returned the gesture.
If it were an ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivator, or even a Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivator, they would have difficulty noticing this person’s disguise.
But Xu Ping was different, his Divine Sense was powerful, akin to a Fake Pill cultivator, and thus could easily detect the probe.
"So, the Hundred Beasts Sect deliberately sent a Fake Pill cultivator with hidden cultivation here because they’re afraid I’ll seize by force?"
"Or do they have another agenda, planning to... manipulate me and take all the benefits?"
Thinking to this point, Xu Ping tended to lean towards the latter suspicion internally.
"Seems like this Hundred Beasts Sect is seeking death!" Xu Ping couldn’t help but let out a cold laugh, hidden with an air of chill in his heart.
A Fake Pill cultivator plus four Foundation Establishment cultivators, to him, even capturing all of them in one go wouldn’t be a hard task.
However, he didn’t intend to act now; everything should wait until he obtained the Second-stage Spirit Worm before making any further moves.
After exchanging a few pleasantries with empty sincerity, Xu Ping spoke, "Fellow Daoist Pang, although I’m confident I can drive the Second-stage Spirit Worm out from the Spirit Vein, I must first confirm its location."
"But now this Second-stage Spirit Worm is hidden within the Spirit Vein somewhere, and even if I use my Earth Master’s Gaze, it would be difficult to find it."
"Does Fellow Daoist Pang have any good strategies?" Xu Ping’s gaze steadily fell on Pang Po as he inquired.
"No need to worry, Fellow Daoist Li, we already have a countermeasure for this situation." Pang Po seemed full of confidence.
"Take a look!"
As he spoke, he gently overturned his palm, revealing a special Spirit Grass about one foot high emanating a faint red glow.
"What is this?"
Xu Ping stared intently at the special Spirit Grass in Pang Po’s hand and asked full of doubt.
Even though he was an Alchemist and had seen numerous Spirit Medicines and Spirit Plants, he had never seen this special Spirit Grass.
"This Spirit Grass is called Red Beast Grass, it’s the favorite food of the Second-stage Spirit Worm."
"As long as it is placed in an open area, the Second-stage Spirit Worm will surely be unable to resist the temptation and appear." Pang Po said confidently.
"Red Beast Grass?"
Upon hearing the name, Xu Ping’s eyes brightened intensely.
This indeed is a rare treasure; with the assistance of the Red Beast Grass, capturing the Second-stage Spirit Worm would undoubtedly become much easier.
However, since the Hundred Beasts Sect has Red Beast Grass and has even raised a Second-stage Spirit Worm before within their sect, they must be well aware of the Spirit Worm’s behavior.
Why then haven’t they captured this Second-stage Spirit Worm themselves and instead sought his help?
Could there be some hidden difficulties involved?
With these thoughts, Xu Ping voiced his doubts directly.
"Fellow Daoist, there is something you don’t know."
Upon hearing Xu Ping’s question, Pang Po smiled bitterly in resignation and explained slowly:
"The Second-stage Spirit Worm is extremely sensitive to fluctuations in Spiritual Qi; if an array is set up in advance, due to its cunning nature, it won’t enter our preset encirclement."
"Oh?"
Upon hearing Pang Po’s explanation, Xu Ping raised his brow slightly and showed evident surprise, "Is that so?"
This Second-stage Spirit Worm is indeed hard to catch.
No wonder the Hundred Beasts Sect spent such a long time yet were unable to capture it.
Its concealment techniques are already extremely strong, and with such sensitivity to Spiritual Qi fluctuations, trying to capture it becomes exponentially difficult.
If he hadn’t known these beforehand and came alone to catch the Second-stage Spirit Worm, he would most likely return empty-handed.
"Indeed!"
Pang Po nodded slightly and continued, "Our Hundred Beasts Sect has previously raised a Second-stage Spirit Worm and thus thoroughly understands its habits."
"So, we invited Fellow Daoist Li, a Second-stage Earth Master, over." With that, Pang Po laughed heartily.
"To lure out the Second-stage Spirit Worm is not difficult; but as for how to successfully capture it afterward, that depends entirely on you, Fellow Daoist Li."
Pang Po looked intently at Xu Ping with discerning eyes, "I wonder if Fellow Daoist Li has any thoughts on this?"
Xu Ping slightly squinted his eyes and fell into contemplation.
After a moment, he slowly began, "The Second-stage Spirit Worm is so cunning, ordinary means might be difficult to subdue it."
"As of now..."
After pausing briefly, Xu Ping continued, "The only way is to plant Earth Vein Flags at all the Spirit Vein nodes of Spirit Void Peak, guide out the Earth Qi, and use it to set up an array to force it out from underground."
"Earth Vein Flags?"
"Using Earth Qi to form an array?"
Xu Ping’s proposal left Pang Po’s group dumbfounded.
They were already not very familiar with Earth Masters, and when it involved arrays as well, it only left them further confused.
However, Song Li displayed a thoughtful expression.
Though his understanding of Earth Masters was limited, he was an exceptionally rare Second-stage Upper Grade Array Master.
With his research and skill in arrays, utilizing Earth Qi to set up an array was something he could barely manage.
However, he wasn’t an Earth Master, making it impossible to accurately locate the Spirit Vein nodes, let alone successfully draw out the Earth Qi.

chapters.title: Chapter 302 - 204: Capturing the Tier 2 Spirit Worm (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 302: Chapter 204: Capturing the Tier 2 Spirit Worm (Part 2)
"It seems this young fellow is not only a Second-stage Earth Master but also possesses significant expertise in arrays!" Song Li thought privately.
In the entire Yue Country, Second-stage Earth Masters are extremely rare, and if one also possesses profound array expertise, then they are as rare as a phoenix’s feather.
’This young fellow might not be an ordinary Loose Cultivator in Foundation Establishment!’
Thinking of this, a trace of vigilance and unease involuntarily rose in Song Li’s heart.
However, when his hand inadvertently touched the advanced Spirit Beast pouch at his waist, his heart suddenly calmed a lot.
No matter how many tricks this boy has in front of him, in the face of absolute power, they are nothing but ants!
"Of course, matters of expertise should be handled by professionals, let’s proceed as Fellow Daoist Li suggested." Song Li, having regained his composure, decisively made the decision.
With Song Li speaking, Pang Po and his group naturally dared not raise any objections.
"We will completely follow Fellow Daoist Li’s commands!" Pang Po immediately clasped his hands and said.
"Fellow Daoist Pang speaks too highly, it’s not commanding at all, I just have one thing indeed that requires the aid of your fellow Daoists." Xu Ping said with a smile and a polite wave.
"Please speak, fellow Daoist." Pang Po said earnestly.
"To be honest, I don’t have the Earth Vein Flag with me, and if I start refining it now, it will take too long and might miss the opportunity to capture the Second-stage Spirit Worm, which is quite urgent."
"So I was wondering if you fellow Daoists could help me collect some Earth Vein Flags." Xu Ping clasped his hands and said.
The Earth Vein Flag, refined from the Mystical Rock Soil containing earth’s power, is not very precious.
But he needs a large quantity, and if he collects them alone, it surely requires considerable effort.
However, with the numerous and widespread connections of the Hundred Beasts Sect, their efficiency in collecting is undoubtedly much higher.
Upon hearing Xu Ping’s request, Pang Po, without hesitation, immediately patted his chest and promised earnestly:
"This is just a small matter, fellow Daoist rest assured, I will immediately instruct my disciples to collect them wholeheartedly.
With the capabilities of our Hundred Beasts Sect, I believe we can collect enough Earth Vein Flags in just a few days."
"Then many thanks to Fellow Daoist Pang." Xu Ping outwardly expressed thanks with a smile, but inwardly felt a chill.
Pang Po’s easy promises, not even mentioning Spirit Stone rewards, increasingly convinced Xu Ping that the Hundred Beasts Sect must harbor ulterior motives, seeking to take all benefits.
...
The task of finding Earth Vein Flags was soon properly arranged by Pang Po.
Soon after, everyone settled patiently on Spirit Void Peak to wait.
During this wait, Pang Po always tried to subtly extract information from Xu Ping, probing his situation.
Xu Ping, aware of their intentions as if looking into a clear mirror, knew it very well, often secretly scoffing.
Facing Pang Po’s probing, Xu Ping casually responded with a few words, merely claiming he was just an ordinary loose cultivator.
"It seems this person’s vigilance is quite high, but he indeed seems like a loose cultivator." Pang Po thought to himself.
...
Time flew by, and ten days passed quickly.
"Fellow Daoist Li, the Earth Vein Flags you requested are all in this storage bag."
Pang Po, smiling broadly, handed a gray-looking storage bag to Xu Ping.
Xu Ping reached out to take the storage bag, a trace of Divine Sense instantly probing into it.
He saw hundreds of earth-yellow Earth Vein Flags neatly placed inside the storage bag.
