"Thanks for your concern, Fellow Daoist Pang." Xu Ping smiled and clasped his hands in gratitude.
Undoubtedly, the numerous members of the Hundred Beasts Sect make processing this kind of trivial matter impressively efficient.
"It’s a small matter, not worth mentioning."
Pang Po generously waved his hand, then impatiently urged, "The Earth Vein Flags have been collected in full, so can Fellow Daoist Li begin the setup?"
"Certainly no problem, fellow Daoists just follow me shortly."
Xu Ping smiled calmly, then took out a handful of Earth Vein Flags and walked with steady, powerful steps toward the depths of the forest.
After exchanging a look among each other, Pang Po and Song Li followed closely behind Xu Ping without any hesitation.
Xu Ping activated the Earth Master’s Gaze, and suddenly, his eyes gleamed brightly.
With steady steps, he carefully searched for Spirit Vein nodes in every corner of Spirit Void Peak.
The Earth Master’s Gaze was running at full strength, not missing any subtle traces or clues.
Whenever he discovered a Spirit Vein node, Xu Ping would carefully insert the Earth Vein Flag into it.
Following closely behind Xu Ping, Pang Po and the others felt much more assured seeing his skilled and fluid motions.
Song Li, on the other hand, kept observing Xu Ping’s every move silently, his eyes filled with scrutiny and vigilance.
As a Second-stage Upper Grade Array Master, he knew well the great difficulty of setting up arrays based on earth energy, which made him increasingly curious about Xu Ping’s true abilities.
With each Earth Vein Flag precisely inserted into the Spirit Vein nodes, the earth energy around Spirit Void Peak began to undergo subtle and peculiar changes.
The originally smooth and orderly flowing earth energy now became chaotic and disordered, faintly showing signs of breaking through the ground’s constraints.
Spirit Void Peak is vast, with numerous Spirit Vein nodes, each far apart, coupled with Xu Ping’s need for meticulous exploration, allowing no negligence.
Thus, even with the assistance of Pang Po and others, Xu Ping spent a full five days before finally placing Earth Vein Flags on all the Spirit Vein nodes of Spirit Void Peak.

chapters.title: Chapter 303 - 204: Capturing the Tier 2 Spirit Worm (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 303: Chapter 204: Capturing the Tier 2 Spirit Worm (Part 3)
"The array formation is complete; we just need to find an open and spacious area to lure the Second-stage Spirit Worm over," Xu Ping exhaled deeply after setting up the array.
Hearing this, Song Li nodded slightly in approval, "Fellow Daoist Li’s array setup is nothing short of perfect."
"Although it has yet to be activated, judging by the tightly connected energy between the Earth Vein Flags, once triggered, the power of this array will undoubtedly be formidable!"
"Fellow Daoist Song, you flatter me. This array has a rather simple function, merely for trapping and not for causing harm, and doesn’t qualify as an advanced formation," Xu Ping humbly waved his hand.
"Even so, it’s more than adequate for capturing the Second-stage Spirit Worm," Song Li agreed wholeheartedly.
With Song Li’s profound knowledge in arrays and witnessing the setup under his own watchful eyes, he naturally understood its function and effectiveness thoroughly.
However, arranging an array using earth energy was something Song Li had never tried before.
At that moment, he couldn’t help feeling a bit excited and was about to say a few more words when Pang Po suddenly interjected, "Senior Brother Song, Fellow Daoist Li, we’ve already found a wide open space.
"In my opinion, it would be better to have a good chat after we’ve successfully captured the Second-stage Spirit Worm."
"Junior Brother Pang is right. We can have an in-depth exchange with Fellow Daoist Li after capturing the Spirit Worm," Song Li nodded in agreement.
Thus, they all summoned their Escape Light and with a flash, soared into the sky like arrows leaving the string.
Soon after, Xu Ping and the others arrived at a flat area covered with lush green grass.
A short distance away were sparse low shrubs.
"This place is quite suitable," Xu Ping nodded slightly, satisfaction evident in his eyes.
Then, with a flick of his palm, five earth-colored Array Flags appeared in his hand.
"Fellow Daoists, controlling this array formation is quite challenging and I’m afraid I won’t be able to manage it perfectly on my own, so I need your assistance," Xu Ping said seriously.
"That’s certainly no problem."
"Fellow Daoist Xu, just tell us what’s needed, and we’ll follow your lead."
...
Upon hearing Xu Ping’s words, Pang Po and the others nodded without hesitation.
"Rest assured, fellow Daoists, it’s nothing too difficult. Just follow my instructions and channel your Mana into this flag."
Xu Ping smiled slightly and lightly tossed the Array Flags, which landed steadily in the hands of the five under the light drag of Mana.
"What Fellow Daoist Li said is true; controlling this Array Flag is indeed quite simple," Song Li agreed as he caught the Array Flag.
After a brief discussion, Pang Po went to the middle of the grassland and dug a small hole.
He then carefully took out the Red Beast Grass from the Storage Ring, half-burying it in the hole, leaving half exposed, and sprinkled some unknown powder on it.
As the powder scattered, a faint medicinal fragrance spread instantly.
"This should do it. This Second-stage Red Beast Grass will surely attract the Second-stage Spirit Worm, even if it is hidden within the Spirit Vein."
Pang Po stood up, contentedly patting his hands.
"Well done, Fellow Daoist Pang," Xu Ping smiled and advised, "Fellow Daoists, position yourselves in the sky. When the Second-stage Spirit Worm appears, at my signal, channel Mana into the Array Flags to activate the formation, trapping it with the power of earth energy."
"With this, the Second-stage Spirit Worm won’t be able to escape."
"No problem,"
Upon hearing this, excitement and anticipation gleamed in the eyes of Pang Po and the others.
This Li Feiyu fellow indeed has some skills, it makes one almost reluctant to kill him.
After exchanging a few more words, they all summoned their Escape Light again, shooting up like lightning, hovering steadily 56 yards above, maintaining a still position.
Then, they each cast their Secret Techniques, cleverly concealing themselves while holding the Array Flags.
Because this matter was about capturing the Second-stage Spirit Worm in one go, Pang Po, Song Li, and the others were naturally tense, fully focused, staring intently below without daring to relax even a bit.
Even Xu Ping’s eyes were sharp, full of spirit, with a sombre look on his face, fully prepared to handle the situation about to unfold.
The moment they concealed themselves, the area instantly fell silent, devoid of any sound.
...
Time passed slowly as they waited tensely.
They waited from daytime until nightfall, but the anticipated movement never occurred.
Even so, none of them showed any signs of impatience or panic.
After all, even at the very least, they were Early-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivators; having patience and endurance was naturally no issue for them.
Several more hours passed quietly, and before they knew it, dawn was about to break.
The night before dawn was like a heavy curtain, weighing down on everything.
Not a hint of moonlight penetrated the layers of leaves, and the darkness was as thick as ink, spreading freely in every corner of the space.
Suddenly!
A snap!
A very faint yet extraordinarily clear sound instantly drew everyone’s attention.
The ground started to tremble slightly, with tiny cracks, like a spider’s web, appearing around where the Red Beast Grass was placed, gradually spreading.
"It’s coming!"

chapters.title: Chapter 304 - 205: Capturing a Tier-2 Spirit Worm; Tearing Off All Pretense
chapters.content:
Chapter 304: Chapter 205: Capturing a Tier-2 Spirit Worm; Tearing Off All Pretense
"It’s coming!"
Under the gaze of several people’s mixed surprise and joy.
A special Demon Beast with a body length of two zhang was slowly squeezing out from the crack.
This beast emitted a faint green glow all over, and its body was evenly covered with a layer of fine scales; the most intriguing feature was a pair of agile tentacles growing from the top of its head.
Its pair of blood-red eyes flashed with crimson, and the tentacles on its head flickered with spirit light, seemingly probing for something.
Witnessing this scene, Xu Ping and his companions, suspended in mid-air, hurriedly operated their Secret Techniques to the extreme.
In no time, the aura around them became restrained, as if they had blended into the void without leaving a trace.
The Second-stage Spirit Worm did not notice the individuals hidden within the void. It cautiously surveyed its surroundings, and after seeing no anomalies, its courage gradually increased.
Soon, its blood-red eyes slowly locked onto the Red Beast Grass growing in the distance, and then it silently slithered toward the target.
However, when the Second-stage Spirit Worm was only a dozen zhang away from the Red Beast Grass, its body abruptly stopped.
The tentacles on its head suddenly emitted a strong burst of spirit light, a hint of suspicion flashed in its eyes, as if it had discovered something.
Seeing this, Xu Ping secretly thought things were going wrong.
If the Second-stage Spirit Worm were to retreat now, the previous efforts would be in vain.
Immediately, he executed a Spell, and "Earth Master’s Gaze" quietly unfolded.
His gaze was intense and decisive, and he immediately used sound transmission to announce to everyone: "Fellow Daoists, prepare to act immediately! Listen to my command, and simultaneously input Mana into the Array Flag!"
Pang Po and the others felt a tinge of tension but knew that the arrow was on the string, and they could not hold back. They all secretly circulated their Mana, awaiting Xu Ping’s directive.
Xu Ping’s eyes were glued to every move of the Second-stage Spirit Worm, his gaze never wavering for a second.
Just as the tentacles atop the Spirit Worm’s head flickered intensely with spirit light, indicating a retreating motion, he shouted loudly, "Move!"
Instantly, Pang Po, Song Li, and the other five acted with determination, simultaneously channeling their surging Mana into the Array Flags they held tightly.
Immediately, with six Array Flags as conduits, the Earth Vein Flags inserted into Spirit Vein nodes around Spirit Void Peak responded in unison.
A vast and cryptic earth energy surged skyward, interwoven above this flatland, forming a massive Array glowing with an earthen yellow hue.
The area enveloped by the Array churned with earth energy, and the ground’s cracks rapidly expanded and stretched, creating a giant circular zone that entrapped the Second-stage Spirit Worm.
"Hiss!"
The Second-stage Spirit Worm keenly sensed the impending danger, emitting a sharp and piercing hiss.
The sound cut through the sky like a blade slicing through satin, painful to the ears.
At the same time, its body twisted frantically, the green glow on its surface growing ever stronger, with scales rubbed against each other, producing a rustling noise.
In its panic, this Second-stage Spirit Worm recklessly broke through the hard earth.
Along with a burst of flying soil and rocks, it darted toward the Spirit Vein underground like a cannonball.
In just the blink of an eye, it disappeared without a trace.
"Friend Li!!"
Witnessing this scene, Pang Po’s expression immediately became tense, his tone tinged with urgency.
However, at this moment, Xu Ping kept his lips tightly shut, remaining silent.
The "Earth Master’s Gaze" opened on his forehead operated to its limit, with his eyes radiating brilliant light, resembling two blazing suns in the sky.
With the Earth Master’s Gaze’s extraordinary probing capability, every move of the Second-stage Spirit Worm underground, including its attempted escape route, unfolded like a vivid painting before Xu Ping.
Xu Ping raised his hand to unleash a surge of powerful Mana, landing precisely on a flag, then executed a Magic Technique.
In an instant, all Earth Vein Flags inserted at Spirit Vein nodes on Spirit Void Peak simultaneously erupted with a strong, dazzling spirit light.
The light pierced the sky, illuminating the entire Spirit Void Peak.
At this moment, the earth energy underground seemed summoned by some invisible force, spreading out like a tidal wave.
Wherever the earth energy passed, the soil rapidly condensed, and solid barriers shimmering with earthen yellow spirit light rose from the ground.
Blocking all possible escape routes for the Second-stage Spirit Worm, sealing them completely.
The Second-stage Spirit Worm was trapped in this narrow space underground, struggling like a cornered beast.
It roared angrily, the green glow on its surface reaching its peak, like a burning green flame, illuminating the surroundings in verdant light.
Then, the Second-stage Spirit Worm charged with all its might, crashing into the solid barrier that flickered with earthen yellow spirit light.
Boom!
With Spirit Void Peak subtly trembling, a slightly muffled yet immensely loud sound emerged from deep underground.
This roar was like a muffled thunder in the heavens, painfully impactful on everyone’s eardrums.
However, the solid barrier flickering with earthen yellow spirit light proved too sturdy.
The Second-stage Spirit Worm’s powerful collision was mighty but only left it dizzy and seeing stars, while the barrier remained unyielding, not displaying even a single crack, steadily standing firm and unmovable.
"What...?"
At this moment, above Spirit Void Peak, Song Li, Pang Po, and the others keenly perceived the intense commotion from underground, their expressions slightly changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 305 - 205: Capture of the Tier-2 Spirit Worm; Tearing Off Pretenses (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 305: Chapter 205: Capture of the Tier-2 Spirit Worm; Tearing Off Pretenses (Part 2)
They didn’t have the Earth Master’s Gaze nor any secret techniques to probe the underground, so naturally, they were unaware of what was happening below.
They wanted to ask about the current situation, but seeing Xu Ping’s grave expression, they closed their mouths and obediently held the array flag, continuously injecting mana into it.
Compared to Song Li, Pang Po, and others’ nervousness, Xu Ping’s mood gradually relaxed.
Because, under such a tight encirclement by the sturdy barrier formed from condensed earth energy.
The Second-stage Spirit Worm’s activity range had been compressed to the extreme, like a bird in a cage, with no hope of escape.
Crack!
Rumble!
With a ground-shaking tremor, the earth suddenly and unexpectedly split open with a gigantic crack several yards long.
The next moment.
The enormous body of the Second-stage Spirit Worm was violently thrown out of the crack, as if by some irresistible force.
At this moment, its eyes were blood-red, and it let out an extremely furious howl towards Xu Ping and the others.
However, its scales were already damaged in many places, and the eerie green light had dimmed a bit, exposing its weakness.
"It’s forced out!!"
Seeing this scene, Pang Po, Song Li, and others were instantly hit with a wave of ecstatic joy, their faces lighting up with wild excitement.
They didn’t expect that this guy named Li Feiyu really had skills, managing to actually force the Second-stage Spirit Worm out from underground.
But before Pang Po, Song Li, and the others could recover from this immense joy, Xu Ping had already seized the moment, charging down like lightning.
In the blink of an eye, he was ghost-like beside the Second-stage Spirit Worm.
Xu Ping’s hands shot out like eagle claws, precise and firm, seizing the head of the Second-stage Spirit Worm.
His hands were like iron clamps, tightly holding on, not giving the Second-stage Spirit Worm the slightest chance to break free.
"Hiss!"
The Second-stage Spirit Worm, feeling its head restrained, was filled with extreme anger, letting out another sharp howl.
At the same time, an intense green light burst from its body, like a tangible blade, seeming to shred everything around it.
Following that, its body began to swell dramatically, muscles tense, strength overflowing. It desperately writhed its enormous body, attempting to break free of Xu Ping’s iron-like grip.
For a moment, strong winds rose, dust flew, and the scene was chaotic.
However, Xu Ping remained unfazed, his body surrounded by a surge of blood-like energy, an immense power from deep within erupting like a volcano.
This power was overwhelming, indestructible, firmly suppressing the Second-stage Spirit Worm, rendering all its frantic struggles futile.
In the next instant.
Mana from Xu Ping’s dantian rushed through specific meridians, flooding into his hands.
With a flash of blinding spiritual light, dense patterns of restriction arrays appeared on the surface of the Second-stage Spirit Worm.
As the restriction patterns emerged, the green glow on its surface gradually dissipated, and its struggling ceased.
Its eyes rolled white, and it instantly fell into unconsciousness.
"The Second-stage Spirit Worm is secured!" Xu Ping relaxed.
The most critical task had been completed smoothly, making everything that followed much simpler.
However, compared to Xu Ping’s relaxation and joy, Song Li and the others were filled with complex emotions.
They never expected Xu Ping to act with such speed.
While they were still in shock and hadn’t reacted, he had efficiently captured the Second-stage Spirit Worm.
Pang Po’s eyes turned, a smile appearing on his face: "Congratulations to Daoist Li for achieving your goal and capturing the Second-stage Spirit Worm. Such extraordinary skill truly commands our admiration."
Changing his tone, he continued: "However, the Second-stage Spirit Worm is inherently wild and hard to tame. Completely controlling it is no easy task."
"Our Hundred Beasts Sect has considerable experience in taming exotic beasts. Why not hand this Second-stage Spirit Worm over to us? We can help you tame it."
"This way, the Second-stage Spirit Worm can be made to serve at its fullest for Daoist Li."
Pang Po’s tone was sincere, his words earnest, appearing to genuinely have Xu Ping’s interests at heart.
But Xu Ping, who already knew their intentions, would certainly not be deceived by such nonsense.
"No need to trouble Daoist Pang, I have my own plans," Xu Ping replied indifferently.
Saying this, he reached out and grabbed the Second-stage Spirit Worm, directly stuffing it into the spirit beast pouch hanging at his waist.
His pouch was of low grade and its space was limited.
Stuffing the entire Second-stage Spirit Worm into it made it a bit cramped.
But the currently unconscious Second-stage Spirit Worm obviously had no complaints.
Seeing Xu Ping succinctly refuse and swiftly pocket the Second-stage Spirit Worm, Pang Po’s eye twitched, the smile he had been desperately maintaining instantly becoming stiff and forced.
Even so, he feigned sincerity: "Li... Li Daoist, I really meant well. If you don’t tame the Second-stage Spirit Worm, you risk it escaping, and that would be a huge loss."
During this exchange, apart from Song Li, several Hundred Beasts Sect Foundation Establishment cultivators subtly surrounded Xu Ping.
Observing this, Xu Ping didn’t appear even slightly flustered or anxious, instead displaying an amused expression:
"Oh?"
"Is the Hundred Beasts Sect planning to betray its word?"
"Daoist, you jest, we were only..."

chapters.title: Chapter 306 - 205: Capture of a Rank 2 Spirit Worm; Breaking All Pretense (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 306: Chapter 205: Capture of a Rank 2 Spirit Worm; Breaking All Pretense (Part 3)
Pang Po feared that Xu Ping would fight desperately, his face still maintaining a fake smile, initially wanting to argue.
But unexpectedly, another Foundation Establishment Cultivator with a sallow complexion suddenly interrupted, with a tone full of sarcasm:
"Talking about trustworthiness in the Cultivation Realm, you must be confused, are you insane?"
He glanced at Xu Ping disdainfully and then said viciously: "Let me tell you, this Second-stage Spirit Worm is something my Hundred Beasts Sect is determined to obtain. If you, a mere Loose Cultivator, know what’s good for you, lay it down quickly and don’t seek your own demise."
As soon as he spoke, the fragile facade between them was torn apart completely, and the atmosphere instantly became tense and confrontational.
Seeing this development, Pang Po no longer bothered to maintain the pretentious smile.
His face turned gloomy in an instant, and he spoke in a cold tone: "Fellow Daoist Li, I must admit you do have some skills. Our Hundred Beasts Sect has always valued talent."
"As long as you obediently offer the Second-stage Spirit Worm and let me plant a Divine Sense imprint within your Sea of Consciousness, we at the Hundred Beasts Sect are still willing to grant you a chance to survive."
Upon hearing such shameless words, Xu Ping remained calm and unperturbed, his tone tranquil yet decisively firm: "In fact, there is a second path — and that is to kill all of you!"
"Kill us all?"
The sallow-complexioned Foundation Establishment Cultivator seemed to hear an enormous joke, loudly mocked:
"You are nothing more than a mere Late-Stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator, yet your arrogance surpasses even those Fake Pill Cultivators. I want to see, what kind of formidable means you really have!"
Before he finished speaking, he injected a bit of Mana into his spirit beast bag.
As the Mana was infused, the spirit beast bag flashed with light.
"Wooosh"
A huge black spider instantly appeared in the void.
This spider resembled a small black fortress, emanating a chilling Demonic Power throughout its body, with a strength reaching Second-stage Upper Grade. The sheer formidable aura was suffocating.
Seeing this, the other Hundred Beasts Sect cultivators also summoned their own spirit beasts.
For a moment, four hideous and terrifying spirit beasts gathered here, almost occupying the entire sky.
Their surrounding Demonic Power surged like waves, creating fierce wind pressure, making the surrounding air roar.
Those blood-like scarlet eyes all stared fiercely at Xu Ping, as if ready to tear him apart in the next instant.
If it were ordinary cultivators, or even Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivators, they’d probably be scared stiff seeing such a scene.
However, Xu Ping remained serene, with a faint mocking smile at the corner of his lips.
As if saying: Is this all?
"Since you seek death, we will fulfill your wish."
Pang Po’s eyes flashed with cold light full of killing intent, followed by an icy command: "Kill him!"
Xu Ping’s indifferent attitude completely infuriated them.
Four Foundation Establishment Cultivators along with four Second-stage Demon Beasts, including two Second-stage Upper Grade Demon Beasts.
Such a lineup can even contend with a Fake Pill cultivator.
Moreover, in the distance is Song Li this genuine Fake Pill cultivator providing support.
"Die!"
With Pang Po’s order, the four Foundation Establishment Cultivators and four Demon Beasts launched an attack without any hesitation.
Various Magical Artifacts with immense power rushed towards Xu Ping like roaring winds.
"I’ll feed you to my spirit beasts!"
The sallow-faced Foundation Establishment Cultivator let out a sinister laugh.
His hands quickly formed a Seal Formation, controlling a top-grade Magical Artifact shaped like an ancient, spiritually potent hammer, which crashed down towards Xu Ping with thundering force.
At the same time, the giant Second-stage spider demon beast next to him opened its bloody maw, spewing large quantities of purple-black spider silk.
These spider silks, like viscous venom, rapidly intertwined and extended in the air, forming an impenetrable massive web, aiming to entrap Xu Ping tightly within.
Faced with this overwhelming attack, Xu Ping remained calmly composed, without a trace of panic.
Suddenly, his figure flickered, instantly vanishing from his original spot.
Boom!
Several attacks all missed, heavily hitting the ground.
For a moment, the earth shook, dust rose, and the solid ground was riddled with huge pits.
While evading the attacks, the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword had silently landed in Xu Ping’s hand, with the mutated liquid Mana injected into it.
Immediately, an immensely powerful Mana pressure spread rapidly from Xu Ping as its center, rippling outward.
Then, Xu Ping wielded the sword with one hand, suddenly slashing forward.
Boom!
Rumble!
Like the advent of the Thunder God, a dazzling, grand sword light burst from the sword tip, carrying the momentum to cleave through heaven and earth and the terrifying power to crush everything.
The sword light effortlessly sliced that seemingly unbreakable spider silk web and two top-grade Magical Artifacts into two pieces.
The spider silk instantly shattered into countless fragments floating in the air; the two top-grade Magical Artifacts let out a mournful cry, dimmed in light, fell uncontrollably to the ground.
Then, the sword light’s power unabatedly aimed at the sallow-faced Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
"No!"
Feeling the oncoming sword light filled with endless destruction, the sallow-faced Foundation Establishment Cultivator’s face turned pale like paper, bloodless.
Extreme fear flickered in his eyes.
At this critical life-or-death moment, he did not hesitate to drive his spirit beast to block in front.
Then, he frantically pulled out several defensive talismans from his storage bag, slapping them on himself, hoping to withstand this sword light.
However, facing this irresistible terrifying sword light, all he did was futile, like a mantis trying to stop a chariot.
Crash!
The dazzling sword light with an ultimate fierceness directly pierced through the Second-stage spider demon beast’s body, splitting the mighty Second-stage Upper Grade spider in half.
Poor powerful demon beast could not even utter a scream before dying miserably under this terrifying sword light.
Its huge body split in half, heavily fell to the ground, splattering blood and raising dust.
And the sallow-faced Foundation Establishment Cultivator did not fare any better.
After slaying the Second-stage spider demon beast, the sword light continued unabated, easily breaking through the layers of protective shields on him, finally slicing his head as effortlessly as cutting tofu.
Splat!
Blood gushed like a fountain from his neck, the headless corpse lost the support of strength, dropped straight from the air, crashing heavily on the ground, raising clouds of dust.
"What!"
"Sword Qi Thunder Sound? Or Sword Light Like a Rainbow?"

chapters.title: Chapter 307 - 206: Slaying the Rank 3 Serpent Python; Rich Rewards
chapters.content:
Chapter 307: Chapter 206: Slaying the Rank 3 Serpent Python; Rich Rewards
Pang Po and several other Foundation Establishment Cultivators watched this scene, their eyes almost popping out in shock, faces full of horror.
Their mouths were agape, as if they could fit an egg inside, unable to believe what was happening in front of them.
No matter what, they never expected that this guy named Li Feiyu was actually a peerless Sword Cultivator who had comprehended the second realm of the Sword Dao.
This is the second realm of the Sword Dao!
Even ordinary Golden Core Cultivators find it difficult to comprehend!
At this moment, Song Li, who was responsible for overseeing from a distance, had his face turned completely grim.
As a Fake Pill Cultivator, he naturally knew that the opponent hadn’t completely mastered the sword light like a rainbow, only grasped the basics of it.
But even so, this was by no means a height that ordinary Foundation Establishment Cultivators could reach, the sword cultivation talent this person displayed was truly astonishing.
Once he successfully entered the Golden Core Realm, with such astonishing talent, completely mastering "sword light like a rainbow" was almost a certainty.
By that time, I’m afraid the whole Hundred Beasts Sect would have to bow under his fierce sword might.
Moreover, what Song Li found most unbelievable and incomprehensible was that this mere Foundation Establishment junior could proficiently wield a magical treasure?
This fact was simply more remarkable than his astonishing Sword Dao realm!
Song Li’s eyes flickered with a sinister glow, staring fixedly at the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword tightly gripped in Xu Ping’s hand.
Immediately, the Fake Pill aura around him flared up, enveloping his entire body in a halo of light.
The next moment, his form flickered, instantly appearing like a ghost in front of Pang Po and the others.
"Elder Song!"
Pang Po and the others were relieved at the sight of Song Li, quickly greeting him respectfully.
No matter how strong the opponent’s Sword Dao realm was, how could their combat strength match a Fake Pill Cultivator?
Moreover, Elder Song definitely wasn’t without trump cards.
Song Li completely ignored Pang Po and the others, his eyes still locked tightly on Xu Ping, filled with coldness and determination.
"No matter how demonic you are, Spirit Void Peak will be your burial ground." His tone was as cold as ice.
"Such big talk." Xu Ping stood with the sword in one hand, his posture upright, his expression still as calm as water, without a trace of panic.
"Hmph!"
Song Li snorted coldly, unwilling to argue further, directly channeling a trace of Mana into the Spirit Beast Bag hanging at his waist.
Against such a demonic entity, he must give it his all, not leaving even the slightest chance to breathe.
"Hiss!"
With a heart-wrenching hiss, the originally clear sky suddenly cast a heavy shadow.
Everyone hurriedly looked up, only to see a giant python as large as a small mountain, hovering in mid-air.
Its entire body was covered with shiny black scales, each of which glistened with a metallic sheen, like carefully crafted armor.
Its head was flat and broad, its triangular eyes exuding a bloodthirsty red light, the tongue flicking now and then, making a "hiss" sound, the air reeking with a nauseating stench.
The python’s body was incredibly thick, coiling in the air, its massive size creating an immense pressure.
"Third-rank Lower Grade Demon Beast!"
Feeling the overwhelming pressure from the giant python, Xu Ping didn’t feel a trace of fear, instead, he inexplicably let out a breath of relief.
This should be the opponent’s entire trump card.
After all, mobilizing a Third-rank Lower Grade Demon Beast to deal with a mere Foundation Establishment Cultivator was already considered a very serious affair.
"Kill him!"
Song Li ordered the giant python, his voice filled with killing intent.
Upon hearing this command, a shadow of dark light flashed in the triangular eyes of the giant python.
It twisted its massive body, lunging towards Xu Ping like a black lightning bolt.
Wherever it passed, the air was compressed to the point of producing a sharp whistling sound, the ground gouged out in deep grooves by the currents it stirred up.
The ground was not spared either, with the fierce air currents gouging out deep, eye-catching ravines like the earth’s hideous wounds.
Just as the giant python launched its attack, Song Li chanted under his breath, his hands quickly forming seals, then suddenly unleashed his magical treasure, a strangely-shaped black bone claw.
The five claws of the bone claw were curved like hooks, each emitting a chilling cold light, like a deadly weapon from the Nine Nether’s hell, exuding a terrifying aura.
"Here it comes!"
Feeling the imminent threat, Xu Ping’s eyes suddenly became incredibly sharp.
"Appear!"
The Magical Treasure Wooden Sword in his hand instantly disappeared, and with a soft cry, the Storage Ring flashed with spirit light, shooting out three Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans.
"Control!"
Xu Ping’s hands rapidly transformed, accurately pinching out a Magic Technique.
In an instant, three slender yet powerful Mana threads shot out from his fingertips, landing precisely on the three Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans.
"Consolidate!"
"Trap!"
Under Xu Ping’s precise control, the three talismans weaved through the void with agility, coordinating seamlessly without interference.
At the same time, their energy began to interlink, strand by strand, tightly connecting as if becoming an indivisible whole.
"Explode!"
Xu Ping’s lips parted slightly, coldly uttering one word.
The next moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 308 - 206: Slaying the Rank 3 Serpent Python; Rich Rewards_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 308: Chapter 206: Slaying the Rank 3 Serpent Python; Rich Rewards_2
An earth-shattering explosion suddenly reverberated, as if the entire world trembled violently from this terrifying force.
The three-talismans array composed of three Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans erupted without any reservation at this moment.
The released terrifying might was akin to a raging tsunami, surging with an unstoppable momentum towards the giant serpent and that black bone claw fiercely.
The blinding bright light instantly illuminated the entire Spirit Void Peak, its intense glow as dazzling as the scorching sun, causing everyone present to almost be unable to open their eyes.
The powerful air currents formed visible shockwaves driven by the explosion, like rampant savage beasts.
Where they reached, the surrounding towering trees were uprooted completely, their thick trunks helplessly tumbling through the air.
The debris scattered on the ground like a barrage of dense artillery shells, creating a chaotic yet terrifying scene.
The unparalleled power of the explosion wave instantly submerged the giant serpent mercilessly.
Even a third-rank Lower Grade demon beast was as fragile as an ant before this terrifying might.
Its huge mountain-like body was tightly wrapped by the force of the explosion, its shiny black scales peeling off under the powerful impact like raindrops.
The giant serpent let out an extremely mournful scream, its voice filled with pain and despair, but it was soon drowned out by the roar of the explosion.
Only a moment.
The battered remains of the giant serpent and the dim spiritual light, the heavily damaged black bone claw, lost their supporting power, ultimately plummeting heavily to the ground, raising a cloud of dust.
"What!!?"
Song Li and Pang Po, along with several Foundation Establishment cultivators witnessed this scene, their facial expressions froze instantly, their eyes filled with unbelievable shock.
"This... what kind of talisman array is this??"
Song Li’s face was filled with terror, losing his image entirely and shouting in alarm, his voice full of fear and disbelief.
No matter how hard he tried to imagine, he couldn’t conceive that just a late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator could deploy such a terrifying talisman array, instantly annihilating a third-rank Lower Grade demon beast.
The terrifying might unleashed by this talisman array, was probably unmatched even by a mid-stage Golden Core cultivator’s full-force lethal strike.
And Pang Po and the other Foundation Establishment cultivators were even more disheveled and wretched in their reactions at this moment.
Their faces were as pale as paper, devoid of color, lips trembling uncontrollably.
Before they could recover from their shock, Xu Ping looked at them coldly, his eyes showing no trace of pity.
He rapidly moved his hands, retrieving another Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman and several Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans from the storage ring.
"Not good!"
Seeing this, Song Li’s expression instantly became extremely terrified.
Mana surged around him, transforming his entire body into a streak of light, desperately fleeing towards the distance.
Meanwhile, Pang Po and the others delayed slightly but after realizing, also scattered and fled in all directions.
Seeing this scene, Xu Ping remained unhurried.
"Swift!"
He chanted rapidly, while his hands formed seals swiftly.
The Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman instantly emitted dazzling golden light, as the talismans flickered, a mighty force emerged from within.
Simultaneously, several Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans were activated, thick cyan lightning shot out from the talismans, crackling and popping, filling the air with a pungent charred smell.
The Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman and the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans carried endless might and an earth-shattering aura, roaring towards Song Li and Pang Po.
"Third-rank talisman!!"
Song Li and Pang Po felt the power contained within the talismans, their hearts reaching the peak of fear.
Who on earth was this person?
Not only was his Sword Dao realm astonishingly monstrous, who would have thought his proficiency in talisman arrays was even deeper and more unfathomable, far beyond ordinary imagination!
However, there was no time to ponder at this moment.
They frantically mobilized the mana within themselves, attempting to enhance the speed of their escape techniques, while hastily retrieving various defensive magical artifacts and talismans from their storage bags.
Next, they indiscriminately threw their carefully nurtured spirit beasts in front of themselves.
In this critical life-and-death moment, what was the worth of the spirit beast’s life compared to their own safety?
However, their struggle appeared utterly futile in the face of the powerful third-rank talismans.
The speed of the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman and the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans was as fast as lightning, catching up with them in the blink of an eye.
"Boom!"
The Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman first caught up with Song Li.
The terrifying force, as if a towering mountain bearing down, easily shattered the layers of protective shields around him.
Finally, the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman struck heavily on Song Li.
"Ah!"
Accompanied by his extremely miserable scream, Song Li’s body was instantly turned into powder in the destructive explosion, leaving not a trace behind.
Only a crisp "bang" was heard.
His storage ring also shattered in the explosion, countless spirit stones, precious talismans, and precious magical artifacts scattered across the sky like the scattering of flowers.
Immediately, the cyan lightning unleashed by the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman transformed into gigantic Thunder Dragons, instantly enveloping Pang Po and the Foundation Establishment cultivators along with their spirit beasts in front of them.
Thunder boomed! It was deafening.
Numerous fierce thunders intertwined, drowning three people and three beasts mercilessly.
"Ah!"
"Roar!"
Amidst miserable screams and despairing beast roars, it took only a brief moment for three people and three beasts to be turned into pitch-black charcoal by the powerful force of thunder and lightning.

chapters.title: Chapter 309 - 206: Slaying the Rank 3 Serpent Python; Rich Rewards_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 309: Chapter 206: Slaying the Rank 3 Serpent Python; Rich Rewards_3
Falling powerlessly from the sky, crashing heavily onto the ground, stirring up clouds of dust.
From this moment, Song Li, Pang Po, and several other Hundred Beasts Sect cultivators who participated in the encirclement and attack on Xu Ping have all met their doom.
The battlefield was eerily silent, only the breeze stirred, lifting the dust and debris scattered on the ground.
Xu Ping stood quietly in place, looking at the desolate scene before him, his complexion slightly pale.
Even with his current Divine Sense and Mana, continuously using the Three Talismans Array and several Third-stage talismans was quite strenuous, consuming him greatly.
However, now was clearly not the time to sit and recuperate his mana.
His actions had slain a Fake Pill cultivator, a Third-stage Demon Beast, several Foundation Establishment cultivators, as well as several Second-stage Demon Beasts, inflicting grave injuries on the Hundred Beasts Sect!
The Hundred Beasts Sect would definitely not easily swallow this and let it go.
With his current strength, opposing the entire Hundred Beasts Sect still falls far short.
Therefore, he must quickly clean up the traces of battle here and then promptly leave.
...
...
Half an hour later, having already cleaned up the battlefield and collected all the spoils of war, Xu Ping set up an Escape Light and left Spirit Void Peak.
Time flew by, and half a month passed in the blink of an eye.
Xu Ping traveled hastily all the way, finally returning to Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Upon arrival, the Water Lake Mouse came over obsequiously, greeting with a flattering expression, but Xu Ping ignored it and continued toward the cultivation chamber without stopping.
Once inside the cultivation chamber, he first sat cross-legged on a meditation mat, closed his eyes, and began to meditate and regulate his breath.
As time passed, Mana slowly circulated within him, gradually returning to near its peak state.
Only then did he have the mind to check the spoils from this battle.
Xu Ping inspected the spoils briefly, his face broke into a wide smile, his mouth stretching almost to his ears.
A Fake Pill cultivator, four Foundation Establishment cultivators, the Spirit Stones alone totaled nearly a hundred thousand.
Not to mention the magical treasures, magical artifacts, talismans, and other items.
Their assets were far wealthier than those of typical cultivators of the same stage.
"Raising spiritual beasts is really profitable!" Xu Ping couldn’t help but exclaim.
Now, the number of Spirit Stones he had stored had reached six figures.
Such a scale of Spirit Stones already matched the reserves of an average Fake Pill sect power.
Xu Ping, grinning, sorted the Spirit Stones, talismans, magical artifacts... and then began to handle the main part of the spoils of war—Demon Beast corpses.
Xu Ping first dealt with the four Second-stage Demon Beasts.
He sequentially took out the four Second-stage Demon Beasts, then skillfully dissected and extracted the Demon Core.
Admittedly, his luck was pretty good, managing to obtain four Second-stage Demon Cores.
After all, among these four Demon Beasts, two were Second-stage Middle Grade Demon Beasts, and not all such Demon Beasts have Demon Cores within them, so gaining this harvest was truly rare.
"Just right, I was running low on Second-stage Demon Cores before, this replenishes them nicely."
Xu Ping’s mouth slightly upturned, forming a satisfied curve.
As he spoke, he gently flipped his palm, and the four Second-stage Demon Cores instantly disappeared, stored within his Storage Ring.
Having dealt with the Second-stage Demon Beasts, he penetrated his Divine Sense into his Storage Ring, followed by infusing a thread of Mana.
In the blink of an eye, a tattered giant python carcass appeared prominently in the cultivation chamber.
This giant python was even larger than the previous Third-stage Demon Beast, almost filling the entire space of the cultivation chamber.
Simultaneously, a strong and pungent bloody smell spread swiftly from the giant python’s wound, rapidly filling the entire room.
This bloody smell was extremely intense, and if inhaled for a while, it would cause feelings of dizziness and vertigo.
Evidently, this giant python’s bloody smell contained poison.
However, this level of toxicity was of no concern to Xu Ping.
He calmly stared at the giant python corpse, which still faintly emitted an unsettlingly oppressive aura.
"Let’s extract the Core first!"
Xu Ping’s palm flipped, and the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword suddenly appeared in hand.
Facing the Third-stage Demon Beast once more, he felt considerably calmer.
Moreover, even though this Third-stage Demon Beast was much larger than the previous one, its cultivation was somewhat inferior.
Xu Ping’s Divine Sense, like a fine thread, gently swept over the enormous Third-stage Demon Beast’s corpse.
The next moment.
He grasped the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword, and as Mana surged from around him, he stabbed it into the Third-stage Demon Beast’s corpse.
Then, with a flick upward, a dark-colored, textured Crystal Stone directly flew out and landed steadily in his hand.
"Another Third-stage Demon Core!" Xu Ping felt somewhat excited.
With two Third-stage Demon Cores in hand, as long as luck isn’t too bad, he could basically create a Fake Pill cultivator.
Nevertheless, Xu Ping wasn’t particularly interested in using Third-stage Demon Cores to create a Fake Pill cultivator.
He had other plans, wanting to try exchanging these two Third-stage Demon Cores for a portion of Crystal Condensing Liquid.
Though from a pure value perspective, two Third-stage Demon Cores undoubtedly exceed the value of a portion of Crystal Condensing Liquid, Crystal Condensing Liquid signifies the hope to achieve Golden Core, which cannot be easily measured by value.
Therefore, he wasn’t sure if he could successfully trade them.
"If I really can’t exchange for suitable Core Formation Spiritual Objects, feeding these two Third-stage Demon Cores to the Water Lake Mouse wouldn’t be a waste."
Xu Ping thought to himself, not overly worried about it.
Once the Water Lake Mouse reaches Second-stage Perfection, with the two Third-stage Demon Cores fed and other aids added, the hope of reaching Third-stage Demon Beast is immense.
Considering the talent and battle strength the Water Lake Mouse currently exhibited.
Once it breaks through to Third-stage, although it might not completely rival and have a draw against Middle Stage of Golden Core experts, skirmishing with them shouldn’t be a big issue.
In this way, the value of the two Demon Cores could be maximized.
"Perhaps, the Water Lake Mouse might even break through to the third stage level before me."
Xu Ping mused privately, thinking this possibility was quite high.

chapters.title: Chapter 310 - 207: Conquering the Tier 2 Spirit Worm
chapters.content:
Chapter 310: Chapter 207: Conquering the Tier 2 Spirit Worm
Although now he has stepped into the Late-Stage Foundation Establishment realm, which is a whole level higher than that of the water lake mouse in terms of cultivation.
However, he still has to disperse his mana and start cultivation anew, a process that would at least take several decades of long years.
In contrast, the water lake mouse has broken through to the Second-stage Middle Grade for some time now, and after this period of cultivation, it is not far from the peak of the Second-stage Middle Grade.
Judging by the talent the water lake mouse has shown, breaking through to the Second-stage Upper Grade should not be a big problem.
Once the water lake mouse successfully reaches the Second-stage Upper Grade, after another twenty to thirty years of arduous cultivation,
By then, utilizing two Tier-Three Demon Cores and other auxiliary items, the success rate of breaking through to Tier-Three will be at least fifty percent.
It should be known that for ordinary Foundation Establishment Cultivators or regular Second-stage Demon Beasts, such a high success rate is an unparalleled luxury they dare not even dream of.
"It seems I indeed need to cultivate this water lake mouse with extra focus in the future." Xu Ping murmured to himself.
After all, if the water lake mouse can successfully break through to the Tier-Three realm before him, the benefits for him would be enormous as well.
On one hand, during the time he disperses his mana, his strength will significantly weaken, the water lake mouse can rely on its Tier-Three strength to ensure his safety.
On the other hand, at the critical moment when he is impacting the Golden Core Realm, the water lake mouse can also protect him, preventing interference and attacks from the outside world.
One should know, breaking through to the Golden Core Realm is itself as difficult as ascending to heaven, with the slightest carelessness rendering previous efforts futile.
If there is interference from external factors at the time of breakthrough, it would undoubtedly be a devastating blow for a cultivator.
Once the water lake mouse successfully reaches Tier-Three, coupled with the array set up at Thousand Leaves Mountain, the entire defense of Thousand Leaves Mountain will be as solid as gold and iron.
Unless it’s a Late-Stage Golden Core master taking action, or several Middle Stage Golden Core cultivators attacking simultaneously, it should be impossible to break Thousand Leaves Mountain’s defense.
"When I finish dealing with matters at hand, the ’good days’ for the water lake mouse should finally come."
With this thought, the corner of Xu Ping’s mouth involuntarily curved into a meaningful yet slightly cruel arc.
"Achoo!"
Just at that moment, the water lake mouse busy in the spirit field suddenly sneezed loudly without warning.
It paused its actions, lifted its small paw to rub its nose, with a face full of inexplicable expression.
"Could it be that something good is happening?"
The water lake mouse thought joyfully, its heart filled with a burst of joy, and thus it worked even harder in the spirit field with renewed enthusiasm.
...
Inside the cultivation room.
After properly storing away the Tier-Three Demon Core, he then immediately began dealing with the massive corpse of the Tier-Three Demon Beast.
Several hours passed, and the cultivation room was busy.
"Finally cleaned up." Xu Ping let out a long sigh of relief, his tense nerves finally relaxed a bit.
This giant python’s size was indeed too enormous, far exceeding that of an average demon beast, and coupled with the toxic nature of its blood, it was extremely challenging to process, with the procedures being intricate and complex, consuming much of his energy.
After categorizing and placing the processed Demon Beast Flesh and various precious demon beast materials into his storage pouch one by one,
Xu Ping’s gaze slowly fell on the spirit beast pouch hanging at his waist.
"Finally... this Second-stage Spirit Worm!"
Xu Ping’s eyes narrowed slightly, a flash of stored brilliance in his eyes, then he directly injected a wisp of Mana into the spirit beast pouch.
In the blink of an eye, the Second-stage Spirit Worm, now unconscious, appeared in the cultivation room.
At this moment, its body was covered with densely packed, luminescent restriction runes over its fine scales.
"With the help of this Second-stage Spirit Worm, the speed of spirit vein enhancement will surely increase dramatically. Thus, before impacting the Core Formation Realm, elevating the spirit veins to the Quasi-Tier Three standard shouldn’t be a big issue."
Xu Ping looked at the unconscious Second-stage Spirit Worm before him, and a satisfied smile could not help manifest on his lips.
"Moreover, the Hundred Beasts Sect attaches such importance to the Second-stage Spirit Worm, there must be something about it of which I’m not aware." Xu Ping frowned slightly, pondering inwardly.
After all, if it were really just to bait him, there would be no need for such trouble.
And it’s certainly not necessary to mobilize a Tier-Three Demon Beast.
It seems there’s definitely something unknown, some secret about the Second-stage Spirit Worm.
’Could it be that the Second-stage Spirit Worm’s ability to improve the quality of spirit veins is somewhat extraordinary?’
With this thought, a spiritual light emanated from Xu Ping’s fingertip, lightly tracing the center of the Spirit Worm’s forehead, where circular patterns abounded.
The sleeping spirit beast suddenly convulsed violently, its scale-covered body twisted into a bizarre curve on the stone floor, the hundreds of sharp teeth hidden inside its mouth parts clanking unconsciously, emitting a jarring clicking sound.
Xu Ping focused his attention, threading his Divine Sense into the Sea of Consciousness of the Second-stage Spirit Worm like a thread.
With his powerful Divine Sense comparable to that of a Fake Pill Realm expert, implanting a Divine Sense imprint in the Sea of Consciousness of this Second-stage Spirit Worm, which had no power to resist, posed no significant difficulty.
However, implanting a Divine Sense imprint doesn’t mean complete control over this Second-stage Spirit Worm.
It’s known that wild Second-stage Demon Beasts have extremely irritable temperaments and are exceptionally difficult to handle.
Even if a cultivator successfully implants a Divine Sense imprint and holds their life and death in their hands, it would be difficult to make them completely submit, with many demon beasts even choosing death over submission.
Moreover, the intelligence of the Second-stage Spirit Worm is even lower compared to ordinary Second-stage Demon Beasts, with its thinking being simple and direct.

chapters.title: Chapter 311 - 207: Subduing the Tier 2 Spirit Worm (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 311: Chapter 207: Subduing the Tier 2 Spirit Worm (Part 2)
To completely tame it, making it willingly obey commands, will likely require some time and effort.
Buzz!
As the Divine Sense imprint formed within the Sea of Consciousness of the Second-stage Spirit Worm, its body suddenly shook, then returned to calm.
After placing the Divine Sense imprint, Xu Ping quietly observed the still unconscious Second-stage Spirit Worm, his hands swiftly forming Magic Techniques.
In an instant, spiritual lights flickered in the cultivation room, and the densely packed restriction talisman patterns on the Second-stage Spirit Worm’s body melted away like ice meeting warm sunlight.
"Hiss!"
At the moment the restriction talisman patterns disappeared, the Second-stage Spirit Worm let out a low and instinctive hiss.
Then, it slowly opened its eyes, and as its muddled gaze took in the surroundings, a flicker of panic and alertness crossed its eyes.
Almost instinctively, it twisted its body, a strong green glow emanating from its skin as its fine scales rubbed against each other, producing a rustling sound.
In its panic, the Second-stage Spirit Worm crashed directly into the blue stone floor of the cultivation room.
However, Xu Ping had anticipated this.
"Hmmph!"
At the moment of the Spirit Worm’s movement, Xu Ping coldly snorted, and his Divine Sense moved, causing the freshly planted Divine Sense imprint in the Second-stage Spirit Worm’s Sea of Consciousness to tremble fiercely.
Instantly, the Spirit Worm felt as if thousands of steel needles were simultaneously piercing its Sea of Consciousness, and the intense pain rendered its body rigid, soon after it started convulsing uncontrollably.
"Clack, clack!"
The hundreds of sharp teeth hidden deep within the Spirit Worm’s oral cavity frantically opened and closed, producing a tooth-grinding sound.
Its scale-covered body twisted into various bizarre arcs on the blue stone floor, trying to escape this sudden pain.
But Xu Ping did not relent, coldly watching the Spirit Worm’s struggles, imposing pain repeatedly through the Divine Sense imprint.
After several rounds, the Spirit Worm finally realized its resistance was futile.
Its once wild and defiant gaze gradually dimmed, replaced with deep fear and hopelessness.
After yet another bout of agonizing torture, the Spirit Worm finally quieted down.
It gasped heavily, its body trembling slightly, lying prone on the ground without attempting to flee.
At this moment, it understood its current predicament.
Xu Ping watched the quietened Spirit Worm with a slight emotion stirring in his heart.
He eased the pressure from his Divine Sense, releasing a signal of comfort.
As the sense of pain continuously waned, the Spirit Worm slowly lifted its head, now looking at Xu Ping with a degree of caution, as if fearful of angering this terrifying human once more.
Its face showed a fawning smile.
"This Second-stage Spirit Worm... submitting too quickly, isn’t it?"
Seeing this scene, Xu Ping felt extremely surprised.
He had originally prepared for a prolonged battle, yet it surrendered so easily?
Though it was merely a preliminary submission, the result was far beyond his expectations.
"Moreover... this Second-stage Spirit Worm seems somewhat different."
Xu Ping’s gaze slowly settled on the Second-stage Spirit Worm now gently nudging his pant leg with its head.
The Second-stage Spirit Worm keenly sensed Xu Ping’s incoming gaze, quickly lifting its head.
Its face immediately displayed a flattering and ingratiating smile, entirely resembling a sycophant.
Xu Ping...
Always felt...
The look on the Second-stage Spirit Worm... he had seen somewhere before.
"Achoo!"
Meanwhile, the Waterfield Mouse busily working in the spiritual field sneezed again.
"Could it be... good things come in pairs?"
The Waterfield Mouse rubbed its nose, its face joyous.
"Seems like the master sees how hard I’ve been working recently and plans to reward me?"
The more the Waterfield Mouse thought, the happier it became, cheerfully anticipating the upcoming bounty.
Originally planning to slack off, it energetically resumed its work.
...
Inside the cultivation room.
"The intelligence of this Second-stage Spirit Worm might be far superior to that of typical Second-stage Demon Beasts."
Xu Ping noted the highly human-like expression on the Second-stage Spirit Worm’s face, silently musing.
Having slain numerous Second-stage Demon Beasts, Xu Ping naturally knew the usual intelligence of such beasts was far from reaching this level.
Moreover, the intelligence of Second-stage Spirit Worms was typically lower than that of average Second-stage Demon Beasts.
But now, it seemed its intelligence was only slightly inferior to the Waterfield Mouse capable of transmitting messages through Divine Sense.
"Interesting."
Xu Ping’s lips curved slightly, revealing a strong sense of curiosity, his eyes filled with exploratory light.
Clearly, something unusual might have happened to this Second-stage Spirit Worm, leading to its distinctiveness.
Perhaps it had consumed remarkable spiritual treasures?
Or maybe it possessed impressive innate talents similar to the Waterfield Mouse?
Seeing Xu Ping sport such an expression, the Second-stage Spirit Worm’s previously flattering look froze instantly.
For some reason, it felt uneasy.
"Could it be that my performance wasn’t up to par?"
The Second-stage Spirit Worm wondered, "Should I behave even more ingratiatingly?"
At that moment.
"Open your mouth!"
Xu Ping’s commanding voice suddenly sounded.
Upon hearing this, a trace of hesitation appeared in the Second-stage Spirit Worm’s eyes, yet ultimately it slowly opened its mouth.
For its own life’s sake, it better comply obediently.
Seeing the Second-stage Spirit Worm able to comprehend his command, Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction.
Then, with a flick of his fingers, a grey Pill transformed into a streak of light, entering the Second-stage Spirit Worm’s mouth.
"Gulp!"
Accompanied by the motion in the Second-stage Spirit Worm’s throat, that grey Pill slid down its throat, slowly settling into its stomach.

chapters.title: Chapter 312 - 207: Subduing the Tier 2 Spirit Worm (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 312: Chapter 207: Subduing the Tier 2 Spirit Worm (Part 3)
Just a moment later, under the powerful digestive ability of the Second-stage Spirit Worm, the gray Pill began to melt rapidly.
The medicinal power surged like a torrential tide, instantly erupting from its abdomen and spreading throughout its entire body at a rapid speed.
Feeling the medicinal power surging like a flood inside, the blood-red pupils of the Second-stage Spirit Worm involuntarily revealed an uncontrollable look of delight.
"In the future, as long as you behave, you will naturally not be short of Pills," Xu Ping said calmly, his tone indifferent.
First a bit of intimidation, then timely rewards, this tactic, though old-fashioned, works surprisingly well.
As for why its intelligence is so high, Xu Ping is not in a hurry, there’s plenty of time to explore this slowly in the future.
Upon hearing Xu Ping’s words, the Second-stage Spirit Worm hurriedly nodded, its head shaking like a rattle.
At this moment, its face was even more filled with a fawning and flattering expression, almost overflowing.
’If I can often taste this gray but amazingly potent stuff in the future, it seems submitting to this person isn’t too much of a loss.’
Suddenly, the Second-stage Spirit Worm seemed to think of something, urgently swinging its tail, jumping up and down in front of Xu Ping, gesturing frantically.
"You... what are you doing?"
Watching its current gesturing movements, Xu Ping couldn’t help but frown and asked in confusion.
The Second-stage Spirit Worm saw that Xu Ping did not understand and immediately panicked.
Not only did it increase the strength of its tail gestures, but it also kept "hissing" non-stop, trying in every possible way to make Xu Ping understand its intention.
Xu Ping frowned even more tightly, then moved his Divine Sense to communicate with the Divine Sense imprint of the Second-stage Spirit Worm’s Sea of Consciousness.
After a while.
With the help of the Divine Sense imprint, Xu Ping managed with difficulty to understand what the Second-stage Spirit Worm wanted to convey.
He frowned slightly and asked, "Are you saying there’s something good hidden under Spirit Void Peak?"
"But that good thing is guarded by a group of extraordinarily fierce creatures?"
The Second-stage Spirit Worm’s eyes lit up, nodding frantically.
Xu Ping already had some idea in mind, and then asked, "Have you eaten that thing before?"
The Second-stage Spirit Worm nodded without hesitation.
Now recalling that taste, it couldn’t help but start drooling.
"You’ve eaten it?"
A thought crossed Xu Ping’s mind, and he couldn’t help but speculate, ’The Second-stage Spirit Worm’s intelligence is so high, perhaps it’s due to consuming that good thing.’
Something that can enhance a Demon Beast’s intelligence is surely incredibly precious.
Thinking of this, Xu Ping’s mind became active.
"What exactly does that good thing look like, describe it in detail," Xu Ping immediately ordered.
However, upon hearing this request, the Second-stage Spirit Worm suddenly became troubled. It tilted its head, racking its brains, but had no idea how to describe it and twisted its body anxiously.
Seeing this, Xu Ping thought for a moment and changed the question: "After eating that good thing, did you feel like you became smarter and more agile than before?"
The Second-stage Spirit Worm hesitated for a moment, as if recalling the situation at the time, then slowly nodded.
It seemed that ever since it ate that delicious good thing, its mind became much sharper.
And not long after, it advanced to the Second-stage level.
"It really is!"
Xu Ping’s eyes lit up, his gaze revealing excitement.
A treasure that can enhance a Demon Beast’s intelligence is worth exploring.
If it’s really some heaven-defying treasure, then it’s a huge gain.
Although he learned from the Second-stage Spirit Worm that a group of extremely fierce creatures guards this treasure.
But in his opinion, what is very fierce for the Second-stage Spirit Worm should be manageable with his strength.
Moreover, before taking action, he can completely have the Second-stage Spirit Worm scout the way, and only after understanding the situation will he proceed.
"Understood."
Xu Ping lightly nodded, then said, "About that good thing, let’s wait a while. I’ll take you to explore it when the time comes."
Currently, there will definitely be cultivators from the Hundred Beasts Sect investigating around Spirit Void Peak, maybe even Golden Core middle stage cultivators coming in person.
Under such circumstances, rushing to Spirit Void Peak recklessly would be like walking into a trap.
It’s better to be cautious and only go when the people from the Hundred Beasts Sect have withdrawn.
At that time, he can also have the Second-stage Spirit Worm summon all First Rank Spirit Worms inhabiting Spirit Void Peak to enhance the Spirit Vein quality of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Hearing that it would have to wait a while before looking for the good thing, a trace of disappointment flashed through the Second-stage Spirit Worm’s heart.
But it did not show any of this on its face, still maintaining a fawning smile.
"Do you know how to enhance the Spirit Vein quality?" Xu Ping suddenly asked.
The Second-stage Spirit Worm confidently nodded. Enhancing Spirit Vein quality was its specialty, practically its signature skill.
"Alright, then from now on, put your full effort into enhancing the Spirit Vein quality beneath this mountain. As long as you do it well, there will naturally be plenty of benefits for you."
Xu Ping finished speaking, nodding with satisfaction, and then walked out of the cultivation room with large strides, saying, "Come on, I’ll take you to meet another companion of yours."
The Second-stage Spirit Worm quickly twisted its body, closely following behind Xu Ping.
The two of them—one human and one beast—walked out of the cultivation room and directly entered the spirit field.
"Water Lake Mouse!"
Xu Ping immediately summoned the Water Lake Mouse with a transmission of Divine Sense.
"Coming, Master."
The Water Lake Mouse ran over with a spring in its step.
However, the moment it saw the snake-like Demon Beast beside Xu Ping with a face full of fawning smiles, its expression stiffened.
"This beast is definitely my nemesis!" The Water Lake Mouse sounded a silent alarm in its heart and became wary.
At the same time, when the Second-stage Spirit Worm saw the Water Lake Mouse, it felt the same sentiment swelling within its heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 313 - 208: Tier 2 Earthworm Summoning, Spiritual Qi Resonance
chapters.content:
Chapter 313: Chapter 208: Tier 2 Earthworm Summoning, Spiritual Qi Resonance
"The Water Lake Rat is responsible for surveying the Spiritual Fields; the Second-stage Spirit Worm, you focus wholeheartedly on improving the quality of the Spirit Vein, work well together."
Xu Ping didn’t notice the individual thoughts of the two demon beasts, merely gave a simple instruction.
"Spirit Worm, go down into the Spirit Vein underground and devote yourself fully to enhancing the quality of the Spirit Vein."
After the introductions were complete, Xu Ping directed his gaze to the Second-stage Spirit Worm and gave instructions.
The Second-stage Spirit Worm nodded hastily, then slowly wriggled its body towards a vacant area.
Immediately, its demonic power surged, and its body emitted a strong ghostly green light, with fine scales rubbing against each other, producing a rustling sound.
In an instant, it seemed to ignore the solid ground, burrowing straight into the Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Witnessing this scene, Xu Ping quickly executed a spell, activating the Earth Master’s Gaze.
Relying on the sensing from the Divine Sense imprint, coupled with the observations from the Earth Master’s Gaze, he saw the Second-stage Spirit Worm burrow near the Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Then, it began to shuttle back and forth around the Spirit Vein, making the soil surrounding the Spirit Vein loose.
With the loosening of the soil around the Spirit Vein, the flow of Spiritual Qi underground became increasingly smooth, even the circulation of Spiritual Qi on the Thousand Leaves Mountain became freer.
"Not bad."
Xu Ping’s eyes, under the Earth Master’s Gaze, sparkled as he sensed the changes in the Spiritual Qi flow on the Thousand Leaves Mountain, nodding with satisfaction.
This efficiency value is definitely much better than a group of First Rank Spirit Worms.
At this rate, the process of upgrading the Spirit Vein of the Thousand Leaves Mountain to a Quasi-Tier Three Spirit Vein should accelerate considerably.
The Water Lake Rat, seeing Xu Ping’s expression, suddenly felt a strong sense of crisis.
Although it couldn’t see exactly what the Second-stage Spirit Worm was doing, it was clearly doing an excellent job.
"Master, rest assured, I will definitely ensure all Spirit Medicines and Spirit Plants in the Thousand Leaves Mountain are well attended to."
The Water Lake Rat puffed out its chest, defiantly declared.
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping deactivated the Earth Master’s Gaze and turned his gaze towards the Water Lake Rat.
Instantly, the slight smile on his face vanished without a trace, replaced by a cold indifference:
"Have you been slacking off in your cultivation lately?"
Seeing Xu Ping’s sudden change of demeanor, the expression on the Water Lake Rat’s face froze instantly.
What’s happening?
Could it be that after acquiring a new Spirit Pet, the master is starting to dislike his old Spirit Pet?
The Water Lake Rat hurriedly expressed its attitude: "Master, definitely not, I’ve always been diligently and painstakingly cultivating!"
"Really?"
Xu Ping narrowed his eyes slightly, a scrutinizing look in his gaze.
"I really..."
The Water Lake Rat tried to argue through Divine Sense telepathy, but before it could finish, Xu Ping interrupted mercilessly.
"No problem, from now on, I will thoroughly cultivate you."
A mysterious smile appeared on Xu Ping’s face, his tone laced with deeper meaning.
"Cultivate me?"
"Gulp!"
A sudden panic gripped the Water Lake Rat, it swallowed nervously.
It had seen this demeanor of the master before!!
"Ma...Master, there’s no need, I promise I will cultivate earnestly in the future!" The Water Lake Rat pleaded woefully.
However, Xu Ping’s attitude was resolute, showing no signs of wavering: "This is for your own good, it’s decided."
’Finished!’
’Seems like having a new Spirit Pet really made him despise the old one!’
The Water Lake Rat lamented inwardly, knowing it couldn’t avoid the situation this time.
"Master, how do you plan to cultivate me?"
The Water Lake Rat, feeling conflicted, put on a pitiful look, cautiously asked.
"Don’t worry, there’ll be no harm." Xu Ping’s mouth curled up into a slightly cruel arc.
As the words fell, he directly pulled out a Demon Core that emanated robust Spiritual Power waves from the storage pouch.
"Open your mouth!" Xu Ping commanded.
"Demon Core?"
"Could it be that this is actually a good thing?"
Seeing this, the Water Lake Rat’s eyes lit up instantly, and swiftly opened its small mouse mouth.
Xu Ping flicked his finger lightly, and the Demon Core transformed into a streak of light, directly entering the Water Lake Rat’s mouth.
"Thank you, Master!"
"Gulp," the Water Lake Rat swallowed the Demon Core, immediately feeling the vast power erupting continuously from within.
In an instant, its face was filled with a fawning, ingratiating smile.
"It’s just a small matter, I had long promised to thoroughly cultivate you."
Xu Ping watched the Water Lake Rat with an enigmatic smile, leisurely said, "To allow you to fully absorb the medicinal power of the Demon Core, while also stabilizing your own foundation, I’ve decided to spar with you for a quarter-hour every day."
"Every day... fight me!!!"
Upon hearing this, the Water Lake Rat’s eyeballs almost popped out in shock.
It knew the master’s strength could only be described as unfathomable.
Fighting with the master, isn’t this seeking death?
Would spitting out the Demon Core now still be in time?
However, before the Water Lake Rat could respond, Xu Ping was already making a move.
"Watch the strike!"
Xu Ping snorted coldly, the mana in his Dantian surging like roaring waves, and then suddenly struck out with a palm.
Instantly, dazzling light erupted in the void, a colossal mana hand appeared out of thin air, carrying a mountain-crushing momentum, fiercely sweeping towards the Water Lake Rat.
"They’re going to kill the Rat!!"
The Water Lake Rat felt the terrifying power contained within the mana hand, its eyes involuntarily flashed with a hint of panic.
The Water Lake Rat’s reaction was justified.
It should be known that the liquid mana in Xu Ping’s Dantian, whether in quantity or quality, far exceeded that of a typical Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivator.

chapters.title: Chapter 314 - 208: Tier 2 Earthworm Summoning, Spiritual Qi Resonance_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 314: Chapter 208: Tier 2 Earthworm Summoning, Spiritual Qi Resonance_2
Even though he casually channeled mana to unleash a palm strike, a cultivator at the late-stage Foundation Establishment would need to cautiously and fully confront it.
Buzz!
Facing the overwhelmingly incoming giant mana palm, the Water Lake Rat gritted its teeth, instantly erupting with a powerful wave of demonic power.
Red and blue spiritual light surged up around its body, and even its originally blood-red eyes turned oddly into one red and one blue.
Following closely, before the Water Lake Rat’s mouth, a ghostly blue water ball and a blazing purple flame instantly formed.
The next instant.
Boom!
The ghostly blue water ball and the scorching purple flame shot out like two meteors from the rat’s mouth, spiraling through the air and directly bombarding the mana palm.
Rumble!
The two sides collided fiercely, accompanied by a deafening explosion, an invisible surge of powerful energy spread wildly from the point of impact like ripples.
Ultimately, these two powerful energies entangled and devoured each other, gradually dissipating into nothingness.
However, the Water Lake Rat had no time to relax before it was shocked to find Xu Ping had eerily appeared overhead.
Xu Ping was expressionless, his eyes as calm as water, raising his fist high and, without warning, slammed it down hard toward the Water Lake Rat.
Thud!
With an extremely heavy thud, the Water Lake Rat was hammered solidly into the ground.
The ground instantly was smashed into a deep pit, numerous stones flying in all directions, raising a cloud of dust.
"Hiss!"
The dust settled, and the Water Lake Rat lay in the pit, gritting its teeth in pain, miserably saying, "Master, this is murder!"
But Xu Ping turned a deaf ear and kicked again.
The Water Lake Rat saw this and could only clumsily roll over and dodge...
A quarter of an hour passed in an instant.
At this moment, Xu Ping stood calmly in the clearing, his breathing steady, as if everything that happened just now had no effect on him.
On the other side, the Water Lake Rat lay bruised and swollen on the ground, gasping for breath, looking extremely miserable.
"Continue tomorrow."
Xu Ping casually threw down this sentence and then turned to leave, leaving the dazed, lost-spirited Water Lake Rat questioning its own life, all alone in place.
.....
...
Just like this, under Xu Ping’s repeated "beatings" of the Water Lake Rat, time passed slowly.
Three months later.
On this night.
The bright moon hung high in the sky.
The clear moonlight poured down without obstruction, like countless silver threads wrapping tightly around Thousand Leaves Mountain.
As the moonlight illuminated, the contours of Thousand Leaves Mountain became distinctly visible. The towering main peak pierced the sky, resembling a majestic giant quietly guarding this land.
At this moment.
Now, Xu Ping sat cross-legged on an enormous stone, his posture straight, eyes closed, silently waiting for the arrival of the Spiritual Qi tide.
Suddenly.
A crisp crack shattered the silence of the night.
The ground slowly cracked open with a gap, and a Spirit Worm wriggled its way out from the fissure.
"How did you get up here?"
Xu Ping opened his eyes, focusing his gaze on the Spirit Worm, and asked with a frown.
The Spiritual Qi tide was imminent and could not tolerate any disturbance.
"Hiss hiss!"
The Spirit Worm emitted sounds while obsequiously swaying its body, and kept gesturing various movements with its tail.
Xu Ping, with a motion of his divine sense, communicated with the Sea of Consciousness imprint of the Second-stage Spirit Worm.
Moments later.
A look of surprise appeared on Xu Ping’s face: "You mean, you can use the Spiritual Qi tide to perform ’Spiritual Qi Resonance’, summoning Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi into the Spirit Vein to facilitate its self-purification and upgrade?"
Having raised the Spirit Worm for several months, Xu Ping now could clearly understand what it intended to convey through the divine sense imprint.
The Spirit Worm nodded energetically, appearing very confident.
"Interesting."
Receiving an affirmative answer, Xu Ping’s face instantly showed a curious expression.
Using the Spiritual Qi tide to guide Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi into the Spirit Vein, promoting its purification and upgrade.
This seemed to bear a striking resemblance to the Secret Technique ’Guiding Qi into the Vein’ that he mastered.
Just not sure if its effectiveness is comparable to ’Guiding Qi into the Vein’.
"This should be a unique Divine Technique of the Second-stage Spirit Worm," Xu Ping speculated in his mind.
"In that case, you may give it a try." Xu Ping’s lips slightly curved, eyes showing a trace of expectation.
He was curious to see how capable this Second-stage Spirit Worm truly was.
Given Xu Ping’s permission, the Spirit Worm became excited, energetically gesturing.
"Rest assured, as long as you truly have the ability to summon Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi into the Spirit Vein, the benefits will not shortchange you." Xu Ping smiled and nodded, his tone soothing.
Upon hearing this, the Spirit Worm became even more excited, immediately straightening up its body as if saying: "Master, just wait and see."
"Quietly wait for a moment, the Spiritual Qi tide is still some time away."
After speaking, Xu Ping gently closed his eyes again, entering a state of deep focus and waiting.
The Spirit Worm saw this and quietly laid on the ground.
In the distance, the Water Lake Rat, whose aura was almost at the peak of the Second-stage Middle Grade, watched this scene with a face full of worry.
The role of this Spirit Worm is becoming increasingly significant, wouldn’t that make it seem even more worthless?
If things continue this way, wouldn’t the master beat it even harder in the future?
No way!
It can absolutely not stand by idly!
The Water Lake Rat secretly resolved that it must think of a way to reclaim its prominent position in the master’s heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 315 - 208: Tier 2 Earthworm Summoning, Spiritual Qi Resonance_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 315: Chapter 208: Tier 2 Earthworm Summoning, Spiritual Qi Resonance_3
Time passed silently in the midst of the water rat’s heart filled with worry and entanglement.
Suddenly, an extremely faint fluctuation faintly came from the distant sky.
This fluctuation was as light as a gentle breeze, quietly brushing over the calm, undisturbed lake surface, causing a series of subtle ripples in an instant.
This seemingly insignificant fluctuation, however, contained an ineffable mystical force.
"It’s here!"
Xu Ping abruptly opened his eyes, his gaze sharp like lightning, seemingly able to penetrate the deep night.
The Spirit Worm, originally lying quietly on the ground, instantly straightened its body as well, its excitement evident, with a gleam of excitement sparkling in its small eyes.
Xu Ping’s expression was calm as water, unperturbed, as he immediately circulated his Spiritual Power and activated the Earth Master’s Gaze.
"Guide the spirit into the vein!"
Then, his hands quickly formed seals as he chanted, with a shimmer of light emanating all around him.
Buzz!
At this moment, a gentle halo radiated from Xu Ping’s body.
Soon, strands of Spiritual Qi gathered from all directions, forming a massive vortex of Spiritual Qi above his head.
Despite enduring immense pressure from the Spiritual Qi at this moment,
Xu Ping, having performed "Guide the spirit into the vein" many times, was long accustomed to this pressure.
He remained calm and composed, as steady as a mountain, without a hint of panic.
"Appear!"
"Merge!"
Xu Ping lightly called out, his hands altering with a Magic Technique, pointing a finger.
In a flash, a faintly visible channel of Spiritual Qi slowly formed.
