Instantly, the Spiritual Qi within the channel surged with overwhelming momentum towards the Spirit Vein under Thousand Leaves Mountain.
The Spirit Vein under Thousand Leaves Mountain trembled fiercely, then began to greedily absorb the hard-won nourishment from the Spiritual Qi.
Simultaneously, the Spirit Worm also started to act.
Buzz!
It twisted its massive body, emitting a ghostly green light, as streams of strange energy were released from its body.
These energies spread in all directions like agile threads.
The thread-like energies intertwined with the Spiritual Qi, colliding and sparking splendid glimmers of light.
The Spirit Worm’s body twisted faster and faster, the energy it released growing stronger.
Gradually, a larger and more violent vortex of Spiritual Qi formed with it at the center.
The Spiritual Qi in the vortex swirled madly, drawn in as if into a black hole, producing a wondrous reaction with the energy released by the Spirit Worm.
It was as though an invisible force was pulling, drawing the surrounding Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi towards this vortex.
The previously scattered Spiritual Qi was now being organized and gathered into the vortex.
Then, following the direction guided by the Spirit Worm, they surged mightily towards the Spirit Vein of Thousand Leaves Mountain, creating a spectacular scene.
While Xu Ping performed the Secret Technique, he also watched the movements on the Spirit Worm’s side.
He initially thought that even though the Spirit Worm possessed the ability to guide Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi into the Spirit Vein, its effect would certainly be far less than his "Guide the spirit into the vein."
After all, Xu Ping had long achieved a Minor Achievement with "Guide the spirit into the vein," and its power to channel the Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi was already incomparable to before.
But witnessing the Spirit Worm’s methods firsthand, he realized how utterly mistaken he was.
The power displayed was no less than his own, and in some aspects, faintly surpassed even his "Guide the spirit into the vein."
This sudden discovery greatly astonished him.
Moreover, Xu Ping keenly sensed that his fully deployed Secret Technique "Guide the spirit into the vein" and the "Spiritual Qi resonance" phenomenon triggered by the Spirit Worm were producing a harmonious synergy on some mysterious and subtle level.
The two different methods were now seemingly in sync.
They resonated with each other, cooperating to propel a vast amount of Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi, surging towards the Spirit Vein of Thousand Leaves Mountain like rivers returning to the sea.
This unexpected discovery truly delighted Xu Ping.
"It’s like finding a treasure, no wonder the Hundred Beasts Sect places such importance on this Second-stage Spirit Worm." A gleam of excitement flashed in Xu Ping’s eyes.
"For a major power, the value of this Second-stage Spirit Worm might not be inferior to some ordinary Third-rank Demon Beasts!" Xu Ping pondered secretly, increasingly recognizing the Spirit Worm’s worth.
"After all, this is only a Second-stage Lower Grade Spirit Worm, and as its grade increases, its ability to guide the Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi will likely enhance significantly.
"Once it successfully advances to the Second-stage Upper Grade level, with its formidable capability, upgrading a Third-rank Upper Grade Spirit Vein to a quasi-Fourth Rank Spirit Vein might not be a far-fetched dream."
"It seems that in the future, I must focus on cultivating this Second-stage Spirit Worm."
Despite the thousands of thoughts racing through Xu Ping’s mind, the Spiritual Qi channel remained as steady as a mountain.
And with the frenzied influx of two streams of Spiritual Qi, the Spirit Vein of Thousand Leaves Mountain underwent astonishing changes.
The Spiritual Qi channel within the Spirit Vein continuously expanded, the distant ends of the Spirit Vein, which were somewhat dim, began to glow again, the light growing brighter and purer.
The overall quality of the Spirit Vein seemed to be improving noticeably.
Not far away, the water rat watched in shock, its round eyes wide open with awe.
It naturally noticed that the Spirit Worm’s ability to guide Spiritual Qi seemed to surpass its own master’s slightly.
Though envious and somewhat unwilling, it could only watch intently, daring not to disturb anything.
As time quietly slipped away, the surge of Spiritual Qi like a rolling tide gradually began to show signs of receding.
The once overwhelming Spiritual Qi rushing towards the Spirit Vein grew increasingly sparse.
Like the seawater receding at low tide, it slowly returned to the depths of the sea.
Once the Spiritual Qi tide completely receded, Xu Ping and the Spirit Worm stopped simultaneously.
For a moment, the entire Thousand Leaves Mountain returned to its previous tranquility.
If not for the significantly denser Spiritual Qi now enveloping Thousand Leaves Mountain, giving a sense of freshness and moisture, everything would have seemed as though nothing had ever happened there.

chapters.title: Chapter 316 - 209: Epiphany—Entry Level Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 316: Chapter 209: Epiphany—Entry Level Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill
Xu Ping slowly extended his Divine Sense like fine threads, until it enveloped the entire summit of Thousand Leaves Mountain. He concentrated deeply, attentively sensing every tiny change here.
After half an incense stick’s time, he retracted his Divine Sense with satisfaction.
"It’s truly impressive! The Spiritual Qi concentration on Thousand Leaves Mountain now compared to before has increased by more than double at least."
Xu Ping’s lips slightly curled, carrying a hint of a joyful smile, as he murmured to himself.
It should be noted that this is merely the Spiritual Qi concentration in the ordinary areas of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
If it were a training chamber with an Array formation, the richness of Spiritual Qi reaching Quasi-Tier Three levels would be undoubtedly certain.
"Quasi-Tier Three, huh!" Xu Ping murmured a phrase, a hint of excitement flickering in his eyes.
Originally, he thought it would take considerable time to reach this level, but unexpectedly, it was achieved ahead of schedule.
Although the Spirit Vein on Thousand Leaves Mountain has not truly advanced to Quasi-Tier Three, the gap between them is already negligible.
Judging by the rapid pace of this current enhancement, in just a few more years, the Spirit Vein beneath Thousand Leaves Mountain could be solidly elevated to Quasi-Tier Three.
By then, with the placement of a Third-rank Array, this dojo could truly be considered impregnable.
Thinking of this, Xu Ping lowered his head, his gaze resting on the Spirit Worm lying exhausted and sprawled softly on the ground.
Tonight, the contributions of this Spirit Worm are in no way inferior to his, and from a certain perspective, even more outstanding.
In the days to come, its assistance will surely be indispensable.
"Your performance was quite impressive." Xu Ping looked at the Spirit Worm with eyes full of commendation.
Upon hearing this, the Spirit Worm lifted its head, a stream of happiness flowing from its eyes, slightly moving its body as if responding to Xu Ping’s praise.
"Open your mouth, I’ll give you a reward!" Xu Ping said with a smile.
Upon hearing this, the Spirit Worm’s eyes instantly brightened, swiftly opening its large gaping mouth.
Xu Ping flicked his fingers lightly, and two gray Pills transformed into streaks of light, directly entering the Spirit Worm’s mouth.
"Gulp!"
Accompanied by the rolling of the Spirit Worm’s throat, the two gray Pills slowly descended into its belly.
Feeling the surging medicinal power like a torrent within, the blood-red pupils of the Spirit Worm involuntarily revealed an expression of uncontrollable delight.
Filled with joy, it busily and affectionately rubbed Xu Ping’s leg with its head.
"You’ve worked hard tonight, go now, have a good rest, and recover your strength." Xu Ping patted its head and spoke.
"Hiss hiss!"
The Spirit Worm opened its mouth and hissed in response, then swiftly burrowed into the ground.
"Master, you’ve worked hard!"
At this moment, just as the Spirit Worm burrowed underground, the Water Lake Rat scurried over to Xu Ping’s side.
Its face brimming with a flattering smile, it handed Xu Ping a freshly brewed cup of Spirit Tea.
"Mm."
Xu Ping merely nodded slightly, took the Spirit Tea, and after drinking it in one gulp, turned around and headed towards the training chamber.
"Master, walk slowly."
Even though treated so dismissively, the Water Lake Rat still wore a broad smile on its face.
Yet, secretly worried within, it resolved to break through to Second-stage Upper Grade as soon as possible, to once again become Master’s cherished one.
....
....
Within the training chamber, silence reigned, only the faint fluctuations of Spiritual Qi subtly circulating.
Xu Ping held the Array Token in his hand, sitting cross-legged on the stone bed.
Then, he infused a wisp of Mana into the Array Token.
In an instant, the Array Token erupted with dazzling and brilliant Spiritual light, as if tangible, illuminating the entire training chamber.
Simultaneously, the Array that originally covered the skies above suddenly commenced full operation, countless free-roaming Spiritual Qi across Thousand Leaves Mountain being drawn by this formidable suction, rushing crazily into the training chamber like rivers converging into the sea.
Moments later.
The entire training chamber was filled with extremely rich Spiritual Qi.
That Spiritual Qi resembled a tangible entity, presenting a faint milky white, flowing slowly in the air, sparkling with soft and enticing radiance.
"This is the Spiritual Qi concentration at Quasi-Tier Three level!" Witnessing this scene, Xu Ping couldn’t help but feel a surge of emotion within his heart.
Simply breathing in, he could distinctly feel countless lively Spiritual Qi eagerly rushing into his nose and mouth.
If he had always been cultivating in such a Spiritual Qi environment, he would have achieved Foundation Establishment Perfection long ago.
And this is merely the Spiritual Qi concentration at Quasi-Tier Three level, one cannot imagine how exaggerated it would be if reaching Tier Three.
"Hoo!"
Xu Ping took a deep breath, gently closing his eyes, casting aside distracting thoughts, immersing his mind into his body, beginning to slowly circulate his cultivation technique.
As the cultivation technique operated, a faint layer of radiance emerged around Xu Ping.
At this moment, the Spiritual Qi suffusing the training chamber, akin to an old bachelor single for decades witnessing a beauty lying naked on his own bed, rushed into Xu Ping’s body without restraint.
An hour passed.
The radiance surrounding Xu Ping grew increasingly bright, eventually abruptly gathering.
He slowly opened his eyes, a glimmer of joy flashing through them: "This efficiency value has increased by several times at least compared to before."
"With this pace, in just a few years, I will be able to reach Foundation Establishment Perfection."
At this thought, an involuntary smile of satisfaction appeared at the corner of Xu Ping’s mouth, and his tense mind and body completely relaxed.
For some reason, at this moment he only felt his mind clear and lucid, his thoughts unprecedented in clarity and sharpness, even his Sea of Consciousness became exceptionally active.
Though he had not extended his Divine Sense outward, he could still distinctly perceive every subtle change around him.

chapters.title: Chapter 317 - 209: Epiphany—Entry Level of Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 317: Chapter 209: Epiphany—Entry Level of Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill
Even the slightest movement could not escape his perception.
Xu Ping found himself in an incredibly peculiar state.
This state was somewhat similar to the epiphany he experienced while practicing swordplay before, yet it was not as intense.
"A minor epiphany?"
A hint of understanding emerged in Xu Ping’s mind.
This state is unpredictable and elusive, but if grasped properly, it might lead to a significant breakthrough in his cultivation.
Before him lay two choices: practice the "Primordial Sword Skill" or cultivate the "Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill."
Almost instantly, Xu Ping made his decision—to cultivate the "Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill."
After all, the current minor epiphany was far less intense than the last time he practiced swordplay.
Even if he chose to practice the "Primordial Sword Skill," it would likely be difficult to achieve a significant leap in strength.
It would be better to take advantage of this precious opportunity to try cultivating the "Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill."
It’s known that this cultivation technique is extremely difficult to practice, with a very challenging process. Succeeding in entry to it through this opportunity would undoubtedly be a huge gain.
Having made up his mind, Xu Ping didn’t hesitate or procrastinate. He raised his hand, immediately retrieving the jade slip recording the "Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill" from his storage ring.
Immediately, he sent his divine sense into it.
In an instant, countless complex and profound symbols and patterns surged into his sea of consciousness like a roaring tide.
These symbols flickered with mysterious light, intertwining to form a wondrous picture.
This was the true formation diagram of the "Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill." Only by comprehending the profound truths within could one count as having entered, truly beginning to cultivate this technique.
Xu Ping immersed himself completely in it, diligently interpreting the deeper meanings contained in each symbol.
In his extraordinary state of epiphany, the symbols that originally seemed chaotic and without pattern gradually revealed a hidden order, becoming faintly discernible.
No one knows how much time passed before a spark of insight flashed through Xu Ping’s mind.
At that moment, all the symbols seemed to find their place, and a complete and clear true diagram of the "Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill" appeared in his sea of consciousness.
A surge of ecstatic joy welled up in Xu Ping’s heart—he had successfully comprehended it!
In this true diagram, the image of the profound turtle was vivid and lifelike. The patterns on its shell contained the fundamental truths of heaven and earth, and the posture of its limbs seemed to carry the power of mountains and rivers.
Xu Ping carefully observed every detail, engraving it deeply in his mind.
Comprehending the true diagram was only the first step; the next step was to integrate it into his own cultivation.
Xu Ping directly took out earth core rock milk from the storage ring and drank half a bottle in one go.
The instant Xu Ping drank it, he felt an incomparably scorching force, like a raging flood of lava, pouring straight down his throat.
The intense pain and burning sensation was as if countless red-hot steel needles were simultaneously piercing into his body, and as if his entire body was being mercilessly scorched by a raging fire. Every inch of skin, every meridian was enduring unbearable agony.
Even with Xu Ping’s current physique, it was somewhat unbearable.
However, Xu Ping gritted his teeth, using his immense willpower to forcibly endure the bone-eroding pain, then began to slowly circulate the "Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill."
With the circulation of the cultivation technique, his body seemed to transform into a mysterious furnace, and the vast energy of the earth core rock milk became the precious fuel thrown into the furnace.
Xu Ping could clearly feel his bones making slight "crack crack" sounds under the influence of this force, as if undergoing a metamorphic remolding.
Every bone was continually strengthening, becoming increasingly hard and dense, like beams forged from refined steel, seemingly able to bear heavy pressure without bending.
Simultaneously, something astonishing happened; every pore on his body began to ooze fine blood.
After calming down and carefully sensing it, Xu Ping understood that this was not his normal blood but the demon beast’s essence blood absorbed during his previous cultivation of Blood Demon Body Refining.
"This ’Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill’ is truly overbearing!"
Witnessing such a scene, Xu Ping was indeed quite shocked.
He had not anticipated that the "Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill" would be so overpowering.
It directly sought to eradicate the impacts left by the Blood Demon Body Refining he had arduously cultivated.
"The Blood Demon Body Refining I’ve painstakingly cultivated!" Xu Ping couldn’t help but lament inwardly.
It’s important to note that the Blood Demon Body Refining had already been cultivated to the second layer, a genuine second-stage middle-grade body cultivation.
In contrast, even if the "Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill" is successfully cultivated at this moment, it would merely be stepping into the first layer, barely reaching a second-stage lower-grade body cultivation level.
Inevitably, Xu Ping felt worry in his heart, unsure if his physique would deteriorate after completely mastering the "Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill."
But now, the decision was made, and he had no way back, forcing him to bite the bullet and continue cultivating.
After all, from the perspective of long-term potential, the "Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill" undoubtedly far surpasses the "Blood Demon Body Refining," so he might as well persistently cultivate it slowly.
Time passed slowly amidst the pain and transformation, with Xu Ping immersed in the world of cultivation, oblivious to everything outside.
His consciousness was completely focused within, concentrating on guiding the flow of energy and adjusting the rhythm of the cultivation technique.
No one knows how long it took before the excruciating pain, once as overwhelming as surging waves threatening to drown Xu Ping, finally began to diminish.

chapters.title: Chapter 318 - 209: Epiphany—Entry Level of Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill
chapters.content:
Chapter 318: Chapter 209: Epiphany—Entry Level of Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill
In its place was a warm, tingling sense of comfort.
At this moment, Xu Ping slowly opened his eyes, excitement and elation gleaming in them.
He couldn’t wait to open the proficiency panel.
[Name: Xu Ping]
[Life Span: 70/678 years]
[Cultivation Level: Late-Stage Foundation Establishment: 75/100; Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill, Level 1: 1/100]
[Cultivation Technique: Longevity Skill Mastery: 1161/1600]
...
"Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill... finally cultivated successfully!"
Seeing the clear display on the proficiency panel, Xu Ping couldn’t help but burst into laughter.
After spending so much time and effort, and taking advantage of this rare opportunity for a small enlightenment, he finally managed to cultivate it successfully.
If he relied on slowly comprehending it himself, who knows when he would reach the entry level.
"Whew!"
Xu Ping took a deep breath, striving to suppress the tumultuous emotions in his heart, and began to calmly sense the various changes in his body.
Crack!
When Xu Ping clenched his fist tightly, the muscles on his arms instantly tensed, becoming as hard as iron.
Thick veins bulged clearly beneath the skin, resembling hibernating flood dragons, and his joints emitted a crisp sound.
A torrent of unprecedented strength surged from the depths of Xu Ping’s body, making him feel as though he could effortlessly shatter everything before him.
Of course, he knew well that this was just a side effect of the tremendous increase in strength over a short period.
"The strength didn’t diminish; instead, it increased by forty to fifty percent!"
After carefully sensing and judging, Xu Ping reached this delightful conclusion.
His eyes instantly lit up, and a wave of ecstatic joy surged in his heart.
He truly didn’t expect the ’Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill’ to be so formidable.
Having just stepped into the first level, the increase in strength was already forty to fifty percent stronger than the peak state of the second level of the ’Blood Demon Body Refining.’
Xu Ping estimated in his heart that at this rate of development, when the ’Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill’ was cultivated to the third level, its explosive strength might not be much weaker than that of an ordinary Golden Core body cultivator.
Thinking of this, he was filled with anticipation for the future of this cultivation technique.
"Let’s test its renowned defensive power!"
Xu Ping turned his palm, and a brilliantly cold upper-grade magical blade appeared in his hand.
This magical blade had an exquisitely crafted shape, with the blade flashing a cold gleam, clearly indicating it was no ordinary item.
Next, Xu Ping slowly infused a trace of mana into the upper-grade magical blade, and as the mana circulated, the blade’s glow became increasingly dazzling.
He lightly gritted his teeth and forcefully swung the blade across his own arm.
Screech!
A piercing sound of friction rang out, like metal scraping against glass, terribly painful to the ears.
A white mark appeared on Xu Ping’s arm, yet this white mark quickly vanished without a trace in the blink of an eye under his abnormal recovery ability.
"This defensive power... a bit exaggerated, isn’t it!" Witnessing this scene, Xu Ping couldn’t help but be shocked.
An upper-grade magical artifact couldn’t even break through the defense?
This defensive power is probably far superior to that of an ordinary second-stage upper-grade body cultivator.
"It seems Tong Xingbang didn’t exaggerate the capabilities of the ’Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill’. Should this technique be cultivated to the sixth-layer perfection realm, it might really withstand a strike from a Nascent Soul cultivator without dying!" Xu Ping thought to himself.
Bear in mind, the gap between Nascent Soul cultivators and Golden Core cultivators is far greater than from Foundation Establishment to Golden Core, like a chasm.
In the Foundation Establishment realm, perhaps through clever use of talisman arrays and other means, there is a chance to injure Golden Core cultivators, or even defeat them is not entirely impossible.
But no matter how exceptional a Golden Core cultivator is, facing a Nascent Soul cultivator, just barely holding their own is already considered a remarkable talent with unmatched battle prowess.
"Reaching that level, truly is the moment when the sky is high for birds to fly, and the ocean broad for fish to leap," Xu Ping sighed in his heart.
However, as of now, he was still countless miles away, so he would continue diligently.
Soon, Xu Ping’s mind calmed down.
It was then that he noticed he was emitting a strong smell of blood.
Xu Ping frowned slightly and summoned water to wash away the residual demon beast blood.
However, although he was clean, his stomach rumbled loudly.
The sensation of hunger swept over him like a tide, with every cell in his body yearning for nutritional energy.
The hunger was so intense that even Xu Ping’s willpower struggled to endure it.
Quickly, he pulled out a few of his own refined fasting pills and swallowed them.
However, the meager energy contained in the fasting pills was merely a drop in the ocean for his current need for nutrients and fell far short of satisfying his body’s needs.
So he had to set his sights on the flesh of third-tier demon beasts.
"Shuihu rat, come to the training room," Xu Ping transmitted with his divine sense.
"Coming, Master."
Responding quickly, the Shuihu rat scampered into the training room.
"Master, what can I do for you?" Shuihu rat asked, smiling widely.
"Roast this meat!" Xu Ping tossed a large piece of third-tier giant python meat to the Shuihu rat.
Although he’d crossed over into the cultivation realm for several decades, his habit of not eating raw meat was ingrained in him.
Furthermore, the demon fire of the Shuihu rat was undoubtedly superior to his Foundation True Flame, making it the natural choice for roasting third-stage demon beast flesh.
"Third-stage demon beast meat!"
The Shuihu rat caught the large piece of meat steadily, suddenly feeling astonished.
But thinking of the master’s incredible abilities, it quickly relaxed.
"Alrighty!"
The Shuihu rat responded and began to spit demon fire to roast this large piece of demon beast meat.
Time passed.
Before long, the inviting aroma of the roast meat gradually wafted out, filling the entire training room.
"Gulp!"
Xu Ping involuntarily swallowed, his eyes slightly reddened from extreme hunger.
The hunger was so intense, almost making him lose control.
Meanwhile, the Shuihu rat, roasting the meat beside him, watched Xu Ping with trepidation.
It truly feared that with one careless move, the master might just eat him instead.

chapters.title: Chapter 319 - 210: Hongyi Arrives, 9-Leaf Dragon Saliva Ganoderma
chapters.content:
Chapter 319: Chapter 210: Hongyi Arrives, 9-Leaf Dragon Saliva Ganoderma
Fortunately, Xu Ping didn’t have to wait too long. The Third-stage Demon Beast Flesh was finally roasted.
"M... Master, here you go."
The Water Lake Rat forced a smile, respectfully handing the roasted Third-stage Demon Beast Flesh to Xu Ping.
Xu Ping reached out to take it, immediately devouring it ravenously. With a "crunch" sound, he even chewed and swallowed the bones.
Seeing this, the Water Lake Rat huddled shivering in the corner, fearing that once the Third-stage Demon Beast Flesh was gone, he would become the next meal.
At last, after consuming thirty or forty pounds of Third-stage Demon Beast Flesh, the ravenous hunger in Xu Ping’s belly finally dissipated.
"Burp—"
Xu Ping let out a long, satisfied belch.
Thankfully, the energy contained in this Third-stage Demon Beast Flesh was extremely abundant. If it had been Second-stage Demon Beast Flesh, he’d need a hundred or two hundred pounds to meet his body’s energy requirements.
"Here you go."
Xu Ping casually tossed the remaining Third-stage Demon Beast Flesh toward the shivering Water Lake Rat hiding in the corner.
"Thank you, Master!"
The Water Lake Rat caught the Third-stage Demon Beast Flesh steadily, its eyes immediately lighting up with excitement.
One must know that Third-stage Demon Beast Flesh was also a rare and great supplement for it!
Without delay, it eagerly opened its mouth, devouring the meat clean in a few bites, finally licking its paws with lingering desire.
"You may withdraw now."
After another belch, Xu Ping leisurely instructed.
"Got it."
The Water Lake Rat responded obsequiously, hurriedly agreed, then quickly ran out.
Once the Water Lake Rat left, Xu Ping sat cross-legged on the meditation mat and started the "Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill".
As the cultivation technique began to operate slowly, the vast energy contained in the recently consumed Third-stage Demon Beast Flesh was gradually guided to his four limbs and body like a gentle stream.
Strands of energy flowed through his meridians, continuously nourishing and strengthening his qi, blood, and physique.
Time unknown, Xu Ping finally digested and absorbed all the energy from the demon beast flesh in his stomach.
"Indeed, for a Body Cultivator, Third-stage Demon Beast Flesh is far more effective than those spirit pills and elixirs."
Xu Ping slowly opened his eyes, a faint smile appearing unconsciously at the corner of his mouth.
At this moment, he clearly felt his physique had improved a bit.
With the help of Third-stage Demon Beast Flesh and the proficiency panel, perhaps his Body Cultivation could soon catch up with his cultivation realm.
However, just as he was about to get up and stretch his limbs...
The Water Lake Rat’s divine sense transmission pierced through the wall and clearly reached his ears: "Master, Master, Hongyi is here!"
"Hongyi?"
Xu Ping was slightly taken aback, then tidied up his clothes and calmly walked out of the cultivation chamber.
After all, it had been some time since any news had been heard from the other party, and he wondered if he had successfully acquired the Transformation Pill Fruit this time.
...
...
As soon as Xu Ping saw Hongyi, a look of surprise appeared on his face.
Only to see Hongyi with a reserved aura, faintly exuding a unique pressure of a Golden Core Cultivator, clearly having successfully broken through to the Golden Core Realm.
"Not only did Hongyi successfully seize the Transformation Pill Fruit, but he also broke through to the Golden Core Realm," Xu Ping was secretly amazed in his heart.
One must know, although the Transformation Pill Fruit could dissolve the Fake Pill inside a Fake Pill cultivator, how to break through to the Golden Core was still fraught with difficulties.
A success rate of over thirty percent was already heaven’s blessing.
However, compared to the success rate of breaking through from Foundation Establishment Perfection to the Golden Core, it was indeed something one would not dare to wish for.
"Congratulations to Elder Hong on achieving the Golden Core. May your immortal path be smooth and prosperous in the future."
Though Xu Ping’s mind was awash with thoughts, he showed no trace of it on his face, instead bowing with a smile and offering his congratulations.
"Fellow Daoist Xu is too kind; it was merely a coincidence."
Hongyi smiled, returning the courtesy with a bow, then continued, "If not for Fellow Daoist Xu’s talismans, I fear I wouldn’t have even obtained the Transformation Pill Fruit, let alone achieved the Golden Core."
"It was nothing more than a normal transaction between Elder Hong and me, truly nothing significant," Xu Ping dismissed the praise with a humble wave.
"There’s no need for such formality between us; let’s simply refer to each other as ’Friend’ from now on," Hongyi said seriously with a solemn expression.
"Then let it be as Friend Hong suggests," Xu Ping chuckled softly.
It seemed that having broken through to the Golden Core, the other party had not become arrogant and self-important.
Xu Ping warmly led Hongyi to the pavilion in the courtyard, instructing the Water Lake Rat to serve Spirit Tea.
The two sat as host and guest, and after a few idle chats, the topic naturally turned to the relics of the Nine Nether Elder.
"So, the Yin Yang Qi Cauldron is indeed confirmed to be in the relics of the Nine Nether Elder?" Xu Ping’s expression grew slightly serious.
"Yes."
Hongyi nodded, "Nascent Soul cultivators from three countries have already clashed. It’s just that the Yin Yang Qi Cauldron has not fully emerged yet, so it hasn’t progressed to a struggle of life and death."
"I see."
Xu Ping appeared thoughtful, but internally, he was quite indifferent, as long as it didn’t affect him.
Moreover, while it was easy to defeat Nascent Soul cultivators, it was extremely difficult to kill them.
So there was no need to worry excessively about the fall of Nascent Soul cultivators causing chaos in the Yue Country.
After a few more casual exchanges, Hongyi placed his teacup down, his expression growing serious: "Fellow Daoist Xu, the real reason for my visit today is to ask if you could sell me some more Third-stage talismans?"
"Although I have now stepped into the Golden Core Realm, I still need the help of talismans to handle some tricky matters."
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping nodded immediately: "No problem, how many would Friend Hong want?"

chapters.title: Chapter 320 - 210: Hongyi Arrives, 9-Leaved Dragon Salvia (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 320: Chapter 210: Hongyi Arrives, 9-Leaved Dragon Salvia (Part 2)
Hongyi was just about to speak when his expression suddenly shifted slightly, and a hint of shock flickered across his eyes.
But he quickly regained his composure, pondered briefly, and then slowly said:
"Fellow Daoist Xu has been a Third-rank Talisman Master for years. With your skills, drawing Third-rank Middle Grade talismans should not be a problem. Would it be possible for you to sell me a few Third-rank Middle Grade talismans?"
"Third-rank Middle Grade talismans?"
Xu Ping’s brow furrowed imperceptibly, then he chuckled bitterly, "Hongyi really overestimates me. I’m just at the Foundation Establishment Realm. To be able to craft Third-rank Lower Grade talismans is already quite fortunate."
"As for Third-rank Middle Grade talismans, they are far beyond my capabilities." Xu Ping spread his hands helplessly.
At this moment, Xu Ping certainly couldn’t openly sell Third-rank Middle Grade talismans.
After all, he is currently only a Foundation Establishment Cultivator, and being able to draw Third-rank Lower Grade talismans at this realm already speaks volumes of his extraordinary talent.
But crafting Third-rank Middle Grade talismans is not something that can be explained merely by gifted talent; it would certainly invite many unnecessary troubles.
"Fellow Daoist Xu is too modest. With such world-shocking talent, crafting Third-rank Middle Grade talismans surely shouldn’t be a problem." Hongyi smiled broadly and said with a chuckle.
"As long as Fellow Daoist Xu is willing to sell me the Third-rank Middle Grade talismans, regardless of what it is, as long as you need it, we can negotiate."
"Even Crystal Condensing Liquid isn’t out of the question for discussion," Hongyi stated seriously.
"Anything?"
"Crystal Condensing Liquid?"
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping’s heart jolted fiercely, his pupils subconsciously contracted slightly.
Wasn’t Hongyi’s tone a bit too grandiose?
Moreover, from his determined voice, it seemed he was certain Xu Ping possessed Third-rank Middle Grade talismans.
But how could he be sure?
Xu Ping had never exposed this matter in front of anyone.
After giving Hongyi a deep look, Xu Ping still smiled bitterly and declined: "Fellow Daoist Hong, I truly do not have such skills to craft Third-rank Middle Grade talismans."
After speaking, he nonchalantly probed, "I wonder where Fellow Daoist Hong heard the rumor that I can craft Third-rank Middle Grade talismans?"
"It’s just my speculation."
Hongyi chuckled, trying to bypass the topic, "Since Fellow Daoist Xu indeed does not have Third-rank Middle Grade talismans, then sell me a few Third-rank Lower Grade talismans."
"That is certainly not a problem."
Upon hearing that, Xu Ping gathered his thoughts, smiled slightly, and then asked, "I wonder how many talismans Fellow Daoist Hong wants?"
"The more the better," Hongyi responded.
"I have only a total of seven Third-rank talismans with me," Xu Ping replied helplessly.
"Seven?"
Hongyi murmured briefly and nodded, "Barely sufficient."
"Since Fellow Daoist is quite fond of longevity items, I shall exchange these seven Third-rank talismans with Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushrooms. What do you think?"
As soon as the words fell, Hongyi flipped his hand, and a jade-green box appeared in his palm.
"Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom?"
Upon hearing, a hint of ecstasy flashed in Xu Ping’s eyes, and he immediately asked, "Is this true?"
Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom is also a renowned Third-rank longevity item in the Cultivation Realm. Although its effect isn’t as potent as that of millennial Spiritual Liquid, it is still a rare heavenly treasure.
"It’s certainly true, Fellow Daoist, have a look."
Hongyi confidently smiled, gently placed the jade box on the table, and pushed it towards Xu Ping.
Seeing this, Xu Ping eagerly reached out to pick up the jade box.
Inside the jade box, a jade-green plant lay quietly.
The plant was about a foot tall, its stem seemingly slender yet subtly exuding a sense of resilience, like the warm glow of jade.
Its nine leaves resembled willow leaves but were broader and thicker, with veins flowing a mystical liquid like dragon saliva.
"So this is the Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom!"
Xu Ping’s eyes sparkled with excitement, and he carefully lifted the lid of the jade box.
At that moment, a faint fragrance spread, intermingled with a subtle, rich and enduring dragon saliva-like aroma.
The instant Xu Ping inhaled this mystical scent, a strong desire, like a tidal wave, surged from the depths of his soul to immediately consume the Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom.
Fortunately, this desire was not as intense as upon smelling millennial Spiritual Liquid.
Moreover, Xu Ping had experienced this before, so he did not show any sign of unusual behavior.
"This Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom is indeed genuine!" Xu Ping pressed down his inner excitement, smiling gently and nodding.
The fact that he reacted this way confirms that this plant is indeed the true and valuable Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom.
"Well... pleasant cooperation." Hongyi smiled.
"Pleasant cooperation."
Xu Ping smiled gently, stored the jade box safely, and then handed over seven talismans infused with Thunder Power to Hongyi.
Purely from a value perspective, the worth of these seven Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans undoubtedly exceeds that of the Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom.
After all, the Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom’s effects are quite singular, primarily used for extending lifespan, and its longevity effect is somewhat inferior to that of millennial Spiritual Liquid.
However, the value gap between the two is not excessively vast, falling within the normal range of value fluctuations in transactions.
Hongyi carefully inspected, confirmed the talismans were correct, and also carefully stowed away the seven Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans.
"If Fellow Daoist Xu succeeds in crafting Third-rank Middle Grade talismans in the future, be sure to notify me at once."

chapters.title: Chapter 321 - 210: Hongyi Arrives, 9-Leaf Dragon Saliva Ganoderma (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 321: Chapter 210: Hongyi Arrives, 9-Leaf Dragon Saliva Ganoderma (Part 3)
"No matter what Fellow Daoist wants, we can always discuss it." Hongyi’s gaze was deep, and his words were quite meaningful.
Xu Ping’s eyes narrowed slightly, but he replied readily, "That’s naturally not a problem. If I do manage to create third-rank middle-grade talismans one day, you’ll be the first to know, Fellow Daoist."
This Hongyi feels nine parts suspicious, unless he surpasses the Golden Core level; otherwise, these third-rank middle-grade talismans certainly won’t be sold to him.
...
...
After the transaction ended, the two chatted casually for a while, and then Hongyi got up to take his leave.
"Take care."
Xu Ping rose to see him out of the pavilion, watching him leave.
"Please stay, Fellow Daoist Xu."
Hongyi politely returned the gesture before summoning a leaf-shaped Spiritual Boat.
As he stepped onto the Spiritual Boat, with the operation of his spiritual power, the boat transformed into a stream of light, speeding towards the horizon, disappearing without a trace in the blink of an eye.
Once Hongyi completely vanished from view, Xu Ping’s expression gradually darkened:
"This Hongyi, after reaching the Golden Core... he’s rather unusual!" Xu Ping thought to himself.
Logically speaking, the other party should have no reason to know about his ability to craft third-rank middle-grade talismans.
However, from the tone in which Hongyi spoke just now, it was clear that he firmly believed Xu Ping could craft third-rank middle-grade talismans.
This was rather bizarre!
But after pondering for quite some time without any leads, he had no choice but to give up for the time being.
"It seems that I must keep my distance from him in the future," Xu Ping silently decided in his heart.
No matter what changes the other party has undergone, staying away from him is undoubtedly the best choice to avoid trouble.
...
...
Meanwhile.
Riding on the Spiritual Boat, a hint of curiosity flashed in Hongyi’s eyes as he whispered to himself:
"Senior Nine Nether, why are you so sure that Fellow Daoist Xu can craft third-rank middle-grade talismans?"
After a moment, an aged and somewhat hoarse voice slowly echoed from within Hongyi’s sea of consciousness:
"There are at least a dozen third-rank middle-grade metal element talismans lying in his Storage Ring."
"For a mere Foundation Establishment cultivator, if he didn’t craft them himself, where else could he get them?"
"A dozen third-rank middle-grade metal element talismans!!"
Hongyi was shocked to his core upon hearing this, his face full of amazement.
Isn’t this number of third-rank middle-grade talismans too exaggerated?
Even an ordinary third-rank middle-grade Talisman Master’s talisman stockpile isn’t nearly this plentiful.
"These many third-rank middle-grade talismans, did Fellow Daoist Xu really draw them?" Hongyi couldn’t believe it, and he couldn’t help but ask again.
"What?"
The aged voice carried a hint of displeasure, "Do you think I would deceive you?"
"Of course not, Senior Nine Nether, you are a Nascent Soul True Monarch overseeing three nations; naturally, you wouldn’t deceive a mere Golden Core Cultivator like me."
Hongyi quickly lowered his head to admit fault, "It’s just that a Foundation Establishment realm cultivator being able to craft third-rank middle-grade talismans is truly beyond shocking and surprising to me."
"Hmph, what can a little Golden Core Cultivator know!" True Monarch Nine Nether mercilessly scoffed.
Then the voice continued, "That youngster, though only in the Foundation Establishment realm, possesses a divine sense incredibly powerful, probably stronger than some Fake Pill cultivators."
"His divine sense is stronger than a Fake Pill cultivator’s?"
Hearing this, Hongyi’s pupils shrank suddenly, nearly blurting out more questions, but he managed to restrain himself at the last moment.
What kind of nonsense is this? His cultivation is only at Foundation Establishment, yet his divine sense is stronger than a Fake Pill cultivator’s?
Then he heard True Monarch Nine Nether continue, "Since that young man can craft third-rank lower-grade talismans at the Foundation Establishment realm, he is likely endowed with a special spirit body related to talisman-making."
"Adding on his extraordinarily formidable divine sense, it isn’t completely impossible for him to craft third-rank middle-grade talismans at his current Foundation Establishment realm."
Listening to Senior Nine Nether’s detailed analysis calmed Hongyi’s emotions gradually.
It seems this Fellow Daoist Xu truly is hiding deeply!
Not only is his divine sense much stronger than a Fake Pill cultivator’s, but he even possesses the ability to craft third-rank middle-grade talismans.
It’s almost like he has no difference from a Golden Core cultivator!
"But Fellow Daoist Xu’s adamance not to sell third-rank middle-grade talismans, could this affect our subsequent plans?"
Once calm, Hongyi queried True Monarch Nine Nether.
"Talismans are only supplementary; without third-rank middle-grade talismans, we can still refine the Talisman Array Plate," True Monarch Nine Nether stated calmly.
"The Talisman Array Plate!"
Upon hearing this, Hongyi’s eyes suddenly brightened.
The Talisman Array Plate is a third-rank magical artifact using talismans that can unleash the power of a talisman array.
If the Talisman Array Plate could indeed be refined, even when wielding third-rank lower-grade talismans, an ordinary early-stage Golden Core cultivator wouldn’t be able to withstand it.
...
...
Soon after Hongyi left, Xu Ping returned to his cultivation chamber.
Once inside, he impatiently retrieved the jade box containing the Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom from his storage bag.
Then, he slowly opened the lid of the jade box.
Instantly, a faint but distinct aroma, rich and long-lasting like dragon saliva, quickly filled the entire cultivation chamber.
"Gulp!"
Xu Ping involuntarily swallowed, suppressing the urge to devour the Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom in one bite.
He then extended his divine sense, carefully examining the Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom.
Recalling Hongyi’s bizarre behavior today, Xu Ping couldn’t help but become vigilant, naturally needing to be extra cautious.
Focusing entirely, Xu Ping meticulously scanned it several times with his divine sense, leaving no detail unchecked.
Fortunately, after a thorough inspection, he found no anomalous signs on the Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom, allowing him to finally breathe a slight sigh of relief.

chapters.title: Chapter 322 - 211: Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill Reaches Minor Achievement, Divine Sense Surges
chapters.content:
Chapter 322: Chapter 211: Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill Reaches Minor Achievement, Divine Sense Surges
"No problem!"
After Xu Ping’s Divine Sense carefully probed and confirmed that there were no anomalies, he finally relaxed.
Xu Ping’s nose lightly twitched as he inhaled the unique fragrance emanating from the Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom, and he couldn’t help but smile.
No longer suppressing his inner desires, he carefully grasped the Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom in his hand, and then took big bites.
The rich juice burst in his mouth, spreading instantly, intoxicating him.
As Xu Ping swallowed one mouthful after another, the Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom entered his stomach and was immediately wrapped tightly by the perpetually circulating Longevity Mana within him, beginning a slow and continuous refining process.
Before long, the Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom transformed into a vigorous and ceaseless stream of Essence power, swiftly merging into his body, nourishing every meridian and organ.
Time quietly slipped away, and several hours passed unnoticed until the Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom was completely absorbed by him.
Xu Ping’s eyes were filled with delight as he eagerly opened his proficiency panel.
[Name: Xu Ping]
[Lifespan: 70/770 years]
[Realm: Late-Stage Foundation Establishment: 75/100; Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill Level One: 1/100]
[Cultivation Technique: Longevity Skill Major Achievement: 1253/1600]
...
"Ninety-two years of extended lifespan, and the proficiency of Longevity Skill also increased by ninety-two points!"
Xu Ping’s gaze was fixed on the data displayed on the panel, his lips involuntarily curving into a smile.
At this moment, his lifespan formally broke through the seven-hundred-year threshold, reaching 770 years!
This longevity far exceeded that of ordinary Golden Core Cultivators.
Moreover, the proficiency of Longevity Skill also successfully surpassed twelve hundred points, just three hundred points shy of the Perfection Level.
"Almost there!"
With this thought, Xu Ping couldn’t help but mutter to himself, a fiery glint of excitement flashing in his eyes.
Once the Longevity Skill reaches Perfection, his own Mana will surely undergo another evolution.
Then, even without relying on third-tier talismans, his real combat power might be able to match against Early-Stage Golden Core Cultivators.
More crucially, the probability of successfully breaking through to the Golden Core Realm will also increase significantly.
"It’s a pity that three-tier lifespan-extending items are truly rare and hard to find."
"Otherwise, if I could find a few more, I might be able to directly elevate the Longevity Skill to the Perfection Level!" Xu Ping gently shook his head, his tone full of regret.
"For Hongyi to easily produce a Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom, he likely has other third-tier lifespan-extending items on him."
A trace of curiosity stirred in his heart.
But the next moment, just as this thought arose, he forcefully suppressed it.
After all, it just requires spending more time.
There’s really no need to provoke Hongyi.
Everything should prioritize caution.
...
...
After Hongyi left, Xu Ping’s life returned to tranquility.
Daily, he practiced swordplay, cultivated, and delved into various magics, filling his schedule to the brim.
Xu Ping had long since adapted to such a tight and intense cultivation rhythm.
What might seem monotonous and arduously tiring to others was, to him, endlessly enjoyable.
Time flows by quietly, and in the blink of an eye, half a year passed.
Ruins Deserted Island.
At this moment, under the grand and solemn steps of an altar.
Hongyi’s face was filled with shock, his eyes fixed on a cauldron floating quietly at the center of the altar.
This cauldron had a unique and distinctive shape, standing about half the height of a person, with a simple yet elegant hue, neither quite gold nor jade.
On its sides, lifelike carvings of Yin and Yang fish swirled together, forming a perfect Taiji diagram from which threads of Yin Yang Qi seeped out, intertwining dreamily.
"Is this the Heaven-Reaching Spiritual Treasure of the senior, the Yin Yang Qi Cauldron?" Hongyi muttered to himself, his face full of awe and reverence.
Even without anyone actively urging this treasure cauldron, the overwhelming majestic aura emanating from it left him shivering in fear, his knees slightly trembling.
Just then, a wisp of elusive spirit emerged from Hongyi’s Sea of Consciousness.
This spirit gradually took form, manifesting as a skeletal old man.
A trace of complex nostalgia appeared in the old man’s hollow eyes as he quietly remarked, "It’s been thousands of years!"
Then, a strand of his Divine Sense extended, reaching towards the Yin Yang Qi Cauldron.
In an instant, a sudden change occurred!
Buzz!
The Yin Yang Qi Cauldron abruptly tremored without warning, emitting a low hum.
Immediately after, strands of Yin Yang Qi spread like raging waves, sweeping outwards in an overwhelming tide.
Below the altar, Hongyi, in the line of fire, felt as though the sky was collapsing and the earth was falling.
The oncoming Yin Yang Qi, carrying a world-destroying power, turned his face ghostly pale.
His body shook uncontrollably, his legs weakened, nearly causing him to kneel outright.
"Nine... Nine Nether Senior!"
Hongyi was utterly terrified, his teeth chattering, uttering the words with difficulty through clenched jaws.
"Weakling!"
The skeletal old man cast a disdainful glance at Hongyi before swiftly withdrawing his Divine Sense.
As the old man’s Divine Sense retreated, the Yin Yang Qi Cauldron quickly returned to stillness.
The Yin Yang Qi that had just raged and pervaded the surroundings vanished without a trace, as though nothing had ever happened.
"Huff, huff, huff..."
With the pressure abruptly gone, Hongyi gasped for breath, the fear on his face lingering for a long time.

chapters.title: Chapter 323 - 211: Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill Breaks Through to Minor Achievement, Divine Sense Soars (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 323: Chapter 211: Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill Breaks Through to Minor Achievement, Divine Sense Soars (Part 2)
Recalling the terrifying power the Yin Yang Qi Cauldron just displayed, he was still shaken.
This Yin Yang Qi Cauldron was truly too horrifying, with just a slight activation, it displayed such astonishing might.
He simply dared not imagine, if this precious cauldron were fully activated, what kind of earth-shattering, terrifying scene it would be.
In front of the Yin Yang Qi Cauldron, he felt as insignificant as an ant.
"Nine Nether Elder, would there be unforeseen consequences if Feng Country’s Nascent Soul cultivator acquires the Yin Yang Qi Cauldron?"
Once his mood calmed slightly, a deep worry surged again in Hongyi’s heart.
A Nascent Soul cultivator wielding a Heaven-Reaching Spiritual Treasure, is this combination really something they can easily calculate?
"What’s there to fear?"
The skinny old man sneered disdainfully, his tone full of contempt, "It’s merely a mere Early-Stage Nascent Soul cultivator."
’Merely a mere Early-Stage Nascent Soul cultivator?’
Upon hearing this, Hongyi’s mouth twitched fiercely.
He opened his mouth, initially wanting to retort a few words, but swallowed them back forcibly, eventually closing his mouth silently.
If he spoke, he feared he would inevitably be scolded by the Nine Nether Elder again.
Moreover, what they were secretly plotting this time was not just dealing with Feng Country’s one Nascent Soul cultivator, there were indeed too many unforeseen events and variables.
This truly left him filled with worry.
But now, the arrow was already on the bow, there was no choice but to continue.
...
...
A month’s time, like a fleeting moment, silently slipped through the fingers.
Thousand Leaves Mountain, inside the serene cultivation room.
Xu Ping closed his eyes, his aura restrained, deeply immersed in a deep state of cultivation.
Suddenly!
A majestic and unstoppable Divine Sense, like a torrential flood, erupted from Xu Ping’s Sea of Consciousness.
This overwhelming Divine Sense engulfed the entire cultivation room with a mountain-crushing force.
Whish!
This potent Divine Sense seemed tangible, reverberating freely in the void, creating ripples visible to the naked eye.
These ripples, like lively waves, spread circle by circle, easily breaking through the solid array covering the cultivation room and reverberating to every corner of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
At this moment, the Water Lake Mouse busy in the spirit field felt a chill approach.
It suddenly turned to look towards the cultivation room, its mouse face full of shock:
"This... Is this the owner’s Divine Sense? How did it become so powerful?"
Fortunately, this powerful Divine Sense wave lasted only for a very brief moment, then suddenly subsided like receding tides.
Inside the cultivation room.
Sitting cross-legged on the stone bed, Xu Ping slowly opened his eyes.
At this moment, his gaze revealed uncontrollable excitement, his mouth curling into a smile:
"Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill... Finally broke through!"
His gaze fell on the familiar panel.
[Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill Minor Achievement: 1/800]
...
"Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill... Finally broke through to the Minor Achievement level."
Looking at the clear display on the panel, Xu Ping’s smile became more pronounced.
His Divine Sense had already been stronger than an average Foundation Establishment cultivator, having significant advantages when cultivating ’Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill’, and with the attribute panel’s assistance, the progress was so swift.
Xu Ping closed his eyes again, calming his mind, starting to thoroughly perceive the significant changes in his Sea of Consciousness and Divine Sense.
Firstly, he clearly perceived that now his Sea of Consciousness had greatly improved in both toughness and breadth.
The improvement was immensely significant, without exaggeration.
Currently, his Sea of Consciousness was stronger and steadier than that of an Early-Stage Golden Core cultivator.
Besides that, the most notable improvement was undoubtedly in his Divine Sense.
Xu Ping’s Divine Sense extended outward, effortlessly breaking through the array covering the cultivation room and spreading across the entire Thousand Leaves Mountain.
It’s important to know, the Thousand Leaves Mountain was equipped with a dual internal and external array, their cooperation made it difficult for even a Fake Pill cultivator’s Divine Sense to penetrate.
Yet Xu Ping accomplished it so easily.
Though the internal breakthrough might be relatively easier, one cannot deny the strength of his Divine Sense now.
"With my current Divine Sense strength, it shouldn’t be inferior to an Early-Stage Golden Core cultivator!" Xu Ping retracted his Divine Sense, excitedly speaking to himself.
The Divine Sense strength of a Foundation Establishment cultivator comparable to a Golden Core.
If those high Nascent Soul masters knew, they would probably be shocked.
Furthermore, this was merely the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill breaking through Minor Achievement.
Once the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill was cultivated to Perfection, at that time his Divine Sense might not be inferior to an ordinary Middle Stage Golden Core cultivator.
...
"With the Divine Sense surge, today I’ll take a day off."
Xu Ping slowly rose, stretched comfortably, loosening his slightly stiff body after prolonged cultivation, he immediately walked out of the cultivation room.
After all, having cultivated diligently for so long, he indeed deserved a day off.
Under the array-covered peak of Thousand Leaves Mountain, it’s warm and pleasant like spring throughout the seasons.
A gentle breeze blew by, bringing fresh air, refreshing the mind.
Xu Ping stepped out of the cave abode.
At first glance, he felt delighted.
The greenness and vibrant reds of the mountain surrounded him, the unique fragrance of spirit medicine and spirit plants permeating all of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
At this moment, the Water Lake Mouse was performing spirit rain irrigation on spirit medicine at a piece of herbal field, under the pitter-patter of spirit rain irrigation, spirit medicine became greener.

chapters.title: Chapter 324 - 211: Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill Breaks Through to Minor Achievement, Divine Sense Soars (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 324: Chapter 211: Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill Breaks Through to Minor Achievement, Divine Sense Soars (Part 3)
Xu Ping arrived beneath the lush Hundred Bamboo Wood.
He lightly leaped and lay down on a flat stone slab, his eyes slightly closed, entering a state of pretended slumber.
A look of utmost contentment on his face.
...
...
At the same time.
Ruins Deserted Island.
Boom!
Accompanied by a thunderous roar, a stream of light shot out desperately from the depths of the deserted island.
Enclosed within that stream was a young man emitting the aura of a Nascent Soul Cultivator.
At this moment, his face was as pale as paper, devoid of any color, with a trace of black blood at the corner of his mouth, and his breath was chaotic—all evident of his severe injuries.
Behind him, at the entrance of the deserted island, Spiritual Power surged, and the space distorted.
Moments later, two additional Nascent Soul Cultivators emerged like phantoms in pursuit.
One was tall and burly, clad in a crimson robe, his face covered in rough flesh, with icy glints in his eyes; he was none other than Wan Ming, a Nascent Soul Cultivator from Hu Country.
The other, a middle-aged man with a slim build and three wisps of long beard, was Jiang Jingxing, Sect Leader of Luoyun Sect.
"Master Xuanfeng, hand over the Yin Yang Qi Cauldron! You are already severely injured and cannot take it away!"
Wan Ming roared, his voice echoing in the air like a bell, causing the surrounding air to hum.
"Destroy!"
With a loud shout, Wan Ming swung the iron fan in his hand, and the bluish flame, like a roaring dragon, surged towards Master Xuanfeng with boundless power.
Upon seeing this scene, Master Xuanfeng gritted his teeth and summoned his spirit treasure, the Profound Ice Mirror, which he had nurtured for many years.
The moment the Profound Ice Mirror appeared, it emanated a bone-chilling aura, instantly freezing the surrounding water vapor and creating a world of translucent ice crystals.
Boom!
The bluish flame and the Profound Ice Mirror collided, unleashing a thunderous explosion.
At that moment, it seemed as if the entire world trembled; the intense light was blinding and unbearable to look at.
The violent energy flow spread out like a surging tsunami, distorting the surrounding space as if it might collapse at any moment.
However, although Master Xuanfeng had successfully blocked Wan Ming’s fierce blow with the Profound Ice Mirror, it caused him to lose a precious moment.
In that fleeting instant, Jiang Jingxing had closed in.
"Slash!"
Jiang Jingxing’s Mana surged around him like a tidal wave, and with a slight move of his finger, a gigantic purple sword, hundreds of feet tall, appeared out of thin air.
The giant sword emitted an aura so fierce it was terrifying, and with a momentum capable of cleaving heaven and earth, it aimed fiercely at Master Xuanfeng.
Facing the perilous situation of being attacked from both sides, Master Xuanfeng’s expression turned grim.
His cultivation was initially deeper than the other two, and during the struggle for the Yin Yang Qi Cauldron, he had the advantage all along.
But who would have guessed that the Yin Yang Qi Cauldron would suddenly unleash its power without his detecting, striking him heavily.
If not for that, even against two, he certainly wouldn’t have ended up in such a dire state.
Hatred surged within Master Xuanfeng’s heart, yet he understood the urgency of the situation.
He gritted his teeth, forcefully swung his sleeve, and a sudden dazzling radiance erupted.
In an instant, several high-grade magical artifacts appeared in midair.
"Explode!"
Master Xuanfeng softly uttered.
In an instant, the magical artifacts simultaneously self-destructed.
Boom!!
A series of deafening explosions sounded.
The terrifying impact from the self-destruction of the magical artifacts swept towards Wan Ming and Jiang Jingxing like an overwhelming tidal wave.
The dazzling light immediately illuminated the entire sky above the Ruins Deserted Island, and the tremendous roar caused rocks to roll down the island and the sea to rise in gigantic waves dozens of feet high.
Wan Ming and Jiang Jingxing’s expressions changed slightly, as they continuously deployed techniques to resist.
Meanwhile, taking advantage of this gap, Master Xuanfeng transformed into a flash of blood light and fled into the distance.
After Wan Ming and Jiang Jingxing had resisted the power of the self-explosive artifacts, they exchanged a glance and chased after without hesitation.
Though deep-seated grudges existed between them, they had to join forces for the sake of the Yin Qi and Qi Cauldron.
...
...
Early the next day.
Gong Yang and Duan Shuang both visited, bringing with them earth-shattering news.
"Is this true!!"
Upon hearing their account, Xu Ping couldn’t help but reveal a hint of surprise, a slight ripple in his previously composed gaze.
"It’s absolutely true. By now, the entire Yue Country is probably abuzz with the news!" Gong Yang nodded solemnly, his expression unusually grave.
With that, he sighed lightly, exclaiming, "Who could have imagined that the Supreme Elder of the Profound Nether Sect, Profound Wind True Monarch, would be besieged by Wan Ming from Hu Country and Jiang Jingxing, Sect Leader of Luoyun Sect.
"In the end, he met a tragic end with his physical form destroyed, now left only with a Nascent Soul to barely escape.
"To think he was at the peak of Early-Stage Nascent Soul, originally the most profound in cultivation among the three of them."
Gong Yang spoke while lightly shaking his head, his eyes full of lament.
"Indeed!"
Duan Shuang’s beautiful eyes also carried a deep surprise, quickly nodding in agreement, "And who knows what kind of upheaval occurred within it."
When she heard this news, she was stunned for quite a while.
After all, this involved a Nascent Soul True Monarch!
An existence akin to an Immortal among the Three Kingdoms.
"The reasons within this matter clearly aren’t something we can easily comprehend."
Xu Ping slightly lowered his head, contemplating silently before shaking it calmly.
As far as he was concerned, as long as these events did not have a substantial impact on him, he had little interest in investigating further.
After all, the collapse and severe injury of Master Xuanfeng’s physical form were likely to cause major upheavals in Feng Country, but to him personally, the impact was negligible.
"That much is true."
Gong Yang nodded in agreement, then shifted the topic, continuing,
"However, with Profound Wind True Monarch severely injured, only the Nascent Soul remains, and even if he were to seize another body, retaining thirty to forty percent of his power would be highly fortunate."
"Moreover, with the Heaven-Reaching Spiritual Treasure, the Yin Yang Qi Cauldron, in his possession, True Monarch Wan Ming and Luoyun Sect definitely will not let it go easily."
"There is bound to be significant upheaval in the Three Kingdoms of Yue, Hu, and Feng next!"
As he spoke, Gong Yang’s eyes flickered involuntarily.
Beside him, when Duan Shuang heard these words, her elegant brows raised slightly as she fell into contemplation, becoming somewhat lost in thought.
In contrast, Xu Ping remained completely calm, without any waves of emotion.
He was naturally quite clear about everything Gong Yang spoke of.
However, it simply wasn’t his business.
As long as it didn’t affect him, there was no need to pay further attention.

chapters.title: Chapter 325 - 212: The Expeditionary Army
chapters.content:
Chapter 325: Chapter 212: The Expeditionary Army
"What is it?"
Noticing the interest on their faces, Xu Ping gently sipped the Spirit Tea, the steam swirling around him, and slowly asked.
"Are the two Fellow Daoists particularly intrigued by this?"
Upon hearing these words, both of them were silent for a moment.
Afterward, Gong Yang’s expression turned grave, and he slowly said, "The current political turmoil among the three countries is indeed an extraordinary opportunity for us."
Beside him, Duan Shuang did not speak, but her beautiful eyes subtly revealed an undeniable firmness.
"It is indeed an excellent opportunity, yet the level of danger involved is beyond imagination!" Xu Ping nodded slightly, agreeing.
He was not at all surprised by their reaction.
After all, Duan Shuang had already successfully broken through to the Late-Stage Foundation Establishment Realm, and Gong Yang was only one step away from Foundation Establishment Perfection.
Although they had gained numerous opportunities on this Ruins Deserted Island.
Based on their own talents and accumulated foundations, the chance to break through to the Golden Core Realm still seemed very slim.
Take Duan Shuang, for instance.
She was born with a Pure Yin Body, giving her slightly better chances for a breakthrough to the Golden Core compared to Gong Yang.
But this is merely relative.
Without any rare Spiritual Objects to assist in Core Formation.
The probability of her succeeding in the breakthrough would be incredibly fortunate to reach even one percent.
If they don’t exhaust every effort to strive for various opportunities, this Foundation Establishment Realm might very well be the end of their cultivation path.
"We cultivators are meant to defy destiny!"
Duan Shuang’s lips slightly curled into a gentle yet resolute smile, her words filled with determination.
Her Dao heart has never wavered.
Either she completely controls her own destiny, advancing fearlessly on the path of cultivation; or she accepts the fate of demise calmly, without regret.
"Ultimately, it depends on what decisions the high-ranking officials of Yue and Hu countries will make."
After pondering for a moment, Gong Yang added.
After all, as cultivators at the Foundation Establishment Stage, they have no power to decide the course of such significant affairs.
They can only go with the flow, hoping to find a chance to benefit amidst the shifting tides.
"It should be soon."
Xu Ping furrowed his brow slightly, and after a moment of contemplation, he spoke slowly, "Luoyun Sect and Myriad Phenomena Sect will certainly not give Master Xuanfeng a chance to restore his strength. They will take action within a few days."
Currently, Master Xuanfeng, the Supreme Elder of the Profound Nether Sect, has suffered severe injuries, his physical body has collapsed, leaving only his Nascent Soul intact, causing his strength to plummet.
Moreover, Feng Country no longer has other Nascent Soul Stage cultivators to hold the fort.
They definitely can’t withstand the combined force of Wan Ming and Jiang Jingxing, these two Nascent Soul masters.
No matter how much they rely on the Array, it can’t prolong their survival for long.
For the numerous Loose Cultivators in Yue and Hu countries and other forces, this rare opportunity won’t be easily missed.
After all, plundering is always the fastest way to accumulate capital.
As the invaders, if they succeed, they might accumulate wealth equivalent to several lifetimes.
...
...
Two days later.
As expected by Xu Ping, the situation unfolded.
Myriad Phenomena Sect and Luoyun Sect openly announced their alliance, planning a two-pronged attack to encircle Feng Country.
Furthermore, the two sects widely issued notices, inviting cultivators from all directions to join this punitive expedition.
As soon as this news spread, it instantly ignited the fervor among cultivators from Yue and Hu countries.
Countless cultivators responded eagerly, without hesitation throwing themselves into the punitive army.
Each of them was eagerly preparing, their eyes shining with greed, eagerly awaiting the chance to take a big bite out of the "fat meat" of Feng Country.
Of course, Duan Shuang and Gong Yang were among them.
At Thousand Leaves Mountain, in the cool pavilion.
"Since both Fellow Daoists have decided to join the punitive army, I sincerely wish you a smooth journey and a fruitful return!" Xu Ping clasped his hands and said.
He clearly knew that if they only intended to profit a bit from the opportunity to conquer Feng Country, the dangers were relatively controllable.
But if they fancied seizing the elusive opportunities for Core Formation amidst this chaos, it would be extremely perilous, almost a matter of life and death.
After all, in this conflict, not only must they defend against the resistance of the local cultivators in Feng Country, but they must also remain constantly vigilant against the schemes from fellow cultivators of Yue and Hu countries.
"Thank you for your kind words!" Duan Shuang and Gong Yang both grinned and returned the courtesy.
Seeing this, Xu Ping did not say much more.
After all, having grown from First Rank Loose Cultivators to their current Late-Stage Foundation Establishment Stage, they must have gained rich experience and naturally did not need his reminders.
"These two Third-rank Lower Grade Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans are a token of my goodwill, I hope the two Fellow Daoists will accept them."
Xu Ping took out two Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans and handed them to Duan Shuang and Gong Yang.
They had been friends for decades, and he truly did not wish for them to never return.
Besides, now the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman was no longer something too precious to him.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Xu *2!"
Duan Shuang and Gong Yang’s faces shone with surprise, a hint of uncontrollable excitement crossing their eyes, and they thanked him sincerely.
In truth, their visit was partly to say farewell to Xu Ping but mainly for the talismans.
Especially for the top-notch Second-stage talismans.
As for Third-rank talismans, they are precious items even for Golden Core cultivators.
The two of them knew their place, and naturally did not dare to hope for such treasures.

chapters.title: Chapter 326 - 212: Crusade Army (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 326: Chapter 212: Crusade Army (2)
To their great surprise, Xu Ping was so generous and straightforward, gifting each of them a third-rank talisman.
This unexpected generous gift was undoubtedly a favor as weighty as Mount Tai for them.
"We three have known each other for decades, the friendship runs deep; there’s no need to be so formal and polite,"
Xu Ping smiled and waved his hand, then added, "However, I do hope that the two fellow Daoists can help me gather various longevity materials, the higher the grade, the better."
"That’s naturally not a problem." The two nodded without hesitation.
Feng Country is vast and has abundant resources, surely better than the resources within the Nine Nether ruins.
As they invade Feng Country, they will have chances to acquire all sorts of resources; collecting some high-grade longevity materials should not be impossible.
...
...
Two days after Duan Shuang and Gong Yang left, people from the Luoyun Sect came to purchase third-rank talismans.
The person who came was a cultured middle-aged fake pill cultivator.
He was dressed in a light blue robe and wore a black square cap, exuding the demeanor of a literati in his gestures.
"I am Wang Jingxuan, I’ve long admired Fellow Daoist Xu’s reputation." The cultured middle-aged man smiled politely and bowed with clasped hands.
"Elder Wang, you’re too kind." Xu Ping returned the courtesy with a smile, showing modesty and manners.
Before his arrival, he had used a super long-distance sound transmission talisman to contact Xu Ping, and they briefly discussed the transaction details.
"Elder Wang, the journey must have been tiring; how about we rest for a moment at the pavilion?" Xu Ping warmly invited.
"That sounds good." Wang Jingxuan smiled and nodded in agreement.
Then, led by Xu Ping, they both went to the pavilion on Thousand Leaves Mountain.
In the pavilion, the fragrance of tea lingered.
Xu Ping personally poured a cup of spirit tea for Wang Jingxuan—the tea was clear, and the Spiritual Qi was prevailing, indicating it was not an ordinary product.
"Elder He hasn’t come this time; is it because he’s also going to attack Feng Country?"
During their chat, Xu Ping seemingly casually brought up He Chen.
"He’s not going." Wang Jingxuan was entirely unguarded and without hesitation disclosed He Chen’s whereabouts,
"He has been tasked by the sect to guard Wanfeng Market."
"Wanfeng Market..." Xu Ping slightly lowered his head, his lips subtly moving as if murmuring to himself.
A trace of an imperceptible cold light flashed in his eyes.
He had not forgotten He Chen scheming against him.
He Chen plotting and calculating against him was something he always kept in mind and never forgot for a moment.
In his heart, such a life-and-death enmity could only be resolved by completely eliminating the opponent to quench his hatred.
However, to avoid arousing Wang Jingxuan’s suspicion, Xu Ping did not continue this topic and instead turned to the matter of their transaction.
"Elder Wang, the five Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans and two third-rank lower-grade Breaking Charms needed by your sect!"
Xu Ping gently placed two jade boxes on the table and then pushed them towards Wang Jingxuan.
Seeing this, Wang Jingxuan lightly flicked his sleeve, and with a crisp "snap," the two jade boxes opened automatically.
Inside those two jade boxes, several talismans lay quietly, the runes on the talismans flickering with a subtle spiritual light.
Wang Jingxuan slightly squinted his eyes, a wisp of Divine Sense stretched out like a thread, carefully inspecting the talismans in the jade boxes.
A moment later, he nodded in satisfaction, smiling: "The quantity and quality are all correct."
After speaking, he likewise took out two jade boxes from his storage ring.
One jade box contained a Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom, while the other housed a piece of third-rank mid-grade Spirit Wood.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, have a look." Wang Jingxuan smiled as he handed the two jade boxes to Xu Ping.
Xu Ping took the boxes, checked them slightly to confirm their authenticity.
The Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom and the piece of third-rank mid-grade Spirit Wood were roughly equivalent in value to his talismans.
It belonged to a state where neither party suffered a loss.
After confirming everything was correct, the two parties smoothly completed the transaction.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, I have sect affairs to attend to and must return to report immediately, so I’ll take my leave."
After properly storing the jade boxes obtained from the transaction, Wang Jingxuan got up and said goodbye to Xu Ping.
"Elder Wang, take care."
Xu Ping courteously replied, personally seeing him out of the pavilion and standing there as he watched Wang Jingxuan’s figure gradually disappear into the distance.
...
Once Wang Jingxuan had completely vanished from the horizon, Xu Ping turned back to his cultivation room.
Inside the cultivation room, it was silent, the air filled with an extremely dense Spiritual Qi.
Xu Ping opened the jade box containing the Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom.
In an instant.
The unique rich fragrance of the Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom spread instantly, filling the entire cultivation room.
However, for Xu Ping, since he had already consumed it once, the allure of the Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom had greatly diminished.
Of course, it’s still a matter of medicinal effect!
If it were replaced by thousand-year Spiritual Liquid, even after consuming it once, the allure would absolutely not be small.
Actually, Xu Ping wanted to ask if Luoyun Sect had thousand-year Spiritual Liquid for sale, but ultimately he abandoned that idea.
He feared Luoyun Sect would suspect that the person who purchased the thousand-year Spiritual Liquid at the auction last time was him.
Although there was no evidence, suspicion alone was enough for these grand sects.
For Xu Ping, although thousand-year Spiritual Liquid was extremely precious, it was not worth taking such risks.
"Phew!"
Xu Ping took a deep breath, suppressed his thoughts, took the Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom, bit into it a few times, and swallowed it.
Then, he sat cross-legged on the bed, silently operating the Longevity Skill to refine its medicinal power.

chapters.title: Chapter 327 - 212: Crusade Army (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 327: Chapter 212: Crusade Army (Part 3)
After several hours, Xu Ping opened his eyes, a hint of joy flashing in them.
"Not bad at all!"
Xu Ping smiled at the corner of his mouth, "I gained fifty-eight years of longevity, and the proficiency of the Longevity Skill also increased by fifty-eight points."
He was very satisfied with the results from taking the Nine-leaf Dragon Saliva Mushroom for the second time.
After this consumption, his lifespan had successfully surpassed eight hundred years.
The gap between him and the Nascent Soul cultivator’s long lifespan was getting smaller and smaller.
Xu Ping adjusted his breath slightly, letting the spiritual power within him flow more smoothly, then ended his cultivation session.
He slowly got up and walked out of the cultivation chamber.
The lush green of the mountains greeted his eyes, a scene full of vitality.
However, at this moment, Xu Ping’s mind was not on the beautiful scenery; instead, thoughts of Yue and Hu countries’ expedition against Feng Country involuntarily occupied his mind.
"This time, in the campaign against Feng Country, Yue and Hu countries will definitely go all out, dispatching a large amount of elite forces."
"In this way, the defense within their sects will significantly weaken."
Xu Ping pondered as he paced back and forth, "This is an excellent opportunity, a heaven-sent chance to kill He Chen."
Currently, He Chen had been sent to guard the Wanfeng Market and was not within the Luoyun Sect.
Given his strength and disguise abilities, as long as he is willing to spend some time, he should be able to kill him.
"However, this matter should not be rushed."
Xu Ping frowned slightly, weighing the pros and cons in his mind, "It’s not too late to plan carefully once the three countries are in full confrontation and the situation becomes clearer."
"For now, it’s best to first explore the Spirit Void Peak."
After some thought, Xu Ping quickly decided on his next course of action.
This campaign against Feng Country would certainly involve the Hundred Beasts Sect sending people there, and given how much time has passed, right now is indeed the best time to explore Spirit Void Peak.
Moreover, after spending so much time with the Spirit Worm and communicating, he roughly figured out what the good thing it mentioned was.
A peculiar plant that resides in magma, resembling a lotus root.
According to the Spirit Worm, its intelligence surged after consuming one of its seeds.
Thus, the target range is greatly narrowed down.
