Xu Ping speculated that the spiritual object was either the legendary ’Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus’ or the even rarer ’Fusion Spirit Wise Heart Lotus.’
Other unfamiliar treasures of heaven and earth are relatively less likely.
Even though the specific spiritual object cannot be determined.
While he cannot yet ascertain exactly what this spiritual object is.
Just the potential existence of the ’Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus’ or the ’Fusion Spirit Wise Heart Lotus’ makes Spirit Void Peak a spot worth visiting.
After all, taking the former would enable Demon Beasts to awaken their intelligence.
It would make their once chaotic thoughts clear, allowing them to understand human language and complex matters, accelerating their evolution process.
For cultivators who consume it, their thinking becomes extremely active in a short time, greatly increasing their comprehension.
Whether it is to understand cultivation techniques or grasp Heaven and Earth Laws, the results can be achieved with half the effort.
As for the latter, its effects are even more heaven-defying.
Once a Demon Beast swallows it, their intelligence leaps to new heights.
Not only can they learn simple magic skills, but they can also gain a deeper understanding and utilization of their innate divine ability.
If a cultivator consumes it, it will permanently enhance their comprehension.
"Let’s hope it’s the latter!"
At this thought, a streak of excitement flickered in Xu Ping’s eyes.
If it is truly the ’Fusion Spirit Wise Heart Lotus,’ it will greatly benefit his future cultivation path.
Heaven-defying comprehension, coupled with the proficiency panel.
This combination is unimaginable, with no limits in sight.
Divinity Transformation?
Void Refinement?
....
Or even... becoming an Immortal!
An endless stream of fantasies surged in Xu Ping’s heart.
However, if it’s the ’Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus,’ that’s not bad either.
It can enhance comprehension in a short period, working in tandem with the proficiency panel, creating an excellent combination.
It can greatly assist in increasing the power and proficiency of various spells.
As for the group of fierce things the Spirit Worm mentioned, Xu Ping had not yet figured out what they were.
He only roughly knew they were Demon Beasts resembling Fire Mosquitoes.
Just as the Spirit Worm mentioned a group of fierce things, Xu Ping still hadn’t fully understood what exactly they were.
He only roughly knew it was a group of Demon Beasts resembling Fire Mosquitoes.
But with his current strength and methods, Xu Ping believed handling them should not pose a major problem.
...
...
Half a month later.
In the Cultivation Realm of Yue Country, the five major sects, led by the Luoyun Sect, organized a massive army of tens of thousands of cultivators to officially launch an expedition against Feng Country.
The cultivator army, with late-stage Qi Cultivators as soldiers, Foundation Establishment Stage as backbone, and Core Formation cultivators as high-level combat power, set out from the northern lands, essentially stabbing towards Feng Country’s back!
The army assembled by Hu Country attacked from the south, forming a front and back pincer attack between the two countries.
From a strategic perspective, the pincer attack by the two countries is undoubtedly the best choice.
Among the three countries, Feng Country is vast and resource-rich, with a more ancient cultivation civilization.
Yue Country and Hu Country are relatively backward.
This opportunity is excellent, and if they can seize the rich resources and foundational heritage of the powerful cultivation country, it will undoubtedly be a blessing far outweighing the drawbacks for the Cultivation Realm of Yue Country.
...
Under the leadership of Nascent Soul cultivators, the Yue Country’s cultivator army surged forward like a torrential wave, entering Feng Country’s borderlands mightily.
They moved with unstoppable momentum, obliterating countless cultivation clans and small sects in the storm of this war.
Their ultimate target was none other than the Profound Nether Sect.
However, as the Yue Country sects advanced triumphantly on the Feng Country battlefield.
The internal affairs of Yue Country were not so stable.
As the sects dispatched a large amount of manpower to the Feng Country battlefield, it distracted their attention.
Some fugitives, normally deterred by the sects and not daring to emerge, as well as various spirits and demons, began to stir.
However, all this turmoil and conflict were as distant as the clouds for Xu Ping, unrelated to him.
Two months after the Yue Country’s cultivator army set off, Xu Ping quietly made his way to Spirit Void Peak, taking advantage of the major sects being too preoccupied to pay attention to him.
And as he expected, there were not many people stationed there, just a few Qi Refinement disciples from the Hundred Beasts Sect.
With their meager strength, noticing Xu Ping’s presence was nothing short of a fairy tale.
On a small hill on Spirit Void Peak, a gentle breeze blew, rustling the surrounding grass and trees.
"Where is the good thing you mentioned?"
Xu Ping leaned slightly forward, turning his head to look at the Spirit Worm lying on the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 328 - 113: Lava World, Top-Tier Spiritual Material Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree
chapters.content:
Chapter 328: Chapter 113: Lava World, Top-Tier Spiritual Material Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree
The Spirit Worm slightly shook its head after hearing Xu Ping’s inquiry, as if pondering for a moment.
"Hiss hiss!"
Then, it let out a unique hissing sound while swaying its body, indicating for Xu Ping to follow it.
If it were alone, it could simply travel underground directly.
But with Xu Ping, it could only take the conventional route.
As soon as the words fell, the Spirit Worm’s body suddenly moved, darting forward like an arrow released from a bow.
Xu Ping maintained a calm demeanor, unhurriedly following behind, as they made their way through the lush forests of Spirit Void Peak.
Before long, the person and beast arrived at an extremely secluded spot on Spirit Void Peak.
A pitch-black cave was hidden beneath the mountain wall.
The entrance was half-covered with tangled vines and wild grass, so unless closely examined, it was hard to discover this hidden wonder.
"Squeak squeak!"
Just as the duo stepped into the cave, a large swarm of bats rushed out from the depths of the cavern with a fierce roar.
These bats were so dense, they blotted out the sun.
If an ordinary person, or even a regular Qi Cultivator, were to find themselves here, they would likely be frightened and lose their composure at such an unexpected and magnificent scene.
However, for Xu Ping, who possessed a powerful Divine Sense, the scene was anticipated and naturally did not faze him.
"Hiss!"
Seeing this, the Spirit Worm let out a low growl, and the powerful aura of a Second-stage Demon Beast began to subtly emanate from its body.
This aura was like a tangible pressure, spreading through the entire cave like a tidal wave.
Swish swish!
The bats, which could barely be considered First Rank Lower Grade Demon Beasts at best, were intimidated by the powerful aura of the Second-stage Demon Beast.
Instantly, like raindrops, they fell from the sky, crashing heavily onto the ground with a dense, chaotic clatter.
After easily dealing with these bats, the duo wasted no time and continued deeper into the cave.
With the Spirit Worm, a Second-stage Demon Beast familiar with the terrain leading the way, the journey proceeded more smoothly than expected.
Several hours passed quietly.
In the deep, dark cave ahead, a faint glimmer of light suddenly appeared.
At the same time, waves of intense heat surged down the tunnel, as if trying to consume everything.
As their steps gradually closed the distance, the light grew brighter, and the rushing heat waves hit them like turbulent tides.
Finally, Xu Ping passed through the narrow, winding passage, and the scene before him instantly became open and clear.
What unfolded before him was a vast, unimaginably wide underground lava world.
Blazing lava churned and surged in the enormous subterranean space, producing a "gurgling" sound, reminiscent of the low growl of slumbering giant beasts.
The lava emitted a dazzling red light, illuminating the entire space like a sea of fire.
Occasionally, scalding fragments of rock would fall from above, striking the lava and sending tall sparks flying.
The surrounding cave walls were scorched red by the high temperatures, their textures distorted.
...
Xu Ping stood quietly on the edge of this lava world, genuinely feeling the onslaught of heat waves.
This ferocious heat was so extreme that ordinary Qi Cultivators would likely be reduced to charcoal in an instant if they existed here.
Xu Ping couldn’t help but show a hint of shock on his face: "This is probably no ordinary lava world!"
It’s known that ordinary underground lava doesn’t come close to having such terrifying high temperatures.
Even with his current physical constitution, crossing this lava world would likely consume considerable Mana and stamina.
Xu Ping extended his Divine Sense, but to his astonishment, in this bizarre subterranean world...
His Divine Sense was compressed to a terrifying degree.
In an instant, alarm bells rang in Xu Ping’s heart.
It’s known that his Divine Sense, comparable to that of a Golden Core Cultivator, is one of his strongest assets, yet now it was so severely suppressed.
This undoubtedly made him more certain that this lava world before him wasn’t simple.
Moreover, this lava world was deeply hidden at least ten thousand feet underground.
Without definite clues, even Golden Core Cultivators with extensive Divine Techniques would find it challenging to discover its trace.
Thinking of this, Xu Ping’s expression changed unpredictably, and a wave of hesitation surged in his heart.
But after careful consideration, he finally decided to delve deeper into this lava world to explore.
After all, the Spirit Worm had been traveling back and forth in this magma world for a long time and was still alive and well.
From this, it could be deduced that even if there was danger here, it was probably within a tolerable range.
If something truly untoward happened, at worst, he could withdraw swiftly.
With his current strength, unless he encountered a Late-Stage Golden Core or above Great Cultivator, escaping wouldn’t be difficult.
Decision made, Xu Ping turned to look at the Spirit Worm lying on the ground, decisively instructing:
"Carry me."
The Spirit Worm not only had thick skin but also had a high resistance to the Fire Attribute, allowing it to move freely in this perilous lava as if walking on flat ground.
With it carrying him, the journey would undoubtedly be much easier.
"Hiss hiss!"
The Spirit Worm responded with a cry, slowly crawling under Xu Ping’s feet with its massive body.
Xu Ping lightly leapt and steadily landed on the Spirit Worm’s back.
"Let’s go!"
Xu Ping, looking at the infinite lava world in front, ordered again.
"Hiss hiss!"
Following the command, the Spirit Worm’s body flashed like lightning, instantly dashing into the churning lava.

chapters.title: Chapter 329 - 113: Lava World, Top-Tier Spiritual Material Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree
chapters.content:
Chapter 329: Chapter 113: Lava World, Top-Tier Spiritual Material Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree
Xu Ping stood on the broad back of the Spirit Worm, feeling the seething lava around him, with hot air rushing towards him, as if the space itself were being roasted and distorted.
The massive body of the Spirit Worm moved agilely through the magma, where its path caused the lava to be pushed aside, forming waves of hot molten rock.
"Roar!"
Perhaps the commotion caused by the Spirit Worm as it traversed the magma alarmed the demon beasts residing within it.
Or perhaps it was due to some other unknown reasons, at this moment, waves of deafening beast roars echoed from afar.
At this moment, waves of beast roars came from afar.
A hint of vigilance immediately surged in Xu Ping’s heart, and he scanned all directions with his Divine Sense, constantly observing the movements around him.
Fortunately, despite the continuous beast roars, no demon beast rashly launched an attack against them.
However, Xu Ping did not relax his vigilance in the slightest, still constantly observing the movements around him.
The Spirit Worm steadily carried Xu Ping further into this scalding world of magma.
Suddenly, a vast cluster of black reefs appeared in his field of vision ahead.
These reefs were of varied shapes, densely covered with bizarre patterns on their surfaces, which, at first glance, seemed to have been formed by lava.
However, through Xu Ping’s Divine Sense sweep.
He discovered that this seemingly tranquil reef group was actually a swarm of demon beasts, silently lurking among them.
After a round of investigation, Xu Ping felt somewhat relieved, as it was merely a group of First Rank demon beasts mingled with a few Second-stage demon beasts.
With his current strength, these demon beasts posed no threat whatsoever.
Just then, with a loud "boom".
A previously quiet reef suddenly moved, transforming instantaneously into a giant black crab-like demon beast.
This crab demon beast brandished its claws menacingly, opening its massive pincers and swinging them fiercely towards Xu Ping.
An intense wave of hot air was stirred up, causing the surrounding magma to roll violently.
With the leading crab demon beast initiating the attack, the other crab demon beasts, camouflaged as black reefs, also began to move.
In an instant, dozens of crab demon beasts opened their massive pincers, attacking Xu Ping from all directions.
Witnessing this scene, Xu Ping’s gaze turned cold, his palm flipped, and the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword appeared in his hand.
"Slash!"
With a thought, Mana surged around Xu Ping.
In an instant, the sword’s body radiated brilliant light, dazzling and bright, as a resplendent Sword Qi shot out from the sword’s tip.
The formidable Sword Qi rampaged like a torrential flood, where it passed, the crab demon beasts shattered like ants, unable to withstand the fierce attack.
Sword Qi crisscrossed and streaked through the crab swarm, instantly slaughtering a large number of crab demon beasts.
Blood splattered amidst the scalding magma, soon evaporated by the intense heat.
Immediately after, Xu Ping’s wrist twisted, and the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword drew sharp arcs in the air, thrusting swiftly several more times.
The dazzling sword light flickered incessantly, with an overwhelming momentum obliterating more of the remaining crab demon beasts.
Those lucky enough to survive were now terrified, fleeing frantically into the depths of the magma, disregarding anything else.
Xu Ping watched the escaping crab demon beasts with a calm expression, choosing not to pursue them further for another attack.
Although the materials on these demon beasts did hold certain value.
Expending too much energy and precious time for such incremental gains was evidently not worth the effort.
He jumped off the Spirit Worm’s back and began to simply collect the materials from the slain demon beasts around.
These demon beast materials, be they fur, bones... all had certain value and should not be wasted.
After finishing the collection, Xu Ping leapt back onto the Spirit Worm’s back, calmly instructing, "Let’s go."
"Hiss hiss!"
The Spirit Worm responded with a hiss, swaying its massive body, proceeding slowly into the deeper magma world.
On their journey further, they encountered several more demon beasts.
Some of these demon beasts were akin to massive lizards, covered in hard scales, swimming quickly through the magma.
Others were like winged snakes, spiraling and flying through the air, occasionally spewing fire at Xu Ping and the Spirit Worm.
However, for Xu Ping nowadays, these demon beasts posed no substantial threat.
With a few strikes of his sword, he slew them, gaining numerous demon beast materials and Demon Cores.
Even so, the frequent encounters with demon beasts in this magma world left Xu Ping secretly astonished.
He felt that the frequency of demon beast appearances in this magma world seemed higher than that within the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range’s inner mountains.
As it is known, quite a number of Third-rank demon beasts dwelled within the inner mountains of the Yellow Dragon Mountain Range.
Therefore, it is highly likely that this place, too, harbors Third-rank demon beasts.
Xu Ping’s vigilance increased even more.
If it was merely a Third-rank Lower Grade demon beast, that would be manageable; what worried him was encountering those of Third-rank Middle Grade or higher.
...
One man and one beast progressed steadily through the magma world.
In this scorching environment, time seemed to lose its meaning.
No one knew how much time had passed, the flow of magma around them grew more turbulent, and the heat more intense, as if the very air were ignited.
Xu Ping remained highly vigilant, sweeping his Divine Sense across all directions without reservation, not missing any abnormality amidst the restless magma around.
Suddenly.
A faint, elusive fluctuation of Wood Attribute Spiritual Qi, like a pebble tossed into a calm lake, immediately caught his attention.
Despite being weak, this Spiritual Qi fluctuation was distinctly out of place in the magma world filled with Fire Attribute energy.

chapters.title: Chapter 330 - 113: Lava World, Top-Tier Spiritual Material Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree
chapters.content:
Chapter 330: Chapter 113: Lava World, Top-Tier Spiritual Material Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree
Xu Ping turned his head and saw, a thousand feet away, a small mountain formed by the continuous accumulation of lava came into view.
This small mountain was particularly striking in the rolling lava, and at the top of that mountain, a spirit tree emitting strange light instantly captured his attention.
The trunk of this spirit tree was extremely sturdy, so thick that it would take a person to embrace it.
The surface of the trunk presented a deep and mysterious crimson, as if it were burning with an eternal and unquenchable flame, exuding a scorching and enigmatic aura.
"Is this... the Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree?"
Recognizing this peculiar plant, Xu Ping was both surprised and delighted.
The trunk’s special texture made it an excellent material for crafting artifact embryos, a rarity indeed.
More precious, however, was the wood core hidden within the trunk.
This Cyan Phoenix Wood Core could be called a rare spiritual material capable of enhancing the power of wood element magical treasures.
Its value was comparable to the thousand-year-old Thunderstruck Wood, the highlight of Luoyun Sect’s auction event.
Naturally, it would have to be at least a thousand years old to achieve this.
"To that small mountain!"
Suppressing his excitement, Xu Ping eagerly commanded the Spirit Worm to swim towards the small mountain.
How could he easily let such a rare treasure pass by?
After all, he needed to forge a lifebound magical treasure upon breaking through to the Golden Core Realm.
His cultivation technique was wood-attributed to begin with, so naturally, he wanted to create a wood attribute magical treasure that perfectly aligned with his technique.
If the precious Cyan Phoenix Wood Core assisted him then, the power of his lifebound magical treasure would likely be enhanced to an unimaginably terrifying degree.
Nonetheless, Xu Ping was not so dazzled by the sudden treasure that he lost his head, staying vigilant of his surroundings at all times.
Usually, rare spiritual materials were guarded by demon beasts, and he certainly didn’t want to capsize in this gutter due to carelessness.
Receiving the command, the Spirit Worm accelerated its pace, swiftly swimming towards the lava-formed small mountain.
As they got closer to the mountain, the surrounding lava seemed to be affected by some force, becoming more violent, with huge waves of lava surging and battering the body of the Spirit Worm.
But the Spirit Worm, relying on its tough skin and thick flesh and ability to adapt to the lava environment, struggled across the raging lava.
As they drew nearer to the mountain, Xu Ping’s heightened vigilance reached its zenith.
He swept his Divine Sense all around, missing not the slightest movement.
Suddenly!
Bang!
Bang!
Two loud roars exploded like muffled thunder in his ears.
The lava suddenly erupted, and two enormous demon beasts burst out from the lava.
The two beasts resembled crocodiles, their bodies covered with thick black scales still streaming with scalding lava, exuding a suffocating heat.
Their eyes were like two burning flames, radiating ferocity and greed, with their gaping maws bristling with sharp fangs, each as thick as an arm.
More astonishingly, the aura emanating from these two demon beasts was comparable to Fake Pill cultivators, powerful and terrifying.
"Roar!"
"Roar!"
The two demon beasts let out an angry bellow at Xu Ping, their voices resonating through the lava world, causing the surrounding lava to churn violently.
The Spirit Worm suddenly froze mid-motion, its formerly supple body now as rigid as stone, and its face flushed with an indelible fear.
Faced with these two terrifying demon beasts whose power was comparable to the Fake Pill Realm, it was trembling uncontrollably.
If not for Xu Ping’s presence, it might have turned to flee.
However, Xu Ping let out a sigh of relief instead.
After all, with his current strength, two demon beasts comparable to Fake Pill cultivators were still far from posing any substantial threat to him.
Bang! Bang!
At that moment, the two demon beasts spewed gigantic lava fireballs towards Xu Ping.
The fireballs were as large as millstones, enveloped in world-destroying heat, accompanied by a whistling wind and pungent sulfur, charging towards Xu Ping like blazing meteors.
Wherever they passed, the surrounding lava was evaporated by the high temperature, creating twisted columns of steam.
"Rise!"
Long before the two demon beasts were about to make their move, Xu Ping had keenly sensed it and promptly seized the initiative.
A glint of coldness flashed in his eyes as mana surged, then three Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans radiated spiritual light and shot from his palm.
"Control!"
Xu Ping’s hands swiftly morphed, precisely forming one magic technique after another.
Under his control, the three Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans interlocked and intertwined, with their energies connecting to one another.
Xu Ping was already skilled and adept in constructing a Talisman Array, mastering the technique proficiently.
In just a fleeting moment, the Talisman Array was completed.
"Explode!"
Xu Ping’s lips slightly parted, coldly releasing a single word.
With an earth-shattering roar of thunder power, the Talisman Array formed by the three Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans erupted without reservation.
The unleashed thunder power seemed as if the Thunder God had descended, with an unstoppable force akin to a moving thunderous mountain, fiercely colliding with the advancing huge lava fireballs.
In an instant, thunder and flame clashed, erupting with a deafening, earth-shaking roar.
The immense shockwave churned the surrounding lava like boiling water, furiously surging.
The terrifying high temperatures of the lava fireballs were formidable, yet the Talisman Array constructed from the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talismans could inflict severe damage to an Early Stage Golden Core cultivator, more powerful than expected.
Bang! Bang!
With two explosive sounds.
The two lava fireballs were effortlessly shattered by the thunder power, disintegrating into countless fragments of lava scattered in the air.
However, the momentum of the thunder power remained unabated, like a roaring Thunder Dragon, continuing to thunderously crash towards the two demon beasts equivalent to the Fake Pill Realm.
The two demon beasts, seeing their full-strength spewed lava fireballs easily negated, flashed panic in their eyes.
But they were born fierce and quickly composed themselves, letting out a heaven-shaking roar in unison.
With the roar, the demonic power surged around them like a wave of black chaos.
Their already immense bodies gyrated fiercely, with four razor-sharp talons raised high, pulling up scalding streams of lava like four winding fire dragons.
They attempted to use this ferocious attack to shred the threatening thunder power into pieces.

chapters.title: Chapter 331 - 214: Obtaining the Green Wu Core; Changes in the Lava World
chapters.content:
Chapter 331: Chapter 214: Obtaining the Green Wu Core; Changes in the Lava World
However, the Thunder Power unleashed by the Three Talent Talisman Array far exceeded the imagination of the two Demon Beasts.
"Boom!"
A deafening thunderous noise, as if the entire lava world trembled because of it.
The Thunder Power surged like a torrential flood, instantly engulfing the two Demon Beasts completely.
Electric arcs flickered madly, releasing a terrifying might, as if possessing the power to destroy heavens and earth.
"Roar!"
"Roar!"
The two Demon Beasts roared in agony, their bodies trembling violently, the once fierce gaze filled with pain and fear.
Yet, the ever more frenzied power of lightning was akin to lacerating Thunder Dragons of destruction.
Rampantly crossing over and wreaking havoc on their massive bodies.
Each arc of electricity left shocking scars upon the Demon Beasts’ bodies.
Not long after, the solid bodies of the two Demon Beasts had been battered by the lightning into severe wounds and lacerations.
Large patches of black scales fell off, carrying the pungent smell of scorching, smoking, dropping into the boiling lava.
Just moments later, their enormous bodies collapsed heavily into the lava, splashing high columns of lava, never to move again.
"Finished!"
Watching all of it, Xu Ping’s face remained calm and collected, his heart not stirred much.
After all, true third-tier Demon Beasts, he had already slain two.
These creatures merely comparable to Fake Pill cultivators could not stir much emotion in his heart.
Xu Ping leapt off the Spirit Worm’s back, skillfully handling the two corpses of the Demon Beasts comparable to Fake Pill cultivators, then stored them in his Storage Ring before heading directly towards the Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree.
At this moment, however, the Spirit Worm remained in shock.
’Master... Master is this fierce?’
Its eyes widened in disbelief, blankly staring at Xu Ping’s departing silhouette, filled with incredulity.
Previously on Spirit Void Mountain, it had been caught and placed into a spirit beast pouch by Xu Ping, naturally it hadn’t seen the subsequent events.
This was its first time witnessing Xu Ping’s full strength, unexpectedly given such tremendous shock.
The two Demon Beasts capable of swallowing it whole, just died like that?
How strong could Master be?
When the Spirit Worm snapped out of its shock, Xu Ping had already reached the Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree.
Seeing this scene, the Spirit Worm hurriedly twisted its body and followed behind.
On the lava hill.
"Is this the renowned Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree?"
Xu Ping gazed at the spirit tree before him, eyes brimming with uncontrollable excitement and thrill.
Upon approach, he could truly feel that this Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree was far more grand and magnificent than what he saw from a distance.
The entire Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree emitted a mysterious radiance, with light intertwining and merging, forming a faint halo that enveloped the surrounding space.
The trunk exhibited a deep and rich red hue, like flaming fire, yet emitted extremely dense Spiritual Qi of the Wood Attribute.
That Spiritual Qi seemed like a tangible airflow, undulating wave after wave.
"First, extract the core of Cyan Phoenix Wood!"
Xu Ping suppressed the exhilarating excitement within, as his Divine Sense swept slowly through the Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree like intricate threads.
About the time it takes for a cup of tea to brew later.
"Found it!"
Xu Ping’s eyes suddenly brightened, flashing with joy.
Next, he flipped his palm, and a Magical Treasure Wooden Sword appeared spectacularly in hand.
He gripped the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword, Mana surging around him, followed by a thrust into the core trunk of the Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree.
Then he flicked upwards, a crystal emitting ethereal Wood Essence was immediately tossed out.
Xu Ping reacted swiftly, quickly extending his hand to grasp it, and the crystal was firmly absorbed into his palm.
"Cyan Phoenix Wood Core!!"
Xu Ping tightly held the crystal in his hand.
Feeling the overwhelming surges of Wood Essence within, the excitement in his eyes was almost ready to burst forth.
But he forcibly restrained himself.
Immediately, his Divine Sense spread out, meticulously sensing the spirit power fluctuations from the Wood Essence contained within the Cyan Phoenix Wood Core.
He performed this to determine the growth age of the Cyan Phoenix Wood Core.
The stronger the spirit power fluctuations from the Wood Essence, the higher its growth age, hence its value naturally increases.
A quarter of an hour later.
"Millennium-era Cyan Phoenix Wood Core!!"
Xu Ping gazed at the crystal in his hand that was as lustrous as jade, his eyes gleaming with brilliant light.
At this moment, he could no longer suppress the roaring waves of excitement within, involuntarily bursting into laughter.
Through meticulous and repeated sensing with his Divine Sense, he firmly confirmed that this Cyan Phoenix Wood Core had a growth age of at least a millennium.
This kind of Spiritual Material could be deemed as equally matched with Millennium-era Thunderstruck Wood, a top-tier Spiritual Material!
If placed in the outside world, not to mention Late-Stage Golden Core cultivators, even super Great Cultivators with Golden Core Perfection, might be enthralled.
"This time, I truly found treasure!"
Xu Ping’s eyes filled with an ecstatic glimmer, whispered to himself.
Even if there were no other gains to follow, just this Cyan Phoenix Wood Core would ensure an extremely lucrative harvest from this journey.
After all, top-tier Spiritual Materials capable of enhancing the power of Magical Treasures are exceedingly rare and hard to come by.
Magical Treasures are divided into three levels: Artifact Embryo, Magical Treasure, and top-tier Magical Treasure.
Such as the extremely rare top-tier Spiritual Material like the millennium Cyan Phoenix Wood Core.
If fully absorbed by Wood Attribute Magical Treasures, there’s a considerable chance it will aid the Magical Treasure in surpassing boundaries, advancing to a top-tier Magical Treasure.
If the treasure itself is already a top-tier Magical Treasure being absorbed and fused.
Though it can’t directly elevate the treasure to a higher Spirit Treasure tier.

chapters.title: Chapter 332 - 214: Obtaining the Green Wu Core; Changes in the Lava World (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 332: Chapter 214: Obtaining the Green Wu Core; Changes in the Lava World (Part 2)
But even so, its power far surpasses ordinary top-level magical artifacts.
One must know that top-level magical artifacts have always been treasures coveted and pursued by late-stage Golden Core and even Golden Core Perfection cultivators.
And among top-level magical artifacts, those that can be considered masterpieces are rare even for Golden Core Perfection cultivators.
These are the few individuals standing at the pinnacle of power below the Nascent Soul Realm.
"Store it well!"
Once his mind had settled, Xu Ping carefully placed the core of the Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree into a wooden box.
He then affixed a restriction talisman on it to prevent the loss of Spiritual Qi.
"Once I obtain all the treasures described by the Spirit Worm, I must thoroughly explore this lava world."
After securing the core of the Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree, Xu Ping pondered to himself.
The resources in this lava world are too abundant.
The area he has traversed so far is merely the tip of the iceberg in this entire lava world.
Yet he had obtained such top-tier spiritual materials here.
It is unimaginable how many unknown treasures this mysterious lava world still harbors.
If he could acquire more top-tier spiritual materials comparable to the core of the Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree, it would be the greatest fortune he has encountered thus far.
However, in the face of such a tempting opportunity, Xu Ping still maintained an extraordinary level of calm.
He knew well that in the Cultivation Realm, opportunities often come hand in hand with dangers.
One must never lose rationality due to greed and impulsiveness and thereby fall into an irredeemable situation.
At this moment, a doubt also involuntarily arose in his heart.
This lava world is so resource-rich that, by reason, it should have long been sought after by major sects and forces.
Yet the actual situation is that not only has no sect sent disciples to explore it,
but even in all his years roaming the Cultivation Realm, he had never heard any news about this lava world.
This is all, quite plainly, against all logic!
Though this lava world is buried deep underground, making its discovery exceedingly difficult,
the major sects have had their roots in Yue Country for at least a thousand years.
Sects with deep histories like the Luoyun Sect have been established here for far more than a thousand years.
In such a long time, despite the lava world’s secrecy, these sects should have discovered some clues here and there.
Would the sects, given their nature, let this lava world off the hook?
The doubts lingering in his mind constantly reminded Xu Ping to maintain the highest level of vigilance.
Simultaneously, he secretly made up his mind: "At the first sign of anything unusual, I must leave this place immediately!"
Although treasures of the wondrous land are enticing, compared to one’s life, they are utterly insignificant.
He is not one to risk his life just for treasures of the wondrous land.
...
Half an hour passed in the blink of an eye.
Xu Ping neatly severed the Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree at the waist and then carefully stored it in his Storage Ring.
Having completed this task, the Spirit Worm carried Xu Ping, slowly leaving the area, continuing its journey into the depths of the lava world.
The Spirit Worm’s massive body moved effortlessly through the thick lava, quite nimbly.
Wherever it passed, the lava was pushed aside, forming waves of scorching heat.
The boiling lava flowed slowly like viscous blood, with massive bubbles constantly rising to the surface.
The bursting bubbles emitted a dull "pop" and a pungent sulfurous smell filled the air.
In no time, one man and one beast were gradually swallowed by the vast sea of lava.
Not long after they left,
a bright red bubble floated slowly up from the lava, finally hovering above the half-remaining Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree.
"Pop!"
The next moment, the bubble burst unexpectedly with a dull sound.
When the bubble fractured, the half-remaining Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree suddenly emitted a faint green spiritual light.
As time went on, this green spiritual light grew brighter and brighter, becoming so intense that it was nearly impossible to keep one’s eyes open.
When the spiritual light reached its peak!
Boom!
A deafening explosion echoed, and the Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree, along with the lava mound supporting it, suddenly shattered into pieces.
A strange and mysterious wave burst forth from the explosion’s center, rippling outward like a torrent.
The already turbulent lava seemed utterly enraged by this wave, instantly surging with towering, mountain-like waves.
The torrents appeared intent on engulfing the entire lava world, an exceptionally terrifying scene.
...
...
The Spirit Worm carried Xu Ping for half an hour more within the lava.
Xu Ping keenly sensed the surrounding lava seemingly became more perilous.
Boom boom.....
Giant waves of lava, several meters high, charged at them like ferocious beasts.
However, the power contained within these waves was evidently not enough to pose a substantial threat to Xu Ping and the Spirit Worm.
"Is this normal in the lava world?"
Xu Ping looked at the relentless waves of lava and narrowed his eyes slightly.
For reasons unknown, an uneasy feeling crept into his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 333 - 214: Obtaining the Green Wu Core; Changes in the Lava World
chapters.content:
Chapter 333: Chapter 214: Obtaining the Green Wu Core; Changes in the Lava World
"It seems that after obtaining all the mystical treasures that the Spirit Worm consumes, we must leave here immediately."
After pondering and weighing his options, Xu Ping decisively made his decision.
Although the resources of this lava world were tempting, at such a critical moment, he chose to trust his keen spiritual intuition.
He did not want to place himself in danger out of greed.
Boom!
Just as Xu Ping was contemplating in secret.
A gigantic wave of lava, dozens of meters high, like an imposing wall forged from scorching molten lava, surged towards them with a terrifying, world-destroying momentum.
The surface of the lava shimmered with a dazzling and eerie red light, and inside, hot energy churned, as if ready to devour and melt everything it touched.
The Spirit Worm, feeling the horrifying heatwave rushing towards it, shivered all over in fright.
A lava wave dozens of meters high was impossible for it to resist, despite its thick skin.
It would be crushed to death.
"Hiss hiss!"
The Spirit Worm was terrified, its eyes bulging wide as it fixedly stared at the surging lava wave, emitting a series of frantic cries.
However, standing steadily on the Spirit Worm’s back, Xu Ping’s expression showed no sign of panic.
His gaze was penetrating, locking tightly onto the approaching lava wave.
"Slash!"
The Magical Treasure Wooden Sword entered Xu Ping’s hand, with mana flowing, and he executed a slash.
Boom!
A sword light, with a fleeting white arc, seemed like a divine sword cleaving the heavens, as if it would tear the very void apart.
This sword light, imbued with endless sharpness, directly split the dozens-of-meters-high lava wave in two.
The scorching lava poured down the sides like a breached flood, creating a spectacular scene.
"Through!"
Xu Ping, with a calm demeanor and steady voice, instructed.
"Hiss hiss!"
The Spirit Worm frantically wriggled its body, accelerating through the gap in the lava wave.
"Have you encountered lava waves of such scale here before?"
Once the Spirit Worm completely passed through the lava wave, Xu Ping asked calmly from its back.
Upon hearing this, the Spirit Worm shook its head vigorously, its head wobbling like a rattle drum.
If it had indeed encountered such a massive lava wave, would it still be alive?
Seeing the Spirit Worm’s reaction, Xu Ping felt reassured.
The unusual lava wave confirmed the correctness of his spiritual intuition.
However, they were now very close to the place where the Spirit Worm consumed the lotus seeds, and it probably wouldn’t take much of his time.
First, see what kind of mystical treasure the lotus seeds are, and then plan the next step.
"Go!"
Xu Ping instructed the Spirit Worm with a word.
The Spirit Worm hissed lowly, suddenly accelerated, and headed toward the northwest direction of the lava world.
.....
The Spirit Worm carried Xu Ping further for another half an hour.
All along the way, the surrounding lava continued to surge, emitting a suffocatingly hot aura.
Finally, they arrived at a strange area, filled with reefs formed from solidified lava, in various shapes, jaggedly interwoven.
These reefs, under the reflection of the lava, emitted an eerie dark red sheen.
Just as Xu Ping was observing the surroundings, suddenly, a faint but dense rustling sound came from all directions.
Alert, Xu Ping looked closely, only to see nearly a hundred crimson swarms, like tides, flooding toward them from the void.
These bugs were not large, but each exuded a fierce aura.
Their eyes glowed with a bloodthirsty light, opening their sharp mandibles and producing a chilling buzzing sound.
"Hiss hiss!"
Seeing these crimson swarms, the Spirit Worm instantly became agitated.
It emitted a deafening roar, its sturdy and powerful tail raised high, drawing an arc through the air.
Then, it slammed down heavily with tremendous force onto the large crimson swarm.
Boom!
Along with a dull thud, the swarm was scattered in all directions by the impact, with many directly smashed into the scalding lava.
However, the defensive power of these crimson swarms was beyond imagination.
Most of the bugs were only slightly dazed and didn’t suffer much damage.
The recovered swarm, far from showing any sign of retreat, seemed thoroughly enraged, crazily surging towards the Spirit Worm.
They opened their razor-sharp mouths, revealing serrated teeth, fiercely biting the Spirit Worm’s body.
The Spirit Worm cried out in pain, its scales being gnawed with a creaking sound by the swarm.
In its eyes, flames of fury ignited.
Ignoring its injuries, it once again raised its tail high and smashed into the swarm with all its strength.
Once, twice... each strike brought a shower of blood, and the scorching lava splashed high.
"Is this... does the Spirit Worm have a grudge with these bugs?"
Witnessing this scene, Xu Ping’s face showed some anomaly.
With a swift motion, he caught one of the crimson bugs effortlessly in his hand.
Observing closely, these crimson bugs had a particularly terrifying appearance.
They were about half a foot long, their bodies covered by a layer of hard, metallic lustered crimson carapace, packed with intricate patterns.
Xu Ping applied slight pressure to test the bug’s hardness.
Crack!
The crimson bug was immediately squeezed into a deformed shape, and its body twisted into an odd form, yet it stubbornly struggled and was not easily crushed.
"These bugs are quite interesting. Even for a First Rank Demon Beast, their defensive power is remarkably strong!"
Xu Ping’s eyes immediately revealed a hint of curiosity.
With the defensive power of these First Rank bugs, it would require a Foundation Establishment Cultivator to unleash their full power to cause significant damage to them.
"Is this swarm of ferocious creatures what you referred to earlier?" Xu Ping turned and called out to the Spirit Worm, which was still venting on the swarm.
By now, a large number of bug corpses littered the reefs and the lava, with only a few still struggling and writhing.
After venting its anger, the Spirit Worm’s mood seemed significantly improved.
Upon hearing Xu Ping’s question, it first nodded, then shook its head.

chapters.title: Chapter 334 - 215: Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus, Accelerated Growth
chapters.content:
Chapter 334: Chapter 215: Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus, Accelerated Growth
Xu Ping instantly understood the Spirit Worm’s intention and immediately asked:
"Are you saying it’s the same kind of bug, but at an even higher level?"
The Spirit Worm nodded eagerly.
If these accursed bugs were merely at the First Rank, with its abilities, it would have long ago charged through and devoured all those good things.
At this moment, Xu Ping’s brow couldn’t help but knit slightly.
If it were a group of second-stage bugs, even with his abilities, handling them would likely be extremely troublesome.
After all, the defensive power of this kind of bug is astonishingly strong!
If there were any third-stage bugs in the swarm, he would probably have no choice but to turn and flee without hesitation.
But thinking it through carefully, it’s unlikely, as if there were truly third-stage bugs, the Spirit Worm wouldn’t have survived until now.
However, for the sake of caution, Xu Ping decided to have the Spirit Worm conduct a test.
Thinking this, his gaze naturally fell upon the Spirit Worm.
"You go lure the... " Xu Ping hastily corrected himself, "uh... those demon bugs that bullied you, and I’ll avenge you."
Upon hearing this, the Spirit Worm’s blood-red eyes immediately brightened.
If it hadn’t witnessed its master in action before, it would be filled with doubts.
But now, it had absolute faith in its master’s abilities.
"Hiss hiss!"
The Spirit Worm instantly stood upright, puffing out its chest with full confidence, as if saying, "Leave this to me."
"Be quick!" Xu Ping instructed.
"Hiss hiss!"
The Spirit Worm responded, then shot towards the depths of the reef like a black bolt of lightning.
Xu Ping stood quietly in place, waiting, while secretly preparing to retreat at any moment.
Time passed second by second.
The roaring sound of the surrounding magma and the hot atmosphere continuously assaulted Xu Ping’s senses, yet his expression remained steady, showing no panic.
Half an hour later.
’Rustle...’
At this moment, a familiar rustling sound suddenly echoed from afar.
This sound was far more chaotic and oppressive than when the First Rank bug swarm surged before, as if it carried endless pressure.
Xu Ping’s eyes sharpened, locking tightly onto the direction the sound came from.
The Spirit Worm’s massive body shot out from the depths of the reef like an arrow leaving the string.
Behind it, a wave of crimson surged like a sea of blood, marking the arrival of that group of ferocious, bloodlusting red-shelled bugs.
Among this swarm, more than a dozen bugs were noticeably larger. The aura they emitted was far more potent than the First Rank Upper Grade bug swarm, clearly at the second-stage level.
And surrounding these second-stage bugs were hundreds of First Rank Upper Grade bugs, densely packed together.
From a distance, they looked like a terrifying blood-red cloud, exuding a chilling aura.
"No third-stage or quasi-tier three bugs."
Seeing this scene, Xu Ping secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
At this moment, with only second-stage and first-stage bugs, it shouldn’t pose too much of a threat to him.
"Hiss hiss!"
The Spirit Worm, frantically fleeing, let out urgent hissing sounds towards Xu Ping, clearly signaling for help.
Xu Ping made a swift decision without hesitation, quickly flipping his hand, and his Magical Treasure Wooden Sword appeared instantly.
"Slash!"
He gripped the sword hilt tightly, his internal spiritual power surging like a torrent, then suddenly slashed.
In an instant.
A fiercely sharp sword light burst forth.
This sword light, carrying a faint dazzling white arc, held immense power as it slashed towards the bug swarm.
As the sword light cut through, the air seemed burdened, accompanied by deafening explosions.
Even the boiling hot magma was stirred up into towering waves by the fierce sword qi, like a boiling sea of fire surging violently.
However, when the sword light touched the bug swarm, Xu Ping’s heart sank.
Boom!
The sword qi exploded!
The First Rank Upper Grade bugs, under the fierce impact of the sword qi, many were instantly slain, their shells shattering and scattering across the ground.
But the dozen or so second-stage bugs greatly surprised Xu Ping.
Their demonic power surged wildly!
Their crimson shells erupted with blinding red spiritual light.
Like blazing flames, they resisted Xu Ping’s astonishingly powerful sword light.
Boom!
In just a moment’s stalemate.
The sword light, infused with Xu Ping’s immense power, ultimately couldn’t hold and shattered, turning into tiny fragments of spiritual light.
"How can these second-stage bugs have such absurdly strong defense!?"
Upon witnessing this, Xu Ping was immediately shocked, his expression turning exceedingly serious.
To know, the power contained in his swordsmanship, while not matching the full might of a Golden Core cultivator.
But compared to ordinary Fake Pill cultivators, it was significantly stronger.
Yet now, facing these second-stage bugs, he seemed to have no solution, much to his astonishment.
Unwilling to give up, Xu Ping viciously slashed several more times at the bug swarm.
The sword wind howled, sword qi raged!
But ultimately, aside from managing to kill some first-stage bugs, slightly slowing the advance of the bug swarm.
He hadn’t inflicted any substantial damage on the second-stage bugs.
Facing such a swarm, an Early-Stage Golden Core Cultivator would likely have to flee in panic.
"There’s no way!"
A hint of gravity appeared in Xu Ping’s gaze, and he flipped his hand, sending the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword back into the Storage Ring.

chapters.title: Chapter 335 - 215: Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus, Accelerated Ripening_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 335: Chapter 215: Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus, Accelerated Ripening_2
Then, with a flash of light from the Storage Ring, three Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans appeared suddenly in the void.
With the defensive power of these Second-stage insects, using the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman to construct a Talisman Array might not be enough to catch them all in one fell swoop.
Only by using the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman, a Third-rank Middle Grade talisman, could the insect swarm be killed in one strike.
"Control!"
With a thought, Xu Ping’s hands swiftly formed a seal, muttering words under his breath.
Under his control, the three Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans intermingled, their forces linking with each other.
At the moment the Talisman Array formed.
Xu Ping’s lips pressed tightly together, then he uttered a cold and decisive word:
"Explode!"
Bang!
In an instant, a mighty force capable of destroying heaven and earth erupted without restraint.
The terrifying power unleashed surged forward like an unstoppable tide, sweeping viciously toward the insect swarm.
Under the propulsion of this terrifying explosion, strong air currents instantly formed visible shock waves.
These shock waves raged like roaring beasts, agitating the surrounding magma and raising towering waves.
The explosion’s unparalleled wave of destruction instantly engulfed the insect swarm mercilessly.
The Second-stage insects used all their strength, frantically surging their Demonic Power.
The red Spiritual Qi on their shells shone brightly to the extreme, trying to withstand the terrifying strike.
However, faced with the heaven-destroying and earth-shattering power unleashed by the Golden Armor-Breaking Talisman’s Talisman Array.
Their struggles remained utterly futile.
Bang!
One by one, the Second-stage insects were shattered violently, their bodies turning to dust in the Spiritual Qi.
The First Rank Upper Grade insects, once closely packed together, offered no resistance, being instantly overwhelmed by the terrifying power.
The insect swarm perished in droves.
The shattered shells fell like raindrops, filling the air with a pungent, bloody scent.
In just a moment.
The once formidable and fierce insect swarm was reduced to a mere few severely wounded First Rank insects, struggling helplessly on the ground.
The scene of near-extermination created an eerie silence in the area.
Only the continuous rumbling of the rolling magma seemed to recount the fierce battle that just unfolded.
"Whew!"
Xu Ping slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air, his face slightly pale.
Having consecutively deployed the Talisman Array twice, even with his current amount of Mana, the expenditure was not insignificant.
Xu Ping took out several Pills that emitted a faint glow.
With a "gulp," he swallowed all the Pills.
Once the Pills hit his stomach, they immediately transformed into a warm current, with the medicinal power rapidly dispersing and converting into pure Spiritual Qi.
With the ingenious prompting of the Longevity Skill, this Spiritual Qi gradually condensed and transformed into the Mana required for his cultivation.
Normally, Xu Ping rarely relied on Pills to restore Mana.
Although using Pills to restore Mana was much faster compared to meditative cultivation.
It could not, however, improve his proficiency.
But in this world of lava, there was no time or environment where he could sit and meditate to recover Mana safely.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
At this moment, a series of sudden loud crashes echoed.
Xu Ping turned his head toward the sound.
He saw the Spirit Worm enthusiastically wagging its tail, repeatedly and heavily striking at the still-breathing insects.
’Does this Spirit Worm really hold such a grudge?’ Xu Ping thought helplessly in his heart.
Soon, he summoned the Spirit Worm back and asked, "Are there any other Second-stage insect swarms around here?"
Upon hearing Xu Ping’s question, the Spirit Worm hastily shook its head.
It felt extremely satisfied, as the enemy insects that bullied it had all been dealt with.
Xu Ping was inwardly delighted at this sight.
If a few more waves of Second-stage insect swarms appeared, he might not be able to handle it in his current state.
Now, without the threat of Second-stage insect swarms, the journey to seek rare plants and treasures should proceed much more smoothly.
...
After collecting the corpses of the Second-stage demonic insects scattered on the reefs, Xu Ping followed the Spirit Worm deeper into the reef clusters.
Along the way, the hot magma occasionally splashed, and the high temperature distorted the air.
In just a little over half an hour, they arrived at a relatively quiet corner.
Here, the flow of magma seemed to have slowed significantly, and the surrounding reefs exhibited a peculiar color.
On a reef not far ahead, an unusual lotus-shaped Spirit Plant caught Xu Ping’s eye.
The lotus was entirely fiery red, with petals flowing with a spirited glow, and from the stamens, wisps of heat rose as if burning with flames.
"Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus!"
At a glance, Xu Ping immediately identified the rare Spirit Plant before him.
A hint of uncontrollable joy flashed in his eyes as he quickened his steps toward the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus.
Although the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus is not as precious as the Merging Soul Enlightenment Heart Lotus, it is still a top-tier treasure and a perfect match for his skill set.
Moreover, he had previously obtained the precious Cyan Wutong Heartwood.
This trip was already a big score; what more could one ask?
However, as Xu Ping approached the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus with a heart full of joy, his brows unconsciously furrowed a little:
"This Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus doesn’t seem to be fully mature yet?"
The Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus before him had a flower bud in its center that was not fully open, only slightly parted.

chapters.title: Chapter 336 - 215: Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus, Forced Maturation (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 336: Chapter 215: Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus, Forced Maturation (Part 3)
Moreover, the spiritual power fluctuations emanating from it are rather weak.
Far from the powerful and abundant feeling of spiritual power of a mature Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus.
Xu Ping’s Divine Sense spread out, and after a careful investigation, he came to a conclusion that left him somewhat dumbfounded.
This Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus is indeed far from mature.
According to his judgment, it will take at least fifty more years to fully mature.
"Fifty years?"
Xu Ping frowned tightly.
It’s important to know that he had only been in this Cultivation Realm for about fifty or sixty years.
Making him wait here for such a long time just to wait for the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus to slowly mature is clearly unrealistic.
After all, there are too many variables involved.
Not to mention being in this somewhat eerie lava world.
As for transplanting the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus elsewhere.
Given his current level of expertise in Spirit Plant cultivation, he is far from capable of doing this.
Xu Ping thought carefully and realized that there was only one way left to harvest this Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus.
And that is to hasten its maturity!
His current Longevity Skill can hasten the maturity of Spirit Plants and Spirit Medicine in extremely short time.
Although it consumes lifespan, it is definitely worthwhile for top-tier spiritual materials like the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus.
Of course, whether this is to be implemented depends on how much lifespan will be consumed to hasten the maturity of this Spirit Lotus.
If the consumption is too great, it would not be worth the loss.
However, just when Xu Ping was about to take action to hasten the maturity of the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus.
"Bang!"
A dull sound came from the side.
Xu Ping frowned slightly and looked toward the source of the sound.
Only to see the Spirit Worm recklessly destroying the red oval-shaped embryos attached to the rocks.
These embryos appeared smooth and glossy, exuding a peculiar sheen.
"Are these the embryos of that group of insects?"
Xu Ping’s heart moved, and upon sensing the same aura as the previous group of insects from these embryos, he slightly raised his eyebrow and immediately shouted to stop the Spirit Worm:
"Don’t destroy them, collect all these embryos, I have great use for them."
He had witnessed the defensive power of this group of insects. If these embryos could be carefully nurtured to grow.
They would undoubtedly become a formidable aid for him, providing massive assistance.
A dozen Second-stage insects would probably make even Early Stage Golden Core cultivators flee at the sight.
If he could nurture dozens, or even hundreds, they might even have the capability to besiege an Early Stage Golden Core cultivator.
"Sssss!"
Hearing this, the Spirit Worm was somewhat reluctant.
But it dared not defy Xu Ping’s orders and could only obediently start collecting those red oval-shaped embryos from the rocks.
"Remember to collect them all, don’t leave a single one behind."
Xu Ping specifically reminded again, and then turned his gaze back to the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus.
"Let’s begin!"
Xu Ping’s expression turned solemn, and he gently raised his finger.
In an instant, strands of Longevity Mana radiating an aquamarine glow.
Like soft and light rain, drifted continuously towards the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus, merging into it.
Time quietly passed by, and before he knew it, nearly half an hour had gone by.
At this moment, Xu Ping stopped his mana.
His Divine Sense spread out, carefully perceiving the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus.
"Hastened by one year."
Xu Ping muttered to himself, then slightly frowned, "But it consumed as much as a year and a half of my lifespan!"
A hint of contemplation appeared in his eyes.
In the past, hastening a Second-stage Spirit Medicine by a year only consumed two months of lifespan.
But this time, hastening the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus, the lifespan consumption was so much greater, the difference was simply too vast.
To fully hasten the maturity of this Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus, it would consume seventy-five years of his lifespan.
"Seventy-five years, huh?"
Xu Ping murmured to himself, while also making up his mind.
To fully hasten the maturity of the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus!
He now had a lifespan that had exceeded the 800-year mark.
For him, consuming seventy-five years to hasten the maturity of the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus was not something unacceptable.
Moreover, the consumed lifespan could also be fully replenished with longevity treasures from heaven and earth.
After making up his mind, Xu Ping once again raised his finger.
Strands of even denser Longevity Mana with an aquamarine glow surged endlessly towards the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus like surging tides.
With the injection of mana, the surrounding air seemed to be stirred and distorted, producing a faint buzzing sound.
Time slowly passed in a tense and serious atmosphere.
In the process, Xu Ping’s mana was continuously being consumed.
To maintain the supply of mana, he had to swallow several mana-recovery pills.
Only then did he barely sustain it, ensuring that the supply of mana was not interrupted.
An hour passed.
Under his continuous hastening, the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus had undergone noticeable changes.
The initially closed bud had slightly opened, revealing more spiritual charm from within.
Moreover, the spiritual power fluctuations it emitted were stronger than before, as if this Spirit Lotus was gradually awakening, radiating stronger vitality.
Two hours passed.
At this point, the bud of the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus had opened wider, and the Spiritual Qi surrounding it became denser, with a faint tendency to form spiritual mist.
...
Finally, after a long six hours.
With a crisp "pop" sound, the bud of the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus fully bloomed.
In an instant, a wave of extremely strong Spiritual Qi fluctuation spread explosively in all directions with the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus at the center.
Whoo!!
This Spiritual Qi fluctuation was extremely strong, where it passed, the lava was pushed aside, forming huge gullies, creating an extremely spectacular scene.
However, this level of Spiritual Qi fluctuation was clearly not enough to shake Xu Ping.
"Finally... successfully hastened to maturity!"
At this moment, Xu Ping’s face appeared somewhat pale from the dual consumption of mana and lifespan, but his eyes were filled with excitement and elation.

chapters.title: Chapter 337 - 216: Harvest; Upheaval
chapters.content:
Chapter 337: Chapter 216: Harvest; Upheaval
"Finally... successfully catalyzed!"
Xu Ping stared at the fully blooming Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus before him, his eyes brimming with uncontrollable excitement and joy.
At this moment, the blooming Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus was like a radiant celestial medicine.
The petals were crystalline and transparent, shimmering with multicolored brilliance, the stamens gently swaying, emitting strands of a delicate fragrance that lingered in the space.
In the center of the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus, nine lotus seeds stood quietly, like resplendent stars in the night sky.
These were the core existence of the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus, containing Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seeds that could temporarily enhance a cultivator’s comprehension.
With a flip of his palm, the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword appeared in Xu Ping’s hand.
He grasped the hilt, lightly swung his arm, and a swift Sword Qi flashed, precisely severing the lotus pod atop the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus.
Immediately afterwards, Xu Ping circulated the Mana within his body, and it instantly coalesced into an enormous and solid Mana Hand.
Steadily catching the lotus pod, he carefully stored it into his storage treasure.
Xu Ping did not uproot this Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus; perhaps in a thousand years, it could bloom and bear fruit again.
Meanwhile, the Spirit Worm had also completed its task.
At this moment, it brought all the collected insect embryos before Xu Ping.
Xu Ping’s eyes swept over like lightning, and he couldn’t help but be secretly delighted, counting carefully, there were actually over fifty.
With so many insect embryos, if all were cultivated to the Second-stage level.
If used properly, they could probably besiege Early Stage Golden Core practitioners and block Middle Stage of Golden Core cultivators without any issue.
"Not bad at all."
Although collecting insect embryos was not inherently complex, in his pleased mood, Xu Ping was generous enough to praise the Spirit Worm.
Qingwu Wood Core, Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus, insect eggs!
The harvest from this trip could be considered the greatest opportunity he had encountered so far.
"Hiss hiss!"
At this moment, the Spirit Worm responded happily.
Although it didn’t know what its master wanted with these hateful insect eggs, it was obvious that the master was very pleased now.
...
After praising the Spirit Worm, Xu Ping proceeded to collect these insect embryos.
With a light flick of his sleeve, under the support of Mana, the crimson embryos, like lively fish, were sequentially stored into the spirit beast pouch.
Just as Xu Ping was calmly collecting the insect embryos.
In the searing magma, several crimson bubbles were leisurely floating upwards, finally suspending above the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus.
All this naturally fell into Xu Ping’s eyes.
However, to him, these were nothing more than ordinary magma bubbles, hardly worth his attention.
Just as he was about to store the last crimson embryo.
"Pop!"
The bubbles suddenly burst without any warning, emitting a muffled and sudden sound.
At the moment the bubbles burst.
The previously calm Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus suddenly glowed with a ghostly green spiritual light.
In just an extremely fleeting moment, this green light intensified to its peak at an astonishing speed.
When Xu Ping detected that something was amiss, it was already too late.
Boom!
With an earth-shattering explosion, the base of the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus along with the surrounding large reef group suddenly shattered without warning.
Thud!
An extraordinary and powerful energy, like an overwhelming, unstoppable torrent, instantly spread in all directions.
In an instant, the entire lava world appeared thoroughly incensed, plunging into an unprecedented frenzy.
The once restless, ever-rolling molten lava now seemed ignited with endless fury, surging violently.
Raising colossal waves dozens of meters high, as if intending to devour the entire world.
The scalding magma spattered everywhere like raindrops, splashing onto the surrounding reefs, producing a sizzling sound.
The hard reefs, under the erosion of the high-temperature lava, instantly melted into a searing red liquid.
"Oh no!!"
Witnessing this sudden eerie scene, Xu Ping’s face drastically changed color.
With a flip of his palm, the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword appeared in his hand.
"Slash!"
Grasping the sword hilt tightly, the Spiritual Power within him surged like a roaring river, channeling all his strength into delivering a fierce slash forward.
In an instant, a dazzling and tangible sword light burst forth from the sword tip like lightning.
With a crisp "crack."
The towering wave, over dozens of meters high, was forcibly cleaved in two by that one sword.
The scalding magma poured down like broken pearls to either side, creating a truly breathtaking spectacle.
Although the gigantic wave, formed of lava, was easily sliced, Xu Ping’s expression remained incredibly grim.
Because the severe situation before him was far more terrifying than imagined.
Ahead, countless lava waves like surging tides, were madly rushing in, endlessly overwhelming and destroying everything in their path!
Even more perilous was.
With his keen perception, Xu Ping distinctly sensed a vast yet invisible pressure.
Radiating silently yet inexorably throughout the entire lava world.
This pressure was like an invisible mountain, making it difficult for anyone to breathe.
"Quick! Get me out of here!"
Xu Ping leaped onto the back of the Spirit Worm, giving a loud, grave command.

chapters.title: Chapter 338 - 216: Harvest; Upheaval_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 338: Chapter 216: Harvest; Upheaval_2
The lava world is likely about to undergo a cataclysmic change.
We must leave this place immediately, or else he might perish here.
"Ssss!"
The Spirit Worm faced with this terrifying situation was already trembling in fear.
Upon hearing Xu Ping’s command, it forcibly suppressed its inner fear, unleashing unprecedented strength without hesitation.
Using all its might, it carried Xu Ping swiftly over the scorching lava.
Its body moved rapidly across the lava’s surface, creating streams of hot air.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
However, one wave after another of lava tsunamis, towering several dozen meters high, charged at them like furious primordial beasts.
With deafening roars, they surged forward fiercely.
These waves emitted a terrifying heat, seemingly capable of melting everything into nothingness in an instant.
Xu Ping stood on the back of the Spirit Worm, his eyes slightly narrowed.
His hands tightly gripped the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword, and the spiritual power within him surged madly, pouring ceaselessly into the sword.
Then, his body flashed, and he delivered several sword strikes in rapid succession, slashing fiercely at the oncoming lava waves.
Each sword light fell precisely, slicing the raging lava waves in half.
The scalding magma splashed everywhere, making a sizzling sound, and the air was filled with the acrid smell of sulfur.
However, the incessantly surging immense lava waves were far from the worst situation!
The worst was that, for some unknown reason, groups of demon beasts from all directions were recklessly charging at them.
These demon beasts varied in form; some resembled giant lizards covered with hard scales.
Others looked like winged venomous snakes with a wide-open bloody maw spewing nauseating venom.
...
But their goal was very clear, and that was Xu Ping.
"Have these demon beasts gone mad?"
Seeing this scene, Xu Ping’s face turned extremely gloomy.
Many demon beasts were crushed into pulp by the dozens of meters high magma waves before they could reach them.
The blood and flesh mixed into the searing lava, making the area increasingly bloody and terrifying.
Yet even so, the remaining demon beasts continued to roar in anger, disregarding their safety and charging courageously at Xu Ping.
The unending magma waves; the incredibly fierce and crazed demon beasts!
This feeling was as if he was fighting against the entire lava world.
At this moment, a powerful unease surged in Xu Ping’s heart.
Did he anger this bizarre lava world?
Was it because he killed so many lava demon beasts, or because he plucked two top-tier mystical treasures?
Thinking back to the sudden explosion of the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus, Xu Ping believed it was most likely the latter.
Moreover, the previous abrupt changes in the lava world were probably due to his plucking of the Cyan Phoenix Fire Tree.
No time to think further!
"Ssss..."
Accompanied by deafening roars, a massive lava beast slithered through the towering magma waves like a specter, launching an attack on Xu Ping.
This lava beast resembled a giant python, its entire body covered with a thick layer of black scales, with hot lava flowing over them, exuding an intimidating aura.
It opened its bloody maw, revealing sharp fangs, and suddenly spewed out a thick column of fire.
The column of fire rushed forth like a roaring fire dragon, surrounded by rolling heat, shooting directly at Xu Ping.
A flash of cold light appeared in Xu Ping’s eyes, and a chill instantly surfaced, he slashed out with his sword without hesitation.
Rumble!
Like a thunderclap, the brilliant sword light effortlessly split the thick column of fire in half.
The scorching lava splashed and shot outward, while the suffocating heatwave rushed forward.
Yet the power of the sword light did not diminish, as the light swept forward with overwhelming spiritual power, striking heavily against the lava beast.
In an extremely shrill scream, the massive lava beast was instantly sliced into two pieces.
Blood sprinkled over the scalding lava, vanishing instantly.
A Second-stage Demon Beast, naturally could not pose a threat to Xu Ping.
But as time went on, the demon beasts attacking them were not only increasing in number but also growing stronger.
Even Fake Pill-level demon beasts began to appear!
Roar!
A gigantic leopard broke through numerous obstacles, roaring as it leaped toward them.
Fire blazed around its entire body, and with every breath, it spat scalding flames, causing the lava to rise into even higher waves as it passed.
"Fake Pill Demon Beast!"
Xu Ping’s expression turned extremely serious.
Faced with such a level of demon beast, he knew merely relying on the power of his swordsmanship wouldn’t be enough to slay it with one strike, he must use a Third-stage Talisman.
After all, if he couldn’t kill it or severely injure it in one strike, being entangled with it would lead to unimaginable consequences!
"Swift!"
Without hesitation, Xu Ping deployed the Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman.
This Cyan Profound Divine Thunder Talisman instantly emitted a dazzling glow, transforming into a powerful and massive purple Thunder Dragon.
This purple Thunder Dragon was wrapped in crackling arcs of lightning, eradiating a terrifying power that threatened to destroy everything, charging toward the Fake Pill Fire Beast.
Rumble!
The thunder rumbled, and countless arcs of lightning exploded, engulfing the Fake Pill Fire Beast.
Roar!!
The Fake Pill Fire Beast couldn’t help but emit a series of shrill wails.
Under the onslaught of this violent Thunder Power, its life energy rapidly dissipated, and soon it was lifeless, its enormous body slowly sinking into the boiling lava.

chapters.title: Chapter 339 - 216: Harvest; Upheaval_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 339: Chapter 216: Harvest; Upheaval_3
However, dealing with a Fake Pill level Demon Beast, for Xu Ping at this moment, is merely a drop in the bucket, far from alleviating the immediate crisis.
In his line of sight, three Fake Pill level Demon Beasts are approaching him.
"No, the Spirit Worm is too slow." Xu Ping’s face looked grim.
It’s unknown how vast this Lava World is, and there are countless Demon Beasts within.
Now it’s only Fake Pill level Demon Beasts, but once a third-tier Demon Beast arrives, that’s when the real trouble begins for him.
’I have to run by myself!’
In a split second, Xu Ping made up his mind.
With his escape technique far surpassing that of an ordinary Fake Pill cultivator, perhaps he can break through the encirclement of the Demon Beasts.
Xu Ping no longer hesitated, and directly collected the Spirit Worm, already scared out of its wits, into the spirit beast bag.
Then, he quickly formed seals with his hands, and a series of Spells flickered at his fingertips.
In an instant, his entire being transformed into a black stream of light, as fast as lightning, swiftly leaving the many clawing Demon Beasts far behind.
...
...
At the same time.
In another area of the Lava World.
A young man enveloped by a bluish light, dressed in the attire of the Luoyun Sect, had a trace of uncontainable greed glinting in his eyes.
The young man’s name was Hong Yue, an ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivator from the Luoyun Sect.
At this moment, his gaze was tightly fixed on a Spirit Medicine of completely red hue.
This Spirit Medicine was called "Red Essence Liquid Grass," and it had great utility for Foundation Establishment cultivators who practiced Fire Attribute Cultivation Techniques.
If a Foundation Establishment cultivator takes the "Red Essence Liquid Grass" while attempting to break through a bottleneck.
It can quickly soothe the chaotic Spiritual Power within the cultivator, promoting its cohesion, thus greatly increasing the success rate of breaking through the bottleneck.
"This Lava World truly lives up to its name, the resources here are immensely abundant!"
Hong Yue was extremely excited and couldn’t help but mutter to himself.
However, he was not so overwhelmed by the precious "Red Essence Liquid Grass" before him to lose his rationality.
He cautiously and vigilantly observed the surrounding movements first.
Only after confirming there was nothing unusual, did he slowly approach the "Red Essence Liquid Grass."
It’s no wonder he was so careful!
After all, this Lava World has always been treated as a forbidden zone within the Luoyun Sect, strictly sealed off.
According to ancient records!
This Lava World is vast beyond compare, with top-tier treasures and materials almost everywhere.
The richness of its resources surpasses even that of the entire Yue Country.
A thousand years ago, when the Luoyun Sect accidentally discovered this Lava World, they thought fortune had fallen from the sky.
But when the sect was preparing to explore it fully, they discovered things were far from as ideal as imagined.
First, this magma world had very special restrictions, allowing only cultivators below the Fake Pill Realm to enter.
No matter how the Fake Pill and Golden Core cultivators of the sect tried, they were always unable to set foot in it.
At the entrance of the Lava World, it seemed as if there was an invisible but indestructible barrier preventing them from entering.
Even the most esteemed and powerful Nascent Soul Supreme Elder of the sect attempted to force entry, but ultimately failed.
You must understand, a Nascent Soul cultivator is like a deity in the Yue Country, yet couldn’t even step foot into this magma world.
This undoubtedly instilled strong apprehension towards this magma world.
Even though the sect’s high-level members understood this Lava World was exceedingly unusual.
Faced with the allure of top-tier treasures and materials.
They still dispatched large numbers of Foundation Establishment cultivators to explore and search for these treasures in the Lava World.
But to the sect’s shock, every Foundation Establishment cultivator they sent in met with certain death without exception
This included seven or eight Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivators.
Yet, the sect leadership was not deterred.
After careful discussion, they again meticulously selected and sent a batch of Foundation Establishment cultivators into the Lava World.
They even equipped some top-tier combat Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivators with powerful third-tier talismans to ensure results.
Just when they thought they might finally have some success.
Another bad news arrived.
This batch, which they had pinned high hopes on, almost ended up wiped out again.
Only one, with top-tier combat capability almost comparable to the Fake Pill Realm, returned gravely injured.
It was from this severely injured returning cultivator that the Luoyun Sect learned.
Even though this Lava World contained extremely rich resources.
The number of Demon Beasts within was also astonishing, with third-tier Demon Beasts also present.
For ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivators.
Not to mention exploring those precious treasures, they might not even make it far in this Lava World before ending up in the belly of a Demon Beast.
Even if they miraculously avoided being devoured and managed to acquire those treasures.
The most terrifying thing would follow immediately, the entire Lava World would erupt in massive waves of lava.
Faced with such overwhelming waves, even a Foundation Establishment cultivator had almost no chance of survival, truly a ten-deaths-no-life situation.
Not to mention, during this time, Demon Beasts would relentlessly attack them.
In such extremely dire circumstances, forget about the Fake Pill Realm.
Even Golden Core cultivators would have to flee, and the slowest ones would likely perish here.
The upper echelons of the Luoyun Sect, upon hearing about the situation in the Lava World, despite their immense unwillingness, practically gave up hope.
After all, acquiring treasures from the magma world was exceedingly difficult.
At least possessing Golden Core combat power was necessary, and not just any ordinary Golden Core power, to possibly obtain one or two treasures.
But can a Foundation Establishment cultivator possess Golden Core combat power?
The gap is simply too vast!
Thus, after repeated failures.
The Luoyun Sect had no choice but to seal off this Lava World completely and formally designate it as a sect forbidden zone.
From then on, disciples were strictly prohibited from entering on their own to avoid unnecessary loss of life.

chapters.title: Chapter 340 - 217: Mid-grade Tier 3 Demon Beast Assault
chapters.content:
