Chapter 340: Chapter 217: Mid-grade Tier 3 Demon Beast Assault
Now, a thousand years have passed, and the Luoyun Sect is almost forgotten by most.
If not for Hong Yue coming across information in an ancient book, he might never have known about it in this lifetime.
However, upon discovering such a world of lava, a strong interest was ignited in his heart.
Although he learned from the book that this place is extremely dangerous.
The greed deep within Hong Yue’s heart grew wildly like weeds, eventually overwhelming him completely.
He held a stroke of luck in his heart!
Now a millennium has passed, who knows what the situation inside might be?
Maybe it has even gotten better?
Moreover, he thought that as long as he didn’t covet the most precious and rare natural treasures.
Just taking some relatively ordinary ones shouldn’t be too big of a problem.
Thus, during the perfect opportunity when every elite of the sect left to attack Feng Country, significantly reducing the defensive strength within the sect.
Hong Yue seized the chance, sneaked past the extremely sparse guards, and quietly entered the world of lava.
Not long after he entered.
No demon beasts had been spotted yet, but Hong Yue first discovered a stalk of ’Red Essence Liquid Grass’.
Seizing it would make breaking through the Late-Stage Foundation Establishment just around the corner.
Moreover, with the help of such a resource-rich lava world.
In due time, reaching for the Golden Core Realm, or even touching upon the seemingly unreachable Nascent Soul Realm, wouldn’t be completely hopeless.
Such an enticing prospect made Hong Yue’s heart burn even more fiercely.
Nevertheless, despite his excitement.
He maintained a calm mind, his Divine Sense spreading out like spider threads, constantly on alert for any slight movements around him.
Suddenly!
Boom!
Not far from the ’Red Essence Liquid Grass,’ in the magma, a massive lava fire beast shot out like a cannonball.
This fire beast, several feet long, had a body made of multiple segments, each covered in a layer of hard, barbed black shells.
Its eyes were blood-red as it roared at Hong Yue, a fierce aura rushing towards him.
"Second-stage Middle Grade!"
Feeling the beast’s aura, Hong Yue’s heart sank.
With cultivation on par and fighting in its terrain, this would be hard to deal with!
However, at this moment, with the bow drawn and the arrow notched, he couldn’t retreat.
He certainly wouldn’t give up now.
As Hong Yue took out his Magical Artifact, ready to engage in a serious fight with the fire beast.
Rumble!
"Rumble!" The previously somewhat calm surface of the lava lake was suddenly stirred by an invisible giant hand, starting to churn violently.
The scorching lava boiled like water, instantly raising tumultuous waves several dozen feet high.
The gigantic waves of lava, with an apocalyptic terrifying momentum, surged toward Hong Yue.
Everywhere it passed, the abrupt rocks standing in the lava were swallowed without mercy, soon turning into a thick liquid under the intense heat.
"No!"
Witnessing this scene, Hong Yue’s face turned as pale as paper, his eyes filled with uncontrollable fear.
At this life-and-death moment.
He frantically took out all the defensive Magical Artifacts and talismans he had accumulated over time, hoping to fend off the charging massive wave of lava.
But before the destructive power of the lava waves, it was all in vain.
Boom!
Crack!
The massive lava waves mercilessly melted all his Magical Artifacts and talismans.
Hong Yue could only let out a piercing scream before being completely engulfed by the surging lava waves, disappearing without a trace...
...
...
In this blood-red, blazing hot world of lava, the black stream of light transformed by Xu Ping was desperately fleeing through the fiery heatwaves.
Everything around was distorted by the high temperature, as if the entire space was filled with the aura of destruction.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The endless clamor echoed throughout this world.
The overwhelming lava waves, like the furious ancient beasts, surged at him with the intent to destroy everything.
Each wave carried a terrifying heat capable of instantly melting Mid-grade Magical Artifacts, warping the space they passed, causing it to slightly tremble with layers of strange ripples.
Seeing this, Xu Ping’s expression grew increasingly grave, as if shrouded by a layer of frost.
He gripped the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword tightly, continuously swinging it.
Brilliant streaks of sword light shot from the tip, slicing the surging waves in half.
The blazing magma splattered around, sizzling, the air suffused with a pungent smell.
Then, without slowing down, he dashed through the gap, desperately fleeing toward the exit of the lava world.
Roar!
Hiss!
.....
At this moment, countless lava fire beasts, of various shapes, continued to roar and rush toward Xu Ping.
But under Xu Ping’s Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill at the Perfection Level, these demon beasts were easily left far behind.
Boom!
Xu Ping swung his sword again fiercely, the mighty Sword Qi erupting once more, successfully slicing yet another wave of surging lava waves in half.
Taking advantage of this brief pause, he quickly took out several Pills and swallowed them to restore depleted Mana.
In this lava world that constantly exudes scorching heat, the Mana consumption was undoubtedly much faster than usual.
Despite such perilous conditions, Xu Ping maintained an extraordinary calmness in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 341 - 217: Mid-grade Tier 3 Demon Beast Attack (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 341: Chapter 217: Mid-grade Tier 3 Demon Beast Attack (Part 2)
"Almost there!"
"The exit... is almost here!"
His eyes were fixed on the spot, already able to vaguely see the exceedingly crimson cliff walls at the edge of the lava world.
The speed he exerted with full force was naturally much faster than the Spirit Worm.
However, although the exit seemed to be within reach, Xu Ping’s heart was still not relaxed at all.
The more this moment approached, the more cautious one must be.
Suddenly!
Roar!!
A deafening roar, echoing between heaven and earth, was heard like thunder crashing from behind.
Xu Ping’s expression changed abruptly, his body instinctively jerked back to look.
To see, a gigantic demon beast with flames raging around it, resembling a moving volcano, had suddenly appeared behind Xu Ping.
It was galloping with overwhelming speed, riding the rolling magma, far surpassing Xu Ping.
"Third-rank middle-grade demon beast??"
Feeling the mountain-like pressure of the demon beast, Xu Ping’s face instantly became extremely grim.
He had considered the possibility of a third-rank demon beast attack, but never expected it would be a third-rank middle-grade demon beast.
Roar!
This terrifying demon beast seemed to sense Xu Ping’s gaze, letting out an angry roar.
The sound waves spread out like a tangible substance, violently agitating the surrounding lava.
Right after, a massive lava fire column erupted from its mouth.
The lava fire column, like a rampaging fire dragon, carried an air of destruction as it charged toward Xu Ping with thunderous momentum.
The path of the lava fire column seemed to ignite the air, forming a long line of fire, while the surrounding lava surged more turbulently.
"Not good!"
Xu Ping’s expression changed dramatically.
At this moment, he was in a state of full-speed escape, coupled with the rapid speed of the fire column.
He had no time to dodge, biting his teeth, choosing to endure the lethal blow.
Xu Ping knew his life hung by a thread at this moment, so without hesitation, he summoned a defensive magic treasure to shield himself.
At the same time, Xu Ping chanted under his breath, his hands swiftly forming a seal, casting the "Cyan Wood Shield" he had trained to a great level.
Instantly.
A dense green glow emanated from around his body, forming a sturdy shield enveloping him completely.
"Boom."
Just as the Cyan Wood Shield rose.
The surging lava fire column, with an annihilating force, slammed fiercely against the defensive magic treasure, producing a sound that echoed throughout the heavens.
Invisible energy waves rippled outward like a raging storm, immediately lifting magma waves dozens of yards high.
The immense impact made the defensive magic treasure tremble violently, the glow on its surface flickering unstably.
Under the continued assault of the lava fire column, the defensive magic treasure lasted only a few breaths.
Then, unable to bear the terrifying power anymore, it was blasted away with a whoosh.
Following that, the lava fire column mercilessly collided with the "Cyan Wood Shield."
Thud!
At the instant of contact, a silent sound erupted, releasing a powerful energy wave.
The high temperature of the lava fire column and the impact created by the "Cyan Wood Shield" intertwined, shattering the surrounding lava and reefs.
With Xu Ping’s current mana exhibiting the great level of the ’Cyan Wood Shield,’ even the attacks of an early-stage Golden Core cultivator could be defended.
However, the terrifying demon beast before him, comparable to the middle stage of Golden Core, had an attack power far exceeding that of the early stage Golden Core.
Even though the previous lava fire column was somewhat weakened by the defensive magic treasure, for the "Cyan Wood Shield," it was still a heavy burden.
In the fierce clash, the energy surged out like a raging beast.
The glow of the ’Cyan Wood Shield’ flickered continuously, akin to a candle in the wind, threatening to extinguish at any moment.
The next moment.
With a crack, the "Cyan Wood Shield" ultimately failed to withstand the terrifying attack, dissipating into dots of green light in the air.
Thankfully, through the layered defenses of the magic treasure and "Cyan Wood Shield,"
The fire column’s power was reduced by at least seventy percent.
By this time, the fire column was still fearsome, but had weakened considerably compared to its initial ferocity.
Taking advantage of this brief respite, Xu Ping dared not relax at all.
His hands formed quick seals, chanting under his breath, as he fully activated the ’Profound Turtle Mountain-Suppressing Skill’.
As the cultivation technique operated, a thick and solid earthen-colored spiritual light began to circulate on Xu Ping’s skin.
This layer of earthen-colored spiritual light was like an invisible armor, emanating a heavy and sturdy aura.
Yet, before Xu Ping could prepare entirely, the remaining intense power of the immense fire column brutally struck his body.
The terrifying power contained in the lava fire column exploded instantly, the tremendous impact sending Xu Ping flying backward.
Xu Ping only felt as though his chest had been hammered fiercely!
A wave of intense pain surged like a tide, seemingly dislocating and churning his organs.
A mouthful of blood spurted uncontrollably from his lips, forming a mist of blood in mid-air.
But before the blood mist could fall, it was instantly evaporated by the surrounding high temperature, disappearing without a trace.
His clothes caught fire instantly from the high heat, turning to ashes in the blink of an eye.
Even his skin, under the searing fire column, quickly blackened, with large patches being roasted off.
Fortunately, this strike did not claim his life.
"Cough!"
Xu Ping coughed violently, a mouthful of fresh blood trickling down his lips, starkly contrasting against his pale complexion.

chapters.title: Chapter 342 - 217: Mid-grade Tier 3 Demon Beast Attack_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 342: Chapter 217: Mid-grade Tier 3 Demon Beast Attack_3
Within his dantian, mana surged, finally halting his backward flight in midair.
Only a breath after being injured, the vitality within his body surged rapidly, and the damaged skin began to heal at a speed visible to the naked eye.
New skin gradually grew, replacing the charred parts.
However, Xu Ping at this moment had no time to care about his own recovery.
His gaze was like a torch, fixed intently on the third-rank middle-grade demon beast not far away.
He now truly understood the vast gap, like a chasm, between a third-rank middle-grade demon beast and a third-rank lower-grade demon beast.
A third-rank lower-grade demon beast, even without a talisman array, he should be able to contend with it.
But this third-rank middle-grade demon beast in front of him, with just a casual strike, nearly claimed his life—its terrifying strength far exceeded his imagination.
With such prowess, even a talisman array constructed with Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans might not be enough to severely injure it, let alone kill it outright.
And the distant third-rank middle-grade demon beast, seeing Xu Ping forcibly block its attack.
A hint of surprise, extremely rare and human-like, appeared in those demonic eyes.
However, this surprise was fleeting, quickly replaced by deep contempt.
Just a minor Foundation Establishment Cultivator, blocking its first strike—could he block the second?
It advanced slowly towards Xu Ping with heavy steps, each falling step seeming to make the entire lava world tremble.
Facing such an almost hopeless situation, Xu Ping’s heart instead gradually calmed.
There was no other retreat now; only by fighting desperately could there be a sliver of hope.
"Come on, let’s see who dies first!"
A flash of resolute ferocity crossed Xu Ping’s eyes.
"Appear!"
Xu Ping’s hands formed a magic technique, and he uttered a low shout.
In an instant, six Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans appeared out of thin air, floating serenely in the scalding air.
’Control!’
Xu Ping’s hands moved quickly, forming one magic technique after another with precision.
At this moment, his spiritual power continuously gathered onto the talismans floating in the void.
The six talismans instantly burst into intense spiritual light, dazzling in brilliance.
"Condense!"
Xu Ping’s expression became extremely solemn, and his magic technique suddenly changed.
Buzz!
The six talismans quivered violently, interweaving and shuttling through the void with agility.
At this moment, Xu Ping’s divine sense was pushed to its limit, with beads of sweat rolling down his forehead.
But he strove to control the formation of two Three-Talent Talisman Arrays.
Executing one Three-Talent Talisman Array, given Xu Ping’s current capabilities, was not easy, but not insurmountably difficult either.
However, controlling two simultaneously increased the difficulty exponentially.
This not only required robust mana support but also demanded extremely fine control of his divine sense.
Any slight error might not only cause the talisman array to fail to form but could also result in a backlash from the talismans, leaving him severely injured.
If not for the breakthrough to Minor Achievement in the Spirit Platform Cyan Clarity Skill, which significantly boosted his divine sense, he wouldn’t dare try so readily.
"Trap!"
Accompanied by a low cry, Xu Ping’s magic technique continued to change.
However, at this moment, his divine sense suddenly experienced a stabbing pain, as if gripped by an invisible giant hand.
It turned out that controlling too many talismans at once had overloaded his divine sense, showing signs of disorder.
"Trap!"
Xu Ping gritted his teeth, his face twisted in pain, beads of sweat sliding down his face only to be instantly evaporated by the heat.
He forcibly consolidated his somewhat scattered divine sense, despite the excruciating pain in his mind like a thousand needles pricking, he continued with all his might to push for the formation of the talisman array.
Meanwhile, the third-rank middle-grade demon beast seemed to have sensed the peculiarity on Xu Ping’s side.
It halted its heavy steps, raised its enormous head high, and a glint of vigilance passed through its eyes.
Following that, it let out a deafening roar towards the sky.
The flames surrounding its body instantly surged several zhang high, the scorching temperature distorting the air around it.
Immediately, the beast opened its massive mouth, once again spewing out a pillar of lava fire.
This time, the lava fire pillar’s power surpassed its previous one, containing an even more terrifying strength.
The pillar, like a primordial beast freed from its shackles, surged wildly towards Xu Ping with heaven-destroying, earth-extinguishing momentum.
Wherever it passed, it seemed to set space ablaze, leaving a twisted black trail, and the surrounding magma was stirred up into waves dozens of zhang high, making a formidable spectacle.
Xu Ping endured the piercing pain in his mind like a thousand needles pricking, seeing the surging lava fire pillar.
His eyes showed not a hint of fear, only endless grim determination.
"Explode!!!"
Xu Ping’s lips parted slightly, chillingly uttering a single word.
"Boom!"
In an instant, the two hard-formed Three-Talent Talisman Arrays met the surging lava fire pillar and resolutely exploded.
The terrifying might released by the talisman arrays was like a meteor from the heavens crashing down, stirring up massive waves of magma in this world of lava.
Thud!
That terrifying power collided head-on with the lava fire pillar.
For a moment, it seemed the entire world held only this fierce clash of two forces.
The light was blinding, and the roaring sound was so loud it hurt the eardrums.
Energy waves rippled outward, turning any solid rock instantaneously to dust, and churning the surrounding magma like boiling water, splattering in all directions.
In this intense collision, the power of the Three-Talent Talisman Array gradually gained the upper hand.
The once unstoppable lava fire pillar began to twist and deform under the fierce impact of the talisman array’s power.
Finally, with a loud explosion, the lava fire pillar was completely shattered by the Three-Talent Talisman Array.
The fragmented fire pillar turned into countless scorching fragments, scattering in all directions.
And the remaining power of the talisman array, like a surging tide, swept towards the third-rank middle-grade demon beast.
The demon beast seemed to realize that danger was approaching.
Its eyes showed a human-like fear, the once fierce eyes now filled with panic.
It surged demonic power throughout its body, attempting to struggle away, but it was already too late.
Boom!
Roar!
The power of the talisman array instantly engulfed it, and the beast let out a series of tragic screams.
Under the continued assault of the talisman array, the aura of the third-rank middle-grade demon beast quickly weakened.
The flames that once blazed brightly around its body became dim and lackluster, like a candle about to go out.
Large areas of its massive body were covered in charred, savage wounds, from which blood gushed out, only to vaporize in the heat, merging into the surrounding molten rock as if never having existed at all...

chapters.title: Chapter 343 - 218: Escape from Death, Sword Training Epiphany
chapters.content:
Chapter 343: Chapter 218: Escape from Death, Sword Training Epiphany
Meanwhile, Xu Ping found himself severely weakened after successfully deploying two Three Talents Talisman Arrays.
At this moment, his Divine Sense was almost completely depleted, leaving his Sea of Consciousness empty, with only waves of stabbing pain surging like a tide.
His Mana was nearly exhausted as well, making it hard to muster even a single thread of power.
Fortunately, the "Taihang Nourishing God Skill" began to operate on its own.
Small strands of coolness spread from the Cultivation Technique to the Sea of Consciousness, like a long drought meeting a sweet rain, bringing some solace to the aching Sea of Consciousness.
It allowed Xu Ping to barely recover a sliver of spirit.
Thus, he quickly took out several Mana-restoration Pills from his storage bag and swallowed them without hesitation.
The Pills melted as they entered his mouth, a warm medicinal power spreading within him, slowly nourishing the parched meridians, replenishing the drained Mana.
At the same time, Xu Ping recalled the magic treasure that had been blasted away earlier.
That treasure now dimmed, evidently having suffered significant damage during the previous battle.
Xu Ping squeezed out the remaining Mana from his body and hurried toward the mouth of the lava world using the Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill.
As for whether this third-rank middle-grade Demon Beast survived or perished, he couldn’t care less now.
Luckily, in their earlier battle, the surging magma waves around them had almost all been dispersed.
The menacing Demon Beasts had all been killed by the aftermath of the fight.
With no more obstacles, Xu Ping took only a brief moment to arrive at the exit.
"Finally... I’m about to escape this cursed place!"
However, just as Xu Ping was about to heave a sigh of relief—
Roar!
A majestic beast’s roar suddenly came from deep within the lava world.
The sound seemed to carry an overwhelming sense of oppression, like an invisible mountain pressing down, making it hard to breathe.
With this roar, the entire lava world began to tremble violently, with the already turbulent magma rising in towering waves a hundred feet high, creating a terrifying scene.
More fearsome was that this beast’s roar seemed to contain a powerful Spiritual Sense Attack.
Even though Xu Ping was quite far from the source of the sound, he could not avoid being slightly affected.
Under normal circumstances, this level of Spiritual Sense impact would have been no more than a gentle breeze brushing his cheek, nothing worth mentioning for him.
But at this moment, his Divine Sense had long been utterly depleted, and he had no resistance at all.
The beast’s roar pierced into his ears as if a heavy hammer were pounding hard on his Sea of Consciousness.
This made his Sea of Consciousness buzz, and his vision darkened as he almost fainted on the spot.
Luckily, his Sea of Consciousness was sturdy enough to withstand this wave of impact with sheer willpower.
But even so, the Sea of Consciousness throbbed with unbearable pain, causing him to break into a cold sweat, rendering him incapable of performing even the Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill.
"Quick, carry me out of here!"
Xu Ping, suppressing the agony from his Sea of Consciousness, arduously summoned the Spirit Worm from the spirit beast bag.
Though inside the spirit beast bag, the Spirit Worm keenly sensed the terrifying energy fluctuations outside and naturally understood the urgent danger of the situation.
"Hiss hiss!"
It suppressed its panic and fear, carried Xu Ping, and dashed into the pitch-black exit, fleeing with all its strength.
Roar!
The majestic beast’s roar still faintly echoed, but it grew weaker and finally vanished entirely into the boundless darkness.
"Phew!"
Though the cave was pitch-black and one couldn’t see their hand in front of them, Xu Ping couldn’t help but let out a long breath.
However, he dared not relax in the slightest, his nerves still taut.
After all, he couldn’t be entirely sure he was safe yet; who knew if some unpredictable change might still occur in that mysterious and unpredictable lava world?
Likewise, the Spirit Worm understood the gravity of the situation and didn’t dare slow down for even a moment, continuing to flee with all its might without the slightest relaxation.
...
Thus, the Spirit Worm carried Xu Ping in a desperate escape through the dark and deep cave, not knowing how much time had passed.
Finally, a faint light appeared ahead in the dark, deep cave.
At the same time, a cool breeze blew in, sweeping away all the high temperatures within the passage.
Seeing this scene, the Spirit Worm couldn’t help but reveal a look of ecstasy and excitement in its eyes—finally, they were leaving that cursed place!
It never wanted to come back!
Meanwhile, Xu Ping, sitting steadily on the Spirit Worm’s back, finally relaxed his heart that had been hanging in suspense.
Throughout this desperate escape, no Demon Beast had pursued them.
It seemed that they had indeed completely escaped danger and were now safe.
One person and one beast passed through the narrow, winding passage, and the scene before them suddenly became wide and clear.
The long-missed warm sunlight gently spilled on Xu Ping’s face.
He instinctively narrowed his eyes slightly but quickly adjusted to the bright light.
"Stop here."
Xu Ping called to the Spirit Worm that was still about to flee desperately.
Outside, if the Spirit Worm carried him while running, the target would be far too conspicuous.
Moreover, after a period of recovery, his Divine Sense and Mana had somewhat regained, and performing the Escape Technique was no problem.
After returning the Spirit Worm to the storage bag, Xu Ping immediately used his Escape Light skill, quickly disappearing far into the horizon in the blink of an eye.
Meanwhile, the Hundred Beasts Sect Qi Cultivation disciples stationed at Spirit Void Peak noticed nothing unusual.
.....
...
Time flew by, and half a month passed quickly.
When the familiar silhouette of Thousand Leaves Mountain loomed in the distance before Xu Ping’s eyes,

chapters.title: Chapter 344 - 218: Escape from Death, Epiphany in Sword Training (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 344: Chapter 218: Escape from Death, Epiphany in Sword Training (Part 2)
His nerves, which had been tense all along, finally relaxed a little.
But when he thought of that lava world, a shadow still flashed across his heart.
Although he gained substantial rewards this trip, the process was extremely perilous, and he almost met his end in the belly of a Demon Beast.
Especially the beast roar that echoed at the last moment in the lava world. Even from such a distance, it easily shook his Sea of Consciousness.
Xu Ping speculated in his heart that the source of this roar was likely a Fourth Rank Demon Beast comparable in power to a Nascent Soul cultivator.
"A Fourth Rank Demon Beast!"
Xu Ping murmured softly, his eyes slightly narrowed and his expression grave.
Fortunately, he didn’t delve too deep into that lava world; otherwise, he definitely wouldn’t have survived.
Moreover, he vaguely suspected that the major sects of Yue Country might be aware of this lava world.
But it was too dangerous, so they hadn’t dared to explore it.
After all, in this lava world, not to mention Golden Core cultivators, even Nascent Soul cultivators would find little benefit and might even risk their lives.
If given the choice again, he certainly wouldn’t go.
Opportunities are tempting, but they’re always accompanied by huge, unpredictable dangers.
Henceforth, it would be better to cultivate steadily and honestly.
...
A quarter of an hour later.
Xu Ping descended on Thousand Leaves Mountain.
He ignored the sycophantic greeting of the Water Lake Rat, paying it no heed at all.
After releasing the Spirit Worm from his Spiritual Beast bag, Xu Ping walked toward the cultivation chamber without looking back.
This journey was arguably the most dangerous moment he’d experienced, with both his Divine Sense and Mana nearly exhausted.
Subsequently, he had traveled non-stop for half a month and was now utterly exhausted, both physically and mentally.
Inside the cultivation chamber.
Summoning water with Mana, Xu Ping cleansed his entire body thoroughly and then sank into a deep sleep.
This sleep was profoundly gratifying for Xu Ping.
It wasn’t until five days later that he awoke, refreshed and invigorated.
Xu Ping gently opened his eyes, stretched lazily, and couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
"Whew!"
Instantly, the dense Spiritual Qi in the chamber, almost solidified, surged like a tide into his nostrils.
It then flowed along his meridians, swiftly integrating into his body.
At this moment, the Longevity Skill quietly operated, turning all the Spiritual Qi within him into drops of viscous liquid Mana.
Then, Xu Ping calmed his mind and slowly immersed himself in his Sea of Consciousness, focusing intently for a moment.
"Not bad, my Divine Sense has mostly recovered."
Xu Ping slowly opened his eyes, a faint smile unconsciously emerging at the corners of his mouth.
It’s known that once Divine Sense is overexerted, recovery is notoriously slow.
Thankfully, his Sea of Consciousness was solid enough that his recovery speed was much faster than usual.
By this rate, in a few more days, his Divine Sense should fully return to its original state.
...
Xu Ping meticulously checked his Sea of Consciousness several times, ensuring there were no abnormalities before proceeding.
He then took out the Blue Phoenix wood core from his Storage Ring.
At the moment the Blue Phoenix wood core appeared, a vast surge of pure Wood Energy spread immediately throughout the cultivation chamber like a flood breaking its banks.
"Blue Phoenix wood core!"
Upon witnessing this scene, the corners of Xu Ping’s mouth turned upward slightly, forming a satisfied curve.
For now, the Blue Phoenix wood core wasn’t yet useful for Xu Ping.
However, after forming his Golden Core, when crafting his Lifebound Magical Treasure, this Blue Phoenix wood core would play an enormous role.
After all, he had extremely high expectations for his Lifebound Magical Treasure and naturally aimed to craft it as a top-grade magical treasure.
Only in this way could he maximize his combat power.
However, even with the Blue Phoenix wood core, creating a top-grade magical treasure still required other equally top-grade spiritual materials.
Such top-grade materials are exceedingly rare and often fiercely contested by Golden Core cultivators.
With his current strength, competing with numerous Golden Core cultivators for top-tier spiritual materials is truly unnecessary.
Never mind; it’s better to consider these matters after reaching Core Formation."
After pondering for a long time, Xu Ping shook his head in resignation.
Then, with a gentle flip of his hand, the Blue Phoenix wood core re-entered the Storage Ring.
After forming his Golden Core, his strength should see a surge, making it much easier to gather top-tier spiritual materials by then.
After putting away the Blue Phoenix wood core, Xu Ping took out the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus.
If the Blue Phoenix wood core was to serve its purpose post-Golden Core, then the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus could exert its significant effects both now and in the future.
After all, a treasure that enhanced perception was absolutely perfect for someone like Xu Ping, who possessed a proficiency board.
"A total of nine lotus seeds, meaning nine chances for brief perceptive enhancement."
Xu Ping gazed at the Flame Splendor Enlightenment Heart Lotus, the nine lotus seeds gleaming like brilliant stars, and his eyes involuntarily showed signs of excitement and eagerness.
If used wisely, these Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seeds might elevate his abilities to the next level.
Thinking of this, Xu Ping couldn’t wait to open his proficiency board.
His eyes quickly scanned all his skills and eventually settled on the Primordial Sword Skill.
[Primordial Sword Skill Perfection: 1291/1600]
...
At this moment, the Primordial Sword Skill needed 309 more proficiency points to break through to the state of Perfection.
At the normal pace, it would take at least a dozen or even twenty years to break through.
After all, proficiency becomes harder to increase as it nears completion.

chapters.title: Chapter 345 - 218: Escape from Death, Epiphany in Sword Training (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 345: Chapter 218: Escape from Death, Epiphany in Sword Training (Part 3)
But with the help of the Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seeds, I believe it won’t take long to break through to the Perfection Level.
Once the Primordial Sword Skill reaches perfection, it will be the moment he fully comprehends the second realm of Sword Dao—Sword Light Like a Rainbow.
"Sword Light Like a Rainbow!!"
At the thought of this, Xu Ping couldn’t help but feel a surge of uncontrollable excitement in his heart.
It is known that even among Golden Core Cultivators, sword cultivators who can comprehend Sword Light Like a Rainbow are extremely rare.
They are undoubtedly the most elite among the Golden Core Cultivators.
A general Golden Core Cultivator might be defeated with a single sword strike.
For Xu Ping, even if he fully comprehends Sword Light Like a Rainbow, limited by his own mana, he certainly won’t possess the terrifying power of those top-tier sword cultivators.
But he believes that with this realm, he should have a good chance of slaying an Early-Stage Golden Core Cultivator.
...
Although Xu Ping was already determined, he did not rashly consume the Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seeds.
Instead, he spent several days restoring his Divine Sense and Mana to their optimal state.
After all, only this way could he maximize the effects of the Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seeds.
Six days later, inside the cultivation chamber.
"Let’s begin!"
With the Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seeds in his palm, Xu Ping gazed at them for a long time, filled with anticipation and caution.
In the next moment, he tilted his head back and put the seeds into his mouth.
The seeds melted as soon as they entered!
Instantly, a strange power surged into his mind like a trickling stream.
In an instant, Xu Ping felt his mind become utterly clear and pure, as if a spring rain had washed away all dust.
His thoughts were unprecedentedly sharp and clear, each turn of thought as fast as lightning, unhindered.
Even his Sea of Consciousness became particularly active, the originally calm sea now stirred by a giant stone, creating ripples upon ripples, with light flickering intermittently.
At this moment, even without spreading his Divine Sense, he could still clearly sense every subtle change around him.
The movement of each speck of dust in the chamber, the faint energy fluctuations emitted by the array runes on the walls, all clearly transmitted into his perception.
This wondrous state was similar to his previous small epiphany, but more profound and lasting.
Xu Ping knew such an opportunity was once in a lifetime, and he couldn’t waste a single moment.
He immediately stood up, his figure flickering like a ghost as he left the cultivation chamber and arrived at a vacant spot on Thousand Leaves Mountain.
The surroundings were tranquil, only a gentle breeze sweeping past, flowers and grasses swaying.
Xu Ping stood firm, feet slightly apart, firmly rooted to the earth, hands tightly gripping the hilt of the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword.
Sunlight shone on the sword blade, reflecting a cool and sharp azure glow.
Xu Ping held the sword with one hand and thrust it forward sharply, a fierce sword light instantly slicing through the air with a sharp whistling sound, the Primordial Sword Skill flowing out naturally and smoothly.
As the sword moves were continuously performed!
In an instant, various insights into the Primordial Sword Skill flooded into his mind like a tidal wave.
His Swordsmanship became increasingly exquisite.
The sword wind whistled, lifting sand and stones from the ground, forming vortices in the air.
With every move and every style, Xu Ping infused his newfound insights into the Primordial Sword Skill.
His body seemed to merge with the sword, movements fluid and natural, the power of his Swordsmanship growing stronger.
Time quietly passed as Xu Ping lost himself in his sword practice.
A day passed, two days passed...
He was completely immersed in the world of Sword Dao, forgetting everything around him, forgetting the passage of time.
In his eyes, there was only the sword in his hand and the continuously climbing insights into Sword Dao.
Thus, the process of practicing swordsmanship continued.
However, the effects of the Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seeds gradually diminished unnoticed...
...
A month and a half passed quietly as Xu Ping was immersed in the world of Sword Dao cultivation.
Finally, when the effects of the Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seeds completely disappeared.
Xu Ping slowly sheathed his sword, awakening from his state of immersion.
At this moment, he appeared slightly fatigued, but his eyes sparkled with extreme excitement.
Xu Ping impatiently checked the proficiency panel.
[Primordial Sword Skill Mastery: 1460/1600]
...
"1460 points!"
"An increase of 169 points in proficiency!!"
Seeing the clear display on the panel, Xu Ping could no longer contain his inner excitement and joy, breaking into hearty laughter.
The effects of the Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seeds were simply too good, far exceeding his expectations.
It increased his proficiency by dozens of points more than his last epiphany.
Now, the Primordial Sword Skill is only 140 points away from a complete breakthrough to the Perfection Level.
If it were before, accumulating these 140 proficiency points would have taken at least a decade with regular cultivation speed.
But now, it seems that consuming just one more Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seeds could easily achieve it.
This stark contrast left Xu Ping in continuous amazement at the magical effects of the Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seeds.
"However, how long have I been practicing sword?"
With his emotions slightly calmed, Xu Ping calculated and realized he had spent a full month and a half practicing the "Primordial Sword Skill" unknowingly.
"Indeed, so much time has passed!" Xu Ping marveled inwardly.
Although he had a vague sense of it during cultivation, confirming the duration indeed greatly surprised him.
Reflecting on it, it’s no wonder that the proficiency in the Primordial Sword Skill saw such a significant boost.
After all, his last epiphany of sword practice lasted only ten days.
"That means the effect of the Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seeds can last for forty-five days." Upon realizing this, Xu Ping’s eyes lit up instantly.
This long duration!
As long as he’s not cultivating those extremely heaven-defying, high-difficulty secret techniques or cultivation techniques.
With the Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seeds enhancing his comprehension.
Whether significantly increasing the proficiency of secret techniques and cultivation techniques, or directly cultivating them to the entry level, should be quite achievable.
Indeed, the Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seeds and his proficiency panel are a perfect match!!
"The next time I consume the Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seeds, it will be the moment I comprehend Sword Light Like a Rainbow."
Xu Ping thought with great ambition, then gracefully spun a beautiful sword flower before gently placing the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword into his Storage Ring.
The long period of intense sword practice had drained his physical and mental energy significantly.
After all, immersing himself entirely in sword practice for such a long time had exhausted his physical and mental energy to the limit.
If he were to forcibly consume another Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seed and continue practicing swordsmanship, his body might not withstand it, and the ultimate cultivation effect would surely be compromised.
He decided to wait until his energy and stamina were restored to their best state before consuming another Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seed.

chapters.title: Chapter 346 - 219: Wild Bugs, Red Flame Golden Beetle
chapters.content:
Chapter 346: Chapter 219: Wild Bugs, Red Flame Golden Beetle
"Master, thank you for your hard work!"
At this moment, the Water Lake Mouse trotted over, its face full of a flattering smile, and respectfully handed Xu Ping a freshly brewed cup.
"Mm."
Xu Ping gently responded, reaching out to take the Spirit Tea, his gaze slowly falling on the Water Lake Mouse.
At this time, the aura emanating from the Water Lake Mouse had already reached the pinnacle of the Second-stage Middle Grade, just a step away from the Second-stage Upper Grade.
"Not bad, it seems you haven’t been slacking off." Xu Ping, quite pleased, couldn’t help but praise the Water Lake Mouse.
"It’s all thanks to your excellent guidance, Master!"
The Water Lake Mouse, hearing this, had an even more ingratiating smile on its face and quickly flattered Xu Ping endlessly.
"If you diligently stabilize your cultivation for another two or three months, I will help you break through to the Second-stage Upper Grade."
Xu Ping nodded with satisfaction and said.
The Water Lake Mouse had great natural talent, and with his assistance, the chance of breaking through to the Second-stage Upper Grade was still very high.
Once it reaches the Second-stage Upper Grade, it can prepare for a breakthrough to the Third-stage.
"Thank you, Master."
Upon hearing this, the Water Lake Mouse was overjoyed, and quickly expressed its gratitude repeatedly.
In its heart, it thought to itself that once it broke through to the Second-stage Upper Grade, it would definitely surpass that stupid Spirit Worm.
...
Feeling slightly exhausted, Xu Ping did not continue chatting with the Water Lake Mouse. After downing the Spirit Tea in one go, he turned around and went straight back to the cultivation chamber.
Five more days passed.
Time flew by, and in the blink of an eye, another five days had passed.
Inside the cultivation chamber.
Whoosh!
Accompanied by the slow operation of the Longevity Skill, the countless Spiritual Qi in the surrounding heaven and earth rushed towards Xu Ping’s body like a lustful ghost seeing a naked woman.
Once the Spiritual Qi entered his body, it quickly refined into droplets of dense and substantial liquid mana.
Suddenly!
The spirit beast pouch hanging at Xu Ping’s waist trembled slightly without warning.
Xu Ping, who was silently cultivating, frowned slightly and immediately stopped the operation of the Longevity Skill, slowly opening his eyes.
Immediately, his Divine Sense spread out and directly invaded the spirit beast pouch.
"This is... the embryos of the bugs are about to hatch?" Xu Ping was full of surprise.
He clearly discovered that the surface of the more than fifty blood-red embryos in the spirit beast pouch was now covered with a dense network of cracks.
After pondering for a moment, he directly injected a trace of mana into the spirit beast pouch.
In an instant, more than fifty blood-red embryos appeared out of thin air on the floor of the cultivation chamber, neatly piled together.
Crack, crack, crack...
Crisp sounds rang out in succession, the cracks on the more than fifty blood-red embryos spreading quickly like a spider web.
Crack...
Finally, the embryos all cracked open one by one.
Inch-sized larvae broke out of their shells, covered in crimson carapaces.
As soon as these larvae were born, they were driven by instinct to immediately start devouring the embryos from which they hatched.
Their sharp mandibles, glistening with a cold light, moved rapidly, gnawing away the embryos bit by bit.
Among them, three or four particularly agile larvae devoured their embryos so quickly that after finishing, their bodies were noticeably larger, appearing much stronger than the rest.
Perhaps because they felt the significant increase in power, or perhaps out of a natural instinct for resource competition.
These few larger larvae suddenly turned and charged at the embryos that the other larvae had yet to finish eating.
After devouring more embryos, the larvae, now even larger, obviously held a significant advantage over the other larvae.
Xu Ping stood by, watching this scene quietly without intervening.
After all, only through such a brutal selection could the most potential individuals be retained.
At the same time, Xu Ping’s Divine Sense spread out like threads, penetrating into the Sea of Consciousness of the fifty or so larvae.
Then, he planted Divine Sense imprints in them individually to better control these larvae in the future.
Given Xu Ping’s current Divine Sense strength.
Planting Divine Sense imprints in the Sea of Consciousness of fifty barely First Rank Lower Grade demon beasts was not particularly difficult.
It only took a quarter of an hour to plant the Divine Sense imprints in all the larvae’s Seas of Consciousness.
And at this moment, the embryos that hatched the larvae had been completely devoured clean.
It seemed that they had successfully completed the first stage of growth, their bodies noticeably larger than when they had just hatched.
"Zizi!"
Upon letting out a collective screech, the larvae swarmed towards Xu Ping.
In their crimson demon eyes, a faint sense of closeness towards Xu Ping was unexpectedly revealed.
Xu Ping’s heart stirred slightly, keenly aware of the dependency these larvae had on him.
Upon reflection, this was actually quite normal.
After all, the larvae had just come into the world, and Xu Ping had planted a Divine Sense imprint in their Sea of Consciousness.
They instinctively mistook the familiar aura from Xu Ping’s body as someone closest to them.
"Zizi!"
The larvae circled tightly around Xu Ping, constantly emitting bursts of screeches.
"Are they... hungry?"
Xu Ping wondered, then extended his Divine Sense, clearly receiving a strong sense of hunger from the larvae.
Clearly, the embryos had only been an appetizer for them.
Now they urgently needed more food to satisfy their growth needs.

chapters.title: Chapter 347 - 219: Wild Bugs, Red Flame Golden Beetle_2
chapters.content:
Chapter 347: Chapter 219: Wild Bugs, Red Flame Golden Beetle_2
Xu Ping did not hesitate in the slightest and took out some pills he had stored for ordinary use.
These pills were meticulously refined by him, containing abundant spiritual power, and were extremely nourishing for an average demon beast.
However, the larvae merely circled around the pills, their antennae slightly moving, yet not a single one stepped forward to consume them.
Xu Ping frowned slightly, then immediately took out a few spirit medicines from his storage ring.
But the larvae were still unmoved, merely wandering in place, while that feeling of hunger grew stronger.
Seeing this scene, Xu Ping’s brow furrowed tightly, pondering to himself:
"They don’t eat pills, nor do they touch spirit medicines, so what exactly do they eat?"
While he was contemplating silently.
The divine sense transmission of the Water Lake Mouse pierced through the wall, clearly entering his ear: "Master, Zhou Tianle has come to visit!"
"Zhou Tianle?"
Xu Ping’s expression shifted, and he promptly said, "Invite him to the pavilion."
Over the years, the other party occasionally came to Thousand Leaves Mountain to purchase pills or talismans from him.
Moreover, the Zhou family was specifically engaged in the breeding of spiritual beasts, so perhaps they would know what these larvae eat.
...
...
In the pavilion, the fragrance of tea lingered.
Xu Ping personally poured a cup of spirit tea for Zhou Tianle; the tea was clear, the spiritual qi billowing, obviously an uncommon product.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Xu." Zhou Tianle said slightly nervously.
Though both of them were cultivators at the Foundation Establishment Stage, Xu Ping’s status was far above his.
If it weren’t for their long acquaintance and some slight affection between them, he might not even be able to enter Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"Fellow Daoist Zhou, we have been acquainted for many years, and our friendship is deep, there’s no need to be so formal." Xu Ping smiled slightly.
Hearing this, Zhou Tianle couldn’t help but breathe a sigh of relief, his previously tense expression also relaxed significantly, and a smile gradually appeared on his face:
"Fellow Daoist Xu, despite your busy affairs, you still take the time to entertain me, I am truly flattered."
Xu Ping gently sipped the spirit tea, then put down the teacup, with a faint smile on his lips, and slowly said:
"Currently, I am quite relaxed, since most of the elite cultivators from Yue Country have gone to Feng Country, no one comes to buy talismans from me."
"That’s true, recently, the sales of the spiritual beasts my family raises have also dropped significantly."
Zhou Tianle nodded in agreement, echoing along.
The two of them casually chatted, and the atmosphere gradually became congenial.
After a few casual exchanges, Zhou Tianle’s face showed a hint of hesitation, but in the end, he said: "Fellow Daoist Xu, this time I actually have a request."
"By all means." Xu Ping assumed a posture of earnest listening, nodding slightly.
He was also planning to ask the other party about those larvae.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, could you help me refine a Foundation Establishment Pill?"
While saying this, Zhou Tianle respectfully cupped his hands, his attitude very sincere, "I have already prepared all the materials needed for refining the Foundation Establishment Pill."
Having known each other for years, Zhou Tianle naturally knew Xu Ping’s initial expertise was in alchemy.
However, in later days, Xu Ping’s skills in drawing talismans improved rapidly, unexpectedly reaching the third tier, and his reputation grew larger.
"Refining a Foundation Establishment Pill?"
Upon hearing this request, Xu Ping slightly squinted his eyes, pondered a bit, then nodded and agreed,
"Since Fellow Daoist Zhou has asked, I will undertake this matter."
Given his current proficiency in alchemy, refining a Foundation Establishment Pill was not too challenging a task.
Hearing this, Zhou Tianle was overjoyed, immediately stood up and bowed in gratitude: "Fellow Daoist Xu, I will never forget your great kindness!"
Currently, in Yue Country, alchemists capable of refining Foundation Establishment Pills were very few, most having gone to Feng Country.
Now, among the people Zhou Tianle knew, the only person he felt had a great chance of refining a Foundation Establishment Pill and whom he was acquainted with was Xu Ping.
"Fellow Daoist Zhou, you are being too courteous. In fact, I also have a matter where I need your advice."
Xu Ping smiled and gestured for Zhou Tianle to sit down, then continued.
"Please feel free to ask, Fellow Daoist Xu. As long as it is within my ability, I will not refuse!" Zhou Tianle promised earnestly.
"Fellow Daoist Zhou, don’t be nervous, it’s not a big deal."
Xu Ping smiled slightly, then turned his palm, revealing a larvae with a bright red shell suddenly in his palm.
"Do you happen to recognize this larvae, Fellow Daoist Zhou?" Xu Ping handed the larvae to Zhou Tianle and asked.
"This...demon insect?"
Seeing the larvae that had suddenly appeared, Zhou Tianle couldn’t help but frown slightly, a trace of doubt flashed in his eyes.
He immediately leaned in, closely observing the larvae, carefully identifying it.
"Chi chi!"
The larvae, seeing Zhou Tianle before it, let out an angry squeal, flapped its wings, and tried to rush to bite him.
"Quite fierce?"
Zhou Tianle pointed his finger, and mana surged forth, instantly immobilizing the larvae mid-air, then began to examine it carefully.
As time ticked by, after a quarter of an hour, Zhou Tianle frowned even more deeply, immersed in profound thought.
He sometimes lowered his head to gaze at the larvae, sometimes gently shook his head, seemingly recalling something.
Xu Ping sat silently on the side, not interrupting.
Another quarter-hour passed.
"Could it be..."
Zhou Tianle’s expression suddenly changed slightly, a trace of surprise and realization flickered in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 348 - 219: Wild Bugs, Red Flame Golden Beetle_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 348: Chapter 219: Wild Bugs, Red Flame Golden Beetle_3
Immediately afterwards, he took out a piece of crimson ore and held it near the larva’s mouth with Mana.
"Squeak Squeak!!"
The larva, upon seeing this piece of crimson ore, let out an extremely excited scream.
Its appearance was akin to a starving ghost suddenly encountering a feast, eagerly opening its sharp mandibles and beginning to devour the red ore greedily.
"These insects like to eat ore?" Seeing this scene, Xu Ping raised an eyebrow in surprise.
At this moment, Zhou Tianle, observing the larva’s frenzied feeding behavior, gradually relaxed his furrowed brow, displaying a confident expression on his face as he declared assuredly:
"Fellow Daoist Xu, this larva should indeed be the famed Wild Beast—the Red Flame Golden Beetle!"
"Wild Beast?"
"Red Flame Golden Beetle?"
Xu Ping looked puzzled and then asked, "What difference is there between a Wild Beast and a Demon Beast?"
Zhou Tianle fell silent for a moment, organizing his thoughts before speaking: "The biggest difference between Wild Beasts and Demon Beasts mainly lies in two aspects."
"Firstly, it’s their spiritual intelligence."
He paused slightly and emphasized, "Wild Beasts possess far less spiritual intelligence compared to Demon Beasts."
"Moreover, even if Wild Beasts cross the high-grade advancement, there won’t be much increase or change in their intelligence."
"The second difference lies in transformation."
At this point, Zhou Tianle looked at Xu Ping, seemingly checking if he was aware of the relevant information.
"I suppose Fellow Daoist Xu knows that Demon Beasts reaching the Fourth Rank possess the ability to transform, right?"
"In this regard, I am indeed aware." Xu Ping nodded.
Third Rank peak Demon Beasts, after surviving the Fourth Rank transformation tribulation, can partially transform into human form.
As a Demon Beast’s cultivation deepens, more of its body can transform. When reaching the Fourth Rank peak, comparable to Nascent Soul Perfection cultivators, it can fully transform into human form.
It should be noted that Demon Beasts already have an incredibly long lifespan.
Now having fully transformed into human form, with human intelligence, their combat power would undergo a tremendous increase.
Ordinary Nascent Soul Perfection cultivators wouldn’t be able to compete.
"Even if Wild Beasts achieve the Fourth Rank, they do not transform, maintaining their original form."
Zhou Tianle continued, "Although in terms of intelligence and transformation, Wild Beasts are far inferior to Demon Beasts."
But in certain specific areas, Wild Beasts have an advantage far beyond Demon Beasts."
"For example, the Red Flame Golden Beetle in Fellow Daoist Xu’s possession is renowned for defense; an adult Red Flame Golden Beetle can withstand magical treasure attacks."
"Moreover, this creature’s teeth are extraordinarily sharp, even able to gnaw on magical treasures."
"Capable of gnawing on magical treasures?"
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping’s eyes gleamed.
This, he didn’t know.
After all, those dozen mature Red Flame Golden Beetles were easily killed by him using a Talisman Array back then.
It seems, he underestimated this insect.
To besiege a Golden Core Cultivator, perhaps a dozen Red Flame Golden Beetles would suffice.
Suppressing his thoughts, Xu Ping then asked, "Do these Red Flame Golden Beetles indeed feed on ore?"
"Yes."
Zhou Tianle nodded, "The higher the quality of the ore, the greater the attraction to them."
After listening, Xu Ping immediately understood.
Zhou Tianle pondered for a moment, then smiled as he took out a jade slip from the storage ring and handed it to Xu Ping:
"Fellow Daoist Xu, this jade slip contains the hereditary method for raising spiritual beasts by the Zhou family."
"Inside are detailed records of various Demon Beasts or Wild Beasts. If Fellow Daoist Xu does not mind, please take it."
If an ordinary person wanted his family’s spiritual beast raising hereditary jade slip, they wouldn’t even dream about it; there’s no way.
But Xu Ping is, after all, a Third Rank Talisman Master and presently has a request toward the other party.
If their relationship could advance further, the benefits would be tremendous for both him and his family.
Xu Ping did not refuse, reached out to take the jade slip, and quickly scanned it with his Divine Sense.
After merely glancing at it briefly, he displayed a satisfied smile and promptly stored the jade slip, smiling:
"Then, without further ado, I will gladly accept it."
This set of hereditary jade slips contains numerous detailed information about Demon Beasts and Wild Beasts.
If transacted at an auction house, considering the value contained within, it could undoubtedly fetch an extremely high price.
...
The two then exchanged a few sentences around spiritual beast raising and Alchemy Techniques before Xu Ping glanced at the sky and stood up to say:
"Fellow Daoist Zhou, there’s no time to waste; let’s begin alchemy."
Upon hearing this, Zhou Tianle quickly nodded repeatedly in agreement.
Naturally, he was eager to refine the Foundation Establishment Pill successfully as soon as possible; hearing Xu Ping propose to start alchemy, he had no reason to refuse.
Subsequently, the two entered Xu Ping’s dedicated alchemy room.
After Xu Ping thoroughly checked the materials Zhou Tianle had prepared, confirming their accuracy, he began the alchemy process.
In the room, the Pill Furnace emitted a scorching glow as Xu Ping calmly controlled the heat and adjusted the timing for adding various materials.
Given his current alchemy technique and proficient skills panel, the possibility of failing to refine the Foundation Establishment Pill was virtually nonexistent.
...
Four days passed quietly.
A faint medicinal scent wafted from the room, refreshing the mind.
At this point, the alchemy process was nearing its end.
The Alchemy Furnace emitted radiant light, exuding a dense medicinal aroma.
"Open!"
Xu Ping gently breathed out the word, made a spell with his hands, and performed the Furnace Skill.
Buzz!
A shimmering array of colors burst through the furnace lid as heat surged outward.
Above the Alchemy Furnace, faintly appeared auspicious clouds, enveloped by colorful halos.
"This phenomenon...."
"The Foundation Establishment Pill is complete!!"
Zhou Tianle’s eyes widened, his face displaying both shock and joy.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
The auspicious clouds wrapped around two pills, dropping them into Xu Ping’s hands.
Excitedly, Zhou Tianle looked over.
Two pills, gleaming with crystal clarity, rested silently in Xu Ping’s palm.

chapters.title: Chapter 349 - 220: Sword Light Like a Rainbow
chapters.content:
Chapter 349: Chapter 220: Sword Light Like a Rainbow
"Fortunately, the mission is not disgraced, and the Foundation Establishment Pill has been successfully refined."
Xu Ping smiled slightly, his expression calm and composed.
In fact, if he gave it his all, he could probably produce three pills.
But there was really no need; maintaining it at an average level was sufficient.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Xu."
Zhou Tianle couldn’t hide the joy in his heart, his voice involuntarily rising a few notches.
Though, given Xu Ping’s profound mastery in the path of alchemy, the likelihood of successfully refining the Foundation Establishment Pill was very high.
However, alchemy is always unpredictable; even the top alchemists dare not guarantee a hundred percent success rate.
There is always a risk of failure, after all.
Now, seeing this long-dreamed-of Foundation Establishment Pill successfully refined, the heavy stone that pressed on his heart for so long finally dropped.
"It’s just my duty."
Xu Ping replied with a smile, then used mana to float the two Foundation Establishment Pills towards Zhou Tianle.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, you...what is this?"
Looking at the two pills in front of him, their colors glossy and bright, Zhou Tianle’s face showed a hint of hesitation.
According to the unwritten rule for refining the Foundation Establishment Pill, if two pills are formed, one should be given to the alchemist.
"I have long succeeded in establishing my foundation, and I have no descendants, so this Foundation Establishment Pill isn’t of much use to me."
Xu Ping smiled slightly and explained, "Besides, the spiritual beast inheritance that Fellow Daoist Zhou previously gifted to me is already precious enough to compensate for this session of alchemy."
To him, while the Foundation Establishment Pill is indeed valuable, the spiritual beast inheritance is evidently more useful.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, great kindness needs no thanks. Should you require anything of Zhou in the future, as long as it is within my ability, I will certainly not refuse."
Upon hearing this, Zhou Tianle spoke with a tone of sincere gratitude.
Now, with two Foundation Establishment Pills in hand, as long as fortune doesn’t turn unfavorable, at least one Foundation Establishment Cultivator should arise within their clan, greatly enhancing the clan’s strength as a result.
"Fellow Daoist Zhou, you are too kind."
Xu Ping waved his hand and then said, "However, I hope Fellow Daoist Zhou can help me gather some ores for the Red Flame Golden Beetle to feed on."
"The higher the quality, the better!" he added as a final comment.
Although gathering ores is not a troublesome matter, it does consume a significant amount of time.
It’s best to have Zhou Tianle gather them instead.
After all, they have many clan members, and they are quite familiar with the Red Flame Golden Beetle, so they naturally know what kind of ores to collect.
"A mere trifle! Rest assured, Fellow Daoist Xu!"
Zhou Tianle confidently replied, patting his chest.
Gathering these ores, indeed, wasn’t a difficult task for him.
"Thank you, then, Fellow Daoist Zhou." Xu Ping thanked him with a smile.
The two of them then chatted casually for a while, the atmosphere harmonious.
Before long, Zhou Tianle stood up to bid farewell.
"I shall take my leave now; I will promptly collect the ores for Fellow Daoist Xu."
Zhou Tianle cupped his hands in salute, bowing respectfully.
"No rush, no rush, Fellow Daoist Zhou, there’s no need to hurry, let everything proceed slowly."
Xu Ping said as he escorted Zhou Tianle out of the cave.
"Please stay, Fellow Daoist Xu."
Zhou Tianle politely returned the salute and then summoned a spiritual boat.
Stepping onto the spiritual boat, with spiritual power circulating, the boat transformed into a streak of light, rushing towards the sky.
Just as Xu Ping was about to return to the cultivation room.
A subtle Divine Sense attempted to sweep across Thousand Leaves Mountain, bypassing numerous arrays.
Due to the obstruction of the arrays and the person’s fear of causing any unusual fluctuation in them, they didn’t force their way through.
In an instant, Xu Ping’s steps suddenly paused.
But it was only for a moment, and he quickly resumed as usual, his expression steady as he headed towards the cultivation room.
On the surface, he walked with a calm demeanor, but his heart couldn’t help but sink a little.
He keenly sensed that this Divine Sense attempting to spy on Thousand Leaves Mountain was actually slightly stronger than his own.
Undoubtedly, this was a genuine Golden Core level Divine Sense.
Fortunately, it was only a little stronger than his, indicating that it was likely just an Early-Stage Golden Core Cultivator.
"Who could it be?"
"Could it be... Song Fei?"
Almost instantly, Song Fei’s image flashed through Xu Ping’s mind.
At the Early-Stage Golden Core level, and secretly spying on Thousand Leaves Mountain with ill intentions, there were not many suspects.
The one with the greatest suspicion was Song Fei, who was wanted by the Luoyun Sect.
He hadn’t forgotten the last time when Song Fei colluded with Shuize Sect remnant Haojun to plot against him.
"I haven’t gone looking for you, yet you come looking for me instead." Xu Ping coldly sneered in his heart, killing intent quietly spreading.
Currently, most of the Luoyun Sect’s elites have gone to Feng Country to participate in the campaign, significantly reducing their control over Yue Country.
In such a situation, it seemed reasonable for Song Fei to dare to show up.
Given the remaining strength of Luoyun Sect, ensuring their own safety is already considered good, let alone having the strength to capture Song Fei.
After Xu Ping entered the cultivation room, the array of the room slowly activated, completely isolating all external perception.
At this moment, the calmness on his face instantly disappeared, replaced by a sullen expression.
"I must find an opportunity to kill him!"
Plotting against him repeatedly, did they really think he was made of clay?
Although killing an Early-Stage Golden Core Cultivator is more difficult than killing a third-rank lower-grade demon beast.
But with his strength, it’s not an insurmountable task.
As long as he plans, sooner or later, he will kill him.

chapters.title: Chapter 350 - 220: Sword Light Like a Rainbow (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 350: Chapter 220: Sword Light Like a Rainbow (Part 2)
However, Xu Ping calmed down and after careful consideration, decided to temporarily set this matter aside.
He planned to first break through to the Perfection realm of the Primordial Sword Skill, fully comprehending the state of Sword Light like a Rainbow, before dealing with Song Fei.
Currently, the only means in his hands that could pose a deadly threat to Song Fei was the Talisman Array.
But Xu Ping felt that this was not secure!
He couldn’t guarantee that Song Fei wouldn’t have some hidden trump card.
Once he fully comprehends "Sword Light like a Rainbow," he would be confident of defeating Song Fei relying solely on swordsmanship.
With such double assurance, he could significantly increase the success rate of assassinating Song Fei.
Otherwise, if by accident, the opponent escapes, it would be a very troublesome matter.
After making up his mind, Xu Ping did not hesitate any further, immediately sitting cross-legged on a mat, closing his eyes, and focusing all his effort on recovering the Mana and Divine Sense consumed during the recent days of alchemy.
After all, the matter of consuming the Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seeds was extremely important and couldn’t be done blindly. He had to adjust his state to its best to ensure nothing would go wrong.
.....
...
Outside Thousand Leaves Mountain.
In a tranquil dense forest, a thick black fog as substantial as a solid entity was raging wildly.
Suddenly, the black fog surged, and slowly emerged a young cultivator dressed in a cyan robe.
Upon a closer look, it was actually Song Fei!
At this moment, his whole body exuded an intense Evil Qi that was almost tangible.
Even in his deep eyes, wisps of black gas swirled mysteriously, sending chills down one’s spine.
"Trying to probe into the inside of Thousand Leaves Mountain without triggering the Array is extremely difficult!"
Song Fei gazed with a sinister expression at Thousand Leaves Mountain, which was tightly enveloped by the Array, his brows furrowing tightly.
Recalling the previous instance where Hao Jun disguised himself and sneaked into Thousand Leaves Mountain only to be easily discovered by Xu Ping, Song Fei no longer dared to recklessly venture into Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Though he always prided himself on having disguising skills far superior to Hao Jun’s,
he wouldn’t dare to attempt anything with even a slight risk in matters concerning life and death.
In Thousand Leaves Mountain, with the suppression of the Array, plus Xu Ping, the Third Tier Talisman Master, even as a Golden Core Cultivator, he would likely be at a disadvantage.
"I don’t believe you can stay in Thousand Leaves Mountain forever!" A glint of coldness flashed in Song Fei’s eyes.
To prevent unexpected situations, he would guard outside Thousand Leaves Mountain, waiting for Xu Ping to make a move.
Anyway, the elite of the Luoyun Sect had almost all gone to conquer Feng Country.
Now he had both the time and patience to slowly wear down Xu Ping.
...
...
Time flew by swiftly; five days passed in a flash like a fleeting horse.
Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Inside the cultivation chamber.
"This time, I must fully comprehend Sword Light like a Rainbow!!"
Xu Ping gazed at the Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seed in his palm that emitted a gentle glow, a flicker of determination in his eyes.
In the next moment, he lifted his head and placed the Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seed into his mouth.
The lotus seed, just like last time, melted upon entry.
Instantly, a tremendous and rich strange power surged into his mind like a torrential river.
At this moment, all distracting thoughts in his heart disappeared instantly, as if he found himself in a pure spiritual realm.
This time, Xu Ping did not rush to draw his sword.
He slowly closed his eyes, immersed in this powerful force of comprehension, beginning to construct a world of Sword Dao in his mind.
He recalled every bit of his past sword practice, from the initial ignorance in the Sword Dao to the gradual improvement of his Sword Dao state, every detail, every change of mindset clearly surfaced.
In this spiritual world, Xu Ping wielded his heart as the sword, his intent driving his form.
He dissected and reassembled every move of the Primordial Sword Skill, seeking deeper logic and profound meanings within them.
He no longer confined himself to the superficial forms of sword moves but delved into the essence, comprehending the ultimate state where Sword Intent precedes, and sword moves follow.
Immersed like this in deep exploration of thought, unknown periods passed before Xu Ping slowly opened his eyes, his gaze shining brightly.
He reached out and grasped the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword by his side.
This time he did not hurry to perform sword moves but gently waved the wooden sword, feeling the friction between the sword and the air, experiencing the purest form of swinging a sword.
Xu Ping lightly tapped his foot, his figure drifting like a phantom through the cultivation chamber.
His movements were light and graceful, seemingly casual yet imbued with a certain rhythm.
The Magical Treasure Wooden Sword in his hand moved slowly at times, vibrating rapidly at others, each movement subtly changing the surrounding Spiritual Power.
He no longer pursued the sharpness and ferocity of sword moves but focused on the harmonious unification of sword, self, and the surrounding environment.
Within this small cultivation chamber,
an invisible yet powerful sword force began to spread slowly with him at the center.
The Sword Intent in the air became more intense, making the surroundings seem motionless, even as if time itself stood still.
With the continuous execution of sword moves, various insights regarding the Primordial Sword Skill poured into his mind like a continuous stream.
These insights were no longer scattered fragments but gradually woven into a complete system, allowing Xu Ping’s understanding of the Primordial Sword Skill to reach a new height.
In that instant, Xu Ping’s body seemed to merge with heaven and earth.
The power of his swordsmanship became increasingly stronger, with crisscrossing Sword Qi forming a splendid yet dangerous realm of the sword in the cultivation chamber.
Half a month quietly passed, and the medicinal power of the Enlightenment Heart Lotus Seed gradually faded.
Yet, Xu Ping was deeply immersed in the wondrous realm of Sword Dao, unable to extricate himself.
His swordsmanship entered a state of spontaneity where without deliberate thought, his body could naturally execute sword moves in alignment with the surrounding environment and his inner Sword Intent.

chapters.title: Chapter 351 - 220: Sword Light Like a Rainbow (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 351: Chapter 220: Sword Light Like a Rainbow (Part 3)
Another month had passed, and the atmosphere within the cultivation chamber grew increasingly heavy.
Xu Ping stood quietly in place, surrounded by an almost imperceptible aura of Sword Qi.
This Sword Qi was no longer sharp and fierce, but carried a gentle and peaceful yet unfathomable presence.
Finally, in a tranquil moment, Xu Ping gently shook the wooden sword in his hand.
In an instant, a soft and radiant light blossomed from the sword’s tip.
The light was not dazzlingly bright, but spread like moonlight, gentle and far-reaching.
The next instant.
"Hoo!"
Xu Ping exhaled a long breath, slowly waking from the miraculous state of enlightenment.
He opened his eyes slowly, a sharp gleam seemingly flashing through his gaze.
At this moment, he appeared bewildered, as if he had just endured a long and deep dream, momentarily unsure of his whereabouts.
Only after a long daze did he gradually regain his senses.
Feeling the surging Spiritual Power within him, and the sword Dao insights brimming in his mind.
"I have completely... comprehended Sword Light Like a Rainbow?" Xu Ping murmured to himself.
A strong sense of joy filled his heart and soul, and he couldn’t help but smile, which soon turned into a broad grin, culminating in hearty laughter that echoed through the cultivation chamber:
"Hahaha..."
"After years of effort, I have finally entered the second stage of Sword Dao—Sword Light Like a Rainbow!!"
He had comprehended Sword Qi Thunder Sound during the fifth level of Qi Cultivation, yet only fully grasped Sword Light Like a Rainbow by the Late-Stage Foundation Establishment.
And this was with the assistance of the proficiency panel.
It’s no wonder, even those peerless Sword Cultivators fully comprehend Sword Light Like a Rainbow at the middle stage of the Golden Core, or even late-stage Golden Core, Perfection Level.
It is hard to imagine how tough it must be to fully comprehend the third stage of Sword Dao—Sword Light Diversification.
Such Sword Cultivators are likely among the elite even as Nascent Soul Cultivators.
...
As his emotions calmed slightly, Xu Ping activated the proficiency panel.
[Primordial Sword Skill Perfection: ∞]
"It’s finally perfect!" Xu Ping couldn’t help but be filled with deep emotion.
Though he had perfected numerous skills over the years.
The boost to his combat power brought by the perfection of the Primordial Sword Skill likely equaled a major realm breakthrough.
Xu Ping’s gaze shifted, landing on the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword in his hand.
At this moment, a sudden urge surged within him to unleash a powerful strike.
Fortunately, he managed to restrain himself.
If he were to unleash it, not only would the cultivation chamber be destroyed, but the array would likely be obliterated too.
At this moment, a strange yet wondrous feeling quietly emerged in his heart.
Xu Ping vaguely felt that he could merge completely with the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword in his hand.
"Body Fusion?"
Xu Ping murmured softly, his expression filled with contemplation.
Afterward, he slowly left the cultivation chamber.
Warm sunlight cascaded gently upon him, bringing traces of warmth.
He leisurely made his way to the open field.
Xu Ping stood firm, holding his sword in one hand, and closed his eyes.
He calmed his mind, focusing entirely on feeling that wondrous sense of merging with the sword.
Time flowed gently in the silence.
The feeling of merging with the sword grew increasingly intense, like streams converging into mighty rivers.
When this feeling peaked!
Xu Ping opened his eyes suddenly, a sharp gleam flashed through them.
The next moment.
Mana surged around Xu Ping, causing the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword to hum and its blade to shine brightly.
"Shoo!"
Accompanied by a sharp sound breaking the air, his figure vanished instantly from his original spot.
In the blink of an eye, he appeared on a small hill on Thousand Leaves Mountain.
The soft breeze gently fluttered his hair and clothes as Xu Ping stood quietly at the hilltop, gazing at the open field he had just left. His mouth unconsciously curved into a satisfied smile.
"This... truly is Sword Flight!"
Xu Ping murmured to himself, his tone filled with a strong sense of joy.
Sword Flight, a distinctive escape technique, is renowned in the cultivation realm.
It’s known that the reason Sword Cultivators are widely famed in the cultivation realm isn’t solely because of their unparalleled offense.
Their unique escape technique—Sword Flight—is undoubtedly top-tier as well.
Facing Sword Cultivators, many cultivators find themselves in the plight of being unable to compete in combat or flee!
This is the fundamental reason why Sword Cultivators hold such tremendous renown in the cultivation world.
Xu Ping secretly compared Sword Flight with the Perfection Level Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill.
Through this comparison, he was surprised to discover that Sword Flight was indeed faster by more than a notch than the Perfection Level Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill.
"At this speed, perhaps even Early-Stage Golden Core Cultivators are far behind me." Xu Ping’s eyes flashed with excitement and thrill.
After all, while the Perfection Level Elemental Magnetic Escape Skill is considered one of the fastest among Fake Pill Cultivators, it still falls slightly short compared to true Golden Core Level escape techniques.
But now, with mastery over Sword Flight, the situation is entirely different.
"Song Fei, heaven is surely against you!" Xu Ping’s eyes flashed with a hint of coldness.
Before mastering Sword Flight, Song Fei still had a fair chance of escaping pursuit using speed.
Yet now, such a possibility has significantly diminished.
However, Xu Ping wasn’t recklessly driven by emotion, he didn’t act impulsively.
After all, he had just barely broken through to the Sword Light Like a Rainbow stage; regardless of swordsmanship or escape technique, his familiarity was yet to be deep.
It’s better to wait until he can use them effortlessly and proficiently before seeking out Song Fei.
...
...
In the following days, Xu Ping focused on adapting to his swordsmanship after mastery of Sword Light Like a Rainbow and the top-tier escape technique, Sword Flight.
Even with his profound strength at the time, it took a full five days to cultivate these two skills to a seamless, effortless level.
That day at noon.
In the pavilion on Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Xu Ping was savoring Spirit Tea served by the Water Lake Mouse.
Swoosh!
A Foundation Establishment Stage Escape Light, carrying waves of surging Spiritual Power, streaked like a meteor swiftly traveling from beyond the Purple Lord Mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 352 - 221: Battle with Song Fei
chapters.content:
Chapter 352: Chapter 221: Battle with Song Fei
Xu Ping looked up and instantly recognized the owner of the rushing Escape Light. It was Zhou Tianle, whom he hadn’t seen for several months.
At that moment, Xu Ping stood up and moved to an open area of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
He quickly formed seals with his hands, chanting under his breath to control the mountain’s array.
Before long, the array’s lights flickered, slowly opening a path through the formation.
Zhou Tianle maneuvered his Escape Light through the array path with ease, landing steadily on Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"Fellow Daoist Xu." Zhou Tianle smiled and cupped his hands in greeting.
Seeing Zhou Tianle before him, Xu Ping was slightly startled, his pupils involuntarily contracting.
However, he showed no sign of this on his face, instead, he enthusiastically said:
"Fellow Daoist Zhou, your journey must have been tiring. Why don’t we move to the pavilion and chat at leisure?"
Zhou Tianle naturally had no objections.
Thus, under Xu Ping’s guidance, the two of them went to the pavilion.
Inside the pavilion, the fragrance of Spirit Tea lingered.
After pouring a cup of Spirit Tea for Zhou Tianle, Xu Ping smiled and asked, "Fellow Daoist Zhou, you mentioned earlier, have you finished collecting the ores?"
"Yes, they are all collected."
Zhou Tianle nodded with a smile, responding as he took out a storage pouch from his magical storage item and handed it to Xu Ping, "The various ores consumed by the Red Flame Golden Beetle are all inside this pouch."
Xu Ping reached out to take the storage pouch and extended his Divine Sense into it.
The storage pouch was packed full, containing all sorts of minerals.
Upon closer inspection, the majority were of the red attribute and earth attribute ores.
"Fellow Daoist Zhou, you’ve worked hard this time."
Xu Ping nodded with satisfaction, then lightly turned his palm, and the storage pouch filled with minerals instantly disappeared into his Storage Ring.
In fact, he himself had quite a reserve of various minerals.
