It’s just that the Red Flame Golden Beetles had an astonishing appetite, nearly consuming all of his reserved minerals during this period.
"Such a trivial matter, hardly worth mentioning."
Zhou Tianle took a sip of Spirit Tea, his smile widening.
After all, his family had been specializing in raising various spiritual beasts for generations, and their clan wasn’t short of rare spiritual beasts that devour minerals.
Therefore, collecting these minerals was indeed not a difficult task for them.
"For Fellow Daoist Zhou, it is indeed a small matter, but it saves me a lot of effort." Xu Ping smiled slightly.
"If Fellow Daoist Xu needs it in the future, Zhou could collect and deliver the minerals for you." Zhou Tianle half-jokingly said.
"That would be wonderful. I will certainly need a large amount of minerals in the future, so I’ll rely on Fellow Daoist Zhou for this favor." Xu Ping smiled faintly.
"That’s no problem at all!"
Hearing this, Zhou Tianle was overjoyed and agreed without hesitation.
He didn’t expect that a joke would come true!
He had been thinking about how to get closer to Xu Ping, and here it was, presented on a silver platter.
"In that case, I must trouble Fellow Daoist Zhou." Xu Ping cupped his hands.
"Not at all, not at all." Zhou Tianle quickly returned the gesture.
Helping out a tier-three Talisman Master, who wouldn’t look up to him and his family in the future?
What hardship is there to speak of?
If other Foundation Establishment cultivators knew about this, they’d surely be green with envy.
...
...
After chatting for a few more moments, Zhou Tianle proposed to take his leave.
Lately, two Foundation Establishment seeds within their family were preparing to take Foundation Establishment Pills to breakthrough the Foundation Establishment stage.
He definitely had to go back to protect them, not stay outside for long.
"Take care, Fellow Daoist Zhou."
Xu Ping did not insist on him staying, directly seeing Zhou Tianle out of the pavilion.
Zhou Tianle returned the courtesy before flying away from Thousand Leaves Mountain on his Escape Light.
Watching Zhou Tianle’s silhouette gradually fade into the distance, Xu Ping’s expression turned grim.
It wasn’t an issue with Zhou Tianle himself.
Rather, from the moment Zhou Tianle arrived, Xu Ping had keenly discovered that someone had quietly set an exceedingly subtle tracking mark on Zhou Tianle.
This tracking mark was so well-hidden that not to mention ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivators, even average Fake Pill cultivators would have difficulty detecting it.
Xu Ping roughly judged that the person who deployed this marking secret technique should be an Early Stage Golden Core cultivator.
After all, if it were a Middle Stage Golden Core cultivator, even with his Divine Sense, he probably wouldn’t have detected it.
"Hmph, it seems those Golden Core cultivators plotting against me can no longer hold back!"
A cold smirk appeared on Xu Ping’s lips, with a glint of chill in his eyes.
Zhou Tianle, a mere Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, obviously wasn’t worth a Golden Core cultivator planting a tracking mark on him secretly.
If they had the time for that, a Golden Core cultivator would have eliminated Zhou Tianle several times over.
Clearly, this Golden Core cultivator was targeting him.
It seems this person must have noticed that Xu Ping hadn’t ventured out for a long time, thus planning to use other means.
"Let’s see who really becomes the oriole in the end." A bone-chilling killing intent flashed in Xu Ping’s eyes.
His swordsmanship had broken through, and he had unintentionally mastered Sword Flight.
Today, he intended to let the plotting Golden Core cultivator meet their end!
...
...
After leaving Thousand Leaves Mountain, Zhou Tianle flew rapidly towards his family territory.
As he flew over a tranquil lake, the serene surface suddenly started to ripple with strange waves.
Poof!
A terrifying black mist, as dark as ink, surged into the sky, carrying dreadful power as it hurtled toward Zhou Tianle.
"No!!"
Zhou Tianle immediately felt the imminent deadly threat, his face instantly filled with terror.

chapters.title: Chapter 353 - 221: Battle with Song Fei (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 353: Chapter 221: Battle with Song Fei (Part 2)
As he could clearly sense, this attack contained the terrifying power genuinely at the Golden Core Level.
The vast and majestic, despair-inducing aura was like an invisible mountain, pressing on his chest and making it almost impossible for him to breathe.
His heart was full of confusion and fear.
He was merely a small Mid-Stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator; what could he possibly have done to provoke a Golden Core Cultivator into launching such a sudden ambush against him?
Zhou Tianle instinctively tried to resist, his hands frantically forming spell after spell, summoning a magical artifact and a protective Spiritual Qi shield in front of him.
However, his meager power was just like an ant trying to stop a chariot in the face of an attack at the Golden Core Level.
That extremely terrifying black energy enveloped with a world-destroying might, mercilessly smashed towards him.
Boom!
With a deafening explosion, the black energy heavily collided with the hastily summoned defensive magical artifact and Spiritual Qi shield of Zhou Tianle.
Crack!
In just a fleeting moment, the seemingly sturdy defensive magical artifact and Spiritual Qi shield shattered like fragile glass, turning into countless fragments scattered in the air.
Immediately after, the full terrifying might of the black energy poured unreservedly onto Zhou Tianle.
"Pff!"
Zhou Tianle’s entire body was struck as if by lightning, uncontrollably flying backward, spewing blood from his mouth.
He fell heavily onto the ground by the lake, kicking up a cloud of dust.
After landing, Zhou Tianle’s limbs twitched a few times, then his eyes rolled back, and he fell into unconsciousness, his life or death unknown.
At this moment, the Golden Core Cultivator who attacked Zhou Tianle slowly emerged from the lake.
The water rippled around him, forming strange patterns in the surface.
This person was wrapped in a black robe swaying in the wind, carrying a chilling aura.
Upon closer inspection, it was Song Fei.
Given his strength as a Golden Core Cultivator, dealing with a small Foundation Establishment Cultivator was as easy as squashing an ant.
If he hadn’t deliberately restrained his hand, just a simple flick would have been enough to kill Zhou Tianle on the spot.
Song Fei strode over to Zhou Tianle’s side, extended his withered hand, and was about to grab Zhou Tianle’s head, preparing to use the Soul-Searching Technique to obtain the information he required.
However, just as his hand was only a short distance away from Zhou Tianle’s head.
Suddenly.
Buzz!
A heaven-piercing sword light suddenly cut through the sky, the sound sharp and piercing, as if trying to tear the silent space apart.
The sword light was dazzling, like a meteor falling from the sky, filled with endless sharpness and killing intent.
"Not good!"
Song Fei’s expression changed instantly, feeling the powerful force contained in the sword light, and a strong sense of crisis surged in his heart.
This sword light’s power had surprisingly reached the Golden Core Level!
"Defend!"
Song Fei dared not be careless, pinching a spell with both hands, hurriedly mobilizing all his mana.
In an instant, black energy surged from his body like a raging tide, forming a thick black shield in front of him.
The surface of the shield was inscribed with strange runes, emitting a chilling aura.
Just as the black shield had barely risen.
Boom!
The magnificent sword light struck the black shield hard, making a deafening roar that echoed across the sky.
In an instant, the light burst forth, with countless chaotic Spiritual Qi fluctuations exploding outward from the impact point like shockwaves.
Wherever they passed, a fierce wind howled, uprooting and flipping over countless towering trees.
"Shatter!"
Song Fei exerted all his strength, veins bulging on his forehead, his hands rapidly changing spells.
The shield formed by black energy immediately changed shape, transforming into a massive black net, tightly enveloping the fierce sword light.
Ultimately, the sword light and shield collided and tore at each other, their forces continuously offsetting, transforming into spots of Spiritual Qi, dissipating into the vast world.
"Who is it?"
After blocking the sword light, Song Fei’s eyes were full of shock and anger.
He quickly turned his head to look at the attacker, only to see a tall, burly man coldly staring at him from not far away.
This person, though exuding an aura merely at the Late-Stage Foundation Establishment, naturally emanated a sharp, compelling Sword Intent from his entire body.
This Sword Intent, like a tangible blade, could make one feel its sharpness even from a distance.
"A Sword Cultivator?"
Song Fei’s heart sank, suppressing the anger within, he coldly asked, "Who are you? Why do you attack me?"
The aura emanating from this burly man may seem like that of a Late-Stage Foundation Establishment level, but that incredibly powerful sword light just now was not something any ordinary Foundation Establishment Cultivator could unleash.
It’s evident this person must be masquerading as a Golden Core Cultivator.
Facing a Golden Core Sword Cultivator, unless absolutely necessary, he would naturally want to avoid a life-or-death struggle!
"The one who’ll kill you!"
The burly man, with one hand holding the sword, stood tall and steady like a pine tree, his expression calm, yet his tone carried a thick killing intent.
This burly man was none other than Xu Ping in disguise.
With his current Divine Sense strength and disguise ability, an Early-Stage Golden Core Cultivator couldn’t detect any flaws.
Upon hearing this, Song Fei’s face turned completely dark.
Black energy surged in his eyes, revealing an aura of madness.
"Then let’s see who dies first!"
Song Fei took the initiative to attack, his hands dancing like ghosts as intricate magic techniques flew out from his fingertips.
In an instant, thick black fog rose around him, soaring into the sky like a fierce beast opening its huge mouth, rushing towards Xu Ping.

chapters.title: Chapter 354 - 221: Battle Song Fei_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 354: Chapter 221: Battle Song Fei_3
In the mist, faint, eerie wails of ghosts howling and wolves crying emerged, as if countless vengeful spirits were struggling and roaring within.
"How has Song Fei changed so much after breaking through to the Golden Core?" Xu Ping frowned slightly.
This method of attack clearly leaned towards the demonic path!
Xu Ping lightly tapped his foot, pointed his sword finger forward, and shouted softly.
"Break!"
A dazzling sword light tore through the black mist, like the blazing sun piercing through the haze, dispersing the black mist wherever it reached.
He then changed his sword technique, releasing streams of fierce Sword Qi.
Each stream of Sword Qi accurately struck the ghostly fog shaped like evil spirits, instantly annihilating them.
The ghost fog hit by the Sword Qi let out piercing screams, transforming into wisps of black smoke and vanishing into the air.
"A Golden Core Sword Cultivator is truly formidable!"
Seeing the opponent easily breaking his technique, Song Fei frowned deeply, a hint of dread rising in his heart.
However, this slight feeling of dread was quickly overwhelmed by the surging tide of murderous intent flooding his heart.
Because the Sword Cultivator before him reminded him of some unpleasant memories!
"I must kill you today!"
Song Fei roared in anger, clapping his hands forcefully.
In an instant, the previously condensed black aura shattered into countless tiny black droplets.
These droplets, though small, contained terrifying power, capable of easily penetrating the defenses of a Foundation Establishment Perfection cultivator.
They shot towards Xu Ping densely, like a deadly black rain, covering the sky, inescapable.
Upon seeing this scene, Xu Ping’s eyes slightly narrowed.
"Slash!"
He wielded his sword with one hand, mana surging around him, and fiercely slashed out.
Boom!
Amidst a thunderous explosion, a brilliant sword light shot from the tip of the sword.
This sword light, like a Thunder Dragon carrying the force of destruction, surged towards the myriad black droplets shooting forth.
Thud, thud, thud.....
The sword light and black droplets clashed fiercely, erupting a series of deafening explosions.
For a moment, the sky was filled with the explosive sounds from their violent collisions, as if the entire space trembled under the powerful forces.
At this moment, black mist spread from the shattered black droplets.
The mist carried a pungent odor, rapidly diffusing around.
Xu Ping’s nose twitched slightly, instantly tasting spiciness spreading in his mouth.
But as the Longevity Skill circulated, the spiciness vanished instantly.
"Mere tricks!"
The giant disguised by Xu Ping let out a contemptuous snort.
With his current physique and Longevity Mana, even poison that could fell a Golden Core cultivator had little effect on him.
"Die!"
Xu Ping’s mana surged furiously like a volcanic eruption, his sword glowing intensely.
He wielded the sword light, each beam slashing fiercely at Song Fei like lightning.
The sword light, like silver ribbons, carved dazzling traces through the air.
These continuous beams of sword light interwove into an impenetrable web, crushing towards Song Fei with overwhelming force.
Wherever the sword web reached, it sliced through the air with a hissing sound, constantly eroding the black aura surrounding Song Fei, trapping him securely within.
Under the sword web, Song Fei’s face grew increasingly grim as he tried to break free, but all attempts failed!
"Smash!"
Xu Ping’s eyes were cold as he uttered softly.
Pfft!
The sword light’s power suddenly surged, emitting slicing sounds, directly cutting through all the black aura, slashing towards Song Fei.
Witnessing this scene, Song Fei’s expression changed dramatically.
With a flip of his palm, a black skull appeared.
The sockets of the skull flickered with an eerie green flame, emitting a nauseating stench.
"Rise!"
Song Fei pinched a Magic Technique, and instantly the green flame surged tens of zhangs, enveloping the sword light completely.
Boom!
In just a moment, under the fierce burn of the green flame, the fierce sword light was gradually burned to nothing, disappearing completely.
"Spectral Fire of Life!"
Seeing the green flame occupying nearly half the sky before him, Xu Ping’s expression turned somber.
If the Magic Song Fei cast before was slightly inclined towards the demonic path, then the Spectral Fire of Life he now brandished was undoubtedly a true demonic artifact.
Moreover, this Spectral Fire of Life was renowned for its cruelty among numerous demonic artifacts.
Has Song Fei turned to the demonic path after breaking through to the Golden Core?
"I will use your flesh, blood, and soul to further enhance my magical treasure!"
At this moment, Song Fei’s eyes were nearly engulfed by all the black aura, making him look increasingly frenzied.
He quickly formed seals with his hands, bizarre runes flew out from his fingertips, merging into the skull.
With the infusion of runes, the flame began to surge wildly, and a cold yet bloodthirsty aura spread out intensely!
Simultaneously, the aura on Song Fei’s body rapidly declined.
Originally somewhat normal, his face turned extremely pale, devoid of color, as if the essence of life was being swiftly drained.
"Ready to risk it all?"
Xu Ping’s expression also turned grave.
After all, a demonic Golden Core cultivator going all out was a force to be reckoned with.
Xu Ping made a decisive decision, pinching a Magic Technique, and three Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans appeared in the void.
"Control!"
With a thought, Xu Ping quickly formed seals with both hands, chanting.
Under his control, the three Golden Armor-Breaking Talismans interwove, their energies connecting.
At the moment the Three Talent Talisman Array formed.
"Extinguish the World with Demonic Flame!"
Song Fei clapped his hands together, completing the technique.
The skull’s body abruptly expanded!
The originally human-sized skull rapidly grew to the size of a small mountain in the blink of an eye.
The eerie green flame in its sockets surged like a torrential flood, engulfing Xu Ping overwhelmingly.
The green flame erupted instantly, staining the entire sky with a strange green hue.
Seeing this scene, Xu Ping’s eyes turned icy, his lips pressed tightly, then he decisively uttered a single word:
"Explode!"

chapters.title: Chapter 355 - 222: Song Fei Slain; Evil Ghost Order
chapters.content:
Chapter 355: Chapter 222: Song Fei Slain; Evil Ghost Order
In an instant, a terrifying power wave that seemed capable of destroying the heavens and earth erupted unreservedly.
The released terrifying might, with an unstoppable grandeur, swept towards the fierce ghostly green flames like a surging tsunami.
Boom!
The power released by the Talisman Array collided fiercely with the ghostly green flames.
At this moment, it was as if an invisible mighty force shook the heavens and earth, the winds and clouds changed, and a deafening thunderous roar echoed through the sky and earth, causing eardrums to ache.
A wave of terrifying power rippled out in all directions!
The once lush green forests, under the impact of this terrifying force, had their trees uprooted, flying chaotically in the air like fragile straw.
In this intense collision, the power released by the Three Talents Talisman Array clearly held the upper hand.
After a brief and fierce confrontation with the ghostly green flames, the array’s power gradually suppressed the demonic flames like crushing dry weeds.
Thud!
Finally, the ghostly green flames gradually extinguished under the power of the array, leaving only wisps of black smoke drifting in the air.
However, the array’s power did not stop there. After extinguishing the green flames, it continued its unstoppable momentum, surging towards Song Fei like a torrential tide.
"What!"
Song Fei’s complexion changed drastically in an instant, a slight trace of fear flickering in his eyes.
He naturally recognized the use of a Talisman Array from the other party, but the power contained within this array was far too formidable and domineering, vastly exceeding his expectations.
Even a cultivator at the Middle Stage of the Golden Core might not easily benefit when facing such a Talisman Array.
And he was only at the Early Stage Golden Core, how could he withstand this terrifying might!
In this moment, he deeply felt the threat of death.
"I won’t die!"
"Explode for me!"
At this life-and-death moment, Song Fei showed the ruthlessness of a Demonic Cultivator!
He quickly formed a seal with both hands, chanting incantations in pain, his face twisted in agony.
With his actions, the enormous skull, already massive as a small hill, began to tremble violently.
The remaining ghostly green flames in its eye sockets flickered wildly, emitting a stronger stench.
The next moment.
Boom!
The massive skull suddenly self-exploded without warning, a more terrifying and violent energy erupting like a volcanic explosion.
Black Demonic Qi mixed with ghostly green light spread outwards, clashing directly with the Talisman Array’s power.
This impact was even more intense than before, as if the entire space was being twisted and deformed.
The tremendous energy waves whipped up fierce winds, drawing everything around into it.
"Self-exploding his Lifebound Magical Treasure!!"
Xu Ping’s eyes narrowed, and with Mana surging, a layer of azure protective barrier enveloped his entire body.
Pfft!
At the moment of the skull’s self-explosion, Song Fei spouted a mouthful of blood.
His face turned as pale as paper, his aura extremely weak and chaotic.
It’s known that the Lifebound Magical Treasure is intricately linked with a cultivator’s soul, and self-exploding it is akin to self-harm.
Yet at this moment, Song Fei could not care anymore.
Enduring the intense pain in his body, he unhesitatingly used his Demonic Escape Technique to flee.
He rapidly changed spells with his hands, thick black fog rising around him, completely enveloping his body.
Then, he transformed into a streak of black light, rushing off into the distance at lightning speed.
"How ruthless!"
Gazing at Song Fei’s retreating figure, Xu Ping’s eyes showed a dense killing intent.
He self-exploded his Lifebound Magical Treasure without a second thought.
It’s to be known that even if Song Fei didn’t self-explode his Lifebound Magical Treasure, the Three Talents Talisman Array’s power would at most severely injure him.
Faced with such a Demonic Cultivator, if he wasn’t eliminated today, who knows what madness he might do next.
"Swift!"
With Mana surging around Xu Ping, the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword hummed with a resounding buzz, its blade shining brightly.
Swoosh!
In an instant, his figure disappeared from the spot and pursued Song Fei with an extreme speed.
The two of them, one chasing, one fleeing, in the blink of an eye had covered a hundred miles.
"Sword Flight!!"
Song Fei remained continuously wary. When he swept his Divine Sense behind him, he immediately saw Xu Ping, standing on the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword, persistently in pursuit.
This sight made him tremble with anger!
"We have no enmity, why are you so bent on bringing about my death?" He could not help but voice his furious query.
He was certain he had never seen this person before, let alone offended him.
Yet this person seemed crazed, determined not to stop until he lay dead, something Song Fei couldn’t fathom.
"Go ask in hell!" Xu Ping sneered coldly.
He would have to be an idiot to tell Song Fei the truth!
As the distance between the two continued to close, Song Fei transmitted with his Divine Sense, his expression twisted:
"Ah, ah, ah... you pushed me to this!"
"I will perish together with you!"
In the next instant, Song Fei abruptly halted his Escape Light.
The Mana within him became turbulent and chaotic, seemingly on the verge of self-detonating his body, aiming to perish together with Xu Ping.
"Thinking of self-detonating?"
"Let me help you!"
Xu Ping’s lips curled into a grim smile, his eyes revealing an undisguised killing intent.
Thoughts turning, the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword steadily landed in his palm.
"Slash!"
With that, Xu Ping grasped the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword tightly and slashed fiercely.
A sword light, like a dazzling white rainbow fleeting across the sky, instantly tore open the previously calm void.

chapters.title: Chapter 356 - 222: Song Fei Slain; Evil Ghost Order (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 356: Chapter 222: Song Fei Slain; Evil Ghost Order (2)
The sword light carried an endless sharpness, shooting towards Song Fei at a nearly incomprehensible speed, like a bolt of lightning.
Song Fei’s eyes widened in terror, clearly reflecting the terrifying sword light approaching with grandeur.
However, at this moment, he felt as if his body was nailed to the spot, unable to make any evasive reaction.
Thud!
With a dull thud, the blinding sword light instantly pierced through the thick black aura enveloping him, as if in a no-man’s land, flashing past his body.
By the time Song Fei reacted, he realized with shock that his chest was slightly aching, and a warm liquid began to seep out.
Initially, the blood only seeped out bit by bit, but in the blink of an eye, the speed of the blood overflow suddenly increased.
Moments later, the blood gushed out like a flood breaking through a dam, even mixed with shattered internal organs, continuously spurting from his chest.
The bright red blood quickly dyed his originally black robe into a shocking dark red.
Song Fei struggled to lower his head, his gaze slowly falling onto his own chest, and only then did he notice a terrifying sword scar that pierced through front and back.
"Sword light...!"
Song Fei’s lips slightly parted, trying to say something.
But a large amount of blood surged up like a tidal wave, instantly blocking his throat, making it impossible for him to make any sound.
At this moment, his internal organs had already been crushed to pieces by the fierce sword light.
If it weren’t for the extraordinary vitality of a Golden Core Cultivator, an ordinary Qi Cultivator would have already died on the spot.
"Cough!"
Song Fei suddenly coughed out a mouthful of blood mixed with internal organs.
As this mouthful of blood spurted out, his lifeforce quickly dissipated like a candle in the wind, no longer able to maintain the Escape Light flight.
His body, like a kite with a broken string, plummeted straight from the high sky and finally crashed heavily to the ground.
Raising a cloud of dust all around, and when the dust gradually settled, Song Fei lay on the ground, lifeless.
Xu Ping hovered quietly in mid-air, his gaze fixed on the now tattered corpse of Song Fei on the ground, and a faint smile of satisfaction slowly spread across his lips.
"Revenge fulfilled!"
This person had plotted against him multiple times, and today he finally succeeded in slaying him.
This also meant the complete eradication of a major hidden threat lurking in the shadows and could erupt at any time.
At the same time, Xu Ping now had a fairly clear understanding of his current strength.
Even without using the sword light like a rainbow, he should still be able to overpower an ordinary Early-Stage Golden Core Cultivator.
If he fully exerted himself, killing an Early-Stage Golden Core Cultivator was not considered difficult.
However, compared to the Middle Stage of Golden Core cultivators, he should still be lacking somewhat.
After pondering for a moment, Xu Ping controlled the Escape Light to slowly approach Song Fei’s side.
He extended his Divine Sense, carefully searching all around, completely stripping Song Fei of everything useful.
After finishing the plundering, Xu Ping flicked his finger, and a fireball instantly reduced Song Fei’s body to ashes.
Having done all this, Xu Ping carefully cleaned up the scene.
Ensuring that no trace of his whereabouts could be discovered, he once again took to the Escape Light, sped off into the distance, and soon disappeared into the vast sky.
...
...
Meanwhile.
Zhou Tianle, who had been knocked unconscious by Song Fei’s sudden attack, slowly regained consciousness at this time.
Thanks to Xu Ping’s deliberate control, the aftermath of the previous fierce battle did not affect him.
As he just regained awareness, Zhou Tianle’s mind was momentarily blank and confused.
But immediately, waves of acute pain surged from his body like a tide, snapping him awake instantly.
"A Golden Core Cultivator!!"
Zhou Tianle’s face instantly turned pale, and he exclaimed in surprise.
He hurriedly extended his Divine Sense like a fine thread, cautiously scanning the surroundings.
In front of him was a scene of devastation:
The ground was riddled with huge craters, as if some terrifying force had rampaged through;
Towering trees were uprooted and chaotically sprawled on the ground, a dismal mess.
"Golden Core battle?"
Zhou Tianle’s expression instantly turned uncertain.
This tragic scene before him was clearly caused by the aftermath of a battle.
And only the intense conflict between Golden Core cultivators could possess such terrifying destructive power.
Afterwards, Zhou Tianle didn’t waste any time thinking and hurriedly checked his physical condition in detail.
Upon inspection, to his relief, his Storage Ring remained intact on his finger, and it seemed nothing inside had been lost.
As for his injuries, they were only from the initial surprise attack by that Golden Core cultivator.
"What is going on here?"
Zhou Tianle furrowed his brow tightly, resembling a twisted rope.
He racked his brains, repeatedly pondering in his mind, yet he still couldn’t find any explanation for all this.
A Golden Core cultivator ambushing him was already bewildering enough.
But now, another Golden Core cultivator inexplicably appeared, and the two engaged in a fierce battle at this location.
And he, being in the thick of it, miraculously suffered no additional effects?
All this was far too bizarre to believe.
"Whew!"
Zhou Tianle took a deep breath, striving to calm himself down and forcefully suppress the chaotic panic in his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 357 - 222: Slaying Song Fei; Evil Ghost Order_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 357: Chapter 222: Slaying Song Fei; Evil Ghost Order_3
No matter the current situation, it’s clear that this place is not suitable to linger for long; it’s best to leave this troublesome area as soon as possible.
With this thought, Zhou Tianle hesitated no longer, immediately maneuvering Escape Light, hurriedly leaving for the distance...
...
...
Half an hour later.
Xu Ping navigated Escape Light and landed on Thousand Leaves Mountain, then directly entered the cultivation chamber.
Upon entering the chamber, he stood steadily, his palm gently turning, Song Fei’s Storage Ring appeared in his palm.
"Let’s see what I’ve gained!" Xu Ping muttered to himself, a trace of anticipation flashing in his eyes.
A Golden Core Cultivator’s Storage Ring, presumably it wouldn’t disappoint him.
After some refining, Xu Ping gently tipped it.
In an instant, a Spirit Stone shimmering with light appeared before him.
Counting slightly, he discovered this pile of Spirit Stones numbered at least over a hundred thousand.
Included among them were four Upper Grade Spirit Stones.
"Not bad at all!" Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction.
With the Spirit Stone reserve, he now possessed a massive amount of two hundred thousand.
Such wealth far surpassed that of ordinary Fake Pill forces.
Besides the astonishing quantity of Spirit Stones, the materials in the Storage Ring were also quite abundant.
Inside, there was a Magical Artifact, two Artifact Embryos, as well as several top-grade Magical Artifacts and Upper Grade Magical Artifacts.
It was as if a few Fake Pill forces’ treasure troves had been ransacked.
Xu Ping, after pondering for a moment, considered it normal.
After all, Song Fei had wiped out a few Fake Pill forces before.
Plus, Luoyun Sect had issued a bounty on him, so he dared not sell the looted materials offhand.
Thus, his Storage Ring had accumulated such precious Magical Artifacts.
After Xu Ping carefully stored the Spirit Stones and Magical Artifacts, there weren’t many items left.
Among them, the most captivating were an ancient, worn Sword Technique and a mysteriously black Token.
Xu Ping first picked up that Sword Technique.
It’s known that nowadays, many Sword Techniques are recorded in the form of jade slips.
This kind of Sword Technique recorded in traditional book form is usually an extremely valuable original.
Xu Ping opened the first page.
The four characters "Wind Night Sword Skill" instantly came into view.
"Wind Night Sword Skill?"
Xu Ping couldn’t help but be slightly taken aback.
He had heard of this Sword Technique’s name; it was the sect’s third-level swordsmanship of Wind Night Pavilion.
However, Wind Night Pavilion had been exterminated by Song Fei.
It’s only natural for "Wind Night Sword Skill" to appear in the Storage Ring now.
"This is like finding a pillow when you’re about to sleep!"
Xu Ping’s lips curved into a slight smile.
After all, the "Primordial Sword Skill" he previously cultivated had reached Perfection, and he was just looking for a new Sword Technique.
Now this powerful third-level Sword Technique, "Wind Night Sword Skill," appeared precisely to meet his needs, which was perfect.
"Put it away!"
After placing "Wind Night Sword Skill" into the Storage Ring, Xu Ping’s gaze fell on the mysterious black Token.
He extended his hand, steadily picked up the Token, studying it carefully.
This Token had a very unique material. At first glance, it seemed like jade, but upon touch, it didn’t have the usual warmth of ordinary jade.
Its entire body showed a deep and subdued black hue, with bizarre dark-red patterns faintly flowing on the surface.
The front of the Token was carved with a ferocious ghost face, bulging eyes, protruding fangs, radiating an intimidating aura.
"Is this... the Evil Ghost Order of the Six Demon Countries Alliance?"
Upon recognizing the Token, Xu Ping’s expression changed drastically.
He had been practicing in this world for years, naturally having some understanding of the complex layout of the Nanchuan Cultivation Realm.
The Six Demon Countries Alliance comprised six medium and large countries, also encompassing many smaller countries.
In the numerous forces and countries of the Nanchuan Cultivation Realm, the Six Demon Countries Alliance undoubtedly stood at the pinnacle, with considerable influence and deterrence.
Take Yue Country, for example; Yue Country is a medium country.
But in the eyes of the Six Demon Countries Alliance, it might not be trivial like an ant, but the Alliance could easily destroy it, as simple as retrieving an item from a bag.
The Evil Ghost Order could only be issued by Nascent Soul Cultivators within the Six Demon Countries Alliance.
"Wasn’t Song Fei fleeing to Hu Country? Why does he have an Evil Ghost Order from the Six Demon Countries Alliance?"
Xu Ping tightly gripped the Token in his hand, frowning, his expression alternating between uncertainty.
One must know that Feng, Hu, and Yue, these three countries, though not orthodox Orthodoxy countries, their stance was inclined towards Orthodoxy.
Consequently, these three countries had few Demon Cultivators, let alone the presence of Demonic Nascent Soul Cultivators with Evil Ghost Orders.
Xu Ping sat there, contemplating intensely, various possibilities swirling in his mind, yet he couldn’t find any leads and was ultimately compelled to abandon the thought.
"If only I’d let Song Fei live," he sighed softly, his tone carrying a slight helplessness.
However, Xu Ping knew full well that if Song Fei were truly from the Six Demon Countries Alliance, it would still be difficult to perform a Soul Search on him.
Given the methods of Demon Cultivators, Song Fei’s Sea of Consciousness would definitely have a Restriction.
Perhaps during the Soul Search, he would encounter unexpected incidents.
After all, the power of a Nascent Soul Cultivator’s Restriction he couldn’t easily withstand.
Even a tiny attraction to the Restriction’s force might not benefit him, potentially endangering his life.
Thinking of this, Xu Ping took a deep breath, trying to calm himself, forcibly suppressing the turbulent thoughts within his heart.
Afterward, he began reflecting on the entire process of slaughtering Song Fei, carefully recalling if any clues might reveal his identity.
After a long while, Xu Ping slowly shook his head: "Probably not."
Throughout, he was extremely cautious, revealing nothing that might link him to any identity.
Under such circumstances, even a Nascent Soul Cultivator would find it extremely difficult to find traces.
And Song Fei was just an Early Stage Golden Core Cultivator, would a Nascent Soul Cultivator spend valuable time seeking his killer?
Xu Ping thought such a possibility was very low.
Especially for ruthless and profit-driven Demonic Cultivators, this was even more unlikely.
With this thought, the tension in Xu Ping’s heart finally eased a little.
Nevertheless, he didn’t think he could relax entirely; caution was still necessary.
He resolved to stay quietly on Thousand Leaves Mountain for now.

chapters.title: Chapter 358 - 223: Master Xuan Gu; Entry Level Swordsmanship
chapters.content:
Chapter 358: Chapter 223: Master Xuan Gu; Entry Level Swordsmanship
The time just a bit earlier.
Feng Country, Bright Moon Mountain.
This mountain serves as the base of the Profound Nether Sect, with a Fourth Rank Middle Grade Spirit Vein!
Ordinarily, this place is viewed by Feng Country cultivators as a kind of holy land.
But now, the entire Bright Moon Mountain is surrounded entirely by cultivators from Hu Country and Yue Country.
"Attack!"
With the loud shouts from the Hu Country cultivators.
Forty to fifty Foundation Establishment Cultivators, under the leadership of seven to eight Golden Core Cultivators, begin chanting spells in unison, gathering their mana together.
In the void, a massive amount of lightning attribute Spiritual Power converges, turning into dozens of lightning bolts several hundred feet long, striking fiercely on the moonlight-like glow of the array barrier covering Bright Moon Mountain.
Boom!
Accompanied by a thunderous roar, the lightning erupts, causing ripples to spread across the array’s spiritual glow.
But the Hu Country cultivators are not to be outdone.
"Borders of Endless Wood!"
With an angry shout.
Two to three dozen Foundation Establishment Stage cultivators, along with hundreds of Late-Stage Qi Cultivation disciples, led by several Golden Core Stage powerhouses, chant spells in unison.
In no time, the mana surges around the crowd, gathering at one point.
In the void, a large amount of Wood Attribute Spiritual Power gathers, morphing into massive round logs hundreds of feet long, slamming violently against the Mountain Protection Array of the Profound Nether Sect.
"Boom boom boom..."
The sounds of thunder and impact intertwine, as if tearing apart the entire world.
The fierce attack causes layers of spiritual light ripples, like ocean waves, shaking unsteadily under the intense impact.
"The Mountain Protection Array, could it really be unable to hold?"
Witnessing this scene, countless disciples of the Profound Nether Sect feel a deep sense of worry wash over them like a shadow.
...
"Master Xuanfeng, dare you come out to fight!"
At this moment, a thunderous shout suddenly echoes.
Two dazzling Escape Lights rise up from the depths of the Hu and Yue countries’ cultivator armies, with the unique terrifying pressure of Nascent Soul Masters, dashing toward Wangyue Mountain like meteors.
Jiang Jingxing and Wan Ming stand proudly in the void
The powerful aura around them is like two towering mountains, giving off an invisible sense of oppression.
"Nascent Soul Masters!!"
Disciples of the Profound Nether Sect within the array turn pale instantly, faces flooding with overwhelming fear and panic.
Can their sect’s Mountain Protection Array really withstand two Nascent Soul Cultivators?
At this moment, outside the array, Wan Ming sees Master Xuanfeng hasn’t appeared for a long time, a flash of cold light in his eyes as he coolly says:
"Since you won’t come out, I’ll force you out!"
Before the words fall, he suddenly swings his iron fan, the azure fire like a roaring dragon, carrying endless power to attack the fiercely surging Mountain Protection Array of the Profound Nether Sect.
Boom!
The violent energy streams spread like a raging tidal wave, seeming to shake and distort the surrounding space.
"Slash!"
Having seen Wan Ming make his move, Jiang Jingxing hesitates no longer.
Around him, the mana surges like a tide, and with a light tap of his finger, a tremendous purple sword, hundreds of feet tall, appears out of thin air.
This giant sword radiates a chilling sharpness, with an overwhelming momentum, slashing fiercely towards the Mountain Protection Array of the Profound Nether Sect.
Under the formidable attacks of the two Nascent Soul True Monarchs, the Mountain Protection Array of the Profound Nether Sect bears unprecedented pressure, flickering unsteadily between light and dark.
The array, once unbelievably sturdy, now resembles a candle in the storm, constantly on the verge of being snuffed out.
Inside the Profound Nether Sect, the oppressive atmosphere is so thick it seems it could drip water.
Countless disciples of the Profound Nether Sect stare at the swaying Mountain Protection Array, their faces nearly overflowing with terror and concern.
"Hmph!"
At this moment, a cold snort suddenly reverberates from Wangyue Mountain.
A dark light rises from the depths of the Profound Nether Sect, appearing before everyone in just an instant.
This person is the head of the Profound Nether Sect, Master Xuanfeng.
In a black robe rustling in the wind, his visage is stern, eyes filled with an endless, imposing authority and calmness.
However, upon closer examination, it’s not hard to notice that his face is as pale as paper, his aura exceedingly weak.
These small details mercilessly reveal the fact that he is severely wounded.
"Master Xuanfeng, I thought you planned to play the turtle hiding in its shell forever!"
Upon seeing Master Xuanfeng appear, a mocking smile appears at the corner of Wan Ming’s mouth.
Jiang Jingxing also coolly speaks from the side: "Hand over the Yin Yang Qi Cauldron, and we’ll spare the Profound Nether Sect."
Despite Master Xuanfeng’s serious injuries, facing the two fully capable Nascent Soul cultivators, his expression remains unflustered, his tone calm:
"I could hand over the Yin Yang Qi Cauldron, yet, I wonder, to which of you should I give this treasure?"
"A clumsy attempt at sowing discord."
Hearing this, a disdainful smile emerges on Wan Ming’s lips, "Do you take us for children?"
"Master Xuanfeng, don’t delude yourself, bringing about your own destruction."
Jiang Jingxing’s voice carries a hint of coldness, "Although you have obtained a new body through soul transfer, your strength is not even a tenth, you are no match for us!"
Jiang Jingxing and Wan Ming naturally won’t fall for such a clumsy attempt at sowing discord.
What’s more, they had already discussed the eventual ownership of the Yin Yang Qi Cauldron in advance.
Yet, hearing the words of the two, Master Xuanfeng shows not a trace of fear.
Instead, he looks up and laughs heartily, the laughter resonating in the air with a few notes of defiance: "Do you truly believe you have cornered me?"
"Hmph! You refuse a toast only to be forced to drink a forfeit!"

chapters.title: Chapter 359 - 223: Master Xuan Gu; Entry Level Swordsmanship
chapters.content:
Chapter 359: Chapter 223: Master Xuan Gu; Entry Level Swordsmanship
Wan Ming knew that Master Xuanfeng wouldn’t submit so easily, and couldn’t be bothered to waste time with more nonsense, so he joined Jiang Jingxing in attacking the Mountain Protection Array of the Profound Nether Sect with various techniques.
Boom boom boom...
Accompanied by earth-shattering roars, the spiritual light of the Mountain Protection Array flickered intensely, its glow increasingly dimming, on the verge of extinguishing at any moment.
"Protect!"
Master Xuanfeng’s eyes narrowed, and his hands formed a magic technique.
Instantly, the array nodes of Bright Moon Mountain erupted with dazzling spiritual light, and countless special runes emerged on the surface of the entire Mountain Protection Array.
With the appearance of the countless runes, the initially wildly flickering Mountain Protection Array stabilized.
Even Wan Ming and Jiang Jingxing couldn’t shake it in the slightest.
"Ancestor Xuanfeng!!"
Upon witnessing this scene, the disciples of the Profound Nether Sect, who were on the brink of despair, suddenly showed a flush of ecstasy, with a surge of strong confidence rising in their hearts.
With Ancestor Xuanfeng maintaining the array, even two Nascent Soul Cultivators would absolutely be unable to overcome their Mountain Protection Array.
However, amidst this jubilation, in an inconspicuous corner of the Profound Nether Sect.
A seemingly ordinary Foundation Establishment disciple of the Profound Nether Sect showed a trace of worry inappropriately.
"Senior Nine Nether, could it be that even the allied forces of Hu and Gu Kingdoms cannot overcome the Profound Nether Sect?" he murmured quietly.
This person, surprisingly, was Hongyi disguised as a disciple of the Profound Nether Sect.
"Why panic!"
The elderly and somewhat hoarse voice of the Nine Nether Elder leisurely sounded in Hongyi’s mind.
"If Master Xuanfeng were at his peak, they naturally couldn’t overcome this Mountain Protection Array."
"But now, Xuanfeng has taken on a new body, far from a time of recovery; the drain on him from maintaining the array, he can’t bear it!"
"I see!"
Hongyi immediately felt relieved, but soon another worry arose in his heart.
"Senior Nine Nether, we’re planning to snatch from two Nascent Soul Cultivators; even if we succeed, how do we escape afterward?"
"Stop fretting!"
The Nine Nether Elder immediately rebuked him with irritation, his tone full of displeasure, "I have my own plan in mind, just do your part and stop worrying!"
Hongyi stiffened with the reprimand, afraid to anger Nine Nether Elder further, quickly sealed his lips, not daring to utter another word.
...
Time quietly passed, with every minute and second seemingly stretched.
Under Wan Ming and Jiang Jingxing’s relentless and stormy attacks.
Just as Nine Nether Elder predicted, Master Xuanfeng, striving to maintain array stability, gradually began to show signs of fatigue.
His complexion became increasingly pale; a trace of blood appeared at the corner of his mouth, and his breathing began to destabilize.
And Bright Moon Mountain’s Mountain Protection Array started flickering intermittently, becoming unstable again.
Jiang Jingxing and Wan Ming keenly noticed this change in the Mountain Protection Array and decisively increased their attack intensity.
Their intention was to keep Master Xuanfeng expending his Mana, unable to restore his Primordial Qi.
As soon as Master Xuanfeng was taken down, the Profound Nether Sect, without a Nascent Soul True Monarch, would have no power to resist.
"Ssss..."
At this moment, a bizarre laugh suddenly resonated from all directions without warning.
The laughter was eerie and terrifying, as if from the hells of Nine Nether, making one’s skin crawl.
Wan Ming and Jiang Jingxing turned pale instantly, looking towards the source of the sound.
They saw in the distant sky, a thick black fog, like billowing dark clouds, was rapidly coming towards them.
As the black fog approached gradually, a vague thin silhouette appeared within, becoming clearer.
As the fog dispersed slightly, a thin, old man, exuding strong Evil Qi and tightly wrapped in the black fog, emerged before everyone.
The old man’s posture was hunched over, his skin wrinkled like tree bark, and his eyes glowed with a blood-red light, chilling to the bone!
"Master Xuan Gu!"
Upon recognizing him, Jiang Jingxing and Wan Ming’s faces turned extremely sour, as though they had swallowed a fly unpleasantly.
Master Xuan Gu was a notorious figure well-known in the demonic path, infamous for his ruthlessness and cruel methods, and his eerie demon skills struck terror in people’s hearts.
Moreover, he was from the Six Demon Countries Alliance.
Master Xuan Gu’s blood-red eyes scanned the crowd, emitting a cold, eerie laugh: "Hahaha, what a lively event!"
This laughter echoed in the air, carrying chills that made everyone present tense.
Master Xuan Gu’s gaze lingered on Wan Ming and Jiang Jingxing briefly, before he slowly began to speak:
"Gentlemen, for my sake, how about letting this matter go today?"
Wan Ming, hearing this, furrowed his brows tightly in apprehension.
Even though he was reluctant to offend the other party easily, he certainly didn’t want to let them leave so effortlessly.
"Master Xuan Gu, this is between us, I advise you not to meddle in these troubled waters lightly," Wan Ming said coldly.
Master Xuan Gu didn’t get angry due to Wan Ming’s tough stance. Instead, he sneered, and that smile looked particularly sinister on his wrinkled face:
"Suppose you offer up a piece of ten-thousand-year Soul Nourishing Wood to me, then I won’t interfere; indeed, I could even assist you."
"Ten-thousand-year Soul Nourishing Wood?"
Upon hearing the demand, the corners of Jiang Jingxing and Wan Ming’s mouths twitched starkly.
The ten-thousand-year Soul Nourishing Wood was a top-tier Fourth Rank Spiritual Material; how could they possess it?

chapters.title: Chapter 360 - 223: Master Xuan Gu; Entry Level Swordsmanship_3
chapters.content:
Chapter 360: Chapter 223: Master Xuan Gu; Entry Level Swordsmanship_3
Moreover, even if there is one, it wouldn’t be so easily taken out.
The cultivators from Hu and Yue, including the disciples of the Profound Nether Sect, all clearly heard the conversation between a few individuals.
A burst of commotion ensued, with expressions varying and appearing extremely peculiar.
However, upon hearing the conversation of several Nascent Soul cultivators, Hongyi turned pale with shock, because the ten-thousand-year-old Soul Nourishing Wood was also one of their targets.
"Nine Nether Elder, what should we do?" Hongyi asked urgently.
A moment later, the voice of the Nine Nether Elder, filled with intense killing intent, echoed eerily from within Hongyi’s Sea of Consciousness:
"Since the Demonic Nascent Soul shares the same target as us, we’ll have to slay him!"
"Slay... Slay him?"
Upon hearing this, Hongyi was so frightened he almost felt like his soul was leaving his body, and his heart skipped a beat.
Slaying a Demonic Nascent Soul cultivator, especially one from the Six Demon Countries Alliance, was this an attempt to pierce the heavens?
Moreover, relying solely on him, a mere Early Stage Golden Core cultivator, along with a Nascent Soul remnant, can they truly slay a Demonic Nascent Soul cultivator?
In his view, this was simply fantastical.
"Master Xuan Gu, your request is too outrageous!"
Upon hearing Master Xuan Gu’s unreasonable demand, Jiang Jingxing spoke coldly.
His Spiritual Power began to flow rapidly like surging waves, exuding a faint yet powerful aura, poised to confront Master Xuan Gu.
"Hmph."
Master Xuan Gu sneered, preparing to speak, but his expression subtly changed, abruptly turning towards the direction of Yue Country.
"The materials for my Human Pill seem to have been slaughtered!" A hint of killing intent emerged in Master Xuan Gu’s eyes.
...
...
Several months passed quietly.
At the open space on Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Xu Ping held the sword in one hand, his wrist flicking, causing the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword to dart forward like a spirit snake, creating a fierce wind sound, showcasing the opening move of the Sword Technique "Wind Shadow First Movement."
In an instant, the wooden sword rapidly weaved back and forth through the air, its trajectory so swift that it left behind faint and indistinct light shadows.
It seemed as if the air in this space was completely stirred by the sudden sword strike, presenting a slightly distorted and peculiar scene.
Next, Xu Ping’s aura dramatically changed, and the Mana within his body surged like a turbulent undercurrent.
He raised the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword high above his head, then exerted force to slash down fiercely, shouting aloud:
"Slash!"
Suddenly, an enormous sword light ascended to the skies, its dazzling brilliance extremely striking, seemingly about to tear the Array’s spiritual light apart.
Where the sword light swept through, a series of slight yet clear explosive sounds were heard, as if this space was unable to withstand such potent force impact, with imminent risk of being shattered.
"Disperse!"
Just as the sword light was about to slash toward the Array’s spiritual light, Xu Ping shifted his thoughts.
Instantly, the vast Sword Qi quickly dissipated like an ephemeral illusion, transforming into tiny specks of spiritual light, gradually vanishing into the boundless void.
"Wind Night Sword Skill... finally successfully reached Entry Level!"
Witnessing this scene, Xu Ping’s lips unconsciously curved upward in a slight smile.
After spending three months, the Wind Night Sword Skill was finally successfully at Entry Level, next he simply needed to slowly grind through!
Xu Ping twirled the sword before storing away the Magical Treasure Wooden Sword.
"Master, well done!"
At this moment, the lake mouse scurried over, respectfully handing a freshly brewed cup to Xu Ping.
At this moment, the water lake mouse was noticeably much larger than before.
Carefully sensing, one could detect the aura it emitted had astonishingly reached the level of a Second-stage Upper Grade Demon Beast.
"Not bad."
Xu Ping’s gaze fell upon the water lake mouse, and he reached out to receive the Spirit Tea, nodding in satisfaction, "Your cultivation has completely stabilized."
A month ago, with his assistance, the water lake mouse had already successfully breached into the Second-stage Upper Grade.
Now, its cultivation was thoroughly stabilized.
For the water lake mouse, after achieving the Second-stage Upper Grade, it could begin preparing for the breakthrough to a Third-stage Demon Beast.
"It’s all thanks to the master’s efforts." The water lake mouse’s face was full of flattering smiles.
It honestly meant what it said.
After all, without Xu Ping, it might not have broken through the Second-stage, let alone reached its current Second-stage Upper Grade.
...
Xu Ping did not engage further with the water lake mouse, turning to directly enter the insect breeding chamber he specially established.
"Squeak squeak!"
As soon as Xu Ping stepped into the insect breeding chamber, those Red Flame Golden Beetles instantly emitted extremely excited shrill cries.
If not for the surrounding Array blocking them resolutely, these Red Flame Golden Beetles would likely swarm over.
Encircling Xu Ping completely inside and out.
Seeing this sight, Xu Ping smiled slightly, extending his Divine Sense to soothe the Red Flame Golden Beetles.
Engaging frequently with the Red Flame Golden Beetles could further deepen the connection between them.
When they matured, commanding them to go to their deaths wouldn’t require much effort.
After appeasing the Red Flame Golden Beetles, Xu Ping took out several bulky minerals from Storage Bag, casually tossing them in front of the Red Flame Golden Beetles.
"Squeak squeak!"
All the Red Flame Golden Beetles roared and swarmed, eagerly devouring the minerals.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Xu Ping also drew out a half bottle of Second-stage Demon Beast blood from his Storage Ring.
"Blood Refining Skill!"
As Xu Ping muttered incantations, his Mana fiercely surged, rapidly conjuring complex Magic Techniques with both hands.
In a flash!
The Second-stage Demon Beast blood within the bottle surged out as if summoned, swiftly transforming into a dense blood curtain in the air, quietly suspended over the Red Flame Golden Beetles.
"Fall!"
Accompanied by Xu Ping’s soft command.
Whoosh!
The sheet of blood curtain began to gently fall like raindrops of crimson, raining down.
Miraculously, these raindrops of crimson seemed guided by some mysterious force, perfectly landing on each Red Flame Golden Beetle.

chapters.title: Chapter 361 - 224: Upgrading to Quasi-Tier 3 Spirit Vein
chapters.content:
Chapter 361: Chapter 224: Upgrading to Quasi-Tier 3 Spirit Vein
At this moment.
The Red Flame Golden Beetles, their incomparably hard shells resembling sponges that have awaited rain after a long drought.
Each drop of blood-colored rain that fell upon them was devoured eagerly, leaving not a trace behind.
"This ’Blood Refining Skill’ indeed has astonishing effects on accelerating the maturation of these beetles!"
"If this continues, the maturation cycle of the Red Flame Golden Beetles is bound to be significantly shortened!"
Watching the Red Flame Golden Beetles grow larger after the blood rain, Xu Ping nodded in satisfaction.
The ’Blood Refining Skill’ was a unique secret technique recorded in the inheritance passed to him by Zhou Tianle, specifically used to accelerate the growth and development of wild beetles.
This secret technique is truly miraculous, not only significantly speeding up the growth of the beetles.
But also providing a chance to induce mutations, allowing the beetles to surpass their inherent limitations.
However, the probability of these mutation breakthroughs is quite low.
In addition, for the beetles to surpass their own limitations, the grade of beast blood used must exceed that of the beetle by one tier.
Take a Second-stage beetle for example. To achieve a breakthrough, at least Third-rank Lower Grade beast blood is required as an aid.
However, for Xu Ping, this was not much of a challenge.
He had already slain two Third-rank Lower Grade demon beasts, and the Third-rank blood had remained untouched.
Xu Ping planned to use the Third-rank beast blood to perform the ’Blood Refining Skill’ once the Red Flame Golden Beetles reached the Second-stage.
At that time, even if only two or three out of over fifty beetles were to break through their limits, it would be a tremendous aid to Xu Ping.
It must be known that even a Second-stage Red Flame Golden Beetle has astonishing defensive power, capable of withstanding the attacks of a Golden Core Cultivator.
If he could truly nurture beetles to a Quasi-Tier Three, or even Third-rank level, what terrifying heights of defensive power would they reach?
Late-Stage Golden Core?
Golden Core Perfection?
Or even Nascent Soul?
Thinking of this, Xu Ping could not help but feel a surge of eager anticipation.
Though he was well aware that the goal was still quite distant.
Even with the ’Blood Refining Skill’, it would still take at least a decade.
.....
...
Three days after Xu Ping successfully cultivated the Wind Night Sword Skill to the Entry Level, Zhou Tianle arrived as scheduled to deliver the ores they had previously collected.
Simultaneously, he brought Xu Ping a shocking piece of information.
In the pavilion, the aroma of tea lingered.
"You’re saying that three months ago, the Nascent Soul Cultivator Master Xuan Bone from the Six Demon Countries Alliance has joined the San Guo battlefield?"
Hearing Zhou Tianle slowly narrate the news, Xu Ping’s eyes widened in shock.
Initially, the outcome of the San Guo battlefield seemed destined.
But with Master Xuan Bone’s sudden involvement, the entire situation was filled with uncertainty, the future unforeseeable.
Furthermore, when he thought of the Evil Ghost Order on Song Fei, a shadow loomed over his heart!
"Yes."
Zhou Tianle gave a helpless bitter smile and nodded lightly,
"Due to the remote distance, news travels slowly, so it was only recently that I accurately learned of this."
Upon receiving the confirmation, Xu Ping’s expression turned uncertain.
After pondering for a moment, he quickly asked, "Is Master Xuan Bone heading to the San Guo battlefield for the Yin Yang Two Qi Cauldron?"
"No."
Zhou Tianle shook his head decisively, with a solemn expression, "Master Xuan Bone was invited by Master Xuanfeng using the Thousand Year Soul Nurturing Wood."
"Thousand Year Soul Nurturing Wood?"
Xu Ping raised his eyebrows slightly, astonished, and clicked his tongue, "That’s quite a hefty price to pay!"
The Thousand Year Soul Nurturing Wood is a Fourth-rank top-grade spiritual material, capable of nurturing the soul of a cultivator and slowly repairing a damaged Divine Soul.
Its value is likely not much less than a Heaven-Reaching Spiritual Treasure.
In the eyes of certain special cultivators, it might even be much more valuable than a Heaven-Reaching Spiritual Treasure.
"Indeed!"
Zhou Tianle agreed, then added, "After all, Feng Country is stronger than Yue and Hu countries, and it’s not remarkable for the Profound Nether Sect to possess a Thousand Year Soul Nurturing Wood!"
"Indeed!" Xu Ping nodded.
However, Master Xuanfeng offering the Thousand Year Soul Nurturing Wood to invite Master Xuan Bone implies that the situation for the Profound Nether Sect had reached a critical point.
Upon reflection, it’s understandable. A Nascent Soul Cultivator with a destroyed flesh body would find it hard to defend against two attacking Nascent Soul Cultivators for long, even relying on the power of arrays.
"Sigh, with Master Xuan Bone’s interference, the originally smoothly progressing war is likely to undergo monumental changes!"
Zhou Tianle sighed softly, his tone filled with helplessness, "It’s uncertain whether this change will affect us ultimately."
The sudden emergence of a Nascent Soul True Monarch, especially a demonic one, indeed causes much anxiety.
After all, a Demonic Nascent Soul often disagrees without hesitation, refining sects and cultivator families in blood.
Hearing this, Xu Ping was momentarily silent.
His feelings were somewhat complicated now.
The Evil Ghost Order on Song Fei already had an eerie aspect, and now with the sudden emergence of Master Xuan Bone, it was hard not to associate the two.
It’s crucial to note that the distance between the Six Demon Countries Alliance and the three countries is significantly vast.
Even for a formidable Nascent Soul Cultivator, traversing such a long distance wouldn’t be achieved in just a few years.

chapters.title: Chapter 362 - 224: Upgrading to Quasi-Grade 3 Spirit Vein (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 362: Chapter 224: Upgrading to Quasi-Grade 3 Spirit Vein (2)
But for Master Xuan Gu to appear so timely at this critical juncture, it’s highly likely that he was originally lurking near the area of the Three Kingdoms.
This inevitably leads one to suspect that the mysterious Evil Ghost Order on Song Fei’s body is very likely given by Master Xuan Gu.
However, looking at the current situation, after Master Xuan Gu joined the battlefield of the Three Kingdoms, he would inevitably be deeply entangled and unable to extract himself in the short term.
This doesn’t affect him much!
Moreover, a long time has passed since this incident.
Even if one is a Nascent Soul cultivator with great divine techniques, it’s extremely difficult to find even the slightest clue.
Thinking of this, the tension in Xu Ping’s heart slowly relaxed.
"It seems it shouldn’t have a significant impact on us."
Xu Ping remained silent for a while. After some calm thinking and analysis, he slowly spoke,
"After all, Master Xuan Gu is just the helper specially invited by Master Xuanfeng; he’s not likely to recklessly fight to the death with True Monarch Wan Ming and Sect Leader Jiang."
"And as for True Monarch Wan Ming and Sect Leader Jiang, they probably wouldn’t dare to easily offend such a massive force as the Six Demon Countries Alliance, naturally they wouldn’t rashly attack Master Xuan Gu either!"
"With such a stalemate between both sides, the most likely outcome in the end is that the cultivators from the two countries will once again scour the territory of Feng Country and then withdraw their troops."
Zhou Tianle listened intently to Xu Ping’s analysis and immediately nodded in agreement, sincerely praising:
"What Fellow Daoist Xu said is extremely reasonable and well analyzed."
As for whether Master Xuan Gu would turn against the Three Kingdoms and wreak havoc on them after the dust settles on the battlefield, Zhou Tianle wasn’t too concerned.
After all, in the structure of the Cultivation Realm of Nanchuan, although the Six Demon Countries Alliance is one of the top and powerful forces, it doesn’t mean they don’t have opponents to restrain them.
For example, the alliance formed by the united orthodox countries, ’One Qi Alliance’, has been a longstanding nemesis of the Six Demon Countries Alliance.
The two major forces have been fighting for years, with continuous conflicts, and during the protracted struggle, Nascent Soul cultivators have fallen on both sides.
However, despite intense fights, neither side has been able to outmatch the other decisively.
So in such a delicate situation today, even cultivators from the demonic path have to be cautious with their actions.
They wouldn’t wantonly carry out blood sacrifices and other brutal actions on a country that is barely considered neutral and also has Nascent Soul cultivators residing domestically.
After all, they worry that this move would push this neutral country entirely into the ’One Qi Alliance’ camp.
Should such a situation arise, the balance of power that has been maintained for so long would be broken, and the situation would develop in an unfavorable direction.
As for those weak countries with no Nascent Soul cultivators, they can only seek fortune on their own.
Facing these small countries, ’One Qi Alliance’ typically only issues verbal condemnation at most, without taking real action to provide aid.
...
After the two chatted a bit more about various matters concerning the battlefield of the Three Kingdoms.
Zhou Tianle’s face suddenly showed a trace of hesitation, as if he was struggling intensely within.
Eventually, he clenched his teeth and offered a reminder,
"Fellow Daoist Xu, the situation in Yue Country has been a bit unstable recently. If you’re out and about, you must be extra careful."
Upon hearing this, Xu Ping slightly narrowed his eyes, a gleam flashed in them, but then he faintly smiled and said:
"When was the situation in Yue Country ever safe? It’s always turbulent."
Zhou Tianle didn’t say much else, vaguely saying something like ’still, be careful’, before leaving aboard his Escape Light from the Thousand Leaves Mountain.
"Farewell, Fellow Daoist Zhou." Xu Ping escorted Zhou Tianle out of the pavilion.
After Zhou Tianle completely disappeared from sight, Xu Ping’s eyes held a hint of contemplation and hesitation.
If there remains any potential hidden danger in the assassination of Song Fei, that would be Zhou Tianle!
However, thinking it over, this hidden danger is too small.
Moreover, Zhou Tianle would certainly be extremely wary of this matter, and wouldn’t dare to disclose even a fraction of it.
Even if a Nascent Soul cultivator with great divine techniques wanted to investigate and clarify the situation, it would be extremely difficult.
Actually, from the most prudent standpoint, it would be best to kill Zhou Tianle.
In that case, it would be basically impossible for anyone to find out that Song Fei was killed by him.
However, after repeatedly weighing it in his mind, Xu Ping hesitated for a while but ultimately gave up on this thought.
While he doesn’t think of himself as a good person, he is also not someone heartless and indiscriminate in killing the innocent.
He has known Zhou Tianle for decades, and they have some friendship between them.
Merely because of such a small potential for exposure, Xu Ping can’t bring himself to kill Zhou Tianle.
"Alas, at the end of the day, my power is still too weak!"
Xu Ping sighed slightly, his tone full of helplessness and emotion.
His current strength, though far beyond that of cultivators of the same tier.
But compared to a Nascent Soul cultivator, the difference is too great, like that of an ant.
If he had the strength of a Nascent Soul, why would he fear Master Xuan Gu?
And why would he be so beset by concerns over some potential hidden dangers?
With this thought, Xu Ping’s originally rock-solid heart for pursuing the path became even more firm.

chapters.title: Chapter 363 - 224: Upgrading to Quasi-Tier 3 Spirit Vein (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 363: Chapter 224: Upgrading to Quasi-Tier 3 Spirit Vein (3)
In this cultivation world where strength reigns supreme, only a big fist is the hard truth!
.....
...
Thus, as Xu Ping calmly cultivated, time slowly passed by.
Four months later, in the dead of night.
A large round moon hung high in the sky, like a warm white jade plate, casting silver light as clear as water.
In the distance, rolling mountains revealed their contours under the caress of moonlight, their peaks seemingly gilded with a layer of sacred brilliance, complementing the majestic moon in the vast night sky.
At this moment.
Xu Ping sat cross-legged on a giant rock, eyes closed in meditation.
Beside him, the spirit worm sat quietly.
Time slowly trickled by, the serene atmosphere enveloping this tranquil place like an invisible web.
Within this peace, suddenly, at a certain moment, a trace of anomaly shattered the calmness.
Sitting cross-legged on the giant rock, Xu Ping keenly sensed a rather strong Spiritual Qi fluctuation faintly transmitting from distant skies.
At first, the fluctuation was very weak, akin to a breeze over a lake, stirring a barely noticeable ripple.
But as time passed, this fluctuation grew more intense.
In the vast void, ripples of Spiritual Qi kept spreading outward.
"The Spiritual Qi tide today is a bit strong, isn’t it?"
Xu Ping opened his eyes, feeling the Spiritual Qi fluctuation far exceeding previous levels, a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes.
"Could it be a rare large-scale Spiritual Qi tide?" A guess surfaced in his heart.
Soon, Xu Ping affirmed this guess internally.
For the Spiritual Qi tide hadn’t yet reached its peak state.
But the intensity it showcased had already surpassed previous Spiritual Qi tides many times over.
"Looks like my luck is quite good!" Xu Ping’s lips curved slightly.
It’s known that large Spiritual Qi tides are exceedingly rare, occurring perhaps once in decades or even centuries.
Such a rare opportunity is truly a chance encounter, hard to come by.
Xu Ping deeply recognized the rare chance of the large Spiritual Qi tide, decisively circulating Spiritual Power inside his body, activating Earth Master’s Gaze.
"Channel Qi into the vein!"
Next, Xu Ping quickly formed seals with his hands, chanting incantations, and his body radiated a bright light.
Buzz!
At this moment, a gentle aura emanated from Xu Ping.
Soon, strands of Spiritual Qi from all directions gathered above him to form a gigantic Qi vortex.
As Xu Ping executed ’Channel Qi into the vein’, the spirit worm wasn’t idle either.
It wriggled its large body, emitting a faint green glow, releasing strands of peculiar energy from its body.
Buzz!
These energy strands spread out like agile threads.
Gradually, a gigantic Qi vortex formed, centered on the worm.
From a direct view, the scale of Xu Ping’s Qi vortex was much larger, more than twice the size of the spirit worm’s vortex.
This was to be expected.
After all, the magic ’Channel Qi into the vein’ had been cultivated by Xu Ping to the Great Success Realm.
Moreover, with his profound cultivation and strong Divine Sense, far surpassing the spirit worm.
Thus, the Qi vortex created by the man and the beast was like two frenzied black holes, relentlessly absorbing the Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi around them.
Due to coinciding with the large Spiritual Qi tide, the Spiritual Qi in the universe was astonishingly abundant.
The amount of Qi drawn into these gigantic vortices was far greater than any previous occasion.
However, this vast influx of Spiritual Qi presented them with unprecedented consumption and pressure.
With Xu Ping’s current cultivation realm, he was able to handle it with ease, but the spirit worm’s condition was far from ideal.
As the Qi continuously drew in, the worm’s massive body began to tremble uncontrollably.
Even the vortex above its head became unstable, swaying precariously.
Upon seeing this, Xu Ping’s face darkened instantly, promptly commanding, "Open your mouth!"
Upon receiving the command, the spirit worm unhesitatingly opened its gaping mouth, revealing sharp, fierce fangs.
Xu Ping flicked his finger lightly, and a faintly glowing second-stage demon core shot across the night sky like a meteor, directly entering the spirit worm’s mouth.
Though using the second-stage demon core as consumable was somewhat wasteful, at the moment he couldn’t afford to think much.
After all, the value comparison between the spirit vein and the demon core was clear to him.
"Gulp!"
As the spirit worm swallowed the demon core in one gulp, it managed to stabilize its posture, barely sustaining the precarious Qi vortex over its head.
"Fuse!"
At this point, Xu Ping hesitated no more, accompanied by a soft shout.
The man and the beast, each using their means, guided the Qi in the vortex to merge into the spirit vein beneath Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Though different methods, they resonated and coordinated with each other.
Together they pushed the overwhelming Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi, like rivers flowing into the sea, rushing towards the spirit vein of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Buzz!!!
Through relentless effort by the man and the beast, the spirit vein within Thousand Leaves Mountain transformed into a greedy beast, wildly absorbing endless Spiritual Qi.
Every trace of Spiritual Qi infused made the spirit vein tremble slightly, as if letting out a satisfied sigh.
With the continuous influx of Qi, the internal energy of the vein grew increasingly abundant, and the originally stable structure began to withstand immense pressure.
Finally, as the accumulation reached a critical point, the spirit vein suddenly trembled violently.
Initially, this tremor was quite subtle, like a breeze gently rippling across a calm lake.
But in a blink, it intensified swiftly, as if a primordial beast slumbering underground was roared and struggled fiercely.
If not for the protective array arranged on Thousand Leaves Mountain, this unexpected tremor would likely trigger a dreadful earthquake, upheaving the entire region.
Under the watch of Xu Ping’s Earth Master’s Gaze, he naturally discerned the drastic change in the spirit vein.
"Is this...the vein about to transform and evolve!?" An uncontrollable surge of joy filled Xu Ping’s heart.
For this moment, he had invested so much time and effort.
Now, finally, the vein under Thousand Leaves Mountain reached the critical juncture for evolution.
Nonetheless, Xu Ping knew well that this was the vein’s critical transformation period, allowing no negligence or carelessness.
Thus, he quickly focused, fully guiding the Qi, not allowing himself any slack.
As time went on, the Qi absorbed by the vein reached a phenomenal level.

chapters.title: Chapter 364 - 225: Finally Becomes a Quasi-Tier 3 Spirit Vein; The Death of Master Xuan Gu
chapters.content:
Chapter 364: Chapter 225: Finally Becomes a Quasi-Tier 3 Spirit Vein; The Death of Master Xuan Gu
At a certain moment!
The Spirit Vein finally ushered in a dramatic transformation that could be described as earth-shattering.
The previously somewhat dim Spirit Vein now radiated with brilliant light, filled with powerful and pure Spiritual Qi.
The form of the Spirit Vein gradually changed, the veins became clearer and more robust, as if evolving from a small trickle into a mighty river.
A dense Spiritual Qi, almost impossible to dissolve, spread out from the upgraded Quasi-Tier Three Spirit Vein.
This Spiritual Qi carried a fresh, rich fragrance, like a gentle spring breeze, softly caressing every inch of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
The Spiritual Qi quickly spread, like a flood bursting its banks, sweeping towards every corner of Thousand Leaves Mountain. The surrounding Spirit Medicine and Spirit Plants instantly burst into vigorous vitality under its nourishment.
"Finally... it’s upgraded to a Quasi-Tier Three Spirit Vein!!"
Xu Ping stood tall on a giant rock, fully experiencing the richer-than-ever Spiritual Qi of Thousand Leaves Mountain at this moment.
Uncontrollable joy uncontrollably shone in his eyes.
Xu Ping took a deep breath, the dense Spiritual Qi surged into his body through his respiratory tract, instantly spreading throughout his limbs, making him feel completely comfortable.
At this moment, even without deliberately sensing it with his Divine Sense, he could truly feel the enormous change in the Spiritual Qi of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Compared to before, the concentration of Spiritual Qi now had multiplied several times over.
This rapid Spirit Vein upgrade greatly exceeded Xu Ping’s expectations.
According to the original plan and progress estimation, it would at least require several small Spiritual Qi tides to achieve the goal.
But who would have thought, this time it was a large-scale Spiritual Qi tide.
With the joint efforts of him and the Spirit Worm, they finally upgraded the Second-stage Upper Grade Spirit Vein of Thousand Leaves Mountain to a Quasi-Tier Three Spirit Vein.
Thinking of this, Xu Ping’s eyes fell on the Spirit Worm which was already exhausted lying on the ground.
It indeed contributed significantly to the rapid upgrade of the Spirit Vein.
"You’ve worked hard tonight."
Xu Ping comforted it with a word and gave it a few Pills, then let it return to the ground for rest.
And Xu Ping also turned back to the cultivation room.
...
Inside the cultivation room, it was silent, with only subtle flows of Spiritual Qi lingering.
Xu Ping sat cross-legged on the stone bed.
At this moment, his entire body was heavily enveloped by extremely dense Spiritual Qi, only a vague human figure could be discerned.
"Phew!"
Xu Ping took a deep breath, gently closed his eyes, discarded distractions, and immersed his mind into his body, slowly starting to operate the cultivation technique.
As the cultivation technique operated, a faint glow rose around Xu Ping.
At this moment, the Spiritual Qi pervading the cultivation room surged into his body uncontrollably.
An hour passed.
The glow around Xu Ping became increasingly brighter, and finally, it abruptly converged.
He slowly opened his eyes, though his brows slightly furrowed: "This concentration of Spiritual Qi should not yet have reached the true third-stage level!"
Although there was an array setup in the cultivation room for enhancement, even so, the concentration of Spiritual Qi here was only slightly stronger than outside.
Not to say it’s ten thousand miles away from a real third-stage Spiritual Qi concentration, but it was definitely far from it.
"The Spirit Vein has indeed successfully upgraded, but the concentration of Spiritual Qi is dissatisfactory; the only reason might be this Second-stage Array holding it back!"
Xu Ping raised his head, his gaze seemingly penetrating the thick walls, directly landing on the array light screen enveloping the entire Thousand Leaves Mountain.
Evidently, the Second-stage Array is somewhat insufficient in the face of the upgraded Spirit Vein of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
To maximally gather and absorb the abundant Spiritual Qi of Thousand Leaves Mountain currently, the array level must at least be upgraded to the third stage.
"A Third-rank Array, hmm."
Xu Ping couldn’t help but mutter to himself.
With his array knowledge, setting up a Third-rank Array wasn’t an insurmountable task.
It’s just that he doesn’t have the materials for arranging a Third-rank Array on him, so he’ll need to purchase them.
"In a few days, I’ll go out to make the purchase!"
Xu Ping soon made up his mind.
Although the circumstances were tumultuous now, the benefits of setting up a Third-rank Array were too great.
Not only could it greatly enhance the safety of the location, but it could also further gather dense Spiritual Qi for cultivation.
More crucially, the Third-rank Array could cleverly conceal the substantial changes happening to the Spirit Vein of Thousand Leaves Mountain.
It’s not that he couldn’t upgrade the Spirit Vein, but the speed at which he upgraded it was too fast, likely drawing attention.
If he waits another twenty years or so, then publicly announces the successful upgrade of Thousand Leaves Mountain to a Quasi-Tier Three Spirit Vein, there shouldn’t be any issue.
...
...
A few days later.
Xu Ping departed from Thousand Leaves Mountain via his Escape Light.
At the same time, at Bright Moon Mountain.
Boom!
A deafening, earth-shattering roar suddenly erupted.
A mana fluctuation potent enough to kill a Middle Stage of Golden Core cultivator radiated from the explosion point, rippling outwards like surging waves.
At this moment, three figures in the energy center swiftly retreated hundreds of feet.
"Master Xuan Gu, do you really intend to become our enemy!"
At this moment, Wan Ming, engulfed in flames, stopped himself, eyes fixed on the black mist-covered Master Xuan Gu, with a chill in his voice.
"Heh!"
Master Xuan Gu’s lips curled into a taunting smile, his voice full of disdain, "Even if I become your enemy, what of it?"
